bible.translation: Maasai 2018 (BIBLIA SINYATI TE NKUTUK OO LMAASAI NATISIRAKI ENG'EJUK NAATA MBUKUI E DITROKANONI)

chapter.verse: Ore apa te nkiterunoto, neitaa Enkai keper o enkop.
Ore apa enkop nemeeta shoto, nemetii toki naa enaimin natii oriong o enguton. Ore Enkiyang'et e Nkai nelo tioriong inkariak.
Nejo Enkai; inchoo metijing'a ewang'an, nejing ewang'an.
Nedol Enkai ajo aisidai ewang'an. Nerishu Enkai ewang'an aitung'uaa enaimin.
Neipot Enkai ewang'an ajo endama, neipot enaimin ajo enkewarie. Neaku keetae enteipa o entadekenya enkolong e dukuya.
Nejo Enkai; “Inchoo metaa ketii oloing'ang'e erishata oo nkariak, naa inchoo metirisha inkariak o nkariak.”
Neitayu Enkai oloing'ang'e nerish inkariak natii abori oloing'ang'e o nkariak naatii shumata oloing'ang'e, neaku neijia.
Neipot Enkai oloing'ang'e ajo Keper. Neaku teipa neaku tadekenya enkolong e are.
Nejo Enkai: “Inchoo inkariak naatii abori e keper eiturrurrokino pooki nebo, naa inchoo enkop natoyio eibalayu.” Neaku neijia.
Neipot Enkai enkop natoyio ajo Enkop, ore inkariak naaiturrurro tenebo neipot ajo inaaiposha. Nedol Enkai ajo aisidai.
Nejo Enkai: “Inchoo enkop metoiu inkaitubulu, inkaitubulu naaiu ilanterera, neiu ilkeek loo lng'anayio ilanterera too mpukunot enye te nkop.” Neaku neijia.
Neiu enkop inkaitubulu enyena, o nkaitubulu naaiu ilanterera te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o lkeek ooiu ilng'anayio too lanterera lenye anaa empukunoto enye. Nedol Enkai ajo ai sidai.
Neaku keetae enteipa neetae entadekenya enkolong e uni.
Nejo Enkai “Inchoo metaa keetae ewang'an to loing'ang'e le keper peyie erishu endama te nkewarie, neaku sii ilooitodolu ilmonek too nkatitin oo nkolong'i o larin.
Inchoo sii metaa ketii ewang'an oloing'ang'e le keper peyie eisho ewang'an enkop.” Neaku neijia.
Neitayu Enkai ilkilang'ilang'eta aare sapuki, ore ina wang'an sapuk neitore endama, ore ewang'an kiti neitore enkewarie. Neitayu sii ilakir.
Nepik ninche oloing'ang'e le keper peyie eisho ewang'an enkop neitore endama o enkewarie.
Nerishu sii ewang'an tiatua enaimin, nedol Enkai ajo aisidai.
Neaku teipa neaku tadekenya enkolong e ong'uan.
Nejo Enkai, “Inchoo metijing'a inkariak ntokitin naaishu, inchoo sii imotonyi meshomo to loing'ang'e le keper aaing'at enkop.”

Metaa eitaa Enkai ing'uesi sapuki oo naaiposha o ntokitin naaishu pooki o naaiserpepiari naatii atua enaiposha too mpukunot enye, o pooki motonyi te risioroto e mpukunoto enye, nedol Enkai ajo aisidai.
Nemayian Enkai ninche ajo, “Entoisho niponariri aaiput inkariak oo naaiposha, naa nchoo sii imotonyi o loing'ang'e metubula te nkop.”
Neaku teipa neaku tadekenya, enkolong e imiet.
Nejo Enkai, “Inchoo enkop meitayu ing'uesi naaishu te risioroto oo mpukunot enye; inkishu o ng'uesi naaiserpepiari te nkop o ng'uesi e nkop te risioroto oo mpukunot enye.” Neaku neijia.
Neitayu Enkai ing'uesi e nkop te risioroto oo mpukunot enye o nkishu te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop te risioroto empukunoto enye. Nedol Enkai ajo aisidai.

Nejo Enkai; “Emaitobira tung'ani te nkitanyaanyukoto ang onyaanyukie iyiook, nikincho ninche meitoria isinkir le naiposha, o motonyi oloing'ang'e, o nkishu o enkop pooki o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop.”
Metaa eitayio Enkai oltung'ani te nkitanyaanyukoto enye makewan. Te nkitanyaanyukoto Enkai eitayio ninye ninche, olee o eng'oruoi.
Nemayian Enkai ninche, nejoki “Entoisho, entoponari, emputa enkop nintorere. Entoria sii isinkir le naiposha o motonyi o loing'ang'e, o pooki toki ake ninye naishu naiseuseu te nkop.”
Nejo Enkai; “Ng'ura ajo aaishoo iyie pooki aitubului naiu ilanterera natii oriong enkop, o pooki shani oata ilng'anayio ilanterera intaa endaa.
O pooki ng'ues e nkop o pooki motonyi o loing'ang'e o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop o pooki toki naata enkiyang'et e nkishui, aaishoo enkaitubului pooki nanyori peyie intaa endaa.” Neaku neijia.
Nedol Enkai pooki toki naitobirua ajo aisidai katukul. Neaku teipa neaku tadekenya enkolong e ile.
Metaa eidipaki keper o enkop o ntokitin pooki naatii.
Ore te nkolong e naapishana neidip Enkai ina siaai enye nataasa. Neyeng'iyeng'a te nkolong e naapishana te siaai enye pooki nataasa.
Metaa etamayiana Enkai enkolong e naapishana neitisiny, amu teina olong apa eyeng'iyeng'e ninye te siaai enye pooki nataasa e nkitobirare.
Kuna ninche iishoritin e keper o enkop ina kata pee eitobiri. Ore te nkolong apa naitobirua Olaitoriani Enkai enkop o keper,
eton meetae hoo ilkeek te nkop anaa inkaitubulu naabulu ti ong'ata eton eitu eisho Olaitoriani Enkai enkop menoto enchan, nemeetae sii apa oltung'ani otur enkop.
Kake enkinuku ake nadumunye te nkop aitashal oriong e nkop, pooki.
Neitoki Olaitoriani Enkai aitobiru oltung'ani te nterit e nkop. Nekutaki inkumeishin enyena entooma e nkishui, neaku oltung'ani oloata enkishui.
Neun Olaitoriani Enkai enkurma, te Eden te nkalo oloosaen. Nepik ilo tung'ani oitobira atua.
Neitubulu te nkop Olaitoriani Enkai ilkeek pooki oitiship inkonyek naa sidain sii te ndaa. Keuno sii apa olchani le nkishui te mpolos enkurma. Netii sii olchani le eng'eno oo supati o ntorrok.
Kerukunye sii apa olkeju oing'uaa Eden opik enkurma enkare. Neoro ilo keju teine aaku ilkejek oong'uan.
Ore enkarna olkeju le dukuya naa keji Pishon, naa ninye ilo oruko aman enkop pooki e Hafila, ine netii saabu.
Naa ore saabu eina kop aisidai. Ketii isoito oimerlel te sidano.
Ore olkeju li are naa Gihon; naa ninye oshi oman enkop pooki e Kush.
Ore olkeju liokuni naa Tigris, nerukokino enkalo oloosaen te Asiria. Ore olkeju liong'uan naa Frati.
Neya Olaitoriani Enkai ilo tung'ani apik ninye enkurma e Eden peyie etur neramat sii.
Neitanap Olaitoriani Enkai oltung'ani ajoki, “Ore pooki shani otii atua enkurma indim ainosa,
kake ore olchani le ng'eno oo supati o ntorrok minya ake, amu ore kenya enkolong ninya, meeta inchere pee miye.”
Nejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Meishiaakino neton olee aa ninye ake, ekaitaiki enkaretoni naishiakino ninye.”

Metaa neitayu Olaitoriani Enkai pooki ng'ues e ong'ata o motonyi pooki o loing'ang'e neyau ninche enetii oltung'ani, pee edol eneiko teneisho ninche inkarn, naa ore enkarna ake ninye naba anaa enaishoo pooki toki neaku ina.
Neisho ilo tung'ani inkarn inkishu pooki, o nena motonyi o loing'ang'e o pooki ng'ues e ong'ata; kake ore ilo tung'ani eitu etumi enkaretoni naishiaakino ninye.
Metaa etipika Olaitoriani Enkai injio naairoshi ilo tung'ani meirurayu. Ore eirura, neitayu olarasi obo lenye nenuk ine wueji too nkiri.
Ore ilo arasi oitayio Olaitoriani Enkai te ilo tung'ani neitaa enkitok, nerikoki ninye ilo tung'ani.
Nejo ilo tung'ani, “Kesipa ele taata oloito loo loik laainei, naa eoroti osesen lai. Ekeipoti ninye aajo enkitok amu eitayioki ninye tiatua olee.”
Ina paa keorore olee menye o ng'otonye, neibung'are enkitok enye neaku pokira are osesen obo.
Ore apa ilo olee o enkitok enye meeta apa entoki naishopito nemedol enkurruna.
Ore apa olasurai naa aing'en oleng alang ing'uesi pooki naaitobira Olaitoriani Enkai. Neikilikuan ninye enkitok ajoki, “Eji ketejo doi Enkai, ‘Eminya pooki ng'anayioi lo lchani otii ena kurma?’ ”
Nejoki enkitok olasurai, “Aikiindim iyiook aainosa ilng'anayio pooki loo lkeek le nkurma,
kake etejo Enkai, ‘Eminya ilo ng'anayioi leilo shani otii empolos e nkurma, nimishoroo hoo ninye aashu iyeye.’ ”
Kake etiaaka olasurai enkitok, “Miyeye ntae;
amu keyiolo Enkai ajo ore tininyanya ilo ng'anayioi nebolo inkonyek inyi, nitiuu anaa Enkai, niyiolouu isupati o ntorrok.”

Ore peyie edol enkitok ilo shani ajo aisidai te ndaa, naa olchani sii oitiship inkonyek, naa olchani sii ong'uarrayu oiteng'en oltung'ani, neitayu olng'anayioi lenye nenya, neisho sii olpayian lenye embata, nenya sii ninye.
Ore inkonyek e pokira nebolo, neyiolou ina kata aajo meishopo. Nerip mbenek o lng'aboli aitaa nkilani.
Nening ninche oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai eloito te nkurma eiropija enkolong. Ore olpayian o enkitok enye neisudori peyie medol Enkai tiatua ilkeek le nkurma.
Kake eipoto Olaitoriani Enkai ilo tung'ani nejoki ninye: “Kaji itii iyie?”
Neng'amaa ajoki, “Atoning'o oltoilo lino te nkurma, naureishoyu amu atoduaa ajo maishopo naipirri aisudori.”
Nejoki Enkai, “Aing'ae likitiaaka minchopo? Inosa olng'anayioi lo lchani laitanapa apa intae ajoki eminya?”
Nejo ilo tung'ani, “Ore ina kitok apa nikinchoo metaa tenebo nanu, ninye naaishoo olng'anayioi lo lchani, mainosa.”
Ina pee ejoki Olaitoriani Enkai enkitok, “Kaa bae ena nitaasa?” Nejo enkitok, “Olasurai laateleja nanya.”

Nejoki Olaitoriani Enkai olasurai, “Ore amu itaasa ena, kitediaaki iyie aaitulus too nkishu pooki o too ng'uesi pooki entim, keaku iserpepiari te nkop, naa enterit ninye endaa ino, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino.
Ekapik mang'atisho erishata ino o enkitok. Neijia sii etiu erishata e ishoi ino o eishoi enye. Ekepurd ninye elukunya ino, ore iyie niony entutunyo enye.”
Nejoki Enkai enkitok, “Kaaponiki nanu emion iisho, te mion sapuk iiu inkera. Ore iyieunot inono pooki keaku ino lpayian lino, neaku sii ninye likintore iyie.”

Nejoki ninye Adam, “Ore amu itoning'o ororei le nkitok ino, ninosa ilo ng'anayioi lo lchani laaitanapa ajoki ‘Minya,’ etediaaki enkop te nkaraki iyie, ekeaku enenkinyinyiret ake inya te nkishui ino pooki.
Kebulu ilkiku o ntulele te nkurma, neaku inya nena aitubulu oo nkurman.
Te nkinyinyiret inya endaa, ometaba anaa nirrinyokino enterit, amu teine apa kintobiruaki. Ira enterit naa enterit irrinyokino.”
Neisho ilo tung'ani enkitok enye enkarna ajo Hawa amu ninye ng'otonye oo looishu pooki.
Neitobiraki Olaitoriani Enkai Adam o enkitok enye nkilani oo ndapan, neishopoki ninche.

Nejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Ore amu etotiwuo oltung'ani anaa obo lang, etayiolo isidain o ntorrok; ore tena kata, keidim ninye aitorioki enkaina enye olchani le nkishui ainosa, neaku keishu ninye intarasi.”
Metaa eitayio Olaitoriani Enkai Adam te nkurma e Eden peyie epuo aatur enkop apa naitobirunyeki ninche.
Nearaa ninye ilo tung'ani. Ore te nkalo oloosaen le Eden, etipika ninye olmalaika o lalem oyupuyup oman pooki alo peyie errip enkoitoi o lchani le nkishui.
Neboitare Adam enkitok enye, neiroshiu neiu Kain. Nejo: “Anoto olee te retoto o Laitoriani.”
Neitoki aiu olalashe lenye Abel. Ore apa Abel naa olairritani loo ntare, ore Kain naa olaturoni le nkop.
Ore etulusoyie enkata, neyaki Kain Olaitoriani enkishooroto oo lng'anayio lenyena le nkop.
Neyau sii ninye Abel ilkikaunot loo ntare enyena naapir. Neng'amaa Olaitoriani Abel tenebo enkishooroto enye.
Kake eitu eng'amaa Kain tenebo o enkishooroto enye. Negoro Kain nesot enkomom oleng.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Kain, “Kainyoo peyie itagore naa kainyoo peyie isot enkomom?
Amaa tiniaas isupati aimitum omom? Naa teneitu ias isupati, kigira ing'ok aarresh te nkutuk enkaji, naa iyie eyieu neibung kake keishiaakino nimir ninche.”
Nejoki Kain olalashe lenye Abel, “Maape ong'ata.” Ore peyie ebaiki ong'ata nedumakino Kain olalashe lenye Abel aar metua.
Neikilikuan Olaitoriani Kain, “Koree olalashe lino Abel?” Nejo, “Mayiolo, ainanu oshi olairritani lo lalashe lai?”
Nejoki Olaitoriani, “Kaa bae ena nitaasa?” Kaagira oltoilo lo sarge lo lalashe lino aishiraki te nkop.
Ore taata iyie kitediaaki te nkop, ina natabolo enkutuk enye ang'amaa osarge lo lalashe lino te nkaina ino.
Tinitur enkop, nemeiu ninye ae toki. Iyaku olaisikani olimana te nkop.
Nejoki Kain Olaitoriani, “Aisapuk enkitamioto ai alang enaidimu.
Ng'urai amu kitaarayie nanu ena olong aitung'uaa enkop, nikintalam sii enkomom ino peyie madol, naaku ololo te nkop metaa ore oltung'ani laatum naar nanu matua.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Kain, “Mme neijia etiu, ore oltung'ani likiar iyie tua, neitamei ninye kat naapishana.” Nepik Olaitoriani olmishire Kain peyie ore oloinepu ninye nemear metua.
Neing'uaa Kain enkomom o Laitoriani, nelo amany enkop e Nod natii oloosaen te Eden.
Neboitare Kain enkitok enye, nenutayu neiu Enok, neshet enkanasa, neipot ina anasa ajo Enok anaa enkarna o layioni lenye.
Neikini Enok Irad, neiu Irad Mehujael, neiu Mehujael Metushael neiu Metushael Lamek.
Neyam Lamek inkituaak are. Ore enkarna e nabo naa keji Ada, neji enkarna enkae Sila.
Neiu Ada Yabal laa ninye apa menye le lelo ootoni too lng'oborri neramat sii inkishu.
Neji enkarna o lalashe lenye Yubal, laa ninye menye le lelo oosh ilwululi loo usin o ndulen.
Neiu Sila Tubalkain, laa ninye olkunoni oidong'u inkinantani too suyan, o sekenke. Neji enkanashe e Tubalkain Naama.
Nejoki Lamek inkituaak enyena, Ada o Sila, “Entoning oltoilo lai; intae nakituaak e Lamek enining'o enajo nanu: Ataara oltung'ani metua laatipika olbae, ilo barnoti laatoosho nanu”.
“Tenaa keitalaki Kain elap kat naapishana, kesipa ajo ore Lamek naa katitin ntomoni naapishana o naapishana eitalaki.”
Neboitare Adam enkitok enye aigil, neiu enkayioni neipot enkarna enye ajo Seti, amu etejo, “Aanyaaka Enkai apikaki nanu ae kerai najing ewueji e Abel amu etaara Kain ninye metua.”
Neitokini aaiki Seti olayioni, neipoti enkarna enye aajo Enosh. Ore ina kata neiterutua iltung'ana aaipot enkarna Olaitoriani.
Ore ena buku naa ene ishoi e Adam. Ore peyie eitayu Enkai oltung'ani, eitayio ninye te nkitanyaanyukoto enye makewan.
Eitayio ninye olee o nkitok nemayian ninche neipot ninche ajo, “tung'ani” peyie eidip eitobiru.
Ore peyie eeishu Adam ilarin iip nabo o tomoni uni, neaku ninye menye lo layioni laa ninye kewan enyaanyukie, neipot ninye ajo Seti.
Ore inkolong'i e Adam anaa peyie eaku menye le Seti naa ilarin iip isiet. Neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Adam naa ilarin iip naaudo o tomoni uni, neye ninye.
Eishua Seti ilarin iip nabo o imiet, neaku menye le Enosh.
Nebik seti anaa peyie eini Enosh ilarin iip isiet o naapishana, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Seti naa ilarin iip naaudo o tomon aare, neye ninye.
Ore peyie ebik Enosh ilarin intomoni naaudo, neaku menye le Kenan.
Nebik Enosh eidipaki aatoiu Kenan ilarin iip isiet o tomon o miet, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Enosh naa ilarin iip naaudo o imiet, neye ninye.
Ore peyie ebik Kenan ilarin intomoni naapishana, neaku menye le Mahalel,
nebik Kenan etoiwuoki Mahalel ilarin iip isiet o artam, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Neaku inkolong'i pooki e Kenan ilarin iip naaudo o tomon, neye ninye.
Ore peyie eeishu Mahalel ilarin ntomoni ile o miet, neaku menye le Yared.
Nebik Mahalel etoiwuoki Yared ilarin iip isiet o tomoni uni, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Mahalel naa ilarin iip isiet o ntomoni naaudo o miet, neye ninye.
Ore peyie eeishu Yared ilarin iip o ntomoni ile oaare, neaku menye Enok.
Nebik Yared etoiwuoki Enok ilarin iip isiet, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Yared naa ilarin iip naaudo o ntomoni ile oaare, neye ninye.
Ore peyie eeishu Enok ilarin ntomoni ile o imiet, neaku menye le Metusela.
Eiriamariyie Enok Enkai eidipaki aatoiu Metusela ilarin iip uni, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Metaa ore inkolong'i e Enok naa ilarin iip uni o ntomoni ile o imiet.
Nelo Enok tenebo Enkai, nelai ninye amu ewa Enkai ninye.
Ore peyie eeishu Metusela ilarin iip o ntomoni isiet o naapishana, neaku menye le Lamek.
Nebik Metusela etoiwuoki Lamek ilarin iip naapishana o ntomoni isiet oaare, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Metusela naa ilarin iip naaudo o ntomoni ile o naaudo neye ninye.
Ore peyie eishu Lamek ilarin iip o ntomoni isiet oaare, neiu olayioni,
neipot enkarna enye ajo Noa. Nejo: “Ore tiatua enkop natediaa Olaitoriani, ele ninye oyooki ayaki iyiook enkilejilej too siaaitin ang o too nyamalaritin oo nkaik ang.”
Nebik Lamek etoiwuoki Noa ilarin iip imiet o ntomoni naaudo o imiet, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Lamek naa ilarin iip naapishana o ntomoni naapishana o naapishana, neye ninye.
Ore etaa Noa oloo larin iip imiet, neaku menye le Shem o Ham o Shafet.
Ore peyie eiteru iltung'ana aaponari ti oriong enkop, netoikioki ninche intoyie,
nedol ilayiok le Nkai ilayiok le Nkai intoyie oo ltung'ana ajo aisidain, neyaki ate inkituaak anaa enagelu tenena, anaa enayieu.
Nejo Olaitoriani: “Meitoki enkiyang'et ai amany tung'ani ntarasi, amu ore ninye naa keye. Keaku inkolong'i enyena ilarin iip nabo o tikitam.”

Etii sii apa intiamasin sapuki enkop te nena olong'i, ore peyie epuonu ilayiok le Nkai aajing'aki aayiolou intoyie oo ltung'ana, neiki ninche inkera. Naa kulo apa iltung'ana magil liapa naa yiolot oleng.
Nedol Olaitoriani enkarruoisho e tung'ani ajo etaa sapuk te nkop oleng, naa ore emusunoto o endamunoto enye pooki e atua oltau naa entorroni ake eponaa.
Neinosu Olaitoriani ajo kainyoo pee eitobira oltung'ani te nkop, netum osina sapuk.

Nejo Olaitoriani: “Kajutu tioriong enkop oltung'ani laitobira, tung'ani tenebo o ng'uesi o pooki toki naiserpepiari o motonyi o loing'ang'e, amu aanyaaka ainosu ajo kainyoo apa peyie aitobirua ninche.”
Kake enoto Noa omom too nkonyek o Laitoriani.
Kuna ninche iishoritin e Noa. Ore apa Noa naa oltung'ani oitashe too sipat, nemeeta entioto to lporror lenye: eiriamariyie Noa Enkai.
Eeta sii apa Noa ilayiok okuni, Shem o Ham o Yafet.
Etarruoyie apa enkop oleng too nkonyek e Nkai, neiputa ninye o larrabal.
Nedol Enkai enkop ajo etarruoyie oleng. Amu ore iseseni pooki neitarruoitie inkoitoi enye te nkop.
Nejoki Enkai Noa, “Atumuta to ltau ajo kaiting'ie pooki sesen, amu eiputa enkop olarrabal te nkaraki ninche, idol ajo kaidakie nanu ninche o enkop”.
“Intaiki kewan esafina to lchani le gofer, nipik ilgilat atua esafina, nimur atua o oriong te nkoronko.
Naa inji ayieu ninkunu. Ore enkadori e safina naa intemat e nkaina iip uni, ore elalai naa intemat e nkaina onom, ore enkilepata eiteru te kop naa intemat e nkaina tomoni uni.
Ntushura sii esafina, ning'uaa erishata e ntemata nabo e nkaina, pee eyau ewang'an. Nipik sii kutuk aji enchoto e safina. Nipik atua iorot oo nkajijik e abori o nempolos, o neshumata.
Amu kayau oloirrag loo nkare shumata enkop, peyie eishu iseseni pooki ooata enkiyang'et e nkishui, tiabori keper, ore pooki toki natii enkop naa keye.
Kake kaitasheyie olning'o lo sotua lai o iyie naa aijing iyie esafina, iyie o layiok linono o enkitok ino o nkituaak oo layiok linono tenebo o iyie.
O pooki toki naishu naata osesen, iyau maare e pooki pukunoto atua esafina. Niramat ninche peyie meye; naa ore pooki naa oloing'oni ake o elipong.
Enoo motonyi te risioroto oo mpukunot enye enoo ng'uesi te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, enoo naaiserpepiari te risioroto e mpukunoto enye. Kejing maare anaa impukunot enye enitii, peyie iramat meye.
Ore sii, kayieu niya atua esafina indaiki oo mpukunot pooki tushuma. Naa keaku endaa ino o ninche.”
Neas Noa nena; etaasa nena pooki naaitanapa Enkai ninye.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Noa: “Tijing'a iyie o enkaji ino pooki atua esafina, amu atoduaa ajo ira oltung'ani oitashe too sipat te dukuya nanu tena ishoi.
Iwa ing'uesi naapishana maare nemeeta intiot, oloing'oni ake o elipong. Iwa sii ing'uesi naapishana maare naata intiot, oloing'oni ake o elipong.
Niya sii imotonyi o loing'ang'e maare naapishana, oloing'oni ake o elipong peyie eitubulaa impukunot enye tioriong enkop.
Amu ore teneishunye inkolong'i naapishana, kairriu enchan shumata enkop too nkolong'i artam kewarie o dama. Metaa ore pooki toki naitobira, kajutu tioriong enkop.”
Neas Noa nena pooki naitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.
Ore apa Noa ina kata naa oloo larin iip ile te moruao, peyie elotu oloirrag le nkare shumata enkop.
Neaku ore Noa tenebo o layiok lenyena o enkitok enye o nkituaak oo layiok lenyena tenebo ninye, nejing esafina aailany oloirrag le nkare.
Ore ing'uesi pooki nemeeta ntiyot o ng'uesi pooki naata ntiyot o motonyi o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop,
maare maare, aa oloing'oni ake o elipong, etijing'a atua esafina tenebo Noa anaa enaitanapa Enkai Noa.
Ore peyie eishunye inkolong'i naapishana, neiput oloirrag sapuk le nkare shumata enkop.
Ore to lari le iip ile le nkishui e Noa, to lapa le are enkolong e tomon o naapishana o lapa, nedanya inkonyek oo nkariak naagut aaruko, nebolo sii ilusien e keper.
Neshaiki enchan enchumata e nkop indamaritin artam o nkewarietin artam.
Teina olong ake etijing'a Noa o Shem o Ham o Yafet ilayiok le Noa, o enkitok e Noa o nkituaak uni oo layiok lenyena atua esafina.

Ninche o pooki ng'ues te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o nkishu pooki te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o motonyi pooki te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o pooki motonyi e pooki pukunoto.
Nejing pooki atua esafina tenebo Noa, maare maare o seseni pooki ooata enkishui.
Ore nena naatijing'a, oloing'oni o elipong e pooki toki naata osesen, nejing atua, anaa enaitanapa Enkai Noa. Neikenoo Olaitoriani Noa tiatua.
Nebik oloirrag le nkare tioriong enkop inkolong'i artam, neponari enkare o metudumu esafina aing'atie enkop ailepie.
Neponari enkare oleng neiput enkop, neporoo esafina shumata enkare.
Neponari enkare oleng te nkop, ometaa ore ildonyio pooki adoru ootii abori keper neimisieki.
Neitemoo enkare ildonyio pooki metaa eng'uton intemat e nkaina tomon o imiet.
Neye pooki toki naata osesen naloolo te shumata e te nkop. Imotonyi o nkishu o ng'uesi o pooki toki naishu te nkop o pooki tung'ani,
o pooki toki natii enkop natoyio naata enkiyang'et e enkishui, neye pooki.

Nejutuni pooki toki naishu natii oriong enkop, aa tung'ani o ng'uesi o pooki toki naiserpepiari o motonyi o loing'ang'e, etujutuo Enkai pooki te nkop. Noa ake etung'uayioki tenebo o looboitare tiatua esafina.
Nebik inkariak tioriong enkop inkolong'i iip o onom.
Kake etadamua Enkai Noa o ng'uesi pooki, o nkishu pooki naaboitare ninye te safina. Neisho Enkai osiwuo meima shumata enkop, neng'oroo enkare,
neiken sii inkonyek oo nkariak e nguton o lusien e keper. Neguarr enchan e keper.
Neiteru enkare te nkop ang'oru. Ore te nkiting'oto enkolong e iip o onom, neiteru enkare ang'oroo te nkop.
Ore to lapa liopishana, te nkolong e tomon o naapishana o lapa, nedou esafina airrag te nchumata o ldoinyo le Ararat.
Neng'oru inkariak o metabaiki olapa le tomon. Ore peyie ebau enkiting'oto o lapa le tomon, te nkolong e dukuya olapa, nelioyu inchumat oo ldoinyo.
Ore peyie eishunye inkolong'i artam, nebol Noa elusie eina safina naitobirua apa.
Neirriwaa Noa olkurruk, neloolo to loing'ang'e ometoito inkariak te nkop.
Neitoki airriwaa enturkuluo meing'urai tenaa keishunye inkariak ti oriong enkop.
Kake eitu etum eneroro, nerrinyokino ninye atua esafina, amu eton etii inkariak oriong enkop pooki. Neitorioo Noa enkaina enye aibung ninye neyau ninye atua esafina ine netii.
Neitoki aanyu kulie olong'i naapishana, neitoki aigil airriwaa enturkuluo aitupuku te safina.
Nerrinyunye enturkuluo teipa eeta embeneyioi nashal te nkutuk enye naitayio to lchani lo loirien. Neyiolou ina kata Noa ajo eishunye enkare te nkop.
Neitoki Noa aanyu kulie olong'i naapishana, neirriwaa enturkuluo kake eitu eigil arrinyokino ninye.
Ore to lari le iip ile o obo, to lapa le dukuya enkolong e dukuya o lapa, eishunye inkariak tioriong enkop, neiwuang'ie Noa enkikenet e Safina, nedol ajo etoyio oriong enkop.
Ore to lapa li are te nkolong e tikitam o naapishana o lapa, netoyio apa enkop.
Neirorie Enkai Noa ajoki,
“Tupuku te safina, iyie o enkitok ino o layiok linono o nkituaak oo layiok linono, mpang'a shomo,
toshoru tenebo iyie pooki toki naishu natii tenebo iyie e pooki sesen, imotonyi o ng'uesi o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop, peyie etum aatoisho aatubul aaiputa enkop.”
Neipang Noa alo o layiok lenyena, o enkitok enye o nkituaak oo layiok lenyena.
Ore pooki ng'ues o pooki toki naiserpepiari o pooki motonyi o pooki toki nalo tioriong enkop nepuku pooki anaa impukunot enye aaing'uaa esafina nepuo.
Ina peyie eshetaki Noa Olaitoriani ewueji olasar, neya pooki ng'ues nemeeta entioto, o pooki motonyi, nemeeta entioto, neitaki Enkai olasar opejori te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

Ore peyie eing'uaya Olaitoriani esong'ouna narropil, nejo Olaitoriani to ltau lenye; “Maitoki aikata adek enkop te nkaraki oltung'ani, amu ore endamunoto oltau lo ltung'ani eiteru te keraisho naa intorrok, nemaitoki aekata aidakie pooki toki naishu anaa enataasa.
Ore eton eetae enkop, meishunye aekata enkata eunore o enkata enkikesare oo ndaiki o enkirobi o enkirowuaj o ladalu o loirujuruj o endama o enkewarie.”
Nemayian Enkai Noa o layiok lenyena, nejoki ninche: “Entoisho entubul entoponari, emputa enkop.
Keureyu intae pooki ng'ues natii enkop o pooki motonyi o loing'ang'e o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop, o pooki sinkirri le naiposha, keaku inkaik inyi etii.
Ore pooki toki naishu nalo keaku endaa te intae, ore anaa enaishoo intae inkaitubulu naanyori, aishoo intae pooki toki.
Minyanya ake inkiri naata enkishui enye, aa inchere osarge lenye.
Amu ore osarge le nkishui naa kaitalaku, kaitalaku nanu te pooki ng'ues o te tung'ani, ore pooki ng'ae oar metua likae tung'ani naitalaku te nkishui enye.
Ore oloba anaa oloibukoo osarge lo ltung'ani, naa oltung'ani oibukoo osarge lenye, amu eitayio Enkai oltung'ani te nkitanyaanyukoto enye makewan.
Ore intae, entubul entoponari entaa kumok emputa enkop.”
Nejoki Enkai Noa o te nebo ilayiok lenyena ooboitare:
“Ing'ura ajo, kaitasheyie osotua lo lning'o o iyie o tenebo o ishoritin nikisuju,
o pooki toki naishu nikiboitare o imotonyi o inkishu o pooki ng'ues enkop nikiboitare o pooki ake ninye natupukuo tiatua esafina.
Naa kaitasheyie osotua lai o ntae, aa inchere maitoki aekata amut iseseni pooki to loirrag le nkare, nemeitoki aekata enkop amuta te nkare.”
Nejo Enkai: “Ele ninye olmonekie lo sotua lo lning'o laitayu te rishata ai o ntae, o pooki toki naishu natii tenebo intae o too lporori oosuju.
Atipika olokirrai lai atua enkatampoi naa keaku olmonekie lo sotua lai o enkop.
Tenayau inkatampo te shumata enkop, nedoli olokirrai too nkatampo,
Naa kadamu nanu osotua lo lning'o lai otii erishata ai o intae, o pooki toki naishu e pooki sesen, nemeitoki aekata nkariak aaku oloirrag sapuk omut iseseni pooki.
Ore etii olokirrai atua inkatampo, naa kaing'or ninye nadamu osotua lai lo lning'o ntarasi otii erishata Enkai o pooki toki naishu natii oriong enkop.”
Nejoki Enkai Noa: “Ele ninye olmonekie lo sotua laitasheyie te rishata ai o pooki sesen otii oriong enkop.”
Metaa ore ilayiok le Noa ootupukutuo te safina naa Shem o Ham o Yafet. Naa Ham apa menye le Kanaan.
Ore kulo pokira okuni naa ilayiok le Noa, naa ninche ooiputa enkop pooki.
Noa apa olaturoni le dukuya le nkop, etuuno ninye enkurma oo sabibu.
Neok Noa enaisho oo sabibu nemera oleng neirrag to lng'obor lenye meishopo.
Nedol Ham laa ninye menye le Kanaan emasipaisho e menye. Neliki ilalashera lenyena aare te boo.
Ina peyie eyau Shem o Yafet olkila eiteleikino iloilila lenye, nepuo te siadi, neitoip emasipaisho e Papaai lenye; ore inkomomi enye neing'orie dikae, neitu ninche edol emasipaisho e papaai lenye.
Ore peyie einyototo Noa te merai e naisho, neyiolou enaitaasa olayioni lenye oti ninye,
nejo ninye, “Metedeki Kanaan, keaku ninye orrindik loo rrindiki too ilalashera lenyena.”
Nejo ake sii: “Metamayiana Olaitoriani Enkai ai Shem, naa inchoo Kanaan metaa orrindik lenye.
Meitubula Enkai Yafet naa inchoo metotona to lng'obor le Shem, neaku Kanaan osinka lenye.”
Ore peyie eishunye oloirrag le nkare, neitoki Noa abik ilarin iip uni o onom.
Ore inkolong'i pooki e Noa naa ilarin iip naaudo o onom neye ninye.
Kuna iishoritin oo layiok le Noa, Shem, o Ham o Yafet. Netoikioki ninche ilayiok te siadi o loirrag le nkare.
Ore ilayiok le Yafet naa kulo: Gomer o Madai, Yafan, Tubal, Mishek o Tiras.
Ore ilayiok le Gomer naa Askenas o Rifat o Togarma.
Ore ilayiok le Yafan naa Elisha o Tarshishi o Kitim o Dodaim.
Te kulo etegelari iltung'ana loo lkirinen le naiposha aaidapashari. Ore kulo naa ilayiok le Yafet too nkuapi enye, oltung'ani ake o enkutuk enye, too lmareita lenye tiatua iloshon lenye.
Ore ilayiok le Ham naa Kush o Misiri o Puti o Kanaan.
Ore ilayiok le Kush naa Seba, o Hafila o Sabta o Raama o Sabteka. Ore ilayiok le Raama naa Sheba o Dedan.
Neiu Kush Nimrod laa ninye apa otang'asa aaku oltung'ani magilani te nkop.
Ore apa Nimrod naa olang'oroni loo ng'uesi magilani te dukuya Olaitoriani. Ore te nkaraki ina etejoki, “Olotiu anaa Nimrod olang'oroni llo ng'uesi magilani te dukuya Olaitoriani.”
Ore enkiterunoto e nkitoria enye naa Babel o Erek o Akad o netii pooki ootii enkop e Shinar.
Nepuku teinakop alo Asiria neshet Ninawi o Rehobosuira o Kala;
o Rasen te rishata e Ninawi o Kala, aa ninye enkanasa kitok.
Neaku Misiri menye le Ludi o Anami o Lehabi, o Naftuhi
o Patrusi o Kasluhi, (laa ninye eing'uaa Ilfilisti) o Kafitori.
Neaku Kanaan menye le Sidon ilo kikau lenye o Het
o Lyebusi o Lamori, o Lgirgashi,
o Lhifi o Larki o Lsini,
o Larfadi o Lsemari o Lhamat. Ore te siadi neidapashakino ilmareita le Kanaan inkuapi.
Ore olpolosie le Kanaan nedumunye te Sidon te nkalo e Gerar, ometabaiki Gasa, te nkalo e Sodom o Gomorra o Adma o Siboiim ometabaiki Lasha.
Kulo ninche ilayiok loo loshon lenye.
Naa Shem sii menye loo nkera pooki e Eber, olalashe botor le Yafet, etoikioki sii ninye inkera.
Ore ilayiok le Shem naa Elam o Ashur, o Arpakashad o Lud o Aram.
Ore ilayiok le Aram naa Usi o Hul o Geter o Mash.
Neaku Arpakashad menye le Shela, neaku Shela menye le Eber.
Neikini Eber ilayiok oaare, nejo obo enkarna Peleg, amu too nkolong'i enyena etoore enkop. Neji olalashe lenye Yokitan.
Neaku Yokitan menye Almodad o Shelaf o Hasarmafet o Yara o
Hadoran o Usal o Dikla
o Obal o Abimael o Sheba
o Ofir o Hafila o Yobab; ore lelo pooki naa ilayiok le Yokitan.
Ore emanyisho enye nepuku aing'uaa Mesha te nkalo e Sefar o metabaiki enkop oo ldoinyio te nkilepunoto enkolong.
Kulo ilayiok le Shem to lmarei lenye o too nkutukie enye o too nkuapi enye o too loshon lenye.
Kulo ninche ilmareita loo layiok le Noa, te risioroto oo ishoritin enye, too loshon lenye. Naa te kulo eidapashakinote iloshon oriong enkop eidipa atulusoi oloirrag le nkare.
Ore apa enkop pooki naa enkutuk nabo eeta o rorei obo.
Neaku ore peyie eidurru iltung'ana aaing'uaa oloosaen netum enkop naisiasha te nkop e Shinar, neitaa ine emanyisho enye.
Nejokino ninche maate, “Wootu emaitayu Ilmatofali le sarng'ab nikipej te nkima oleng.” Neshetishore ilmatofali te rishata oo soito o lami te rishata osinyai oshula o enturoto.
Ina pee ejo: “Wootu emateshetaki ate enkanasa naata oltalet olo abaiki keper, nikintaiki ate enkarna peyie mikindapashakino ineelakua ti oriong enkop pooki.”
Nedou Olaitoriani aing'or ina anasa o ilo talet otesheta inkera oo ltung'ana.
Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura ajo olorere obo ninche, neiro pooki enkutuk nabo, naa ena enkiterunoto oo siaaitin naas. Naa ore pooki nayieu neas metii engoloto te ninche.
Wootu, emaape aadoyio aitarruoo enkutuk enye, peyie meitoki aaning'uno maate te nkiroroto.”
Metaa eidapashaka Olaitoriani ninche oriong enkop pooki teine, nepal enchetata e nkanasa.
Te nkaraki eina peyie etejoki enkarna enye Babel, amu teine apa etomilo Olaitoriani enkutuk e nkop pooki, naa teine eidapashaka Olaitoriani ninche oriong enkop pooki.
Kulo ile ishoi e Shem. Ore peyie eaku Shem oloo larin iip nabo, netaa ninye menye le Arpakashad ilarin aare anaa neishunye oloirrag le nkare.
Enyaaka Shem abik ilarin iip imiet eidipaki aatoiu Arpakashad, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Ore peyie eeishu Arpakashad ilarin tomoni uni o miet, neaku menye le Shela.
Enyaaka Arpakashad abik ilarin iip ong'uan o okuni eidipaki aatoiu Shela, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Ore peyie eishu Shela ilarin tomoni uni, etaa ninye menye le Eber.
Enyaaka Shela abik ilarin iip ong'uan o okuni eidipaki aatoiu Eber, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Ore peyie eeishu Eber ilarin tomoni uni oong'uan, netaa ninye menye le Peleg.
Enyaaka Eber abik ilarin iip ong'uan o tomoni uni eidipaki aatoiu Peleg, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Ore peyie eeishu Peleg ilarin tomoni uni, etaa ninye menye le Reu.
Enyaaka Peleg abik ilarin iip are o naaudo eidipaki aatoiu Reu, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Ore peyie eeishu Reu ilarin tomoni uni o aare, etaa ninye menye le Serug.
Enyaaka Reu abik ilarin iip are o opishana eidipaki aatoiu Serug, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Ore peyie eeishu Serug ilarin tomoni uni, etaa menye le Nahor.
Enyaaka Serug abik ilarin iip are eidipaki aatoiu Nahor, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Ore peyie eishu Nahor ilarin tikitam ooudo, etaa ninye menye le Terah.
Enyaaka Nahor abik ilarin iip o tomon o ooudo eidipaki aatoiu Terah, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.
Ore peyie eishu Tera ilarin ntomoni naapishana etaa ninye menye le Abram, o Nahor o Haran.
Naa kulo ile ishoi e Tera. Ore apa Tera naa menye le Abram o Nahor o Haran. Ore apa Haran naa menye le Lot.
Nesiooyo Haran aye te dukuya Papaai lenye Tera teinakop natoinyeki ninye e Uri oo Ilkaldayo.
Neyam Abram Sarai, neyam Nahor Milka, entito e Haran aa menye Milka o Iska.
Ore apa Sarai naa koolupi amu meeta apa enkerai.

Nerik Tera Abram olayioni lenye, o Lot olayioni le Haran olayioni lo layioni lenye, o Sarai, enkitok olayioni lenye Abram, nepuku aaing'uaa pooki Uri oo Lkaldayo aapuo enkop e Kanaan. Ore peyie ebau Haran, neitaa ine emanyisho.
Ore inkolong'i e Tera naa ilarin iip are o miet neye ninye te Haran.
“Nejoki Olaitoriani Abram, ‘Tupuku shomo tung'uai enkop ino o ltung'ana linono le sotua, o enkaji e papaai lino, shomo enkop naautaki.
Naa kaaitainye iyie olosho sapuk, naa kaamayian iyie, naitaa enkarna ino kitok metaa iaku emayianata.
Ekamayian lelo likimayian, ore ilo likidek naa kadek. Te iyie emayiani ilmarei pooki le nkop.’ ”
Neaku eshomo apa Abram anaa enatiaaka Olaitoriani ninye, neiriamariyie Lot ninye, eshomo Abram aing'uaa Haran aa oloo larin ntomoni naapishana o imiet.
Nerik Abram enkitok enye Sarai, o Lot olayioni lo lalashe lenye, o masaa pooki enye naatasotutuo, o ltung'ana oonoto te Haran, nepuku aapuo enkop e Kanaan. Ore peyie ebau enkop e Kanaan,
nedung Abram atua enkop o meshomo ewueji e Shekem o metabaiki enetii oji olchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli te More. Ore ina rishata naa Lkanaan oomanya ina kop.
Neipang'aki Olaitoriani Abram nejoki, “Ekaisho eishoi ino ena kop.” Metaa eteshetaka Abram Enkai teine olperere lo lasar, ilo Aitoriani oipang'aka ninye.

Neidur teine nelo oldoinyo le nkalo oloosaen te Betel, neun olng'obor lenye. Etii Betel enkalo e Moikuape, netii Ai oloosaen. Neshetaki Abram teine olaitoriani olperere lo lasar neipot ninye enkarna o Laitoriani.
Neitoki Abram aidur teine neito alo enkalo e Negeb.
Netijing'a apa enkop e Kanaan olameyu oleng. Nedou Abram alotu enkop e Misiri, aparan, amu etagolo olameyu asapuku te nkop.
Ore pee eaku kebau Misiri, nejoki Sarai enkitok enye, “Kayiolo ajo aira enkitok sidai te neing'ori,
naa tinikidol Ilmisiri, naa kejo, enkitok ele tung'ani ena. Naa kaar nanu matua nikipal iyie inchu.
Tejo ira enkanashe ai peyie atum eseriani te nkaraki iyie, netum enkishui ai atumunyana te iyie.”
Ore peyie ejing Abram Misiri, nedol Ilmisiri aajo aisidai ina kitok oleng.
Nedol ilkituaak le Farao Sarai, neisisaki Farao, neriki ninye enkaji e Farao.
Ore te nkaraki Sarai, eitaasaki Abram isupati, neishori intare o lmong'i o nkishu o sirkon o laisiaayiak, o nkaisiaayiak o sirkon lipong'a o ntamesin.
Kake eitamio Olaitoriani Farao o enkaji enye to lmeitai kitok te nkaraki Sarai enkitok e Abram.
Neipot Farao Abram nejoki, “Kainyoo ena nikintaasa nanu? Kainyoo peyie eitu kiliki ajoki enkitok ino Sarai?
Kainyoo iyie pee itejo, enkanashe ino ninye,” metaa aawa ninye ayam aitaa enkitok ai? Ore naa iyie, nena enkitok ino toriko enchom.
Neishoru Farao inkitanapat aisho iltung'ana te nkaraki Abram; neisho ninye meshomo, tenebo o enkitok enye, o pooki toki naata.
Metaa eilepa Abram alo aing'uaa Misiri, ninye o enkitok enye, o pooki toki naata, tenebo Lot aapuo enkop e Negeb.
Naa karsis oleng Abram too nkishu o te nkosholai, o te saabu.
Neidur ninye aing'uaa Negeb ometabaiki Betel ewueji apa netii olng'obor lenye te nkiterunoto aa erishata e Betel o Ai.
Ewueji apa netang'asa aitobirie olperere lo lasar. Neipot Abram teine enkarna o Laitoriani.
Ore sii ninye Lot oiriamunore Abram eboitare ninye, neeta sii ninye inkishu, o ntare, o lng'oborri,
metaa meishaa enkop pokira aare te nemanya, amu aikumok imasaa e pokira.
Nejing enchankar ilchekuti loo nkishu e Abram o lchekuti loo nkishu e Lot. Ore apa ina kata, eton emanya Ilkanaan o Lperisi enkop.
Nejoki Abram Lot, “Meishiaakino sii ake nejing erishata ang enchankar anaa ejing erishata oo lchekuti linono o lchekuti laainei amu aikira emudong nabo.
Aimetii enkop pooki dukuya iyie? Toorori te nanu. Teniito iyie enkaina e kedianye, naito ene tatene naa tiniito iyie ene tatene, naito nanu ene kedianye.”

Neraposhu Lot inkonyek enyena, nedol ajo ore oyerata le Yordan keeta inkariak te pooki wueji, anaa enkurma o Laitoriani, anaa enkop e Misiri te nkalo e Soar, ina kata eton eitu eidaikie Olaitoriani Sodom o Gomorra.
Metaa negelaki Lot kewan oyerata pooki le Yordan, nelo ninye oloosaen. Neoro o Abram teine.
Nemany Abram enkop e Kanaan, nemany Lot inkanas oyarata, neidurrie olng'obor lenye ometabaiki Sodom.
Ore apa iltung'ana le Sodom naa kaarruok, naa ilaing'okok oleng te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Abram, eidipa atoorori Lot aing'uaa ninye, “Taraposhu inkonyek inono ing'ura aiteru teine nitii, moikuap, o kopikop o loosaen o oloo ntoluo.
Ore ina kop pooki nidolita, naa kaaisho iyie tenebo o eishoi ino ntarasi.
Kaitaba eishoi ino anaa enterit e nkop; metaa te neidimayu meikeni enterit enkop, neidimayu sii meikeni eishoi ino.
Tudumunye, shomo tudung'o eneba enkadori o endapasho enkop, amu aaishoo iyie.”
Neaku eidurrie Abram olng'obor lenye nelotu abik too lkeek oonyaanyukie ilng'abolo le Mamre otii Hebron. Ore teine Neshetaki Abram Olaitoriani olperere lo lasar.
Ore too nkolong'i e Amrefel olaiguanani le Shina, Ariok olaiguanani le Elisar, Kedorloamer olaiguanani le Elam o Tidal olaiguanani le Gooim,

neipiru kulo aiguanak olarrabal aarare Bera olaiguanani le Sodom, o Birsha olaiguanani le Gomora, o Shinab olaiguanani le Adma. O Shemeber olaiguanani le Sibooiim, olaiguanani le Bela (aa ninye Soar.)
Neitushulu kulo pooki enjore aitaa nabo to erata le Siddim (aa taa enaiposha e munyan).
Neisiaai Kederlaomer ilarin tomon aare, ore to lari le tomon oo kuni negolong'u ninche.
Ore to lari le tomon oong'uan nelotu Kederlaomer, o laiguanak otii tenebo ninye aar Ilrefai te Ashterot-Karnaim, o Susim te Ham, o Emin te Sharekiriatiam
o Lhori to ldoinyo lenye le Seir, ometabaiki Elparan olpolosie liong'ota.
Neshukunye aapuo En-mishapat (aa ninye Kadesh) near enkop pooki oo Lmaleki, near sii Ilamori lelo oomanya Hasason tamar.
Ore olaiguanani le Sodom o laiguanani le Adma o Seboiim o Bela (aa ninye Soar), neipang aapuo aajing olarrabal to erata le sidim
aashetaki tenebo Kederlaomer olaiguanani le Elam, olaiguanani Tidal le Gooim, o Amrefel olaiguanani le Shinar o Ariok olaiguanani le Elisar. Ilaiguanak oong'uan egilunore ilaiguanak imiet.
Nebore oerata le Siddim ingumot naatuturunyeki laam. Ore eilanyisho ilaiguanak le Sodom o Gomora, etusulakinote kulikae nena gumot, ore olkulikae nesaru oldoinyo.
Metaa ewaita ilmang'ati imasaa e Sodom o Gomorra o ndaiki enye pooki nepuo.
Ewaita sii ninye Lot, olayioni lo lalashe le Abram omanya Sodom tenebo o masaa enyena nepuo.
Ore obo oilanyishe, nelotu ainosaki Abram Olheburaniai omanya ina kata embata oo lkeek oonyaanyukie ilng'abolo te Mamre oo Lamori, olalashe le Eshkol o Aner, laa ilootoning'ore ninche Abram.

Ore peyie ening Abram inchere ewaki oltung'ani le mudong enye eyararoto, nerik iltung'ana ooyiolo olarrabal laa iinot le nkaji enye, iltung'ana oora esiana iip uni o tomon o isiet, nelo asujaa ninche ometabaiki Dan.

Neor ninye iltimito lenyena agilunore ninche kewarie. Etii sii ninye o ilaisiaayiak lenyena olarrabal, metaa ore ninye tenebo ilaisiaayiak lenyena, etudumutua ninche lelo mang'ati nemiraa ometabaiki Hoba natii moikuape e Dameski.
Nerrinyu ninye imasaa pooki naawaki tenebo sii oltung'ani lenye le mudong Lot o masaa enyena o nkituaak o ltung'ana.
Ore peyie eidip Abram atushukunye eisulie olarrabal le Kedorloamer tenebo ilaiguanak ooboitare, nepuku olaiguanani le Sodom alo anang'are to erata le Shafe, (aa ninye oerata lo laiguanani.)
Neyau Melkisedek, olaiguanani le Salem emukate o enaisho oo sabibu: ore apa ninye naa olapolosani le Nkai natii shumata aisul.
Nemayian ninye ejo; “Metamayiana Enkai natii shumata aisul Abram, ilo oitobira keper o enkop.
Metamayiana Enkai natii shumata aisul, ilo otipika ilmang'ati linono inkaik inono.” Neisho Abram Melkisedek ematua e tomon e pooki toki.
Nejoki olaiguanani le Sodom Abram, “Inchooki olorere ake, ore imasaa niya aitaa ininono.”
Kake etiaaka Abram olaiguanani le Sodom, “Ainosa olmumai to Laitoriani Enkai natii shumata aisul, oitobira keper o enkop,
inchere maya hoo pito ebaiki enkeene enamuke, anaa toki ino pooki, peyie mijo ake aitaa nanu Abram karsis.
Meeta toki naya nanu meteleku entoki nainosa ilbarnot laainei o ematua oo ltung'ana laaturubare, aa Aner o Eshkol o Mamre neya sii ninche erubata enye.”
Ore te siadi e kuna baa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Abram te nduaata ejo, “Miureishoyu Abram, kara nanu elong'o ino, kesapuku oleng enkishooroto nikinchori iyie.”
Kake newaliki Abram, “Olaitoriani Enkai, kainyoo doi kincho, kadolita ajo keloito enkishon dukuya maata enkerai, ore olajung'oni le nkaji ai naa Elieser le Dameski?”
Neitoki ake Abram ajo, “Kesipa eitu kincho nanu eishoi, ore osinka otoiwuoki te nkaji ai ninye oyooki aaku olajung'oni lai.”
Ng'ura, neirorie Olaitoriani ninye ajoki, “Ore ele tung'ani meaku olajung'oni lino, olayioni loo nkiri inono ninye likijung.”
Neipang'unye ninye boo nejoki, “Ng'ura sii iyie keper, ninken ilakir tenaa aindim atipika esiana.” Neitoki ake ajoki, “Metaa neijia ebayu eishoi ino.”
Neiruk Abram Olaitoriani, neikenakini ninye aajo oloitashe too sipat.
Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Kara Olaitoriani likintayio te Uri oo lkadayo peyie aaisho iyie ena kop intaa enino.”
Kake etejo Abram, “Oi Olaitoriani Enkai, kaji aiko tenayiolou ajo keaku enaai?”
Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Iyakaki entawuo oo larin okuni o enkine oo larin okuni o lmeregesh loo larin okuni o enturkuluo o emotonyi kinyi.”
Neyaki Abram Enkai kuna tokitin pooki nesash ninche maare neiteleiki enkiperrati nabo aishiaakinye enkae; kake eitu edung nena motonyi asash.
Ore pee edoiki ilkurragoso nena popoki, neiture Abram aitalamaa.
Ore etaa kedoyio enkolong, netir injio naairoshi Abram; nejing oloputukunyi kitok le naimin kitok shumata ninye.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Abram, “Tayiolo miata olng'ash ajo keaku eishoi ino ilomon te nkop neme enenye, neaku sii irrindiki teine, naa keibookini enkop too larin iip ong'uan;
kake kayau endung'okinoto enkiguana olosho oisiaaita, ore te siadi, nepuku ninche teinakop etudupote.
Ore iyie, ilo enetii iloo papaai lino to sotua nikinukari itaa olpayian kitok oiputakinote ilarin.
Naa keshukunye eishoi ino ene te ishoi e ong'uan, amu eton eitu elulung'ayu ing'ok oo Lamori.”
Ore peyie edoyio enkolong etomisimiso enkop neliooyu emoti napuru o lang'at le nkima elo te rishata e nena sashat.
Ore teina olong, neitobir Olaitoriani osotua o Abram nejoki, “Ore iishoritin inono ekaisho ena kop, eiteru to lkeju le Misiri o metabaiki olkeju sapuk ilo keju le Frati.
Enkop oo Lkanaan o Lkeniti o Lkenisi o Lkadmoni
o Lhiti o Lperisi o lrafai
o Lamori o Lkanaani o Lgirgashi o Lyebusi.”
Ore Sarai enkitok e Abram eitu eiki Abram inkera. Neeta apa enkaisiaayiani e Misiri naji enkarna enye Hagar.
Nejoki Sarai Abram, “Ng'ura sii ake, aaikeno Olaitoriani enguset pee maisho, shomo taboitare enkaisiaayiani ai, amu ebaiki natum inkera te ninye.” Neiruk Abram oltoilo le Sarai.
Metaa ore eishua Abram ilarin tomon te nkop e Kanaan, ore Sarai enkitok e Abram, neya Hagar ina aisiaayiani enye oo Lmisiri, neisho Abram olpayian lenye meitaa enkitok enye.
Neboitare Abram Hagar, neiroshiu. Ore peyie edol enkaisiaayiani ajo eiroshiwuo, nemenu Sarai.

Nejoki Sarai Abram, “Inchoo ntorrok naaitaasitae meetu shumata iyie. Aaishoo iyie enkaisiaayiani ai ntamuata nkaik ore peyie edol ajo eiroshiwuo naamenu nanu. Inchoo Olaitoriani eiguanare erishata ai o enino!”
Kake etiaaka Abram Sarai, “Ng'ura, etii enkaisiaayiani ino inkaik inono, intaasa anaa enidol eishiaakino te iyie.” Neisomit Sarai Hagar aisilisil o meisikie aitung'uaa kewan.
Neinepu olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye te mbata enchorro enkare ti ong'ata. Etii ina shorro e nkoitoi nalo Shur.
Nejoki ninye, “Hagar enkaisiaayiani e Sarai, kaji iyie ing'uaa naa kaji iloito?” Nejo Hagar, “Kaisikita ailany ina naaitore ai naji Sarai.”
Nejoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye, “Torrinyokinoyu Sarai nilo ayanyit ninye.”
Neitoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ajoki ninye, “Ekaponaa oleng eishoi ino metaa meikenayu te nkumoi.”
Nejoki olmalaika ninye, “Ng'ura ajo inuta, naa iiu enkayioni, nimpot enkarna enye ajo Ishmael, amu etoning'o Olaitoriani osina lino.”
Naa keaku ninye osikiria le ntim tiatua iltung'ana, keaku ore enkaina enye kear pooki tung'ani, ore inkaik e pooki tung'ani keaku kearr ninye. Naa keibayu ninye ilalashera lenyena.
Metaa neipot Hagar enkarna Olaitoriani oirorie ninye ajo, “Ira iyie Enkai nadol,” amu etejo, “Kesipa doi katoduaa Enkai neton aishu aidipa atoduaa ninye?.”
Ore te nkaraki ina eishooki ina shorro enkarna aajo Beer-lahai-roi, netii ninye erishata e Kadesh o Bered.
Neiki Hagar Abram enkayioni, neipot Abram enkarna enkayioni enye natoikio Hagar ajo Ishmael.
Ore apa Abram naa oloo larin ntomoni isiet o ile pee eiki Haga ninye Ishmael.
Ore pee eaku Abram oloo larin intomoni naaudo o naaudo neipang'aki Olaitoriani ninye nejoki, “Kara nanu Enkai Magilani, toning'oki nanu nias isupati,
naa kaitobir osotua lai lo lning'o te rishata ai o iyie, naa kaponaa eishoi ino.”
Nebatata Abram te nkomom enye, neirorie Enkai ninye ajoki,
“Ing'ura etii osotua lai tenebo iyie, naa iyaku menye loo loshon kumok.
Mikintokini aajo enkarna Abram, kake keaku aikiji enkarna ino Abraham amu kaaitaa iyie menye loo lororani too loshon.
Naa kaaitubulaa oleng, naa kaitayu iloshon tiatua iyie, naa kepuku ilaiguanak tiatua iyie.
Naa kaitasheyie nanu osotua lai te rishata ai o iyie o eishoi ino indipa iyie atulusoi tiatua iishoritin enye olning'o lo sotua lai loo ntarasi. Naa kaaku Enkai te iyie o tenebo eishoi ino nikisuju.
Naa kaaisho iyie tenebo o eishoi ino nikisuju enkop nitaayie omoni o enkop pooki e Kanaan metaa enino o ntarasi naa kaaku Enkai enye.”
Neitoki Enkai ajoki Abraham, “Ore iyie imbung'a olning'o lai, lo sotua iyie o eishoi ino too iishoritin pooki naapuonu te siadi iyie.
Osotua lai ele, limbung iyie, te rishata ai o iyie o eishoi nikisuju iyie: ore pooki lee tiatua intae, naa kemurati.
Kemurati intae isuaten oo seseni linyi, naa keaku ina olmonekie lo sotua te rishata ai o ntae.
Ore pooki ng'ae oitabayie inkolong'i isiet naa kemurati, pooki lee tiatua iishoritin pooki, oloba anaa olotoiwuoki te nkaji ino, anaa oloinyang'uaki too mpisai inono te pooki omoni leme oinoti linyi.
Ore ilo oino te nkaji ino o ilo oinyang'uno too mpisai, nemurati pokira. Metaa ketii osotua lai atua iseseni linyi anaa osotua loo ntarasi
Ore pooki lee lememurata esuate o sesen lenye, nedung'ori aaiwuang'ie tiatua iltung'ana lenyena amu etigila osotua lai.”
Nejoki Enkai Abraham, “Ore Sarai enkitok ino, mintoki aipot ninye ajo Sarai, kake keaku keji enkarna enye Sara.
Naa kamayian nanu ninye, ore sii naa kaaisho iyie enkayioni te ninye. Naa kamayian nanu ninye neaku ninye ng'otonye oo loshon, kepukunye ninye ilaiguanak loo loreren.”
Nebatata Abraham te nkomom enye nekueni eirorie kewan nejo; “Keikini enkerai olpayian kitok oitabayie ilarin iip nabo? Keidim Sara naitabayie ilarin ntomoni naudo atoiu enkerai?”
Nejoki Abraham Enkai, “Oi incho ina kisiligata metaa Ishmael eipirare.”
Nejo Enkai, “A'a, kesipa eikiiki enkitok ino Sara enkayioni, naa impot enkarna enye ajo Isaak, naa kaitasheyie osotua lai o ninye, metaa osotua loo ntarasi o too iishoritin naapuonu te siadi ninye.
Ore too naipirta Ishmael, aatoning'o iyie, idol ajo kamayian nanu ninye naitubulaa naponaa oleng. Naa keaku ninye menye ilaiguanak tomon aare, naa kaitaa ninye olosho sapuk.
Kake kaitasheyie nanu osotua lai te Isaak, aikiiki Sara iyie te rishata naaijo ena, telde ari olotu.”
Ore peyie eidip airorie ninye, nelo Enkai aing'uaa Abraham.

Neya Abraham olayioni lenye o tenebo irrindiki pooki ootoiwuoki te nkaji enye anaa iloinyang'uaki too mpisai enyena o pooki lee otii atua ilewa le nkaji e Abraham, nemurat pooki isuaten oo seseni lenye ina olong, anaa enaitanapa Enkai ninye.
Ore apa Abraham naa oloo larin intomoni naudo o naudo ina kata peyie emurati esuate osesen lenye.
Ore Ishmael olayioni lenye naa oloo larin tomon oo kuni peyie emurati esuate osesen lenye.
Ore teina olong ake nemurati Abraham tenebo olayioni lenye Ishmael.
O lelo lewa pooki le nkaji enye, inot le nkaji enye, o lelo ooinyang'uaki too mpisai too lomon, nemurati pooki tenebo ninye.
Neipang'aki Olaitoriani Abraham te mbata oo lkeek oo nyaanyukie lng'abolo te Mamre, etonita te kutuk aji o lng'obor lenye eirowua enkolong.
Neraposhu inkonyek enyena neing'orisho, nedol eitashe iltung'ana okuni te dukuya ninye. Ore pee edol ninche, nepuku akuetu tiatua olng'obor anang'are ninche, neirrugo ninye abaiki enkop nejo:
“Olaitoriani lai, tenanoto omom too nkonyek inono, migiroo ake osinka lino.
Inchoo eyauni enkiti are peyie intukuyieyie inkejek inyi, niyeng'iyeng'ang'a te ntonata o lchani.
Naa kayau enkiti daa peyie intokiki aagolu nindimidimi aashom itagolo amu iimutua enetii osinka linyi.” Nejo ninche, “Taasa anaa enitejo.”
Neisarrisar Abraham alo atua olng'obor enetii Sara, nejoki ninye, “Isiosionie imboreitin uni e ntapa napuyiapuy nimpurj aitobir imukateni.”
Neipirri Abraham alo enetii inkishu enyena, nereu olashe onana sidai, neisho olaisiaayiani lenye, meisiosionie aitobir.
Neyau eng'orno o kule o nkiri eilo ashe onana oitobira airragie te dukuya ninche. Neitashe te mbata ninche te ntonata olchani einosita endaa.
Nejoki ninche ninye, “Koree doi Sara enkitok ino?” Neng'amaa ajoki,

“Etii atua olng'obor.” Nejoki Olaitoriani, “Meeta duoo inchere pee maarrinyokino iyie te rishata naaijo ena telde ari, ore Sara enkitok ino, keaku anaata eeta enkayioni ina kata.” Ore eirorita einining'isho ake Sara te nkutuk olng'obor ti oriong e Abraham.
Etaa apa moruak oleng ina kata Abraham o Sara, etaa kituaak oleng, metaa meekure duoo ninye eidim Sara atoiu enkerai.
Nekweni Sara makewan nejo: “Aidipa ataa moruo, netamorua sii ninye olpayian lai, katum nanu murruna?”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Abraham, “Kainyoo doi peyie etakuenia Sara nejo, ‘Kesipa hoo doi ajo kaiu enkerai, nataa taata moruo?’
Keetae entoki nagol to Laitoriani? Ore te nkata nageluno kaashukokino rishata naaijo ena telde ari, naa ketum Sara enkayioni.”
Kake etomikio Sara ajo, “Eitu nanu akueni,” amu etureishe. Kake etiaaka, ninye “A'a kesipa itakuenia iyie.”
Neinyototo lelo tung'ana teine neing'or enkalo e Sodom neiriamariyie Abraham ninche aitarioo.
Nejo Olaitoriani, “Kaisudorie Abraham embae netaa kaas,
amu kadolita ajo ore Abraham naa keaku olosho kitok magilani, ore iloshon pooki le nkop kemayian ate te ninye?

A'a, amu ategelua ninye peyie atum aitanapa inkera enyena o lmarei lenye osuju ninye meibung'a orrekie lo Laitoriani eas isupati o sipat, peyie etum Olaitoriani ayaki Abraham imbaa naaisiligie ninye.”
Metaa nejoki Olaitoriani Abraham, “Ore amu etaa olkiyioi sapuk te nkaraki Sodom o Gomora, netaa torrok oleng ing'ok tiatua ninye,
ekadoyio alo aing'or tenaa ketaasa te risioroto olkiyioi oewuo enatii, naa teneme neijia, nayiolou.”
Neibelekenya lelo tung'ana teine, nepuo aaitoriokino enkalo e Sodom. Kake eitirring'e Abraham aitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Nenyikaki Abraham Olaitoriani nejoki, “Amaa doi aindaikie isupati tenebo iltorrok?
Amaa naaji te netii iltung'ana onom supati atua ina anasa, indim aidakie ewueji pooki nimipalie lelo supati onom otii atua?
Metalakuana ena bae te iyie pee mias ena bae, aar metuata isupati o ltorrok, eji metaa kenyaanyuk osupat o ltorrono! Metalakuana ina bae te iyie! Amaa ilo oiguanare enkop pooki aimeas esipata?”
Nejo Olaitoriani, “Tenatum tiatua Sodom iltung'ana onom ooitashe too sipat, naa kapal enkanasa pooki te nkaraki ninche.”
Newal Abraham ajo, “Ing'ura ajo, ayawua kewan peyie airorie Olaitoriani, nara nanu enterit o nkuruon.
Amaa sa teneng'oru imiet te onom le lelo ooitashe too sipat, indaikie enkanasa pooki te nkaraki natong'oro imiet.” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Maidaikie ninye tenainepu artam o miet teine.”
Neitoki ake Abraham airorie ninye ejo, “Oo tenaa artam etumi teine?” Neng'amaa ajoki, “Ore te nkaraki lelo artam, maas ina.”
Neitoki Abraham ajo, “Oi mincho Olaitoriani egoro naa kairo. Oo tenaa tomoni uni etumi teine?” Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Maas nanu ina tenatum tomoni uni teine.”
Nejo Abraham, “Ing'ura ajo ayawua kewan airorie Olaitoriani. Oo tenaa tikitam etumi teine?” Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Ore te nkaraki lelo tikitam maidaikie ninye.”
Neitoki Abraham ajo, “Oi mincho Olaitoriani egoro, naa kairo ena ae nabo ake. Oo tenetumi tomon teine.” Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Ore te nkaraki e lelo tomon nemaidaikie nanu ninye.”
Nelo Olaitoriani aing'uaa ine, eidipa airorie Abraham. Nerrinyo Abraham alo ewueji enye.
Nepuonu ilmalaika oaare Sodom teipa, ore egira apa Lot aton te kishomi e Sodom. Ore peyie edol Lot ninche, neinyototo alo anang'are, neirrugo aitabaiki enkomom enye enkop,

nejo, “Ilkituaak laainei embelekenyunye atasayia intae entijing enkaji osinka linyi, erraga, nintukuku inkejek inyi, nidumunyenye tadekenya aayok aapuo.” Nejo ninche, “A'a, aikiirrag enkoitoi nalala.”
Kake etasayia Lot ninche oleng, o meibelekenyakinoto enkaji enye, neitaiki ninche osirua, nepejoki ninche imukateni neitu eisuishieki nenya ninche.
Ore eton eitu eirura ninche nepuonu iltung'ana le nkanasa e Sodom ilooti o lbotoro olorere pooki o metabaiki olobayie aaman enkaji,
neipot ninche Lot aajoki, “Koree iltung'ana ooetuo enitii ena kewarie? Intupuku ninche enikitii peyie kitum aataboitare ninche.”
Neipang'aki Lot ninche te boo, nerrinyoki enkikenet enkaji.
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Atasayia intae ilalashera laainei emiaas entorroni naba inji.
Eng'ura, aata intoyie are neitu aikata eboitare olee, entasho matorikoki intae peyie ipuopuo aitaas eniyieuu, ore kulo tung'ana emintaas ae amu eetuo aajing oloip le nkaji ai.”

Kake etiakita ninche lot, “Wuang'a iyie,” nejo maate “Eewuo ele tung'ani aa olomoni naa ninye olotu aiguanare iyiook! Etaa kintaas iyie entorroni nalang enikintaas ninche.” Nerrumokino pooki aairony Lot, nenyikaki enkaji peyie egil kutuk aji.
Kake eitaituo lelo tung'ana aare inkaik neyietaki Lot atua enkaji natii neiken kutuk aji.
Neosh te modoki lelo tung'ana otii boo e kutuk aji e ina aji ilooti o lbotoro metaa etanyamala eirrapurrapu enetii kutuk aji.
Nejoki lelo tung'ana Lot, “Teniata kulikae tung'ana tene?” Aa ilaputak linono, o ntoyie, anaa likae tung'ani ake ninye liata te nkanasa, intupuku ninche tiatua ene wueji.
Amu etinyikua peyie kindaikie ene wueji, amu etasapuka olkiyioi lenye te dukuya Enkai, neirriwua iyiook Olaitoriani maidaikie.

Neipang Lot alo airorie ilaputak ooyam intoyie enyena, nejoki “Enyoito entupuku tene wueji, amu etinyikua peyie eidakie Olaitoriani enkanasa.” Kake etotiwuo ninye too laputak anaa oltung'ani oiguranie ninche.
Ore enasirie neisiosionie ilmalaika Lot ejoki, “Inyo toriko enkitok ino o ntoyie inono pokira are naatii ene, pee mindaaya te nkitamioto ena anasa.”
Kake etotona ailitilito, ometaba anaa neibung lelo tung'ana enkaina enye o enkitok enye, o ntoyie enyena pokira are. Ore te nkaraki olng'ur lo Laitoriani te ninye, eyautua ninye auluo enkanasa.
Ore peyie eitupuku ninche ninye, nejoki, “Isikie enkishui ino, niminang ake silig, nimintashe ake te dikae to yarata, isikaki indoinyo pee mindaaya.”
Nejo Lot, “Oi mme neijia Olaitoriani lai.
Ing'ura ajo enoto osinka lino omom too nkonyek inono, nitoponayie olng'ur lino te nanu anaa pee intajeu enkishon ai, kake maidim aisikaki indoinyo eitu aainepu enkidaaroto naye nanu.
Ing'ura enda anasa nataana naa kiti sii, nchooki makuetiki ine aime kiti ninye? Naa keitajeuni enkishui ai.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Ing'ura ajo aatonyorrikia sii ina bae, metaa maidaikie ina anasa nitejo.
Tasioi isikaki ine, amu maas ae o tabai ine.” Te nkaraki ina peyie etejoki enkarna eina anasa Soar.
Eilepua enkolong ina kata nabau Lot Soar,
neitashaiki Olaitoriani Sodom o Gomorra isoito ooyupuyup o looishu o enkima, eing'uaa Olaitoriani eimu keper.
Nemut ninye nena anas o oerata pooki o pooki omanya inkanas, o pooki toki nabulu e nkop.
Kake etanang'a enkitok e Lot silig esujita ninye, neaku ninye eng'ape e Munyan.
Neinyototo Abraham tadekenya alo ewueji neitasheyie te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Neing'or ninye enkalo e Sodom o Gomorra o enkalo enkop pooki o yerata, naa nedol eilepita empuruo eina kop anaa empuruo olkokuet.
Metaa ina apa emutata oo nkanas natii oerata. Etadamua Enkai Abraham neirriwaa Lot aitung'uaa atua ineemuti, anaa peyie emut inkanas naamanya Lot.
Nepuku Lot aing'uaa Soar, amany ildoinyo tenebo ntoyie enyena pokira are amu ekeure apa atotona te Soar, metaa etamanya enkapune tenebo ntoyie enyena pokira are.
Nejoki entito botor enkanashe “Etamorua papa, nemetii oltung'ani te nkop oboitare iyiook to rrekie le nkiyama.
Wou, maitemera papa te naisho oo sabibu peyie kisiap ninye nikintudupaki ninye eishoi.”
Neitemer menye te naisho oo sabibu ina kewarie, nejing entito botor aisiap menye, neitu eyiolou Lot enkata naisiapa ninye o enkata natupukuo aing'uaa.
Ore peyie eaku enkolong e are, nejoki entito botor enkiti, “Ing'ura ajo aisiapa ng'ole papa; manyaaki aisho ninye enaisho ena kewarie, nilo sii iyie aisiap peyie kitum aaitudupai eishoi e papa lang.”
Neitemer menye te naisho oo sabibu ina kewarie nasuju, nedumunye entito kiti aisiap menye, neitu eyiolou Lot enkata naisiapa ninye o enkata natudumunye.
Metaa nenutayu intoyie pokira are e Lot te menye.
Ore entito botor etoiwuo enkayioni neipot enkarna enye ajo Moab, naa ninye menye lo Lmoabu ometabaiki ena olong.
Neiu sii ninye enkiti enkayioni, neipot enkarna enye ajo Ben-ammi, naa ninye menye loo Lamoni o metabaiki ena olong.
Neidur Abraham teine alo enkalo enkop e Negeb, nemany erishata e Kadesh o Shur nelo sii Gerar.
Nejo Abraham tialo Sara enkitok enye, “Enkanashe ai ninye.” Ore olaiguanani Abimelek le Gerar, neirriwaa enkutuk meyauni Sara aayaki.
Kake eewuo Enkai kewarie enetii Abimelek te nkidetidet, nejoki, “Ira iyie oltung'ani otua te nkaraki ina kitok niwa, amu ore ninye naa enkitok e likae tung'ani.”
Ore amu eton eitu elo Abimelek anyikaki Sara, nejo, “Olaitoriani, iar metuata iltung'ana loo sipat?
Keitu aajoki ninye makewan, ‘Enkanashe ai ninye?’ Netejo sii ninye enkitok, ‘Olalashe lai ninye.’ Metaa esupatisho o ltau o sidano ataasie ena.”
Nejoki Enkai ninye teina kidetidet, “Ee ekayiolo ajo itaasa ena te supatisho o ltau lino, kake nanu laaibooyie peyie mikintaas eng'oki, metaa eitu aaisho iyie iseyie ninye.

Ore tena kata kayieu nirrinyoki olpayian enkitok enye, amu ore ninye naa oloiboni le Nkai, naa aikiomonoki ninye peyie miye. Kake tinimirrinyoki iyie ninye, tayiolo ajo meeta inchere pee miye, iyie o pooki toki ino.”
Neinyototo Abimelek tadekenya enasirie, neipotu ilaisiaayiak lenyena pooki neinosaki ninche kuna baa pooki, neureishoyu iltung'ana oleng.

Neipotu Abimelek Abraham, nejoki ninye, “Kaa bae ena nintaasa iyiook? Naa kaa ng'oki aaitaasa nanu iyie eji metaa kiyaka iyie nanu o enkitoria ai eng'oki sapuk? Kintaasa nanu imbaa nemeishaakino neasi.”
Nejoki Abimelek Abraham, “Kainyoo endamunoto niata peyie itaasa ena bae?”
Nejo Abraham, “Ataasa amu atadamua ajo, metii ene euriata e Nkai katukul, naa kaari te nkaraki enkitok ai.
Ore sii enkae, ekesipa doi tenajo enkanashe ai amu ore ninye, naa entito e papa lai neme entito e yieyio lai, netaa enkitok ai.
Ore apa peyie aaisho Enkai maidurra te nkaji e papa, naatiaaka ninye, ‘Ena embae o lng'ur nikintaas nanu, ore pooki wueji nikijing, tejo tialo nanu, olalashe lai ninye.’ ”
Neitayu Abimelek intare o lmong'i o lewa o nkituaak rrindiki, neisho pooki Abraham nerrinyoki ninye enkitok enye Sara.
Nejo, Abimelek, “Ore enkop ai pooki, etii dukuya ino tamanya eneba anaa eninyor.”
Nejoki Sara, “Aishoo olalashe lino inkoshola enkalifu nabo, naaku ine nkitoipoto ino too nkonyek e lelo pooki likiboitare, neaku aikinkenakini esipata.”
Neomon Abraham Enkai, neishiunye Enkai Abimelek tenebo enkitok enye o nkituaak rrindiki metaa etoiutuo inkera.
Amu eteena apa Olaitoriani inguseti enkaji pooki e Abimelek te nkaraki Sara enkitok e Abraham.
Nedamu Olaitoriani Sara anaa apa enatejo, neitaas ninye anaa enaisiligie.
Nenutayu Sara neiki Abraham enkayioni te nkata e moruao enye, te nkata erishata natiaka ninye Enkai.
Neipot Abraham enkarna e nkayioni enye natoikio ninye Sara ajo Isaak.
Nemurat Abraham enkayioni enye Isaak etaa oloo nkolong'i isiet, te inoto, anaa enaitanapa Enkai ninye.
Etaa Abraham oloo larin iip peyie eikini ninye enkayioni enye Isaak.
Nejo Sara, “Aaitobiraka nanu Enkai enkuenia; ore pooki ng'ae oning nekweni tenebo o nanu.”
Nejo ninye, “Aing'ae aikata oidima atiaaki Abraham inchere keitanak Sara inkera? Ore ake eyia, natoikio ninye enkayioni te nkata emoruao enye.”
Nebulu ina kerai, neoruni ilki, neitobir Abraham osirua sapuk ina olong naoruni Isaak ilki.
Nedol Sara enkayioni e Hagar enapa Misiri natoikio ninye Abraham eiguran o enkayioni enye Isaak.
Nejoki ninye Abraham, “Taarai impang'ie ena kitok rrindik tenebo o enkayioni enye, amu meaku enkayioni ena kitok rrindik olajung'oni tenebo o layioni lai Isaak.”
Neitanyamal ina bae Abraham oleng te nkaraki enkayioni enye sii ninye Ishmael.
Kake etiaaka Enkai Abraham, “Mincho kintagor ororei le nkerai o te nkaraki enkitok ino rrindik, ore pooki nikijoki Sara, taasa ina. Amu Isaak eipotieki eishoi ino.
Naa kaitayu sii olosho tiatua enkayioni enkitok rrindik, amu ole ishoi ino sii ninye.”

Neinyototo Abraham tadekenya enasirie, neya endaa o lbene lo lchoni le nkare; neisho Haga meiteleiki oloililai lenye tenebo ina kerai neisho ninche meshomo. Nedumunye alo nelimana ti ong'ata e Beer-sheba.
Ore peyie emita enkare natii olbene lo lchoni neing'uaa enkerai te ntonata osanag.
Nelo aing'uaa aton tenelamita te wueji neba anaa eng'ororoto e mbae. Amu etejo, “Mincho aduaaki keeya enkerai ai.” Ore eton tenelamita ninye, neilepie enkerai oltoilo aishir.

Nening Enkai oltoilo leina ayioni, neipot olmalaika le Nkai Haga eing'uaa keper nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo nikigira aitanyamal iyie Haga? Miureishoyu, amu etoning'o Enkai oltoilo le nkishirata leina ayioni teine netii.
Inyo tudumu enkerai imbung'a tukurraki inkaik inono, amu kaitaa ninye olosho kitok.”
Nebol Enkai inkonyek e Hagar nedol enchorro enkare, nelo aiput ilo bene lenye lo lchoni enkare neisho ina ayioni metooko.
Netii Enkai tenebo enkayioni nebulu ninye nebik tiong'ota, neaku olang'oroni padan le nkawuo.
Nebik tiong'ata e Paran, neyamaki ng'otonye enkitok naitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.
Ore apa ina kata, etiaakita Abimelek tenebo Fiko aa olkitok le njore, Abraham, “Etii Enkai tenebo iyie too siaaitin pooki nias,

ore naa taata, kayieu ninya olmumai te nanu ajo ore te Nkai mikintaas emonkoi, anaa intaas enkerai ai, anaa intaas eishoi ai. Kake ore anaa ina supatisho naaitaasa, ninye sii nanu intaasaki teina kop nitaayie omoni.”
Nejo Abraham, “Kanya olmumai.”
Neing'unyung'unyaki Abraham Abimelek te nkaraki enchorro natoorutuo isinkan le Abimelek.
Nejo Abimelek, “Mayiolo ajo aing'ae otaasa ena bae, eitu sii kiliki, neitu aekata aning ometabaiki ena olong.”
Neyau Abraham inkerra o lmong'i neisho ninche Abimelek, neitayu pokira olning'o.
Negelu Abraham isupeni naapishana e kerra too ntare meitasho oopeny.
Nejoki Abimeleki Abraham, “Kainyoo eitodolu kuna supeni naapishana e kerra nitegelua meitasho oopeny.”
Nejo, “Ore kuna supeni naapishana e kerra ining'amaa too nkaik aainei metaa iyaku iyie olchakeni lai inchere atuturo ena shorro.”
Ore te nkaraki ina, neji ine Beer-sheba, amu teine einosa pokira oaare olmumai.
Metaa eitaituo ninche olning'o te Beer-sheba. Nerrinyo Abimelek tenebo Fiko olkitok lenye le njore enkop oo Filistia.
Neun Abraham enchani nanyaanyukie oloilei te Beer-sheba, neipot ninye teine enkarna o Laitoriani, Enkai oo ntarasi.
Nebik Abraham te nkop oo Filistia inkolong'i kumok.
Ore etulusoitie kuna baa netem Enkai Abraham nejoki ninye, “Abraham” nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”
Nejoki, “Toriko olayioni lino Isaak ilo laa ninye ake iata, ilo linyor, nipuopuo enkop e Moria, nintayu ninye teine metaa olasar opejori te nchumata o ldoinyo obo laaliki.”

Neinyototo Abraham tadekenya enasirie neirot osikiria lenye, nerik ilbarnot lenyena oaare tenebo enkayioni enye Isaak. Nedung'u ilkeek ooinokie olasar opejori, nedumunye alo ewueji netiaka ninye Enkai.
Ore te nkolong e uni, neshumu Abraham inkonyek nedol ewueji nelakua.
Nejoki Abraham ilbarnot lenyena, “Entotoni tene tenebo ele sikiria pee alo nanu o enkayioni idie aaserem Enkai peyie kintoki aashukunye.”
Neya Abraham ilkeek ooinokieki olasar opejori, neiteleiki oloililai le Isaak enkayioni enye. Nenap te nkaina enye enkima o enkalem. Nepuo pokira aare aairiamari.
Nejoki Isaak papaai lenye Abraham, “Papaai!” Nejo Abraham “Nele nanu enkayioni ai.” Nejo Isaak, “Ing'ura ajo kiata enkima o lkeek kake koree doi olkuoo le ker likintainye olasar opejori?”
Nejo Abraham, “Ekeisho Enkai kewan olkuoo le ker lo lasar opejori, enkayioni ai.” Kaae nepuo pokira are aairiamari.
Ore peyie ebau ewueji netuutaka Enkai Abraham, neshetu Abraham olperere lo lasar teine neirragie ilkeek aitobiraki, neen Isaak enkayioni enye, neirragie ninye te wueji o lasar te nchumata oo lkeek.
Neitorioo Abraham enkaina enye nedumu enkalem nayieng'ie enkayioni enye.
Kake eipoto ninye olmalaika lo Laitoriani eing'uaa keper nejoki, “Abraham! Abraham!” Nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”
Nejo, olmalaika, “Minteleiki enkaina ino enkayioni anaa intaas ninye ae, amu atayiolo taata ajo iure Enkai amu atoduaa ajo eitu kimitiki enkayioni ino ina naa ninye ake iata.”

Neshumu Abraham inkonyek enyena aing'orisho nedol te siadi ninye olmeregesh oibung'a entim imowuarak enyena, nelo Abraham aibung ilo meregesh, neitayu ninye aitaa olasar opejori te rishata e nkayioni enye.
Neipot Abraham ine wueji ajo, “Eneishoorie Olaitoriani.” Naa ina arna eeta ine o taata, ore to ldoinyo lo Laitoriani keishoori.
Neitoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani aipot Abraham enkata e are eing'uaa keper.
Nejo, “Ainosa nanu olmumai te nkewan ai, ejo Olaitoriani, ore amu itaasa ena neitu imit enkayioni ino aa ninye ake iata,
ekaamayian iyie oleng, naa kaponaa eishoi ino metotiwuo anaa ilakir le keper netiu sii anaa osinyai le nkiyopata enaiposha. Ore eishoi ino neaku e nenye kishomi oo lmang'ati lenye.
Naa tiatua eishoi ino emayian iloshon le nkop pooki ate, amu itoning'o oltoilo lai.”
Nerrinyokino Abraham ilbarnot lenyena, nedumunye pooki aapuo Beer-sheba. Nebik Abraham te Beer-sheba.
Neaku ore pee eishunye kuna baa, nejokini Abraham, “Ing'ura sii ajo, etoikio Milka olalashe lino Nahor inkera.
Usi ilo kikau lenye o Obus olalashe lenye o Kemuel menye le Aram.
Keseed o Haso o Pildash o Yidlaf o Betuel.”
Neaku Betuel menye le Rebeka. Lelo pokira isiet etoikio Milka olalashe le Abraham Nahor.
Ore ake sii, ore ina apiani enye naji enkarna enye Reuma, etoiwuo Teba o Gaham o Tahash o Maaka.
Eishua apa Sara ilarin iip o tikitam o pishana, lelo apa ilarin le nkishui e Sara.
Neye Sara te Keriath-arba (aa ninye Hebron), te nkop e Kanaan. Nelotu Abraham aishiraki to sina Sara, neishir oleng.
Neinyototo Abraham te dukuya ina tang'atang'a enye, nejoki lelo Hiti,
“Kara olomoni o lalotoni tiatua intae, enchooki ewueji tiatua intae metaa ewueji enkurare pee atum atuturoi entang'atang'a ai aiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei.”
Newaliki Ilhiti Abraham aajoki,

“Toning'o iyiook olkitok lang, ira iyie olkitok magilani tiatua iyiook. Tuturoi entang'atang'a ino te nkurare naba anaa enigelu too nkuraren ang, meetae hoo obo lang Likimitiki enkurare enye anaa kimitiki eniturorie entang'atang'a ino.”
Neinyototo Abraham neirrugo te dukuya lelo Hiti oopeny enkop.
Nejoki ninche, “Tiniyieuu nanukaa entang'atang'a ai aiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei, entoning enajo, entoomonokoki te Efron olayioni le Sohar,
peyie aaisho enkapune e Makpela naata to lpijata lo lokeri lenye. Inchoo maaishoo te nkinyang'a enye pooki idolitata metaa ewueji ai oo nkuraren.”
Netonita sii apa ninye Efron tiatua Lhiti. Newaliki Efron, ilo Hiti Abraham ening'ito ilhiti o pooki oimita kishomi e nkanasa, ajo:
“A'a, olkitok lai, toning'o enajo, ekaisho olokeri tenebo enkapune natii atua, te dukuya ilayiok pooki lo lorere lai, aaishoo iyie tunukarie entang'atang'a ino.”
Neirugo Abraham te dukuya olorere le ina kop.
Nejoki Efron ening'ito olorere le ina kop, “Kake tenaa aikining, aatasayia inchooki matalaa iropiyiani o lokeri, tang'amai elaata te nanu peyie atum atuturoi entang'atang'a ai teine.”
Newaliki Efron Abraham ajoki,
“Olkitok lai, toning'oki: amaa eoroti e nkop nanya shekeli iip ong'uan e nkosholai, kainyoo ina te rishata ai o iyie? Tuturoi entang'atang'a ino.”
Nening'okino Abraham o Efron ina laata. Neikenaki Abraham Efron inkoshola naaipotuo ening'ito Lhiti, shekeli iip ong'uan e nkosholai anaa enkinyiang'a oo lamirak.
Metaa eishooki Abraham olokeri le Efron otii Makpela natii oloosaen le Mamre olokeri oata enkapune tiatua o lkeek ootii olokeri,
eishooki Abraham metaa enenye te dukuya Ilhiti, o lelo pooki ooim enkishomi ejing enkanasa.
Ore peyie eidipayu ina neturoo Abraham Sara enkitok enye te nkapune o lokeri le Makpela natii oloosaen le Mamre (aa ninye Hebron) te nkop oo Lkanaan.
Ore olokeri tenebo enkapune natii atua eishooitie Lhiti aaisho Abraham metaa ewueji e nkurare oo ltung'ana lenyena.
Etaa apa Abraham olpayian kitok otobikoyie ilarin kumok oleng, netamayiana Olaitoriani ninye te pooki toki.
Nejoki Abraham osinka lenye otobiko oleng te nkaji laa ninye oitasheiki imasaa enyena pooki, “Tipika enkaina kirrisha nkupesir aainei,
naa kaainosie iyie olmumai to Laitoriani, te Nkai e keper o enkop, inchere miyamaki olayioni lai enkitok too ntoyie oo Lkanaan laa ninche amanya atua.
Kake ilo enkop ai o lgilata lai, nirikoki olayioni lai Isaak enkitok.”
Nejoki olaisiaayiani ninye, “Keidimayu pee eany enkitok aasuju alotu ena kop, karik olayioni lino arriny ina kop apa ning'uaa?”
Nejoki Abraham ninye, “Toduaa ake mirriny olayioni lai ine.

Ore Olaitoriani Enkai e keper laaitayio nanu te nkaji e papaai lai o te nkop apa naatoinyieki, laairorie naainosie olmumai naajoki, ‘Iishoritin inono aisho ena kop.’ Ekeirriwaa olmalaika lenye te dukuya iyie, naa ilo iyie arikoki olayioni lai entito teine.
Naa tenemeyieu enkitok nikisuju iyie, nimikintoki olmumai lai aibung: kake mirrinyoki ake olayioni lai ine.”
Metaa nepik osinka enkaina enye kirrisha enkupes e Abraham olkitok lenye, nenya olmumai te nkaraki ina bae.
Nereu osinka intamesin tomon o lkitok lenye nelo eeta nkishoorot kumok oo mpukunot pooki to lkitok lenye nedumunye alo Mesopotamia, enkanasa e Nahor.
Neitigil intamesin kung tiauluo enkanasa te mbata enchorro etaa teipa erishata napuonu inkituaak aaoku enkare.
Nejo ninye, “Oi Olaitoriani Enkai o lkitok lai Abraham, inchooki ena olong dupoto aatoomono iyie, nintodolu enyorrata ino nauno to olkitok lai Abraham.
Lele nanu oitashe te mbata enchorro e nkare, ore intoyie oo ltung'ana lena anasa egira aapuku aaipang'u aoku enkare.

Inchoo metaa ore entito najoki, aatoomono intadou emoti ino matooko enkare, naajoki tooko, naa kaokoki sii intamesin inono inchoo metaa ninye itegelaka osinka lino Isaak. Teina ayiolou ajo intodolua enyorrata nauno to olkitok lai.”
Ore eton eitu eishu inkirorot, nemaniki Rabeka entito e Betuel olayioni le Milka, enkitok e Nahor olalashe le Abraham elotu eeta emoti to loililai lenye.
Naa entito sidai oleng tining'or, eselenkei neitu aikata aboitare olee, nedoiki enchorro, neiput emoti enye enkare, neilepu.
Nekuet osinka anang'are ninye nejoki, “Aatoomono inchooki enkiti are naok te moti ino.”
Nejo ninye, “Tooko olkitok lai,” nesiokisioki aitadou emoti te nkaina enye neisho ninye metooko.
Ore peyie eidip aishoo ninye metooko nejoki, “Ekaokoki sii intamesin inono o metaba anaa neraposho.”
Metaa eijililiaka emoti enye empeut neipirri arrinyo enchorro aoku omeitaraposho intamesin enyena pooki.
Neing'or osinka ninye aitirring'a meiro, ajurru tenaa keitudupo Olaitoriani elotunoto enye anaa keitu.
Ore peyie eidip intamesin aatookisho, neitayu oltung'ani olgisoi le saabu laa eoroti nabo e shekel te nkiroishi o lkataarri aare loo nkaik enyena oobaya enkiroishi enye shekeli tomon e saabu.
Nejo, “Aatasayia tolikioki ajo ira entito e ng'ae? Ketii olgilata likirrag enkaji e papaai lino?”
Nejoki ninye ninye, “Kara entito e Betuel olayioni le Milka otoikio Nahor.”
Neitoki ajoki, “Kiata sii pokira, olkujita o lgilat ooirragi.”
Neirrug oladuoo tung'ani elukunya aserem Olaitoriani.

Nejo: “Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai o lkitok lai Abraham, leitu aing'uaa enyorrata enye nauno o bayarotisho enye to Laitoriani lai. Ore nanu, aatorikuo Olaitoriani te nkoitoi arikoki enkaji oo lalashera lo lkitok lai.”
Neipirri ina tito aliki enkaji e ng'otonye kuna baa.
Eeta apa Rebeka olalashe oji enkarna enye Laban. Nepuku Laban akuet alo enetii ilo tung'ani te nchorro.

Ore peyie edol olgisoi o lkataarri otii inkaik e nkanashe, nening'u sii irorei le Rebeka enkanashe enye oojo, “Neijia aatiaaka oltung'ani,” nelo enetii oltung'ani; neinepu eitashe te mbata oo ntamesin te nchorro.
Nejoki, “Tijing'u, olomayiana lo Laitoriani, kainyoo peyie intashe tiauluo: naidipa aitobira enkaji o ewueji oo ntamesin.”
Metaa etijing'ua ilo tung'ani atua aji, nelaku Laban ilolan too ntamesin, neisho ninye ninche endaa oo ntamesin. Neisho sii ninye enkare naisujie inkejek enyena o tenebo lelo oiriamunore.
Neirragakinyeki ninye endaa meinosa, kake etejo ninye; “Manya endaa o metaba anaa nairo ororei laayawua.” Nejoki Laban ninye, “Iroro.”
Metaa etejo ninye, “Kara nanu osinka le Abraham! Netamayiana Olaitoriani olkitok lai oleng, neitaa ninye karsis:
eishoo ninye inkishu o ntare o nkoshola o saabu o sinkan o nkaisiaayiak o ntamesin o sirkon.
Ore Sara, enkitok olkitok lai, etoikio ninye enkayioni etaa moruo. Ore nena masaa pooki neishoo olayioni lenye.
Aainosie olkitok lai olmumai ajoki, ‘Milo iyie ayamaki olayioni lai enkitok too ntoyie oo Lkanaan lena kop naamanya.
Kake shomo enkaji e papa lai, o ltung'ana lang torikoki olayioni lai enkitok.’
Najoki nanu olkitok lai, ‘Keidimayu pee aany enkitok aasuju nanu.’
Kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, ‘Ore Olaitoriani laa ninye laarikoo naa keirriu olmalaika lenye tenebo iyie neitumunyan enkoitoi ino, nirikoki olayioni lai enkitok too ltung'ana lang le nkaji e papa.
Niking'uaa ina kata olmumai tinilo enetii iltung'ana laainei. Naa tinikimitiki ninche ninye, nimikintoki aibung iyie olmumai lai.’
“Nalotu duoo nanu enchorro najo, ‘Oi Olaitoriani Enkai o lkitok lai Abraham, ntumunyanakaki tena kata enkoitoi naim aitorioo.
Lele nanu oitashe te mbata enchorro e nkare, inchoo entito nalotu aoku enkare naa tenajoki: Aatoomono inchooki te moti ino; enkiti are naok.
Naajoki nanu! Tooko naa kaokoki sii intamesin inono, inchoo metaa ninye enkitok nategeleka Olaitoriani olayioni lo olkitok lai.’
“Ore sii ake eitu aishu enkiroroto oltau lai, nelotu Rebeka enapita emoti e nkare to loililai, nedoiki enchorro aoku enkare. Najoki ninye, ‘Aatoomono inchooki matooko.’
Nesioki aitadou emoti enye to loililai lenye nejo; ‘Tooko, naa kaisho sii ninche ntamesin inono.’ Neaku atooko nanu neisho sii nena tamesin enkare.
Naitoki aikilikuan ninye ajoki: ‘Ira entito e ng'ae?’ Nejo, ‘Entito e Betuel olayioni le Nahor otoikio ninye Milka.’ Napik olgisoi enkume enye o lkataarri inkaik enyena.
Nairrug elukunya aserem Olaitoriani, naisis Olaitoriani Enkai o lkitok lai Abraham, ilo laatorikoyie te nkoitoi nasipa matoriko entito o lalashe lo lkitok lai arikoki olayioni lenye.
Ore naa taata, tenaa aiyasiasa esupatisho o esipata to lkitok lai, entolikioki nanu, naa tinimiasiasa entolikioki nanu peyie atum aibelekenyakinoyu enkaina e tatene aashu kedianye.”
Newal Laban o Betuel aajo, “Ore ena bae naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa. Mikindiim aatiaaki iyie entorrono anaa esidai.
Ing'ura neeina Rebeka natii dukuya iyie, toriko ninye shomo metaa ninye enkitok olayioni lo lkitok lino anaa enairoro Olaitoriani.”
Ore peyie ening olaisiaayiani le Abraham irorei lenye neirrugo abaiki enkop te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Neyau ilo aisiaayiani intokitin naagol enkinyiang'a o enkosholai o saabu o nkilani neisho ninche Rebeka. Eishoo sii ninye olalashe lenye tenebo ng'otonye intokitin naagol enkinyiang'a.
Ore ninye o lelo tung'ana apa ootii tenebo ninye, nedaa neokisho, neirrag ine. Ore pee einyototo ninche tadekenya, nejo ninye, “Enchooki matushukoyu enetii olkitok lai.”
Nejo olalashe tenebo ng'otonye, “Enchoo entito eng'as aton tenebo iyiook inkuti olong'i, anaa naaji inkolong'i tomon, ore peyie eishunye neidim ashomo.”
Kake etiaaka ninye ninche, “Mikintokiki ailitilit, anaa enaidipa Olaitoriani aitumunyana enkoitoi ai, enchooki mashomo enetii olkitok lai.”
Nejo ninche; “Aikimpot entito aaikilikuan enajo.”
Neipot ninche Rebeka, nejoki ninye, “Amaa airiamariyie ele tung'ani?” Newal ajo, “Ekalo.”
Neaku eishoo ninche Rebeka enkanashe enye meshomo tenebo enkaisiaayiani enye, o sinka le Abraham tenebo iltung'ana lenyena.
Nemayian ninche Rebeka nejoki: “Enkanashe ang taa iyie ng'otonye oo nkalifuni, o nkalifuni tomon, naa inchoo metujung'o eishoi ino kishomi e lelo ooiba ninche.”
Nedumunye Rebeka tenebo inkaisiaayiak enyena, neked intamesin neirukurukore ilo tung'ani, neaku etoriko ilo aisiayani Rabeka, nelo enkop enye.
Eewuo apa Isaak ina kata eing'uaa Beer-lahai-roi nelotu abik te Negeb.
Nepuku Isaak alo ong'ata adamisho teipa, neshumu inkonyek enyena, nedol intamesin naapuonu.
Neshumu Rebeka inkonyek enyena nedol Isaak, ore peyie edol ninye nedou te ntames,
nejoki ilo aisiaayiani, “Kalo tung'ani lido olotu ti ong'ata anang'are iyiook?” Nejoki ilo aisiaayiani, “Olkitok lai.” Neitayu enkarasha aitoip kewan.
Neinosaki ilo aisiaayiani Isaak imbaa pooki naataasate.
Nerik Isaak ninye atua olng'obor. Neya Rebeka neaku ninye enkitok enye, nenyorru ninye. Neaku eitagoloki apa Isaak te keeya e ng'otonye.
Eyama apa Abraham ae kitok naji enkarna enye Ketura.
Neiki ninye Simran o Yokshan o Medan o Midian o Ishbak o Shua.
Ore apa Tokshan naa ninye menye le Sheba, o Dedan. Ore ilayiok le Dedan, naa Asshurim o Letushim o Leumim.
Ore ilayiok le Midian naa Epa o Eper o Hanok o Abida o Eldaa. Ore apa kulo naa nkera e ketura.
Neisho Abraham pooki toki naata Isaak.
Kake eishoo Abraham ilayiok loo nkapiak enyena inkishoorot, ore eton eishu, neidurrie ninche aitung'uaa olayioni lenye Isaak meshomo enkop oloosaen.
Kulo larin le nkishui e Abraham, ilarin iip o ntomoni naapishana o imiet.
Neye Abraham etaa olpayian kitok etamorua amitunye, nepiki ninye eneiturrurrorre olorere lenye.
Nenukaa ninye ilayiok lenyena Isaak o Ishmael te nkapune e Makpela te nkurma e Efron olayioni le Soha loo Lhiti
to loosaen le Mamre, te nkurma nainyiang'ua apa Abraham too Lhiti. Metaa teine apa etunukayioki Abraham tenebo o enkitok enye Sara.
Ore peyie eidip Abraham atua, nemayian Enkai Isaak olayioni lenye. Nebik Isaak te Beer-lahai-roi.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le ishoi e Ishmael olayioni le Abraham otoikio ninye Haga e Misiri naa enkaisiaayiani apa e Sara.
Kuna ninche nkarn oo layiok le Ishmael anaa enaikunakino te inoto enye: Nebaiot aa ninye olkikau le Ishmael o Kedar o Adbeel o Mibsam,
Mishma o Duma o Masa
o Hadad o Tema o Yetur o Napish o Kedema.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Ishmael naa kuna inkarn enye, too nkang'itie enye o too lng'oborri lenye. Ilkituaak tomon o are anaa iloshon lenye.
(Kulo ilarin le nkishui e Ishmael, ilarin iip o tomoni uni o naapishana, neitianya aye, neiturrurrokino ninye olorere lenye.)
Nemany ebaiki Hafila o meshomo Shur, natii enkalo o loosaen le Misiri te nkalo e Asiria. Etamanya apa ninye enetalakinore olikae orere pooki lenye.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le ishoi e Isaak olayioni le Abraham: ore apa Abraham naa ninye menye le Isaak.
Ore apa Isaak naa oloo larin artam peyie eyam enkitok enye Rebeka, ina tito e Betuel le Aramean te Padan Aram, ina anashe e Laban le Aramean.
