Neomon Isaak Olaitoriani te nkaraki enkitok enye, amu koolupi apa ninye, newal Enkai enkomono enye, neiroshiu Rebeka enkitok enye.
Nepupung'a nkera tiatua enkoshoke enye, nejo ninye, “Amaa tenaa inji etiu, kainyoo doi peyie aishu? Nelo ninye aikilikuan Olaitoriani ina bae.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Etii iloshon aare atua enkoshoke ino, naa ore lelo tung'ana pookira liiu, naa ekeori, ekegolu obo alang olikae, ore olbotor naa keisiaai oloti.”
Ore peyie ebau inkolong'i enyena peyie ejing aji, eeta ilmao te nkoshoke enye.
Ore olotang'asunye naa kenyokie, naa keju osesen lenye pooki anaa ilpapit le nkila, neipot ninye aajo enkarna Esau.
Neitoki olalashe lenye asuju, ore enkaina enye neibung'ita entutunyo e Esau, neipot ninye aajo Yakobo. Ore apa Isaak naa oloo larin ntomoni ile peyie eiki Rebeka ninye lelo mao.
Ore peyie ebulu lelo ayiok, neaku Esau olang'oroni padan naa oltung'ani sii liong'ota. Ore Yakobo, naa oltung'ani obor ogira aton too lng'oborri.
Kenyor apa Isaak Esau te nkaraki nkiri oo ng'uesi naayaki ninye. Ore Rebeka nenyor Yakobo.
Ore nabo olong egira Yakobo ayier imotori oo nkaitubulu e nkurma enye, nebau Esau eing'uaa ong'ata neeta esumash oleng.
Nejoki Esau Yakobo; “Etaa kaye te sumash, inchooki mainosa ina toki nayiara natii emoti. Ore te nkaraki ina, neji enkarna enye Edom.”
Newaliki Yakobo ninye ajoki “Tang'asa timirakaki esipata e kikausho ino.”
Nejo Esau, “Etaa kaye, kene nyoo tipat naata esipata e kikausho te nanu?”
Nejoki Yakobo, “Tang'asa inosakaki olmumai.” Nenya Esau olmumai, nemiraki ninye Yakobo esipata enye e kikausho.
Neaku eishoo Yakobo Esau emukate tenebo nena motori, nenya neok sii, neinyototo alo. Neaku etemenayie Esau esipata enye e kikausho.
Ore pee eitoki olameyu ajing enkop leme olapa ameyu le nkata e Abraham. Nelo Isaak Gera enetii Abimelek olaiguanani loo Lfilisti.
Neipang'aki Olaitoriani ninye nejoki, “Midoyio alo Misiri, totona tamanya enkop naaliki.
Tobiko tena kop, naa kaaku nanu tenebo iyie, naa kaamayian nanu iyie tenebo iishoritin inono aisho kuna kuapi pooki, naitabaya olmumai lainosie papaai lino Abraham.
Kaponaa eishoi ino metotiwuo anaa ilakir lo loing'ang'e, naisho eishoi ino ena kop pooki naa te ishoi ino emayiani iloshon le nkop pooki
amu etoning'o Abraham oltoilo lai, neibung enkikoo ai, o nkitanapat aainei pooki.”
Neaku etamanya apa Isaak Gera.

Ore peyie eikilikuan ilewa leine imbaa naipirta enkitok enye, nejo ninye “Enkanashe ai ninye.” Amu eturia ninye ejo, “Enkitok ai” edamu ajo, “Keidim ilewa leine ataar ninye metua te nkaraki Rebeka,” amu aisidai ninye oleng te nidol.
Ore peyie ebik Isaak teine enkata naado eturumishe te lusie Abimelek olaiguanani loo Lfilisti, nedol Isaak eirrapirap Rebeka enkitok enye.
Neipot Abimelek Isaak nejoki, “Nyorriki ime enkitok ino, kaji inkuna peyie itejo ‘Enkanashe ai ninye’?” Nejoki Isaak ninye, “Amu atadamua ajo, ‘Peyie maye te nkaraki ninye,’ ”
Nejo Abimelek, “Kainyoo ena nintaasa iyiook? Keidim obo loo ltung'ana ashomo enetii enkitok ino, nipik iyiook entaboi te sunkuroisho.”
Neikok Abimelek iltung'ana pooki nejoki, “Ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie ele tung'ani anaa enkitok enye naa keari metua.”
Neunisho Isaak teinakop ilo ari, neikesisho katitin iip aitulus enatuunishe. Nemayian Olaitoriani ninye.
Neaku apa ninye karsis neponari imasaa oleng oleng, ometaa olkarsis.
Keeta apa ntare kumok o luaat oo nkishu o lmarei sapuk ometaa etoduakita Ilfilisti olom.
Nenuk Ilfilisti nchorroi pooki te nterit apa naatuturo ilaisiaayiak le menye aa Abraham.
Nejoki Abimelek Isaak, “Shomo tung'uai iyiook, amu itaa magilani oleng te iyiook.”
Neaku eidurra apa Isaak teine, nelo apik olng'obor lenye oerata le Gera nebik teine.
Neitoki Isaak atur nena shorroi oo nkariak naatuturoki apa too nkolong'i e Papaai lenye, Abraham, amu etapalaitie Ilfilisti ninche peyie eye Abraham. Neisho sii inkarn apa naishoo menye.
Kake ore peyie eidip ilaisiaayiak le Isaak aatuturisho te yarrata netum teine enchorro e nkare naijirrijirru.
Neishankarrarre ilchekuti le Gera ilchekuti le Isaak aajoki, “Enaang ena are.” Neaku eipoto Isaak ina shorro enkare ajo Esek, amu eishankarrarre ninche ninye.
Neitoki ninche aatur ae shorro, neitoki ake aishankarrarre ninye teina aaigil, neaku eipoto enkarna enye ajo Sitina.
Neidur teine atur ae shorro, neitu ejing enchankar ina, neaku eipoto enkarna eina ajo Rehobot ejo, “Ore tena kata eitaikia iyiook Olaitoriani ewueji nelala, naa aikibul te nkop.”
Nepuku Isaak teine ailep alo Beer-sheba.
Neipang'aki Olaitoriani ninye ina kewarie nejoki, “Kara nanu Enkai e Abraham papaai lino, miureishoyu amu atii tenebo iyie, naa kaamayian iyie naitubul eishoi ino te nkaraki osinka lai Abraham.”
Neaku etesheta Isaak olperere lo lasar teine neipot enkarna Olaitoriani, neun olng'obor lenye teine, Netur ilaisiaayiak le Isaak enchorro enkare teine.
Neitoki Abimelek adumunye alo enetii Isaak eing'uaa Gera tenebo o Ahusa olautaroni lenye tenebo o Fikol olkitok lenye le njore.
Nejoki Isaak ninche, “Kainyoo peyie ietuo enatii nadolita ajo aikimbaba intae nanu, nikitaaraitie aitung'uaa ate?”
Nejo ninche, “Kidolita tukul aajo ketii Olaitoriani tenebo iyie metaa kitejo, inchoo maitayu olmumai te rishata ino o iyiook naa maitayu sii olning'o o iyie,
inchere mintaas iyiook intorrok anaa eneitu kiseyie iyie neitu kintaas iyie entorroni meteleku eseriani ake nikincho iyie shomo te seriani. Ira taata iyie olomayiana lo Laitoriani.”
Metaa eitobiraka Isaak ninche osirua, nedaa neokisho.
Ore peyie ekenyu, neinyototo ninche enasirie aanya pooki olmumai, neisho Isaak ninche meshomo, nepuo aaing'uaa ninye to sotua.
Ore ake teina olong nepuonu ilaisiaayiak le Isaak aaliki ninye enchorro e nkare natuturo nejoki ninye,
“Kinotito enkare.” Neisho enkarna ine aajo shiba, metaa ore enkarna eina anasa naa keji Beer-sheba ometabaiki ena olong.
Ore peyie eaku Esau oloo larin artam, eyama Yudit entito e Beeri loo Lhiti tenebo o Basemat entito e Elon oo Lhiti.
Nepik emion enkishui e Isaak o Rebeka.
Ore apa peyie eaku Isaak moruo oleng metaa eiliilaitie inkonyek metaa meekure edolisho neipotu Esau olkikau lenye, nejoki ninye, “Enkerai ai” neng'amaa menye ajoki, “Nele nanu.”
Nejoki Isaak ninye idolita ajo atamorua nemayiolo enkolong naye.
Tudumu imasaa inono, emootian ino tenebo o enkawuo ino, nilo ong'ata pee kilo ang'oroki eng'ues.
Nikintobiraki endaa namelok, anaa enoshi nanyor, nikiyaki mainosa peyie aatum atamayiana eton eitu aye.
Ore apa Rebeka, einining'ito Isaak egira airorie olayioni lenye Esau. Metaa ore peyie edumunye Esau alo ong'ata ang'or eng'ues, nayau
nejoki Rebeka olayioni lenye Yakobo “Atoning'o papaai lino eirorie olalashe lino Esau ejoki,
‘Iyakaki eng'ues nikilotu aitobiraki endaa sidai. Natum ainosa naamayian iyie te dukuya Olaitoriani eton eitu aye.’
Ore naa tena kata olayioni lai, toning'o ororei lai anaa enaaitanap ajoki.
Shomo intare, niking'uraki ilkuoo le kineji aare sidain, peyie aitobirie endaa namelok sidai naaijo enoshi nanyor papaai lino.
Niyaki ninye papaai lino meinosa peyie kitum atamayiana eton eitu eye.”
Kake etiaaka Yakobo Rebeka ng'otonye, “Ng'ura ajo ore Esau olalashe lai naa oltung'ani oju, nara nanu oltung'ani osipa.
Keidimayu naairrapirrap papa nanu, natiu nanu anaa oltung'ani olej ninye, nayaki kewan oldeket ajo emayianata aing'oru.”
Nejoki ng'otonye ninye, “Inchoo oldeket lino elotu shumata nanu enkerai ai, toning'o ake iyie ororei lai nikilo aing'uraki lelo kuoo.”
Nelo Yakobo ayau ninche ayaki ng'otonye, neitobir ng'otonye endaa sidai namelok naaijo enoshi nanyor Isaak.

Neishopoki Rebeka inkilani sidan e Esau olkikau lenye, naata tiaji, olayioni lenye oti Yakobo, neripaki indapan oo ilkineji inkaik enyena tenebo emurt enye nasipa. Neisho ninye endaa sidai namelok tenebo emukate naitobira olayioni lenye Yakobo.
Ore nena dapan oo ilkineji nepik inkaik enyena o ine wueji nesipa te murt enye;
neisho ninye endaa sidai namelok tenebo emukate naitobiraka apik inkaik o layioni lenye Yakobo.
Metaa eshomo Yakobo ajing'aki menye nejoki, “Papa”. Neng'amaa ajoki, “Nele nanu, ira ng'ae enkerai ai?”
Nejoki Yakobo menye, “Nanu doi Esau olkikau lino. Aidipa ataasa anaa enikitiaaka. Inyo totona inosa inkiri oo ng'uesi aainei peyie kitum atamayiana.”
Kake etiaaka Isaak olayioni lenye, “Kaji doi inkuna peyie itasioko taata atum olayioni lai?” Newaliki Yakobo ajoki, “Amu aaishoo Olaitoriani Enkai ina dupoto.”
Ina pee ejoki Isaak Yakobo, “Wou tinyiku, peyie atum airrapirrapa ajur enkerai ai, matayiolo katukul metii olng'ash ajo ira olayioni lai Esau anaa aimira.”
Neigutaki Yakobo Isaak papaai lenye. Neirrapirrap ninye nejo, “Ore oltoilo naa oltoilo le Yakobo, kake ore inkaik naa ine Esau.”
Neitu eyiolou ninye amu ore inkaik enyena naa keju anaa ino lalashe lenye Esau, neaku etamayiana ninye.
Nejo Isaak, “Aira hoo doi olayioni lai Esau?” Newaliki Yakobo ajoki, “Ekara.”
Ina peyie ejo Isaak, “Iyakaki nanu endaa peyie atum ainosa, inkiri oo ng'uesi o layioni lai naatum atamayiana.” Neyau Yakobo ayaki ninye, nenya ninye, neyaki ninye enaisho oo sabibu neok ninye.
Ina peyie ejoki Isaak olayioni lenye, “Wou tinyikakaki tung'ututaki olayioni lai.”
Metaa etinyikua Yakobo neng'utut menye neing'uaya olng'usil too nkilani enyena, nemayian ninye ejoki, “Ing'ura olng'usil lo layioni lai otiu anaa olng'usil liong'ata otamayiana Olaitoriani.
Mikinchoo Enkai enkolielio e keper, tenebo empiron e nkop, tenebo o enkikesare sapuk o enaisho oo sabibu.

Inchoo kisiaai iyie iloreren, nikigilaki kung iyie iloshon. Taa olkitok too lalashera linono, naa inchoo ilayiok le ng'utunyi kirrugokino iyie. Metedeki pooki ng'ae likidek, nemayiani pooki ng'ae likimayian iyie!”
Ore ake aa enaidipie Isaak atamayiana Yakobo, ore ake enaipang'ie Yakobo aing'uaa ine netii Isaak Papaai lenye, nejing'u olalashe lenye Esau eing'uaa eng'orore.
Neitobir sii ninye endaa sidai namelok, neyau ayaki papaai lenye. Nejoki menye “Papaai, inyo nosa inkiri e ng'ues pee kitum atamayiana.”
Neng'amaa papaai lenye Isaak ajoki ninye, “Ira doi ng'ae?” Newaliki ajoki, “Nanu doi olayioni lino, olkikau lino Esau.”
Netum Isaak olokirikiri sapuk le ng'oro nejo ninye; “Aing'ae doi naaji otang'oro eng'ues naayaki nanu, nainosa pooki eton eitu ibau, naidipa atamayiana ninye? Nesipa ee, naa kemayiana ninye.”
Ore peyie ening Esau irorei le papaai lenye neishir abuaku to ltoilo sapuk o te mion, nejoki papaai lenye, “Oi tamayianaki sii nanu, nchooki sii nanu emayianata ino, papaai lai!”
Kake etiaaka Isaak Esau, “Eewuo olalashe lino to losek, neewa emayianata ino.”

Nejo Esau, “Aime keji doi te sipata etejoki enkarna enye Yakobo? Naaeseka ninye nanu kuna katitin are. Ewa apa ninye esipata ai e kikausho, naa ng'ura ake ajo enyaaka tena kata aya emayianata ai.” Ina peyie ejoki “Keitu hoo ninye kilekaki nanu emayianata?”

Newaliki Isaak Esau ajoki, “Ing'ura ajo aitaa ninye olkitok lino, naa ore ilalashera lenyena, aishoo ninye meitaa isinkan, naa too lpaek tenebo enaisho oo sabibu aitotio ninye. Kaa naa taata aaitaas enkerai ai?”
Nejoki Esau papaai lenye, “Ke mayianata nabo duoo ake iata papaai lai? Oi tamayianaki sii nanu, nchooki sii nanu emayianata ino, papaai lai!” Neilepie Esau oltoilo lenye neishir.
Newaliki Isaak papaai lenye Esau ajoki, “Iyaku ololamita empiron e nkop te manyisho ino, niaku sii ololamita enkoileelio e keper e shumata.
Keaku olalem lino ninye inchuyie, niaku oloisiaai olalashe lino, naa tinigelunye te nkitoria enye, nigil enchata oo lmong'i natii emurt ino.”

Ore ina kata, neibayu Esau Yakobo te nkaraki emayianata natamayiana papaai lenye ninye. Nejo Esau to ltau lenye. “Etabautua inkolong'i naishiraki papaai, ore peyie eishunye natum ataara metua olalashe lai Yakobo.”

Kake ore irorei le Esau ilo ayioni lenye botor etolikioki Rebeka; metaa eirriwayie Rebeka ilkiliku meipoti ilo ayioni lenye oti, Yakobo nejoki ninye, “Ing'ura, ore olalashe lino Esau, eitagolito kewan oshoke pee kitum atara tua.
Metaa ore tena kata enkerai ai toning'o oltoilo lai tudumunye isikaki enetii Laban olalashe lai otii Haran,
niton tenebo ninye te nkiti rishata, ometaba anaa neyagaa engoro napi o lalashe lino;
o metaba anaa nerrinyo engoro olalashe lino. Nerikino enintaasa ninye, naa kairriu olkilikuai mikitorikuni teine. Kainyoo peyie aiturraa intae pookira te keeya te nkolong nabo?”

Ina peyie ejoki Rebeka Isaak, “Enaure enkishui ai te nkaraki kuna kituaak oo Lhiti. Teneyam sii ninye Yakobo nabo o nkituaak oo Lhiti naaijo kuna, nabo oo nkituaak ena kop, kainyoo tipat enkishui te nanu?”
Neitoki Isaak aipot Yakobo, nemayian ninye, neitanap ejoki, “Mayieu niyam hoo nabo oo nkituaak oo Lkanaan.
Inyo tudumunye shomo Padan Aram enkaji e Betuel laa ninye otoiwuo yeyioo lino, niyau aitaa enkitok teine entito nabo e Laban olalashe yieyioo lino.
Mikitamayiana Enkai Magilani, nikintubul aponaa, metaa iaku olorere kumok too ltung'ana.
Mikinchoo ninye iyie emayianata e Abraham o tenebo eishoi ino, niaku oloya enkop nitaayie omoni naishoo Enkai Abraham!”
Neisho Isaak Yakobo meshomo. Nelo Padan Aram enetii Laban olayioni le Betuel le Aram, naa olalashe le Rebeka ng'otonye Yakobo o tenebo Esau.
Etoduaa apa Esau ajo etamayiana Isaak Yakobo neisho ninye meshomo Padan Aram meing'oru enkitok teine. Netamayiana sii neitanap ajoki, “Mayieu niyam enkitok hoo nabo oo Lkanaan,”
netoning'o Yakobo menye o ng'otonye nelo Padan Aram.
Metaa ore peyie edol Esau ajo eitu eitiship nena kituaak oo Lkanaan papaai lenye Isaak;
nelo Esau enetii Ishmael, neyam aitaa enkitok, aponaa te nena kituaak naata, Mahalat entito e Ishmael, olayioni le Abraham; enkanashe e Naboiot.
Neing'uaa Yakobo Beer-sheba alo enkalo e Haran.
Nelotu ewueji neje, neirrag ine ina kewarie, amu etadoyie enkolong nedumu osoit obo teine airishunye elukunya enye neirrag teine airura.
Ore eirura, netum enkidetidet naitodolu olkedet ororita enkop, ore enchumata enye nebaiki keper, nedol ilmalaika le Nkai oodou neilep te ilo kedet.

Nedol Olaitoriani eitashe te nchumata ninye, nejo ninye, “Ara nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai e Abraham papaai lino, nara sii Enkai e Isaak, naa ore ena kop naa ninye irragie, ekaaisho nanu iyie tenebo o eishoi ino.

Naa kebayu eishoi ino anaa enterit enkop naa aiponari aibulaa aidapashakino enkop te nkalo o loontoluo, o te nkalo o loosaen, o te nkalo e moikuape o te nkalo e kopikop; naa te iyie tenebo o eishoi ino emayiani iloshon le nkop pooki.
Tadamu ajo atii nanu te nebo iyie naa kaarrip iyie te pooki wueji naba anaa enilo, naaitoki arrinyu ena kop, amu maaing'uaa nanu iyie o metaba anaa naas ina naatolikio.”
Neinyototo Yakobo too njio enyena nejo, “Kesipa ketii Olaitoriani ene wueji, neitu duoo ayiolou.”
Neureishoyu oleng nejo, “Kebaa eitureisho ene wueji! Meeta duoo inchere paa dikae ene wueji neme enkaji e Nkai, naa enkishomi najing'ieki keper, ena.”
Neinyototo Yakobo tadekenya enasirie, neya oladuoo soit oirishunye elukunya enye neitasheyie aitaa eng'ape nebukoki eilata shumata ninye.
Neipot enkarna eine wueji ajo Betel, kake keji apa enkarna e ina anasa Lus te dukuya.
Nenya Yakobo olmumai ajo, “Tenaa keaku Enkai tenebo nanu, naarrip nanu tena lototo, naaisho sii endaa nanya o nkilani naishop
metaa anyaaka arrinyunye enkaji e papa lai te seriani, naa keaku Olaitoriani Enkai ai.
Ore ele soit laitasheyie aitaa eng'ape, naa keaku enkaji Enkai, ore pooki nikincho nanu naa kaaisho iyie ematua e tomon.”
Nedumunye Yakobo aibung enkoitoi alo, nebau enkop oo ltung'ana oomanya oloosaen.

Ore eing'orisho, nedol enchorro ti ong'ata, ore ake sii, nedol iluaat uni oo nkishu o nkerrai eirrag te mbata eina shorro amu teina shorro eokokinyieki enkare naok. Netii osoit sapuk enkutuk enchorro.

Naa tenereuni nkerrai pooki meirraga teine, neibeleleng'oo ilchekuti ilo soit te nkutuk enchorro peyie etum aishoo ntare enye enkare. Ore ake peyie eidip aaitooko pooki, neitoki aiken enchoro teilo soit aapik enkutuk enchorro.
Nejoki Yakobo lelo shekuti “Ilalashera laainei, kaji doi ing'uaa?” Nejo ninche, “King'uaa Haran.”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Amaa iyiololo Laban olayioni le Nahor?” Nejo ninche, “Aikiyiolo ninye.”
Nejoki Yakobo ninche “Aisupat ninye?” Neng'amaa aajo, “Ee aisupat, naa ore entito enye Raheli elotu ereuta ntare!” Nejo Yakobo,
“Ore amu eton aa enaipirie enkolong, eton mme nkata naiturrurri nkerrai aaokoki enkare peyie etum aashom aatadaata.”
Kake etejo lelo shekuti, “Mikintook omeiturrurroto nkerrai pooki tenebo, nikimbeleleng'oo osoit te nkutuk e nchorro nikitum aaitooko inkerrai.”
Ore eton eirorie ninche, nebau Raheli ereuta ntare e papaai lenye aa ninye nairritita.

Ore peyie edol Yakobo Raheli entito e Laban olalashe ng'otonye tenebo nkerrai e Laban olalashe ng'otonye, nelo Yakobo aibeleleng'oo osoit te nkutuk enchorro, neitook inkerrai e Laban, olalashe ng'otonye.
Neng'utut Yakobo Raheli eishir abuaku te nchipai.
Neliki Yakobo Raheli ajoki ole sotua, naa olayioni le Rebeka. Neipirri Raheli ang alo aliki menye.
Ore peyie ening Laban ilomon le Yakobo olayioni le nkanashe, neipirri alo anang'are ninye, neitamuat ninye inkaik neng'utut neriku ninye enkaji enye. Neliki Yakobo Laban kuna baa pooki,
neaku etiaaka Laban ninye, “Kesipa tukul ajo ira osarge lai, nira sii osesen lai!” Neton aboitare ninye olapa.
Neitoki Laban ajoki Yakobo, “Ore amu ira ole sotua, aikisiaai iyie nanu pesho? Tolikioki ajo kainyoo elaata niyieu naalaaki?”
Eeta apa Laban ntoyie are, neji entito botor Lea neji entito kiti Raheli.
Aitorrok apa nkonyek e Lea, ore Raheli naa aisidai neikishiaan.
Nenyorru Yakobo Raheli ometejo, “Ekaaisiaai iyie ilarin oopishana te nkaraki Raheli ina tito ino kiti.”
Nejo Laban, “Enaikash te naaisho iyie alang te naisho ninye likae lee; totona tenebo nanu.”
Neaku eisiaayia apa Yakobo Laban ilarin oopishana te nkaraki Raheli, netiu lelo arin anaa inkolong'i kuti te nkaraki enyorrata sapuk naata te ninye.
Neitoki Yakobo ajoki Laban, “Inchooki nanu enkitok ai peyie alo ayiolou ninye, amu aitabayie enkata ai.”
Neiturrurru Laban iltung'ana pooki leine, neitayu osirua
kake ore teipa ewa entito enye Lea ayaki ninye Yakobo; neboitare Yakobo ninye ina kewarie.
(Eishooyie Laban enkaisiaayiani enye Silpa, aisho Lea entito enye metaa enkaisiaayiani enye.)
Ore peyie ekenyu nedol Yakobo ajo Lea ng'ole eishooki, Nejoki Yakobo Laban, “Kainyoo ena nikintaasa nanu? Aime enaji Raheli doi apa aaisiayie? Kainyoo naa peyie kiteleja iyie nanu?”
Neng'amaa Laban ejo, “Measi oshi neijia te nkop ang, aaishooyo entito kiti eton eitu eishoori enkikau.
Iishu e wiki ena, naa aikintoki aaisho iyie enkae tinikisiaai kulikae arin oopishana.”
Neas Yakobo ina, neishu ewiki enye; neaku neisho Laban ninye Raheli ina tito enye meitaa enkitok.
(Eishooyie Laban enkaisiaayiani enye Bilha, aisho Raheli entito enye metaa enkaisiaayiani enye.)
Neaku enyaaka sii Yakobo alo aboitare Raheli nenyorru Raheli oleng aitalang enanyor Lea neisiaai Laban kulikae arin oopishana.
Ore peyie edol Olaitoriani ajo keibai Lea, nebol enguset enye, kake ore apa Raheli naa koolupi.
Nenutayu Lea neiu enkayioni neipot ninye enkarna ajo Ruben, amu etejo, “Te nkaraki natoduaa Olaitoriani enkisilisiloto ai, nesipa taata ajo ekaanyoru olpayian lai.”
Neitoki ake anutayu, neiu enkayioni, nejo, “Te nkaraki natoning'o Olaitoriani ajo kaaibai naaisho ena ayioni aigil.” Neipot enkarna enye ajo Simon.
Neitoki ake anutayu neiu enkayioni nejo, “Ore taata naa kaaibung'are olpayian lai, amu atoikio ninye ilayiok okuni.” Ina peyie eipot enkarna enye ajo Lawi.
Neitoki anutayu neiu enkayioni nejo “Ore taata naa kaisis Olaitoriani,” metaa eipoto ninye enkarna ajo Yuda, ina pee edung eishoi.
Ore peyie edol Raheli ajo eitu eiki Yakobo inkera, netum olom te nkanashe enye oleng, nejoki ninye Yakobo, “Nchooki nanu inkera ashu aye!”
Negorokino Yakobo Raheli nejoki ninye, “Katii nanu ewueji Enkai nikitomitikio eishoi e nguset ino?”
Ina peyie ejo Raheli, “Neina enkaisiaayiani ai Bilha; shomo enetii peyie aaiki nanu nkera.”
Metaa eishoo ninye Yakobo enkaisiaayiani enye Bilha meitaa enkitok. Nelo Yakobo ayiolou ninye.
Neiroshiu Bilhah neiki Yakobo olayioni.
Ina peyie ejo Raheli, “Aatudung'oko Enkai enkiguana, netoning'o sii oltoilo lai naaisho nanu enkayioni.” Neaku eipoto enkarna enye ajo Dan.
Neitoki errindik e Raheli anutayu neiki Yakobo olayioni li are.
Ina peyie ejo Raheli, “Te nkesha nagol atigilunore enkanashe ai natimirishe;” neipot enkarna enye ajo Naftali.
Ore peyie edol Lea ajo etudunge meekure eisho, neisho sii ninye enkaisiaayiani enye Silpa Yakobo meitaa enkitok.
Neiki ina rrindik e Lea naji Silpa Yakobo olayioni.
Nejo Lea, “Atumunyana!” Metaa eishoo enkarna enye ajo Gad.
Neigil ake errindik e Lea naji Silpa aiki Yakobo ae ayioni e are.
Ina pee ejo Lea, “Kashipa nanu! Amu kaaipot nanu inkituaak aajo nashipa.” Ina pee eipot enkarna enye ajo Asheri.

Ore too nkolong'i e nkikesare e nkano eshomo Ruben olokeri neinepu nkaitubulu naaji tunkuja tiong'ota, neyaki ng'otonye Lea. Ina peyie ejoki Raheli Lea “Inchooki aatasayia embata oo nkaitubulu e tunkuja e nkayioni ino.”

Kake etiaaka Lea ninye, “Ijo doi kembae kiti tinikioru olpayian lai? Iyieu sii nintoki aya tunkuja o layioni lai?” Nejo Raheli, “Inchoo naa meirraga enitii ena kewarie te nkaraki tunkuja olayioni lino.”

Ore peyie eshukunye Yakobo tiong'ata teipa, eshomo Lea anang'are ninye nejoki ninye, “Meeta nchere peyie mikilotu taata ayiolou, amu aainyiang'ua iyie te tunkuja o layioni lai.” Metaa etaboitare Yakobo Lea ina kewarie.
Nening Enkai Lea, nenutayu neiki Yakobo olayioni le imiet.
Nejo Lea, “Aishoo Enkai elaakinoto ai amu aishooyie errindik ai aisho olpayian lai;” neipot enkarna ajo Isachar.
Neitoki Lea anutayu, neiki Yakobo enkayioni e ile,
ina peyie ejo Lea, “Aaishoo Enkai enkishooroto sapuk; ekaayanyitu taata olpayian lai, amu atoikio ninye ilayiok ile;” neipot enkarna enye ajo Sebulon.
Neitoki ake te siadi aiu entito neipot enkarna enye ajo Dina.
Neitoki Enkai adamu Raheli, nening Enkai ninye nebol enguset.
Nenutayu neiu enkayioni nejo, “Eiwuangie Enkai esulare ai,”
neipot enkarna enye ajo Yosef ejo, “Maatoponiki Olaitoriani ae ayioni.”
Ore peyie eiki Raheli Yakobo Yosef, nejoki ninye Laban, “Inchooki nanu mashomo, pee atum ashomo enkang ai o enkop ai.
Inchooki inkituaak aainei tenebo nkera aainei nena naisiaayua te iyie nikincho mashomo amu iyiolo esiaai naataasaka.”
Kake etiaaka Laban ninye, “Tenaa aikincho matejo ena, atayiolo te limunoto o laitumusumusoni inchere aatamayiana Olaitoriani te nkaraki iyie.
Tolimu elaakinoto ino naa kaishoru.”
Nejoki Yakobo ninye, “Iyiolo iyie openy enaikuna tenaaisiaai, niyiolo sii eneikuna inkishu inono peyie eponari te nanu.
Amu aikuti apa imasaa inono enalotunye, netoponari aaku kumok, nikitamayiana iyie Olaitoriani te pooki wueji naibelekenyakine. Paa amaa kanu kenya nanu agolie olmarei lai makewan?”
Nejo Laban, “Kainyoo iyieu naaisho?” Nejo Yakobo, “Meeta entoki nikincho tinikintaas ena, ekaitoki ake aaku oloirrita naramat aing'or intare inono.
“Nchooki matijing'a atua intare inono ena olong aitayu tiatua pooki ker naata oltipoto anaa nairimo o pooki kuoo le ker orok, tenebo pooki kine oirimo tiatua inkineji; neaku nena elaakinoto ai.

Metaa esipata ai ninye naawalaki te siadi, tinilotu aing'or elaakinoto ai te iyie. Ore pooki nemeeta oltipoto nemeirimo sii tiatua inkineji, nerok sii tiatua lkuoo le kerra metaa tenelo netumi te nanu, neikenari aajo kepurruno.”
Nejo Laban, “Aisidai! Inchoo etiu anaa enitejo.”
Kake ore ina olong, eitayio Laban iloroi pooki ootipo neirrimo tenebo inkineji pooki naaitipo neirimo, pooki ake ninye naata eneibor o pooki sitima lo lker orok, neisho ilayiok lenyena metaramata.
Nelo Laban alamari elakuani oo nkolong'i uni elototo te rishata enye o Yakobo; neirrita Yakobo kulie tare pooki e Laban.
Neitayu Yakobo ing'usidin naashal too lkeek oonyaanyukie olporokuai o seki o siteti nekinyu nkopit e oriong te nena keek metaa kelio ing'udisin eibor.
Nepik nena ng'usidin naatikinya te dukuya ntare too mpeuti aa taa, ine neokishoreki, ine nepuonu ntare aaokie enkare. Amu kesesh etonie ilmeregeshi anaa iloroi intare teine.
Neraposhoyu intare te dukuya nena ng'usidin metaa etoiutuo ilkuoo oo rasha, o loo tipo, o loo nkererin.
Negelaa Yakobo isitiman, neing'orie inkomomi oo ntare enkalo natii inaarasha tenebo inaarook pooki naatii tiatua intare e Laban; neitalamaa inenyena, neitu eitushulaki ine Laban.
Ore enkata pooki natonie ilmeregeshi anaa iloroi intare biot, neirragie Yakobo ing'usidin too mpeuti te dukuya ninche peyie etum aatotonie intare te nena ng'usidin,
kake ore nena sasin too ntare, eitu eirragie ing'usidin teine; metaa ore nena sasin neaku ine Laban ore inaapir neaku ine Yakobo.
Metaa etaa Yakobo karsis oleng, netum intare luaat kumok o nkaisiaayiak o ilaisiaayiak o intamesin o sirkon.
Etoning'o apa Yakobo ilayiok le Laban ejo, “Ewa Yakobo pooki apa naara ine papa lang; ore sii te nena pooki apa naara ine papa lang, nenoto ninye ena karsisisho.”
Nedol Yakobo ajo meekure enyor Laban ninye anaa apa te dukuya.
Ina peyie ejoki Olaitoriani Yakobo, “Torrinyoyu enkop oo loo papaai lino, tushukokinoyu iltung'ana linono naa kaaku nanu tenebo iyie.”
Neirriwaa Yakobo olkilikuai aipotu Raheli tenebo Lea meetu ina ong'ata natii ntare enyena.
Nejoki ninche, “Kadolita taata ajo meekure aanyor papaai linyi anaa apa. Kake etii Enkai e papaai lai tenebo nanu.
Iyiololo aajo aisiaaiyia papaai linyi te ngolon ai pooki;
ore ake eyia, aateleja papaai linyi aibelekeny olekoisiaayio lai katitin tomon, kake eitu eisho Enkai ninye maaitamio.

Ore pee ejo, ‘Ore pooki tare naaitipo naa keaku olekoisiaayio lino,’ ina pee eiu intare pooki inaata iltipot; naa tenejo, ninye, ‘Naata nkererin naaku olekoisiaayio lino,’ neiu intare pooki naata nkererin.
Metaa neijia eikuna Enkai aya inkishu e papaai linyi naaisho ninche nanu.
Ore te nkata nadumu iloroi anaa ilmaregeshi intare, atejo adumu inkonyek aainei nadol te nkidetidet inchere ore iloroi pooki oodumu intare naa ilooata nkererin o iltipot nerasha neirrimo.
Ina peyie aajoki olmalaika le Nkai te nkidetidet, ‘Yakobo,’ nang'amaa ajo, ‘Nele nanu!’
Nejo ninye, ‘Tushumu inkonyek inono ing'orisho, ore inkineji pooki naaitigiran tiaatua intare naa keeta nkererin, neeta iltipot nerasha; amu atoduaa nena pooki nikintaasa Laban iyie.
Kara nanu Enkai e Betel, ine wueji apa nintisinyie osoit abukoki eilata nikinosie sii olmumai. Ore tena kata inyo shomo tung'uai ena kop nirrinyo alo enkop apa nikitoinyieki.’ ”
Ina pee ewalaki Raheli o Lea aajoki ninye, “Ketii ae rubata aashu enjung'ore natung'ueikiaki iyiook te nkaji e papa lang?
Amaa taata iyiook emeitaa iyiook ilomon? Amu etimira iyiook, netaasishore impisai naaishoruaki te nkaraki iyiook.
Ore nena masaa pooki naawa Enkai aitung'uaa papaai lang eishoo metaa inkunaang o nkera ang, ore tena kata, ore pooki nikijoki Enkai iyie, taasa.”
Neinyototo Yakobo neitaked ilayiok lenyena o nkituaak enyena intamesin,
nereu ninye aidurrie inkishu enyena pooki, tenebo imasaa enyena pooki naanoto, inkishu enyena naanoto te Padan Aram, pee epuo enkop e Kanaan enetii papaai lenye Isaak.
Ore pee elo Laban adung ilpapit loo nkerra enyena, ore Raheli nepurroo inkaitin enkaji e papaai lenye.
Neluaya Yakobo eitu eliki Laban le Aram, ajoki ekeisikita alo.
Neisik ninye o nena masaa pooki naata, neinyototo alang olkeju le Frati, neitoriokino oldoinyo le Gilead.
Ore peyie elikini Laban te enkolong e uni inchere eisika Yakobo,
nerik iltung'ana lenyena le sotua, nepuo aasuj ninye inkolong'i naapishana esuj aigutaki ninye oleng to ldoinyio le Gilead.
Kake eewuo Enkai enetii Laban le Aram te nkidetidet kewarie nejoki ninye, “Toduaa ake kewan mijoki Yakobo ororei hoo obo sidai aashu torrono.”
Neinepu Laban Yakobo. Ore ina kata eidipa Yakobo atuuno olng'obor lenye te nkop oo ldoinyio, ore Laban o ltung'ana lenyena le sotua neun ilng'oborri too ldoinyo le Gilead.
Nejoki Laban Yakobo, “Kaa ena nikintaasa peyie kilotu alej aiko nji, niya intoyie aainei anaa iyarunot o lalem?
Kainyoo peyie isika apurrorri, nikilej nanu, neitu kiliki nanu, metaa anaata aaishoo iyie shomo te nchipai o too sinkolioitin o te ntampuri o too lwululi loo usin?
Naa kainyoo peyie eitu kincho matung'ututa ilayiok laainei o ntoyie aainei aisho olesere? Itaasa tukul ene modai.
Ekaata engolon naaitameyie kake aairorie Enkai e papaai lino ena kewarie naajoki, ‘Toduaa ake kewan mijoki Yakobo ororei hoo obo sidai aashu torrono.’
Ishomo naa taata aidur te nkaraki niyieu oleng to ltau enkaji e papaai lino, kake kainyoo peyie itupurroyie inkaitin aainei?”
Newaliki Yakobo Laban ajoki, “Amu atureishe, atadamua ajo aikindim atooru intoyie inono te ngolon.

Ore ake ninye oltung'ani litum eeta inkaitin inono nemeitoki abik eishu. Ore te dukuya iltung'ana lang le sotua imbalunye entoki ino pooki naata pee iya.” Eitu eyiolou Yakobo ajo Raheli natupurroyie nena aitin.

Metaa etijing'a Laban olng'obor le Yakobo, neitoki alo olng'obor le Lea neitoki alo oloo nkaisiaayiak enyena pokira, neitu etum ninche katukul. Nepuku aing'uaa olng'obor le Lea, nejing olng'obor le Raheli.
Ore ina kata earr Laban ilng'oborri naa Raheli apa naawa inkaitin enkaji e Papaai lenye nepik abori olorika otonieki te ntames, netonie ninche. Near Laban olng'obor pooki, kake eitu etum ninche.
Nejoki Raheli Papaai, lenye, “Mincho olkitok lai egoro amu maaidim aitasho te dukuya iyie, amu kaata empukunoto oo nkituaak.” Metaa etuturuo aing'oru oleng neitu etum inkaitin enkaji enye tukul.
Neaku etagore Yakobo oleng oleng metaa keitarriki Laban, nejoki Yakobo Laban, “Kainyoo doi enkitarruorroto ai? Kainyoo eng'oki ai pee kitusujua te ngoro sapuk?

Ore hoo nitijing'a aidapash intokitin aainei, kainyoo inoto tiatua naara imasaa enkaji ino? Iyau irragie tene te dukuya iltung'ana laainei le sotua o te dukuya iltung'ana linono le sotua pee etum aatirrish iyiook pokira.
Kitaboitate tenebo o iyie kulo arin tikitam; neitu aikata eibiru isupeni e kerra inono anaa inkineji inono, neitu anya ilmeregeshi loo ntare inono.
Ore nena naainosa ing'uesi e ntim eitu aayaki, nanu otalaa, kintalaa pooki enatupurroyioki dama anaa kewarie.
Metaa neijia apa atiu aanya enkolong naa neijia etiu enkewarie, nemeekure apa atumoki aimula nkonyek airurayu.

Ore te kulo arin tikitam latotona te nkaji ino; naataasaka esiaai ilarin tomon oong'uan te nkaraki intoyie inono pokira are, naataasaka esiaai ilarin ile too ntare inono, nimbelekenya olekoisiaayio lai katitin tomon.

Tenaa aime Enkai duoo e papaai lai Enkai e Abraham tenebo o lturiaki le Isaak ootii enkalo ai, kesipa katukul inchere anaata kinchoo mashomo too nkaik naarook. Etoduaa Enkai osina lai tenebo o esiaai oo nkaik aainei, nikisikong ng'ole kewarie.”

Ina peyie ewalu Laban ajoki Yakobo, “Ore kuna toyie naa inaainei, ore kuna kera naa inaainei, ore kuna tare naa inaainei, naa ore pooki nidolita naa inaainei. Kake kaa naa aitaas kuna toyie aainei ena olong aashu inkera enye naatoiutuo ninche? Wou taata maitayu olning'o te rishata ai o iyie.
Ore iyie o nanu naa inchoo metijing'a shakeni erishata ang.”
Ina peyie eyau Yakobo osoit, neitasheyie aitaa eng'ape.
Nejoki Yakobo iltung'ana lenyena le sotua, “Entasotu isoito,” neyau pooki isoito neitayu osototi; nenya endaa te mbata e ilo sototi loo soito.
Neipot Laban ine ajo Yegarsahaduta, neipot ninye Yakobo ajo Gilead.
Nejo Laban, “Ore ele sototi loo soito naa shakeni te rishata ino o nanu tena olong.”
Metaa eipoto ine ajo Gilead, ore eng'ape nejo Mispa, nejo, “Inchoo meing'ura Olaitoriani erishata ai o enino, tinikipuo aalama,
Tinintanyamal intoyie aainei, anaa tiniyam kulie kituaak neme intoyie aainei, ore hoo nemetii likae lee ine oyiolo, tadamu ajo, Enkai ninye shakeni te rishata ai o iyie.”
Ina peyie ejoki Laban Yakobo, “Ing'ura ele sototi loo soito tenebo o eng'ape naitasheyie ena olong te dukuya iyie o nanu.
Ore ele sototi naa shakeni naa neijia etiu eng'ape, inchere migiru ele sototi loo soito, nimilang'u sii iyie ele sototi loo soito kilang'aki, neijia etiu eng'ape kilotu aitame nanu.
Ore Enkai e Abraham o Nkai e Nahor o Nkai oo papaai lenye inchoo metirisha iyiook.” Ina peyie enya Yakobo olmumai te uriata e papaai lenye, Isaak.
Neitayu Yakobo olasar to ldoinyo neipoti iltung'ana lenyena le sotua meinosa endaa, nenya endaa netoni enkewarie pooki te ilo doinyio.
Ore tadekenya enasirie, neinyototo Laban ayooki ang'utut inoo nkakuyiaa enyena tenebo o intoyie enyena nemayian ninche; nerrinyo alo enkang enye.
Nedumunye Yakobo alo arrinyo enkop enye, nenang'are ilmalaika le Nkai ninye.
Ore peyie edol Yakobo ninche, nejo, “Enjore e Nkai ena!” Neipot enkarna eine ajo Mahanaim.
Neirriwaa Yakobo ilkiliku meituruko aapuo enetii olalashe lenye Esau te nkop e Seir, natii enkop e Edom.
Neitaarriyian ninche nejoki, “Inji intae enchom entiaaki olkitok lai Esau inji ejo olaisiaayiani lino Yakobo, ‘Ataboitare Laban o taata,
naata ilmong'i o sirkon o ntare o laisiaayiak lewa o nkaisiaayiak ng'oruo nairriwua olkilikuai aliki olkitok lai, pee atum anoto omom too nkonyek inono.’ ”
Nerrinyunye lelo kiliku enetii Yakobo nejoki, “Kitabaikitia olalashe lino Esau, naa elotu ninye peyie kinang'are iyie nerikito ilewa iip ong'uan.”
Neureishoyu Yakobo oleng oleng netum enkiputukuny oleng, Neor lelo tung'ana apa ooboitare, neor inkishu o ntamesin, neitainye pooki ntukusi are edamu ajo,
“Tenelotu Esau aidaikie entukus nabo, neaku ore entukus natelekua neidim aisika.”
Nejo Yakobo, “Na Ai Enkai e papa lai Abraham naa Enkai e papa lai Isaak, Lo Aitoriani, ilo apa laatiaaka nanu, ‘Torrinyoyu shomo enkop ino enetii olorere lino le sotua, naa kaitaas iyie esidai,’
maaishiaakino nanu katukul ina nyorrata ino nauno, tenebo o ina kisiligata nintoduaa iyie osinka lino, amu te ng'udi ai ake atalang'a ele keju le Yordan; nataa taata iltimito oaare.
Tokorduaki nanu, aatoomono iyie, te nkaina olalashe lai, te nkaina e Esau, amu kaure nanu ninye melotu ake aar iyiook pooki matuata, inkera o noo ng'otonye.
Kake itejo, ‘Ekaaitaas iyie esidai, naisho eishoi ino metaba anaa osinyai le naiposha, nemeikenayu te nkumoi.’ ”
Metaa eirraga ine ina kewarie, neitayu te nena naata ninye enkishooroto naisho olalashe lenye Esau.
Inkineji iip are o oloroi tikitam o supeni e kerra iip are tenebo ilmeregeshi tikitam,
intamesin naalepo tomoni uni o nkurrarrun enye o nkishu artam tenebo iloing'ok tomon o sirkon lipong'a tikitam o lamuyeishi tomon.
Neitarasaa kuna too nkaik oo laisiaayiak lenyena, meeta ake ineitu erewi te luaata enye maate, nejoki sinkan lenyena, “Enchom enturuko ninchosho metaa ketii erishata eluaata ake o eluaata.”
Neitaarriyian olorikito pooki ajoki, “Ore te nenang'are intae Esau olalashe lai, nikinkilikuan ajoki, ‘Ira iyie oleng'ae? Kaji iloito? Naa einkuneng'ae kuna masaa nireutata?’
Naa ijokiki ninye, ‘Ino sinka lino Yakobo naa enkishooroto nairriwaka olkitok lai Esau, ore ake sii, elotu ninye te siadi ang.’ ”
Neitaarriyian ake sii ilo liare o ilo liokuni o lelo pooki ooreuta nena masaa nejoki, “Entiaaki Esau ina bae tininang'arere, ninye.

Naa ijokiki intae, ‘Ore ake sii, elotu osinka lino Yakobo te siadi.’ ” Amu etadamua Yakobo ajo, “Kaidim aitoborro ninye too nkishoorot naashomo te dukuya nanu, ore esuju ina naidim atoduaa enkomom enye, nebaiki naaidim atang'amai nanu.”
Metaa neiturukieki nkishoorot e Yakobo, ore ina kewarie neirrag ninye olng'obor.
Ore ake ina kewarie nedumunye Yakobo arik inkituaak enyena pokira are, o nkaisiaayiak enyena pokira are tenebo inkera enyena tomon oobo nelang te lang'ata e Yabok.
Neya ninche aitalang enkare, tenebo o pooki toki naba anaa enaata,
neing'uari Yakobo aa ninye ake. Ore ina kewarie etii oltung'ani otupupungare enkewarie pooki o metamanai esirua.
Ore peyie edol ilo tung'ani ajo eitu eidimu Yakobo, neiseyie oloudo le nkupes, nepuku enkupes e Yakobo te rubata oloudo ina kata epupung'are ilo tung'ani.
Ina peyie ejo oltung'ani, “Inchooki mashomo, amu ekenyua.” Kake etiaaka Yakobo, “Maaisho hoo ilo o metaba anaa nikimayian.”
Nejoki ninye, “Aikiji ng'ae enkarna?” Nejo, “Yakobo.”
Ina peyie ejoki “Mikintokini aekata aajo Yakobo, kake Israel, amu itekeshare Enkai tenebo o iltung'ana nisulie.”
Neitoki Yakobo aikilikuan ninye ajoki, “Tolikioki aatasayia enkarna ino.” Kake etiaaka, “Kainyoo doi peyie inkilikuanu enkarna ai?” Nemayian ninye teine.
Neipot Yakobo enkarna ine wueji ajo Peniel etejo, “Amu kitoduaate o Enkai too nkomomi, ore ake eyia neton aishu.”
Neilepaki enkolong egiroo Penuel, neitong'ojinari te nkaraki enkupes enye.
Ore ebaiki ina olong, menya Isiraeli emorloo o loudo; naatii enkong'u oloudo, te nkaraki naibung'a apa ilo tung'ani enkong'u oloudo le Yakobo o emorloo enye.
Neshumu Yakobo inkonyek enyena aing'orisho nedol Esau elotu nerikito iltung'ana iip ong'uan. Metaa etooro inkera aoriki Lea o Raheli o nkaisiaayiak enyena.
Nepik inkaisiaayiak tenebo inkera enye dukuya, ore Lea o nkera enyena o Raheli o Yosef nepuonu te siadi.
Ore ninye makewan neituruk te dukuya ninche, neirrugo abaiki enkop katitin naapishana o metaba anaa nenyiku olalashe lenye.
Kake ekuetua Esau alo anang'are olalashe, neng'utut ninye, nebatatakino emurt enye ang'utut, neishir pokira.
Ore peyie ehumu Esau nkonyek enyena nedol inkituaak o nkera, nejo ninye, “Kakua kuna nikiboitare?” Nejo Yakobo, “Inkera naaishoo Enkai to lng'ur osinka lino.”
Neitoki nena aisiaayiak aanyiku, ninche tenebo inkera enye, neirrugo aabaiki enkop;
neitoki Lea tenebo inkera enyena aabau aanyiku neirrugo aabaiki enkop; ore te bayie e pooki nenyiku Yosef o Raheli, neirrugokino aabaiki enkop.
Nejo Esau, “Kainyoo eutu ele orora pooki lainepua?” Newal Yakobo ajo, “Pee atum omom te dukuya nkonyek olkitok lai.”
Kake etejo Esau, “Ekaata inaabaiki, olalashe lai, intaa pooki niata ininono.”

Nejo Yakobo, “A'a, aatasayia, tenaa kanoto omom too nkonyek inono, neaku tang'amai naa enkishooroto ai too nkaik aainei, amu kesipa tenajo ore enduaata natoduaa enkomom ino netiu anaa enduaata natoduaa enkomom e Nkai amu te nyorrata natiu neijia kitang'amua nanu.
Tang'amai, aatasayia ina kishooroto ai nikiyakaki iyie, amu aaing'urrie Enkai oleng, naa kaata sii inaabaiki.” Ina peyie earaki Yakobo Esau meewa, nenyorraa ninye.
Neitoki Esau ajo, “Emaibung'a enkoitoi aapuo, naa kaituruk te dukuya iyie.”
Kake etiaaka Yakobo ninye, “Iyiolo olkitok lai ajo ore kuna ng'aturran naa kenana, naa nanu ogolie intare o nkishu tenebo ilasho lenye, naa te nerewi oleng enkolong nabo, naa keye imasaa pooki.
Inchoo olkitok lai egiroo osinka lenye, pee ariku ninche maakutiti te risioroto e lototo oo nkishu naatii dukuya nanu o te risioroto e lototo oo inkera, omatabau enetii olkitok lai te Seir.”
Nejo Esau, “Inchooki maatung'ueiki embata oo ltung'ana laainei laata tene.” Kake etejo, “Meeta tipat ning'uarie. Kayieu ake duoo natum omom te dukuya enkomom ino olkitok lai.”
Metaa etorrinye Esau ina olong alo Seir.
Kake eshomo Yakobo Sukot, neshetaki kewan enkaji neitayu ninye ilng'oborri loo nkishu enyena, metaa keji enkarna e ine wueji Sukot!
Nelotu Yakobo te Seriani o metabaiki enkanasa naji Shekem, natii ina kop e Kanaan eing'uaa Padan Aram, neun ilng'oborri te mbata enkanasa.
Neinyang'u too layiok le Hamor, aa papaai le Shekem too mpisai iip nabo esashati enkop naa ninye etuunie ilng'oborri lenyena.
Neshetu teine olperere lo lasar nedung'oki enkarna ine ajo El-Elohe Israel.
Nedumunye Dina entito e Lea natoikio ninye Yakobo alo aparan inkituaak eina kop;
ore peyie edol Shekem olayioni le Hamor le Hifi ilo kitok leina kop, neibung ninye te ngolon aikony nesul ninye.
Neng'uar ninye Dina oleng to ltau lenye ina tito e Yakobo; nenyorru ninye ina tito, neirorie ninye too rorei oobor.
Metaa eshomo Shekem airorie papaai lenye Hamor ajoki: “Ing'urakaki ena tito maitaa enkitok.”
Nening apa Yakobo ajo einyala shekem entito enye Dina; netii apa ilayiok lenyena nkishu ti ong'ata, negira Yakobo eitu ejo ae o metaba anaa nepuonu ninche.
Nelotu Hamor menye le Shekem enetii Yakobo airorie ninye.

Nejing'u ilayiok le Yakobo eing'uaa ong'ata peyie ening ilo omoni; negoro ninche oleng pee ening ina bae amu etaasa Shekem ina nayawuaesulare atua Siraeli aikony entito e Yakobo, amu ore embae naaijo ena nemeishiaakino neasi.
Kake eirorie Hamor ninche nejoki, “Etayiewua naleng oltau lo layioni lai Shekem entito ino; aatasayia, enchoo ninye meyama.
Emayamata maate, enchoo iyiook intoyie inyi; niyaya sii intae intoyie ang.
Nikishula aaku elatia, ore enkop neaku kebolokino intae, entamany nikiwal imasaa nitumutumu imasaa kumok.”
Nejoki ake sii ninye Shekem menye ina tito tenebo ilalashera lenyena, “Nchooki manoto omom te dukuya inkonyek inyi, naa ore pooki nikijokiki intae naa kaishoru.

Inkilikuanu te nanu imasaa pooki naaba anaa niyieu too nkishoorot, naa kaishoru te risioroto eina nikijokiki nanu, kake intabai ake ena naata to ltau, inchooki ake ninye nanu ena tito metaa enkitok ai.”
Newaliki ilayiok le Yakobo Shekem tenebo papaai lenye Hamor te ntorroni te nkaraki nainyala enkanashe enye Dina.
Etiakita ninche ninche, “Mikiindim iyiook aataas ena bae, aaisho enkanashe ang oltung'ani lememurata, amu keaku ina esulare te iyiook.
Pooki ake pee kinyorraa tiniasiasa ena: Tiniakuku ake anaa iyiook, ore pooki lee linyi nemurati.
Ina kata ake kinyorraa aaisho intae intoyie ang, nikiya sii iyiook intoyie inyi, nikiparana tenebo aaku olorere obo.
Naa tinimining'ining'i iyiook ninchosho metumurati intae, neaku aikiya entito ang, nikipuo aaidur.”
Neitiship irorei lenye Hamor o layioni lenye Shekem.
Neaku eitu eitoki ilo barnoti aitumutiki ina bae, amu etonyorra ninye ina tito e Yakobo. Naa ninye apa enyorri oleng aaitulus to lmarei pooki.
Metaa eshomo Hamor tenebo o olayioni lenye Shekem kishomi enkanasa enye neirorie ilewa le nkanasa enye nejoki,
“Ore kulo tung'ana naa iltung'ana supati, enchoo etoni tena kop nikimirakino intokitin, amu idolitata aajo kelala enkop oleng te ninche. Emayama intoyie enye nikincho sii ninche meyama intoyie ang.
Tena bae ake eidim kulo tung'ana aatonyorrai aatotoni tiatua iyiook, nikiaku olorere obo: pee emurati pooki lee tiatua iyiook anaa pee emurata ninche.
Aimeaku inkishu enye, o ntokitin enye o masaa enye pooki inkunaang? Ematonyorrai ake duoo ina nayieu, naa kemany ninche atua iyiook.”
Ore lelo pooki oimutua kishomi e nkanasa enye, nenyorraa nena pooki naatejo Hamor o Shekem metaa etumurataki pooki lee, o pooki ooimutua kishomi eina anasa.
Ore te nkolong e uni, aa enamuratieki neton emuoyiaa, nedumunye ilayiok aare le Yakobo, Simon o Lawi oong'arie kina Dina, neya ilalema lenye aarasaki enkanasa meyioloi, near lelo lewa pooki metuata.
Near Hamor metua tenebo o layioni lenye Shekem to lalem neitayu Dina aitung'uaa enkaji e Shekem, nepuo aaing'uaa.
Nedoiki ilayiok le Yakobo aar enkanasa, near iltung'ana metuata neya ntokitin te nkanasa amu einyalaki enkanashe enye.
Neya intare enye o nkishu enye o sirkon lenye o pooki toki ake ninye natii atua enkanasa o naatii nkurman.
Neya pooki toki naata tipat, o nkera enye pooki tenebo inkituaak enye, o pooki toki natii atua inkajijik neibung aaisardakie ninche.

Ina peyie ejoki Yakobo Simon o Lawi, “Kiyakita nanu enyamali amu kintong'ueita nanu tiatua olorere lena kop, too Ilkanaani o Ilperesi; aikuti iltung'ana laainei, naa tenelo neibung'a aaitoriokino aarare nanu, naa kaamuti nanu tenebo o enkaji ai pooki.”
Kake etejo ninche, “Keishaakino ninye neitaa enkanashe ang e mulayoi?”
Nejoki Enkai Yakobo, “Tudumunye ilepa shomo Betel, nilo amany ine; nintobir teine olperere lo lasar, aitaiki Enkai ina nikimpang'aka ina kata apa peyie ilo ailany olalashe lino Esau.”
Metaa etiaaka Yakobo Enkaji enye o lelo pooki apa ootii tenebo ninye, “Ewuangie kulie aitin oo loreren naatii atua intae, nintisinyinyi ate, nimbelekenyenye inkilani inyi.
Ematudumunye aailep aapuo Betel, peyie atum aitayu teine olperere lo lasar aitaiki Enkai, ina naatawalikia nanu te nkata osina, naataboitare te pooki wueji nashomo.”
Ina peyie eisho Yakobo nena aitin oo loreren pooki naata, tenebo o ilgiso ootii inkiyiaa enye; neisudoo Yakobo nena pooki te ntonata olchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli otii embata Shekem.
Ore eidurrita ninche nedoiki enkuretisho naing'uaa Enkai inkanas naamanita ninche, metaa eitu esujaa ninche ilayiok le Yakobo.
Nelotu Yakobo Lus (aa ninye Betel), aa ninye natii enkop e Kanaan. Ore ninye tenebo o lorere pooki oboitare,
neshet olperere lo lasar teine, nejo ine wueji El-betel, amu ine apa eibalakinye Enkai kewan ninye ina kata naisik alo aing'uaa olalashe lenye.
Neye Debora enkaisiaayiani e Rebeka teine, nenukari te ntonata olchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli tiabori Betel, metaa etejoki enkarna e ine Allon-bakut.
Neitoki ake Enkai aipang'aki Yakobo aigil, ina kata pee elotu aing'uaa Padan Aram, nemayian ninye.
Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Aikiji enkarna ino Yakobo; kake mikintokini aikata aajo Yakobo, kake aikiji enkarna ino Israel.” Metaa eipotoki enkarna enye aajo Israel.
Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Kara Enkai Magilani; entoisho entoponari, kepuku te iyie olorere o lorora loo loreren, nepuku ilaiguanak te iyie.
Ore ina kop apa naishoo Abraham o Isaak naa kaaisho iyie, naa kaisho ina kop eishoi ino nikisuju.”
Nelo Enkai aig'uaa ninye teine neirorie Yakobo.
Neitasheyie Yakobo eng'ape teine apa neirorie Enkai o ninye, eng'ape o soit; nebukoki olasar opikuni enchumata enye, nebukoki eilata shumata enye.
Metaa eishoo enkarna ine wueji neirorie Enkai ajo Betel.
Neitoki Yakobo o lmarei lenye aaidur aapuo te Betel; ore eton elakuaniki Efrat, nesaisayu Raheli, near enkop oleng.
Ore eitanyamal emion oleng, etiaaka enkaitoyioni ninye, “Miureishoyu amu itum ae ayioni.”
Ore ena kata edung'o tau (amu etua), neipot enkarna enye ajo Benoni; kake eipoto menye enkarna enye ajo Benchamen.
Metaa etua Raheli, nenukari te nkoitoi epuoi Efrat, (aa ninye Betlehem),
neitasheyie Yakobo eng'ape te nchumata enkurare e Raheli; naa eng'ape ina enkurare e Raheli, netii ina ng'ape o taata.
Neidur Israel alo, neun olng'obor lenye te dukuya oltalet le Eder.
Ore emanya Israel ina kop, nejing'aki Ruben aboitare Bilhah ina apiani e papaai lenye, nening Israel ina bae.
Nera ina kata ilayiok le Yakobo tomon aare. Ore ilayiok le Lea naa: Ruben, (olkikau le Yakobo) o Simion o Lawi o Yuda o Isaakar o Sebulon.
Ore ilayiok le Raheli naa: Yosef o Benchamen.
Ore ilayiok le Bilhah enkaisiaayiani e Raheli naa: Dan o Naftali.
Ore ilayiok le Silpa enkaisiaayiani e Lea naa Gad o Asheri. Kulo apa ilayiok le Yakobo ootoikioki ninye te Padan Aram.
Nelotu Yakobo enetii Isaak papaai lenye te wueji neji Mamre, aashu Kiriat-tarba (aa ninye taa eji Hebron), ine apa etamanya Abraham o Isaak.
Etabaitie ina kata inkolong'i e Isaak ilarin iip o ntomoni isiet.
Neye ninye, nelo eneiturrurrorre iltung'ana lenyena apa ootuata, etaa oltung'ani moruo oiputakinote nkolong'i, ore ilayiok lenyena Esau o Yakobo nenukaa ninye.
Kulo ninche ile ishoi e Esau (aa ninye Edom).
Eyama Esau inkituaak oo lkanaani; Ada entito e Elon oo Lhiti, o Oholibama entito e Akna olayioni le Sibeon loo Lhifi,
o Basemat entito e Ishmael enkanashe e Nebaiot.
Neiki Adah Esau, Elifas; neiu Basemat Reul;
neiu Oholibama Yeush o Yalam o Kora. Kulo ninche Ilayiok le Esau ootoikioki ninye te nkop e Kanaan.

Neya Esau inkituaak enyena o layiok lenyena o ntoyie enyena o ltung'ana pooki lo lmarei lenye o nkishu enyena o masaa pooki enyena o ntokitin enyena pooki e tipat naanoto te nkop e Kanaan. Nelo enkop nalakua alam olalashe lenye Yakobo.
Amu ore imasaa enye naa aikumok apa oleng nemeidim aatamany nebo; ore enkop apa naidurrakita ninche meekure eishaa te nkaraki enkumoi oo nkishu enye.
Metaa eshomo Esau (aa ninye Edom) amany enkop oo ldoinyo e Seir.
Kulo ninche ile ishoi e Esau menye loo le Edom teinakop oo ldoinyo le Seir.
Kuna ninche inkarn oo layiok le Esau: Elifas olayioni le Ada enkitok e Esau, Reul olayioni le Basement enkitok e Esau.
Ore ilayiok le Elifas naa Teman o Omar o Sefo o Gatam o Kenas,
(ore apa Timna naa enkapiani e Elifas), olayioni le Esau, neiki Elidas Amalek. Kulo ilayiok le Ada, enkitok e Esau.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Reul: Nahat o Sera o Shamma o Misa. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Basemat, enkitok e Esau.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Oholibama entito e Ana olayioni le Sibeon, enkitok e Esau: Etoikio ninche Esau, Yeush o Yalam o Kora.
Kulo ilarikok loo layiok le Esau. Ilayiok le Elifas olkikau le Esau: ilarikok ooji Teman o Omar o Sefo
o Kenas o Kora o Gatam o Amalek. Kulo ilarikok le Elifas te nkop e Edom; Naa ilayiok le Ada.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Reul olayioni le Esau; ore ilarikok naa Natan o Sera o Shama o Misa. Kulo ninche ilarikok le Reul te nkop e Edom; naa ninche ilayiok le Basement enkitok e Esau.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Oholibama, enkitok e Esau: ilarikok le Yeush o Yalam o Kora; lelo ilarikok ootoikioki Oholibama entito e Ana, enkitok e Esau.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Esau (aa ninye Edom) naa kulo ilarikok lenye.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Seir loo le Hori iloopeny enkop: Lotan o Shobal o Sibeon o Ana,
o Dishon o Eser o Sisham; kulo apa ilarikok lo Lhori ilayiok le Seir te nkop e Edom.
Ore apa ilayiok le Lotan naa Hori o Heman; ore apa enkanashe e Lotan naa Timna.
Kulo ilayiok le Shobal: Alfan o Manahat o Ebal o Shefo o Onom.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Sibeon: Ayia o Ana. Ana apa ilo onoto inchorroi nairowua tiong'ota, eirrita isirkon le Sibeon papaai lenye.
Kuna ninche inkera e Ana, Dishon o Oholibama entito e Ana.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Dishon: Hemdan o Eshban o Itran o Keran.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Eser: Bilham o Saafan o Akan.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Dishan: Usi o Aran.
Kulo ninche ilarikok le Hori: ore lelo arikok naa Lotan o Shobal o Sibeon o Ana
o Dishon o Eser o Dishan: kulo ninche ilarikok le Hori te risioroto oo ilgilat lenye te nkop e Seir.
Kulo ninche ilaiguanak apa oitoreisho te nkop e Edom, eton eitu etumi hoo likae aiguanani oitoreisho too Siraeli.
Eitoria Bela olayioni le Beori enkop e Edom, neji enkarna enkanasa enye Dinhaban.
Neye Bela, neitoreisho Yobab olayioni le sera le Bosra te rishata enye.
Neye Yobab neitoreisho Husham le nkop e Ltemani te rishata enye.
Neye Husham neitoreisho Hadad olayioni le Bedad, laa ninye apa otimira ile Midian te nkop e Moab te rishata enye, neji enkarna e nkanasa enye Afiti.
Neye Hadad, neitoreisho Samla le Masreka te rishata enye.
Neye Samla, neitoreisho Shaul le Rehobot to lkeju le Frati te rishata enye.
Neye Shaul, neitoreisho Baalhanan olayioni le Akbor te rishata enye.
Neye Baalhanan olayioni le Akbor neitoreisho Hadar te rishata enye, ore enkarna e nkanasa enye neji Pau, neji apa enkarna enkitok enye Mehetabel, ina tito e Matred, entito e Mesahab.
Kuna ninche inkarn oo larikok Le Esau, te risioroto oo ilmareita lenye o manyishoritin enye anaa enatiu inkarn enye. Ore ilarikok naa Timna, o Alifa o Yelet
o Oholibama o Ela o Pinon
o Kenas o Tenan o Mibsar
o Magdiel o Imran. Kulo ninche ilarikok le Edom (aa ninye eji Esau, menye le Edom), te risioroto oo manyishoritin enye teinakop nataa enenye.
Nebik Yakobo teinakop apa naidurraka lo papaai lenye teina kop e Kanaan.

Ena enkatini o lmarei le Yakobo. Ore aa oloo larin tomon oopishana Yosef, neirritita apa intare tenebo o lalashera lenyena; ore apa aa enkayioni ninye netii apa tenebo o layiok le Bilha o Silpa nena kituaak e Papaai lenye. Neyaki Yosef papaai lenye ilomon torrok ooipirta ilalashera lenyena.
Kenyor apa Israel Yosef oleng aitalang inkera enyena pooki, amu etoikioki ninye etaa kitok oleng, neitobiraki ninye olkila oodo loo loo muain kumok.
Ore peyie edol ilalashera lenyena aajo kenyor menye Yosef aitalang ilalashera lenyena pooki, neibayu ninche ninye oleng, neaku meyieu neirorie ninye te supatisho.
Netum Yosef enkidetidet, ore peyie eliki ilalashera lenyena neibayu ninche ninye oleng.
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Entoning ena kidetidet naidetidetua.

Atoduaa kigira iyiook aaen irridat le nkano tiatua enkurma naa nadol orridati lai etudumunye aitashe, aitoriori naa nadol irridat linyi pooki eetuo pooki aiturrurrokino aaman orridati lai, neirrugokino pooki ninye.”
Nejoki ilalashera lenyena ninye, “Kesipa iyaku oloitore iyiook? Aashu iyaku oloata enkitoo te iyiook pooki?” Neaku eibaitie ninche Yosef oleng too nkidetidetat enyena o too rorei lenyena.
Neitoki ake Yosef atum ae kidetidet, neliki ilalashera lenyena nejo, “Anyaaka ake atum ae kidetidet; naa ng'ura, ore enkolong o lapa o lakir tomon oobo naairrugokino nanu.”

Kake ore ake peyie eliki menye neliki sii ilalashera, neisikong menye nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo doi ena kidetidet nindetidetu? Metaa kaalotu nanu tenebo yieyioo lino o lalashera linono aairrugo aabaiki enkop te dukuya iyie?”
Netum ilalashera lenyena olom te nkaraki ninye, kake etushuma menye ina kiroroto to ltau.
Nedumunye ilalashera le Yosef aapuo airrita intare e menye te mbata e Shekem.
Nejoki Israel Yosef, “Aimegira ilalashera linono aairrita intare te Shekem? Wou maairriwai enetii ninche.” Nejoki Yosef ninye, “Nele nanu.” Ina peyie ejoki Israel Yosef,
“Shomo tena kata taleenoi tenaa keserian ilalashera linono, o ntare, nikintoki ayaki olomoni.” Neaku eirriwayie ninye to erata le Hebron, nelo Shekem.
Neinepu oltung'ani Yosef egira aiposha too nkong'at, neikilikuan ilo tung'ani ninye ajoki, “Kainyoo doi ing'oru?”
Nejo ninye, “Agira aing'oru ilalashera laainei, tolikioki sii ake aatasayia, kaji doi egira aairritayie intare.”
Nejoki ilo tung'ani, “Eshomo aaidurraki dikae, amu atoning'o ninche ejo, ‘Maape Dotan.’ ” Metaa eshomo Yosef asujaa ilalashera lenyena, netum ninche te Dotan.
Nedolu ninche ninye elakua, ore eton eitu elotu anyikaki ninche, nenya ninche enkiguana peyie ear ninye metua.
Nejokino maate, “Nelido oloshi aidetidetani olotu.
Wootu taata, emataar ninye metua nikinang'aki ninye engumoto nabo te kuna, nikipuo aajo eng'ues entim nainosa ninye, nikianyu aadol enaaku inkidetidetat enyena.”
Kake ore peyie ening Ruben ina, neitajeu Yosef too nkaik enye nejoki, “Mikiar ninye metua.”

Nejoki Ruben ninche, “Emimbukoo osarge; entanang'aki ninye atua ena gumoto tene tiong'ota, kake eminteleiki ninye enkaina aar metua,” peyie etum aitajeu ninye aitung'uaa inkaik enye, nerrinyoki ninye papaai lenye.
Metaa ore peyie elotu Yosef enetii ilalashera lenyena, neng'as aaoru ninye olkila lenye, ilo kila oodo oata imuain kumok oishopito;
neya ninye aanang'aki eng'umoto, ore ina gumoto nemetii toki, metii enkare atua.

Netoni ninche te nkop aanya endaa, nejo matushumu nkonyek enye nedol encholiek oo lbiasharani le Ishmael epuonu aaing'uaa Gilead, ereuta intamesin enye, nenapita intokitin naaji ubani o Seu o emanoo etii enkoitoi edoyio aapuo Misiri.
Ina peyie ejoki Yuda ilalashera lenyena, “Kainyoo taa doi kitum tinikiar olalashe lang metua, nikituroo osarge lenye?
Wootu, ematimir ninye aamiraki kulo tung'ana le Ishmael, nimikincho inkaik ang ebaiki ninye, amu olalashe lang ninye, olo sarge lang.” Nenyorraa ilalashera lenyena ina natejo.
Ore peyie epuonu ilbiasharani le Midian aaim ine: neyietu Yosef aaitayu te ng'umoto, nemiraki ninye lelo tung'ana le Ishmael te shekeli tikitam e nkosholai; neya ninche Yosef Misiri.
Ore pee eshukunye Ruben enaduoo gumoto nedol ajo meekure etii Yosef ine, nepolos inkilani enyena to sina sapuk.
Nerrinyo enetii ilalashera lenyena nejoki: “Metii enkayioni ine kaji taata alo nanu?”
Neya olkila le Yosef, neyieng enkine, neitadoiki ilo kila osarge.
Neirriwaa ilo kila oodo loo muain kumok meyakini menye, nejo, “Nele olkila likinotito, ng'ura sii iyie tujurru tenaa ko lkila lo layioni lino anaa aime ninye.”
Neyiolou nabo kata ninye, nejo, “Olkila lo layioni lai, einosa eng'ues e ntim ninye, maata olng'ash tukul ajo etumuta Yosef ing'uesi!”
Nepolos Yakobo inkilani enyena to sina nerrid olkuniyia te mpolos enye. Neishiraki olayioni lenye inkolong'i kumok.

Neinyototo ilayiok pooki lenyena tenebo o ntoyie enyena pooki aaibung ninye aitagol; kake etanya ninye tukul eitagoli, nejo, “A'a ekalo abori enemeneng'a enetii olayioni lai, aishirita.” Metaa eishiraka menye Yosef oleng.
Ore ina rishata neidipa Ilmidian aatimir Yosef te Misiri aamiraki Potifa, obo loo laitoriak le Farao, aa ninye olkitok loo larripok le wueji netii Farao.
Ore te nena olong'i, etadoyie Yuda alo aing'uaa ilalashera lenyena nelo aitaa elatia oltung'ani obo le Adullam oji enkarna enye Hira.
Ore etii ine nedol Yuda entito e likae tung'ani loo Lkanaan neji enkarna enye Shua; neyam ninye nelo aboitare.
Neiroshiu neiu enkayioni, nedung'oki ninye enkarna ajo Eri.
Neitoki ake anutayu neiu enkayioni, nedung'oki ninye enkarna enye ajo Onan.
Neitoki ake aigil aiu enkayioni, neisho ng'otonye enkarna enye ajo Shela. Naa Kesib apa etii peyie eiu Shela.
Neyamaki Yuda olayioni lenye kikau Eri enkitok, naji enkarna enye Tamar.
Kake ore apa ilo kikau lenye oji Eri, naa oltung'ani apa arruoni oleng te dukuya Olaitoriani; near Olaitoriani ninye metua.
Ina peyie ejoki Yuda Onan, “Shomo tijing'aki ina kitok oliai o lalashe lino tayiolo ninye, pee etum olalashe lino nkera te iyie.”
Kake keyiolo apa Onan ajo ore inkera naaiu nemeaku inenyena, neaku ore ake peyie elo ayiolou enkitok olalashe lenye, nebukoki enkare e lewaisho enkop pee meisho ake inkera olalashe lenye.
Ore ina nataasa, eitu katukul eitiship Olaitoriani, near sii ninye metua.

Ina peyie ejoki Yuda Tamar ina kitok o layioni lenye. “Totona ira enkoliai te nkaji e papaai lino, o metaba anaa nebulu olayioni lai Shela.” Amu etureishe ajo keidim sii ninye atua anaa ilalashera lenyena. Metaa eshomo Tamar enkaji e menye.
Ore etulusoyie enkiti rishata neye enkitok e Yuda, entito e Shua. Ore peyie eitagoli Yuda, nelo ninye tenebo o lchore lenye Hira le Adulam ewueji neji Timna, ewueji nebarnieki intare enyena.
Ore peyie elikini Tamar aajoki, “Ekeloito olaputani lino Timna abarn intare enyena.”

Neitayu to sesen lenye inkilani enyena e nkoliai, nepika enkarasha aitoipie elukunya enye peyie medoli enkomom, nelotu aton te kishomi e Enaim, natii enkoitoi nalala nalo Timna; amu etodua ajo etubulua Shela, neitu eishori ninye meyama.
Ore peyie edol Yuda ninye, nedamu ninye ajo inoshi kituaak naibor onyek, amu eitoipo ninye enkomom enye.
Nelo ninye enetii te mbata enkoitoi nalala nejoki ninye, “Wou inchooki maatayiolo,” amu eitu eyiolou ninye ajo entito o layioni lenye. Nejo ninye, “Kainyoo naa kincho peyie kitum atayiolo?”
Newaliki ajoki, “Ekaairriwaki olkuoo too ntare aainei.” Nejo Tamar, “Amaa aikincho entoki ino naibung naarreshunye o terewakaki ilo kuo?”

Nejoki Yuda, “Kainyoo iyieu naaisho?” Newaliki ajoki, “Inchooki olgisoi lino o enkeene ino o ina ng'udi ino nimbung'ita te nkaina ino.” Neaku eishooyie ninye ninche nelo ayiolou ninye neiroshiu ninye.
Neinyototo Tamar alo; neitayu enkarasha te nkomom neishop inkilani enyena oo nkolia.
Ore peyie eirriu Yuda olkuoo meyau olchore lenye le Adullam, peyie etum enaduoo kitok aishoru intokitin naata e Yuda, nelotu alau ninye te naduoo wueji.
Neikilikuan ninye iltung'ana ootii ine ajoki, “Koree ake enkitok mulayoi natii naaji embata enkoitoi nalala e Naim aton?” Nejo ninche, “Meetae emulayoi natii ene.”
Neaku etushukokine Yuda nejoki, “Eitu alo atum, netejo sii iltung'ana le ine, ‘Metii emulayoi natii ine.’ ”
Newaliki Yuda ajoki, “Inchoo ninye eya nena tokitin aitaa inenyena, peyie mekueniyieki ake iyiook, idol ajo airriwaka ele kuo, neitu ilo ainepu ninye.”

Ore peyie eishunye ilapaitin okuni, nelikini Yuda aajoki, “Ore Tamar enkitok o layioni lino, etaa emulayoi, ore ake sii keiroishi te nkerai e mulayaisho.” Nejo Yuda, “Entoriku entupuku boo peyie kipuo aapejoo ninye.”

Ore eitupukuni boo, neirriwaa olkilikuai airriwaki olaputani lenye nejoki, “Olopeny kuna tokitin anotie enkerai.” Nejo, “Ing'ura tujurru, aatasayia, ainkuneng'ae kuna tokitin o lgisoi o enkeene o eng'udi.”
Nenyorraa Yuda ninche nejo, “Aisinyati ninye peyie aalang, anaa keitu apa aitabaya ororei lai aisho ninye olayioni lai Shela meyama.” Neitu eitoki aikata ayiolou ninye.
Ore peyie ebau enkata najing Tamar aji neiu ilmao te ishoi.
Ore earita enkop, neitayu obo enkaina aitupuku neng'amaa enkaitoiyioni neeniki ina aina enkopito pile, ejoito, “Ele otang'asunye.”
Kake ore erriny enkaina enye, nepuku olalashe, nejo enkaitoiyioni, “Metaa inji doi inkununye tinipuku!” Nedung'okini ninye enkarna enye aajo Peres.
Ore te siadi nepuku olalashe lenye eeta enaduoo opito pile eenikino enkaina enye; neipoti enkarna enye aajo Serah.
Ewaki apa ina kata Yosef Misiri, ore Potifa laa obo loo lkituaak le Farao, olkitok le rripore, naa olmisiri sii, einyiang'ua Potifa ninye too ltung'ana le Ishmael laa ninche ooyautua ninye ina kop.
Etii apa Olaitoriani tenebo o Yosef, neaku oltung'ani otudupe oleng, neton te nkaji olkitok lenye ilo Misiri.
Nedol olkitok lenye ajo ketii Olaitoriani tenebo Yosef, ore pooki naata neisho Olaitoriani metubula too nkaik enyena.
Metaa enoto Yosef omom too nkonyek e Potifa, neisho ninye metaa oloitasheikinoni le nkaji enye pooki neaku ninye oitore pooki toki naata.

Ore ebaiki ina kata neitaa ninye olaitasheikinoni le nkaji enye o pooki toki naata, nemayian Olaitoriani enkaji e ilo Misiri te nkaraki Yosef. Ore emayianata Enkai nejing pooki toki naata, tiaji o te nkurma.
Metaa etung'ueikia apa Potifa pooki naata metaa Yosef oitasheiki; neaku ore eeta Yosef, eitu eitoki anyamaliki ae toki meteleku endaa ake nanya ninye. Ore apa Yosef naa oltung'ani sidai te mua.
Ore etulusoyie enkata, nekurraki enkitok o lkitok lenye inkonyek enyena ang'uar Yosef, nejoki, “Irraga tenebo nanu.”
Kake etanya ninye nejoki enkitok nejoki enkitok olkitok lenye, “Ing'ura, ore atii ene meekure enyamaliki olkitok lai ae toki tena aji, netipika pooki toki naata atua enkaina ai.

Meekure aa kitok tena aji pee aalang nanu; nemeeta hoo ae toki naatirishie nanu meteleku iyie ake, amu ira iyie enkitok enye; kaji taa pasa aiko peyie aas enkarruoisho naba inji, naas eng'oki te dukuya Enkai?”
Ore hoo duoo ninye neirorie Yosef anaake eitu ening Yosef ninye, peyie eirrag tenebo ninye, aashu eisiritore ninye.
Kake ore nabo olong, eshomo Yosef atua enkaji aas esiaai enye nemeetae likae lee otii atua aji.
Neibung enkitok e Potifa enkila enye nejoki, “Irraga tenebo nanu.” Kake etung'uayie ninye enkila enye te nkaina enye, neilanyisho aisik aipang te nkaji.
Ore peyie edol ina kitok ajo etung'uayie Yosef enkila enye te nkaina enye eibung'ita, neisik alo aing'uaa enkaji.
Neipot ilewa le nkaji enye nejoki ninche, “Eng'ura, eyaka ninye iyiook Potifa Olburaniai meeu amor iyiook; aaewuo ajing'aki ajo aboitare, naishir oleng to ltoilo sapuk.
Ore peyie ening ajo ailepie oltoilo lai aishir oleng, neing'uaa enkila enye te nkaina ai neilanyisho aipirri aipang boo.”
Neirragie ninye ina kila enye te mbata enye o meeu olkitok lenye ang.
Neliki ninye Potifa ina bae ake ajoki, “Ore ilo sinka loo Lbrania, ilo liyaua atua iyiook, aaewuo ajing'aki amor;
kake ore ake peyie ailepie oltoilo lai aishir, neing'uaa enkila enye aata neilanyisho aisik apuku te nkaji.”
Ore peyie ening olkitok le Yosef lelo rorei ooiroro enkitok enye, “Neijia aaikuna osinka lino.” Neyupuyup engoro enye.
Neya olkitok le Yosef ninye apik jila, ine wueji nepiki ilmapuusuni lo laiguanani. Nepiki ninye jila.
Kake etii apa Olaitoriani tenebo o Yosef neitodol ninye enyorrata nauno, neisho ninye omom too nkonyek olaitasheikinoni le jila.
Ore ilo aitasheikinoni, nepik Yosef aitaa ninye oitasheiki lelo pooki ooikenoro te jila neaku ore pooki naasi naa ninye oas.
Ore ilo kitok le jila eitu eitoki aitanyamaluo te pooki toki natipika inkaik e Yosef, amu etii Olaitoriani tenebo ninye; neaku ore pooki nataasa, neisho Olaitoriani meitobirari.
Ore etulusoyie enkata, neyooki olaitasheikinoni le naisho oo sabibu lo laiguanani le Misiri tenebo o lapejoni loo mukateni o laiguanani, aaitagor olkitok lenye ilo aiguanani le Misiri.
Negoro Farao te nkaraki lelo aitasheikinok lenyena pokira, o laitasheikinoni kitok le naisho oo sabibu tenebo o lapejoni kitok loo mukateni.
Nepik ninche enkaji narripieki iltung'ana arruok natii enkaji o lkitok le rripore, teina jila naikenorieki Yosef.
Ore ilo kitok le rripore neitanap Yosef meing'ura, neisaiai ninche. Netoni inkolong'i naaikash teina aji oo larruok.

Ore enkewarie nabo, neidetidet pokira, olaitasheikinoni kitok le naisho oo sabibu tenebo o lapejoni loo mukateni lo lkitok le Misiri, eikenoro te jila. Meeta ake oleitu eidetidet enkidetidet enye, nemeeta ake enkidetidet nemeeta enautu.
Ore peyie eyooki Yosef ninche enasirie, nedol ninche, nenyorriki ajo kenyamal oleng pokira.
Neikilikuan ilaitasheikinok le Farao ootii tenebo te nkaji naenishoreki te enkaji olkitok lenye ajoki, “Kainyoo doi anaaijo kesoto taata intae inkomomi?”

Nejoki ninche ninye, “Kindetideta duo, nemeeta hoo oltung'ani oidim aibelekenyaki iyiook atoliki aibalakinye.” Nejoki Yosef ninche, “Amaa doi enkibelekenyata aime ene Nkai? Entolikioki atasayia intae.”
Ore ilo aitasheikinoni kitok le naisho oo sabibu, neliki Yosef enkidetidet enye nejoki ninye, “Ore te nkidetidet ai, etii duoo osabibu dukuya nanu,
ore te nchumata eilo sabibu, etii ilng'osil okuni; ore ake peyie eitapuku, nelioyu esidano enye, neku aimarrimar aaku osabibu.
Netii duoo enkikompe e Farao enkaina ai, naitayu ilng'anayio loo sabibu, naironyaki enkare enye ina kikompe, napik ina kikompe e Farao inkaik e Farao.”
Ina peyie ejoki Yosef ninye, “Ena enkibelekenyata ena kidetidet: ore ilng'osil okuni naa inkolong'i uni,
ore too nkolong'i uni naa aikidumu Farao endukuya ino nikinyiaaki esiaai ino, neaku aipikaki Farao enkaina enye enkikompe enye anaa apake te dukuya aa olaitasheikinoni le naisho oo sabibu.
Kake tadamuaki tenilo nitum eseriani, nikintaas sii nanu esupatisho peyie kimbalie sii nanu te dukuya Farao, pee kintayu nanu tena aji.
Amu kesipa tukul ajo kapurruno te nkop ooore sii tene natii maata enataasa peyie aatipikaki atua jila.”
Ore peyie edol olapejoni loo mukateni ajo ore enkibelekenyata naibelekenya Yosef naa kening'unoyu, nejoki sii ninye Yosef “Aidetideta sii nanu, etii nkikapuni uni oo mukateni elukunya ai,
ore enkikapu natii shumata inkulie netii indaiki oo mpukunot pooki naapejuno e Farao, neinosita imotonyi nena daiki naatii enkikapu natii endukuya ai.”
Newaliki Yosef ajoki, “Ena enkibelekenyata enye: Ore inkikapuni uni naa inkolong'i uni;
ore too nkolong'i uni, naa kedumu Farao endukuya ino nikintung'uaa iyie! Nikilili iyie to lchani, ore imotonyi naa kenya inkiri o sesen lino.”
Ore te nkolong e uni, aa enkolong apa natoinyieki Farao, neitaiki ilaisiaayiak lenyena pooki osirua nedumu endukuya o laitookoni kitok tenebo o endukuya o layiarani kitok tiatua ilaisiaayiak lenyena.
Neshukoki olaitasheikinoni kitok le naisho oo sabibu, nepik enkikompe inkaik e Farao,
kake eililio ilo apejoni kitok loo mukateni, anaa enatolikio apa Yosef ninche.
Ore ake eyia, eitu edamu ilo kitok le naisho oo sabibu Yosef, etorikine ninye.
Ore peyie eishunye ilarin oaare oolulung'a, neidetidet Farao enkidetidet natoduaa kewan eitashe te mbata o lkeju le Nail.
Nedol etupukutuo aailepu to lkeju le Nail inkishu naapishana sidain naapir, nenya ilo kujita otii embata olkeju.
Nedol eetuo kulie kishu naapishana sasin, naaikinyoot aailepu to lkeju le Nail aasuju ninche, neitashe te mbata oo nkulie te nkiyopata olkeju le Nail.
Ore nena kishu sasin naaikinyoot, nenya nena kishu sidain naapir. Neputunye Farao te nkidetidet.
Neitoki airura neitoki aidetidet eniare, nedol ilukuny naapishana loo lpaek oopir naa sidain ebulu to lpaeki obo.
Nemaniki peyie eitalioo ilukuny pokira naapishana, neitoki kulie kiyiaa naapishana aaliooyu naa sasin naaitoyio enkijape naing'uaa enkalo oloosaen.
Ore nena lukuny sasin e ntapa neijoo ilkiyiaa oopishana sidain oopir. Neputunye Farao nedol ajo enkidetidet duoo ake ina.

Metaa ore peyie ekenyu etanyamala oleng Farao to oltau lenye, neirriwaa olkilikuai meipoti ilasakutok o ltung'ana le Misiri o olang'eni pooki, neliki Farao ninche ina kidetidet enye pooki, neitu etumi obo te ninche ooidim aibelekenya ina kidetidet aliki Farao.
Nejoki olaitasheikinoni kitok le naisho oo sabibu Farao, “Atadamua taata inkitarruorrot aainei.
Ore apa peyie egorokino Farao ilaisiaayiak lenyena, naapik nanu tenebo o lapejoni kitok loo mukateni enkaji narripieki iltung'ana arruok natii enkaji olkitok le rripore,
nikindetidet pokira ina kewarie, ore iyiook pokira meeta oleitu eidetidet enkidetidet enye naata eutunoto enye.

Netii apa oloti barnoti loo Lbrania oboitare iyiook teine, olaisiaayiani lo lkitok le rripore, ore peyie kiliki ninye nena kidetidetat neibelekenyaki ninye yiook, aisho ake enkipirta e nkidetidet pooki ng'ae anaa enatiu enkidetidet enye.”
Naa ore peyie eliki iyiook, nelotu aaku ina natolimuo, naashukokini esiaai ai, ore olapejoni kitok loo mukateni nepuoi aailili.
Neirriwaa Farao olkilikuai meipoti Yosef, neyauni ninye aaitasieku aaitung'uaa jila, ore peyie eidip atabarnoyu neibelekeny sii inkilani enyena nelotu atua aitashe te dukuya Farao.
Nejoki Farao Yosef, “Anoto det enkidetidet, nemeetae likae tung'ani laaidim aibalakinye ninye, natoning'o eji ore peyie ining enkidetidet naa indim aibelekenya.”
Newaliki Yosef ajoki, “Mme nanu etii ewalata, keisho Enkai Farao ewalata sidai naitiship.”
Ina peyie ejoki Farao Yosef, “Atoduaa te nkidetdet ai, aitashe apa te nkiyopata olkeju le Nail,
nepuonu inkishu naapishana naapir naa sidain aailepu to lkeju le Nail, neiteru aadaa tiatua Olng'arua,
nepuonu kulie kishu naapishana enetii, naa ore ninche naa sasin neikinyoot ineitu aikata adol te nkop e Misiri.
Ore nena kishu sasin naaikinyoot, nenya nena kishu e dukuya naapishana
kake ore peyie eidip aainosa ninche, meetae hoo obo otayiolo ajo einosa ninche, inkulie amu eton ake emuoyiaa naa sasin anaa enatiu te nkiterunoto. Ina peyie aputunye.
Anyaaka ake sii te nkidetidet ai adol ilkiyiaa oopishana oobulu to lpaeki obo oobore naa sidain.
Ore kulie kiyiaa naapishana, netoito, naa sasin, neitoi olkutati lo loosaen.
Etubulakita ninche, Ore lelo kiyiaa sasin lo lpaek neijoo lelo kiyiaa oopishana sidan. Natolikio nanu nena kidetidetat ilasakutok kake metii hoo obo laaidima atoliki ina kidetidet.”
Ina peyie ejoki Yosef Farao, “Ore enkidetidet e Farao naa nabo; eitoduaa Enkai Farao enataa kejo pee eas.
Ore inkishu naapishana sidain naapir, naa ilarin oopishana, ore ilkiyaa oopishana sidain naa ilarin oopishana; ore enkidetidet naa nabo.
Ore inkishu sasin naaikinyoot naapishana, naaetuo aasuju ninche naa ilarin oopishana, ore ilkiyiaa lemeeta toki oopishana ooitoyio olkutati lo loosaen naa ilarin lo lameyu oopishana.
Eketiu anaa enatiaaka Farao, eitoduaa Enkai Farao enataa kejo pee eas.
Kepuonu ilarin oopishana ootumieki endaa sapuk te nkop pooki e Misiri,
kake ore ake peyie eishunye lelo arin, nepuonu ilarin oopishana lo lameyu sapuk, ore lelo arin pooki le ndaa sapuk nerikinisho te nkop pooki e Misiri, nemut olameyu ena kop.
Neaku meitokini ninye aadamu enapa naatae sapuk te nkaraki ilo ameyu osuju, amu ekeaku torrono oleng.
Ore enkigilata enkidetidet e Farao, neitodolu inchere ore ina siaai naa Enkai natipika, naa keyau Enkai aitaa te nkata nemelakua.
Inchoo naa tena kata Farao egelu oltung'ani oisiligayu neeta sii eng'eno neisho ninye meitasheiki enkop e Misiri.
Shomo dukuya tegelu ilaitashekinok tena kop niya ematua e imiet e pooki daa naiu enkop e Misiri te kulo arin oopishana le ndaa sapuk.
Nincho ninche metasoto endaa pooki e kulo arin sidain oopuonu, neiteng'eli ilpaek tiabori enkitoria e Farao pee eaku endaa too nkanas, nincho ninche meiteng'ela.
Ekeaku ina daa enashumi te nkaraki enkop te lelo arin oopishana lo lameyu oopuonu ena kop e Misiri, pee meidaaya enkop teina rishata o lameyu.”
Ore ina bae naa aisidai apa oleng te Farao o too laisiaayiak lenyena pooki.
Nejoki Farao ilaisiaayiak lenyena, “Aikindim aanoto oltung'ani laaijo ele, otii Enkiyang'et e Nkai atua ninye?”
Ina peyie ejoki Farao Yosef, “Ore amu kintoduaa Enkai kuna pooki, meetae likae arriyia naa ng'en laaijo iyie;
iyaku olaitasheiki enkaji ai, ore iltung'ana laainei pooki ekeaku ilooning ina nintanap; meteleku to lorika le nkitoo ake aaku nanu kitok te iyie.”
Nejoki Farao Yosef, “Ng'ura ajo Aategelua iyie ntasheiki enkop pooki e Misiri.”
Neitayu Farao olgisoi lenye lo lmishire te nkaina enye, nepik enkaina e Yosef; neishopoki ninye ilkilani le kitani oopuyiapui, nepik olpisiai le saabu emurt enye.
Neisho ninye Farao meshomo ekedito engarri enye e are oo mbartan, neishir olarriponi lenye te dukuya ninye ajo, “Entigil kung!” Neaku etipikaki Yosef meitasheiki ina kop pooki e Misiri.
Ore ake sii, etiaaka Farao Yosef, “Ekara Farao, naa ore teneme to rorei lino, meetae oltung'ani odumu enkaina anaa enkeju te nkop pooki e Misiri.”
Neisho Farao Yosef enkarna oo Lmisiri ajo Safenatapanea; neisho ninye meyama Asenat, ina tito e Potifera olapolosani le Oni. Metaa eshomo Yosef enkop e Misiri.
Oloo larin tomoni uni apa Yosef peyie ejing enkisiaayiare e Farao olaiguanani le Misiri. Nelo Yosef aing'uaa Farao, nelo aman enkop pooki e Misiri.
Ore te lelo arin oopishana lo lari sapuk, enoto enkop eishoi sapuk,
neiturrurru indaiki pooki oo larin oopishana eton eetae endaa sapuk te nkop e Misiri, neshum endaa pooki too nkanas, etushuma te pooki anasa ina daa naing'uaa nkurman naamanita.
Neshum Yosef entapa te nkumoi naba anaa osinyai le naiposha o metaa meekure eyiolo eneba ndaiki te nkumoi amu aimeekure etemayu.
Ore eton eitu elotu olari lo lameyu, eeta Yosef ina rishata ilayiok aare, ootoikio Asenata entito e Potifera olapolosani le Oni.
Nedung'oki Yosef ilo kikau lenye enkarna ajo Manase, amu etejo, “Aishoo Enkai maatorikinoto ingolikinot aainei pooki, o enkaji e papaai lai pooki.”
Neipot enkarna oliare ajo Efraim, “Amu aitaa Enkai olotubula tena kop enyamali ai.”
Nebau enkiting'oto oo larin oopishana le sapuko e ndaa.
Neiteru ilarin oopishana lo lameyu aabau, anaa enatejo apa Yosef. Neaku olameyu sapuk too nkuapi pooki; kake ore te nkop pooki e Misiri, netii endaa ina rishata.
Ore peyie eishunye indaiki te nkop e Misiri to lorere, neishiraki olorere Farao meishoo endaa; nejoki Farao iltung'ana pooki le Misiri, “Enchom enetii Yosef, ore pooki najoki intae, entaas.”
Metaa ore peyie eibulu olameyu ina kop pooki, nebol Yosef inkajijik naashumishoreki, nemiraki ninye Ilmisiri ilpaek, amu etaa torrono olameyu oleng te nkop e Misiri.
Ore ake sii, eetuo iloreren pooki le nkop Misiri enetii Yosef aainyiang'u ilpaek, amu aitorrono apa olameyu te nkop pooki nalulung'a.
Ore peyie ening Yakobo ajo keetae entapa te Misiri, nejoki ilayiok lenyena, “Kainyoo doi peyie itonini aaing'ura maate tene?”
Nejo, “Atoning'o ajo keetae ilpaek te Misiri; enchom ina kop enyiang'u ilpaek einyiang'aki iyiook teine, peyie kibikoo eitu kiye.”
Metaa eshomo ilalashera le Yosef tomon aainyiang'u ilpaek te Misiri.
Kake eitu eirriwaa Yakobo Benchamen, olalashe le Yosef tenebo ilalashera lenyena, amu keure ajo ketum enyamali.
Neaku eetuo apa ilayiok le Israel aainyiang'isho anaa olikae orere oetuo, amu etijing'a apa olameyu enkop e Kanaan.

Ore apa ina kata naa Yosef olgafanai leina kop naa ninye enkorrok apa omiraki ilpaek olorere pooki le nkop. Nepuonu ilalashera le Yosef, neirrugo ninche te dukuya ninye aaitabaiki inkomomi enye enkop.

Nedol Yosef ilalashera lenyena, neyiolou ninye ninche, kake eitaasa ninye ninche anaa lomon neirorie ninche te nkisikong'ata nejoki, “Kaji doi ing'uaa?” Nejo ninche, “Enkop e Kanaan king'uaa kietuo ainyiang'u endaa.”
Metaa etayiolo Yosef ilalashera lenyena, kake eitu eyiolou ninche ninye.
Nedamu Yosef inapa kidetidetat naaidetideta naaipirta ninche, nejoki ninche, “Irara ilaikitalak, iyetuo aajur enchalan oo itung'ana lena kop.”
Nejoki ninche ninye, “A'a olkitok lang, kake kietuo ainyiang'u endaa, ina pee eetuo isinkan linono.
Aikira pooki ilayiok lo lpayian obo, nikira iltung'ana ooisiligayu, ore isinkan linono neme ilaikitalak.”
Nejoki Yosef ninche, “A'a, iyetuo aajur enchalan oo ltung'ana lena kop.”
Nejo ninche, “Ore iyiook isinkan linono, kira ilalashera tomon aare, ilayiok lo lpayian obo te nkop e Kanaan; naa ore oloti te iyiook eboitare ena olong papaai lang, ore obo nemeekure eetae.”
Kake etiaaka Yosef ninche, “Etiu ake anaa enatiaaka intae inchere irara ilaikitalak.
Ore te nkaraki ina naa ketemi intae. Ore te nkishui e Farao, mipuopuo aing'uaa ene wueji ometaba anaa nelotu olalashe linyi oti ene.
Erriwai obo linyi olo ayau olalashe linyi, ore intae nianyunyu te jila pee etumi aatujur irorei linyi, tenaa ketii esipata atua intae, aashu anaa te nkishui e Farao, kesipa irara ilaikitalak.”
Nepik pooki tenebo jila too nkolong'i uni.
Ore te nkolong e uni nejoki Yosef ninche, “Entaas ena peyie miyeye, amu kaure Enkai.
Tenaa irara iltung'ana loo sipat, enchoo olalashe linyi obo eing'uari eikenoro teine neikenorieki intae, nepuo ilkulikae aaya entapa te nkaraki olameyu loo lmareita linyi,
nikiyakiki olalashe linyi, oti; pee etumi aatonyorrai irorei linyi, nimiyeye.” Neas ninche ina.

Nejokino maate, “Ore taa te sipata einepua iyiook entorroni o lapa alashe lang, amu kitoduaa enyamali oltau lenye, ina kata peyie esai iyiook neitu kinining ninye katukul, neaku ena pee eewuo ena nyamali atua iyiook.”
Newaliki Ruben ajo, “Ekeitu apa ajoki intae emintaas entorrono enkayioni? Neitu kinining'ining'i. Metaa ore taata etabawua naa elaata osarge lenye.”
Eitu ninche eyiolou aajo etoning'o Yosef irorei lenye pooki, amu ketii apa olaibelekenyani erishata enye.
Nepuku ninye aing'uaa ninche alo aishir; neshukunye airorie ninche. Neitayu ninye Simon tiatua ninche neen ninye te dukuya ninche.
Neitanapisho Yosef meiputi ilbenia lenye te ntapa, neshukokini pooki bene impisai nayautua ninche, neishori sii endaa nainosaa te nkoitoi. Neitaasi ninche ina.
Neirot isirkon lenye too lpaek nedumunye aapuo.
Ore pee ejo obo lenye abol olbene lenye pee eisho osikiria lenye endaa te wueji neirraga, nedol impisai enyena te nkutuk olbene lenye.

Nejoki ilalashera lenyena; “Aatushukokoki nanu impisai aainei, noona naatii enkutuk olbene lai!” Ore ake pee ening ina neikirikira to lkirutoto nerrinyokino maate ejokino, “Kaa bae ena naitaasa iyiook Enkai?”
Ore pee epuonu enetii Yakobo; papaai lenye, te nkop e Kanaan, neliki nena pooki naanoto ninche, nejoki,
“Ore ilo tung'ani, ilo kitok leina kop, eirorie iyiook te nkisikong'ata, neiko iyiook anaa aikira ilaikitalak leina kop.
Kake kitiakita ninye, ‘Aikira iltung'ana ooisiligayu, mikira ilaikitalak;
ekira iyiook ilalashera tomon aare, ilayiok le papa lang; nemeekure eishu obo lang, ore oloti neboitare ena olong papaai te nkop e Kanaan.’

Ina peyie ejo ilo tung'ani, ilo kitok leina kop ajoki iyiook, ‘Ore pee ayiolou ajo irara iltung'ana asipak, entung'uai olalashe linyi obo entung'ueikiaki, niyaya ilpaek aayaki olorere te nkaraki olameyu loo lmareita linyi, nipuopuo aarrinyo.
Entorikokoki olalashe linyi oti, pee atum atayiolo ajo mirara ilaikitalak kake iltung'ana ooisiligayu, naa kalaaki intae olalashe linyi, nindimidimi ataas biashara tena kop.’ ”
Ore eitayu ntokitin too lbenia lenye, meeta ake oltung'ani lemeeta orridati loo mpisai enyena to lbene. Ore pee edol ninche tenebo o menye irridat loo mpisai, neirut oleng.

Nejoki Yakobo papaai lenye ninche, “Kinchirie intae to sina sapuk aaiturrarrie inkera aainei: Meekure eetae Yosef, nemeekure eetae Simon, ore tena kata naa intokiki aaya Benchamen, ore kuna pooki naa inaanoto nanu.”
Ina pee ejoki Ruben menye, “Taara ilayiok laainei aare metuata tenemayau ninye ashuku enitii; tipika ninye inkaik aainei naa kashuku ninye enitii.”

Kake etejo Yakobo, “Melo olayioni lai airiamariyie intae, amu etua olalashe lenye, naa ninye ake taata etung'uayioki. Tenelo netum bata te nkoitoi ina kata ipuopuo, ataa nanu oltung'ani kitok oibor lukunya, ore osina likiyakiki nanu naa kaar nanu matua.”
Etaa apa olameyu sapuk oleng te nkop e Kanaan.
Ore pee emut ina tapa nayautua te Misiri, nejoki papaai lenye ninche, “Enyaaki enchom, enyiang'aki iyiook enkiti daa.”
Kake etiaaka Yuda ninye, “Eitanapa apa iyiook ilo tung'ani ajoki iyiook, ‘Midolidolo enkomom ai, aashu ake tenaa ketii olalashe linyi tenebo intae.’
Tinirriwaa olalashe lang tenebo iyiook, naa aikipuo ainyiang'aki iyie endaa teine,
kake tinimirriwaa ninye nimikipuo ine, amu etiaaka apa iyiook, ilo tung'ani, ‘Midolidolo enkomom ai tukul, aashu tinirikitoto ake olalashe linyi.’ ”
Nejo Israel, “Kainyoo doi pee kinkuna inji aitamuoi aaliki ilo tung'ani aajoki iatata likae alashe?”

Newaliki aajo, “Ore ilo tung'ani, eikilikuanishore iyiook te nkarriyiano aikilikuanu imbaa naaipirta iyiook o lmarei lang nejoki iyiook, ‘Keton eishu papaai linyi? Iyatata likae alashe?’ Ore nena nikitiakita naa iwalat e nena kikilikuanat; ijo duoo aikinteiki aajo kejoki iyiook, ‘Eyau olalashe linyi ene?’ ”
