Nejoki Yuda Israel, Papaai lenye, “Inchoo enkayioni elo tenebo nanu, nikidumunye aapuo pee mikiiye iyiook o iyie o tenebo inkera ang.
Aitayio enkishui ai te nkaraki ninye metaa te nanu ing'oru ninye. Teneitu ashuku ninye enitii naitasheyie ninye te dukuya iyie, neaku entorroni ai intarasi.
Amu teneitu taa doi apa kimutie anaata taata kindipa aashom ine katitin are nikishukunye.”

Nejoki papaai lenye Israel ninche, “Tenaa neijia etiu, entaas ena, ewaita embata oo lng'anayio gelunot lena kop too lbenia linyi, niyakiki ilo tung'ani enkishooroto, enkiti ilata narropil o enkiti aisho o emanoo o enkorropil o lng'anayio lo lchani onyaanyukie oseki.
Niyaya impisai kat are ipuopuo, nirrinyirrinyi inapa pisai naatushukokoki intae too nkutukie oo lbenia linyi; amu ebaiki apa naa keitu edoli.
Entorik sii ninye olalashe linyi nidumunyenye aapuo, nishukokinono enetii ilo tung'ani,
meishoo intae Enkai Magilani olng'ur te dukuya ilo tung'ani, pee etum aishoo intae entushuku olikae alashe linyi o Benchamen. Tenaa apa kaiturraa inkera aainei, inchoo aiturraa.”
Neaku ewaita iltung'ana inkishoorot, neya irridat maare oo mpisai tenebo ninche o tenebo Benchamen; nedumunye aadoyio aapuo enkop e Misiri neitashe te dukuya Yosef.
Ore pee edol Yosef Benchamen tenebo ninche, nejoki ilo aitasheikinoni le nkaji enye, “Toriku lelo tung'ana atua aji niyiang'aki, amu kenya ninche taata endaa tenebo nanu teneipir enkolong.”
Neas ilo sinka anaa enaitanapa Yosef ninye, nerik lelo tung'ana enkaji e Yosef.

Neureishoyu iltung'ana amu eyawuaki ninche enkaji e Yosef, nejo, “Te nkaraki taa inapa pisai naatipikaki ilbenia lang te nkata e dukuya, ina pee etum anoto enaitaas iyiook nebaiki aitaa iyiook irrindiki neibung isirkon lang.”
Metaa eshomo ninche enetii olaitasheikinoni le nkaji e Yosef, neirorie ninye te kutuk aji nejoki.
“Oi olkitok lang, kietuo apa enkata e dukuya ainyiang'u endaa;
ore kipuoito te nkoitoi, ore ewueji nikirraga nikibol ilbenia lang, nemeeta olbene hoo obo lemetii irridat loo mpisai enkutuk olbene lenye, eba ake impisai anaa apake; neaku kitorrinyutuo pooki,
nikiyautua sii too nkaik ang kulie pisai nikinosie endaa. Mikiyiolo aajo aing'ae otorrinyoko impisai ang ilbenia lang.”

Nejoki olaitasheikinoni ninche, “Entotoni miatata enkuretisho; ore Enkai inyi o Enkai oo loo papaai linyi ninye natipika ilo shumati atua ilbenia linyi apikaki intae; atang'amayie impisai inyi.” Neriku ninye Simon enetii ninche.
Ore pee eriku ilo tung'ani lelo tung'ana atua enkaji e Yosef, neisho ninche enkare, neisuj inkejek enye, neisho sii isirkon lenye olkujita onya.
Nerretena aanyu elotunoto e Yosef enaipirie enkolong, amu etoning'o aajo kenya endaa tenebo teine.
Ore pee elotu Yosef ang, neyau atua enkaji enye inkishoorot naata, neirrugokino ninche ninye aabaiki enkop.
Neikilikuan Yosef ninche ilomon le seriani ajo, “Aisupat papaai linyi, ilo apa payian kitok liimakiita? Keton eishu?”
Nejo ninche, “Ore osinka lino, papaai lang naa aisupat neton eishu.” Neirrug ilukuny enye te dukuya ninye te nkanyit sapuk.
Nedumu Yosef inkonyek enyena nedol olalashe lenye Benchamen, olayioni le ng'otonye nejo, “Kele doi olalashe linyi oti ilo apa likitolikitio? Miking'urrie iyie Enkai enkayioni ai!”
Neisarrisar Yosef amu etayiewua oltau lenye olalashe lenye te nkirimo sapuk, nelo aing'oru ewueji nelo aishirie. Nejing atua olgilata, nelo aishir teine.
Ore pee eidip aishira, neituku enkomom enye nepuku; neitagol kewan nejo, “Enchoo endaa eyauni.”

Neng'asi aaisho Yosef eton openy, neitokini aisho ninche etoni oopeny, ore Ilmisiri ootoni oopeny neishori sii ninche aa ninche ake, amu ebaiki nemeng'ar Ilmisiri endaa tenebo Ilbrania, amu entoki ina naa enturuj too Lmisiri.
Netoni pooki te dukuya Yosef anaa enaikunari te mbotoro eiteru to lbotor te inoto ometabaiki oloti te inoto anaa kitisho enye; neing'or iltung'ana ate te nking'asia sapuk.
Neyakini pooki endaa naing'uaa emisa e Yosef, kake ore ene Benchamen naa katitin imiet te sapuko elusoo too nkulie. Metaa etookishote ninche neshipa tenebo Yosef.

Ina pee eitanap Yosef olaitasheikinoni lenye le nkaji enye ajoki, “Imputa ilbenia le lelo tung'ana endaa, tipika enaba anaa enaidim ake ninche aatanap, nipik impisai e pooki tung'ani enkutuk olbene lenye.
Nipik enkikompe ai ina kikompe e nkosholai enkutuk olbene lo loti lenye tenebo o impisai enyena naainosie ilpaek.”
Neas anaa enaitanapa Yosef ninye. Ore ake pee ekenyu, neishori iltung'ana epuo aareu isirkon lenye.

Ore ake pee epuo aalamari penyo aalam enkanasa, nejoki Yosef olaitasheikinoni le nkaji, enye, “Inyo, tusuja lelo tung'ana, ore ake pee inepu, tiaaki ninche, ‘Kainyoo pee itushukutuo entorrono te sidai? Kainyoo pee itupurroitie enkikompe ai e nkosholai?
Aime ena kikompe oshi eokishore olkitok lai naa te ninye eibonisho? Itaasa entorroni teina nitaasa.’ ”
Ore ake pee einepu ninche, neirorie ninche lelo rorei.
Nejoki ninche ninye, “Kainyoo pee eiro olkitok lang irorei laaijo kulo? Metalama isinkan linono ina, pee meas ake embae naaijo ina!
Itoduaa ajo ore inapa pisai nikinotito too nkutukie oo lbenia lang, kitushukutuo aashukoki iyie king'ua enkop e Kanaan; kaji naa kinko siake tinikipurroo enkosholai aashu saabu te nkaji olkitok lino?
Inchoo ake obo lang too sinkan linono otumi eeta, enchoo eye, nikiaku sii iyiook pooki irrindiki lo lkitok lang.”
Nejo ninye, “Enchoo naa eaku anaa enitejo, ore ake olotumi eeta neaku orrindik lai, ore ilkulikae linyi pooki neaku meeta entioto.”
Nesioki pooki ng'ae aitadou olbene lenye enkop, nebol pooki tung'ani olbene lenye.
Neing'oru te pooki eiteru to lbotor neitabayie to loti, netumi enkikompe to lbene le Benchamen.
Nepolos pooki inkilani enye, neirot pooki ng'ae esikiria enye, nerrinyo aapuo enkanasa.
Ore pee elotu Yuda o lalashera lenyena enkaji e Yosef, eton ake etii Yosef ine, nebatata te dukuya ninye aabatatakino enkop.
Nejoki Yosef ninche, “Kaa bae ena nikintaasa? Aimiyiololo aajo ore oltung'ani laaijo nanu naa kaidim aibonisho?”

Nejo Yuda, “Kaa taa kijoki olkitok lang? Kainyoo taa kiro aajo? Anaa kaji kinko tinikilaku ate? Enoto Enkai entorroni oo sinkan linono, kira iyiook irrindiki lo lkitok lang, iyiook pooki ometabaiki lido duoo linotie enkikompe.”
Kake etejo Yosef, “Meidimayu te nanu mataasa ina! Oltung'ani ake onotieki enkikompe ninye ake oaku orrindik lai, kake ore intae, enchom te seriani enetii papaai linyi.”

Ina pee elo Yuda enetii Yosef nejoki, “Oi olkitok lang, inchoo osinka lino eiro, aatasayia, kaliki ororei enkiok o lkitok lai, nimincho engoro ino eyupuyup to sinka lino, amu itiu doi iyie anaa Farao enkorrok.
Eikilikuana apa olkitok lai isinkan lenyena ajoki, ‘Iyatata papaai linyi anaa likae alashe?’

Nikiwal apa aajoki olkitok lang, ‘Kiata papa, naa olpayian kitok oleng, nikiata sii olalashe lang, oti olotioiwuoki te moruao enye, netua apa olalashe lenye, neaku ninye ake etung'uayioki too nkera e ng'otonye; naa kenyor menye ninye oleng.’
Nintoki ajoki isinkan linono, ‘Eyau ninye ene natii, pee adol ninye too nkonyek aainei.’
Nikijoki olkitok lang, ‘Meidim enkayioni atung'uai menye, amu tenelo aing'uaa menye, naa keye menye.’
Ina pee ijoki isinkan linono, ‘Pooki ake pee intokiki aadol enkomom ai, tenelotu olalashe linyi oti tenebo intae.’
“Ore pee kirrinyo enetii osinka lino, aa papa, nikiliki irorei lo lkitok lang.
Ore pee ejo papaai lang, ‘Enchom enyaaki enyiang'aki iyiook enkiti daa;’
nikijo, ‘Mikipuo katukul. Tenaa keiriamariyie iyiook olalashe lang oti naa aikipuo, amu mikindim katukul aatodol enkomom eilo tung'ani aashu ake kiata olalashe lang oti tenebo iyiook.’
Ina pee ejoki iyiook osinka lino papaai lang, ‘Iyiololo apa aajo aatoikio enkitok ai ilayiok oaare;
ore obo naatung'uayie nanu. Ina pee ajo, kesipa etumutaki apa aaitaa ndung'udung'ot, neitu aekata aitoki adol ninye.
Tinintokiki sii taata aaya ele aaitung'uaa nanu nelo netum enyamali e nkitamioto niyauu ilpapit laainei ooibor to sina enemeneng'a.’
Ore naa taata, ore tenalotu enetii osinka lino papaai lang, nemetii enkayioni tenebo iyiook, neaku ore enkishui enye neibung'are ena ayioni.
Ore pee edol ajo metii enkayioni tenebo iyiook, neye ninye, neyau isinkan linono ilpapit ooibor lo sinka lino papaai lang to sina enemeneng'a.
Amu etaa osinka lino oloitasheiki enkishui enkayioni, te papaai lang ejoki. Teneitu ashuku ninye enitii, naaku oloata entorroni te dukuya papaai te nkishui ai pooki,
metaa, ore naa taata, inchoo osinka lino, aatasayia, ejing erishata enkayioni aaku orrindik lo lkitok lai, nincho enkayioni eshuko tenebo ilalashera lenyena.
Amu kaji naa aikunari tenarrinyokino papaai lai marikito enkayioni? Ekaure doi ninye tenadol intorrok naajing'aki papaai lai.”

Neaku meekure eidim Yosef aibooi kewan te dukuya lelo pooki ooitashe te dukuya ninye; neishir ajo, “Enchoo pooki ng'ae otii ene aaipang aing'uaa.” Metaa meetae hoo oltung'ani obo otii ine ina kata eibalakinye Yosef kewan ilalashera lenyena.
Nebuaku aishir ometoning'o Ilmisiri ninye, nening sii enkaji pooki e Farao.
Nejoki Yosef ilalashera lenyena, “Ekara doi Yosef; keton eishu papaai?” Kake eitu eidim ilalashera lenyena aatawaliki ninye, amu eiputukunyo oleng te dukuya ninye.
Ina pee ejoki Yosef ilalashera lenyena, “Wootu entinyiku enatii atasayia intae.” Nepuonu aanyiku. Nejoki ninye, “Ekara olalashe linyi Yosef, ilo apa litimirakita enkop e Misiri.
Naa ore naa taata emiureishoyu, anaa igororo maate, te nkaraki nikitimirakita apa ena kop; amu Enkai apa naaiturukunye nanu maeu aitopok enkishui oo ltung'ana.
Amu etijing'a olameyu enkop te kulo arin pokira aare; neton aa kepuonu kulikae arin imiet laa metumi enturore anaa enkikesare.
Naairriu apa Enkai ene pee aituruku te ntae, pee alotu aitajeu ilekunot te nkop naitasheyie te nkaraki intae pee meye ilkumok.
Metaa mme intae apa likirriutua ene kake Enkai; naaeuo aaitaa menye le Farao, naaku olkitok le nkaji enye pooki o loitore enkop pooki e Misiri.
“Entasiooi esarisara enchom enetii papaai nijokiki ninye, ‘Inji ejo olayioni lino Yosef, aitaa Enkai olkitok le nkop pooki e Misiri; wou ene natii, mayieu nimutie.
Ilotu amany enkop e Goshen nikilotu anyikaki iyie tenebo o inkera inono o nkera oo nkera inono o ntare inono o nkishu inono o pooki toki niata.
Ore itii ine naaisho pooki toki niyieu, amu eton eetae kulikae arin imiet leton epuonu lo lameyu, pee mikiya iyie osina o lmarei lino pooki o pooki toki niata.’
“Idolitata too nkonyek inyi, nedolita nkonyek o lalashe lai Benchamen inchere enkutuk ai nairorie intae.
Enchom entoliki papaai esikar pooki naata tene te Misiri, o pooki toki nitodua tene. Entasiooi eyau papaai ene.”
Ina pee emuataki inkaik olalashe lenye Benchamen aishiraki; neishirakino pokira.
Neng'utut ilalashera lenyena pooki neishiraki ninye ninche; ore pee eidip ina neiteru ilalashera aairorie ninye.
Ore pee ening'i ilo omoni te nkaji e Farao, eji, “Eetuo ilalashera le Yosef,” neitiship ina Farao o ilaisiaayiak lenyena.
Nejoki Farao Yosef, “Tiaaki ilalashera linono, entaas ena ‘Eroto isirkon linyi nipuopuo aarrinyo enkop e Kanaan;
nirikuku papaai linyi o pooki tung'ani loo lmareita linyi, nipuonunu enatii, naa kaisho nanu intae enkop naisul ena kop e Misiri te sidano, naa ainyanya empiron ena kop.’
Intanapa ake sii ninche tiaaki, ‘Entaas ena: entereu ingarrin tena kop e Misiri pee enapunyieki inkera inyi o nkituaak inyi, niyauu papaai linyi nipuonunu.
Niminkenaa aajo kitung'uaitie imasaa ang e tipat teine amu ore inaaisul enkop pooki e Misiri naa inkuninyi.’ ”
Neas ilayiok le Israel ina; neisho Yosef ninche ingarrin te risioroto eina naitanapishe Farao, neisho sii ninche endaa nainosaa epuo te nkoitoi o epuonu.
Meeta ake sii oleitu eisho te pooki lenye inkilani ng'ejuko kake eishoo Benchamen shekeli iip uni e nkosholai o nkilani imiet ng'ejuko.
Ore papaai lenye, neirriwaki kuna; isirkon tomon ooiroto too ntokitin sidain e Misiri, o lipong'a tomon oo sirkon naanapita entapa, o imukateni, o ntokitin naanya papaai lenye te nkoitoi.
Ina pee eisho ilalashera lenyena meshomo, nejoki ninche, “Mayieu ake ninchankarrarra te nkoitoi.”
Metaa etudumunye aapuo aaing'uaa Misiri nebau Kanaan enetii papaai lenye, Yakobo.
Neliki ninye lelo omon, nejoki, “Eton doi ake eishu Yosef, naa ninye oitore enkop pooki e Misiri!” Neiterre Yakobo, amu eitu eiruk ninye ninche.
Kake ore pee eliki ninche irorei pooki le Yosef, lelo apa ootiaka ninye ninche, ore ake sii pee edol ingarrin naaetuo pee enap ninye neitoki oltau le Yakobo papaai lenye apok.
Nejo Israel eidipe eton doi eishu olayioni lai Yosef; ekalo adol ninye eton eitu aye.
Metaa etudumunye Yakobo alo o pooki toki naata, nepuonu Beer-sheba, neitayu ilasarri aaitaiki Enkai e papaai lenye Isaak.
Neirorie Enkai Israel too nkitoduat e kewarie nejoki ninye, “Yakobo, Yakobo,” nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”
Ina pee ejoki, “Kara nanu Enkai, Enkai e papaai lino; miureyu ilo Misiri; amu kaalo aitaa olosho sapuk teine.
Ekaairiamariyie iyie Misiri, naa kaaitoki ashuku ene, neaku inkaik e Yosef ilo airurare.”
Ina pee epuku Yakobo aing'uaa Beer-sheba, nenap ilayiok le Israel Yakobo papaai lenye, o nkera enye, o nkituaak enye too ngarrin naairriwua Farao metanapa ninche.
Eterewa sii inkishu enye o masaa enye, naanoto te nkop e Kanaan, nepuonu enkop e Misiri, Yakobo o eishoi enye pooki:
ilayiok lenyena, o layiok loo layiok lenyena tenebo ninye o ntoyie enyena o ntoyie oo layiok lenyena o eishoi enye pooki eyaua ninye pooki tenebo ninye Misiri.
Kuna ninche inkarn e ishoi e Israel, naaetuo atua Misiri, Yakobo o layiok lenyena, Ruben, olkikau le Yakobo.
Ore ilayiok le Ruben, naa: Hanok o Palu o Hesron o Karmi.
Ore ilayiok le Simon naa: Yemuel o Yamin o Ohal o Yakin o Sohar o Saul, aa layiok le nkitok oo Lkanaani.
Ore ilayiok le Lawi naa: Gershon o Kohat o Merari.
Ore ilayiok le Yuda naa: Eri o Onan o Shela o Peres o Sera (kake ore Eri o Onan netuata te nkop e Kanaan): ore ilayiok le Peres naa: Hesron o Hamul.
Ore ilayiok le Isaakar naa: Tola o Pufa o Yob o Shimron.
Ore ilayiok le Sebulon naa: Sered o Elon o Yahaleel
(kulo apa ilayiok le Lea ootoikio ninye Yakobo te Padan Aram, tenebo entito enye Dina; neaku pooki ilayiok o ntoyie enyena iltung'ana tomoni uni o kuni).
Ore ilayiok le Gad naa: Sifion o Haggi o Shuni o Esbon o Eri o Arod o Areli.
Ore ilayiok le Asheri naa: Imna o Ishfa o Ishfi o Beria, tenebo Sera enkanashe enye. Ore ilayiok le Beria naa: Heber o Malkiel
(kulo ninche ilayiok le Silpa oishoo Laban Lea entito enye; neaku kulo etoikio Yakobo - iltung'ana tomon o ile).
Ore ilayiok le Raheli, enkitok e Yakobo naa: Yosef o Benchamen.
Neikini Yosef te nkop e Misiri Manaseh o Efraim, laa ninche etoikio Asenat entito e Potifera olapolosani le Oni.
Ore ilayiok le Benchamen naa: Bela o Becher o Ashbel o Gera o Naaman o Ehi o Rosh o Mupin o Huppin o Ard
(kulo ninche ilayiok le Raheli ootoikioki Yakobo - iltung'ana tomon oong'uan pooki.)
Ore ilayiok le Dan naa: Hushim.
Ore ilayiok le Naftali naa: Yahseel o Guni o Yeser o Shilem,
(kulo ninche ilayiok le Bilha, ooishoo Laban Raheli entito enye, neaku kulo ninye etoikio Yakobo - iltung'ana oopishana pooki.)
Ore iltung'ana pooki le Yakobo ooetuo atua Misiri, laa ile ishoi enye enkorrok, nemeikenaro ilayiok loo nkituaak oo layiok lenyena naa iltung'ana intomoni ile o ile pooki;
o layiok aare le Yosef ootoikioki ninye te Misiri. Neaku ore olorere pooki le nkaji e Yakobo oetuo atua Misiri naa iltung'ana intomoni naapishana.
Neirriwaa Israel Yuda meituruko alo enetii Yosef ajoki ninye menotore ninye te Goshen; nepuonu ninche enkop e Goshen.
Neirot Yosef engarri enye oo mbartan nelo anang'are papaai lenye Israel te Goshen; nekuetiki Yosef papaai lenye nemuataki inkaik enyena emurt, aishir te murt enye te nkata naado.
Nejoki Israel Yosef, “Etaa taa nchooki matua amu aatoduaa enkomom ino nayiolo ajo eton ake inchu.”
Nejoki Yosef ilalashera lenyena o enkaji e menye pooki; “Ekalo ainosaki Farao, naa kajoki ninye, ‘Ore ilalashera laainei o enkaji e papa pooki, ootii apa enkop e Kanaan, neetuo enatii.
Ore lelo tung'ana naa ilairritak, amu ilaramatak loo nkishu, neyautua intare enye o nkishu enye o pooki toki naata.’
Ore teneipot intae nejoki intae: ‘Kainyoo esiaai inyi niasiasa?’

Enchom entejo, ore isinkan linono naa ilaramatak loo nkishu eiteru te keraisho o metabaiki ena kata, iyiook tenebo o loo papa lang; pee itumutumu aatamany enkop e Goshen; Amu ore pooki aramatani loo ntare naa olminong too Lmisiri.”

Metaa eshomo Yosef ajing'aki Farao te nkaji, nejoki: “Ore papaai lai o lalashera laainei, tenebo o intare enye o nkishu enye o pooki toki naata, eetuo aaing'uaa enkop e Kanaan. Netii taata ninche ina kop e Goshen.”
Neriku too lalashera lenyena ltung'ana imiet arikoki Farao.
Nejoki Farao ilalashera le Yosef. “Kainyoo oshi esaiai inyi niasiasa?” Nejoki ninche Farao, “Ore isinkan linono naa ilaramatak, anaa enatiu apa iloo papa lang.”

Nejoki ninche Farao, “Kietuo iyiook aamany ena kop, amu meeta indaat oo ntare isinkan linono, amu etaa olameyu sapuk te nkop e Kanaan; naa ore taata, kiomon iyie inchoo isinkan linono emany enkop e Goshen.”
Ina pee ejoki Farao Yosef, “Eewuo papaai lino o lalashera enitii.

Neina enkop e Misiri natii dukuya iyie, intamanya papaai lino o lalashera linono ine wueji sidai aisul tena kop, inchoo emany enkop e Goshen naa tiniyiolo iltung'ana airritak supati te ninche tipika ninche meitasheiki inkishu aainei.”
Ina peyie eitijing'u Yosef Yakobo papaai lenye neitoton te dukuya Farao, nemayian Yakobo Farao.
Nejoki Farao Yakobo, “Kaja inkolong'i oo larin le nkishui ino.”

Nejoki Yakobo Farao, “Ore inkolong'i oo larin laainei lenkidurrudur ai naa ilarin iip o tomoni uni; kuti naa torrok inkolong'i oo larin le nkishui ai, neitu ebaiki inkolong'i oo larin le nkishui oo loo papa too nkolong'i enkidurrudur enye.”
Nemayian Yakobo Farao nepuku alo aing'uaa Farao.
Neaku eitamanya Yosef ilalashera lenyena Misiri, neisho ninye ninche enkop metaa enenye te Misiri, ewueji neisul teina kop e Rameses, anaa enaitanapishe Farao.
Neisho Yosef papaai lenye, tenebo o ilalashera lenyena, o lmarei lenye pooki endaa, te risioroto esiana oo ltung'ana lenye.
Etaa apa meekure eetae endaa teinakop pooki; amu etasapuka olameyu oleng, metaa etaa enkop e Misiri o enkop e Kanaan enaisumash te nkaraki olameyu.
Nesotu Yosef impisai pooki naanotoki te nkop e Misiri o te nkop e Kanaan, te ntapa nainyiang'utua; neyau Yosef nena pisai aya enkaji e Farao.
Neaku ore pee emiri aaishu impisai pooki te nkop e Misiri o te nkop e Kanaan, nepuonu Ilmisiri pooki enetii Yosef nejoki ninye, “Inchoo iyiook endaa; Kainyoo pee kiye te dukuya nkonyek inono?
Amu kiishutua impisai ang.” Newaliki Yosef ajoki, “Enchoru inkishu inyi, naa kaisho intae endaa awalunye nkishu inyi tenetaa eishunye impisai inyi.”
Metaa nerewaki inkishu enye Yosef; neisho Yosef ninche endaa awalunye imbartan enye o intare o nkishu o sirkon: neisho ninye ninche endaa awalunye nkishu enye pooki teilo ari.

Ore pee eishunye ilo ari, neitoki aapuonu to likae ari nejoki Yosef, “Mikisudorie ate olkitok lang inchere eishunye impisai ang pooki, ore iluaat oo nkishu naa ino lkitok lang; metii ae toki natung'uayioki te dukuya olkitok lang meteleku iseseni lang ake o enkop ang.

Kainyoo pee kiye te dukuya inkonyek inono, iyiook tenebo o enkop ang? Inyiang'u iyiook tenebo o enkop ang te ndaa; ore iyiook tenebo enkop ang nikiaku irrindiki le Farao; nincho iyiook ilanterera pee mikiiye, neaku ena kop pooki mitil.”
Metaa einyiang'ua Yosef enkop pooki e Misiri ainyiang'aki Farao, amu etimira Ilmisiri inkurman enye amu etarasua olameyu oleng te ninche. Neaku enkop pooki ene Farao.
Ore iltung'ana neaku, irrindiki pooki eiteru te nkiting'oto nabo e Misiri o metabaiki enkae kiting'oto.
Enkop ake oo lapolosak ake eitu einyiang'u; amu keeta apa ilapolosak emborei enye nauno naishoo Farao, neishunyie ina borei enye naishoo Farao ninche. Metaa eitu ninche emir enkop enye.
Ina pee ejoki Yosef iltung'ana, “Idolitata ajo ainyiang'ua intae ena olong tenebo o enkop inyi aitaa ene Farao. Ore naa, noolo ilanterera linyi, naa entuun enkop.
Ore te nkata e nkikesare ninchosho ematua e imiet Farao, ore ematua e ong'uan neaku eninyi too ilanterera le nkop, neaku sii endaa inyi o lmarei linyi, o ndaiki naanya inkera inyi.”
Nejo ninche, “Intajeuo enkishui ang; inchoo eitiship ena olkitok lang, aikiaaku iyiook irrindiki le Farao.”
Metaa eitobirua Yosef inkiguanat naaipirta enkop e Misiri, neitashe nena kiguanat o taata, inchere ketum Farao ematua e imiet e nkikesare. Enkop ake oo lapolosak neitu eaku ene Farao.
Metaa etamanya Israel Enkop e Misiri ina kop e Goshen; netum imasaa kumok teine, neeisho oleng nebul te nkumoi.
Neton Yakobo te nkop e Misiri ilarin tomon opishana; metaa ore inkolong'i oo larin le nkishui e Yakobo naa iip o artam oopishana.

Ore pee enyiku inkolong'i pee eaku enkata nairura Israel, neipot olayioni lenye Yosef nejoki ninye, “Tenetaa taata anoto omom too nkonyek inono, tipika enkaina ino kirrisha nkupesir aainei nikisiligie ajo aikintaas nanu enkanyit o esipata.

Ore pee airura tenebo olopapamayieu nikinukaa nanu te Misiri, kake tunukayioki nanu tiatua inkuraren oo loo papa; tanapaki nanu intung'uayioki Misiri nikilo aturoo nanu te wueji enye neturorie olorere.” Newaliki Yosef ajoki, “Ekaas anaa enitejo.”
Nejo, “Inosa olmumai te nanu.” Nenya Yosef olmumai. Ina pee eirrug Israel endukuya enye te dukuya e ndapash enye.
Ore pee elusoo nena, nelikini Yosef aajoki, Kemuoi papaai lenye. Metaa etoriko ninye ilayiok lenyena aare, Manase o Efraim.
Nelikini Yakobo aajoki, “Eewuo olayioni lino Yosef enitii;” neitagoluo Israel nenyok ainyototo aton te ndapash.
Nejoki Yakobo Yosef, “Aaipang'aka Enkai Magilani nanu te Lus te nkop e Kanaan naamayian nanu,
naajoki nanu, ‘Idol ajo kaaisho iyie tubula, naa kaaponaa iyie, naaitaa iyie olorora loo ltung'ana kumok, naa kaisho ena kop eishoi ino nikisuju metaa enenye intarasi.’
“Ore ilayiok linono pokira aare likitoikioki te nkop e Misiri eton eitu alotu enitii tene te Misiri; naa ilaainei; Efraim o Manase keaku ilaanei anaa paa ilaainei Ruben o Simon.
Ore eishoi nitum te siadi ninche naa keaku ilinono; naa keipotieki ninche enkarna oo lalashera te njung'ore enye.
Amu ore apa pee alotu te Padan Aram, aainepua osina etua Raheli te nkop e Kanaan te nkoitoi, eton elakua elototo pee ebau Efrat. Naturoo ninye teine te nkotoi aloito Efrat (aa ninye Betlehem).”
Ore pee edol Israel ilayiok le Yosef, nejo “Kakua doi kulo?”
Nejoki Yosef papaai lenye, “Ilayiok laainei ninche, lelo apa laaishoo Enkai tene.” Nejo Israel, “Toriku ninche ene natii, aatasayia pee atum atamayiana ninche.”
Ore ina kata, eiliilaitie nkonyek e Israel te moruao, metaa meidim ninye atisipu. Neaku eyaua Yosef ninche aitinyiaki ninye; neng'utut Israel ninche neitamuat inkaik enyena.
Nejoki Israel Yosef, “Majo apa kaitoki adol enkomom ino; kake aaishoo Enkai matoduaa sii inkera inono.”
Metaa eiwuangie Yosef ninche too nkung e papaai lenye, neirrugo ninye makewan abaiki enkop.

Nerik Yosef ninche pokira, etii Efraim enkaina enye e tatene eitorioki enkaina e kedianye e Israel, netii Manase enkaina enye e kedianye eitorioki ninye enkaina e tatene e Israel, neriku Yosef ninche aitinyikaki papaai lenye.

Neitorioo Israel enkaina enye e tatene neiteleiki ninye endukuya e Efraim, laa ninye oloti, ore enkaina enye e kedianye neiteleikiendukuya e Manase, aitapaash inkaik, amu ore Manase naa ninye olbotor.
Nemayian ninye Yosef ajo: “Ore ina Ai naisiaayia iloo Papa te dukuya nanu, Abraham o Isaak, ina Ai naatorikoyie te nkishui ai pooki o metabaiki ena olong,

Ilo malaika laaitajeuo nanu te pooki torroni, tamayiana kuna ayiok. Naa te ninche inchoo enkarna ai meipoti, tenebo o enkarna oo loo papa Abraham o Isaak; Naa inchoo ninche ebul aaku ilororani tiatua ena kop pooki.”
Ore pee edol Yosef ajo eiteleikia menye enkaina e tatene shumata endukuya e Efraim neitu eitiship ninye, nedumu enkaina e menye aitayu aitung'uaa endukuya e Efraim apik ene Manase.
Nejoki Yosef papaai lenye, “Ime neijia etiu papaai, amu ore ilo naa ninye olkikau; tipika enkaina ino e tatene shumata endukuya enye.”
Kake etanya menye tukul nejo, “Ekayiolo olayioni lai, ekayiolo; ekeaku sii ninye kitok; kake ore ake eyia, ekeaku olalashe lenye oti kitok te ninye, ore eishoi enye naa keaku olorere kumok.”
Metaa etamayiana ninye ninche ina olong nejoki, “Te iyie elo Israel aibalie imayianat ajo, ‘Mikintotiwuo Enkai anaa Efraim o Manase’ ”, neaku neijia eikuna Israel aitojool Efraim Manase.
Ina pee ejoki Israel Yosef, “Etataana enkata pee aye, kake keaku Enkai tenebo iyie, naa aikintoki ayau iyie ina kop o loo papaai lino.
Ore ake sii, aaishoo iyie ineitu aisho ilalashera linono Shekem enkiyopata o ldoinyo, ine wueji nepir naawa too nkaik oo Lamori to lalem lai o te nkawuo ai.”
Ina peyie eipotu Yakobo ilayiok lenyena nejoki, “Enturrurroto tenebo, pee atum atoliki intae imbaa naatiu too nkolong'i naapuonu.
Enturrurroto entoning, intae ilayiok le Yakobo, nining'ining'i Israel papaai linyi.
Ruben, ira iyie olkikau lai, engolon ai, naa olng'anayioi le dukuya lai le ngolon ai. Oloituruk lo lwuasa naa oloituruk te ngolon.
Olemeitirring'a anaa enkare, miaku iyie ololus te pooki, amu itijing'aka endapash e papaai lino; ina peyie isarkionie ninye ishomo endapash ai ainyal.
Ore Simion o Lawi naa ilalashera, ore imasaa enye olarrabal naa ilalema lenye.
Oi oltau lai, milotu ake enkiguana enye; Oi lotau lai, mintaa ninche encholiek. Amu te ngoro enye ear iltung'ana metuata, naa to lwuasa lenye etudung'o errishet o lkiteng.
Metedeki engoro enye, amu kepi ninye; o engoro enye napi, amu ketolo! Ekaor ninche tiatua Yakobo, naidapash ninche tiatua Israel.
Yuda, aikisis iyie ilalashera linono; Neibung inkaik inono imurto oo lmang'ati linono; ore ilayiok le papaai lino naa keirrugo te dukuya iyie.
Ore Yuda naa ketiu anaa olkuoo lo lng'atuny; olotu eing'uaa eng'orore, enkerai ai ilepa iyie. Itadowuo iyie anaa olng'atuny aitirring'a, anaa elipong olng'atuny, aing'ae oitieu atuputu ninye.
Meing'uaa eng'udi e nkitoria enkaji e Yuda, aashu orinka le nkitoria empolos oo nkejek enyena, ometaba anaa nebaiki ninye olopeny, neaku enenye enkanyit oo iltung'ana pooki.

Neeniki osikiria lenye olchani lo sabibu, ore olkurrarru lenye neeniki ilo sabibu gelunoti. Neisuj ninye inkilani enyena te naisho oo sabibu, neisuj inkilani enyena too lng'anayio oonyokie anaa osarge.
Ekedoru inkonyek enyena te naisho oo sabibu. Neibor ilala lenyena te okoto e kule.
Ore Sebulon naa kemany embata enaiposha, naa keaku ewueji neitasheyie imelin. Ore olpolosie lenye netii Sidon.
Ore Isaakar naa osikiria ogol, neirrag te rishata oo muatat oo ntare.
Etoduaa ajo ore eneyeng'iyeng'areki naa aisidai, naa ekeitishipisho enkop, metaa keirrugoo oloililae lenye anap, neaku orrindik te siaai naarakini.
Ekeiguanare Dan iltung'ana lenyena, anaa obo loo loshon le Israel.
Keaku Dan olasurai te nkoitoi, enturbubua te nkoitoi, ina naony intutuny oo mbartan, ometusulu ilo okedito embarta.
Ekaanyu enjeunoto ino, iyie Olaitoriani.
Kerasaki ilapurrok Gad, kake keibelekenyakino ninye ninche amir ninche.
Ore enkop e Asheri naa keiu endaa sapuk, naa keitayu ninye endaa nanya olkitok.
Ore Naftali naa enkolii naipirri etalaayioki, neitayu ororei sidai.
Ore Yosef naa olng'osila oiu ilng'anayio, olng'osila loo lng'anayio te nkong'u enkare. Keibulaa ilng'osil lenyena esuntai.
Kearare ilang'orok loo mbaa ninye te ngolon, neng'or ninye, neitagor ninye oleng.
Nemeing'unung'unieki hoo enkawuo enye, neitaariyiani inkaik enyena, inkaik Olmagilani le Yakobo (Te nkarna e ilo Shekut, Endapidapoi e Israel).
Te Nkai e papaai lino laa ninye likiret iyie, te Nkai Magilani laa ninye likimayian iyie, too mayianat e keper e shumata. Imayianat oo neegut naairrag tiabori, imayianat oo lki o ene nguset.

Ore Imayianat e papaai lino naa Magil aalus too mayianat oo ldoinyo loo ntarasi. Ore nena tokitin sidain naaing'uaa ndoinyo oo ntarasi; metotonie ninche endukuya e Yosef, o enkopiyia eilo apa otoorori too lalashera lenyena.
Ore Benchamen, naa osuyiani otang'arase, neyooki enasirie aar eng'ues, ore teipa neor iyarunot.”
Ore kulo pooki naa iloshon tomon oaare le Israel; naa nena apa eitanapa menye pooki emayian ninye ninche, emayianaki pooki ng'ae emayianata naishiaakino ninye.
Ina pee eitanap Yakobo ilayiok lenyena nejoki ninche, “Ore amu ekalo enetii iltung'ana lainei te keeya; entunukayioki tenebo iloo papa te nkapune natii enkurma e Efron le Hiti.
Ina apune natii enkurma e Makpela, oloosaen le Mamre te nkop e Kanaan, nainyiang'ua apa Abraham tenebo o ina kurma e Efron lo Lhiti aitaa enenye nanukarie iltung'ana lenyena.
Teine apa etunukaitie ninche Abraham o Sara enkitok enye naa te ninye sii etunukayioki Isaak o Rebeka enkitok enye; naa teine sii atunukayie Lea.
Ore ina kurma tenebo o ina apune natii atua neinyang'uaki apa too Lhiti.”
Ore pee eidip Yakobo aitanapa ilayiok lenyena, nerrinyoki inkejek enyena endapash, neirurayie ina. Nepiki ninye eneiturrurrorre olorere lenye pooki.
Ina pee ebatatakino Yosef enkomom e menye neishiraki ninye, neng'utut ninye.
Neitanap Yosef isinkan lenyena lelo kitarrini meitobira osesen le papaai lenye pee meng'uoyu. Metaa eitobira ilkitarrini osesen le Israel pee meng'uoyu.
Ewa enkielata inoshi ake olong'i artam naasieki ina siaai e nkitobirata o sesen. Neishiraki Ilmisiri ninye too nkolong'i ntomoni naapishana.
Ore pee eishunye inkolong'i naaishirakinyeki ninye, neirorie Yosef olmarei pooki le Farao nejoki, “Ore taata tenanoto omom too nkonyek inyi eroro, atasayia intae entiaki Farao,

aainosie apa papa olmumai aajoki, ‘Etaa kaye: te nkurare ai natuturoko kewan te nkop e Kanaan, ninye kinukarierie nanu.’ Metaa ore naa taata nchooki nanu mashomo atasayia ntae, pee alo anukaa papa, pee aitoki ashukunye.”
Newaliki Farao Yosef ajoki, “Shomo, tunukai papaai lino anaa apa enikinosie olmumai.”
Metaa eshomo Yosef anukaa papaai lenye, neiriamariyie ninye isinkan pooki le Farao, o lpayiani lo lmarei lenye pooki tenebo ilpayiani pooki le nkop e Misiri.
Tenebo enkaji pooki e menye o enenye o lalashera lenyena o lmarei pooki le papaai lenye, nkera enye ake etung'uayioki o ntare o nkishu te nkop e Goshen.
Metaa eshomo tenebo ninye ingarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan; metaa olorora kitok apa oleng.

Ore pee ebau olkurroto oidong'ishoreki te wueji neji Atad natii oloosaen le Yordan, neishir teine olkiyioi sapuk le nkishirita o sina; neitobiraki Yosef enkishirata e papaai lenye too nkolong'i naapishana.

Ore pee edol Ilkanaani aa ninche iloopeny ina kop enkishirata to lkurroto ooidong'ishoreki le Atad, nejo ninche, “Ore ena kishirata naa eno sina kitok too Lmisiri.” Metaa eishooki apa ine wueji enkarna aajo Abel-Misraim; naa dukuya e Yordan etii.
Ina apa eitaasa ilayiok le Yakobo menye anaa enaitanapa ninche;

mu etanapa apa ilayiok lenyena ninye aaya enkop e Kanaan, nenukaa ninye te nkapune natii enkurma e Makpela, natii oloosaen le Mamre, nainyiang'ua apa Abraham tenebo o enkurma e Efron lo Lhiti, metaa ewueji enye oo nkuraren.
Ore pee eidip atunukai papaai lenye, neshuko Yosef alo Misiri tenebo o ilalashera lenyena o lelo pooki oiriamariyie ninye pee epuo aanukaa papaai lenye.
Ore peyie edol ilalashera le Yosef aajo etua papaai lenye nejo ninche, “Ebaiki taa neibayu iyiook Yosef neitalak iyiook enapa lap nikintaasa iyiook ninye.”
Metaa eirriwaitie ninche olkilikuai aairriwaki Yosef nejoki, “Eishorua apa papaai lino ena kitanapata eton eitu eye nejo,

‘Entiaki Yosef, tapalaki, aatasayia enkitarruorroto oo lalashera linono o eng'oki enye, amu kintaasa ninche iyie entorroni.’ Ore naa taata, kisai iyie, tapalaki inkitadiaat oo sinkan le Nkai e papaai lino.” Neishir Yosef pee eirorie ilalashera lenyena ninye.
Nepuonu ilalashera lenyena nebatata te dukuya ninye nejoki, “Ng'ura, aikira iyiook isinkan linono.”
Kake etiaaka Yosef ninche, “Emiureishoyu, katii nanu ewueji e Nkai?
Ore te intae, naa entorroni apa kiyiewuakiki; kake eitaa ninye Enkai esidai, pee etum aitopuaa iltung'ana kumok anaa enatiu ena olong.
Metaa emiureishoyu; kaisho intae eretoto tenebo o nkera inyi.” Neijia eikuna aitisipaki ninche neitagol ninche.
Metaa etotona Yosef te Misiri, ninye tenebo o lmarei le papaai lenye; nebik Yosef ilarin iip o tomon.
Einepua Yosef adol eishoi o layioni lenye Efraim e uni, etodua sii inkera e Makir olayioni le Manase naatoikioki olmarei le Yosef.
Nejoki Yosef ilalashera lenyena, “Etaa kaye, kake kelotu Enkai amayian intae, nelotu aitayu intae aitung'uaa ena kop arik intae enkop nainosakinye Abraham olmumai, o Isaak o Yakobo.”
Nenya Yosef olmumai too layiok le Israel nejoki, “Kemayian intae Enkai, naa entanap iloik lainei entung'uai ena kop.”
Metaa eirure Yosef, aa oloo larin iip o tomon te moruao; neitobir ninche osesen lenye pee meng'uoyu, nepiki osesen lenye osanduku te Misiri.
Kuna inkarn oo layiok le Yakobo ooetuo apa Misiri te nebo ninye, oltung'ani ake o lmarei lenye:
Ruben o Simion o Lawi o Yuda,
Isakar o Sebulon o Benchamen,
Dan o Naftali, Gad o Asheri.
Ore eishoi pooki e Yakobo naa iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana, netii Yosef apa laa obo lenye ina kata Misiri.
Neye Yosef o lalashera lenyena pooki o ina ishoi pooki.
Kake ore apa eishoi e Israel naa kebul oleng neponari aaku kumok; neponari ninche neaku olosho ogol; neiput ina kop.
Neitokini aaput likae aiguanani te Misiri lemeyiolo Yosef.
Nejoki ninye iltung'ana lenyena, “Eng'ura ajo aikumok oleng iltung'ana loo Siraeli, negoli oleng te iyiook.
Wootu maing'uraki ninche olosek, pee mebul ake, pee te nelo ake nikitum olarrabal, neibung'are ilmang'ati lang neing'ar iyiook neisik te nkop ang.”
Negeluni ilaitasheikinok ooitasheiki ninche pee eisilisil ninche te sinkaisho nagol oleng; neshetaki Farao nkanas naashumishoreki naaji Pisom o Ramases.
Kake ore anaa enaibookini ninche enkop, neponari neidapashakino aaiput enkop. Neiput enkuretisho iltung'ana le Misiri neureyu Isiraeli oleng.
Neaku keisho ninche iltung'ana loo Siraeli meisiaaisho to sina sapuk.

Nepik enkishui enye emion te sinkaisho nagol anaa enchetare nagol oo nkajijik oo soito o too mpukunot pooki e siaai ti ong'ata; ore too siaaitin enye pooki neisho ninche meisiaaisho te sinkaisho nagol oleng.
Neitoki ilo aiguanani le Misiri ajoki inkaitoyiok oo Lbrania, aa keji nabo Shifra neji enkae Pua,
“Ti nintoishosho nkituaak oo Lbrania nidolidolo ina kata eisho, tenaa enkayioni niariara ninye metua; kake tenaa entito enchoo eton eishu.”
Kake keure apa nena aitoyiok Enkai, neitu eas anaa enaitanapa ninche olaiguanani le Misiri, kake eishoo inkayiok etoni eishu.
Metaa eipoto olaiguanani le Misiri nena aitoyiok, nejoki ninche, “Kainyoo pee itaasa ena, ninchosho nkayiok eishu?”
Nejoki nena aitoyiok Farao, “Te nkaraki nemetiu inkituaak oo Lbrania anaa inkituaak oo Lmisiri; amu kegol inkituaak oo Lbrania oishuaa, naa keisho eton eitu ebau enkaitoyioni.”
Neitaas Enkai esidai nena aitoyiok; neponari iltung'ana loo Siraeli aagolu neaku kumok oleng.
Ore te nkaraki naure nena aitoyiok Enkai neisho ninche ilmareita.
Neitoki Farao aitanap iltung'ana lenyena pooki ajo, “Ore pooki ayioni naini too Lbrania ninang'akiki olkeju oji Nail, kake enchoo intoyie eishu.”
Nelo oltung'ani obo le nkaji e Lawi ayam entito e Lawi.
Nenutayu ina kitok neiu enkayioni, ore ake pee edol ajo enkerai sidai, neisudoo ninye ilapaitin okuni.
Ore ake pee eaku meekure eisudoroyu, neshetaki ninye enkikapu naitobiraki too seyia nemur te ntoki naji laam; nepik ninye enkerai atua paa kepik ina kikapu atua iseyia te mbata o lkeju.
Neitashe enkanashe enye te nelakua, pee eyiolou enaitaasi ninye.
Ore ina kata ake nelotu entito e Farao adou aisuja to lkeju, nepuonu nkaisiaayiak enyena te mbata o lkeju; nedol ninye enkikapu tiatua iseyia, neirriwaa enkaisiaayiani enye meyau.
Ore ake pee ebol nedol enkerai, neishirita ina kerai. Neing'urrie ninye nejo, “Enoo nkera oo Lbrania ena kerai.”
Nejoki enkanashe eina looyo entito e Farao, “Aalo aipotoki enkaibung'ani too nkituaak oo Lbrania pee kintubulaki ena kerai?”
Nejoki entito e Farao ninye, “Shomo.” Nelo entito aipotu ng'otonye ina kerai.
Nejoki entito e Farao ninye, “Iwa ina kerai, pee kintubulaki nanu, naa kaaisho nanu olekoisiaayio lino.” Neya ina kitok enkerai aitubulu.
Nebulu ina kerai, neyau ninye ayaki entito e Farao, neaku ninye olayioni lenye, neipot enkarna enye ajo Musa, amu etejo, “Te nkaraki naitayio ninye tiatua enkare.”
Ore nabo olong, etubulua Musa, neipang alo enetii iltung'ana lenyena nedol enkiroishi e siaai nagol naasita. Neitoki adol Olmisiri earita Olbruaniai, obo loo ltung'ana lenyena.
Neing'oring'orisho, ore ake pee edol ajo melio oltung'ani hoo obo, near ninye ilo Misiri metua nenukaa tiatua osinyai.
Ore pee eitoki aipang likae kekun, nedol Ilbrania aare oopupung'a aara; nejoki ninye ilo tung'ani oitarruoyie, “Kainyoo pee iar oltung'ani lo lorere lino?”
Nejoki ilo tung'ani ninye, “Kaing'ae likintaa iyie olkitok o larishani te iyiook? Ijo pee kiar nanu matua anaa enitaara Olmisiri metua?” Neirut Musa, nejo, “Esipa etayioloki ena bae.”
Ore pee ening Farao ina, neing'oru pee ear Musa metua. Kake eisika Musa ailany Farao, nebik te nkop e Midian neton te mbata e nchorro.
Etii apa olapolosani le Midian oata ntoyie naapishana, nepuonu aaoku enkare neiput impeuti pee eitook ntare e menye.
Nepuonu ilairritak loontare aaraa ninche, kake eitasho Musa aretu ninche, neitook ntare enye.
Ore ake pee epuonu ninche enetii menye lenye Reul, nejoki ninye ninche, “Kaji taata eikununo pee ietuo aasieku?”
Nejo ninche, “Olmisiri oitajewuo iyiook too nkaik oo lchekuti o metooku ninye enkare neitook ntare.”
Nejoki menye nena toyie enyena, “Paa kaji etii ninye? Kainyoo pee itung'uaitie ilo tung'ani? Empoto ninye pee elotu anya endaa.”
Nenyorraa Musa aton te nebo ilo tung'ani, neisho ninye Musa entito enye naji Sipora.
Neiki ninye enkayioni, nejo ninye enkarna enye Gershom, amu etejo ninye, “Kara olomoni te nkop neme enaai.”

Ore etulusoitie ilarin ooikash, neye ilo aiguanani le Misiri. Neton ake eisomita iltung'ana loo Siraeli te sinkaisho enye, neyietu aaishiru eretoto; ore ilo kiyioi lenye le sinkaisho neilep enetii Enkai.
Nening Enkai ilo somit lenye, nedamu Enkai olning'o lenye lo sotua o Abraham o Isaak o tenebo Yakobo.
Nedol Enkai iltung'ana le Israel, neyiolou Enkai empukunoto enye.
Eing'orita apa Musa ntare o laputani lenye oji Yesro, laa olapolosani le Midian, nerikoo eluaata enye aipirie enkalo o loontoluo le Midian, nelotu ewueji neji Horeb ilo doinyo le Nkai.
Neipang'aki ninye olmalaika lo Laitoriani to lng'ejep le nkima opuku te mpolos o sanag, neing'or nedol eyupuyupito osanag, neitu emut enkima.
Nejo Musa, “Ekaibelekenya aing'or ena pukunoto e nking'asia kitok, inchere kainyoo pee eitu enya enkima ilo sanag.”
Ore ake pee edol Olaitoriani ajo eibelekenye aing'or, neipot Enkai ninye tiatua empolos o sanag, nejo, “Musa, Musa!” Nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”
Neitoki ninye ajoki, “Milotu anyiku, intayu inamuka inono too nkejek inono, amu ore ine wueji nintasheyie naa ewueji nesinya.”
Neitoki ajo, “Kara nanu Enkai e papa lino, Enkai e Abraham, Enkai e Isak o Enkai e Yakobo.” Neisudoo Musa enkomom enye amu keure aing'ura Enkai.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Atoduaa osomit loo ltung'ana laainei ootii Misiri, natoning'o olkiyioi lenye te nkaraki ilaitasheikinok lenye; nayiolo olosilisili lenye,

naewuo nanu adou pee aitajeu ninche metupuku aing'uaa enkaina oo ltung'ana le Misiri, nayau ailepunye ninche metupuku aing'uaa ina kop nepuonu enkop sidai nalala naruko inaishi o kule, aapuo ewueji oo Lkanaani o Lhiti, Ilamori, Ilperesi, Ilhifi o Lyebusi.
Ore taata, etabawua olkiyioi loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli enatii, natodua enkibookinoto e nkop naibookito iltung'ana le Misiri ninche.
Wou, amu kaairriwaa nanu iyie enetii Farao, pee itum ashomo aitayu iltung'ana laainei, lelo ayiok loo Siraeli, metupuku aing'uaa Misiri.”
Kake etiaaka Musa Enkai, “Kara nanu ng'ae olo enetii Farao, nayau ilayiok loo Siraeli aaitung'uaa Misiri?”
Nejo ninye, “Ekaaku te nebo o iyie, naa ena nalo aaku olmonekie te iyie, nchere aairriwayie: ore ake pee indip aitupuku iltung'ana aitung'uai Misiri ipuonunu aaisiaai Enkai tele doinyo.”

Neitoki Musa ajoki Enkai, “Amaa te nalotu enetii iltung'ana loo Siraeli najoki ninche ‘Aairriwua nanu Enkai oo loo papaai linyi maeu enitii ntae,’ naaikilikuan ninche aajoki, ‘Keji ng'ae enkarna enye?’ Kaa ajoki ninche?”
Nejoki Enkai Musa, “KARA NANU ILO ORA.” Neitoki ajo, “Tiaaki ena iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘ILO ORA laairriwua nanu enitii.’ ”

Neitoki Enkai ajoki Musa, “Tiaaki ena iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi, Enkai e Abraham, Enkai e Isaak o Enkai e Yakobo naairriwua nanu enitii’ ena enkarna ai ntarasi, naa ninye aadamunye iishoritin pooki.

Shomo inturrurro ilpayiani loo Siraeli te nebo, nijoki ninche! Aaipang'aka nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi Enkai e Abraham o ene Isaak o ene Yakobo, ejo! Atisipua intae o ina naitaasaki intae te Misiri;
natumuta nchere, kayau intae ailepunye aaitung'uaa osina le Misiri, aapuonu enkop o Lkanaani, Ilhiti, Ilamori, Ilperesi, Ilhifi te nebo o Lyebusi, enkop naruko kule o naishi.

Naa kenyoraa ninche ina nijoki; nilo iyie o lpayiani loo Siraeli enetii olaiguanani le Misiri nijokiki ninye, ‘Enotore iyiook Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Lbrania; ore taata nikiomon iyie, nchoo iyiook maape nkolong'i uni ong'ata, pee kitum aatopolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’
Kayiolo ajo meisho ntae olaiguanani le Misiri ipuopuo meteleku ake te nkaraki enkaina naata enkidimata naas tiatua ninye; ore te siadi ina niyaya karsisisho e Misiri.
Metaa kaitorioo nanu enkaina ai aosh Misiri too mbaa pooki e nking'asia nalo nanu aas teine, ore te siadi ina naa kaisho intae enchom.
Naa kaisho nanu kulo tung'ana omom too nkonyek oo Lmisiri, naa ore tenipuopuo, nimipuopuo too nkaik naarook.
Kake ore pooki kitok neomon ene latia enye, o ina naboitare tiaji, imasaa e nkosholai o saabu, o nkilani, nipik ninche ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono, ore teina niyaya karsisisho e Misiri.”
Neitoki Musa awalu, nejo, “Ng'ura, maairuk ninche nanu aashu ening enajoki, amu kejo ninche, ‘Eitu kimpang'aki iyie Olaitoriani.’ ”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Kainyoo ina nimbung'ita te nkaina ino?” Nejoki ninye, “Eng'udi.”
Neitoki ninye ajo, “Tanang'aki enkop.” Nenang'aki enkop, neaku ina ng'udi olasurai; nekwet Musa ailany.
Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino mbung'a olkidong'oe.” Neitorioo enkaina enye neibung, neitoki aaku eng'udi te nkaina enye.
“Taasa ena pee etum aairuko nchere Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye, Enkai e Abraham, Enkai e Isaak o Enkai e Yakobo nikimpang'aka iyie.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tipika enkaina ino olgoo lino.” Nepik ninye enkaina enye olgoo lenye; ore pee eitayu nedol etijing'a enkaina enye enkeeya oo lbolot, neibor anaa enkinuku.
Neitoki Enkai ajo, “Nyaaki tipika enkaina ino olgoo lino.” Neitoki ninye apik enkaina enye olgoo lenye; ore ake pee eitayu, nedol eitotiwuoki anaa osesen lenye pooki.
Nejo Enkai, “Naa ti nimikiruk ninche, aashu te nemenyorraa enkitoduaata e dukuya, neidim ninche aairuko ina kitoduaata e are.

Ore pee meiruk ninche ebaiki nena kitoduaat pokira aashu ening enijoki, niya iyie enkare to lkeju le Nail nilo abukoki enkop natoyio; ore ina are nilo aya to lkeju le Nail naa keaku osarge ti oriong enkop natoyio.”
Kake etiaaka Musa Olaitoriani, “Olaitoriani lai, mara nanu oltung'ani arriyia te nkiguana, aashu ebaiki ena kata pee irorie osinka lino; kake mayiolo airoro na kaasha sii olng'ejep.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki ninye, “Kaing'ae oitobira enkutuk oltung'ani, oitiming'an te nkiroroto o te ning'oto, aashu oitodolisho aashu aitamodok? Aime nanu, Olaitoriani ake?
Shomo naa taata, naa kaaku nanu te nebo enkutuk ino naaitayiolo enijo.”
Kake etiaaka ninye, “Oi, Olaitoriani lai, aatoomono, irriwai likae tung'ani.”

Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani te nkaraki Musa neitoki ajo, “Aimetii Aron ilo alashe lino loo Lawi? Kayiolo ajo keidim airoro aitobiraki naa ng'ura, elotu ninye pee kinang'are, naa ore pee kidol ninye neshipayu to ltau lenye.
Nirorie iyie ninye nipik irorei enkutuk enye, naa kaitaarriyian nanu enkutuk ino o enkutuk enye naaitayiolo iyie eniaas.
Keirorie ninye iltung'ana te rishata ino, neaku ninye enkutuk te iyie, nitiu te ninye anaa Enkai.”
Naa iya te nkaina ino ena ng'udi, naa ninye iasie nkitoduaat.

Nerrinyo Musa alo ashuko enetii Yesro olaputani lenye, nejoki ninye, “Aatoomono, nchooki nanu mashomo ashuko, pee ashukokino iltung'ana lang ootii Misiri pee adol tenaa keton eishu.” Nejoki Yesro Musa, “Shomo te seriani.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa te Midian, “Shomo tushukoyu Misiri; amu ore iltung'ana pooki apa ooing'oru enkishui ino netuata.”
Nedumu Musa enkitok enye o layiok lenyena nepik osikiria, nelo ashuko enkop e Misiri; naa ore te nkaina enye neya Musa eng'udi e Nkai.

Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ore irrinyo alo Misiri, toduaa nchere itaasa te dukuya Farao nena pooki enking'asia natipika nanu engolon ina kake kaitagol nanu oltau lenye, pee meisho ninye iltung'ana meshomo.
Naa ilo ajoki Farao, ‘Etejo Olaitoriani inchere, ore Israel naa olkikau lai,
naajoki naa iyie: Nchoo olayioni lai elo pee aatum aisiaayia nanu.’ Ti nimitiki ninye elo naar nanu ilo kikau lino metua.”
Ore teine wueji neirraga te nkoitoi nenang'are Olaitoriani Musa nejo aar ninye metua.
Neitayu Sipora osoit opi nemurat ilayiok lenyena paa keelie osarge nkejek e Musa, nejo,
“Kesipa ira olpayian lai te nkaraki osarge le muratare.” Neaku etapala Olaitoriani eitu eitoki aar metua.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Aron, “Shomo ong'ata tanang'are Musa.” Nelo ninye nenang'are ninye to ldoinyo le Nkai neng'utut ninye.
Neliki Musa Aron irorei pooki lo Laitoriani laa ninche eirriunye ninye, o nkitoduaat pooki naaitanapa ninye metaasa.
Nelo Musa o Aron aaiturrur te nebo ilpayiani loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli.
Neliki Aron ninche irorei pooki ootiaaka Olaitoriani Musa, neas nkitoduaat te dukuya iltung'ana.
Neiruk iltung'ana; ore ake pee ening nchere etaparana Olaitoriani iltung'ana loo Siraeli netoduaa osina lenye, neirrug ninche ilukuny enye aaserem.
Ore te siadi ina nelo Musa o Aron enetii Farao nejoki, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, pee aatum aaitaiki osirua ti ong'ata.’ ”
Kake etejo Farao, “Kaing'ae Olaitoriani, laidim nanu atoning'o oltoilo lenye naisho Isiraeli epuo.”

Nejo ninche, “Enotore iyiook Enkai oo Lbrania; nchoo iyiook maape, kitoomono iyie, maape elototo oo nkolong'i uni ti ong'ata pee kipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai, mear ake iyiook to lmeitai aashu to lalem.”
Nejoki olaiguanani le Misiri, “Musa o Aron, kainyoo pee iyaya iltung'ana aaitung'uaa esiaai enye? Entorrinyoto enchom isiaaitin inyi.”
Neitoki Farao ajo, “Ng'ura, ajo aikumok taata kulo tung'ana tena kop niyeng'iyeng'ie iyie ninche too siaaitin enye!”
Ore teina olong ake neitanap Farao ilaitasheikinok le siaai o lkituaak le siaai,
“Mintokiki aekata aaisho iltung'ana olkujita oitayunye ilmatofali anaa oshi eninkoko; enchoo ninche epuo aasotu olkujita maate.
Ore esiana oo lmatofali apa naitayu enchoo eaku lelo ake, emintong'oriki ninche, amu aiturua ninche; neaku keishir, ‘Nchoo iyiook maape aaitaiki Enkai ang olasar.’
Nchoo esiaai nagol oleng eiteeki iltung'ana, pee etum aataasisho nemeitoki aainining lelo rorei le lejare.”
Neaku eshomo lelo aitasheikinok o ilkituaak le siaai nejoki iltung'ana, “Etejo Farao nji, ‘Maisho nanu ntae olkujita.
Enchom maate, eyau olkujita linyi te wueji neba anaa enitumiemie; kake ore esiaai meitong'ori hoo ninye penyo.’ ”
Neidapashakino iltung'ana enkop pooki e Misiri aasotu suut aaitaa olkujita.
Netem apa lelo aitasheikinok aarrumoki ninche esiaai, nejoki, “Entabai esiaai inyi, e anaake, anaa apa eetae olkujita.”

Ore ilkituaak loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, laa ninche etipika ilaitasheikinok le Farao meitasheiki ninche, neari, neikilikuani aajoki, “Kainyoo pee eitu iasiasa esiaai inyi aaitobir ilmatofali taata anaa apa?”
Nepuonu lelo kituaak loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli aaishiraki Farao, “Kainyoo pee intaas iyiook, isinkan linono, ena?
Meetae olkujita ooishooki isinkan linono, ore ake eyia, nejoki ninche iyiook, ‘Entobira ilmatofali!’ Naa ng'ura earitae isinkan linono, kake ore enkitarruoroto netii atua iltung'ana linono ake.”
Nejo ninye, “Irara turua, irara turua, neaku ijojo, ‘Nchoo iyiook maape aapolosaki Olaitoriani.’
Enchom taata, naa entaasisho; amu meetae olkujita oishori intae, ore ake eyia, niyauu enoshi ake siana oo lmatofali.”
Nedol ilkituaak loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli aajo etii ninche erishata torrono, ina kata pee ejo ninche, “Meitong'ori hoo ninye penyo esiana oo lmatofali linyi lintayuyu anaake.”
Netumore ninche Musa o Aron, eanyita apa ninche, epuku aaing'ua enetii Farao.
Nejoki ninche, “Nchoo eing'or ntae Olaitoriani neiguanare, amu intaa ntae iyiook ilarruok te dukuya Farao o laisiaayiak lenyena, nitipika olalem enkaina enye pee ear iyiook matuata.”
Neitoki Musa aibelekenyakino Olaitoriani nejoki, “Olaitoriani, kainyoo pee kintasima airriu nanu?
Amu ore anaa nalotu enetii Farao airo te nkarna ino, neitaasa ninye ntorrok kulo tung'ana, neitu iyie intajeu iltung'ana linono tukul.”
Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Idol taata iyie ina naitaas Farao; amu te nkaina nagol eisho ninche meshomo, ee te nkaina nagol earaa ninche meshomo aaing'uaa enkop enye.”
Neitoki Enkai ajoki Musa, “Kara Olaitoriani.
Aipang'aka apa Abraham o Isaak o Yakobo anaa Enkai Magilani, kake ore te nkarna ai naji Olaitoriani eitu aitayiolo ninche.
Aitobirua sii osotua lai o ninche, pee aisho ninche enkop e Kanaan, enkop apa natobikie aa lomon.
Ore ake eyia natoning'o osina loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli ooitaa Lmisiri isinkan natadamua naa ilo ning'o lai.
Tiaaki naa iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Kara nanu Olaitoriani, naa kayau nanu ntae aitung'uaa esinkaisho enye, naa kalaku nanu ntae te nkaina naitoriori o too nkiasin sapuki e nkiguana.
Naya nanu ntae aitaa iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai inyi, naa iyiolouu ntae aajo kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, naa ninye nayaua ntae aitung'uaa abori ilolan le sinkaisho oo Lmisiri.
Naa kayau nanu ntae atua enkop apa nainosa olmumai ajo kaisho Abraham o Isaak o Yakobo; kaisho nanu ntae metaa eninyi enkorrok. Kara nanu Olaitoriani.’ ”
Neliki Musa iltung'ana loo Siraeli nena, kake eitu ninche ening Musa te nkaraki iltauja lenye oiting'o osiligi te sinkaisho enye eng'ogong'i.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Shomo tijing'aki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, tiaaki meishoo iltung'ana loo Siraeli meipang'a aapuo te nkop enye.”
Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, eitu ninche aaning nanu iltung'ana loo Siraeli; kaji naa eiko te naaning nanu Farao, nara oltung'ani leme arriyia te nkiroroto?”
Kake eirorie Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, neisho ninche enkitanapata nayaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli o Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, pee eriku iltung'ana loo Siraeli aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.
Kuna ninche lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye: ilayiok le Ruben, olkikau le Israel; Hanok, Palu, Hesron o Karmi, kulo ninche ilmareita le Ruben.
Ilayiok le Simion: Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Sohar o Shaul, olayioni le nkitok oo Lkanaani; kulo ninche ilmareita le Simion.
Kuna ninche nkarn oo layiok le Lawi te risioroto oo ishoritin enye: Gershon, Kohas o Merari, ore larin le nkishui e Lawi naa ilarin iip o tomoni uni o oopishana.
Ilayiok le Geshom: Libni o Shimei, too lmareita lenye.
Ilayiok le Kohas: Amram, Ishar, Hebron o Usiel, era ilarin le nkishui e Kohas iip o tomoni uni o okuni.
Ilayiok le Merari: Mahali o Mushi. Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Lawi te risioroto oo ishoritin enye.
Ewa Amram Yokobet ayam enkanashe e menye neiki ninye Aron o Musa, era ilarin le nkishui e Amram iip o tomoni uni o oopishana.
Ilayiok le Ishar: Kora, Nefeg o Sichri.
O layiok le Usiel: Mishael, Elsafan o Sisri.
Neya Aron ayam Elisheba, entito e Aminadab naa enkanashe e Nashon; neiki ninye Nadab o Abihu o Eliesa te nebo Isamar.
Ore ilayiok le Kora naa Alir o Elkana te nebo Abiasaf; kulo ninche ilmareita loo Lkorati.
Neya Eliesa, olayioni le Aron, ayam entito nabo oo ntoyie e Putiel; neiki ninye Finihas. Kuna ninche lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye oo Lawi too lmareita lenye.
Kulo lelo, Aron o Musa, laa ninche etiaaka Olaitoriani, “Entayu iltung'ana loo Siraeli metupuku aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri too lororani lenye.”
Ninche apa ooirorie Farao olaiguanani le Misiri eimaki enkitayunoto oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli metung'uai Misiri, kulo lelo: Musa o Aron.
Ore teina olong neirorie Olaitoriani Musa te nkop e Misiri,
nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Kara nanu Olaitoriani; tiaaki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri nena pooki naatiaka.”
Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “mara nanu arriyia te nkiroroto, kaji naa eiko Farao te naaning?”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Toduaaki maaitotiu anaa Enkai te Farao neaku Aron olalashe lino oloiboni lino.
Ilo iyie airo nena pooki naaitanapa; ore Aron olalashe lino nejoki Farao meishoo iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo aaing'uaa enkop enye.
Kake kaitagol oltau le Farao, naa ore hoo tenaponaa nkitoduaat aainei o mbaa e nking'asia te nkop e Misiri,
mikining iyie Farao; naitoki nanu aiteleiki enkaina ai shumata Misiri naitayu olorora lai, iltung'ana laainei lelo ayiok loo Siraeli, metupuku aaing'uaa Misiri too nkiasin sapuki e nkiguana.
Neyiolou Ilmisiri aajo kara nanu Olaitoriani te naitorioo enkaina ai te shumata Misiri naitayu iltung'ana loo Siraeli metupuku tiatua ninche.”
Neas Musa o Aron ina, neas anaa enaitanapa ninche Olaitoriani.
Ore Musa naa oloo larin ntomoni isiet, ore Aron naa oloo larin ntomoni isiet o okuni ina kata pee eirorie ninche Farao.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,
“Enchoo ake pee ejoki ntae Farao, ‘Entisipa ate te asata o lbulabuli,’ nijoki Aaron, ‘Tudumu ina ng'udi ino tanang'aki enkop te dukuya Farao, pee etum aibelekenyayu aata olasurai.’ ”
Nelo Musa o Aron enetii Farao neas anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani; nenang'aki Aron ina ng'udi enye enkop te dukuya Farao o sinkan lenyena, neaku ina ng'udi olasurai.
Neipot Farao ilang'eni lenyena o lasakutok; ore sii ninche, lelo ang'eni loo ltung'ana le Misiri, neas ina te sakutore enye.
Amu etanang'aka pooki tung'ani eng'udi enye enkop, neaku ilasuriaa. Kake etoijoyie eng'udi e Aron ing'usidin enye.
Neton ake eitagoloki oltau le Farao, nemening ninye ninche anaa enatejo Olaitoriani.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Aitagolo oltau le Farao, pee meisho ninye iltung'ana meshomo.
Shomo enetii Farao tadekenya, ina kata elo enkare; taanyu ninye te ngilata olkeju niya iyie te nkaina ino ina ng'udi apa naibelekenye aaku olasurai.
Nijoki iyie ninye, ‘Airriwua nanu Olaitoriani enitii, Enkai o Lbrania ejo: Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, pee aatum aaisiaayia ti ong'ata; naa ng'ura, eton ake eitu iruk.’ ”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Tena iyie iyiolou ajo kara nanu Olaitoriani: ng'ura, ekaosh nanu enkare natii atua olkeju le Nail tena ng'udi naata te nkaina ai, naa keibelekenya aaku osarge.
Neye isinkir ootii atua olkeju le Nail neng'uoyu ilo keju le Nail.”

Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaaki Aron, ‘Tudumu eng'udi ino nintorioo enkaina ino ti oriong nkariak e Misiri, ti oriong ilkejek lenye, o erat lenye, o mugurri enye o lchorroi lenye, pooki loo nkariak, pee etum aataa osarge, neaku osarge te nkop pooki e Misiri too oketa oo nkeek o too oketa oo soito.’ ”

Neas Musa o Aron anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani; ore te dukuya Farao o te dukuya ilaisiaayiak lenyena, neilepie ninye eng'udi neosh ina are apa natii atua olkeju le Nail; ore ina are pooki apa natii atua olkeju le Nail neibelekenya aaku osarge.
Neye isinkir pooki ootii atua olkeju le Nail; neng'uoyu olkeju le Nail o metaa meidim Ilmisiri aatook enkare naing'uaa olkeju le Nail; neaku osarge te nkop pooki e Misiri.
Kake etaasa sii ninche ilasakutok le Misiri ina te sakutore enye; neton ake egol oltau le Farao, nemening ninye ninche anaa enatejo Olaitoriani.
Neibelekenya Farao nelo atua enkaji enye, neitu duoo ninye epik ena oltau ashilaa.
Netur Ilmisiri pooki mbat o lkeju le Nail aaing'oru enkare naok, amu meidim aatook enkare e ilo keju le Nail.
Nelusoo nkolong'i naapishana anaa pee eosh Olaitoriani olkeju le Nail.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Shomo tijing'aki Farao nijoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo peyie aatum aaisiaayia.
Kake ti niany iyie incho ninche epuo, naa kaar enkop ino pooki too ntuaan.

Neiput olkeju le Nail nena tuaan naapuonu atua enkaji ino, o atua olgilata lino oirragi o enchumata endapash ino o atua inkajijik oo laisiaayiak linono o noo ltung'ana linono o ine wueji neyierishoreki o mbakulini inono naaipurjishoreki.
Eikipuonu nena tuaan aaked iyie o ltung'ana linono o sinkan linono.’”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaaki Aron, ‘Ntorioi enkaina ino o eng'udi ino te shumata oo lkejek o te shumata oo erat o te shumata oo lturot, nchoo ntuaan meetu enkop e Misiri!’ ”
Neitorioo Aron enkaina enye tioriong nkariak e Misiri, neilepu ntuaan neiput enkop e Misiri.
Neas ilasakutok anaa ina te sakutore enye, neyau ntuaan oriong enkop e Misiri.
Neitoki Farao aipot Musa o Aron nejoki, “Entoomon Olaitoriani meiwuang'ie ntuaan maatung'uai nanu o ltung'ana laainei; naa kaisho nanu iltung'ana epuo aapolosaki Olaitoriani.”

Nejoki Musa Farao, “Tiaakaki ake duoo iyie anaa eniyieu, kanu iyieu naaomonoki, o laisiaayiak linono o ltung'ana linono, peyie emuti ntuaan te iyie, o too nkajijik inono metaa olkeju le Nail ake etii.”
Nejoki ninye, “Taisere.” Nejo Musa, “Metotiwuo anaa ina nitejo, peyie iyiolouu aajo metii likae onyaanyukie Olaitoriani Enkai ang.
Eikipuo ntuaan aaing'uaa iyie o nkajijik inono o laisiaayiak linono o ltung'ana linono; neaku to lkeju ake le Nail eing'uari.”
Neipang Musa o Aron aapuo aaing'uaa Farao, neishiraki Musa Olaitoriani te nkaraki ntuaan, anaa enatoning'okinote o Farao.
Neas Olaitoriani te risioroto ororei le Musa, neye ntuaan too nkajijik o too ndung'orot o too nkong'at.
Neiturrur ninche too lchalai neing'usilu enkop.
Kake ore ake peyie edol Farao ajo eikasha eng'uan te nkop, neitagol oltau lenye, nemening ninye; anaa enatejo Olaitoriani.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tiaaki Aron, ‘Ntorioi eng'udi ino toosho enterit e nkop, peyie eaku enkojong'ani te nkop pooki e Misiri.’ ”

Neiko ninche neijia; neitorioo Aron enkaina enye o eng'udi enye neosh enterit e nkop, nelotu enkojong'ani ajing'aki iltung'ana o ng'uesi; neaku enterit pooki e nkop enkojong'ani te nkop pooki e Misiri.
Netem ilang'eni loo ltung'ana te ng'eno enye aayau enkojong'ani neitu eidim. Neaku keetae enkojong'ani te pooki tung'ani o te pooki ng'ues.
Nejoki ilang'eni loo ltung'ana Farao, “Olkimojino le Nkai ele.” Kake eitagoloki oltau le Farao neaku mening ninche; anaa enatejo apa Olaitoriani.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tayooki inyo tadekenya taanyu Farao elotu enetii enkare, nijoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo peyie aatum aaisiaayia nanu.

Naa, ti nimincho iltung'ana laainei epuo, ng'ura naa kaaitame airriwaki iyie emus oo lojong'a o laisiaayiak linono o ltung'ana linono o atua nkajijik inono, neiput inkajijik oo Lmisiri emus oo lojong'a o ina kop naitasheyie ninche.
Kake ore teina olong naoru enkop e Goshen, naa ninye etonie iltung'ana laainei, metaa mejing emus oo lojong'a ine, peyie iyiolou nchere kara nanu Olaitoriani otii empolos e nkop.’ ”
Metaa kaoru nanu ltung'ana laainei o ltung'ana linono. Taisere eaku ele monekie.
Neiko neijia Olaitoriani; nelotu emus kitok oo lojong'a atua enkaji e Farao o atua nkajijik oo laisiaayiak lenyena; ore atua enkop pooki e Misiri nerruoyo enkop te nkaraki ilojong'a.
Neitoki Farao aipot Musa o Aron nejoki, “Enchom, entopolosaki Enkai inyi tiatua ena kop.”

Kake etiaaka Musa, “Meishiaakino ti nikiaas ina; amu eikipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ang ilasarri ooitagor Ilmisiri. Amaa ti nikipolos ilasarri ooitagor Ilmisiri te dukuya nkonyek enye, aimear iyiook too soito?
Eikipuo elototo oo nkolong'i uni ti ong'ata peyie kipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai anaa enaitanap iyiook.”
Nejo Farao, “Ekaisho intae enchom peyie ipolosakiki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ti ong'ata; kake mipuopuo aalamari oleng. Entoomonokoki.”

Neitoki Musa ajoki, “Ng'ura, kaaipang alo aing'uaa naa kaaomonoki to Laitoriani peyie elo emus oo lojong'a aing'uaa Farao, neing'uaa ilaisiaayiak lenyena, neing'uaa iltung'ana lenyena taaisere; enyor ake nemeitoki Farao alej iyiook, amitiki iltung'ana meshomo aapolosaki Olaitoriani.”
Nelo Musa aing'uaa Farao, neomon Olaitoriani.
Neas Olaitoriani anaa enaikilikuanua Musa, neiwuang'ie ina mus oo lojong'a te Farao o too laisiaayiak lenyena o too ltung'ana lenyena; eitu eing'uari obo.
Kake eitagolo ake sii Farao oltau lenye tena kata, neitu eisho iltung'ana meshomo.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Shomo tijing'aki Farao, nijoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Lbrania: Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, peyie aatum aaisiaayia.
Amu ti niany iyie incho ninche epuo niton aibok ninche,
nedoiki intae enkaina o Laitoriani tolmeitai torrono o nkishu inyi naatii ong'ata o mbartan o sirkon o ntamesin o luaat oo nkishu o luaat oo ntare.
Nerish Olaitoriani nkishu oo Siraeli o nkishu e Misiri, metaa meye hoo toki te nena pooki naara inoo ltung'ana loo Siraeli.’
Nedung'u Olaitoriani enkata, ejo ‘Taisere eas Olaitoriani ena bae tiatua ena kop.’ ”
Ore ake peyie ekenyu neas Olaitoriani ena bae; neye nkishu pooki oo Lmisiri, kake ore nkishu oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli eitu ninye eye nabo.
Neirriwaa Farao olkilikuai, naa ng'ura, eitu ninye eye hoo nabo oo nkishu oo Siraeli. Kake eitagoloki oltau le Farao, neitu ninye eisho iltung'ana meshomo.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, “Entayutu mboreitin oo nkaik oo nkurruon to lkokuet, ninchosho Musa meisuai shumata te dukuya Farao.
Naa keaku enterit napuyiapui te nkop pooki e Misiri, neaku Ildututa ooiwotiota aaku ilbaa to ltung'ani o te ng'ues te nkop pooki e Misiri.”
Neitayu ninche nkurruon to lkokuet, neitashe te dukuya Farao, neisua Musa aipirie shumata, neaku Ildututa ooiwotiota ilbaa torrok te tung'ani o te ng'ues.
Neitu eidimu lelo ang'eni loo ltung'ana oitasheito te dukuya Musa te nkaraki Ildututa, amu etijing'a Ildututa lelo ang'eni loo ltung'ana o Lmisiri pooki.
Kake eitagolo Olaitoriani oltau le Farao, neitu ninye ening ninche anaa enairorie Olaitoriani Musa.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tayooki inyo tadekenya shomo ntasho te dukuya Farao nijoki ninye: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Lbrania: Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, peyie aatum aaisiaayia nanu.
Amu ore ena kata naa kairriwaki ilmeita laainei pooki meetu oltau lino, o laisiaayiak linono peyie itum atayiolo ajo metii likae laanyaanyukie te nkop pooki.
Amu ore taata anaata atudumua enkaina ai naaosh iyie o ltung'ana linono to lmeitai naa anaata kiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa enkop.
Kake te nkaraki ena pee atapala inchu, peyie aaitodol iyie engolon ai neibalunyeki enkarna ai te nkop pooki.
Eton ake igira ailepie kewan too ltung'ana laainei, nimincho ninche meshomo.
Ng'ura ore taaisere tena saa naitasha enchan oo soito neitu aekata etumi te Misiri ebaiki apa peyie eiteruni o metabaiki taata.

Ore naa taata irriwai ilkiliku meitushuri nkishu o pooki toki niatata too lng'oborri; amu kelotu enchan oo soito ashaiki pooki tung'ani o eng'ues pooki natii ong'ata nemeitokini aayau ang, naa keye.’ ”
Ore ilo oure ororei lo Laitoriani tiatua ilaisiaayiak le Farao neisikie isinkan lenyena o nkishu aaya atua nkajijik;
kake ore ilo leitu eshilaa ororei lo Laitoriani neing'uaa isinkan lenyena o nkishu enyena ti ong'ata.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino ing'orie shumata, peyie ejing enchan oo soito enkop pooki e Misiri.”
Neitorioo Musa eng'udi enye aing'orie shumata; neirriu Olaitoriani enkikurrukur o enchan oo soito, nedou enkima alotu enkop. Neitasha Olaitoriani enchan oo soito te nkop e Misiri.
Nesha enchan oo soito o enkima naimerlel tiatua enchan oo soito, nesha enchan oo soito sapuk oleng, neitu ae kata ejing enkop e Misiri ebaiki apa pee eaku olosho.
Near enchan oo soito pooki toki natii ong'ata te nkop pooki e Misiri, aa iltung'ana o eng'uesi; near enchan oo soito pooki aitubului e ong'ata, negil pooki shani li ong'ata.
Tiatua enkop e Goshen ake, ine apa netii iltung'ana loo Siraeli metii enchan oo soito.
Neirriwaa Farao iltung'ana, meipoto Musa o Aron, nejoki ninche, “Ataasa nanu ing'ok tena rishata; Olaitoriani ninye olasipani ore nanu o ltung'ana laainei nikira ile nkarruoisho.
Entoomon Olaitoriani, amu eidipa iyiook ena kikurrukur o ena shan oo soito; ekaisho ntae enchom, nimintokiki aabik.”
Nejoki Musa ninye, “Ore ake peyie alo auluo ena ang, naitorioki Olaitoriani nkaik aainei, negira enkikurrukur nemeitoki atii enchan oo soito peyie itum atayiolo ajo eno Laitoriani enkop.
Kake ore iyie o laisiaayiak linono kayiolo nanu ajo eton ake miurere Olaitoriani Enkai.”
(Eitarruoyioki enkaitubului naji enkatani o shairi, amu eo apa shairi neitapuka enkatani.
Kake eitu eitarruorri enkano amu eimutie te mbulunoto.)
Neing'uaa Musa Farao alo auluo ina ang, neitorioki Olaitoriani nkaik enyena, neishunye enkikurrukur o enchan oo soito neitu eitoki ashaiki oriong enkop.
Ore ake peyie edol Farao ajo eishunye enchan o enchan oo soito o enkikurrukur neigil aas eng'oki, neitagol oltau lenye, ninye o laisiaayiak lenyena.
Neaku eitagoloki oltau le Farao neitu eisho iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo; anaa enairoro Olaitoriani aimunye Musa.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tijing'aki Farao; amu aitagolo oltau lenye o oltau loo laisiaayiak lenyena, peyie atum aitoduaai kuna kitoduaat aainei enking'asia nataasa tiatua ninche,
peyie itum aitoning'o olayioni lino o layioni lo layioni lino enaikuna peyie aitomod Ilmisiri too nkitoduaat aainei enking'asia nataasa tiatua ninche; peyie iyiolouu nchere kara nanu Olaitoriani.”

Nelo Musa o Aron atua ine netii Farao, nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Lbrania, ‘Iany kenya o anu intobor kewan te dukuya nanu? Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, peyie aatum aaisiaayia nanu.
Amu ti nimitiki iltung'ana laainei epuo, ore taaisere nayau ilmaat atua enkop ino,
naa keitoip oriong e nkop, metaa metii hoo oltung'ani obo oidim atoduaa enkop; nenya ina nikitelekakaki te nchan oo soito, naa kenya pooki shani lino onyori obulu ti ong'ata,

naa keiput inkajijik inono, o nkajijik oo laisiaayiak linono pooki o noo Lmisiri pooki; te nkoitoi neitu aekata edol iloo papaai linyi o loo nkakuyiaa linyi, ebaiki apa peyie epuonu oriong e nkop ometabaiki taata.’ ” Neibelekenya ninye neipang aing'uaa Farao.

Nejoki ilaisiaayiak le Farao ninye, “Keaku kenya ele tung'ani orreshet te iyiook o anu? Enchoo kulo tung'ana epuo, peyie etum aaisiaayia Olaitoriani Enkai enye; keton ake midol ajo etarruoyie Misiri?”
Neshukuni Musa o Aron meetu enetii Farao; nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom esiaayia Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; kake kakua oopuo?”
Nejo Musa, “Eikipuo iyiook o elelero ang o enkitoo ang; eikipuo iyiook o layiok lang o ntoyie ang o ntare ang o nchoo ang amu meeta inchere mikintaiki Olaitoriani osirua.”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Metaa Olaitoriani te nebo o ntae tenaa kaisho aekata ntae o nkera inyi enchom! Ng'ura ajo iatata nkitobirat torrok too ndamunot inyi.
A'a! Enchom ilewa ake, esiaayia Olaitoriani, amu ina iyieuu.” Nerrumori ninche aaitung'uaa ine netii Farao.

Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino ti oriong enkop e Misiri te nkaraki ilmaat, peyie epuonu oriong e nkop e Misiri, nenya pooki aitubului te nkop, pooki toki natung'uayie enchan oo soito.”

Neitorioo Musa eng'udi enye ti oriong e nkop e Misiri, neyau Olaitoriani olkutati le nkilepunoto e nkolong ina kop endama pooki o ina kewarie pooki; ore ake peyie ekenyu eyaua duoo olkutati le nkilepunoto e nkolong ilmaat.
Nepuonu ilmaat oriong enkop pooki e Misiri, neton te nkop pooki e Misiri, emus sapuk oleng o lmaat neitu aekata etumi nemeitokini aekata aatum.

Amu eitoipo oriong e nkop pooki, neaku eitomisimisoki enkop, nenya ninche pooki aitubului te nkop o pooki ng'anayioi loo lkeek otelekua enchan oo soito; eitu eleku hoo toki nabo nanyori, mme olchani neme enkaitubului e ong'ata, te nkop pooki e Misiri.
Neitoki Farao aipot Musa o Aron te siokinoto nejo “Ataasa eng'oki to Laitoriani Enkai inyi o te ntae.
Ore naa taata entapalakaki eng'oki ai, atoomono ntae, ena kata ake, nikiomonokiki to Laitoriani Enkai inyi peyie eiwuang'ie ake ninye ena keeya te nanu.”
Neipang alo aing'uaa Farao neomon Olaitoriani.
Neibelekeny Olaitoriani olkutati te ndoyioroto e nkolong o laa ninye otudumua ilmaat neya arrumoki atua Enaiposha Nanyokie; eitu ninye eing'uari olmaati obo te nkop pooki e Misiri.
Kake eitagolo Olaitoriani oltau le Farao, neitu ninye eisho inkera oo Isiraeli epuo.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino ing'orie shumata peyie ejing enaimin enkop e Misiri, enaimin narok ong'u.”
Neitorioo Musa enkaina enye aing'orie keper nejing enaimin sapuk atua enkop e Misiri nkolong'i uni;
neitu ninche eduaa maate neitu edumunye hoo ng'ae te wueji enye too nkolong'i uni; kake eeta iltung'ana loo Siraeli pooki ewang'an teine nemanya ninche.
Neitoki Farao aipot Musa nejo, “Enchom esiaayia Olaitoriani; eidim sii nkera inyi aashom te nebo intae; enchoo ake metaa nkerrai inyi o nchoo inyi eing'uari.”
Kake etejo Musa, “Meeta nchere peyie mincho iyiook maitayu ilasarri o nkishoorot naapejori, peyie kipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

Ekepuo sii nkishu ang te nebo iyiook; meing'uari ninye oloisotoo, amu eikiya ninche peyie kipuo aaisiai Olaitoriani Enkai ang, nimikiyiolo aajo kainyoo kisiaayie Olaitoriani o metaba anaa nikibaya ine.”
Kake eitagolo Olaitoriani Farao oltau, neitu eisho ninche meshomo.
Nejoki Farao Musa, “Shomo tung'uayioki, toduaa kewan mikingil aekata adol enkomom ai; amu ore kenya enkolong nidol enkomom ai niye.”
Nejo Musa, “Anaa enitejo! Maigil adol enkomom ino.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Eng'or olmeitai obo layaki Farao o Misiri; ore te siadi naa keisho ninye ntae enchom, te neisho ntae enchom naa kearaa ntae enchom katukul.
Iroro naa taata metoning'o iltung'ana, peyie eomonu pooki lee to lelatia enye, o pooki kitok ene latia enye ilgiso le nkosholai o saabu.”
Neisho Olaitoriani omom iltung'ana too nkonyek oo Lmisiri. Ore sii ele tung'ani oji Musa naa eikitok apa oleng te nkop e Misiri te dukuya ilaisiaayiak le Farao o te dukuya iltung'ana.
Nejo Musa, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ore tenenyiku empolos e nkewarie naa Kalo olo tiatua enkop e Misiri.

Ore ilkikaunot pooki tiatua enkop e Misiri naa keye, ebaiki ilo kikau le Farao otonita to lorika lenye le nkitoo o metabaiki olkikau le ina sinka natii oriong ine neidong'ieki, enkurma o lkikaunot pooki loo nkishu.
Naa keaku olkiyioi sapuk tiatua enkop pooki e Misiri, leitu aekata eaku nemeitoki aekata aaku.
Kake ore te pooki ng'ae too ltung'ana loo Siraeli aa oltung'ani aashu ing'uesi, mebuaaki ninye oldia ninche; peyie itumutumu aatayiolo nchere keor arishu Olaitoriani Ilmisiri o Siraeli.

Ore kulo aisiaayiak linono pooki naa kedou aapuonu enatii, naairrugokino nanu ejo, ‘Tupuku iyie, o ltung'ana pooki likisujita iyie.’ Ore te siadi ina napuku nanu.” Neipang Musa aing'uaa Farao te ngoro sapuk.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Mikining Farao iyie; peyie eponari nena enking'asia aainei tiatua enkop e Misiri.”
Neas Musa o Aron kuna pooki e nking'asia te dukuya Farao. Neitagol Olaitoriani oltau le Farao, neitu ninye eisho iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo aaipang te nkop enye.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron tiatua enkop e Misiri,
“Keaku ele apa te ntae enkiterunoto oo lapaitin; ekeaku olapa le dukuya lo lari te ntae.
Entiaaki olturrur pooki loo Siraeli nchere ore te nkolong e tomon ele apa naa keitayu ake pooki tung'ani olkuoo le ker te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye olkuoo le ker ake te nkaji;

naa tenaa eikiti oleng enkaji to lkuo le ker, ore ake oltung'ani o lelatia enye otashare enkaji enye neitayu te risioroto esiana oo ltung'ana; anaa enaidim ake oltung'ani ainosa nintayuyu olkuoo le ker obo.
Ore ilo kuo le ker linyi enchoo metaa meeta entioto, ositima lo lari obo, nintayuyu tiatua nkerra aashu tiatua nkineji.
Nintaanyunyu ometabaiki enkolong e tomon o ong'uan ele apa, ina kata nayieng'ie olorere pooki o lturrur loo Siraeli ilkuoo lenye le kerra teipa.
Neitayu ninche embata o sarge, nepik ntaloishin pokira are e kutuk aji o emolinka e kutuk aji enena ajijik naainosie ilkuoo le kerra.
Nenya ninche nkiri ina kewarie, naatapejoki; te nebo imukateni neitu eisuishieki nenya sii mbenek naadua.
Eminya ake te nena ejon aashu eitokitokieki te nkare, kake epejo endukuya enye te nebo loilelek lenyena o enkoshoke enye.
Nimilekuku ake ae toki enye o mekenyu, ore pooki toki naton o mekenyu nipejoo.
Naa tena oitoi inyanya; eena ntae impolosi, etii namuka nkejek inyi netii ng'usidin inyi nkaik inyi; ninyanya te naipuk. Engiroroto ena o Laitoriani.
Amu kaim atua enkop e Misiri ina kewarie, naar metuata ilkikaunot pooki tiatua enkop e Misiri nadung'oki nanu enkiguana nkaitin pooki e misiri. Kara nanu Olaitoriani.
Keaku ilo sarge olmonekie te ntae, too nkajijik nitii; naa te nadol osarge nagiroo ntae, nemetii olmeitai ojing'aki ntae peyie emut ntae te naar enkop e Misiri.
“Keaku ena olong te ntae enitumutumu aadamu, nimbung'ubung'u aitaa osirua to Laitoriani; ore tiatua ishoritin inyi pooki embung'a anaa enkitanapata oo ntarasi.”

“Enosa imukateni neitu eisuishieki nkolong'i naapishana; ore te nkolong e dukuya niwuang'ieng'ie enkisuisho aaitayu too nkajijik inyi, amu te nenya oltung'ani emukate naisuisho, ebaiki enkolong edukuya o metabaiki enkolong e naapishana neorori ilo tung'ani aaitung'uaa Isiraeli.
Ore te nkolong e dukuya netumo olturrur osinya; meetae esiaai naasi te nena olong'i; kake ina nanya pooki ng'ae ake intobiriri.

Ning'oring'oro osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuishieki, amu teina olong apa aitayio ilororani linyi aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri: metaa embung'a ena olong tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki, anaa enkitanapata oo ntarasi.
Ore to lapa le dukuya te nkolong e tomon o ong'uan o lapa te nkata e nteipa, ninyanya imukateni neitu eisuishieki ninkoko neijia o metabaiki enkolong e tikitam o obo o lapa te nkata e nteipa.

Ore too nkolong'i naapishana enchoo metaa metumi enkisuisho too nkajijik inyi; amu te nenya oltung'ani emukate naisuisho neorori ilo tung'ani aitung'uaa olturrur loo Siraeli, enyor naa ketadokuo aashu eino teinakop.
Minyanya pooki toki naisuisho; ore too manyishoritin inyi pooki enosa imukateni neitu eisuishieki.”
Neipot Musa ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli, nejoki ninche, “Entegelaki ate ilkuoo le kerra te risioroto oo lmareita linyi, niyieng'iyieng'e ilo kuoo le ker le ng'iroroto.

Nintayuyu orridati le nkaitubului naji hisopo nilopilopiepie ilo sarge otii embakuli, paa ieliele emolink'a oo ntaloishin pokira are te ilo sarge otii embakuli; nemetii hoo obo linyi oipang aim kutuk aji e nkaji enye o mekenyu.

Amu kegiroo Olaitoriani alo aar metuata Ilmisiri; naa ore te nedol osarge te molinka o too ntaloishin pokira e kutuk aji negiroo Olaitoriani kutuk aji nemeisho ilo arani metijing'u nkajijik inyi peyie ear ntae entuata.
Embung'a ele kerreti anaa enkitanapata te ntae o too nkera inyi ntarasi.
Ore kenya ake peyie ipuonunu enkop naisho ntae Olaitoriani, anaa enatejo, nimbung'ubung'u ena kisiaayiare.
Ore ake peyie kijoki nkera inono, ‘Kene nyoo ena kisiaayiare?’
Tejo iyie, ‘Olasar lo Laitoriani le Pasaka, amu etogiroyie apa nkajijik oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli te Misiri apa peyie ear Lmisiri kake etapala nkajijik ang.’ ” Neirrug iltung'ana ilukuny enye neserem.
Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli aas ina; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa o Aron neiko neijia.

Ore te mpolos e nkewarie near metuata Olaitoriani ilkikaunot pooki te nkop e Misiri, eiteru tolkikau le Farao oton to lorika lenye le nkitoo o metabaiki olkikau le ilo oena te nkaji naenishoreki o ilkikaunot pooki loo nkishu.
Neinyototo Farao kewarie, ninye o laisiaayiak lenyena pooki o Ilmisiri pooki; netii apa olkiyioi sapuk Misiri amu metii apa enkaji neitu eye oltung'ani obo.
Neipot ninye Musa o Aron te nkewarie, nejo, “Enyoito, enchom entung'uai iltung'ana laainei, intae o ltung'ana loo Siraeli; enchom esiayia Olaitoriani, anaa apa enitejo.
Ewaita nkerrai inyi o nchoo inyi anaa enitejo, enchom naa entamayianaki sii nanu.”
Neipukie Ilmisiri iltung'ana, peyie earaa ninche metupuku aaing'uaa enkop te nkisarrisar amu etejo, “Kituata pooki.”
Neya iltung'ana enkurma enye eton eitu eisuishieki o mbakulini naaipurjishoreki neimulumulari too nkilani enye nenap too loilila.
Netaasa sii iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa enatiaaka Musa, amu etoomonutuo ilgiso loo Lmisiri le nkosholai o le saabu o nkilani.
Neishoo Olaitoriani iltung'ana omom te dukuya Ilmisiri metaa eishoo nena naatoomunutuo. Nedupore Isiraeli Ilmisiri.
Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli te Rameses o metabaiki Sukot, ilewa oobaya nkalifuni ile too nkejek, metii nkituaak o nkera.
Nelo sii olorora oshula te nebo ninche o nkishu kumok oleng; o nkerrai o nchoo.
Nepej ninche imukateni neitu eisuishieki enapa kurma nayautua aaitung'uaa Misiri neitu eishori metotoni, neitu sii eitobiraki ate endaa.
Ore enkata natotona iltung'ana loo Siraeli te Misiri naa ilarin iip ong'uan o tomoni uni.
Ore te siadi ilarin iip ong'uan o tomoni uni, teina olong kewan, neipang aapuo olorora pooki lo Laitoriani aaing'uaa Misiri.
Enkewarie apa netagolie Olaitoriani ninche, aitupuku ninche te nkop e Misiri; metaa ore ena kewarie naa enkewarie naing'ori to Laitoriani iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli tiatua iishoritin enye pooki.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, “Ena enkitanapata o sirua le Ng'iroroto: meetae oltung'ani omoni olo anya ilo sirua.
Kake ore pooki rrindik oinyiang'uaki too mpisai neidim ainosa te neidipi aatumurat ninye.
Menya olomoni aashu olaisiaayiani oigeroki.
Te nkaji nabo enyae; meyae ake hoo ae kiring'o aaipang'unye ti aji; nimigiligili ake oloito lenye.
Nchoo eibung ena olturrur pooki loo Siraeli.
Naa te nelotu oltung'ani omoni aton te nebo ntae neyieu neitaiki Olaitoriani osirua le ng'iroroto, nchoo emurati ilewa lenyena pooki. Kake meetae oltung'ani lememurata onya.
Enkitanapata nabo ake eetae to inoti o to ltung'ani omoni oton tiatua intae.”
Neiko neijia iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa o Aron neas ninche.
Ore teina olong ake neitayu Olaitoriani iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri too lororani lenye.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Nteng'elakaki nanu ilkikaunot pooki;
ore pooki kikau tiatua Siraeli to ltung'ani o te ng'ues naa olalai.”

Nejoki Musa iltung'ana, “Entadamu ena olong; naa ninye apa itupukunye aaing'uaa Misiri, aaing'uaa enkop e sinkaisho, amu te ngolon e nkaina eitayio ntae Olaitoriani aaitung'uaa ene wueji; meinosi emukate naisuishieki.
Ipuopuo intae ena olong to lapa le Abibu.

Ore ake te neyau intae Olaitoriani atua enkop oo Lkanaani o Ilhiti o Ilamori o Ilhifi o Lyebusi, apa nainosa olmumai too loo papaai linyi pee eisho intae enkop naruko kule o enaisho nimbung'ubung'u ena kisiaayiare tele apa.
Too nkolong'i naapishana inyanya imukateni neitu eisuishieki, ore te nkolong e naapishana neaku osirua to Laitoriani.
Imukateni neitu eisuishieki einosi too nkolong'i naapishana; medoli emukate naisuishieki te ntae, nemedoli emukate naisuishieki te nkop inyi.
Nijoki kenya olayioni lino teina olong te nkaraki e ina naaitaasa nanu Olaitoriani apa pee apuku aing'uaa Misiri.

Naa ketiu te iyie anaa enkitoduaata te nkaina ino netiu anaa endamunoto te rishata oo nkonyek inono, pee etum enkitanapata o Laitoriani atijing'a enkutuk ino; amu te nkaina nagol kiyaua iyie Olaitoriani aitung'uaa Misiri.
Metaa imbunga naa ena kitanapata te nkata enye nageluno te pooki ari.
“Ore kenya ti nikiyau Olaitoriani enkop oo Lkanaani, anaa enainosa olmumai te iyie o too loo papaai linyi, naa eikincho iyie.
Ninteng'el iyie te nkaraki Olaitoriani nena pooki kikaunot. Ore ilkikaunot pooki loo nkishu inono oora ilbung'aiko, neaku ilo Laitoriani.
Ore olkurrarru pooki le sikiria ong'asi aaiu, nelakuni to sitima le ker, naa te nimilaku iyie ninye niburukush emurt enye. Ore olkikau pooki loo layiok linyi nilaku.
Ore te nkata nalotu te nikinkilikuan olayioni lino, ajoki, ‘Kainyoo doi eutu ena?’ Nijoki iyie ninye, ‘Te ngolon e nkaina eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani aitupuku te Misiri, aitung'uaa enkop e sinkaisho.

Amu ore apa pee eany Farao te ngolong'u eisho iyiook maape near Olaitoriani ilkikaunot pooki te nkop e Misiri, olkikau lo ltung'ani o le nkiteng. Metaa kapolosaki Olaitoriani ilbung'aiko pooki kikaunot; kake ore ilkikaunot pooki loo layiok laainei nawalu.’
Naa keaku olmishire te nkaina ino aashu te rishata oo nkonyek inono, amu te nkaina nagol eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani aitung'uaa Misiri.”
