Ore apa pee eisho Farao iltung'ana meshomo, neitu erikoo Enkai ninche aimie nkoitoi e nkop oo Filistia, hoo naa ina apa nataana; amu etejo, “Mayieu neibelekenya iltung'ana te nedol olarrabal, neshuko aapuo Misiri.”
Kake etorikoyie Enkai iltung'ana aitamanaa te nkoitoi o lpurkel aing'orie Enaiposha Nanyokie. Neilepu iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaipang'u te nkop e Misiri eterretenate to larrabal.

Neya Musa iloik lo sesen le Yosef te nebo ninye, amu eitayio apa Yosef enkutuk nenya olmumai too ltung'ana loo Siraeli, ejo, “Kebaiki intae Enkai; naa eiyaya intae iloik laainei te nebo intae aaitung'uaa Misiri.”
Nedumunye ninche te Sukot neitayu ilng'oborri te Esam, te bayie o lpurkel.

Nelo Olaitoriani dukuya ninche dama te nkatampoi naikununo anaa eng'ape pee erikoo ninche te nkoitoi, ore te nkewarie naa te nkima naikununo anaa eng'ape pee eitawang'aki ninche, pee etum aashom dama o kewarie.
Ore ina atampoi neikununo anaa eng'ape te ndama o enkima naikununo anaa eng'ape te nkewarie neitu eiwuang te dukuya iltung'ana.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli metushukoto siadi aapik ilng'oborri dukuya e Pi-ha-hirot, erishata e Migdol o enaiposha, dukuya e Baal-sefon; enteshet ilng'oborri empirie embata e naiposha.
Amu kejo ninye Farao tialo iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Eibookoki ninche atua ina kop eibooyie ninche olpurkel.’
Naa kaitagol nanu oltau le Farao, naa kesujaa ninche natum enkisisa te Farao o te njore enye pooki; naa keyiolou Ilmisiri aajo kara nanu Olaitoriani.” Neiko ninche neijia.

Ore ake pee elikini olaiguanani le Misiri aajoki eisika iltung'ana, neibelekenya endamunoto e Farao o enoo laisiaayiak lenyena tialo iltung'ana, nejo ninche, “Kainyoo ena nikitaasa nchere kinchoo Siraeli meshomo meekure esiaai iyiook?”
Neitobir ninye engarri enye oo mbartan nedumu enjore enye,
neya ingarrin oo mbartan naageluno iip ile o kulie garrin oo mbartan e Misiri ekedito ilkituaak ninche pooki.
Neitagol Olaitoriani oltau le Farao olaiguanani le Misiri nesujaa ninye iltung'ana loo Siraeli ooisula aapuku te ng'olong'u.

Nesujaa Ilmisiri ninche, mbartan pooki e Farao o ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan o enjore enye, neinepu ninche too lng'oborri te mbata e naiposha, te mbata e Pi-ha-hirot, te dukuya e Baal-sefon.
Ore ake pee enyiku Farao, neraposhu iltung'ana loo Siraeli nkonyek enye, nedol epuonu Ilmisiri te siadi ninche; neureishoyu oleng. Neishiraki iltung'ana loo Siraeli Olaitoriani;
nejoki ninche Musa, “Te nkaraki nemetii nkuraren Misiri pee iyaua iyiook matuata to lpurkel? Kainyoo intaasa iyiook iyaua iyiook aitung'uaa Misiri?
Aime ena apa kitiaakita iyie te Misiri, ‘Tapala iyiook naa nchoo maisiaayia Ilmisiri?’ Amu enaikash apa te iyiook ti nikisiai Ilmisiri alang ti nikiye to lpurkel.”

Nejoki Musa iltung'ana, “Emiureishoyu, entashoito tukul, metii olng'ash pee idolidolo enjeunoto o Laitoriani, naitobiraki ninye ntae taata; amu ore kulo Misiri lidolitata taata, mintokiki ae kata aadol.
Kemitu intae Olaitoriani, metaa entirring'ata.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Kainyoo pee kinchiraki nanu? Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo dukuya.
Tudumu ilepie eng'udi ino, nintorioo enkaina ino te shumata enaiposha tooro, pee etum iltung'ana loo Siraeli aashom te nkop natoyio te mpolos e naiposha.
Naa kaitagol iltauja loo Lmisiri pee epuo atua aasujaa ninche, naa katum enkitoo te Farao o te njore enye pooki, too ngarrin oo mbartan oo too lakedok loo mbartan.
Neyiolou Ilmisiri aajo, kara nanu Olaitoriani, te naidip nanu anoto enkitoo te Farao, too ngarrin oo mbartan o too lakedok loo mbartan.”
Neitoki olmalaika le Nkai apa orikito te dukuya e njore oo Siraeli aiwuang'a nelo siadi ninche; ore ina atampoi naikununo anaa eng'ape neiwuang'a te dukuya ninche neitashe te siadi ninche
alotu te rishata e njore e Misiri o enjore oo Siraeli. Netii ina atampoi o enaimin; nelusoo enkewarie meetae enaewuo anyikaki enkae enkewarie pooki.
Neitorioo Musa enkaina enye te shumata enaiposha; nereu Olaitoriani enaiposha siadi to siwuo ogol le nkilepunoto e nkolong e nkewarie pooki, neitaa enaiposha enkop natoyio, neoro nkariak.
Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli tiatua empolos e naiposha aaim enkop natoyio, etaa nkariak esuntai te ninche te nkaina e tatene o te kedianye.
Nesujaa Ilmisiri, nepuo atua emirita ninche nepuo empolos e naiposha, mbartan pooki e Farao, ngarrin oo mbartan enyena o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan.
Ore tadekenya enasirie neing'or Olaitoriani tiatua ina kima naikununo anaa eng'ape o ina atampoi enjore o Lmisiri neisirng'ang'ie enjore oo Lmisiri,
aun inkejek oo ngarrin enye metupurpurrito te lototo; nejo Ilmisiri, “Emaisika te dukuya Siraeli; amu kemitu ninche Olaitoriani aing'arraki Ilmisiri.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino te shumata enaiposha, pee eshukunye enkare shumata Ilmisiri o shumata ingarrin enye oo mbartan o shumata ilakedok lenye loo mbartan.”

Neitorioo Musa enkaina enye te shumata enaiposha, neshukunye enaiposha enoshi ake kirragata enye emanaa enkakenya; nejo Ilmisiri maisika aailany enkare kake eibooko ninche Olaitoriani empolos enaiposha.
Neshukunye inkariak neimisie ingarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan o ina jore pooki e Farao, natusujaka ninche atua enaiposha; eitu ninye eleku obo lenye.
Kake eshomo iltung'ana loo Siraeli te nkop natoyio te mpolos e naiposha, etaa nkariak esuntai te ninche te nkaina enye e tatene o te kedianye.
Neiko neijia Olaitoriani aitajeu Isiraeli ina olong too nkaik oo Lmisiri; nedol Isiraeli Ilmisiri etuata te mbata e naiposha.
Nedol Isiraeli esiaai sapuk naitaasa Olaitoriani Ilmisiri, neureyu iltung'ana Olaitoriani; neiruk ninche Olaitoriani o osinka lenye Musa.
Neranyaki Musa o ltung'ana loo Siraeli Olaitoriani ele sinkolio ejo, “Karanyaki nanu Olaitoriani, amu etimirishe te nkitoo; ore mbarrtan o lakedok lenye netanang'aka atua enaiposha.
Olaitoriani engolon ai naa osinkolio lai, netaa sii enjeunoto ai; Enkai ai ena naa kaisis ninye, Enkai oo loo papa lai, naa karrep ninye.
Ore Olaitoriani neisula to larrabal; keji enkarna enye Olaitoriani.
“Etanang'aka ingarrin oo mbartan e Farao o enjore enye atua enaiposha, ore ilkituaak lenyena gelunot eimiso te Enaiposha Nanyokie.
Eimulumulaitie ninche inkariak; nepuo ninche aadoiki atua eng'uton anaa osoit.
Keitore enkaina ino e tatene te ngolon, iyie Olaitoriani, Kegiligili enkaina ino e tatene ilmang'ati, iyie Olaitoriani,.
Ore te ngolon e nkitoo ino, nimir lelo liking'orunore; irriwaa engoro ino neyupuyupoki ninche anaa enkima olkujita.
Ore te nkutata oo nkumeishin inono neiturrurro nkariak, neitashe inkariak aarupa, neibung'a aatiu anaa osoit tiatua e negut enaiposha.
Etejo olmang'atinta, ‘Ekasujaa, ekainepu; naor nanu iyarunot enye naya pooki toki nayieu; nashutu nanu olalem lai, near enkaina ai ninche metuata.’
Itukuta te nkijape ino, neitemoo ninche enaiposha; neimis anaa osoit tiatua inkariak kituaak.
“Kaing'ae likinyaanyukie, iyie Olaitoriani, tiatua inkaitin? Kaing'ae otiu anaa iyie, kitok te sinyatisho, Olourei too nkiaasin e nkitoo, oas isapuki e nking'asia.
Intorioyie iyie enkaina ino e tatene, neijoo ninche enkop.
“Te nyorrata ino nauno itoriko lelo tung'ana litokordua, ituutayie iyie te ngolon ino meshomo emanyisho ino sinyati.
Etoning'o iloreren, neikirikira ninche; enoto emion lelo ootoni te Filistia.
Eiputukunyo ilaiguanak le Edom; eibung'a ilarikok le Moabu olokirikiri; Etalepori to lkirutoto lelo pooki oomanya Kanaan.

Nejing ninche olkirutoto o enkuretisho; te nkaraki enkitoo e nkaina ino, eitirring'ate ninche anaa osoit, o metaba anaa nelusoo iltung'ana linono, Olaitoriani, o metaba anaa nelusoo lelo apa linyiang'ua.
Intijing'u iyie ninche atua, niun ninche te nchumata o ldoinyo lino, ine wueji, Olaitoriani, nintobira te nkaraki emanyisho ino, ine nesinya, Olaitoriani, nintobira iyie te nkaina ino.
Ekeitoreisho Olaitoriani ntarasi o ntarasi.”

Kake ore apa pee epuo mbartan e Farao o ngarrin enyena oo mbartan o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan atua enaiposha, neyau Olaitoriani ashuku inkariak e naiposha shumata ninche; kake eshomo iltung'ana loo Siraeli te nkop natoyio te mpolos e naiposha.
Neitoki Miriam, ina oiboni e Nkai, anashe e Aaron, adumu entampuri te nkaina enye; neipang inkituaak pooki aasuj ninye too ntampurini eipidipid aaranyisho.
Neranyaki Miriam ninche ejo: “Entaranyaki Olaitoriani amu etimirishe te nkitoo; ore mbarrtan o lakedok netanang'aka ninche atua enaiposha.”
Nerikoo Musa Isiraeli dukuya aaing'uaa Enaiposha Nanyokie, nepuo olpurkel le Shuri; nepuo nkolong'i uni to lpurkel neitu etum enkare.
Ore ake pee epuonu Mara, neitu eidim aatook enkare e Mara amu kedua, neaku etejoki ine Mara.
Neing'unyung'unyaki iltung'ana Musa, ejo, “Kainyoo kiok?”

Neishiraki ninye Olaitoriani; neitodol ninye Olaitoriani olchani, nenang'aki atua enkare nemelonu enkare. Neisho ninche Olaitoriani nkitanapat o nkikoot teine naatum aaishuyie, netem ninche teine ejo,

“Tinining'ining'i intae oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, niasiasa ina sidai too nkonyek enyena, nining'ining'i nkitanapat enyena nimbung'ubung'u pooki, nemapik hoo nabo oo nkeyaitin ntae apa natipika Ilmisiri; amu kara nanu Olaitoriani oishiunye intae.”
Neitoki ninche aapuonu Elim, ine apa netii nchorroi tomon o are e nkare o ltuka ntomoni naapishana, neitayu ilng'oborri teine te mbata e nkare.

Nedumunye Isiraeli aapuo aaing'uaa Elim, nepuonu olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli olpurkel le Sini, otii erishata e Elim o Sinai, te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa li are eidipa aashom te nkop e Misiri.
Neing'unyung'unyaki olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel Musa o Aron te ilo purkel,

nejoki ninche, “Enaikash apa tenaa eikituata te nkaina o Laitoriani te nkop e Misiri, ina kata apa kitoni te mbata oo motiok oo nkiri nikinya imukateni aaraposho; amu intupukutuo intae iyiook aayau ele purkel, matuata ena umata pooki te sumash.”

Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ng'ura, ekashau imukateni naaing'uaa shumata te nkaraki intae; naa kepuo iltung'ana aaiturrurru endaa naidip ina olong, pee atem ninche tenaa keibung nkitanapat aainei anaa emeibung.
Ore te nkolong e ile nereten nena naayau atua aji naa keaku katitin are te nena naiturrur anaake.”
Nejoki Musa o Aron iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, “Ore teipa niyiolouu aajo Olaitoriani apa oyaua intae aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri;
ore tadekenya nidolidolo enkitoo o Laitoriani amu etoning'o ninye enking'unyung'uny inyi ing'unyung'unyakiki Olaitoriani amu eikira iyiook nyoo pee ing'unyung'unyakiki iyiook?”

Nejo Musa, “Te neisho intae Olaitoriani teipa inkiri ninyanya neisho intae tadekenya imukateni aiputaki, amu etoning'o Olaitoriani enking'unyung'uny inyi ning'unyung'unyakita ninye. Eikira iyiook nyoo? Ore enking'unyung'uny inyi neme enaang kake eno Laitoriani.”
Nejoki Musa Aron, “Tiaaki olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Entinyiku wootu dukuya Olaitoriani, amu etoning'o ninye enking'unyung'uny inyi.’ ”
Ore anaa enairorie Aron olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, neing'or enkalo o lpurkel, nemaniki etaliee enkitoo o Laitoriani te nkatampoi.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Atoning'o inking'unyung'unyat oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli; tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore teipa ninyanya inkiri, ore tadekenya neiputakini intae imukateni, pee iyiolouu aajo kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.’ ”
Ore teipa nepuonu nkurlen neiput lelo ng'oborri; ore tadekenya neiput enkoilelio aman lelo ng'oborri.
Ore ake pee edumunye enkoilelio te nkop netii enkoriong e ilo purkel entoki naibor, napurupurana natii oriong enkop, (naikununo anaa isoito le nchan).
Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana loo Siraeli nejokino maate, “Kainyoo ena?” Amu meyiolo apa ninche aajo kainyoo ina. Nejoki Musa ninche, “Emukate, naa ninye eishoo Olaitoriani intae enosa.

Ena eitanapishe Olaitoriani: ‘Entasotu, pooki tung'ani te ntae, anaa enaidim ainosa; ewaita emborei emoti naji omer, te risioroto e siana oo ltung'ana naba anaa enaata ake oltung'ani to lng'obor lenye.’ ”
Neas iltung'ana loo Siraeli ina, nesotu ilkulikae inkumok, nesotu kulikae inkuti.
Kake ore ake pee etem te mborei e ina moti naji omer, ore ilo apa otasotuo nkumok nemeeta entoki natelekua, ore ilo otasotuo nkuti netaraposhe; etasotuo ake oltung'ani enaba anaa enaidim ainosa.
Nejoki Musa ninche, “Emincho oltung'ani eshum o mekenyu.”
Kake eitu ninche ening Musa; etelekutua embata o mekenyiki neiruj ilkuru neng'uoyu; negorokino Musa ninche.
Nesotu ninche anaake tadekenya, oltung'ani ake anaa enaidim ainosa, kake ore ake pee eirowuaju enkolong neshola.
Ore te nkolong e ile nesotu imukateni katitin are oo noshi ake, iyierat are ake oltung'ani; ore ake pee epuonu ilarikok pooki lo lturrur aaliki Musa,

nejoki ninye ninche, “Ena eitanapishe Olaitoriani, ‘Enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng taaisere, Sabato sinyati o Laitoriani; entapej ina nipejipeje niyieriyiere ina niyieriyiere; ore ina pooki naleku nirragiegie o mekenyu.’ ”
Neirragie ninche o metaba anaa nekenyu, anaa enaitanapa Musa ninche, neitu eng'uoyu neitu ejing ilkuru.
Nejo Musa “Enosa taata, amu ore taata naa Sabato o Laitoriani, mitumutumu taata ti ong'ata.
Too nkolong'i ile isotutu; kake ore te nkolong e naapishana aa ene Sabato nemetii hoo toki.”
Ore te nkolong e naapishana nepuo kulikae tung'ana aasotu neitu etum hoo toki.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ianyianya kenya imbungubungu nkitanapat o nkirorot aainei o anu?

Entayiolo aajo eishoo intae Olaitoriani Sabato, metaa ore te nkolong e ile neisho intae imukateni oo nkolong'i are. Totona pooki tung'ani te ntae te wueji enye, emincho oltung'ani eipang alo te wueji enye te nkolong e naapishana.”
Neyeng'iyeng'a iltung'ana te nkolong e naapishana.
Nejo enkaji oo Siraeli enkarna e ina daa mana; neikununo anaa ilanterera ooibor, netiu emeloni enye anaa enoo nkaukau naaitobiraki te naisho oo lotorok.

Nejo Musa, “Ena eitanapishe Olaitoriani: ‘Enchoo emborei e moti oo nkulupuok naji omer eshumi tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki, pee etum aatodol ina mukate naitotiyie nanu intae to lpurkel, inakata apa pee aitupuku intae aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.’ ”
Nejoki Musa Aaron, “Tudumu embakuli tipika emborei e mana atua nirragie te dukuya o Laitoriani, neshumi tiatua iishoritin inyi.”
Anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, neiko neijia Aaron airragie te dukuya Shakenisho, metushumi.
Nenya iltung'ana loo Siraeli mana ilarin artam, o metaba anaa nepuonu olpolosie le nkop e Kanaan.
(Ore omer naa erubata e tomon e efa.)
Nepuo olturrur pooki loo Siraeli to lpurkel le Sini too lkirragarien, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani, neitayu ilng'oborri te Refidim; kake metii apa enkare naok iltung'ana.
Neilepilepaki iltung'ana Musa, nejo, “Nchoo iyiook enkare nikiok.” Nejoki Musa ninche, “Kainyoo pee kilepilepakiki nanu? Kainyoo pee itemiteme Olaitoriani?”
Kake etotiro iltung'ana enkure oleng, neing'unyung'unyaki iltung'ana Musa, nejo, “Kainyoo apa pee iyaua iyiook aaitung'uaa Misiri, nilotu aar iyiook matuata o nkera ang o nkishu ang te nkure?”
Neishiraki Musa Olaitoriani nejo, “Kaa aitaas kulo tung'ana? Etaa ninche kejo pee aanang too soito.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Togiroi iltung'ana te dukuya, nishoroo te nebo iyie embata oo lpayiani loo Siraeli; niya te nkaina ino ina ng'udi apa nitooshie olkeju le Nail, nilo.

Kalo nanu aitashe te dukuya iyie te idie te nchumata e ndapidapoi te Horeb, niosh iyie ina dapidapoi, naa kepuku enkare tiatua ninye, pee etum iltung'ana aatook.” Neas Musa ina te dukuya ilpayiani loo Siraeli.
Nejo ninye enkarna eine wueji Masa o Meriba, te nkaraki enking'unyung'uny oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, o te nkaraki natetema ninche Olaitoriani ejo. “Ketii Olaitoriani te nebo iyiook aashu metii?”
Neitoki Ilmaleki aapuonu aarare Isiraeli te Refidim.
Nejoki Musa Yoshua, “Tegelaki iyiook ilewa, nimpang'ipang'a aapuo, aarare Ilmaleki; ore taaisere naitashe nanu te nchumata e ndoinyo aata ina ng'udi e Nkai te nkaina ai.”
Neas Yoshua enatiaaka Musa, nearare Ilmaleki; nelo Musa o Aron o Huri enchumata e ndoinyo.
Ore ake te neilepie Musa enkaina, nemirisho Isiraeli, ore ake te neitadou enkaina enye, nemirisho Ilmaleki.

Kake enaurate inkaik e Musa, neyau ninche osoit nepik abori ninye, netonie ninye nedumu Aron o Huri inkaik enyena aailepie, obo ake te nchoto nabo o likae ti ae shoto; metaa keitirring'a eitoriori inkaik enyena o metadoi enkolong.
Nemir Yoshua aitadoyio Ilmaleki o ltung'ana lenyena neidaikie te nepi o lalem.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ing'ero ena te mbuku metaa endamunoto niliki Yoshua ajoki ekamut nanu aimisie endamunoto oo Ilmaleki aiwuang'ie ti abori keper.”
Neshetu Musa olperere lo lasar nejo enkarna enye, Olaitoriani ninye enanka ai
ejo, “Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai nchere kearare ninye Ilmaleki ebaiki eishoi o eishoi.”
Nening Yesro, ilo apolosani le Midian, olaputani le Musa, nena pooki naaitaasa Enkai Musa o Siraeli iltung'ana lenyena, eneikunuwua Olaitoriani eitayu Isiraeli aitung'uaa Misiri.
Nelotu ninye enetii Musa, neshoru te nebo ninye Sipora, enkitok e Musa natung'uayioki apa te siadi
o Gerishom o Eliesa, ilayiok lenyena pokira oaare. (Etejo Musa, “Ataa apa olomoni te nkop eeiking'a neaku etejo olayioni obo Gerishom.”)
Ore enkarna o likae naa Eliesa. (Amu etejo, “Enkai apa e papa lai ereretoto ai, naaitajeu nanu to lalem le Farao.”)
Nelotu Yesro, olaputani le Musa o layiok lenyena o enkitok enye enetii Musa to lpurkel teine apa netipika ilng'oborri to ldoinyo le Nkai.
Nelotu oltung'ani oriua Yesro ajoki Musa, “Elotu olaputani lino, Yesro, enitii tenebo enkitok ino o layiok linono pokira oaare,”
neipang Musa alo anang'are olaputani lenye, neirrugokino neng'utut ninye; neikilikuana maate ilomon lenye nejing ninche atua olng'obor.
Neliki Musa olaputani lenye nena pooki naaitaasa Olaitoriani Farao o Ilmisiri te nkaraki Isiraeli, o sinaitin oogol pooki ooetuo shumata ninche te nkoitoi.
Neng'idayu Yesro te pooki sidai naitaasa Olaitoriani Isiraeli, teina nayawua ninche aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lmisiri.
Nejo Yesro, “Meisisi Olaitoriani, laa ninye oitajewuo intae aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lmisiri neitung'uaa enkaina e Farao.
Kayiolo taata ajo aikitok Olaitoriani alang inkaitin pooki, amu eyaua iltung'ana aitung'uaa abori enkaina oo Lmisiri ina kata apa eisikong ninche.”
Neitayu Yesro, olaputani le Musa, enkishooroto olasar opejori o nkishoorot naapolosakini Enkai, nelotu Aron te nebo o lpayiani pooki loo Siraeli aanya endaa te nebo olaputani le Musa te dukuya Enkai.
Ore ake pee ekenyu neton Musa arish iltung'ana, neitashe iltung'ana aaman Musa ebaiki tadekenya o metabaiki teipa.

Ore ake pee edol olaputani le Musa nena pooki naasita te nkaraki iltung'ana, nejo, “Kainyoo ena niasita te nkaraki iltung'ana? Kainyoo pee iton openy, nikintashe aaman iltung'ana pooki ebaiki tadekenya o metaa teipa?”
Nejoki Musa olaputani lenye, “Te nkaraki napuonu iltung'ana enatii aaikilikuanu mbaa e Nkai.
Ore te neeta enchankar nepuonu enatii narish nanu oltung'ani o ilo le latia enye, naitayiolo nanu ninche nkitanapat e Nkai o nena naatejo ninye.”
Nejoki olaputani le Musa ninye, “Ore ena niasita neme sidai.
Ore iyie o ltung'ana liboitare iariara ate, amu keiroishi ena te iyie; nimindim ataasa openy.
Toning'o naa enaajoki amu kaaikok, metaa Enkai te nebo o iyie! Ilo iyie aitashe te dukuya e Nkai niyaa inkolati oo ltung'ana dukuya e Nkai;
ninteng'en ninche nkitanapat o naatejo, nintayiolo ninche enkoitoi napuoyie o enaishiaakino neas.

Naa tegelu iltung'ana oata enkidimata too ltung'ana pooki, lelo ooure Enkai, iltung'ana ooisiligayu neiba eropare, nipik kulo payiani shumata iltung'ana aitaa ilarikok loo nkalifuni, loo maa iip, loo moo onom o loo maa tomon.
Nincho ninche meiguanare iltung'ana nkatitin pooki; ore pooki bae sapuk neyau enitii kake ore embae kiti neiguanare oopeny, pee eleleku te iyie nenap sii ninche olola te nebo o iyie.
Te nias ena, anaa enikirikoo Enkai, naa ina kata ineneng'u, nepuo sii kulo tung'ana pooki ewueji enye te seriani.”
Nening Musa enkikoo o laputani lenye neas nena pooki naatejo ninye.
Negelu Musa iltung'ana ooata enkidimata tiatua Siraeli pooki, neitaa ninche ilaguanak looltung'ana, ilaitoriak loo nkalifuni, loo maa iip, loo moo onom o loo maa tomon.
Neiguanare ninche iltung'ana nkatitin pooki; ore ilomon oogol neyaki ninche Musa, kake ore embae pooki kiti neiguanare oopeny.
Neisho Musa olaputani lenye meshomo, neibung ninye enkoitoi alo enkop enye.
Ore te nkolong e dukuya olapa liokuni anaa pee epuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli te nkop e Misiri, ore ina olong nepuonu olpurkel le Sinai.
Ore pee edumunye te Refidim aapuonu olpurkel le Sinai neitayu ilng'oborri to lpurkel; ore teine nepik Isiraeli ilng'oborri dukuya o ldoinyo.
Neked Musa alo enetii Enkai, neipot ninye Olaitoriani to ldoinyo, ejo, “Ena iyie ilo ajoki enkaji e Yakobo, niliki iltung'ana loo Siraeli: ajoki,
Itoduaa intae enaikuna Ilmisiri, ina natanapa nanu intae too naipuko o lkurragos nayaki intae kewan ai.
Ore naa taata tinining'ining'i oltoilo lai nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat osotua lai, niaakuku iltung'ana laainei tukul tiatua iltung'ana pooki; amu ore enkop pooki naa enaai,
naa iakuku intae te nanu enkitoria oo lapolosak o losho osinya. Kulo ninche irorei lilo ajoki nkera oo Siraeli.”
Nelotu Musa neipot lelo payiani loo ltung'ana, neibalie te dukuya ninche kulo rorei pooki ooitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.
Newal iltung'ana pooki te nebo nejo, “Ore nena pooki naatejo Olaitoriani eikiaas.” Nelikioo Musa irorei loo ltung'ana to Laitoriani.

Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ng'ura, kalotu nanu te nkatampoi nairrusha, pee etum iltung'ana aatoning te naairorie iyie, pee kitum sii ninche aairuko ntarasi.” Neitoki Musa aliki Olaitoriani irorei loo ltung'ana.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Shomo enetii iltung'ana nintisiny ninche taata o taaisere, nincho ninche meisuja inkilani enye,
nerretena te nkolong e uni; amu ore te nkolong e uni nelotu Olaitoriani adou enchumata o ldoinyo le Sinai metoduaa iltung'ana.
Nipikaki iltung'ana olpolosie aitamanaa, nijoki ninche ‘Entodol ake mipuopuo shumata o ldoinyo aashu iseyieyie olpolosie lenye; ore pooki ng'ae ororo oldoinyo neari metua.
Nemeetae enkaina naiseyie ninye kake kenang'i too soito aashu eng'ori, aa eng'ues aashu oltung'ani, melo ninye eishu.’ Ore pee eru esekekua ayiataa, naa keilepu ninche aapuonu oldoinyo.”
Nedou Musa to ldoinyo alotu enetii iltung'ana, neitisiny ninye iltung'ana neisuj ninche inkilani enye.
Nejoki ninye iltung'ana, “Enterretenata te nkolong e uni, nimipuopuo aanyikaki nkituaak.”
Ore takedenya te nkolong e uni, netii ndarat o nkiwuang'at o enkatampoi nairrusha e nchumata oldoinyo o endarata sapuk e ntarumpeta o metaa eikirikirate iltung'ana pooki ootii ilng'oborri.
Neyau Musa iltung'ana aitung'uaa ilng'oborri meetu aatumore Enkai; neitashe ninche te ntonata o ldoinyo.
Neimulumul oldoinyo le Sinai empuruo, amu etadoikio Olaitoriani enchumata enye te nkima, neilep empuruo enye anaa empuruo o lkokuet, neikirikira oldoinyo pooki oleng.
Naa ore anaa enadar embuakunoto e sekekua aponari, neiro Musa, newaliki ninye Enkai te ndarata.
Nelotu Olaitoriani adoiki oldoinyo le Sinai, entopij o ldoinyo; neipot Olaitoriani Musa meshomo entopij o ldoinyo, neilep Musa alo.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tadoi shomo inkoo iltung'ana, melang'u ake olpolosie memuta ake ilkumok lenye.
Nchoo sii lelo apolosak oonyikaki Olaitoriani eitisiny ate, pee maitame ake ninche.”
Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Mepuonu iltung'ana aailepu oldoinyo le Sinai; amu iyie enkorrok ino oitanapa iyiook, ajo, ‘Entayu ilpolosien to ldoinyo, nintisinyinyi ninche.’ ”
Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Tadoi shomo nilepu o Aron; kake mincho ilapolosak o ltung'ana elang'u olpolosie aailepu enetii Olaitoriani menang'are ake Olaitoriani ninche.”
Nelo Musa adoyio enetii iltung'ana neliki ninche.
Neiro Enkai kulo rorei pooki ajo,
“Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo likiyawua aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, aitung'uaa enkop e sinkaisho.
Miserem ake kulie aitin neme nanu.
Mintobiraki kewan enkitanyaanyukoto nagueta, aashu ae nanyaanyukie ae toki te shumata aashu enatii abori enkop, aashu enatii abori nkariak te nkop.
Mirrugokino ninche aashu isiaai ninche; amu ore nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino kara Enkai olom, naitusuj inkera nkitarruorrot oo loo menye o metabaiki eishoi e uni o eni ong'uan e lelo laaiba nanu,
kake kaitodolu enyorrata nauno too nkalifuni oo ishoritin e lelo laanyor nanu neibung inkitanapat aainei.
“Mimpot enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ino pesho amu keiguanare Olaitoriani ilo ooipot enkarna enye pesho.
“Tadamu enkolong e Sabato, mbung'a nintisiny.
Too nkolong'i ile taasisho, nias isiaaitin inono pooki;

kake ore te nkolong e naapishana naa Sabato to Laitoriani Enkai ino; ore teina olong nimiaas hoo ae siaai, iyie aashu olayioni lino, aashu entito ino o sinka lino lee, aashu esinka ino, aashu inkishu inono, aashu olomoni otadokuo otii atua enkang ino.

Amu too nkolong'i ile eitobira Olaitoriani keper o enkop o enaiposha o nena pooki naatii atua ninche, neyeng'iyeng'a te nkolong e naapishana. Metaa etamayiana Olaitoriani enkolong e naapishana neitaa sinyati.
“Iyanyita minyi o ng'utunyi pee itum atobikoi teina kop nikincho Olaitoriani Enkai ino.
“Miar metua.
“Miloloito.
“Mipurrisho.
“Minteeniki ole latia ino elejare.
“Ming'uar enkaji eilo le latia ino; ming'uar enkitok e ilo le latia ino, aashu osinka lenye, aashu esinka enye, aashu olkiteng lenye, aashu osikiria lenye, aashu hoo ae toki ole latia ino.”
Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana pooki ndarat nedol inkiwuang'at o embuakunoto e sekekua o empuruo to ldoinyo, neirut iltung'ana neikirikira, nelamari aaitashe tenelakua.
Nejoki ninche Musa, “Irorie iyie iyiook, amu eikining; kake nchoo metaa mme Enkai nairorie iyiook, mikiye ake.”
Nejoki Musa iltung'ana, “Emiureshoyu, amu keewuo ake Enkai atem intae, pee aa ore euriata enye nelotu dukuya nkonyek inyi, pee miasiasa ake ing'ok.”
Nelamari iltung'ana aaitashe te nelakua, etaa kenyikaki Musa ina aimin nairrusha teine netii Enkai.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ena tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli: ‘Itoduaakita ntae ate nchere airorie nanu intae atii keper.
Mintayuyu nkaitin e nkosholai pee eaku te nebo nanu, nimintaikiki sii ate nkaitin e saabu.

Olperere le nkulupuoni ninye kintaikiki nanu nikipolosakiki te nchumata enye ilasarri linyi oopejori o lasarri linyi le seriani; enker inyi o lkiteng linyi. Ore pooki wueji nagelu metadamunyeki enkarna ai naa kalotu enitii namayian intae.
Naa ti nikintaikiki intae nanu olperere lo lasar loo soito, mishetutu too soito oogueta, amu ti niguetiguete te ntolu nisarkionienie.
Nimikedikede too nkedeta olperere lai lo lasar, pee mimbalayuyu ajo minchopopo.’
“Kuna ninche inkitanapat nipik dukuya ninche.
Ti ninyiang'u orrindik loo Lbrania, neasisho ninye ilarin ile, ore to lari liopishana neipang ninye alo elakuno, nemelak toki.
Tenaa keewuo apa aa ninye ake, nelo ninye aa ninye ake; te neewuo apa eyamishe nelo enkitok enye te nebo ninye.
Te neishoo apa olkitok lenye enkitok neiki ninye ilayiok aashu ntoyie, neaku enkitok o nkera enyena ino lkitok lenye nelo ninye openy.
Kake te neibalunye orrindik ajo, ‘Kanyor olkitok lai o enkitok ai o nkera aainei; malo nanu alakuno,’
neyau olkitok lenye enetii Enkai, neyau ninye kutuk aji aashu eng'ape e kutuk aji neud olkitok lenye enkiok enye to ltidu; neisiaai ninye te nkishui pooki.
“Te nemir oltung'ani entito enye aitaa errindik nemelo aekata anaa enapuo irrindiki lewa.
Te nemeitiship olkitok lenye, laa ninye otisiraka kewan, neisho ninye meinyiang'uni ninye, meeta ninye esipata namirakinye iltung'ana loo loreren amu etonyorra apa ninye te sunkuroisho.
Te nesiraki oltung'ani olayioni lenye entito rrindik neiko ninye anaa entito enye.
Te neyamaki kewan enkitok e are nemeitong'or endaa enye o nkilani enyena o enjung'ore e ina kitok botor.
Naa te nemeitaas olee ninye kuna pokira uni, nelo ninye aing'uaa ninye pesho, metii elaata oo mpisai.
“Ore pooki ng'ae oosh oltung'ani near metua, neari metua.
Kake te neitu eirrag arreshu ninye, kake Enkai ake natorikoyie metabatatakinoyu inkaik enyena, naa kegelaki intae Enkai ewueji naa ninye eisikaki.
Kake te neotiki oltung'ani aitirraki olikae pee ear metua, ewaita intae ninye aaitung'uaa olperere lai pee eye.
“Ore pooki ng'ae oosh menye aashu ng'otonye neari metua.
“Ore pooki ng'ae opurroo oltung'ani, pee emir aashu etumi ninye tiatua imasaa enyena, neari metua.
“Ore pooki ng'ae odek menye aashu ng'otonye neari metua.
“Te neishankarra iltung'ana neosh obo olikae to soit aashu te nkaina neitu eye oltung'ani eirraga te rruat,
ore pee edumunye ilo nelo te ntirma, ore ilo otoosho ninye nelakuni; kake kelak ina kata naiturrayie neing'or ninye o meishiu alaari.
“Te nedumu oltung'ani eng'udi neosh orrindik lenye, aa olee aashu enkitok, neye orrindik teine, neitamei ilo tung'ani.
Kake te neitu eye orrindik te nkolong nabo aashu too nkolong'i are, nemeitamei amu ore orrindik naa emasai enye.

“Te neara iltung'ana nepik entuaa olbae o metapololoyu, nemetii ae torroni natusuja, ore ilo otipika ninye olbae neitalaki te risioroto e nkitalakunoto naitalak ninye olpayian le ina kitok; nelak anaa enanyorraa iladung'ok le nkiguana.
Te nesuju ae torroni neitalakuni enkishui te nkishui,
enkong'u te nkong'u, olalae to lalae, enkaina te nkaina, enkeju te nkeju,
enkinosata e nkima te nkinosata e nkima, olbae to lbae, olkordata to lkordata.
“Te neosh oltung'ani enkong'u o rrindik lenye, olee aashu enkitok, neitarruoo, neisho ninye ilo rrindik meshomo te nkaraki enkong'u.
Te neitayu olalae lo rrindik lenye, olee aashu enkitok, nelo ilo rrindik te nkaraki olalae.
“Te near olkiteng oltung'ani lee aashu enkitok metua, neari ilo kiteng too soito metua; nemenyae inkiri enyena; ore olopeny ilo kiteng nelakuni.
Kake te netamoo ilo kiteng ear iltung'ana, neikooki olopeny neany ening, near ilo kiteng metua olee aashu enkitok, neari ilo kiteng too soito metua, neari sii olopeny metua.
Naa te neigeroki metawalu enkishui enye nelak ninye meitajeu enkishui enye esiana pooki naba anaa enatudung'okoki.
Te near olkiteng olayioni le likae tung'ani aashu entito, neiguanareki olopeny te risioroto ena kitanapata nabo.
“Te near olkiteng orrindik metua, olee aashu enkitok, neisho olopeny olkitok le ilo rrindiki shekeli tomoni uni e nkosholai. Neari ilo kiteng too soito metua.
“Te neing'uaa oltung'ani engumoto menuka aashu te netur oltung'ani engumoto nemenuk, nedoiki olkiteng aashu osikiria atua,
neitobir olopeny ina gumoto neisho impisai olopeny o lkiteng o sikiria neaku ina natua enenye.
“Te near olkiteng le likae tung'ani olkiteng le likae metua nemir ninche ilo kiteng oishu neor impisai enyena. Neor sii ina ng'ues natua.
Naa te neyioloi aajo etamoo oshi ilo kiteng earisho neitu eing'or olopeny, nelak ninye olkiteng to lkiteng neaku ina ng'ues natua enenye.
“Te nepurroo oltung'ani olkiteng aashu enker, neyieng aashu emir, nelak ninye ilmong'i imiet to lkiteng obo o nkerra ong'uan te nker nabo.
Meeta nchere melak ninye ina toki natupurroyie. Te nemeeta ninye toki, nemiri ninye anaa orrindik, pee elak ina natupurroyie.
Te netumi ina ng'ues natupurroyie ninye tiatua imasaa enyena, aa enkiteng, osikiria aashu enker nelak ninye are te nabo.
Te neibung'i olapurroni egilita enkaji kewarie neari metua; ore ilo otaara ninye metua nemeeta iloikop. Kake tenaa dama neeta ninye iloikop.

“Te neisho oltung'ani inkishu edaa te nkurma anaa te nkurma oo sabibu anaa epalaa enkiteng meshomo anya enkurma e likae tung'ani meeta inchere pee meitalakuni teina naisul naing'uaa enkurma enye oo sabibu.
Te nenya enkima enkop, neibung inkiku o metaa ore enkanasa nateenaki aashu enkano naitashe aashu enkurma nabulu einosa enkima, ore ilo oinua enkima nelak pooki.
“Te neisho oltung'ani ole latia enye impisai aashu intokitin metushuma, nepurrorri te nkaji enye, ore te netumi olapurroni, nelak ninye katitin are.
Te neitu etumi olapurroni, ore ilo openy e nkaji nelotu ataaniki Enkai, aitodolu tenaa ketipika ninye enkaina enye atua intokitin ole latia enye aashu eitu epik.

“Ore olomoni pooki opong'oreki, tenaa te nkaraki olkiteng anaa, te nkaraki osikiria, anaa te nkaraki enker, anaa te nkaraki inkilani aashu pooki toki naimina najoyie oltung'ani, ‘Ninye ena’, neyauni enchankar oo nkaloli pokira dukuya Enkai; ore ilo odung'oki Enkai enkiguana nelaaki katitin are ilo le latia enye.
“Te neisho oltung'ani ole latia enye osikiria aashu olkiteng, aashu enker, aashu ae ng'ues pooki meing'ura, neye, aashu etum olbae, aashu eyae, eitu eduaaya hoo ng'ae,
nenya pokira olmumai to Laitoriani pee edoli tenaa ketipika ninye enkaina enye atua imasaa e ilo le latia enye. Nenyorraa olopeny olmumai nemeitalaku enyamu.
Naa tenaa ketupurroyioki too nkaik enyena, nelaaki naa ninye olopeny.
Tenaa ing'uesi e ntim naatara inchoo ninye eyau shakenisho; nemelak ninye enyamu teina nataara ing'uesi e ntim.
“Te neisilenoo oltung'ani ae toki to le latia enye, netum olbae aashu eye metii olopeny, nelak enyamu pooki.
Naa te netii olopeny te nebo ina kiteng nemelak. Tenaa entoki apa naisilenuoki aasishore nelakieki enatoning'okinoteki.
“Te neirorie oltung'ani entito neitu eyami, neboitare ninye, neishoru ninye intokitin e nkaputi te nkaraki ninye, neitaa ninye enkitok enye.
Te neany menye eisho ninye meyama, nelaaki impisai naarisiore ine nkiyama oo ntoyie neitu aekata eyiolou olee.
“Taara metua enkasakutoni.
“Ore pooki ng'ae ololoitore eng'ues neari metua.
“Ore pooki ng'ae opolosaki kulie aitin neme Olaitoriani ake neishuni tukul.
“Eminyal olomoni aashu imbooki ninye enkop, amu irara sii apa intae ilomon te nkop e Misiri.
Minosie osina enkoliai aashu enkerai okishi.
Naa ti ninosie ninche osina naaishiraki ninche nanu, naa kaning nanu olkiyioi lenye,
neyupuyup engoro ai, naar nanu intae to lalem, neaku inkituaak inyi inkolia, neaku inkera inyi okishin.
“Ti nisilenoki impisai obo loo ltung'ana laainei otii atua intae ora aisinani, mitiu te ninye anaa oloitalaku esile niming'oru dupoto te ninye.
Te nelo niya olkila le ilo le latia ino pee intalakunye esile tushukoki ninye eitu edoyio enkolong,
amu ninye ake eitoipore, ninye enkitoipet to sesen lenye; kainyoo naa eitoipore? Naa te naaishiraki ninye nanu, naning amu kara oloata olng'ur.
“Misukeny Enkai nimidek olarikoni loo ltung'ana linono.
“Mimutie te nkishorunoto e nkiputakinoto e nkikesare ino o te mborei nadooyo e naisho oo sabibu. “Ore olkikau loo layiok linono nikincho nanu.
Ninko sii neijia too lmong'i o too ntare; inchoo eboitare ng'otonye too nkolong'i naapishana; ore te nkolong e naapishana nikincho nanu.
“Iakuku intae iltung'ana ooitisinyaki te nkaraki nanu; metaa eminyanya inkiri oo ng'uesi naatara lowuarak, enchoo ildiein.
“Minosaa intae ilomon le lejare. Mimbung'arere oltung'ani torrono aaitayu shakenisho e lejare.
Mirubarere enkumoi oo ltung'ana aas intorrok, nimintayuyu shakenisho te nkiguana aarubare enkumoi oo ltung'ana pee inturraa esipata.
Nimintodolu olkep to ltung'ani aisinani te nkiguana enye.
“Ti ninang'are enkiteng aashu osikiria lo lmanga'tinta lino eimina tushukoki ninye.
Ti nidol osikiria leilo likimba etepetikia olola enkop, nimilo aing'uaa, taretoki ninye metudumu olola.
“Mintapong'oo esipata naipirare ilo aisinani te nkiguana enye.
Talama enkitang'oroto e lejare, nimiar metua ole meeta entioto o lasipani, amu maikenaki nanu esipata olarruoni.
Niming'amu entoki e ropare, amu ore eropare naa keitamodok ilkituaak neinyal erishata e lelo loo sipat.
“Misoruru olomoni, iyiololo oltau lo lomoni, amu irara apa intae ilomon te nkop e Misiri.
“Too larin ile entuun ninkesikese nkurman inyi;

kake ore to lari li opishana nipalipala eminkes hoo ae toki nabulu. Pee enya ilaisinak le lelo tung'ana linyi; ore inaaleku nenya ing'uesi e ntim. Ninkoko neijia too sabibu linyi o too lng'anayio linyi.
“Entaas esiaai inyi too nkolong'i ile, kake ore te nkolong e naapishana niyeng'iyeng'ang'a pee etum olkiteng lino o sikiria lino enkiyeng'iyeng, negolu olayioni le rrindik ino o ilo dokunoti.
Embung'a nena pooki natiaaka intae, nimimpotipoto ake nkarn e kulie aitin aashu minchosho metoning'i eimu nkutukie inyi.
“Katitin uni to lari kintobirakiki nanu osirua.

Embung'a osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuishieki, anaa apa enaaitanapa, ninyanya imukateni neitu eisuishieki too nkolong'i naapishana te nkolong natudung'oki olapa le Abibu amu te ninye apa itupukutuo aaing'uaa Misiri. Meetae oltung'ani olotu dukuya nanu too nkaik naarook.

Embung'a osirua le nkikesare oo lng'anayio le dukuya le siaai inyi, te nena nintera aun tiatua enkurma. Embung'a osirua le nkiturrurrorre te nkiting'oto o lari, ti ninturrur te nkurma lelo ng'anayio le siaai inyi.
Katitin uni to lari epuonu ilewa linyi pooki dukuya o Laitoriani Enkai.
“Mintayu osarge lo lasar lai te nebo imukateni naaisuishieki aashu inchosho eilata o sirua lai eirrag o mekenyu.
“Ore ilng'anayio ooituruku le lelo le dukuya le nkop inyi eyau enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai inyi. Miyierie olkuoo kule e ng'otonye.
“Ng'ura, kairriwaa olmalaika dukuya iyie, pee kirrip iyie te nkoitoi, nikiyau iyie ewueji naidipa aitobira.
Toning'o ninye nias enajo, migolong'aki ninye, amu mikipalaki ninye enkitarruoroto ino; amu etii enkarna ai atua ninye.
“Kake ti nining asipu oltoilo lenye nias nena pooki najo, naaku nanu olmang'atinta loo lmang'ati linono nagilunore lelo likigilunore iyie.
“Te nelo olmalaika lai dukuya intae, neyau intae atua enkop oo lamori o Ilhiti o Ilperesi o Ilkanaani o Ilhifi o Ilyebusi, te najutu nanu ninche, (aishu),
nimirrugokino iyie inkaitin enye, aashu aisiaai ninche, aashu aas anaa enaishiaakino isiaatin enye, kake tusulai ninche tukul nibel ing'apeta enye metaa mbelat.
Olaitoriani Enkai ino isiayiaa, naa kamayian nanu emukate ino o enkare ino; naiwuang'ie imuoyiaritin tiatua intae.
Ore te nkop ino nemetii enkitok naibiru aashu enkolupi. Kaaisho nanu iyie enkishui naado.
Kairriu nanu olkirutoto lai meshomo te dukuya ntae napik enkiuyiaui iltung'ana pooki likiarare naisho ilmang'ati linono pooki meibelekenyata nikilany.
Kapik nanu ilmang'ati linono enkuretisho, naaraa Ilhifi o Ilkanaani o Ilhiti mikishomo aaing'uaa.
Maaraa nanu ninche meshomo te dukuya iyie to lari obo, pee meaku ake enkop enatii eliyio neponari ilowuarak le ntim nikintanyamal.
Kaaraa ninche maakutiti meshomo te dukuya iyie, metaba anaa niponariri aaya enkop.

Napik nanu olpolosie lino ebaiki Enaiposha Nanyokie o metabaiki enaiposha oo Lfilisti, o ebaiki olpurkel o metabaiki olkeju le Frati; amu kayau lelo oomanya enkop apik enkaina ino, niaraa iyie ninche te dukuya iyie.
Mining'ore aitayunye osotua ninche aashu te nebo nkaitin enye.
Metoni ninche te nkop ino, pee mikipik ake easata oo ng'ok tialo nanu; amu ti nisiaai nkaitin enye meeta nchere pee meaku ina orreshet te iyie.”
Nejoki Enkai Musa, “Ilepu wou enetii Olaitoriani, iyie o Aron o Nadab o Abihu o lpayiani ntomoni naapishana loo Siraeli, enteserem te nelakua.
Musa ake olotu ataaniki Olaitoriani, kake mepuonu ilkulikae aanyiku, nemeilepu iltung'ana te nebo ninye.”
Nelotu Musa, neliki iltung'ana irorei pooki lo Laitoriani o nkitanapat pooki; newalu iltung'ana pooki to ltoilo obo nejo, “Ore irorei pooki ooiroro Olaitoriani naa eikiaas.”
Neiger Musa irorei pooki lo Laitoriani. Nedumunye ayooki tadekenya neshet olperere lo lasar te ntonata o ldoinyo, o ng'apeta tomon o are aitorisioki iloshon tomon o are loo Siraeli.
Neirriwaa ilbarnot loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, ooitaituo nkishoorot oo ilasarri oopejori nepolosaki Olaitoriani nkishoorot, ilasarri le seriani oo lmong'i.
Nedumu Musa olpisiai lo sarge nepik embakuli, ore olikae pisiai lo sarge nebukoki olperere.
Neitoki adumu embuku osotua neisumaki iltung'ana metoning'o; nejo ninche, “Ore nena pooki naatejo Olaitoriani naa eikiaas, naa eikining'ishoyu iyiook.”
Nedumu Musa osarge neisuaaki iltung'ana nejo, “Eng'ura osarge lo sotua oitobira Olaitoriani o ntae te risioroto e kulo rorei pooki.”
Neitoki Musa o Aaron o Nadab o Abihu o lpayiani ntomoni naapishana loo Siraeli aailep,
nedol ninche Enkai oo Siraeli, netii abori nkejek enyena entoki naaijo oltiren oitobiraki too soito sidain, ooikununo anaa oloing'ang'e te mua.
Neitu ninye eitame lelo arikok loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli; nedol ninche Enkai, neokisho nedaa.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ilepu wou enatii to ldoinyo, nianyisho teine; naa kaaisho nanu isoito dapashi, te nebo nkitanapat, naigero nanu te nkaraki enkiteng'enare enye.”
Nedumunye Musa te nebo osinka lenye Yoshua, neilep Musa alo ilo doinyo le Nkai.
Nejoki ninye ilpayiani, “Entaanyu iyiook tene o metaba anaa nikintoki aapuonu enitii, naa ng'ura, etii Aron o Huri te nebo intae; ore pooki ng'ae oata enyamali nchoo elo enetii ninche.”
Neilep Musa alo oldoinyo, neitoip enkatampoi oldoinyo,
enkitoo o Laitoriani to ldoinyo le Sinai neitoip enkatampoi inkolong'i ile; ore te nkolong e naapishana neipot ninye Musa tiatua ina atampoi.
Ore eloito enkitoo o Laitoriani neikununo anaa enkima nayupuyup te nchumata o ldoinyo te dukuya iltung'ana loo Siraeli.
Nejing Musa atua enkatampoi neilepaki oldoinyo. Netii apa Musa oldoinyo nkolong'i artam o nkewarietin artam.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Irorie iltung'ana loo Siraeli, pee aaitaiki enkishooroto. Tang'amu enkishooroto te rishata ai te pooki tung'ani otonyorra aishoru to ltau lenye, ning'amu iyie enkishooroto te nkaraki nanu.
Naa ena enkishooroto ning'amu te ninche: saabu o enkosholai o suyai,
nkarash pusi o sinteti, o naanyokie o kitani napuyiapui o lpapit loo nkineji,
ndapan naanota oo lmeregeshi o ndapan oo nkineji, mbaoi oo lera,
eilata oo ltaai o enkorropil o te ilata naaputishoreki o te rropili o lbani,
o soito barrikon ooji oniks o lkulikae soito oopiki olkila lo lapolosani kitok o ina bene enye o lgoo.
Nchoo ninche aaitobiraki nanu ewueji nesinya, pee atum atotona tiatua ninche.
Anaa nena pooki naaitodol iyie naaipirta olchetie to lng'obor lo Laitoriani o masaa enyena pooki, neaku intobir aiko neijia.
“Nchoo eitobir ninche osanduku too nkeek o lerai, intemeta are o lpisiai te nkadoro, entemet nabo o lpisiai endapasho, naa entemet nabo o lpisiai enkilepata.
Nimulumul ninye te saabu nasila, nintoip oriong o atua, nipik enkamanaa e saabu aitaman ninye.
Nipik ilgiso oong'uan le saabu oonapieki, nipik ninche nkejek enyena pokira ong'uan, ilgiso oaare te nchoto enye nabo o lgiso oaare te nkae shoto enye.
Nintayu mbokishi oo nkeek o lchani oji olerai, nimur ninche te saabu.
Nipik nena bokishi atua lelo giso too mbat o sanduku pee enapieki ilo sanduku.
Netoni nena keek, tiatua lelo giso too mbat o sanduku pee enapieki ilo sanduku; nemeitaini aaitung'uaa ninye.
Nipik atua osanduku ina dapidapoi naigerore nkitanapat naaisho nanu iyie.
Nintoki aitayu empising'et o lng'ur e saabu nasila; naa intemeta are o lpisiai enkadoro naa entemet nabo o lpisiai endapasho.
Nindong'u ilkerubi oaare te saabu nipik nkaloli pokira are e ilo orika lo lng'ur.
Intayu olkerubi obo te nkalo nabo nintayu olikae te nkae shoto; te ntoki nabo intobira lelo kerubi o ilo orika lo lng'ur too nkaloli enyena pokira are.
Nelak lelo kerubi inaipuko enye aaitushur olorika lo lng'ur too naipuko enye, neipira nkomomi enye eing'orita lkerubi ilo orika lo lng'ur.
Naa ipik ilo orika lo lng'ur enchumata o sanduku; ore atua ilo sanduku nipik inena dapidapo naaisho nanu.

Teine nanu aalotu atumore, naa te shumata olorika lo lng'ur o te rishata e lelo kerubi ootii enchumata o sanduku le shakenisho, aairorie nanu iyie tialo nena pooki naaisho nanu iyie too nkitanapat te nkaraki itung'ana loo Siraeli.
“Naa ntobira emisa oo nkeek olerai ntemat are enkadoro, naa entemata nabo endapasho, naa entemata nabo o lpisiai enkilepata.
Imulumula te saabu nasila nipik enkamanaa e saabu.
Nipik aitaman enkamanaa e ntemata e ndapasho endap
naa ntobiraki ilgiso oong'uan le saabu nieniki lelo giso ilpijat pokira oong'uan too nkejek enyena pokira ong'uan.
Neirrag lelo giso te mbata e nkamanaa pee eimieki nena bokishi naanapieki emisa.
Nintayuyu mbokishi o lerai nimur te saabu naa kuna enapieki emisa.
Naa intobir isaanini enyena e nkorropil o masaa enyena naapikunyeki olasar opikuni, te saabu nasila intobir ninche.
Nipik emukate nasinya emisa dukuya nanu anaake.

“Naa intobir enkitashet e saabu nasila napiki iltaai. Ore entonata o empolos enye neitobiri te siaai e nkidong'ore; ore nkikompeni enyena, o neeigululu enyena o ntapuka enyena neitaae pooki nabo o enkitashet.
Nepiki ilng'osil ile oipang too nkaloli enyena, ilng'osil okuni te nkibung'et te nkalo nabo o lng'osil okuni te nkibung'et te nkae alo enye;

netii ake nkikompeni uni naikunuwuaki anaa intapuka o lgulului, eeta ake nabo eneigululu o entapukai, to lng'osila obo o nkikompeni uni naikunuwuaki anaa ntapuka o lgulului, meetae ake ene meeta eneigululu o entapukai, to likae ng'osila, netiu neijia pokira ile ooipang'u teina kibung'et.
Ore te nkitashet kewan netii inkikompeni ong'uan naikunuwuaki anaa ilgululu, eeta ineigululu o ntapuka,
netii ake eneigululu nabo abori ilng'osil oaare o oiriamari te lelo ng'osil ile le ina kitashet.
Ore nena kiyiaa enye oo ntapuka o lng'osil lenye neitaa entoki nabo o ninye; neaku pooki entoki nabo e siaai naidong'uoki te saabu nasila.
Nintaiki iltaai oopishana, nepiki iltaai pee eitawang'aki dukuya enye.
Ore intokitin naarieki iltaai o neeiteleikini naa ile saabu nasila.
Te ntalanta nabo e saabu eitobiri te nebo kuna masaa pooki.
Ning'or nchere, intobira te nkitanyaanyukoto enye, apa nikintoduaaki to ldoinyo.
“Ore ake tenebo nena intobira olng'obor le Nkai too lkarash le kitani oopuyiapui tomon, ilpusi o lmorijo o lpilei, neripakini ilkerubi te nkarriayiano oleng.
Ore enkadoro, e pooki karasha nchoo eaku intemat tikitam o isiet enkadoro, ore endapasho e pooki karasha naa intemat ong'uan endapasho. Nerisioroyu ilkarash pooki.
Nchoo eripi ilkarash imiet aaibung'ie te nebo, neitokini aarip aaibung'ie ilkarash imiet te nebo.
Intayu ilgoso loo nkopit pusi loo nkarash te matua e oriong e lelo karash te ntukus e dukuya. Nintoki ake aiko neijia, aitayu ilkiintani pusi loo nkarash te matua e oriong e ina tukus e are.
Ilkiintani onom intayu te ntukus nabo oo lkarash, nintoki aitayu ilkiintani onom te matua e oriong e ina tukus e are oo lkarash; ore lelo goso nchoo eipira.
Intayu ilala onom le saabu oololo paa ninche intutumie entukus oo lkarash o enkae pee eaku enkaji e Nkai entoki nabo.
“Intobira sii nkilani oo lpapit loo nkineji naaitushur olng'obor; ntobira nkilani tomon o obo.
Ore enkadoro e pooki kila naa intemat tomoni uni enkadoro naa intemat ong'uan endapasho; ore nena kilani pokira tomon o obo nerisioroyu.
Nintutum ilkarash imiet te nebo, o nkilani ile te nebo, ore enkila e ile nipud te shumata te mbata e kutuk aji najing'ieki olng'obor.
Nintayu ilkiintani onom te matua e nkila ti oriong e ntukus nabo, o lkiintani onom te matua e oriong e ntukus e are e nkila.
“Nintayu iltidii ooriwuo lo suyai onom, nipik lelo tidii atua lelo kiintani nintutum olng'obor te nebo metaa entoki nabo.
Ore ina shoto naleku too lkarash o lng'obor, ilo pisiai lo lkarasha, neisiong'a ti oriong o lng'obor.
Ore ina matua naleku te nchoto nabo, o ematua naleku te nkae shoto, te nkadoro oo nkilani o lng'obor.
Neisiong'a too mbat o lng'obor enkikenet oo ndapan naanota oo lmeregeshi o noo nkineji.
“Ntobira intorioi irubat oo sunta o lng'obor too nkeek o lerai.
Ore ake erubata e suntai naa intemat tomon enkadoro o entemata nabo o lpisiai e ndapasho.
Netii ake erubata nabo ing'amat are pee etumi aaturub te nebo; ninko neijia too rubat pooki.
Ntobira nkeek o lng'obor, irubat tikitam e nkosholai te nkalo e kopikop.
Ntoneta artam e nkosholai ti abori nena rubat tikitam oo sunta, ntoneta are ti abori erubata nabo too ng'amat enyena pokira are o ntoneta are te rubata nabo too ng'amat enyena pokira are.
Ore te nchoto e are o lng'obor, te nkalo e moikuape irubat tikitam oo sunta.
O ntoneta enye tikitam e nkosholai, ntoneta are ti abori erubata nabo o ntoneta are ti abori enkae rubata.
Ore ti oriong o lng'obor te nkalo o loo ntoluo nintayu irubat ile oo sunta.
Nintayu irubat are too lpijat lo lng'obor ti oriong;
nepaasha ninche te kop kake nchoo eibung'a te shumata, to lgisoi le dukuya, netiu inji te pokira are; neitayu ilpijat pokira are.
Naa keaku irubat isiet, tenebo ntoneta enye e nkosholai, ntoneta tomon o ile, o ntoneta are tiabori erubata nabo, o ntoneta are tiabori enkae rubata.
“Nintayu iloom lo lerai, imiet too rubat e nkalo nabo olng'obor,
o loom imiet too rubat enkae alo o lng'obor, o loom imiet too rubat o lng'bor te nkalo e oriong te nkalo o loo ntoluo.
Ore ilo loomi le mpolos oitorit nena rubat neng'ung'ur ebaiki enkiting'oto o metabaiki enkiting'oto.
Nimulumul irubat te saabu, nintayu ilgiso lenye le saabu pee eibung iloom, nimur iloom te saabu.
Nishetu olng'obor te nkitanyaanyukoto apa anaa enikintoduaaki to ldoinyo.
“Nintobir oliaatua too ntokitin pusi o sinteti o mpilei o nkarash e kitani napuiyiapui. Neitobir te siaai e nkarriayiano neripakini ilkerubi.
Neisiong ninche too ng'apeta o lerai nemur te saabu, neeta ilala oololo le saabu, too ntoneta ong'uan e nkosholai.
Niik oliatua te lelo ala oololo, niyau osanduku le shakenisho atua oliaatua; nikirishaki ilo liaatua ewueji sinyati o ine nesinya oleng.
Nipik ilo orika lo lng'ur shumata ilo sanduku le shakenisho ine wueji nesinya oleng.
Nipik ina misa oriong o liaatua, nipik enkitashet o ltaa enkalo e kopikop o lng'obor neipirakinore emisa; nipik emisa enkalo e moikuape.
“Ore kutuk aji o lng'obor nintayu olkarasha pus o olmorijoi o lpile, oitobiruno te kitani napuyiapui napiyaya, neikodi to ltidu.
Nintaiki lelo karash ing'apeta imiet o lerai nimur te saabu, ore ilala lenye oololo naa ile saabu nintaiki ntoneta imiet o suyai.
“Ntobira olperere too nkeek o lerai intemat imiet enkadoro naa intemat imiet endapasho; nerisioro olperere too nkaloli pooki. Ore enkilepata enye naa intemat uni.
Nipik imowuarak lelo pijat lenyena pokira oong'uan; neaku nena mowuarak entoki nabo o ninye. Nimur to suyai.
Nintayu imotioo enyena naooku nkuruon o ilkijikoni o mbakulini o ntokitin naaitobirieki enkima; ore ntokitin enyena pooki naasishoreki nintobir to suyai.
Nintaiki sii ng'esherreta naashetuno to suyai; ore nena ng'esherreta nipik ilgiso oong'uan lo suyai ilpijat lenyena pokira oong'uan.
Tipika ina ng'esherrie abori emanaroto o lperere pee eitorit ina ng'esherrie o lperere ti abori.
Nintayu imbokishi o lperere, imbokishi o lerai nimur ninche to suyai;
nepiki nena bokishi aaimie lelo giso metaa ketii imbokishi nchot pokira o lperere te nenapi.
Intobira too nkeek, nintugum anaa apa enikintoduaaki to ldoinyo, neitobirunye atiu neijia.
“Intobira endung'oroto o lng'obor le Nkai. Ore te nkalo e kopikop nepiki endung'oroto olkarasha oisiong'a sidai oshetuno too usin naapiyaya loo intemat iip enkadoro te nkalo nabo.
Ore ing'apeta enye naa tikitam, ore ntoneta enye naa tikitam lo suyai, kake ore ilala oololo loo ng'apeta o lgoso lenye naa ine nkosholai.

Neijia sii etiu enkadoro enye te nkalo e moikuape, tipika nkisiong'at oo ilkarash loo ntemat iip. Nera ing'apeta enye tikitam, nera ntoneta enye tikitam naa ino suyai, kake ore lelo ala oololo loo lgoso lenye naa ile nkosholai.
Ore te nkalo e ndoyioroto e nkolong tipika ilkarash onom te nkadoro o ng'apeta tomon o ntoneta tomon.
Ore endapasho e ndung'oroto te nkalo najing'ieki te nkilepunoto e nkolong naa intemat onom.
Ore ilkarash te nkalo nabo e kishomi naa intemat tomon o imiet o ng'apeta uni o ntoneta uni.
Ore te nkae shoto naa intemat tomon o imiet o ng'apeta uni o ntoneta uni.

Ore enkishomi e ndung'oroto nipik aitolok olkarasha loo ntemat tikitam te nkadoro oata emua pus o emorijoi o empile nashetuno te nkarasha sidai napuyiapui. Neikodoki te ripare o ltidu; nepiki ing'apeta ong'uan o ntoneta ong'uan.
Ore ing'apeta pooki naamanita endung'oroto neitutumi te nkeene e nkosholai, ore lala lenye oololo naa ile nkosholai, ore ntoneta enye naa ino suyai.
Ore enkadoro e ndung'oroto naa intemat imiet. Netii ilkarash ooluaa sidain oopuyiapui o ntoneta o suyai.
Ore imasaa pooki e ilo ng'obor e pooki siaai o ncheito enyena pooki endung'oroto naa ino suyai.
“Nintanap iltung'ana loo Siraeli pee kiyaki ninche eilata naironyuno nasila oo loirienito te nkaraki ewang'an, pee eiki oltaa meiyupuyupo enkata pooki.

Ore te ilo ng'obor otumoreki, ti oriong ilo liatua otii dukuya shakenisho, neitobir Aron o layiok lenyena ebaiki teipa o metabaiki tadekenya te dukuya Olaitoriani. Neaku enkitanapata ntarasi naibung'i tiatua iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli o eishoi enye.
“Niyau iyie Aron, olalashe lino o layiok lenyena Nadab o Abihu o Eliesa o Isamar tiatua iltung'ana loo Siraeli pee aisiaai nanu anaa ilapolosak.
Nintaiki Aron olalashe lino ilkilani oosinya, te nkitoo o te sidano.
Nirorie lelo pooki oata enkidimata, lelo laishoo eng'eno, pee eitobir ilkilani le Aron, pee eitisinyi te mpolosare ai.

Kuna inkilani naaitobir ninche, enkila o lgoo, enkila dorrop, o lkila oodo, enkila e oriong naikodo o enkarasha e lukunya, o enkene e mpolos; neitobir ninche nkilani naasinya te nkaraki Aron olalashe lino o layiok lenyena pee aaisiaai ninche anaa ilapolosak.
“Neng'amu ninche saabu o nkarash pusi o morijo o mpilei o kitani napuyiapui napiyaya.
Neitobir ninche enkila dorrop te saabu, too usin pusi o too morijo o too mpilei o te kitani napuyiapui napiyaya te nkarriayiano.
Neeta inkeenta are ooronyi too lpijat lenyena pee eitutumieki te nebo
o enkeene e mpolos naitobiruno te nkarriyiano te nena tokitin, pee eenieki; te saabu o too usin pusi o sinteti o naanyokie o naaibor sidain.
Niya isoito are barrikon ooji oniks niguetaki asiraki ninche nkarn oo layiok le Israel,
inkarn enye ile to soit obo, ore nkulie ile naaleku ning'eroki olikae soit, too inot enye.
Ore anaa enaguet olaguetani omishir isoito te nkarriyiano, neijia sii iyie inkuna enguetata e lelo soito oaare inkarn oo layiok le Israel; nipik nena nitaguetua te saabu.
Nipik lelo soito pooki inkaloli ooronyi le ina kila dorrop, pee eaku isoito oodamunyeki ilayiok le Israel; nenap Aron inkarn enye te dukuya o Laitoriani too ronyi lenyena pee edamuni.
Nipik inkikodot are e saabu
o lpisia oaare le saabu nasila, ooirina anaa empito nipik nimbung'ie ina saabu naikodore enkila.
“Nintobir sii ina kila o lgoo e nkiguana, te nkarriyiano, anaa ina kila dorrop, te saabu o too usin pusi o morijo o mpilei o kitani napuyiapui napiyaya.
Nerisioroyu nkaloli pooki, netasha entemata e ndap enkadoro o entemata e ndap endapasho.
Nipik ilkererin oong'uan loo soito olkereri obo lo ltotoi barrikoi, oltotoi onyori oltotoi onyokie oleng oaku olkereri le dukuya.
Ore olkereri li are naa oltotoi sintet oltotoi pus oata iltiil o ltotoi sidai oji almasi;
ore olkereri liokuni naa oltotoi pile o ltotoi owang oji agat o ltotoi pile oji ametist;
ore olkereri li ong'uan naa oltotoi oji beril, oltotoi oji oniks o ltotoi pus oji Jaspa. Neitobir te nkikodo e saabu.
Nepik isoito tomon o are o nkarn enye anaa inkarn oo layiok le Israel. Netiu ninche anaa olmishire, meetae ake olemeguetuno enkarna enye too loshon tomon aare.
Nintobiraki ina kila o lgoo ilpisia ooipila anaa impi, le saabu nasila;
nintobiraki ina kila o lgoo ilgiso oaare le saabu nipik lelo giso oaare ilpijat pokira oaare le mbene o lgoo.
Nipik lelo pisia aare le saabu ooipila atua lelo giso ootii ile mowuarak le mbene o lgoo.
Ore ineeiting'ie lelo pisia oaare ooipila nimbung'ie lelo kererin oaare le nkikodo e saabu, nimbung'ie te nkalo e dukuya te nena keenta e nkila dorrop naatii ironyi.
Nintoki aitayu ilgiso aare le saabu nimbung'ie lelo lemowuarak aare le nkila to lgoo te nkalo e atua te mbata e ina kila dorrop.
Nintoki aitayu ilgiso aare le saabu, nimbung'ie ninche te nkalo e dukuya ti abori nena keenta are e nkila dorrop natii ironyi, te nchumata ina keene e nkila dorrop naripuno te nkarriyiano.

Neitutum ninche ina kila o lgoo too lgiso lenyena o lgisoi le ina kila dorrop te nkeene pus, pee eirrag teina keene e nkila dorrop naripuno te nkarriyiano, pee melolong'u ina kila o lgoo teina kila dorrop.
“Nenap ninye Aron inkarn oo layiok le Israel teina kila o lgoo e nkiguana, to ltau lenye, te nelo ninye atua ine wueji nesinya, pee edamuni ninche anaake te dukuya Olaitoriani.

Ore ina kila o lgoo e nkiguana tipika Urimu o Sumimu, pee eaku ketii ninche oltau le Aron, te nebo ninye enkata nilo dukuya Olaitoriani. Neaku kenapita ninye Aron enkiguana oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli to ltau lenye te dukuya Olaitoriani anaake.
“Nintaa iyie olkila li oriong pus muj le ina kila dorrop.
Nipik ilo kila enaudoto naimieki endukuya; ore ina audoto neitamani eripata anaa enaudoto e nkila pee mepolosa.
Ore eripata enye ti abori tiripaki ilonyek le usi pus, o empile o enanyokie aitaman o ntualan e saabu erishata enye,
entuala e saabu o long'u, nemanaa te ripata e abori olkila.
Neishop Aron ele kila te neisiaaisho anaa olapolosani. Ore enkorui enye nening'i te nelo atua ine wueji sinyati dukuya Olaitoriani o te neipang'u boo, pee meye.
“Nintayu enchili e saabu nasila niguetaki oriong enye, anaa isirat lo lmishire: ‘Sinyati to Laitoriani.’
Nieniki ina arasha narridieki endukuya te nkeene pus; tipika enkalo e dukuya e ina arasha narridieki endukuya.

Neishop Aron te nkomom enye, neya ninye Aron enkorrok enye pooki torroni naitayuni to lasar osinya, oyanyit iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa nkishoorot enye naasinya. Neton ina masaai anaake te nkomom enye, pee eng'amari nena kishoorot te dukuya Olaitoriani.
“Niripu olkila te nkarriyiano te nkarasha sidai napuyiapui, nintayu ina arasha narridieki endukuya te nkarasha sidai napuyiapui, nintayu enkeene e mpolos aikodu to ltidu.
“Ore ilayiok le Aron nintaiki ilkilani o nkeenta o maupen. Nintayu ninche te nkitoo o te nkishiaa.
Ninchopoki lelo kilani Aron olalashe lino, te nebo ilayiok lenyena, nibukoki eilata aput ninche, ninteng'el peyie aatum aaisiaayia anaa ilapolosak.
Niripaki nkilani e atua te nkarasha sidai pee eitoip masipaisho enye; nkilani naabaiki mpolosi nebaiki nkupesir;

neishop Aron o layiok lenyena te nepuonu aanyikaki olperere lo lasar aaisiaisho te wueji sinyati, meyaki ake ate entorroni meye. Naa keaku ena enkitanapata nauno te ninye o too ishoritin enyena te siadi ninye.
“Nji nkuna te niput Aaron o layiok lenyena pee aatum aaisiayia anaa ilapolosak. Iwa oloing'oni obo oti o lmeregeshi aare lemeeta entioto,
o mukateni neitu eisuishieki o mukateni naamelok neitu eisuishieki naatipikaki eilata o loirien o nkaukau o mukateni neitu eisuishieki naaelieki eilata. Te nkano sidai napuyiapui intayu ninche.
Nipik atua olbene obo, niyau ninche teina kikapu, niyau ilo oing'oni o lelo meregeshi pokira oaare.
Niyau Aron o layiok lenyena kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo, nintuku ninche te nkare.
Nintayu nkilani ninchopoki Aron enkila e oriong o enkila dorrop o enkila o lgoo, nien empolos teina keene naripuno te nkarriyano e ina kila dorrop.
Ninchopoki enkarasha narridieki endukuya enye. Nipik ilo marisian osinya enchumata e ina arasha.
Niyau ina ilata naputishoreki, nibukoki endukuya enye aput ninye.
Nintoki ayau ilayiok lenyena, ninchopoki ninche inkilani,
nien impolosi enye too nkeenta, ninchopoki imaupen; neaku enenye empolosare te nkitanapata nauno. Inji nkuna iput Aron o layiok lenyena apik esiaai sinyati.
“Nintoki ayau oloing'oni dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo. Neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye endukuya e ilo oing'oni,
niar ilo oing'oni metua te dukuya Olaitoriani te kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo.
Niya embata o sarge lo loing'oni nipik imowuarak olperere lo lasar to lkimojino lino; ore olikae sarge mbukoi ti abori olperere lo lasar.
Niya ina kurriny pooki naimulumul imonyit o lkina le moinyua o lairakuj pokira aare eeta enkurriny enye, nipej ninche te nchumata olperere.
Kake ore nkiri o loing'oni, o lchoni lenye o emodiei enye, nipejoo ninche te nkima tialuo ina ang oo lng'oborri; olasar ninye te nkaraki olasar lo ng'ok.
“Nintoki aitayu obo loo lmeregeshi, neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye endukuya e ilo meregesh,
niyieng ilo meregesh, nisuaaya osarge lenye te mbata o lperere lo lasar aitaman.
Nintoki adung'udung ilo meregesh, metaa nkutiti kiri, nintuku enkoshoke enye o loilelek nipik ninche te nebo irubat enyena o endukuya enye,
nipejoo olmeregesh pooki te nchumata o lperere lo lasar; olasar opejori te nkima ninye to Laitoriani, esong'ouna naitishipisho o lasar le nkima to Laitoriani.
“Nintoki aitayu olikae meregesh, neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye endukuya o lmeregesh,

niyieng ilo meregesh, niya embata o sarge nipik esegerua e nkiok e tatene e Aron o segeruani oo nkiyiaa e tatene oo layiok lenyena, o lmogirrani loo nkaik enye e tatene o lmogirrani loo nkejek enye e tatene, ore ilo sarge otashare olperere lo lasar nisuaaya aitaman.

Nisuaaya olikai sarge otii enchumata o lperere lo lasar o ina ilata naputishoreki nisuaaki Aron o lkilani lenyena, o layiok lenyena o lkilani loo layiok lenyena te nebo ninye. Ore ninye o lkilani lenyena nesinyayu o layiok lenyena o lkilani loo layiok lenyena te nebo ninye.

“Nintoki sii aitayu eilata o lmeregesh o eilata o lkidong'oe o enkurriny e nkoshoke o lkina le moinyua o lairakuj pokira are eeta enkurriny enye o emuro e tatene (amu olmeregesh oputishoreki opikieki Aron o layiok lenyena esiaai sinyati).
Nintayu tiatua enkikapu oo mukateni neitu eisuishieki natii dukuya Olaitoriani, emukate nabo namelok natii o enkaukau nabo eilata,
o emukate nipik kuna pooki inkaik e Aron o nkaik oo layiok lenyena, niyukuyuk iyie ninche metaa olasar oyukuyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Nintoki iyie aitayu too nkaik enye, nipejoo to lperere lo lasar metoponai olasar opejori, pee eaku esong'ouna naitishipisho te dukuya Olaitoriani; olasar le nkima to Laitoriani.
“Nintayu oloikulu le ilo meregesh otuputieki Aron aapik esiaai sinyati, niyuk pee eaku olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani; neaku erubata ino.
Nintisiny oloikulu lo lasar oyuki o ina muro aa ninye erubata o lapolosani, nayukoki, naa ninye eishoruaki teilo meregesh oputishoreki amu te nkaraki Aron o te nkaraki layiok lenyena.
Naa keaku ninche ine Aron o noo layiok lenyena, erubata enye naisho ninche iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaake, too lasarri lenye le seriani; neaku olasar lenye to Laitoriani.
“Ore lelo kilani sinyat le Aron naa keaku iloo layiok lenyena oosuju ninye, pee ebukokini eilata eishopito, neputi ninche eishopito.
Ore ilo ayioni oaku olapolosani erishata enye neishop ninche inkolong'i naapishana, tenelotu atua olng'obor le ntumo aisiaaisho te wueji sinyati.
“Niya ilo meregesh oputishoreki niyier inkiri enyena te wueji sinyati.
Nenya Aron o layiok lenyena inkiri e ilo meregesh o mukateni naatii atua nkikapuni te kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo.
Nenya ninche nena tokitin naaitobirieki to lning'o lo sotua, pee epikieki ninche esiaai sinyati, neitisinyi, kake menya oltung'ani le boo, amu eisinyat ninche.
Kake te neleku ae kirring'o naputishoreki aashu emukate o mekenyu, nipejoo iyie te nkima ina natelekua, meinosi ninye, amu eisinyati.
“Nintaas ina Aron o layiok lenyena, te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa; too nkolong'i naapishana ipik ninche ina siaai sinyati.

Ore ake te nkolong nintayu, nipolos oloing'oni pee eaku olasar loo ng'ok lo lning'o lo sotua. Nintayu sii olasar loo ng'ok te nkaraki olperere lo lasar, ti nintayu olning'o lo sotua te ninye nibukoki ninye eilata, aitisiny.
Too nkolong'i naapishana intayu olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki olperere lo lasar, nintisiny, neaku ilo perere lo lasar sinyati oleng; ore pooki toki naiseyie olperere lo lasar neitisinyi.
“Naa ele olasar lintayu te nchumata o lperere lo lasar, ilkuoo oaare le kerra lo lari obo, anaake te nkolong.
Topolosa olkuoo obo le ker tadekenya, ore olikae kuo le ker nipolos teipa.
Ore te nebo ilo kuoo le ker le dukuya irrantilini aare le nkano nasila naipurjare, emborei o ltulet le ilata sidai o emborei o ltulet le naisho oo sabibu pee eaku olasar.
Ore olikae kuo le ker topolosa teipa ninko anaa ilo le tadekenya, nintayu te nebo ninye olasar le nkurma naidong'o o lasar opikuni. Olasar le nkima ele to Laitoriani, neitishipisho esong'ouna enye.
Keaku ninye olasar opeji anaake tiatua iishoritin inyi te kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo, te dukuya Olaitoriani teine natumore nanu intae, pee airorie nanu intae teine.
Teine atumore iltung'ana loo Siraeli, neitisiny enkitoo ai ine.
Naitisiny nanu ilo ng'obor le ntumo o lperere lo lasar; naitisiny sii Aron o layiok lenyena, pee aaisiaai ninche anaa ilapolosak.
Namany nanu atua ltung'ana le Israel, naaku Enkai enye.
Neyiolou ninche aajo kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, oyaua ninche aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, pee atum nanu atotona tiatua ninche. Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye.
“Intobira olperere lo lasar pee ipejie enkorropil enchumata enye. Too nkeek o lerai intobira.
Naa keaku entemata nabo enkadoro naa entemata nabo endapasho. Nerisioroyu inkaloli pooki, naa intemat are enkilepata; ore mowuarak enyena naa entoki nabo o lperere.
Tumura te saabu nasila enkoriong enye o matuan o mouarak enyena. Nipik enkamanaa e saabu aitaman.
Nintobiraki ilgiso oaare le saabu, ti abori enkamanaa, too nkaloli enyena pokira are, pee eibung nena bokishi naa ninche enapieki.
Nintayu imbokishi o lerai nimur ninche te saabu.
Nipik ninye dukuya ilo liatua otii embata o sanduku le shakenisho, otii dukuya olorika lo lng'ur, te nchumata shakenisho, teine natumore nanu intae.
Nepej Aron enkorropil naisonkoyo oleng to lperere lo lasar ore anaake tadekenya te neitobir iltaai nepej.
Naa ore te neinok Aron iltaai teipa nepej enkorropil oo nkolong'i pooki te dukuya Olaitoriani tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.
Mintayuyu ake enkorropil nemesinya te nchumata teine, aashu olasar opejori, aashu olasar le nkurma naidong'o nimibukokiki olasar opikuni.

Neitobir Aron olning'o lo sotua too mowuarak enyena kata nabo to lari; teilo sarge lo lasar loo ng'ok lo lning'o lo sotua eitobir ninye olning'o lo sotua nabo kata to lari tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki. Kesinya oleng ilo perere lo lasar to Laitoriani.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

“Teninkenikene ltung'ana loo Siraeli, aayiolou esiana neishoru ake pooki ng'ae elakunoto te nkaraki enkorrok enye to Laitoriani te ninken iyie ninche, pee mejing ake olmeitai atua ninche te ninken iyie ninche.
Ore pooki ng'ae oikenayioki te nkikenare neishoru ena: olpisiai loo mpisai naaji shekeli te risioroto e shekeli eine wueji sinyati. Neitayu olpisiai le shekeli anaa olasar to Laitoriani.
Ore pooki ng'ae oikenayioki te nkikena, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, neishoru olasar to Laitoriani.
Meishoru olkarsis inkumok nemeishoru olaisinani inkuti, to lpisiai le shekeli, te ninchoru olasar lo Laitoriani aitaiyu olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki kewan ino.

Niya iyie impisai o lning'o lo sotua too ltung'ana loo Siraeli, nigelu aitaa ine nkisiaayiare o lng'obor le ntumo, pee eyau iltung'ana loo Siraeli metadamuni te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee intobiribiri olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki intae maate.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Intobira emoti o suyai naitukuoreki; ore entonet enye naa eno suyai, pee eitukuoreki. Nipik ninye erishata o lng'obor le ntumo o lperere lo lasar, nipik enkare atua,
pee aa ninye eitukuyie Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye o nkejek enye.
Te nepuo atua olng'obor le ntumo, aashu te nepuonu embata o lperere lo lasar aaisiaisho, aapejoki Olaitoriani olasar te nkima, neitukuo ninche te nkare, meye ake.
Neituku ninche inkaik enye o nkejek enye, meye ake. Neaku ena enkitanapata ntarasi te Aron o too ishoritin enyena tiatua ishoritin enye pooki.”
Ore tenebo nena neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Ntayu isonkoyoni sidain oleng; shekeli iip imiet e manoo, naruko, o lpisiai le nena loo nkabobok o sinantei naarropil oleng, aa taa shekeli iip are o onom,
o shekeli iip imiet o sinantei oojuno, te risioroto e ntemata e wueji sinyati, o eilata oo loirienito mboreitin imiet e mpirbil.
Nintayu iyie te kuna eilata nasinya naputishoreki.
Nibukoki aitisiny ilo ng'obor le ntumo o ilo sanduku le shakenisho,
o emisa o ntokitin enyena pooki o enkitashet oo ltaai o ntokitin enyena pooki o lperere le nkorropil
o lperere lo lasar opejorieki ilasarri tenebo ntokitin enyena o embeshen naitukuoreki o ntonet enye.
Nteng'ele iyie ninche pee etum aataa sinyat tukul. Ore pooki naiseyie ninye neaku sinyati.
Nibukoki Aron o layiok lenyena aitisiny ninche, pee aatum aaisiaayia anaa ilapolosak.
Nijoki iyie iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Keaku ena eilata ai sinyati naputishoreki tiatua ishoritin inyi.
Nemebukokini iseseni ake le pooki ng'ae, nimintayu ae nanyaanyukie te nkitobirunoto; kesinya ninye, naa keton esinya te iyie.
Ore pooki tung'ani oitobira aitushulu ae nanyaanyukie, aashu pooki ng'ae opik ae te ninye oltung'ani le boo neiwuang'ieki tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.’ ”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Intayu intokitin naarropil, naaji natafi o shekeli o kelbena; o ntokitin naarropil te nebo enkorropil nasila nerisioroyu pooki.
Intobira enkorropil naitushulaki te nkarriyiano olaitobirani loo sonkoyoni natipikaki emunyan aasil neitisinyi.
Nindong iyie embata enye kiti oleng, nipik embata enye dukuya shakenisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo teine naatumore nanu iyie; neaku ninye te iyie sinyati oleng.
Ore enkorropil nintayu te risioroto e enkitushulata enye, nimintayu te nkaraki intae maate, keaku ninye te ntae sinyati to Laitoriani.
Ore pooki ng'ae oitayu ae nanyaanyukie pee easishore anaa esonkoyo neiwuang'ieki tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Ng'ura, aaipoto nanu te nkarna e Besalel olayioni le Uri, olayioni le Huri, lo losho le Yuda:
naiputa nanu ninye Enkiyang'et e Nkai, te nkidimata o te nkalamasisho o te ng'eno o te nkarriyiano pooki.
Pee eipiru mbaa e nkarriyiano, neasisho te saabu o te nkosholai o to suyai,
te ndung'oto oo soito oopiki iwuejitin o te ng'uetata oo nkeek, te siaai e nkarriyiano pooki.
Naa ng'ura, ategelua nanu te nebo ninye Oholiab olayioni le Ahisamak, lo losho le Dan; naishoo nanu iltung'ana pooki oodupa enkidimata, pee etum aaitobira nena pooki naaitanapa nanu iyie:
ilo ng'obor le ntumo o ilo sanduku le shakenisho o ilo orika lo lng'ur otii enchumata enye, o masaa pooki e ilo ng'obor;
emisa o ntokitin enyena o ina kitashet o ltaa le saabu nasila te nebo ntokitin enyena pooki, olperere le nkorropil,
o ilo perere lo lasar opejori te nebo ntokitin, enyena pooki, o emoti naitukuoreki o eneitotonieki enye,
o lelo kilani ootiripuaki aaikod le Aron olapolosani, o lkilani loo layiok lenyena, te nkisiaayiare enye anaa ilapolosak,
o ina ilata naputishoreki o enkorropil naisonkoyo e ine wueji sinyati. Anaa nena pooki naaitanapa iyie. Neas ninche.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli ‘Embung'a Sabato ai amu olmonokie ele te rishata ai o ntae tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki, pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere, nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny intae.
Embung'a Sabato amu aisinyati te ntae; ore pooki ng'ae oisarkionie neari metua; ore oltung'ani oasisho teina olong neiwuang'ieki ninye tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.
Too nkolong'i ile easi esiaai kake ore enkolong e naapishana naa Sabato, enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng naitisinyi, sinyati to Laitoriani; ore oltung'ani oas pooki siaai te nkolong e Sabato neari metua.
Metaa keibung iltung'ana loo Siraeli Sabato, neing'or Sabato tiatua iishoritin enye pooki, anaa osotua loo ntarasi.
Olmonekie ele intarasi te rishata ai o ltung'ana loo Siraeli nchere too nkolong'i ile eitobira Olaitoriani keper o enkop; ore te nkolong e naapishana neyeng'iyeng'a.’ ”
Neisho Olaitoriani Musa nena dapidapo are e shakenisho ina kata pee eidip airorie te nchumata oldoinyo le Sinai, indapidapo o soit, naaigero to lkimojino le Nkai.

Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana aajo eimutie Musa eitu elotu adou to ldoinyo, neiturrurro iltung'ana aasotokino Aron, nejoki ninye, “Inyo, intaiki iyiook inkaitin naapuo te dukuya iyiook, amu ore ele Musa, ele tung'ani laa ninye oyaua iyiook ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, mikiyiolo iyiook enataase te ninye.”
Nejoki Aron ninche, “Entayutu lelo giso le saabu ootii inkiyiaa oo nkituaak inyi, o ilayiok linyi, o ntoyie inyi, nikiyakiki nanu.”
Neitayu iltung'ana pooki ilgiso le saabu ootii nkiyiaa enye, neyaki ninche Aron.

Neng'amu ninye ina saabu too nkaik enye, neitobir te ntoki naguetishoreki, neitayu olashe le saabu natosholaki; nejo ninche, “Kuna ninche inkaitin inyi, intae Isiraeli, naayautua aailepunye aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri!”
Ore ake pee edol Aron ena, neshetu ninye olperere lo laser te dukuya ninye; neitubulaa Aron ajo, “Ore taaisere naa keaku osirua lo Laitoriani.”
Neinyototo ninche aayooki taaisere, neitayu ilasarri oopejori, neyau ilasarri le seriani; netoni iltung'ana aadaa neokisho, neinyototo aaiguran.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tadoi shomo; amu ore iltung'ana linono, laa ninche apa iyaua ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, neinyala ate aagil inkitanapat,

neibelekenyate aapaashaa aasioki aaing'uaa enkoitoi apa naa ninye aitanapa ninche; eitaikitia ate olashe oitobirutua te saabu nashola, neteserema ninche ninye neitaiki ninye olasar, nejo, ‘Kuna ninche inkaitin inyi intae Isiraeli, naa ninche naayautua intae aailepunye aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.’ ”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Atoduaa kulo tung'ana, naa nayiolou ajo iltung'ana oogol ilukuny
ore naa tung'uayioki nanu, pee etum engoro ayupuyupo neirowuaju te ninche amu aidim aidaikie ninche, kake ore te iyie naitayu olorere kitok.”

Kake etasayia Musa Olaitoriani Enkai enye nejo, “Olaitoriani, kainyoo pee eyupuyup engoro ino airowuaju te nkaraki iltung'ana linono laa ninche apa iyaua aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri te ngolon sapuk o te nkaina e nkidimata?

Kainyoo pee ejo Ilmisiri, e ntorroni apake eyiewakini ninche, pee eitupukuo te Misiri alotu aar metuata too ldoinyo, nemut ninche aiwuang'ie ti oriong e nkop? Mbelekenyayu tapala engoro ino napi, nirridu tena torroni te nkaraki iltung'ana linono.

“Tadamu Abraham, o Isaak, o Israel, isinkan linono, laa te ninche inosa olmumai te kewan ino, nijoki iyie ninche, ‘Kaponaa nanu eishoi ino anaa ilakir le shumata; ore ena kop pooki natonyorra aishoru, naa kaisho nanu eishoi ino nejung ninche ntarasi.’ ”
Neirridu Olaitoriani ina torroni natadamua pee itaasiltung'ana lenyena.
Neibelekenya Musa, nelo adoyio to ldoinyo eeta mbaoi are e shakenisho too nkaik enyena, mbaoi naaigero too nkaloli pokira are; eigero te nkalo nabo neigero te nkae alo.
Ore lelo soito dapashi naa esiaai e Nkai, ore ilkigerot naa ilkigerot le Nkai ootaguetakaki oriong lelo soito dapashi.
Ore ake pee ening Yoshua ololepilepi loo ltung'ana ebuakita, nejoki ninye Musa, “Etii ololepilepi lo larrabal atua enkang oo lng'oborri.”
Nejo, “Mme oltoilo le mbuakunoto e nkisulata aashu oltoilo le nkishirata e mirata, kake oltoilo le ranyare ilo laning'ito.”

Ore ake enyiku aataaniki ilng'oborri nedol ilo ashe o sinkolio, neyupuyup engoro e Musa airowuaju nenang'aa ninye lelo soito oigerore ikitanapat e Nkai too nkaik enyena, nebel ninche te ntonata o ldoinyo.
Neya ninye ilo ashe oitobirutua ninche, nepejoo ninye te nkima, neidong aitaa empunyua, neidapashaki oriong enkare, neitook iltung'ana loo Siraeli ina are.
Nejoki Musa Aron, “Kainyoo kintaasa kulo tung'ana pee iyaua eng'oki sapuk shumata ninche?”
Nejo Aron, “Mincho engoro o lkitok lai eyupuyup airowuaju; iyiolo iyie kulo tung'ana nchere eiulokinote entorroni.

Amu aatiaakita ninche nanu, ‘Ntobiraki iyiook inkaitin, naapuo te dukuya iyiook; amu ore ele Musa, ilo tung'ani oyaua iyiook ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, mikiyiolo iyiook enatotiwuo te ninye.’
Najoki nanu ninche, ‘Enchoo pooki ng'ae oata saabu eitayu,’ naaisho ninche nanu, nanang'aki nanu atua enkima, nepukunye ine ele ashe.”
Ore ake pee edol Musa ajo meekure eitoriayu iltung'ana (etapalayie Aron metaa meitoriayu, aitukurru ninche tiatua ilmang'ati lenye),
neitoki Musa aitashe te kishomi e ina ang oo lng'oborri, nejo, “Kaing'ae ole nkalo o Laitoriani? Wou enatii.” Neiturrurro ilayiok le Lawi maate teine netii ninye.

Nejoki ninye ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Teena pooki ng'ae olalem te mpolos enye, nilo aman enkang oo lng'oborri pooki ebaiki kishomi o enkae kishomi ning'il ake ashukunye, taara pooki tung'ani olalashe lenye, o le ncholiek enye olelatia enye.’ ”
Neas ilayiok le Lawi te risioroto ororei le Musa; nebatata ina olong iltung'ana oobaya inkalifuni uni.
Nejo Musa, “Ore taata nituputo ate te nkisiayiare o Laitoriani, pooki ng'ae te nkinyiang'a o layioni lenye o eno lalashe lenye, pee eisho ninye Enkai ntae emayianata ena olong taata.”
Ore taaisere nejoki Musa iltung'ana, “Itaasa intae eng'oki sapuk. Ore taata naa kailep alo enetii Olaitoariani; amu ebaiki naitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ing'ok inyi.”
Neaku enyaaka Musa ashuko alo enetii Olaitoriani nejo, “Wooi etaasa kulo tung'ana eng'oki torrono oleng; eitobiritua inkaitin te saabu neserem ninche.
Tapaliki sii ake ninche eng'oki enye; naa ti nimipaliki, tujutoki aatasayia tiatua ina buku ino apa niking'erie.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ore pooki ng'ae otaasa eng'oki tialo nanu, ninye ajut enkarna enye tiatua embuku ai.
Kake shomo taata toriko iltung'ana ine wueji apa naatiaaka; ng'ura, kelo olmalaika lai te dukuya iyie. Ore ake eyia, ore ina olong nabau nanu naitame ing'ok enye te shumata ninche.”
Neirriwaki Olaitoriani olmeitai iltung'ana, te nkaraki naitobirutua ilo ashe oitobirua Aron.

Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Entudumunye enchom, intae o lelo tung'ana apa liyaua ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, meshomo ina kop apa naa ninye ainosie olmumai pee aisho Abraham o Isaak o Yakobo, ajoki ‘Eishoi inyi aisho ninye.’
Naa kairriwaa nanu olmalaika dukuya intae, naaraa nanu meshomo Ilkanaani, Ilamori o Ilhiti o Lperesi Lhifi o Lyebusi.
Elepa enchom ina kop naruko kule o naishi; kake malo nanu tiatua intae, maidaikie ake intae te nkoitoi, amu irara iltung'ana oogol ilukuny.”
Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana kulo omon torrok, neishir, nemetii oltung'ani oonyaaka aishop imasaa enyena.

Amu etiaaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Irara iltung'ana oogol ilukuny; te nalo nanu te nkata nabo tiatua intae, naidaikie intae. Ore naa taata entayutu imasaa inyi entung'uai ate, pee ayiolou enaitaas intae.’ ”
Neitayu iltung'ana loo Siraeli masaa enye, ebaiki oldoinyo le Horeb neito dukuya.

Naa kesesh apa eya Musa olng'obor nelo aun aitaman ina ang oo lng'oborri, nejo ninye olng'obor le ntumo. Ore pooki ng'ae oing'oru Olaitoriani neipang alo ilo ng'obor le ntumo otii auluo ina ang oo lng'oborri.
Ore ake enkata naipang Musa alo olng'obor, neinyototo iltung'ana pooki aaitashe, neitashe ake oltung'ani te kutuk aji o lng'obor lenye, neduaaya Musa ometaba anaa nejing atua ilo ng'obor.
Naa ore ake pee ejing Musa olng'obor, neirorie Olaitoriani Musa.
Naa ore ake pee edol iltung'ana pooki ina ng'ape e nkatampoi eitashe te nkutuk o lng'obor, neinyototo iltung'ana pooki aaitashe aaserem, oltung'ani ake te kutuk aji o lng'obor lenye.

Neirorie Olaitoriani Musa eing'ura too nkomomi anaa oltung'ani te neirorie olchore lenye. Ore pee eitoki Musa ashuko alo atua ina ang oo lng'oborri, ore osinka lenye Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo barnoti neitu elo aing'uaa ilo ng'obor.

Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura ajo kitiaaka nanu, ‘Toriku kulo tung'ana ilepunye’. Kake eitu kincho nanu matayiolo ajo kaing'ae irriwaa te nebo nanu. Ninyaaka ajo, ‘Kaayiolo nanu iyie enkarna, ninoto sii omom too nkonyek aainei.’

Ore naa taata, aatoomono, tenaa kanoto omom too nkonyek inono, intoduaaki taata nanu inkoitoi inono, pee aatum nanu atayiolo iyie natum omom too nkonyek inono. Tadamu sii ajo ore ele osho naa iltung'ana linono.”
Nejo Olaitoriani, “Kalo nanu te nebo intae, naa kaisho nanu intae enkiyeng'iyeng.”
Nejoki Musa Enkai, “Ti nimilo iyie te nebo iyiook, miya iyiook aituang'uaa ene.

Amu kaji naa eikoni pee eyiolouni aajo anoto omom too nkonyek inono, nanu o ltung'ana linono? Aime ti nilo iyie te nebo iyiook, pee kimbalayu iyiook, nanu o ltung'ana linono too ltung'ana pooki ootii oriong enkop?”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ore nena baa nitejo naa kaas; amu inoto omom too nkonyek aainei, naa kaayiolo nanu iyie enkarna.”
Nejo Musa, “Aatoomono nanu iyie intoduaaki enkitoo ino.”
Nejoki ninye, “Kaisho nanu enkishiaa ai pooki meshomo te dukuya iyie, naibalunye te dukuya iyie enkarna ai, ‘Olaitoriani’; naipirisie nanu ilo laipirisie naing'urrie ilo laing'urrie.”
Nejo ninye, “Kake mindim iyie atoduaa enkomom ai; amu meetae oltung'ani odol enkomom ai neitoki aishu.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Ng'ura, etii ewueji te mbata nanu naa ninye intasheyie te shumata e ndapidapoi;
naa ore ina kata kigiroo enkitoo ai naapik iyie olbaata le ina dapidapoi, naaimulumul nanu iyie te nkaina ai o metaba anaa nalusoo,
naitoki nanu aiwangie enkaina ai, nikidol iyie nanu enkoriong ai, kake medoli enkomom ai.”
