ore too layiok le Yosef o te Efraim, naa Elishama olayioni le Amihud;
Neing'uaa olosho le Manase Gamaliel olayioni le Pedasur;
Neing'uaa olosho le Benchamen Abidan olayioni le Gideon; Neing'uaa olosho le Dan Ahieser olayioni le Amishadai;
Neing'uaa olosho le Asheri, Pagiel olayioni le Oharan;
Neing'uaa olosho le Gad Eliasaf olayioni le Deuel;
Neing'uaa olosho le Naftali Ahira olayioni le Enan.”
Kulo apa lelo ootegeluaki to lturrur, lelo arikok loo loshon lenye, aa ninche ilukuny oo loshon le Israel.
Nerik Musa o Aron kulo tung'ana ootegeluaki;

ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa li are, neiturrur ninche eumata pooki te nebo, neiger ninche ate anaa ilmareita, anaa inkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto oo nkarn ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, ilukuny pooki
anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa. Neaku eikena apa ninye ninche ti ong'ata e Sinai.

Ore iltung'ana le Ruben ilo kikau le Israel, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye te risioroto e siana oo nkarn o lukuny pooki o pooki lee ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, lelo pooki ooidim aashom olarrabal,
ore esiana o losho le Ruben naa inkalifuni artam o ile o iip imiet.

Ore too ltung'ana le Simeon, iishoritin enye, too lmareita, lenye too nkajijik oo loo menye, lelo apa lenye ooikenaki, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ilukuny pooki, pooki lee ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, lelo pooki ooidim aashom enjore:
nera apa esiana o losho le Simeon inkalifuni onom o oudo o iip uni.
Ore too ltung'ana le Gad, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, lelo pooki ooidim aashom olarrabal:
nera esiana o losho le Gad inkalifuni artam o miet o iip ile o onom.
Ore too ltung'ana le Yuda, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep o pooki lee ooidim ashomo olarrabal
nera esiana o losho le Yuda inkalifuni ntomoni naapishana oo ong'uan o iip ile.
Ore too ltung'ana le Isaakar, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep; pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo olarrabal,
nera esiana o losho le Isaakar inkalifuni onom oong'uan o iip ong'uan.
Ore too ltung'ana le Sebulon, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo olarrabal,
nera esiana o losho le Sebulon inkalifuni onom o oopishana o iip ong'uan.

Ore iltung'ana le Yosef aa taa iltung'ana le Efraim, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki lee ake ninye oidim ashomo olarrabal,
nera esiana o losho le Efraim inkalifuni artam o iip imiet.
Ore too ltung'ana le Manase, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki lee ake ninye oidim ashomo olarrabal,
nera esiana o losho le Manase inkalifuni tomoni uni o are o iip are.
Ore too ltung'ana le Benchamen, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki lee oidim ashomo olarrabal,
nera esiana o losho le Benchamen inkalifuni tomoni uni o imiet o iip ong'uan.
Ore too ltung'ana le Dan, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki lee oidim ashomo olarrabal,
nera esiana o losho le Dan inkalifuni ntomoni ile o are o iip naapishana.
Ore too ltung'ana le Asheri, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki lee oidim ashomo olarrabal,
nera esiana o losho le Asheri inkalifuni artam o obo o iip imiet.
Ore too ltung'ana le Naftali, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki lee oidim ashomo olarrabal,
nera esiana o losho le Naftali nkalifuni onom o okuni o iip ong'uan.
Kulo apa lelo laa ninche eikenaki, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron te retoto oo lpayiani le Israel, iltung'ana tomon o are, ore ake oltung'ani netii te rishata e nkaji e papaai lenye.
Neaku ore esiana pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel, too nkajijik oo loo menye, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki ng'ae ooidim ashomo olarrabal te Israel
ore apa esiana enye pooki naa inkalifuni iip ile o okuni o iip imiet o onom.
Kake eitu apa eikenari ile Lawi aaitusuj iloshon loo loomenye te nebo ninche.
Amu etiaaka Olaitoriani Musa,
“Olosho le Lawi ake ninye minken, nimisir ninche aiken te nebo iltung'ana le Israel;

kake tegelu ile Lawi meitasheiki olng'obor le shakenisho neitasheiki nena masaa enyena, neitasheiki nena tokitin pooki eine; nenap ninche ilo ng'obor o ntokitin enyena, neisiai ninye, neitaman ilo ng'obor emanyisho.
Naa ore te nkata naidurrieki ilo ng'obor, naa te nepuoi aaun, naa ile Lawi ooun. Naa tenenyiku likae tung'ani, neari ninye metua.
Nchoo iltung'ana le Israel eun ilng'oborri lenye anaa ilturrurri, oltung'ani ake to lng'obor lenye makewan, oltung'ani ake te rishata enye makewan;
kake ore ile Lawi neitaman ilng'oborri lenye ilo ng'obor le shakenisho, pee metumi ake embae naitagorisho tialo eumata oo ltung'ana le Israel; naa ile Lawi ooitasheiki ilo ng'obor le shakenisho.”
Neijia apa eikuna iltung'ana le Israel; etaasa apa ninche te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,
“Inchoo iltung'ana le Israel emanyisho te mbata e nanka enye, to lmonekie loo nkajijik oo loo menye, nchoo eun ilng'oborri aaipirie ilo ng'obor le ntumo te pooki shoto.

Ore lelo oomanyisho te nkalo o loosaen - te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong naa keaku enanka o lng'obor le Yuda too lturrurri lenye, aa ore olarikoni lo lturrur le Yuda naa Nahashon olayioni le Aminadab;
ore esiana o lorora anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni ntomoni naapishana oong'uan o iip ile.
Ore lelo ooitoki aaun ilng'oborri aatashare ninye naa olosho le Isaakar, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Isaakar naa Natanel olayioni le Suar.
Ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni onom o ong'uan o iip ong'uan.
Nesuju olosho le Sebulon, naa Eliab olayioni le Helon olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Sebulon.
Ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni onom oopishana o iip ong'uan.
Ore esiana nalulung'a e lelo ng'oborri le Yuda, too lturrurri lenye naa inkalifuni iip nabo o ntomoni isiet o ile o iip ong'uan. Ninche oong'as aapuo.
“Ore te nkalo e kopikop naa enanka oo lng'oborri le Ruben too lturrurri lenye, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Ruben naa Elisur olayioni le Shedeur.
Ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni artam o ile o iip imiet.
Ore lelo ooun ilng'oborri aasujaki ninche naa olosho le Simeon, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Simeon naa Shelumiel olayioni le Surishadai.
Ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni onom o oudo o iip uni.
Nesujaki olosho le Gad, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Gad naa Elisaf olayioni le Reuel.
Ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni artam o imiet o iip ile o onom.
Ore esiana pooki oo lng'oborri le Ruben, too lturrurri lenye naa inkalifuni iip o onom o obo o iip ong'uan o onom. Ninche oaku ili aare.
“Neitokini aaitusuj olng'obor le ntumo, nepiki ilo ng'obor loo Lawi empolos oo lng'oborri; ore anaa enamanyisho ninche inchoo eiko neijia, aapik ake olng'obor erishata enye, enanka ake o enanka.
“Ore te nkalo o loo ntoluo naa enanka oo lng'oborri le Efraim, too lturrurri lenye, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Efraim naa Elishama olayioni le Amihud.
Ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni artam o iip imiet.
Ore olosujaki ninche naa olosho le Manase, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Manase naa Gamaliel olayioni le Pedasur,
ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni tomoni uni o aare o iip are.
Neitoki asuju olosho le Benchamen, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Benchamen naa Abidan olayioni le Gideon.
Ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni tomoni uni o imiet o iip ong'uan.
Ore esiana pooki oo lng'oborri le Efraim, too lturrurri lenye naa inkalifuni iip nabo o ntomoni isiet o iip nabo. Ninche oaku ili okuni.
“Ore te nkalo e moikuape naa enkereri oo lng'oborri le Dan too lturrurri lenye, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Dan naa Ahi-eser olayioni le Amishadai.
Ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni ntomoni ile o aare o iip naapishana.
Ore lelo oosujaki ninche too lng'oborri naa olosho le Asheri, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Asheri naa Pagiel olayioni le Okran.
Ore esiana o lorora lenye naa inkalifuni artam o obo o iip imiet.
Neitoki asuju olosho le Naftali, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Naftali naa Ahira olayioni le Enan.
Ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni onom o okuni o iip ong'uan.
Ore esiana pooki oo lng'oborri le Dan naa inkalifuni iip nabo o onom o opishana o iip ile. Ninche oobayie anaa too nankan.”
Kulo ninche iltung'ana le Israel anaa enaikenaki too nkajijik oo loo menye; ore lelo pooki apa ootii ilng'oborri ooikenaki too lturrurri lenye naa inkalifuni iip ile o okuni o iip imiet o onom.
Kake eitu apa eikeni ile Lawi te nebo iltung'ana le Israel, anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

Neijia apa eikuna iltung'ana le Israel. Ore te risioroto e ina pooki naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, neiko ninche neijia aaun ilng'oborri too nkererin, oltung'ani ake to lmarei lenye te risioroto e nkaji e papaai lenye.
Kuna ninche iishoritin e Aron o Musa teina kata pee eirorie Olaitoriani Musa to ldoinyo le Sinai.
Kuna ninche inkarn oo layiok le Aron: Nadab olkikau, o Abihu o Eleasar o Itamar;
kuna ninche inkarn oo layiok le Aron, lelo apolosak ootubukokoki eilata aaput, laa ninche etegelua pee eisiaaisho anaa ilapolosak.

Kake ore Nadab o Abihu netuata te dukuya Olaitoriani ina kata apa pee eishoru olasar le nkima lemesinya te dukuya Olaitoriani ti ong'ata e Sinai; nemeeta apa ninche inkera. Neaku Eliesa o Itamar apa ooisiaishote anaa lapolosak te nkata e nkishui e Aron papaai lenye.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Toriku olosho le Lawi intinyiku, nipik ninche dukuya Aron ilo apolosani, pee etum ninche aaisiaayia ninye.
Inchoo ninche eitabaya enkisiaayiare te ninye o to lturrur pooki te dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo, anaa enaisiaisho ninche tiatua olng'obor le Nkai.
Inchoo ninche eitaisheiki imasaa pooki e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nejing enkisiaayiare te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel anaa te neisiaaisho ninche to lng'obor.
Ninchooyo iyie ile Lawi aisho Aron o layiok lenyena; eishooki ninche ninye tukul tiatua iltung'ana le Israel.
Nigelu iyie Aron o layiok lenyena, nejing ninche esiaai enye e mpolosare; kake te nelotu likae tung'ani anyiku neari metua.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“kaitayu nanu ile Lawi aitung'uaa atua iltung'ana le Israel te rishata e pooki kikau too ltung'ana le Israel. Keaku ore ile Lawi naa ilaainei,

amu ore ilkikaunot pooki naa ilaainei; ore apa ina olong nataara nanu metuata ilkikaunot pooki te nkop e Misiri, aitisinyaka nanu kewan ilkikaunot pooki tiatua Israel aa olayioni le tung'ani o le eng'ues; keaku ninche ilaainei: Kara nanu Olaitoriani.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa ti ong'ata e Sinai,
“Inkena ilayiok le Lawi, anaa too nkajijik oo loo menye o too lmareita; ore pooki lee lo lapa obo neilep inkenai.”
Neaku eikena apa Musa ninche te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, anaa enaitanapaki.
Naa kulo apa ilayiok le Lawi anaa too nkarn enye: Gershon o Kohat o Merari.
Naa kuna ninche inkarn oo layiok le Gershon too lmareita lenye: Libni o Shimei.
Ore ilayiok le Kohat anaa too lmareita lenye naa: Amram o Ishar o Hebron o Usiel.
Ore ilayiok le Merari anaa too lmareita lenye naa; Mahili o Mushi. Kulo ninche ilmareita loo lawi anaa too nkajijik oo loo menye.
Ore apa ile Gershon naa olmarei le Libni o lmarei le Shimei; kulo apa ilmareita loo le Gershon.
Ore esiana enye te risioroto e nkikena oo lewa pooki ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa inkalifuni naapishana o iip imiet.
Ore ilmareita loo le Gershon neun ilng'oborri ti oriong olng'obor le Nkai te nchoto o loo ntoluo,
te nebo Eliasaaf, olayioni le Lael aa ninye endukuya e nkaji oo loo menye too le Gershon.

Ore apa enkitanapata oo layiok le Gershon te ilo ng'obor le ntumo, naa pee eing'or ilo ng'obor le Nkai, olng'obor kewan o enkimulumulata enye o enkikenet e kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo o neeikishoreki to lgoriet,
o enkikenet o lgoriet, ilo omanita olng'obor le Nkai o lperere lo lasar o nkeenta enyena o enkisiaayiare pooki naipirta kuna.
Ore too le Kohat naa olmarei loo le Amram, olmarei loo le Ishart o lmarei loo le Hebron o lmarei loo le Usiel; kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Kohat.
Ore esiana oo lewa pooki ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa inkalifuni isiet o iip ile, lelo ooisiaaisho te wueji sinyati.
Ore ilmareita loo layiok le Kohat neun ilng'oborri lenye te nchoto e kopikop o lng'obor le Nkai,
te nebo Elisafan olayioni le Usiel, aa ninye endukuya te nkaji oo loo menye too lmareita loo le Kohat.

Ore enaitanapaki ninche naa pee eing'or osanduku, o emisa o iketa oo iltaai o lpereren loo lasarri nena masaa e wueji sinyati naa ninche eisiaaishore ilapolosak o lkarasha lo lodung'oro o enkisiaayiare pooki naipirta kuna baa.
Ore Eliesa olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani neaku ninye olkitok loo larikok loo Lawi neitasheiki lelo aitasheikinok le wueji sinyati.
Ore too ile Merari naa olmarei loo le Mahili o lmarei loo le Mushi: kulo ninche ilmareita le Merari.
Ore esiana enye te risioroto e nkikena oo lewa ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa inkalifuni ile o iip are.
Ore endukuya e nkaji oo loo menye lo lmarei le Merari naa Suriel olayioni le Abihail; neun ninche ilng'oborri lenye te nchoto e moikuape o lng'obor le Nkai.
Ore esiaai nategeluaki aaitanap ilayiok le Merari naa irubat oo sunta e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, inkeek o ng'apeta o ntoneta oo ng'apeta o ntokitin naaidikidikore enkisiaayiare pooki naipirta kuna baa;
te nebo sii nena ng'apeta o lgoriet naamanaa o ntoneta enye o ncheito enye o nkeenta.

Ore ilooun olng'obor lenye te dukuya olng'obor le Nkai te nchoto o loosaen, te dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo te nchoto e nkilepunoto e nkolong naa Musa o Aron o layiok lenyena, eitaisheiki mbaa pooki e seremare teine wueji sinyati o pooki naasi, te nkaraki iltung'ana loo Siraeli; naa ore ake oltung'ani onyiku neari metua.
Ore lelo pooki apa ooikenaki too le Lawi, laa ninche apa eikena Musa o Aron te nkitanapata o Laitoriani, anaa too lmareita, ore ilewa pooki ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa inkalifuni tikitam o are.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Inkena ilewa kikaunot pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel, ebaiki olapa obo neilep, niya esiana enye anaa too nkarn.
Nincho ile Lawi metaa ilaainei - Kara nanu Olaitoriani, te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel, inkishu oo le Lawi te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki loo nkishu oo ltung'ana le Israel.”
Neaku eikena apa Musa ilkikaunot pooki tiatua iltung'ana le Israel, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.
Neiken ilkikaunot pooki lewa, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ore ebaiki olapa obo neilep anaa enaikenaki naa inkalifuni tikitam oaare o iip are o ntomoni naapishana o okuni.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Iwa ile Lawi te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki tiatua iltung'ana le Israel o nkishu oo le Lawi te rishata oo nkishu enye; neaku Ilawi ilaainei: Kara nanu Olaitoriani.
Ore te nkordunoto e lelo kikaunot iip are o ntomoni naapishana o kuni le lelo kikaunot loo ltung'ana le Israel, ootulusoitie aagiroo esiana oo le Lawi,
iwa shekeli imiet ake te pooki tung'ani, neitorisiokini shekeli e wueji sinyati; ore ina shekeli gera tikitam na ilo aya ninche
nincho nena pisai e lelo ootuluso esiana enye, oolootalakuaki, nincho Aron o layiok lenyena.”
Neaku ewa apa Musa nena pisai oo ltung'ana ootuluso, ootalakutua ile Lawi ootalakuaki.
Ore too lkikaunot loo ltung'ana le Israel neya iropiyiani, shekeli enkalifu nabo o iip uni o ntomoni ile o imiet, naaitorisiokoki shekeli e wueji sinyati;
neisho Musa nena pisai e lakunoto Aron o layiok lenyena te risioroto ororei lo Laitoriani, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,
“Inkena esiana oo layiok le Kohat, tirishu tiatua ilayiok le Lawi, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,
ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, lelo pooki ooidim aatijing enkisiaayiare, pee easisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.
Ena ninye enkisiaayiare oo layiok le Kohat tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo: nena tokitin naasinya oleng.
Te nedotuni ilng'oborri, nejing Aron o layiok lenyena atua olng'obor aaitayu olkarasha lo lodung'oro, neimulumul ilo sanduku le shakenisho te ninye;
neitoki aapik shumata ninye enkimulumulet e ndapana e nkine, neisalaashaki shumata ina kila pus alak, neitokini aapik nkeek enyena.

Ore enchumata e ina misa o emukate naishori Enkai neisalaashaki ninche enkila pus, neiteleiki shumata ninye isaanini o masaa e nkorropil o embakuli o nkikompeni te nkaraki ilo asar ooki; ore sii nena mukateni e anaake netii shumata ina misa;
neitoki aaisalaashaki shumata ninche enkarasha sintet, neitoki aaimulumulaki shumata endapana e nkine, nepik nkeek enyena.
Neitoki ninche aaya enkarasha pus, neimulumul ina kitashet o ltaa te nkaraki ewang'an, te nebo iltaai lenyena o ltoneta loo ltaai o mbakulini enye o masaa pooki e ilata naapikieki.
Nepik ninche te nebo imasaa enyena pooki neimulumuli te ndapana e nkine nepiki ninye shumata nkeek enyena naanapieki.
Ore shumata ilo perere lo lasar oitobiruno te saabu neisalaashaki enkarasha pus, neimulumul shumata ninye te ndapana e nkine, neitokini aapik nkeek enyena.

Neitoki ninche aaya nena masaa pooki e nkisiayiare naasishoreki tiatua ine wueji sinyati; nepik ninche atua enkila pus, neitoki aaimulumul ninche te ndapana e nkine, neiteleiki ninche nkeek enyena naanapieki.
Neitoki ninche aaitayu inkuruon to lperere lo lasar, neisalaashaki ninche enkarasha sintet;

neiteleiki shumata ninye nena masaa pooki o lperere lo lasar, naa ninche easishoreki te nkisiaayiare teine o motioo e nkima o njipeta o lkurteta, o mbakulini, nena masaa pooki o lperere lo lasar; neisalaashaki shumata ninche nena endapana e nkine, neisuroki nkeek enyena.

Naa ore ake pee eidip Aron o layiok lenyena aaimulumula ine wueji sinyati o nena masaa pooki e wueji sinyati, ina kata edumuni ilng'oborri, neitoki ilayiok le Kohat aapuonu aanap kuna, kake meibung ninche nena tokitin sinyat, pee meye ake. Kuna ninche intokitin e ilo ng'obor le ntumo naa ninche enap ilayiok le Kohat.

“Ore Eliesa olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani neitasheiki eilata oo ltaai o enkorropil, ilo asar le ntapa li anaake o ina ilata naputishoreki o enkitasheikinoto pooki eilo ng'obor le Nkai o nena pooki naatii atua o ine wueji sinyati o masaa enyena.
“Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,
Mincho olosho loo lmareita le Kohat eimisieki aaiwuang'ie too le Lawi;

kake entaasa ninche ena pee etum ninche aatopok nemeye te nepuonu aanyikaki nena tokitin naasinya aaisul: inchoo elo Aron o layiok lenyena atua olng'obor negelaki ake oltung'ani esiaai enye o lola lenye,
kake mejing ninche atua aapuo aaing'or nena tokitin naasinya hoo te nkata ninye nabo, pee meye ake.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Inkena sii esiana oo layiok le Gershon, too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye;
ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, inkena ninche, lelo pooki ooidim aatijing enkisiaayiare, pee easisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.
Ena ninye enkisiaayiare oo lmareita loo le Gershon, te nkisiaayare o te napata oo lolan:
kenap ninche ilkarash lo lng'obor le Nkai, o lng'obor le ntumo te nebo enkimulumulet enye o enkimulumulet e ndapana e nkine natii shumata ninye o enkikenet e kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo

o nkisiong'at o lgoriet o enkikenet e ine nejing'ieki olgos lo lgoriet omanita ine wueji sinyati o lperere lo lasar o nkeenta enyena o masaa pooki e nkisiaayiare; naa keas ninche nena pooki naaishiaakinore ninche neas.
Ore esiaai pooki oo layiok loo le Gershon naa Aron o layiok lenyena ooitasheiki teina pooki napuo ninche aanap.
Ena ninye enkisiaayiare oo lmareita loo layiok le Gershon tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ore esiaai enye naa keaku abori enkitasheikinoto e Ltamar olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani.
“Ore tialo ilayiok le Merari nkena ninche anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye;
ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni neilep o metabaiki ilarin onom. Inkena pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidim enkisiaayiare, pee eas esiaai tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.
Naa ena apa eitanapaki ninche metaasa, anaa esiaai enye pooki tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo; nena rubat oo sunta o lng'obor le Nkai, te nebo inkeek enyena, ing'apeta o ntoneta
o ng'apeta e ilo goriet omanita te nebo intoneta o ncheito o nkeenta te nebo imasaa enyena pooki o ntelon enyena pooki. Nioriki aipotoki nena masaa naaishiaakino ninche nenap.
Ena ninye enkisiaayiare oo lmareita loo layiok le Merari, ninye enkisiaayiare enye nalulung'a tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo ti abori enkitasheikinoto e Ltamar olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani.”
Neitoki Musa o Aron o larikok lo lturrur aaiken ilayiok le Kohat, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,
ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni, pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidima enkisiaayiare, pee eas esiaai tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.
Ore esiana enye anaa too lmareita lenye naa inkalifuni are o iip naapishana o onom.
Ena apa ninye esiana oo lmareita loo le Kohat, lelo pooki ooisiaaisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron te risioroto e nkitanapata naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.
Ore esiana oo layiok le Gershon, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,
ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, pooki ng'ae oidim atijing'a enkisiaayiare aisiaaisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.
Ore esiana enye anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye naa inkalifuni are o iip ile o tomoni uni.
Ena ninye esiana oo lmareita loo layiok le Gershon, lelo pooki apa ooisiaaisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani.
Ore esiana oo lmareita loo layiok le Merari, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,
ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidim atijing'a enkisiaayiare, pee eas esiaai tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo,
ore esiana enye anaa too lmareita naa inkalifuni uni o iip are.
Kulo ninche lelo apa ooikenaki too lmareita loo layiok le Merari, ooikena Musa o Aron te risioroto e nkitanapata naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.
Ore lelo pooki ooikenaki too le Lawi, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron o Larikok le Israel, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,
ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni neilep ometabaiki ilarin onom, pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidim atijing'a enkisiaayiare neasisho anap ilolan tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo,
ore lelo lenye ooikenaki naa nkalifuni isiet o iip imiet o ntomoni isiet.

Ore te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani naimua Musa negeluni ninche, oltung'ani ake te siaai enye e nkisiaayiare aashu te napare; kaae neiken ninye ninche aiko neijia, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Intanapa iltung'ana le Israel pee eipang'ie tiatua ilng'oborri pooki ng'ae ake ninye oata enkeeya oolbolot o pooki ng'ae oata olbae loo nkimek o pooki ng'ae lemesinya oiseyie oltung'ani otua;
impang'ie pokira, olee o eng'oruoi. Tipika ninche auluo ilng'oborri, pee meisarkionie ilng'oborri lenye, laa empolos enye ninye emanyisho ai.”
Neas ina iltung'ana le Israel, neipang'ie ninche too lng'oborri meshomo auluo; ore anaa enatiaaka Olaitoriani Musa, ina etaasa iltung'ana le Israel.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel Te neas olee aashu enkitok pooki ng'oki ake ninye naas iltung'ana aagil enkirukoto to Laitoriani, neaku ilo tung'ani olarruoni,
nelimu ninye aibalunye ina ng'oki nataasa, neitobir ninye elaata nalulung'a teina kitarruoroto enye, aponaa erubata e imiet teina, neisho ilo laa ninye einyala.

Kake te nemeeta oltung'ani iltung'ana lenye ooidimi aatalaaki teina kitarruoroto, ore ina laakinoto neaku eno Laitoriani te nkaraki olapolosani neponikini ilo ker lo lning'o lo sotua laa ninye eitobirakinyeki ninye olning'o lo sotua.
Ore inkishoorot pooki o ntokitin pooki naasinya oo ltung'ana le Israel, nena naayaki ninche ilo apolosani neaku inenyena;
o ntokitin naasinya e pooki tung'ani ake ninye neaku inolapolosani; ore pooki toki naba anaa enaisho oltung'ani olapolosani neaku enenye.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, te nelo nepong'ori enkitok e likae moruo ake ninye, neas emamalisho tialo ninye,
te nelo neboitare olee ninye, neisudori ina bae too nkonyek o lmoruo lenye, neaku mejurrunoyu hoo neinosie kewan olduruk, nemeetae olchakeni oishakenoki ninye, amu eitu eibung'akini ina bae;

naa te nelotu oltau lo lom shumata ilo lmoruo, netum olom tialo ina kitok enye natipika kewan olduruk; aashu te nelotu oltau lo lom shumata ninye, netum ninye olom tialo ina kitok enye hoo neitu ninye einosie ina kitok kewan olduruk.

Inchoo naa eriku ilo lee ina kitok enye enetii olapolosani, neyau enkishooroto naipirta ina kitok, erubata e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui; nemebukoki ninye eilata shumata ina tapa nemepik enkorropil, amu olasar le ntapa lo lom ilo. Olasar le ntapa le ndamunoto, odamunyeki entorroni.
“Neyau olapolosani ina kitok aitinyiku, nepik ninye dukuya Olaitoriani,
neitoki olapolosani ayau enkare nasinya te moti oo nkulupuok, neya enkiti terit to ltiren le ina aji e Nkai nepik atua ina are.

Nepik ilo apolosani ina kitok dukuya Olaitoriani, nelak ilpapit le ndukuya enye, nepik inkaik enyena ina tapa o lasar le ndamunoto, aa ninye o lasar le ntapa lo lom. Ore te nkaina enye neibung olapolosani ina are e nduaran naa ninye nayau oldeket.

Neinosie taa olapolosani ina kitok olmumai, ejo, ‘Te nemeetae olee litaboitare, naa te neitu iyie imbelekenya aibelekenyakino olduruk, eton itii abori enkitoria o lmoruo lino, talakunoyu iyie tena are nadua nayau oldeket.
Kake ti nitapong'ori iyie hoo nitii abori enkitoria o lmoruo lino, naa ti ninosie kewan olduruk neaku kitaboitare likae lee leme lmoruo lino,’

(inchoo naa olapolosani einosie ina kitok olmumai lo ldeket, nejoki ina kitok), ‘Kintaa iyie o Laitoriani oldeket o lmumai tiatua iltung'ana linono, ti nikincho Olaitoriani meibibiari enkupes ino neiteijia osesen lino;
metaa ore ena are nayau enduaran, inchoo elo atua enkoshoke ino, neiteijia osesen lino neibibiaa enkupes ino.’ Nejo ina kitok, ‘Eesai, Eesai.’
“Neitoki olapolosani aiger kulo deketa tiatua embuku, nejut ninche teina are e nduaran,
neitook ninye ina kitok ina are e nduaran nayau oldeket, ore ina are nayau oldeket nelo atua ninye nepik ninye emion kitok.
Neitoki olapolosani aya ilo asar le ntapa otii enkaina e ina kitok, neyuk ilo asar le ntapa te dukuya Olaitoriani neitoki ayau enchumata o lperere lo lasar.
Neitoki olapolosani aya emborei e nkaina e ilo asar le ntapa anaa erubata enye nadamuni, nepej ninye te nchumata o lperere lo lasar; ore te siadi neitoki aitook ina kitok enkare.

Ore ake pee eidip aitooko ina kitok enkare, te nelo ninye neaku einosie kewan olduruk neas emamalisho tialo olmoruo lenye, ore ina are nayau oldeket nejing atua ninye nepik emion kitok, nejeyu osesen lenye neibibiari enkupes enye, neaku ina kitok oldeket tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.
Kake te neitu einosie ina kitok kewan olduruk metaa meeta ninye entioto, nelakunoyu ninye naa keiu inkera.
“Ena ninye enkitanapata too mbaa naatii olom, te nelo enkitok natii abori enkitoria o lmoruo lenye aimalimal neinosie kewan olduruk.
Aashu te nelotu oltau lo lom shumata oltung'ani netum ninye olom tialo enkitok enye; nepik ninye ina kitok dukuya Olaitoriani, nedung'oki olapolosani enkiguana tena kitanapata pooki.
Inchoo olee eton meeta entioto kake ore enkitok keitalaki entorroni enye.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, te nelo nenya oltung'ani olmumai, olee aashu enkitok, te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee eaku sinyati to Laitoriani, neiteng'elaki kewan o Laitoriani,
inchoo eiteng'el kewan te naisho oo sabibu o te naisho napi, meok ninye ae toki naironyuaki too sabibu aashu enaisho napi; nemenya isabibu ooshal aashu ilootoito.
Ore te nena olong'i pooki e nkiteng'elata enye nemenya ninye ae toki naitobiruaki too sabibu o metabaiki ninye ilanterera lenyena aashu inkabobok enyena.

“Ore inkolong'i pooki e ilo mumai lenye le nkiteng'elata meiseyie olmurunya endukuya enye; o metaba anaa neishunye ina kata apa naiteng'elaka ninye kewan Olaitoriani. Keaku ninye sinyati; keisho ninye iyenat oo lpapit lenyena metoodorito.
“Ore te nena olong'i pooki naaiteng'elaki ninye kewan Olaitoriani nemenyikaki olmeneng'ani.

Aa olayioni le menye aashu olayioni le ng'otonye, aashu olo lalashe aashu enkanashe, te neye ninche. Kepik ninye kewan eleyiata; te nkaraki natii enkiteng'elata naiteng'elaka kewan Enkai shumata endukuya enye.
Ore too nkolong'i pooki naaiteng'elaka ninye kewan Olaitoriani naa kesinya ninye to Laitoriani.

“Naa te neye oltung'ani nabo kata etashare ninye, nepik eleyiata ina dukuya enye naiteng'elakaki Olaitoriani, nelo ninye abarn endukuya enye te nkolong e nkitukuo; te nkolong e naapishana elo ninye abarn.
Ore te nkolong e isiet, neyau ninye nturkuluoni are aashu imotonyi are kutiti ayaki olapolosani te kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo,

nepolos olapolosani nabo te nkaraki olasar loo ng'ok, nepolos enkae te nkaraki olasar opejori, neitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye, te nkaraki nataasa ninye eng'oki aiseyie ilo meneng'ani. Neitisiny ninye endukuya enye ina olong ake,

neiteng'elaki kewan Olaitoriani too nkolong'i enyena e nkiteng'elata, neyau olkuoo le ker sitima lo lari obo te nkaraki olasar le nkitarruoroto; kake ore enaduoo kata e dukuya neaku pesho, amu ore enkiteng'elata enye neidurukieki.
“Naa ena enkitanapata e ilo lo lmumai, te nelulung'ayu enkata enye e nkiteng'elata: neyauni ninye kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

Neitarasaki ninye enkishooroto enye Olaitoriani, olkuoo obo le ker sitima lemeeta entioto te nkaraki olasar opejori o esupen nabo e ker o lari obo nemeeta entioto naaku olasar loo ng'ok, o lmeregesh obo lemeeta entioto oaku olasar le seriani
o lbene loo mukateni neitu eisuishieki o mukateni e ntapa napuyiapui naaipurjaki te ilata o mukateni naapejo naaelieki eilata o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki.
Neitarasaa olapolosani ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani, neitayu olasar lenye le ng'oki o lasar lenye opejori.
Neitayu ninye olmeregesh metaa olasar le seriani to Laitoriani, tenebo o lbene loo mukateni neitu eisuishieki, neyau sii olapolosani olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki.
Ore ilo lo lmumai nebarn ina dukuya enye naitisinyaki te kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neya ninye lelo papit le ndukuya enye naitisinyaki nelo apik enkima ti abori ilo asar le seriani.

Neitayu olapolosani orony le ilo meregesh eidipaki aaitokitokie, neitayu emukate nabo neitu eisuishieki tiatua o lbene o emukate nabo napejo neitu eisuishieki nepik ninche aiteleiki inkaik e ilo lo lmumai. Ore ake pee eidip ninye atabarna ilpapit le nkitisinyata enye,

neyuk olapolosani ninche metaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani, neaku kuna daiki erubata nasinya to lapolosani te nebo oloikulu oyuki o ina muro naishoruaki; ore te siadi ina neidim ilo lo lmumai atooko enaisho oo sabibu.

“Ena ninye enkitanapata eilo onya olmumai. Ore olasar lenye oishori Olaitoriani neitorisiokini olmumai lenye anaa olonya olmumai te nebo pooki toki ake ninye naba anaa enaata ninye te risioroto e ilo mumai onya ninye, neiko ninye neijia te risioroto e nkitanapata e nkiteng'elata enye olmumai eitisinyaki kewan Olaitoriani.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaaki Aron o layiok lenyena,
Inji enkuna ti nimayianana iltung'ana le Israel entejo,
Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani nikigolie:
Mikintawang'aki Olaitoriani enkomom enye, niking'urrie:
Miking'urrie Olaitoriani, nikincho eseriani.
“Naa inchoo ninche metipika enkarna ai shumata lelo tung'ana le Israel pee amayian nanu ninche.”
Ore apa teina olong pee eidip Musa atuuno olng'obor le Nkai, nebukoki eilata neitisiny ninye te nebo imasaa enyena, nebukoki eilata neitisiny olperere lo lasar, te nebo imasaa pooki.
Ore ilarikok le Israel, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye ilarikok loo loshon otii shumata lelo apa ooikenaki,

neyau inkishoorot enye dukuya Olaitoriani, ingarrin ile naaimulumula o lmong'i tomon o aare, ore ake engarri netii ilarikok oaare, ore ake olarikoni neeta olkiteng, nepolos ninche te dukuya ilo ng'obor le Nkai.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Tang'amai kuna kishoorot naaing'uaa ninche pee etumi aataasishore ninche te nkisiaayiare e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nincho ninche lelo le Lawi, oltung'ani ake te risioroto e nkisiayiare enye.”
Neaku etang'amayie apa Musa nena garrin o lelo mong'i neisho ninye ile Lawi.
Ore ingarrin are o lmong'i oong'uan neisho ilayiok le Gershon te risioroto e nkisiaayiare enye.
Ore ingarrin ong'uan o lmong'i isiet neisho ilayiok le Merari, te risioroto e nkisiayiare enye erikoo Ltamar olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani.
Kake ore too layiok le Kohat neitu eishori ninche toki, te nkaraki naitanapaki apa ninche meing'ura nena tokitin naasinya naanapi too iloilila.
Ore ilarikok neishooyo ilasarri te nkaraki enkitisinyata o lperere lo lasar teina olong apa natubukokoki eilata aaitisiny, neishooyo lelo arikok ilasarri lenye te dukuya olperere lo lasar.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Keishori ninche ilasarri lenye, olarikoni ake te nkolong enye, te nkaraki enkitisinyata o lperere lo lasar.”
Ore apa ilo otang'asa aitayu olasar lenye te nkolong e dukuya naa Nashon olayioni le Aminadab, lo losho le Yuda;

ore olasar lenye naa esaani e nkosholai naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni enkiroishi enye o embakuli nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, ebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata aaitaa olasar le ntapa;
o enkijiko nabo e saabu e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil
o loing'oni obo oti o lmeregesh obo o lkuo obo le ker sitima lo lari obo te nkaraki olasar opejori;
o lkine obo oaku olasar loo ng'ok.
Naa ore to lasar loo nkishoorot le seriani, naa ilmong'i oaare o lmeregeshi imiet o lkineji imiet o lkerra imiet lo lari obo. Ele apa olasar le Nashon olayioni le Aminadab.
Ore te nkolong e are neitayu Natanel olayioni le Suar, ilo arikoni le Isaakar olasar;

neitayu ninye to lasar lenye esaani nabo e nkosholai naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip o tomoni uni o embakuli nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa.
O enkijiko nabo e saabu e shekeli nabore enkorropil;
o loing'oni obo oti o lmeregesh obo o lker obo lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori;
o lkine obo oaku olasar loo ng'ok.
Ore to lasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oaare o lmeregeshi imiet o lkineji imiet o sitiman le kerra imiet lo lari obo. Ele ninye olasar le Natanel olayioni le Suar.
Ore te nkolong e uni naa Eliabu olayioni le Helon, ilo arikoni loo ltung'ana le Sebulon oyaua olasar lenye:

ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni, o embakuli nabo e nkosholai e shekeli intomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai nebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata metaa olasar le ntapa;
o enkijiko nabo e saabu e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil;
o loing'oni obo oti o lmeregesh obo o sitima le ker lo lari obo, oaku olasar opejori
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki,
naa ore to lasar le seriani naa ilmong'i o aare o lmeregeshi imiet, isitiman imiet le kineji o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Eliab olayioni le Helon.
Ore te nkolong e ong'uan naa Elisuri olayioni le Shedeur, olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Ruben.

Ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni o embakuli nabo e nkosholai e shekeli intomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;
o enkijiko e saabu naata enkiroishi e shekeli tomon, nabore nkorropil;
o loti oing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo o sitima le ker lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori;
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki;
ore to lasar le seriani, naa ilmong'i oaare o lmeregeshi imiet o sitiman imiet le kineji o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele ninye olasar le Elisuri olayioni le Shedeur.
Ore te nkolong e imiet naa Shelumiel olayioni le Surishadai, olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Simeon oyaua olasar lenye:

ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni, o embakuli nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;
o embakuli nabo e saabu naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli tomon, nabore enkorropil,
o loti oing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo te nkaraki olasar opejori;
o sitima obo le kine te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki;
ore to lasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oaare o lmeregeshi imiet o sitiman le kineji imiet o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Shelumiel olayioni le Surishadai.
Ore te nkolong e ile naa Eliasaf olayioni le Deuel olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Gad:

ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni, o embakuli nabo e nkosholai e shekeli intomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;
o embakuli nabo e saabu naata enkiroishi e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil;
o loti oing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori;
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki;
ore olasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oaare o lmeregeshi imiet o sitiman imiet le kineji o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Eliasaf olayioni le Deuel.
Ore te nkolong e naapishana naa Elishama olayioni le Amihud ninye olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Efraim:

ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni o embakuli nabo e nkosholai naata enkiroishi e shekeli intomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;
o embakuli nabo e saabu e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil;
o loti oing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori;
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki;
ore olasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oaare, o lmeregeshi imiet o sitiman imiet le kineji o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Elishama olayioni le Amihud.
Ore te nkolong e isiet naa Gamaliel olayioni le Pedasur, ninye olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Manase:

ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni o embakuli nabo naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli intomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;
o enkijiko nabo e saabu naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli tomon, nabore enkorropil;
o loti oing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo, oaku olasar opejori;
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki;
ore olasar le seriani naa, ilmong'i oaare o lmeregeshi imiet o sitiman imiet le kineji o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Gamaliel olayioni le Pedasur.
Ore te nkolong e naaudo naa Abidan olayioni le Gideon olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Benchamen oyaua olasar lenye:

ore olasar lenye naa esaani e nkosholai naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli intomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;
o enkijiko nabo e saabu naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil;
o loti oing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo, oaku olasar opejori;
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki;
ore olasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oaare o lmeregeshi imiet o sitiman imiet le kineji o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Abidan olayioni le Gideon.
Ore te nkolong e tomon naa Ahieser olayioni le Amishadai ninye olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Dan:

ore olasar lenye, naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip o tomoni uni o embakuli e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;
o embakuli nabo e saabu naa ore enkiroishi enye naa e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil,
o loti oing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo, oaku olasar opejori,
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar loo ng'ok,
ore olasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oaare, o lmeregeshi imiet, o sitiman imiet lkineji sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Ahieser olayioni le Amishadai.
Ore te nkolong e tomon oobo naa Pagiel olayioni le Okran, ninye olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Asheri oyaua olasar lenye:

ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli intomoni naapishana te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;
o enkijiko nabo e saabu e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil;
o loti oing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo, oaku olasar opejori;
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki;
ore olasar le seriani naa ilmong'i o aare o lmeregeshi imiet o sitiman imiet le kineji o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Pagiel olayioni le Okran.
Ore te nkolong e tomon o are naa Ahira olayioni le Enan, ninye olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Naftali:

ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip o tomoni uni o embakuli nabo e nkosholai naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli intomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa;
o enkijiko nabo e saabu e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil;
o loti oing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo o sitima obo le ker lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar loo ng'ok;
ore olasar le seriani naa, ilmong'i, o aare o lmeregeshi imiet o sitiman imiet le kineji o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Ahira olayioni le Enan.

Ele apa olasar le nkitisinyata te nkaraki olperere lo lasar, teina olong apa natubukokoki eilata aaitisiny, oing'uaa ilarikok le Israel: isaanini tomon o aare e nkosholai o mbakulini tomon o are e nkosholai o nkijikoni tomon o are e saabu,

ore ake esaani e nkosholai nabo te ninche naa ore enkiroishi enye naashekeli intomoni naapishana, ore enkosholai pooki e kuna masaa naa shekeli inkalifuni are o iip ong'uan te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai,

ore nena kijikoni tomon o aare e saabu naabore enkorropil, eeta ake nabo enkiroishi e shekeli tomon, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, ore saabu pooki e nena kijikoni naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip o tikitam.

Ore inkishu pooki o lasar opejori naa iloing'ok tomon o are o lmeregeshi tomon oaare o sitiman tomon o are le kerra lo lari obo te nebo olasar lenye le ntapa; o sitiman tomon o aare le kineji lo lasar le ng'oki.

Ore inkishu pooki o lasar le seriani naa iloing'ok tikitam oo ng'uan o lmeregeshi intomoni ile o sitiman le kineji intomoni ile, ore isitiman le kerra lo lari obo naa intomoni ile. Ele apa ninye olasar le nkitisinyata lo lperere lo lasar eidipaki aatubukoki eilata aaitisinya.

Ore apa pee elo Musa atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo airorie Olaitoriani, nening ninye oltoilo eirorie ninye eing'uaa shumata ilo orika lo lng'ur apa otii shumata osanduku le shakenisho, eimu erishata e lelo kerubi pokira o aare; neirorie ninye.
Neitoki apa Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Tiaaki Aron, ti nindip atipika iltaai inkitasheta, ore lelo taai oopishana neitawang dukuya ina kitashet oo ltaai.”
Neiko neijia Aron; nepik ninye iltaai lenyena meitawang'a dukuya ina kitashet oo ltaai, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

Naa ena apa enkitobirunoto e ilo iket lo ltaa, naa saabu naidong'oki ebaiki entonata enye o metabaiki ntapuka enyena esiaai e nkidong'ore, te risioroto e ilo rrekie otuutaka Olaitoriani Musa. Neaku eitobirua ninye ilo iket.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Toriko ile Lawi intung'uai iltung'ana le Israel, nintisiny ninche.
Naa neijia inkuna ninche, intukuo ninche, isuaaki ninche enkare e nkitisinyata, nebarn ninche iseseni lenye, neituku inkilani enye, neitisiny ate.
Inchoo ninche eya oloti oing'oni o lasar lenye le ntapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata, nintoki aya likae oti oing'oni oaku olasar le ng'oki.
Niyau iyie lelo le Lawi meetu dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ninturrur ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel.
Ore ake pee iyau lelo le Lawi dukuya Olaitoriani, ore iltung'ana le Israel, neiteleiki inkaik enye lelo le Lawi.
Neishooyo Aron ile Lawi te dukuya Olaitoriani pee eaku olasar oyuki oing'uaa iltung'ana le Israel pee eaku enenye enkisiaayiare o Laitoriani.

Neitoki lelo Lawi aaiteleiki inkaik enye ilukuny e lelo oing'ok; nipolos iyie obo pee eaku olasar le ng'oki ore olikae neaku olasar opejori oishori Olaitoriani, pee eitobir osotua lo lning'o lo Laitoriani too le Lawi.
Inchoo iyie ile Lawi meetu abori Aron o layiok lenyena, pee eishooyo ninche anaa olasar oyuki to Laitoriani.
“Neijia inkuna nteng'ela ile Lawi ntung'uai atua iltung'ana le Israel, neaku ile Lawi ilaainei.
Ore te siadi ine nepuo ile Lawi atua aaisiaaisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, te nindip iyie aitukuo ninche ninchooyo ninche anaa olasar oyuki.
Amu aaishooki nanu ninche tukul iltung'ana le Israel; te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki le Israel, ore ilkikaunot pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel aawa nanu makewan ninche.
Amu ore ilkikaunot pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel naa ilaainei o lo ltung'ani o le ng'ues; ore apa teina olong nataara nanu metuata ilkikaunot pooki te nkop e Misiri aitisinyaka nanu ninche kewan,
naawa nanu ile Lawi te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki tiatua iltung'ana le Israel.

Naishooyie nanu ile Lawi anaa enkishooroto aisho Aron o layiok lenyena, aitung'uaa iltung'ana le Israel, pee eas enkisiaayiare te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neitobir osotua lo lning'o te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel, pee mejing ake olmeitai atua iltung'ana le Israel te nelo nenyikaki iltung'ana le Israel enkaji e Nkai.”
Ina apa eitaasa Musa o Aron o lturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel ile Lawi; ore te risioroto e ina pooki naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa too naaipirta ile Lawi neitaas ninche iltung'ana le Israel ina.
Neitisiny ile Lawi ate aalam ing'ok, neituku inkilani enye; neishooyo Aron ninche anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani, neitobir Aron osotua lo lning'o te nkaraki ninche eituku ninche.

Ore te siadi ina nepuo ile Lawi atua aas enkisiaayiare enye tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, aasisho ti abori Aron o layiok lenyena. Ore anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa too naaipirta ile Lawi ina ninye eitaasa ninche.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Kuna baa naaishiaakino too le Lawi: ore ebaiki ilarin tikitam o miet neilep, kepuo ninche aas enkisiaayiare tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo;
naa ore ebaiki ilarin onom neing'uaa ninche enkisiaayiare nemeitoki aaisiaaisho,
kake keisiaai ilalashera lenye tiatua olng'obor le ntumo, neibung iutarot, kake meisiaaisho ninche. Inji iyie ilo aaitaas ile Lawi arishaki isiaaitin enye.”
Neirorie Olaitoriani Musa tiong'ata e Sinai, to lapa le dukuya lo lari liaare eidipa aatupuku te nkop e Misiri, nejoki,
“Inchoo iltung'ana le Israel eibung Pasaka te rishata enye nategeluaki.
Ore te nkolong e tomon oong'uan ele apa, teipa, nimbung'ubung'u te nkata enye nategeluaki te risioroto oo nkikoot pooki, o nkiguanat pooki ipuopuo intae aaibung.”
Neaku etiaaka Musa iltung'ana le Israel pee eibung Pasaka.
Neibung ninche Pasaka to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e tomon oong'uan o lapa, teipa, tiongota e Sinai; te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, neas iltung'ana le Israel ina.
Netii apa ilkuti tung'ana lemesinya ooiseyie osesen lo ltung'ani otua, neaku meidim ninche aaibung'a Pasaka teina olong; nepuonu ninche dukuya Musa o Aron teina olong.

Nejoki lelo tung'ana ninche, “Kira iyiook ilooiduruk amu kiseyie osesen lo ltung'ani otua; kainyoo pee etekepayioki iyiook eitu kinchooyo olasar lo Laitoriani te nkata nategeluaki tiatua iltung'ana le Israel?”
Nejoki Musa ninche, “Entasho, pee atum atoning'o enaitanapisho Olaitoriani tialo intae.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, “Teneiduruk ake ninye oltung'ani tiatua intae aashu olayioni le ishoi inyi, eiseyie oltung'ani otua aashu elakua te lototo enye apa nashomo, naa keibung ake Pasaka o Laitoriani.
Ore to lapa liare, te nkolong e tomon oong'uan naa keibung ninche ilo sirua, nenya ninche tenebo imukateni neitu eisuishieki o lkeek oodua.
Nemeleku ninche toki o mekenyu, nemegil oloito lenye; te risioroto oo nkikoot pooki e Pasaka eibung ninche.

Kake ore ilo tung'ani oiduruk nemetii elototo, kake nekepari aany eibung Pasaka, ore ilo tung'ani neiwuang'ieki too ltung'ana lenyena amu eitu eishoru olasar lo Laitoriani te rishata enye nageluno; nenap ilo tung'ani eng'oki enye.
Naa tenelotu oltung'ani omoni amanyisho tiatua intae, neibung Pasaka to Laitoriani, te risioroto oo nkikoot e Pasaka, metaa ninye ina. Enkikoo nabo intae ipupuo aata, to lomoni o to inoti.”

Ore apa ina olong natuunoki olng'obor le Nkai, neimulumul enkatampoi ilo ng'obor le Nkai, ilo ng'obor le shakenisho; ore teipa netii ina atampoi shumata ilo ng'obor nelioo eikununo anaa enkima o mekenyu.
Netiu neijia anaake, neimulumul enkatampoi ilo ng'obor dama, neliooyu anaa enkima kewarie.

Naa ore ake te neiwuang'ieki ina atampoi te nchumata e ilo ng'obor, ore te siadi ina nedumunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaidur; naa ore ake ewueji nedoiki ina atampoi neun iltung'ana loo Siraeli ilng'oborri teine.

Naa te nkitanapata o Laitoriani edumunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaidur, naa te nkitanapata o Laitoriani sii eun ninche ilng'oborri; ore te nkata naba anaa enabik enkatampoi te nchumata ilo ng'obor le Nkai, nebik ninche too lng'oborri.
Ore duoo ninye tenaa nkolong'i kumok ebik enkatampoi te nchumata e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, neibung iltung'ana loo Siraeli enkitanapata o Laitoriani, nemedumunye ninche aaidur.

Ore apa kulie katitin na nkuti olong'i ake etii ina atampoi shumata ilo ng'obor le Nkai, naa ore te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani nebik ninche too lng'oborri, ore ake te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani nedumunye ninche aaidur.

Ore ake sii apa kulie katitin etotona enkatampoi ebaiki teipa o mekenyu; naa ore ake pee edumuni aailepie enkatampoi tadekenya, nedumunye ninche aaidur aashu te netobiko enkolong nabo o enkewarie, ore ake pee eiwuang'ieki ina atampoi nedumunye ninche aaidur.
Tenaa inkolong'i are apa aashu olapa, aashu enkata naado, etobiko ina atampoi te nchumata ilo ng'obor le Nkai, neton teine, nebik iltung'ana loo Siraeli too lng'oborri, nemedumunye aaidur

kake te eyai aailepie, nedumunye ninche aaidur. Te nkitanapata o Laitoriani eun ninche ilng'oborri, naa te nkitanapata o Laitoriani edumunye ninche aapuo; eibung'a apa ninche enkitanapata o Laitoriani, ina kitanapata o Laitoriani naimua Musa.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Intobira intarumpetani are e nkosholai te nkarriyiano ndong'u ninche, neaku ninche impotunye eumata, naa ninche egilieki ilng'oborri.
Naa te nekuti pokira are, neiturrurrunye eumata pooki aapuonu enitii te kutukaji ilo ng'obor le ntumo.
Kake tenaa nabo ake etukutaki, naa ilarikok, nena lukuny oo loshon loo Siraeli, likinturrurrokino.
Naa ti niosh abuaku, ore lelo ng'oborri ootii enchoto o loosaen nedumunye,
ore pee intoki aosh abuaku e niare, ore lelo ng'oborri ootii enchoto e kopikop nedumunye aaidur. Embuakunoto eoshi enkata naba anaa enadumunye ninche.
Kake tenaa eumata eiturrurri te nebo, nikut, kake mipik embuakunoto.
Ore lelo ayiok le Aron, lelo apolosak, nekut intarumpetani. Ore eoshoto oo sekekuani naa keaku te intae enkitanapata e anaake tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.

Naa tenipuopuo enjore te nkop inyi aagilunore ilo mang'atinta linyi oibooki intae enkop, nitumokiki taa aaitadara intarumpetani, pee edamuni intae te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, neitajeuni intae too lmang'ati linyi.

Ore sii too nkatitin e ng'ida - too siruai linyi lo lapa ng'ejuk o te kulikae siruai te sayiata e Nkai - tukuta nena tarumpetani ina kata intarasaa ilasarri linyi oopejori o lasarri linyi le seriani pee atum taa atareto intae: Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino.”
Ore to lari li are, to lapa li are te nkolong e tikitam o lapa nedumuni enkatampoi aailepie aaitung'uaa shumata ilo ng'obor le Nkai le shakenisho,
nedumunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa ntukusi aaidur aaing'uaa ong'ata e Sinai; nelo ina atampoi airrag tiong'ota e Paran.
Nedumunye ninche aaidur te nkata e dukuya te nkitanapata o Laitoriani naimua Musa.
Ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Yuda etang'asaki aaun too ntukusi enye, naa Nashon olayioni le Aminadab olarikoni lenye.
Ore apa olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Isaakar naa Natanel olayioni le Suar.
Ore apa olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Sebulon naa Eliab olayioni le Helon.
Naa ore apa te nedotuni olng'obor le ntumo, naa ilayiok le Gershon o layiok le Merari laa ninche apa oonap ilo ng'obor le Nkai, nedumunye aaidur.
Neitoki asuj olturrur loo lng'oborri le Ruben too ntukusi enye, ore olarikoni lenye naa Elisuri olayioni le Shedeur.
Ore olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Simeon naa Shelumiel olayioni le Surishadai.
Ore olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Gad naa Eliasaf olayioni le Deuel.
Neitoki ile Kohat aadumunye aaidur, enapita nena tokitin naasinya, neitasheyie ilo ng'obor le Nkai eton eitu ebau ninche.
Neitoki entukus oo lng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Efraim adumunye too lturrurri lenye; ore olarikoni lenye naa Elishama olayioni le Amihud.
Ore olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Manase naa Gamaliel olayioni le Pedasur.
Ore olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Benchamen naa Abidan olayioni le Gideon.
Neitoki enkereri oo lng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Dan aa ninche ootii siadi ilng'oborri pooki, aadumunye too lturrurri lenye; ore olarikoni lo lorora lenye naa Ahieser olayioni le Amishadai.
Ore olarikoni lo lorora loo ltung'ana lo losho le Asheri naa Pagiel olayioni le Okran.
Ore olarikoni lo lorora loo ltung'ana le Naftali naa Ahira olayioni le Enan.
Ena apa empukunoto e lototo oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli te risioroto oo lororani lenye, te nedumunye aaidur.

Nejoki Musa Hobab olayioni le Ruel ilo Midiani, aputani le Musa, “Eikidumunye iyiook aapuo ine wueji natejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kaisho nanu intae’, wootu te nebo iyiook, amu eikintaas iyiook intae esidai; amu eisiligie Olaitoriani Isiraeli embae sidai.”
Kake etiaaka apa Hobab Musa, “Malo nanu; kaorori nanu alo enkop ai makewan o lorere lai.”
Neitoki Musa ajoki ninye, “Aatoomono, ming'uaa iyiook, amu iyiolo enikipuo aaiko kiun ilng'oborri ti ong'ata naa eilo iyie aaku nkonyek te iyiook.
Naa ti nilo iyie te nebo iyiook ore pooki toki sidai naba anaa enaitaas iyiook Olaitoriani, nikintaas iyiook iyie ina ake.”

Neaku etudumunye apa ninche aapuo to ldoinyo le Nkai elototo oo nkolong'i uni; ore ilo sanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani nelo te dukuya ninche teina lototo oo nkolong'i uni, pee etum aing'uraki ninche ewueji nepuo aayeng'iyeng'are.
Netii apa enkatampoi o Laitoriani shumata ninche dama enkata ake naba anaa enadumunye ninche aaidur too lng'oborri.
Naa ore ake enkata naba anaa enadumuni ilo sanduku aaya, nejo Musa, “Tudumunye, iyie Olaitoriani, naa nchoo ilmang'ati linono eisardaka naa inchoo lelo likimba iyie eilanyisho te dukuya iyie.”
Naa ore ake pee eirragieki, nejo ninye, “Torrinyokinoyu iyie Olaitoriani inkalifuni iip tomon oo Siraeli.”

Neing'unyung'unyaki iltung'ana Olaitoriani te nkaraki enyamali enye; ore ake pee ening Olaitoriani ina neyupuyup engoro enye, nepej engoro o Laitoriani atua ninche, nenya kulie wuejitin e lelo ng'oborri.
Neitoki iltung'ana aaishiraki Musa, neomon Musa Olaitoriani neye ina kima.
Neaku keji apa enkarna eine wueji Tabera te nkaraki natapejo enkima o Laitoriani atua ninche.
Ore apa iltung'ana loo loreren ootii atua ninche netum kuuru oleng, neitoki sii iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaishir nejo, “Oi naaji kitum inkiri nikinya!
Eikidamu isinkir apa likinya te Misiri pesho o nkaitubulu naaijo ilmalenken o kitunkuu o mbenek naainosi, o kulie tokitin kumok;
kake ore taata eishunye engolon ang, nemeetae hoo ae toki meteleku ake ena manna king'or.”
Ore apa ina manna neikununo anaa ilanterera, kutiti; ore emua enye naa aisikitok neibor.

Nemanimanaa apa iltung'ana aapuo aasotu, neidong too soito ooiutuutishoreki aashu eidong'i te nkidong'et neitokitokie too motioo, neitayunye imukateni; ore enkishamu enye neikununo anaa enoo mukateni naayiera te ilata.
Te nedoiki enkolieelio ilng'oborri kewarie neitadou manna.
Nening Musa iltung'ana eyietu aaishir too lmareita lenye, oltung'ani ake te kutukaji o lng'obor lenye; neyupuyup airowuaju engoro o Laitoriani oleng, neisinanuo Musa.
Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Kainyoo iye pee intaasa entorroni osinka lino? Naa kainyoo nanu pee eitu atum omon too nkonyek inono, neaku kinteleikia nanu olola le kulo tung'ana pooki?

Katoiwuo nanu te nutai kulo tung'ana pooki? Kai nanu otoiuo ninche, metaa eikijoki iyie nanu, ‘Tanapa to lgoo lino, anaa enanap enkaibung'ani enkerai nanakita, aya ina kop ninosie iyie olmumai pee incho iloo menye?’
Kaji nanu atumie inkiri naisho kulo tung'ana pooki? Amu keyietu ninche aaishir te dukuya nanu nejo, ‘Inchoo iyiook inkiri, pee kitum aainosa.’
Maidim nanu atanapa kulo tung'ana openy, keiroishi ele ola oleng te nanu.
Tenaa kena kintaas nanu taaraki matua nabo kata, te nanoto omom too nkonyek inono, pee madol nanu entorroni ai.”

Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Nturrurrokoki nanu iltung'ana intomoni naapishana loo ilpayiani le Israel, lelo liyiolo iyie ajo ilpayiani lo lorere o larikok loo ltung'ana, nincho ninche meitasho teine te nebo iyie.

Naa kadou nanu alotu airorie intae teine. Naa kaya nanu embata e ina kiyang'et natii shumata iyie napik shumata ninche; naa kenap ninche ilo ola le kulo tung'ana te nebo iyie, pee mintoki iyie anap openy.

Nijoki iyie iltung'ana, ‘Entisinya ate taaisere ninyanya inkiri; amu inchirakita Olaitoriani, ijojo, “Kaing'ae naisho iyiook inkiri nikinya? Amu keikash apa kitii Misiri.” Ore naa keisho intae Olaitoriani inkiri, naa inyanya intae.
Minyanya intae enkolong nabo, aashu inkolong'i are, aashu inkolong'i imiet, aashu inkolong'i tomon, aashu inkolong'i tikitam,

kake olapa olulung'a, o metaba anaa neimu intae inkumeishin, nirikaka, te nkaraki nitanyaita intae Olaitoriani otii te nebo intae, ninchirishiri te dukuya ninye, ijojo, “Kainyoo iyiook pee kitupukutuo te nkop e Misiri?’ ”
Kake etejo Musa, “Ore kulo tung'ana latii nanu atua oobaya inkalifuni iip ile oopuo too nkejek; eji nijo iyie, ‘Kaisho nanu inkiri, pee etum aainosa olapa olulung'a!’
Ke nkishu o nkerrai eyieng'i te nkaraki ninche, pee eitaraposhi ninche? Aashu ke sinkir pooki le naiposha eiturrurruni te nkaraki ninche, pee eitaraposhi ninche?”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Keitodorropaki enkaina o Laitoriani? Ore taata idol iyie tenaa kesipayu ororei lai te iyie aashu mesipayu.”
Neaku eipang'a apa Musa alo ajoki iltung'ana irorei lo Laitoriani; neiturrur ninye iltung'ana intomoni naapishana loo lpayiani loo ltung'ana, neitaman ninche olng'obor.

Nelotu Olaitoriani te nkatampoi airorie ninye, neya embata e ina kiyang'et natii shumata ninye nepik shumata lelo payiani intomoni naapishana; ore pee eirrag ina kiyang'et te shumata ninche, neibonisho ninche. Kake eitu eigil aaiko neijia.

Neing'uari apa iltung'ana aare too lng'oborri, neji obo Eldad ore o likae neji Medad, netonie enkiyang'et ninche; neaku ninche te nebo lelo ooigeroki kake eitu ninche eipang aapuo ilo ng'obor, neaku eibonishote ninche tiatua ilo ng'obor.
Nekuet olbarnoti obo alo ajoki Musa, “Eibonisho Eldad o Medad to lng'obor.”
Ore Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo aisiaayiani le Musa, obo le lelo tung'ana oogeluno, nejo, “Olkitok lai Musa, tomitiki ninche.”
Kake etiaaka Musa ninye, “Iata iyie olom te nkaraki nanu? Oo naaji tenaa ore iltung'ana pooki lo Laitoriani, naa iloibonok, nepik Olaitoriani enkiyang'et enye shumata ninche!”
Nerrinyo Musa o lpayiani le Israel aapuo ilng'oborri.

Nedumunye olkutati oing'uaa Olaitoriani, neyau inkurlen aitung'uaa enkalo e naiposha, neisho ninche edou te mbata oo lng'oborri, eneba anaa elototo e nkolong nabo tena shoto o elototo e nkolong nabo te nkae shoto, te manaroto oo lng'oborri, naa eneba anaa intemat are e nkaina eirrag ti oriong enkop.
Nedumunye iltung'ana ina olong pooki o enkewarie pooki o ina olong pooki natusujua nesotu inkurlen, ore olotasotuo inkuti naa ilbenia tomon, neisalaashaki ninche ate aaitaman ilng'oborri.
Ore ina kata eton etii nena kiri irishat oo lala lenye eton eitu enya aamut, neyupuyupoki engoro o Laitoriani iltung'ana, near Olaitoriani olorere to lmeitai kitok.
Neaku etejoki apa enkarna e ine wueji Kibrot-hatafa. Te nkaraki naa teine apa etunukayioki lelo tung'ana lo lorok.
Nedumunye iltung'ana te Kibrot-hatafa nepuo Haserot nebik ninche te Haserot.
Etukurra Miriam o Aron Musa te nkaraki ina kitok oo Lkushi nayama, amu entito oo Lkushi apa eyama Musa.
Nejo ninche, “Ke Musa ake eirorie Olaitoriani? Keitu sii ninye eirorie iyiook?” Nening Olaitoriani ina.
Ore apa ilo tung'ani oji Musa naa oltung'ani obor oleng alang iltung'ana pooki ootii oriong enkop.
Ore nabo kata nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron o Miriam, “Entupuku wootu, intae pokira okuni atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.” Nepuku pokira uni aapuonu.
Nedou Olaitoriani alotu enkop te ng'ape e nkatampoi neitashe te kutukaji o lng'obor, neipot Aron o Miriam, nepuonu pokira are dukuya.
Nejoki ninche, “Entoning irorei laainei: Tenaa ketii oloiboni atua intae, ore nanu Olaitoriani makewan naitayiolo kewan ai ninye te nduata nairorie ninye te nkidetidet.
Mme neijia to sinka lai Musa; ninye eishooki enkaji ai pooki.
Ore ninye kairorie nanu kiwalikino too nkutukie, te nkibalakinoto, neme te nkiroroto misil; naa keing'or ninye eneikununo Olaitoriani. Kainyoo naa pee miurere intae aatukur ilo sinka lai Musa?”
Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani tialo ninche, nelo aing'uaa.
Ore ake pee eiwuang ina atampoi te shumata ilo ng'obor nejing Miriam enkeeya oo lbolot naibor anaa enturoto. Neibelekenya Aron aing'or Miriam, nedol etijing'a ninye enkeeya oo lbolot.
Nejoki Aron Musa, “Oi lo kitok lai, mintame iyiook amu kitaasa iyiook te modai, nikitaasa eng'oki.
Mincho ninye etiu anaa enatua, naidaaitie inkiri o sesen apa pee eiu ng'otonye.”
Neishiraki Musa Olaitoriani ejo, “Nchiunye ninye, Na Ai, aatasayia.”

Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Amaa naaji tenaa ketonotaka menye miriam enkomom enye, aimekurru ninye nkolong'i naapishana? Inchoo ninye eikenori ti auluo ilng'oborri inkolong'i naapishana, ore te siadi ina neidimi aanyaaki aaitijing'u.”
Neaku eikenoyioki apa Miriam ti auluo ilng'oborri inkolong'i naapishana, neitu edumunye iltung'ana aapuo o metaba anaa neitokini aaitijing'u Miriam.
Ore te siadi ina nedumunye iltung'ana aapuo te Haserot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri ti ong'ata e Paran.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Irriwai iltung'ana meshomo aaikitalan ina kop e Kanaan, naisho nanu iltung'ana loo Siraeli;
ore ake te pooki osho loo loo menye irriwai oltung'ani, ore ake oltung'ani naa olarikoni tiatua ninche.”
Neaku eirriwayie apa Musa ninche ti ong'ata e Paran, te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani o lelo tung'ana pooki aa lukuny oo ltung'ana le Israel.
Naa kuna apa nkarn enye: Ore to losho le Ruben naa Shamua olayioni le Sakuri;
ore to losho le Simeon naa Shafat olayioni le Hor;
ore to losho le Yuda, naa Kaleb olayioni le Yefune;
ore to losho le Isaakar naa Igal olayioni le Yosef;
ore to losho le Efraim naa Hoshea olayioni le Nuni;
ore to losho le Benchamen, naa Palti olayioni le Rafu,
ore to losho le Sebulon, naa Gadiel olayioni le Sodi;
ore to losho le Yosef aa taa to losho loo olayioni le Manase, naa Gad olayioni le Susi;
ore to losho le Dan naa Amiel olayioni le Gemali;
ore to losho le Asheri naa Setur olayioni le Mikael;
ore to losho le Naftali na Nahabi olayioni le Fopsi;
ore to losho le Gad naa Geuel olayioni le Maki.
Kuna apa inkarn e lelo tung'ana ooirriwayie Musa meshomo aaikitalan ina kop e Kanaan. Neisho apa Musa Hoshea olayioni le Nuni enkarna, nejo Yoshua.
Neirriwaa apa Musa ninche meshomo aaikitalan ina kop e Kanaan, nejoki ninche, “Elepa enchom Negeb te idie, nilepilepe aapuo ina kop oo ldoinyo.
Entodol aajo kaji eikununo ina kop, tenaa kegol iltung'ana oomanya aashu tenaa keshal,
aashu tenaa ae kuti anaa aikumok aashu sii tenaa eisidai ina kop namanya ninche anaa eitorrono aashu sii tenaa ore nena anas naamanya ninche naa ilng'oborri aashu isempewueti.
Entayiolo sii tenaa kepir enkop tenaa aimepir, ketii ilkeek anaa aimetii. Entonyok eyautu embata oo lng'anayio le ina kop.” Ore apa ina kata naa erishata oo sabibu le dukuya ooto.
Neaku etudumunye apa lelo aikitalak aapuo aaikitalan enkop ebaiki ong'ata e Sin o metabaiki Rehob; embata e nejing'ieki Hamat;
nepuo apa ninche Negeb, neitoki aapuonu Hebron; o Ahiman o Sheshai o Talmai ore apa lelo le ishoi e Anak naa ine etii. (Eteshetaki apa Hebron ilarin oopishana te dukuya Soan te Misiri.)
Neitoki ninche aapuonu oerata le Eshkol, nedung'u ninche teine olng'osila oimarrimarr too lng'anayio loo sabibu, nenap iltung'ana oaare te nchata; eyautua sii ilng'anayio ooji kukumanka o lng'abolo.
Keji apa ine wueji oerata le Eshkol, te nkaraki ina kimarrimarrati natudung'utuo iltung'ana le Israel.
Ore te siadi inkolong'i artam neshukunye ninche eing'uaa ina leenore e ina kop.
Nepuonu ninche enetii Musa o Aron o ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel ti ong'ata e Paran, te Kadesh; neyaki ninche olomoni o ina umata pooki, neitodol ninche ilng'anayio le ina kop.
Nejoki ninche Musa, “Kitabaitie iyiook ina kop apa nirriwayie iyiook; keruko kule o naishi, naa kulo ilng'anayio lenyena.
Kake ore eyia kegol iltung'ana oomanya ina kop, naa kesheta inkanas enye nelala oleng; ore te nebo ina kitoduaa eishoi e Anak teine.
Ore Ilmaleki nemanya enkop e Negeb, ore ile Hiti o Iyebusi o le Amori nemanya ina kop oo ndoinyo, netii ile Kanaan embata e naiposha, olkeju le Yordan.”
Kake eitigira apa Kaleb olorere te dukuya Musa, nejo ninye “Mailepa iyiook aapuo nabo kata, pee kipuo aamany, amu eikindim iyiook aaibung'a ina kop.”
Ore apa lelo tung'ana ooshomo te nebo Kaleb nejo, “Mikindim iyiook aashom aairisha ilo orere; amu kegol ninche aalang iyiook.”

Neaku eyakita apa ninche iltung'ana le Israel olomoni torrono le ina kop nashomo aaikitalan, ejo, “Ore ina kop nikishomo iyiook aaikitalan naa enkop nanya lelo oomanya, ore lelo tung'ana pooki likitoduaa teina kop naa adoru naa iltung'ana sapuki oleng.
Ore teine nikitoduaa intiamasin, nikitiu iyiook anaa ilmaat, neijia iyiook kitotiutuo te ninche.”
Neyietu ina umata pooki aaishir, neishir iltung'ana ina kewarie.
Ore iltung'ana pooki le Israel neing'unyung'unyaki Musa o Aron; nejoki ina umata pooki ninche, “Aimeikash apa tenaa ekituata te nkop e Misiri aashu tenaa aikituata tena ong'ata!
Kainyoo pee eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani ena kop, pee kipuonu aabatata to lalem? Ore inkituaak ang o nkera ang kutiti naa keaku inaari metuata; aimeikash naaji te iyiook te nikirrinyo aapuo Misiri?”
Nejokino ninche maate, “Mategelu iyiook olarikoni pee kirrinyo aapuo Misiri.”
Neitoki Musa o Aron aabatata too nkomomi te dukuya ina umata e ilo turrur loo ltung'ana le Israel.
Ore Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o Kaleb olayioni le Yefune apa ootii te nebo lelo ooshomo aaikitalan enkop, nepolos ilkilani lenye,
nejoki ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel, “Ore ina kop nikishomo iyiook aaikitalan naa enkop sidai oleng.
Tenaa keshipakino iyiook Olaitoriani, naa keyau iyiook atua ena kop neisho iyiook, ena kop naruko kule o naishi.

Emigolong'aki ake duoo intae Olaitoriani, nimiureyuyu lelo tung'ana le ina kop, amu ekimir ninche aasioki, eiwuang'ieki erripoto enye aaitung'uaa ninche netii Olaitoriani te nebo iyiook; emiureyu ninche.”
Kake etejo olturrur pooki pee enang ninche too soito. Nelioyu enkitoo o Laitoriani to lng'obor le ntumo too ltung'ana pooki le Israel.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Kaamenu kenya kulo tung'ana o anu? Ketoni ninche eitu aairuk nanu o anu, aasita kuna kitoduaat pooki nataasa nanu tiatua ninche?
Kaosh nanu ninche to lmeitai nemaitujung ninche, naa kaitayu nanu te iyie olosho kitok naa magilani alang ninche.”
Kake etiaaka Musa Olaitoriani, “Ekening naa ile Misiri ina, amu intayio iyie ele orere te ngolon ino aitung'uaa ile Misiri,

naa kepuo ninche aaliki kulo oomanya ena kop. Etoning'o apa ninche nchere, ore iyie Olaitoriani itii atua ele orere; amu ore iyie Olaitoriani nitoduare ninche too nkonyek, neitashe enkatampoi ino te shumata ninche nilo iyie te dukuya ninche, te ng'ape e nkatampoi dama o te ng'ape e nkima kewarie.
Ore taata te niar ele orere metuata anaa oltung'ani obo, ore apa lelo oshon ootoning'o enkisisa ino nejo,
‘Te nkaraki nemeidim Olaitoriani ayau ele orere atua ina kop nainosie olmumai pee eisho ninche, neaku etaara ninche metuata ti ong'ata.’
Ore naa taata, aatoomono nanu, inchoo engolon o Laitoriani eaku kitok anaa apa enisiligie ninche pee ijo,

‘Mesioki Olaitoriani agoro, neton ninye te nyorrata nauno, nepalaki iltung'ana te ntorroni o te ngolon e nkong'u, kake meeta ninye nchere pee eiwuang'ie eng'oki eitu eitabaiki entorroni oo loo menye shumata inkera enye, shumata e ishoi e uni o shumata eishoi e ong'uan.’
Tapaliki entorroni e kulo tung'ana, aatoomono nanu iyie, te risioroto e nkitoo e nyorrata ino, o te risioroto e mpalikino ino nitapalikia iyie ele orere, ebaiki apa te Misiri o taata.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Atapalikia nanu ninche te risioroto o rorei lino;
kake esipa ore anaa enaishu nanu o anaa sii enabore enkop pooki enkitoo e nkisisa o Laitoriani,
meetae obo le kulo tung'ana ootoduaa enkitoo e nkisisa ai o nkitoduaat aainei nataasa te Misiri o tiong'ota, naatetema katitin tomon neitu ening oltoilo lai
olo adol ina kop apa nainosie nanu olmumai pee aisho iloo menye; nemeetae obo le lelo laatemenaitie nanu olo adol ina kop.
Kake ore osinka lai Kaleb, te nkaraki naata ninye oltau opaashaa naatusuja ninye nanu tukul, kayau nanu ninye atua ina kop apa nashomo,
ore eishoi enye naa kepuo aaya ina kop. Ore taata amu emanya Ilmaleki o lkanaani iyerat, tayooki imbelekenyayu shomo ong'ata aim enkoitoi Enaiposha Nanyokie.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa o Aron,
“Kaaing'unyung'unyaki kenya ena umata torrono o anu? Atoning'o nanu enking'unyung'uny oo ltung'ana le Israel aaing'unyung'unyaki nanu.
Tiaaki ninche, ore anaa enaishu, Olaitoriani ojo, ‘Ore ina nitejo intae too nkiyiaa aainei kaitaas nanu intae.
Ore impopoki inyi kepuo aairragaa tena ong'ata, ore te siana inyi pooki ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, le lelo laaing'unyung'unyakitia nanu,
meetae obo olo atua ina kop apa nainosie olmumai inchere kaisho intae entamany, meteleku ake Kaleb olayioni le Yefune o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.
Kake ore nena kera inyi apa nitejo kearari, kaitijing nanu ina kop, naa kepuo ninche aayiolou ina kop apa nitemenaitie.
Kake ore intae keiput mpopoki inyi ena ong'ata.
Naa keaku inkera inyi ilchekuti loo ntare to lpurkel ilarin artam netum ninche osina te nkaraki nimisiligayuyu o metaba anaa neirrag impopoki olobayie linyi tiong'ata.
Te risioroto e siana oo nkolong'i apa nishomo aikitalan enkop, inkolong'i artam, te nkolong ake to lari, inapinapa intae entorroni inyi, ilarin artam, naa ipuopuo intae aayiolou engoro ai.’
Nanu, Olaitoriani oiroro; kesipa ena nanu ayooki aitaas ele turrur torrono pooki laaiturrurrokine nanu: ore tena ong'ata naa kepuonu ninche enkiting'oto enye tukul, naa teine epuo aaye.”
Ore lelo tung'ana apa ooirriwayie Musa meikitalana ina kop, lelo apa ootushukunye neisho olturrur meing'unyung'unyaki ninye neyau olkilikuai torrono ina kop,
lelo tung'ana apa ooyautua olkilikuai torrono le ina kop, neye ninche to lmeitai te dukuya o Laitoriani.
Kake ore Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o Kaleb olayioni le Yefune neitu eye, te nebo lelo tung'ana apa ooshomo aaikitalan enkop.
Nejoki Musa kulo rorei iltung'ana pooki le Israel neishir iltung'ana eisinanuo oleng.

Neyooki ninche aainyototo tadekenya oleng nepuo eneika e ina kop oo ldoinyo ejoito, “Ng'ura kitii iyiook ene, eikilep iyiook aapuo ine wueji apa neisiligie Olaitoriani iyiook; amu kitaasa iyiook eng'oki.”
Kake etejo Musa, “Kainyoo naa taata pee igolong'akiki intae enkitanapata o Laitoriani? Measayu ina niyieuu?
Milepilepe intae aapuo, pee meari intae aairragie te dukuya ilmang'ati linyi, amu metii Olaitoriani te nebo intae.
Amu ore te idie netii Ilmaleki o Lkanaani dukuya intae, naa ipuopuo intae aabatata to lalem, te nkaraki nimbelekenyate intae aaing'uaa esujata o Laitoriani, meitoki Olaitoriani atii te nebo intae.”
Kake eshomo ake duoo ninche eneika teina kop oo ldoinyo, hoo neitu eipang osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani o Musa aaing'uaa ilng'oborri.
Neitoki Ilmaleki o Lkanaani apa oomanya ina kop oo ldoinyo aadou aapuonu, nemir ninche, nesujaa ninche, o metabaiki Horma.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel,
Ti nipuonunu kenya ina kop nipuopuo aamany,

ina naisho nanu intae, ninchosho Olaitoriani inkishoorot naaing'uaa eluaata oo nkishu, aashu enoo ntare, olasar le nkima aashu olasar opejori, aashu olasar ake duo, pee intabayaya ilo mumai aashu olasar lo lpela, aashu too lasarri linyi ootegeluaki pee intobirakiki esong'ouna narropil Olaitoriani.
Ore naa ilo oyau inkishoorot enyena neisho sii Olaitoriani olasar le ntapa le matua e tomon e ntapa napuyiapui eipurjaki te rubata e ong'uan e ilata,
o enaisho te nkaraki olasar ooki, ore erubata e ong'uan nintobir te nebo olasar opejori, aashu te nkaraki olasar, to lkuo ake le ker.
Aashu ore to lmeregesh nintobir to lasar le ntapa intemat are e matua e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui naipurja too mboreitin uni e ilata,
naa ore to lasar ooki nintayu mboreitin uni e naisho pee eaku olng'usil orropil to Laitoriani.
Naa ti nintobir oloing'oni pee eaku olasar opejori, aashu olasar, pee intabaya olmumai, aashu olasar le seriani to Laitoriani,
neitayu ake oltung'ani te nebo ilo oing'oni olasar le ntapa loo mboreitin uni e matua e tomon e efa entapa napuyiapui, naipurjaki te ilata naitorit empiribil.
Ninchooyo to lasar ooki empirbil naitorit e naisho oo sabibu pee eaku olasar le nkima, olng'usil orropil to Laitoriani.
Neijia epuoi aaiko te pooki oing'oni aashu to lmeregesh, aashu te pooki sitima le ker aashu to le kine.
Ore te risioroto e ina siana nintobiriri, naa neijia enkuna te pooki ng'ae te risioroto e siana enye.
Ore lelo pooki inot linyi nchoo eas kuna baa tena oitoi, aaishooyo olasar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

Naa te neewuo oltung'ani leiking'a amanyisho te nebo intae, aashu te netii likae tung'ani atua intae too ishoritin inyi, neyieu ninye neishoru olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani, inchoo ninye eas anaa eniasiasa.

Amu ore te umata naa keaku enkitanapata nabo ake, te intae o to lomoni otii te nebo intae, enkitanapata nabikoo tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki, ore anaa enitiuu naa neijia etiu ilo omoni te dukuya o Laitoriani.
Keaku enkitanapata nabo o enkikoo nabo te iyie o te ilo omoni omanyisho te nebo intae.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, te nipuonunu atua ina kop nayau nanu intae,
naa ore ake pee inyanya endaa e ina kop, nintaikiki Olaitoriani enkishooroto.
Ore ina tapa inyi e dukuya ninchooyoyo emukate naaku olasar; ore anaa olasar oing'uaa osoit oiutuutishoreki, ninchooyoyo.
Ore ilo asar linyi le ntapa e dukuya enchorie Olaitoriani olasar tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.
“Kake tinintarruoo nimimbung'ubung'u kuna kitanapat naairoro Olaitoriani aimunye Musa,
ebaiki ina olong apa naishorua Olaitoriani inkitanapat neito dukuya tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki,

kake te neitadiaki te nkaraki meyiolo eumata neitayu naa ina umata pooki oloti oing'oni oaku olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani, te nebo olasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki te risioroto e nkitanapata o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki.

Neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel, naa kepalakini ninye, amu enkitapong'oto apake, neyautua ninche olasar lenye, ilo asar le nkima oishori Olaitoriani, neyau ilo asar lenye le ng'oki dukuya Olaitoriani, te nkaraki ina kitarruoroto enye.
Ore ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel naa kepalakini o ilo omoni otii te nebo ninche, amu etijing'a apa ilo orere pooki ina kitarruoroto.
“Te neas oltung'ani eng'oki eitu eotiki, neitayu ninye esupen e kine o lari obo naaku olasar le ng'oki.
Neitobir olopolosani osotua lo lning'o te dukuya o Laitoriani te nkaraki ilo tung'ani otaasa enkitarruoroto, teneas ninye eng'oki eitu eotiki, naa kepalakini ninye.
Inchoo eaku enkitanapata nabo iata te ilo oas pooki toki eitu eotiki, o te ilo ora oinoti le Israel o te ilo omoni otamanyishe tiatua intae.
Kake ore ilo tung'ani oas pooki toki te otikinoto, aa oinoti aashu olomoni neinyala Olaitoriani, ore ilo tung'ani naa keiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa iltung'ana lenye
te nkaraki natemenayie ninye ororei lo Laitoriani, netigila enkitanapata enye, ore ilo tung'ani keiwuang'ieki tukul, ore eng'oki enye naa keaku shumata ninye.”
Ore apa eton etii iltung'ana le Israel olpurkel netum ninche oltung'ani osotu ilkeek te nkolong e Sabato.
Ore apa lelo oonoto ninye esotu ilkeek, neyau ninye enetii Musa o Aron o ilo turrur pooki.
Neikenori ninye, amu eitu apa eibalunyeki enaitaasi ninye.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Keari ilo tung'ani metua; naa kenang ilo turrur pooki ninye too soito o metua ti auluo ilng'oborri.”
Neyau ilo turrur pooki ilo tung'ani auluo nenang ninye o metua too soito, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Irorie iltung'ana le Israel nintanap ninche pee epik ilkisialisal ilcholo loo lkilani lenye tiatua iishoritin enye pooki ore ake olkisialisialati le pooki sholoi enkeene pus;
naa keaku te iyie olkisialisialati oing'or nedamuni inkitanapat pooki o Laitoriani, pee easi ninche, mme pee isujaa oltau lino makewan o nkonyek inono makewan.
Neaku entadamu niasiasa inkitanapat aainei pooki niakuku sinyat to Laitoriani Enkai inyi.
Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, ilo apa likintayio iyie aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, pee aaku Enkai inyi. Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.”
Ore apa Kora olayioni le Ishar, olayioni le Kohat olayioni le Lawi o Datan o Abiram ilayiok le Eliabu o Oni olayioni le Pelet, olayioni le Ruben
neya iltung'ana, negolong'aki Musa, te nebo esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel, iltung'ana iip are o onom arikok le ilo turrur ootegeluaki teina umata, iltung'ana yiolot oleng.

Neiturrurro ninche maate te nebo aagilunore Musa o Aron, nejoki ninche, “Ishomo intae aalus! Amu ore ele turrur pooki kesinya pooki ng'ae lenye, netii Olaitoriani atua ninche; kainyoo naa pee ilepiepie intae ate aaitulus te umata o Laitoriani?”
Ore ake pee ening Musa ena, nebatata ninye te nkomom enye;

nejoki ninye Kora o ina sholiek enye pooki, “Ore tadekenya keyooki Olaitoriani aitodolu ajo kalo olenye, naa kalo osinya, neisho meeu anyikaki ninye, ore ilo olo ninye agelu naa keisho meeu anyikaki ninye.
Taasa iyie ena, ewaita embakuli e nkima, Kora o encholiek ino pooki,
entipik enkima atua ninche nipikipiki enkorropil shumata ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani taaisere, ore ilo tung'ani oyooki Olaitoriani agelu neaku ilo sinyati. Ishomo aaitulus ilayiok le Lawi!”
Nejoki Musa Kora, “Entoning taata, intae ilayiok le Lawi!

Kentoki kiti ena te intae inchere etegelayie intae Enkai oo Siraeli aitung'uaa olturrur le Israel, pee eitataaniki intae kewan, pee iasiasa enkisiaayiare te ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani, nintasheshe te dukuya olturrur aaisiaai ninche;
amaa amu kiyaua ninye aitinyikaki kewan o lalashera linono lelo ayiok le Lawi te nebo iyie, ing'oruru sii intae empolosare?
Ore naa meitiship Olaitoriani ena inchere ore iyie o encholiek ino pooki inturrurrote te nebo; Kainyoo pee ing'unyung'unyakiki Aron?”
