Neirriwaa Musa olkilikuai aipotu Datan o Abiram lelo ayiok le Eliab; nejo ninche, “Mikipuonu iyiook.
Ke mbae kiti ena inchere iyaua iyiook ailepunye teina kop naruko kule o naishi pee ilotu aar iyiook matuata tiong'ota, pee itumoki sii aitaa kewan kitok te shumata iyiook?
Ore ninye, eitu iyie iyau iyiook ina kop naruko kule o naishi, neitu incho iyiook enjung'ore e nkop o nkurman oo lng'anayio. Ikurtu iyie inkonyek e kulo tung'ana? Mikipuonu iyiook.”
Negoro apa Musa oleng, nejoki Olaitoriani, “Mishilaa iyie olasar lenye. Eitu ninye nanu aya osikiria lenye neitu ainyal obo lenye.”
Nejoki Musa Kora, “Wou taaisere dukuya Olaitoriani, iyie o encholiek ino o Aron.

Naa inchoo ake oltung'ani eya embakuli enye oo nkuk o lasar, nepik enkorropil shumata ninye, neyau ake pooki ng'ae te intae dukuya Olaitoriani embakuli enye, imbakulini iip are o onom; ore sii iyie o Aron neyau ake oltung'ani embakuli enye.”
Neaku ewa apa oltung'ani ake embakuli enye, nepik nkimaitie atua neiteleiki enkorropil shumata, neitashe te kutuk aji ilo ng'obor le ntumo te nebo Musa o Aron.
Neitoki Kora aiturrur ilo turrur pooki aipirakinye ninche kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo. Neliooyu enkitoo enkisisa o Laitoriani teina umata pooki.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa o Aron,
“Entoorunye ewuang'a tena umata, pee atum nanu aidaikie ninche nabo kata.”
Nebatata ninche too nkomomi enye, nejo, “Na Ai, na Ai oo ltauja le pooki naishu, keas oltung'ani obo eng'oki nigorokino eumata pooki?”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Tiaaki ena umata, ‘Ewuang'a tena manyisho e Kora o Datan o Abiram.’ ”
Neitoki Musa adumunye alo enetii Datan o Abiram; nesujaa ilpayiani le Israel ninye.
Nejoki ninye ina umata, “Ewuang'a, atoomono intae enchom, entung'uai ilng'oborri le kulo tung'ana arruok, nimimbung'ubung'u hoo ae toki enye pooki pee memuti ake intae tenebo nena ng'ok enye pooki.”

Neaku eipang'a apa ninche aaing'uaa emanyisho e Kora o Datan o Abiram; neipang'u Datan o Abiram nepuonu aaitashe te kutukaji oo lng'oborri lenye, te nebo inkituaak enye o layiok lenye o nkera enye kutiti.
Nejo Musa “Tena taa iyiolouu inchere Olaitoriani laairriua mataasa kuna siaaitin pooki neme te nkaraki kewan ai.
Te neye kulo tung'ana enkeeya e oshiaake oo ltung'ana pooki aashu te neinepu entaboi oo ltung'ana pooki, neaku naa eitu aairriu Olaitoriani.
Kake te neitobiru Olaitoriani entoki ng'ejuk, nebol enkop enkutuk enye, neijoo ninche tenebo imasaa enye pooki aapuo enemeneng'a eishu, niyiolouu taa inchere Olaitoriani etemenaitie kulo tung'ana.”
Ore enaidipie airoro kulo rorei pooki, ore enkop ti abori ninche neiperra; nebol enkop enkutuk enye
neijoo ninche o lmareita lenye o lelo tung'ana pooki le Kora o masaa enye.
Neaku ore ninche o nena pooki naara inkunenye nedoyio eishu aapuo enemeneng'a neikeno enkop te shumata ninche, neidaaya ninche te mpolos e ina umata.
Ore lelo Siraeli pooki oomanita ninche, neisik to lkiyioi lenye, amu etejo ninche, “Eji pee meijoo iyiook enkop.”
Nedou enkima naing'uaa Olaitoriani, nemut lelo tung'ana iip are o onom apa oopejito enkorropil.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Tiaaki Eliesa olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani, pee eitayu nena bakulini naapejieki enkorropil te nkima; neitalamaa enkima neidapashaa. Amu kesinya ninche.

Ore nena bakulini e kulo tung'ana ootaasa eng'oki aainosie enkishui enye, inchoo ninche eidong'unyeki imbakulini naaiteleikini olasar, amu eishorutua apa ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani; metaa kesinya ninche. Neaku kepuo ninche aaku enkitanyaanyukoto too ltung'ana le Israel.”
Neaku ewa apa Eliesa ilo apolosani nena bakulini o suyai, apa naaishorutua lelo ootapejoyioki, neidong'i aaitaa entoki naimulumulieki olperere lo lasar,

pee eaku enkitadamunoto too ltung'ana le Israel pee metii hoo obo leme olapolosani, leme olayioni le ishoi e Aron, onyiku alotu apej enkorropil te dukuya Olaitoriani, metiu ake anaa Kora o encholiek enye - anaa apa enatiaaka Olaitoriani Eliesa aimunye Musa.
Ore pee ekenyu neing'unyung'unyaki eumata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel Musa o Aron, ejo, “Itaara intae metuata iltung'ana lo Laitoriani.”
Ore ake pee eiturrurrokino ina umata Musa o Aron, neibelekenya ninche aaing'or olng'obor le ntumo; naa ing'ura, neimulumul enkatampoi ilo ng'obor, neliooyu enkitoo enkisisa o Laitoriani.
Nelotu Musa o Aron dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo,
nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Enchom entung'uai atua ena umata, pee atum nanu aidaikie ninche nabo kata.” Nebatata ninche too nkomomi enye.

Nejoki Musa Aron, “Intayu embakuli ino e nkorropil, nipik enkima atua naing'uaa olperere lo lasar, nipik enkorropil shumata ninye, ninap aitasiooyo ine netii eumata, nintobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninche; amu etupukuo engoro naing'uaa Olaitoriani, neiterua alotu olmeitai.”
Kaae neyau Aron anaa enatiaaka Musa nekuet alo empolos eumata naa ing'ura, eidipa aiteru olmeitai tiatua iltung'ana; neinok ninye enkorropil, neitobir olning'o lo sotua o ltung'ana.
Neitashe ninye te rishata oo lootuata o looishu; neitasheyieki olmeitai.
Ore apa lelo ootuata to lmeitai naa inkalifuni tomon oong'uan o iip naapishana, metii lekua ootuata te siaai e Kora.
Nerrinyokino Aron Musa te kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ina kata pee eitasheyieki olmeitai.
Neirorie Olaitoriani Musa nejoki,

“Irorie iltung'ana le Israel, niyau te ninche eng'udi, nabo ake te nkaji oo loo menye, niyau too larikok pooki te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ing'usidin tomon oaare. Ing'ero ake enkarna o ltung'ani te ng'udi enye
ninger enkarna e Aron te ng'udi e Lawi. Amu keaku keetae eng'udi nabo te ndukuya e pooki aji oo loo menye.
Shomo tipika ninche atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, dukuya ina shakenisho, teine naalotu atumore.
Ore eng'udi e ilo lagelu nejing inkaitubulu. Naisho taa meisha te nanu ina king'unyung'uny oo ltung'ana le Israel niking'unyung'unyaki ninche iyie.”

Neirorie Musa iltung'ana le Israel neisho lelo arikok lenye pooki ing'usidin, nabo ake to larikoni, ore te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ing'usidin tomon oaare, ore eng'udi e Aron naa nabo e nena ng'usidin enye.
Nepik Musa nena ng'usidin dukuya Olaitoriani tiatua ilo ng'obor le shakenisho.
Ore pee ekenyu nelo Musa atua ilo ng'obor le shakenisho; naa ng'ura, ore eng'udi e Aron te nkaji e Lawi etijing'a inkaitubulu nejing ilng'osil neitapuku, neiu ilng'anayio ooto.
Neyau Musa nena ng'usidin pooki aitung'uaa dukuya Olaitoriani, ayau dukuya iltung'ana pooki le Israel; neing'or neya ake oltung'ani eng'udi enye.

Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Torrinyoki eng'udi e Aron dukuya shakenisho, pee eshumi aitaa enkitoduaata too loogolong'u, pee etum atapal enking'unyung'uny enye naaing'unyung'unyaki ninche nanu, pee meye ake.”
Ina etaasa Musa. Ore anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani neas ninye ina.
Nejoki iltung'ana le Israel Musa, “Ng'ura, eikindaaya iyiook, kiisha iyiook, kiisha iyiook pooki.
Ore pooki ng'ae olotu anyikaki olng'obor lo Laitoriani neye. Eikindaaya iyiook pooki?”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Aron, “Ore iyie o layiok linono, o enkaji e papaai lino te nebo iyie, iyaya intae entorroni tialo ine wueji sinyati; ore iyie o layiok linono niyaya entorroni tialo empolosare.

Naa ore te nebo iyie toshoru sii ilalashera linono, ilo osho le Lawi, ilo osho le papaai lino, pee kitum ninche aatushulare, nikisiaai iyie ina kata itii iyie o layiok linono dukuya ilo ng'obor le shakenisho.
Eikisiaai ninche iyie neas enkisiaayiare pooki e ilo ng'obor; kake menyikaki ninche nena masaa e ine wueji sinyati aashu enyiku aapuonu olperere lo lasar, pee meye ake ninche niye sii iyie.
Inchoo kishulare ninche, nejing'u atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, teina kisiaayiare pooki e ilo ng'obor; nemeetae likae tung'ani hoo obo likilotu anyikaki.
Nijing iyie enkisiaayiare e ine wueji sinyati o enkisiaayiare o lperere lo lasar pee meitoki alotu engoro shumata iltung'ana le Israel.
Naa ng'ura, aawa nanu ilalashera linono lelo le Lawi aitung'uaa atua iltung'ana le Israel, enkishooroto ninche te iyie, naaishooki Olaitoriani pee eas enkisiaayiare e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

Ore iyie o layiok linono te nebo iyie nijing'ijing'i empolosare te pooki naipirta olperere lo lasar o ina natii atua olodung'oro; nisiaisho iyie. Aaishoo nanu empolosare ino metaa enkishooroto, ore pooki ng'ae olotu anyiku neari metua.”

Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Aron naa, “Ng'ura, aaishoo nanu iyie pooki toki naba anaa enatushumaki too nkishoorot naaitakiaiki nanu o nena tokitin pooki naaitisinyaki oo ltung'ana le Israel; aaisho nanu iyie ninche metaa erubata oo layiok linono metaa erubata enye e anaake.

Keaku enino ina nasinya aisul naiteng'elaki neitu epejori te nkima; ore pooki kishooroto enye o lasar, o pooki asar lenye le ng'oki laaisho ninche nanu naa keaku kesinya oleng te iyie o too layiok linono.
Te wueji nesinya oleng inya iyie ina naa keidim pooki lee ainosa, kesinya ina te iyie.

Enino sii ena, ilo asar loo nkishorunot enye, ore lelo asarri pooki ooyuki loo ltung'ana le Israel; aaishoo nanu iyie ninche o layiok linono o ntoyie inono te nebo iyie, metaa erubata ino e anaake. Ore pooki ng'ae lemeeta entioto otii atua enkaji ino neidim ainosa.
Ore ina ilata sidai aisul o ina aisho pooki sidai o entapa o lelo ng'anayio le dukuya ooisho ninche Olaitoriani, aaishoo nanu iyie.
Ore lelo ng'anayio oong'as aaku te pooki naatii atua ina kop, ooyaki ninche Olaitoriani, naa keaku ilkulinyi; ore pooki ng'ae lemeeta entioto otii atua enkaji ino neidim ainosa.
Ore pooki naiteng'elakaki Olaitoriani tiatua Siraeli naa keaku eninyi.

Ore pooki kikau aa olayioni le tung'ani aashu olee le ng'ues, ilo oishori Olaitoriani naa keaku olinyi, ore ake eyia olkikau le tung'ani tokordu inyang'u, ore olkikau pooki le ng'ues lemesinya inyang'u tokordu.
Ore enkinyang'a e nkordunoto enye (aa te mbotoro o lapa obo ikordu ninche) tipika shekeli imiet e nkosholai, te risioroto e shekeli e ine wueji sinyati.

Kake ore olkikau le nkiteng, aashu olkikau le nker aashu olkikau le nkine, mikordu ainyang'u; kesinya ninche. Isuaaki osarge lenye shumata olperere lo lasar, nipejoo eilata enye metaa olasar opejori te nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani;
kake ore inkiri enye naa keaku nkuninyi, anaa ilo oikulu oyukoki o anaa ina muro enkalo e tatene naara ininono.

Ore nena tokitin pooki naasinya naaisho iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, aaishoo nanu iyie o layiok linono o ntoyie inono naatii te nebo iyie, metaa erubata e anaake. Osotua le munyan ele intarasi te dukuya Olaitoriani, te iyie o te ishoi ino natii te nebo iyie.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Aron, “Miata iyie enjung'ore tiatua enkop enye, nimiata erubata tiatua ninche; kara nanu erubata ino nara enjung'ore ino tiatua iltung'ana le Israel.
“Ore ile Lawi aishoo nanu ninche pooki ematua e tomon tiatua Isiraeli metaa enjung'ore enye, pee eaku ole rrinyore teina kisiaayiare enye naisiaaisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.
Ore naa ebaiki taata mepuonu iltung'ana le Israel aanyikaki ilo ng'obor le ntumo, menap ake ng'ok neye.

Kake lelo le Lawi oas enkisiaayiare e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, naa kenap ninche ina ng'oki enye; keaku ena enkitanapata nadamuni tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki; ore tiatua iltung'ana le Israel meeta ninche enjung'ore.

Amu ore ina rubata e tomon oo ltung'ana le Israel naitarasaki ninche Olaitoriani anaa olasar, aishoo nanu ile Lawi metaa enjung'ore enye; metaa atejo nanu tialo ninche inchere metum enjung'ore tiatua iltung'ana loo Siraeli.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

“Ore ake sii, shomo tiaaki ile Lawi, ‘Ti niyaya too ltung'ana le Israel ina matua e tomon naishoo nanu intae te ninche pee eaku enjung'ore inyi nintokiki naa sii intae aaitayu olasar teina aaisho Olaitoriani, ematua e tomon napukunye ematua e tomon.
Naa keikenari ilo asar linyi anaa entapa o soit oiutuutishoreki aashu anaa enaisho naing'uaa enkironyet.
Neaku intarasakiki sii intae Olaitoriani olasar oing'uaa nena matuan inyi e tomon, ning'amumu too ltung'ana le Israel. Naa ore te nena ninchosho ilo asar lo Laitoriani Aron ilo apolosani.
Ore tiatua nena kishoorot inyi pooki, entarasai pooki kishoroto naipirakinore Olaitoriani, ina naisul pooki, ninchooyoyo ina naisul pooki.’

Metaa tiaaki iyie ninche, ‘Ti nindipidipi aaishooi ilo asar, ina naisul, ore ina naleku neikenakini ile Lawi anaa entoki naing'uaa olkurroto oidong'ishoreki anaa entoki naing'uaa enkironyet oo sabibu;
nindim iyie ainosa te pooki wueji, iyie o enkaji ino, amu enkishooroto ino te nkaraki enkisiaayiare ino tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.
Niminap iyie eng'oki te nkinosata e ina, indipa iyie aishooi enaisul kake emisarkionie nena tokitin naasinya oo ltung'ana le Israel, pee miyeye ake.’ ”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron;
“Ena enkitanapata naitanapishe Olaitoriani, Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel pee kiyaki enkashe nanyokie nemeeta eleyiata nemeeta entioto neitu ae kata eenikini enchata emurt.
Nilo aisho ina ashe Eliesa olapolosani, neipang'ieki ninye aaya auluo nepuoi aayieng te dukuya ninye.
Ore Eliesa olapolosani neya embata o sarge le ina ashe to lkimojino lenye, neisuaaki embata e ilo sarge dukuya e ilo ng'obor le ntumo katitin naapishana.
Ore ina ashe nepejori, te dukuya ninye, nepejori olchoni lenye o nkiri enyena o sarge lenye nepejori sii imoyok enyena.
Neya olapolosani inkeek o ltarakwai o mbenek e hisopo o enkarasha nanyokie nenang'aki empolos eine nepejorieki ina ashe.
Ore te siadi ina, neituku olapolosani ilkilani lenyena nebukoki kewan enkare, netum taa atijing'a ilng'oborri; kake keton ninye mesinya o metaa teipa.
Ore ilo opejoo ina ashe neituku ilkilani lenyena te nkare neituku osesen lenye te nkare, neton ninye mesinya o metaa teipa.

Ore oltung'ani osinya nesotu nkuruon e ina ashe nelo apik auluo ilng'oborri e ewueji nemetii olduruk; neshumi ninche te nkaraki eumata oo ltung'ana le Israel te nkaraki enkare naitisinyishoreki, te nkitukuoroto oo ng'ok.

Ore ilo oiturrur nkuruon e ina ashe neituku ilkarash lenyena neton ninye mesinya o metaa teipa. Naa keaku ena te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel o te nkaraki ilo omoni otamanyishe tiatua ninche, enkitanapata ena oo nkatitin pooki.
“Ore ilo oiseyie olmeneng'ani le likae tung'ani ake ninye, nesarkionu nkolong'i naapishana.
Inchoo ninye eituku kewan te nkare te nkolong e uni o te nkolong e naapishana, pee etum taa atisinyayu; kake te nemeituku ninye kewan te nkolong e uni o te nkolong e naapishana, nemesinyayu ninye.

Ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie olmeneng'ani, ilo sesen ake ninye lo ltung'ani otua, nemeituku kewan, neiduruku olng'obor lo Laitoriani, ore ilo tung'ani nedung'ori aaiwuang'ie tiatua Israel; te nkaraki neitu eisuaakini enkare enkitisinyata shumata ninye, keaku ninye mesinya keton olduruk lenye te shumata ninye.
“Ena ninye enkitanapata te neye oltung'ani tiatua olng'obor: ore pooki ng'ae ojing'u atua olng'obor o pooki ng'ae otii atua olng'obor neaku olemesinya inkolong'i naapishana.
Ore pooki toki nang'a nemepising'a neiduruku.
Ore pooki ng'ae ti ong'ata oiseyie ilo otasesekuanaki to lalem, aashu olmeneng'ani, aashu oloito lo ltung'ani, aashu enkurare neaku olemesinya inkolong'i naapishana.
Ore te ilo lemesinya inchoo eyai embata oo nkuruon e ilo asar otapejoyioki loo ng'ok o enkare naruko napiki empirbil;

nelotu taa oltung'ani osinya aitayu imbenek e nchani naji hisopo, neitadoiki atua ina are, neisuaaki shumata ilo ng'obor o shumata imasaa pooki ilorikan o shumata lelo tung'ana ootii ine, o shumata ilo oiseyie oloito, aashu olotasesekuanaki, aashu olotua, aashu enkurare.

Ore ilo tung'ani osinya neisuaki ilo tung'ani lemesinya te nkolong e uni o te nkolong e naapishana, ore te nkolong e naapishana neitisiny ninye, neituku ninye ilkilani lenyena neituku kewan te nkare, ore pee eaku teipa nesinyayu ninye.

“Kake ore ilo tung'ani lemesinya nemeituku kewan, nedung'ori ilo tung'ani aitung'uaa atua eumata, te nkaraki naidurukie ewueji sinyati o Laitoriani; te nkaraki neitu ebukokini enkare e enkitisinyata shumata ninye, mesinya ninye.
Naa keaku enkitanapata oo nkatitin pooki te ninche. Ore ilo oisuaaya ina are naitisinyishoreki neituku ilkilani lenyena neaku mesinya o metaa teipa.
Ore entoki pooki naba anaa enaiseyie oltung'ani lemesinya neaku enemesinya; ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie ina neaku oltung'ani lemesinya o metaa teipa.”
Ore iltung'ana le Israel, ina umata pooki, nepuonu ina ong'ata e Sin, to lapa le dukuya, netoni lelo tung'ana te Kadesh; neye Miriam teine, nenukari ninye teine.
Nemetii apa enkare naok ina umata; neiturrurro ninche maate aarare Musa nearare Aron.
Neishankarrare lelo tung'ana Musa, nejoki, “Enaikash apa tenaa aikituata ina kata apa pee eye ilalashera lang te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Kainyoo iyie pee iyaua ena umata o Laitoriani atua ena ong'ata, pee kipuonu aaye tene, iyiook o nkishu ang.
Naa kainyoo pee ilepunye iyiook aitupuku te Misiri, ayau iyiook ene wueji torrono? Mme ewueji ene e nkurma, aashu ilng'abolo aashu isabibu aashu ilng'anayio ooji kukumanka; nemetii enkare naoki.”
Nepuo Musa o Aron aaing'uaa ine netii eumata aapuo kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo, nebatata too nkomomi enye. Neliooyu enkitoo o Laitoriani te ninche,
nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

“Iwa ina ng'udi, nilo aiturrur ina umata, iyie o Aron ilo alashe lino, nijoki ina dapidapoi te dukuya inkonyek enye meishoru enkare; neaku iyau iyie enkare naing'uaa atua endapidapoi te nkaraki ninche; nincho metooko ina umata o nkishu enye.”
Neya Musa ina ng'udi te dukuya Olaitoriani, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.
Neiturrur Musa o Aron ina umata te nebo te dukuya ina dapidapoi nejoki ninche, “Entoning taata, intae iloogolongu; aikiyaki iyiook intae enkare naing'uaa ena dapidapoi?”
Neilepie Musa enkaina enye aosh ina dapidapoi teina ng'udi enye katitin are; nerukunye enkare te nkumoi, neok ina umata, o nkishu enye.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, “Ore te nkaraki neitu intae kirukuruku nanu, pee kintisinyinyi nanu too nkonyek e kulo tung'ana le Israel, miyauu naa ena umata aaitijing atua ina kop naishoo ninche.”
Inkariak e Meriba nena, naa teine eishankarrare iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, neitodolu ninye esinyatisho enye te ninche.
Eirriwayie apa Musa ilkiliku te Kadesh meshomo enetii olaiguanani le Edom, nejoki, “Inji ejo olalashe linyi Israel: iyiolo iyie enyamali pooki nikinoto iyiook:
enapa kata pee epuo loo papa Misiri nikibik iyiook te Misiri enkata naado; ore lelo le Misiri neitaas iyiook entorroni o loo papa;
ore ake pee kinchiraki Olaitoriani, nening ninye oltoilo lang, neirriwaki iyiook olmalaika oilepunye iyiook aitupuku te Misiri, naa noolo iyiook ootii Kadesh, enkanasa natii olpolosie le nkop ino.

Inchoo naa taata iyiook maima atua enkop ino. Mikiimaa iyiook inkurman aashu ilookeri loo sabibu, nimikiok enkare to lchorro; e nkoitoi nalala o laiguanani kiim. Mikimbelekenya iyiook aaim enkalo e tatene aashu enkalo e kedianye o metaba anaa nikimpang tiatua enkop ino.”
Kake etiaaka apa Edom ninye, “Miim iyie enkop ai, maalotu ake aarare to lalem.”
Nejoki iltung'ana le Israel ninye, “Eikipuo iyiook aaim enkoitoi nalala; naa ti nikiok iyiook enkare ino, nanu o nkishu aainei, nalak nanu; nchooki ake duoo maimai too nkejek, metii ae toki.”
Kake etejo apa ninye, “Mipuopuo intae aaim.” Nelotu Edom aarare ninche eeta iltung'ana kumok o enjore nagol.
Neaku etanya apa Edom eisho Israel enkoitoi naaim te nkop enye, nerrinyo Isiraeli aaing'uaa ninye.
Nepuo ninche aaing'uaa Kadesh, ore lelo tung'ana le Israel ina umata pooki, nepuonu Oldoinyo le Hor.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron to ldoinyo le Hor, to lpolosie le nkop e Edom,
“Kelo Aron eneiturrurrore iltung'ana lenyena apa ootuata; amu mejing ninye atua ina kop naishoo nanu iltung'ana le Israel, amu etogolong'aka apa enkitanapata ai too inkariak e Meriba.
Iwa Aron o Eliesa olayioni lenye niyau ninche enchumata Oldoinyo le Hor;
nioru Aroni ilkilani lenyena ninchopoki Eliesa olayioni lenye; amu kelo Aron eneiturrurrokino iltung'ana lenyena, naa keye ninye teine.”
Neas Musa anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani, neilep ninche aapuo enchumata Oldoinyo le Hor eing'orita ina umata pooki.
Neitayu Musa lelo kilani le Aron, neishopoki Eliesa olayioni lenye; neye Aron teine te nchumata o ldoinyo. Neitoki Musa o Eliesa aadou te ilo doinyo.
Ore ake pee edol ina umata pooki aajo etua Aron neishiraki enkaji pooki e Israel Aron inkolong'i tomoni uni.
Ore ake pee ening ilo Kanaani aiguanani le Arad apa omanya Negeb, inchere kelotu Isiraeli aaimu enkoitoi e Afarim, nearare ninye Israel, neibung kulikae lenye araya.
Nenya Israel olmumai to Laitoriani, nejo, “Ti ninchoru iyie ele orere apik enkaina ai, nalo naa nanu aidaikie inkanas enye tukul.”
Nening Olaitoriani oltoilo le Israel, neishooyo lelo le Kanaan; neidaikie Siraeli ninche o nkanas enye. Neaku keji ine wueji Horma.
Nedumunye to ldoinyo le Hor neim enkoitoi Enaiposha Nanyokie, aapuo aamanaa te nkop e Edom; nesi iltung'ana te nkoitoi.

Neiro ninche mbaa torrok tialo Enkai o Musa. Neing'unyung'uny ninche nejo, “Kainyoo pee iyaua iyiook aitupuku te nkop e Misiri maetu aaye tene tiong'ota? Amu metii endaa nemetii enkare, neitirika iyiook ena daa nemeeta tipat.”
Neirriu Olaitoriani ilasuriaa oopi atua iltung'ana, neony ninche iltung'ana o metuata iltung'ana kumok le Israel.

Nepuonu iltung'ana enetii Musa, nejoki, “Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, amu kiroro iyiook imbaa torrok tialo Olaitoriani o tialo iyie; toomono Olaitoriani pee eiwuang'ie ninye ilasuriaa te iyiook.” Neomonoki Musa iltung'ana.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Intobiru olasurai opi nipik shumata eng'ape; ore ake pooki ng'ae oonyi, te neing'or ninye, nepok.”
Neaku eitobirua Musa olasurai lo suyai nepik shumata e ng'ape; naa te nelo neony olasurai likae tung'ani, neing'or ninye ilo asurai lo suyai nepok.
Nedumunye iltung'ana le Israel nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Obot.
Neitoki aadumunye te Obot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Iye-abarim, te ilo purkel oipirare Moab, te nchoto e nkilepunoto e nkolong.
Nedumunye teine aapuo, neun ilng'oborri to erata le Sared.

Nedumunye teine aapuo neun ilng'oborri te nkae shoto e Arnon, naa ninye natii ina ong'ata, nelo abaiki olpolosie loo le Amori; amu ore apa Anon naa ninye olpolosie le Moab, te rishata e Moab o le Amori.
Neaku etejoki apa te mbuku oo njorin o Laitoriani, “Waheb te Sufa, o erat le Arnon,
o lelo ooshong'ishong le lelo erat oopuo aabaya entonata e Ari, nepuo o meikobo olpolosie le Moab.”
Nepuo teine o metabaiki Beeri, aa taa, olchorro apa laa ninye etiaakinye Olaitoriani Musa, “Inturrurro iltung'ana te nebo, pee aisho nanu enkare.”
Nerany apa Israel ele sinkolio: “Turukunye, na shorro! - Entaranyaki ninye!
Ena shorro apa natuturo ilkituaak, natoota ilooyanyiti loo ltung'ana, too rinkan lenye le nkitoo o too ng'usidin enye.” Neitoki aadumunye to lpurkel nepuo Matana.
Nedumunye te Matana nepuo Nahaliel, nedumunye te Nahaliel nepuo Bamot,
nedumunye te Bamot nepuo ilo erata otii enkop e Moab, enchumata e Pisga, ine nerumaki kop o lpurkel.
Neitoki Israel airriwaki Sihon ilkiliku, ilo aiguanani le Amori, nejoki,

“Inchooki nanu maima atua enkop ino; mikimbelekenya iyiook aapuo olokeri aashu enkurma oo sabibu, mikiok iyiook enkare enchorro; eikipuo iyiook aaim ina oitoi nalala o laiguanani o metaba anaa nikimpang tiatua enkop ino.”
Kake etanya Sihon eisho Israel meima atua enkop enye. Neiturrur ninye iltung'ana lenyena pooki te nebo, neipang alo aarare Israel to lpurkel, nebau Yahas, nearare Israel.
Nesesekuan Israel ninye te nepi o lalem, neya enkop enye ebaiki Arnon o metabaiki Yabok o meshomo abaiki ile Amori; amu Yaser apa olpolosie loo le Amori.
Neya Israel nena anas pooki, nemany Israel nena anas pooki oo le Amori, te Heshbon o nkang'itie enyena pooki kutiti.
Amu Heshbon apa enkanasa e Sihon ilo aiguanani loo le Amori, laa ninye otaarare olaiguanani le dukuya le Moab, neya enkop pooki aitung'uaa ninye o metabaiki Arnon.
Neaku kejo ilaranyak loo nkaatini, “Wootu Heshbon, nchoo esheti ninye, nchoo enkanasa e Sihon metesheti aaitagol.
Amu eipang'ua enkima te Heshbon, eipang'ua olng'ejep le nkima te nkanasa e Sihon, Eidaikie Ari e Moab, o lkituaak loo neeika e Arnon.
Oi iyie, Moab! Indaaitie lo tung'ana le Kemosh! Eitaa ninye ilayiok lenyena ilaisikak, neitaa intoyie enyena iyararot, o laiguanani le Amori, oji Sihon.
Eidaayie eishoi enye te Heshbon, o metabaiki Dibon, kindaikie iyiook o metaba anaa nebaiki enkima Medeba.”
Nemany apa Israel enkop oo le Amori.
Neirriwaa Musa iltung'ana meshomo aaikitalan Yaser; neya ninche inkang'itie enye kutiti, neiwuang'ie lelo apa le Amori oomanya ine.
Neitoki ninche aaibelekenya neilep aaim enkoitoi e Bashan; ore Oog olaiguanani le Bashan nelotu aarare ninche, ninye o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, pee epuo aaitayu olarrabal te Edrei.

Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Miureyu iyie ninye; amu aishorua nanu ninye apik atua inkaik inono, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki o enkop enye; naa ilo iyie aitaas ninye anaa enintaasa Sihon olaiguanani le Amori, apa omanya Heshbon.”
Neaku etasesekuana apa Isiraeli Oog o layiok lenyena o ltung'ana lenyena pooki o metaba anaa neaku meetae obo aa taa olaishirani otelekua te ninye; neya ninche ina kop aaitaa enenye.
Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aadumunye, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri teina kop naisiasha e Moab, te lido kekun le Yordan te mbata e Yeriko.
Netoduaa apa Balak olayioni le Sipor nena pooki naaitaasa Isiraeli ile Amori.
Neirut oleng Moab te nkaraki iltung'ana, amu eikumok apa oleng; eidimua apa Moab enkuretisho eure iltung'ana le Israel.

Nejoki Moab lelo payiani le Midian, “Kemeju taata ele orora pooki toki namanita iyiook, anaa enameju olkiteng inkujit e ong'ata.” Neaku ore apa Balak olayioni le Sipor, laa ninye apa olaiguanani le Moab teina kata,

neirriwaki Balak ilkiliku Balaam olayioni le Beor te Peter, apa aa ninye nataaniki Olkeju, tiatua enkop e Amawa pee eipotu ninye, ajoki, “Ng'ura, eileputua olorere te Misiri; oitoipo oriong olchoni le nkop, naaetuo aatalakinore te manyisho.

Wou naa taata, tediaa kulo tung'ana te nkaraki nanu, amu aimagil ninche te nanu; pee ebaiki namir nanu ninche naidurrie nanu ninche tena kop; amu kayiolo nanu ajo ore ilo limayian iyie nemayiana, ore ilo lidek netediaaki.”
Nepuo ilpayiani le Moab o lpayiani le Midian eibung'ita mpisai naalakieki enaibon too nkaik enye; nepuonu ninche enetii Balaam, neisho ninye olkilikuai le Balak.
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Erraga ene ena kewarie, amu kayaki nanu intae olomoni anaa enaairorie nanu Olaitoriani;” neaku etotona apa lelo kituaak le Moab te nebo Balaam.
Nelotu Enkai enetii Balaam nejoki, “Kakua tung'ana kulo ootii te nebo iyie?”
Nejoki Balaam Enkai, “Balak olayioni le Sipor, olaiguanani le Moab ninye laairriwaka olkilikuai ejo,
‘Ng'ura eileputua olorere te Misiri neiput oriong olchoni le nkop; wou naa taata tediaa te nkaraki nanu; pee ebaiki naarare nanu ninche naidurrie ninche.’ ”
Nejoki Enkai Balam, “Milo iyie te nebo ninche; midek iyie kulo tung'ana, amu kemayiana ninche.”
Neinyototo Balam tadekenya, nejoki lelo kituaak le Balak, “Enchom enkop inyi, amu etanya Olaitoriani alo te nebo intae.”
Neaku etudumunye lelo kituaak le Moab nepuo enetii Balak, nejoki. “Etanya Balaam elotu te nebo iyiook.”
Neigil ake Balak airriwaa ilkituaak, iltung'ana kumok oyanyiti alang lelo le dukuya.
Nepuonu ninche enetii Balaam nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Balak olayioni le Sipor: ‘Mincho kimbooyo ae toki eitu ilotu enatii;
amu kesipa kaaisho nanu iyie enkanyit kitok, ore entoki pooki naba anaa enikijoki iyie naa kaas; wou tediaa ele orere te nkaraki nanu.’ ”

Kake etawala apa Balaam ajoki lelo sinkan le Balak, “Ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa kaaisho Balak enkaji enye ebore enkosholai o saabu, maidim nanu ashomo atogiroi enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai ai, aitodorropu aashu aitulus.
Atoomono naa intae, enyaaki erraga ene ena kewarie, pee atum atayiolo enaaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki nanu.”
Nelotu Enkai enetii Balaam kewarie nejoki ninye, “Tenaa eikietuo lelo tung'ana aaipot iyie, inyo, shomo te nebo ninche; kake ina ake naajoki iyie, ninye taasa.”
Neaku etudumunye apa Balaam tadekenya, neirot osikiria lenye, nelo te nebo lelo kituaak le Moab.

Kake eyupuyupo engoro e Nkai te nkaraki nashomo ninye; nelo olmalaika lo Laitoriani aitashe te nkoitoi anaa olmang'atinta lenye. Nekedito apa Balaam osikiria, netii isinkan lenyena oaare te nebo ninye.
Nedol ilo sikiria olmalaika lo Laitoriani eitashe te nkoitoi eeta enchutati olalem te nkaina enye; neibelekenya ilo sikiria apaash enkoitoi, nelo ong'ata; neosh Balaam ilo sikiria aboiniki enkoitoi.
Neitoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani alo aitashe to lgos le nkoitoi napirik, te rishata oo sabibu, netii ake esuntai pooki shoto.
Ore ake pee edol ilo sikiria ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, nelo arepaa esuntai, nepudaki enkeju e Balaam esuntai; neitoki ninye aosh.
Neitoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani aigut alo dukuya, nelo aitashe te wueji ronkai te nkoitoi, nemetii ewueji neibelekenyakino te nkalo e tatene aashu te nkalo e kedianye.
Ore ake pee edol ilo sikiria olmalaika lo Laitoriani, neirrag te nkop ti abori Balaam; neyupuyup engoro e Balaam, neosh ninye ilo sikiria te ng'udi enye.
Nebol Olaitoriani enkutuk e ilo sikiria, nejoki ninye Balaam, “Kainyoo nanu aaitaasa iyie, pee kitoosho iyie nanu katitin uni?”
Nejoki Balaam ilo sikiria, “Te nkaraki nikigira iyie aiguranie nanu. Kenyor naji naa kaata olalem, pee aatum atara iyie tua.”
Nejoki ilo sikiria Balaam, “Emara nanu osikiria lino, naa ninye itakedo te nkishui ino pooki o metabaiki ena olong? Katamoo nanu aaitaas iyie ena?” Nejoki Balaam, “A'a.”
Nebol Olaitoriani nkonyek e Balaam, nedol ninye ilo malaika lo Laitoriani eitashe te nkoitoi eeta enchutati o lalem te nkaina enye; neirrug Balaam endukuya enye, nebatata te nkomom.
Nejoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee itoosho osikiria lino kuna katitin uni? Ng'ura, aewuo nanu pee aaibooyo amu ore enkoitoi ino naa kepaashare enkoitoi ai;
natoduaa nanu ele sikiria, naaibelekenya apaash nanu kuna katitin pokira uni. Te neme kaaibelekenye ninye apaash, esipa, anaata aatara iyie tua napal ninye eishu.”

Neitoki Balaam ajoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, “Ataasa nanu eng'oki, amu eitu nanu ayiolou ajo itii enkoitoi pee kimbooyo nanu. Ore naa taata, tenaa embae torrono ena too nkonyek inono, karrinyo nanu alo.”
Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani Balaam, “Shomo iyie te nebo kulo tung'ana; kake ilo rorei ake laaliki ninye shomo iroro.” Neaku eshomo apa Balaam te nebo lelo kituaak le Balak.
Ore ake pee ening Balak inchere eewuo Balaam, neipang ninye alo anang'are ninye te nkanasa e Moab, te ilo polosie oitayu olkeju te Arnon, te ilo polosie kewan.
Nejoki Balak Balaam, “Keitu nanu airriu ilkiliku pee kimpoti iyie? Kainyoo pee eitu iyie ilotu enatii? Eimaaidim nanu ayanyita iyie?” Nejoki Balaam Balak, “Oi, aewuo nanu enitii?
Keton nanu aata ae golon nairorie ai toki? Ilo rorei opik Enkai enkutuk ai, ninye nanu airo.”
Nelo Balaam te nebo Balak, nepuonu Kariat-husot.
Nepolos Balak ilmong'i o ntare, neyaki Balaam o lelo kituaak ootii te nebo ninye.
Ore pee ekenyu nerik Balak Balaam o metabaiki Bamotbaal; ore teine nedol ninye emurte nataaniki oo ltung'ana.
Neitoki Balaam ajoki Balak, “Teshetakaki nanu ilpereren oopishana lo lasar tene, nikincho nanu iloing'ok oopishana o lmeregeshi oopishana.”
Neas Balak anaa ina natejo Balaam; ore Balak o Balaam neishoru ake to lperere lo lasar oloing'oni o lmeregesh.

Neitoki Balaam ajoki Balak, “Intasho te mbata o lasar lino opejori, mashomo nanu amu keidimayu naalotu nanu Olaitoriani atumore; naa ore pooki naba anaa enaaitodol nanu naaliki iyie.” Neilep ninye alo ewueji neisiasha neika.
Netumore Enkai Balaam; nejoki Balaam ninye, “Aitobira ilpereren lo lasar oopishana, naishorua nanu te nchumata e pooki perere, oloing'oni o lmeregesh.”
Nepik Olaitoriani ororei enkutuk e Balaam, nejoki ninye, “Torrinyoyu iyie shomo enetii Balak, naa inji shomo tiaaki.”
Nerrinyo ninye alo enetii ninye, nedol eitashe ninye te nebo ilkituaak pooki le Moab te mbata e ilo asar lenye opejori.
Neraposhoki Balaam ajo, “Te Aram aaipoto nanu Balak, ilo aiguanani le Moab oing'uaa ildoinyio lo loosaen: ‘Wou tediaa Yakobo te nkaraki nanu, naa wou ilepilepaki Israel!’
Kaji nanu aiko te nadek ilo leitu edek Enkai? Kaji nanu aiko te nailepilepaki ilo leitu eilepilepaki Olaitoriani?
Amu ore too nchumat oo ldoinyo nadol nanu ninye, te nchumata oo ndoinyo aing'or nanu ninye; nadol olorere ootoni o openy, nemeshulare ninche kulikae oreren!
Kaing'ae naidim aikena inkera e Yakobo naaba anaa enterit, aashu ematua e ong'uan e Israel? Intasho matua nanu keeya o ltung'ani supat, naa nchoo enkiting'oto ai etiu anaa enenye!”
Nejoki Balak Balaam, “Kainyoo ena nikintaasa iyie nanu? Aayawua iyie pee ilotu adek ilmang'ati laainei, naa ng'ura, meeta ae nitaasa itamayiana ake.”
Newal ninye ajo, “Eimaning nanu nairo ina natipika Olaitoriani atua enkutuk ai?”
Nejoki Balak Balaam, “Wou te nebo nanu maape ae wueji, nindimie iyie atodolie ninche; idol iyie emurte nabayie te ninche, kake midol ninche pooki; pee itum iyie atediaa ninche te nkaraki nanu teine.”
Nerik ninye ong'ata e Sifim o meitabaiki enchumata e Pisga, neshet ilpereren oopishana lo lasar neishoru ake oloing'oni o lmeregesh to lperere ake pooki lo lasar.
Nejoki Balaam Balak, “Ntasho tene te mbata o lasar lino opejori, mashomo atumore Olaitoriani te idie.”
Netumore Olaitoriani Balaam, nepik ororei enkutuk enye, nejo ninye, “Torrinyokinoyu Balak, naa inji shomo tiaaki.”
Nelo enetii ninye, nedol Balak eitashe ninye te mbata o lasar lenye opejori, o lkituaak le Moab te nebo ninye. Nejoki Balak ninye, “Kainyoo etejo Olaitoriani?”
Neitoki Balaam araposhoki, nejo, “Inyo, Balak, toning'o; toning'oki nanu ara Sipor:
Mme oltung'ani Enkai, eji metaa kelejisho, aashu enkerai e tung'ani eji metaa keirridu. Amaa, keiro ninye nemeitabaya? Aashu kelimu ninye nemeas?
Ng'ura, atang'amua nanu enkitanapata pee amayianisho; etamayianishe ninye, nemalak nanu.
Eitu ninye eing'or olbuket le Yakobo; neitu ninye edol entorroni te Israel. Etii Olaitoriani Enkai enye te nebo ninche, ore embuakunoto o laiguanani netii te nebo ninche.
Eyawua Enkai ninche aitung'uaa Misiri, netiu apa ninche anaa iloata imowuarak o losokuan.
Meetae eushei tialo Yakobo, metii esakut tialo Israel; kepuoi taata aajo tialo Yakobo o Israel, ‘Kaa etaasa Enkai!’
Ng'ura, ele orere! Eilepa anaa elipong o lng'atuny, edumunye anaa olng'atuny odumunye; nemeirrag ninye o metaba anaa nenya ina ng'ues narreshito, neok osarge le ina natasesekuanaki.”
Nejoki Balak Balaam, “Midek ninche katukul, nimimayian ninche katukul.”
Kake etawalikia Balaam Balak ajoki, “Keitu nanu aajoki iyie inchere, ‘Ore pooki naajoki Olaitoriani, naa ina ake aas?’ ”
Nejoki Balak Balaam, “Wou taata maatoriko nanu ae wueji; amu ebaiki neitiship ine Enkai pee idek iyie ninche te nkaraki nanu.”
Nerik Balak Balaam enchumata o ldoinyo le Peor ine netalita olpurkel.
Nejoki Balaam Balak, “Teshetakaki nanu tene ilpereren oopishana lo lasar, nikincho nanu tene iloing'ok oopishana o lmeregeshi oopishana.”
Neas Balak anaa enatiaka Balaam, neishooyo ninye oloing'oni o lmeregesh te pooki perere lo lasar.
Ore ake pee edol Balaam nchere keitiship Olaitoriani te nemayian ninye Israel, neitu ninye elo, anaa te kulie katitin, aing'oru intaleng'o, kake eipirie ninye enkomom enye olpurkel.
Neshumu Balaam inkonyek enyena, nedol Israel etii ilng'oborri, anaa loshon. Nelotu Enkiyang'et e Nkai shumata ninye,
neraposhoki ninye, nejo, “Irorei le Balaam olayioni le Beor, irorei le ilo tung'ani otaboloki enkong'u enye,
irorei le ilo oning irorei le Nkai, ilo odol enduata o Laidimani, otabatate, kake meimulumul inkonyek enyena:
kebaa esidano oo lng'oborri linono, iyie Yakobo, o emanyisho ino, iyie Israel!
Eikununo anaa ierat oopuo eniaado, anaa nkurman naatii embata e wuaso, enyaanyukie osuguroi otuno Olaitoriani, eikununo anaa iltarakua ootii embata e nkare.
Kedooyo enkare too ltooi lenyena, ore olantererai lenye neaku inkariak kumok etii, ore olaiguanani lenye naa ninye olusoo alang Agag, ore enkitoo enye naa kebul.
Eyawua Enkai ninye aitupuku te Misiri; netiu ninye anaa oloata mouarak o losokuan, kelo ninye aijoo lelo oshon mang'ati lenyena, negil iloik lenye aitaa mbelibelat, neng'or ninche too mbaa enyena.
Eirraga ninye anaa olng'atuny, naa amaa, amu eikununo anaa elipong o lng'atuny, aing'ae olo ainyeyie ninye? Kemayiana pooki ng'ae likimayian iyie, nediaa pooki ng'ae likidek iyie.”

Neyupuyup engoro e Balak tialo Balaam, neosh ninye inkaik, neitoki Balak ajoki Balaam, “Aaipotuo nanu iyie pee ilotu adek ilmang'ati laainei, naa ng'ura, itamayiana iyie ninche kuna katitin pokira uni.
Ore naa taata isika shomo ewueji ino; atejo apa nanu, ‘Kaayanyit iyie,’ kake kimboo Olaitoriani amitiki enkanyit.”
Nejoki Balaam Balak, “Keitu apa nanu ajoki lelo kiliku linono likirriwaka nanu,

‘Tenaa naaji ninye kaaisho Balak enkaji enye ebore enkosholai o saabu, nemaidim ake ashomo atapaasha ororei lo Laitoriani, aas esidai aashu entorrono te yieunoto ai makewan, ore ina najo Olaitoriani naa ina nanu airo?’
“Ore naa, kalo nanu enetii iltung'ana laainei; wou, pee aaliki nanu enepuo kulo tung'ana aaitaas iltung'ana linyi, too nkolong'i e siadi.”
Neitoki ninye araposhoki, nejo, “Irorei le Balaam olayioni le Beor, irorei lo ltung'ani otaboloki enkong'u enye,
irorei le ilo oning irorei le Nkai, neyiolo eng'eno e Ilo otii shumata Aisul ilo odol enduata o Laidimani, ilo obatata, kake eitu eimulumul inkonyek enyena.

Adolita nanu ninye, kake mme tena kata; adolita ninye, kake metaana; eipang'ua olakira tiatua Yakobo, naa keilepu eng'udi enkitoo te Israel; kedany ninye olpura le nkomom le Moab. Negiligil ilayiok pooki le Sheti.
Kepuoi aaya Edom, ore Seir o ilmang'ati lenyena naa kepuoi aaya, ore Israel neisulu,
Te Yakobo easisho engolon e nkitoo, ore lelo aishirak too nkanas neidaikieki!”
Neitoki ninye aing'or Amalek, neraposhoki ajo, “Amalek apa olayioni le dukuya loo loshon, kake ore te siadi naa keidaikieki.”
Neitoki aing'or ile Kain, neraposhoki, nejo, “Kegol neserian ina manyisho ino, ore enkaji netipikaki enchumata endapidapoi;
Kake ore ake eyia, keidaikieki Kain. Ke nkata kenya nabaa kiyaita Ashur aaraya?”
Neitoki araposhoki ajo, “Amaa, kaing'ae kenya elekuni te neas Enkai ena?
Kake kepuonu imelin naaing'uaa Kitim, naa kepuonu aaisilisil Ashur o Eber; kake kelo ake sii ninye aidak.”
Neitoki Balaam adumunye nelo ewueji enye; nelo sii Balak te nkoitoi enye.
Ore apa ina kata emanya Israel Shitim neiteru iltung'ana aaiborrie onyek too ntoyie e Moab.
Ore kuna ng'oruo neitoomon iltung'ana too lasarri loo nkaitin enye, nenya iltung'ana, neirrugokino inkaitin enye.
Neaku eteenikia Israel kewan Baal e Peor. Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani tialo Israel;
nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Iwa lelo arikok pooki loo ltung'ana, ililio ninche to ldalati te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee etum ina goro napi o Laitoriani atapaasha Israel.”
Nejoki Musa lelo arishak le Israel, “Nchoo ake pooki ng'ae te intae esesekuan oltung'ani lenye oteenikia kewan esinkaisho e Baal e Peor.”

Nelotu oltung'ani obo loo ltung'ana le Israel, ayau enkitok e Midian atua olmarei lenye, too nkonyek e Musa o too nkonyek e ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel ina kata apa eishirita ninche te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.
Ore ake pee edol Finehas olayioni le Eliesa, ilo ayioni le Aron olapolosani, nedumunye ninye alo aing'uaa ilo turrur, nedumu empere te nkaina enye

nelo asujaa ilo tung'ani le Israel o meshomo olgilata li atua, nerem pokira are, ilo tung'ani le Israel o ina kitok, aipang'ie empere to sesen lenye. Ina taa pee eiwuang'ieki olmeitai too ltung'ana le Israel.
Ore ake eyia, lelo apa ootuata to lmeitai naa inkalifuni tikitam o ong'uan.
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,
“Ore Finehas, olayioni le Eliesa, olayioni le Aron olapolosani, neiwuang'ie engoro ai too Siraeli nchere eeta ninye olom lai tiatua ninche, metaa eitu nanu amut iltung'ana le Israel to lom lai.
Metaa tiaaki ninye, ‘Kaaisho nanu ninye osotua lai le seriani;

naa keaku te ninye o te ishoi enye, te siadi ninye, ilo ning'o lo sotua le mpolosare e anaake, te nkaraki naata ninye olom te nkaraki Enkai enye, neitobira olning'o lo sotua too ltung'ana le Israel!’ ”
Ore apa enkarna e ilo tung'ani le Israel otasesekuanaki te nebo enkitok e Midian, naa Simri olayioni le Salu, laa endukuya enkaji oo loo menye le nkaji oo le Simeon.
Ore apa enkarna e ina kitok e Midian natasesekuanaki naa Kosbi entito e Suri, naa ninye apa endukuya o lorere le nkaji oo loo menye te Midian.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Ntanyamala ile Midian, niosh aar ninche;

amu kintanyamala ninche iyie te nkeleekisho enye, amu ninye etelejie intae teina bae e Peor o teina bae e Kosbi, ina tito o lkitok le Midian, ina anashe enye apa nataraki metua te nkolong o lmeitai te mbae e Peor.”
Ore etulusoyie ilo meitai nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Eliesa olayioni le Aron olapolosani,
“Enkena ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, too nkajijik oo loo menye pooki tiatua Siraeli ooidim aashom olarrabal.”
Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani neirorie ninche too nkisiashat e Moab te mbata o lkeju le Yordan te Yeriko, ejo,
“Enkena iltung'ana, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.” Ore lelo tung'ana le Israel ooetuo aapuku te nkop e Misiri, naa:
Ruben ilo kikau le Israel; ilayiok le Ruben, ile Hanok, ilo marei loo le Hanok; ile Palu, o lmarei loo le Palu;
ile Hesron, o lmarei loo le Hesron; ile Karmi, o lmarei loo le Karmi.
Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Ruben; ore esiana enye naa inkalifuni artam o okuni o iip naapishana o tomoni uni.
Ore ilayiok le Palu naa: Eliab.

Ore ilayiok le Eliab naa: Nemuel, Datan o Abiram. Kulo apa etegeluaki te umata, Datan o Abiram metaa ilarikok lo lturrur, ootekeshare Musa o Aron to lturrur le Kora, ina kata apa pee ekeshare ninche Olaitoriani,
neng'a enkop enkutuk enye neijoo ninche te nebo Kora o ilo turrur otuata pee emut enkima iltung'ana iip are o onom, neaku ninche enkikoo.
Ore ake etiu neijia, eitu eye ilayiok le Kora.
Ilayiok le Simeon te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Nemuel o lmarei loo le Nemuel; ile Yamin o lmarei loo le Yamin, ile Yakin o lmarei loo le Yakin;
ile Sera o lmarei loo le Sera; ile Shaul o lmarei loo le Shaul.
Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Simeon, inkalifuni tikitam o are o iip o are.
Ilayiok le Gad te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Sefon o lmarei loo le Sefon, ile Hagi o lmarei loo le Hagi, ile Shuni o lmarei loo le Shuni;
ile Osini o lmarei loo le Osini, ile Eri o lmarei loo le Eri;
ile Arod o lmarei loo le Arod, ile Areli o lmarei loo le Areli.
Kulo ninche ilmareita loo layiok le Gad, te risioroto e siana enye, inkalifuni artam o iip imiet.
Ore ilayiok le Yuda naa Eri o Onan; netuata apa Eri o Onan te nkop e Kanaan.
Ore ilayiok le Yuda te risioroto oo lmareita lenye naa: ile Shela o lmarei loo le Shela; ile Peres o lmarei loo le Peres, ile Sera o lmarei loo le Sera.
Ore ilayiok le Peres naa: ile Hesron o lmarei loo le Hesron, ile Hamul o lmarei loo le Hamul.
Kulo apa ninche ilmareita le Yuda te risioroto e siana enye, inkalifuni ntomoni naapishana o ile o iip imiet.
Ilayiok le Isaakar te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Tola o lmarei loo le Tola; ile Puni o lmarei loo le Puni;
ile Yashub o lmarei loo le Yashub; ile Shimron o lmarei loo le Shimron.
Kulo apa ninche ilmareita le Isaakar te risioroto e siana enye, inkalifuni ntomoni ile o ong'uan o iip uni.
Ilayiok le Sebulon te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Sered o lmarei loo le Sered, ile Elon o lmarei loo le Elon; ile Yaleel o lmarei loo le Yaleel.
Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Sebulon te risioroto e siana enye, inkalifuni ntomoni ile o iip imiet.
Ilayiok le Yosef te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: Manase o Efraim.
Ilayiok le Manase: ile Makir o lmarei loo le Makir, naa Makir apa ninye menye le Gilead. Ile Gilead o lmarei loo le Gilead.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Gilead: Ileseri; ile Heler o lmarei loo le Heler, ile Helek o lmarei loo le Helek,
ile Asiriel o lmarei loo le Asiriel; o le Shekem o lmarei loo le Shekem,
o le Shemida o lmarei loo le Shemida; o le Heper o lmarei loo le Heper.
Ore apa Selofehad olayioni le Heper nemeeta ilayiok kake keeta intoyie; ore inkarn oo ntoyie e Selofehad naa Mahala o Noa o Hogla o Milka o Tirsa.
Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Manase, ore esiana enye naa inkalifuni onom o oaare o iip naapishana.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Efraim te risioroto oo lmareita lenye; ile Shutela o lmarei loo le Shutela; ile Beker o lmarei loo le Bekeri; ile Tahani o lmarei loo le Tahani.
Naa kulo ninche ilayiok le Shutela; ile Erani o lmarei loo le Erani.
Kulo ninche ilmareita loo layiok le Efraim te risioroto e siana enye, inkalifuni tomoni uni oaare o iip imiet. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Yosef te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.
Ilayiok le Benchamen te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Bela; ile Ashebel o lmarei loo le Ashbel; ile Ahiram o lmareita loo le Ahiram;
ile Shefufam o lmarei loo le Shefufam; ile Hufam, o lmareita loo le Hufam.
Ore apa ilayiok le Bela naa Ardi o Naaman: ile Ardi o lmareita loo le Ardi; ile Naaman o lmarei loo le Naaman.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Benchamen te risioroto oo lmareita lenye; ore esiana enye naa inkalifuni artam o imiet o iip ile.
Kulo ninche ilayiok le Dan te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Shuham o lmarei loo le Shuham. Kulo ninche ilmareita le Dan te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.
Ore ilmareita pooki loo le Shuham, te risioroto e siana enye, naa inkalifuni ntomoni ile o ong'uan o iip ong'uan.
Ilayiok le Asheri te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Imna o lmarei loo le Imna, ile Ishfi o lmarei loo le Ishfi, ile Beria o lmarei loo le Beria.
Ilayiok le Beria: ile Heberi o lmarei loo le Heberi, ile Malkiel o lmarei loo le Malkiel.
Ore enkarna e ntito e Asheri naa Sera.
Kulo ninche ilmareita loo layiok le Asheri te risioroto e siana enye inkalifuni onom o okuni o iip ong'uan.
Ilayiok le Naftali te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Yaseel o lmarei loo le Yaseel, ile Guni o lmarei loo le Guni;
ile Yeser o lmarei loo le Yeser, ile Shilem o lmarei loo le Shilem.
Kulo ninche ilmareita le Naftali te risioroto oo lmareita lenye; ore esiana enye naa inkalifuni artam o miet o iip ong'uan.
Ena apa esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel, inkalifuni iip ile o obo o iip naapishana o tomoni uni.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa;
“Keorikini kulo tung'ana enkop pee eaku enjung'ore, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn.
Ore olosho sapuk inchoo enjung'ore sapuk, ore olosho oti nchoo enjung'ore kiti; ore pooki osho neishori ake enjung'ore enye te risioroto e siana enye.
Kake keoshokini ina kop enkukuo; te risioroto oo nkarn oo loshon loo loo menye nejung ninche.
Keori ina jung'ore enye te risioroto e nkukuo to losho sapuk o to loti.”
Kulo ninche ile Lawi anaa enaikenaki te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Gershon o lmarei loo le Gershon, ile Kohat o lmarei loo le Kohat; ile Merari o lmarei loo le Merari.
Kulo ninche ilmareita le Lawi: olmarei loo le Libni o lmarei loo le Hebron o lmarei loo le Mala o lmarei loo le Mushi o lmarei loo le Kora. Naa Kohat apa menye le Amram.
Ore apa enkitok e Amram naa keji Yokebed, entito e Lawi, apa natoikioki Lawi te Misiri; neiki ninye Amram Aron o Musa o Miriam enkanashe enye.
Ore to lmarei le Aron neini Nadab o Abihu o Eliesa o Itamar.
Kake etua apa Nadab o Abihu ina kata apa pee eitarasaki Olaitoriani enkima nemesinya.

Ore apa lelo ooikenaki te ninche naa inkalifuni tikitam o okuni, pooki lee lo lari obo neilep; amu eitu apa eikeni ninche te nebo iltung'ana le Israel, amu meetae apa enjung'ore naishooki ninche te nebo iltung'ana le Israel.
Kulo apa ninche lelo ooikena Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani, laa ninche esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel too nkisiashat e Moab te mbata olkeju le Yordan te Yeriko.
Kake ore tiatua kulo metii hoo oltung'ani oikena Musa aashu Aron ilo apolosani, apa oikena iltung'ana le Israel ti ong'ata e Sinai.
Amu etiaaka Olaitoriani ninche, “Kepuo ninche aaye tiong'ota.” Eitu apa eleku oltung'ani te ninche, Kaleb ake olayioni le Yefune o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.

Neitoki aanyiku nena toyie e Selofehad olayioni le Hefer, olayioni le Gilead, olayioni le Makir, olayioni le Manase, olayioni le Yosef. Ore apa inkarn e nena toyie enyena naa: Mahala o Noa o Hogla o Milka o Tirsa.
Neitashe ninche te dukuya Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani o te dukuya lelo arikok o ina umata, te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nejo,
“Etua apa papa lang tiong'ota; metii apa ninye ina umata e lelo ooiturrurrote aapaashare Olaitoriani te ncholiek e Kora, kake etua te nkaraki eng'oki enye makewan; nemeeta apa ilayiok.
Kainyoo naa pee eiwuang'ieki enkarna e papa lang to lmarei lenye, te nkaraki nemeeta olayioni? Nchoo iyiook erubata tiatua ilalashera le papa.”
Neyau Musa ilo omoni lenye dukuya Olaitoriani.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Etisipa nena toyie e Selofehad; nchoo ninche erubata e njung'ore tiatua ilalashera le menye, nincho ina jung'ore e menye lenye meshomo aaku enenye,
Nijoki iyie iltung'ana le Israel, ‘Te neye oltung'ani, nemeeta olayioni, nincho enjung'ore enye meshomo aaku ene ntito enye.
Naa te nemeeta entito, nincho enjung'ore enye eaku enoo lalashera lenyena.
Naa te nemeeta ilalashera, nincho naa enjung'ore enye ilalashera le menye.

Naa te nemeeta menye ilalashera nincho naa enjung'ore enye oltung'ani lenye, laa ninye onyikare olmarei lenye, pee eya ninye. Naa keaku ena enkitanapata o enkikoo too ltung'ana le Israel, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.’ ”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ilepa shomo enchumata ele doinyo le Abarim, pee idol ina kop naishoo nanu iltung'ana le Israel.
Naa ore ake pee indip atoduaa ina kop, nintoki sii iyie alo eneiturrure iltung'ana linono apa ootuata anaa apa enashomo olalashe lino Aron,

te nkaraki nitogolong'aka ororei lai ti ong'ata e Sin, ina kata apa eing'unyung'uny eumata maayanyit aaitisiny nanu te nena ariak apa naatii dukuya inkonyek enye. (Inkariak kuna e Meriba e Kadesh tiong'ata e Sin.)
Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani,
‘Nchoo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo nkiyang'eta e pooki naaishu egelu oltung'ani oitasheiki ena umata,
oipang alo dukuya ninche, nejing'u alotu te dukuya ninche, orikoo ninche aipang'ie neriku ninche aitijing'u; pee metiu eumata o Laitoriani anaa nkerra nemeeta olchekut.’ ”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Iwa Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo tung'ani otii enkiyang'et atua ninye, ninteleiki inkaik shumata ninye.
Nchoo ninye meitasho te dukuya Eliesa ilo apolosani o ina umata pooki, nintanap aisho enkitoo te dukuya ninche.
Inchopoki ninye embata e nkitoria ino, pee etum eumata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel aatoning.

Naa keitashe ninye te dukuya Eliesa ilo apolosani, laa ninye oikilikuanisho te nkaraki ninye, te nkiguana e Urim te dukuya Olaitoriani; to rorei lenye eipang ninche aapuo naa to rorei lenye ninche ejing'u atua, ninye o ltung'ana pooki le Israel ootii te nebo ninye, ina umata pooki.”
Neas Musa anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani; neya ninye Yoshua neitasheyie ninye te dukuya Eliesa ilo apolosani o ina umata pooki,
eiteleiki ninye inkaik enyena shumata ninye, neitanap ninye aisho enkitoo anaa enatuutua Olaitoriani aimunye Musa.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Ntanapa iltung'ana le Israel, tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore olasar lai, endaa ai too lasarri laainei le nkima, esong'ouna ai narropil, embung'a pee kintarasakiki nanu te rishata enye.’
Naa tiaaki iyie ninche, Olasar le nkima ele linchosho intae Olaitoriani: isitiman oaare le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entibili, anaake, pee eaku olasar loo nkolong'i pooki.
Ore olkuoo obo nipolososo tadekenya, ore olikae kuo nipolososo teipa;
ore ematua e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui nintayuyu pee eaku olasar le ntapa, naipurjaki te matua e ong'uan e hini e ilata naidong'oki.
Olasar ele opejori anaake apa oitanapishoteki to ldoinyo le Sinai, te nkaraki esong'ouna narropil, olasar le nkima oishori Olaitoriani.
Ore olasar ooki naa erubata nabo e ong'uan e hini to sitima ake obo; teine wueji sinyati shomo tipika ilo asar ooki oirrusha nchoo Olaitoriani.
Ore olikae kuoo shomo topolosa teipa, anaa ilo asar le ntapa le tadekenya o anaa ilo asar ooki, shomo nchooi anaa olasar le nkima, esong'ouna nerropil te nkaraki Olaitoriani.’”

“Ore te nkolong e Sabato, enchooi isitiman oaare le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto o ematua e are e tomon e Efa e ntapa napuyiapui pee eaku olasar le ntapa, eipurjaki te ilata o ilo asar lenye ooki:
ele ninye olasar opejori le pooki olong e Sabato, te nebo ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar ooki.
“Ore too nkiterunot oo lapaitin linyi ninchooyoyo olasar opejori aaisho Olaitoriani: iloing'ok oaare ooti o lmeregesh obo o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto;
o matuan uni e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui pee eaku olasar le ntapa, naipurjaki te ilata, te pooki oing'oni o matuan are e tomon e ntapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata to lmeregesh obo;
o ematua nabo e tomon e ntapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata anaa olasar le ntapa to lkuoo ake obo le ker; pee eaku olasar opejori le song'ouna narropil; olasar le nkima oishori Olaitoriani.

Ore olasar lenye ooki naa keaku olpisiai le hini le naisho oo sabibu to loing'oni ake obo o entemata e uni e hini to lmeregesh, naa entemata e uni e ong'uan e hini to lkuoo le ker; ele ninye olasar opejori te pooki apa too lapaitin pooki lo lari
o sitima obo sii le kine te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki oishori Olaitoriani; keitayuni ninye te nebo ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar lenye ooki.
“Ore te nkolong e tomon o ong'uan olapa le dukuya naa Pasaka o Laitoriani.
Naa ore te nkolong e tomon o imiet ele apa naa enkolong o sirua; nkolong'i naapishana einosi imukateni neitu eisuishieki.
Ore te nkolong e dukuya naa keaku eumata sinyati: mias esiaai e sinkaisho,
kake enchooi olasar le nkima, olasar opejori te nkaraki Olaitoriani: iloing'ok oaare ooti o lmeregesh obo o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo; toduaa nchere meeta entioto;
o lasarri sii lenye le ntapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata; imatuan uni e efa te tomon nchooi to loing'oni obo o matuan are e tomon to lmeregesh;
nchooi ematua nabo e tomon te pooki meregesh le lelo oopishana;
o sitima obo le kine pee eaku olasar le ng'oki pee eitayunyeki olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki iyie.
Nchooi iyie kuna te nebo olasar opejori le tadekenya, laa olasar le mpejoroto le anaake.
Naa teina oitoi ake inchooi anaake, too nkolong'i naapishana, ina daa o lasar opejori te nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani; keitarasari ninye te nebo ilo asar le anaake o ilo asar lenye ooki.
Naa ore te nkolong e naapishana nimbung'ubung'u eumata nasinya; nimiasiasa esiaai nagol.

“Ore te nkolong oo lng'anayio le dukuya, ti ninchooyo iyie olasar le ntapa te nkaraki entapa ng'ejuk naishori Olaitoriani, te ilo sirua linyi loo wikii, ninturrurrorro aaibung eumata sinyati; nimiasiasa esiaai nagol,
kake entarasai olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani: iloing'ok oaare ooti o lmeregesh obo, isitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo;
o lasar le ntapa napuyiapui, naipurja te ilata o matuan uni e tomon e efa to loing'oni ake obo o matuan are e tomon e efa to lmeregesh,
o ematua nabo e tomon te pooki ake ninye sitima le ker le lelo oopishana;
te nebo o sitima obo le kine, pee eitobir osotua lo lning'o te nkaraki intae.
Ore te nebo ilo asar opejori le anaake o lasar lenye le ntapa, ntarasai iyie ninche te nebo o ilo asar lenye ooki. Toduaa nchere meeta ninche entioto.
“Ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa liopishana, enturrurroto embung'a eumata nasinya; miasiasa esiaai nagol. Enkolong ina te intae nioshiosho imowuarak,
ninchooyoyo olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani: oloing'oni obo oti o lmeregesh obo o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto;
o lasar sii lenye le ntapa napuyiapui, naipurjaki te ilata o ematua e uni e tomon e efa to loing'oni ake, ematua e are e tomon to lmeregesh,
o ematua nabo e tomon to sitima ake le ker le lelo oopishana;
te nebo ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, pee eitobir osotua lo lning'o te nkaraki intae.

Nepudare ilo asar opejori lo lapa ng'ejuk, olasar lenye le ntapa o ilo asar opejori le anaake o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki, te risioroto e ina kitanapa enye, esong'ouna narropil, olasar le nkima oishori Olaitoriani.
“Ore te nkolong e tomon ele apa li opishana, ninturrurrorro intae aaibung eumata sinyati, nieniene ate, nimiasiasa esiaai,
kake entarasai olasar opejori aaisho Olaitoriani, esong'uona narropil: oloing'oni obo oti o lmeregesh obo o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo; nchoo eaku meeta ntiot;
o lasarri lenye le ntapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata o matuan uni e tomon e efa, to loing'oni obo o matuan are e tomon to lmeregesh obo,
o e matua nabo e tomon te pooki sitima le ker le lelo oopishana:
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, te nebo ilo asar lenye leilo sotua lo lning'o o ilo asar le anaake opejori o ilo asar lenye le ntapa o lasarri lenye ooki.
“Ore te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa li opishana, ninturrurrorro aaibung eumata nasinya; miasiasa esiaai nagol embung'a osirua lo Laitoriani inkolong'i naapishana;
ninchooyoyo olasar opejori, ilo asar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani, iloing'ok tomon o okuni o lmeregeshi oaare o sitiman tomon o ong'uan le kerra lo lari obo; naa lelo lemeeta ntiot;
o lasari lenye le ntapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata o matuan uni e tomon e efa ti obo ake le lelo oing'ok tomon o okuni o matuan are e tomon to lmeregesh ake obo te lelo pokira are,
o ematua nabo e tomon te pooki sitima le lelo sitiman le kerra tomon o ong'uan;
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki epudare ilo asar le anaake o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasarri lenye ooki.
“Ore te nkolong e are entopolos iloing'ok tomon o are ooti o lmeregeshi oaare o sitiman tomon o ong'uan lo lari obo lemeeta intiot,
te nebo olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki te lelo oing'ok o loo lmeregeshi o loo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;
o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori li anaake o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasarri lenye ooki.
“Ore te nkolong e uni naa iloing'ok tomon o obo o lmeregeshi oaare o sitiman le kerra tomon o ong'uan lo lari obo lemeeta ntiot,
te nebo olasar le ntapa o lasarri ooki te lelo oing'ok o loo lmeregeshi o loo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata.
Te nebo sii ositima obo le kine to lasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki.
“Ore te nkolong e ong'uan naa iloing'ok tomon o lmeregeshi oaare o sitiman tomon o ong'uan le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto,
te nebo ilo asar le ntapa o lasarri ooki, te lelo oing'ok, o lelo meregeshi o te lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;
te nebo ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki.
“Ore te nkolong e imiet naa iloing'ok ooudo o lmeregeshi oaare o sitiman le kerra tomon o ong'uan lo lari obo lemeeta entioto,
te nebo ilo asar le ntapa o lelo asarri ooki te lelo oing'ok o te lelo meregeshi o lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;
te nebo sii ositima obo le kine to lasar le ng'oki; epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar lenye le ntapa o ilo asar lenye ooki.
“Ore te nkolong e ile naa iloing'ok isiet o lmeregeshi oaare o sitiman tomon o ong'uan le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta ntiot,
te nebo ilo asar le ntapa o lasarri ooki te lelo oing'ok o too lmeregeshi o te lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;
te nebo sii ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake, ilo asar lenye le ntapa o lelo asarri lenye ooki.
“Ore te nkolong e naapishana naa iloing'ok oopishana o lmeregeshi oaare o sitiman tomon o ong'uan lo lari obo lemeeta ntiot,
te nebo olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki, te lelo oing'ok o lelo meregeshi o lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;
te nebo sii ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake, ilo asar lenye le ntapa o ilo asar lenye ooki.
“Ore te nkolong e isiet embung'a eumata nasinya: miasiasa esiaai nagol,
kake enchooi olasar opejori, ilo asar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani; aapolos oloing'oni obo o lmeregesh obo o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta intiot
o lasar le ntapa o lasarri ooki, to loing'oni ake o to lmeregesh o te lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenare te risioroto e nkitanapata;
te nebo sii ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar lenye le ntapa o ilo asar lenye ooki.

“Kuna ninche intarasakiki Olaitoriani te lelo siruai linyi oogeluno, te nebo lelo asarri linosie olmumai o lasarri linyi le yieunoto, te nkaraki lelo asarri linyi oopejori o lasarri linyi le ntapa o lasarri linyi ooki o lasarri linyi le seriani.”
Neliki Musa iltung'ana le Israel pooki toki anaa ake enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.
Nejoki Musa ilukuny oo loshon loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, “Ena ninye eitanapishe Olaitoriani.

Te nenya oltung'ani olmumai te nkaraki Olaitoriani, aashu te nenya olmumai pee een kewan te mbae natejo, nchoo ninye eaku olemeibelekeny enatejo; nchoo ninye eas te risioroto e ina pooki naimua enkutuk enye.
Aashu te nenya enkitok olmumai te nkaraki Olaitoriani, neen kewan enye teina bae natejo, ina kata eton etii enkaji e papaai lenye, te kitisho enye,
nening menye ilo mumai lenye o ina natejo ninye, nateenie ninye kewan, nemejoki ninye ae, ore ilo mumai lenye pooki neunoyu. Ore pooki natejo ninye aen kewan neunoyu.
Kake te neany menye enyorraa ilo mumai ina olong apa pee ening, nemeitoki atii olmumai te ninye, nemetii eenata e kewan nauno, naa kepaliki Olaitoriani ninye te nkaraki naa menye otomitikio ninye.
Naa te neyami ina kata eton etii eenata eilo mumai lenye, aashu nena kirorot e nkutuk enye naateenie ninye kewan,
nening olpayian lenye ina, neitu ejoki ae ina kata pee ening, ore naa ilo mumai lenye naa keuno, ore nena baa enyena naateenie kewan naa keunoyu.

Kake ore teina olong apa natoning'o olpayian lenye, neany ninye enyorraa, neitaa naa parmetii ilo mumai lenye apa oinosa, o nena kirorot e nkutuk enye, apa naa ninche eteenie kewan. Naa kepaliki Olaitoriani ninye.
Kake ore pooki mumai le nkoliai, aashu le nkitok natung'uayie olmoruo lenye, ore ake ninye entoki nateenie kewan, naa keitalakuni te ninye.
Naa te nenya ninye olmumai tiatua enkaji olpayian lenye, aashu een kewan enye to lmumai,
nening olpayian lenye ina, neitu ejoki ninye ae, neitu erishie ninye; ore ilo mumai lenye pooki naa keunoyu, ore enkiroroto ake pooki nateenie ninye kewan naa keunoyu.

Kake te neitaa olpayian lenye ilo mumai parmetii neitaa pesho ina olong apa pee ening, neaku naa, ore embae pooki naimu enkutuk enye naipirta olmumai lenye aashu naipirta ina enata e kewan nemelo aunoyu; eitaa olpayian lenye pesho, naa kepaliki Olaitoriani ninye.
Ore olmumai pooki o enata olmumai nainosie oltung'ani kewan osina, keidim olpayian lenye atuuno, aashu eidim aitaa parmetii.

Kake te nemejoki olpayian lenye ae te nkolong ake ninye, neitubulaa naa ilo mumai le nkitok enye, o nena pooki naatejo ninye aenie kewan, nena naatii shumata ninye; eitubula ninye ninche te nkaraki neitu ejoki ae ina olong apa naning nena baa.
Kake te neitaa olpayian nena baa pesho neitaa parmetii eidipa ninye atoning'o, nenap naa ninye eng'oki e nkitok enye.”
Kuna ninche inkitanapat naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, naaipirta olee o enkitok enye, olpayian o entito enye, te lelero enye, eton etii enkaji e papaai lenye.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Intalaku elap oo ltung'ana le Israel too ltung'ana le Midian; ore te siadi ina naa ilo iyie eneiturrurrore iltung'ana linono apa ootuata.”
Nejoki Musa olorere, “Enterreten iltung'ana tiatua intae oopuo enjore pee etum aashom aataarare iltungana le Midian, pee eitalaku elap o Laitoriani te Midian.
Irriwai ilewa enkalifu nabo ake to losho pooki le Israel pee epuo enjore.”
Neaku eishoruaki apa kulo lewa, ooing'uaa lelo oora inkalifuni le Israel, oing'uaa ake enkalifu nabo olosho obo, nenapa lelo oora inkalifuni tomon o are aapuo enjore.

Neirriwaa Musa ninche meshomo enjore eing'uaa ake enkalifu nabo olosho obo, te nebo Finehas olayioni le Eliesa ilo apolosani, tenebo nena masaa eine wueji sinyati, neeta te nkaina enye esekekua naosh.
Nearare ninche iltung'ana le Midian anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, near metua olee ake ninye pooki.
Near metuata ilaiguanak le Midian te nebo lelo kulikae ootasesekuanaki: Efi o Rekem o Surian o Hur o Reba lelo aiguanak imiet te Midian neitoki sii aasesekuan Balaam olayioni le Beor to lalem.
Ore lelo tung'ana le Israel neraya nena kituaak e Midian o nkera enye; neraya sii inkishu enye pooki, o nkerrai o ntokitin enye pooki.
Ore inkanas enye pooki too wuejitin neemanya o lng'oborri lenye pooki, nepejoo te nkima,
neya nena pooki naataarutua, aa iltung'ana o nkishu.
Neyau lelo o yarunot o masaa naaruno enetii Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani o ina umata oo ltung'ana le Israel, te lelo ng'oborri ootii enkisiashata e Moab te mbata o lkeju le Yordan te netaaniki Yeriko.
Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani o lelo arikok pooki le ina umata, neipang aapuo aanang'are ina jore ti auluo.
Netagorokine apa Musa lelo kituaak le njore, lelo arikok loo nkalifuni o lelo arikok loo maa iip, ooetuo eing'ua enjore.
Nejoki Musa ninche, “Itapala intae inkituaak pooki eishu?
Kuna apa naaishoo iltung'ana le Israel, te nkiteng'enare e Balaam metogolong'aki Olaitoriani, teina bae e Peor, neaku eewuo olmeitai atua eumata o Laitoriani.
Ore naa taata entaar pooki lee tiatua nena kera kutiti metua, niariara pooki kitok nataboitare olee metua.
Kake ore nena silan pooki kutiti neitu ai kata eboitare olee entapal eishu metaa inkuninyi.

Nchoo etoni ti auluo inkolong'i naapishana; pooki ng'ae ake ninye linyi otasesekuana oltung'ani o pooki ng'ae oiseyie olmeneng'ani, entisinya ate o lelo yarunot linyi te nkolong e uni o te nkolong e naapishana.
Entisinya enkila ake pooki o pooki toki o lchoni o pooki toki naitobiraki too lpapit loo nkineji o pooki toki naguetuno te nchata.”
Nejoki Eliesa ilo apolosani lelo tung'ana ooshomo enjore: “Ena ninye enkikoo e ina kitanapata naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa:
saabu ake o enkosholai o suyai o esekenkei o empirbil o ntokitin naaikununo neijia,
Ore pooki toki nemenya enkima, niimiemie atua enkima naa kesinyayu ninye asidanu. Ore ake etiu neijia, keitukui sii te nkare e nkitisinyata, ore pooki toki nemepikayu enkima, niimiemie atua enkima.
Entukuo ilkilani linyi te nkolong e naapishana, niakuku taa sidain; ore te siadi ina nipuonunu taa atua ilng'oborri.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,
“Nkena nena tokitin naataaruaki, aa iltung'ana o aa nchoo, iyie o Eliesa ilo apolosani o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye e ina umata;
nior nena naataaruaki katitin are, aoriki lelo murran apa ooshomo enjore o e umata pooki.
Neitalaki iltungana le njore o Laitoriani kodi naing'uaa lelo tung'ana le njore ooshomo enjore, obo ake tiatua iip imiet, too ltung'ana o too lmong'i o too sirkon o too nkerrai;
intayu olpisiai lenye nincho Eliesa ilo apolosani pee eaku olasar to Laitoriani.

Ore to lpisiai loo Siraeli loo ltung'ana, le nena tokitin ntayu nabo tiatua onom ake ninye, too ltung'ana o too lmong'i o sirkon o too nkerrai o too nchoo pooki, ninchosho ninche ile Lawi laa ninche ooing'or olng'obor lo Laitoriani.”
Neas Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.
Ore apa nena yarunot naatelekutua naawaita lelo tung'ana le njore naa nkerra inkalifuni iip ile o ntomoni naapishana o imiet,
o nkishu inkalifuni intomoni naapishana o are
o isirkon inkalifuni intomoni ile o obo,
o ltung'ana inkalifuni tomoni uni o are o nkituaak neitu ai kata eboitare olee.
Ore ilo pisiai leina rubata e le lelo apa ooshomo enjore, ore esiana enye naa nkerra inkalifuni iip uni o tomoni uni o opishana o iip imiet,
ore elaakinoto o Laitoriani naa nkerra iip ile o ntomoni naapishana o imiet.
Ore nkishu naa inkalifuni tomoni uni oile, ore te kuna naa intomoni naapishana oaare elaakinoto o Laitoriani.
Ore isirkon naa inkalifuni tomoni uni o iip imiet, ore te kuna naa intomoni ile o obo elaakinoto o Laitoriani.
Ore iltung'ana naa inkalifuni tomon o ile, ore erubata o Laitoriani naa iltung'ana tomoni uni o are.
Neishooyo Musa ina laakinoto, naa ninye olasar to Laitoriani, neisho Eliesa ilo apolosani, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.
Ore inaaing'uaa ilo pisiai te nkalo oo ltung'ana le Israel apa naategelayie Musa aitung'uaa ine, lelo tung'ana apa ooshomo enjore
ore apa olpisiai le nena teina umata naa nkerra inkalifuni iip uni o tomoni uni o opishana o iip imiet (337,500),
o nkishu nkalifuni tomoni uni o ile (36,000),
o sirkon inkalifuni tomoni uni o iip imiet (30,500),
o ltung'ana inkalifuni tomon o ile (16,000).

Ore inaaing'uaa ilo pisiai loo ltung'ana le Israel neya Musa nabo te pooki onom, aa too ltung'ana o too nchoo, neisho ninche lelo le Lawi ooing'or olng'obor lo Laitoriani; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.
Neitoki lelo kituaak ooitasheiki inkalifuni e njore o lelo arikok loo nkalifuni o lairikok le lelo maa iip aapuonu aanyikaki Musa,
nejoki ninche Musa, “Eikena isinkan linono lelo tung'ana le njore ootii abori erikore ang, nemetii oltung'ani oiwuang'a te yiook.

Nikiyautua iyiook olasar lo Laitoriani, entoki ake ninye nanoto oltung'ani, ntokitin e saabu, ilkataarri o mankek o ilgiso o sakankarri o saen, pee kipuonu aaitobiraki ate osotua lo lning'o te dukuya Olaitoriani.”
Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani neng'amaa te ninche ina saabu pooki apa naitaaki imasaa.
Ore ina saabu pooki oo nkishoorot naishoo ninche Olaitoriani, eing'uaa lelo arikok le lelo oora nkalifuni le njore o lelo le maa iip naa shekeli inkalifuni tomon o ile o iip naapishana o onom.
(Ore apa lelo tung'ana le njore newaita nena naataarutua ewa ake oltung'ani inenyena.)

Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani neng'amaa ina saabu te lelo arikok le njore loo nkalifuni o loo maa iip neyau atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, pee eaku entoki nadamuni too ltung'ana le Israel te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Ore apa ilayiok le Ruben o layiok le Gad na keeta inkishu kumok oleng, nedol ninche enkop e Yaser o enkop e Gilead aajo kenyor apa ine wueji inkishu.
Neaku eetuo apa lelo ayiok le Gad o lelo ayiok le Ruben aajoki Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani o lelo arikok le umata,
“Atorat o Dibon o Yaser o Nimra o Heshbon o Eliele o Sebam o Nebo o Beon,
ore ena kop natara Olaitoriani te dukuya eumata e Israel, naa enkop nanyor inkishu, neeta isinkan linono inkishu.”
Nejo ninche, “Tenaa eikinoto iyiook omon too nkonyek inono, nchoo naa isinkan linono meishori ena kop meitaa enenye; mintalang iyiook olkeju le Yordan.”
Kake etiaaka Musa lelo ayiok le Gad o lelo ayiok le Ruben, “Kepuo ilalashera linyi enjore itonini intae tene?
Kainyoo pee igiligili iltauja loo ltung'ana le Israel, aamitiki elang aapuo ina kop apa naishoo Olaitoriani ninche?
Ina apa etaasa loo papaai linyi ina kata pee airriwaa nanu ninche te Kadesh-Barnea meshomo aadol ina kop.
Amu ore apa pee epuo ninche oerata le Eshkol nepuo aadol ina kop, negil ninche iltauja loo ltung'ana le Israel aamitiki epuo ina kop apa naishoo Olaitoriani ninche.
Neyupuyup apa engoro o Laitoriani teina olong, nenya ninye olmumai ejo,

‘Esipa meetae hoo obo le lelo tung'ana apa ooileputua aapuonu te Misiri, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep olo adol ina kop apa nainosie olmumai pee aisho Abraham o Isaak o Yakobo te nkaraki neitu ninche aaunokino aasuj nanu;
meteleku ake Kaleb olayioni le Yefune ilo loo Lkenise o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni amu etusuja ninche Olaitoriani katukul.’
Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani tialo Siraeli, neisho ninche metilimanata ti ong'ata ilarin artam o metaba anaa neishunye ina ishoi apa pooki nataasa entorroni te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Naa ng'ura, itubulua ajing erishata oo loo minyi, entipat oo ltung'ana aing'okok, pee iponaa oleng ina goro o Laitoriani napi tialo Siraeli!
Amu ti nimbelekenyanya aany isujusuju Olaitoriani, naa keigil ninye apalaa intae ti ong'ata, neidaikie intae kulo tung'ana pooki.”
Neitoki ninche aanyikaki ninye nejoki, “Eikishetu iyiook imuatat tene te nkaraki nkerrai ang o nkanas te nkaraki inkera ang,

kake eikidumu iyiook iruparen, nikinapa aapuo dukuya iltung'ana le Israel o metaba anaa nikintabau ninche ewueji enye; ore inkera ang kutiti netoni too nkanas naasheta sunta te nkaraki lelo oomanya ina kop.
Mikirrinyunye iyiook aapuonu nkang'itie ang o metaba anaa nejung oltung'ani ake pooki le Israel enjung'ore enye.
Amu mikijung iyiook te nebo ninche lido kekun le Yordan neito idia alo; amu ore enjung'ore ang neeuo ena shoto e Yordan neito enkalo oloosaen.”
Neaku etiaaka apa Musa ninche, “Ti niasiasa intae ena, tenaa eidumumu intae iruparen aapuo enjore te dukuya Olaitoriani,
ore ake pooki tung'ani linyi oata ruparen nelang olkeju le Yordan alo te dukuya Olaitoriani o metaba anaa nearaa ilmang'ati lenyena aiwuang'ie te dukuya ninye,
neisulieki ina kop te dukuya Olaitoriani; ore naa te siadi ina nindimidimi aatorrinyoto, nimintokiki aatakinore to Laitoriani o te Israel; ore ena kop naa keaku eninyi te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Kake ti nimiasiasa ina, nitaasa naa eng'oki to Laitoriani; naa entayiolo nchere meeta nchere, esipa meinepu intae ina ng'oki inyi.
Enteshetu inkanas te nkaraki inkera inyi kutiti, o muatat te nkaraki nkerrai inyi; niasiasa ina nisiligishore.”
Ore ilayiok le Gad o lelo ayiok le Ruben nejoki Musa, “Keas isinkan linono anaa enaitanapisho olkitok lai.
Ore inkera ang kutiti o nkituaak ang o ntare ang o nkishu ang pooki, kebik te idie too nkanas e Gilead;
kake kegiroo isinkan linono aapuo, pooki tung'ani ake otanape alo enjore, nelo enjore te dukuya Olaitoriani, anaa enaitanapisho olkitok lai.”
Neisho Musa enkitanapata naipirta ninche Eliesa ilo apolosani, o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye oo loshon loo ltung'ana le Israel.

Nejoki Musa ninche, “Te nelang ile Gad o ile Ruben, pooki ng'ae otanape alo enjore te dukuya o Laitoriani, nelang te nebo intae olkeju le Yordan neisulieki ina kop te dukuya intae, ninchosho taa ninche enkop e Gilead metaa enenye;
kake te nemelang ninche te nebo intae; etanapate, nepuo naa aatum enkop te nebo intae te nkop e Kanaan.”
Newal lelo le Gad o lelo le Ruben aajo, “Ore anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani isinkan linono, ina kipuo aas.
Eikilang iyiook olkeju le Yordan kitanapate te dukuya Olaitoriani aapuo enkop e Kanaan, ore ina jung'ore ang niking'uaa te lido kekun le Yordan.”

Neisho Musa ninche, lelo le Gad o lelo ayiok le Ruben o lpisiai lo losho le Manase, olayioni le Yosef, enkitoria e Sihon olaiguanani le Amori, o enkitoria e Oog olaiguanani le Bashan, ina kop o nkanas enyena te nebo ilpolosien lenye, inkanas e ina kop tiatua enkop pooki.
Neshet lelo le Gad Dibon o Atorat o Aroen
o Atrot-shofan o Yaser o Yogebeha,
Bet-nimra o Bet-haran, inkanas naasheta sunta o muatat oo nkerrai.
Ore ile Ruben neshet Heshbon o Eleale o Kiriataim,
o Nebo o Baal-meon (eibelekenyaki inkarn enye) o Sibma, neisho ninche kulie arn nena anas naatesheta ninche.
Ore ilayiok le Makir o layiok le Manase nepuo Gilead neya aaitaa enenye.
Neisho Musa Makir olayioni le Manase Gilead, nemany ninye ine.
Ore Yair olayioni le Manase nelo aya inkang'itie enye neisho ninche enkarna ajo Hafot-yair.
Nelo Noba aya Kenat o nkang'itie enye neisho ninye enkarna ajo Noba, aipotie kewan.
Kulo apa ilkirragarien loo ltung'ana le Israel, ina kata apa pee eipung aapuo aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri, too lororani lenye erikito Musa o Aron.

Neiger Musa enkiterunoto e lototo enye, anaa ilkirragarien le pooki wueji ake ninye neimaitie, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani; naa kulo apa ilkirragarien lenye te risioroto oo wuejitin neetang'asa aaimaa.
Etudumunye ninche te Ramases to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa; teina olong etulusoyie Pasaka, neipang iltung'ana le Israel aapuo eishuro te dukuya ile Misiri pooki,
ina kata enukaa ile Misiri ilkikaunot lenye pooki ootara Olaitoriani tiatua ninche; ore inkaitin enye nedung'oki Olaitoriani enkiguana.
Neaku etudumunye apa iltung'ana le Israel te Ramases, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Sukot.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Sukot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Etam, natii embata e ong'ata.
Neitoki aadumunye te Etam neibelekenya aarrinyo Pi-ha-hirot, aa ninye natii enkalo oloosaen le Baal-sefon; nepuo ninche aaun ilng'oborri te netaaniki Migdol.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te neipirare Hahirot neim empolos e naiposha nepuo olpurkel, nepuo elototo oo nkolong'i uni tiong'ata e Etam, neun ilng'oborri te Mara.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Mara nepuonu Elim; ore apa te Elim netii inchorroi tomon o are oo nkariak o ltuka intomoni naapishana, neun ninche ilng'oborri teine.
Neitoki aadumunye te Elim neun ilng'oborri te mbata Enaiposha Nanyokie.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te mbata Enaiposha Nanyokie neun ilng'oborri tiong'ata e Sin.
Neitoki aadumunye tiong'ata e Sin neun ilng'oborri te Dofka.
Nedumunye ninche te Dofka nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Alush.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Alush nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Refidim, teine apa nemetii enkare naok iltung'ana.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Refidim nepuo aaun ilng'oborri tiong'ata e Sinai.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye tiong'ata e Sinai, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Kibrot-hatafa.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Kibrot-hatafa nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Heserot.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Heserot, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Ritma.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Ritma nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Rimon-peres.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Rimon-peres, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Libna.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Libna nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Risa.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Risa nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Kehelata.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Kehelata nepuo aaun ilng'oborri to ldoinyo le Shefer.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye to ldoinyo le Shefer nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Harada.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Harada nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Makelot.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Makelot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Tahat.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Tahat nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Tera.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Tera nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Mitka.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Mitka nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Hashmona
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Hashmona nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Moserot.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Moserot, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Bene-yakan.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Bene-Yakan, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Hor-hagidgad.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Hor-hagidgad, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Yotbata.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Yotbata, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Abrona.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Abrona nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Esion-geber.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Esion-geber nepuo aaun ilng'oborri tiong'ata e Sin (aa taa Kadesh ina).
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Kadesh nepuo aaun ilng'oborri to ldoinyo le Hor, to lkirene le nkop e Edom.

Ore Aron ilo apolosani neilep alo enchumata o ldoinyo le Hor anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani, nelo aye teine, to lari li artam eidipa iltung'ana le Israel aatupuku te nkop e Misiri, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le imiet.
Naa oloo larin iip o tikitam o okuni apa Aron ina kata pee eye to ldoinyo le Hor.
Ore ilo Kanaani, olaiguanani le Arad, apa omanya Negeb te nkop e Kanaan, nening ina lotunoto oo ltung'ana le Israel.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye to ldoinyo le Hor nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Salmona.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Salmona, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Punon.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Punon, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Obot.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Obot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Iye-abarim te nkop oo le Moab.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Iyim, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Dibon-gad.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Dibon-gad nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Almon-diblataim.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Almon-diblataim nepuo aaun ilng'oborri too ldoinyo le Abarim, te nkipirakinoto e Nebo.
Neitoki ninche aadumunye too ldoinyo le Abarim nepuo aaun ilng'oborri too nkisiashat e Moab te mbata e Yordan eipirare Yeriko.
Neun ninche ilng'oborri te mbata e Yordan ebaiki Bet-Yeshimot o metabaiki Abel-shitim too nkisiashat e Moab.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa te nena kisiashat e Moab te mbata e Yordan eipirare Yeriko,
“Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, Ti nilang'ilang'a Yordan aapuo enkop e Kanaan,

nipuopuo naa aaraa lelo pooki oomanya ina kop aaiwuang'ie te dukuya intae nindaikiekie nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo soito, nindaikiekie nena kitanyaanyukot enye naaipurjuno, nigiligili nene wuejitin neeika naaitainyeki ilasarri pooki.
Niyaya ina kop aaitaa eninyi nimanyimanya, amu aishoo nanu intae ina kop pee iyaya.
