Neaku etushukote apa lelo le Ruben o le Gad o ilo pisiai lo losho le Manase aapuo inkang'itie, aaorore iltung'ana le Israel te Shilo, aa ninye apa natii enkop e Kanaan, aapuo enkop e Gilead, enkop enye maate apa naibung'a maate te nkitanapata o Laitoriani naimua Musa.
Ore ake pee epuonu ninche enkop natii embata e Yordan ti atua enkop e Kanaan neshet ile Ruben o le Gad o lpisiai le Manase olperere lo lasar teine te mbata e Yordan, olperere lo lasar kitok oleng.

Nening iltung'ana le Israel eji, “Etesheta ile Ruben ole Gad o ilo pisiai lo losho le Manase olperere lo lasar te dukuya enkop e Kanaan, tiatua ina kop nataaniki Yordan, teina shoto apa nara enoo ltung'ana le Israel.”
Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana le Israel ina, neiturrurro olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel te Shilo, pee earare ninche.
Neirriwaki iltung'ana le Israel olkilikuai iltung'ana le Ruben o le Gad o ilo pisiai lo losho le Manase te nkop e Gilead, Finehas olayioni le Eliasa olapolosani,
netii te nebo ninye ilaiguanak tomon, obo ake loo loshon loo lmareita le Israel.
Nepuonu ninche enetii ile Ruben o le Gad o ilo pisiai le Manase te nkop e Gilead, nejoki ninche,

“Inji ejo olturrur lo Laitoriani, ‘Kaa taboi ena nitaasa intae tialo Enkai e Israel aaibelekenya ena olong aaing'uaa esujata o Laitoriani, teina niteshetakita ate ena olong olperere lo lasar te ngolong'akinoto o Laitoriani?
Keitu iyiook kiaas eng'oki sapuk te Peor neton eitu o tene kintisiny ate, naa te nkaraki ninye pee eewuo olmeitai shumata olturrur lo Laitoriani,
eji pee imbelekenyanya ena olong aaing'uaa Olaitoriani? Naa ti nigolong'akiki ena olong Olaitoriani naa kegorokino ninye olturrur pooki le Israel taisere.

Kake ore taata, te nemesinya enkop inyi, entogiru wootu atua enkop o Laitoriani ine netii olng'obor lo Laitoriani, nimbung'akiki ate enkop tiatua iyiook; emigolong'akiki ake duoo intae Olaitoriani, aashu intaa iyiook iloogolong'u te nchetakinoto nishetakiki ate olperere lo lasar leme ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ang.
Keitu apa eiturraa Akan olayioni le Sera enkirukoto tialo nena baa naaiteng'elaki, nedoiki engoro olturrur pooki le Israel? Neme ninye ake oidaayie te nkitarruoroto enye.’ ”
Neitoki lelo le Ruben, o le Gad o lpisiai le Manase aajo te walakinoto e nena lukuny oo lmareita le Israel,

Olmagilani, Enkai, Olaitoriani! Olmagilani, Enkai, Olaitoriani! Eyiolo ninye; naa nchoo sii Israel eyiolou makewan! Tenaa ei te ngolong'akinoto, anaa te anyata e nkirukoto tialo Olaitoriani, mileku iyiook taata

te nkaraki enchetata o lperere lo lasar pee kitum aaibelekenyata aatung'uai esujata o Laitoriani; aashu tenaa eikitaasa iyiook ina pee kitum aaishoru ilasarri oopejori aashu ilasarri le nkurma aashu ilasarri le seriani te nchumata enye, metaa Olaitoriani makewan oitalak iyiook.
A'a, kake kitaasa iyiook te nkuretisho nchere ore te nkata nalotu neidim inkera inyi aatiaki inkera ang, Kaa intae iporokiki Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel?
Amu eitaa Olaitoriani Yordan olpolosie lang o intae, ore intae ile Ruben o le Gad; miatata intae erubata tiatua Olaitoriani. Neaku keidim inkera inyi aaitapong'oi inkera ang eseremata o Laitoriani.
Neaku kitejo apa, Mateshetu iyiook olperere lo lasar, neme olopejorieki inkishorunot, neme ino lasar.

Kake pee eaku shakeni te iyiook o te intae o ishoritin te siadi iyiook, nchere eikintayu iyiook olasar lo Laitoriani te dukuya ninye too nkishoorot ang naapejori o lasarri o nkishoorot e seriani; pee meyooki ake inkera inyi aajoki inkera ang te nkata nalotu, Miatata intae erubata tiatua Olaitoriani.

Nikijo apa iyiook, te nelo nejokini iyiook ena aashu eishoi ang te nkata nalotu, nikindim iyiook aatejo, Eng'ura, enkitanyaanyukoto o lperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, apa naitobira iloo papa, neme too nkishoroot naapejori, neme too lasarri, kake pee eaku shakenisho te iyiook o te intae.

Kilome! Mikigolong'aki iyiook Olaitoriani aaibelekenya ena olong aaing'uaa esujata o Laitoriani te nchetata o lperere lo lasar te nkaraki inkishoorot naapejori o nkishoorot e nkurma aashu olasar. Mikishet iyiook likae perere lo lasar meteleku ake ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ang oitashe te dukuya olng'obor lenye!

Ore ake pee ening Finehas ilo apolosani o lelo kituaak lo lturrur o nena lukuny oo lmareita le Israel apa naatii te nebo ninye, lelo rorei ootejo ile Ruben o le Gad o le Manase, neitiship ninche oleng.

Nejoki Finehas ilo apolosani ayioni le Eliesa ile Ruben o le Gad o le Manase, Akiyiolo iyiook, ena olong aajo ketii Olaitoriani atua iyiook, amu eitu intae iasiasa ena kitarruoroto to Laitoriani; ore taata intajeutuo intae iltung'ana le Israel te nkaina o Laitoriani.
Neitoki Finehas olayioni le Eliesa ilo apolosani o lkituaak aashuko too le Ruben o le Gad te nkop e Gilead aapuo enkop e Kanaan, enetii iltung'ana le Israel neyaki ilomon.
Neitiship lelo omon lelo tung'ana le Israel, neisis iltung'ana le Israel Enkai, neitu eigil aaimaki olarrabal tialo ninche, pee eidaikie ina kop apa natamanya ile Ruben o le Gad.
Nejo apa ile Ruben o le Gad, “enkarna e ilo perere lo lasar Shakeni; amu etejo ninche, shakeni ninye te iyiook nchere Olaitoriani ninye Enkai.”
Ore etulusoitie inkolong'i kumok, eidipa Olaitoriani aishoo Israel enkiyeng'iyeng tialo ilmang'ati lenye oomanita ninche, netamorua Yoshua oleng neaku oloo larin kumok.
Neipotu Yoshua Israel pooki, ilpayiani lenye, o lukuny oo nkajijik, olarishak lenye o lkituaak, nejoki ninche, “Atamorua taata nanu nataa oloo larin kumok;
nitoduaa intae nena pooki naaitaasa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi kuna kuapi pooki te nkaraki intae, amu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ninye otijing'a olarrabal te nkaraki intae.
Atoorikia nanu intae metaa enjung'ore too loshon linyi nena kuapi naang'or, te nebo inkuapi pooki naidipa nanu aiwuang'ie, ebaiki Yordan o metabaiki enaiposha kitok te nkalo o loo ntoluo.
Kerrumoo ninche arriny siadi Olaitoriani Enkai inyi te dukuya intae nereu ninche aiwuang'ie too nkonyek inyi; naa iyaya intae enkop enye anaa apa enaisiligie intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.
Metaa entuunoto embung'a niasiasa nena pooki naaigero tiatua embuku oo nkitanapat e Musa, nimimbelekenyanya aaing'uaa aapuo enkalo e tatene aashu enkalo e kedianye,
pee mishularere ake kuna kuapi naatelekutua naatii atua intae, aashu impotipoto inkaitin enye, aashu inyanya olmumai te ninche, aashu isiaayiayia ninche, aashu irrugokinono ninche,
kake enteenikinoto Olaitoriani Enkai inyi anaa enitaasa intae o metabaiki ena olong.
Amu etaarayie Olaitoriani te dukuya intae inkuapi kituaak naagol, ore tialo intae meetae oltung'ani oidima aitasheikinore intae o metabaiki ena olong.
Oltung'ani obo te intae odumu enkalifu meisika, amu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi otii olarrabal te nkaraki intae, anaa apa enaisiligie intae.
Entujurroto naa maate, pee inyorrurru Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.
Amu ti nimbelekenyanya aaibung'are olpisiai le kuna kuapi naatelekutua tene tiatua intae niyamama o ninche, pee iyamiyama inkituaak enye neyam inkuninyi.

Entayiolo te sipata nchere meitoki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi areu kuna kuapi te dukuya intae; kake keaku ninche orreshet te intae, enchipishipi too sunta inyi o lkiku too nkonyek inyi o metaba anaa nindaayaya aaishunye tena kop sidai naishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

“Ore naa taata etaa nanu kalo anaa enapuo iltung'ana pooki, niyiololo intae too ltauja linyi o te nkishui inyi, intae pooki, nchere, meetae embae hoo nabo neitu ebaya te nena baa pooki sidain naaisiligishore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi tialo intae, eetuo pooki aabaya te nkaraki intae, meetae hoo nabo neitu ebaya.

Kake ore anaa enaitabayioki nena baa pooki sidain naaisiligishore Olaitoriani tialo intae, neijia sii eiko Olaitoriani ayaki intae intorrok pooki o metaba anaa nemut intae aiwuang'ie tena kop sidai apa naishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai.

Ti nigiligili olning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, apa oitanapa ninye intae, nipuopuo aaisiai kulie aitin, nirrugokinono ninche. Netum taa engoro o Laitoriani ayupuyupo te nkaraki intae nindaayaya intae aaing'uaa ina kop sidai naishoo ninye intae.”
Neitoki Yoshua aiturrur iloshon pooki le Israel te Shekem, neipotu ilpayiani, ilukuny oo nkajijik o larishak o lkituaak le Israel, neyau ninche ate dukuya Enkai.
Nejoki Yoshua lelo tung'ana pooki, “Inji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ‘Etamanya apa loo papaai linyi lido kekun le Frati, Tera menye le Abraham o Nahori; neisiaai ninche kulie aitin.
Naya apa nanu papaai linyi Abraham aitayu te lido kekun o lkeju narik nanu ninye tiatua enkop e Kanaan pooki; naitubul eishoi enye aitaa kumok. Aishoo nanu ninye Isaak;
naisho Isaak Yakobo o Esau. Naisho nanu Esau ina kop oo ldoinyo e Seir meitaa enenye, kake eshomo Yakobo o nkera enyena Misiri.
Nairriwaa nanu Musa o Aron, naar nanu enkop e Misiri te nena nataasa nanu tiatua ninche; ore te siadi naipang'unye nanu intae.
Naipang'unye nanu loo papaai linyi aitung'uaa Misiri, nipuonunu enaiposha; nesuju apa Ilmisiri loo papaai linyi too ngarrin o too mbartan o meetu Enaiposha Nanyokie.

Ore ake pee eishiraki ninche Olaitoriani nepik ninye enaimin erishata intae o lelo Misiri, naisho enaiposha meeu shumata ninche neitemoo ninche; netoduaa inkonyek inyi enaitaasa nanu Misiri; nitotona intae to lpurkel enkata naado.

Naitoki nanu ayau intae enkop oo Lamori, laa ninche apa ootii lido likae kekun le Yordan; nearare ninche intae, naishoru nanu ninche apik atua inkaik inyi, niyaya intae enkop enye aaitaa eninyi, naidaikie nanu ninche te dukuya intae.
Neitoki adumunye Balak olayioni le Sipor, olaiguanani le Moab, nearare Israel; neirriwaa olkilikuai aitoomon Balaam olayioni le Beor meeu adek intae,
kake eitu nanu aning Balaam; neaku etamayiana ninye intae; neaku atokordua nanu intae aitung'uaa enkaina enye.
Nitalang'utua apa intae Yordan nipuonunu Yeriko, nearare intae iltung'ana le Yeriko o Lamori sii o Lperisi o Lkanaani o Lhiti o Lgigashi o Lhifi o Lyebusi; naishoru nanu ninche apik atua inkaik inyi.
Napik nanu enkuretisho dukuya intae naa te nkaraki ena apa mme olalem linyi neme enkawuo inyi, natimirayie lelo aiguanak oaare loo Lamori.
Aishoo nanu intae enkop neitu iekarere o nkanas neitu ishetishete, nibikitoto intae tiatua ninche ninyanya ilng'anayio le nkurma o sabibu leitu iunuunu.’

“Ore naa taata entureita Olaitoriani nisiaayiayia ninye to ltau owang o te sipata (metii esunkuroisho); ewuang'ie nena aitin apa naaisiaayia iloo papaai linyi te lido kekun le Yordan; o te Misiri nisiayiayia Olaitoriani.

Naa ti nimiyieuu intae nisiaayiayia Olaitoriani, entegelu ena olong olisiaayiayia tenaa ai nena aitin apa naaisiaayia iloo papaai linyi te lido kekun le Yordan aashu tenaa ai nena aitin oo Lamori naa enkop enye itii; kake ore nanu o olmarei lai naa aikisiaai Olaitoriani.”
Newal iltung'ana aajo, “Kilome miking'uaa iyiook Olaitoriani, aapuo aaisiaai kulie aitin!,

Amu Olaitoriani Enkai ang apa oyaua iyiook o loo papa aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, aitupuku te nkop e sinkaisho, naa ninye apa otaasa nena kitoduaat sapuki too nkonyek ang, negolie iyiook teina oitoi pooki apa nikiima o tiatua iltung'ana pooki apa likiimaitie atua ninche.
Nearaa Olaitoriani te dukuya iyiook iloreren pooki, Ilamori apa laa ninche emanya ena kop; metaa eikisiai sii iyiook Olaitoriani, amu ninye Enkai ang.”
Kake etiaaka Yoshua iltung'ana, “Mindimidimi intae aaisiaayia Olaitoriani, amu Enkai sinyati ninye; Enkai o lom ninye; mepalaki ninye inkitarruorot inyi aashu ing'ok inyi.
Tining'uaa intae Olaitoriani aapuo aaisiaai inkaitin omon, naa keibelekenya sii ninye neitaas intae entorrono, nemut intae, eidipa aitaasa intae esidai.”
Nejoki iltung'ana Yoshua, “A'a; eikisiai iyiook Olaitoriani.”
Neitoki Yoshua ajoki iltung'ana, “Irara intae ilchakenini tialo intae maate nchere itudutaitie Olaitoriani pee isiaayiayia ninye.” Nejo ninche, “Kira iyiook ilchakenini.”
Nejo Yoshua, “Ewuang'ie naa nena aitin omon naatii atua intae nimbelekenyakiki oltau linyi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.”
Nejoki lelo tung'ana Yoshua, “Olaitoriani Enkai ang iyiook kisiaai, naa oltoilo lenye iyiook kining.”
Neitobir Yoshua olning'o o ltung'ana ina olong, neisho ninche inkitanapat o nkikoot te Shekem.
Neiger Yoshua kulo rorei tiatua embuku oo nkitanapat e Nkai; neya osoit kitok neitasheyie teine ti abori olchani teine wueji o Laitoriani.

Nejoki Yoshua lelo tung'ana pooki, “Ore ele soit naa keaku shakenisho tialo iyiook; amu etoning'o ninye irorei pooki lo Laitoriani ootiaka ninye iyiook; metaa keaku shakeni tialo intae, pee mintaasiasa ake entorroni Enkai inyi.”
Neisho taa Yoshua iltung'ana meshomo, oltung'ani ake nelo enjung'ore enye.
Ore te siadi kuna baa neye Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, osinka lo Laitoriani, aa oloo larin iip o tomon.
Nenukaa ninche ninye tiatua enjung'ore enye te Timnat-sera, apa naa ninye natii ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, moikuape o ldoinyo le Gaash.
Neisiaai Israel Olaitoriani too nkolong'i pooki e Yoshua o nkolong'i pooki e lelo payiani apa ootung'uayie Yoshua, apa ooyiolo esiaai pooki nataasa Olaitoriani te nkaraki Israel.

Ore iloik le Yosef apa ooyautua iltung'ana le Israel te Misiri nenukari te Shekem, tiatua erubata e nkop apa nainyiang'ua Yakobo too layiok le Hamor menye Shekem too mpisai iip; netaa apa ine enjung'ore oo layiok le Yosef.
Neye sii Eliesa olayioni le Aron nenukaa ninche ninye te Gibeya, te nkang e Finehas olayioni lenye apa naishooki ninye tiatua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim.
Ore te siadi keeya e Yoshua neikilikuanishore iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani ejo, “Kaing'ae ong'as aituruk alo te nkaraki iyiook pee earare Ilkanaani?”
Nejo Olaitoriani, “Yuda oilep alo; aishooyie nanu enkop apik atua enkaina enye.”

Nejoki Yuda Simion olalashe lenye, “Ilepu wou te nebo nanu tamanya atua ena kop naatoorikiaki nanu, pee kitum aataarare Ilkanaani; ore sii nanu naa kaiko neijia alo te nebo iyie atua ina kop nikitoorikiaki iyie.” Nelo Simion te nebo ninye.
Neilep Yuda alo neishooyo Olaitoriani Ilkanaani o Lperesi apik atua enkaina enye, nemir apa ninche ilewa nkalifuni tomon te Besek.
Nepuonu apa ninche aadoiki Adonibesek te Besek, nearare ninye, neisulie Ilkanaani o Lperesi.
Neisik Adonibesek; kake etimira, neibung ninye, nedung'oo ninche ilmogirrani lenyena loo nkaik o loo nkejek.

Nejo Adonibesek, “Ore apa ilaiguanak intomoni naapishana ootudung'oyioki ilmogirrani lenye loo nkaik o loo nkejek naa ti abori emisa ai esotu ndaiki naadoyio; anaa enataasa nanu, neaku atalaaka nanu Enkai.” Neyau ninche ninye Yerusalem, neye ninye teine.
Nearare iltung'ana le Yuda Yerusalem, neibung, near te nepi o lalem nepik ina anasa enkima.
Ore te siadi nena nepuo iltung'ana le Yuda aarare Ilkanaani apa oomanya enkop oo ldoinyo tiatua Negeb o teina kop nagum.
Nelo Yuda aarare lelo Kanaani apa oomanya Hebron, ore apa enkarna e Hebron naa keji Kiriat Arba; near neisulie nkajijik e Sheshai o Ahiman o Talmai.
Nedumunye ilewa le Yuda teine nepuo aarare lelo oomanya Debir. Ore apa enkarna e Debir naa keji Kiriat-sefer.
Nejo Kaleb, “Ore ilo orasaki Kiriat-sefer neya ninye, naisho ninye Aksa entito ai meitaa enkitok enye.”
Neya Otniel olayioni le Kenas, olalashe oti le Kaleb, neisho Kaleb ninye Aksa ina tito enye meitaa enkitok.
Ore ake pee eyam ninye, neikilikuan Aksa ninye metoomono menye enkop; nedou ninye to sikiria lenye, nejoki Kaleb ninye, “Kainyoo iyieu?”
Nejoki ninye, “Nchooki enkishooroto; ore amu kiterewa nanu mashomo enkop e Negeb, nchooki sii nkonyek e nkare.” Neisho Kaleb ninye nkonyek e nkare e shumata o ni abori.

Ore lelo le ishoi e Keni, ilo aputani le Musa, neilep aapuo te nebo iltung'ana le Yuda teina anasa oo ltuka nepuo ong'ata e Yuda apa natii Negeb embata e Aradi; nepuo ninche aatoni te nebo o lelo tung'ana.
Nelo Yuda te nebo Simion olalashe lenye, nemir ninche Ilkanaani apa oomanya Sefat, neidaikie tukul. Neaku keji apa enkarna e ina anasa Horma.
Ewa sii apa Yuda Gasa te nebo enkop enye o Ashkelon te nebo enkop enye o Ekron te nebo enkop enye.
Netii apa Olaitoriani te nebo Yuda neya ninye aitaa enenye ina kop oo ldoinyo, kake eitu apa eidimu ataarai aipang'ie lelo oomanya enkisiashata, amuk eeta apa ninche ngarrin oo sekenke.
Neishooyioki apa Hebron aaisho Kaleb anaa apa enatejo Musa; nearaa Kaleb aipang'ie tiatua ninye lelo ayiok pokira okuni le Anak.
Kake eitu earaa iltung'ana le Benchamen Ilyebusi apa oomanya Yerusalem; neaku etobiko apa Ilyebusi te nebo iltung'ana le Benchamen te Yerusalem ometabaiki ena olong.
Ore sii apa enkaji e Yosef neilep aapuo aarare Betel; netii Olaitoriani te nebo ninche.
Neirriwaa enkaji e Yosef ilaikitalak meshomo aaikitalan Betel. (Ore apa enkarna e ina anasa naa keji Lus).
Nedol lelo aikitalak oltung'ani eipang'u te nkanasa, nejoki, “Tuutaki sii ake iyiook enkoitoi nalo atua enkanasa, pee kintaas iyie esidai.”
Neitodol ninye ninche enkoitoi nalo atua ina anasa; near ninche ina anasa te nepi o lalem, kake eishoo ninche ilo tung'ani te nebo olmarei lenye meshomo.
Nelo ilo tung'ani enkop oo Lhiti nelo ashet enkanasa nejo enkarna enye Lus; ina enkarna enye o metabaiki ena olong.

Eitu apa earaa enkaji e Manase aipang'ie lelo oomanya Betshean o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, aashu Taanak o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, aashu lelo oomanya Dori o nkang'itie enyena kutiti aashu lelo oomanya Ibleam o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, aashu lelo oomanya Megido o nkang'itie enyena kutiti; kake eting'iria Ilkanaani aabik tiatua ina kop.
Ore ake pee egolu Israel, nepik ninche Ilkanaani enkisiaayiare nagol, kake eitu earaa ninche aaipang'ie tukul.
Eitu apa earaa enkaji e Efraim aipang'ie lelo Kanaani oomanya Geser; kake etobiko Ilkanaani tiatua Geser te nebo ninche.
Eitu apa earaa enkaji e Sebulon aipang'ie lelo oomanya Kitron, aashu lelo oomanya Nahalol; kake etobiko Ilkanaani tiatua ninche neaku ilenkisiaayiare nagol.
Eitu apa earaa enkaji e Asheri aipang'ie lelo oomanya Ako, aashu lelo oomanya Sidon, aashu ile Ahalab, aashu ile Aksib, aashu ile Helba, aashu ile Afik, aashu ile Rehob;
kake etobiko apa ile Asheri tiatua Ilkanaani lelo oomanya ina kop; amu eitu earaa ninche aaipang'ie.

Eitu apa earaa enkaji e Naftali aaipang'ie lelo oomanya Bet-shemesh, aashu lelo oomanya Bet-anat, kake etobiko ninche tiatua lelo Kanaani oomanya ina kop; ore ake eyia, ore lelo oomanya Bet-shemesh, o le Bet-anat netaa ilenkisiaayiare nagol te ninche.
Eturrumokito apa Ilamori iltung'ana le Dan enkop oo ndoinyo, amu eitu apa eisho ninche meetu enkisiashata tiabori.
Neng'iri Ilamori aabik tiatua Har-heres o tiatua Aiyalon, o tiatua Sha-albim, kake eturokine enkaina e nkaji e Yosef ninche te ngolon, neaku ile nkisiaayiare nagol.
Ore olpolosie loo Lamori nelo te nkilepunoto e Akrabim ebaiki Sela neilep.

Neilep olmalaika lo Laitoriani te Gilgal alo Bokim. Nejo ninye, “Ayaua apa nanu intae ailepunye te Misiri, nayau intae atua ina kop apa nainosa olmumai pee aisho loo papaai linyi. Atejo apa, ‘Magil ae kata olning'o lai o intae,
nimintobiribiri sii intae olning'o o kulo oomanya ena kop; niaariara ilpereren lenye lo lasar’ kake eitu intae imbung'ubung'u enkitanapata ai. Kainyoo ena nitaasa intae?
Neaku ajoki taata intae, maaraa ninche aipang'ie te dukuya intae; kake keaku ninche ilmang'ati te ntae, naa keaku inkaitin enye orreshet te intae.”
Ore ake pee eiro ilo malaika lo Laitoriani kulo rorei too ltung'ana pooki le Israel, neyietu iltung'ana aaishir.
Neisho ninche ine wueji enkarna aajo Bokim; neitaiki Olaitoriani olasar teine.
Ore ake pee eisho Yoshua iltung'ana meshomo, nepuo lelo tung'ana le Israel oltung'ani ake enjung'ore enye, pee elo aya enkop.
Neisiaai iltung'ana Olaitoriani inkolong'i pooki e Yoshua o nkolong'i pooki e lelo payiani apa ootii te siadi Yoshua, apa ootoduaa ina siaai pooki kitok nataasa Olaitoriani te nkaraki Israel.
Neye Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo sinka lo Laitoriani, aa oloo larin iip o tomon.
Nenukaa ninche ninye to lpolosie le njung'ore enye te Timat-heres, tiatua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, te moikuape oldoinyo le Gaash.
Ore apa ina ishoi pooki neishunye sii ninche aaye; neitoki ailepu ae ishoi te siadi ninche, apa nemeyiolo ninye Olaitoriani aashu esiaai apa nataasa ninye te nkaraki Israel.
Neas lelo tung'ana le Israel entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani neisiaai inkaitin e Baal.

Neing'uaa ninche Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye apa naa ninye nayawua ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri; nepuo ninche aasujaa kulie aitin, tiatua nena aitin oo loreren apa oomanita ninche, neirrugokino ninche; neitagor ninche Olaitoriani.
Neing'uaa ninche Olaitoriani, neisiaai inkaitin e Baal o Ashtarot.

Neaku eyupuyupo apa engoro o Laitoriani tialo Israel, neishooyo ninye ninche apik atua inkaik oo lmang'ati lenye nemiraki ninche engolon e lelo mang'ati oomanita ninche, o metaa meekure eidim aairisha ilmang'ati lenye.
Kejo ake maape olarrabal, negilunore ninche enkaina o Laitoriani te ntorroni anaa apa enatejo Olaitoriani, o anaa sii enainosa Olaitoriani olmumai tialo ninche, neing'aing'ai ninche oleng.
Neput Olaitoriani ilarishak, ooitajeu ninche aaitayu te ngolon e lelo apa ootaraitie ninche.

Ore ake eyia, eitu ninche ening ilarishak lenye, amu eiborrie onyek esujaa kulie aitin neirrugokino ninche; eibelekenyate apa nabo kata aapong ina oitoi naa ninye apa eima loo menye, lelo apa oibung'a nkitanapat o Laitoriani, neitu ninche eas ina.

Ore ake anaa te neput Olaitoriani ilarishak te nkaraki ninche, netii Olaitoriani te nebo ilo arishani, neitajeu ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye too nkolong'i pooki e ilo arishani; amu eing'urrie apa Olaitoriani ninche te nkaraki osina lenye te nkaraki lelo apa ooisomita ninche neinosie osina.

Kake ore apa te neye olarishani, neibelekenya ninche neas intorrok alang iloo menye, epuo aasujaa kulie aitin, neisiaai ninche neirrugokino ninche; eitu apa ninche epal ae nabo oo mbaa enye torrok aashu nena enye e ngolong'u.
Neaku eyupuyupo apa engoro o Laitoriani te nkaraki Israel; nejo ninye, “Ore te nkaraki natigila kulo tung'ana olning'o lai apa laitanapa nanu loo menye, neitu ening oltoilo lai,
meekure nanu ebaiki taata aaraa aipang'ie te dukuya ninche hoo ninye olosho obo te lelo apa ootung'uayie Yoshua pee eye,
paa ore te ninche natum nanu atetema Israel, tenaa keshilaa aapuo te nkoitoi o Laitoriani, anaa apa enataasa iloomenye aashu eneitu.”
Neaku etapala apa Olaitoriani lelo oshon, eitu earaa ninche aipang'ie nabo kata, neitu ninye eishooyo ninche apik atua engolon e Yoshua.
Kulo apa iloshon ootelekua Olaitoriani pee etemie ninche Israel, aa taa lelo pooki tiatua Israel leitu ae kata eyiolou likae arrabal obo te Kanaan.
Te nkaraki ena apa pee etum iishoritin oo ltung'ana le Israel aatayioloito olarrabal, pee etum ninye aiteng'ena ninche olarrabal, amu eitu apa eyiolou.
Kulo ninche lelo oreren: Ilkituaak imiet loo Lfilisti o Lkanaani pooki, le Sidon o Lhafi apa oomanya oldoinyo le Lebanon, ebaiki oldoinyo le Baalhermon ebaiki enejing'ieki Hamat.
Ilootemieki Israel apa ninche, pee eyiolouni tenaa keidim Israel aibung'a inkitanapat o Laitoriani apa naaitanapa ninye loo menye te Musa.
Neaku etobiko apa iltung'ana le Israel tiatua Ilkanaani o Ilhiti, Ilamori, Ilperisi, Ilhifi o Lyebusi;
neyam ninche ntoyie enye aaitaa inkituaak enye, ore ntoyie enye maate neisho ilayiok le lelo oreren, neisiaai inkaitin enye.
Neas iltung'ana le Israel entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani, nerikino ninche Olaitoriani Enkai enye, neisiaai inkaitin e Baal o Asherot.
Neaku eyupuyupo apa engoro o Laitoriani tialo Israel nemir ninche metijing'a atua enkaina e Kushan-rishataim olaiguanani le Mesopotamia neisiaai iltung'ana le Israel Kushan-rishataim ilarin isiet.

Kake ore ake pee eishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, neisho Olaitoriani olakordunoni te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel, laa ninye apa otokordua ninche, Otiniel olayioni le Kenas, olalashe oti le Kaleb.

Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata ninye, neaku ninye olarishani te Israel; neilep ninye alo olarrabal neishooyo Olaitoriani Kushan-rishataim, olaiguanani le Mesepotamia apik atua enkaina enye; neisulu enkaina enye Kushan-rishataim.
Netum taa enkop enkiyeng'iyeng ilarin artam. Neye Otiniel olayioni le Kenas.

Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aaigil aas entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani; neitagol Olaitoriani Eglon olaiguanani le Moab metaarare Israel, te nkaraki nataasa ninche entorroni too nkonyek o Loitoriani.
Neiturrurroki ninye kewan Ilamori o Lmaleki nelo amir Israel neya ninche ina anasa oo ltuka aaitaa enenye.
Neisiaai iltung'ana le Israel Eglon olaiguanani le Moab ilarin tomon o isiet.

Kake ore ake pee eishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani neisho Olaitoriani ninche olakordunoni, Ehudi, olayioni le Gera, lo losho le Benchamen, oltung'ani kedianye. Neirriwaa iltung'ana le Israel ninye meyaki Eglon olaiguanani le Moab kodi.
Neitobiraki Ehudi kewan olalem opi nkaloli pokira are laa entemet nabo e nkaina o lpisiai enkadoro, neeniki ninye enkupes enye e nkeju e tatene aitabolu nkilani enyena.
Neitarasaa ninye ina kishooroto aisho Eglon olaiguanani le Moab, naa oltung'ani apa opir oleng.
Ore ake pee eidip Ehudi aitarasai ina kodi, neisho lelo tung'ana meshomo apa ooyautua ina kodi.

Kake eibelekenyunye ninye makewan ashukunye te nena kitanyaanyukot oo soito naaguetuno naatii embata e Gilgal, nejo, “Kaata nanu olkilikuai laakurraki olaiguanani.” Nejo ninye, “Entigirata.” Ore apa lelo pooki ooisiaaita ninye neipang aapuo aaing'uaa ninye.
Nelotu Ehudi enetii ninye, etonita openy tiatua olgilata lenye oirobi le shumata. Nejo Ehudi, “Kaata olkilikuai oing'uaa Enkai te nkaraki iyie.” Nedumunye Eglon to lorika lenye.
Neitorioo Ehudi enkaina enye e kedianye, neshutu olalem te nkupes enye e tatene neisuroki atua enkoshoke o laiguanani.
Nejing pooki o olkidong'oi lenye, neibung enkurriny ilo alem, amu eitu apa eshutu ilo alem te nkoshoke enye; nebukunye enkorotik e nkoshoke.
Neipang'u Ehudi boo, neiken inkutukie oo nkajijik e ilo gilata le shumata, neen.
Ore eidipa ashomo, nepuonu ilaisiaayiak; ore pee edol aajo keikeno nkutukie e lelo gilat le shumata, nejo ninche, “Ebaiki naa kewan ebakita tiatua ilo gilata oirobi.”
Neanyisho ninche o metaba anaa nepalari; kake ore ake eton eitu ebol ninye nkutukie e lelo gilat le shumata, neitayu ninche olbolet nebol; neirragita teine olkitok lenye to ltiren etua.
Neisika duoo Ehudi aluaya ina kata eanyisho ninche, nelo agiroo nena kitanyaanyukot naaguetuno too soito, neisik alo Se-ira.
Ore ake pee ebaya neosh esekekua teina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, nepuo iltung'ana le Israel te nebo ninye aadoyio teina kop oo ndoinyo, etii ninye dukuya ninche.

Nejoki ninye ninche, “Entusujuaki; amu eishorua Olaitoriani ilmang'ati linyi lelo Moabu apik atua enkaina inyi.” Neaku etadoitie apa ninche aasujaa ninye, neibung ilang'at o lkeju le Yordan naaimu Ilmoabu, neitu ninche eisho hoo oltung'ani obo metalang'u.
Near ninche ina olong iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni tomon loo Lmoabu, oogol pooki, eitu ninye eimisho obo.
Neaku etimiraki apa Moab ina olong nejing abori enkaina e Israel. Netum apa ina kop enkiyeng'iyeng too larin intomoni isiet.
Ore te siadi Ehudi naa Shamgar olayioni le Anat oowa erishata enye, apa laa ninye otara metuata iltung'ana iip ile loo Lfilisti te ng'udi nareyieki lmong'i, netokordua sii ninye Israel.
Neigil ake iltung'ana le Israel aas entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, ina kata eidipa Ehudi atua.
Nemir Olaitoriani ninche metijing'a atua enkaina e Yabin olaiguanani le Kanaan, apa laa ninye oitoreisho te Hasor. Ore apa olarikoni le njore enye naa Sisera, nemanya apa ninye Harosheta-goiim.
Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aaishiraki Olaitoriani metaretu; amu keeta apa Yabin ngarrin iip naaudo oo sekenke, neisomita apa iltung'ana le Israel te nkisikong'ata too larin tikitam.
Ore apa Debora enkoiboni e Nkai, ina kitok e Lapidot, naa ninye apa narishita Israel teina kata.
Neton apa ninye te ntonata o ltukai le Debora te rishata e Rama o Betel tiatua ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim. Neilepu iltung'ana le Israel aapuonu enetii ninye te rishare.

Neirriwaa ninye olkilikuai aipotu Barak olayioni le Abinoam te Kedesh tiatua Naftali, nejoki ninye, “Kintanapa iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, nejo, ‘Shomo nturrurro iltung'ana linono to ldoinyo le Tabor, iwa iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon lo losho le Naftali o lo losho le Sebulon.
Naa kayietu nanu Sisera, ilo kitok le njore e Yabin, pee kilotu atumore te mbata o lkeju le Kishon te nebo ngarrin enyena o ltimito lenyena; naa kaishoru nanu ninye apik atua enkaina ino.’ ”
Nejoki Barak ninye, “Ti nilo iyie te nebo nanu, nalo, kake te nimilo iyie te nebo nanu, nemalo nanu.”

Nejo ninye, “Ore te sipata, kalo nanu te nebo iyie; ore eyia, ore ina oitoi niim iyie nemeyau enkisisa ino, amu kemir Olaitoriani Sisera apik atua enkaina e nkitok.” Nedumunye Debora alo te nebo Barak Kedesh.
Neipotu Barak Sebulon o Naftali meetu Kedesh; neilep iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon aasujaa ninye, nelo sii Debora te nebo ninye.
Netoorote apa Heberi ilo le Keni o Lkeni, lelo le ishoi e Hobabu olaputani le Musa, nelo aunoki olng'obor lenye olchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli te Sa-ananim, apa nataaniki Kedesh.
Ore ake pee elikini Sisera nchere eshomo Barak olayioni le Abinoam oldoinyo le Tabor,
neipotu Sisera ngarrin enyena pooki, ngarrin iip naaudo oo sekenke, o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye, ebaiki Haroshet-hagoiim o metabaiki olkeju le Kishon.

Nejoki Debora Barak, “Tudumunye! Amu ena olong eishooyie Olaitoriani Sisera apik atua enkaina ino. Aime Olaitoriani olo te dukuya iyie?” Nedoiyio Barak to ldoinyo le Tabor tenebo iltung'ana inkalifuni tomon oosujita ninye.
Nemir Olaitoriani Sisera o ngarrin enyena pooki o enjore enye pooki te dukuya Barak nepik enepi olalem; nedou Sisera te ngarri enye neisik alo too nkejek.
Nesujaa Barak nena garrin o mbartan o enjore o meshomo Haroshet-hagoiim, ore ina jore pooki e Sisera nebatata te nepi olalem; eitu ninye eleku oltung'ani.
Kake eisika apa Sisera too nkejek o meshomo olng'obor le Yael, enkitok e Heberi loo Lkeni, amu etii apa eseriani erishata e Yabin olaiguanani le Hasor o enkaji e Heberi ilo Keni.
Neipang'u Yael alotu anang'are Sisera, nejoki ninye, “Wou, olkitok lai, wou enkaji ai, miureishoyu.” Neaku eibelekenyunye ninye ajing atua olng'obor lenye neimulumul ninye to lkarasha.
Nejoki Sisera ninye, “Nchooki siaake enkiti are naok; amu kaata enkure.” Nebol ninye olbene lo lchoni le kule neisho ninye metooko neitoki aimulumul ninye.
Nejoki ninye, “Ntasho te kutuk aji o lng'obor, naa ore pooki tung'ani likilotu aikilikuan ajoki, ‘Ketii oltung'ani ene?’ Tejo, ‘Metii.’ ”
Kake ewa apa Yael ina kitok e Heberi encheitoi o Lng'obor, neya enyuntu te nkaina enye, nelo ninye maakutiti, neoshoki encheitoi eseder enye nepudaki enkop, kaae neye ninye te nauri.

Naa ng'ura ore esujita Barak Sisera nelo Yael anang'are ninye, nejoki ninye, “Wou maaitoduaa ilo tung'ani ligira aing'oru.” Nelo ninye atua olng'obor lenye, neirrag Sisera teine etua, etii encheitoi o lng'obor olpura le nkomom enye.
Neaku ore apa ina olong etimira Enkai Yabin olaiguanani le Kanaan te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel.
Netum enkaina oo ltung'ana le Israel engolon oleng tialo Yabin ilo aiguanani le Kanaan, o metaba anaa neidaikie Yabin olaiguanani le Kanaan.
Ore apa ina olong nerany Debora o Barak olayioni le Abinoam ele sinkolio:
“Ore te nkaraki natijing'a ilkituaak dukuya te Israel, ore te nkaraki naitaituo iltung'ana ate te yieunoto, meisisi Olaitoriani!
“Entoning intae Ilaiguanak, enchoru enkiok, lo kituaak; Olaitoriani nanu aranyaki, kaoshoki nanu olkerempe, Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel.
“Olaitoriani, ore ishomo iyie aaing'uaa Seir, nilo iyie te nkop e Edom, neikirikira enkop, neitong'u shumata, ee, neitong'u inkatambo enkare.
Neikirikira ildoinyo te dukuya Olaitoriani, lido doinyio le Sinai te dukuya Enkai e Israel.
“Ore apa too nkolong'i e Shamgar, olayioni le Anat, ore apa too nkolong'i e Yael, eishunye ilapuayak, ore lelo oopuaya neim embata oo nkoitoi.
Eishunye iloing'ok te Israel, eishunye ninche o metaba anaa nilotu iyie Debora alotu anaa ng'otonye e Israel.
Te negeluni apa kulie aitin, neaku nchomito etii olarrabal. Amaa, ketumi apa elong'o anaa empere tiatua nkalifuni artam te Israel?
Eipirta oltau lai ilarikok le njore e Israel, lelo apa ooitaituo ate te yieunoto tialo iltung'ana. Meisisi Olaitoriani.
“Embalunye ninye, intae ilooked isirkon barrikon, intae ilootonie ilmukekani oogol enkinyiang'a, o intae iloopuo te nkoitoi.

Ore too ltoiloishi loo laranyak, too wuejitin oo nkariak, ore teine nelikioo aaigil nkisulat o Laitoriani, enkisulata oo loing'ok lenye tiatua Israel. “Neruko aadoyio aaim nchomito iltung'ana lo Laitoriani.
“Inyo, Inyo, Debora! Inyo, inyo taranya osinkolio! Tudumunye, Barak, toriko lelo litarayie, La ayioni le Abinoam.
Nedoyio aapuo ilo pisiai loo lkituaak; neruko aadoyio iltung'ana lo Laitoriani, te nkaraki ninye, aapuo aarare lelo magil.

Ore ebaiki Efraim nepuonu ninche aaipang'u nejing oerata, kisujita iyie Benchamen tenebo iltung'ana linono. Ore te Makir neruko ilkituaak aapuo, ore te Sebulon neruko aapuo lelo oonap esiare o larikoni.
Eetuo ilkituaak le Isaakar te nebo Debora, o Isaakar oisiligayu te Barak; atua ilo erata ekuetikitia aasuj ninye. Ore tiatua ilgilat le Ruben netii apa eoro sapuk.
Kainyoo iyie pee itotona too ntare ijo pee ining nkisulat oo ntare? Ore tiatua ilgilat le Ruben netii eoro sapuk eitu emut tenaa keidim aaetu.
Etotona Gilead te lido kekun le Yordan; oo Dan, kainyoo pee etotona ninye too melin? Etotona Asheri aitirring'a to lomanaa le naiposha, neton abik te nedounyeki.
Ore Sebulon naa olorere otipika enkishui batisho o metabaiki keeya neijia sii etiu Naftali, too neerupa ti ong'ata.
“Eetuo ilaiguanak, neitayu olarrabal; nearare ilaiguanak le Kanaan, te Taanak, te mbata oo nkariak e Megido; neitu ninche etum iyarunot e nkosholai.
Ore te shumata keper etarate ilakir, ore epuoito ninche nearare Sisera.
Ore ilo keju le Kishon onang'ari neya ninche, ina are naisarrisar, o lkeju le Kishon. Lo tau lai, shomo dukuya te ngolon.
“Neitayu oltoilo le ndarata nkejek oo mbartan, eng'orori, aang'orori mbartan o larrabal.
“Tediaa Meros, neijia ejo olmalaika lo Laitoriani, tediaa te nduaran lelo oomanya ninye, amu eitu ninche epuonu aaretu Olaitoriani, aapuonu aaretu Olaitoriani earare lelo magil.
“Kemayiana Yael aisul too nkituaak, ina kitok e Heber loo Lkeni, kemayiana aisul tiatua nena kituaak naamanya lng'oborri.
Eikilikuanua ninye enkare neisho ninye kule, eyaka ninye kule naaoto te mbakuli e nkitoo.
Etipika ninye enkaina enye encheitoi o lng'obor. Ore te enkaina enye e tatene neibung enyuntu o laisiaayiani, neosh ninye Sisera, nedany endukuya enye, neud eseder enye.
Eirruge ninye nebatata, neirrag ninye too nkejek e Yael; too nkejek enyena eirruge neirrag, ore ine neirrugore neirrag etua.

“Te lusie ninye eturumishe, neishir ng'otonye e Sisera erumisho te lusie. ‘Kainyoo pee eimutie engarri enye oo mbartan eitu elotu? Kainyoo pee eimutie oltoilo loo nkejek oo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan?’
Ore nena kituaak enyena ng'eni newaliki, A'a, etawalikia ninye kewan,
‘Aimetumito neorita nena naataarutua, neya ake oltung'ani entito nabo aashu are. Ore te Sisera naa inkilani oomuain kumok, inkilani naaikodo, mpukunot are oomuain naaikodo te murt ai anaa iyarunot?’
“Meidaai aaiko neijia ilmang'ati linono Olaitoriani! Kake ore ilchoreta nchoo eilepu anaa enkolong eilepu te ngolon enye.” Netum apa enkop enkiyeng'iyeng ilarin artam.
Etaasa apa iltung'ana le Israel entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neishooyo Olaitoriani ninche apik atua inkaik e Midian ilarin oopishana.
Netum enkaina e Midian engolon alang Israel; ore te nkaraki Midian neitaiki iltung'ana le Israel ate ngumot too ldoinyo, o nkapuniaa o sempewueti.
Amu ore ake enkata pooki naun Isiraeli ilanterera, nepuonu Ilmidian o Ilmaleki o iltung'ana lo loo saen aarasaki ninche.
Nepuonu ninche aaitayu ilng'oborri aarare ninche neinyal nena daiki naatuunoki o metabaiki elatia enye Gasa, neing'uaa Israel metii endaa, nemetii enker aashu olkiteng aashu osikiria.
Amu kepuonu apa ninche te nebo nkishu enye o lng'oborri lenye, nepuonu eba anaa olmaati te nkumoi; ore ninche o ntamesin enye meikenayu, neaku keinyal apa enkop te nepuonu.
Neisomit apa Midian Israel oleng,
neishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani te nkaraki Ilmidian.

Neirriwaki Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Israel oloiboni; nejoki ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, Atorikoyie apa nanu intae ailepunye aitung'uaa Misiri, naipang'unye intae te nkop e sinkaisho;
nakordu intae te nkaina oo Lmisiri o te nkaina e lelo pooki ooibooki intae enkop, naaraa ninche te dukuya intae, naisho intae enkop enye.
Najoki nanu intae, ‘Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; mintokiki intae aayanyitu inkaitin oo Lamori, laa atua enkop enye imanyanya!’ Kake eitu intae ining'ining'i oltoilo lai.”

Nelotu apa olmalaika lo Laitoriani neton ti abori olchani apa laa ole Yoash te Ofra, Olabiesiri, ina kata apa eidong'ito olayioni lenye Gideon enkano te nkironyet oo sabibu, ejo pee eisudoo te nkaraki Ilmidian.
Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye nejoki, “Etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyie, iyie oloing'oni magilani.”

Nejoki Gideon ninye, “Aatoomono, olkitok, amaa tenaa ketii Olaitoriani te nebo iyiook, kainyoo naa pee etadoikitio iyiook kuna pooki? Naa koree nkiasin enyena pooki e nking'asia apa naainosakita iyiook iloo papa, ejo, ‘Keitu ninye eilepunye iyiook Olaitoriani aitung'uaa Misiri?’ Kake ore taata eiturrayie iyiook Olaitoriani neishooyie iyiook apik atua inkaik oo Lmidian.”
Neibelekenyakino Olaitoriani ninye nejoki, “Shomo tena magilanisho ino tokordu Israel te nkaina e Midian; aime nanu laairriwayie?”
Nejoki ninye, “Aatoomono, Olaitoriani, kaji nanu aiko te nakordu Israel? Ng'ura ajo ore olgilata lang naa ninye oloti te Manase, naa nanu oloti lo lmarei lang.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Ee, kake atii nanu te nebo iyie, naa iosh iyie Ilmidian anaa oltung'ani obo.”
Nejoki ninye, “Tenaa taata kanoto omom te iyie, ntoduaaki naa olmonekie inchere iyie doi ilo likirorie nanu.
Milo iyie aing'uaa ene, aatoomono o metaba anaa nalotu nanu enitii, pee ayau enkishooroto ai, nairragie te dukuya iyie.” Nejo ninye, “Katon nanu o metaba anaa nishukunye.”
Neaku eshomo Gideon enkaji enye neyieng olkuoo, neitobir imukateni neitu eisuishieki e nkurma; nepik inkiri atua enkikapu, nepik imotori atua emoti, neyaki ninye ti abori olchani, neitarasaki ninche.
Nejoki ilo malaika le Nkai ninye, “Ntayu nena kiri o nena mukateni neitu eisuishieki tipika ninche enchumata ena dapidapoi nibukoki imotori shumata ninche.” Neiko ninye neijia.

Neitoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani aitorioo ina ng'udi apa natii enkaina enye, neiseyie nena kiri o nena mukateni apa neitu eisuishieki; neipang'u enkima teine te ndapidapoi nenya nena kiri o nena mukateni neitu eisuishieki; neimin ilo malaika lo Laitoriani too nkonyek enyena.
Nemusu taa Gideon inchere olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye; nejo Gideon, “Oi nanu, Olaitoriani Enkai! Amu atoduare nanu olmalaika lo Laitoriani king'ura too nkomomi.”
Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani ninye, “Metaa eseriani te nebo iyie, miureishoyu, miye iyie.”
Neshetaki Gideon teine Olaitoriani olperere lo lasar, nejo ninye, “Olaitoriani eseriani.” Ore ebaiki ena olong neton eitashe ilo perere te Ofra nara enoo Ilabieseri.

Ore ina kewarie nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Iwa oloing'oni li are le papaai lino, ilo loo larin oopishana, niuroki enkop ilo perere lo lasar le Baal oata papaai lino, nidung ina Ashera natii embata enye.

Nishet olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ino te nchumata o osempewuet tene, nirragie isoito aitobiraki, niyau ilo oing'oni li are nintaa olasar opejori te nena keek e ina Ashera nidung meirraga te nkop.”

Neya Gideon iltung'ana tomon te lelo aisiaayiak lenyena, neas anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani ninye, kake ore amu keure apa aataas dama te nkaraki olmarei lenye, o lelo tung'ana le ina ang, etaasa apa ninye ina kewarie.

Ore pee einyototo iltung'ana teina ang tadekenya enasirie nedol etigilaki olperere lo lasar le Baal, ore ina Ashera apa natii embata enye netudung'oki meirraga te nkop, ore ilo oing'oni li are neitaaki olasar te nchumata e ilo perere lo lasar oteshetaki.
Nejokino ninche maate, “Kaing'ae otaasa ena?” Ore ake pee eidip aatujurr neikilikuanu, nejo ninche, “Gideon olayioni le Yoash otaasa ena.”
Nejoki iltung'ana teina ang Yoash, “Mpang'unye olayioni lino, pee etum atua, amu etusulua ninye olperere lo lasar le Baal, netudung'o ina Ashera natashare.”

Nejoki Yoash lelo pooki apa ooing'orunore ninye, “Ai Baal ing'oring'oro intae? Aashu orrekie lenye igolielie? Ore oloba anaa oloing'or ninye neyookini aar metua tadekenya. Tenaa ke nkai ninye nchoo eing'or kewan amu etusulayioki aauroo olperere lenye lo lasar.”
Neaku ore ebaiki ina olong etaa keji ninye Yerubaal, aa taa, “Nchoo Baal eng'or kewan” amu etusulayie ninye auroo olperere lenye lo lasar.
Neitoki iltung'ana le Midian o le Amaleki o iltung'ana le nkalo o loo saen aaipotuno te nebo, nelang'u Yordan neshet ilng'oborri to oerata le Yesreel.
Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata Gideon, neosh ninye esekekua neipotuni iltung'ana le Abiesiri metusujai ninye.
Neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku meshomo atua Manase pooki, neipotuni sii ninche metusujai ninche. Neitoki airriwaa ilkiliku meshomo Asher, o Sebulon, o Naftali neilep ninche aapuo aanang'are ninche.
Neitoki Gideon ajoki Enkai, “Tenaa eikordu iyie Israel te nkaina ai anaa enitejo,

ng'ura, kairragie nanu endapana e nker te wueji neidong'ieki enkano; ore ake pee ejing enkoileelio endapana ake, netoyio enkae wueji pooki, nayiolou taa ajo ikordu iyie Israel te nkaina ai, anaa enitejo iyie.”
Netiu neijia. Ore ake pee einyototo Gideon tadekenya enasirie neirony ina dapana, neironyu enkoileelio naiputa olbakuli enkare.

Neitoki Gideon ajoki Enkai, “Mincho iyie engoro ino eyupuyup tialo nanu, kake nchooki nanu mairoro ena kata nabo ake, aatoomono, nchooki nanu manyaaki atem ena kata nabo endapana; aatoomono, nchoo endapana ake metoyio, ore enkae kop pooki nchoo ejing enkoileelio.”
Neiko Enkai neijia ina kewarie; amu etoyio apa endapana ake, ore enkop pooki nejing enkoileelio.

Neitoki Gideon (oji sii Yerubaal) o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye aadumunye tadekenya nepuo aaitayu ilng'oborri te mbata enchorro e Harod; netii apa ilng'oborri le Midian moikuape enye, embata oldoinyo le More, tiatua oerata.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Eikumok kulo tung'ana ootii te nebo iyie te nanu, te naishoru ile Midian apik atua inkaik enye, mewuasayu ake Israel tialo nanu, ejo, ‘Enkaina ai makewan naatokordua nanu.

Ore naa taata mbalunye too nkiyiaa oo ltung'ana, tejo, ore pooki ng'ae otureishe neikirikira, nchoo ninye eshuko alo ang.’” Netem Gideon ninche, neshuko iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oaare, neleku iltung'ana inkalifuni tomon.

Nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Eton aa kumok kulo tung'ana oleng; toriko ninche metadoi aapuo enkare pee atem nanu ninche teine. Ore olaajoki nanu, ‘Kelo ele tung'ani te nebo iyie,’ nelo te nebo iyie, ore oloba anaa olaajoki, ‘Melo ele tung'ani te nebo iyie’, melo ninye.”
Nerik ninye iltung'ana enkare; nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Ore pooki oilab enkare to lng'ejep lenye, anaa enailab oldia, taaraki ninye enkalo nabo, neijia ake sii nkuna ilo ogil kung aok enkare.”
Ore esiana e lelo ooilab enkare, epik nkaik enye nkutukie enye naa iltung'ana iip uni; kake ore ilkulikae tung'ana pooki negil kung aaok enkare.

Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Gideon, “Ore te lelo tung'ana iip uni ooilab enkare naa kakordu nanu intae napik iltung'ana le Midian atua inkaik inyi; naa nchoo lelo kulikae tung'ana meshomo pooki tung'ani enkang enye.”

Neya ninye iltooi le lelo tung'ana o sekekuani too nkaik enye, neisho ninye lelo kulikae pooki le Israel meshomo ake oltung'ani olng'obor lenye, kake eiboo lelo tung'ana apa iip uni; netii apa ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Midian abori ninye to erata.
Ore apa ina kewarie nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Tudumunye shomo tadoi taara enkang oo lng'oborri, amu aishorua nanu apik enkaina ino.
Kake ti niure iyie ashomo, tadoi shomo ina ang oo lng'oborri te nebo Pura, osinka lino;

amu ilo iyie aning enejo ninche; ore te siadi ina nikigolu oshoke pee ilo arasaki lelo ng'oborri.” Nedoyio ninye alo te nebo Pura, ilo sinka lenye, nepuo enetii iltung'ana oobayie ooata imasaa o larrabal le lelo ng'oborri.
Ore lelo tung'ana le Midian o le Maleki o ltung'ana pooki lo loo saen neirrag to erata eba anaa olmaati te nkumoi; ore ntamesin enye nemeikenayu, eba anaa osinyai le nkiyopata e naiposha te nkumoi.

Ore ake pee elotu Gideon, nedol etii oltung'ani oinosaki ole ncholiek enye enkidetidet; nejoki, “Ng'ura aidetidetua nanu emukate natadoikio atua enkang oo lng'oborri oo le Midian, nelotu olng'obor obo, neosh neibelekeny airragie ti oriong, neaku te nkop eirrag ilo ng'obor.”
Newaliki ilo oboitare ajoki, “Mme likae ele leme olalem le Gideon olayioni le Yoash, oltung'ani le Israel; atua enkaina enye etipika Enkai Midian o lorora lenye pooki.”

Ore ake pee ening Gideon elimunoto e ina kidetidet o empukunoto enye, neserem; neshuko alo ilng'oborri le Israel, nejo, “Entudumunye, amu eishorua Olaitoriani ilo orora le Midian apik atua enkaina inyi.”
Neor ninye lelo tung'ana iip uni aitaa ilturrurri okuni, nepik intarumpetani inkaik enye pooki o ltooi lemetii enkare, nepik ilkilang'ilang'eta tiatua nena tooi.
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Eng'uraki nanu, niasiasa enaas; te nalotu nanu auluo e nkang oo lng'oborri entaas anaa enaas nanu.
Te naosh nanu esekekua, nanu o lelo pooki ootii te nebo nanu, entoosh sii intae intarumpetani te pooki shoto e nkang oo lng'oborri, nibuakuku aajo, ‘Te nkaraki Olaitoriani o te nkaraki Gideon.’ ”

Nelotu Gideon o lelo tung'ana iip apa ootii te nebo ninye auluo e nkang oo lng'oborri te mpolos e nkewarie, ina kata ake pee eibelekenya ilarripok, nekut ninche intarumpetani, nedany lelo tooi apa ootii inkaik enye.

Neosh lelo turrurri okuni intarumpetani nedany lelo tooi; neibung too nkaik enye e kedianye inkilang'ilang'eta. Ore too nkaik enye e tatene neibung'ita intarumpetani pee eosh; nebuaku ninche aajo, “Olalem lo Laitoriani o Gideon!”
Neitashe ninche oltung'ani ake te wueji enye emanita ina ang oo lng'oborri, nekuet ina jore pooki, neyietu aaishir, neisik.

Ore ake pee eosh nena tarumpetani iip uni neiuloki Olaitoriani olalem ake lo ltung'ani olikae tung'ani o enjore pooki; neisik ina jore o meshomo Betshita enkalo e Serera, o metabaiki olpolosie le Abel-mehola, te mbata e Tabat.
Neipotuni iltung'ana le Israel te Naftali o te Asheri o te Manase pooki metusujai aamir iltung'ana le Midian.

Neirriwaki Gideon ilkiliku aibulunye ina kop pooki oo ldoinyo e Efraim, ejo, “Entadou wootu mataarare iltung'ana le Midian, nimbung'ubung'u nena ariak ebaiki Betbara o Yordan.” Neipotuni iltung'ana pooki le Efraim, neibung ninche nkariak ebaiki Betbara, o Yordan sii.

Neya ninche lelo kituaak pokira oaare le Midian, Oreb o Seeb; near ninche Oreb metua te ndapidapoi e Oreb, ore Seeb near metua te nkironyet oo sabibu e Seeb, ina kata esujita ninche iltung'ana le Midian; neyau ninche ilukuny e Oreb o Seeb enetii Gideon te lido kekun le Yordan.
Nejoki iltung'ana le Efraim Gideon, “Kainyoo ena nintaasa iyie iyiook, eitu impot iyiook te nilo aarare Midian?” Neilepilepaki ninye oleng.
Nejoki Gideon ninche, “Kaa nanu ataasa te naaitanyaanyukieki intae? Aimesidan ilekunot oo sabibu le Efraim alang enkikesare e Abisi?

Eishorua Enkai apik atua inkaik inyi lelo kituaak le Midian, Oreb o Seeb: kaa nanu aaidim ataasa te naaitanyaanyukieki intae?” Neyagaa taa engoro enye apa natagorokinote apa ninye, ina kata pee ejo neijia.
Nelotu Gideon Yordan nelang alo lido kekun le Yordan, ninye o lelo tung'ana iip uni apa ootii te nebo ninye, enaurate nesujita ake olmang'atinta.
Neaku etiaaka apa ninye lelo tung'ana le Sukot, “Atoomono intae, enchoo sii ake endaa kulo tung'ana laasujita nanu, amu etaa keiterre, nasujita nanu Seba o Salmuna, lelo aiguanak le Midian.”
Nejo lelo kituaak le Sukot, “Keidipa Seba o Salmuna aatijing atua enkaina ino metaa eji eikincho iyiook endaa enjore ino?”
Nejo Gideon, “Ore te nkaraki ena, ore kenya te nelo nepik Olaitoriani Seba o Salmuna enkaina ai nayiet nanu iseseni linyi too ikiku lo lpurkel o te ntamejoi.”
Nedumunye teine nelo Penuel, neirorie iltung'ana teine teina oitoi; newaliki iltung'ana le Penuel ninye anaa apa enatawalikitia iltung'ana le Sukot.
Nejoki ninye iltung'ana le Penuel, “Ore te naitoki ashukunye te seriani nagil ele talet asulu.”

Netii apa Seba o Salmuna Karkor te nebo enjore enye, iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni tomon o imiet, lelo pooki apa ootelekuaki te njore pooki oo ltung'ana lo loosaen; amu etabatatate apa iltung'ana nkalifuni iip o tikitam ooata lalema.
Neilep apa Gideon aim enkoitoi naim intamesin to loosaen le Neba o Yogbeha nerasaki ina jore; amu merripo apa ina jore.
Neisik Seba o Salmuna; nemir ninye ninche neibung lelo aiguanak pokira oaare le Midian, Seba o Salmuna, nepik ninye ina jore pooki olkirutoto.
Neitoki Gideon olayioni le Yoash ashukunye to larrabal aimu embata e nkilepunoto e Heresi.
Neibung olbarnoti le Sukot, neikilikuanishore ninye, neigeroki ilo barnoti ninye ilkituaak loo lpayiani le Sukot, iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana o opishana.

Nelotu Gideon enetii iltung'ana le Sukot, nejoki, “Eng'ura Seba o Salmuna, laa ninche apa kitusurdaanyie nanu ijojo, ‘Keidipa Seba o Salmuna, aatijing atua enkaina ino pee kitum aaishoo endaa lelo tung'ana linono ooiterre?’ ”
Neya Gideon ilpayiani le ina anasa neya ilkiku lo lpurkel o entamejoi neiteng'enie ninche iltung'ana le Sukot.
Negil ninye asulu oltalet le Penuel, nesesekuan iltung'ana le ina anasa.

Neitoki ninye ajoki Seba o Salmuna, “Koree apa iltung'ana litasesekuana te Tabor?” Newal ninche aajo, “Ore anaa eninkununo iyie, neijia apa eikununo ninche, oltung'ani ake te ninche; kenyaanyukie apa ninche ilayiok lo laiguanani.”
Nejo Gideon, “Ilalashara laainei apa ninche, ilayiok le yieyio; ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, tenaa apa eitajeutuo ninche aaitopok, anaata nanu masesekuan intae.”
Nejoki ninye Yeter olkikau lenye, “Tudumunye tasesekuana ninche.” Kake eitu apa eshutu ilo barnoti olalem lenye; amu eturia, te nkaraki apa neton aa olbarnoti.

Neitoki Seba o Salmuna aajo, “Tudumunye makewan tadoiki iyiook: amu ore anaa enatiu oltung'ani, naa neijia etiu engolon enye.” Nedumunye Gideon nesesekuan Seba o Salmuna, neya nena masaa apa naatii imurto o ntamesin enye.
Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aajoki Gideon, “Ntoria iyiook, iyie o layioni o layioni lo layioni lino, amu itokordua iyiook aitayu te nkaina e Midian.”
Nejoki Gideon ninche, “Maitore nanu intae, nemeitore intae olayioni lai; Olaitoriani ninye oitore intae.”

Neitoki Gideon ajoki ninche, “Enchooki nanu matoomono intae entoki nabo; enchooki nanu pooki ng'ae te intae ilgiso loo nkiyiaa apa liwaita le lelo tung'ana litaara.” (Amu eeta apa ninche ilgiso loo nkiyaa le saabu, te nkaraki naa ile Ishmael.)
Newal ninche aajo, “Eikinchoru iyiook te nyorrata.” Neisalaash ninche olkila, nenang'aki ine pooki tung'ani lelo giso loo nkiyiaa apa ooyaua.

Ore enkiroishi e lelo giso loo nkiyiaa le saabu apa ootoomonuo naa shekeli e saabu enkalifu nabo o iip naapishana, te nebo imasaa o nkilani sinteti apa naaishopito lelo kituaak le Midian o lkataarri apa ootii imurto oo ntamesin enye.
Neitayunye Gideon enkila dorrop ina saabu nepik ninye enkanasa enye makewan, Ofra; neloloito Israel pooki te ninye, neaku orreshet te Gideon o to lmarei lenye.
Neaku etimira apa iltung'ana le Israel Midian, neitu aekata eigil aairish ninche. Netum apa enkop enkiyeng'iyeng ilarin artam too nkolong'i e Gideon.
Nelo apa Yerubaal olayioni le Yoash aton te nkaji enye.
Neeta apa Gideon ilayiok ntomoni naapishana, inot lenyena, amu keeta apa nkituaak kumok.
Ore apa enkapiani enye natii Shekem neiu sii ninye olayioni, neji enkarna enye Abimelek.
Neye apa Gideon olayioni le Yoash etaa moruo oleng, nenukari ninye te nkurare e Yoash papaai lenye, te Ofra oo Labiesi.
Erisio ake etua Gideon, neibelekenya iltung'ana le Israel aaloloito aasujaa inkaitin e Baal, neitaa Baal-berit enkai enye.
Neitu eitoki iltung'ana le Israel aadamu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, laa ninye apa otokordua ninche aitayu te nkaina oo lmang'ati lenye pooki te pooki shoto.
Neitu ninche eitaas isidain olmarei le Gideon (oji sii Yerubaal) te nkaraki nena pooki sidain naaitaasa ninye Israel.
Nelo apa Abimelek olayioni le Gideon Shekem, enetii ilalashera ng'otonye nejoki ninche o lgilata pooki lo lmarei le ng'otonye,

“Entejo too nkiyiaa e kulo oomanya Shekem, ‘Kaa naikash te intae, te neitore intae ilayiok pokira ntomoni naapishana anaa te neitore intae obo?’ Entadamu sii aajo kara nanu oloito linyi o erubata inyi.”
Neiro ilalashera ng'otonye kulo rorei pooki te rishata enye too inkiyiaa oo ltung'ana pooki te Shekem: neng'amaa iltauja lenye pee esujaa Abimelek, amu etejo ninche, “Olalashe lang ninye.”
Neisho ninche ninye mpisai e nkosholai ntomoni naapishana naaing'uaa enkaji e Baalberit, naa ninche eigerie Abimelek iltung'ana le pesho arruok, apa ootusuja ninye.

Nelo ninye enkaji e papaai lenye te Ofra nesesekuan ilalashera lenyena, lelo ayiok le Yerubaal, pokira ntomoni naapishana, te nchumata osoit obo; kake etelekuaki apa Yotam olayioni oti le Yerubaal, amu eisudoyie kewan.
Neiturrurrunye lelo oomanya Shekem te nebo, o Bet-milo pooki, nepuo ninche neitaa Abimelek olaiguanani, te mbata o lchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli le ng'ape te Shekem.
Ore ake pee elikini Yotam, nelo ninye aitashe te nchumata o ldoinyo le Gerisim, neyietu aishir nejoki ninche, “Entoning'oki nanu lo tung'ana le Shekem, pee etum Enkai atoning'o intae.
Eshomo apa ilkeek aagelaki ate olaiguanani, nejoki ninche oloirien, ‘Ntoria iyiook.’
Nejoki ilo oirien ninche, ‘Kaing'uaa nanu eilata ai naa ninye eyanyitieki inkaitin o ltung'ana, nalo alimana tiatua ilkeek?’
Nejoki lelo keek olng'aboli, ‘Wou iyie ntoria iyiook.’
Nejoki ilo ng'aboli ninche, ‘Kalo nanu aing'uaa emeloni ai o lng'anayioi lai sidai nalo alimana too lkeek?’
Nejoki lelo keek osabibu, ‘Wou iyie ntoria iyiook.’
Nejoki ilo sabibu ninche,
‘Kalo nanu aing'uaa enaisho ai oo sabibu naa ninye naitiship inkaitin o ltung'ana nalo alimana too lkeek?’ Nejoki ilkeek pooki olchani onyaanyukie olayakuji, ‘Wou iyie ntoria iyiook.’

Nejoki ilo shani onyaanyukie olayakuji lelo keek, ‘Tinikibukokiki nanu eilata aaitaa olaiguanani maitoria intae, wootu naa entaseriana to loip lai; naa te neme neijia, nchoo meipang'u enkima te ilo shani loo lkiku nemut lelo tarakua le Lebanon.’

“Ore naa taata, tenaa eitaasa apa intae te nkirukoto sidai o te nkanyit ina kata apa pee intaa intae Abimelek olaiguanani, naa tenintaasa apa intae esidai Gideon o enkaji enye, nintaasa intae ninye anaa enaishiaakino inkiasin enyena
amu etarishe papa te nkaraki intae, nepik enkishui enye batisho, nekordu intae aitung'uaa enkaina e Midian;

nitudumakinote intae enkaji e papa aarare ena olong, nitasesekuana intae ilayiok lenyena, iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana te nchumata osoit obo, nintaa Abimelek olayioni le nkapiani, olaiguanani oitore lelo oomanya Shekem, te nkaraki naa olalashe linyi.
Tenaa eitaasa apa te nkirukoto sidai o te nkanyit o Yerubaal o enkaji enye ena olong, enting'idakinoto naa Abimelek, naa nchoo sii ninye eng'idakino intae,
kake te neme neijia, nchoo enkima epuku te Abimelek, nemut lelo oomanya Shekem o Bet-milo nemut Abimelek.”
Nekuet Yotam aisik, nelo Beer-sheba nebik teine, te nkaraki naure Abimelek olalashe lenye.
Neitore Abimelek Israel ilarin okuni.
Neirriu Enkai oltau torrono erishata e Abimelek o lelo tung'ana le Shekem; ore lelo tung'ana le Shekem neitaas Abimelek intorrok;

nchere ore ina torroni apa naitaasaki lelo ayiok pokira ntomoni naapishana le Yerubaal naa kelotu osarge lenye shumata Abimelek olalashe lenye, laa ninye apa otasesekuana ninche, o shumata lelo tung'ana le Shekem laa ninche apa ooitagolo inkaik enyena metesesekuana ilalashera lenyena.
Nepik lelo tung'ana le Shekem iltung'ana olnukata pee ear Abimelek te nchumata o ldoinyo, neoru ninche ntokitin lelo pooki apa ootogiroitie ninche te nkoitoi, nelikini Abimelek.
Nelo apa Gaal olayioni le Ebed Shekem te nebo ilalashera lenyena, neisilig apa iltung'ana le Shekem ninye.
Neipang ninche aapuo nkurman, nesotu ninche isabibu te nena kurman enye oo sabibu, neirony ninche, nenya osirua, nepuo atua enkaji e nkai enye, nedaa neokisho nedek Abimelek.

Nejo Gaal olayioni le Ebed, “Kaing'ae Abimelek naa eikira iyiook nyoo ile Shekem, eji pee kisiaai ninye? Keitu eisiaai olayioni le Yerubaal o Sebul, olkitok lenye, iltung'ana le Hamori, menye le Shekem? Kainyoo naa pee kisiaai iyiook ninye?
Tenaa naaji kaabori enkaina ai etii ele orere anaata aiwuang'ie Abimelek. Anaata ajoki Abimelek, ‘Toponai enjore ino, nimpang'u alotu.’ ”
Ore ake pee ening Sebul ilo apa laa ninye oitore enkanasa irorei le Gaal olayioni le Ebed, neyupuyup engoro enye.
Neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku enetii Abimelek te Aruma, ejo, “Ng'ura, ore Gaal olayioni le Ebed o lalashera lenyena eetuo Shekem, neing'oling'ola ninche enkanasa pee kiarare iyie.
Ore naa taata, shomo kewarie, iyie o lelo tung'ana ootii te nebo iyie nirragirraga aanyu ti ong'ata.

Ore te nkakenya, ore ake pee eng'oru enkolong iltiil, nidumunyenye aayooki nikuetikiki ina anasa. Ore ake pee kimpang'aki ninye o lelo tung'ana ootii te nebo ninye aapuonu aarare, entaasa ninche anaa enaishiaakino.”
Nedumunye Abimelek o lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye kewarie, neirrag aanyisho pee earare Shekem too lturrurri oong'uan.
Neipang Gaal olayioni le Ebed alo aitashe te nejing'ieki kishomi e nkanasa; nedumunye Abimelek o lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye to lnukata.
Ore ake pee edol Gaal lelo tung'ana nejoki Sebul, “Ng'ura, iltung'ana edou aapuonu too nchumat oo ldoinyo!” Nejoki Sebul ninye, “Iloipi loo ldoinyo idol, nijo iltung'ana.”
Neitoki Gaal airo nejo, “Ng'ura, iltung'ana edou aaing'uaa empolos e nkop, ore oltim obo nelotu aimu enkalo o lchani loo laitumusumusok onyaanyukie olng'aboli.”
Neitoki Sebul ajoki ninye, “Koree naa taata enkutuk ino, iyie apa otejo ‘Kainyoo ninye Abimelek eji metaa eikisiaai ninye?’ Aime kulo tung'ana apa itemena? Mpang'a taata shomo taarare ninche.”
Neipang Gaal alo ajing dukuya iltung'ana le Shekem nearare Abimelek.
Nemir Abimelek ninye, neisik ninye te dukuya Abimelek, nebatata ilkumok ootipikaki ilbaa, o metabaiki enejing'ieki kishomi.
Nebik Abimelek te Aruma; nearaa Sebul Gaal o lalashera lenyena, pee meitoki ninche aatoni te Shekem.
Ore pee ekenyu neipang lelo tung'ana aapuo ong'ata. Nelikini Abimelek.
Nedung ninye iltung'ana lenyena metaa ilturrurri okuni, neirrag aanyisho ti ong'ata. Neing'orisho ninye nedol iltung'ana eipang'u aapuku te nkanasa, nedumunye ninye, aar ninche nesesekuan ninche.

Neisarrisar Abimelek o ilo tim apa otii te nebo ninye nepuo aaitashe te nejing'ieki kishomi e nkanasa, ina kata eisarisaraki lelo timito pokira oaare o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii ong'ata nesesekuan ninche.
Nearare Abimelek ina anasa ina olong pooki, neya ninye ina anasa near metuata lelo tung'ana apa ootii atua, nemut ina anasa nebukoki enkop emunyan.
Ore ake pee ening lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii oltalet le Shekem ina, nejing ninche osempewuet le nkaji e Elberit.
Netolikioki apa Abimelek nchere eiturrurrote iltung'ana pooki to ltalet le Shekem te nebo.

Neilep Abimelek alo oldoinyo le Salmon, ninye o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye. Nedumu Abimelek entolu te nkaina enye, nedung'u olng'osila lo lchani, nedumu aiteleiki oloililai lenye. Nejoki lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye, “Ore ina nikitoduaa nanu aasita, esarisara entaas, anaa enataasa nanu.”

Neaku etudung'uo pooki ng'ae te lelo tung'ana olng'osila lenye nesuj Abimelek neirishakini ilo sempewuet, nepik ilo sempewuet enkima te shumata ninche, neaku etuata apa sii ninche iltung'ana pooki to ltalet le Shekem, iltung'ana oobaya enkalifu ilewa o nkituaak.
Neitoki Abimelek alo Tebes, nelo aitayu ilng'oborri aarare Tebes, neya ninye.
Kake etii apa oltalet ogol atua ina anasa, ore iltung'ana pooki le nkanasa neisik aapuo ine, ilewa pooki o nkituaak, neikenoo ate tiatua ine; nepuo ninche enchumata o ltalet.
Nelotu Abimelek ilo talet, nearare ninye, nenyiku alotu enkutuk e ilo talet pee epejoo ninye te nkima.
Nenang'u enkitok nabo nenang'aki osoit le shumata oituutishoreki endukuya e Abimelek, nedany elukunya enye.

Neipotu nabo kata ilo barnoti apa onapaki ruparen, nejoki ninye, “Tushutu olalem lino taaraki nanu matua, mejo ake ilewa tialo nanu, ‘Enkitok natara ninye metua.’ ” Nerem ilo barnoti aipang'ie olalem, neye ninye.
Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana le Israel nchere etua Abimelek, nepuo ninche oltung'ani ake enkang enye.
Neijia eikuna Olaitoriani Enkai aitalaku entorroni e Abimelek apa nataasa tialo papaai lenye pee ear ilalashera lenyena pokira ntomoni naapishana.
Neisho sii Enkai entorroni pooki oo ltung'ana le Shekem metadoiki nchumat oo lukuny enye, nelotu shumata ninche ilo deket apa le Yotam olayioni le Yerubaal.
Ore te siadi Abimelek nedumunye Tola olayioni le Pua, olayioni le Dodo pee ekordu Israel, oltung'ani le Isaakar, neton apa ninye te Shamir tiatua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim.
Neaku ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin tikitam ookuni. Neye ninye, nenukari te Shamir.
Ore te siadi ninye nedumunye Yair, ilo le Gilead, laa ninye apa otaa olarishani le Israel ilarin tikitam oaare.
Neeta apa ninye ilayiok tomoni uni ooked isirkon tomoni uni; neeta apa ninche nkanas tomoni uni, naaji Yair o metabaiki ena olong, apa naatii enkop e Gilead.
Neye apa Yair nenukari te Kamon.

Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aas intorrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neisiaai inkaitin e Baal o Ashtarot, nena aitin e Siria o nkaitin e Sidon o nkaitin e Moab o nkaitin oo Lamori o nkaitin oo Filistia, neing'uaa ninche Olaitoriani neitu eisiaai ninye.
Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani tialo Israel, nemir ninye ninche metijing'a atua enkaina oo Lfilisti o atua enkaina oo Lamori.

Neisomit ninche neibooki enkop iltung'ana le Israel te ilo ari. Ore too larin tomon o isiet neibooki ninche enkop lelo tung'ana le Israel apa ootii lido kekun le Yordan te nkop oo Lamori, apa natii Gilead.
Nelang'u Ilamori Yordan aapuonu sii aarare Yuda earare Benchamen nearare enkaji e Efraim; neaku etudupa osina Israel oleng.
Neishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, ejo, “Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki tialo iyie, te nkaraki nikitung'uaitie Enkai ang nikisiaai inkaitin e Baal.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Israel, “Keitu apa nanu akordu intae aitung'uaa Ilmisiri naitung'uaa Ilamori, naitung'uaa Ilamoni naitung'uaa Ilfilisti?
Eibookito sii intae enkop iltung'ana le Sidon o Lmaleki o Lmaoni; nikinchirakiki intae nanu, nakordu nanu intae aitayu tiatua inkaik enye.
Ore ake eyia kitung'uaitie intae nanu nipuopuo aaisiaai kulie aitin; neaku maitoki nanu akordu intae.
Enchom enchiraki nena aitin nitudutaitie; nchoo ninche ekordu intae te nkata inyi o sina.”
Nejoki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, “Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki; ntaasa iyiook anaa enidol eishiaakino te iyie; kake tokordu ake duoo iyie iyiook, kitoomono iyie ena olong.”
Neiwuang'ie ninche nena aitin omon apa naatii atua ninche, neisiaai Olaitoriani, netum ninye emion oleng te nkaraki osina le Israel.
Neipotuni apa iltung'ana le Amon metanapata, nepik ninche ilng'oborri lenye Gilead, neiturrurro sii ninche iltung'ana le Israel te nebo, nepik ilng'oborri lenye Mispa.
Ore lelo tung'ana, lelo arikok le Gilead, nejokino maate, “Kalo tung'ani oiteru aarare ile Amon? Ore ilo oiteru naa ninye oaku olkitok te lelo pooki oomanya Gilead.”
Ore apa Yepta ilo le Gilead naa olmurrani magilani, kake olayioni apa le mulayoi ninye. Gilead apa menye le Yepta.
Ore apa enkitok e Gilead neiki sii ninye ilayiok. Ore ake pee ebulu lelo ayiok le ina kitok enye, nearaa ninche Yepta, nejoki ninye, “Mijung iyie enkaji e papa lang; amu ira iyie oliae kitok.”
Neisik Yepta aing'uaa ilalashera lenyena, nelo abik te nkop e Tob; neiturrurrokino iltung'ana le pesho Yepta, nepuo aarisho te nebo ninye.
Ore te nkiti rishata neitayunye iltung'ana le Amon olarrabal Israel.
Ore ake pee eitayunye iltung'ana le Amon Israel olarrabal, nepuo ilpayiani le Gilead aariku Yepta te nkop e Tob.
Nejoki ninche Yepta, “Wou taa olarikoni lang, pee kitum iyiook aataarare Ilamoni.”
Kake etiaaka Yepta lelo payiani le Gilead, “Keitu apa intae kimbayuyu nanu, nikiaraa nanu aaipang'ie te nkaji e papa lai? Kainyoo taata pee ietuo enatii nanu iatata enyamali?”
Nejoki lelo payiani le Gilead Yepta, “Ina pee kimbelekenyakinote taata iyiook iyie, pee itum ashomo te nebo iyiook niarare Ilamoni, niaku olarikoni lang te lelo pooki oomanya Gilead.”
Nejoki Yepta lelo payiani le Gilead, “Ti nikintokiki nanu aaya ang mashomo aarare Ilamoni, ore ake pee aaisho Olaitoriani ninche, naaku nanu olarikoni linyi.”
Nejoki lelo payiani le Gilead Yepta, “Olaitoriani olo aaku shakeni te rishata ang, kesipa eikiaas iyiook anaa enitejo.”
Nelo Yepta te nebo lelo payiani le Gilead, neitaa ninye iltung'ana endukuya o larikoni te shumata ninche; neiro irorei lenyena pooki te dukuya Olaitoriani te Mispa.
Neitoki Yepta airriwaa ilkiliku enetii olaiguanani le Amon nejoki, “Kainyoo iyie kiatakinore nanu, pee iewuo enatii nanu, pee iarare enkop ai?”

Newaliki ilo aiguanani le Amon lelo apa ooirriwayie Yepta ajoki, “Te nkaraki naa ore apa Israel pee elotu te Misiri neya enkop ai, ebaiki Arnon o metabaiki Yabok nelo abaiki Yordan; ore naa taata torrinyu te seriani.”
Neitoki Yepta airriwaki ilkiliku olaiguanani le Amon,
nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Yepta: Eitu eya Israel enkop e Moab aashu enkop e Amon,
kake ore apa pee eilepu Israel te Misiri nepuo aaim olpurkel o metabaiki Enaiposha Nanyokie nepuonu Kadesh.

Neirriwaki Israel ilkiliku olaiguanani le Edom, ejo, ‘Nchoo siaake iyiook maima enkop ino.’ Kake etanya olaiguanani le Edom ening. Neitoki sii airriwaki ilkiliku olaiguanani le Moab, kake eitu enyorraa. Neaku etobiko apa Israel te Kadesh.

Neim ninche olpurkel pooki nepuo aamanaa te nkop e Edom o enkop e Moab, nepuo aaitayu ilng'oborri te nkae shoto e Arnon; kake eitu ninche ejing atua enkop e Moab, ore apa Arnon naa ninye olpolosie le Moab.
Neitoki Isiraeli aairriwaki ilkiliku Sihon loo Lamori o laiguanani le Heshbon; nejoki Israel ninye, ‘Nchoo sii ake iyiook matulusoi kitasayia iyie, aaim enkop ino aapuo enkop ang.’
Kake eitu apa eisilig Sihon Israel meima enkop enye; neaku eiturrurro apa Sihon iltung'ana lenyena pooki te nebo, neitayu ilng'oborri te Yahas, nearare Israel.
Neishoru Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel Sihon o ltung'ana lenyena pooki apik atua inkaik oo Siraeli, nemir Israel ninche; neya taa Israel ina kop pooki oo Lamori, apa oomanya ina kop.
Neya sii ina kop pooki oo Lamori ebaiki Arnon o metabaiki Yabok o ebaiki olpurkel o metabaiki Yordan.
Neaku taa, Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ninye otaarayie aoru Ilamori te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena, Israel; naa amaa iya iyie ninche araya?
Eimiya iyie ina nikincho Kemosh enkai ino? Ore ina pooki naatarua Olaitoriani Enkai ang te dukuya iyiook nikiya iyiook.
Eira iyie supat alang Balak olayioni le Sipor, olaiguanani le Moab? Ketekeshare aekata ninye Israel anaa keshomo aekata aarare ninche?

Amaa apa ebikito Israel te Heshbon o too nkang'itie enye kutiti, o tiatua Aroer o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, o tiatua nena anas pooki apa naatii embata e Arnon, too larin iip uni, kainyoo apa iyie pee eitu iya nena kuapi teina kata?
Eitu naa nanu aas eng'oki tialo iyie, nikintaasa iyie nanu entorrono aitayunye olarrabal; nchoo Olaitoriani, ilo Arishani eaku olarishani too ltung'ana le Israel o too ltung'ana le Amon.”
Kake ore ilo aiguanani le Amon eitu eshilaa ilo kilikuai le Yepta apa oirriwaka ninye.
Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata Yepta, nelo agiroo Gilead o Manase, negiroo alo Mispa e Gilead, aim Gilead negiroo Mispa e Gilead alo enetii ile Amon.
Nenya Yepta olmumai to Laitoriani, nejo, “Tenaa einchoru iyie ile Amon apik atua inkaik aainei,
neaku ore pooki ng'ae oipang'u aimu nkutukie e nkaji ai, pee aalotu anang'are nanu, te narrinyo alotu aisula ile Amon, neaku olo Laitoriani, naishoru nanu ninye metaa olasar opejori.”
Nelang Yepta alo enetii ile Amon aarare ninche neishooyo Olaitoriani ninche apik atua inkaik enyena.
Near ninche ebaiki Aroer o metabaiki elatia e Minit, nkanas tikitam, o metabaiki Abel-keramim, te sesekuanata kitok oleng. Neaku etimiraki apa ile Amon te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel.
Neitoki Yepta alotu enkang enye te Mispa, neipang'u entito enye alotu anang'are ninye eranyisho neosh entampuri, naa ninye apake enkerai naata, meeta apa ae tito aashu olayioni.

Ore ake pee edol ninye, nepolos inkilani enyena, nejo, “Ee entito ai! Kintadouo iyie nanu oleng, nitaa iyie enkipirunoto e nyamali sapuk te nanu; amu ataboloko nanu Olaitoriani enkutuk ai nemaidim ainyaai olmumai lai.”
Nejoki ina tito enye ninye, “Papa, ti nitaboloko iyie Olaitoriani enkutuk ino, ntaasaki nanu enaba anaa enaimua enkutuk ino, amu kitalaaka Olaitoriani too lmang'ati linono te lelo le Amon.”
Nejoki ninye menye, “Nchoo maaitaasi ena bae; nchooki ake duoo iyie ilapaitin oaare, pee alo nanu aisampash too ldoinyo aishiraki titoisho ai, nanu o esirit ai.”
Nejoki menye, “Shomo.” Neisho ninye meshomo ilapaitin oaare; nelo ninye ina tito, ninye o encholiek enye, nelo aishiraki titoisho enye too nchumat oo ldoinyo.
Ore te nkiting'oto oo lapaitin oaare, neshukunye ninye enetii papaai lenye, apa oitaasa ninye te risioroto e ilo mumai apa oinosa. Eitu aekata eyiolou ina tito olee. Neaku apa olkerreti te Israel
nchere kepuo ake ntoyie e Israel to lari aaishiraki entito e Yepta ilo le Gilead nkolong'i ong'uan to lari.

Neipotuni apa iltung'ana le Efraim metanapata te nkaraki olarrabal, nelang ninche aapuo Sapon nejoki Yepta, “Kainyoo iyie pee italang'a alo aarare Ilamoni, neitu impotu iyiook pee kipuo te nebo iyie? Eikipejoo iyiook enkaji ino itii atua te nkima.”
Nejoki Yepta ninche, “Ore nanu o ltung'ana laainei nikitii olarrabal kitok te nebo Ilamoni; ore ake pee aipotu nanu intae, neitu kikordudu nanu te nkaina enye.

Ore ake pee adol ajo mikikordudu intae nanu, naya nanu enkishui ai te nkaina ai, nalang alo aarare Ilamoni, neishoru Olaitoriani ninche apik inkaik aainei, kainyoo naa taata pee ileputua intae aapuonu enatii ena olong, pee kipuonunu aarare nanu?”
Neiturrur Yepta iltung'ana pooki le Gilead nearare Efraim, nesesekuan iltung'ana le Gilead Efraim, te nkaraki natejo, “Irara intae ilaisikak le Efraim, intae ile Gilead, te mpolos e Efraim o Manase.”

Neya lelo tung'ana le Gilead ilang'at e Yordan pee earare ile Efraim. Naa ore ake pee ejo oltung'ani le lelo apa ootimiraki le Efraim, “Ntasho nanu matalang'a alo,” nejoki ninye iltung'ana le Gilead, “Eira iyie ole Efraim?” Ore ake pee ejo ninye, “A'a,”

nejoki ninche ninye, “Tejo naa Shibolet,” nejo ninye “Sibolet” amu meidim ninye atejo ina aitobiraki; neibung taa ninye near metua too lang'at e Yordan. Nebatata ina kata teine ilung'ana le Efraim nkalifuni artam oaare.
Neaku Yepta olarishani le Israel ilarin ile. Neye Yepta nenukari te nkanasa enye e Gilead.
Ore te siadi ninye naa Ibsan le Betlehem otaa olarishani le Israel.

Keeta apa ninye ilayiok tomoni uni; o ntoyie tomoni uni, neishooyo meyami iltung'ana le me lo lgilata lenye neyau ntoyie e boo neme no lgilata lenye meyama ilayiok lenyena. Neaku ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin oopishana.
Neaku etua Ibsan nenukari te Betlehem.
Ore te siadi ninye naa Elon le Sebulon otaa olarishani le Israel, netaa apa ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin tomon.
Neitoki sii Elon aye, ilo le Sebulon nenukari te Aiyalon te nkop e Sebulon.
Ore te siadi ninye naa Abdon olayioni le Hilel le Piraton otaa olarishani le Israel.
Eeta apa ninye ilayiok artam o loo nkakui tomoni uni, apa ooked isirkon ntomoni naapishana; netaa ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin isiet.
Neitoki aye Abdon ilo ayioni le Hilel le Piraton, nenukari te Piraton te nkop e Efraim, teina kop oo ndoinyo oo Lmaleki.
Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aas entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani; neishooyo Olaitoriani ninche apik atua enkaina oo Lfilisti too larin artam.
Netii apa oltung'ani obo le Sora, lo losho le Dan, oji enkarna enye Manoa; naa koolupi apa enkitok enye nemeeta nkera.
Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ina kitok nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura ajo ira iyie olupi nimiaata nkera; kake inutayu iyie niiu olayioni.
Metaa ng'ura kewan, miok enaisho oo sabibu aashu enaisho napi, niminya entoki nemesinya,

amu inutayu iyie niiu olayioni. Nemeetae olmurunya opiki shumata endukuya enye, amu ore ina ayioni naa keaku Olnasarayoi te Nkai ebaiki einoto enye; naa keiteru ninye akordu Israel aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti.”

Nelotu ina kitok ajoki olpayian lenye, “Eewuo oltung'ani le Nkai enatii nanu, ore empukunoto enye nenyaanyukie empukunoto o lmalaika le Nkai, keitureisho oleng; eitu nanu aikilikuan ninye eneing'uaa neitu ninye aaliki enkarna enye;

kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, ‘Ng'ura ajo inutayu iyie niiu enkayioni; metaa naa miok enaisho oo sabibu aashu ae aisho napi niminya entoki nemesinya, amu keaku ina ayioni Olnasarayoi te Nkai ebaiki einoto o metabaiki keeya enye.’ ”
Neomon Manoa Olaitoriani, nejo, “Olaitoriani lai, aatoomono iyie, nchoo ilo tung'ani le Nkai lirriua menyaaki alotu enikitii iyiook, aiteng'en iyiook enikintaas ina ayioni naini.”
Nening Enkai oltoilo le Manoa, neigil ilo malaika le Nkai alotu enetii ina kitok etonita te nkurma; kake metii apa Manoa olpayian lenye te nebo ninye.
Nekuet ina kitok nabo kata alo ajoki olpayian lenye, “Ng'ura ajo ore olapa tung'ani oewuo enatii enapa olong aanyaaka aipang'aki.”
Nedumunye Manoa nelo asuj enkitok enye, nelotu enetii ilo tung'ani nejoki ninye, “Kaiyie apa ilo tung'ani oirorie ena kitok?” Nejoki ilo tung'ani, “Nanu ilo.”
Nejo Manoa, “Amaa, kenya te nebaya irorei linono, kaji kenya etiu ina ayioni, naa kaa kenya eas?”
Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani Manoa, “Ore nena pooki natiaaka ena kitok nchoo ninye eing'or.
Menya ninye ae toki naing'uaa isabibu nemeok enaisho aashu ae toki nemesinya. Ore nena pooki naitanapa ninye nchoo ninye eas.”
Nejoki Manoa ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, “Aatoomono, nchoo iyiook maiboo iyie pee kintobiraki iyie olkuoo le kine.”

Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani Manoa, “Tinikimbok iyie nanu, nemanya nanu endaa ino; kake ti nintobir olasar opejori, ntobiraki naa Olaitoriani.” (Amu eitu apa eyiolou Manoa nchere olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye.)
Nejoki Manoa ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, “Eikiji ng'ae enkarna, pee aa te nelo kenya nebaya irorei linono, nikitum aaishoo iyie enkanyit?”
Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani ninye, “Kainyoo pee inkilikuanu enkarna ai, itoduaa ajo enenking'asia?”
Neya Manoa olkuoo le kine te nebo enkishooroto e ntapa, neitaiki te nchumata endapidapoi Olaitoriani olasar, ilo laa ninye oas inenking'asia.

Ore ake pee eilep olng'ejep le nkima alo shumata epuku te ilo asar, neilep ilo malaika lo Laitoriani te ilo ng'ejep le nkima lo lasar eing'orita Manoa o enkitok enye; nebatata aaitabaiki nkomomi enye enkop.
Eitu aekata eigil ilo malaika lo Laitoriani aipang'aki Manoa o enkitok enye. Neyiolou apa Manoa nchere olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye.
Nejoki Manoa enkitok enye, “Kesipa eikiye iyiook, amu kitoduaa iyiook Enkai.”

Kake etiaaka enkitok enye ninye, “Tenaa keyieu apa Olaitoriani near iyiook matuata, anaata eitu ninye eng'amu ilo asar opejori o lasar le ntapa too nkaik ang, aashu eitodol iyiook kuna baa pooki, aashu eliki iyiook mbaa naaijo kuna.”
Neiu ina kitok olayioni, neipot enkarna enye ajo Samson; nebulu ina ayioni, nemayian Olaitoriani ninye.
Neiteru Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani aputu ninye tiatua Mahane-dan te rishata e Sora o Eshtaol.
Nedoyio apa Samson alo Timna, ore te Timna nedol entito nabo oo Lfilisti.
Neilepu ninye alotu, nejoki menye o ng'otonye, “Atoduaa nanu entito nabo oo Lfilisti te Timna; entorikokoki nanu metaa enkitok ai.”

Kake etiaakita menye o ng'otonye ninye, “Aimeetae enkitok tiatua ntoyie o lgilata linyi, aashu tiatua iltung'ana lang pooki, eji pee ilo ayau enkitok too Lfilisti lememurata?” Kake etiaaka Samson menye, “Torikokoki nanu ninye; amu kaaitiship ninye nanu oleng.”
Meyiolo apa menye o ng'otonye Samson nchere Olaitoriani eing'uaa ina; amu keing'oru apa ninye erishata naarie Ilfilisti. Ore apa ina kata naa Ilfilisti ooitore Israel.
Nedoyio Samson o menye o ng'otonye aapuo Timna, nepuo enkurma oo lng'anayio e Timna. Naa ng'ura, neikurrukurroki ninye olkuoo lo lng'atuny.

Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata ninye te ngolon, nepolos ninye ilo ng'atuny anaa oltung'ani opolos olkuoo le kine; nemeeta apa ninye toki te nkaina enye. Kake eitu apa ninye eliki menye aashu ng'otonye enataasa ninye.
Nedoyio ninye alo airorie ina kitok; neitiship ina kitok Samson oleng.
Ore te nkiti rishata nerrinyo alo aya ninye; neibelekenya aing'or empopok o lapa ng'atuny, naa ng'ura, etii emus oo lotorok ina popok o lng'atuny o enaisho oo lotorok.

Nebelu ninye neibung too nkaik enyena, nelo ainosaa eloito; nelotu enetii menye o ng'otonye, neisho ninche embata, nenya ninche. Kake eitu ninye eliki ninche nchere te mpopok o lng'atuny eitayio ina aisho oo lotorok.
Nedoyio menye Samson alo enetii ina kitok, neitobir Samson osirua teine, amu neijia apa eiko ilbarnot.
Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana ninye, neyau ninche iltung'ana tomoni uni pee epuonu aaku te nebo ninye.

Nejoki Samson ninche, “Kaisho nanu intae oloyiote, naa ti nikindimidimi aatoliki nanu eneikununo, tiatua kuna olong'i naapishana o sirua, niyiolouu aajo kainyoo, naisho nanu intae nkilani tomoni uni e kitani o kulie kilani tomoni uni sidain;
kake ti nimikindimidimi aatoliki nanu nchere kainyoo, nikinchosho intae nanu nkilani tomoni uni e kitani, o nkilani sidain.” Nejoki ninche ninye, “Tolimu oloyiote lino matoning.”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Oyiote: Etupukuo enainosi tiatua ina nainosisho. Etupukuo entoki namelok aimu ina nagol.” Neitu ninche eidim aatayiolo ilo oyiote too nkolong'i uni.

Ore te nkolong e ong'uan nejoki ninche ina kitok e Samson, “Ilejileja olpayian lino metoliki iyiook ajo kainyoo ilo oyiote mikipejoo ake iyie o enkaji e papaai lino te nkima. Intoomono apa iyiook pee itumutumu aawaita imasaa ang?”

Ore ina kitok e Samson neishir te dukuya ninye, nejoki, “Eikimba iyie, mikinyor nanu; itipikaka iyie oloyiote iltung'ana lang, neitu ninye kiliki nanu ajoki kainyoo.” Nejoki Samson, “Ng'ura, eitu aliki papa aashu yieyio, paa eijo iyie aliki?”

Neishir ninye te dukuya ninye nena olong'i naapishana apa osirua lenye. Ore te nkolong e naapishana neliki ina kitok enye, amu eitirrishaka apa ninye oleng. Neliki ina kitok oloyiote lelo tung'ana lenye.

Nejoki ilewa apa le ina anasa ninye te nkolong e naapishana eton eitu edoyio enkolong, “Kainyoo namelok alang enaisho oo lotorok? Kainyoo nagol alang olng'atuny?” Nejoki Samson ninche, “Teneme enkashe ai itukurrishore intae, anaata intae eitu itumutumu oloyiote lai.”

Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani te ngolon shumata ninye, nedoyio ninye alo Ashkelon near metuata iltung'ana tomoni uni le ina ang, neya ntokitin enye neisho nkilani lelo apa ootolimutuo oloyiote. Ore te ngoro napi neshuko alo enkaji e papaai lenye.
Neishori ina kitok e Samson ilo apa oboitare ninye, aa ninye apa shepu olkerr lenye.

Ore etulusoyie enkiti rishata, te nkata naikesuni enkano, nelo Samson aparan enkitok enye, neyaki olkuoo le kine; nejo ninye, “Kalo nanu adol enkitok ai tiatua aji.” Kake eitu apa eisho menye meshomo atua aji.
Nejoki menye le ina kitok, “Kajo apa eimba ninye oleng naisho ninye ilo apa liboitare. Aimesidai ina anashe enye kiti alang ninye? Aatoomono iwa ninye te rishata e nkae.”
Nejoki Samson ninche, “Ore tena kata maaitokini nanu aailap tialo Ilfilisti te naitaas ninche entorrono.”
Nelo Samson neibung mbariak iip uni, neya ilkilang'ilang'eta neitutum ninche ilkidong'o, nepik ake enkilang'ilang'et erishata oo lkidong'o oaare.
Ore ake pee eitudup nena kilang'ilang'eta enkima neisho nena bariak meshomo aaim atua enkano oo Lfilisti nepejoo isotot o enkano nauno o nkurman oo loirienito.

Nejo Ilfilisti, “Kaing'ae otaasa ena?” Nejo ninche, “Samson, ilo aputani lo Ltimini, te nkaraki nawa ninye enkitok enye neisho ilo apa oboitare ninye.” Neilepu Ilfilisti aapuonu nepejoo entito o papaai lenye te nkima.
Nejoki Samson ninche, “Tenaa ena intae iasiasa, kanya nanu olmumai pee aitalak intae, ore te siadi ina nalo nanu.”
Near ninye ninche oleng metuata te nkumoi; nedoyio alo aton tiatua enkapune natii endapidapoi e Etam.
Nepuonu Ilfilisti nepik ilng'oborri Yuda, neibung enkang e Lehi.
