Nejo iltung'ana le Yuda, “Kainyoo intae pee ileputua aapuonu aarare iyiook?” Nejo ninche, “Kileputua iyiook aapuonu aaen Samson, aaitaas ninye anaa enaitaasa iyiook.”

Nepuo iltung'ana nkalifuni uni le Yuda enchumata e ndapidapoi e Etam, nejoki Samson, “Eimiyiolo iyie nchere Ilfilisti ilaitoriak te shumata iyiook kainyoo naa ena nintaasa iyie iyiook?” Nejoki ninye ninche, “Anaa enaaitaasa ninche nanu, ina sii nanu aitaasa ninche.”
Nejoki ninche ninye, “Kietuo iyiook aaen iyie, pee kitum aaishooi iyie tiatua inkaik oo Lfilisti.” Nejoki Samson ninche, “Enosa olmumai nchere mikiaariara intae maate.”
Nejoki ninche ninye, “A'a; eikien ake iyiook iyie nikinchooyo iyie aapik atua inkaik enye; mikiaar iyiook iyie tua.” Neen ninche ninye too lgoso ng'ejuko oaare, neyau aailepunye te ndapidapoi.

Ore ake pee elotu ninye Lehi, nepuonu Lfilisti aanang'are ninye ebuaku; nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata ninye te ngolon. Ore lelo goso apa ootii inkaik enyena netiu anaa iusin naaibung'a enkima; ore ienata enyena neshola too nkaik enyena.
Netum ninye oltagiligili oshal lo sikiria, neitorioo enkaina adumu, ore te ilo tagiligili nesesekuan iltung'ana enkalifu.
Nejo Samson, “Ore to ltagiligili lo sikiria naa osototi te shumata osototi. To ltagiligili lo sikiria atasesekuana nanu iltung'ana enkalifu.”
Ore ake pee eidip ninye airoro, nenang'aa ilo tagiligili lo sikiria te nkaina enye; neji apa enkarna e ine wueji Ramat-lehi.
Netir Samson enkure oleng, neipot ninye Olaitoriani nejo, “Inchorua iyie enkordunoto kitok te nkaina o sinka lino; naa kaye nanu taata te nkure, nabatatakino atua inkaik oo lememurata?”
Nebol Enkai engumoto te Lehi, nepuku enkare teine, ore ake pee eok, neitoki apok, nepiu. Neaku ore enkarna eine wueji netejoki apa En-hakore; netii Lehi o taata.
Neaku ninye olarishani le Israel too nkolong'i oo Lfilisti ilarin tikitam.
Nelo apa Samson Gasa, nedol ninye emulayoi teine, nelo enetii ninye.

Netiaakaki apa lelo le Gasa, “Eewuo Samson ene,” neman ninche ine wueji neirrag aanyu ninye enkewarie pooki te nkishomi e ina anasa. Negira ninche enkewarie pooki, ejo, “Mataanyu iyiook o mekenyu, pee kitum aataar ninye metua.”

Kake eirure apa Samson o metaa empolos e nkewarie; ore te mpolos e nkewarie nedumunye neya nkikeneta e kishomi e ina anasa o ng'apeta pokira are, nedotu ninche, te nebo o esekenkei o pooki toki, neiteleiki ninche oloililai nenap ninche enchumata e ina doinyo apa natii dukuya Hebron.
Ore te siadi ena nenyorru Samson enkitok apa natii oerata le Sorek, naji enkarna enye Delila.

Nepuonu ilkituaak loo Lfilisti enetii Delila nejoki ninye, “Ilejileja Samson, pee idol enetii engolon enye kitok, naa tiaa oitoi kiindim aaitojoola ninye, pee kitum iyiook aateen ninye nikigilu ninye; nikisilisil; naa eikincho iyiook iyie oltung'ani ake mpisai enkalifu nabo o iip nabo e nkosholai.”
Nejoki Delila Samson, “Tolikioki sii ake enetii ena golon ino kitok, naa kaji naaji kinkoni ti nikieni, pee kitum oltung'ani atigilu.”
Nejoki Samson ninye, “Te naaeni nanu too mpi oo nkai ng'ejuko naapishana neton eitu etoyu, nashalu nanu, natiu anaa pooki tung'ani.”
Neyaki ilkituaak loo Lfilisti Delila mpi oo nkai naapishana ng'ejuko neenie ninye.

Neeta apa Delila iltung'ana ooisudori tiatua olgilata ti aji. Nejoki Delila Samson, “Kipuonu Lfilisti aaibung, Samson!” Nedung ninye nena pi anaa usin naaibung'a enkima. Neaku meyioloi apa enkisudoroto e ngolon enye.
Neitoki Delila ajoki Samson, “Ng'ura, kitusukenya nanu nikiteleja nanu; tolikioki sii ake enikinkoni pee kimbung'i.”
Nejoki ninye, “Te naaeni nanu too lgoso ng'ejuko leitu aekata eenishoreki, nashalu nanu natiu anaa pooki tung'ani.”

Neyau Delila lelo goso ng'ejuko neen Samson te ninche, nejoki ninye, “Kipuonu Ilfilisti aaibung, Samson!” Ore apa iltung'ana ooisudori netii olgilata tiatua aji, nedung lelo goso too nkaik enyena anaa empito.

Neitoki Delila ajoki Samson, “Ore o tene kitusukenya nanu, nikilej nanu; tolikioki nanu enikinkoni ti nikimbung'i.” Nejoki Samson ninye, “Ti nishet kuna tukusi aainei naapishana e ndukuya ai te nkarasha nintirrish oleng te ncheitoi, nashalu nanu natiu anaa pooki tung'ani.”

Neaku ore apa eirura Samson, neitayu Delila nena enat oolpapit pokira naapishana neshetaki enkarasha neitirrish ninche aunoki encheitoi, nejoki ninye, “Kipuonu Ilfilisti aaibung iyie Samson!” Neinyototo ninye too njio enyena nedotu encheitoi neshurtaa ina arasha nashetakino.
Nejoki Delila ninye, “Kaji iyie inko ti nijo, ‘Kaanyor nanu iyie,’ te nemetii oltau lino te nebo nanu? Kitusukenya iyie kuna katitin pokira uni, neitu iyie kiliki enetii engolon ino kitok.”
Ore ake pee eitirrishaki Delila ninye too rorei lenyena anaake, neitagor Samson, nenauru oltau lenye oleng.

Neliki Samson Delila mbaa enyena pooki, nejoki Delila, “Eitu ae kata eim olmurunya endukuya ai; amu ataa apa nanu Olnasarayoi te Nkai atii enkoshoke e yieyio. Ore ake naaji pee aabarni, naaing'uaa nanu engolon ai, nashalu nanu natiu anaa pooki tung'ani.”

Ore ake pee edol Delila ajo etolikio ninye mbaa enyena pooki, neirriwaa olkilikuai aipotu ilkituaak loo Lfilisti pooki, nejoki, “Elepu wootu ena kata nabo, amu aatolikio mbaa enyena pooki.” Neilepu ilkituaak loo Lfilisti aapuonu enetii Delila, neyau mpisiai too nkaik enye.
Neisho ninye meirurayu too nkejek enyena; neipotu ninye oltung'ani, neisho ninye metabarnu nena enat naapishana oo lpapit le ndukuya enye. Neiteru aitanyamal ninye, neing'uaa engolon enye ninye.

Nejo Delila, “Kimbung'ita iyie Ilfilisti, Samson!” Neinyototo ninye too njio, nejo, “Kaipang nanu alo boo anaa oshi ake nkulie katitin, narerio.” Neitu apa eyiolou ninye ajo etung'uayie Olaitoriani ninye.
Neibung Ilfilisti ninye nekurtu nkonyek enyena neitadou ninye aayau Gasa, neen ninye too lpisia lo suyai; neidong apa ninye enkano etii atua jila.
Kake enyaakita apa ilpapit le ndukuya enye aabulu ina kata eidipaki aatabarn.
Neiturrurro apa ilkituaak loo Lfilisti pee etum aaitaiki olasar kitok Dagon, enkai enye, neshipa sii, amu etejo apa ninche, “Eishorua enkai ang Samson ilo mang'atinta lang apik atua inkaik ang.”
Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana ninye neisis enkai enye; amu etejo ninche, “Eishorua enkai ang olmang'atinta lang apik atua enkaina ang, laa ninye apa otumuta enkop ang, netasesekuana ilkumok lang.”

Ore eting'idate iltauja lenye, nejo ninche, “Empoto Samson pee elotu aitiship iyiook.” Neipotu ninche ninye tiatua jila, pee eitiship ninye ninche. Neisho ninche Samson meitasho te rishata oo ng'apeta are.
Nejoki Samson enkayioni apa naa ninye narik aibung enkaina, “Ntasho sii iyie mairrapirrapa ng'apeta naairishaa ena aji, pee atum aigarakinoyu ninche.”
Nebore apa ina aji ilewa o nkituaak; netii apa ilkituaak pooki loo Lfilisti ine; ore enchumata enkaji netii apa iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni uni ilewa o nkituaak, ooing'orisho ina kata eiguran Samson.
Neipot Samson Olaitoriani ajo, “Olaitoriani Enkai, tadamuaki nanu, nikintagol nanu aatasayia ena kata nabo, Na Ai, pee atum aitalaku too Lfilisti nabo oo nkonyek aainei.”

Neibung nena ng'apeta pokira are apa naatii empolos enkaji, naa ninche apa nairishaa enkaji, neirishakino te ngolon enye pooki shumata ninche, neibung te nkaina enye e tatene nabo ng'ape neibung tene kedianye enkae.

Nejo Samson, “Ntasho nanu matua te nebo Ilfilisti.” Neirrugo ninye te ngolon enye pooki; neurokino ina aji lelo kituaak o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii atua. Neaku ore iltung'ana apa ootuata te keeya enye naa eikumok aalang lelo apa ootasesekuana ninye eton eishu.

Nepuonu ilalashera lenyena o lmarei lenye pooki aaya ninye neilepunye ninye aapuonu aanukaa te rishata e Sora o Eshtaol te nkurare e Manoa papaai lenye. Etaa apa ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin tikitam.
Etii apa oltung'ani le nkop oo ndoinyo e Efraim oji enkarna enye Mika.

Nejoki ninye ng'otonye, “Ore inapa pisai enkalifu nabo o iip nabo e nkosholai apa nikitooruoki iyie, naa ninche itedekishore, nidekisho too nkiyiaa aainei, ng'ura ajo aata nanu nena oshola; nanu apa oowa.” Nejo ng'otonye, “Metamayiana Olaitoriani enkayioni ai.”

Nerrinyu ninye nena oshola apa enkalifu nabo o iip nabo aisho ng'otonye; nejo ng'otonye, “Kaiteng'el nanu kuna oshola aisho Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie te nkaina ai te nkaraki olayioni lai, pee eitayunyeki enkitanyaanyukoto e Nkai naguetuni o enkitanyaanyukoto nasholuni; ore naa taata kaarrinyoki nanu iyie.”

Neaku ore apa pee errinyoki Mika ng'otonye nena pisai, neya ng'otonye mpisai iip are e nkosholai, neisho ninche ilkunono oopej enkosholai laa ninye oitobira enkitanyaanyukoto naguetuni o enkitanyaanyukoto nasholuni; nepiki apa enkaji e Mika.
Neeta apa oltung'ani oji Mika enkaji oo nkaitin. Neitobiru ninye nkitanyaanyukot o enkila o lgoo oo lapolosak; neput olayioni obo loo layiok lenyena aitaa olapolosani lenye.
Ore apa te nena olong'i nemeetae olaiguanani te Israel; keas apa pooki ng'ae enaba anaa enaitiship too nkonyek enyena makewan.
Etii apa oltung'ani le Betlehem tiatua Yuda, lo lmarei le Yuda, laa olawi apa ninye; neidurraki apa ninye ine.
Nelo apa ilo tung'ani aing'uaa enkang e Betlehem te Yuda alo aton te wueji neidim anotie enemany; ore eidurrita ninye nelotu ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim enetii enkaji e Mika.
Nejoki Mika ninye, “Kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Nejoki ninye, “Kara nanu Olawi le Betlehem tiatua Yuda, naa kalo amany ewueji naidim anotie erishata.”
Nejoki Mika ninye, “Totona te nebo nanu pee iaku te nanu papa o lapolosani naaisho nanu mpisai tomon e nkosholai to lari o nkilani o endaa.”
Nenyorraa ilo Lawi abik te nebo ilo tung'ani; netiu ilo barnoti te ninye anaa obo loo layiok lenyena.
Neput Mika ilo Lawi, neaku ilo barnoti olapolosani lenye, netii apa ninye atua enkaji e Mika.
Nejo apa Mika, “Kayiolo taata ajo kaaitopok Olaitoriani, amu etaa olawi olapolosani lai.”

Ore apa te nena olong'i nemeetae olaiguanani te Israel. Ore apa te nena olong'i neing'oru olosho le Dan enjung'ore enye maate ewueji nemany; amu ore ebaiki ina kata meetae enjung'ore tiatua iloshon loo Siraeli nanoto ninche.

Neirriu apa ile Dan iltung'ana imiet oodupa tiatua iltung'ana lo losho lenye pooki, eing'uaa Sora neing'uaa Eshtaol, pee epuonu aaikitalan enkop nejur; nejokini ninche, “Enchom entujur enkop.” Nepuonu apa ninche ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, ine netii enkaji e Mika, neirrag ine.

Ore apa etii ninche embata e nkaji e Mika, neyiolou ninche oltoilo le ilo barnoti loo Lawi; neibelekenya ninche nejoki ninye, “Kaing'ae likiyaua iyie ine? Kainyoo iyie iasita tene wueji? Kainyoo esiaai ino tene?”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Nji o nji aaitaasa nanu Mika: aaigero nanu, naaitaa nanu olapolosani lenye.”
Nejoki ninche ninye, “Nkilikuanishore Enkai, kitoomono iyie, pee kitum aatayiolo tenaa kerasaa ena lototo nikipuoito.”
Nejoki ilo apolosani ninche, “Enchom te seriani. Ore ina lototo nipuopuo netii abori enkong'u o Laitoriani.”

Nepuo lelo tung'ana pokira imiet, nepuonu Laish, nedol iltung'ana apa ootii ine, eneikununo oltonei lenye te seriani, te mpukunoto oo le Sidon, eitirring'a nememuso, meeta entoki nabo e nkop nang'or, neeta karsisisho, o eneba elakuaniki ile Sidon nemeeta enaporokinore likae tung'ani.
Ore ake pee epuonu ninche enetii ilalashera lenye te Sora o Eshtaol, nejoki ilalashera lenye ninche, “Kainyoo intae ilimumu?”
Nejo ninche, “Entudumunye, maape iyiook aarare ninche; amu kitoduaa iyiook ina kop aajo kepir oleng. Eimiatata intae eniaasiasa? Emiyieta intae te lototo, kake entijing atua ina kop embung'a.
Ti nipuopuo intae, naa ipuopuo aainepu iltung'ana lememuso. Kelala ina kop; ee, eishorua Enkai apik atua inkaik inyi, ewueji nemeeta entoki hoo nabo ena kop nemetii.”
Nedumunye iltung'ana iip ile lo losho le Dan, ootanapate too ruparen o larrabal, nepuo eing'uaa Sora o Eshtaol.
Neilep aapuo neitayu ilng'oborri te Kiriat-Yearim tiatua Yuda. Ore te nkaraki ena naa keji ine wueji enkang e dan o taata; etii enkalo o loo ntoluo le Kiriat-yearim.
Negiroo ninche ine nepuo ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, nepuonu enkaji e Mika.

Nejoki lelo tung'ana apa imiet ooshomo aaikitalan enkop e Laish lelo alashera lenye, “Iyiololo intae aajo ore atua kuna ajijik netii enkila o lgoo oo lapolosak, o Terafim e nkitanyaanyukoto naaguetuno o inaasholuno? Ore naa taata entayiolo eniaasiasa.”
Neibelekenyakino ninche ine, nepuonu enkaji e ilo barnoti loo Lawi te nkang e Mika, neikilikuan ninye ilomon lenyena.
Ore apa lelo tung'ana iip ile le Dan, ootanapate too ruparen enye o larrabal, neitashe te nejing'ieki kishomi.

Ore lelo tung'ana imiet apa ooshomo aikitalan enkop neilep aapuo, nejing atua nepuo aaitayu ina kitanyaanyukoto naguetuno, ina kila o lgoo oo lapolosak, o enkitanyaanyukoto o Terafim, o ina kitanyaanyukoto nasholuno, ina kata eitashe olapolosani te mbata ewueji nejing'ieki kishomi te nebo lelo tung'ana iip ile apa ootanapate too masaa enye o larrabal.

Ore ake pee epuo kulo atua enkaji e Mika neya ina kitanyaanyukoto naguetuno o enkila o lgoo oo lapolosak o Terafim o ina kitanyaanyukoto nasholuno, nejoki ilo apolosani ninche, “Kainyoo intae iasitata?”

Nejoki ninche ninye, “Tigirayu, tipika enkaina ino enkutuk ino, nilotu te nebo iyiook, niaku te iyiook papa o lapolosani. Kenaikash iyie ti niaku olapolosani te nkaji o ltung'ani obo, anaa ei ti niaku olapolosani to losho to lmarei le Israel?”
Neshipayu oltau le ilo apolosani; neitayu ninye ina kila o lgoo oo lapolosak o Terafim, ina kitanyaanyukoto naguetuno, nelo ninye te nebo lelo tung'ana.
Neibelekenya ninche nepuo, nepik nkera kutiti o nchoo o masaa dukuya ninche.
Ore eshomo ninche aalam enkang e Mika, neishiruni iltung'ana ootii nkajijik ootaaniki enkaji e Mika, nepuo ninche aainepu lelo tung'ana le Dan.
Nebuaaki ninche lelo tung'ana le Dan, aaibelekenyunye nejoki Mika, “Kainyoo nikinosita anaijo itorikuo olorere kumok ooba nji?”
Nejoki ninye, “Iwaita intae inkaitin aainei naitayio nanu, o lapolosani, nipuopuo, kainyoo naa aatung'ueikiaki? Kainyoo naa pee kijokiki intae nanu, ‘Eji kainyoo nikinosita?’ ”
Nejoki lelo tung'ana le Dan Mika, “Mincho iyie oltoilo lino metoning'i tiatua iyiook, pee mikidoiki iltung'ana ootagorote, niminie enkishui ino o nena tokitin e nkaji ino.”
Nepuo lelo tung'ana le Dan aaibung enkoitoi enye; ore ake pee edol Mika nchere kegol ninche oleng aalang ninye, neibelekenya neshuko alo enkang enye.

Neyau ninche nena tokitin apa naaitobirua Mika, o ilo apolosani apa ora olenye, nepuonu lelo tung'ana le Dan Laish, enetii iltung'ana oobor lememuso, nesesekuan ninche te nepi o lalem, nepejoo ina anasa te nkima.
Nemeetae apa olakordunoni amu kelakuaniki apa ninye Sidon, nemetii apa kulikae tung'ana ooata enabaikinore ninche. Etii atua oerata le Bet-rehob. Neitoki apa ninche aashet ina anasa nemany atua.
Neisho apa ina anasa enkarna aajo Dan, aaipotie nkakuyiaa lenye, apa otoiuo Israel; amu keji apa enkarna e ina anasa te dukuya Laish.

Neitobiraki apa lelo tung'ana le Dan a teina kitanyaanyukoto e nkai naguetuno; naa Yonatan ilo ayioni le Geshom, olayioni le Musa, o layiok lenyena apa ilapolosak lo losho le Dan o metabau ina olong apa natarayoki ilo osho.
Neaku eitasheyie apa ninche ina kitanyaanyukoto e Mika naguetuno, naitayio ninye ina kata pooki apa natii enkaji e Nkai te Shilo.
Ore apa te nena olong'i, eton meetae olaiguanani tiatua Israel, netii Olawi obo otii nena rishat naaliyio e ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, apa oyaka kewan enkapiani e Betlehem tiatua Yuda.
Ore ina apiani negorokino ninye, nelo enkaji e menye te Betlehem tiatua Yuda aing'uaa ilo Lawi, neton ninye teine too lapaitin oong'uan.

Nedumunye ilo moruo lenye nelo asujaa, pee elo ailejilej ninye neshuku ninye ayau. Netii apa te nebo ninye osinka lenye o sirkon aare. Nelotu apa ninye enkaji e papaai lenye, ore ake pee edol menye ina tito ilo Lawi, nelotu te nchipai anang'are ninye.
Neibok ninye olaputani, menye ina tito, neton ninye te nebo ninye nkolong'i uni; neaku etadaate ninche neokisho neirrag ine.
Ore te nkolong e ong'uan nedumunye ninche tadekenya nenapa ninye pee elo; kake etiaaka menye ina tito olaputani lenye, “Ntagolo kewan inosa endaa, ore te siadi ina nitum taa ashomo.”
Netoni lelo lewa pokira oaare aadaa neokisho te nebo; nejoki menye ina tito ilo tung'ani, “Tobiko tishipayu niyeng'iyeng'a.”
Ore ake pee edumunye ilo tung'ani ajo alo, neitirrishaki olaputani ninye, o menyaaki aigil aairrag ine.
Ore te nkolong e imiet nedumunye ninye tadekenya enasirie pee elo; nejoki menye ina tito, “Ntagolo kewan, totona o metigilayu enkolong.” Nedaa ninche pokira oaare.

Ore ake pee edumunye ilo tung'ani o ina apiani enye o laisiaayiani lenye pee epuo, nejoki ninye olaputani lenye menye ina tito, “Ng'ura, etinyikaiyie endama aaku teipa; totona siaake enkewarie pooki, ng'ura etinyikua endama; irraga ene nchoo oltau lino eng'ida; ore taisere nidumunye tadekenya enasirie te nkaraki elototo ino, pee ilo ang.”

Kake etanya apa ilo tung'ani eirrag ina kewarie nedumunye ninye alo, nelo abaya enkipirakinoto e Yebus (aa taa Yerusalem). Neeta apa te nebo ninye isirkon oaare ooitobiraki pee ekedi, netii apa ina apiani te nebo ninye.
Ore ake pee etaaniki ninche Yebus, netinyikayie endama, nejoki olaisiaayiani olkitok lenye, “Wou taata maibelekenyakinoto iyiook ena anasa oo Lyebusi, pee kirrag ena kewarie.”
Nejoki ilo kitok ninye, “Mikimbelekenya iyiook aajing atua enkanasa oo ltung'ana leeiking'a leme iltung'ana le Israel ninche; kake eikigiroo iyiook aapuo Gibea.”
Neitoki ninye ajoki ilo sinka lenye, “Wou matataaniki iyiook nabo e kuna wuejitin pee kirrag ena kewarie Gibea aashu Rama.”
Negiroo ninche nepuo aaibung enkoitoi enye; nedoyio enkolong etii ninche embata e Gibea, nara ninye ene Benchamen.
Neibelekenya ninche teine, aapuo aairrag ina kewarie Gibea. Nepuo ninche aatoni te nkoitoi kitok e ina anasa; amu meetae oltung'ani otoriko ninche atua enkaji enye meirraga ina kewarie.

Ore ina teipa nelotu apa olpayian kitok eing'uaa esiaai enye tiatua enkurma teipa; ore apa ilo tung'ani naa o leina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, neidurraka apa Gibea amany. Ore apa iltung'ana le ine wueji naa ile Benchamen.
Neshumu ninye nkonyek enyena nedol ilo tung'ani elotu to losinko leina anasa, nejo ilo payian kitok, “Kaji iyie iloito? Naa kaji ing'uaa?”

Nejoki ilo Lawi ilo payian kitok, “Kipuoito iyiook aagiroo Betlehem tiatua Yuda, aapuo nekua rishat naabayie e ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, naa ninye aing'uaa nanu. Ashomo apa Betlehem tiatua Yuda, naloito taata enkang ai, nemetii hoo oltung'ani laatoriko nanu atua enkaji enye.
Kiaata iyiook endaa o lkujita loo sirkon lang o mukateni o enaisho te nkaraki nanu o ena sinka ino o ele barnoti otii te nebo isinkan linono; eitu eng'oriki iyiook toki.”
Nejo ilo payian kitok, “Meeu eseriani enitii; kagolie nanu iyieunot inono pooki; kake mirrag ena kewarie to losinko.”
Neaku etorikuo apa ninye atua enkaji enye, neisho lelo sirkon lenyena olkujita, neisuj ninche nkejek enye, nedaa ninche neokisho.

Ore apa ina kata eegira aashipa ninche too iltauja lenye, nepuonu iltung'ana arruok neng'adu ina aji aaman, neosh kutuk e nkaji nejoki ninche ilo payian kitok, ilo openy e nkaji, “Mpang'unye ilo tung'ani duo oewuo atua enkaji ino, pee kitum iyiook aatayiolo ninye.”
Ore ilo payian, olopeny ina aji, neipang'aki ninche nejoki ninche, “A'a, ilalashera laainei, emiaas intae ena torroni; itoduaa aajo eewuo ele tung'ani atua enkaji ai, emiaas intae ena bae suuji.

Ng'ura ajo etii ene entito selenkei neitu eyiolou olee o enkapiani enye; ntasho maipang'unye nanu ninche. Embung'a ninche nintaasiasa ninche anaa enidolidolo eishiaakino te intae; kake ore tialo ele tung'ani emintaas ena bae suuji.”

Kake eitu ening lelo tung'ana ninye. Neaku eibung'a apa ilo payian enkapiani enye neipung'ie ninye boo mewaita ninche; neyiolou ninche ninye, neinyal enkewarie pooki o mekenyu. Ore ake pee emanaa enkakenya neisho meshomo.
Ore pee ekenyu, nelotu ina kitok nebatata te kutuk aji e nkaji e ilo payian apa naa ninye etii olkitok lenye, neirrag o metawang'a.
Nedumunye olkitok lenye tadekenya; ore ake pee ebol kutuk aji e ina aji neipang alo, nedol enkapiani enye eirragita te kutuk aji e ina aji, eibung'ita too nkaik enyena ntaloishin e kutukaji.
Nejoki ninye, “Tudumunye maape.” Kake eitu ewalikini ninye. Nepik ilo tung'ani ninye enkoriong o sikiria lenye; nedumunye ilo lee nelo enkang enye.
Ore ake pee ejing ninye enkaji enye, neyau enkalem, neibung ina apiani enye neorrior ninye erubata o erubata aitaa irubat tomon o are, neirriwaa ninye nkuapi pooki e Israel.

Ore pooki ootoduaa ina nejo, “Eitu aekata easayu embae naaijo ena aashu edoli ebaiki enkolong apa naileputua iltung'ana le Israel aapuku te nkop e Misiri o metabaiki ena olong! Embirribirra enguanare niwaliwala.”
Nepuonu iltung'ana pooki le Israel, ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba te nebo enkop e Gilead. Ore ina umata neiturrurro anaa oltung'ani obo te dukuya Olaitoriani te Mispa.
Ore ilaiguanak le lelo tung'ana pooki, too loshon pooki le Israel neyau ate atua ilo turrur loo ltung'ana le Nkai, naa nkalifuni iip ong'uan apa iltung'ana oopuo too nkejek ooata ilalema.
Nening apa iltung'ana le Benchamen nchere eilepa iltung'ana le Israel aapuo Mispa. Nejo iltung'ana le Israel, “Entoliki iyiook, kaji apa eikununye ena torroni?”
Ore ilo Lawi, ilo moruo apa le ina kitok nataraki metua, newal ajo, “Aewuo apa nanu Gibea, ina nara ene Benchamen, nanu o enkapiani ai, pee kirrag ina kewarie.
Naadumakino nanu ilewa le Gibea, neman aang'adu ina aji natii kewarie; keyieu apa ninche naar nanu matua, neikony enkapiani ai, netua ninye.

Naya nanu ina apiani ai nadung nanu aitaa ndung'udung'ot, nairriwaa nanu ninye aibulunye enkop pooki enjung'ore e Israel, amu etaasa apa ninche embae torrono naa olminong sapuk entorroni tiatua Israel.
Eng'ura, intae iltung'ana le Israel, intae pooki, enchoru enkikoo inyi o eutaroto inyi tene.”
Nedumunye iltung'ana pooki le Israel anaa nabo nejo, “Mikipuo iyiook hoo obo lang olng'obor lenye, nemeetae olalang orrinyo alo enkaji enye.
Kake ore taata ena iyiook kintaas Gibea: eikipuo iyiook aarare ninye te oshoto e nkukuo,

nikiya iltung'ana tomon te iip tiatua iloshon pooki le Israel, o iip tiatua enkalifu, o enkalifu too nkalifuni tomon, pee eyaki iltung'ana ndaiki, paa te nepuonu ninche netum aaitalaa Gibea e Benchamen elap, teina taboi pooki e ntorroni nataasa ninche tiatua Israel.”
Neaku eiturrurrote apa iltung'ana le Israel aaipirakinore ina anasa eibung'ate aaku nabo.
Neirriwaa iloshon le Israel iltung'ana meshomo atua olosho pooki le Benchamen, ejo, “Kaa torroni ena nataase tiatua intae?

Ore naa taata entayu lelo tung'ana, lelo arruok le Gibea, pee kitum iyiook aataar ninche metuata, nikiwuang'ie entorroni te Israel.” Kake eitu ening ile Benchamen oltoilo loo lalashera lenye, lelo tung'ana le Israel.
Neiturrurrunye ile Benchamen te nebo aaipang'u too nkanas aapuonu Gibea, pee epuo olarrabal aarare iltung'ana le Israel.
Neiturrurro ile Benchamen ina olong too nkanas enye iltung'ana inkalifuni tikitam o ile ooata ilalema, te nebo lelo oomanya Gibea ooiturrurrote iltung'ana iip naapishana gelunot.
Ore tiatua kulo pooki netii iltung'ana iip naapishana gelunot kedienyiaa; laa keidim ake pooki lenye atanang'a oleinyuaa to soit le nkopito nemediak.
Ore iltung'ana le Israel metii Benchamen neiturrur iltung'ana inkalifuni iip ong'uan ooata ilalema; ore kulo pooki naa iltung'ana lo larrabal.
Nedumunye iltung'ana le Israel neilep aapuo Betel, neikilikuanishore Enkai, “Kalo lang oituruk alo aarare ile Benchamen?” Nejoki Olaitoriani, “Yuda ong'as alo.”
Nedumunye iltung'ana le Israel tadekenya nepuo aaitayu ilng'oborri te nkipirakinoto e Gibea.
Neilep iltung'ana le Israel aapuo olarrabal aarare Benchamen; neluaakino iltung'ana le Israel ninche te Gibea.
Neipang ile Benchamen te Gibea neirragieki te nkop ina olong iltung'ana inkalifuni tikitam o are loo Siraeli.
Kake ore lelo tung'ana, lelo lewa le Israel eitagoluote, neitoki aaluaakino olarrabal teine wueji netoluaare te nkolong e dukuya.

Nepuo iltung'ana le Israel aaishir te dukuya Olaitoriani o metaa teipa; neikilikuanishore Olaitoriani aajooki “Eikingil iyiook aaluaakino olarrabal aarare ilalashera lang lelo le Benchamen?” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Elepa enchom entaarare ninche.”
Neigutu iltung'ana le Israel aapuonu aarare lelo le Benchamen te nkolong e are.
Nelo Benchamen aarare ninche te Gibea te nkolong e are, nebatata te nkop iltung'ana inkalifuni tomon o isiet oo ltung'ana le Israel; ore kulo pooki naa iltung'ana loo lalema.

Neitoki iltung'ana pooki le Israel, enjore pooki, aailep aapuo Betel neishir; netoni ninche teine te dukuya Olaitoriani, neen ate aaitupukoo ina olong o metaa teipa, neitayu ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Neikilikuanishore iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani (amu ore apa osanduku lo sotua le Nkai naa ine apa etii te nena olong'i.

Ore Finehas olayioni le Eliesa, olayioni le Aron, neisiaaisho te dukuya ilo sanduku apa te nena olong'i), ejo, “Eikingil iyiook aapuo olarrabal aarare lelo alashera lang lelo le Benchamen, anaa eikintirring'a?” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Elepa enchom; amu ore taisere kaishoru nanu ninche apik atua inkaik inyi.”
Neaku eirriwayie Isiraeli iltung'ana meshomo aajing ilnukat aaman Gibea.
Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli aarare ile Benchamen te nkolong e uni, neitobirakino olarrabal pee earare Gibea, anaa enaikuna too nkulie katitin.

Neipang iltung'ana le Benchamen aapuo aarare lelo tung'ana nerrumori aaitalam enkanasa. Ore anaa oshi ake too nkulie katitin neiteru aaoshisho near embata oo ltung'ana metuata, too nkoitoi, aa ore enkoitoi nabo nalala naa enailep alo Betel, nelo enkae Gibea. Ore teina kisiashata near iltung'ana oobaya tomoni uni o are loo Siraeli.
Nejo lelo tung'ana le Benchamen, “Ekueta ninche te dukuya iyiook anaa apa te dukuya.” Kake etejo iltung'ana loo Siraeli, “Maisika iyiook nikintalamaa ninche te nkanasa aarik inkoitoi kituaak.”

Nedumunye iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli too wuejitin enye, neitobirakino olarrabal te Baal-tamar; ore lelo tung'ana loo Siraeli ootii olnukata neisarrisar too wuejitin enye aapuo enkalo o loo ntoluo le Geba.
Nepuonu aaimu enkalo e Gibea iltung'ana inkalifuni tomon oogeluno tiatua Israel pooki. Negolu olarrabal oleng. Neitu apa eyiolou iltung'ana le Benchamen aajo etataanikia ninche enkidaaroroto.

Nemir Olaitoriani Benchamen te dukuya Israel. Neidaikie iltung'ana le Israel iltung'ana inkalifuni tikitam o imiet o iip nabo oo ltung'ana le Benchamen teina olong. Ore kulo pooki naa iltung'ana loo lalema.
Neaku etoduaa ile Benchamen ina olong aajo etimiraki. Ekueta apa iltung'ana le Israel aailany ile Benchamen, amu eisiliga apa ninche lelo tung'ana ootii olnukata, otii embata e Gibea.
Nedumunye lelo tung'ana apa ootii olnukata, neisarisaru aakuetiki Gibea, nepuo lelo tung'ana ootii olnukata aar enkanasa tenepi o lalam.
Ore apa olmonekie otoning'oteki te rishata oo ltung'ana le Israel o ltung'ana ootii olnukata, naa nchere, teneitayu enkatampoi sapuk e mpuruo naailep shumata, te nkanasa,

neibelekenyakino iltung'ana le Israel olarrabal. Neiterua apa Benchamen aar iltung'ana loo Siraeli metuata oobaya tomoni uni, nejo ninche, “Kesipa etooshoki ninche aanang'ie enkop te dukuya iyiook, anaa apa to larrabal le dukuya.”
Kake ore pee eiteru ilo monekie ailepu te nkanasa, te mpuruo nairrusha, neing'or ile Benchamen siadi, naa nedol etaa duoo enkanasa pooki empuruo naijukujuku alo shumata.
Neibelekenyuni taa iltung'ana loo Siraeli, neidang iltung'ana le Benchamen, amu etoduaa ninche aajo etataanikia ninche enkidaaroroto.
Ore te nkaraki ina, neibelekenya ninche te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel aaipirri ong'ata; kake einepuaki ninche, ore lelo ooipang'u tiatua nkanas nemut ninche te rishata enye.
Nedung'oo iltung'ana le Benchamen, nemir aasujaa ninche neitunyoo ninche ebaiki Noha o meitabaiki enkipirakinoto e Gibea te nkalo o loosaen.
Nebatata ile Benchamen inkalifuni tomon o isiet, ore pooki naa iltung'ana yiolot.

Neibelekenya ninche neisikaki enkalo e ong'ata aapuo endapidapoi e Rimon; neari metuata iltung'ana inkalifuni imiet too nkoitoi kituaak, neitirrishakini aasujaa o meitabaikini Gibom, nesesekuani iltung'ana inkalifuni are teine.
Neaku ore lelo pooki le Benchamen ootabatate teina olong naa nkalifuni tikitam o imiet le lelo ooenita ilalema, ore pooki naa iltung'ana yiolot.
Kake eibelekenyate iltung'ana iip ile neisik aapuo ong'ata enkalo e ndapidapoi e Rimon, nebik ninche teina dapidapoi e Rimon ilapaitin oong'uan.

Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aaibelekenyakino iltung'ana le Benchamen neshurt ninche te nepi olalem, iltung'ana o ng'uesi o pooki naanoto ninche. Ore nkanas enye apa pooki naaitobira nepejoo te nkima.
Einosa apa iltung'ana le Israel olmumai te Mispa, nejo, “Meetae hoo obo te iyiook oisho entito enye meyama iltung'ana le Benchamen.”
Nepuonu iltung'ana Betel netoni teine te dukuya Enkai ometaa teipa, neyietu aaishir te mion.
Nejo ninche, “Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, kainyoo pee eewuo ena atiu nji tiatua Israel, eji metaa keetae taata olosho obo lemeetae te Israel?”
Ore pee ekenyu neyooki iltung'ana aadumunye enasirie, neshet olperere lo lasar teine, neitayu ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani.

Nejo iltung'ana le Israel, “Kalo osho too loshon le Israel leitu elotu ena umata o Laitoriani?” Amu einosa apa ninche olmumai kitok te nkaraki ilo osho leitu elotu eumata o Laitoriani te Mispa, ejo, “Keari ninye metua.”
Keeta apa iltung'ana le Israel olng'ur te nkaraki Benchamen olalashe lenye, nejo ninche, “Eiwuang'ieki olosho obo aaitung'uaa Israel ena olong.
Kaji kinko tenikincho nkituaak lelo ootelekutua, nikinosa apa olmumai to Laitoriani nchere, mikincho ninche hoo nabo oo ntoyie ang meyama.”
Nejo ninche, “Kalo osho ilo too loshon le Israel leitu elotu enetii Olaitoriani te Mispa?” Naa ng'ura, meetae hoo obo ebaiki Yabesh-gilead oshomo ina umata.
Amu ore ina kata eipotitoi iltung'ana inkarn, meetae hoo obo le lelo oomanya Yabesh-gilead oirukishe.
Neaku eirriwayie apa ina umata iltung'ana inkalifuni tomon oaare oopi, neitanap aajoki, “Enchom entaar metuata lelo oomanya Yabesh-gilead to lalem, o nkituaak o nkera.
Ena intae enchom entaas. Ore pooki lee o pooki ng'oruoi naatayiolounote endakie ninche tukul.”
Netum ninche tiatua lelo oomanya Yabesh-gilead iselenken iip ong'uan nemeyiolo olee, neriku ninche ilng'oborri te Shilo, naa enkop e Kanaan etii.
Neitoki ina umata pooki aairriwaki olkilikuai ile Benchamen apa ooti endapidapoi e Rimon, neibalakinye ninche eseriani.
Nerrinyunye Benchamen neisho ninche ile Benchamen nena kituaak apa neitu eari metuata te Yabesh-gilead, kake eitu eidip ninche.
Neing'urrie apa iltung'ana Benchamen te nkaraki natipika Olaitoriani elusie iloshon le Israel.
Neitoki ilpayiani leina umata aajo, “Kaa iyiook kiaas te nkaraki nkituaak e lelo ootelekutua, neidaikieki apa ing'oruo aaishie te Benchamen?”
Nejo ninche, “Meeta nchere metumi enjung'ore te lelo ootelekutua le Benchamen, pee meimin ake ilo osho te Israel.
Ore ake eyia, mikindim iyiook aaishoo ninche ntoyie ang meyama.” Amu einosa olmumai iltung'ana le Israel nchere, “Etediaaki ilo oisho Benchamen enkitok.”
Neaku etejo ninche, “Keetae anaake to lari osirua lo Laitoriani te Shilo, aa taa moikuape e Betel, te nkalo o loosaen enkoitoi kitok nalo te Betel ometabaiki Shekem, o kopikop e Lebona.”
Neitanap ninche ile Benchamen aajoki, “Enchom erraga to lnukata tiatua nkurman oo sabibu,
ning'orishosho, naa tenepuonu ntoyie e Shilo aaranyisho to sinkolio, nimpang'ung'u tiatua enkurma oo sabibu, neibung ake pooki lee enkitok enye aya, te nena toyie e Shilo, nelo enkop e Benchamen.

Naa tenepuonu loo menye anaa ilalashera lenye aailepilepaki iyiook, nikijoki iyiook ninche, ‘Enchoo iyiook mawaita ninche te mpiris, amu eitu iyiook kiya ninche aaitaa inkituaak ang to larrabal, neitu sii intae inchosho iyiook, anaata naa eaku eninyi entorroni.’ ”
Neas ile Benchamen ina, neya nkituaak enye te risioroto esiana enye te nena toyie apa naaranyisho naaibung'a ninche aaya. Neitoki ninche aapuo aarrinyokino enjung'ore enye, neshet inkang'itie nemany.
Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aadumunye. Nelo ake oltung'ani olosho lenye, o lmarei lenye, neipang aapuo teine, nelo ake pooki ng'ae enjung'ore enye.
Ore apa te nena olong'i nemeetae olaiguanani te Israel; etaasa ake pooki tung'ani enaishiaakino too nkonyek enyena.

Ore apa te nena olong'i naaitoreisho ilarishak, netii olameyu enkop, ore oltung'ani obo le Betlehem tiatua enkop e Yuda nelo amany enkop e Moab. Eshomo ninye te nebo enkitok enye o layiok lenyena oaare.

Ore apa enkarna e ilo tung'ani naa Elimelek, ore enkarna e nkitok enye naa Naomi. Ore inkarn oo layiok lenyena pokira oaare naa Mahalon o Kilion. Ile Frati apa ninche ooing'uaa Betlehem tiatua enkop e Yuda. Eshomo apa ninche enkop e Moab nepuo aabik teine.
Kake etua apa Elimelek ilo payian le Naomi, neing'uari Naomi aa ninye ake o layiok lenyena pokira oaare.
Ore kulo pokira neyam intoyie oo Lmoabu; ore apa enkarna e nabo naa Orpa ore enkarna e nkae naa Rusi. Etobiko apa ninche teine ilarin oobaya tomon.
Ore Mahalon o Kilion neye sii ninche, neaku enoto Naomi olkiyioi lo lpayian lenye o loo layiok lenyena.
Nedumunye Naomi o nena toyie oo layiok lenyena pee errinyo teina kop e Moab, amu etoning'o apa ninye teina kop e Moab nchere etamayiana Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena neisho ninche endaa.
Nedumunye teine aapuo teine wueji netii ninye te nebo o ntoyie are oo layiok lenyena, neibung enkoitoi aapuo enkop e Yuda.

Kake enyaaka Naomi ajoki nena toyie are oo layiok lenyena, “Enchom entorrinyoto, shomo ake oltung'ani enkaji e ng'otonye. Naa meitaasa intae Olaitoriani isupati, anaa apa enintaasa intae ilootuata o nanu.
Meidimie intae Olaitoriani enoto inkang'itie, oltung'ani ake te intae netum olpayian!” Neitoki ang'utut ninche, neyietu ninche aaishir.
Nejoki ninche ninye, “A'a, eikirrinyo iyiook te nebo aapuo enetii iltung'ana linono.”
Kake etejo Naomi, “Entorrinyoto enchom intoyie aainei, kainyoo pee kiriamariyieyie nanu? Keton nanu aata ilayiok te nkoshoke ai eji pee eyooki aayam intae?

Entorrinyoto enchom, intoyie aainei, shomo ake oltung'ani enkoitoi enye, amu atamorua nanu meekure atum olpayian. Amaa naaji ninye te najo kaata osiligi, anaa naaji ninye tenaa katum olpayian ena kewarie naiu ilayiok,
iyanyunyu naa o metubulu? Itonini intae miyamama. A'a, intoyie aainei, amu keme oleng te nanu te nkaraki intae, nchere aatigilunore nanu enkaina o Laitoriani.”
Neitoki ninche aayietu aaishir, neng'utut Orpa enkaputani enye kake etamuatakine Rusi ninye.
Nejoki Naomi ninye, “Ng'ura esintani ino ajo eshomo olorere lenye nelo enetii inkaitin enyena; torrinyoyu tusuja esintani ino.”

Kake etejo Rusi, “Mikisai nanu maatung'uai iyie aashu pee arrinyo eitu aasuj iyie; amu ore ewueji nilo ninye nanu alo, ore ewueji nirrag naa ninye nanu airrag; ore iltung'ana linono naa keaku iltung'ana laainei, neaku Enkai ino Enkai ai;
ore ewueji ninang ninye nanu anang, naa teine aanukari nanu. Maaitaasa nanu Olaitoriani ena aitulus tenaa ninye kaarishie keeya iyie.”
Ore ake pee edol Naomi ajo eteenikine Rusi asuj ninye, neitu eitoki ajo ae.
Neaku eshomo ninche pokira are ometabai Betlehem. Ore ake pee ebau Betlehem neing'asia enkang pooki te nkaraki ninche; nejo inkituaak, “Ai Naomi ena?”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Emikimpot nanu aajo Naomi, entejoki nanu Mara, amu aaitaasa nanu Olmagilani imbaa e mion.
Ashomo apa nanu abore, naatorrinyuo nanu Olaitoriani arok. Kainyoo pee kimpotipoto nanu aajo Naomi, aaisilisilo nanu Olaitoriani neyaua Olmagilani entaboi shumata nanu?”
Neaku etorrinyunye Naomi o Rusi ina oo Lmoabu nara entito o layioni lenye. Etorrinyunye ninche eing'uaa enkop e Moab. Nepuonu ninche Betlehem te nkiterunoto e nkikesare e shairi.
Keeta apa Naomi oltung'ani le sotua lo lmarei lo lpayian lenye, oltung'ani karsis, lo lmarei le Elimelek, oji enkarna enye Boas.
Ore Rusi ina oo Lmoabu nejoki Naomi, “Nchooki nanu mashomo enkurma asotu e nkano te siadi ilo latumie nanu ninye omom.” Nejoki Naomi ninye, “Shomo entito ai.”
Neaku etudumunye Rusi alo asotisho tiatua enkurma asuj lelo ooikes, nelotu apa ninye ewueji enkurma e Boas laa olo lmarei le Elimelek.
Nelotu Boas eing'uaa Betlehem, nejoki lelo ooikesita enkurma, “Metaa Olaitoriani te nebo intae!” Newal ninche aajo, “Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani.”
Neitoki Boas ajoki ilo aisiaayiani lenye oitasheiki lelo ooikesisho, “Keneng'ae ena sila?”
Nejoki ilo sinka aitasheikinoni, “Entito oo Lmoabu apa nairiamunore Naomi te nkop e Moab.

Netejo ninye, ‘Aatasayia nchooki nanu matasotu naiturrur tiatua irridat le shairi o le nkano te siadi ilooikes.’ Neaku eewuo ninye, netasotishe ebaiki tadekenya o metabaiki ena kata, eitu ninye eyagie te nkiti rishata.”
Neitoki Boas ajoki Rusi, “Ore taata, toning'o, entito ai, milo asotisho ti ai kurma, nimilo aing'uaa ena, kake tataaniki intoyie aainei.

Ing'ura iyie ewueji nepuo ninche aikesishore, nilo iyie asujaa ninche. Keitu nanu aitanap ilbarnot pee mikintanyamal ninche iyie? Naa te niata enkure shomo enetii motioo tooko ina natookutuo ilbarnot.”
Negilaki kung neirugokino enkop nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo nanu pee anoto omom too nkonyek inono, eji nikitishilayie hoo nara enkomoni?”

Kake etawalikia Boas ninye ajoki, “Ore nena pooki nintaasa enkaputani ino ebaiki keeya o lpayian lino aatolikioki nanu aaitobiraki o ina apa nitung'uayie papaai lino o yieyioo lino o enkop inyi nilotu enkop oo ltung'ana apa limiyiolo.
Mikitalaaki Olaitoriani ina apa nitaasa, nikincho Olaitoriani olerrinyore te nkiputakinoto Enkai oo Siraeli, naa abori inaipuko enyena iewuo asaru!”
Neitoki Rusi ajo, “King'urie iyie nanu, olkitok lai, amu kintagolo nanu oshoke nirorie esinka ino te supatisho, hoo ninye nemara nanu nabo oo nkaisiaayiak inono.”

Ore te nkata nainosi endaa nejoki Boas, “Wou ene, pee inya emukate nintadoiki oldung'oti lino atua enaisho oo sabibu.” Neaku etotona ninye te nebo nena aikesak, neitarasaki ninye emukate natapejoki; nenya ninye o metaraposhoyu, neleku.
Ore pee edumunye ninye alo asotisho, neiguan Boas ilbarnot lenyena ajoki, “Enchoo ninye metasotisho ninye tiatua o metasotu irridat, nimibuakiki ninye.
Ore sii entaiki ninye kulie rridat naatii enkano, ning'ueikiki ninye metasotu, nimibuakiki ninye.”
Neaku etasotishe Rusi tiatua enkurma o metaa teipa; neitoki aidong nena naatasotuo ninye, neaku efa nabo e ntapa naji shairi.
Nedumu ninye aya nelo atua enkanasa; neitodol enkaputani enye entoki natasotuo ninye, neyaua sii aisho ninye endaa duoo natelekua ninye etaraposhe.

Nejoki enkaputani enye ninye, “Kaji duo taata ishomo asotishore? Naa kaji itaasishore? Metamayiani ilo tung'ani likitisirua iyie.” Neaku etolikio ninye enkaputani oltung'ani duo oshomo aaisiaai, nejoki, “Ore enkarna e ilo tung'ani duo lashomo aaisiaai naa keji Boas.”

Nejoki Naomi ina tito o layioni lenye, “Metamayiana Olaitoriani ilo leitu eing'uaa esupatisho enye ilooishu aashu ilootuata!” Neitoki sii Naomi ajoki ninye, “Olo lmarei lang ilo tung'ani, obo le ntaloishi ang.”
Nejo Rusi, ina tito oo Lmoabu, “Ore te nebo nena, aatiaaka ninye, ‘Tataaniki ilaisiaayiak laainei, o metaba anaa neidip enkikesare.’ ”
Neitoki Naomi ajoki Rusi, ina tito o layioni lenye, “Keishiaakino entito ai te nilo iyie te nebo nkaisiaayiak enyena, pee mikintanyamali ake ti ae kurma.”
Neaku etataanikia apa Rusi inkaisiaayiak e Boas, esotisho o metabau enkiting'oto e nkikesare e shairi o enkano; neton ninye te nebo o enkaputani enye.
Neitoki Naomi enkaputani enye ajoki ninye, “Entito ai, aimaaing'uraki nanu iyie ang, pee itum aitirring'ayu?
Amaa, Boas, aime olol lgilata lang, naa atua inkaisiaayiak enyena itii? Ng'ura eitobir ade shairi kewarie te wueji neidong'ishoreki.
Intukuoyu naa niyela te ilata ninchop ilkilani sidain nidoyio alo ewueji neidong'ishoreki; kake mincho kidol ilo tung'ani o metaba anaa neidip ainosa endaa neokisho.
Kake te nelo ninye airrag, tisipu ewueji neirragie ninye; nilo taa abolu inkejek enyena nirrag teine; naa eikiliki ninye enias.”
Newal ninye ajo, “Ore pooki nijo kalo nanu aas.”
Neaku eshomo Rusi ewueji neidong'ishoreki neas anaa enaitanapa enkaputani ninye.
Ore eidipa Boas ainosa endaa neokisho netishipe oltau lenye nelo ninye airrag te bayie o sototi le nkurma. Nelotu Rusi akiti nebolu inkejek enyena, neirrag.
Ore te mpolos e kewarie neipirriu ilo tung'ani, neibelekenya, naa ng'ura, eirragita enkitok too nkejek enyena!
Nejo ninye, “Ira ng'ae?” Newal ninye ajo, “Kara nanu Rusi, enkaisiaayiani ino; isalaasha olkila lino intoipo enkaisiaayiani ino amu iyie olo lgilata lang otaana.”
Nejoki ninye, “Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani, entito ai; inyaaka aitasapuk ena supatisho aitulusoo tene dukuya, nchere eitu iyie ilo asujaa ilbarnot, aa karsisi o aa aisinak.
Ore naa taata entito ai, miureishoyu, kaaitaas nanu nena pooki niomonu, amu eyiolo pooki ng'ae lena ang nchere ira enkitok e tipat.
Naa kesipa inchere kara nanu olo lgilata linyi linyikare, ore ake eyia etii olo lgilata linyikare alang nanu.

Totona ena kewarie, ore tadekenya, ti nikintaas ninye te rishata o ltung'ani lo lgilata, naa sidai; nchoo ninye eas ina. Kake te nemeyieu ninye neas ina rishata o ltung'ani lo lgilata te iyie, ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, nalo nanu aas erishata o ltung'ani lo lgilata te iyie. Irraga mekenyu.”
Neaku eirraga ninye too nkejek enyena o mekenyu, kake etudumunye ninye enasirie; nejoki Boas, “Mincho ake eyiolouni aajo eewuo enkitok ewueji neidong'ishoreki.”
Nejo ninye, “Iyau ilo karasha linchopito toluaa.” Neaku etoluaa ninye, nepik ninye imboreitin ile e shairi neitanap ninye; nelo ninye atua enkanasa.
Ore pee elo ninye enetii enkaputani, nejoki ninye, “Kaji eikunari imbaa entito ai?” Neliki Rusi nena pooki naaitaasa ilo tung'ani,
ejo, “Ore kuna boreitin ile e shairi ninye laaishoo, amu etejo ninye, ‘Milo too nkaik naarook enetii enkaputani ino.’ ”
Newalu Naomi ajo, “Taanyisho entito ai o metaba anaa niyiolou enetiu ena bae, amu meitirring'a ilo tung'ani, kake kelo taata aitabaya ena bae.”
Neilep Boas alo kishomi neton teine; nedol oladuoo lo lgilata lenye onyikare oimaka Boas nelotu agiroo. Neaku etiaaka Boas, “Mbelekenyunye olchore, totona tene;” neibelekenyunye ninye neton.
Neyau ninye ilpayiani tomon le ina anasa nejo, “Entotoni tene;” netoni ninche.
Neitoki ninye ajoki lelo lo lgilata lenye, “Ore Naomi enoshi natushukunye te nkop e Moab, nemirita enkiti wueji e nkop apa o ltung'ani lo lgilata lang oji Elimelek.

Neaku atejo nanu kaaliki iyie, naajoki, Inyang'u te dukuya kulo ootoni tene o te dukuya kulo payiani lo lorere lang. Tenaa iyie inyang'u; kake te niminyang'u, tolikioki nanu, pee atum atayiolo, amu meetae likae likidutieki pee inyang'u, naa nanu laaitoki asuju.” Nejoki ninye, “Kainyang'u nanu.”

Neitoki Boas ajoki, “Ore kenya enkolong ninyang'u enkurma te nkaina e Naomi, ninyang'u sii ninye Rusi, ina tito oo Lmoabu, ina oliai olapa lemeishu pee errinyokini enkarna e ilo lemeishu enjung'ore enye.”
Neitoki ilo tung'ani lo lgilata lenye ajo, “Maidim nanu ainyang'u te nkaraki kewan ai, pee mainyal ake enjung'ore ai. Iwa iyie erishata ai metaa enino makewan, amu maidim nanu atalaku.”

Ele apa olkerreti too le Israel too nkolong'i e apa, too mbaa naaipirta elakunoto o ewalunoto; ore pee eitisipi enkinyiang'a neitayu oltung'ani enamuke neisho olikae, naa ena pukunoto apa enkitabaroto too Siraeli.
Neaku ore ake pee ejoki ilo tung'ani lo lgilata lenye Boas, “Inyang'u iyie,” nedotu ninye enamuke.
Neitoki Boas ajoki lelo payiani o ltung'ana pooki, “Irara intae ilchakenini ena olong nchere ainyang'ua nanu te nkaina e Naomi nena pooki apa naara ine Elimelek, o pooki naara ine Kilion o Mahalon.

O Rusi sii ina tito oo Lmoabu, ina oliai e Mahalon, ainyang'ua nanu ninye metaa enkitok ai, pee eitudupari enkarna e ilo otua te njung'ore enye, pee meiminieki enkarna e ilo lemeishu too lalashera lenyena, o te kishomi e wueji enye; irara intae ilchakenini ena olong.”

Nejo lelo tung'ana pooki ootii kishomi, o lpayiani, “Kira iyiook ilchakenini. Meitotiuo Olaitoriani ina kitok nalotu atua enkaji ino anaa Raheli o Lea, naa ninche pokira naatesheta enkaji e Israel. Tubulu iyie te Efrata nining'oyu te Betlehem;
naa metotiuo enkaji ino anaa enkaji e Peres, laa ninye etoikio Tamar Yuda, te nkaraki inkera nikincho iyie Olaitoriani tena siankiki.”
Neaku ewa Boas Rusi neitaa enkitok enye; nelo aboitare ninye, neisho Olaitoriani metunutayu, neiu enkayioni.
Nejoki inkituaak Naomi, “Meisisi Olaitoriani, laa ninye leitu kipalaa iyie ena olong miata oltung'ani lo lgilata, naa metoning'oyu enkarna enye te Israel!
Keaku ina kerai olikirrinyoki enkishui nikintagol te moruao ino; amu ore ina tito o layioni lino naa aikinyor iyie, nelang ninye ilayiok oopishana, netoishe ninye.”
Kaae nedumu Naomi ina kerai neirragie to lgoo lenye, neaku ninye enkaing'orani enye.
Nedung'oki nkituaak e latia e nkarna, ejo, “Etoikioki Naomi olayioni.” Neisho ninche ninye enkarna aajo Obed; ninye apa menye le Yese, menye Daudi.
Ena ninye eishoi e Peres: Peres apa menye le Hesron,
neiu Hesron Raam, Neiu Raam Aminadab,
Neiu Aminadab Nashon, neiu Nashon Salmon,
neiu Salmon Boas, neiu Boas Obed,
Neiu Obed Yese, neiu Yese Daudi.
Etii apa oltung'ani obo le Ramataim, le ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, oji enkarna enye Elkana olayioni le Yeroham, olayioni le Elihu, olayioni le Tohu, olayioni le Sufi ilo le Efraim.
Neeta apa ninye inkituaak are; ore enkarna e ina e dukuya naa Hana, ore enkarna e nkae naa Penina. Neeta apa Penina inkera kake meeta apa Hana inkera.

Naa keilep apa ele tung'ani te pooki ari te nkanasa enye alo aserem nepolosaki Olaitoriani loo lororani te Shilo, teine apa nerayie ilayiok pokira oaare le Eli, Hofni o Finehas ilapolosak lo Laitoriani.
Ore apa teina olong napolosisho Elkana, neisho ninye irubat Penina, enkitok enye o layiok lenyena pooki o ntoyie enyena;
naa, ore hoo nenyor apa Hana neisho ninye erubata nabo ake, amu eikeno Olaitoriani enguset enye.
Ore apa Penina neitayunore enkaini enye neitagor ninye oleng neinosie osina, te nkaraki naikeno Olaitoriani enguset enye.
Neikunari neijia te pooki ari. Ore anaake te nelo Hana enkaji o Laitoriani neitagor apa ina aini enye ninye. Ore te nkaraki ina neishir Hana ometaa menya endaa.
Ore Elkana ilo payian lenye, nejoki ninye, “Hana, kainyoo peyie inchir? Naa kainyoo pee minya endaa? Naa kainyoo pee eeta oltau lino osina? Aimalusoo too ilayiok tomon te iyie?”
Ore pee eidip ninche aainosa endaa, neokisho te Shilo nedumunye Hana. Netonita apa ina kata Eli ilo apolosani to lorika te mbata e ng'ape e kutukaji e ina aji o Laitoriani.
Neeta apa ninye Hana emion sapuk to ltau neomon Olaitoriani, neishir te mion.

Nenya ninye olmumai nejo, “Olaitoriani loo lororani, tenaa ing'or iyie te sipata osina le sinka ino, nikidamu nanu, nimincho kirikino esinka ino, kake nincho esinka ino olayioni, naisho nanu ninye Olaitoriani inkolong'i pooki e nkishui enye, nemeetae olmurunya oiseyie endukuya enye.”
Ore eomonito ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani, neing'or Eli enkutuk enye.
Eirorita apa Hana to ltau lenye, inchonito enyena e nkutuk ake naaiseuseu nemening'o oltoilo lenye. Ore te nkaraki ina nejo Eli tenaa ketemere enkitok enye.
Nejoki Eli ninye, “Imera ade o anu? Intalamai ina aisho ino.”
Kake etawala Hana ajo, “A'a, Olkitok lai, kara nanu enkitok naata emion to ltau; eitu nanu aok enaisho naitemerisho, agira nanu abukoki Olaitoriani enyamali o ltau lai.
Minko naa esinka ino aitaa enkitok e pesho, amu ore ena rishata pooki kagira alikioo eyieunoto ai o sina lai.”
Neitoki Eli awaliki, “Shomo te seriani, mikinchoo Enkai oo Siraeli nena nitasayua te dukuya ninye.”
Nejo ninye, “Inchoo esinka ino menoto omom too nkonyek inono.” Nelo ina kitok te nkoitoi enye nenya endaa, neitu ninye eitoki aisinanuo.
Neinyototo ninche aayooki tadekenya neserem Olaitoriani; neitoki aashuko aapuo enkang enye te Rama. Neyiolou Elkana Hana ina kitok enye, nedamu Olaitoriani ninye;
ore pee ebaya enkata nenutayu Hana neiu ninye enkayioni, nejo ninye enkarna enye Samuel, amu etejo ninye, “Atoomonuo nanu ninye to Laitoriani.”
Ore ilo tung'ani oji Elkana o enkaji enye pooki neilep aapuo aaitaiki Olaitoriani olasar te pooki ari, nelak ninye olmumai lenye.
Kake eitu ninye eilep Hana alo, amu etiaaka ninye olpayian lenye, “Te neoruni enkerai ilki, nayau nanu ninye, pee etum ataliooyu te dukuya Olaitoriani, neton teine intarasi.”

Nejoki Elkana ilo payian lenye, “Taasa ina naa ninye esidai te iyie; totona ometaba anaa neoruni ninye ilki; meibung'a ake duoo ninye Olaitoriani ororei lenye.” Neton ina kitok neing'or aitubulu olayioni lenye, ometaba anaa neere ninye.

Ore ake pee eoruni ilki neya ninye ailepie te nebo ninye, oloing'oni loo larin okuni o entemet nabo e nkurma o olbene lo lchoni le naisho oo sabibu, neyau ninye enkerai ina aji o Laitoriani natii Shilo; naa aikiti ina kerai.
Neyieng ninche ilo oing'oni, neitoki ninche aayau ina kerai enetii Eli.
Nejo ninye, “Olkitok lai! Ore anaa eninchu, Olkitok lai, kara nanu ina kitok apa naitashe tene te dukuya iyie, eomonito Olaitoriani.
Atoomonuo naaishori ena kerai, naaishoo nanu Olaitoriani eomonunoto ai apa natoomono ninye.
Metaa aishoo nanu ninye Olaitoriani. Ore anaa neishu ninye naa keaku olo Laitoriani.” Neserem ninche Olaitoriani teine.
Neitoki Hana aomon nejo, “Keshipakino oltau lai Olaitoriani; eitaaki kitok engolon ai to Laitoriani. Etaboloki enkutuk ai, matakueniki ilmang'ati laainei, amu kang'idakino nanu enjeunoto ino.
“Metii likae sinyati anaa Olaitoriani. Metii likae leme iyie, metii endapidapoi nanyaanyukie, Enkai ang.
Emintoki aairo aabuaku to lwuasa, emincho enkitokoos eimu inkutukie inyi; amu ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai e ng'eno, naa te ninye eineneng'i iasat.
Etigilate inkai e lelo magil. Kake eitagoloki lelo ooshal.

Ore lelo apa ooiputakinote neisilenoitie ate pee etum endaa, kake ore lelo apa ooata esumashnemeekure eeta esumash. Etoiuo ina apa olupi inkera naapishana, kake ore ina apa naata inkera kumok nemeekure eeta.
Olaitoriani oar metua naa ninye oitopiu. Eitadou ninye aya enemeneng'a neilepunye.
Olaitoriani oitaa aisinani naa ninye oitaa karsis. Ninye oitadou, ninye sii oilepie.

Ninye odumu olaisinani aitung'uaa enterit. Nedumu ilaisinak aitung'uaa olchala loo nkuruon. Neitoton ninche te nebo lelo kituaak nejung olorika le nkanyit. Amu ore ing'apeta e nkop naa ino Laitoriani naa shumata ninche eiteleikia enkop.
“Kerrip ninye inkejek e lelo ooisiligayu lenyena. Kake keiturrarri lelo arruok tiatua enaimin; amu mme te magilanisho eisulu oltung'ani.

Ore lelo mang'ati lo Laitoriani naa kegiligili aaitaa mbelibelat, kegilunore ninche naa kedaraki ninche te keper. Kedung'oki Olaitoriani enkiguana ineeiting'ie enkop, neisho ninye engolon ilo aiguanani lenye, neilepie ninye engolon eilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput.”
Nelo Elkana ang te Rama. Neisiaai ina ayioni Olaitoriani teine netii Eli ilo apolosani.
Ore apa lelo ayiok le Eli naa iltung'ana le pesho; meyanyit apa ninche Olaitoriani.
Ore apa olkuaak loo lapolosak loo ltung'ana naa nchere te neitayu pooki ng'ae olasar, nelotu osinka lo lapolosani, eton eitokitok inkiri, eeta enkisuret oo lala okuni te nkaina enye,

neisuroki ina kisuret atua entereet aashu ene mbakuli aashu emoti oo nkulupuok aashu ae toki; ore ina pooki nayau ina kisuret neya olapolosani makewan. Neas ninche ina te Shilo too Siraeli apa ooetuo ine.

Ore ake sii, eton eitu epeji eilata, nelotu osinka lo lapolosani nejoki ilo tung'ani oitayio olasar, “Nchoru inkiri o lapolosani naapeji. Amu meng'amaa ninye inkiri naayiara te iyie, kake inaajon ake.”
Naa te nejoki ilo tung'ani ninye, “Inchoo ninche eng'as aapej eilata, pee intoki aya inaaba anaa iniyieu,” nejo ninye, “A'a, iyau tena kata; naa te neme neijia, naya nanu te ngolon.”
Ei sapuk apa ina ng'oki e lelo barnot oleng te dukuya Olaitoriani amu eitu eyanyit lelo tung'ana olasar lo Laitoriani.
Keisiaaisho apa Samuel te dukuya Olaitoriani, ina ayioni eishopito enkila sidai dorrop.
Naa keripaki apa ng'otonye oloti kila neyaki ninye te pooki ari, te neilep alo te nebo olpayian lenye epuo aaitayu olasar lo lari.
Nemayian Eli Elkana o enkitok enye, nejoki ninye, “Mikinchoo iyie Olaitoriani inkera tena kitok teina sile apa naisilenoki ninye Olaitoriani,” neitoki ninche aashuko aapuo enkang enye.
Neitoki Olaitoriani amayian Hana, nenutayu ninye neiu ilayiok okuni o ntoyie are. Nebulu ina ayioni Samuel te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Etamorua apa Eli oleng ina kata, nening ninye nena pooki naaitaasita ilayiok lenyena Israel pooki, neboitare ninche nena kituaak naasisho te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kainyoo pee iasiasa kuna baa? Amu atoning'o nanu iasat inyi torrok too ltung'ana pooki.
A'a, ilayiok laainei, ime lomon supati lelo latoning'o iltung'ana eidapashaa.

Te neas oltung'ani eng'oki tialo oltung'ani neitobiraki Enkai osotua, kake amaa teneas oltung'ani eng'oki tialo Enkai, kaing'ae namitu ninye.” Kake mening ninche oltoilo le papaai lenye; amu eyieunoto apa o Laitoriani pee ear ninche metuata.
Nebulu ina ayioni Samuel to sesen netum omom to Laitoriani o too ltung'ana.
Nelotu oltung'ani le Nkai enetii Eli, nejoki ninye, “Inji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Aitodolua apa nanu kewan te nkaji e papaai lino apa etii ninche Misiri, eisiaaisho te nkaji e Farao.

Nagelu nanu ninye tiatua iloshon pooki le Israel pee eaku olapolosani lai, pee eilep alo olperere lai lo lasar, apej enkorropil, neishop ina kila dorrop te dukuya nanu; naisho nanu enkaji e papaai lino ilasarri pooki le nkima ooing'uaa iltung'ana le Israel.

Kainyoo naa pee ing'or too nkonyek o lorok lelo asarri laainei o nkishoorot aainei apa naitanapishe, niyanyitu ilayiok linono aitalang nanu, intopiro ate too rubat nigelulu te pooki kishooroto oo ltung'ana laainei Israel?’

Ore te nkaraki ena eibalunye Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli: Aitisipa nanu inchere, ore enkaji ino o enkaji e papaai lino naa kejing atua neipang te dukuya nanu intarasi; kake eibalunye taata Olaitoriani; Metalakuana ena te nanu; amu ore lelo laayanyit nanu nayanyit si nanu, ore lelo laamen nanu neitololoikini.
Ng'ura ajo kepuonu inkolong'i, pee adung nanu engolon inyi o engolon e nkaji e papaai lino, metaa meitoki atii oltung'ani kitok atua enkaji ino.
Ore to sina ning'or iyie te nkong'u o lom ina karsisisho pooki nayookini aaisho Israel; nemeitoki aekata atii oltung'ani kitok atua enkaji ino intarasi.
Ore oltung'ani te intae leitu aiwuang'ie aitung'uaa olperere lai lo lasar nelekuni pee eishir inkonyek enyena neisinanuo oltau lenye; ore emponaroto pooki e nkaji ino neye to lalem loo ltung'ana.
Naa ore ena nadoiki ilayiok linono pokira oaare, Hofni o Finehas neaku olmonekie te iyie! Keye ninche pokira te nkolong nabo.

Nadumaki nanu kewan olapolosani supat, oas ninye te risioroto e ina natii atua oltau lai o atua endamunoto ai; nashetaki nanu ninye enkaji nasipa, nejing'u ninye neipang boo te dukuya ilo gelunoti lai intarasi.

Ore pooki ng'ae oing'uari tiatua enkaji ino nelotu airrugo asai ninye te nkosholai nabo aashu emukate, naa kejo; Tipikaki nanu aatoomono iyie, atua ewueji nabo oo lapolosak, pee atum ainosa embelati e mukate.”
Ore apa ina ayioni Samuel neisiaai Olaitoriani ti abori Eli. Nemeibala apa ororei lo Laitoriani nena olong'i. Meetae apa induaat oleng.
Ore apa ina kata Eli, eidipa inkonyek aailiilai, metaa meekure edolisho, neirura apa ninye te wueji enye makewan;
Ore oltaa lo Laitoriani neton eitu eye, neirragita Samuel tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, teine apa netii osanduku le Nkai.
Neipotisho Olaitoriani ajo, “Samuel! Samuel!” Nejo ninye, “Nele nanu!”
Neipirri alo enetii Eli nejo, “Nele nanu, amu kimpoto iyie nanu.” Kake etejo ninye, “Eitu nanu aipot; nyaaki irraga.” Nelo ninye airura.
Neitoki Olaitoriani aipotisho nejo, “Samuel!” Nedumunye Samuel nelo enetii Eli, nejo, “Nele nanu, amu kimpoto.” Kake etejo ninye, “Eitu nanu aipotisho, Enkayioni ai, nyaaki irraga.
Neton apa eitu eyiolou Samuel Olaitoriani, neton eitu eibalunyeki ororei lo Laitoriani te ninye.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani aipot Samuel enkata e uni. Nedumunye ninye nelo enetii Eli, nejo, “Nele nanu, amu kimpoto nanu.” Nemusu Eli ajo Olaitoriani oipotito enkayioni.
Nejoki Eli Samuel, “Shomo, irraga; naa ti nikimpot ninye tejo, ‘Iroro, Olaitoriani, amu ening'ito osinka lino.’ ” Nelo Samuel airrag te wueji enye.
Nelotu Olaitoriani aitashe teine, aipotisho anaa too nkulie katitin, ejo “Samuel! Samuel!” Nejo Samuel, “Iroro, amu ening'ito osinka lino.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Samuel, “Ng'ura etaa nanu enaas embae tiatua Israel, naa ore nkiyiaa pokira are e ilo oning neitang'e.
Ore teina olong naitabaya nanu tialo Eli nena pooki natejo naaipirta enkaji enye, ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto.
Najoki nanu ninye nchere etaa nanu kaitame enkaji enye intarasi, teina torroni apa nayiolo ninye, te nkaraki apa namor ilayiok lenyena Enkai, neitu ninye eibooyo ninche.
Metaa kanya nanu olmumai te nkaji e Eli nchere ore ina torroni e nkaji e Eli nemeipooyu aekata to lasar aashu enkishooroto intarasi.”
Neirrag Samuel o mekenyu, neitoki ninye abol inkutukie oo nkajijik e nkaji o Laitoriani. Neureyu Samuel eliki Eli ina duaata.
Kake eipoto Eli Samuel nejoki, “Samuel, enkayioni ai.” Nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”
Nejo Eli, “Kainyoo kitiaaka Olaitoriani? Misudoo iyie te nanu. Metaasa Enkai ena te iyie aitulus, ti nimiki pooki toki e nena pooki nikitiaaka ninye.”
Neliki Samuel ninye pooki toki nemeeta entoki naisudoyie te ninye. Nejo ninye, “Olaitoriani, inchoo ninye eas ina naishaakino te ninye.”
Nebulu Samuel, netii apa Olaitoriani te nebo ninye, neitu eisho obo loo rorei lenyena edoiki enkop.
Ore Israeli pooki ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beersheba neyiolo nchere etudupe Samuel aaku oloiboni lo Laitoriani.
Neitoki Olaitoriani alioyu te Shilo, amu eibalunye Olaitoriani kewan te Samuel te Shilo to rorei lo Laitoriani.
Nelotu ororei le Samuel enetii Israel pooki. Nepuo Isiraeli aarare Ilfilisti; neitayu ilng'oborri te Ebenesa; ore Ilfilisti neitayu ilng'oborri te Afek.
Nenyiku Ilfilisti aaluaa pee earare Isiraeli; ore ake pee eibulaa olarrabal, nemir Ilfilisti Isiraeli nesesekuan iltung'ana oobaya inkalifuni ongu'an teine wueji o larrabal.

Ore ake pee epuonu iltimito ilo kirragarie nejo ilpayiani le Israel, “Kainyoo pee eishoo iyiook Olaitoriani metimira Ilfilisti? Mayautu iyiook osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani ene aaitung'uaa Shilo, pee etum ninye aeu te nebo iyiook aitajeu iyiook aitung'uaa engolon oo lmang'ati lang.”

Neaku eirriwayioki iltung'ana Shilo, meyautu aaitung'uaa ine ilo sanduku lo Sotua lo Laitoriani loo lolorani, ilo otonita te nchumata oo Ikerubi; ore lelo ayiok pokira oaare le Eli, Hofni o Finehas netii apa ine te nebo osanduku lo Sotua le Nkai.
Ore ake pee elotu ilo sanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani atua lelo ng'oborri nebuak Isiraeli pooki embuakunoto kitok, o meikirikirayu enkop.
Ore pee ening Ilfilisti ilo toilo le mbuakunoto sapuk, nejo ninche, “Kainyoo ena buakunoto kitok too lng'oborri loo Lbrania?” Ore ake pee eyiolou aajo eyawuaki osanduku lo Laitoriani ilng'oborri
neureishoyu Ilfilisti; amu etejo ninche, “Eewuo Enkai atua olg'obor.” Nejo ninche “Oi iyiook! Amu meetae aekata entoki natotiuo inji.
Oi iyiook! Kaing'ae okordu iyiook aitung'uaa engolon e kuna aitin magil? Kuna aitin apa naataara Ilmisiri te pooki meitai ti ong'ata.
Entagolo oishua, niarishosho anaa ilewa, intae Ilfilisti, miakuku ake irrindiki loo Lbrania anaa apa enataa ninche te intae; entejo kiti! Anaa ilewa entaarare ninche.”

Neitayu Ilfilisti olarrabal, nemiri Isiraeli, neisik ninche, pooki tung'ani ake enkang enye; nesesekuani iltung'ana kumok oleng, amu etuata too Siraeli isikarini inkalifuni tomoni uni oopuo too nkejek.
Neibung'i ilo sanduku le Nkai; neari metuata lelo ayiok pokira oaare le Eli, Hofni o Finehas.
Neipirri oltung'ani le Benchamen teine nearareki, nelotu Shilo ina olong ake, epolosa inkilani enyena neeta enterit te ndukuya enye.

Ore ake pee ebaya, etonita Eli to lorika lenye te mbata e nkoitoi nalala aing'orisho, amu eiputukunyo oltau lenye te nkaraki ilo sanduku le Nkai. Ore ake pee elotu ilo tung'ani atua ang nelimu ilomon, neyietu enkang pooki aishir.
Ore ake pee ening Eli oltoilo lo lkiyioi, nejo ninye, “Kainyoo ena buakunoto?” Neitoki ilo tung'ani aisarisaru nelotu aliki Eli.
Naa oloo larin intomoni naaudo o isiet apa Eli, netiripate inkonyek enyena metaa meekure edolisho.
Nejoki ilo tung'ani Eli, “Kara nanu ilo oewuo aing'uaa olarrabal; aisikua nanu aing'uaa olarrabal duoo.” Nejoki Eli ninye, “Kaji eikunari, enkerai ai?”

Ore ilo oyaua ilomon newalu ajo, “Eisika Isiraeli te dukuya Ilfilisti, netaaraki sii iltung'ana kumok metuata; etuata sii ilayiok linono pokira oaare, Hofni o Finehas, neibung'aki aaya osanduku le Nkai.”

Ore pee eimaki osanduku le Nkai, nebatata Eli ti oriong aurori to lorika lenye te mbata e kishomi; negila emurt enye neye, amu oltung'ani moruo apa ninye, neiroshi. Netirisha ninye Israeli ilarin artam.

Ore entito enye, ina kitok e Finehas naa entuaa, etaa kejing aji. Ore ake pee ening lelo omon nchere eibung'aki osanduku le Nkai, netua papaai lenye o lpayian lenye, neirrugo aisho; amu etijinga emion enye ninye.
Ore ina kata eye ninye nejoki nena kituaak naaitoisho ninye, “Miureisho, amu itoiuo enkayioni.” Kake eitu ninye ewal aashu eshilaa.
Neisho ninye ina kerai enkarna ajo Ikabod, ejo, “Eshomo enkitoo aing'uaa Israel!” Te nkaraki ilo sanduku le Nkai oibung'aki o te nkaraki papaai lenye o lpayian lenye.
Nejo ninye, “Eshomo enkitoo aing'uaa Israel, amu eibung'aki osanduku le Nkai.”
Ore ake pee eibung Ilfilisti ilo sanduku le Nkai, nenap ebaiki Ebenesa o metabaiki Ashdod.
Neya Ilfilisti ilo sanduku le Nkai nepik atua enkaji e Dagon neitatashaki Dagon.
Ore ake pee eyooki aainyototo iltung'ana le Ashdod, nedol etusulari Dagon te nkomom aosh enkop te dukuya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani. Neya ninche Dagon neinyaaki ewueji enye.

Kake ore ake pee einyototo aayooki ti ae olong, nedol etusulari Dagon te nkomom aosh enkop te dukuya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani; ore endukuya e Dagon o nkaik enyena pokira are neirragita maate te mbata e kutukaji; osesen ake le Dagon etung'uayioki.
Te nkaraki ena pee aa ore ilapolosak le Dagon o pooki oojing ina aji e Dagon nemeroro embata e kutukaji e Dagon te Ashdod o metabaiki ena olong.
Keiroishi apa enkaina o Laitoriani te Shumata iltung'ana le Ashdod, neitame ninche, neisomit ninche too ldututa, Ashdod o ina kop namanita.
Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana le Ashdod eneikununo mbaa, nejo ninche, “Meton osanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli te nebo iyiook; amu keiroishi enkaina enye te shumata iyiook o te shumata Dagon, enkai ang.”

Neirriwaa ninche ilkiliku neiturrur te nebo ilkituaak pooki loo Lfilisti, nejo, “Kaa kintaas osanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli?” Newal ninche, ejo “Inchoo osanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli eyauni aaitamanu Gas.” Neyau ninche osanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli ine.
Kake ore ake pee eyau aaitamanu, near enkaina o Laitoriani ina anasa ayau enkuretisho sapuk, neitame ninye lelo tung'ana le ina ang, ilooti o lbotoro, o metaa eibulaitie ildututa te ninche.

Neirriwaa ninche ilo sanduku le Nkai Ekron. Kake ore ake pee elotu osanduku le Nkai Ekron, neyietu iltung'ana le Ekron aaishir ejo, “Eyautua ninche aaitaman iyiook osanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli pee ear iyiook matuata o iltung'ana lang.”

Neirriwaa ninche ilkiliku neiturrur te nebo ilkituaak loo Lfilisti, nejo, “Ewaita ele sanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli, enchoo eshuko alo ewueji enye makewan, pee memut ake iyiook o ltung'ana lang.” Amu etii apa enkuretisho e keeya atua ina ang pooki. Keiroishiu apa enkaina e Nkai teine oleng;
ore iltung'ana leitu eye nejing ildututa, ore olkiyioi le ina ang neilep alo keper.
Etii apa ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani enkop oo Filistia ilapaitin oopishana.
Neipotu Ilfilisti ilapolosak o lamusumusok nejo, “Kaa kintaas ele sanduku lo Laitoriani? Entoliki iyiook entoki nikiyayie ewueji enye.”

Nejo ninche, “Tiniyaya intae aashuk ilo sanduku le Nkai oo Siraeli, emiyaya ake erok, kake entayiolo ake pee ishorikiki ninye olasar le nkitarruorroto pee eishiunyeki intae, neyiolouni te intae aajo kainyoo pee meibelekenya enkaina enye tialo intae.”

Nejo ninche, “Kainyoo ilo asar le nkitarruorroto likishukoki iyiook ninye?” Newalu ninche aajo, “Ildututa imiet le saabu o ndero imiet e saabu, anaa esiana oo lkituaak loo Lfilisti; amu etii apa shumata intae olmeitai otiu anaa ele o shumata ilkituaak linyi.

Metaa meeta inchere pee mintayuyu nkitanyaanyukot oo ldututa linyi o inkitanyaanyukot oo ndero inyi naainyal enkop, ninchosho enkitoo Enkai oo Siraeli; amu ebaiki neiteneneng ninye aitung'uaa intae o nkaitin inyi o enkop inyi.
Kainyoo pee intagoligolo intae iltauja linyi anaa apa enaitagolo Ilmisiri o Farao iltauja lenye? Amaa pee eidip ninye atekeshare ninche, keitu ninche eisho iltung'ana meshomo, nedumunye ninche aapuo?

Ore naa taata ewaita nintobiribiri engarri ng'ejuk o nkishu naalepo are neitu aekata epiki inkeek oo murto imurto niyenikiki nena kishu engarri, kake ewaita ilasho lenye ang, aaitalamaa teine netii ninche.

Niyaya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani ninteleikiki ina garri, nepiki atua ilo sanduku enchoto enye nabo nena kitanyaanyukot e saabu, naa ninche ishukoki ninye anaa olasar le nkitarruorroto. Nireureu ninye, nipalipala meshomo openy.

Ning'oring'oro; te neilep ninye aibung enkoitoi nalo enkop enye kewan, alo Bet-shemesh, naa ninye ilo oitaasa iyiook ena taboi; Kake te neme neijia, nikiyiolou iyiook inchere mme enkaina enye natoosho iyiook, ketotiuo ake duoo neijia te iyiook to lbuket.”
Neiko neijia iltung'ana, neya inkishu are naalepo neeniki ninche ina garri, neikenoo ilasho lenye ti ang.
Nepik ninche ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani eng'arri, o ilo sanduku te nebo indero e saabu o inkitanyaanyukot oo ldututa lenye.

Nepuo nena kishu aaitoriori enkalo e Bet-shemesh aaibung enkoitoi naporo neru epuoito; nemeibelekeny enkalo aapuo tatene aashu aapuo kedianye; ore ilkituaak loo Lfilisti nesujaa ninche o metabaiki olpolosie le Bet-shemesh.
Ore ina kata neikesa iltung'ana le Bet-shemesh enkano to erata; ore ake pee eshumu inkonyek enye nedol osanduku lo Laitoriani neng'idayu pee edol ninye.
Nelotu ina garri atua enkurma e Yoshua le Bet-shemesh Neitashe teine. Netii apa osoit sapuk ine, neiper apa ninche inkeek e ina garri neitayu nena kishu anaa olasar opejori to Laitoriani.

Neitadou Ilawi ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani o ilo sanduku otashare, laa ninye etii atua nena kitanyaanyukot e saabu, neirragie ninche te nchumata o soit sapuk; ore iltung'ana le Bet-shemesh neitayu ilasarri oopejori nepolosaki ilasarri Olaitoriani ina olong.
Ore ake pee edol lelo kituaak loo Lfilisti ina, neshuko ninche ina olong aapuo Ekron.
Kulo ninche lelo dututa le saabu ootushukutuo Ilfilisti anaa olasar le nkitarruorroto to Laitoriani: obo le Ashdod, obo le Gasa, obo le Ashkelon, obo le Gas, obo le Ekron;

ore sii nena dero e saabu, naa te risioroto oo nkang'itie oo Lfilisti e lelo kituaak pokira imiet, inkang'itie naasheta sunta o inkang'itie kutiti nemeeta sunta. Ore ilo soit sapuk, apa laa ninye eiteleikiaki ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani, naa shakenisho ebaiki ena olong tiatua enkurma e Yoshua olayioni le Bet-shemesh.

Near Olaitoriani metuata embata oo ltung'ana le Bet-shemesh, te nkaraki naing'ura ninche atua ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani; near ninye metuata iltung'ana intomoni naapishana te ninche, neishir iltung'ana te nkaraki naitayio Olaitoriani emutata kitok tiatua iltung'ana.
Nejo iltung'ana le Bet-shemesh, “Kaing'ae oidim aitasho te dukuya Olaitoriani, ena Ai sinyati? Kaing'ae eyakini pee eilep alo aing'uaa iyiook?”
Neirriwaki ninche ilkiliku lelo oomanya Kiriat-Yearim, ejo, “Etushukutuo Ilfilisti osanduku lo Laitoriani. Entadou wootu ewaita enitii.”

Nepuonu iltung'ana le Kiriat-Yearim, neilepie ninche aaya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani neyau ninye enkaji e Abinadab te nchumata oldoinyo; neitisiny ninche olayioni lenye Eliesa, pee etum enkitasheikinoto e ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani.
Ore ebaiki ina olong apa nairragieki osanduku lo Laitoriani te Kiriat-Yearim, netulusoyie enkata naado, enkata oo larin tikitam, ore enkaji pooki e Israel neishiraki Olaitoriani.

Nejoki Samuel enkaji pooki e Israel, “Tenaa ishukunyenye aapuonu enetii Olaitoriani to ltau linyi pooki, ewuangie naa nena aitin oo loreren o ina Ashtarot entung'uai ate, nintoriokiki oltau linyi Olaitoriani, nisiaayiayia ninye ake, naa keitajeu ninye intae aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti.”
Neiwuang'ie Isiraeli inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naaji baal o Astorot, neisiaai ninche Olaitoriani ake.
Neitoki Samuel ajo, “Enturrurro Isiraeli pooki te Mispa, pee aomon nanu Olaitoriani te nkaraki intae.”

Neiturrurro ninche te Mispa, neoku enkare neibukoo ina are te dukuya o Laitoriani ina olong, neen ate aaitupukoo teina olong. Nejo ninche kitaasa eng'oki to Laitoriani. Neiguanaki Samuel iltung'ana le Israel te Mispa.
Ore ake pee ening Ilfilisti nchere eiturrurrote iltung'ana le Israel te Mispa, neilepu ilkituaak loo Lfilisti aapuo aarare Israel. Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana le Israel ina neureyu Ilfilisti oleng.
Nejoki iltung'ana le Israel Samuel, “Migira ake eitu inchiraki Olaitoriani Enkai ang te nkaraki iyiook, pee etum ninye aitajeu iyiook aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti.”
Neya Samuel olkuoo oleporeki nepolos anaa olasar opejori pooki to Laitoriani; neishiraki Samuel Olaitoriani te nkaraki Isiraeli, newaliki Olaitoriani ninye.
Ore eitayu Samuel olasar opejori, nenyiku Ilfilisti pee earare Israel: kake etadara Olaitoriani to ltoilo sapuk adaraki Ilfilisti nenang'aki ninche atua olmilo; neilanyisho aaisik te dukuya Israel.
Neipang iltung'ana le Israel te Mispa nesujaa Ilfilisti, nemut ninche o metabaiki abori Bes-kar.
Neitoki Samuel adumu osoit neirragie te rishata e Mispa o Yeshana, nejo enkarna enye Ebenesa; amu etejo ninye, “Ore otene etareto iyiook Olaitoriani.”
Nemiri Ilfilisti neitu eigil aajing enkop oo Siraeli. Nearare enkaina o Laitoriani Ilfilisti too nkolong'i pooki e Samuel.
Ore inkanas e Israel apa naawaita Ilfilisti neshukokini Israel, ebaiki Ekron o metabaiki Gat; nekordu Israeli enkop enye aaitung'ua enkaina oo Lfilisti. Netii apa eseriani erishata e Israel o Lamori.
Neaku Samuel olarishani te Israel too nkolong'i pooki enkishui enye.
Nelo ninye amanaa to lari o to lari alo Betel o Gilgal o Mispa; neiguanaki ninye Israel te kuna wuejitin pooki.
Paa keshuko alo Rama, amu ine apa etii enkanasa enye, naa teine sii apa eiguanaki Isiraeli arish. Neshetaki ninye teine Olaitoriani olperere lo lasar.
Ore ake pee emoruau Samuel neitaa ilayiok lenyena ilarishak te Israel.
Ore enkarna e ilo ayioni lenye kikau naa Yoel, ore enkarna o liare, neji Abija; neiguana apa ninche te Beer-sheba.
Ore eyia eitu apa eibung lelo ayiok lenyena inkoitoi enyena, kake eibelekenyate aasujaa dupoto; neng'amaa ninche intokitin e ropare neboin esipata.
Neitoki ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli aaiturrurro te nebo nepuonu enetii Samuel te Rama,
nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura, ira iyie moruo, ore ilayiok linono nemepuo too nkoitoi inono; ore naa taata tegelaki iyiook olaiguanani pee eitore iyiook anaa nkuapi pooki.”
Kake eitu eitiship ina bae Samuel ina kata pee ejo ninche, “Inchoo iyiook olaiguanani pee eitore iyiook.” Neomon Samuel Olaitoriani.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Samuel, “Toning'o oltoilo loo ltung'ana te nena pooki nikijoki ninche iyie; amu eitu ninche kiany iyie, kake aatanyaita ninche nanu pee maitoki aaku olaiguanani lenye.

Ore te risioroto oo nkiaasin pooki naaitaasa ninche nanu, ebaiki ina olong apa nayawua ailepunye aitung'uaa Misiri o metabaiki ena olong, aaing'uaa nanu, neisiai kulie aitin, metaa easita sii ina te iyie.
Ore naa taata, toning'o oltoilo lenye; nabo ake, nkoo ninche tuunoki, nintodol ninche inkoitoi e ilo aiguanani ooyooki aitore ninche.”
Neliki Samuel irorei pooki lo Laitoriani lelo tung'ana ooikilikuanu olaiguanani te ninye.
Nejo ninye, “Kuna eas ilo aiguanani oyooki aitore intae; keya ninye ilayiok linyi, negelaki ingarrin enyena neaku ilakedok loo mbartan enyena, neipirri ninche te dukuya ingarrin enyena;

negelu te nkaraki kewan enye ilarikok loo nkalifuni o larikok loo maa onom, o kulikae pee etur enkurma enye o kulikae pee eikes enkurma enye, neitobir sii imasaa olarrabal o ntokitin oo ngarrin enyena.
Neya ninye intoyie inyi aitaa nkaitobirak oo sonkoyoni, o nkayiarak o nkapejok oo mukateni.
Neya ninye eneisul too nkurman inyi, o too sabibu o nkurman oo loirienito neisho ninche isinkan lenyena.
Neya ninye ematua e tomon oo ntapa inyi o enoo sabibu neisho ninche ilkituaak lenyena o isinkan lenyena.
Neya ninye isinkan linyi lewa o nkaisiaayiak inyi, o nkishu inyi naaisul, o sirkon linyi, nepik ninche esiaai enye.
Neya ninye ematua e tomon oo nkerra inyi, niakuku intae irrindiki lenyena.
Ore kenya ina olong niyietutu aaishir te nkaraki olaiguanani linyi, laa ninye itegelakita ate; kake meng'amaa kenya intae Olaitoriani teina olong.”
Kake etanyaita iltung'ana einining ilo toilo le Samuel; nejo ninche, “A'a! Kake aikiyeu ake iyiook olaiguanani oitore iyiook,
pee kitum sii iyiook aatotiu anaa inkuapi pooki, netum sii olaiguanani lang aitoria iyiook, nerikoo ninye iyiook, nearisho ninye too larrabali lang.”
Ore ake pee eidip Samuel atoning'o irorei pooki loo ltung'ana, nelimu ninche pooki too nkiyiaa o Laitoriani.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Samuel, “Toning'o oltoilo lenye, nigelaki ninche olaiguanani.” Neitoki Samuel ajoki iltung'ana le Israel, “Shomo pooki tung'ani enkanasa enye.”
Etii apa oltung'ani le Benchamen oji enkarna enye Kish, olayioni le Abiel, olayioni le Seror, olayioni le Bekoras, olayioni le Afia, Olbenchameni, oltung'ani karsis oleng.

Neeta apa olayioni oji enkarna enye Saul, ilo barnoti oikishiaan. Metii apa oltung'ani tiatua iltung'ana pooki le Israel olang ninye te nkishaa; ebaiki ironyi lenyena neilep neado apa ninye alang pooki tung'ani.
Neimin apa isirkon le Kish, menye Saul. Nejoki Kish Saul olayioni lenye, “Toriko obo loo sinkan te nebo iyie, nidumunyenye, aapuo aing'oru isirkon.”

Neim ninche enkop oo ldoinyo e Efraim neim enkop e Shalisha, kake eitu ninche etum. Neitoki ninche aaim enkop e Shaalim kake metii apa ine. Neitoki ninche aaim enkop e Benchamen, kake eitu etum ninche.
Ore ake pee epuonu ninche enkop e Suf, nejoki Saulo ilo sinka lenye apa otii te nebo ninye, “Wou, maape aashuko mepal ake papaai lai enadamu isirkon neaku iyiook edamu.”
Kake etiaaka, “Ng'ura, etii oltung'ani le Nkai ena ang, naa oltung'ani oyanyiti; ore ina pooki najo ninye nesipayu. Maape iyiook ine; ebaiki neliki ninye iyiook inaaipirta ena lototo nikitii.”

Neitoki Saul ajoki ilo sinka lenye, “Kake amaa ti nikipuo, kainyoo iyiook kiyaki ilo tung'ani? Amu eishunye imukateni naatii atua ilbenia lang, nemetii enkishooroto nikiyaki ilo tung'ani le Nkai. Kainyoo kiata iyiook?”
Neitoki ilo sinka awaliki Saul ajoki, “Ore tene, aata nanu ematua e ong'uan e shekel enkosholai; naa kaisho ilo tung'ani le Nkai, pee eliki iyiook enkoitoi ang.”
Ore apa te Israel, te nelo oltung'ani aikilikuanisho tialo inaaipirta Enkai, nejo ninye, “Wootu maapeiti enetii oladuaani,” amu ore ilo taata oji oloiboni naa keji apa oladuaani.
Nejoki Saul osinka lenye, “Enkiroroto sidai, wou maape.” Nepuo ninche ina ang apa natii ilo tung'ani le Nkai.
Ore eilepaki oldoinyo aapuo ina ang, nenang'are ninche iselenken aisiaayiak eipang'u aapuonu aaoku enkare, nejoki ninche, “Ketii oladuaani ene?”
Newalu ninche, “Etii, ng'ura, etii ninye dukuya intae. Esarisara; eewuo ninye tena kata ang, amu eeta taata iltung'ana olasar te wueji e shumata.

Ore ina kata ake ti nijing'ijing'i enkanasa nitumutumu intae ninye, eton eitu elo eilep alo ine wueji neika anya endaa; amu menya iltung'ana endaa o metaba anaa nelotu, aa keng'as ninye amayian olasar; ore te siadi nenya endaa lelo ooitoomonoki. Elepa taata enchom, amu ipuopuo aainepu ninye aasioki.”
Neilep ninche aapuo ina anasa. Ore ejing'ita ninche ang, nedol ninche Samuel eipang'u alotu anang'are ninche eloito ailep alo ine wueji e shumata.
Ore apa eton eitu elotu Saul, netaboloko Olaitoriani Samuel:

“Ore taisere enyikita ena saa naairriwaki nanu iyie oltung'ani oing'uaa enkop e Benchamen, naa ibukoki iyie ninye eilata aput pee eaku olkitok oitore iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli. Neitajeu ninye iltung'ana laainei aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti; amu atoduaa nanu osina loo ltung'ana laainei, amu eewuo olkiyioi lenye enatii nanu.”
Ore ake pee edol Samuel Saul, nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Nele oltung'ani laa ninye aatolikio iyie! Ninye ilo olo aitore iltung'ana laainei.”
Netaaniki Saul Samuel te kishomi, nejo, “Tolikioki nanu enetii enkaji o laduani.”

Newaliki Samuel Saul, “Kara nanu oladuaani; ilepa shomo te dukuya nanu ine wueji e shumata, amu ore taata inya iyie endaa te nebo nanu, ore tadekenya naayooki aisho iyie shomo naaliki iyie nena pooki naatii indamunot inono.
Ore te lelo sirkon linono ooimina inkolong'i uni naatulusoitie, mintoki adamu ninche, amu eidipaki aanoto. Naa kaing'ae ilo oyieuni tiatua Israel pooki? Aime iyie o enkaji e papaai lino pooki?”

Newalu Saul, “Eimara nanu Olbenchameni, ilo osho kiti oleng too loshon le Israel? Aime kiti oleng, olmarei lang alang ilmareita pooki lo losho le Benchamen? Kainyoo naa pee kirorie iyie nanu tena oitoi?”
Nerik Samuel Saul o ilo sinka lenye neyau ninche atua aji neisho ninche ewueji te dukuya lelo pooki ooitoomonoki, nebaya apa lelo tung'ana tomoni uni.
Nejoki Samuel olayierani, “Iyau erubata duoo naaishoo, naa ninye aatiaaka iyie inteng'ela.”

Neyau olayierani emuro o enkiring'o naibung'are neirragie ninche te dukuya Saul; nejo Samuel, “Toduaa ajo ore ina duoo natushumaki neirragieki te dukuya iyie. Inosa amu iyie duoo etushumakaki o metabau esaa natudung'uoki, pee itum ainosa te nebo ilomon.”
Nedaa Saul te nebo Samuel ina olong. Ore ake pee edou ninche aaing'uaa ine wueji e shumata aapuonu ina anasa, eitobirakaki Saul endapash te nchumata enkaji neirrag ninye airura.
Ore enasirie neipot Samuel Saul te nchumata e nkaji ajoki, “Inyo, pee aatum airriwai iyie te nkoitoi ino.” Neinyototo Saul, ore ninye o Samuel neipang aapuo enkoitoi.

Ore epuoito ninche auluo ina ang, nejoki Samuel Saul, “Tiaaki ele sinka meituruko alo dukuya iyiook, ore eidipa aituruko, intasho iyie tene te nkiti rishata, pee atum aibalunye te iyie ororei le Nkai.”

Neitayu Samuel oltulet le ilata nebukoki endukuya e Saul eilata aput, neng'utut ninye nejo, Keitu iyie kibukoki Olaitoriani eilata aput pee iaku olkitok oitore iltung'ana lenyena Isiraeli? Naa intore iyie iltung'ana lo Laitoriani, nintajeu iyie ninche aitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye oomanita. Neaku ele olmonekie te iyie nchere kitubukoko iyie Olaitoriani eilata aput pee iaku olkitok oitore enjung'ore enye.

Tinikilo iyie aorore nanu taata nitum iltung'ana oaare te mbata e nkurare e Raeli te nkop e Benchamen pee etumo o Selsa, nikijoki ninche iyie, ‘Ore ilapa sirkon lishomo iyie aing'oru nenotoki; ore taata papaai lino etapala enadamu isirkon neaku intae edamu, ejo; “Kaji aiko to layioni lai?’

Nilo iyie dukuya o tabaiki olchani onyanyukie olng'aboli otii Tabor; nikinang'are iyie teine iltung'ana okuni ooilep aapuo enetii Enkai te Betel, enapita obo ilkuoo okuni le kineji, nenapita olikae imukateni uni, ore olikae nenapita olbene lo lchoni le naisho oo sabibu.
Nikiroroki ninche nikincho iyie imukateni are ning'amu iyie te nkaina enye.

Ore te siadi ina nilotu iyie Gibeat-elohim, ine netii oltim loo Lfilisti; ore teine, ilotu ina anasa, ninang'are olturur loo loibonok edou aapuonu eing'uaa ine wueji e shumata eeta enkawuo oo sinkolioitin o ntampurini o endule, o lwulul loo usin, te dukuya ninche, eibonisho.
Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani te ngolon shumata iyie, naa imbonisho iyie te nebo ninche nikimbelekenyi iyie aaitaa likae tung'ani.
Nchoo ake pee kinang'are iyie kulo monek, taasa enaba anaa enatum inkaik inono aataas, amu etii Enkai te nebo iyie.

Nidoyio iyie alo Gilgal te dukuya nanu; naa ng'ura, kalotu nanu enitii aitayu olasar opejori napolos olasar le seriani. Too nkolong'i naapishana taanyisho, o metaba anaa nalotu pee aaitodol iyie eniaas.”
Ore ake pee eibelekenya ninye aisho Samuel enkoriong enye, neisho Enkai ninye likae tau; nebaya lelo monek pooki ina olong.
Ore ake pee epuonu ninche Gibea, nenang'are ninye olturur loo loibonok; nelotu enkiyang'et e Nkai te ngolon shumata Saul, neibonisho ninye tiatua ninche.
Ore apa lelo pooki ooyiolo ninye pee edol eneiko te neibonisho te nebo iloibonok, nejokino iltung'ana maate, “Kainyoo naewuo shumata olayioni le Kish? Ketii sii Saul atua iloibonok?”
Newal oltung'ani le ine wueji ajo, “Naa kaing'ae papaai lenye?” Metaa etaa endung'et e rashe eji, “Ketii sii ninye Saul atua iloibonok?”
