Ore ake pee eidip Saul aibonisho nelotu ine wueji e shumata.
Nejoki olenkapu lenye Saul o ilo sinka lenye, “Kaji apa ishomo?” Nejo ninye, “Kishomo aaing'oru isirkon; ore ake pee kidol aajo metumi, nikipuo enetii Samuel.”
Nejo ilo le nkapu le Saul, “Tolikioki siaake enikitiaaka Samuel.”
Nejoki Saul olenkapu lenye, “Etiaaka ninye iyiook aibalakinye nchere enotoki lelo sirkon.” Kake ore tialo ina bae e nkitoria natejo Samuel, eitu ninye eliki ai toki.
Neipotu Samuel iltung'ana meiturrurrokinoto Olaitoriani te Mispa.

Nejoki ninye iltung'ana le Israel, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Ayaua nanu Israel ailepunye aitung'uaa Misiri, nalaku nanu intae aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lmisiri naitung'ua enkaina oo nkitoriat apa pooki naaisomita intae.’

Kake itanyaita intae ena olong Enkai inyi, ilo oitajeu intae tiatua isinaitin linyi pooki o losilisili; nitejo intae, ‘A'a, kake tipika olaiguanani shumata iyiook.’ Ore naa taata eyautu ate dukuya Olaitoriani too loshon linyi o too nkalifuni inyi.”
Neriku Samuel iloshon pooki le Israel enetaana, nedoiki enkukuo olosho le Benchamen.

Neyau olosho le Benchamen enetaana too lmareita lenyena, nedoiki enkukuo olmarei le Matrit; ore te siadi neyau olmarei le Matri enetaana olee o lee, nedoiki enkukuo Saul ole Kish. Kake ore ake pee eing'oru ninche ninye, neitu etumi ninye.
Neitoki ninche aaikilikuanu to Laitoriani, “Keewuo ele tung'ani ene?” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, eisudori ninye tiatua lolan.”
Neipirri ninche aayau ninye teine; ore pee eitashe tiatua iltung'ana, naa keado alang pooki tung'ani ebaiki ironyi lenyena neilep.
Nejoki Samuel iltung'ana pooki, “Idolitata olaa ninye etegelua Olaitoriani? Metii likae laaijo ninye tiatua iltung'ana pooki.” Nebuaku iltung'ana pooki aajo, “Metobikoi olaiguanani!”

Neliki Samuel iltung'ana enkitoo nairirikino olaiguanani isiaaitin enyena; neiger tiatua embuku neirragie te dukuya Olaitoriani. Neisho Samuel iltung'ana pooki meshomo, oltung'ani ake nelo enkang enye.
Nelo sii ninye Saul enkanasa enye te Gibea, ore te nebo ninye nepuo ilpayiani oogol ooiseyie Enkai iltauja lenye.
Kake ore ilkulikae tung'ana le pesho, nejo, “Kaji eiko ele tung'ani te neitajeu iyiook?” Nemenaa ninche ninye, neitu ninche eyaki ninye inkishoorot. Kake etigire ninye.
Neitoki Nahash, ilo Amoni, ailep alo neman Yabesh-gilead; nejoki iltung'ana pooki le Yabesh Nahash, “Ntaiki iyiook olning'o pee kisiaai iyie.”
Kake etiaaka ninye Nahash, ilo Amoni, “Tena oitoi aitaiki intae olning'o inchere kakurtu nanu inkonyek inyi pooki e tatene, napik esulare Israel pooki.”

Nejoki ilpayiani le Yabesh ninye, “Nchoo iyiook erishata oo nkolong'i naapishana pee kitum aairriwai ilkiliku enkop pooki e Israel. Ore ake pee metii hoo obo oitajeu iyiook, nikincho iyiook iyie ate.”
Ore ake pee epuonu ilkiliku Gibea e Saul, nelikioo ninche olomoni too nkiyiaa oo ltung'ana; neishir iltung'ana pooki aayietu.
Negira Saul alotu te nkurma te siadi ilmong'i; nejo Saul, “Kainyoo naishirie iltung'ana, pee eishirita?” Neliki ninche ilomon le lelo tung'ana le Yabesh.
Nelotu Enkiyang'et e Nkai te ngolon shumata Saul pee eidip atoning'o kulo omon, neyupuyup oleng engoro enye.

Neya ninye ilmong'i oaare ootii enchata emurt nabo, nedung'udung ninche aitaa indung'ot, neirriwaa nena dung'ot enkop pooki e Israel, too nkaik e lelo kiliku ejo, “Ore pooki ng'ae lemeipang'u asuj Saul o Samuel, neikoni neijia ilmong'i lenyena!” Nejing iltung'ana euriata o Laitoriani, neipang'u ninche anaa oltung'ani obo.
Ore ake pee eiturrur aiken ninche te Besek, nera iltung'ana le Israel inkalifuni iip uni, ore iltung'ana le Yuda naa inkalifuni tomoni uni.

Nejoki ninche lelo ooetuo ooata olkilikuai, “Entiaaki iltung'ana le Yabesh-gilead inji, ‘Ore taisere, te neirouaju enkolong, nitumutumu intae enkordunoto.’ ” Ore pee epuonu lelo lo ilkilikuai neliki iltung'ana le Yabesh, neng'idayu ninche.
Neaku etejo iltung'ana le Yabesh, “Ore taisere naa aikipalari iyiook te ntae, naa indimidimi aaitaasa iyiook enaba anaa enidolitata aa sidai te ntae.”

Ore pee ekenyu nepik Saul lelo tung'ana ilturrurri okuni; nepuonu ninche atua empolos oo lng'oborri tadekenya enasirie, nedung lelo Amoni o meipira enkolong; ore lelo ooimishote neidapasha, o metaba anaa neaku meetae ninye oaare lenye ootoni te nebo.
Nejoki iltung'ana Samuel, “Kaing'ae ilo apa otejo, ‘Eji keitore iyiook Saul?’ Entoriku lelo tung'ana pee kiar iyiook metuata.”
Kake etejo Saul, “Meari ninye oltung'ani obo metua ena olong, amu ore taata neyaua Olaitoriani enkordunoto tiatua Israel.”
Neitoki Samuel ajoki iltung'ana, “Wootu, maapeiti iyiook Gilgal paa teine kintang'ejuk enkitoria.”

Neaku eshomo iltung'ana pooki Gilgal, ore teine neitaa ninche Saul olaiguanani te dukuya Olaitoriani te Gilgal. Ore teine nepolos ninche ilasarri le seriani te dukuya Olaitoriani; ore teine neshipa Saul o ltung'ana pooki le Israel oleng.
Nejoki Samuel Isiraeli pooki, “Eng'ura, atoning'o nanu oltoilo linyi te nena pooki nikitiaakita intae nanu, natuputoko nanu intae olaiguanani.

Ore taata, eng'ura, eloito olaiguanani te dukuya intae; nara nanu moruo naaiborra elukunya, naa eng'ura, etii ilayiok laainei te nebo intae; nashomo nanu te dukuya intae ebaiki kitisho ai o metabaiki ena olong.

Nele nanu; enchakenoi tialo nanu te dukuya Olaitoriani o te dukuya ilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput. Kol kiteng le ng'ae nanu aawa? Aashu ko sikiria le ng'ae nanu aawa? Aashu kaing'ae nanu ainyala? Kaing'ae nanu ainosie osina? Aashu ai te nkaina e ng'ae nanu atang'amua eropare pee aitamodok inkonyek aainei te ninye? Enchakenoi tialo nanu, naa kashukoki nanu intae.”
Nejo ninche, “Eitu iyie iinyal iyiook aashu ainosie osina, aashu aisimaa ae toki te nkaina o ltung'ani.”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Olaitoriani olchakeni tialo intae, naa ilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput olchakeni ena olong, nchere eitu intae itumutumu ae toki te nkaina ai.” Nejo ninche, “Ninye olchakeni.”
Nejoki Samuel iltung'ana, “Olaitoriani olchakeni apa otegelua Musa o Aron neyau iloo papaai linyi ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.
Ore naa taata entasho entirring'ata, pee atum atasayia intae te dukuya Olaitoriani tialo inkiasin pooki e njeunoto o Laitoriani naataasa ninye te nkaraki intae o te nkaraki iloo papaai linyi.

Ore apa pee elo Yakobo Misiri neinosie ninye Ilmisirini osina, neishiraki iloo papaai linyi Olaitoriani neirriwaa Olaitoriani Musa O Aron, laa ninche ooyautua iloo papaai linyi aaitung'uaa Misiri, neisho ninche metobiko tene wueji.

Kake etorikinote ninche Olaitoriani Enkai enye; nemiraki ninye ninche atua enkaina e Sisera, olkitok le njore e Yabin, olaiguanani le Hasor, o atua enkaina oo lfilisti, o atua enkaina o laiguanani le Moab; nearare ninche lelo.

Neishiraki ninche Olaitoriani, nejo, ‘Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki amu kitung'uaitie iyiook Olaitoriani, nikisiaayia iyiook Baal o Astarot; kake ore taata tokordu iyiook intung'uai atua enkaina oo lmang'ati lang, naa eikisiaai iyie.’
Neirriu Olaitoriani Yerubaal o Barak o Yepsa, o Samuel, nekordu ninche intae aaitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati linyi te pooki shoto; nibikibiki intae te seriani.
Ore pee idolidolo intae Nahash, olaiguanani loo Lamoni eewuo aarare intae, nikijokiki intae nanu, ‘A'a, kake olaiguanani oitore iyiook,’ apa aa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi olaiguanani linyi.
Ore naa taata eng'ura ilo aiguanani litegelutua, laa ninye inkilikuanutua intae; eng'ura, etipika Olaitoriani olaiguanani shumata intae.

Ti niureyuyu intae Olaitoriani nisiaiaya ninye, nining'ining'i oltoilo lenye, nimipaashaa aarare enkitanapata o Laitoriani, naa ti nisujaa intae tenebo olaiguanani oitore intae, Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, nisidanunu
kake te nimining'ining'i oltoilo lo Laitoriani, kake nianyianya ina kitanapata o Laitoriani, nearare intae enkaina o Laitoriani, o ilo aiguanani linyi.
Ore naa taata entasho entirring'ata pee idolidolo ena toki kitok, nayooki Olaitoriani aas te dukuya inkonyek inyi.

Aime enkolong e enkikesare e nkano ena olong? Ee, kaipot nanu Olaitoriani pee etum airriu endarata o enchan; niyiolouu nidolidolo aajo aikitok esuujisho inyi, apa nitaasa too nkonyek o Laitoriani, inkilikuanakiki ate olaiguanani.”
Neaku neipot Samuel Olaitoriani, neirriu Olaitoriani endarata o enchan ina olong apa; neureyu iltung'ana pooki Olaitoriani o Samuel oleng.

Nejoki iltung'ana pooki Samuel, “Toomonoki isinkan linono to Laitoriani Enkai ino, pee mikiye iyiook; amu kinkilikuanakita ate ing'ok o ena suujisho amu kitopona iyiook ing'ok ang tena torroni, kinkilikuanakita ate olaiguanani.”
Nejoki Samuel iltung'ana, “Emiureishoyu; itaasa intae ena torroni pooki, ore eyia emimbelekenya intae aany isujusuju Olaitoriani, kake esiaayia Olaitoriani too ltauja linyi pooki;
nimimbelekenyanya aasujaa intokiting e pesho nemeretisho nemeitajeusho, amu ine pesho.
Amu meiturraa Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, te nkaraki enkarna enye kitok, amu eitisipa Olaitoriani pee eitaa intae iltung'ana lenyena.
Ore ake anaa te nanu, metalakuana te nanu malo ake naas eng'oki to Laitoriani te mpalata napal aomonoki intae naa kaiteng'en nanu intae te nkoitoi sidai naitoriori.
Entureita ake Olaitoriani nisiaayiayia te sipata to ltau linyi pooki; entadamu eneba mbaa sapuki naaitaasa ninye intae.
Kake te neton iasiasa ine suujisho, nejutori, intae o laiguanani linyi.”
Keeta apa Saul ilarin esiana pee eiteru aitoreisho; neitore ninye Israel ilarin ooata esiana.

Negelu Saul iltung'ana inkalifuni uni le Israel; ore inkalifuni are netii te nebo Saul te Mikmash te ina kop oo ldoinyo e Betel, ore enkalifu nabo netii te nebo Yonatan te Gibea e Benchamen; ore ilkulikae tung'ana nerriny ang, pooki tung'ani ake nelo olng'obor lenye.
Nemir Yonatan oltim loo Lfilisti apa otii Geba; nening Ilfilisti ina. Neosh Saul emowuo te nkop pooki; ejo, Nchoo Lbrania metoning'o.
Nening Isiraeli pooki eji nchere etimira Saul enjore oo Lfilisti, o sii etaa Isiraeli ilmang'ati too Lfilisti. Neipoti iltung'ana meetu aaibung'are Saul te Gilgal.

Neiturrurro lfilisti pee earare Israel, ingarrin oo mbartan inkalifuni tomoni uni, o lakedok loo mbartan inkalifuni ile o sikarini ooba anaa osinyai le naiposha te nkumoi; nepuonu aailepu nepik ilng'oborri lenye Mikmash, natii enchoto oloosaen e Beshafen.
Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana le Israel aajo etaa kemiri (amu earitae apa iltung'ana oleng) neisudoo iltung'ana ate too nkapuniaa o too ngumot o too ndapidapo o too nkuraren o too lchorroi,
aashu eim ilang'at e Yordan aapuo e nkop e Gad o Gilead. Neton apa etii Saul Gilgal, nesujaa iltung'ana pooki ninye eikirikira.
Neanyisho ninye inkolong'i naapishana, enkata apa natudung'o Samuel; kake eitu elotu Samuel Gilgal, negira iltung'ana aaidapasha aaing'uaa ninye.
Neaku etejo Saul, “Eyautu ilo asar opejori ene natii, o ilo asar le seriani.” Neitayu ninye olasar opejori.
Ore enaidipie enkitayunoto o lasar opejori, nelotu Samuel; neipang Saul alo anang'are ninye neiroroki ninye.
Nejo Samuel, “Kaa iyie itaasa?” Nejo Saul, “Ore ake pee adol nchere kaaidapashari iltung'ana aaing'uaa nanu, neitu sii ilotu too nkolong'i nikitudung'okinote neiturrurrote sii Lfilisti te Mikmash,
najo nanu, ‘Kaapuonu taata Ilfilisti aadoiki te Gilgal, neton eitu aing'oru omom to Laitoriani’; neaku ataaraka kewan, naitayu olasar opejori.”
Nejoki Samuel Saul, “Itaasa te modai; eitu iyie imbung enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai ino, apa nikintanapa; amu ore taata enaata eitubulayie Olaitoriani enkitoria ino te Israel intarasi.

Kake ore taata mebikoo enkitoria ino; eing'orua Olaitoriani oltung'ani onyor oltau lenye; netegelua ninye Olaitoriani pee eaku olkitok too ltung'ana lenyena, te nkaraki neitu iyie imbung ina nikintanapa Olaitoriani.”
Nedumunye Samuel, neilep te Gilgal alo Gibea e Benchamen. Neiken Saul iltung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye, naa iltung'ana oobaya iip ile.
Ore Saul o Yonatan, olayioni lenye, o lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninche netoni te Geba e Benchamen; kake etuuno Lfilisti ilng'oborri te Mikmash.
Ore lelo ooarisho neipang'u aaing'uaa ilng'oborri loo Lfilisti too lturrurri okuni; neibelekenya olturrur obo aing'or Ofra, alo enkop e Shual;
ore olikae turrur neibelekenya aing'or enchoto e Bet-horon, ore olikae turrur neibelekenya aing'or ilo polosie oing'orita oerata le Sebuim te nkalo o lpurkel.
Nemetumi apa olkunoni hoo obo te nkop pooki e Israel; amu etejo Ilfilisti, “Pee meitobiraki ate Ilbrania ilalema aashu iremeta.”
Kake ore pooki ng'ae loo Siraeli nedoyio alo enetii Ilfilisti pee eii olchempe lenye o osururu, o entolu enye o empanka enye naololo nadung'ieki enkano;
ore apa elaata naa esenti nabo kiti te nkiiyioto oo nchempei o too munton, naa erubata e shekel te nkiiyioto oo ntoluo o te mpikata oo nkeek.
Neaku ore teina olong apa o larrabal nemetumi olalem aashu empere te nkaina e likae tung'ani obo le lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo Saul o Yonatan; kake eeta apa Saul o Yonatan, olayioni lenye.
Neipang oltim loo Lfilisti aapuo empaash e Mikmash.
Nejoki nabo olong Yonatan olayioni le Saul olbarnoti apa onap imasaa enyena o larrabal, “Wou, maape iyiook enetii oltim loo Lfilisti te lido kekun.” Kake eitu ninye eliki menye.
Netonita apa Saul te netaaniki Gibea ti abori olchani otii Migron; ore iltung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye nebaya iip ile,
o Ahija olayioni le Ahitab, ilo alashe le Ikabod olayioni le Finehas, olayioni le Eli, ilo apolosani lo Laitoriani te Shilo eishop enkila dorrop. Neitu eyiolou iltung'ana aajo eshomo Yonatan.
Ore te mpaash teine apa neim Yonatan elo eneti oltim loo Lfilisti netii apa emarti enchoto nabo o emarti te nkae shoto; neji nabo Boses neji enkae Sene.
Ore emarti nabo neitashe te moikuape te dukuya Mikmash ore enkae te kopikop te dukuya Geba.

Nejoki Yonatan ilo barnoti apa onapita imasaa enyena o larrabal, “Wou, maape iyiook enetii oltim le kulo lememurata; keidimayu pee eret Olaitoriani iyiook; amu meetae ae toki naidim aibooi Olaitoriani amitiki eitajeusho too lkumok aashu too lkuti.”
Nejoki ilo onapita imasaa enyena o larrabal ninye, “Taasa anaa eniyieu niaas; ng'ura, atii nanu te nebo iyie, anaa enatiu indamunot inono neijia etiu inaainei.”
Nejo ninye Yonatan, “Ng'ura, eikilang iyiook aapuo enetii ilewa, nikintodol ate ninche.
Ore pee ejoki iyiook, ‘Entaanyisho o maetu iyiook enitii intae;’ nikintashe iyiook aaitirring'a te wueji ang, nimikilep iyiook aapuo enetii ninche.
Kake te nejo ninche, ‘Wootu elepu enikitii,’ nikilep iyiook aapuo; amu eishorua Olaitoriani ninche apik enkaina ang. Neaku ele olmonekie te iyiook.”
Neitoduaaya pokira oaare ate oltim loo Lfilisti; nejo Ilfilisti, “Eng'ura, epuonu Ilbrania aaipang'u too ngumot te nenen apa neisudorie ate.”

Neipotu lelo tung'ana lo ltim Yonatan o ilo anapani loo masaa enyena olarrabal nejo, “Elepu wootu enikitii, naa aikintodol intae entoki.” Nejoki Yonatan ilo anapani lenye, “Ilepu wou tusujuaki amu eishoo ninche Olaitoriani metijing'a atua enkaina e Israel.”
Neked Yonatan ailep too nkaik enyena o too nkejek, nesuju olanapani lenye onap imaasa enyena olarrabal. Nebatata ninche te dukuya Yonatan near ilo anapani ninche metuata te siadi ninye.
Ore lelo meneng'a le dukuya, ooitayutuo Yonatan o ilo anapani lenye, nebaya iltung'ana tikitam te rishata naba anaa olpisiai le eka.
Nejing enkuretisho ilng'oborri o ong'ata o atua iltung'ana; ore enjore o lelo ooarisho neikirikira; neikirikira enkop neaku olkirutoto kitok.
Neing'or ilarripok le Saul te Gibea e Benchamen; naa ng'ura, eidapashari olorora idie o idie.
Nejoki Saul lelo tung'ana ootii te nebo ninye, “Enkenisho eng'urai kaing'ae oshomo tiatua iyiook.” Ore ake pee eidip aaikenisho, ng'ura, metii Yonatan o lanapani lenye loo masaa olarrabal ine.
Nejoki Saul Ahija, “Iyau ene ilo Sanduku le Nkai.” Amu kelo apa ilo Sanduku le Nkai ina kata te nebo iltung'ana le Israel.
Ore egira Saul airorie olapolosani, neponari olodoo too lng'oborri loo Lfilisti oleng oleng; nejoki Saul ilo apolosani, “Tushuko enkaina ino.”
Ore Saul o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye neipirri aapuo olarrabal; naa ng'ura, ore ake olalem lo ltung'ani near olikae, netii apa olmilo kitok oleng.
Ore ina kata Ilbrania apa ootii te nebo Ilfilisti te dukuya ina kata, lelo ooshomo aailep atua ilng'oborri, eibelekenyate aaku te nebo Israeli apa ootii te nebo Saul o Yonatan.
Neijia eikununo, ore iltung'ana pooki le Israel apa ooisudoitie ate teina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim nening nchere eisikita Ilfilisti; nesuju sii ninche te ngolon epuo enjore.
Neaku etokordua Olaitoriani Israel ina olong; ore olarrabal negiroo teidia alo Bes-afen.

Nenyamalu iltung'ana le Israel ina olong; amu einosie Saul iltung'ana olmumai, ejo, “Ediaa ilo tung'ani onya endaa o metaba anaa neaku teipa aitalakua too lmang'ati laainei.” Neaku meetae obo too ltung'ana oishamishama endaa.
Nepuonu iltung'ana pooki atua entim; netii apa enaisho enkop.
Ore ake pee ejing iltung'ana entim, ng'ura, eitong'ita olkenkei le naisho, kake meetae oltung'ani otipika enkaina enkutuk; amu etureita iltung'ana ilo mumai.
Kake eitu ening Yonatan eitanap papaai lenye iltung'ana ilo mumai; neaku eisuroko eng'udi apa natii enkaina, nepik atua lukuny oo naishi nepik enkaina enkutuk; newang'u inkonyek enyena.
Nejo obo loo ltung'ana, Eitanapa papaai lino iltung'ana akurraki to lmumai, ejo, Ediaa ilo tung'ani onya endaa ena olong. Nenaurate iltung'ana.
Nejo Yonatan, eitanyamala papaai enkop; ng'ura ajo etawang'ita inkonyek aainei te nkaraki naishamishama enkiti ena aisho.
Kebaa na keikash tenaa keinosa iltung'ana ena olong nena yarunot oo lmang'ati lenye naaineputua ninche. Amu ore taata earata olalem too Lfilisti neme kitok.
Near ninche Ilfilisti ina olong ebaiki Mikmash o metabaiki Aijalon. Neaku enaurate iltung'ana,
nekuetiki iltung'ana nena tokitin apa naataarutua, neya ninche nkerra o lmong'i o lasho, neyieng te nkop nenya iltung'ana ninche te nebo osarge.
Nejoki ninche Saul, “Ng'ura, easita iltung'ana eng'oki to Laitoriani, aanya inkiri te nebo osarge.” Nejo ninye, “Itaasa te nkaldaroto; embeleleng'u osoit sapuk ene natii nanu.”

Neitoki Saul ajo, “Endapashaki ate atua olorere, nijokiki ninche, ‘Nchoo pooki tung'ani meyau olkiteng lenye aashu enker enye, neyieng ninche tene, nenya; nimiasiasa eng'oki to Laitoriani aanya inkiri te nebo osarge.’ ” Neaku eyaua pooki tung'ani olkiteng lenye te nebo ninye ina kewarie apa, neyieng ninche teine.
Neshetu Saul olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani; naa olperere lo lasar le dukuya oitera Saul ashetaki Olaitoriani.

Neitoki Saul ajo, “Matadoi aapuo aasujaa Ilfilisti nikimbung, nikiya intokitin enye nikiar kewarie ninche o mekenyu; miking'uaa iyiook oltung'ani obo te ninche.” Nejo ninche, “Taasa enaba anaa enidol aa sidai te iyie.” Kake etejo olapolosani, “Maigutu iyiook aanyikaki Enkai tene.”
Neikilikuanishore Saul Enkai, “Amaa, kalo nanu adoyio asujaa Ilfilisti? Amaa inchoru ninche apik atua enkaina e Israel?” Kake eitu ninye ewaliki Enkai ina olong.
Neitoki Saul ajo, “Wootu ene, intae ilarikok pooki loo ltung'ana; entayiolo nidolidolo eneikununye ena ng'oki taata.
Amu ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, ilo oitajeu Israel, hoo tenaa atua Yonatan, olayioni lai etii meeta nchere pee eitu eye ninye.” Kake metii apa oltung'ani tiatua iltung'ana pooki otawalikia ninye.
Neitoki ninye ajoki Israel pooki, “Entijing intae enkalo nabo, ore nanu o Yonatan, olayioni lai, nikijing enkae shoto.” Nejoki iltung'ana Saul, “Taasa ina nidol aa sidai te iyie.”

Neaku etejo Saul, “Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, kainyoo pee eitu iwaliki osinka lino ena olong? Tenaa atua nanu etii ena torroni aashu atua Yonatan, olayioni lai, Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, inchoru Urim; kake tenaa atua iltung'ana linono Israel etii ena torroni, inchoru Tummin.” Neyae Yonatan o Saul, nepok iltung'ana.
Neitoki Saul ajo, “Entoosh enkukuo te rishata nanu o layioni lai Yonatan.” Neyae Yonatan.
Nejoki Saul Yonatan, “Tolikioki nanu ina nitaasa.” Neliki Yonatan ninye, “Aishamishama nanu enkiti aisho te ndukuya e ng'udi apa natii enkaina ai; nele nanu, naa kaye.”
Nejo Saul, “Metaasa Enkai ena te nanu neitulus; meeta nchere pee miye iyie, Yonatan.”

Nejoki iltung'ana Saul, “Keye Yonatan laa ninye oisula te nkisulata sapuk e Israel? Ekelakua ina! Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, meetae ninye olpapita le ndukuya enye odoiki enkop; amu etaasishe ninye te nebo Enkai ena olong.” Neaku eitopuaa iltung'ana Yonatan, metaa eitu eye.
Neilep Saul alo aing'uaa emirata oo lfilisti; nepuo Ilfilisti ewueji enye.

Ore apa pee eya Saul enkiguana te Israel, nearare ninye ilmang'ati lenyena pooki te pooki shoto, etaarare Moab o Ilamoni o le edom o laiguanak le Soba o Lfilisti; naa ore ake eneibelekenyakine neisulu ninye.
Nearisho te mpijan nemir Ilmaleki, nekordu Israel aitung'uaa inkaik e lelo apa ooibung'a ninche.
Ore apa ilayiok le Saul naa Yonatan o Ishfi o Malkishua; ore inkarn oo ntoyie enyena pokira are ninche kuna; eji ina kikau Merab, neji ina kiti Mikal;
neji enkitok e Saul Ahinoam, entito e Ahimaas. Neji olkitok lenye le Njore Abna olayioni le Ner, olenkapu le Saul;
Kish apa menye le Saul, ore Ner menye le Abna naa olayioni apa le Abiel.
Eetae apa olarrabal ogol too Lfilisti too nkolong'i pooki e Saul, naa ore ake pee edol Saul oltung'ani ogol, aashu oltung'ani opi, neitinyikaki ninye kewan enye.
Nejoki Samuel Saul, “Olaitoriani apa laairriwua nanu maatubukoki eilata aput pee iaku olaiguanani te shumata iltung'ana lenyena Isiraeli; ore naa taata toning'o irorei lo Laitoriani.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, ‘Kaitame nanu ina naitaasa Ilamaleki Israel teina naibooitie ninche te nkoitoi, apa eilepu eing'uaa Misiri.
Shomo taata taara Amalek, inyala tukul nena pooki naata ninche; mileku ninche, kake taara metua oltung'ani pooki olee o enkitok, enkerai kiti o enanakita, olkiteng o enker, entames o sikiria.’ ”
Neaku eipoto Saul iltung'ana neiken ninche te Telaim, netii apa iltung'ana oopuo too nkejek inkalifuni iip are, o nkalifuni tomon oo ltung'ana le Yuda.
Nelotu Saul enkanasa oo Lamaleki neirrag arresh to erata.

Nejoki Saul Ilkeni, “Entudumunye, enchom entadoi enchom entung'uai Ilmaleki, mamut ake nanu intae te nebo ninche; amu intodolutua apa intae esupatisho too ltung'ana pooki le Israel apa pee epuonu aailepu aapuku aaing'uaa Misiri.” Neaku etudumunye Ilkeni aapuku tiatua Ilameleki.
Nemir Saul lelo Amaleki ebaiki Hafila o meshomo aabaiki Shur, aa ninye oloo saen le Misiri.
Neibung Agag ilo aiguanani loo Lamaleki eishu, nemut tukul iltung'ana pooki te nepi o lalem.

Kake etelekutua Saul o iltung'ana Agag, o nkerra sidain oleng o lmong'i o lasho o lkuoo le kerra o pooki nara sidai, neitu eyieng ninche amut; ore ina pooki apa nameni naa pesho neidaikie ninche tukul.
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Samuel ejo:
“Airridua nanu pee aitaa Saul olaiguanani; amu eibelekenye ninye ashuko aing'uaa esujata ai, neitu eas inkitanapat aainei.” Netagore apa Samuel neishiraki ninye Olaitoriani enkewarie pooki.
Neinyototo Samuel ayooki pee enang'are Saul tadekenya; netiaakaki apa Samuel, “Eewuo Saul Karmel, neteshetaka kewan esoit nadamunyeki neitoki ashuko, nelo agiroo, nedoyio alo Gilgal.”
Nelotu Samuel enetii Saul, nejoki Saul ninye, “Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani; ataasa nanu enaaitanapa Olaitoriani.”
Neitoki Samuel ajo, “Kainyoo naa ena orui oo nkerra too nkiyiaa aainei, o nkipurrot oo lmong'i naning'ito nanu?”
Nejo Saul, “Eyautua ninche too Lamaleki; amu etelekutua iltung'ana nkerra sidain o lmong'i, pee epolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai; ore inkulie nikitumuta iyiook tukul.”
Neitoki Samuel ajoki Saul, “Tigirayu! Ekaaliki nanu enaatiaaka Olaitoriani ena kewarie.” Nejoki Saul ninye “Tolimu.”
Nejo Samuel, “Ore hoo nira oti too nkonyek inono, aimira iyie endukuya oo loshon le Israel? Kitubukoko iyie Olaitoriani eilata aput aitaa olaiguanani le Israel.
Nikirriwayie iyie Olaitoriani esiaai, nejo, ‘Shomo, indaikie lelo aing'okok, Ilamaleki, niarare ninche o metaba anaa neishunye.’
Kainyoo naa pee eitu ining oltoilo lo Laitoriani? Kainyoo pee ikuetikia nena tokitin nitaarutua, niaas embae torrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani.”
Nejoki Saul Samuel, “Atoning'o oltoilo lo Laitoriani, ashomo nanu esiaai naa ninye aairriwayie Olaitoriani, ayawua Agag olaiguanani le Amalek, natumuta aidaikie Ilmaleki.
Kake eyautua iltung'ana nena tokitin naataarutua, nkerra o lmong'i, nena tokitin sidain apa naatejoki keidaikieki pee epolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ino te Gilgal.”

Nejo Samuel, “Amaa keeta Olaitoriani enchipai sapuk too lasarri oopejori o nkishoorot, anaa te nening'i oltoilo lo Laitoriani? Ng'ura aisidai ening'unoto alang olasar, o enkinining'oto alang ilmeregeshi oopir.

Amu etiu empaasharoto anaa esakutore, ore engolon e nkong'u naa esuujisho anaa eseremata oo ntokitin neme Enkai. Ore te nkaraki nitanya ororei lo Laitoriani, kitanya sii ninye iyie pee miaku olaiguanani.”
Nejoki Saul Samuel, “Ataasa nanu eng'oki; amu atigila nanu enkitanapata o Laitoriani o rorei linono, amu aturia nanu iltung'ana naning oltoilo lenye.
Ore naa taata, aatoomono nanu, tapalikiaki eng'oki ai, nirrinyo te nebo nanu, pee atum nanu ateserema Olaitoriani.”
Nejoki Samuel Saul, “Marrinyo nanu te nebo o iyie; amu itanya iyie ororei lo Laitoriani, nikitanya iyie Olaitoriani pee miaku olaiguanani te Israel.”
Ore eshuko Samuel alo aing'uaa, neibung Saul olcholoi lo lkila lenye, nepolosa.
Nejoki Samuel ninye, “Etopolosayie Olaitoriani enkitoria e Israel te iyie ena olong, neishoo ninye olelatia ino, laa ninye osupat likilang iyie.
Ore sii Ilo ora Enkitoo e Israel nemelejisho aashu eirridu; amu mme oltung'ani ninye, metaa keirridu.”
Nejo ninye, “Ataasa nanu eng'oki; ore eyia; iyanyitaki taata te dukuya ilpayiani loo ltung'ana laainei o te dukuya Israel, nirrinyo te nebo nanu, pee atum nanu ateserema Olaitoriani Enkai ino.”
Nerrinyo Samuel asuj Saul; neserem Saul Olaitoriani.
Neitoki Samuel ajo, “Iyau ene natii nanu Agag, ilo aiguanani loo Lamaleki.” Nelotu Agag enetii ninye eshipa. Nejo Agag, “Kesipa etulusoyie emion e keeya.”
Nejo Samuel, “Ore anaa enatooruo olalem lino inkituaak inkera, keaku sii ninye taata ng'utunyi enemeeta enkerai tiatua inkituaak.” Nedung Samuel Agag aitaa indung'ot te dukuya Olaitoriani te Gilgal.
Neitoki Samuel alo Rama; nelo Saul enkaji enye te Gibea e Saul.
Neitu ae kata eitoki Samuel adol Saul o metabau enkolong e keeya enye, kake eishiraka Samuel Saul. Neinosu Olaitoriani pee eitaa Saul olaiguanani le Israel.

Nejoki Olaitoriani Samuel, “Inchiraki kenya Saul o anu, idolita ajo atanya nanu ninye pee meitoki aaku olaiguanani te Israel? Imputa ina mowuo eilata nilo; kaairriwaa nanu iyie enetii Yese, ilo Betlehemi, amu aing'uraka nanu kewan ai olaiguanani tiatua ilayiok lenyena.”
Nejo Samuel, “Kaji nanu aiko te nalo? Te nening Saul ina naa kaar nanu matua.” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Iwa enkashe te nebo iyie nijo, ‘Aewuo pee apolosaki Olaitoriani olasar.’
Nintoomon Yese meeu olasar, naa kaaitadol eniaas; nibukoki iyie eilata aput ilo laaipotoki enkarna enye.”
Neas Samuel ina naitanapa Olaitoriani, nelotu Betlehem. Nepuonu ilpayiani le nkanasa eikirikira aanang'are ninye nejo, “Ilotu iyie te seriani?”
Nejo ninye, “Te seriani; aewuo nanu apolosaki Olaitoriani; entisinya ate, nipuonunu te nebo nanu olasar.” Neitisiny ninye Yese o layiok lenyena, neitoomon ninche to lasar.
Ore pee ebau ninche, neing'or ninye Eliab, nedamu ajo, “Esipa etii ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput dukuya.”

Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani Samuel, “Ming'or enaikununo ninye aashu enkadoro enye o lkitashei lenye, amu atanya nanu ninye; amu meing'or Olaitoriani anaa enaing'or oltung'ani, keing'or oltung'ani enaikununo oriong, kake oltau eing'or Olaitoriani.”
Neitoki Yese aipot Abinadab, neisho ninye metogiroi te dukuya Samuel. Nejo ninye, “Eitu sii egelu Olaitoriani ele.”
Neitoki Yese aisho Shamas metogiroi. Nejo ninye, “Eitu sii egelu Olaitoriani ele.”
Neisho Yese ilayiok lenyena pokira oopishana metogiroi te dukuya Samuel. Nejoki Samuel Yese, “Eitu egelu Olaitoriani kulo.”

Nejoki Samuel Yese, “Ketii ilayiok linono pooki ene?” Nejo ninye, “Etiooyo ilo oti, kake etii ninye ntare.” Nejoki Samuel Yese, “Irriwai olkilikuai metorikuni ninye; amu mikitoni iyiook o metaba anaa nelotu ninye ene.”
Neirriwaa ninye olkilikuai, nerikuni ninye aaitijing'u. Naa kenyokie apa ninye newang inkonyek enyena, neikishiaan. Nejo Olaitoriani, “Tudumunye, tubukoki ninye eilata; amu ninye ele.”

Neya Samuel emowuo e ilata nebukoki Daudi eilata aput te mpolos oo lalashera lenyena; nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani te ngolon shumata Daudi ebaiki ina olong neito dukuya. Nedumunye Samuel nelo Rama.
Nelo Enkiyang'et e Nkai aing'uaa Saul, nelotu enkiyang'et torrono naing'uaa Olaitoriani aitanyamal neisomit ninye.
Nejoki isinkan lenyena Saul, “Kiyiolo taata aajo, kintanyamalita iyie enkiyang'et torrono naing'uaa Enkai.

Inchoo taata olkitok lang eitanap isinkan linono ootii dukuya iyie, pee eing'oru oltung'ani oyiolo atoosho enkawuo oo sinkolioitin; ore ake pee eitoki atii shumata iyie enkiyang'et torrono naing'uaa Enkai, nerany ninye teina auo oo sinkolioitin, naa inchiu iyie.”
Neaku etiaaka Saul isinkan lenyena, “Entorikokoki nanu oltung'ani oyiolo ataranya oleng, nirikuku ninye ene natii.”

Newal obo loo lbarnot ajo, “Ng'ura, atoduaa nanu olayioni le Yese le Betlehem, laa kaarriyia te ranyare, oltung'ani opi, naa oltung'ani lo larrabal, arriyia te nkiroroto naa oltung'ani le nkishaa sidai; netii Olaitoriani te nebo ninye.”
Neaku eirriwayie Saul ilkiliku enetii Yese nejo, “Irriwakaki nanu Daudi, olayioni lino, laa ninye otii intare.”
Neitayu Yese olkurrarru onap imukateni, olbene lo lchoni le naisho, o lkuoo le kine, neirriwaa ninche te Daudi, olayioni lenye, airriwaki Saul.
Nelotu Daudi enetii Saul, nejing enkisiaayiare enye. Nenyorru Saul ninye oleng; neaku ninye olanapani lenye loo masaa o larrabal.
Neirriwaki Saul olkilikuai Yese, ejo, “Inchoo Daudi eton te nkisiaayiare ai, amu enoto ninye omom too nkonyek aainei.”

Naa ore ake pee elotu enkiyang'et torrono naing'uaa Enkai shumata Saul, nedumu Daudi enkawuo oo sinkolioitin neosh te nkaina enye; neaku eitagoloki apa Saul, nesupatu, neing'uaa ninye ina kiyang'et torrono.
Neiturrur apa Ilfilisti ilororani lenye le njore te nkaraki olarrabal. Neiturrurrote apa ninche te Soko natii Yuda, nepik ilng'oborri erishata e Soko o Aseka, te Efes-damim.
Ore Saul o iltung'ana le Israel neiturrurrote, nepik ilng'oborri oerata le Ela, neluaa too lkererin lo larrabal pee earare Ilfilisti.
Neitashe Ilfilisti te nchumata oldoinyo te nkalo nabo, neitashe Isiraeli te nchumata oldoinyo te nkae shoto, etii oerata erishata ninche.
Neipang'u apuku too lng'oborri loo Lfilisti oloing'oni oji Goliat, le Gas, laa ore enkadoro enye negiroo ntemat e nkaina ile,
neeta apa ninye enkopiyia o suyai neishopito enkila o lgoo o suyai e shekeli inkalifuni imiet.
Neeta apa inkitushureta o suyai too nkejek enyena. Ore eremet o suyai neika te rishata oo ronyi lenyena.
Neba enchata e remet enye anaa enauner ore esipil e ina remet enye naa irratilini tomon o imiet; ore ilo onap elong'o enye nelo te dukuya ninye.

Neitashe ninye nebuaaki enjore oo Siraeli ejo, “Kainyoo pee impang'utua intae aapuonu aataaniki olarrabal? Ae mara nanu Olfilisti, nirara intae isinkan le Saul? Entegelaki ate oltung'ani, ninchosho ninye edou alotu ene natii.
Te naidim ninye ataarare nanu naar nanu matua, nikiaku iyiook isinkan linyi; kake te naisulu nanu te ninye naar ninye metua, niakuku intae isinkan lang, nisiaayiayia iyiook.”
Nejo ilo Filisti, “Atamoro nanu iltimito le njore e Israel ena olong; enchooki nanu oltung'ani pee kitum aatarata te nebo.”
Ore ake pee ening Saul o Siraeli pooki kulo omon lo Lfilisti neing'aeng'ae ninche neirut oleng.
Ore apa Daudi naa olayioni le Yese lo Lframiti le Betlehem te Yuda, neeta apa ilayiok isiet. Ore apa too nkolong'i e Saul netamorua ilo tung'ani oleng neaku oloo larin kumok.
Ore lelo ayiok okuni botoro le Yese netusuja apa Saul aapuo enjore; ore inkarn e lelo ayiok lenyena ooshomo enjore naa Eliab ilo kikau, ore olosujita ninye naa Abinadab, ore oliokuni naa Shama.
Daudi apa oloti te pooki; ore lelo okuni botoro netusuja Saul,
kake eshomo apa, Daudi ailoiki enetii Saul o Betlehem alo airrita intare e menye.
Too nkolong'i artam apa eewuo ilo Filisti dukuya neitashe te nkitashoto enye, tadekenya o teipa.
Nejoki Yese Daudi olayioni lenye, “Iyaki ilalashera linono ena efa enkano napejo, o kuna mukateni tomon, ninap aitasiooyo aya ilng'oborri enetii ilalashera linono;
niyaki sii kulo belat tomon le ng'orno naitoyioki olkitok le nkalifu enye. Toduaa eneikununo ilalashera linono, nishoru iyie entoki naitodolu ajo itoduaa ninche naa aisupati.”
Ore apa Saul o ninche o ltung'ana pooki le Israel, netii atua oerata le Ela, eara o lelo Filisti.

Neinyototo Daudi ayooki tadekenya, neing'uaa inkerra te nebo olaing'urani, neya endaa, nelo anaa enaitanapa Yese ninye; nelotu lelo ng'oborri egira olorora alo dukuya too lkererin lo larrabal te wueji niarareki; ebuaku to lkiyioi lo larrabal.
Ore Isiraeli o Lfilisti nenyikakino pee eara, enjore earare njore.
Neing'ueiki Daudi intokitin olaing'urani loo lolan, nekwet alo enetii iltimito, nelo neiroroki ilalashera lenyena.
Ore eirorie ninche, nedol ilo oing'oni ilo Filisti le Gas, oji Goliat neilepu apuku tiatua iltimito loo Lfilisti; neiro lelo rorei anaa apa. Nening Daudi ninye.
Ore iltung'ana pooki le Israel, pee edol ilo tung'ani, neisik aailany ninye, neirut ninche oleng.

Nejo iltung'ana le Israel, “Itoduaa iyie ele tung'ani oilepua? Kesipa eewuo ninye ailepu pee emor Israel; ore oltung'ani oar ninye metua, neitaa ninye olaiguanani karsis te nkarsisisho kitok, neisho ninye entito enye neitaa enkaji e papaai lenye metalakunoyu te Israel.”

Nejoki Daudi lelo tung'ana apa ooitashe te mbata enye, “Kaa eitaasi oltung'ani oar ele Filisti metua, neitayu emoroto te Israel? Amu kaing'ae ninye ele Filisti lememurata, metaa keidim atamoro injoreitin e Nkai naishu?”
Newaliki ninye iltung'ana neijia nchere, “Ina eitaasi oltung'ani oar ninye metua.”

Nening Eliab, ilo alashe lenye botor, eirorie iltung'ana; neyupuyup engoro e Eliab te nkaraki Daudi, nejo ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee itadouo ene? Naa kaing'ae itung'ueikia nekua kuti kerra naatii ong'ata? Kayiolo nanu enkitokoos ino, o entorroni o ltau lino; amu iewuo adou aing'or olarrabal.”
Nejo Daudi, “Kaa taata ataasa? Aime ororei ake?”
Neibelekenya aing'uaa ninye alo enetii olikae, neiro teina oitoi; neitoki iltung'ana aawaliki ninye anaa duoo ake te dukuya.
Ore ake pee ening'i lelo rorei ooiroro Daudi, neigil ninche aalimu te dukuya Saul; neirriwaa ninye olkilikuai aipotu ninye.
Nejoki Daudi Saul, “Emincho oltung'ani hoo obo epalari te nkaraki ninye; kelo osinka lino aarare ele Filisti.”
Nejoki Saul Daudi, “Mindim iyie ashomo ataarare ele Filisti; amu ira iyie olbarnoti ake, naa oltung'ani apa ninye lo larrabal ebaiki kitisho enye.”
Kake etiaaka Daudi Saul, “Keing'or apa osinka lino inkerra e papaai lenye; naa tenelotu olng'atuny aashu olng'arurumi, neya olkuoo tiatua eluaata,
nalo nanu asujaa naar ninye naitayu nanu olkuoo te nkutuk enye; naa te nelo naadumakino nanu, naibung olmunyei lenye naar metua.
Etaara osinka lino metuata ilng'atunyo o lng'arurum; ore ele Filisti lememurata naa ketiu anaa obo te ninche, amu etamoro injoreitin e Nkai naishu.”
Nejo Daudi, “Ore ilo Aitoriani laaitajeuo nanu too loisotok lo lng'atuny o te nkaina o lng'arurumi naa kaaitajeu te nkaina ele Filisti.” Nejoki Saul Daudi, “Shomo, neaku Olaitoriani te nebo iyie.”
Neishopoki Saul Daudi iruparen enyena e njore; nepik enkopiyia o suyai e ndukuya enye, neishopoki enkila o lgoo o larrabal.
Nerreten Daudi olalem lenye ti oriong enkila enye o larrabal, nejo “Maidim nanu ashomo te kuna; amu eitu nanu amoku ninche.” Neitayu Daudi ninche airragie.
Neya ninye eng'udi enye te nkaina, negelu isoito imiet oosipa to lkeju, nepik atua ilo bene lenye lo lairritani loo ntare, netii enkopito enye enkaina, nelo anyikaki ilo Filisti.
Nelotu ilo Filisti anyikaki Daudi, etii ilo anapani le long'o enye dukuya ninye.
Ore ake pee eing'or ilo Filisti, nedol Daudi; nemenaa ninye, amu olbarnoti apa ninye onyokie neikishiaan te nking'urata.
Nejoki ilo Filisti Daudi, “Kara nanu oldia, pee ilotu enatii too ng'usidin?” Nedek ilo Filisti Daudi too nkaitin enyena.
Nejoki ilo Filisti Daudi, “Wou enatii, naa kaisho nanu inkiri o sesen lino imotonyi o loing'ang'e o ng'uesi e ong'ata.”

Neitoki Daudi ajoki ilo Filisti, “Ilotu iyie enatii to lalem o te mpere, o te nkae pere naado; kake alotu nanu enitii iyie te nkarna o Laitoriani loo lororani, ina Ai oo njoreitin e Israel, naa ninye iyie itamoro.

Ore ena olong aikipik iyie Olaitoriani atua enkaina ai, naar abatat, nadung'oo endukuya ino, naisho nanu impopoki oo lororani ootuata loo Lfilisti ena olong imotonyi o loing'ang'e o ilowuarak le ntim pee etum enkop pooki atayiolo nchere etii Enkai atua Israel,
neyiolou sii ele turrur pooki nchere keitajeu Olaitoriani neme to lalem o te remet; amu olo Laitoriani ele arrabal naa eikinchoru ninye apik iyie atua enkaina ang.”
Ore ake pee edumunye ilo Filisti nelotu pee enang'are Daudi, nekwet Daudi asiooyo alo ilo kereri lo larrabal anang'are ilo Filisti.

Nepik Daudi enkaina atua olbene lenye neitayu osoit, nepik enkopito, neyuk ninye, nenang ilo Filisti olpura le nkomom enye; neimis ilo soit tiatua olpura le nkomom enye, nebatata ninye te nkomom enye aosh enkop.
Neaku eisula Daudi ilo Filisti te nkopito o to soit, neosh ilo Filisti, near ninye metua; nemetii apa olalem enkaina e Daudi.

Nekwet Daudi neitashe te nchumata e ilo Filisti, neya olalem lenye, neyietu ashurtu te nchashur enye, near ninye metua, nedung'orie endukuya enye. Ore ake pee edol Ilfilisti aajo etua oloing'oni lenye neisik.
Ore iltung'ana le Israel o Yuda nedumunye te mbuakunoto nesuj Ilfilisti o metabai Gas o nchomito e Ekron neaku ore lelo Filisti loo lbaa nebatata ebaiki She-ara-im o metabaiki Gas o Ekron.
Nepuonu Israeli aashukunye te mirata oo Lfilisti neya intokitin too lng'oborri lenye.
Neyau Daudi endukuya eilo Filisti Yerusalem, kake etipika imasaa enyena o larrabal atua olngobor lenye.
Ore ake pee edol Saul Daudi elo aarare ilo Filisti, nejoki ninye Abna, olkitok le njore, “Abna, kole ng'ae ele barnoti?” Nejo Abna, “Anaa enaishu oltau lino, olaiguanani, maaidim nanu atolimu.”
Nejo olaiguanani, “Inkilikuanu ajo kole ng'ae ele ayioni.”
Ore eshukunye Daudi aing'uaa enkirragata e ilo Filisti, neya Abna ninye, neyau ninye dukuya Saul eeta elukunya e ilo Filisti te nkaina enye.
Nejoki Saul ninye, “Ira iyie ole ng'ae, lo barnoti?” Newal Daudi ajo, “Kara nanu olo sinka lino Yese le Betlehem.”
Ore ake pee eidip airorie Saul, neibung'a oltau le Yonatan oltau le Daudi, nenyorru Yonatan ninye anaa oltau lenye kewan.
Nerik Saul ninye ina olong, nemeisho ninye metushukoyu alo enkang enye.
Nenya Yonatan olmumai lo sotua te nebo Daudi, te nkaraki apa nanyor ninye anaa oltau lenye kewan.
Neitayu Yonatan olkila apa oishopito neisho Daudi, o masaa enyena, o lalem lenye o enkawuo o enkeene e mpolos enye.

Naa ore ake te neipang Daudi alo eneba anaa eneirriwayie Saul nedupoyu; neaku etipika ninye Saul shumata iltung'ana le njore. Naa aisidai apa ina too nkonyek oo ltung'ana pooki o too nkonyek sii oo sinkan le Saul.

Ore egira aapuonu ang, ina kata pee eshukunye Daudi eing'uaa esesekuanata e ilo Filisti, neipang'u inkituaak aapuonu too nkanas pooki e Israel, eranyisho neiguran pee enang'are olaiguanani Saul, too ntampurini o too sinkolioitin le ng'ida o too nkinantani oo sinkolioitin.
Neranyakino inkituaak maate neshipakino ejo, “Etasesekuana Saul inkalifuni enyena, nesesekuan Daudi inkalifuni tomon enyena.”

Negoro Saul oleng, ore ena kiroroto neitu eitiship ninye; nejo ninye, “Eterrepakita ninche Daudi inkalifuni tomon, ore nanu naaterrepakita inkalifuni; kainyoo ae naitoki ninye aata meteleku enkitoria?”
Neduaaki Saul Daudi olom ebaiki ina olong neito dukuya.

Ore pee ekenyu nelotu enkiyang'et torrono naing'uaa Enkai nejing atua Saul, neiyiang'iyiang ninye tiatua enkaji enye, eoshito Daudi enkawuo oo sinkolioitin, anaa ake. Neeta apa Saul empere te nkaina enye;
neng'oroo Saul empere amu etejo ninye, “Kapudaki nanu Daudi esuntai.” Kake etapaashare Daudi ninye katitin are.
Keure apa Saul Daudi, amu etii Olaitoriani te nebo ninye kake etung'uayie Saul.
Neaku eiwuang'ie Saul ninye teine netii, neitaa ninye olkitok le nkalifu neipang alo nelo dukuya iltung'ana.
Netum Daudi dupoto te nena pooki apa naataasa; amu etii Olaitoriani te nebo ninye.
Ore ake pee edol Saul nchere enoto ninye dupoto sapuk, neureyu ninye.
Kake ore Israel pooki o Yuda pooki naa kenyor apa Daudi amu eshomo apa ninye aipang nejing'u atua te dukuya ninche.

Nejoki Saul Daudi, “Nena entito ai botor Merab; kaaisho nanu iyie pee intaa enkitok; kake tudupayu te nanu niarisho too larrabali lo Laitoriani.” Amu etejo Saul, “Mincho enkaina ai eaku shumata ninye, kake nchoo enkaina oo Lfilisti eaku shumata ninye.”
Nejoki Daudi Saul, “Kara nanu ng'ae, naa kainyoo olmarei lai, olmarei le papaai te Israel, metaa kaaku nanu olaputani lo laiguanani?”
Kake te nkata apa nataa keishori Merab, entito e Saul, Daudi, neishori ninye Adriel ilo Meholati meitaa enkitok.
Nenyor apa entito e Saul, Mikal, Daudi; neliki ninche Saul, neitiship ina toki ninye.
Nejo Saul, “Intasho maishoo nanu ninye, pee etum ataa orreshet te ninye, pee etum sii enkaina oo Lfilisti ataarare ninye.” Metaa etiaaka Saul Daudi te nkata e are, “Iaku taata iyie olaputani lai.”
Neitanap Saul isinkan lenyena ejo, “Erorie Daudi too nkurrat nijokiki, ‘Aikishipakino iyie olaiguanani, naa aikinyor isinkan lenyena pooki; ore naa taata taa olaputani lo laiguanani.’ ”
Neiro isinkan le Saul lelo rorei too nkiyiaa e Daudi. Nejo Daudi, “Idolidolo intae aa entoki kiti te neaku oltung'ani olaputani lo laiguanani, idolitata aajo ara nanu oltung'ani aiterani lemening'o?”
Nejoki ninye isinkan le Saul, “Inji o nji eiroro Daudi.”

Neitoki Saul ajo, “Entoliki Daudi ijokiki, ‘Meyieu olaiguanani entoki e nkaputi meteleku isuaaten iip oo Lfilisti pee etum aitalaku elap too lmang'ati lo laiguanani.’ ” Naa kejo apa Saul pee eisho Daudi metua te nkaina oo Lfilisti.
Ore ake eliki isinkan lenyena Daudi kulo rorei, neitiship Daudi ina neaku olaputani lo laiguanani. Ore eton eitu eishunye enkata,

nedumunye Daudi nelo, te nebo iltung'ana lenyena, near metuata Ilfilisti iip are; neyau Daudi isuaaten enye, naaishooki apa te siana nalulung'a olaiguanani, pee etum ninye ataa olaputani lo laiguanani. Neisho Saul ninye ina tito enye Mikal meitaa enkitok.
Kake ore ake pee edol Saul neyiolou ajo etii Olaitoriani te nebo Daudi, o nchere kenyor Isiraeli pooki ninye,
neponari Saul aureyu Daudi oleng. Neaku etaa apa Saul olmang'atinta le Daudi anaake.
Neitoki ilkituaak loo Lfilisti aaipang'u aapuonu olarrabal, naa ore ake anaa te nepuonu netum Daudi dupoto sapuk alang isinkan pooki le Saul; neaku yioloti enkarna enye oleng.
Neirorie Saul Yonatan, olayioni lenye o lelo sinkan lenyena pooki, nchere pee ear ninche Daudi metua. Kake ore Yonatan, olayioni le Saul, kenyor apa Daudi oleng.
Nejoki Yonatan Daudi, “Ore Saul, papaai lai, naa aiking'oru iyie aar tua; neaku tagolie kewan tadekenya, totona te wueji misil isudoi kewan;
naa kalo nanu aipang aitashe atashare papaai lai teine wueji nitii, nairorie nanu papaai lai imbaa inono; naa te nayiolou nanu pooki toki naaliki iyie.”

Neiro Yonatan imbaa sidain tialo Daudi te Saul, papaai lenye, nejoki ninye, “Mincho olaiguanani eas eng'oki tialo osinka lenye Daudi; amu eitu ninye eas eng'oki tialo iyie, amu ore inkiaasin enyena naa ine nkisiaayiare sidain apa te iyie;

amu etipika ninye enkishui enye inkaik enyena nesesekuan ninye ilo Filisti, neyaki Olaitoriani Israel pooki emirata kitok. Itoduaa apa iyie, ning'idayu; kainyoo naa pee ias eng'oki to sarge lemeeta entioto aar Daudi metua meeta emporeet?”
Nening Saul oltoilo le Yonatan; nenya Saul olmumai ajo, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, meari ninye metua.”
Neipotu Yonatan Daudi, neitodol Yonatan ninye kuna baa pooki. Neriku Yonatan Daudi enetii Saul, netii apa ninye ine netii ninye anaa apa te dukuya.
Neitoki olarrabal apuku; neipang Daudi alo nearare Ilfilisti, neitayu esesekuanare sapuk tiatua ninche, neisik te dukuya ninye.
Neitoki enkiyang'et torrono naing'uaa Olaitoriani alotu shumata Saul, etonita tiatua enkaji enye eeta empere enye te nkaina enye; neoshito Daudi enkawuo oo sinkolioitin.
Nejo Saul apudaki Daudi esuntai te mpere; kake etapaashare Daudi Saul, neibitaki empere esuntai. Neisik Daudi, neimisho.

Ore ina kewarie neirriwaa Saul iltungana enkaji e Daudi metaleeno ninye, pee etum ataara ninye metua tadekenya. Kake etiaaka ninye Mikal, enkitok e Daudi, “Ti nimintajeu enkishui ino ena kewarie, ore taisere niye.”
Neaku eitadoyie Mikal Daudi aimie elusie nelo ninye aisik neimisho.
Neya Mikal enkitanyaanyukoto neirragie ninye te ndapash nepik entoki nairishunyeki endukuya oo lpapit loo ntare elukunya enye, neimulumul too nkarash.
Ore ake pee eirriwaa Saul ilkiliku meshomo aaya Daudi, nejo ninye, “Kemuoi ninye.”
Neirriwaa Saul ilkiliku meshomo aadol Daudi, ejo, “Eyakaki nanu tiatua endapash, pee atum nanu ataara ninye metua.”
Ore ake pee ejing'u lelo kipaareta, nedol etii ina kitanyaanyukoto endapash, o ina toki nairishunyeki endukuya oo lpapit loo nkineji te ndukuya enye.
Nejoki Saul Mikal “Kainyoo pee kiteleja aiko nji, nincho olmang'atinta lai meshomo neaku etajeuo ninye?” Newaliki Mikal Saul, “Aatiaaka ninye nanu, ‘Intasho mashomo; kainyoo pee aar nanu iyie tua?’ ”
Neisik Daudi neimisho nelotu apa ninye enetii Samuel te Rama, neliki nena pooki naaitaasa Saul ninye. Ore ninye o Samuel nepuo aabik te Naios.
Netiaakaki apa Saul, “Ng'ura, etii Daudi Naios te Rama.”

Neitoki Saul airriwaa ilkiliku meyau Daudi; ore ake pee edol ninche olturrur loo loibonok le Nkai eibonisho o Samuel aa olarikoni te shumata ninche, nelotu Enkiyang'et e Nkai shumata lelo kipaareta le Saul, neibonisho sii ninche.
Ore ake pee elikini Saul, neirriwaa ninye kulikae kipaareta, neibonisho sii ninche. Neitoki Saul airriwaa ilkiliku te nkata e uni, neibonisho ake sii ninche.
Neitoki ninye makewan alo Rama, nelotu ilo shorro sapuk apa otii Seku; neikilikuanu ajo, “Kaji etii Samuel o Daudi?” Nejo obo, “Ng'ura, etii ninche Naios te Rama.”
Nelo ninye teine Naios te Rama; nelotu Enkiyang'et e Nkai shumata ninye, ore eloito neibonisho ninye, o metaba anaa nelotu ninye Naios e Rama.
Neshurtu sii ninye inkilani enyena, neibonisho sii ninye te dukuya Samuel, neirrag meeta enkila ina olong pooki o ina kewarie pooki. Neaku etejoki, “Ketii sii ninye Saul atua iloibonok le Nkai?”
Neitoki Daudi aisik aing'uaa Naios te Rama, nelotu ajoki Yonatan, “Kainyoo nanu ataasa? Kainyoo entorroni ai? Naa kainyoo eng'oki ai te dukuya papaai lino, metaa keing'oru ninye enkishui ai?”
Nejoki Yonatan ninye, “Metalakuana ina! Miye iyie. Ng'ura, meas papaai toki aa kitok o aa kiti eitu aaimakinye nanu; naa kainyoo naa pee aamikinye nanu papaai ena? Mme neijia etiu.”

Kake etawalikia Daudi ajoki, “Keyiolo papaai lino oleng nchere anoto nanu omom too nkonyek inono; nejo ninye, ‘Mincho Yonatan eyiolou ena, pee megoro ake.’ Kake kesipa, anaa enaishu Olaitoriani o anaa enaishu oltau lino, eroruata nabo ake natii erishata nanu o keeya.”
Neitoki Yonatan ajoki Daudi, “Ore pooki nijo, naaitaas nanu iyie.”

Nejoki Daudi Yonatan, “Ng'ura, olapa ng'ejuk taisere, nemajoyio nanu eitu aton te misa te nebo olaiguanani, kake nchooki nanu mashomo, pee atum aisudoi kewan ti ong'ata o metabau enkolong e uni teipa.
Te naalau nanu papaai lino tukul, nijoki, ‘Etasaishe Daudi aomonu pee ekuet alo Betlehem, enkanasa enye; amu etii ine olasar anaake to lari to lmarei pooki.’
Te nejo ninye, ‘Aisidai!’ Nesidanu to sinka lino; kake te negoro ninye, nitum atayiolo ajo eitobirita ninye entorroni.
Neaku intaasa osinka lino te supatisho, amu iyaua osinka lino atua olmumai osinya lo sotua te nebo iyie. Kake te netii entorroni atua nanu, taaraki iyie nanu; amu kainyoo paa papaai lino kiyaki?”
Nejo Yonatan, “Mikitalama kuna! Amaa naaji tenaa kayiolo nchere eitobirita papaai entorroni pee elotu shumata iyie, aimaaliki nanu iyie?”
Neitoki Daudi ajoki Yonatan, “Kaing'ae laaliki nanu tenaa eikiwaliki papaai lino te nkisikong'ota?”
Nejoki Yonatan Daudi, “Wou, maipang'a aapuo ong'ata.” Neaku eipang'a pokira oaare aapuo ong'ata.

Nejoki Yonatan Daudi, “Metaa Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli shakeni! Te naimakinye nanu papaai lai tena rishata taisere, aashu te nkolong e uni, ng'ura, tenaa esidai ninye tialo iyie, aimairriu nanu olkilikuai pee aaitayiolo iyie.

Kake te nelo neaku keitiship papaai lai pee kintaas iyie entorrono, metaasa sii Olaitoriani ina te Yonatan, neitulusoo sii te nemaaitayiolo nanu, areu iyie shomo, pee itum ashomo te seriani. Metaa Olaitoriani te nebo iyie, anaa enataa te nebo o papaai lai.
Te neton nanu aishu, intoduaaki nanu enyorrata nemeibelekenya o Laitoriani, pee maye nanu;
nimidung esupatisho ino aitung'uaa enkaji ai intarasi. Te neiwuang'ie Olaitoriani adung'oo pooki ng'ae loo lmang'ati le Daudi aiwuang'ie ti oriong e nkop,
mincho enkarna e Yonatan edung'ori aaitung'uaa enkaji e Daudi. Naa meitalaku Olaitoriani elap too lmang'ati le Daudi.”
Neitoki Yonatan ainosie Daudi olmumai aigil tialo enyorrata enye te ninye; amu kenyor apa ninye anaa enanyor oltau lenye.
Neitoki Yonatan ajoki ninye, “Ore taisere naa olapa ng'ejuk; naa eikilai iyie, te nkaraki nemetii toki olorika lino.
Ore te nkolong e uni naa eikilai iyie oleng; neaku shomo ewueji apa nisudoriyie kewan aa torrok mbaa, niton te mbata oo soito oosoto.
Naa kang'oroo nanu mbaa uni embata enye anaa duoo kaata entoki nang'orito.

Naa ng'ura, kairriu nanu enkerai, ajoki, ‘Shomo, ing'oru mbaa.’ Ore ake pee ajoki enkerai, ‘Ng'ura ena shoto ino etii mbaa, iyau ninche’; nilotu iyie, amu, ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, keserian te iyie nemetii embatisho.
Kake te najoki nanu ilo barnoti, ‘Ng'ura etii mbaa teidia alo iyie;’ shomo, amu Olaitoriani likirriwayie iyie shomo.
Ore tialo ina bae nikiimakitia nanu o iyie, ng'ura, etii Olaitoriani erishata iyie o nanu intarasi.”
Neaku eisudoyie Daudi kewan tiatua enkurma; ore ake pee elotu olapa ng'ejuk, neton olaiguanani anya endaa.
Neton olaiguanani to lorika lenye, anaa too nkulie katitin, to lorika otii embata e suntai; neton Yonatan aipirakinore, neton Abna atashare Saul kake keisiu ewueji e Daudi.
Ore eyia eitu ejo Saul ae ina olong; amu etejo ninye, “Keeta ake enaanoto ninye; mesinya ninye, kesipa mesinya ninye.”
Kake ore te nkolong e are, taisere e tulusoyie olapa ng'ejuk, neisiu ake ewueji e Daudi. Nejoki Saul Yonatan, olayioni lenye, “Kainyoo pee eitu elotu olayioni le Yese anya endaa, ng'ole aashu taata?”
Newaliki Yonatan Saul ajoki, “Aatasayia nanu Daudi aomonu pee elo Betlehem;

etejo ninye, ‘nchooki nanu mashomo; amu eeta olmarei lang olasar tiatua enkanasa, naaitanapa nanu olalashe lai pee atii ine. Neaku taata, te nanoto nanu omom too nkonyek inono, nchooki mashomo, pee adol ilalashera laainei.’ Te nkaraki ena eitu ninye elotu emisa o laiguanani.”

Neyupuyup engoro e Saul tialo Yonatan, nejoki ninye Yonatan “Iyie olayioni le nkitok modai nemening'isho, aimayiolo nanu ajo itegelua iyie olayioni le Yese te nkurruna ino makewan, o te nkurruna e masipaisho e ng'utunyi?
Amu ore anaa enaishu olayioni le Yese ti oriong enkop, mibul iyie nemebul enkitoria ino. Metaa irriwai olkilikuai niyau ninye enatii, amu kesipa keye ake.”
Neitoki Yonatan awaliki Saul, papaai lenye ajoki, “Kainyoo pee eari ninye metua? Kainyoo etaasa ninye?”
Kake etang'oroyie Saul empere enye ajo ang'or ninye; neaku etayiolo Yonatan nchere enyokita apa papaai lenye ajo aar Daudi metua.
Nedumunye Yonatan aing'uaa emisa te ngoro napi neitu enya endaa te nkolong e are o lapa, amu eishirieki te nkaraki Daudi, te nkaraki naitukurrua papaai lenye ninye.
Ore tadekenya neipang Yonatan alo atua enkurma ewueji netoning'okinote o Daudi, nelo te nebo ninye enkiti ayioni.
Nejoki ninye enkerai enye, “Kueta ing'oru nena baa natang'oroyie nanu.” Ore ekuet enkayioni neng'oroo Yonatan embae teidia alo ninye.
Ore ake elotu enkayioni ewueji netii ina bae natang'oroyie Yonatan, neipot Yonatan enkayioni nejoki,
“Aimetii embae teidia alo iyie?” Neipot Yonatan enkayioni, “Tasiooi, isarisara, miton.” Neaku etasotuo enkayioni e Yonatan mbaa, nelotu enetii olkitok lenye.
Kake meyiolo apa ina ayioni ae toki; Yonatan ake o Daudi ooyiolo ina bae.
Neisho Yonatan imasaa enyena olarrabal ina ayioni nejoki ninye, “Shomo iwa ninche enkanasa.”

Ore eidipa enkayioni ashomo nedumunye Daudi te mbata oo soito oorupa, nebatata ninye te nkomom enye abaiki enkop, neirrugo katitin uni; neng'ututa maate, neishirakino maate, o metaba anaa neyagaa Daudi.

Neitoki Yonatan ajoki Daudi, “Shomo te seriani, amu ore anaa enikinosa olmumai iyiook pokira te nkarna o Laitoriani, kijo, Olaitoriani otii erishata nanu o iyie, o erishata e ishoi ai o eshoi ino, intarasi.” Nedumunye Daudi ninye nelo; nelo Yonatan ajing enkanasa.
Nelotu Daudi Nob enetii Ahimelek olapolosani; nelotu Ahimelek anang'are Daudi eikirikira, nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo paa iyie openy, nemetii hoo obo te nebo iyie?”

Nejoki Daudi Ahimelek ilo apolosani, “Aairriwayie nanu olaiguanani te mbae naje, naajoki nanu, ‘Mincho ake hoo ng'ae eyiolou ae toki ena bae naa ninye aairriwarie, naa ninye aaitanapa iyie.’ Aata nanu ndung'eta oo lbarnot te wueji neje.
Ore naa, kainyoo iata? Nchooki nanu imukateni imiet, aashu entoki naba anaa enatii ene.”
Newaliki ilo apolosani Daudi ajo, “Maata nanu imukateni e oshi ake tene, kake etii imukateni naasinya, te neitalama ake duoo ninche ilbarnot ate nkituaak.”

Newaliki Daudi ilo apolosani ajo, “Ore te sipata eitalamayioki apa nkituaak te iyiook anaa oshi ake te nalo te nkisiaayiare eisinyat imasaa oo lbarnot, hoo duoo ninye tenaa elototo e oshi ake; kebaa naa taata aa sinyat imasaa enye?”

Neaku eishoo olapolosani ninye emukate nasinya, amu metii apa emukate ine meteleku ake ina mukate nasinya, naa ninche eiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa dukuya o Laitoriani, pee eitapaashikini imukateni naairowua ina olong naawaki.
Netii apa oltung'ani oje loo sinkan le Saul ine ina olong, oikenoyioki te dukuya o Laitoriani; ore apa enkarna enye naa Doeg le Edom, olkitok loo lchekuti le Saul.
Nejoki Daudi Ahimelek, “Amaa aimiaata iyie empere aashu olalem tene? Amu eitu duoo ayau olalem lai aashu empere ai te nebo nanu, te nkaraki naa ore enkisiaayiare o laiguanani neyieu enkisarrisar.”

Nejo olapolosani, “Ore olalem le Goliat ilo Filisti litara apa to oerata le Ela, ng'ura, etii ene eirina te nkarasha ti oriong enkila dorrop; tenaa iya ilo, iwa, amu metii likae kake ele ake.” Nejo Daudi, “Meetae likae laaijo ilo; nchooki nanu.”
Nedumunye Daudi neisik ina olong ailany Saul, nelo enetii Akish olaiguanani le Gas.

Nejoki ninye isinkan le Akish, “Aime Daudi ele olaiguanani le nkop? Keitu ninche eranyakino maate tialo ninye too sinkolioitin ejo: ‘Etasesekuana Saul nkalifuni enyena, Ore Daudi naa nkalifuni tomon enyena?’ ”
Neya Daudi kulo rorei to ltau, neureyu oleng Akish ilo aiguanani le Gas.
Neaku eibelekenya ninye olkuaak lenye te dukuya ninche, neitaakuno ko ltung'ani omoda, too nkaik enyena, nekord mbaoi oo milankoni e kishomi, neisho nkamulak edou aapuo olmunyei lenye.
Nejoki Akish isinkan lenyena, “Eng'ura aajo kemoda ele tung'ani; kainyoo naa pee iyautua intae enatii?
Aimaata nanu iltung'ana oomoda, pee iyautua ele tung'ani metaasa emodaisho te dukuya nanu? Kelotu ele tung'ani atua enkaji ai?”
Nedumunye Daudi teine neisik alo enkapune e Adulam; ore ake pee ening ilalashera lenyena o enkaji e papaai lenye pooki, nedoyio aapuo enetii ninye.
Ore pooki ng'ae oata osina, o pooki ng'ae oata esile, o pooki ng'ae leton emonira neiturrurrukino ninye, neaku ninye olarikoni lenye. Netii apa te nebo ninye iltung'ana oobaya iip ong'uan.
Nelo Daudi teine Mispe e Moab; nejoki ninye olaiguanani le Moab, “Aatoomono nchoo sii ake papaai o yieyio etoni te nebo o iyie, o metaba anaa nayiolou enaas Enkai te nanu.”
Neing'uaa ninye ninche te nebo olaiguanani le Moab, netoni ninche te nebo ninye ina kata pooki etii Daudi enkapune.
Nejoki oloiboni le Nkai Daudi, “Mintoki aton to lnukata, shomo enkop e Yuda.” Neaku etudumunye Daudi nelo atua entim e Heres.

Nening apa Saul nchere enotoki Daudi, o lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye. Netonita apa Saul te Gibea ti abori olchani oji olkuaju te wueji neika, eeta empere enye te nkaina enye neitashe isinkan lenyena pooki aaman ninye.

Nejoki Saul lelo sinkan lenyena oomanita ninye, “Entoning taata, intae ile Benchamen; amaa keisho ole Yese pooki ng'ae te intae inkurman o nkurman oo sabibu, keitaa ninye intae pooki ilkituaak loo nkalifuni o ilkituaak lo maaip,

pee kitarresho intae pooki nanu? Meetae hoo obo laaliki nanu enkata naibung'are olayioni lai olayioni le Yese, meetae obo te intae laaing'urrie nanu aashu aaliki nanu nchere eisisa olayioni lai osinka lai maataara nanu, maatarresho, anaa enatiu ena olong.”
Newal Doeg le Edom, apa oitasho te mbata oo sinkan le Saul ejo, “Atoduaa nanu olayioni le Yese elotu Nob, enetii Ahimelek, olayioni le Ahitab,
neikilikuanishore ninye Olaitoriani te nkaraki ninye, neisho ninye indaiki, neisho ninye olalem le Goliat ilo Filisti.”
Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaa olkilikuai aipotu Ahimelek olapolosani, olayioni le Ahitab, o enkaji e papaai lenye pooki, lelo apolosak apa ootii Nob; nepuonu ninche pooki enetii olaiguanani.
Nejo Saul, “Toning'o taata, olayioni le Ahitab.” Newalu ninye, “Nele nanu, olkitok lai.”

Nejoki Saul ninye, “Kainyoo pee kitarresho nanu, iyie o layioni le Yese, teina ninchoo ninye imukateni o olalem, ninkilikuanishore Enkai te nkaraki ninye, neaku aatudumakine ninye nanu naairrag arresh, anaa enatiu ena olong?”

Newaliki Ahimelek olaiguanani ajo, “Naa kaing'ae tiatua isinkan linono pooki oisiligayu oleng alang Daudi, kaing'ae olaputani lo laiguanani, olkitok oitasheiki lelo likirrip iyie, neyanyiti tiatua enkaji ino?

Ae taata enkata e dukuya naikilikuanishore nanu Enkai te nkaraki ninye? A'a! Mincho olaiguanani eomonu ae toki to sinka lenye aashu te nkaji pooki e papaai lai; amu eitu eyiolou osinka lino ae toki te kuna pooki, te sapuk aashu te nkiti.”
Nejo olaiguanani, “Kesipa, iye ake, Ahimelek, iyie o enkaji e papaai lino.”

Nejoki olaiguanani lelo arripok oomanita ninye, “Embelekenyata entaar ilapolosak lo Laitoriani metuata; amu etii sii enkaina enye te nebo Daudi, neyiolo apa aajo eisika ninye, neitu ninche aaliki nanu.” Kake ore isinkan lo laiguanani nemeidim aatudumu enkaina enye aaiteleiki lelo apolosak lo Laitoriani.

Neitoki olaiguanani ajoki Doeg, “Imbelekenyayu iyie tusulakinoyu ilapolosak.” Neibelekenya Doeg le Edom nedoiki lelo apolosak, near ninye ina olong iltung'ana intomoni isiet o imiet ooishopito enkila dorrop sidai.
Ore Nob ina ang oo lapolosak, near ninye to lalem; ilewa o nkituaak, nkera o naanakita, ilmong'i, isirkon o nkerra, near to lalem.
Kake ore obo loo layiok le Ahimelek ole Ahitab, oji Abiata, neisudori neisik asujaa Daudi.
Neliki Abiata Daudi nchere etaara Saul ilapolosak lo Laitoriani metuata.
Nejoki Daudi Abiata, “Atayiolo apa teina olong, etii Doeg ilo Edometi ine, inchere esipa keliki ninye Saul. Ayaua nanu ina keeya oo ltung'ana pooki le nkaji e papaai lino.
Totona te nebo nanu, miureisho; amu ore ilo oing'oru enkishui ai neing'oru enkishui ino; ore te nebo nanu niton te wueji neserian.”
Nejoki ninche Daudi, “Ng'ura, earita Ilfilisti Keila nepurrito nenen neeitobirieki enkurma.”
Neaku eikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, “Kalo nanu aar kulo Filisti?” Nejoki Olaitoriani Daudi, “Shomo taara pee intajeu Keila.”
Kake etiaakita iltung'ana le Daudi ninye, “Ng'ura, eikiureisho iyiook tene te Yuda; kebaa naa naaji ti nikipuo Keila aarare injorin oo Lfilisti?”
Neitoki ake Daudi aikilikuanishore Olaitoriani. Newaliki Olaitoriani ninye ajo, “Tudumunye, tadoi shomo Keila; amu kaishoru nanu Ilfilisti apik atua inkaik inono.”
Nelo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena Keila, nearare Ilfilisti, neyau nchoo enye, near iltung'ana kumok metuata tiatua ninche. Neaku etokordua Daudi lelo oomanya Keila.
Ore apa pee eisik Abiata olayioni le Ahimelek alo enetii Daudi te Keila, nedou ninye alotu eeta enkila dorrop te nkaina enye.
Netiaakaki apa Saul nchere eewuo Daudi Keila. Nejo Saul, “Eishorua Enkai ninye apik atua inkaik aainei amu eikenoyie ninye kewan ajing enkanasa naata inchomito oo sekenke.”
Neipotu Saul iltung'ana pooki meetu olarrabal, metadoi aapuo Keila, pee eng'adu Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena.
Neyiolou Daudi ajo eitobirita Saul entorroni te nkaraki ninye; nejoki ninye Abiata ilo apolosani, “Iyau ina kila dorrop ene.”
Nejo Daudi, “Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, etoning'o osinka lino asipu nchere keing'oru Saul pee elotu Keila pee eidaikie enkang te nkaraki nanu.

Amaa, kaaishooyo nanu iltung'ana le Keila aapik atua enkaina enye? Kedou Saul alotu, anaa enatoning'o osinka lino? Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, aatasayia iyie, toliki osinka lino.” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Kedou ninye alotu.”
Neitoki Daudi ajo, “Amaa, kaishooyo nanu iltung'ana le Keila iltung'ana laainei aapik atua enkaina e Saul?” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Eikinchooyo ninche.”
Nedumunye Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena, oobaya iip ile neing'uaa Keila, nepuo ninche eneba anaa eneidim aashom. Ore ake pee elikini Saul nchere eisika Daudi nepal elototo.
Neton Daudi tiatua ilnukat ti ong'ata, teina kop oo ldoinyo lo lpurkel le Sif. Neing'oru Saul ninye inkolong'i pooki, kake eitu epik ninye Enkai atua enkaina enye.
Neiruto apa Daudi te nkaraki naipang'u Saul alo aing'oru enkishui enye. Netii apa Daudi ong'ata e Sif te Horesh.
Nedumunye Yonatan, olayioni le Saul, nelo enetii Daudi te Horesh, neitagol enkaina enye te Nkai.
Nejoki, “Miureisho amu ore enkaina e Saul, papaai lai, mikitum iyie; iaku iyie olaiguanani te Israel, naaku nanu oliare te iyie; keyiolo sii Saul papaai lai ena.”
Nenya pokira oaare olmumai lo sotua te dukuya Olaitoriani; neton Daudi te Horesh, nelo Yonatan ang.
Nepuo Ilsifi enetii Saul te Gibea, ejo, “Aimeisudori Daudi tiatua iyiook too lnukat te Horesh, ldoinyo le Hakila, le kopikop e Yesimon?
Tadou naa wou, olaiguanani, te risioroto e yieunoto o ltau lino pooki pee idou alotu; ore erishata ang naa pee kinchoru ninye aapik atua enkaina o laiguanani.”
Nejo Saul, “Metamayiana intae Olaitoriani; amu inotito intae olng'ur te nanu.
Enchom, enyaaki entisipa oleng; entayiolo nidolidolo eneisudoriyie, naa kaing'ae otodua ninye teine; amu aatiaakaki nchere eikalamas ninye oleng.

Entodol naa, nijurrurru iwuejitin oshi neeisudoriyie, o neerreshishore, nishukunyenye enatii iatata olomoni osipa, pee alo nanu te nebo intae; naa te netii ninye ina kop, naing'oru nanu ninye tiatua inkalifuni pooki e Yuda.”
Nedumunye ninche, nepuo Sif aaituruk te Saul. Netii apa Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena ong'ata e Maon, tiatua Araba te nkalo e kopikop e Yesimon.
Nelo Saul o ltung'ana lenyena aaing'oru ninye. Nelikini Daudi; neaku etadoyie alo endapidapoi natii ong'ata e Moan. Ore ake pee ening Saul ina, nesujaa Daudi ti ong'ata e Moan.

Nelo Saul enchoto nabo o ldoinyo, nelo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena te nkai shoto o ldoinyo, neisarisarita apa Daudi pee eilany Saul, ore etinyikutua Saul o ltung'ana lenyena aapunyaki Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena pee eibung ninche,
nelotu olkipaaret enetii Saul, ejo, “Isarisaru wou; amu etaara Ilfilisti enkop.”
Neaku etushuke Saul eitu eitoki asujaa Daudi, nelo aarare Ilfilisti; neaku etejoki apa ine wueji Endapidapoi e nkisikata.
Neilep Daudi alo teine, nebik too lnukat le En-gedi.
Ore pee eshukunye Saul eing'uaa esujata oo Lfilisti, nejokini, “Etii Daudi ong'ata e En-gedi.”
Neya Saul iltung'ana inkalifuni uni oogeluno tiatua Israel pooki, nepuo aaing'oru Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena te dukuya indapidapo oo nkineji oo soito.
Nelotu ninye imuatat oo nkerra e mbata e nkoitoi, ine apa netii enkapune, nelo Saul atua pee eyeng'iyeng'ie kewan. Ore apa Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena netonita teneiting'ie enkapune tiatua.

Nejoki iltung'ana le Daudi ninye, “Nena enkolong naa ninye kitiaaka iyie Olaitoriani, ‘Ng'ura, kapik nanu olmang'atinta lino atua enkaina ino, naa intaas ninye anaa enidol aa sidai.’ ” Neinyototo Daudi neiseleejari alo adung'oo olcholoi lo lkila le Saul.
Ore te siadi neitanyamal Daudi oltau lenye, te nkaraki natudung'oyie ninye olcholoi lo lkila le Saul.

Nejoki ninye iltung'ana lenyena, “Keiba Olaitoriani te naitaas nanu ena olkitok lai, ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput aitorioo enkaina ai agilunore ninye adolita ajo olotuputo Olaitoriani ninye.”
Neaku eilejileja Daudi iltung'ana lenyena te kulo rorei, neitu eisho ninche metarasaki Saul. Nedumunye Saul neing'uaa enkapune, nelo te nkoitoi enye.

Ore te siadi nedumunye sii ninye Daudi, neipang'u tiatua enkapune, neipotu Saul, “Olkitok lai, olaiguanani!” Ore ake pee enang Saul silig, neirrugo Daudi o metabaiki enkop te nkomom enye, neserem ninye.
Nejoki Daudi Saul, “Kainyoo iyie pee ining irorei loo ltung'ana oojo, ‘Ng'ura, eing'oru Daudi enkitamioto ino?’

Dol, ore ena olong etoduaa inkonyek inono aajo kitipika taata iyie Olaitoriani atua enkaina ai tiatua enkapune; naajoki nanu ilkulikae maataara iyie tua, kake aatapala nanu. Najo, ‘Maitorioo enkaina ai aar olkitok lai; amu olotubukokoki eilata aaput lo Laitoriani ninye!’

Toduaa, papaai lai, toduaa ajo etii olcholoi lo lkila lino enkaina ai; amu ore te sipata nchere atudung'oyie olcholoi lo lkila lino, neitu aar iyie tua, indim atayiolo nidol nchere metii entorroni e nkibelekenyata aashu enkitoria atua inkaik aainei. Keitu aas eng'oki tialo iyie, hoo nirresh enkishui ai pee intayu.
Metaa Olaitoriani orish erishata ai o iyie, maaitalaa nanu Olaitoriani te iyie; kake mikiarare iyie enkaina ai.
Anaa enajo endung'et e rashe e apa moitie, ‘Atua ilo torrono epukunye entorroni.’ Kake mikiarare iyie enkaina ai.
Kaing'ae eipang'u olaiguanani le Israel asujaa? Kaing'ae isujita iyie? Koldia otua isujita iyie! Kolpidilai isujita!
Metaa naa Olaitoriani orish nedung'oki enkiguana te rishata ai o iyie, neing'or ninye, naamitu nanu, naakordu nanu te nkaina ino.”
Ore ake pee eidip Daudi airorie kulo rorei Saul, nejo Saul, “Koltoilo lino ele, enkerai ai Daudi?” Neyietu Saul aishir.
Nejoki ninye Daudi, “Iyie olasipani alang nanu, amu kitalaaka nanu esidai aa entorroni nanu aatalaaka.
Nimbalunye iyie ena olong ina nikintaasa nanu esidai, teina neitu kiar matua ina kata pee aapik nanu Olaitoriani atua inkaik inono.
Amu amaa te netum oltung'ani olmang'atinta lenye, keisho ninye meshomo ninye eserian? Neaku mikitalaaki Olaitoriani te sidai teina nikintaasa iyie nanu ena olong.
Ore taata, ng'ura, kayiolo nanu ajo kesipa iaku iyie olaiguanani, neitubulari enkitoria e Israel te nkaina ino.
Inosieki olmumai to Laitoriani nchere midung'oo iyie eishoi ai te siadi nanu, o nchere mindaikie iyie enkarna ai aitayu te nkaji e papaai lai.”
Nenya Daudi ele mumai te nkaraki Saul. Nelo Saul ang; kake eshomo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena atua olnukata.
Neye apa Samuel, neiturrurro Israel pooki aaishiraki ninye, nenukaa ninche ninye te nkaji enye te Rama. Nedumunye Daudi nedoyio alo ong'ata e Paran.

Netii apa oltung'ani otii Maon, oata esiaai enye te Karmel. Aikarsis apa ilo tung'ani oleng; keeta apa ninye nkerra inkalifuni uni o nkineji enkalifu nabo. Nebarnu apa ninye ilpapit loo nkerra enyena te Karmel.
Ore apa enkarna e ilo tung'ani naa Nabal, ore enkarna e nkitok enye naa Abigail. Naa ng'en apa ina kitok neikishiaan kake kemoda apa olee naa torrono olkuaak; naa ole ntalipa e Kaleb apa.
Nening Daudi ti ong'ata nchere ebarnita Nabal nkerra enyena.
Neaku eirriwayie Daudi ilbarnot tomon; nejoki Daudi lelo barnot, “Elepa enchom Karmel, nipuopuo enetii Nabal, nirorokiki ninye te nkarna ai.
Naa nji enkuna te nirorokiki ninye: ‘Metaa enino eseriani, metaa eseriani ene nkaji ino, metaa eseriani ene lelo pooki liata iyie.
Atoningo nanu nchere iata iyie ilabarnok; etii oshi ilchekuti linono te nebo iyiook, neitu iyiook kintaas ninche entorrono, neitu ninche elau toki, ina kata pooki etii Karmel.

Inkilikuana ilbarnot linono, amu aikiliki ninche. Metaa nchoo ilbarnot laainei etum omom too nkonyek inono; amu kipuonu iyiook te nkolong o sirua. Kitoomono iyie, nchoo pooki toki niaata isinkan linono o olayioni lino Daudi.’ ”
Ore ake pee epuonu ilbarnot le Daudi, nejoki ninche nena pooki Nabal te nkarna e Daudi; netoni aanyisho.
Newaliki Nabal isinkan le Daudi nejo, “Kaing'ae Daudi? Kaing'ae olayioni le Yese? Etii oshi taata kuna olong'i isinkan kumok oopuo aaing'uaa ilkituaak lenye.
Kaitayu nanu endaa ai o enkare ai o enkiring'o ai nateyieng'uo te nkaraki ilabarnok laainei, aisho iltung'ana ooing'uaa ewueji nemayiolo nanu ajo kaji eing'uaa?”
Neaku eibelekenyate lelo barnot le Daudi aapuo, neshuko neliki ninye ina.

Nejoki Daudi iltung'ana lenyena, “Teena pooki ng'ae olalem lenye!” Ore pooki ng'ae te ninche neen olalem lenye; neen sii ninye Daudi olalem lenye; nepuo iltung'ana oobaya iip ong'uan aasujaa Daudi, netoni iltung'ana iip are aarrip ilolan.
Kake etiaaka obo loo lbarnot Abigail, enkitok e Nabal, “Ng'ura, Eirriwua Daudi ilkiliku ooing'uaa ong'ata meetu aairoroki olkitok lang, kake etamoro ninche.
Ore eyia, aisupati apa lelo tung'ana te iyiook, neitu iyiook kitum entorroni, neitu iyiook kilau toki apa kitii ong'ata, te nkata naba anaa enikishomo te nebo ninche;
esuntai apa ninche te iyiook te nkewarie o te ndama, teina kata pooki apa nikitii iyiook te nebo ninche king'orita nkerra.
Ore naa taata tayiolo ena nidamu eniaas; amu eitobirakita olkitok lang entorroni o enkaji enye pooki, naa kegogong ninye oleng meetae oltung'ani oidim airorie ninye.”

Kaae neisarrisar Abigail, neya imukateni iip are, o lbenia oaare loo lonito le naisho oo sabibu o nkerra imiet naayieng'a, o ntemat imiet enkurma napejo o rridat iip loo sabibu, o mukateni iip are oo lng'abolo, neirragie ninche te nchumata oo sirkon.
Nejoki ninye lelo barnot lenye, “Enchom enturuko te dukuya nanu; ng'ura, kalotu nanu asuju intae.” Kake eitu ninye eliki olpayian lenye Nabal.
Ore eloito ninye ekedito osikiria nedou alotu abori olmelil lo ldoinyo, ng'ura, nelotu Daudi, o ltung'ana lenyena aadou aanang'are ninye; nenang'are ninye ninche.
Netejo apa Daudi, “Kesipa pesho apa nanu atorripo nena pooki naata ele tung'ani ti ong'ata neaku meetae entoki natalaki te nena pooki naara inenyena; naatushukoko ninye nanu entorroni te sidano.
Metaasa Enkai ena te Daudi, neitulusoo sii, te natung'uayie nanu tadekenya obo lee le lelo pooki oora ilenyena.”
Ore ake pee edol Abigail Daudi, neisarrisar ninye, nedou to sikiria, nebatata ninye te dukuya Daudi te nkomom enye, neirrugo abaiki enkop.
Nebatata ninye too nkejek enyena nejo, “Shumata nanu ake, olkitok lai, nchoo elotu entorroni; aatoomono nchoo esinka ino eiro too nkiyiaa inono, nining irorei le sinka ino.

Mincho olkitok lai eshilaa ele tung'ani le ntorroni, Nabal; amu ore anaa enatiu enkarna enye, neijia etiu ninye, Nabal enkarna enye, netii emodai te nebo ninye; kake ore nanu esinka ino eitu adol lelo barnot lo lkitok lai, laa ninche iyie irriwua,

ore naa taata, olkitok lai, anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, o anaa enaishu oltau lino, idolita ajo kimbooyie iyie Olaitoriani aitung'uaa enkibukoroto o sarge, o enkitalakunoto e lap te nkaina ino makewan, ore naa taata nchoo ilmang'ati linono o lelo ooing'oru aaitaas entorroni olkitok lai etiu anaa Nabal.
Ore taata ena kishooroto naa ninye eyaka esinka ino olkitok lai inchoo meishori lelo barnot oosuj olkitok lai.
Aatoomono tapalikiaki engolong'akinoto e sinka ino; amu kesipa keitaa Olaitoriani olkitok lai enkaji nauno, amu ilarrabali lo Laitoriani etii olkitok lai; nemetumi entorroni te iyie anaa ninchu.

Te nedumunye iltung'ana pee kisujaa iyie pee eing'oru enkishui ino, ore enkishui o lkitok lai naa keenari to rridata loo looishu te nking'urata o Laitoriani Enkai ino; ore enkishui oo lmang'ati linono nenang'aa ninye anaa osoit onang'ari te nkopito.
Ore ake pee eidip Olaitoriani aitaasa olkitok lai te risioroto e nena pooki sidain naairoro ninye tialo iyie, nikitegelua ninye taa olkitok te shumata Israel,

metum olkitok lai enaitagor aashu enyamali o ltau, te nkibukoroto o sarge metii emporeet, aashu to lkitok lai eitalaku elap makewan. Ore ake pee kindip Olaitoriani aitaasa olkitok lai esidai, nidamu naa esinka ino.”
Nejoki Daudi Abigail, “Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, laa ninye nikirriua iyie ena olong pee kinang'are nanu!
Metamayiani eng'eno ino, naa mikitamayiani iyie, aa iyie nikimbooyie nanu ena olong te nkibukoroto o sarge o te nkitalakunoto elap te nkaina ai makewan!

Amu ore te sipata anaa enaishu Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, o laa ninye laaibooyie nanu eitu aaitame iyie, te neme eisarisarua iyie nikilotu anang'are nanu, kesipa ore tadekenya anaata eitu ninye elekakini Nabal hoo ninye olee obo.”
Neng'amu Daudi too nkaik eina kitok ina nayaka ninye nejoki ninye, “Ilepa shomo te seriani enkaji ino; ing'ura, atoning'o nanu oltoilo lino, naishorua nanu ina omonunoto ino.”

Nelotu Abigail enetii Nabal; naa, ng'ura eeta apa ninye osirua tiatua enkaji enye, anaa osirua lo laiguanani. Neng'ida apa oltau le Nabal tiatua ninye, amu etemere apa oleng; neaku eitu eliki ninye toki katukul o metaba anaa nekenyu awang'u.
Ore tadekenya eishunye emerai te Nabal, neliki ninye enkitok enye kuna baa, neye oltau lenye tiatua ninye, netiu ninye anaa osoit.
Ore too nkolong'i naabaya tomon te siadi neosh Olaitoriani Nabal; neye ninye.

Ore pee ening Daudi nchere etua Nabal, nejo ninye, “Metamayiani Olaitoriani o laa ninye oitalakua ina moroto apa natang'amua nanu te nkaina e Nabal, neibooyie ninye osinka lenye aitung'uaa entorroni; etushukoko Olaitoriani ina kiaas torrono enchumata endukuya enye makewan.” Neirriwaa Daudi iltung'ana pee esir Abigail aitaa ninye enkitok enye.
Ore ake pee epuonu isinkan le Daudi enetii Abigail te Karmel, nejoki ninche ninye, “Eirriua Daudi iyiook enitii pee kintaa iyie te ninye anaa enkitok enye.”
Nedumunye ninye neirrugo te nkomom enye o metabaiki enkop, nejo, “Ng'ura, ore esinka ino naa enkaisaayiani naituku inkejek oo sinkan lo lkitok lai.”
Neisarrisar Abigail, nedumunye neked osikiria, neisiaai ninye inkaisiaayiak enyena imiet; nesujaa ninye lelo kiliku le Daudi, neaku enkitok enye.
Neitoki sii Daudi aya Ahinoam e Yesreel; neaku ninche pokira are inkituaak enyena.
Neishoo apa Saul Mikal, entito enye, ina kitok e Daudi, Palti olayioni le Laish, o laa olayioni le Galim apa ninye.
Nepuonu Ilsifi enetii Saul te Gibea, nejo, “Aimeisudori Daudi to ldoinyo le Hikila, otii enchoto o loo saen le Yeshimon?”
Neaku etudumunye Saul nedoyio alo ong'ata e Sif, te nebo iltung'ana inkalifuni uni oogeluno le Israel, pee eing'oru Daudi ti ong'ata e Sif.
Neitayu Saul olng'obor to ldoinyo le Hikila, otii embata enkoitoi nalala te nchoto o loosaen le Yesimon. Kake etotona Daudi to lpurkel; ore ake pee edol ajo eewuo Saul asuju ninye atua olpurkel,
neirriwaa Daudi ilaikitalak, pee eyiolou aasipu ajo eewuo Saul.

Nedumunye Daudi nelotu ine wueji apa netipika Saul olng'obor, nedol Daudi ine wueji neirragie Saul, te nebo Abna olayioni le Ner, olkitok le njore enye; neirragita apa Saul tiatua olng'obor nemanita enjore pooki ninye.
Nejoki Daudi Ahimelek ilo Hitati; o lalashe le Yoab Abishai olayioni le Seruiya, “Kaing'ae odoyio alo te nebo nanu atua olng'obor enetii Saul?” Nejo Abishai, “Kadoyio nanu alo te nebo o iyie.”
Neaku eshomo Daudi o Abishai enetii ina jore kewarie; neirragita Saul teine airura tiatua olng'obor, neunokino empere enye enkop te mbata e ndukuya enye; ore Abna o enjore neirrag aaman ninye.
Nejoki Abishai Daudi, “Eishorua Enkai olmang'atinta lino apik atua enkaina ino ena olong; ore naa nchooki nanu matupudaki ninye enkop te remoto nabo e mpere, nemaitoki nanu arem ninye kat are.”
Kake etiaaka Daudi Abishai, “Minyal ninye, amu kaing'ae oidim aitorioi enkaina enye metaarare ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput, neaku meeta entioto?”
Nejo Daudi, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, kear Olaitoriani ninye; aashu elotu enkolong enye pee eye; aashu elo ninye atua olarrabal neari metua.
Metomito Olaitoriani nchere kadumu nanu enkaina ai aar ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput; kake iwa taata ina pere natii embata endukuya enye, o ina moti e nkare, pee kipuo iyiook.”

Neaku ewa Daudi empere o emoti e nkare aitung'uaa endukuya e Saul, nepuo ninche. Metii oltung'ani otoduaa ina, aashu otayiolo ina, aashu einyo hoo likae; amu keirura apa pooki, te nkaraki eetuo injo naairoishi naaing'uaa Olaitoriani shumata ninche.
Neitoki Daudi alang alo lido kekun, neitashe te nelakua te nchumata o ldoinyo, etii erishata sapuk erishata enye.
Neipot ina jore, o Abna olayioni le Ner, ejo, “Aimiwal iyie, Abna?” Newal Abna, “Ira ng'ae ilo oipot olaiguanani?”

Nejoki Daudi Abna, “Aimira iyie olee? Kaing'ae likinyaanyukie iyie tiatua Israel? Kainyoo naa pee eitu iyie irrip olkitok lino olaiguanani? Amu eewuo obo loo ltung'ana atua pee eidaikie olaiguanani olkitok lino.

Ore ena toki nitaasa iyie neme sidai. Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, kinchiaakinore iyie niye, te nkaraki neitu iyie irrip olkitok ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput. Naa ore taata ing'ura enetii empere o laiguanani, o ina moti e nkare duoo natii embata endukuya enye.”
Neyiolou Saul oltoilo le Daudi, nejo, “Koltoilo lino ele, enkerai ai, Daudi?” Nejo Daudi, “Oltoilo lai, olkitok lai, olaiguanani.”
Nejo ninye, “Kainyoo pee esuj olkitok lai osinka lenye? Amu kainyoo nanu ataasa? Kaa torroni natii inkaik aainei?

Ore naa taata nchoo olkitok lai olaiguanani ening irorei lo sinka lenye. Tenaa Olaitoriani likituputuo iyie taaraki nanu, metang'amu ninye olasar; kake tenaa iltung'ana, metaa kediaa ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani, amu aataaraitie ninche aaipang'ie ena olong pee matum nanu eng'arata e njung'ore o Laitoriani, ejo, ‘Shomo isiaayia kulie aitin.’
Ore naa, mincho osarge lai ebukokino enkop te nelakuaniki ine netii Olaitoriani; amu eipang'ua olaiguanani le Israel alotu aing'oru enkishui ai, anaa oltung'ani orresh enkurle too ldoinyo.”
Neitoki Saul ajo, “Ataasa nanu entorrono; tushukunye, enkerai ai, Daudi, amu maaitoki nanu aitaas iyie entorrono, amu keeta enkishui ai tipat ena olong too nkonyek inono.”
Neitoki Daudi awalu ajo, “Nena empere o laiguanani! Nchoo obo loo lbarnot elang'u alotu aya.

Ekelaaki Olaitoriani pooki tung'ani te supatisho enye o te nkisiligata enye; amu kinchorua iyie Olaitoriani apik atua enkaina ai taata, nemadumu nanu enkaina ai aarare ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput.
Ng'ura, anaa enaata enkishui ino tipat ena olong too nkonyek aainei, neaku metaa enkishui ai ene tipat too nkonyek o Laitoriani, naa maatokordu ninye aitayu tiatua isinaitin pooki.”
Neitoki Saul ajoki Daudi, “Mikitamayiani iyie, enkerai ai, Daudi! Ias iyie imbaa kumok naa idupoyu te pooki.” Neaku eshomo Daudi enkoitoi enye neshuko Saul alo ewueji enye.

Nejo Daudi to ltau lenye, “Kaye nanu nabo olong te nkaina e Saul; metii entoki sidai te nanu alang te naisikaki enkop oo Filistia; pee etum Saul atapalari aaing'oru nanu too lpolosien le Israel, naluaya nanu apuku te nkaina enye.”
Neaku etudumunye Daudi nelang alo, ninye o lelo tung'ana iip ile apa ootii te nebo ninye, aapuo enetii Akish olayioni le Moak, olaiguanani le Gas.
Nebik Daudi te nebo Akish te Gas, ninye o ltung'ana lenyena, pooki tung'ani te nebo enkaji enye o Daudi te nebo inkituaak enyena pokira are, Ahinoam e Yesreel, o Abigail e Karmel, enkoliai e Nabal.
Ore ake pee ejokini Saul nchere eshomo Daudi Gas, neitu ninye eitoki aing'oru ninye.

Neitoki Daudi ajoki Akish, “Tenaa kanoto nanu omom too nkonyek inono, nchoo maaishori nanu ewueji tiatua nabo oo nkang'itie ena kop pee atum nanu atobiko teine; amu kainyoo pee eton osinka lino te nkanasa e nkitoo te nebo o iyie?”
Neaku eishoo Akish ninye ina olong Siklag; metaa etaa Siklag enoo laiguanak le Yuda o metabaiki ena olong.
Ore esiana oo nkolong'i naatobiko Daudi te nkop oo Filistia naa olari o lapaitin oong'uan.
Neilep Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena nerasaki Ilgeshuri, Ilgirsi, o Lamaleki; amu kulo apa oomanya enkop ti apa, o Shuri, o metabaiki enkop e Misiri.
Near Daudi enkop, neitu eing'uaa olee aashu enkitok eishu, kake ewa nkerra, o lmong'i, o isirkon, o intamesin, o nkilani, neshukunye alotu enetii Akish.
Ore pee eikilikuan Akish ajo, “Kakua duoo taata itaara?” Nejo Daudi, “Ilnegeb le Yuda,” aashu, “Ilnegeb le Ijerame,” aashu, “Kitaarare Ilnegeb le Keni.”

Neitu eing'uaa Daudi olee aashu enkitok eishu, pee etum ayau olomoni Gas, ejo, “Pee melikioo ake ninche iyiook, nejo, ‘Ena etaasa Daudi.’ ” Ele apa olkuaak lenye ina kata pooki apa ebikito te nkop oo Filistia.
