Neisilig apa Akish Daudi edamu ajo, “Eibaitie tukul iltung'ana lenyena Israeli; metaa keaku ninye osinka lai anaake.”

Ore apa te nena olong'i neiturrur Ilfilisti injoreitin enye te nkaraki olarrabal, pee earare Israel. Nejoki Akish Daudi, “Tayiolo nchere ore iyie o ltung'ana linono naa impang'ipang'a aapuo te nebo nanu tiatua enjore.”
Nejoki Daudi Akish, “Aisidai oleng, iyiolou iyie enaidim osinka lino ataasa.” Nejoki Akish Daudi, “Aisidai oleng, kaaitaa nanu iyie olarriponi lai te nkishui pooki.”
Ore tena rishata netua apa Samuel, neidipa Israel pooki aishiraki ninye nenukaa ninye te Rama, te nkanasa enye kewan. Netaarayie apa Saul lelo aisi le yiolounoto o lasakutok meshomo teina kop.
Neiturrurro Ilfilisti nepuonu aaitayu olng'obor te Shunam; neiturrur Saul Israel pooki, neitayu ninche olng'obor te Gilboa.
Ore ake pee edol Saul enjore oo Lfilisti, neureishoyu neikirikira oltau lenye oleng.
Ore pee eikilikuanishore Saul Olaitoriani, neitu ewaliki Olaitoriani ninye, aa te nkidetidet aashu te Urim, aashu too loibonok.

Neitoki Saul ajoki isinkan lenyena, “Eng'urakaki nanu enkitok nadolisho te naibon, pee atum nanu ashomo enetii ninye naikilikuanishore ninye.” Nejoki isinkan lenyena ninye, “Etii enkaisi nadolisho te naibon Endor.”

Neibelekeny Saul kewan neishop kulikae kilani, nelo, ninye o ltung'ana oaare te nebo ninye; nepuonu ninche enetii ina kitok kewarie. Nejo ninye, “Mbonokoki nanu te nkiyang'et, nikilepakinye nanu oltung'ani obo laaipotoki enkarna enye.”

Nejoki ina kitok ninye, “Kesipa iyiolo ina nataasa Saul, ina naitaasa ninye iloibonok oodolisho, o lasakutok aipang'ie tena kop. Kainyoo naa pee kirragakinye nanu orreshet te nkaraki enkishui ai pee iyau keeya ai?”
Kake einosaka Saul ninye olmumai to Laitoriani nejo, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, melotu enkitamioto shumata iyie tena bae.”
Neitoki ina kitok ajo, “Kaing'ae aayaki ailepakinye?” Nejo ninye, “Iyau ilepakinyeki nanu Samuel.”
Ore ake pee edol ina kitok Samuel neyietu aishir to ltoilo sapuk; nejoki ina kitok Saul, “Kainyoo iyie pee kiteleja nanu? Ira iyie Saul.”
Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Miureshoyu iyie; kainyoo iyie idolita?” Nejoki ina kitok Saul, “Adolita nanu enkitaayayukoto e nkai eilepu apuku te nkop.”

Nejoki Saul ninye, “Kaji eikununo ninye?” Nejo ninye, “Olpayian moruo oilepu alotu; neirina ninye to lkila.” Neyiolou Saul inchere Samuel ilo, neirrugo ninye te nkomom enye o metabaiki enkop, neserem.

Nejoki Samuel Saul, “Kainyoo pee kintanyamal ailepunye nanu?” Newal Saul ajo, “Atii nanu atua osina sapuk, amu aaitirrishakita nanu Ilfilisti aarare, naaibelekenye Enkai aing'uaa nemeekure aawaliki, aa too loibonok aashu te nkidetidet, neaku aaipoto iyie pee kiliki enaas.”
Neitoki Samuel ajo, “Kainyoo naa pee kinkilikuan nanu, aa Olaitoriani likimbelekenye aing'uaa neaku ninye olmang'atinta lino?
Kintaasa iyie Olaitoriani anaa apa enairoro te nanu; amu etopolosayie Olaitoriani enkitoria aitung'uaa enkaina ino, neisho ilo le latia ino Daudi.
Te nkaraki neitu iyie ining oltoilo lo Laitoriani, neitu intabaya ina goro enye napi aarare Amalek, neaku kintaasa iyie Olaitoriani ena bae ena olong.

Ore ake sii keishooyo sii Olaitoriani Israel te nebo iyie apik atua enkaina oo Lfilisti; ore taisere iyie o layiok linono niakuku te nebo o nanu; naa kelo aishoru Olaitoriani enjore e Israel apik atua enkaina oo Lfilisti.”
Nebatata Saul nabo kata te nkop aitorriori eiputa enkuretisho te nkaraki irorei le Samuel; nemeekure apa etii engolon atua ninye, amu eitu ninye enya ae toki endama pooki o enkewarie pooki.
Nelotu ina kitok enetii Saul, ore ake pee edol ajo eiputukunyo, nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura, kitoning'o iyie esinka ino; aitayio nanu enkishui ai te nkaina ai natoning'o ina nikitiaaka iyie nanu.
Ore naa taata, toning'o sii iyie esinka ino; nchooki nanu mairragie embelati e mukate te dukuya iyie; pee inya, pee itum engolon te nilo te nkoitoi ino.”
Neany ninye nejo, “Manya nanu endaa.” Kake etasayia isinkan lenyena ninye te nebo ina kitok, nening irorei lenye. Neaku neinyototo ninye te nkop neton te rruat.
Neeta apa ina kitok olashe opir ti aji, neyieng ninye asioki, neitayu enkurma, neipurjupurj nepeju imukateni neitu eisuishieki,
nepik dukuya Saul o laisiaayiak lenyena; nenya. Nedumunye ninche nepuo ina kewarie.
Neiturrurro apa Ilfilisti injoreitin enye pooki te Afek; ore Israeli neitayutuo apa ninche ilng'oborri te mbata e nkong'u e nkare natii atua Yesreel.
Ore ilkituaak loo Lfilisti nepuo too maa iip o too nkalifuni, ore Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena nepuo ninche te siadi te nebo Akish,

nejo ilkituaak le njore loo Lfilisti, “Kainyoo easita kulo Hebrania tene?” Nejoki Akish lelo kituaak le njore loo Lfilisti, “Aime Daudi ele, osinka le Saul, olaiguanani le Israel, otaa ninye te nebo nanu too nkolong'i o too larin, naa ore anaa neing'uaa ninye alotu enatii nanu eitu atum entorroni tiatua ninye o metabaiki ena olong.”

Kake etagorokinote ilkituaak le njore oo lfilisti ninye; nejoki ninye ilkituaak le njore oo lfilisti, “Tushuko ele tung'ani, pee etum atorrinyoyu ashomo ewueji apa nitiaaka ninye; medoyio ninye alo te nebo iyiook olarrabal, meaku ake to larrabal olmang'atinta te iyiook. Amu kaji eiko ele tung'ani te neitayu osotua o lkitok lenye. Aime too lukuny e kulo tung'ana tene?
Aime ele Daudi, ilo oshi oranyakino maate too sinkolioitin ejo: ‘Etaara Saul inkalifuni enyena, near Daudi inkalifuni tomon enyena!’ ”

Neipotu Akish Daudi nejoki ninye, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, isiligayu oshi iyie, ore te nanu kadol aa sidai te nilo apuku nijing te nebo nanu to larrabal, amu eitu nanu atum entoki torrono tiatua iyie ebaiki enkolong apa elotunoto ino niewuo enatii o metabaiki ena olong. Ore ake eyia mikinyorraa ilkituaak.
Neaku tushukoyu shomo taata, naa shomo te seriani, pee mintagor ake ilkituaak loo Filistia.”
Nejoki Daudi Akish, “Kake kaa nanu ataasa? Kainyoo iyie inoto to sinka lino ebaiki enkolong apa natijing'a enkisiaayiare ino o taata, nchere malo nanu aarare ilmang'ati lo kitok lai olaiguanani?”
Newaliki Akish Daudi ajoki, “Kayiolo ajo miata eleyiata too nkonyek aainei anaa olmalaika le Nkai; ore ake eyia, etejo ilkituaak le njore loo lfilisti, ‘Meilep ninye alo te nebo iyiook olarrabal.’
Ore naa tayooki tudumunye enkakenya te nebo o sinkan lo lkitok lino apa ooetuo te nebo iyie, nipuopuo anaa ake pee eiteru enkakeya awang'aki intae.”
Neaku eshomo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena aayook tadekenya, aashuko aapuo enkop oo lfilisti. Kake eshomo Ilfilisti Yesreel.
Ore apa ina kata pee elotu Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena Siklag te nkolong e uni, netaara Ilmaleki Negeb o Siklag. Eisulie ninche Siklag nepejoo te nkima.
Neya inkituaak o pooki ootii atua, ilooti o lkituaak; eitu ear hoo ng'ae metua, kake etanapa ninche aaya, nepuo enkoitoi enye.
Ore ake pee elotu Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena ina anasa, neinepu etapejoki te nkima, ore inkituaak enye o layiok lenye o ntoyie enye netaraayioki aaya.
Ore Daudi o ltung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye neyietu aaishir o metaba anaa neaku meeta engolon naishirie.
Ore inkituaak pokira are e Daudi newaki sii ninche aaraya, Ahinoam e Yesreel o Abigail ina oliai apa e Nabal le Karmel.

Nenyamalu Daudi oleng; amu kejo iltung'ana pee enang ninye too soito, te nkaraki etamioto iltung'ana pooki too ltauja, oltung'ani ake too layiok lenyena o ntoyie enyena. Kake eitagolo Daudi kewan tiatua Olaitoriani Enkai enye.
Nejoki Daudi Abiatar olapolosani, olayioni le Ahimelek, “Iyakaki nanu enkila dorrop.” Neaku eyaka Abiatar ina kila dorrop Daudi.
Neikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, “Amaa, kasujaa nanu ele wuampa Kamir nanu ninche?” Newaliki ninye ninye, “Tusujai, amu kesipa imir, nesipa imitu akordu.”
Neaku eshomo Daudi o lelo tung'ana iip ile apa ootii te nebo ninye nepuonu ninche oreyiet te Besor, ina netonie lelo ooing'uari te siadi.
Kake eshomo Daudi agiroo ine te sujaroto, ninye o ltung'ana iip ong'uan; netoni iltung'ana iip are te siadi, lelo apa oonaurate oleng leitu eidim aatalang oreyiet le Besor.
Netum ninche Olmisiri te nkop naisiasha, neyau ninye enetii Daudi; neisho ninche emukate nenya ninye, neisho enkare naok,

neisho ninche ninye embelati e mukate oo lng'abolo o nkimarrat are oo sabibu. Ore ake pee enya ninye, nepiu oltau lenye; amu eitu apa ninye enya endaa aashu eok enkare too nkolong'i uni o nkewarietin uni.

Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Aira iyie oleng'ae? Naa kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Nejo ninye, “Ara nanu olbarnoti le Misiri, osinka lo Lamaleki; naatung'uayie nanu olkitok te nkaraki natamuoyia too nkolong'i uni naatulusoitie.
Kitaara apa iyiook Negeb oo Lkerite o ina nara ene Yuda o Negeb e Kaleb; nikipejoo Siklag te nkima.”
Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Aikirik enetii ilo wuampa?” Nejo ninye, “Inosakaki nanu olmumai te Nkai, nchere mikiar matua, aashu kiya nanu apik atua inkaik o lkitok lai, naa kaarik enetii ele wuampa.”
Ore ake pee eaku etoriko ninye aitadoyio, ng'ura, eidapashate ninche te nkop pooki, edaa neokisho neranyisho, te nkaraki nena tokitin kumok naataarutua te nkop oo Filistia o te nkop e Yuda.
Near Daudi ninche aiteru teipa o metabaiki enteipa e nkae olong. Neitu eisik hoo obo lenye, meteleku ilbarnot iip ong'uan apa ookedito intamesin neisik.
Nerrinyu Daudi nena pooki apa naataaraitie Ilmaleki; nekordu Daudi inkituaak enyena pokira are.
Neitu eimin toki aa kiti o aa sapuk, ilayiok aashu intoyie, imasaa aashu ae toki apa nawaki; eyaua Daudi ashuku pooki.
Eibung'a sii apa Daudi nkerrai pooki o nchoo; nereu iltung'ana nena shoo te dukuya ninye, nejo, “Iyarunot e Daudi kuna.”

Neitoki Daudi alotu enetii lelo tung'ana apa iip are oonaurate oleng neitu esuj Daudi, neing'uari apa ninche to erata le Besor; neipang ninche aapuo aanang'are Daudi nenang'are lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye; ore pee elotu Daudi anyikaki iltung'ana neiroroki ninche.

Ore lelo pooki arruok o ltung'ana oora pesho apa ooshomo te nebo Daudi nejo, “Ore te nkaraki neitu ninche epuo te nebo iyiook, mikincho iyiook ninche toki e kuna yarunot nikitushukutuo, meteleku ake nchere keidim pooki ng'ae atoriko enkitok enye o nkera, nelo.”
Kake etejo Daudi, “Minkoko neijia, ilalashera laainei, teina naishoo iyiook Olaitoriani; etagolie ninye iyiook neishoru apik atua enkaina ang ilo wuampa apa oewuo aar iyiook.
Kaing'ae oinining intae tena bae? Amu ore anaa enatiu erubata e ilo olo olarrabal, neijia sii etiu erubata e ilo oton too lolan keng'ar ninche aaitoris.”
Ore ebaiki ina olong neito dukuya neitaa ina inkiguanat o nkitanapat te Israel o metabaiki ena olong.
Ore pee elotu Daudi Siklag, neiteng'el embata oo yarunot pee eisho ilchoreta lenyena, ilpayiani le Yuda; nejo, “Nena enkishooroto te intae naing'uaa nena naaruno too lmang'ati lo Laitoriani;”
ene lelo ootii Betel o lootii Ramot e Negeb te Yatir,
ootii Aroer o Sifmot o Eshtemoa,
otii Rakal atua inkanas oo Ljerahami, o nkanas oo Lkeni,
ootii Horma o Borashan o Atak,
ootii Hebron, too wuejitin pooki neeshomo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena.
Nearare apa Ilfilisti Israel; neisik iltung'ana le Israel te dukuya Ilfilisti neidaikieki to Ldoinyo le Gilboa.
Neinepu Ilfilisti Saul o layiok lenyena; near Ilfilisti Yonatan o Abinadab o Malikishua, lelo ayiok le Saul.
Neitirrishaki olarrabal Saul oleng, netum ninye ilang'orok loo mbaa, netum olbae torrono te lelo ang'orok loo mbaa.

Nejoki Saul ilo anapani lenye loo maasa o larrabal, “Intayu olalem lino taremoki meipang'a te nanu, maapuonu ake kulo lememurata aang'ung'ur nanu, naaitaa nanu enkiguran.” Kake meidim ilo anapani lenye loo maasa o larrabal; amu eturia oleng. Neaku eitayio Saul olalem lenye makewan, nebatatakino.
Ore ake pee edol ilo anapani lenye loo maasa o larrabal ajo etua Saul, nebatatakino sii ninye olalem lenye, neye te nebo ninye.
Neaku etua Saul o layiok lenyena pokira okuni, o lanapani lenye loo maasa o larrabal, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, te nkolong nabo te nebo.

Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana le Israel apa ootii likae kekun o erata o lekua ootii teidia alo Yordan nchere eisika iltung'ana le Israel, netua Saul o layiok lenyena, neing'uaa ninche inkang'itie enye neisik; nepuonu Ilfilisti nebik tiatua ninche.
Ore pee ekenyu, ore pee epuonu Ilfilisti aapur lelo ootaraki metuata, netum ninche Saul o layiok lenyena pokira okuni eirrag to Oldoinyo le Gilboa.
Nedung'oo ninche endukuya enye, neing'uaa imaasa o larrabal neirriwaa ilkiliku tiatua enkop pooki oo Filistia, mewaita ilomon sidain aayaki inkaitin enye o ltung'ana.
Nepik imaasa o larrabal enkaji e nkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Ashtarot; nesheiki osesen lenye esuntai e Betshean.
Kake ore ake pee ening lelo oomanya Yabesh-Gilead ina naitaasa Ilfilisti Saul,
nedumunye iltung'ana pooki oopi, nepuo enkewarie pooki, neitayu osesen le Saul o seseni loo layiok lenyena aaitung'uaa esuntai e Bet-shan; nepuonu ninche Yabesh nepejoo ninche teine.
Neya iloik lenye nenukaa ti abori olchani oji olkuaju te Yabesh, nepukoo ninche inkolong'i naapishana.
Ore eidipa Saul atua, neidipa Daudi atushukunye te mutata oo Lmaleki, neton Daudi inkolong'i are te Siklag;
ore te nkolong e uni, nelotu oltung'ani oing'uaa ilng'oborri le Saul, epolosa inkilani enyena netii enterit endukuya enye. Ore ake pee elotu enetii Daudi, neirrugo abaiki enkop nesai ninye.
Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Nejoki, “Kaisikua nanu aing'uaa ilng'oborri le Israel.”

Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Kaji eikunari mbaa? Tolikioki nanu.” Newalu ninye, nejo “Eisika iltung'ana aaing'uaa olarrabal, ore sii ilkumok loo ltung'ana neirragaa etuata, ore Saul o olayioni lenye Yonatan etuata sii ninche.”
Nejoki Daudi ilo barnoti otiaka ninye, “Kainyoo nikintayiolo iyie inchere etua Saul o Yonatan olayioni lenye?”
Nejoki ilo barnoti apa otiaka ninye, “Aishiaakinore ake duoo atii enchumata oldoinyo le Gilboa; netii Saul airishakino empere enye, nadol, etinyikakita ngarrin o lakedok loo mbartan emir ninye.
Ore ake pee eing'or siadi enye, naadol nanu, naaipot. Nairukisho nanu ajo, ‘Nele nanu.’
Naajoki ninye, ‘Ira iyie alo?’ Nawaliki, ‘Kara nanu Olmaleki.’
Naajoki ninye nanu, ‘Intasho te mbata nanu tasesekuanaki; amu aanoto nanu osina, neton ake eishu enkishui ai tiatua nanu.’

Neaku aitasho nanu te mbata ninye, nasesekuan ninye, amu aitisipa ajo meidim anyaaki atopuaa eidipa atabatatayu; naya ilo marisian apa le nkitoo otii endukuya enye o lkataar apa otii enkaina enye, nayawua ninche ene netii olkitok lai.”
Neibung Daudi inkilani enyena, nepolos, neiko sii neijia lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye;

neishir ninche neitayu ilkiyio nepukoo o metaa teipa te nkaraki Saul o Yonatan olayioni lenye o te nkaraki iltung'ana lo Laitoriani o te nkaraki enkaji e Israel, te nkaraki etabatatate ninche to lalem.
Nejoki Daudi ilo barnoti apa otiaaka ninye, “Kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Newaliki, “Kara nanu olayioni leilo omoni lo Lmaleki.”
Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee eitu iureyu idumu enkaina ino ainyal ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput?”
Neipotu Daudi obo loo lbarnot nejoki, “Shomo, taara ninye metua.” Neosh oltung'ani Olmaleki metua.
Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Meeu osarge lino shumata endukuya ino; amu enkutuk ino kewan nikinchakenoko iyie, ejo, Atasesekuana nanu ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput.”
Nerany Daudi ele sinkolio le nkishirata, aishiraki Saul o Yonatan olayioni lenye.
Nejo ninye keiteng'eni iltung'ana le Yuda; ng'ura kesira te mbuku e Yashar. Nejo:
Etua enkitoo ino, iyie Israel, etasesekuanaki te shumata iwuejitin inono neeika! Kaji eikunakinote embatatata lelo magil!
Milikioo ena te Gas, emintubulaa ena too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa e Askelon; meng'idayu ake intoyie oo Filistia, mewuasayu ake intoyie e lelo lememurata.
Intae ildoinyo le Gilboa, inchoo metaa metii empaso aashu enchan shumata intae aashu enkaitubului nabulu te nkop! Amu teine eidurukieki elong'o e ilo magilani, elong'o e Saul, eitu eelieki eilata.
To sarge le lelo oosesekuani, te ilata e lelo magil, eitu eshuko enkawuo e Yonatan, neitu eshukunye olalem le Saul erok.
Saul o Yonatan oonyorri naa shaati! Ore te nkishui o te keeya merisha ninche; neneneng ninche aalang ilkurragoso, negol ninche aalang ilng'atunyo.
Intae intoyie oo Siraeli enchiraki Saul, oishopo intae too nkilani naanyokioo, neikodo inkilani inyi te saabu.
Kaji eikunakinote embatatata lelo magil, te mpolos o larrabal! Eirrag Yonatan etasesekuanaki te nchumata oo wuejitin inono neeika
Aisinanuo te nkaraki iye olalashe lai Yonatan; aikishipakino apa iyie nanu oleng; ore apa enyorrata ino te nanu naa enking'asia, kegiroo enyorrata oo nkituaak.
Kaji eikunakinote embatatata lelo magil, ore imasaa o larrabal nerruoyo!

Ore te siadi ena neikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, “Kailep nanu alo atua ae nabo oo nkang'itie e Yuda?” Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Ilepa shomo.” Nejo Daudi, “Kaa anasa nabo ailep alo?” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Shomo Hebron.”
Neaku eilepa Daudi nelo ine, te nebo sii inkituaak enyena pokira are, Ahinoam e Yesreel o Abigail ina oliai apa e Nabal le Karmel.
Neyau Daudi ailepunye lelo tung'ana lenyena apa ootii te nebo ninye, oltung'ani ake o enkaji enye; nebik ninche too nkang'itie e Hebron.
Nepuonu iltungana le Yuda, nebukoki ninche Daudi eilata aaput teine aaitaa olaiguanani le nkaji e Yuda. Ore ake pee eliki ninche Daudi aajoki, “Iltung'ana le Yabesh Gilead apa ootunukaitie Saul,”
neirriwaki Daudi ilkiliku lelo tung'ana le Yabesh-gilead, nejoki ninche, “Entaa intae iloomayiana to Laitoriani, te nkaraki nintodolutua intae ena anyit te Saul, olkitok linyi, ninukaa ninye!
Meitodua intae Olaitoriani enyorrata nauno o enkisiligata! Naa kaitaas nanu intae esidai te nkaraki nitaasa ena bae.
Ore naa enchoo metagolo inkaik inyi, nipijuju; amu etua Saul olkitok linyi, naatubukokito nanu enkaji e Yuda eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani te shumata ninche.”
Ore apa Abna olayioni le Ner, olkitok le njore e Saul, neya Ishboshet olayioni le Saul, neyau ninye Mahanaim,
neitaa Abna ninye olaiguanani te shumata Gilead o Ashuri o Yesreel o Efraim o Benchamen o Israel pooki.
Ore apa Ishboshet, ilo ayioni le Saul, naa ilarin artam ina kata pee eiteru aitore Israel, neitore ninye ilarin oaare. Kake etusujaitie enkaji e Yuda Daudi.
Ore enkata apa nara Daudi olaiguanani te Hebron te shumata enkaji e Yuda naa ilarin oopishana o lapaitin ile.
Ore Abna olayioni le Ner o sinkan le Ishboshet olayioni le Saul, neipang aapuo te Mahanaim nepuo Gibeon.
Ore Yoab olayioni le Seruiya o sinkan le Daudi, neipang aapuo nenang'are ninche te nchorro e Gibeon; netoni ninche, obo te nchoto nabo e nchorro o likae te nkae shoto e nchorro.
Nejoki Abna Yoab, “Inchoo ilbarnot edumunye aarany te dukuya iyiook.” Nejo Yoab, “Inchoo edumunye ninche.”
Kaae nedumunye ninche nepuo te siana enye, tomon oaare ile Benchamen o Ishboshet ilo ayioni le Saul, o tomon oaare loo sinkan le Daudi.
Neibung ake oltung'ani ilo oarare endukuya nerrumoki olalem lenye eluboto e ilo oarare; neaku etabatatate te nebo. Neaku etejoki apa ine wueji Helkat-hasurim, naa Gibeon etii.
Nerrishu olarrabal ina olong, nemiri Abna o ltung'ana loo Siraeli te dukuya isinkan le Daudi.
Netii apa ine ilayiok pokira okuni le Seruiya, Yoab, Abishai o Asahel. Naa keneneng apa Asahel too nkejek anaa enkolii e ong'ata;
nemir Asahel Abna, ore eloito neitu ibelekenya aing'or enkaina e tatene aashu enkaina e kedianye esujaa Abna.
Nenang Abna silig nejo, “Kaiyie Asahel?” Newalu ninye, nejo “Ee nanu.”
Nejoki Abna ninye, “Shomo enkaina ino e tatene aashu ene kedianye, imbung'a obo loo lbarnot, pee iya nena naataarua ninye.” Kake meyieu Asahel neibelekenya te sujata enye.
Neitoki Abna aigil ajoki Asahel, “Shomo mikintoki asuj, kainyoo pee aar nanu iyie tua? Kaji naa aiko te nashumaki enkomom ai olalashe lino Yoab?”

Kake etanya ninye elo aapaash neaku etaremo Abna ninye enkoshoke to lmurrat le mpere enye, neaku eipang'ua empere te nkoriong enye, nebatata ninye teine, neye teine apa netii. Ore lelo apa pooki ooetuo ine wueji netabatatare Asahel neye, neitashe aaitirring'a.
Kake etimira Yoab o Abishai Abna; ore edoyio enkolong nepuonu ninche oldoinyo le Ama, laa ninye otii dukuya Gia te nkoitoi nalo olpurkel le Gibeon.
Neiturrurro tenebo iltung'ana le Benchamen te siadi Abna, neaku olwuampa obo, neitashe te ntopij o ldoinyo.
Neipot Abna Yoab, nejoki, “Amaa, keaku kedaa olalem intarasi? Aimiyiolo ajo keduaru enkiting'oto? Kebaa kenya enkata pee imbok iltung'ana linono metapala emirata oo lalashera lenye?”
Nejo Yoab, “Anaa enaishu Enkai, te neme iroro, esipa anaata etapala iltung'ana esujata oo lalashera lenye tadekenya.”
Neaku etoosho Yoab emowuo; neitashe iltung'ana pooki, neitu eitoki aasujaa Israel, aashu eitoki aara.
Ore Abna o ltung'ana lenyena nepuo ina kewarie pooki nepuo aaim atua Araba; nelang ninche olkeju le Yordan, nepuo endama pooki o meetu Mahanaim.
Neshukunye Yoab te mirata e Abna; ore ake pee eidip aiturrurro iltung'ana pooki te nebo, nemetii isinkan le Daudi iltung'ana tomon ooudo metii Asahel.
Kake etaara isinkan le Daudi iltung'ana iip uni o ntomoni ile metuata too ltung'ana le Abna lo losho le Benchamen.
Neya Yoab o ltung'ana lenyena osesen le Asahel, nenukaa te nkurare e papaai lenye, apa natii Betlehem. Nelo Yoab o ltung'ana lenyena enkewarie pooki, neilepaki ninche enkolong te Hebron.
Etii apa te nkata naado olarrabal te rishata enkaji e Saul o enkaji e Daudi; neponari Daudi agolu anaake edoyio enkaji e Saul ashalu anaake.
Neikini Daudi ilayiok te Hebron: ore olkikau lenye naa Amnon, le Ahinoam e Yesreel;
ore oliare, Kileab, le Abigail ina oliai apa e Nabal le Karmel; ore oliokuni, Absalom olayioni le Maaka ina tito e Talmai olaiguanani le Geshur;
ore olioong'uan, Adonija olayioni le Hagis; ore ole miet, Sefatia olayioni le Abital;
ore olayioni le ile, Isrem, le Egla, enkitok e Daudi. Etoikioki kulo ayiok Daudi te Hebron.
Ore etii olarrabal erishata e nkaji e Saul o enkaji e Daudi, neitagolito Abna kewan tiatua enkaji e Saul.
Neeta apa Saul enkapiani naji enkarna Rispa, entito e Aia; nejoki Ishboshet Abna, “Kainyoo pee ishomo iyie ajing'aki enkapiani e papaai lai?”

Negoro oleng Abna te lelo rorei le Ishboshet, nejo, “Kara nanu endukuya o ldia le Yuda? Ore ena olong eton ake aitodolu enkanyit te nkaji e Saul papaai lino, too lalashera lenyena, o too lchoreta lenyena, neton eitu aaishooyo iyie apik inkaik e Daudi; ore taata niking'uanare nanu te nkaraki enkitok.
Metaasa sii Enkai ena te Abna, neitulusoo sii, te neitu nanu aitabaya te Daudi ina apa nainosakinye Olaitoriani ninye olmumai,
aitarasaa enkitoria aitung'uaa enkaji e Saul, neitasheyie olorika le nkitoo le Daudi te shumata Israel o te shumata Yuda, ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba.”
Neitu eitoki Ishboshet aidimu atawaliki Abna likae omoni, amu eturia ninye.
Neirriwaa Abna ilkiliku enetii Daudi te Hebron, ejo, “Keneng'ae ena kop? Intobira olning'o lino o nanu, naa keaku enkaina ai te nebo o iyie pee ayau Israel pooki enitii iyie.”
Nejo Daudi, “Aisidai; Kaitobir nanu olning'o o iyie; kake nabo toki nanu aayieunye iyie; nchere midol iyie enkomom ai, aashu ake te niyau Mikal, entito e Saul, te nikilotu adol enkomom ai.”
Neirriwaki Daudi ilkiliku Ishboshet olayioni le Saul, ejoki, “Inchooki nanu enkitok ai Mikal, naa ninye apa atisira te nkinyang'a oo suaten iip oo Lfilisti.”
Neirriwaa Ishboshet ilkiliku, neya ninye aitung'uaa olpayian lenye Paltiel olayioni le Laish.
Kake eshomo olpayian lenye te nebo o ninye, eishir asujaa ninye te nkoitoi pooki o metabai Bahurim. Nejoki Abna ninye, “Shomo, torrinyoyu;” nerrinyo ninye.
Neiguana Abna te nebo o lpayiani kituaak le Israel, ejo, “Ore te nkata naje natulusoyie ning'oruru intae Daudi aaitaa olaiguanani te shumata intae.

Ore naa taata entabai intae; amu eitanapa Olaitoriani Daudi, ejo, ‘Te nkaina o sinka lai Daudi aitajeu nanu iltung'ana laainei Israel aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti; naitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye pooki.’ ”
Neirorie sii Abna Benchamen; neitoki Abna alo aliki Daudi te Hebron nena pooki naatodua Israel; pooki o enkaji e Benchamen pooki aajo aisidain te neas.
Ore pee elotu Abna te nebo iltung'ana tikitam enetii Daudi te Hebron, neitobiraki Daudi osirua Abna o lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye.

Nejoki Abna Daudi, “Kadumunye nanu alo, naa kaiturrurroki Israel pooki olkitok lai olaiguanani, pee etum ninche aaitobira olning'o o iyie, pee itum iyie aitoreisho te shumata nena pooki naayieu oltau lino.” Neaku eishoo Daudi Abna meshomo; nelo ninye te seriani.

Ore teina kata nebau lelo sinkan le Daudi te nebo Yoab eing'uaa enjore, neyau iyarunot kumok te nebo ninche. Kake metii apa Abna te nebo Daudi te Hebron, amu eishoo ninye meshomo, nelo ninye te seriani.
Ore ake pee ebau Yoab o ina jore pooki apa natii te nebo ninye, nejokini Yoab, “Eewuo Abna olayioni le Ner enetii olaiguanani, neishoo ninye meshomo, neshomo ninye te seriani.”
Nelo Yoab enetii olaiguanani nejo, “Kaa iyie itaasa? Ng'ura ajo eewuo Abna enitii, kainyoo pee inchoo ninye meshomo, neaku eshomo?
Iyiolo iyie ajo kiewuo Abna ilo ayioni le Ner alej, neyiolou elototo ino e boo o elotunoto ino e atua, neyiolou nena pooki niasita.”
Ore eipang'u Yoab aing'uaa ine netii Daudi, neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku metusujai Abna, nerik ninye aashuku teilo kesumet le Sira; kake eitu eyiolou Daudi ina.

Ore ake pee errinyunye Abna Hebron, neya Yoab ninye enkilepata te mpolos e kishomi pee eiro te nebo ninye too nkurrat, ore teine nerem ninye enkoshoke, neye ninye, te nkaraki ilo sarge le Asahel olalashe lenye.
Ore te siadi, ina kata pee ening Daudi ina, nejo ninye, “Ore nanu o enkitoria ai mikiata entioto intarasi te dukuya o Laitoriani te nkaraki osarge le Abna ilo ayioni le Ner.

Metaa endukuya e Yoab edoiki o enchumata enkaji pooki e papaai lenye; naa inchoo metaa melai aekata te nkaji e Yoab oltung'ani oata inkimek aashu enkeeya oo lbolot aashu oloibung'aa entirma aashu olosesekuani to lalem, aashu ololau endaa.”
Kaae near metua Yoab o Abishai olalashe lenye Abna, te nkaraki etaara apa ninye metua olalashe lenye Asahel tiatua olarrabal te Gibeon.

Neitoki Daudi ajoki Yoab o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye, “Entopolos inkilani inyi, nirrotianana ilkuniyiani, ninchirishiri te dukuya Abna.” Nesujaa olaiguanani Daudi ilo sanduku otii osesen.
Nenukaa ninche Abna te Hebron, neyietu olaiguanani aishir te nkurare e Abna; neishir iltung'ana pooki.
Nerany olaiguanani osinkolio lo lkiyioi, ejo “Keye Abna anaa enaiko te neye olmodai?
Meena apa inkaik inono, nemeena apa inkejek inono; Ore anaa enabatata oltung'ani te dukuya lelo torrok itabatate iyie.” Neitoki iltung'ana pooki aaishiraki ninye.

Nepuonu iltung'ana pooki aailejilej Daudi meinosa endaa eton aa dama; kake einosa Daudi olmumai, ejo, “Meikuna Enkai neijia te nanu, neitulusoo sii, te naishamisham endaa aashu ae toki eton eitu edoyio enkolong?”
Nedol iltung'ana pooki ina, neitiship ina ninche, amu ore apa pooki toki naas olaiguanani neitiship iltung'ana.
Neaku etayioloito iltung'ana pooki o Israel pooki ina olong inchere mme eyieunoto apa o laiguanani pee ear Abna olayioni le Ner.
Nejoki olaiguanani isinkan lenyena, “Aimiyiololo intae aajo olarikoni naa oltung'ani kitok oturori ena olong te Israel?

Nashal nanu ena olong, hoo naatubukokoki eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani; ore kulo tung'ana, ayiok le Seruiya naa kegolong'u oleng te nanu. Inchoo elaaki Olaitoriani olarruoni te risioroto enkarruoisho enye!”
Ore ake pee ening Ishboshet, olayioni le Saul, inchere etua Abna te Hebron, neiropijaa empijan enye, ore Israel pooki neiputukuny.

Neeta apa olayioni le Saul iltung'ana oaare laa ilkituaak loo Ltimito le njore; ore enkarna e obo naa Baana, ore enkarna o likae naa Rekab, ilayiok le Rimon oltung'ani le Benchamen oing'uaa Be-erot (amu keyioloi sii apa ninye Be-erot aajo ematua e Benchamen;
eisika apa Ilbeeroti aapuo Gitam netoni ninche teine o metabaiki ena olong.)

Neeta apa Yonatan olayioni le Saul olayioni maima tarrushi inkejek enyena. Naa oloo larin imiet apa ninye ina kata pee epuonu ilomon ooipirta Saul o Yonatan eing'uaa Yesreel; nedumu ninye enkaibung'ani enye, neisik, naa ore eisik te nkisarrisar enye, nebatata, neakunye ina olmaima. Ore apa enkarna enye naa Mefiboshet.

Ore apa ilayiok le Rimon ilo tung'ani le Be-erot naa Rekab o Baana, nepuo ninche, ore te nkata e nkipirata e nkolong nepuonu ninche enkaji e Ishboshet, etii ninye enkiyeng'iyeng enye a enaipirie nkolong.
Naa ng'ura, ore enkaing'urani e kutuk aji negelita enkano, neimug neirura; neaku etasaakinote Rekab o Baana olalashe lenye atua aji.

Ore pee ejing'u ninche atua aji eirrag Ishboshet te ndapash enye tiatua ilo gilata le ndapash, nerem ninye, near metua nedung'u endukuya enye. Neya ninche endukuya enye nepuo aaim enkoitoi e Araba enkewarie pooki,

neyau ninche endukuya e Ishboshet, enetii Daudi te Hebron. Nejoki ninche olaiguanani, “Nena endukuya e Ishboshet, olayioni le Saul, olmang'atinta lino oing'orua apa enkishui ino; eitalakua Olaitoriani elap o lkitok lai olaiguanani ena olong te Saul te ishoi enye.”
Kake etawalikia Daudi Rekab o Baana olalashe lenye, lelo ayiok le Rimon ilo le Be-erot ajoki, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, otokordua enkishui ai aitayu tiatua batisho pooki,
ore apa pee aajoki oltung'ani obo nanu, ‘Ng'ura ajo etua Saul.’ Nejo ninye keyaua ilomon sidain, naibung ninye naar ninye metua te Siklag, aa ilo apa olerrinyore laishoo nanu ninye too lomon lenyena.
Kebaa naa elusoo, te netaara iltung'ana torrok oltung'ani supat tiatua enkaji enye te nchumata e ndapash enye, aimaikilikuanu nanu osarge lenye te nkaina inyi, namut intae aiwuang'ie te nkop?”

Neitanap Daudi ilbarnot lenyena, metaara ninche metuata, nedung'oo inkaik enye o nkejek, neilili ninche te mbata o lchorro te Hebron. Kake ewaita ninche endukuya e Ishboshet, nenukaa te nkurare e Abna te Hebron.
Nepuonu iloshon pooki loo Siraeli enetii Daudi te Hebron, nejo, “Ng'ura ajo kira iyiook iloik linono o nkiri o sesen lino.

Ore too nkolong'i naatulusoitie apa aa Saul olaiguanani te shumata iyiook, iyie apa otorikoyie aipang'ie niriku aitijing'u Israel; nikijoki Olaitoriani iyie, ‘Iaku iyie olchekut loo ltung'ana laainei, Israel, naa iaku kitok te shumata Israel.’ ”

Neaku eetuo ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli enetii olaiguanani te Hebron; neitobir olaiguanani Daudi olning'o te nebo ninche te Hebron te dukuya o Laitoriani, nebukoki ninche Daudi eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani te shumata Israel.
Naa oloo larin tomoni uni apa Daudi pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ilarin artam.
Ore te Hebron neitore ninye Yuda ilarin oopishana o lapaitin ile; ore te Yerusalem neitore Israel pooki o Yuda ilarin tomoni uni o okuni.

Nelo olaiguanani o ltung'ana lenyena Yerusalem aarare Ilyebusi, lelo oomanya ina kop, apa ootiaakita Daudi, “Milotu iyie ajing'u atua ene, kake aikimbooyo ninye ilmodook o lmaiman” - ejo, “Meidim aekata Daudi aeu atua ine.”
Ore eyia eibung'a Daudi eng'ape e Sion, aa taa, enkanasa e Daudi.

Nejo Daudi teina olong, “Ore pooki ng'ae olo aar Ilyebusi, inchoo eilep to lbaata le nkare pee erasaki lelo modook o lmaiman, apa ooiba oltau le Daudi.” Neaku etejoki, “Ore olmodooni o lmaima melotu atua aji.”
Nebik Daudi tiatua ilo sempewuet nejo ninye enkanasa e Daudi. Neshet Daudi ina anasa aitamanaa ebaiki Milo neito atua.
Neaku Daudi kitok oleng oleng, amu ore Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, etii apa te nebo ninye.
Ore Hiram olaiguanani le Tiro neirriwaa ilkiliku enetii Daudi, neirriwaa sii iltarakua o laguetak loo nkeek o laguetak loo soito laa ninche ooteshetakita Daudi enkaji.
Neyiolou Daudi inchere eitasheyie Olaitoriani ninye aitaa olaiguanani le Israel o nchere eilepunye ninye enkitoo enye te nkaraki iltung'ana lenyena Israeli.
Neya Daudi inkapiak kumok o nkituaak te Yerusalem, eidipa aeu eing'uaa Hebron; neikini Daudi ilayiok kumok o ntoyie.
Naa kuna inkarn e lelo ootoikioki ninye te Yerusalem: Shamua o Shobab o Natan o Solomon
o Ibar o Elishua o Nefeg o Yafia
o Elishama o Eliada o Elifelet.
Ore ake pee ening Ilfilisti inchere etubukokoki Daudi eilata aaitaa olaiguanani te Israel, neilepu Ilfilisti pooki eing'oru Daudi; kake etoning'o Daudi ina nelo aisudori to sempewuet.
Neaku eetuo apa Ilfilisti neidapashakino oerata le Rafadim.

Neikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, ejo, “Amaa, kalo nanu aarare Ilfilisti? Inchoru iyie ninche apik atua enkaina ai?” Nejoki Olaitoriani Daudi, “Ilepa shomo; amu kesipa kaishoru nanu Ilfilisti apik atua enkaina ino.”

Nelotu Daudi Baal-Perasim, nemir Daudi ninche teine; nejo ninye, “Etigila Olaitoriani ilmang'ati laainei te dukuya nanu, anaa oloirrag le enkare teneosh enkuaas.” Neaku ore enkarna e ine wueji naa keji Baal-Perasim.
Neing'uaa Ilfilisti nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye teine, nenap Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena ninche aaya.
Neitoki ake Ilfilisti aaigil aailepu aapuonu, neidapashakino oerata le Refaim.
Ore ake pee eikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, nejo ninye, “Milep alo; shomo tamanai iimu te siadi, nilotu enetii ninche te nkishiaakinoto oo lkeek adoru ooji Balsam.
Ore ake pee ining oltoilo le lototo te nchumata oo lkeek, ina kata tonyuaa amu etaa keipang Olaitoriani alo te dukuya ino aar enjore oo Lfilisti.”
Neas Daudi anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye, near Ilfilisti eiteru te Geba o metabaiki Gesa.
Neitoki Daudi aiturrur lelo tung'ana pooki gelunot te Israel, inkalifuni tomoni uni.

Nedumunye Daudi nelo te nebo iltung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye ebaiki Baale-Yuda, pee eyau aailepunye aaitung'uaa ine osanduku le Nkai, laa ninye eipotieki enkarna o Laitoriani loo lororani oton ninye te nkitoo te nchumata oo lkerubi.
Nenap ninche ilo sanduku le Nkai te ngarri ng'ejuk, neyau ninye aaipang'unye te nkaji e Abinadab apa natii enchumata e ndoinyo; ore Usa o Ahio lelo ayiok le Abinadab nereu ina garri ng'ejuk,
te nebo ilo sanduku le Nkai; nelo Ahio dukuya ilo sanduku.

Ore Daudi o enkaji pooki e Israel neiguranita apa te dukuya Olaitoriani te nkidimata enye, too sinkolioitin, too lwululi loo usin o nkai oo sinkolioitin, o ntampurini o kulie kinantani, o saanini naaitooshi aaranyishore.
Ore ake pee epuonu ninche ilo kurroto oidong'ishoreki le Nakon neitorioki Usa enkaina enye ilo sanduku le Nkai, neibung amu etarrorrote lelo mong'i.
Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani te nkaraki Usa, near Enkai ninye teine te nkaraki naitorioyie enkaina enye aibung ilo sanduku; neye ninye teine te mbata ilo sanduku le Nkai.
Negoro apa Daudi te nkaraki natara Olaitoriani Usa; ore ine wueji naa keji Peres-usa, o metabaiki ena olong.
Neureyu apa Daudi Olaitoriani ina olong; nejo ninye, “Kaji eiko te nelotu osanduku lo Laitoriani enatii nanu?”
Neaku meyieu apa Daudi neya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani atua enkanasa e Daudi; kake eiteng'ela Daudi aya enkaji e Obed-Edom ilo Giti.
Neton ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani tiatua enkaji e Obed-e-dom ilo Giti ilapaitin okuni; nemayian Olaitoriani Obed-e-dom o enkaji enye pooki.

Nelikini apa olaiguanani Daudi aajoki, “Etamayiana Olaitoriani enkaji e Obed-Edom o pooki nara enenye, te nkaraki ilo sanduku le Nkai.” Neaku eshomo Daudi neyau ailepunye ilo sanduku le Nkai aitung'uaa e nkaji e Obed-e-dom aya enkanasa e Daudi eng'ida;
ore ake pee epuo lelo oonapita ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani iroruat ile, nepolos ninye olkiteng o lashe opir.
Neiguran Daudi te dukuya Olaitoriani te nkidimata enye pooki; neterretene apa Daudi te nkarasha dorrop napuyiapui.
Neaku eyawua apa Daudi o enkaji e Israel pooki osanduku lo Laitoriani aailepunye te mbuakunoto o to ltoilo le mowuo.
Ore elotu ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani atua ina anasa e Daudi, neing'orisho Mikal entito e Saul te lusie, nedol Olaiguanani Daudi eipid neiguran te dukuya Olaitoriani; nemenu ninye to ltau lenye.

Neyau ninche atua ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani, neirragie ninye te wueji enye, tiatua olng'obor otuuno Daudi te nkaraki ninye; neishoru Daudi ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Ore ake pee eidip Daudi aishooi ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani, nemayian ninye iltung'ana te nkarna o Laitoriani loo lororani,

neishooyo tiatua iltung'ana pooki ina siamo pooki e Israel, ilewa o nkituaak, o ltung'ani ake emukate napurupurana, o ldung'oti le nkiring'o o emukate oo lng'anayio ooitoyioki. Nepuo iltung'ana pooki le Israel, oltung'ani ake enkang enye.

Neshuko Daudi alo amayian enkaji enye. Kake eipang'ua Mikal entito e Saul alotu anang'are Daudi, nejo, “Kebaa duoo taata enkanyit nayanyita olaiguanani le Israel kewan, aiturraa duoo taata inkilani te dukuya inkonyek oo nkaisiaayiak o sinkan lenyena, anaa obo loo ltung'ana oomoda oiturraa inkilani medol enkurruna!”

Nejoki Daudi Mikal, “Te dukuya Olaitoriani laa ninye apa laategelua te shumata papaai lino o te shumata enkaji enye pooki naagelu nanu aitaa kitok te shumata Israel, iltung'ana lo Laitoriani - naa kashipa nanu te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Naa kasul nanu kewan oleng aitalang ena, naaitadouni too nkonyek inono; kake ore te nena sinkan naa ninche iimaka, ore ninche naa kaayanyit nanu oleng.”
Ore Mikal ina tito e Saul neitu aekata etum enkerai o metua.
Ore apa ebikito olaiguanani te nkaji enye, neishoo ninye Olaitoriani enkiyeng'iyeng too lmang'ati lenyena pooki oomanita.
Nejoki olaiguanani Natan ilo oiboni, “Ng'ura taata, abikito nanu te nkaji oo ltarakua, kake ore osanduku le Nkai netonita tiatua olng'obor.”
Nejoki Natan olaiguanani, “Shomo, taasa ina pooki natii atua oltau lino; amu ketii Olaitoriani te nebo o iyie.”
Kake ore ina kewarie ake nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Natan ajoki,
“Shomo tiaaki osinka lai Daudi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Amaa, aikishetaki iyie enkaji nabikie tiatua?
Eitu aekata nanu aton tiatua enkaji ebaiki enkolong apa nailepunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli aitung'uaa Misiri o metabaiki ena olong, kake to lng'obor oshi aloolo aitaa emanyisho ai.

Ore tiatua iwuejitin pooki nashomo nanu te nebo iltung'ana pooki le Israel, eitu nanu airo ororei te likae hoo obo loo larishak loo Israeli laa ninche aitanapa meirrita iltung'ana laainei Israeli, ajoki; Kainyoo pee eitu kishetakiki nanu enkaji oo ltarakua?’

Ore naa nji tiaaki osinka lai Daudi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, aawa apa nanu iyie aitung'uaa enkirritare, aitung'uaa esujata oo nkerra, pee itum ataa olkitok te shumata iltung'ana laainei Israel;
natii nanu te nebo o iyie te pooki wueji nishomo, naar ilmang'ati linono pooki aiwuang'ie te dukuya ino; naa kaaitobiraki nanu iyie enkarna kitok, anaa enkarna e lelo kituaak le nkop.

Naa kagelu nanu ewueji te nkaraki iltung'ana laainei Israel, naun nanu ninche, pee etum aatobik te wueji enye maate, nemeitokini ae kata aaitanyamal; nemeitoki iltung'ana lo larrabal aaisilisil ninche, anaa apa,

ebaiki ina kata apa nagelu ilarishak apik shumata iltung'ana laainei Israel; naa kaaisho nanu iyie enkiyeng'iyeng too lmang'ati linono pooki. Ore ake eibalunye Olaitoriani te iyie inchere, eikintaa iyie Olaitoriani enkaji.
Ore te neiputayu inkolong'i inono nirrag iyie te nebo loo papaai lino, nadamu nanu eishoi ino te siadi iyie, ilo olotu aing'uaa osesen lino, naitubulaa nanu enkitoo enye.
Keshet ninye enkaji te nkaraki enkarna ai, naa kaitasheyie nanu olorika le nkitoo enye intarasi.
Naaku nanu papaai lenye, neaku ninye olayioni lai. Te neas ninye entorroni, naitame nanu ninye te ng'udi e tung'ani o too oshot e nkerai e tung'ani;
kake maiwuang'ie nanu enyorrata ai nauno aitung'uaa ninye, anaa apa enaiwuang'ie te Saul, ilo apa laiwuang'ie nanu te dukuya iyie.
Ore enkaji ino o enkitoria naa keitisipi te dukuya nanu; ore olorika lino le nkitoo keitasheyieki intarasi.’ ”
Ore te risioroto e kulo rorei, o te risioroto ena duaata pooki, neirorie Natan Daudi.
Nelo olaiguanani Daudi atua neton te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, Kara nanu ng'ae, Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, naa kainyoo enkaji ai, metaa eikiyawua nanu eneba nji?

Ore ake eyia naa entoki kiti apa ena too nkonyek inono, Olaitoriani Enkai; iroro sii iyie te nkaraki enkaji o sinka lino te nkata sapuk nalotu, nikintoduaa nanu iishoritin naapuonu, Olaitoriani Enkai!
Naa kainyoo ae nikijoki Daudi iyie? Amu iyiolo iyie osinka lino, Olaitoriani Enkai!
Te nkaraki enkisiligata ino, naa te risioroto oltau lino, itaasa iyie ena e nkitoo aidimie osinka lino metayiolo ina.
Metaa ira iyie kitok, Ee Olaitoriani Enkai; amu metii likae oikununo anaa iyie, nemetii ae Ai neme iyie ake, te risioroto e nena pooki nikitoning'o too nkiyiaa ang.

Kalo likae orere ti oriong e nkop oikununo anaa iltung'ana linono Israel, laa ninche eshomo Enkai akordu aitaa iltung'ana lenyena, aitobiraki kewan enkarna, neas te nkaraki ninche intokitin kituaak naaitureisho, te yararoto te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena iloreren o nkaitin enye?
Nintasheyie te nkaraki kewan ino iltung'ana linono Israel metaa iltung'ana linono intarasi; ore iyie, Olaitoriani, niaku Enkai enye.
“Ore taata, Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, intisipa intarasi ilo rorei liroro iyie oipirta osinka lino neipirta enkaji enye, nias anaa eniroro;
naa kerupi enkarna ino intarasi, eji, ‘Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye Enkai oo Siraeli,’ ore enkaji o sinka lino Daudi neitubulari te dukuya iyie.
Amu iyie, ee Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, naitayio ena bolunoto aitodol osinka lino, ijo, ‘Kaashetaki iyie enkaji;’ neaku etagolo osinka lino oshoke pee kiomon iyie ena omono.
Ore taata, iyie Olaitoriani Enkai, iyie Enkai, nesipa irorei linono, nisiligie ena toki sidai osinka lino;

ore naa taata tishipayu iyie pee imayian enkaji osinka lino, pee etum ashomo dukuya intarasi te dukuya iyie; amu ore iyie, ee Olaitoriani Enkai, niroro, naa te mayianata ino emayiani enkaji o sinka lino intarasi.”
Ore te siadi ena nemir Daudi Ilfilisti neitoreu ninche, neya Daudi Metegama aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti.
Nemir ninye Moab, netem ninche to lgosoi, aisho ninche meirraga te nkop; ore ilkererin oaare netemi pee eari metuata, ore olkereri obo olulung'a nepali. Neaku Ilmoabu isinkan le Daudi neyaki kodi.
Neitoki sii Daudi amir Hadadesa olayioni le Rehob, olaiguanani le Soba, eloito arrinyu enkitoo enye to lkeju le Frati.

Neya Daudi aitung'uaa ninye enkalifu o iip naapishana o sikarini ooked imbartan oo sikarini inkalifuni tikitam oopuo too nkejek nedung Daudi irrisheta mbartan pooki oo ngarrin, kake etelekua inaaidip ingarrin iip oo mbartan.
Ore ake pee epuonu Isiria le Dameski aaretu Hadadesa ilo aiguanani le Soba, near Daudi metuata iltung'ana inkalifuni tikitam oaare loo Siria.
Nepik Daudi iltimito atua Aram e Dameski; neaku Isiria isinkan le Daudi neyaki kodi. Neisho Olaitoriani Daudi metimirisho te pooki wueji neba anaa eneshomo.
Neya Daudi ilong'oi e saabu apa naanapita isinkan le Hadadesa, neyau ninche Yerusalem.
Ore ebaiki Beta ometabaiki Berotai, inkanas e Hadadesa, neya olaiguanani Daudi isuyan kumok.
Ore ake pee ening Toi olaiguanani le Hamat inchere etimira Daudi enjore pooki e Hadadesa,

neirriwaa Toi olayioni lenye Yoram enetii olaiguanani Daudi, o pee eisho ninye enchunet te nkaraki nataarare Hadadesa nemir ninye; amu kesesh apa eeta Hadadesa olarrabal o Toi. Neyau Yoram te nebo ninye intokitin e nkosholai, o saabu o no suyai.
Ore sii kuna neitisiny olaiguanani Daudi to Laitoriani, te nebo ina osholai o saabu apa naaitisinya naaing'uaa iloreren pooki apa ootimira ninye,
ebaiki Edom o Moab o Ilamoni o Filistia o Amaleki o naaing'uaa iyarunot e Hadadesa olayioni le Rehob, olaiguanani le Soba.
Neishur enkarna e Daudi. Ore pee eshukunye ninye, nesesekuan Iltung'ana inkalifuni tomon o isiet tiatua Oerata le Munyan.
Nepik ninye iltimito Edom; ore ile Edom pooki neaku isinkan le Daudi. Neisho Olaitoriani Daudi metimirisho te pooki wueji neba anaa eneshomo.
Neaku eitoria apa Daudi Israel pooki; neisiaaisho Daudi te sipata o te risioroto too ltung'ana lenyena pooki.
Naa Yoab olayioni le Seruiya apa oitore enjore, naa Yehoshafat olayioni le Ahilud apa olaigeroni.
Naa Sadok apa olayioni le Ahitab o Ahimelek olayioni le Abiata ninche ilapolosak; naa Seraia apa olasirani;
naa Benaia olayioni le Yehoida apa otii shumata lelo Kereti o lelo le Peleti ore ilayiok le Daudi naa ilapolosak.
Nejo Daudi, “Keton etii oltung'ani obo otelekua te nkaji e Saul, pee atum nanu aitoduaa ninye esupatisho te nkaraki Yonatan?”
Netii apa osinka le nkaji e Saul oji Siba, neipotu ninche ninye enetii Daudi; nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Ira iyie Siba?” Nejo ninye, “Ore osinka lino naa ninye ilo.”

Nejo olaiguanani, “Aimeton etii likae obo le nkaji e Saul, pee atum nanu aitoduaa ninye esupatisho e Nkai?” Nejoki Siba olaiguanani, “Eton etii olayioni le Yonatan; olmaima ninye tarrushi inkejek enyena.”
Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Koree ninye?” Nejoki Siba olaiguanani, “Etii atua enkaji e Makir olayioni le Amiel te Lo-Debar.”
Kaae neirriwaa olaiguanani meyauni ninye aaitung'uaa enkaji e Makir ole Amiel, te Lo-debar.
Nelotu Mefiboshet, olayioni le Yonatan ole Saul enetii Daudi, nebatata te nkomom enye neserem. Nejo Daudi, “Mefiboshet!” Newal ninye, “Nele osinka lino.”
Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Miureisho; amu kaaitodol nanu esupatisho te nkaraki papaai lino Yonatan, naa kaashukoki iyie enkop pooki e Saul papaai lino; nidaa iyie te misa ai anaake.”
Neserem ninye, nejo, “Kainyoo ninye osinka lino, metaa ing'or iyie oldia otua anaa nanu?”
Neipotu olaiguanani Siba, ilo sinka le Saul, nejoki ninye, “Ore nena pooki apa naara ine Saul o ne nkaji enye pooki aishoo nanu olayioni lo lkitok lino.

Ore iyie o layiok linono o sinkan linono niturokiki ninye enkurma niyauu atua nena nintayuyu, pee etum olayioni lo lkitok lino endaa nanya; kake ore Mefiboshet olayioni lo lkitok lino nedaa anaake te misa ai.” Neeta apa Siba ilayiok tomon o imiet o sinkan tikitam.

Nejoki Siba olaiguanani, “Ore te risioroto e nena pooki, naaitanap olkitok lai olaiguanani osinka lenye, neaku ina eas osinka lino.” Neaku etadee Mefiboshet te misa e Daudi, anaa obo loo layiok lo laiguanani.
Neeta apa mefiboshet olayioni oti oji enkarna Mika. Ore pooki ootobiko te nkaji e Siba neaku isinkan le Mefiboshet.
Neaku etobiko Mefiboshet te Yerusalem; amu kedaa apa ninye anaake te misa o laiguanani. Naa olmaima apa too nkejek enyena pokira are.
Ore te siadi ena neye olaiguanani loo Lamoni neitoreishoyo Hanan olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

Nejo Daudi, “Kaitodol nanu esupatisho Hanan olayioni le Nashash, anaa apa enaaitaasa papaai lenye nanu te supatisho.” Neaku eirriwayie Daudi isinkan lenyena pee eitigir ninye tialo papaai lenye. Nepuonu isinkan le Daudi atua enkop oo Lamoni.

Kake etiaakita lelo kituaak loo Lamoni Hanan olkitok lenye, “Ijo iyie ore te nkaraki nikirriwaka iyie Daudi iltung'ana likintagol naa keyanyitita papaai lino? Keitu ninye eirriu Daudi isinkan lenyena enitii iyie pee eing'or enkanasa, neikitalan ninye, nenang'aa ninye?”
Neaku ewa Hanan isinkan le Daudi, nebarn ake enchoto o lmunyei lo ltung'ani nedung inkilani enye too mpolosi enye neisho ninche meshomo.

Ore ake pee elikini Daudi, neirriwaa iltung'ana metanang'are ninche, amu etukurrutua apa lelo tung'ana oleng. Nejo olaiguanani, “Entotoni te Yeriko o metaba anaa nebulu ilmunyo linyi, pee intokiki aashukunye.”

Ore ake pee edol lelo tung'ana le Amoni aajo etaa ilmang'ati te Daudi, neirriwaa lelo tung'ana le Amoni ilkiliku aaisho esiaai Isiria le Beterehob, o Isiria le Soba, isikarini inkalifuni tikitam oopuo too nkejek o laiguanani le Maaka te nebo iltung'ana enkalifu o ltung'ana le Tob, iltung'ana inkalifuni tomon o are.
Ore ake pee ening Daudi ina, neirriwaa Yoab o lorora pooki lo ltung'ana magil.
Nepuonu Ilamoni aaipang'u neluaa to larrabal te kishomi; ore lelo Siria le Soba o le Rehob o ltung'ana le Tob o Maaka netii ninche maate enkop naisiasha.
Ore pee edol Yoab inchere eirragieki olarrabal aarare ninye te dukuya o te siadi, negelu ninye embata oo ltung'ana gelunot le Israel, neitobiraki ninche metaarare Isiria;
ore ilkulikae pooki loo ltung'ana lenyena nepik ninye atua enkitoria e Abishai olalashe lenye, neitobiraki ninche metaarare Ilamoni.
Nejo Yoab, “Tenaa kegol oleng Isiria te nanu, naa eikiretu iyie nanu; kake tenaa kegol oleng Ilamoni te iyie naa kaalotu nanu aretu iyie.
Intagoluoyu, naa mataa lewa te nkaraki iltung'ana lang, o too nkanas e Nkai ang; naa inchoo metaasa Olaitoriani ina nadol aa sidai te ninye.”
Neaku etupunyakita Yoab o lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye olarrabal aarare Isiria; neisik aailanyisho ninche te dukuya ninye.
Ore pee edol Ilamoni aajo eilanyishote Isiria, neiko sii ninche neijia aailanyisho te dukuya Abishai, nejing atua enkanasa. Kaae neshukunye Yoab aing'uaa olarrabal loo Lamoni, nelotu Yerusalem.
Kake ore ake pee edol Isiria aajo etimira ninche Israel, neiturrurro maate te nebo.
Neirriwaa Hadadesa olkilikuai, neyau aitupuku lelo Siria apa ootii teidia alo Frati; nepuonu ninche Helam, te nebo Shobak olkitok le njore e Hadadesa te dukuya ninche.
Ore ake pee elikini Daudi, neiturrur ninye Israeli pooki te nebo, nelang Yordan, nepuonu Helam. Neitobira Isiria maate aarare Daudi, neitayu olarrabal te nebo ninye.

Neisik Isiria aailanyisho te dukuya Israel, near Daudi metuata too ltung'ana le Siria iip naapishana loo ngarrin, o lakedok loo mbartan inkalifuni artam, nepik olbae Shobak ilo kitok le njore enye, neaku etua ninye teine.
Ore pee edol lelo aiguanak pooki apa laa isinkan le Hadadesa ninche etimira Israel neitayu ninche osotua te nebo Israel, neaku isinkan te ninche. Neaku etureita Isiria eitoki aaretu Ilamoni.

Ore te nkiterunoto o lari, ina kata apa napuoyie ilaiguanak olarrabal, neirriwaa Daudi Yoab o sinkan lenyena te nebo ninye o Israel pooki, neitalaku ninche elap too ltung'ana le Amoni neman aamuat Raba. Kake etotona Daudi te Yerusalem.

Ore nabo olong, etigile enkolong ore pee edumunye Daudi te ndapash enye, neloolo ninye te nchumata e nkaji o laiguanani, nedol ninye te nchumata olperere enkitok nagira aitukuo; naa aisidai ina kitok oleng.
Neirriwaa Daudi olkilikuai aikilikuanu ina kitok. Nejo obo, “Aime Batsheba ena, entito e Eliam, enkitok e Uria Olhiti?”
Neaku eirriwayie Daudi ilkiliku, neya ninye; nelotu ninye enetii, neboitare ninye ninye. (Naa keitobira apa ninye kewan te nkiduruk enye o lapa.) Neitoki ashuko alo enkaji enye.
Nenutayu ina kitok; neirriwaa ninye olkilikuai nejoki Daudi, “Atunute.”
Neirriwaki Daudi Yoab oratioti, ajoki, “Irriwakaki nanu Uria loo Lhiti.” Neirriwaa Yoab Uria enetii Daudi.
Ore pee elotu Uria enetii ninye, neikilikuanu Daudi enaasita Yoab o eneikununo iltung'ana o eneikunari olarrabal.
Nejoki Daudi Uria, “Tadoi shomo enkaji ino, pee intuku inkejek inono.” Neipang Uria alo te nkaji o laiguanani, nesujaa ninye enkishooroto naing'uaa olaiguanani.
Kake eirure Uria te kutukaji e nkaji o laiguanani te nebo isinkan pooki lo lkitok lenye, neitu elo enkaji enye.
Ore ake pee ejoki ninche Daudi, “Eitu edoyio Uria alo enkaji enye,” nejoki Daudi Uria, “Keitu iyie ilotu aing'uaa enkop naado kainyoo pee eitu idoyio alo enkaji ino?”

Nejoki Uria Daudi, “Ore osanduku le Nkai e Israel o Yuda nebikito too lng'oborri; ore olkitok lai Yoab o sinkan lo lkitok lai netii ilng'oborri ti ong'ata naisiasha; kaji nanu aiko tenalo enkaji ai, adaa naokisho, nairrag te nebo enkitok ai? Ore anaa eninchu o anaa enaishu oltau lino, maas nanu ena bae.”
Neitoki Daudi ajoki Uria, “Totona ake sii taata tene, ore taaisere naaisho iyie shomo.” Neaku etotona Uria te Yerusalem ina olong o pee ekenyu.

Neitoomon Daudi ninye, nedaa ninye te dukuya ninye neokisho, neaku eitemera ninye; ore te nteipa neipang ninye alo airrag te ndapash enye te nebo isinkan lo lkitok lenye, kake eitu ninye edoyio alo enkaji enye.
Ore tadekenya neigeroki Daudi Yoab empalai, neirriwaa te nkaina e Uria.
Ore tiatua empalai neiger ajo, “Tipika Uria enkomom o larrabal ogol, paa intokiki aaitiakunye aaing'uaa ninye, pee etumi aatar metua.”
Ore emanita Yoab enkanasa neisho ninye Uria ewueji neyiolo ajo ketii iltung'ana oopi.
Neipang'u iltung'ana le nkanasa aapuonu aarare Yoab, ore embata oo ltung'ana le Daudi tiatua iltung'ana neurori. Ore Uria ilo Hiti nesesekuani sii ninye.
Neirriwaa Yoab olkilikuai aliki Daudi ilomon pooki lo larrabal.
Neitanap ninye ilo kilikuai, ajoki, “Ore ake pee indip ainosaki ilomon pooki lo larrabal olaiguanani,
ore ake pee eilep, engoro o laiguanani, ore ake pee kijoki iyie, ‘Kainyoo intae pee ishomo aataaniki enkang oleng to larrabal? Keitu intae iyiolouu aajo keng'oru mbaa te suntai.

Kaing'ae apa natara Abimelek olayioni le Yerubeshet metua? Aime enkitok natanang'ua osoit oidong'ishoreki aitadoiki te suntai, neaku etua ninye te Tebes. Kainyoo intae pee ishomo oleng aanyikaki esuntai?’ Nijo iyie, ‘Ore sii osinka lino Uria Olhiti etua sii ninye.’ ”
Kaae nelo ilo kilikuai, nelotu neliki Daudi nena pooki naairriwua Yoab ninye metoliki.
Nejoki ilo tung'ani lo lkilikuai Daudi, “Enotokito iyiook iltung'ana, neipang'u aapuonu aarare iyiook ti ong'ata; kake kiterewa aashukoki enejing'ieki kishomi.
Neng'or iltung'ana loo mbaa isinkan linono te suntai; netuata embata oo sinkan lo laiguanani; ore osinka lino Uria Olhiti netua sii ninye.”
Nejoki Daudi ilo kilikuai, “Inji iyie shomo tiaaki Yoab, ‘Mincho iyie ena bae kintanyamal, amu kear olalem pooki ng'ae. Ntirrisha erasakinoto ino e nkanasa nimbung ninye.’ Nintagol ninye oshoke.”
Ore pee ening enkitok e Uria inchere etua Uria olpayian lenye, neishir ninye olkiyioi lo sina te nkaraki olpayian lenye.
Ore pee eishunye olkiyioi, neirriwaa Daudi olkilikuai neyau ninye enkaji enye, neaku ninye enkitok enye, neiki ninye olayioni. Kake ore ina bae nataasa Daudi neitu eitiship Olaitoriani.
Neirriwaa Olaitoriani Natan enetii Daudi. Nelotu Natan enetii Daudi nejoki ninye, “Etii apa iltung'ana oaare enkang naje, naa karsis obo naa aisinani olikae.
Ore ilo tung'ani karsis neeta nkerra kumok o nkishu;

kake ore ilo tung'ani aisinani nemeeta toki meteleku ake enkiti supen e ker, apa nainyiang'ua ninye. Neoroo ninye, nebulu ninye te nebo ninye o te nebo nkera enyena; naa keng'arie apa ninye endaa enye, neokisho te nkikompe enye, neirrag to lgoo lenye, netiu apa ninye anaa entito te ninye.

Nelotu apa olomoni enetii ilo tung'ani karsis, nemeyieu apa ninye neya too nkerrai enyena aashu too nchoo aitoki pee eitobiraki ilo otudung'uo enkop oewuo enetii ninye, kake ewa ninye olkuoo le ilo aisinani, neitobiraki ilo tung'ani apa oewuo enetii ninye.”
Neyupuyup oleng engoro e Daudi te nkaraki ilo tung'ani; nejoki ninye Natan, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, ore ilo tung'ani otaasa ena keishiaakino neye;
nelak ilo kuoo katitin ong'uan, te nkaraki ena bae, o te nkaraki nemeeta olng'ur.”
Nejoki Natan Daudi, “Iyie ilo tung'ani. Inji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ‘Aatubukoko iyie eilata aput aitaa olaiguanani te shumata Israel naatokordua iyie aitayu te nkaina e Saul;
naaisho nanu iyie enkaji o lkitok lino, o nkituaak o lkitok lino to lgoo lino, naaisho iyie enkaji e Israel o ene Yuda; naa tenaa aikiti ena, naaponiki nanu iyie inkumok oleng.

Kainyoo iyie pee itemenayie ororei lo Laitoriani, pee ias ina suuji too nkonyek enyena? Itasesekuana iyie Uria ilo Hiti to lalem, niya enkitok enye metaa enkitok ino, nitara ninye to lalem loo Lamori.
Ore naa taata meiwuang'a aekata olalem te nkaji ino amu kitemena nanu, niya enkitok e Uria ilo Hiti metaa enkitok ino.

Inji ejo Olaitoriani, Kadumu nanu entorroni nikiarare iyie tiatua enkaji ino makewan; naya nanu inkituaak inono te dukuya inkonyek inono, naisho nanu ninche olelatia ino, neirrag ninye te nebo inkituaak inono dama ena olong.
Amu itaasa iyie too nkisudorot kake kaas nanu ena te dukuya Israel pooki, naas nanu dama.’ ”
Nejoki Daudi Natan, “Ataasa nanu eng'oki to Laitoriani.” Nejoki Natan Daudi, “Eiwuang'ie sii ninye Olaitoriani eng'oki ino; miye iyie.
Ore eyia, te nkaraki ore tena yasata nintorioko iyie amor Olaitoriani, keye ina kerai nikitoikioki iyie.” Nelo Natan enkaji enye.
Neosh Olaitoriani ina kerai apa natoikio enkitok e Uria Daudi, nemuoyu ninye.
Nesai Daudi Enkai te nkaraki ina kerai; nepukoo Daudi, nelo atua neirrag enkewarie te nkop.
Ore ilpayiani le nkaji enye neitashe te mbata ninye, pee edumu ninye aaitung'uaa enkop; kake medumunye ninye, nemenya ninye endaa te nebo ninche.

Ore te nkolong e naapishana neye ina kerai. Neureyu isinkan le Daudi eliki ninye inchere etua enkerai; amu etejo ninche, “Ng'ura ajo ore apa eton eishu enkerai, nikirorie iyiook ninye, neitu ninye ening iyiook; kaji naa kinko ti nikijoki ninye inchere etua enkerai? Keidim ninye aitaasa kewan ae torrono.”
Kake ore pee edol Daudi inchere keing'oming'omakino isinkan lenyena, nemuso Daudi ajo etua enkerai; nejoki Daudi isinkan lenyena, “Ketua enkerai?” Nejo ninche, “Etua ninye.”

Kaae nedumunye Daudi te nkop, neitukuo, neel kewan te ilata, neibelekeny inkilani enyena nelo ninye atua enkaji o Laitoriani, neserem; neitoki ninye alo enkaji enye kewan; ore pee eikilikuanu endaa, neirragieki endaa te dukuya ninye, nenya ninye.
Nejoki isinkan lenyena, “Kainyoo ena bae nitaasa iyie? Itupukoyie ninchiraki eton eishu; kake ore ake pee eye enkerai nidumunye ninya endaa.”
Nejo ninye, “Ore apa eton eishu enkerai, napukoo naishir; amu atejo nanu, ‘Kaing'ae oyiolo tenaa kaaing'urrie nanu Olaitoriani, pee epok enkerai?’
Kake ore taata etua; kainyoo naa pee apukoo nanu? Kaidim anyaaki atushuku ninye? Kalo nanu enetii ninye, kake meshukunye ninye enatii nanu.”
Neilejilej Daudi enkitok enye, Bet-sheba, nelo enetii ninye, neirrag te nebo ninye, neiu ninye olayioni, nejo enkarna enye Solomon. Naa kenyor apa ninye Olaitoriani.
Naa kenyor apa Olaitoriani ninye neirriwaa olkilikuai te Natan ilo oiboni, neaku etejo ninye enkarna enye Yedidia, te nkaraki kenyor Olaitoriani ninye.
Nearare Yoab Raba loo Lamoni, neya ina ang e nkitoo.
Neirriwaa Yoab ilkiliku enetii Daudi, nejo, “Ataarare nanu Raba, ore sii, aawa nanu ina anasa oo nkariak.
Ore naa taata, inturrurro tenebo ilkulikae tung'ana, nintayuyu ilng'oborri aaipirakinore enkanasa, niyaya ninye, pee maya ake nanu ina anasa, neaku te nkarna ai eipoti.”
Neaku eiturrurro Daudi iltung'ana pooki tenebo nepuo Raba, nearare ninye neya ninye.

Neya ninye olmarisian le nkitoo lo laiguanani lenye te lukunya enye, ore apa enkiroishi enye naa entalanta e saabu, netii atua ninye osoit ogol e nkinyang'a; nepiki ninye endukuya e Daudi. Neya ninye nena yarunot e ina anasa intokiting kumok oleng.

Neyau ninye lelo tung'ana apa ootii atua enkanasa, nepik ninche enkisiaayiare too sooi, o sururuni o ntoluo, neisho ninche meteekenyata te mpejoto oo lmatofali naa inji eikuna ninye too nkanas pooki oo Lamoni. Kaae neitoki Daudi o ltung'ana pooki aashuko Yerusalem.
Ore apa Absalom, olayioni le Daudi, neeta enkanashe sidai naji enkarna Tamar; ore pee elusoo enkata, nenyorru ninye Amnon, olayioni le Daudi.
Neisomita oleng Amnon o metaba anaa nemuoyu te nkaraki enkanashe enye Tamar; amu eselenkei apa nemeyiolo olee neaku etaliee ajo meidimayu te Amnon pee eitaas ninye ae.
Kake eeta apa Amnon olchore, oji enkarna Yonadab, olayioni le Shimea, olalashe le Daudi; ore apa Yonadab naa oltung'ani kalamas oleng.
Nejoki Yonadab Amnon, “Olayioni lo laiguanani, kainyoo pee igira asasu anaake? Aimikiliki iyie nanu?” Nejoki Amnon ninye, “Kanyor nanu Tamar, enkanashe o lalashe lai Absalom.”

Nejoki Yonadab Amnon, “Irraga te ndapash ino, nintaakuno anaa imuoi; ore ake pee kilotu papaai lino adol, tiaaki ninye, ‘Inchoo enkanashe ai Tamar aalotu aisho endaa nanya, neitobir endaa te dukuya nanu, pee atum nanu atoduaa ina daa, nanya nanu te nkaina enye.’ ”

Neaku eirraga Amnon, neitaakuno kemuoi; ore ake pee elotu olaiguanani adol ninye, nejoki Amnon olaiguanani, “Inchoo siaake enkanashe ai Tamar elotu aitobir inkuti mukateni te dukuya nanu, pee aatum ninye aishoo endaa.”
Neirriwaa Daudi olkilikuai enetii Tamar nejoki, “Shomo enkaji olalashe lino Amnon, intobiraki ninye endaa.”
Neaku eshomo Tamar enkaji o lalashe lenye Amnon, ine apa neirragie. Neya ninye enkurma, neipurj, neitobir imukateni too nkonyek enyena, nepej imukateni.
Neitayu ninye enkarae oo mukateni neitayu imukateni aisho te dukuya ninye, kake etanya ninye enya. Nejo Amnon, “Taarai pooki tung'ani maashomo aaing'uaa nanu.” Neipang pooki ng'ae alo aing'uaa ninye.
Nejoki Amnon Tamar, “Iyau endaa atua olgilata, pee atum nanu ainosa te nkaina ino.” Neya Tamar nena mukateni naaitobira, neyau ninche atua olgilata enetii Amnon olalashe lenye.
Kake ore ake pee eyau ninche aitinyikaki ninye meinosa, neibung ninye, nejoki, “Wou, irraga te nebo o nanu, enkanashe ai.”
Newaliki ninye ajoki, “A'a, olalashe lai, mikiaraki nanu; amu measi ena te Israel; mias ena torroni emodai.
Amaa te nanu, kaji aya enkurruna ai? Amaa te iyie, nitiu iyie anaa obo loo larruok oomoda too Siraeli. Ore naa taata, aatasayia iyie, irorie olaiguanani, amu maamitiki ninye iyie.”
Kake eitu ening, naa ore amu ninye ogol alang ninye, nearaki ninye, neirag ninye te nebo ninye.
Neitoki Amnon aibayu ninye te nkiba sapuk; neaku ore enkiba naiba ninye naa aisapuk alang enyorrata apa natonyorra ninye. Nejoki Amnon ninye, “Tudumunye, shomo.”
Kake etiaaka ninye, “A'a, olalashe lai, amu ore ena kitarruoroto nikiararie nanu naa aikitok alang ina ae nikintaasa nanu.” Kake meinining ninye ninye.
Neipotu ninye olbarnoti apa oisiaaita ninye nejoki, “Iwuang'ie ena kitok tene natii nanu, ninken kutukaji te siadi ninye.”
Neishopito apa ninye olkila oado adoru nkaik; amu inji apa eiko iselenken o laiguanani nemeyiolo olee te neishopo. Neaku eitayio osinka lenye ninye boo, neiken kutukaji te siadi ninye.
Nepik Tamar nkuruon endukuya enye nepolos ilo kila oodo apa oishopito; neiteleiki inkaik enyena endukuya enye, nelo, neyietu aishir eloito.

Nejoki olalashe lenye Absalom ninye, “Ketii duoo Amnon olalashe lino te nebo o iyie? Tigirayu naa taata, enkanashe ai; olalashe lino ninye; minap ena to ltau.” Nebik Tamar, anaa enkitok naliyio, tiatua enkaji o lalashe lenye Absalom.
Ore pee ening Olaiguanani Daudi kuna baa pooki, negoro ninye oleng.
Kake eitu eirorie Absalom Amnon aa esidai aa entorrono; amu eibayie apa Absalom Amnon, te nkaraki naikonya enkanashe enye Tamar.
Ore te siadi ilarin oaare oolulung'a neeta apa Absalom ilabarnok loo nkerra te Baal-hasor, naa ninye nataaniki Efraim, neitoomon Absalom ilayiok pooki lo laiguanani.
Nelotu Absalom enetii olaiguanani, nejo, “Ng'ura, eeta osinka lino ilabarnok loo nkerra; aatasayia inchoo olaiguanani o sinkan lenyena epuo te nebo osinka lino.”
Kake etiaaka olaiguanani Absalom, “A'a, olayioni lai, mincho iyiook kipuo pooki, mikiaku ake iyiook olola te iyie.” Neitirrishaki ninye, kake meyieu ninye nelo kake eishoo ninye emayianata enye.
Nejo Absalom, “Ti nimilo, aatoomono inchoo olalashe lai Amnon elo te nebo o iyiook.” Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Kainyoo pee elo ninye te nebo intae?”
Kake eitirrishaka Absalom ninye o metaba anaa neisho ninye Amnon o layiok pooki lo laiguanani meshomo te nebo ninye.

Neitanap Absalom isinkan lenyena, ejo, “Entujurru ore ake pee emera Amnon te naisho oo sabibu, ore ake pee ajoki intae, ‘Entoosh Amnon,’ niariara intae ninye metua. Emiureisho; aime nanu oitanapa intae? Entipij niarriyianunu.”
Neaku eitaasa isinkan le Absalom Amnon anaa enaitanapishe Absalom. Nedumunye ilayiok lo laiguanani pooki, neked ake oltung'ani enyumpu enye neisik.
Ore epuoito ninche te nkoitoi, nepuonu ilomon enetii Daudi, nejo “Etaara Absalom ilayiok lo laiguanani pooki, metuata neitu ninye eing'uari obo.”
Nedumunye olaiguanani, nepolos ilkilani lenyena, neirrag te nkop; ore isinkan lenyena pooki apa ooitashe te mbata nepolos ilkilani lenye.

Kake etejo Yonadab olayioni le Shimea, ilo alashe le Daudi, “Mincho olkitok lai ejo ketaara ninche metuata lelo barnot pooki, lelo ayiok lo laiguanani, amu Amnon ake otua, amu te nkitanapata e Absalom etaasaki ena ebaiki apa enkolong naikonya ninye enkanashe enye Tamar.
Ore naa taata, mincho olkitok lai olaiguanani epik oltau adamu ajo etuata ilayiok pooki lo laiguanani; amu Amnon ake otua.”
Kake eisika Absalom. Ore apa olbarnoti orripisho nedumu inkonyek enyena, neing'orisho, nedol epuonu iltung'ana aaimu enkoitoi e Horonaim emurte o ldoinyo.
Nejoki Yonadab olaiguanani, “Ng'ura, eetuo ilayiok lo laiguanani; anaa enatejo osinka lino, metaa ketaa ina.”
Ore ake enaidipie airoro, nepuonu ilayiok lo laiguanani, neilepie oltoilo neishir; ore olaiguanani o sinkan lenyena pooki neishir te mion oleng.
Kake eisika Absalom, nelo enetii Talmai olayioni le Amihud, olaiguanani le Geshur. Neishir Daudi te nkaraki olayioni lenye anaake.
Neaku eisika Absalom, nelo enetii Geshur, netii apa ine ilarin okuni.
Neyieu oltau lo laiguanani nelo enetii Absalom; amu eitigiraki tialo Amnon, etodua ajo etua ninye.
Ore apa Yoab olayioni le Seruiya nemusu ajo Absalom edamu oltau lo laiguanani.

Neirriwaa Yoab olkilikuai meshomo Tekoa, meyau teine enkitok ng'en, nejoki ninye, “Intaakunoyu ira enkaishirani, nipika ilkilani lo lkiyioi; nimiel kewan te ilata, kake taasa anaa enkitok naishirita too nkolong'i kumok te nkaraki o lotua.
Nilo enetii olaiguanani, niro aiko inji te ninye.” Neaku etipika Yoab irorei enkutuk enye.
Ore pee elotu ina kitok e Tekoa enetii olaiguanani, nebatata te nkomom enye o metabaiki enkop, nesai, nejo, “Taretuoki, Olaiguanani.”
Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Kainyoo enyamali ino?” Newal ninye ajo, “Kara nanu enkoliai; etua olpayian lai.
Neeta esinka ino ilayiok oaare, neitarrikino ninche maate ti ong'ata; nemetii apa oltung'ani orish ninche, neosh obo olikae near ninye metua.

Ore taata netudumakine olmarei pooki esinka ino, nejo ninche, ‘Inchoru ilo tung'ani otara olalashe lenye, pee kitum iyiook aataar ninye metua te nkaraki olalashe lenye apa otasesekuana’; neaku keinyal sii ninye olajung'oni. Neiko neijia aar enkukuo ai natung'uayioki, nemeing'ueiki olpayian lai enkarna aashu olpisiai ti oriong enkop.”
Nejoki olaiguanani ina kitok, “Shomo enkaji ino, naa kaishoru nanu inkitanapat tialo iyie.”

Nejoki ina kitok e Tekoa olaiguanani, “Inchoo eaku shumata nanu etii enkitarruoroto, Olaitoriani lai olaiguanani, o shumata enkaji e papa lai; inchoo olaiguanani o lorika lenye le nkitoo eaku meeta entioto.”
Nejo olaiguanani, “Ti nikijoki oltung'ani ae toki, iyau ninye enatii nanu, nimikingil aekata ninye aibung.”

Nejo ninye, “Aatoomono inchoo olaiguanani eipot Olaitoriani Enkai ino, paa ore ilo oitalaku elap to sarge nemeitoki aekata asesekuanisho, ore olayioni lai nemeari metua.” Nejo ninye, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, medoiki ninye olpapita obo lo layioni lino enkop.”
Neitoki ina kitok ajo, “Aatasayia inchoo esinka ino eiro ororei to lkitok lai olaiguanani.” Nejo ninye, “Iroro.”

Nejo ina kitok, “Kainyoo naa iyie pee intobira embae naaijo ena aarare iltung'ana le Nkai? Amu ore te nkishorunoto ena walata neen olaiguanani kewan, teina nemeyau olaiguanani ilo lenye oararo nerrinyunye ang.
Meeta nchere mikiye pooki, kitiu iyiook anaa enkare naisuaakaki enkop, nemeitoki asotunoyu; kake meitayu Enkai enkishui e ilo oing'oru nkoitoi pee mepal ilo lenye oararo metaa oloiturrayioki.
Aewuo nanu ajo ena to lkitok lai olaiguanani amu aaitaa nanu iltung'ana kuret; nedamu apa esinka ino, ajo, ‘Kairorie nanu olaiguanani; keidimayu pee eas olaiguanani eomonunoto e sinka enye.
Amu kening olaiguanani, nekordu esinka enye aitung'uaa enkaina o ltung'ani laaidim ainyala nanu o layioni lai te nebo aitung'uaa enjung'ore e Nkai.’

Nedamu esinka ino ajo, ‘Ore ororei lo lkitok lai olaiguanani naa kaayeng'iyeng'ie nanu’; amu ore olkitok lai olaiguanani netiu anaa olmalaika le Nkai te nerish esidai o entorrono. Metaa Olaitoriani Enkai ino te nebo o iyie!”
Neitoki olaiguanani awaliki ina kitok nejo, “Mikisudorie nanu pooki toki naba anaa enaaikilikuan iyie.” Nejo ina kitok, “Inchoo olkitok lai olaiguanani eiro.”

Nejo olaiguanani, “Ketii enkaina e Yoab te nebo iyie te kuna pooki?” Newal ina kitok nejo, “Kesipa ore anaa eninchu iyie, olkitok lai olaiguanani, meidim oltung'ani aibelekenya enkaina e tatene aashu enkaina e kedianye te pooki bae natejo olkitok lai olaiguanani. Osinka lino Yoab laaiguanaka nanu; ninye otipika kulo rorei pooki enkutuk e sinka ino.
Etaasa osinka lino Yoab ena pee etum aibelekenya kuna baa. Kake ore olkitok lai neeta eng'eno anaa olmalaika le Nkai ayiolou imbaa pooki naatii enkop.”
Nejoki olaiguanani Yoab, “Atonyorrayie taata, aishoru ena; shomo tushuku ilo barnoti Absalom.”

Nebatata Yoab te nkomom enye abaiki enkop, nesai, nemayian olaiguanani, nejo Yoab, “Ore taata etayiolo osinka lino inchere anoto omom too nkonyek inono, olkitok lai olaiguanani, teina naishorua olaiguanani eomonunoto osinka lenye.”
Neaku etudumunye Yoab nelo Geshur, nelo ariku Absalom Yerusalem.
Nejo olaiguanani, “Inchoo ninye eton openy tiatua enkaji enye makewan; melotu ninye enatii nanu.” Neaku etotona Absalom openy te enkaji enye makewan, neitu elotu enetii Olaiguanani.
Ore apa tiatua Israel pooki nemetii oltung'ani orrepi te nkishaa enye anaa Absalom; ore ebaiki endap e nkeju enye o metabaiki endukuya enye nemeetae eleyiata te ninye.

Naa te nedung ninye ilpapit le ndukuya enye (amu kedung apa te nkiting'oto e pooki ari; te neiroshiu oleng te ninye, nedung) neipim ninye ilpapit le ndukuya enye, naa shekeli iip are te ntemata o laiguanani.
Netoikioki apa Absalom ilayiok okuni o entito nabo naji Tamar; naa enkitok sidai apa ninye.
Neaku etobiko Absalom ilarin oaare oolulung'a te Yerusalem, eitu elotu enetii olaiguanani.
Neirriwaki Absalom ilkiliku Yoab pee eirriwaa ninye enetii olaiguanani; kake etanya elotu Yoab enetii ninye. Neirriwaa eniare, kake eitu elotu Yoab.
Nejoki Absalom isinkan lenyena, “Eng'ura aajo ore enkurma e Yoab netashare enaai, neeta enkano teine; enchom entipik enkima.” Neaku eshomo aapej enkurma.
Nedumunye Yoab nelo enetii Absalom te nkaji enye, nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo pee etapejo isinkan linono enkurma ai?”

Newaliki Absalom Yoab nejo, Ng'ura aajo aairriwaka iyie olomoni, Wou ene, pee aatum airriwaki olaiguanani, pee aikilikuan ajoki; Kainyoo nanu pee aewuo aing'uaa Geshur? Keikash te nanu te neton atii ine. “Ore naa taata inchooki nanu alo enetii olaiguanani; naa te naata enkitarruoroto, inchoo ninye maatar nanu matua.”

Kaae nelo Yoab enetii olaiguanani, neliki ninye; neipotu ninye Absalom. Neaku eewuo ninye enetii olaiguanani, neirrug kewan te nkomom enye o metabaiki enkop te dukuya olaiguanani; neng'utut olaiguanani Absalom.
Ore te siadi ena neing'uraki Absalom kewan engarri oo mbartan o ltung'ana onom ookuet te dukuya ninye.

Naa keinyototo apa Absalom ayooki neitashe te mbata enkoitoi e kishomi; ore te neeta oltung'ani enkiguana nayau dukuya olaiguanani pee eiguanareki, neipotu Absalom ninye, nejo, “Kaa anasa ing'uaa iyie?” Ore ake pee ejo, “Ore osinka lino naa olosho oje te Israel,”
nejoki Absalom ninye, “Ng'ura, kesipa neishiaakino ena niyieu; kake metii oltung'ani otegelua olaiguanani likining iyie.”
Nepon Absalom ajo, “Oi naaji tena kara oladung'oni le nkiguana tena kop! Neaku ore pooki tung'ani oata enkiguana aashu enaikilikuanu neidim aeu enatii, naisho nanu ninye esipata.”
Naa ore ake pee ejo oltung'ani anyiku alotu aserem ninye, neitorioo enkaina enye neibung ninye, neng'utut ninye.
Neiko neijia Absalom too ltung'ana loo Israeli oopuonu enetii olaiguanani metundung'okini enkiguana; neaku etupurroyie Absalom iltauja loo ltung'ana le Israel.
Ore te nkiting'oto oo larin oong'uan nejoki Absalom olaiguanani, “Aatasayia inchooki nanu mashomo alak olmumai apa lainosa to Laitoriani, te Hebron.
Amu einosa apa osinka lino olmumai amanya Geshur natii Aram, najo, ‘Kesipa te naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani ashuku Yerusalem, naitayu nanu eseremata to Laitoriani.’ ”
Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Shomo te seriani.” Neaku etudumunye ninye nelo Hebron.
Kake eirriwayie Absalom ilkiliku te nkisudoroto atua Israel pooki, ejo, “Ore ake pee ining'ining'i oltoilo le mowuo, entejo, ‘Absalom olaiguanani te Hebron!’ ”
Nepuo te nebo Absalom iltung'ana iip are ooing'uaa Yerusalem aa ilomon apa ooitoomonoki, nepuo ninche meeta ae too ltauja neitu eyiolou toki.

Ore eitayu Absalom olasar, neirriwaki olkilikuai meipotuni Ahitofel ilo le Gilom olaikooni le Daudi meeu te nkanasa enye Gilo. Neponari enkarruoisho e Absalom, ore iltung'ana ootii te nebo Absalom neponari.
Nelotu olkilikuai enetii Daudi, ejo, “Eshomo iltauja loo ltung'ana le Israel aasujaa Absalom.”

Nejoki Daudi iltung'ana lenyena, pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye te Yerusalem, “Entudumunye, emaisika iyiook, aashu eaku mikiata iyiook enikisikaki aailany Absalom; enchom entasiooi meinepu ake ninye iyiook asioki, neyau entorroni aitadoiki shumata iyiook, neshurt ena anasa te nepi o lalem.”
Nejoki isinkan lo laiguanani olaiguanani, “Ng'ura aajo eanyita isinkan linono pee eas enaba anaa enadung'u olkitok lai olaiguanani.”
Neaku eshomo olaiguanani, ore enkaji enye pooki nesujaa ninye. Neing'uaa olaiguanani inkapiak tomon pee eing'or enkaji.
Nelo olaiguanani nesujaa iltung'ana po oki ninye; neitashe ninche te nkaji nabayie.
Negiroo isinkan lenyena pooki ninye; o Lkereti pooki o Lpeleti o lelo iip ile le Giti apa ootusujaitie ninye ebaiki Gas, negiroo aaim dukuya olaiguanani.
Nejoki olaiguanani Itai ilo le Giti, “Kainyoo sii pee ilo iyie te nebo o iyiook? Tushukoyu shomo, pee ilo aton te nebo olaiguanani; amu ira iyie olomoni, nira sii oloisikua aing'uaa enkang ino.

Ng'ole ake iewuo iyie, naa kaaisho nanu iyie taata tamanai te nebo o yiook, idolita ajo aloito, nemayiolo enalo? Tushukoyu shomo, nirik ilalashera linono te nebo o iyie; naa mikintoduaa iyie Olaitoriani enyorrata nauno o enkisiligata.”

Kake etawalikia Itai olaiguanani ajoki, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, naa ore enaishu olkitok lai olaiguanani, ore eneba enaa enetii olkitok lai olaiguanani, aa te keeya aashu te nkishui, ine sii ninye etii osinka lino.”
Nejoki Daudi Itai, “Shomo naa, tulusoi.” Neaku eshomo Itai ilo le Giti agiroo, te nebo iltung'ana lenyena pooki o nena kutiti pooki apa naatii te nebo ninye.
Neishir enkop pooki ayietu egiroo iltung'ana pooki, nelang olaiguanani oerata le Kidron, negiroo iltung'ana pooki aing'or enkalo o lpurkel.
Neilepu Abiata, nelotu sii Sadok, te nebo Ilawi pooki, enapita osanduku lo sotua le Nkai; neirragie ninche ilo sanduku le Nkai, o metaba anaa negiroo iltung'ana pooki ti oriong enkanasa.
Nejoki olaiguanani Sadok, “Entanap osanduku le Nkai, entorriny atua enkanasa. Te natum nanu omom too nkonyek o Laitoriani, naa kaashuku ninye naaisho ninye matodua ninye o emanyisho enye;
kake te nejo ninye, ‘Maashipakino nanu iyie,’ ng'ura, nele nanu, inchoo ninye maaitaasa ina nadol aa sidai te ninye.”
Neitoki ake sii olaiguanani ajoki Sadok olapolosani, “Tushukoyu shomo enkanasa te seriani, iyie o Abiata, te nebo ilayiok linyi pokira oaare, Ahimasi olayioni lino o Yonatan olayioni le Abiata.
Ng'ura, kaanyu nanu iyie too lang'at o lpurkel, o metaba anaa nelotu oratioti oing'uaa enitii pee aaitayiolo nanu.”
Neaku etanapa Sadok o Abiata osanduku le Nkai aashuk Yerusalem; nebik ninche teine.

Kake eilepa Daudi alo enchumata o ldoinyo loo loirienito, neishiraa eloito, meeta namuka neimulumula endukuya enye; ore lelo tung'ana pooki ootii te nebo ninye neimulumul ilukuny enye, neilep ninche aapuo, neishiraa epuoito.
Nejokini apa Daudi, “Etii Ahitofel atua lelo arruok te nebo Absalom.” Nejo Daudi, “Olaitoriani, aatoomono nanu iyie, imbelekenya enkiguana e Ahitofel metaa emodai.”
Ore ake pee elotu Daudi entopij o ldoinyo ine apa neseremieki Enkai, nelotu Hushai ilo Akiti anang'are ninye epolosa olkila lenye lioriong netii enterit endukuya enye.
Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Ti nilo iyie te nebo nanu niaku iyie olola te nanu.

Kake ti nishuko iyie alo enkanasa, nijoki Absalom, ‘Kaaku nanu osinka lino, iyie olaiguanani, naa ore apa anaa enara nanu osinka le papaai lino te nkata natulusoyie, neijia sii taata etiu, kaaku nanu osinka lino,’ niaku intashal iyie te nkaraki nanu enkiguana e Ahitofel.
Aimetii Sadok o Abiata ilapolosak te nebo o iyie te idie? Metaa ore enaba anaa enining te nkaji o laiguanani, toliki Sadok o Abiata ilapolosak.
Ng'ura etii ilayiok lenye pokira oaare te nebo ninche teine, Ahima-as, olayioni le Sadok o Yonatan, olayioni le Abiata; naa te ninche kirriwaki nanu pooki toki nining.”
Neaku eewuo Hushai, olchore le Daudi atua enkanasa, ina kata apa ejing'ita Absalom Yerusalem.

Ore ake pee egiroo Daudi enchumata o ldoinyo penyo, netumore ninye Siba osinka le Mofiboshet, o sirkon are naairotoki, enapita imukateni iip are o rridat iip loo sabibu ooitoyioki o rridat iip loo lng'anayio le nkolong o lbene lo lchoni le naisho oo sabibu.

Nejoki olaiguanani Siba, “Kainyoo iyie pee iyaua kuna?” Newal Siba ajo, “Ore kulo sirkon naa ile nkaji o laiguanani pee eked alotie, ore imukateni o lng'anayio naa inoo lbarnot naanya, ore enaisho oo sabibu naa ene lelo ooiterre to lpurkel pee eok.”
Nejo olaiguanani, “Paa koree olayioni lo lkitok lino?” Nejoki Siba olaiguanani, “Ng'ura, etotona te Yerusalem; amu etejo ninye, ‘Taata aaisho nanu enkaji e Israel aashukoki enkitoria e papa lai.’ ”
Neitoki olaiguanani ajoki Siba, “Ore nena apa pooki naara ine Mefiboshet naa ininono taata.” Nejo Siba, “Kaasai nanu; inchooki nanu manoto omom too nkonyek inono, olkitok lai olaiguanani.”
Ore pee elotu Olaiguanani Daudi Bahurim, neipang'u teine oltung'ani lo lmarei le nkaji e Saul, oji enkarna enye Shimei, olayioni le Gera; naa ore elotu neidikidik adekisho.
Nenang Daudi too soito; nenang sii isinkan pooki lo laiguanani Daudi, o ltung'ana pooki o ltung'ana pooki kituaak ootii enkaina enye e tatene o ene kedianye.
Nejo Shimei ina kata edekisho, “Shomo, shomo, iyie oltung'ani lo sarge, iyie oltung'ani le pesho!

Eitalakua Olaitoriani te iyie osarge pooki le nkaji e Saul, laa te wueji enye intoreishe; neishooyie Olaitoriani enkitoria apik atua enkaina o layioni Absalom. Toduaa ajo etii emutata ino shumata ino; amu ira oltung'ani lo sarge.”
Neitoki Abishai olayioni le Seruiya ajoki olaiguanani, “Kainyoo pee edek ele dia otua olkitok lai olaiguanani? Inchooki nanu mashomo adung'u endukuya enye.”
Kake etejo olaiguanani, “Kaa nanu aabaikinore iyie, olayioni le Seruiya? Te nedekisho ninye te nkaraki natiaaka ninye Olaitoriani, ‘Tediaa Daudi,’ kaing'ae naa ojo, ‘Kainyoo pee itaasa iyie ena?’ ”

Nejoki Daudi Abishai o sinkan lenyena pooki, “Ng'ura, olayioni lai kewan oing'oru enkishui ai; kebaa elusoo ele tung'ani le Benchamen! Tung'uai ninye, naa inchoo ninye edekisho; amu Olaitoriani oishoo ninye.
Eidimayu pee eing'or Olaitoriani osina lai, naa kaalaaki nanu Olaitoriani too supati tele deket lena olong.”
Neaku eshomo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena te nkoitoi, ina kata eloito Shimei te murte o ldoinyo eipirakinore ninye, nedekisho eloito, nenang ninye too soito neisuaaki enterit.
Ore olaiguanani, o ltung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye, nebau enaurate Yordan; neyeng'iyeng'a ninye teine.
Ore apa Absalom o ltung'ana pooki, ilewa le Israel nepuonu Yerusalem o Ahitofel te nebo ninye.
Ore ake pee elotu Hushai, lo losho le Akito ilo shore le Daudi, enetii Absalom, nejoki Hushai Absalom, “Tobikoi olaiguanani! Tobikoi olaiguanani!”
Nejoki Absalom Hushai, “Kena enkanyit ino to lchore lino? Kainyoo pee eitu ilo te nebo olchore lino?”
Nejoki Hushai Absalom, “A'a; amu ore ilo otegelua Olaitoriani o kulo tung'ana o lewa pooki le Israel, olenye aaku nanu, naa te nebo ninye nanu abik.
Ore ake sii, kaing'ae nanu aisiaai? Aime ilo ayioni lenye? Ore apa anaa enaisiaayia papaai lino, kaaisiaai sii nanu iyie.”
Nejoki Absalom Ahitofel, “Inchoru enkikoo ino; kaa iyiook kias?”

Nejoki Ahitofel Absalom, “Shomo iyie atua enetii inkapiak e papaai lino, apa naatung'uayie ninye meing'ura enkaji; pee ening Israel pooki inchere intaa kewan olmang'atinta te papaai lino, ore inkaik e lelo pooki ootii te nebo o iyie neitagoli.”
Neaku etuunokito ninche Absalom olng'obor te nchumata enkaji; nelo Absalom atua enetii inkapiak e papaai lenye edolita Israel pooki.
Ore apa te nena olong'i eutaroto naishoru Ahitofel neikununo ake duoo anaa ororei le Nkai eikilikuanishoreki; keyanyiti apa oleng enkikoo e Ahitofel, Daudi o Absalom, pokira are.
Neponaa Ahitofel ajoki Absalom, “Inchooki nanu mategelu iltung'ana inkalifuni tomon o are, pee aipang nanu amir Daudi kewarie.
Naa karasaki nanu enetii ninye enaure netashala, nanang'aki ninye atua enkiputukuny; ore iltung'ana ootii te nebo ninye neisik. Naar nanu olaiguanani ake,
naayaki nanu iltung'ana pooki enitii anaa esiankiki narikuni ang aarikoki olpayian lenye. Ing'oru iyie enkishui o ltung'ani obo ake, ore iltung'ana pooki neserianu.”
Neitiship ina kikoo Absalom o lpayiani pooki le Israel.
Neitoki Absalom ajo, “Empoto sii ninye Hushai ilo Alkiti, pee kining iyiook enajo ninye.”
Ore pee elotu Hushai enetii Absalom, nejoki Absalom ninye, “Inji eiroro Ahitofel ajo; amaa aikias iyiook anaa enautu ninye? Tinimikias iroro naa iyie.”
Nejoki Hushai Absalom, “Ore tena kata enkikoo naishorua Ahitofel neme sidai.”
