Nejo Hushai, “Ore ake, iyiolo inchere ore papaai lino o ltung'ana lenyena naa ltung'ana magil netarasutua sii, anaa olng'arurumi otooruoki inkera enyena ti ong'ata. Ore etii ina, kaarriyia papaai lino to larrabal; meirura ninye kewarie te nebo iltung'ana.

Ore ninye taata eisudoyie ninye kewan te ngumoto nabo, aashu ti ae wueji. Naa ore ake pee ebatata embata oo ltung'ana te rasakinoto e dukuya, ore pooki ng'ae oning nejo, ‘Ketii enkidaaroto atua lelo tung'ana oosujita Absalom.’

Neaku ore ninye oltung'ani opi, oikununo oltau anaa oltau lo lng'atuny, nelepori tukul te nkuretisho; amu eyiolo Israel pooki inchere ore papaai lino naa oltung'ani magilani, naa ore lekua ootii te nebo ninye naa iltung'ana oopi.
Kake ore eutaroto ai naa inchere pee kinturrurrokino iyie Israel pooki, ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba, eba anaa osinyai le naiposha te nkumoi naa inchere, mirikoo iyie makewan olarrabal.

Neaku eikipuonu iyiook shumata ninye tiatua ewueji neba anaa enetumieki ninye, paa eikidoiki iyiook ninye te wueji neba anaa enetumieki nikidoiki iyiook ninye anaa enadoiki enkoileelio enkop; ore te ninye o ltung'ana pooki ootii te nebo ninye meing'uari ninye obo.
Naa tenelo ninye ajing atua enkanasa, neyau Isiraeli pooki inkeenta ina ang, nikinkurtutaa iyiook ina ang atua oerata o metaba anaa neaku metumi ninye osoit obo teine.”

Ore Absalom o ltung'ana pooki le Israel nejo, “Ore enkikoo e Hushai Olakiti naa aisidai alang enkikoo e Ahitofel.” Amu etegelua Olaitoriani pee emir enkikoo sidai e Ahitofel, pee etum Olaitoriani ayau entorroni shumata Absalom.
Nejoki Hushai Sadok o Abiata lelo apolosak, “Inji o nji eikoo Ahitofel Absalom o lpayiani le Israel; naa inji o nji nanu aikoo.

Ore naa taata erriwai ilkiliku entasioki entiaki Daudi, “Mirura taata iyie kewarie too lang'at oo lkejek to lpurkel, kake togiroi tukul; meijori ake olaiguanani o ltung'ana pooki ootii te nebo ninye.”
Ore apa Yonatan o Ahima-aa neanyisho ninche te En-rogel; nelo apa enkaisiaayiani aliki ninche, nepuo ninche aaliki olaiguanani Daudi; amu meeta inchere pee etoduaki ninche ejing enkanasa.
Kake etoduaa ninche enkayioni, neliki Absalom; neaku eshomo ninche pokira are aasiooyo, nepuonu enkaji o ltung'ani te Bahurim, apa oata enchorro ti oriong e nkaji enye; nedoiki ninche atua.
Neya enkitok neimulumul enkutuk e nchorro, neidapashaki enkano shumata enye; neaku meyiolounoyu toki.

Ore pee epuonu isinkan le Absalom enetii ina kitok ti aji, nejo ninche, “Koree Ahima-as o Yonatan?” Nejoki ina kitok ninche, “Eshomo ninche aalang ereyiet.” Ore ake pee esujaa ninche neitu einepu ninche, neshukunye ninche aapuonu Yerusalem.
Ore pee eidip ninche aatulusoi, neilepu lelo tung'ana te nchorro, nepuo aaliki Olaiguanani Daudi. Nejoki ninche Daudi, “Tudumunye, nilo asiooyo alang enkare; amu inji o nji eikoo Ahitofel te iyie.”
Nedumunye Daudi, o ltung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye, nelang ninche Yordan; ore enasirie eitu eleku obo leitu elang Yordan.

Ore ake pee edol Ahitofel ajo eitu esuji enkikoo enye, neirot osikiria lenye, nelo ninye ang enkanasa enye makewan. Neitobir mbaa e nkaji enye, negor kewan; neye ninye, nenukari te nkurare e papaai lenye.
Neitoki Daudi alotu Mahanaim. Nelang Absalom Yordan te nebo iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli.
Netipika apa Absalom Amasa shumata enjore te rishata e Yoab. Ore apa Amasa naa olayioni lo ltung'ani oji Itra le Ishimail, apa oyama Abigail entito e Nahash, enkanashe e Seruiya, ng'otonye Yoab.
Ore Israel o Absalom neitayu ilng'oborri te nkop o Gilead.
Ore pee elotu Daudi Mahanaim, ore Shobi olayioni le Nahash oing'uaa Raba oo lamori, o Makir olayioni le Amiel oing'uaa Lo-deba, o Barsilai o Lgiliadi ooing'uaa Rogelim,
neyau indapashi o mbakulini o motioo oo nkulupuok o enkano o shairi o enkurma naidong'o o mpoosho o ndaiki oo mpukunot pooki,
o enaisho o eng'orno o nkerra naaitung'uari eluaata te nkaraki Daudi o ltung'ana ootii te nebo ninye pee enya; amu etejo ninche, “Keeta iltung'ana esumash nenaurate nenoto enkure ti ong'ata.”
Neiturrur Daudi aiken iltung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye, nepik shumata ninche ilarikok loo nkalifuni o larikok loo maa iip.

Neya Daudi enjore e matua nabo e uni ti abori erikore e Yoab, ematua nabo e uni ti abori erikore e Abishai olayioni le Seruiya, olalashe le Yoab, o ematua nabo e uni ti abori erikore e Itai Olgiti. Nejoki olaiguanani lelo tung'ana, “Kalo sii nanu makewan aipang te nebo o intae.”

Kake etejo lelo lewa, “Mimpang iyie alo. Amu ti nikisik iyiook nemeshilaa ninche iyiook. Te neye olpisiai lang nemeshilaa ninche iyiook. Kake inyaanyukie iyie iip tomon katitin tomon lang. Metaa enaikash tinirriwaki iyie iyiook eretoto te nkanasa.”
Nejoki olaiguanani ninche, “Ore enaba anaa enidolidolo aa sidai te intae naas nanu.” Neaku eitashe olaiguanani te mbata e kishomi, ina kata eruko enjore pooki aapuo too maa iip o too nkalifuni.

Neitanap olaiguanani Yoab o Abishai o Itai, ajoki, “Emintaas entorrono te nkaraki nanu ilo barnoti Absalom.” Nening iltung'ana pooki eishorita olaiguanani inkitanapat lelo arikok pooki le njore tialo Absalom.
Neaku eipang'a enjore alo ong'ata aarare Israel; neitayuni olarrabal tiatua entim e Efraim.
Nemiri iltung'ana le Israel teine isinkan le Daudi, nesapuku enkidaaroto teine ina olong, iltung'ana inkalifuni tikitam oidaa.
Neidapashakino olarrabal oriong enkop pooki; nenya entim iltung'ana kumok ina olong alang ilotara olalem.

Nediding Absalom isinkan le Daudi. Nekedito apa Absalom enyumpu enye, nelo enyumpu aim abori ilng'osil sapuki lo lchani neng'amari endukuya too lng'osil, neing'uari ninye eililio to lng'am; ore ina nyumpu apa natii abori ninye nelo.
Nedol oltung'ani obo, neliki Yoab, “Ng'ura, atoduaa nanu Absalom eisiong'a to lchani.”

Nejoki Yoab ilo tung'ani otiaka ninye, “Kainyoo, itoduaa iyie ninye! Kainyoo naa pee eitu iosh ninye teine asulaki enkop? Anaata naaji ashipa nanu naaisho iyie mpisai tomon e nkosholai o enkeene e mpolos.”

Kake etiaaka ilo tung'ani Yoab, “Ore naaji ninye hoo te naning nanu te nkaina ai enkiroishi oo mpisai inkalifuni tomon e nkosholai, maitorioo nanu enkaina ai aar olayioni lo laiguanani; amu ore te ning'oto ang nikintanapa iyie olaiguanani o Abishai o Itai, ejo, ‘Ore te nkaraki nanu entomitu ilo barnoti Absalom.’
Ore sii enkae, tenaa naaji kaitaasa nanu enkishui enye entorrono (nemetii entoki naisudoro to laiguanani) anaata indim iyie makewan atekepari.”
Nejo Yoab, “Maitoki nanu aiturraa enkata aiko nji te nebo o iyie.” Neyau ninye iremeta uni te nkaina enye neibitaki ninche oltau le Absalom, eton eishu to lchani.
Ore ilbarnot tomon anapak loo masaa o larrabal e Yoab, neman ninche Absalom neosh ninye near ninye metua.
Neosh Yoab emowuo nepuonu iltimito aashukunye te mirata oo Siraeli amu etomitikio Yoab ninche.
Neitayu ninche Absalom, nenang'aki ninye atua engumoto sapuk tiatua entim, nesot te shumata ninye osototi sapuk loo soito, neisik Israel pooki, pooki ng'ae alo enkang enye.

Ore apa Absalom eton eishu neitobiraka kewan eng'ape osoit natii atua oerata lo Laiguanani, amu etejo ninye, “Maata nanu olayioni oshum enkarna ai metadamuni.” Neipotie ina ng'ape kewan, naa keji enadamunyeki Absalom o metabaiki ena olong.
Nejo Ahimaas olayioni le Sadok, “Inchooki nanu makueta, pee aya ilomon sidain enetii olaiguanani inchere etalakua Olaitoriani ninye aitung'uaa engolon oo lmang'ati lenyena.”
Nejoki Yoab ninye, “Miya iyie ilomon taata; indim iyie aawa ilomon ae olong, kake ore taata miya iyie ilomon, amu etua olayioni lo laiguanani.”
Neitoki Yoab ajoki ilo tung'ani le Kushi, “Shomo tiaaki olaiguanani ina nitoduaa.” Neirrugo Olkushi te dukuya Yoab, nekuet.

Neitoki Ahimaas olayioni le Sadok ajoki Yoab, “Inchoo etiu enatiu, inchooki sii nanu makueta asujaa Olkushi.” Nejoki Yoab, “Kainyoo iyie pee ikuet, olayioni lai, idolita ajo mitum iyie olerrinyore too lomon?”
Nejo ninye, “Inchoo eaku enaaku, kakuet ake.” Neaku etiaaka ninye, “Kueta.” Nekuet Ahimaas te nkoitoi e nkisiashata negiroo ilo Kushi.
Netonita apa Daudi te rishata oo nchomito are; neilep olarriponi alo shumata kishomi te mbata e suntai, ore ake pee eshumu inkonyek enyena neing'orisho, nedol oltung'ani okuetu openy.
Neipotisho olarriponi neliki olaiguanani. Nejo olaiguanani, “Tenaa ninye ake, netii ilomon sidain enkutuk enye.” Nelotu ninye anyiku netaanu.
Nedol olarriponi likae tung'ani ekuetu; neipotisho olarriponi te kishomi nejo, “Ng'ura ekuetu likae tung'ani openy!” Nejo olaiguanani, “Ilomon sidain sii ninye eyau.”
Nejo olarriponi, “Amen ajo ore enkuetata ole dukuya naa kenyaanyukie enkuetata e Ahimaas olayioni le Sadok.” Nejo olaiguanani, “Oltung'ani supat ninye naa kelotu ayau ilomon sidain.”

Neishiraki Ahimaas olaiguanani ajo, “Eseriani.” Neirrugo ninye te dukuya olaiguanani nebaiki enkomom enye enkop, nejo, “Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai ino, laa ninye oishooyie lelo tung'ana ootekepari aarare olkitok lai olaiguanani!”
Nejo olaiguanani, “Aisidain mbaa tialo ilo barnoti Absalom?” Newalu Ahimaas ejo, “Ore pee eirriwaa Yoab osinka lino, nadol enking'oling'ol sapuk, kake mayiolo nanu ajo kainyoo.”
Nejo olaiguanani, “Imbelekenyau intasho tene.” Neaku eitasho ninye te mbata, neitashe aitirring'a.
Naa ng'ura, nelotu Olkushiti; nejo ilo Kushiti, “Ilomon sidain to lkitok lai olaiguanani! Amu kitokordua iyie Olaitoriani ena olong aitung'uaa engolon e pooki apa likitudumakinote iyie.”

Nejoki olaiguanani Olkushiti, “Aisidain mbaa tialo ilo barnoti Absalom?” Newal ilo Kushiti ajo, “Metaa ilmang'ati lo lkitok lai olaiguanani o pooki likidumakino aarare iyie te ntorroni, etiu anaa ilo barnoti.”

Nenyamalu olaiguanani oleng, neilep alo olgilata otii shumata kishomi neishir; naa ore eloito, nejo ninye, “Oi olayioni lai Absalom, olayioni lai, olayioni lai Absalom! Enyor naa katua nanu te rishata ino, Absalom, olayioni lai, olayioni lai!”
Netiaakaki apa Yoab, “Ng'ura, eishirita olaiguanani neisinanuo te nkaraki Absalom.”
Neaku eibelekenyaki enkishuroto e njore ina olong metaa olkiyioi too ltung'ana pooki; amu etoning'o iltung'ana ina olong, “Eisinanuo olaiguanani te nkaraki olayioni lenye.”
Nepurrokino iltung'ana ina olong anaa enapurrokino iltung'ana atua ootukurrutua ekueta to larrabal.
Neimulumul olaiguanani enkomom enye, neishir olaiguanani to ltoilo sapuk, “Oi olayioni lai Absalom, Oi Absalom, olayioni lai, olayioni lai.”

Nelotu Yoab atua aji enetii olaiguanani, nejo, “Imulumula iyie taata te nkurruna inkomomi oo sinkan linono pooki, laa ninche ooitajeutuo ena olong enkishui ino o enkishui oo layiok linono o ntoyie inono o enkishui oo nkituaak inono o nkapiak inono,

te nkaraki ninyor iyie lelo likimba iyie nimba lelo likinyor iyie. Amu imbalunye iyie taata inchere, ore ilarikok le njore o sinkan naa pesho te iyie; amu ore taata kamuso nanu ajo, tenaa naaji keishu Absalom nikituata iyiook pooki taata, anaata ishipa iyie.

Ore naa taata tudumunye, shomo auluo irorie te supatisho isinkan linono; amu kanya nanu olmumai to Laitoriani, ti nimilo iyie, meton ninye oltung'ani hoo obo te nebo o iyie ena kewarie; naa keaku ena torrono oleng te iyie alang entorroni apa naewuo shumata iyie ebaiki kitisho ino o metabaiki taata.”

Nedumunye olaiguanani, netonie olorika lenye te kishomi. Nelikini iltung'ana pooki aajoki, “Ng'ura, etonita olaiguanani te kishomi”; nepuonu iltung'ana pooki dukuya olaiguanani. Ore apa Israel neisika pooki tung'ani alo enkang enye.

Ore iltung'ana pooki neing'oling'ola tiatua iloshon pooki loo Siraeli ejo, “Etokordua iyiook olaiguanani aitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati lang, neitajeuo iyiook aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti; ore taata neisika alo te nkop aing'uaa Absalom.
Kake ore Absalom, o laa ninye kitubukokito eilata aaput meitoria iyiook, netua to larrabal. Ore naa taata kainyoo pee mijojo intae ae tialo enchukunoto o laiguanani?”

Neirriwaa olaiguanani Daudi olkilikuai lenye enetii Sadok o Abiata lelo apolosak nejo, “Entiaaki ilpayiani le Yuda, ‘Kainyoo pee iakuku ile bayie te nchukokinoto o laiguanani enkaji enye, eidipa ororei le Israel pooki aeu enetii olaiguanani?
Irara intae iltung'ana laainei, irara intae oloito lai o sesen lai; kainyoo pee iakuku ile siadi te nchukunoto o laiguanani?’
Naa tiaaki Amasa, ‘Aimira iyie oltoilo lai o sesen lai? Inchoo eiko neijia Enkai te nanu, neitulusoo sii, ti nimira iyie olkitok le njore ai ebaiki taata te rishata e Yoab.’ ”
Neibelekeny ninye oltau loo ltung'ana le Yuda netiu anaa oltung'ani obo; neaku eirriwaitie ninche ororei enetii olaiguanani ejo, “Tushukunye, o sinkan linono pooki.”
Neaku etushukunye olaiguanani alotu Yordan; nelotu Yuda Gilgal anang'are olaiguanani neriku olaiguanani aaitalang'u Yordan.
Ore Shimei olayioni le Gera, ilo lo losho le Benchamen, oing'uaa Bahurim, neisarisaru adou te nebo iltung'ana le Yuda pee enang'are olaiguanani Daudi;

ore te nebo ninye netii iltung'ana enkalifu ooing'uaa Benchamen. Ore Siba osinka le nkaji e Saul, te nebo ilayiok lenyena tomon o imiet o sinkan lenyena tikitam, nekuet aadoyio aapuo Yordan dukuya olaiguanani,
nelang ninche te lang'ata aariku enkaji o laiguanani, neas ninche ina nayieu ninye. Ore Shimei olayioni le Gera nebatata te dukuya olaiguanani, etaa kejo ninye pee elang Yordan,

nejoki olaiguanani, “Mincho olkitok lai aaibung nanu te ntorroni aashu edamu eneikuna osinka lino pee eas entorrono ina olong apa naing'uaa olkitok lai olaiguanani Yerusalem; mincho olaiguanani enap too ndamunot enyena.
Amu keyiolo osinka lino inchere ataasa nanu eng'oki; metaa aewuo nanu ena olong, ole dukuya te nkaji pooki e Yosef otadowuo alotu anang'are olkitok lai olaiguanani.”
Newaliki Abishai olayioni le Seruiya ajoki, “Aimeari Shimei metua tena, te nkaraki netediaa ninye ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata?”

Kake etejo Daudi, “Kaa nanu aporoki intae, intae ilayiok le Seruiya, inchere itiuu intae ena olong anaa ilmang'ati te nanu? Keari pooki ng'ae metua te Israel ena olong? Amu aimayiolo nanu inchere ara nanu ena olong olaiguanani le Israel?”
Nejoki olaiguanani Shimei, “Miye iyie.” Neisho olaiguanani ninye olmumai lenye.

Ore Mefiboshet olayioni le Saul nedou alotu anang'are olaiguanani; neitu ninye eituku inkejek enyena, aashu eitobir olmunyei lenye, aashu eituku inkilani enyena, ebaiki enkolong apa nashomo olaiguanani o metabaiki enkolong naewuo ninye ashukunye te seriani.
Ore pee elotu ninye aing'uaa Yerusalem anang'are olaiguanani, nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Kainyoo pee eitu ilo te nebo nanu Mefiboshet?”
Newal ninye ajo, “Olkitok lai, olaiguanani, aateleja apa nanu osinka lai; amu etiaaka osinka lino ninye, ‘Irotokoki nanu osikiria, pee atum atakedo nalo te nebo olaiguanani.’ Amu olmaima osinka lino.
Etakaldayie ninye osinka lino to lkitok lai olaiguanani. Kake ore olkitok lai olaiguanani netiu anaa olmalaika le Nkai; taasa naa ina nidol aa sidai te iyie.

Amu ore enkaji pooki e papa lai netaa ninche iltung'ana ooishiaakino keeya te dukuya olkitok lai olaiguanani; kake itipika apa iyie osinka lino atua lelo oodaa te misa ino. Kainyoo naa ai sipata naata nanu, naa, pee aishiraki olaiguanani?”
Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Kainyoo pee iro oleng mbaa inono? Atudung'o nanu; ore iyie o Siba naa iorioro enkop.”
Nejoki Mefiboshet olaiguanani, “Oi inchoo ninye eya pooki, etaa keewuo olkitok lai olaiguanani ang te seriani.”
Ore apa Barsilai le Giliad netadowuo alotu aing'uaa Rogelim; nelo ninye te nebo olaiguanani Yordan, pee eitarioo ninye aitalang Yordan.
Ore apa Barsilai naa oltung'ani otamorua oleng, ilarin intomoni isiet; te moruao neishoo apa ninye olaiguanani endaa eton etonita te Mahanaim; amu oltung'ani apa karsis ninye.
Nejoki olaiguanani Barsilai, “Wou talang'u te nebo nanu, naa kaagolie nanu iyie te nebo nanu te Yerusalem.”
Kake etiaaka Barsilai olaiguanani, “Kailarin aja nanu eton aishu, metaa kailep nanu alo te nebo olaiguanani Yerusalem?

Kara nanu ena olong oloo larin intomoni isiet; kaidim nanu atayiolo ajo kainyoo esidai naa kainyoo neme sidai? Keidim osinka lino aishamishama ina nanya ninye aashu enaok ninye? Keton nanu aidim ainining'o oltoilo loo lewa ooranyisho o nkituaak naaranyisho? Kainyoo naa pee eaku osinka lino olola oponari to lkitok lai olaiguanani?
Kelo osinka lino enkiti wueji te nkoitoi te lido kekun Yordan te nebo olaiguanani. Kainyoo pee aalaaki nanu olaiguanani to lerrinyore oba nji?

Aatasayia inchoo osinka lino eshuko, pee atum nanu atua tiatua enkanasa ai makewan, te netaaniki enkurare e papa lai o ene yieyio ai. Kake nele osinka lino Kimham; inchoo ninye elo te nebo olkitok lai olaiguanani; nintaas ninye enaba anaa enidol aa sidai te iyie.”
Newaliki olaiguanani ajoki, “Kelo Kimham te nebo nanu, naa kaitaas nanu ninye enaba enaa enidol aa sidai te iyie; ore nena pooki niyieu iyie te nanu naaitaas nanu iyie.”
Nepuo iltung'ana pooki aalang Yordan, nelo olaiguanani alang; neng'utut olaiguanani Barsilai nemayian ninye, neshuko ninye alo enkang enye kewan.
Nelo olaiguanani dukuya o meshomo Gilgal, nelo Kimham te nebo ninye; ore iltung'ana pooki le Yuda o lpisiai sii loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, neriku olaiguanani te nkoitoi enye.

Nepuonu iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli enetii olaiguanani, nejoki olaiguanani, “Kainyoo pee kitupurroitie iyie ilalashera lang iltung'ana le Yuda, neyau olaiguanani o enkaji enye aaitalang'u Yordan, o ltung'ana pooki le Daudi te nebo ninye?”

Newaliki iltung'ana pooki le Yuda lelo tung'ana loo Siraeli ejo, “Te nkaraki naa olo lgilata onyikita iyiook. Kainyoo naa pee igororo tena bae? Aikitadaate iyiook pooki te nkinyang'a olaiguanani? Anaa tenaa keishoo ninye iyiook ae kishooroto?”

Newaliki iltung'ana loo Siraeli iltung'ana le Yuda nejo, “Kiata iyiook irubat tomon to laiguanani, ore sii te Daudi nikiata iyiook inkumok aitulusoo intae. Kainyoo naa pee itemena intae iyiook? Aimikira iyiook ile dukuya ooiroro pee eshukuni olaiguanani?” Kake ore apa irorei loo ltung'ana le Yuda naa kepe, alang irorei loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli.

Ore apa, netumi oltung'ani lemeeta tipat, oji enkarna enye Sheba, olayioni le Bikiri, lo losho le Benchamen. Neosh ninye emowuo nejo, “Mikiata iyiook erubata te Daudi nimikiata iyiook enjung'ore to layioni le Yese; shomo pooki tung'ani olng'obor lino, iyie Israel!”
Neaku etung'uaitie iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli Daudi, nesuj Sheba olayioni le Bikiri; kake etusuja iltung'ana le Yuda olaiguanani lenye aakurraki ebaiki Yordan o metabaiki Yerusalem.

Nelotu Daudi enkaji enye te Yerusalem; neya olaiguanani inkapiak tomon apa naatung'uayie meing'ura enkaji, nepik ninche atua enkaji narripitoi, neitoti ninche, kake eitu elo atua enetii ninche. Neaku eikenoyioki ninche o metabaiki enkolong e keeya enye, etoni anaa nkolia.
Nejoki olaiguanani Amasa, “Impoto iltung'ana le Yuda te nebo meetu enatii tiatua inkolong'i uni, nitii iyie ene makewan.”
Neaku eshomo Amasa aipot Yuda; kake eimutie ninye aitogiroo enkata apa natudung'okoki apa nategelakaki ninye.

Nejoki Daudi Abishai, “Ore taata keitaas iyiook Sheba olayioni le Bikiri entorrono alang Absalom; iwa isinkan lo lkitok lino tusujai ninye, meisho ake kewan inkanas naasheta isunta too soito nepik iyiook enyamali.”
Neipang aapuo aasujaa Abishai, Yoab o lelo Sheriti o lelo Peleti, o lelo tung'ana pooki magil; neipang ninche aapuo aaing'uaa Yerusalem aasujaa Sheba olayioni le Bikiri.

Ore etii ninche osoit sapuk otii Gibeon, nelotu Amasa anang'are ninche. Neishopito apa Yoab olkila lo ltung'ani le njore, ore ti oriong ninye netii enkeene e mpolos te nebo olalem tiatua enchashur eteenaki aakurraki te mpolos enye; ore eloito ninye dukuya nedoyio.
Nejoki Yoab Amasa, “Iserian iyie, olalashe lai?” Neibung Yoab Amasa olmunyei lenye te nkaina enye e tatene pee eng'utut ninye.

Kake eitu edol Amasa olalem otii enkaina e Yoab; neaku ninye etaremie Yoab ninye enkoshoke, nebuloki imonyit enyena enkop, neye ninye eitu eigilieki ai oshoto. Ore Yoab o Abishai olalashe lenye nesujaa Sheba olayioni le Bikiri.
Ore obo loo ltung'ana le Yoab, neitashe te mbata e Amasa nejo, “Ore olonyor Yoab anaa ole nkalo e Daudi, inchoo ninye esujaa Yoab.”

Ore Amasa neirrag akurro tiatua o sarge lenye te mpolos enkoitoi. Ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo, nedol ninye, neitashe; ore pee edol ilo tung'ani ajo eitasheito iltung'ana pooki, nenap ninye Amasa aitung'uaa enkoitoi apik ong'ata, nenang'aki enkila shumata ninye.
Ore ake pee eyae aaitung'uaa enkoitoi, nepuo iltung'ana pooki aasuj Yoab esujaa olayioni le Bikiri.
Neim Sheba atua iloshon pooki loo Isiraeli o meshomo Abel e Bet-maka, ore lelo Bikiri pooki neiturrurro, nesujaa ninye atua.

Ore lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo Yoab nepuonu aang'adu ninye tiatua Abel e Bet-maka; neitayu ninche olkiu te mbata e nkang, neitashe ninye aipirakinore esuntai; neoshito apa ninche esuntai pee euroo.
Neipotisho enkitok ang'eni tiatua enkanasa ejo, “Entoning! Entoning! Entiaaki Yoab, ‘Wou ene, pee aatum nanu airorie iyie.’ ”
Nelotu ninye ataaniki ninye; nejo ina kitok, “Ira iyie Yoab?” Newaliki ninye, “Kara nanu.” Neitoki ajoki ninye, “Toning'o irorei le sinka ino.” Newaliki ninye, “Kaning'ito nanu.”
Neitoki ninye ajo, “Ore apa naa keji, ‘Inchoo ninche eikilikuanu enkikoo te Abel’; neidip ninche olomoni.
Kara nanu nabo e nekua nemeetayie olomang'ati neisiligayu too Siraeli, amaa ing'oru iyie aidaikie enkanasa naa ninye ng'otonye tiatua Israel; kainyoo pee iijoo iyie ina jung'ore o Laitoriani?”
Newal Yoab, “Kikoino maatalama ena inchere kaijoo nanu aashu aidaikie!

Mesipa ina. Kake oltung'ani le nkop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, oji Sheba olayioni le Bikiri, oilepie enkaina enye aarare olaiguanani Daudi; enchoru ninye ake, naa kalo nanu aing'uaa enkanasa.” Nejoki ina kitok Yoab, “Ng'ura, aikinang'akini iyie endukuya enye aaitadooki te suntai.”

Nelo ina kitok enetii iltung'ana pooki te ng'eno enye. Nedung'u ninche endukuya e Sheba olayioni le Bikiri nenang'u auluo enetii Yoab. Neosh ninye emowuo, neidapasha ninche aaing'uaa enkanasa, oltung'ani ake nelo enkang enye. Nerrinyo Yoab alo Yerusalem enetii olaiguanani.
Naa Yoab apa olkitok le njore pooki e Israel; ore Benaia olayioni le Yehoida naa ninye olkitok loo Lkereti o Lpelesi;
naa Adoram oitasheiki esiaai oo nkaik; naa Yehoshafat olayioni le Ahilud apa olaigeroni;
naa Shefa olasirani; naa Sadok o Abiata apa ilapolosak;
ore apa Ira ilo Yairiti naa olapolosani sii ninye le Daudi.

Netii apa olameyu too nkolong'i e Daudi tiatua ilarin okuni, to lari ake o to lari, neing'oru Daudi enkomom o Laitoriani. Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ketii entorroni o sarge shumata Saul o shumata enkaji enye, te nkaraki nataara Ilgibioni metuata.”

Neaku eipoto olaiguanani Ilgibioni. Ore apa Ilgibioni neme iloo ltung'ana le Israel, kake olpisiai loo Lamori; hoo neinosa iltung'ana le Israel olmumai pee eleku ninche, etonyuaa Saul ear ninche metuata teina nyuata enye te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel o Yuda.
Nejoki Daudi lelo Gibioni, “Kaa nanu aitaas intae? Naa kaji nanu aikunu enkipooto, pee itumutumu intae aatamayian enjung'ore o Laitoriani?”
Nejoki ilgibioni ninye, “Mme embae e nkosholai aashu saabu erishata ang o Saul aashu enkaji enye; neme enaang pee kiar oltung'ani metua te Israel.” Nejo ninye, “Ijojo intae pee aitaas aa nanu intae?”
Nejoki ninche olaiguanani, “Ore ilo tung'ani apa otumuta iyiook neitobir pee eidaikie iyiook, metaa mikitum iyiook ewueji tiatua enkop pooki oo Siraeli.
Inchoo meishori ilayiok lenyena oopishana pee kisiong iyiook ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani te Gibeon to ldoinyo lo Laitoriani.” Nejo olaiguanani, “Kaishoru nanu ninche.”
Kake etelekua olaiguanani Mefiboshet, olayioni lo layioni le Saul, Yonatan, te nkaraki olmumai lo Laitoriani apa otii erishata ninche, o erishata e Daudi o Yonatan olayioni le Saul.
Neya olaiguanani ilayiok oaare le Rispa entito e Aia apa naa ninye etoikio Saul, Armon o Mefiboshet; o layiok imiet le Merab entito e Saul laa ninche etoikio Adriel olayioni le Barsilai ilo Meholati;

neishooyo ninche apik atua inkaik oo Lgibioni; neilili ninche teilo doinyo te dukuya Olaitoriani, ore ninche pokira oopishana neidaaya te nebo. Neari ninche metuata too nkolong'i e dukuya e nkikesare, te nkiterunoto e nkikesare e shairi.

Neitoki Rispa entito e Aia aya ilkuniyiani neisalaashaki te ndapidapoi ebaiki enkiterunoto e nkikesare o metaba anaa neshaiki enchan ninche eing'uaa shumata; neitu ninye eisho imotonyi o loing'ang'e epuonu aadoiki ninche te ndama, aashu ing'uesi e ong'ata te nkewarie.
Ore ake pee elikini Daudi enataasa Rispa entito e Aia ina apiani e Saul,

nelo Daudi aitayu iloik le Saul o loik lo layioni lenye Yonatan tiatua iltung'ana le Yabesh-gilead, apa ootupurroitie ninche to lkurroto otumoreki te Betshean, teine apa neililiyie Ilfilisti ninche, teina olong apa nataara Ilfilisti Saul metua te Gilboa;
neyau ninye ailepunye teine iloik le Saul o loik lo layioni lenye Yonatan; neiturrur ninche iloik le lelo apa ooililioki.

Nenukaa ninche iloik le Saul o layioni lenye Yonatan te nkop e Benchamen te Sela, tiatua enkurare e Kish papaai lenye; neas ninche nena pooki naaitanapishe olaiguanani. Ore te siadi ina nening Enkai eomonokinoto te nkaraki enkop.
Neitoki apa Ilfilisti aata olarrabal o Israel, nedoyio Daudi alo te nebo isinkan lenyena nearare ninche Ilfilisti; neilepunye Daudi.
Ore Ishbi-benob, obo apa le ishoi e lelo tung'ana sapuki laa shekeli iip o suyai enkirroishi e mpere enye, oenita olalem ng'ejuk, neing'oru pee ear Daudi metua.

Kake eewuo Abishai olayioni le Seruiya aretu, nerasaki ilo Filisti near ninye metua. Neitirrishaki iltung'ana le Daudi ninye aajoki, “Mintoki aekata iyie aipang alo te nebo iyiook olarrabal, pee miar ake olkilang'ilang'et le Israel.”
Ore te siadi ena neitoki atii olarrabal apa o Lfilisti te Gob; neari metua Sibekai ol Husati Saf, laa ninye apa obo le ishoi e lelo tung'ana sapuki.
Neetae ake sii apa olarrabal o Lfilisti te Gob; neari Elhanan olayioni le Yaareoregim, le Betlehem near metua Goliat le Giti oba enchata e mpere enye anaa embokishi o lashetani.

Neetae sii apa olarrabal te Gas, teine apa netii oltung'ani sapuk oodo oata ilkimojik ile te pooki aina, o lkimojik ile te pooki keju, tikitam o oong'uan esiana e pooki; naa ole ishoi sii apa ninye e lelo tung'ana sapuki.
Ore ake pee edek ninye Israel near ninye metua Yonatan olayioni le Shimei, ilo alashe le Daudi.
Ore kulo oong'uan naa ile ishoi e lelo tung'ana apa sapuki ootii Gas; near Daudi te nkaina enye o te nkaina oo sinkan lenyena metuata.
Neirorie Daudi Olaitoriani irorei lele sinkolio ina olong natalakua ninye Olaitoriani aitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati lenyena pooki, neitung'uaa enkaina e Saul.
Nejo ninye; Olaitoriani ninye endapidapoi ai, naa osempewuet lai, naa ololakunoni lai.
Enkai ai, endapidapoi ai, laa ninye esarunoto ai elong'o ai o emowuo enjeunoto ai, oltim lai o enkisudoroto ai, Olaitajeunoni lai; kintajeuo iyie nanu aitung'uaa entorroni.
Aipoto nanu Olaitoriani, laa ninye eishiaakino nerrepi, naaitajeuoki nanu too lmang'ati laainei.
“Amu aamanita nanu ilopir le keeya, naapik nanu indoorot e ntorroni enkuretisho.
Aarrueshita nanu inkeenta e nemeneng'a, naaluaakino nanu irresheta le keeya.
“Ore tiatua osina ai nanu aipoto Olaitoriani; Enkai ainanu aipoto. Te nkaji enye etoning'o ninye oltoilo lai, nelotu enkishirata ai nkiyiaa enyena.
“Kaae neikirikira enkop neigirigiro; ore ilkitamanyunot le shumata, neigirigiro, te nkaraki natagore ninye.
Nepuku empuruo eing'uaa inkumeishin enyena, nepuku enkima nanyaisho te nkutuk enye; inkuk naaishu naayupuyup epuku te ninye.
Neirrugu ninye shumata, nelotu adou; netii emisimisi nairrusha abori inkejek enyena.
Etakedo ninye enchumata olkerubi, nelo tiaai; etoduaaki ninye te nchumata oo naipuko osiwuo.
Eishoo enaimin metamana ninye, neman ninye inkatampo naairrusha o nkariak naaiturrurro.
Nepuku teina wang'an natii dukuya ninye inkuk e nkima naayupuyup.
Etadara Olaitoriani te keper, ore ilo otii shumata oleng neitayu oltoilo lenye.
Neng'oru ninye imbaa, neidapash ilmang'ati lenyena; te nkiwuang'ata etang'oruo ninche.
Nedoli kop e naiposha, neirragieki ilkitamanyunot le nkop meirraga aaibalayu, te nkisikong'ata o Laitoriani, te nkutata e nkiyang'et oo nkumeishin enyena.
“Neitoriou ninye enkaina enye te shumata naaya ninye nanu, naaitayu tiatua inkariak kumok.
Aatokordua te nkaina o lmang'atinta lai ogol, aitung'uaa lelo apa laaiba nanu; amu kegol apa oleng te nanu.
Eetuo ninche shumata nanu te nkolong ai e nyamali; kake etaa Olaitoriani enkigarakinoto ai.
Aayaua ninye nanu atua ewueji nelala; aatokordua amu kaashipakino ninye nanu.
“Aaitaasa nanu Olaitoriani te risioroto e supatisho ai; te risioroto e ina nemeiduruk inkaik aainei aaitaasa ninye.
Amu aibung'a inkoitoi o Laitoriani, neitu nanu te ntorroni aing'uaa Enkai ai.
Amu ore inkitanapat enyena pooki netii dukuya nanu, ore too nkitanapat enyena neitu nanu aibelekenya.
Maata apa nanu eleyiata te dukuya ninye, narrip nanu kewan te ntorroni.
Metaa aaitaasa nanu Olaitoriani te risioroto e supatisho ai, te risioroto e ina nemaiduruk nanu too nkonyek enyena.
“Ore te ilo oisiligayu nintodol kewan ajo keisiligayu; ore to ltung'ani lemeeta eleyiata nintodol kewan ajo miata eleyiata;
Ore te ilo oikishian nintodol iyie kewan ajo inkishian, ore ilo lemeitoriori nintodol iyie ajo ira olo larrabal.
Ikordu iyie iltung'ana oobor, kake etii inkonyek inono shumata iloowuasa pee intadou ninche.
Ee, ira iyie oltaa lai, Olaitoriani, naa keitawang Enkai ai enaimin ai.
Ee, te iyie aidim nanu aidaikie oltim, naa te Nkai ainanu aidim aida esuntai.
Ore ena Ai - kesipa enkoitoi enye; ore enkisiligata o Laitoriani naa keibalayu ajo kesipa; elong'o ninye te pooki ooing'oru enkisudoroto te ninye.
“Amu kaing'ae Enkai, neme Olaitoriani? Naa kaing'ae endapidapoi, neme Enkai ang?
Ore ena Ai naa enkisudoroto ai nagol, netaseriana ninye enkoitoi ai.
Neitagol ninye inkejek aainei anaa entarakuet, naagolie ninye mabatata too neeika.
Neiteng'en ninye inkaik aainei to larrabal, metaa keidim inkaik aainei atoolua enkawuo osuyai.
Kinchoo iyie nanu elong'o e njeunoto ino, naaitaa nanu eretoto ino kitok.
Kinchoo iyie nanu ewueji nelala too roruat aainei ti abori nanu, neitu eideketari inkejek aainei;
atusujayie nanu ilmang'ati laainei naidaikie ninche, neitu ashukunye o metaba anaa neishunye ninche.
Aishua nanu ninche; ataremo nanu ninche aipang'ie, metaa eitu ninche edumunye; etabatatate ti abori inkejek aainei.
Amu kiterretena nanu te ngolon te nkaraki olarrabal; nincho iyie ilmang'ati laainei meimiso ti abori nanu.
Inchoo iyie ilmang'ati laainei maaibelekenyaki inkoriong'i enye, lelo laaiba nanu, naidaikie nanu ninche.
Neing'orisho, kake metii hoo obo oitajeu ninche; eishirakita ninche Olaitoriani, kake eitu ninye ewaliki ninche.
Aidong'o nanu ninche naitunyoki ninche enkop anaa esarng'ab e nkoitoi.
“Kintajewuo iyie nanu te lelo tung'ana ootekepari aakeshisho; kitipika nanu mataa endukuya oo loreren; ore apa iltung'ana leitu nanu ayiolou naaisiaai nanu.
Nepuonu iloo loreren naairrugokino nanu; ore ake pee aaning'oo nanu, naairuk ninche nanu.
Etapalari iloo loreren, nepuonu eikirikira aaipang'u too nkisudorot enye.
“Keishu Olaitoriani! Meisisi endapidapoi ai! Naa meitubulari enkitoo e Nkai ai, endapidapoi e njeunoto ai.
Ina Ai naaitalaaka nanu elap neitadou iltung'ana apik abori nanu,
laa ninye laaitayio nanu aitung'uaa ilmang'ati laainei; naailepie nanu te shumata ilmang'ati laainei, nikikordu iyie nanu aitung'uaa iltung'ana arruok.
“Ore tena, kaaisis nanu iyie Olaitoriani, tiatua iloreren, naa karanyaki irrepat e nkarna ino.
Inkisulat sapuki eisho ninye olaiguanani lenye, neitodolu enyorrata nauno te ilo lenye obukokino eilata, Daudi o eishoi enye intarasi.”

Ore taata, kulo ilomon oobayie le Daudi: Irorei le Daudi, olayioni le Yese, irorei le ilo tung'ani oilepieki aaya shumata, ilo obukokino eilata te Nkai e Yakobo, ilo oranyu isinkolioitin oomelok le Israel:
“Eirorita Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani te nanu, etii ororei lenye olng'ejep lai.
Eiroro Enkai e Israel, aatiaka endapidapoi e Israel: Te neitore oltung'ani te sipata iltung'ana, neitore te uriata e Nkai,
neitawang'aki ninche anaa ewang'an e nkakenya, anaa enkolong nawang'u tadekenya metii inkatampo, anaa enchan naitubulu inkujit te nkop.

Ee, aimeitashe enkaji ai aiko neijia te Nkai? Amu eitobira ninye te nebo nanu osotua loo ntarasi, keishiaakino too ntokitin pooki netagolieki. Amu aimeidimie ninye metubula eretoto ai pooki o eyieunoto ai?
Kake ore iltung'ana lemeeta Enkai, netiu pooki anaa ilkiku ootanang'ayioki; amu meidimi aawaita te nkaina;
kake ore ilo tung'ani oibung ninche neeta esekenkei o enchata e mpere, nemuti ninche tukul te nkima.”

Kuna inkarn oo ltung'ana magil apa oata Daudi to larrabal: Yosheb-bashebet Oltakenoni; kitok apa ninye te lelo okuni, eilepie ninye empere enye aarare iltung'ana iip isiet ootasesekuana ninye te nkata nabo.

Ore oliare te ninye tiatua iltung'ana okuni magil naa Eliesa olayioni le Dodo olayioni le Ahohi. Etii apa ninye te nebo Daudi ina kata pee eiturrurro Ilfilisti to larrabal, neshuko iltung'ana le Israel.

Nedumunye ninye near Ilfilisti o meteekunye enkaina enye, neibung'are enkaina enye o lalem lenye; neyau Olaitoriani enkisulata kitok ina olong; nerrinyunye iltung'ana aasujaa ninye pee epur lelo ootasesekuanaki.
Ore olosujita ninye naa Shama, olayioni le Agee Olharari. Eiturrurrote Ilfilisti te nebo te Lehi, teine wueji apa nebore endaa nauno; neisik iltung'ana aailany Ilfilisti.
Kake etune ninye aitashe te mpolos e ine, neng'oroo ine, nesesekuan Ilfilisti; neyau Olaitoriani enkisulata kitok.
Ore okuni loo ltung'ana tomoni uni gelunot nedoyio aapuo, nepuonu enetii Daudi etinyikua enkata e nkikesare te nkapune e Adulam, ina kata apa etii oltim loo Lfilisti oerata le Refaim.
Netii apa Daudi ina kata atua enkisudoroto; ore oltim loo Lfilisti netii Betlehem.
Nejo Daudi te yieunoto, “Oi naaji aaisho nanu oltung'ani enkare naok naing'uaa olchorro le Betlehem otii embata e kishomi!”
Neim lelo tung'ana okuni magil atua ilng'oborri loo Lfilisti; neoku enkare te ilo shorro le Betlehem apa otii embata e kishomi, neyaki Daudi. Kake eitu eok; eibukoyie ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani,
nejo, “Metalakuana te nanu, Olaitoriani, tenaa kaas nanu ena. Kaok nanu osarge loo ltung'ana ooshomo te mbatisho e nkishui enye?” Neaku eitu eok ninye. Kuna baa etaasa lelo tung'ana okuni magil.
Ore apa Abishai, olalashe le Yoab, olayioni le Seruiya, naa ninye olarikoni le tomoni uni. Neilepie ninye enkaina enye aarare iltung'ana iip uni nesesekuan ninche, neisulie enkarna te lelo okuni.
Ninye apa eyioloi oleng te lelo tomoni uni, neaku olarikoni lenye; kake eitu eaku te lelo okuni.

Ore apa Benaia olayioni le Yohoida naa oltung'ani opi oleng le Kabseel, olaasani loo nkiasin sapuki; etara intiamasin are e Moab. Eshomo sii apa adoyio near olng'atuny tiatua engumoto ina kata apa etadowuo empaso e nkirobi.

Nesesekuan olmisiri, oltung'ani oikishian. Keeta apa ilo Misiri empere te nkaina enye; kake eshomo Benaia enetii ninye te ng'udi enye, newuapaa empere te nkaina o Lmisiri, nesesekuan ninye te mpere enye kewan.
Kuna baa etaasa Benaia olayioni le Yehoida, netum enkarna tiatua lelo tung'ana okuni magil.
Keyioloi apa oleng tiatua lelo tomoni uni, kake eitu elusoo te pokira okuni. Nepik apa Daudi ninye meitasheiki ilarripok lenyena.
Ore apa Asahel olalashe le Yoab naa obo le lelo tomoni uni; Elhanan olayioni le Dodo le Betlehem,
Shama le Harod, Elika le Harod,
Heles o Lpalti, Ira olayioni le Ikesh le Tekoa,
Abiesa le Anatot o Mebunai Olhushati,
Salmon Olhohi o Maharai le Netofa,
o Heleb olayioni le Baana le Netofa, Itai olayioni le Ribai le Gibea loo Lbenchamen,
Benaia le Piraton, Hidai loo nong'ot e Gaash,
Abilabon le Lbati, Asmafet le Bahurim,
Eliaba le Shaalbon, olayioni le Yashen, Yonatan,
Shama Olharari, Ahiam olayioni le Sharar Olharari;
Elifelet olayioni le Ahasbai le Maaka, Eliam olayioni le Ahitofel le Gilo,
Hesro le Karmel, Paarai Olabi,
Igal olayioni le Natan le Soba, Bani Olgadi,
Selek Olamori; Naharai le Be-erot, olanapani loo masaa o larrabal le Yoab olayioni le Seruiya,
Ira ilo Tiriti; Gareb ilo Tiriti; Uria ilo Hiti:
tomoni uni o opishana pooki.
Neitoki engoro o Laitoriani ayupuyup te nkaraki Israel, nepik Olaitoriani Daudi endamunoto te nkaraki ninche, nejo, “Shomo inkena Israel o Yuda.”

Neaku etiaaka olaiguanani Yoab o lkituaak le njore, apa ootii te nebo ninye, “Enchom atua iloshon pooki le Israel, ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba, ninkenikene iltung'ana, pee atum atayiolo esiana oo ltung'ana.”

Kake etiaaka Yoab olaiguanani, “Metoponai Olaitoriani Enkai ino iltung'ana katitin iip aa kumok anaa enaba, eton edolita inkonyek o lkitok lai olaiguanani; kake kainyoo pee eshipakino olkitok lai olaiguanani ena bae?”
Kake etune ororei lo laiguanani te Yoab o too lkituaak le njore. Neaku eshomo Yoab o lkituaak le njore teine netii olaiguanani aapuo aaiken iltung'ana.
Nelang ninche Yordan, neiteru abaiki Aroer, o metabaiki ina anasa natii atua empolos o erata, te nkalo e Gad nelo Yaser.
Neitoki aapuonu Gilead o Kadesh tiatua enkop oo Lhiti; nepuonu ninche Dan, nepuo te Dan nemanaa aapuo Sidon,
nepuonu enkisudoroto e Tiro o nkang'itie oo Lhafi o Lkanaani; neipang ninche aapuo Negeb e Yuda te Beer-sheba.
Neaku ore ake pee eidip ninche aashom enkop pooki, nepuonu ninche Yerusalem te nkiting'oto oo lapaitin ooudo o nkolong'i tikitam.
Neisho Yoab esiana e nkikenata oo ltung'ana olaiguanani: ore tiatua Israel netii inkalifuni iip isiet oopi ootushututua ilalema, ore iltung'ana le Yuda naa inkalifuni iip imiet.

Neitanyamal Daudi oltau lenye ena kata eidipa aikena iltung'ana. Nejoki Daudi Olaitoriani, “Ataasa nanu eng'oki sapuk tena nataasa. Kake ore taata, Olaitoriani, aatoomono nanu iyie, iwuang'ie entorroni to sinka lino; amu ataasa nanu te modai.”
Ore ake pee einyototo Daudi tadekenya, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii oloiboni oji Gad, ilo aduani le Daudi, ejo,
“Shomo tiaaki Daudi, Inji ejo Olaitoriani, intokitin uni nanu aaisho; tegelu nabo te ninche, pee aatum aitaasa iyie.’ ”

Neaku eewuo Gad enetii Daudi neliki ninye, nejoki ninye, “Kailarin okuni lo lameyu oopuonu atua enkop ino. Aashu impirri iyie ilapaitin okuni te dukuya ilmang'ati linono kisujita ninche? Aashu te neaku inkolong'i uni ino lmeitai tiatua enkop ino? Nguanare taata, nidut ewalata nashukoki nanu ilo laairiwua.”
Nejoki Daudi Gad, “Atii nanu atua osina sapuk; matabatatakinoto iyiook enkaina o Laitoriani, amu kitok olng'ur lenye, kake mikincho abatatakino enkaina o ltung'ani.”
Neaku eirriwaka Olaitoriani Israel olmeitai ebaiki tadekenya o metabaiki enkata apa natudung'uoki; neye teine iltung'ana ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba inkalifuni intomoni naapishana.

Ore ake pee eitorioo olmalaika enkaina enye aing'orie Yerusalem pee eidaikie, neirridu Olaitoriani ina torroni, nejoki ilo malaika apa oasita ina mutata tiatua iltung'ana, “Eidipe; tushuko taata enkaina ino.” Netii apa ilo malaika lo Laitoriani embata ewueji neidong'ishoreki e Arauna o Lyebusi.

Neirorie Daudi Olaitoriani ina kata pee edol ilo malaika apa oarita iltung'ana, nejo, “Oi, ataasa nanu eng'oki, nataasa entorroni; kake amaa kuna kerra, kaa etaasa ninche? Inchoo enkaina ino aatoomono aar nanu near enkaji e papa.”
Nelotu Gad ina olong enetii Daudi, nejoki ninye, “Shomo ilepa, tataaniki olperere lo lasar enetii Olaitoriani teine wueji neidong'ishoreki e Arauna o Lyebusi.”
Neaku eshomo Daudi ailep to rorei le Gad, anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani.
Ore ake eing'orisho Arauna airrugo, nedol olaiguanani o sinkan lenyena epuonu aayiaya ninye; nelo Arauna, neserem olaiguanani neitabaiki enkomom enye enkop.

Nejo Arauna, “Kainyoo pee eewuo olkitok lai olaiguanani enetii osinka lenye?” Nejo Daudi, “Pee ainyiang'u ene wueji neidong'ishoreki te iyie pee atum ateshetie olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, pee etumi aaiwuang'ie olmeitai too ltung'ana.”
Nejoki Arauna Daudi, “Inchoo olkitok lai olaiguanani eya neishoru ina nadol aa sidai te ninye; noolo ilmong'i lo lasar opejori, ore intokitin naaidong'ishoreki o nkeek oo lmong'i naa keaku ilkeek.
Ore kuna pooki, olaiguanani, eishoo Arauna olaiguanani.” Nejoki Arauna olaiguanani, “Mikitang'amai iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.”

Kake etiaaka olaiguanani Arauna, “A'a, kake kainyiang'u nanu te iyie te nkinyang'a, maishoru nanu olasar opejori to Laitoriani Enkai ai, eitu nanu ainosie toki.” Neaku einyiang'ua Daudi ine wueji neidong'ishoreki, o lmong'i te shekeli onom e nkosholai.
Neshetaki Daudi teine Olaitoriani olperere lo lasar, neishoru olasar opejori o lasar le seriani. Neaku etoning'o Olaitoriani eomonokinoto enkop, neiwuang'ieki olmeitai aaitung'uaa Israel.
Etamorua apa olaiguanani Daudi neaku oloo larin kumok. Ore hoo teneimulumuli ninye too lkilani nemeirouaju osesen.
Ore te nkaraki ina, etiaakita isinkan lenyena, “Olaiguanani, inchoo iyiook maing'uraki iyie enkiti siankiki naairag to lgoo lino pee kigolie ninye nitum airouaja.”
Neaku eing'orutua ninche esiankiki sidai tiatua enkop pooki e Israel, nepuo aatum Abishag e Shunam, neyaki ninye olaiguanani.
Eisidai apa ina siankiki oleng, neaku ninye enkaing'urani o laiguanani neisiaai ninye; kake eitu eboitare olaiguanani ninye.
Ore apa Adonija olayioni le Hagit neitaa kewan kitok ejo, “Kaaku nanu olaiguanani.” Neitobiraki kewan ingarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan o ltung'ana onom oo kuet te dukuya ninye.
Neitu aekata eitagor menye ninye eikilikuan ajoki, “Kainyoo pee itaasa ena o ena?” Oltung'ani sii apa sidai ninye te ning'or, naa ninye etoiwuoki eirukurukore Absalom.
Eiroro ninche o Yoab olayioni le Seruyia tenebo o Abiata olapolosani; nesujaa ninche Adonija neretu ninye.
Kake ore Sadok ilo apolosani o Benaia olayioni le Yehoida, o Natan oloiboni le Nkai, o Shimei, o Rei o lelo tung'ana le Daudi magil nemetii ninche enkalo e Adonija.

Nepolos Adonija ilkerra, o lmong'i o ntokitin naapir te ndapidapoi oo lasuriaa, te mbata e Norogel, neitoomon ninye ilalashera lenyena pooki, lelo ayiok lo laiguanani o lelo tung'ana pooki kituaak le Yuda.
Kake eitu ninye eitoomon Natan oloiboni le Nkai aashu Benaia aashu lelo tung'ana magil lo lalashe lenye Solomon.
Neitoki Natan ajoki Batsheba, ng'otonye Solomon, “Keitu iyie ining ajo etaa Adonija olayioni le Hagit olaiguanani nemeyiolo Daudi olkitok lang?
Wou naa taata maaishoo nanu eutaroto, pee itum aitajeu enkishui ino makewan o enkishui o layioni lino Solomon.

Shomo nabo kata tijing'aki olaiguanani Daudi, nijoki ninye, ‘Keitu apa iyie olkitok lai olaiguanani, inya olmumai te sinka ino, ijo; Solomon olayioni lino oitoreisho te siadi nanu, naa ketonie ninye olorika lai le nkitoo? Kainyoo naa pee etaa Adonija olaiguanani?’
Ore eton irorie olaiguanani, najing'u sii nanu te siadi iyie naitisip irorei linono.”
Neaku eshomo Batsheba enetii olaiguanani tiatua enkaji enye, netamorua olaiguanani oleng, ore Abishag ina e Shunam neisiaaita olaiguanani.
Neirrugo Batsheba aisho olaiguanani enkanyit, nejoki olaiguanani, “Kainyoo iyieu?”
Nejoki ninye, “Olkitok lai, inosie apa esinka ino olmumai, to Laitoriani Enkai ino, nijo, ‘Solomon olayioni lino oitoreisho te siadi nanu, naa ketonie ninye olorika lai le nkitoo.’
Ore naa taata, Adonija ninye olaiguanani, hoo nimiyiolo ninye iyie olkitok lai olaiguanani.
Etopolosa ninye ilmong'i o ntokitin naapir o nkerra kumok, neitoomono ninye ilayiok pooki lo laiguanani, Abiata ilo apolosani o Yoab olarikoni le njore, kake ore Solomon osinka lino eitu eitoomon.
Ore naa taata olkitok lai olaiguanani, iyie eing'orita inkonyek pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli pee iliki ninche ololo atonie olorika le nkitoo lo lkitok lai olaiguanani te siadi ninye.
Amu keidimayu naa teneye olkitok lai olaiganani naaikenari nanu o Solomon olayioni lai anaa ilaitarruorrok.”
Ore eton ninye eirorie olaiguanani, nejing'u Natan oloiboni le Nkai.
Nejoki isinkan lenyena, olaiguanani, “Nele Natan oloiboni le Nkai.” Ore pee ejing'u ninye alotu aitashe te dukuya olaiguanani, neirrugo ninye te dukuya olaiguanani, neitabaiki enkomom enye enkop.
Nejo Natan, “Olkitok lai olaiguanani, amaa, itejo iyie, ‘Adonija oitoreisho te siadi nanu, naa kelo atonie olorika lai le nkitoo?’

Amu eshomo ninye ena olong apolos ilmong'i o ntokitin naapir o nkerra kumok, neitoomono ilayiok pooki lo laiguanani, Yoab olarikoni le njore, o Abiatar olapolosani naa ng'ura edaa ninche neokisho te dukuya ninye, nejo ‘Tobikoi olaiguanani Adonija!’
Kake ore nanu o osinka lino o Sadok olapolosani o Benaia, olayioni le Yehoida, o sinka lino Solomon, neitu ninye eitoomon.
Ko lkitok lang olaiguanani oyaua ena bae? Neitu iyie iliki isinkan linono nchere kalo otonie olorika le nkitoo lo lkitok lai te siadi ninye?”
Neitoki olaiguanani Daudi awalu nejo, “Empotokoki Batsheba.” Neaku eewuo Batsheba enetii olaiguanani, neitashe te dukuya olaiguanani.
Nenya olaiguanani olmumai, nejo, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, laa ninye laatokordua oltau lai te pooki mang'atinta,

anaa enainosa olmumai te iyie te nkarna o Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ajo Solomon olayioni lino oitoreisho te siadi nanu, naa ketonie ninye olorika lai le nkitoo te rishata ai; neijia ake sii aiko ena olong.”
Neirrugo Batsheba aitabaiki enkomom enye enkop, neisho olaiguanani enkanyit, nejo, “Metobikoi olkitok lai olaiguanani Daudi ntarasi!”
Nejo olaiguanani Daudi, “Empotokoki Sadok olapolosani o Natan oloiboni le Nkai o Benaia olayioni le Yehoiada.” Neaku eetuo ninche dukuya olaiguanani.
Nejoki olaiguanani ninche, “Ewaita tenebo intae isinkan lo lkitok linyi, ninchosho Solomon olayioni lai metakedo enyumpu ai nintadou ninye te Gibon;
ninchosho Sadok olapolosani o Natan oloiboni le Nkai metubukoki ninye eilata aaput metaa olaiguanani le Israel; nintokiki aaosh emowuo, nijojo, tobikoi olaiguanani Solomon!
Nintokiki taa aailepu aasuju ninye, nelotu ninye atonie olorika lai le nkitoo, amu ninye oaku olaiguanani te rishata ai; nategelua nanu ninye meitoria Israel o Yuda.”
Newaliki Benaia olayioni le Yehoida olaiguanani ajo “Eesai! Meiruko Olaitoriani lai, Enkai anaa enatii Olaitoriani tenebo olkitok lai olaiguanani, metotiwuo neijia.
Ore anaa enatii Olaitoriani tenebo olkitok lai olaiguanani, metaa sii tenebo Solomon, neitaa kitok olorika lenye le nkitoo aitalang olorika le nkitoo lo lkitok lai Daudi!”
Neaku eshomo Sadok olapolosani o Natan oloiboni le Nkai o Benaia olayioni le Yehoida o lkeresi o lpelesi aaitaked Solomon enyumpu o laiguanani Daudi neyau ninye Gibon.
Ore teine neya Sadok olapolosani emouo e ilata to lng'obor nebukoki Solomon aput. Neitoki ninche aaosh esekekua, nejo iltung'ana pooki tobikoi olaiguanani Solomon.
Neilep iltung'ana pooki aasujaa ninye, ekutita ndulen, neng'ida te nchipai sapuk, ometaa keikirikirie indarat enye enkop.
Nening Adonija o lomon pooki ootii tenebo ninye ina shipai o sirua. Ore pee ening Yoab oltoilo le ntarumpeta nejo, “Kainyoo ele odoo te nkanasa?”
Ore eton eirorita, nelotu Yonatan olayioni le Abiata; nejo Adonija, “Tijing'u, amu ira iyie oltung'ani le tipat oyau ilomon.”
Newaliki Yonatan Adonija ajoki, “A'a amu eitaa olkitok lang olaiguanani Daudi Solomon olaiguanani.
Neirriwayie olaiguanani tenebo ninye Sadok olapolosani, o Natan oloiboni le Nkai, o Benaia olayioni le Yehoida o Lkeresi o llpelesi, neishoo ninche ninye metakedo enyumpu o laiguanani.

Netubukokito Sadok olapolosani o Natan oloiboni le Nkai ninye eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani te Gihon, neilepa ninche aapuo teine eng'ida. Neaku enkanasa enkilepilep. Ena kilepilep ina nitoning'oitie.
Etonita taata Solomon to lorika le nkitoo.

Eetuo sii ilaisiaayiak lo laiguanani aaisho enashe olkitok lang Daudi ejo, ‘Eishoo Enkai ino enkarna e Solomon metoning'oyu alang enkarna ino, neitaa olorika lenye le nkitoo kitok alang olino.’ Neirrugo olaiguanani te ndapash.
Neitoki sii olaiguanani ajo, ‘Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, laa ninye oishoo obo le ishoi ai metotonie olorika lai le nkitoo ena olong, adolita too nkonyek aainei.’ ”
Neikirikira ilomon pooki le Adonija to lkirutoto, nedumunye ninche, nelo ake oltung'ani aim enkoitoi enye makewan.
Neureyu Adonija Solomon, nedumunye ninye, neibung imowuarak o lperere lo lasar.

Nelikini Solomon aajoki, “Keure Adonija ninye amu eji eibung'ita ninye imowuarak o lperere lo lasar, nejoito, ‘Nchoo olaiguanani Solomon eng'as anya olmumai nchere mesesekuan ninye osinka lenye to lalem.’ ”
Nejo Solomon, “Teneitodolu ninye neitisip nchere oltung'ani le tipat, meiseyieki ninye olpapita hoo obo le ndukuya enye.”
Neaku eirriwayie olaiguanani Solomon olkilikuai meyauni Adonija aaitung'uaa olperere lo lasar. Nelotu ninye airrugokino Solomon aisho ninye enkanyit; nejoki Solomon ninye, “Shomo enkaji ino.”
Ore ake pee eaku keye Daudi, neitanap Solomon olayioni lenye; nejoki
“Etataana enkata ai pee alo aye. Ntagoluoyu niaku olee,

nimbung inkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino, aim inkoitoi enyena, nimbung inkiguanat enyena, o nkitanapat enyena, o nkikoot enyena, o shakenisho enye, anaa enaigero too nkitanapat e Musa, pee itum atudupayu te pooki nias o te pooki wueji niim;

pee etum Olaitoriani aitabai ina apa nairoro tialo nanu ajo, ‘Teneing'or ilayiok linono inkoitoi enye, aapuo te dukuya nanu too sipat, too ltauja lenye pooki o te nkishui enye, melai aikata te iyie oltung'ani otonie olorika le nkitoo too Siraeli’.

“Ore ake sii, iyiolo enaaitaasa nanu Yoab olayioni le Seruyia, ina naitaasa ilkituaak oaare le njore oo Siraeli, Abna olayioni le Neer o Amasa olayioni le Yeser, oo tasesekuana ninye. Eitalakua ninye te nkata e seriani, elap o sarge apa oibukoyioki to larrabal, nepik osarge lemeeta entioto enkeene e mpolos natii empolos ai, nepik inamuka naatii inkejek aainei.
Entaasisho naa nabo kata te risioroto e ng'eno inyi, kake emincho ina lukunya enye naibor edoiki enemeneng'a te seriani.
Kake ntoduaa esupatisho lelo ayiok le Barsilai le Gilead, nincho ninche eaku tenebo lelo oodaa te Misa ino; amu teina supatisho aatang'amutua ninche nanu apa pee aisik ailany Absalom olalashe lino.

Netii sii tenebo iyie Shimei olayioni le Gera, le Benchamen oing'ua Bahurin, laa ninye apa laatediaa to ldeket torrono teina olong apa nashomo Mahanaim; kake ore ake pee aalotu anang'are nanu to lkeju le Yordan, nainosaki nanu ninye olmumai to Laitoriani, ajoki, ‘Maar nanu iyie tua to lalem.’
Ore naa taata, eminkenaa ninye aajo meeta entioto, naa ore amu ira iyie oltung'ani ng'en; iyiolo iyie enilo aitaas, niyau iyie ninye etua.”
Neye Daudi, nenukari ninye te nkanasa e Daudi.
Ore apa enkata naitoreishe Daudi te Israel naa ilarin artam, eitoreisho ilarin tomoni uni oo kuni te Yerusalem o larin oopishana te Hebron.
Neaku etotona Solomon to lorika le nkitoo le Daudi papaai lenye ore enkitoo enye neitashe auno.
Neitoki Adonija olayioni le Hagit alotu enetii Batsheba ng'otonye Solomon. Nejoki ninye, “Ai te seriani iewuo iyie?” Nejo ninye “Te seriani.”
Neitoki ajo, “Kaata embae naaliki iyie.” Nejoki ninye, “Tolimu.”

Nejo ninye, “Iyiolo iyie ajo enaai apa enkitoria, naa nanu apa eisiligita Israel pooki pee aitore ninche; kake eibelekenye enkitoria neaku eno lalashe lai, amu enenye apake eing'uaa enetii Olaitoriani.
Ore naa taata kaata embae nabo naomonu te iyie, nimikianyaki iyie nanu.” Nejoki Batsheba ninye, “Tolimu.”
Nejo ninye, “Aatoomono nkilikuana olaiguanani Solomon, amu mikianyaki ninye, pee aaisho nanu Abishag e Shunam maitaa enkitok ai.”
Nejo Batsheba, “Eisidai, kairorie olaiguanani te rishata ino.”

Neaku eshomo Batsheba enetii olaiguanani Solomon, pee eirorie ninye te rishata e Adonija. Nedumunye olaiguanani anang'are ninye, neirrugokino ninye, neitoki aton to lorika lenye le nkitoo, neitoki aipotu olorika meyakini ng'otonye, neton ninye te nkaina enye e tatene.
Neitoki ninye ajo, “Kaata enkiti omonunoto nabo naaomon iyie, mikianyaki iyie nanu.” Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Tolimu eomonunoto ino yieyio lai, amu maanyaki nanu iyie.”
Nejo ninye, “Nchoo Abishag e Shunam meishori Adonija olalashe lino meyama.” Nejoki olaiguanani Solomon ng'otonye, “Paa kainyoo peyie aa Abishag e Shunam iomonu meishori Adonija?
Toomonoki sii ninye enkitoria amu olalashe lai botor ninye, ore Abiatar olapolosani o Yoab olayioni le Seruyia naa ninye eng'orito.”
Neitoki olaiguanani Solomon anya olmumai to Laitoriani ejo, “Maaitaasa Enkai ena naaitulus tenemeinosieki ele rorei enkishui e Adonija!

Ore naa taata anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, laa ninye laaitasheyie nanu aitagol, naaitoton nanu to lorika le Daudi papaai lai, laa ninye laaitaa nanu olmarei, anaa apa enaisiligishore, keari Adonija metua ena olong.”
Neaku eirriwayie olaiguanani Solomon Benaia olayioni le Yehoida; neosh ninye Adonija anang'ie enkop, neye ninye.

Ore tialo Abiatar olapolosani, nejo olaiguanani, “Shomo Anatot, enkop inyi amu keeya nikiririkino iyie. Kake maar nanu iyie tua tena kata, amu itanapa apa osanduku lo Laitoriani Enkai te dukuya Daudi papaai lai, o te nkaraki sii nitang'arie apa papa isinaitin lenyena pooki.”
Neaku etaarayie Solomon Abiatar pee meitoki aaku olapolosani lo Laitoriani, neitabaya ororei lo Laitoriani apa oiroro ninye eipirta enkaji e Eli te Shilo.
Ore ake pee ebaiki ilomon Yoab, amu etijing'a apa Yoab Adonija enkoriong, hoo neitu ejing Absalom, neisikaki Yoab olng'obor lo Laitoriani nelo aibung imowuarak o lperere lo lasar.

Ore ake pee elikini olaiguanani Solomon, nchere, “Eisika Yoab alo atua olng'obor lo Laitoriani, naa ng'ura, etii ninye embata olperere lo lasar.” Neirriwaa Solomon Benaia olayioni le Yehoida, ejo, “Shomo toosho ninye tanang'ie enkop.”

Nelo Benaia atua ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani nejoki ninye, “Eitanapishe olaiguanani ajo, ‘Tupuku’ ” kake etejo ninye, “A'a tene nanu aye.” Neitoki Benaia ayaki olaiguanani olomoni ajoki, “Nji ejo Yoab naa ena einosa olmumai ajo.”

Newaliki olaiguanani ninye ajoki, “Taasa anaa enatejo ninye toosho ninye tanang'ie enkop, nilo anukaa; pee eiwuang'ieki te nanu o te nkaji e papaai lai entorroni o sarge lemeeta entioto oibukoyie Yoab.

Neyau Olaitoriani arrinyu inkiaasin enyena e nkibukoroto o sarge shumata endukuya enye makewan, amu ore apa meyiolo papa Daudi, etarasaka ninye nesesekuan to lalem iltung'ana oaare supati naa ile tipat aalang ninye, Abna olayioni le Neer, ilo kitok le njore oo Siraeli o Amasa olayioni le Yeter, olkitok le njore e Yuda.

Neaku kerrinyunye isargeta lenye aapuonu shumata endukuya e Yoab o shumata oo lukuny e ishoi enye, intarasi, kake ore tialo Daudi, o eishoi enye o enkaji enye o lorika lenye le nkitoo, naa keaku eseriani naing'uaa Olaitoriani enenye ntarasi moitie.”
Nedumunye Benaia olayioni le Yehoida alo neosh Yoab anang'ie enkop, near ninye metua, nenukari ninye tiatua enkaji enye makewan tiong'ota.
Nepik olaiguanani Benaia olayioni le Yehoida aitaa olkitok le njore te rishata e Yoab, nepik olaiguanani Sadok metaa olapolosani te rishata e Abiatar.
Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaa olkilikuai aipotu Shimei nejoki, ninye, “Teshetaki kewan enkaji te Yerusalem, nibik teine, nimilo iyie teine aidurraki dikae.
Amu ore kenya enkolong nilo, alang enong'oto e Kebron, tayiolo ntisipa nchere meeta nchere miye. Ore osarge lino nelotu shumata e ndukuya ino makewan.”
Nejoki Shemei olaiguanani, “Ore ina nitejo iyie naa eisidai, ore anaa enatejo olkitok lai olaiguanani, ina elo osinka lino aas.” Neaku etobiko Shimei te Yerusalem inkolong'i kumok.
Ore etulusoitie ilarin okuni, neisik irrindiki oaare le Shimei aapuo enetii Akish olayioni le Maaka, olaiguanani le Gaat. Ore pee elikini Shimei aajoki, “Etii irrindiki linono Gaat.”
Nedumunye Shimei neirot osikiria nelo Gaat enetii Akish, aing'oru irrindiki lenyena; nelo Shimei arrinyu irrindiki lenyena te Gaat.
Ore ake pee elikini Solomon aajoki eshomo Shimei te Yerusalem nelo Gaat neitoki arrinyunye,

neirriwaa olaiguanani olkilikuai aipotu Shimei, nejoki ninye “Keitu apa nanu aainosie iyie olmumai to Laitoriani, naairorie oleng aikok ajoki, ‘Tayiolo ntisipa nchere ore kenya enkolong nilo ake ninye dikae wueji, niye iyie?’ Nikijoki iyie nanu, ‘Ore enitejo naa eisidai; kairuk nanu.’
Kainyoo naa peyie eitu iyie imbung olmumai to Laitoriani o ina kitanapata naaitanapa nanu iyie?”
Neitoki ake sii olaiguanani ajoki Shimei, “Iyiolo iyie to ltau lino ina torroni apa nintaasa Daudi papa lai; neaku kerrinyu Olaitoriani entorroni ino shumata endukuya ino.
Kake kemayian Olaitoriani olaiguanani Solomon, ore olorika le nkitoo le Daudi neitasheyieki te dukuya Olaitoriani ntarasi.”
Neitoki olaiguanani aitanap Benaia olayioni le Yehoida; neipang ninye alo aosh Shimei anang'ie enkop, neye ninye. Neaku eitasheyieki apa enkitoo te nkitoria e Solomon.

Eitobira apa Solomon osotua o Farao olaiguanani le Misiri; neyam ninye entito e Farao, neriku ninye atua enkanasa e Daudi, o metaba anaa neidip atesheta enkaji enye makewan o enkaji o Laitoriani o esuntai naman Yerusalem.
Too wuejitin neeika apa epolosisho iltung'ana, amu meetae apa enkaji naidipaki aateshet naipotieki Olaitoriani.
Kenyor apa Solomon Olaitoriani, nelo too nkikoot e Daudi papaai lenye. Kake keitayu apa ninye ilasarri nepej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.
Ore nabo olong nelo olaiguanani Gibeon apolosisho teine amu ine apa ewueji neika kitok, naa keishooyo apa Solomon ilasarri oopejori enkalifu te nchumata eilo perere lo lasar.
Ore te Gibeon neipang'aki Olaitoriani Solomon te nkidetidet kewarie, nejoki, “Toomonu entoki niyieu naa kaaisho.” Nejo Solomon,

“Intodolua iyie enyorrata kitok nauno to sinka lino Daudi, papa lai, te nkaraki nashomo ninye te dukuya iyie te supatisho, o too sipat o to ltau oitoriori tialo iyie, nimbung'a iyie te ninye ena nyorrata kitok nauno, ninchoo ninye olayioni otonie olorika lenye le nkitoo ena olong.
Ore taata, Olaitoriani Enkai ai, intaa iyie osinka lino olaiguanani te rishata e Daudi papa lai, hoo ninye naa kara nanu enkerai, mayiolo nanu aipang'a nemayiolo atijing'u.
Netii osinka lino atua iltung'ana linono litegelaka, olorere kitok, lemeidimi aaikena te nkumoi anaa aatayiolo esiana te nkumoi.
Nchoo naa osinka lino endamunoto e ning'unoto pee etum aitoria ltung'ana linono, netum atumusu nerishu mbaa sidain o ntorrok, amu kaing'ae oidim aitoria ele orere lino kitok?”
Etishipakine apa Olaitoriani nchere ena bae etoomono Solomon.

Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Ore te nkaraki ninkilikuanua ena, neitu iomonu enkishui naado te nkaraki enkishui ino, anaa karsisisho, anaa enkishui oo lmang'ati linono, kake itoomonoko kewan pee kinchori eyiolounoto pee imusu esidai,
kaaitaas naa nanu taata te risioto o rorei lino. Kaaisho nanu iyie endamunoto e ng'eno nimusunye mbaa, metaa meetae olikinyaanyukie otulusoyie nemeetae oloyooki atiu anaa iyie te siadi iyie.
Kaaisho sii nena neitu iomonu, karsisisho o enkanyit ometaa meetae likae aiguanani likintanyaanyukieki too nkolong'i inono pooki.
Naa tenilo iyie too nkoitoi aainei, aibung inkitanapat aainei o nkikoot aainei, anaa apa enataasa papaai lino Daudi, naitoodor inkolong'i inono.”

Neputunye Solomon neyiolou ajo enkidetidet ake, Neitoki alotu Yerusalem neitashe te dukuya osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani, neishooyo inkishoorot o lasarri oopejori, o lasarri le seriani, neitobir osirua te nkaraki isinkan lenyena pooki.
Neitoki inkituaak are mulayoni aapuonu enetii olaiguanani neitashe te dukuya ninye.
Nejo enkitok nabo e nena, “Oi olkitok lai, ore ena kitok o nanu naa enkaji nabo kimanya; naisho nanu eton kishula teina aji.
Ore te nkolong e uni aidipa atoisho, neitoki sii ninye ena kitok aisho; naa iyiook ake, metii hoo likae tung'ani tenebo iyiook tiatua aji, iyiook ake pokira are naatii atua aji.
Ore enkayioni ena kitok neye kewarie amu etepetayie ninye.
Nedumunye ninye te mpolos e nkewarie neya enkayioni ai te mbata ai ina kata eirura esinka ino, neirragie ninye to lgoo lenye. Neirragie ina kerai enye natua to lgoo lai.
Ore pee ainyototo tadekenya aaitanak enkerai ai, nadol ajo etua; kake ore ake pee aaing'or nanu asipu tadekenya, nadol ajo mme enapa kerai natoiwuo.”
Kake etejo ina ae kitok, “A'a enaai ena kerai naishu, naa enino ena natua.” Neitoki enaduoo e dukuya ajo, “A'a, enino ina natua, naa enaai ena kerai naishu.” Neijia eikuna eiro te dukuya olaiguanani.
Neitoki olaiguanani ajo, “Ejo ake nabo, ‘Enaai ena kerai naishu, netua enkayioni ino’; nejo enkae; ‘A'a; amu enkayioni ino natua naa enkayioni ai ena naishu.’ ”
Neitoki olaiguanani ajo, “Eyakaki nanu olalem.” Neaku eyauaki olalem dukuya olaiguanani.
Nejo olaiguanani, “Entoor ina kerai naishu katitin are, ninchosho ematua nabo enkitok nabo ninchosho enkae rubata enkae kitok.”

Ore ina kitok apa naishu enkayioni enye nejoki olaiguanani, te nkaraki naata ninye olng'ur to ltau te nkaraki enkayioni enye. “Oi olkitok lai, nchoo ninye meewa ina kerai naishu, nimimper ninye.” Kake etejo ina ae kitok, “Nchoo eaku mme enaai neme enino, tasasha ninye matoor.”
Neitoki olaiguanani awalu ajo, “Enchoo ena kerai naishu enkitok e dukuya, nimisashisasha ake amu ninye ng'otonye.”
Nening Israel pooki enkiguana natudung'o olaiguanani; neing'asiakino ninche olaiguanani; amu etumusutuo aajo etii eng'eno e Nkai atua ninye pee eiguana too sipat.
Olaiguanani Solomon apa oiguanaki enkop e Israel pooki,
naa kulo apa iltung'ana lenyena kituaak: Asaria olayioni le Sadok apa olapolosani;
Elihoref o Ahija ilayiok le Shisha ninche apa ilaigerok; Yehoshefat olayioni le Ahilud apa olashumani loo mbaa;
Benaia olayioni le Yehoida apa olkitok le njore; naa Sadok o Abiatar ninche apa ilapolosak;
Asaira olayioni le Natan apa oitasheiki lelo kituaak, Sabud olayioni le Natan ninye apa olapolosani naa olchore lo laiguanani;
Ahishar ninye apa olaitasheikinoni le nkaji e nkitoo; naa Adomiram olayioni le Abna ninye apa olaitasheikinoni le siaai oo nkaik.
Keeta apa Solomon iltung'ana tomon oaare kituaak te Israel pooki, laa ninche ooisho olaiguanani endaa o lmarei lenye pooki, ore ake oltung'ani neishoru endaa to lapa obo to lari.
Kuna ninche inkarn enye, Benhuri teinakop oo ldoinyio le Efraim,
o Ben-deker te nkop e Makas, o Shaalbim o Betshemesh o Elenbet-hanan,
o Ben-hesed, te nkop e Arubot (enenye apa enkop e Soko o enkop pooki e Hefer)
Ben-abin apa te nkop pooki e Nafat-do (eyama apa ninye Tafat entito e Solomon),

Baana olayioni le Ahilud te nkop e Taanak o Megido o Betshean pooki apa naa ninye natii embata e Saretan tiabori Yesreel. Neitoki adumunye teine ometabaiki Abel-mehola, ometabaiki enkae shoto e Yokmeam,

Benkeber, apa te nkop e Ramot-gilead (keeta apa ninye nkang'itie e Yair olayioni le Manase apa naatii Gilead, neeta sii olkerenket le Argob, otii enkalo e Argob, tiatua enkop e Basham, nkanas ntomoni ile kituaak naasheta sunta o nchomito o suyai),
Ahinadab olayioni le Ido apa te nkop e Mahanaim;
Ahinaas te nkop e Naftali (eyama apa ninye Basemat entito e Solomon);
Baana olayioni le Hushai, te nkop e Asher o te Bealot;
Yehoshefat olayioni le Parua te nkop e Isaakar;
Shimei olayioni le Ela te nkop e Benchamen;
Geber olayioni le Uri te nkop e Gilead, teinakop e Sihon olaiguanani le Amori o Oog olaiguanani le Bashan. Netii apa oltung'ani obo kitok enkop e Yuda.
Ore apa iltung'ana le Yuda o Israel naa eikumok anaa osinyai le naiposha, nedaa apa ninche neokisho neshipayu.
Eitoria apa Solomon nena kitoriat pooki ebaiki olkeju le Frati ometabaiki ina kop oo Filistia ometabaiki olpolosie le Misiri; neyau ninche kodi neisiaai Solomon too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui enye.
Ore apa endaa nayakini Solomon te nkolong nabo, naa mboreitin inkalifuni imiet e ntapa napuyiapui o mboreitin inkalifuni tomon e mpirbil e nkano
o lmong'i tomon oopir o nkishu o lokeri tikitam naapir o nkerra iip, ore tenebo nena ng'uesi naanyanyukie inkoiliin o ronkon o motonyi naapir.
Amu keeta apa ninye enkitoria te nkop pooki o loo ntoluo to lkeju le Frati ebaiki Tipsa ometabaiki Gasa, te shumata ilaiguanak pooki le Frati, neeta ninye eseriani too nchot pooki naamanita ninye.
Ore Yuda o Israel netoni te Seriani, ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba, eton ake oltung'ani tiabori osabibu lenye o tiabori olng'aboli lenye, too nkolong'i pooki e Solomon.
Keeta sii apa Solomon ilaleta inkalifuni artam loo mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan inkalifuni tomon oaare.
Ore apa lelo tung'ana kituaak neisho ninche Solomon endaa o pooki oopuonu emisa o laiguanani Solomon, oltung'ani ake neishooyo endaa to lapa lenye; eitu ninche eisho metong'oro hoo toki.
Eyawuaki sii shairi o lkujita loo mbartan aaitasioki te wueji neyieuni. Neyau ake oltung'ani te risioroto e nkitanapata naitanapaki.
Neisho Enkai Solomon eng'eno nagut o ening'unoto nemeimakinoyu, neiputaki eng'eno naba anaa osinyai le naiposha,
neaku ore eng'eno nagut e Solomon kelusoo te ng'eno oo ltung'ana pooki to loosaen, o ng'eno pooki e Misiri.
Amu aing'en apa ninye alang iltung'ana pooki, ng'en alang Etan le Esrahiti o Heman o Kalkol o Darda lelo ayiok le Mahol, nelo olning'o lenye neibulaa lelo oreren pooki oo manita.
Eiroro sii ndung'eta e rashe nkalifuni uni, ore isinkolioitin lenyena naa enkalifu nabo o imiet.
Eimaka sii ilkeek, ebaiki lelo tarakua otii Lebanon ometabaiki ina hisopo nabulu too sunta neimaki sii ing'uesi o motonyi o ntokitin naaiserpepiari o sinkir.
Nepuonu iltung'ana ooing'uaa iloreren pooki aainining eng'eno nagut e Solomon, o looing'uaa ilaiguanak pooki le nkop, ootoning'oitie eng'eno nagut e Solomon.
Eirriwaka apa Hiram olaiguanani le Tiro Solomon isinkan lenyena etoning'o nchere etuputoki Solomon aaitaa olaiguanani te rishata e papaai lenye, amu kenyor apa Hiram Daudi.
Neirriwaki Solomon Hiram olkilikuai ajoki,

“Iyiolo ajo eitu apa etumoki papaai lai Daudi atesheta enkaji te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai te nkaraki olarrabal amu etang'adutua apa ilmang'ati lenyena ninye, ometaba anaa nepik Olaitoriani ninche abori inkejek enyena.
Kake ore taata, aaishoo nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ai enkiyeng'iyeng te pooki shoto. Metii olmang'atinta nemetii enyamali.”

Neaku atejo kashetu enkaji te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai, anaa apa enatiaaka Olaitoriani Daudi papaai lai, ‘Ore olayioni lino laa ninye nanu apik olorika lino le nkitoo, te rishata ino, ninye oshetu enkaji te nkaraki enkarna ai.’

Ore naa taata ntanapisho pee aadung'okini ltarakua le Lebanon; ore ilaisiaayiak laainei, neibung'are ilaisiaayiak linono naa kalaaki nanu isinkan linono olekoisiaayio anaa enijo; amu iyiolo iyie ajo meetae likae oyiolo atuuroi iltarakua anaa iltung'ana le Sidon.
Ore ake pee ening Hiram lelo omon le Solomon neshipayu oleng, nejo ninye, “Meisisi Olaitoriani ena olong, oishoo Daudi olayioni ng'en oitore ele orere kitok.”
Neirriwaki Hiram Solomon olkilikuai ajoki, “Atoning'o nanu ilo kilikuai likirriwaka; naa kaas nanu nena pooki ninkilikuanua tialo mbaoi o ltarakua o no lchani onyaanyukie oltarakuai.

Keitadou ilaisiaayiak laainei lelo keek te Lebanon neyau embata enaiposha, neen ninche tenebo naaitadoiki te naiposha meetu ewueji niyieu naisho ninche meiperri teine, ning'amaa iyie ninche; ore te nkalo ino naa kayieu nincho iltung'ana laainei endaa.”
Neaku eishoo apa Hiram Solomon mbaoi pooki o ltarakuai o nolerai naaba anaa inaayieu,
neisho Solomon Hiram mboreitin e mpirbil inkalifuni tikitam e nkano meitaa endaa enkaji enye, o mboreitin e mpirbil e ilata nkalifuni tikitam. Neisho Solomon Hiram kuna te pooki ari.
Neisho Olaitoriani Solomon eng'eno, anaa apa enaisiligie ninye, neaku ketii apa eseriani erishata e Hiram o Solomon, ore lelo pokira neitobir olning'o.
Neitayu olaiguanani Solomon iltung'ana oas esiaai te Israel pooki, ore lelo tung'ana naa inkalifuni tomoni uni.

Neirriwaa ninche meshomo Lebanon, nepuo ake iltung'ana inkalifuni tomon te nkata nabo to lapa, netii ake iltung'ana Lebanon to lapa obo, netii ang ilapaitin oaare. Adoniram apa olkitok le lelo tung'ana oasisho.
Keeta sii apa Solomon iltung'ana inkalifuni ntomoni naapishana o naapisho o laguetak loo soito inkalifuni ntomoni isiet te nkop oo ldoinyo.
Ore tenebo lelo etii sii iltung'ana kituaak le Solomon inkalifuni uni o iip uni ooitasheiki esiaai, ninche ooitasheiki lelo tung'ana oonapisho te siaai.
Ore te nkitanapata o laiguanani, nenap ninche isoito sapuki; oogol enkinyiang'a pee etum aatipik olkitamanyunoto le nkaji too soito oogueta.
Neaku ore apa ilashetak le Solomon o lashetak le Hiram, o ltung'ana le Gebal neas esiaai e nguetare neitobir mbaoi o soito pee eshet enkaji e Nkai.

Ore te rishata oo larin iip ong'uan o ntomoni isiet eidipa iltung'ana loo Siraeli aatupuku te nkop e Misiri, to lari liong'uan eitore Solomon Israel, to lapa oji ole Sif, aa ninye olapa liaare, neiteru ninye ashet enkaji o Laitoriani.
Ore apa ina aji nateshetaka olaiguanani Solomon Olaitoriani naa ntemeta e nkaina ntomoni ile enkadoro, naa ntemeta e nkaina tikitam endapasho naa ntemeta e nkaina tomoni uni e nkadoro nailep.
Naa ore olgoriet otii enkalo najing'ieki enkaji naa ntemat e nkaina tikitam, nerisioro endapasho e nkaji, naa ntemat tomon e nkaina eng'uton te dukuya ina aji.
Nepik ninye ilusien naaitobiruaki te nkarriyiano
Neitobir sii aitaman isunta eina aji inkajijik naakedo too nchot pooki.

Ore enkaji eabori naa ntemat imiet e nkaina e ndapasho, ore enkaji e polos naa ntemat ile e nkaina endapasho, ore enkaji e uni te shumata naa ntemat e nkaina naapishana endapasho. Ore te manaroto eina aji neitodorropu isunta pee meibung ake nena rishinani isunta e ina aji.
Ore apa pee esheti ina aji naa too soito ooitobiraki te wueji neguetishoreki, pee mening'i ake enyuntu anaa entolu anaa ae toki e sekenkei tiatua enkaji e Nkai, ina kata eshetitae.
Ore enejing'ieki ilo gilata liabori naa enkalo e kopikop eina aji, naa nkedeta eimi pee epuoi olgilata le polos, nepuoyieki sii olgilata liokuni.
Neaku etesheta Solomon ina aji neidip; nepik enkitoipet e shumata too mbaoi o ltarakuai.
Neitobir ninye lelo gilat meishiaakinore ake olgilata intemeta imiet e nkaina enkadoro, neibung'ieki enkaji too mbaoi o ltarakuai.
Nelotu olkilikuai lo Laitoriani enetii Solomon,
nejo, “Ore ena aji nishetita iyie, tenilo iyie too nkikoot aainei nimbung inkitanapat aainei pooki nirubare ninche, natum taa atuuno ilo rorei te iyie, apa lairorie Daudi papaai lino.
Naa kabik nanu tiatua inkera e Israel nemaing'uaa nanu iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli.”
Neaku etesheta Solomon ina aji, neidip ninye.
Neikod isunta eina aji tiatua too mbaoi o ltarakuai, ore ebaiki oltiren le nkaji ometabaiki enkimulumulet e shumata, nepik nkeek; ore oltiren leina aji neimulumul too nkeek o ltepesi.

Etesheta ninye oriong ina aji apik mbaoi o lerai erishata oo ntemat e nkaina tikitam; etesheta ebaiki oltiren ometabaiki enchumata e suntai, neshet ine aiko anaa atua ina aji e Nkai, anaa ewueji sinyati aisul.
Ore ilo gilata le wueji sinyati oleng naa ntemat tomon o isiet e nkaina enkadoro.
Ore iltarakua ootii atua ina aji negueti aikunu anaa imalasin o ntapuka naalaa, naa iltarakua ake pooki, medoli ninye osoit.
Ore atua ina aji e Nkai, neitobir ninye olgilata liatua tukul, pee etum atipika ine osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani.

Ore apa ilo gilata liatua naa ntemat tikitam e nkaina enkadoro, naa ntemat e nkaina tikitam endapasho, naa ntemet e nkaina tikitam enkadoro nailep, nemura pooki wueji te saabu nasila, nepik olpisiai le saabu metaleng'o dukuya ilo gilata liatua, nemur ninye te saabu.
Nemur Solomon atua ina aji te saabu nasila, nepik ninye olpisiai aitalang ine wueji sinyati, nemur te saabu.
Nemur ninye enkaji pooki te saabu ometaba anaa neidipayu enkaji pooki. Ore sii ilo perere lo lasar liatua ewueji sinyati nemur te saabu.
Ore tiatua ine wueji sinyati neitobir ninye ilkerubi oaare loo nkeek o loirien, ore ake obo, naa intemat tomon e nkaina te nkadoro.
Ntemat imiet e nkaina enkadoro e naipukoi o lkerubi obo. Naa ntemat imiet ebaiki enkiting'oto e naipukoi nabo o metabaiki enkae aipukoi.
Ore olikae kerubi naa ntemat tomon ake sii ninye. Entemata nabo lelo kerubi naa empukunoto nabo.
Ore enkadoro olkerubi obo naa ntemat tomon e nkaina, naa neijia ake sii etiu ilo likae.

Nepik Solomon lelo kerubi ewueji e atua eina aji, ore inaipuko e lelo kerubi nelaki aaisalaash ometaa kebaiki enaipukoi e obo e suntai nebaiki enaipukoi o likae esuntai; ore nkulie aipuko enye nebaikino te mpolos e nkaji.
Nemur ninye lelo kerubi te saabu.
Ore isunta eina aji neikodi aaguetaki ilkerubi oltuka o ntapuka naalaa, neikodi too lgilat o tioriong o too liatuani.
Ore oltiren le nkaji nemur te saabu tiatua o tioriong.
Ore te wueji nejing'ieki ine wueji sinyati nepik nkikeneta o loirien, ore imolinkaishi neripi aaitobiraki, nemur ninye.
Neimulumul ninye aikod nena kikeneta e kutukaji pokira are oo loirienito too ntokitin naaguetuno anaa ilkerubi, o ltuka o ntapuka dapashi, nemur lelo kerubi te saabu o lelo tuka.
Neaku e itobira ninye teine nejing'ieki imolinkaishi e kutukaji o loirien, neisho metorisioto nkaloli pooki,
o nkikenata are e kutukaji oltepesi, ore imatuan are e nkikenet nabo naa keshukunoyu eikeni o eboli naa neijia eitiu enkae matua e nkikenet.
Ore nena kikeneta neikodi aapik olkerubi, o ltuka o ntapuka, nemur ninche te saabu, anaa ina natipikaka nena tokitin naaguetuno.
Neshetu ninye olodung'oro liatua too lkererin okuni loo soito ooguetuno o too ng'apeta oltarakuai.
Ore to lari liong'uan nepiki ina aji o Laitoriani olkitamanyunoto, to lapa le Sif.

Ore to lapa le tomon oobo, to lapa oji ole Buul, laa ninye olapa le imiet neidipayu ina aji too nkaloli pooki, terisioroto oo nkitobirat enyena pooki apa naaitobirakaki ninye. Ilarin oopishana etesheta Solomon ina aji.
Ilarin tomon ookuni apa etesheta Solomon enkaji enye, neidip ninye enchetata enkaji pooki.

Etesheta ninye enkaji e ntim e Lebanon, ore enkadoro enye naa ntemat enkaina iip nabo, ore endapasho naa ntemat e nkaina onom, ore enkadoro eilep naa ntemat e nkaina tomoni uni, neteshetaki apa too lkererin ooiriamari okuni too ng'apeta o ltarakuai, o rishinani oltarakuai te shumata ing'apeta.
Neimulumuli apa shumata lelo gilat te lelo tarakua ootipikaki shumata nena ng'apeta artam oimiet, etii ake iltarakua tomon o imiet olkereri obo.
Netii apa irubat oo lusien olkereri ake obo, netii apa ilusien aaipira too nkaloli pokira, katitin uni.
Ore njing'eta pooki oo nkajijik o lusien naa kerisioro too nchot pooki. Ore ake elusie neipirakinore elusie katitin uni, eiriamari maare.

Neitobir ninye enkaji Nalala oo Ng'apeta; ore enkadoro enye naa ntemat onom e nkaina, ore endapasho enye naa ntemat tomoni uni e nkaina. Netii apa olodungoro dukuya enye oitobiruno too ng'apeta, netii enkitushuret dukuya ninye.
Neitobir ninye enkaji nalala o lorika le nkitoo teine nedung'ie ninye enkiguana, aa taa enkaji e nkiguana, neitobiri too ltarakua ebaiki oltiren o metabaiki shumata enye.

Ore enkaji enye makewan naa ninye, etonie, tiae dung'oroto te siadi ina aji nalala, naa neijia ake eikunuwuaki olchetie. Enyaaka ake sii Solomon aitobiru enkaji natiu anaa ena aji nalala te nkaraki entito e Farao apa nayama.

Eitobiruaki kuna pooki too soito oogol enkinyiang'a, ootaguetaki te risioroto naba anaa enairirikino, neiriri te musumeno, oriong o atua, ebaiki olkitamanyunoto o metabaiki shumata. Ore ebaiki endung'oroto e nkaji o Laitoriani o metabaiki endung'oroto kitok.
Ore apa olkitamanyunoto naa oloo soito oogol enkinyiang'a, isoito sapuki oleng, isoito loo ntemat isiet anaa ntemat tomon enkaina.
Ore shumata naa isoito oogol enkinyiang'a, ooguetuno anaa enairirikino, tenebo iltarakua.

Ore apa ina dung'oroto kitok neeta ilkererin okuni too soito ootaguetaki oomanita o lkereri loo loom loo ltarakua, neeta sii nena ina dung'oroto e atua e nkaji o Laitoriani, o lodung'oro ojing'ieki enkaji.
Neirriwaa olaiguanani Solomon meyauni Hiram aaitung'uaa Tiro.

Olayioni apa ninye le nkoliai o losho le Naftali, ore menye naa oltung'ani le Tiro, olaitobirani lo suyai; naa ng'en apa ninye oleng, neeta eng'eno nagut sapuk o ening'unoto o enkarriyiano te nkitobirata e pooki siaai o suyai. Nelotu ninye enetii olaiguanani Solomon, neas esiaai enye pooki.

Eitobira apa Hiram ing'apeta are o suyai. Ntemat tomon oisiet enkadoro e ng'ape nabo, naa enkopito ntemat tomon oaare enkaina naaman ake eng'ape nabo negum nchumat enye. Ore apa enkirrushai enye naa ilkimojik oong'uan neijia apa eikununo ing'apeta pokira are.
Neitoki sii aitobir intokiting e shumata naaikununo anaa nkopiyiani enkitoo, to suyai otosholaki, pee epiki shumata e nena ng'apeta; ore apa enkadoro entoki nabo naa ntemat imiet e nkaina.

Neitoki aitobiru intokiting are naashetuno anaa ilmarisiani to lpisiai, nepik shumata nena ng'apeta, netii ake ina toki nashetuno anaa olmarisian shumata e ng'ape nabo netii enkae shumata enkae ng'ape.
Neitoki ake sii aitobiru ilgululu oopurupurana oonyaanyukie kukumanka ilkererin oaare pee eitoip nena lukuny oo ng'apeta.
Ore apa nena kikompeni naatii ilukuny e nena ng'apeta neitobiruaki anaa ntapuka, naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina.

Netii apa nena kikompeni ilukuny e nena ng'apeta are, o shumata ina natii embata ena ripata olmarisian, netii apa ilgululu iip are, emanaa too lkererin oaare, naa neijia eikununo enkae toki te nchumata enkae ng'ape.

Neitasheyie Hiram nena ng'apeta ntaloishin pokira are e wueji nejing'ieki enkaji e Nkai; nepik ninye eng'ape enkalo e kopikop nejo enkarna eine Yakini; neitoki, apik eng'ape enkalo e moikuape nejo enkarna enye Boas.
Ore too nchumat oo ng'apeta netii ntokitin naaitobiruaki anaa ntapuka sidain. Neaku eidipe apa esiaai oo ng'apeta.

Neitoki Hiram aitobir olmoti sapuk lo suyai otosholaki, naa kepurupurana ilo moti, naa ntemat tomon e nkaina ebaiki enchoto nabo e nkererema ometabaiki enkae shoto. Naa ntemat imiet e nkaina enkadoro ebaiki kop o metabaiki shumata. Naa ntemat tomoni uni emanaroto enye.
Ore abori enkererema enye netii iltuleta oomanita, ore lelo tuleta naa ilkererin oaare, neenikini ilo moti metaa entoki nabo.

Neitakedi ilo moti shumata iloing'ok tomon oaare lo suyai, neing'orita okuni lenye enkalo e moikuape, neing'orita okuni endoyioroto e nkolong, neing'orita okuni kopikop, neing'orita okuni enkalo o loo ntoluo; ore apa ilo moti naa shumata ninche eiteleikino. Ore enkalo enye pooki e siadi naa atua etii.
Ore endapasho enye neba anaa endap e nkaina, ore enkererema enye neikununo anaa enkererema e nkikompe, eikunuwuaki anaa entapukai sidai. Naa iltooi ooitukuoreki inkalifuni are enkare natii ilo moti.

Enyaaka sii Hiram aitobir inkejek tomon naatonie ilo moti. Ore ake enkitotonet nabo naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina enkadoro, naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina endapasho, naa ntemat uni e nkaina enkadoro nailep.
Ele apa olchetunei loo nkitotoneta. Etipikaki nkeek meibung'a enkamanaa e oriong,

ore nena keek naatipikaki enkamanaa e oriong naguetakino ilng'atunyo o loing'ok o lkerubi. Ore enchumata nena rubat te shumata o tiabori lelo ng'atunyo o loing'ok, netii ilmarisiani le siaai naikoduno.

Ore ake sii keeta ake enkitotonet nabo nkejek e ngarri o ng'uan o suyai o ltidii lo suyai, ore ilpijat pokira oong'uan naa ineeirisharieki ilo moti. Ore nena rishinani neikodoki too lmarisiani te pooki shoto.

Ore enjing'et enye naa enchumata enye etii neilep enkadoro e ntemata nabo e nkaina, ore ina jing'et enye naa kepurupurana naa entemata nabo olpisiai enguton. Ore ina jing'et enye neeta imolinkaishi ore irubat enyena naa kerisioro nchot pooki, mepurupurana.
Netii apa nena kejek pokira ong'uan inkeek e abori. Ore apa nkeek naaibung inkejek naa entoki nabo o nkitotoneta. Ore enkadoro enkeju naa entemet nabo e nkaina olpisiai.
Neitobiraki apa nena kejek anaa nkejek oo ngarrin oo mbartan; ore nkeek enye o enkamanaa o ltidii o eneibung'are, naa ino suyai.
Neeta ake te pooki garri inkeek onguan naairishaa tiabori, naa nabo ninche o engarri.

Ore te nchumata e nkitotonet netii entoki napurupurana aa olpisiai le ntemata e nkaina enkadoro nailep; ore enchumata eina kitotonet, irishinani enyena o nkeek enyena naa entoki nabo o ina garri oo mbartan.
Ore tioriong nena rishinani o tioriong nkeek neguetaki ilkerubi o lng'atunyo o ltuka, te risioroto e rishata e nabo ake enye, neitaman olmarisian.
Ore tele rrekie neitobiru nkitotoneta tomon, neitobiruni pooki aaitanyaanyuk te risioroto o te mpukunoto.
Neitobiru ninye ilmotioo tomon lo suyai; ore ake olmoti obo neeta mboreitin oo ltooi artam ooitukuoreki, ore ake olmoti obo naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina, etii ake olmoti nkitotoneta tomon.
Nepik ninye nena kitasheta imiet enkalo e kopikop eina aji, nepik imiet enkalo e moikuape enkaji, nepik ilo moti olpijata aaitorit kopikop o loo saen leina aji.
Eitobira sii apa Hiram imotioo, o nchempei naata ilala, o ng'irran. Neaku eidipa apa Hiram esiaai pooki nataasaka Solomon tialo ina aji Olaitoriani:
nena ng'apeta pokira are, o lelo bakulini pokira oaare apa otii nchumat e nena ng'apeta, o nena sosin pokira are naaimulumul ilbakulini ootii nchumat oo ng'apeta.
