O lelo gululu iip ong'uan le nena sosin pokira are, ilkererin oaare loo lgululu ake te sos nabo, pee eimulumul lelo bakulini oaare loo nchumat oo ng'apeta;
o nena kitasheta tomon o lelo motioo tomon ootii shumata nkitasheta tomon,
oilo moti obo, o lelo oing'ok tomon oaare ootii abori ilo moti.
Ore nena motioo, o nena kurteta, o mbakulini, ore kuna masaa pooki naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani, apa naaitobiraka Hiram olaiguanani Solomon, naa ino suyai otisikaki.
Ore teina kisiashata e Yordan neiturraa olaiguanani ninche teinakop e nterit natii erishata e Sukot o Seretan.
Neing'ua Solomon nena masaa pooki eitu etemi aaineneng te nkaraki naa eikumok apa oleng. Ore enkiroishi o suyai neitu apa eyiolouni.
Neaku eitobira apa Solomon ntokitin pooki naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani: ilo perere lo lasar le saabu, ina misa e saabu te nkaraki emukate naitisinyaki
o nkitasheta oo ltaai e saabu nasila, imiet te nkalo e kopikop o imiet te nkalo e moikuape, eitu ebaiki ilo gilata liatua; o ntapuka, o ltaai, o ntokitin naarieki iltaai e saabu:

o nkikompeni o nkalema o mbakulini, o ntokitin e nkorropil, o ng'irran e nkima e saabu te nkaraki nena kikeneta e kutukaji e atua ilo gilata liatua, ine wueji nesinya aisul, o nena kikeneta o lgos le nkaji e Nkai.

Neaku ina siaai pooki apa etaasa olaiguanani Solomon neidipayu ina aji o Laitoriani. Neitoki Solomon ayau nena tokiting apa naaitisinya Daudi papaai lenye, ina osholai o ina saabu o nena masaa, neshum ninche te wueji neshumishoreki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

Neitoki Solomon aiturrur ilpayiani loo Siraeli o larikok pooki loo loshon, lelo arikok loo nkajijik oo loo menye, loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, meetu dukuya olaiguanani Solomon te Yerusalem, pee eyau osanduku lo lning'o lo Laitoriani aaitung'uaa enkanasa e Daudi, aa taa Sion.
Neiturrurrokino ilewa pooki loo Siraeli olaiguanani Solomon to sirua to lapa le Etamin, laa ninye olapa liopishana.
Nepuonu ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli, nedumu ilapolosak ilo sanduku.
Neyau ninche ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani, oilo ng'obor, o nena tokiting pooki naasinya apa naatii atua ilo ng'obor, neyau ilapolosak o Lawi nena pooki.
Ore olaiguanani Solomon o eumata pooki oo Siraeli, apa naiturrurre te dukuya ninye, netii tenebo ninye te dukuya ilo sanduku, nepolos inkerra kumok oleng o lmong'i lemeikenayu te nkumoi.
Neitoki ilapolosak aayau ilo sanduku lo lning'o lo Laitoriani ewueji enye, tiatua ilo gilata liatua le nkaji, tiatua ine nesinya aisul. Tiabori inaipuko oo lkerubi.
Amu kelak apa lelo kerubi inaipuko enye aaitushur ilo sanduku o nkeek enyena.
Naa kaadoru apa nena keek oleng ometaa kelioo ineeiting'ie te wueji sinyati eton eitu ejing'i ine wueji sinyati e atua. Kake melioo te boo; netii ninche ine o taata.

Metii apa toki atua ilo sanduku meteleku ake inapa soito are dapashi naatipika Musa ine te Horeb, teine apa neitobirie Olaitoriani olning'o o ltung'ana loo Siraeli, apa pee epuku aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri.
Ore ake pee eipang'u ilapolosak aaing'uaa ine wueji sinyati, neiput enkatampoi enkaji Olaitoriani.
Ore te nkaraki ina, neaku meidim ilapolosak aaitasho aaisiaaisho te nkaraki ina atampoi, amu eiputa enkitoo o laitoriani enkaji o Laitoriani.
Neitoki Solomon ajo, “Etipika Olaitoriani enkolong keper, kake etejo ninye keton ninye te naimin namisimis.
Aateshetaka nanu iyie Enkaji sidai, ewueji nimany iyie ntarasi.”
Neitoki olaiguanani aibelekenya aing'or olorere, nemayian ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli. Neitashe ina kata eumata pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli.
Nejo ninye, “Meisisi Olaitoriani loo Siraeli, laa ninye oitabayie te nkaina enye ina apa naisiligie te nkutuk enye Daudi papaai lai, ajo,

‘Ore ebaiki enkolong nayawua iltung'ana laainei loo Siraeli aitung'uaa Misiri, eitu nanu agelu enkanasa too loshon pooki loo Siraeli naa ninye ashetie enkaji, pee etum enkarna ai ataa ketii ine; kake ategelua nanu Daudi pee eaku oloitore iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli.’
Etii apa atua oltau le Daudi papaai lai pee eshet enkaji te nkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli.
Kake etiaaka apa Olaitoriani Daudi papa, ‘Ore amu etii apa oltau lino pee ishet enkaji te nkaraki enkarna ai, itaasa iyie embae sidai amu ketii apa ena atua oltau lino.
Kake ore ake eyia mishet iyie ina aji, olayioni lino likiikini ninye olo ashet ina aji te nkaraki enkarna ai.’

Ore taata eitabayie Olaitoriani enkisiligata enye apa naisiligishore, amu atijing'a nanu erishata e Daudi papaai lai, naton to lorika le nkitoo le Israel, anaa apa enaisiligishore Olaitoriani, natesheta nanu enkaji te nkaraki enkarna Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.
Ore teina naishorua nanu ewueji nepiki osanduku le Nkai, laa ninye etii atua olning'o lo Laitoriani, apa oitobira tenebo loo papa, apa pee eyau ninche aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.”
Neitoki Solomon aitashe te dukuya olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani te dukuya ina umata pooki oo Siraeli, neitorio inkaik enyena pokira are ailepie shumata;

nejo ninye Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, meetae Enkai nikinyaanyukie, te shumata o te keper, aashu tiabori te nkop. Imbung olning'o nintodolu enyorrata nauno too sinkan linono, oopuo te dukuya iyie too ltauja lenye pooki;
iyie apa oibung'a te papaai Daudi ina nimbalunye te ninye; ee iroro iyie te nkutuk ino, te nkarna ino nintabaya ina ena olong.

Ore naa taata Olaitoriani, Enkai, e Israel, mbung'a to sinka lino Daudi, te papaai lai; ina apa nisiligie ninye ijo, ‘Melai aekata te iyie oltung'ani oitashe te dukuya nanu, pee etonie olorika le nkitoo le Israel, teneing'or ake duoo ninye ilayiok linono inkoitoi enye, nepuo te dukuya nanu anaa apa enishomo te dukuya nanu.’
Ore naa taata na Ai e Israel, nchoo ilo rorei lino meitabari apa lirorie osinka lino Daudi, papaai lai.
“Kake amaa, kemany Enkai enkop? Mikiishaa iyie shumata o keper nalakua; kebaa naa enkitisho ena aji natesheta nanu!
Ore ake eyia itishilayie iyie enkomono o sinka lino o esayiata enye. Olaitoriani Enkai ai, toning'o enkishirata o enkomono naomon osinka lino te dukuya iyie ena olong;
pee etum inkonyek inono aataboloto dama o kewarie aaing'ura ena aji, ene wueji nitejo iyie, ‘Keaku keton enkarna ai teine.’ Pee itum iyie atoning'o ena omono naomon osinka lino te nkaraki ene wueji.
Nining iyie enkomono o esayiata o sinka lino oltung'ana linono Isiraeli, teneomon ninche eing'or ene wueji, ee toning'o iyie itii keper ina manyisho ino; tenining, nipalaki iyiook.
“Teneas oltung'ani eng'oki tialo olelatia enye neinosieki ninye olmumai, nelotu ninye anya olmumai te dukuya olperere lino lo lasar tiatua ena aji,

nining naa iyie te keper, niaas embae, nguanare iyie isinkan linono, nidung'oki enkiguana ilo arruoni, ayau enkarruoisho enye shumata endukuya enye makewan, nimbalunye ilo asipani alaaki ninye te risioroto e supatisho enye.
“Te nemir ilmang'ati iltung'ana linono le Israel, te nkaraki nataasa eng'oki tialo iyie,

te nikimbelekenyakino ninche, neibalunye enkarna ino, neomon aasaisho te dukuya iyie tiatua ena aji; nining iyie te keper, nipalaki ing'ok oo ltung'ana linono. Torrinyu ninche ina kop ninchoo loo menye.

“Teneikeno keper neaku meetae enchan, te nkaraki nataasa ninche eng'oki tialo iyie, teneomon ninche eing'or ene wueji, neibalunye enkarna ino, neibelekenya aaing'uaa ing'ok enye ina kata intamio iyie ninche.

Toning'o naa iyie te keper, nipalaki eng'oki oo sinkan linono, Isiraeli, te ninteng'en iyie ninche enkoitoi napuo aaim, nincho iyie ninche enchan, naa ninye inchoo iltung'ana linono metaa ninye enjungore.

“Tenelotu olameyu enkop, anaa olmeitai, anaa enkidaaroto oo ndaiki, anaa olmaati aashu olkurto; teneman aamuat ninche ilmang'ati lenye tiae anasa nabo oo nkanas enye; to lmeitai ake ninye pooki, o te muoyian ake ninye naba anaa enatii;

Teneomon te nkomono ake pooki, o te sayiata ake pooki nasaisho pooki tung'ani aashu iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli pooki, eyiolo ake oltung'ani emion o ltau lenye makewan, neilepie inkaik enyena aipirie ena aji,

nining naa iyie te keper teina manyisho ino, nipalaki ninche, niaas embae, nincho ake pooki tung'ani te risioroto oo nkoitoi enyena pooki, amu iyie ake, iyie ake, openy oyiolo iltauja too nkera pooki e tung'ani.
Pee kitum ninche aatureita nkolong'i pooki naaishu teinakop apa ninchoo iyie loo menye.
“Ore tenebo nena, tenelotu oltung'ani loo loreren, leme o loo ltung'ana linono Isiraeli, oing'uaa enkop nalakua, nelotu te nkaraki enkarna ino,
(amu kening'oo ninche enkarna ino kitok, o enkarna ino magilani, o enkaina ino naitoriori) tenelotu ninye neomon eing'or ena aji.

Toning'o iyie te keper, teina manyisho ino, niaas te risioroto e nena naaomonu ilo tung'ani loo loreren te iyie; pee etum iloreren pooki le nkop aataiyiolo enkarna ino nikiureyu iyie, anaa enatiu iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, netum sii aatayiolo nchere ore ena aji natesheta nanu naa enkarna ino eipotieki.

“Teneipang iltung'ana linono aapuo olarrabal aagilunore ilmang'ati lenye, te nkoitoi ake ninye naba anaa enirriwayie ninche meima, neomon ninche Olaitoriani eing'or ina anasa nitegelua iyie o enkaji natesheta nanu te nkaraki enkarna ino,
toning'o naa iyie itii keper enkomono o esayiata enye, nincho ninche meisula.

“Teneas ninche eng'oki tialo iyie - amu meetae oltung'ani lemeas eng'oki, nigorokino iyie ninche, nincho iyie ninche ilmang'ati lenye, neaku ewaki ninche aaraya enkop oo lmang'ati lenye, elakua o etaana.

Kake tenepik ninche iltauja lenye teinakop apa nataarayioki aaya, neirridu ninche, nikisai ninche iyie teinakop oo lmang'ati lenye apa ooibung'a ninche nejo, ‘Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, kitogolong'utua nikitaasa entorroni’.

Teneirridu ninche too ndamunot enye pooki o too ltauja lenye pooki tiatua ina kop oo lmang'ati lenye, apa oowaita ninche aaraya, nikiomon ninche eing'orita enkop enye, apa ninchoo iyie loo menye, ina anasa nitegelua iyie, o ina aji natesheta nanu te nkaraki enkarna ino;
toning'o naa iyie ninche te keper teina manyisho ino, enkomono enye o esayiata enye. Nchoo ninche meisula.

Tapalaki lelo tung'ana linono ootaasa eng'oki tialo iyie, tapalaki nkitarruorrot enye pooki naataasa tialo iyie. Nchoo ninche olng'ur too nkonyek e lelo ooibung'a aaraya ninche pee etum aaing'urrie ninche.
(Amu iltung'ana linono ninche, naa enjung'ore ino ninche apa niyaua iyie aitung'uaa Misiri, aitung'uaa atua olmoti le nkima loo sekenke).
Nchoo nkonyek inono metoduaa esayiata o sinka lino o esayiata oo sinkan linono Isiraeli, nining ninche enkata naba anaa enikimpot iyie.
Amu inteng'ela iyie ninche too loreren pooki le nkop, pee eaku enjung'ore ino, anaa apa enimbalunye te Musa, osinka lino, apa pee iyau iyie Olaitoriani Enkai loo papa aitung'uaa Misiri.”
Ore ake pee eidip Solomon atoomono nesai Olaitoriani, neinyototo ninye aing'uaa dukuya olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, te wueji duoo netigilie kung neilepie inkaik enyena aing'orie keper.
Neitashe ninye nemayian eumata pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli to ltoilo kitok, nejo,

“Meisisi Olaitoriani laa ninye oishoo enkiyeng'iyeng iltung'ana lenyena loo Siraeli, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naaisiligishore ninye. Meetae ninye ororei obo otong'oro too nkisiligat enyena sidain, naatolikio apa ninye Musa osinka lenye.
Metaa Olaitoriani Enkai ang tenebo iyiook anaa apa enatii tenebo loo papa; metaa meing'uaa ninye iyiook nemeiturraa iyiook.
Pee etum aitonyorra iltauja lang kewan enye pee kipuo too nkoitoi enyena pooki, nikimbung inkitanapat enyena, o nkikoot enyena, o nkiguanat enyena, apa naaitanapa ninye loo papa.

Nchoo kulo rorei laainei, laa ninche atasaishore te dukuya Olaitoriani, etaaniki Olaitoriani Enkai ang dama o kewarie, naa nchoo ninye meisula osinka lenye, neisulu iltung'ana lenyena, Isiraeli, anaa ake enaishiaakino te pooki olong.
Pee etum iloreren pooki le nkop aatayiolo nchere Olaitoriani ninye Enkai. Meetae likae.
Enchoo naa iltauja linyi eitoriori te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai, nipuopuo too nkiguanat enyena, nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat enyena anaa eninkuna ena olong.”
Neitoki olaiguanani, o Siraeli pooki ootii tenebo, aaitayu olasar te dukuya Olaitoriani.

Neishooyo Solomon anaa ilasarri le seriani to Laitoriani ilmong'i nkalifuni tikitam oaare o nkerra nkalifuni iip nabo o tikitam. Neaku eitisinya olaiguanani o iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli enkaji Olaitoriani.

Ore ake teina olong nemayian olaiguanani empolos e ndung'oroto apa natii dukuya enkaji o Laitoriani. Amu teine eitayio olasar opejori o lasar le ntapa o rubat naapir o lasar le seriani, amu ore apa ilo perere lo lasar lo suyai otii ine naa aikiti oleng, tenepiki olasar opejori o lasar le ntapa, o rubat naapir o lasar le seriani.
Neaku keeta apa Solomon osirua teina kata, o Siraeli pooki tenebo ninye, eumata kitok nabaiki enejing'ieki Hamat o metabaiki oerata le Misiri, te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ang, inkolong'i naapishana.

Ore te nkolong e isiet neisho Solomon iltung'ana meshomo, nemayian lelo tung'ana olaiguanani, nepuo taa inkang'itie enye eng'ida neshipa too ltauja te nkaraki esupatisho pooki naitoduaa Olaitoriani Daudi osinka lenye o Siraeli lelo tung'ana lenyena.
Ore pee eidip Solomon atesheta ina aji o Laitoriani o enkaji o laiguanani o pooki apa naayieu Solomon neshet,
neitoki Olaitoriani aipang'aki Solomon enkata eare, anaa apa enaipang'aka ninye te Gibeon.

Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Atoning'o enkomono ino o sayiata ino, nitoomono iyie te dukuya nanu. Aitisinya nanu ena aji nitesheta iyie, natipika enkarna ai ine ntarasi. Ore inkonyek aainei o ltau lai keaku ine etii nkatitin pooki.
Kake ore tialo iyie, tenaa eilo te dukuya nanu, anaa apa papaai lino Daudi, to ltau le mborron o esupatisho, aas te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa, nimbung nkiguanat aainei o nkikoot,
naun aitubulaa olorika le nkitoria ino te Israel ntarasi, anaa apa enaisiligie Daudi papaai lino, ajoki, ‘Melai aekata te iyie oltung'ani otonie olorika le nkitoo te Israel.’
Kake tenimbelekenya apaash esujata ai, iyie anaa inkera inono, nimimbung inkitanapat aainei, o nkiguanat aainei natipika nanu dukuya intae, nipuopuo aaisiaai kulie aitin niserememe ninche,

naiwuang'ie naa nanu Isiraeli teinakop apa naishoo ninche. Ore ina aji apa naitisinya nanu te nkaraki enkarna ai naiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei, neaku Israel endung'et e rashe o entoki naimakini too loreren.
Neaku ena aji olchala le nkidaaroto, ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo neiputukuny, neisulisho, nejo ninche, ‘Kainyoo pee etaasa Olaitoriani ena tena kop o tena aji?’

Naa kepuo ninche aajo, ‘Te nkaraki natung'uaitie Olaitoriani Enkai enye, naa ninye apa nayawua loo menye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, neibung'are kulie aitin, neserem ninche neisiaai ninche. Ore te nkaraki ina, eyaua Olaitoriani ena torroni pooki shumata ninche.’ ”
Ore etulusoitie ilarin tikitam, eidipa Solomon atesheta nena ajijik pokira are, enkaji o Laitoriani,
o enkaji olaiguanani, neidipa Hiram olaiguanani le Tiro aishoo Solomon iltarakua o mbaoi o saabu, anaa enayieu. Eishoo sii ninye olaiguanani Solomon Hiram nkanas tikitam tiatua enkop e Galilaya.
Kake ore ake pee elotu Hiram te Tiro adol nena anas naaishoo Solomon ninye, neitu eitiship ninye.
Neaku etejo ninye, “Kaji eikununo kuna anas nikinchoo iyie nanu olalashe lai?” “Neaku etejoki apa ninche, enkop e Kabul o taata.”
Neirriwaka apa Hiram olaiguanani Solomon ntalantani iip o tikitam e saabu.
Naa nji eikununo enkisiaayiare, apa nataasa olaiguanani Solomon eshet enkaji o Laitoriani o enkaji enye makewan o Milo, o esuntai e Yerusalem o Hasor o Megido, o Geser.

(Ore apa Farao olaiguanani le Misiri neshomo aibung Geser nepejoo ninye te nkima, netaara apa ninye Ilkanaani oomanya ina anasa metuata, neishooyo enkanasa anaa enkishooroto e nkiyama te ntito enye, ina kitok e Solomon.
Neaku enyaaka apa Solomon ashet Geser) o Bet-horon e abori
o Baalat, o Tamar tiong'ota, tiatua enkop e Yuda,

o nkanas pooki naashumishoreki apa naata Solomon, o nkanas oo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan o nkanas oo lakedok lenyena loo mbartan, o pooki toki apa nayieu Solomon neshet te Yerusalem o tiatua Lebanon o tiatua enkop pooki e nkitoria enye.
Ore lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootelekutua Ilamori o Ilhiti Ilperesi o Lhifi o Lyebusi, lelo apa leme ileilo orere loo Siraeli
ore ina ishoi enye natelekuaki, teinakop, lelo apa leitu eidaikie iltung'ana loo Siraeli tukul - ore kulo neitaa Solomon irrindiki le nkisiaayiare enye, netiu ninche neijia o metabaiki ena olong.

Kake ore too ltung'ana loo Isiraeli eitu eitaa Solomon irrindiki. Isikarini apa ninche, iltung'ana lenyena kituaak apa ninche. Ilkituaak le njore, ilarikok le njore, o lkituaak loo ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan.
Ore kulo naa iltung'ana kituaak ooitasheiki esiaai e Solomon, iip imiet ninche o onom laa ninche ooitasheiki iltung'ana aasak le siaai.
Kake eshomo ina tito e Farao teina anasa e Daudi nelo enkaji enye makewan apa nateshetaka Solomon ninye, neitoki ashetu Milo.

Katitin uni apa to lari eitayu Solomon ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani te nchumata ilo perere lo lasar apa oteshetaka Olaitoriani. Nepej enkorropil te dukuya Olaitoriani. Neaku eidipa apa ninye enkaji.
Eitobira sii apa Solomon imelin kumok te Siong'eber naa ninye nataaniki Eliton, to lomanaa le naiposha Nanyokie, te nkop e Edom.
Neirriwaa Hiram tenebo nena melin kumok isinkan lenyena, iltung'ana oopuo too nkariak, ootamoo enaiposha, tenebo isinkan le Solomon.
Nepuo ninche Ofir neyau saabu teine naa ore esapuko enye ntalantani tikitam, neyaki ninche olaiguanani Solomon.
Naa ore apa pee ening enkaiguanani e Sheba enkishooroto e Solomon tialo enkarna o Laitoriani, nelotu atem ninye too nkikilikuanat naagol.

Nelotu apa ninye Yerusalem erikito iltung'ana kumok oleng, o ntamesin naanapita isonkoyoni, o saabu sapuk oleng o soito oogol enkinyiang'a. Ore ake pee elotu enetii Solomon, neliki ninye nena pooki naadamu naayieu neikilikuanu.
Newal Solomon nkikilikuanat enyena pooki, meetae entoki neitu ewaliki olaiguanani ninye.
Ore ake pee edol ina aiguanani e Sheba ina ng'eno nagut e Solomon pooki o ina aji natesheta,

o endaa natii emisa enye o ltonie loo lkituaak lenyena o enkisiaayiare oo sinkan lenyena, nkilani enye o lanapak lenyena loo nkikompeni o lasarri lenyena oopejori ooishooyo ninye tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, eitu eitoki aidim atejo ae.
Nejoki ninye Solomon, “Ekesipa ilomon apa latoning'o nanu te nkop ai makewan, ooipirta mbaa inono o eng'eno ino.
Kake eitu apa nanu anyorraa lelo omon o maeu adol too nkonyek aainei makewan, naa ng'ura, eitu apa aalikini nanu mbaa pooki; ore eng'eno ino o karsisisho ino kelusoo te nena natoning'o nanu.
Kemunyak iltung'ana inono, nemunyak isinkan linono, ootii dukuya iyie anaake nening eng'eno ino.

Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai ino; amu kitishipakine ninye iyie, nikipik iyie olorika le nkitoo le Israel! Ore te nkaraki natonyorra Olaitoriani Israel ntarasi, kintaa ninye iyie olaiguanani, pee itum atudung'o enkiguana niaas isupati.”

Neitoki ninye aisho Solomon ntalantani iip o tikitam e saabu o sonkoyoni kumok oleng o soito oogol enkinyiang'a. Eitu aekata eitokini aatum enkorropil naba anaa ina naishoo enkaiguanani e Sheba olaiguanani Solomon.
Ore nena melin e Hiram apa naayautua saabu te Efir neyau aaitung'uaa Ofir ilkeek kumok o soito oogol enkinyiang'a.

Neitaa olaiguanani lelo keek ing'apeta e nkaji o Laitoriani, o ne nkaji o laiguanani neitobirie sii ilwululi loo usin o nkai oo sinkolioitin te nkaraki ilaranyak. Eitu aekata eitokini aayau lelo keek, anaa aadol ometabaiki ena olong.

Neisho Solomon ina aiguanani e Sheba nena pooki naayieu ninye. Entoki ake ninye natoomonuo metii nena naaishooki ninye tialo karsisisho o laiguanani Solomon. Neaku etorrinye apa ninye nelo enkop enye, tenebo isinkan lenyena.
Naa ore apa enkiroishi e saabu nayakaki Solomon to lari obo naa intalantani iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile e saabu,
metii ina apa naing'uaa ilbiasharani o kodi oo lamirak o naaing'uaa ilaiguanak pooki le Arabia o lbalusuni leina kop.
Neitobir olaiguanani Solomon ilong'oi iip are dapashi naaidong'uoki te saabu; ore ake nabo naa shekeli iip ile e saabu enkiroishi.
Neitobiru ninye ilong'oi iip uni naaidong'uoki te saabu, nepik ake elong'o nabo nkiloi are e saabu. Nepik olaiguanani nena long'oi atua enkaji naipotoki aajo Entim e Lebanon.
Neitayu sii olaiguanani olorika le nkitoo kitok too lala loo lkanchaoni, nemur ninye te saabu nasila.

Keeta apa ilo orika le nkitoo nkedeta ile, ore tioriong olorika le nkitoo netii endukuya o lashe, ore ake enkalo nabo olorika netii ineeiteleikini inkaik oo lng'atunyo oaare ooitashe te mbata oo neiteleikini inkaik,
neitashe sii ilng'atunyo tomon oaare teine, netii ake obo enkalo nabo e nkedet. Eitu aekata etumi embae nanyaanyukie ena te nkitoria ake ninye pooki.

Ore apa ntokitin pooki naaokishoreki o laiguanani naa ine saabu, ore imasaa pooki enkaji natii entim e Lebanon naa ine saabu nasila. Meetae ine nkosholai, meshilari apa nena aaitaa toki too nkolong'i e Solomon.

Amu keeta apa olaiguanani imelin e Tarshishi te naiposha tenebo imelin e Hiram. Ore ake te nkata nabo te rishata oo larin okuni nepuonu imelin kumok naaing'uaa Tarshishi enapita saabu, o enkosholai, o lala loo lkanchaoni, o lkuluoin, o motonyi sidain.
Kaae, nelusoo olaiguanani Solomon too laiguanak pooki le nkop, te karsisisho o te ng'eno.
Neing'oru enkop pooki enetii Solomon pee epuonu aaning eng'eno enye, natipika Enkai atua endukuya enye.
Neyau ake pooki tung'ani enkishooroto enye, ntokitin e nkosholai o ne saabu o lkarash o manemane o enkorropil o mbartan o nyumpui, neyau nkumok te pooki ari.

Neitoki Solomon aiturrur tenebo ingarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan; eeta apa ninye ingarrin oo mbartan enkalifu nabo o iip ong'uan, o lakedok loo mbartan inkalifuni tomon oaare, apa ootipika ninye nena anas oo ngarrin oo mbartan tenebo sii olaiguanani te Yerusalem.
Neitaa olaiguanani enkosholai entoki nalelek tumoto te Yerusalem, neitotiu anaa isoito, ore iltarakua nebayu anaa ilkeek lo lpurkel.
Ore apa imbartan e Solomon naa Misiri eing'uaa o Kilikia.

Ore lelo ooinyiang'u ngarrin oo mbartan te Misiri naa shekeli iip uni e nkosholai, ore embarta naa shekeli iip o onom neaku ore tialo ilbiasharani lo laiguanani nemirakini mbartan ilaiguanak pooki loo Lhiti o laiguanak le Siria.

Etonyorra apa Olaiguanani Solomon inkituaak kumok oo loreren: entito e Farao, o enoo Lmoabu o enoo le Amon o enoo le Edom, o enoo le Sidon, o nkituaak oo Lhiti, nena e lelo oreren apa ootiaaka Olaitoriani iltung'ana loo Siraeli,
“Emiyamama ake o ninche amu kesipa kepuo ninche aaibelekeny iltauja linyi nisujaa inkaitin enye.” Neibung apa Solomon kuna kituaak te nyorrata.
Keeta apa ninye inkituaak iip naapishana, o nkapiak iip uni, ore nena kituaak enyena neibelekenya oltau lenye.
Ore anaa nemoruau Solomon eibelekenya inkituaak enyena oltau lenye metusujai inkaitin enye; neitu eibung'are oltau lenye oleng Olaitoriani Enkai enye, anaa enatiu apa oltau le Daudi papaai lenye.
Amu etusujayie Solomon Ashtoret ina ai ng'oruoi e Sidon, nesujaa Milkom ilo minong loo le Amoni.
Neaku etaasa apa Solomon entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitu ninye, eunokino asujaa Olaitoriani anaa apa enataasa Daudi papaai lenye.
Neitoki Solomon ashetu ewueji neika e Kermosh ilo minong le Moab o ene Molek ilo minong le Amon, to ldoinyo te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong e Yerusalem.
Neiko ninye neijia te nena kituaak enyena pooki oo loreren naapej enkorropil nepolosaki inkaitin enye.
Negorokino apa Olaitoriani Solomon te nkaraki naibelekenye oltau lenye aing'uaa Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, naipang'aka ninye katitin are.
Neitanapa ninye tialo ena bae pee melo arubare kulie aitin; kake eitu ninye eibung ina naitanapa Olaitoriani.

Ore te nkaraki ina nejoki Olaitoriani Solomon, “Ore amu ena itadamua, neitu imbung olning'o lai lo sotua o nkiguanat aainei naaitanapa nanu iyie esipa, kadung'oo nanu enkitoria ino aiwuang'ie te iyie naisho osinka lino.
Kake ore te nkaraki Daudi papaai lino, maas nanu ena too nkolong'i e nkishui ino, kake kalo nanu adung'oo enkitoria te nkaina o layioni lino.
Ore ake eyia, madung'oo nanu enkitoria pooki; kake kaisho nanu olosho obo olayioni lino, te nkaraki Daudi osinka lai o te nkaraki Yerusalem naa ninye ategelua.”
Nedumu Olaitoriani olmang'atinta metigilunore Solomon, oji Hadad le Edom. Ole nkaji enkitoo apa ninye te Edom.
Amu ore apa etii Daudi Edom, ore Yoab olarikoni le njore neilep alo anukaa ilootuata.
Near Hadad metuata ilewa pooki le Edom. (Amu etobiko apa Yoab o ltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli te Edom ilapaitin ile, ometaba anaa neishie pooki lee te Edom.)
Kake eisikaka Hadad Misiri tenebo kulikae tung'ana le Edom loo sinkan le menye, neton apa aa enkerai kiti Hadad.
Nedumunye ninche te Midian nepuonu Paran, neshoru kulikae te Paran nepuonu Misiri, enetii Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, laa ninye oishoo Enkaji, neikenaki ninye eorikinoto endaa, neisho ninye enkop.
Netum Hadad omom oleng too nkonyek e Farao, neaku eishoo meyama enkanashe e nkitok enye, enkanashe e Tafenes ina kitok o laiguanani.
Ore ina anashe e Tafenes neiki ninye olayioni oji Genubat, laa te nkaji e Farao eoru Tafenes ninye ilki, netii apa Genubat enkaji e Farao aboitare ilayiok le Farao.
Kake ore ake pee ening Hadad ajo etua Daudi, netua sii Yoab olarikoni le njore, nejoki Hadad Farao, “Nchooki nanu mashomo enkop ang.”
Kake etiaaka Farao ninye, “Kainyoo nikitong'orikia te nanu, eji metaa ing'oru arrinyo enkop inyi?” Nejoki Hadad ninye, “Nchooki ake duoo mashomo.”
Neitoki Enkai adumu likae mang'atinta oji Rason olayioni le Eliada apa oisika aing'uaa olkitok lenye Hadadesa olaiguanani le Soba.
Neiturrurroki ninye kewan iltung'ana neaku olarikoni loo larruok, ina kata apa eidipa Daudi atasesekuanisho; nepuo ninche Dameski nebik teine, neitaa ninche ninye olaiguanani le Dameski.
Olmang'atinta apa le Israel ninye too nkolong'i pooki e Solomon, neas ntorrok anaa apa enataasa Hadad. Neaku olmang'atinta le Israel, neitore Siria.
Ore apa Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat le Efraim te Sereda naa osinka le Solomon, oji enkarna e ng'otonye Seruyia, naa enkoliai. Neinyototokino sii ninye agilunore olaiguanani.
Naa te nkaraki ena apa pee etudumakine olaiguanani. Etesheta apa Solomon Milo, neram esuntai apa natigile te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye.
Oltung'ani apa ogol oleng Yeroboam, naa ore ake pee edol Solomon ajo kaarriyia ilo barnoti, neisho meitasheiki esiaai pooki oo nkaik e nkaji e Yosef.
Ore nabo olong neipang Yeroboam te Yerusalem, netumore oloiboni le Nkai oji Ahija le Shilo. Neishopito apa Ahija olkila ng'ejuk; netumo lelo pokira aa ninche ake te nkisiashata.
Neitoki Ahija aibung oladuoo kila ng'ejuk oishopito nepolos aitaa ndung'ot tomon aare.
Nejoki ninye Yeroboam, “Iwa iyie ndung'ot tomon, amu inji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Etaa kajo pee adung'oo enkitoria te nkaina e Solomon, naa kaaisho iyie iloshon tomon,
(kake ketum ninye olosho obo te nkaraki osinka lai Daudi o te nkaraki Yerusalem, ina anasa naa ninye ategelua too loshon loo Siraeli.)

Ore te nkaraki naatung'uayie nanu Solomon, nelo aserem Ashterot ina ai ng'oruoi oo le Sidon, o Kemosh ina ai e Moab o Milkom ina ai oo Lamori, neitu eas esidai too nkonyek aainei, neitu eibung inkikoot aainei, o nkiguanat aainei, anaa apa enataasa Daudi papaai lenye.

Ore ake eyia maya nanu enkitoo pooki aitung'uaa enkaina enye; kake kaitaa nanu ninye olarikoni too nkolong'i pooki enkishui enye te nkaraki Daudi osinka lai, laa ninye ategelua, neibung'a ninye inkitanapat aainei o nkiguanat aainei;
kake kaya nanu enkitoria aitung'uaa enkaina o layioni lenye naaisho nanu iyie iloshon tomon.
Kake ore olayioni le Solomon kaisho nanu olosho obo, pee etum Daudi osinka lai ataa keeta oltaa te dukuya nanu anaake te Yerusalem, teina anasa nategelua nanu apik enkarna ai.
Naa kaaya nanu iyie, nilo aitore nena pooki naang'uar oltau lino, nilo aaku olaiguanani te Israel.

Naa tenining iyie nena pooki naaitanapa nanu iyie, nilo too nkoitoi aainei, niaas isupati too nkonyek aainei, aibung inkikoot aainei, anaa apa enataasa Daudi osinka lai, naaku nanu tenebo iyie, nashetu nanu enkaji ino aitubul, anaa apa enateshetaka Daudi, naaisho nanu iyie Israel.
Naa ore te nkaraki ena kaitame nanu eishoi e Daudi, kake mme ntarasi.’ ”
Neing'oru taa Solomon pee ear Yeroboam metua: kake etudumunye Yeroboam, neisikaki Misiri, nelo enetii Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri, neton ninye te Misiri ometabau keeya e Solomon.
Ore apa teina kata nkiaasin pooki e Solomon o nena pooki naataasa o eng'eno enye nagut, neigeroki te mbuku oo nkiasin e Solomon.
Ore apa enkata naitoria Solomon Yerusalem o Israel pooki naa ilarin artam.
Neirura Solomon aye tenebo loo menye, nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye, neitoreisho Rehoboam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Nelo Rehoboam Shekem, eneshomo apa Isiraeli pooki aaitaayie ninye olaiguanani.
Ore ake pee ening Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat ina, (Amu eton apa etii Misiri, ine apa neisikaka ailany olaiguanani Solomon) neitoki Yeroboam ashukunye te Misiri.
Neirriwaa iloshon le moikuape olkilikuai aaipotu Rehoboam, ore Yeroboam o eumata oo Siraeli pooki nepuonu aajoki Rehoboam,
“Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto. Ore naa taata nteneneng'a ina kisiaayiare nagol e papaai lino, o ina shata nairoishi oo murto natii shumata iyiook, naa aikisiaai iyiook iyie.”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom entung'uayioki too nkolong'i uni, nintokiki aashukunye enatii.” Nepuo iltung'ana.
Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam aikilikuanishore ilpayiani kituaak apa laa ninche ooitashe te dukuya papaai lenye Solomon, apa eton eishu, nejoki, “Kaa kiutakiki matawaliki ele orere?”
Nejoki ninche, “Tenaa iyaku iyie osinka le kulo tung'ana ena olong, nisiaai ninche, nirorie iyie ninche te supatisho tiniwaliki ninche, naa keaku ninche isinkan linono ntarasi.”
Kake etanya ninye ina utaroto natuutakita lelo payiani kituaak, neing'oru eutaroto oo lbarnot le sirit enye, neitasheyie te dukuya ninye.
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kaa intae iututu pee kiwaliki ele orere laatiaakita nanu, ‘Nteneneng'a ina shata oo murto apa natipika papaai lino shumata iyiook?’ ”

Nejoki lelo barnot le sirit enye, “Nji shomo tiaaki ele orere likijoki ninche, ‘Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto, kake inteneneng'aki iyie iyiook’; nji iyie shomo tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore enkilinta ai naa eisapuk alang empolos e papaai.
Naa teneiteleikia papaai intae olchata oiroishi le murt, kaponaa nanu ilo shata linyi loo murto. Eitamio intae papaai too lishien, kaitame nanu intae too nkulupani.’ ”
Neaku eewuo Yeroboam tenebo iltung'ana pooki enetii Rehoboam te nkolong e uni, anaa enatejo olaiguanani, nejoki olaiguanani ninche, “Enyaaki wootu enatii te nkolong e uni.”
Newaliki olaiguanani iltung'ana te nkitarrikinoto, neany ina utaroto naishoo ilpayiani kituaak.

Neirorie olorere anaa enatuutakitia ninye ilbarnot, nejoki, “Eiroshiyie apa papaai enchata inyi oo murto, naa kaponaa nanu ina shata inyi oo murto; eitamio apa intae papaai too lishien kake kaitame nanu intae too nkulupani.”
Neaku eitu ening olaiguanani olorere, amu embae ena nayawua Olaitoriani pee etum aitabai ororei lenye, apa oiroro Olaitoriani aimunye Ahija le Shilon aliki Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat.

Ore ake pee edol Isiraeli pooki aajo eitu ening olaiguanani ninche, newaliki olorere olaiguanani, aajoki, “Kaa rubata iyiook kiata te Daudi? Mikiata iyiook enjung'ore to layioni le Yese. Enchom ilng'oborri linyi intae Israel! Ng'ura naa taata enkaji ino makewan, Daudi.”
Neaku eshomo Isiraeli ilng'oborri lenye. Kake eitoria apa Rehoboam iltung'ana loo Siraeli oomanya atua nkanas e Yuda.

Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam airriwaa Adoram, laa ninye apa olaitasheikinoni le siaai oo nkaik. Nenang iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli ninye too soito ometua. Neisarisaraki olaiguanani Rehoboam aked engari enye oo mbartan, neisikaki Yerusalem.
Neaku etekepari apa Isiraeli aagilunore enkaji e Daudi ometabaiki ena olong.

Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli nchere etorrinyunye Yeroboam, neirriwaa olkilikuai aaipotu ninye meeu eumata, neitaa ninye olaiguanani te shumata Isiraeli pooki. Meetae hoo obo otusujayie enkaji e Daudi, meteleku ake olosho le Yuda.

Ore ake pee elotu Rehoboam Yerusalem, neiturrurru enkaji e Yuda pooki o losho le Benchamen, iltung'ana inkalifuni iip nabo o ntomoni isiet, gelunot ooked ingarrin oo mbartan, pee earare enkaji e Israel, pee errinyoki enkitoria Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon.
Kake eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Shemaia, ilo tung'ani le Nkai, ejo
“Tiaaki Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon, olaiguanani le Yuda, o ltung'ana pooki le nkaji e Yuda o e ne Benchamen, o kulikae tung'ana pooki,

nji ejo Olaitoriani, milo iyie aarare ilalashera linono, lelo tung'ana le Israel. Torrinyoyu pooki ng'ae shomo enkang enye, amu ore ena bae naa nanu eing'uaa.” Neaku etoning'o ninche ororei lo Laitoriani, nerrinyo aapuo nkang'itie, te risioroto ororei lo Laitoriani.
Neitoki Yeroboam ashet Shekem teinakop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, nelo abik teine, neitoki alo teine nelo ashet Penuel.
Nejo Yeroboam to ltau lenye, “Kerrinyunye taata enkitoria alotu enkaji e Daudi,

teneilep kulo tung'ana aapuo aaitayu ilasarri te nkaji o Laitoriani te Yerusalem. Neitoki iltauja le kulo tung'ana aaibelekenyakino olkitok lenye, Rehoboam olaiguanani le Yuda, naar ninche nanu matua nerrinyokino Rehoboam olaiguanani le Yuda.”
Neaku eiguane olaiguanani, neitobir ilasho oaare le saabu. Nejoki olorere, “Ishomo intae Yerusalem enkata naado. Noona inkaitin inyi intae Israel, naa ninche apa naaitayutuo intae te nkop e Misiri.”
Neitasheyie ninye nabo te Betel nepik enkae Dan.
Neaku ina bae eng'oki, amu eshomo iltung'ana aayiaya nabo te Betel, nepuo aayiaya enkae te Dan.
Eitobira sii apa inkajijik too wuejitin e shumata, negelu ilapolosak tiatua olorere pooki, leme iloo Lawi.

Negelu Yeroboam osirua te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa le isiet, anaa apa osirua oatae te Yuda, neitayu ninye ilasarri te nchumata olperere lo lasar, neaku etaasa ninye ina te Betel, apolosaki lelo asho ooitobira. Nepik ilapolosak Betel wuejitin e shumata neeitobira ninye.

Neilep ninye alo ilo perere lo lasar oitobira te Betel te nkolong e tomon o imiet, to lapa le isiet, teilo apa otegelua ninye to ltau lenye makewan; neitisiny ilo sirua te nkaraki iltung'ana loo Siraeli, neilep alo olperere lo lasar apej enkorropil.
Ore te nkintanapata o Laitoriani, nelotu oltung'ani le Nkai oing'uaa Yuda, Betel. Neitashe apa Yeroboam te mbata o lperere lo lasar apej enkorropil.

Neishiraki ilo tung'ani le Nkai olperere lo lasar to rorei lo Laitoriani ejo, “Lo perere lo lasar, lo perere, nji ejo Olaitriani: ‘Keikini enkaji e Daudi enkayioni, naa keji enkarna enye Yosia, naa kepolos ninye te shumata iyie lelo apolosak loo wuejitin neeika, lelo oopej enkorropil te shumata iyie, naa kepuoi aapejoo iloik loo ltung'ana te shumata iyie.’ ”
Neishoru ninye olmonekie teina olong ake, ejo, “Olmonekie ele oiroro Olaitoriani; ejo, ‘Ng'ura kegili ele perere lo lasar aasulaki enkop, ore nena kuruon naatii enchumata enye nebukokini enkop.’”

Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani Yeroboam ina kiroroto o ltung'ani le Nkai, naishiraka ilo perere lo lasar te Betel, neitorioo enkaina enye teilo perere lo lasar ajo, “Embung'a ninye.” Ore ina aina enye duoo naitorioyie aimbung'ie ninye, netoyu, ometaa meekure errinyo.
Nedanya sii olperere lo lasar neibukori nkuruon teilo perere lo lasar, te risioroto eilo monekie oishorua ilo tung'ani le Nkai to rorei lo Laitoriani.

Nejoki olaiguanani ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Toomonokoki taata to Laitoriani Enkai ino, pee etum enkaina ai anyaaki atisidana.” Neomon ilo tung'ani le Nkai Olaitoriani, neitoki enkaina olaiguanani aishiu, netiu anaa duoo.
Neitoki olaiguanani ajoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Wou maape ang pee ilo anya endaa, naaisho sii enkishooroto.”
Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai olaiguanani, “Tenikincho ninye olpisiai le nkaji ino, maairiamariyie nanu iyie. Nemanya nanu endaa aashu aok enkare tene wueji;
amu ina apa aaitanapa ororei lo Laitoriani, ejo, ‘Minya endaa nimiok enkare, nimilo aim enkoitoi duoo niimua.’ ”
Neaku eshomo ninye aim ae oitoi, neitu eibelekenya aim enkoitoi duoo naimua elotu Betel.
Netii apa oloiboni moruo Betel. Nepuonu ilayiok lenyena aaliki nena pooki naataasa oltung'ani le Nkai ina olong te Betel; o lelo rorei sii ootiaaka olaiguanani Yeroboam, neliki ninche papaai lenye.
Nejoki papaai lenye ninche, “Kaa oitoi eima?” Neitodol ilayiok lenyena ninye ina oitoi naimua oltung'ani le Nkai oing'uaa Yuda.
Nejoki ninye ilayiok lenyena, “Erotokoki osikiria,” Neirotoki ninche ninye osikiria, neked ninye.
Nelo ninye asujaa ilo tung'ani le Nkai neinepu etonita te ntonata olchani, oji olmaloni; nejoki ninye, “Eiyie doi oltung'ani le Nkai oing'uaa Yuda?” Nejoki ninye, “Ee nanu.”
Neitoki ajoki ninye, “Wou maape ang pee ilo anya endaa.”
Nejo ninye, “Marrinyo nanu alo tenebo iyie, anaa alo ajing atua aji tenebo iyie; nemanya nanu endaa anaa aok enkare tenebo iyie tene wueji;
amu aatiaka nanu ororei lo Laitoriani, ‘Minya endaa nimiok enkare teine, nimirrinyo aim enkoitoi duoo niimua.’ ”

Nejoki ninye ilo oiboni le Nkai moruo, “Kara sii nanu oloiboni le Nkai anaa iyie, naairorie nanu olmalaika to rorei lo Laitoriani, ejo, ‘Torrinyu ninye meeu tenebo iyie enkaji ino pee etum ainosa endaa neok enkare.’ ”
Kake eteleja apa ninye ninye. Neaku eshomo tenebo ninye nenya endaa te nkaji enye neok enkare.
Ore etonita ninche te misa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii ilo oiboni apa otorrinyuo ninye ariku;
neishiraki ninye ilo tung'ani le Nkai apa oing'uaa Yuda, ejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore te nkaraki neitu imbung ororei lo Laitoriani, neitu imbung inkitanapat Olaitoriani Enkai, kake itorrinyunye,
ninya endaa niok enkare tene wueji, nikitiaaka apa ninye iyie; Minya endaa nimiok enkare. Mepuoi aanukaa osesen lino te nkurare oo loo papaai lino.’ ”
Ore ake pee eidip ainosa endaa neokisho neirotoki osikiria ilo oiboni duoo otorrinyuo ariku.
Ore eloito nenang'are olng'atuny ninye te nkoitoi near ninye metua. Nenang'akini osesen lenye te nkoitoi, neitashe osikiria te mbata enye; neitashe sii olng'atuny te mbata o sesen.
Ore egiroo iltung'ana nedol osesen otanang'akaki enkoitoi, neitashe olng'atuny te mbata. Nepuonu aaimaki teina anasa apa namanya ilo oiboni moruo.

Ore ake pee ening ilo oiboni apa otorrinyuo ninye te nkoitoi ina, nejo ninye, “Oltung'ani le Nkai ilo; leitu ening ororei lo Laitoriani; neaku eishooyie Olaitoriani meinosa olng'atuny, nenya olng'atuny ninye aar metua, te risioroto e ilo rorei oirorie ninye.”
Nejoki ninye ilayiok lenyena, “Erotokoki nanu esikiria” neaku eirotokoki ninye esikiria,
Nelo ninye neinepu ninye eirrag te nkoitoi, neitashe osikiria o lng'atuny te mbata ilo sesen Neitu enya olng'atuny ilo sesen neitu enya ilo sikiria.
Neya ilo oiboni moruo osesen le ilo tung'ani le Nkai neiteleiki osikiria, nerrinyu ayau enkanasa pee eishiraki, nenukaa.
Neirragie ilo sesen anukaa te nkurare enye makewan; neishiraki ninche ninye ejo,
“Ee olalashe lai!” Ore ake pee eidip atunukai ninye, nejoki ilayiok lenyena, “Tenaye kenya, entunukayioki te nkurare natunukarieki oltung'ani le Nkai; erragie iloik laainei te mbata oo loik lenyena.
Amu ore ina kiroroto apa naishiraka to rorei lo Laitoriani olperere lo lasar te Betel, o nkajijik pooki oo wuejitin neeika naatii nkanas e Samaria, kesipa, keyookini aaitabaya.”

Ore te siadi ena eitu eibelekenya inkoitoi e Yeroboam torrok, kake enyaaka aitayu ilapolosak too wuejitin neeika tiatua olorere pooki; neaku ore pooki ng'ae oyieu, neitisiny metaa olapolosani too wuejitin neeika.
Neaku ena bae eng'oki te nkaji e Yeroboam o metaa eiwuang'ieki neidaikieki aaishie te nkop.
Ore apa teina kata nemuoyu olayioni oji Abija, olayioni le Yeroboam.

Nejoki Yeroboam enkitok enye, “Tudumunye nimbelekenya, pee meyiolouni ake ajo ira enkitok e Yeroboam, nilo Shilo; ng'ura etii oloiboni oji Ahija ine laa ninye apa oibonuo tialo nanu nchere kaaku olaiguanani le kulo tung'ana.
Toshoroi imukateni tomon o embata oo mukateni naamelook o esiang'au e naisho, nilo enetii ninye; pee kiliki ninye enatiu enkerai.”
Neas enkitok e Yeroboam ina, nedumunye ninye nelo Shilo, nelo enkaji e Ahija. Nemeekure apa edolisho Ahija amu eiliilaitie inkonyek enyena te nkaraki emoruao.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Ahija, “Ekilotu enkitok e Yeroboam aikilikuanishore te nkaraki olayioni lenye; amu kemuoi ninye. Ena o ena tiaaki ninye.” Ore ake pee ebau neitaakuno kaae kitok.

Kake ore ake pee ening Ahija oltoilo loo roruat enyena, ejing'u aimu kutukaji, nejoki “Tijing'u ena kitok e Yeroboam, kainyoo pee intaakuno eira likae tung'ani? Amu aaitanapaki ilomon ooiroishi te nkaraki iyie.
Shomo tiaaki Yeroboam ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, ore amu aailepie iyie tiatua iltung'ana pooki, naaitaa iyie olarikoni te shumata iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli,

natudung'oyie enkitoria aitung'uaa enkaji e Daudi, naaisho iyie; neitu ake sii itiu anaa osinka lai Daudi, apa oibung inkitanapat aainei naasuj ninye nanu to ltau lenye pooki, aas ake nena sidain too nkonyek aainei,
kake ore iyie itaasa ntorrok aitalang nena pooki apa naatii dukuya iyie, nishomo dukuya aitobiraki kewan kulie aitin, o nkitanyaanyukot naasholuno, nikintagor nanu, nikincho nanu oriong. Ore naa

kayau nanu entorroni shumata enkaji e Yeroboam, naiwuang'ie te Yeroboam pooki lee, aa oloena o lolakuno tiatua Israel pooki, namut nanu enkaji e Yeroboam tukul, anaa enapejoo oltung'ani olchala neishie.
Ore pooki ng'ae lo lmarei le Yeroboam oye tena anasa nenya ildien. Ore pooki ng'ae oye ti ong'ata nenya motonyi o loing'ang'e; amu Olaitoriani oiroro ena.’
“Tudumunye naa taata shomo enkaji ino. Naa tenebaiki inkejek inono enkanasa, neye ina kerai.

Naa keishiraki Isiraeli pooki ninye, nenukaa ninye; amu ore ilo laa ninye eeta Yeroboam naa kenukari te nkurare, amu atua ninye ake enotieki entoki naitiship Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, tiatua enkaji e Yeroboam.
Ore ake sii kedumu Olaitoriani te nkaraki kewan enye olaiguanani olotu shumata Isiraeli, laa ninye olo aiwuang'ie enkaji e Yeroboam.

Naa keosh Olaitoriani Israel neitotiu anaa oseyiai oikirikira tiatua enkare, neitayu Isiraeli aiwuang'ie tena kop sidai apa naishoo loo menye, neidapashaki ninche teidia alo Frati, te nkaraki naitobira ninche Asherim enye neitagor Olaitoriani.
Naa kepalaa ninye Isiraeli te nkaraki ina ng'oki e Yeroboam, apa naataasa neitaas sii iltung'ana loo Siraeli.”
Nerrinyo enkitok e Yeroboam alo Tirsa. Ore ake pee ebau embata e nkaji enye, neye enkerai.
Nenukaa Isiraeli pooki ninye neishiraki te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye Ahija oloiboni le Nkai.
Ore kulie kiaasin e Yeroboam, ilarrabali, o enkitoria enye, eigeroki ninche te mbuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.
Ore enkata apa naitoreishe Yeroboam, naa ilarin tikitam oaare, neirura aye anaa loo menye neitoreisho olayioni lenye Nadab te rishata enye.

Eitoria apa Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon Yuda. Ore apa pee eiteru Rehoboam aitoreisho naa oloo larin artam oobo. Eitoreishe ninye ilarin tomon oopishana te Yerusalem, teina anasa naa ninye etegelua Olaitoriani tiatua iloshon pooki loo Siraeli, pee etum atipika enkarna enye ine. Naa keji apa enkarna e ng'otonye Naama e Amon.
Neas apa iltung'ana le Yuda embae torrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitagor ninche ninye nepik olom te nkaraki nena ng'ok enye naataasa.
Amu eteshetakitia sii ninche ate iwuejitin neeika, o ng'apeta o Asherim, te pooki wueji neika o tiabori pooki shani onyori

neetae sii apa ilewa le nkisiaayiare e seremare enkiborra oo nkonyek teinakop. Etaasa ninche te risioroto e nena pooki olminong te lelo oreren apa ootaarayie Olaitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana loo Siraeli.
Ore to lari le imiet le nkitoria e Rehoboam neilepu Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri alotu agilunore Yerusalem.
Neya ninye ilchumat te nkaji o Laitoriani o lchumat te nkaji o laiguanani, neya ninye pooki toki. Neya sii nena long'oi pooki e saabu apa naaitobira Solomon;
neitobir olaiguanani Rehoboam ilong'oi o suyai apik erishata e nena, neisho ninche lelo kituaak le rripore, apa oorripito kutukaji e nkaji o laiguanani.
Ore pooki kata nalo olaiguanani enkaji o Laitoriani, nenapu olarriponi nena long'oi ayau enkaji e rripore.
Ore nkulie kiaasin e Rehoboam o pooki apa naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.
Neeta apa Rehoboam o Yeroboam olarrabal anaake.
Neirura Rehoboam, neye anaa loo menye nenukari too nkuraren oo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Naama e Amon, neitoreisho Abijam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Ore apa to lari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria o layioni le Nebat, neiteru Abijan aitoreisho te Yuda.
Neitoreisho ninye ilarin okuni te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Maaka entito e Abishalom.
Neas ninye ing'ok pooki apa naataasa menye te dukuya ninye, nemeitoriori oltau lenye tialo Olaitoriani Enkai enye, anaa apa oltau le Daudi nkuyiaa lenye.
Ore ake eyia te nkaraki Daudi, neisho ninye Olaitoriani Enkai enye oltaa te Yerusalem, aisho olayioni lenye metijing'a erishata enye, neitasheyie Yerusalem;

te nkaraki apa nataasa Daudi mbaa supati too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitu ninye eibelekenya te pooki toki naitanapa ninye Olaitoriani, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui enye, meteleku ake te mbae naipirta Uria ilo le Hiti.
Neeta apa Rehoboam o Yeroboam olarrabal too nkolong'i e nkishui enye pooki.
Ore nkulie kiaasin e Abijam o nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda. Neeta apa Abijan olarrabal o Yeroboam.
Neirura Abijam neye anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye te nkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Asa olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Ore to lari le tikitam le nkitoria e Yeroboam olaiguanani loo Siraeli neiteru Asa aitoreisho te Yuda.
Neitoreisho ilarin artam oobo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Maaka entito e Abishalom.
Neas Asa mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani anaa apa enataasa Daudi nkuyiaa lenye.
Neiwuang'ie lelo lewa le nkisiaayiare e seremare enkiborra oo nkonyek apa naitobira loo menye.
Eiwuang'ieki sii Maaka ng'otonye meitoki aaku enkaiguanani te nkaraki naata apa enkitanyaanyukoto olminong apa naitobirakaki Ashera, nesulaki Asa ina kitanyaanyukoto enkop nepejoo to erata le Kedron.
Kake eitu apa eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika. Ore ake eyia, keitoriori apa oltau le Asa tialo Olaitoriani katukul, inkolong'i pooki e nkishui enye.
Neyau ninye atua enkaji o Laitoriani ntokitin apa naaitisinya menye o naaitisinya ninye makewan, enkosholai, o saabu o masaa.
Netii apa olarrabal erishata e Asa o Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli too nkolong'i enye pooki.
Eshomo Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli agilunore Yuda, neshet Rama, pee etum aibooi pooki ng'ae olotu enetii Asa olaiguanani le Yuda.

Neyau Asa enkosholai pooki o ina saabu apa natelekua to lchumati le nkaji o Llaitoriani, o to lchumati le nkaji o Laiguanani, nepik inkaik oo sinkan lenyena. Neirriwaa olaiguanani Asa ninche meshomo enetii Benhadad olayioni le Tabrimon olayioni le Hesion, olaiguanani le Siria, laa Dameski apa namanya, nejoki,

“Maibung'ata iyiook pokira anaa apa enatiu papaai o papaai lino: ng'ura aairriwaka nanu iyie enkishooroto e nkosholai o saabu. Shomo ntobira osotua lino o Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli, pee aatum atung'uai nanu.”
Nening Benhadad enatejo olaiguanani Asa, neirriwaa ilarikok lenyena le njore meshomo aagilunore nkanas oo Siraeli, nemir Iyon o Dan o Abel-bet-maaka o Kinerut pooki tenebo enkop pooki e Naftali.
Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani Baasha ina, neitu eitoki ashet Rama, nelo ninye abik te Tirsa.

Neitoki olaiguanani Asa alimu enkitanapata, tiatua Yuda pooki, pee meing'uari ninye oltung'ani obo, pee epuo aaya lelo soito apa le Rama o mbaoi enyena, apa naa ninche eshetishore Baasha, nelo olaiguanani Asa ashetie Geba e Benchamen o Mispa.

Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Asa, enkidimata enye pooki o nena pooki naataasa ninye o nkanas naatesheta ninye, neigero pooki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli. Kake ore etamorua ninye netum emuoyian too nkejek enyena.
Neirura Asa neye anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye te nkurare oo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi nkuyiaa lenye. Neitoreisho Yehoshafat olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Neiteru Nadab olayioni le Yeroboam aitoreisho tiatua Isiraeli, to lari liaare le Asa ilo aiguanani le Yuda. Neitoreishe ninye te Israel ilarin oaare.
Neas ninye ntorrok te dukuya nkonyek Olaitoriani, nelo aibung olkuaak, le menye. Neas ing'ok, nerikoki Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.
Ore Baasha olayioni le Ahija lo losho le Isaakar, nerresh ninye. Near Baasha ninye metua te Gibeton nara enoo Filistia, amu eirraga apa Nadab o Siraeli pooki aang'adu Gibeton.
Neaku etaara Baasha ninye metua to lari liokuni le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye te rishata e Nadab

re ake pee eaku olaiguanani nesesekuan enkaji e Yeroboam pooki, eitu ninye eing'uaa olaishirani te nkaji e Yeroboam. Eidakie pooki te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye oji Ahija le Shilo.
Naa te nkaraki nena ng'ok e Yeroboam apa naataasa, nerikoki Israel metaasa eng'oki, o te nkaraki ina naitagoro ninye Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Nadab, o nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.
Neeta apa Asa olarrabal, o Baasha ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli too nkolong'i enye pooki.
Ore to lari liokuni le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Baasha olayioni le Ahija aitore Israel pooki te Tirsa, neitoreisho ilarin tikitam oong'uan.
Neas ninye intorrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neibung orrekie le Yeroboam teina ng'oki natorikoko Israeli metaasa.
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani aimu Yehu olayioni le Hanani te nkaraki Baasha, ejo,

“Ore anaa naadumu ailepie iyie aitung'uaa nkulupuok, naaitaa iyie olarikoni loo ltung'ana laainei Isiraeli, nimbung'a iyie orrekie le Yeroboam, nitorikoko iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok. Kintagoro nanu te nkaraki ing'ok enye.
Kaiwuang'ie nanu katukul Baasha o enkaji enye aishie, naitaa enkaji ino anaa enkaji e Yeroboam olayioni le Nabat.
Ore pooki ng'ae to lmarei le Baasha oye tiatua enkanasa, nenya ildiein. Ore pooki ng'ae oye ti ong'ota nenya ilmotonyi o loing'ang'e.”
Ore apa inkiaasin e Baasha, o naataasa, o enkidimata enye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.
Neirura Baasha neye anaa loo menye nenukari te Tirsa; neitoreisho Ela olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu eimu Yehu oloiboni le Nkai, olayioni le Hanani enetii Baasha o enkaji enye apa eipirta ilo rorei, te nkaraki entorroni pooki apa nataasa too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitagor ninye teina siaai oo nkaik enyena, neiko anaa apa Yeroboam, nenyaaka sii aidaikie.
Ore to lari le tikitam o ile lo laiguanani Asa le Yuda, neitore Ela olayioni le Baasha Isiraeli te Tirsa. Neitoreisho ilarin oaare.
Kake etarresho Simri, ilo kitok lo lpisiaai loo ngarrin oo mbartan ninye. Ore apa etii ninye Tirsa, eokisho nemera te nkaji e Arsa, laa ninye apa oitasheiki enkaji te Tirsa,
nejing'u Simri neosh ninye anang'ie enkop, near metua to lari le tikitam oopishana le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye te rishata enye.
Ore ake pee eiteru Simri aitoreisho, ore ake enatonie to lorika lenye le nkitoo, near enkaji e Baasha pooki metuata. Eitu ninye eing'uaa olee obo lo lmarei lenye anaa ilchoreta lenyena.
Neidaikie Simri anaa enkaji e Baasha pooki, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani apa oiroro tialo Baasha aimunye Yehu oloiboni le Nkai,
te nkaraki ing'ok pooki e Baasha o ng'ok e Ela olayioni lenye apa naataasa ninche. Eitagoro ninche Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli too nkitanyaanyukot enye.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Ela o nena pooki naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua mbukui oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.
Ore to lari le tikitam oopishana le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda neitoreisho Simri nkolong'i naapishana te Tirsa. Netii apa iltimito ootuuno ilng'oborri egilunore Gibeton oo Filistia,

ore lelo timito ootii ilng'oborri nening eji, “Etarresho Simri olaiguanani near metua.” Ore te nkaraki ina neitaa Isiraeli pooki Omri ilo kitok le njore, metaa olaiguanani le Israel ina olong oo lng'oborri.
Neaku eilepa Omri aing'uaa Gibeton o Siraeli pooki tenebo ninye. Nepuo aang'adu Tirsa.
Ore ake pee edol Simri nchere eibung'aki enkanasa, nelo ninye olgilata liatua le nkaji o laiguanani, nepejoo inaa aji o laiguanani etii atua, neye ninye.
Etua te nkaraki e nena ng'ok enyena naataasa, neas ntorrok te dukuya Olaitoriani, neibung olkerreti le Yeroboam. O te nkaraki sii ing'ok naataasa erikoki Isiraeli ing'ok.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Simri, o ina natarreshishe, neigeroki tiatua mbukui oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.
Etoorote apa iltung'ana loo Siraeli katitin are: etusujaitie olpisiaai loo ltung'ana Tibni olayioni le Ginat aaitaa olaiguanani. Nesujaa olikae pisiai Omri.
Kake ore lelo tung'ana ootusujaitie Omri, nemir lelo ootusuja Tibni olayioni le Ginat. Neaku etua Tibni neaku Omri ninye olaiguanani.
Ore to lari le tomoni uni okuni le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Omri aitore Israel, neitoreisho ilarin tomon oaare. Too larin ile eitoria Tirsa.

Einyiang'ua apa ninye endoinyo e Samaria te Shemer neinosie ntalantani are e nkosholai, neitobir apa ninye ina doinyo ashet, nejo enkarna eina anasa natesheta Samaria, eipotie enkarna e Shemer, olopeny ina doinyio.
Neas Omri ntorrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neas ntorrok aitulus te lelo pooki ooiturukutuo te dukuya ninye.
Amu eibung'a ninye olkerreti le Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat. Ore too ng'ok naatorikoko ninye Israeli metaasa, neitagor Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, te nkaraki nkitanyaanyukot enye.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin naataasa Omri, o ina kidimata naitodolua, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.
Neirura Omri neye anaa loo menye. Nenukari te Samaria. Neitoreisho Ahab olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Ore to lari le tomoni uni o isiet le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Ahab olayioni le Omri aitore Isiraeli te Samaria. Neitoreisho ilarin tikitam oong'uan.
Neas Ahab olayioni le Omri ntorrok te dukuya Olaitoriani aitulus te lelo apa ooiturukutuo te dukuya ninye.

Ore edol anaa entoki nalelek te ninye teneibung olkerreti le Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, neyau ninye Yesebel entito e Etabal olaiguanani le Sidon aitaa enkitok enye. Nelo ninye aisiaai Baal neserem ninye.
Neshetaki ninye Baal olperere lo lasar tiatua enkaji e Baal apa natesheta te Samaria.
Neitobir Ahab ashera. Etaasa Ahab mbaa kumok naaitagor Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli aitulus too laiguanak pooki loo Siraeli apa ootii te dukuya ninye.

Ore too nkolong'i enyena neshet Hiel le Betel Yeriko. Etipika ninye olkitamanyunoto ainosie Abiram olkikau lenye, nepik nchomito ainosie Segub olayioni lenye oti, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, apa oiroro aimunye Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.
Nejoki apa Eliya le Tishbi Ahab te Gilead, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, laa te dukuya ninye aitashe, metumi enkinuku aashu enchan te kuna olong'i, meteleku ake to rorei lai.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Eliya, ejo,
shomo tung'uai ine nimbelekenya alo enkalo o loosaen, nilo aisudori to erata le Kerit. Aa taa oloo saen lo lkeju le Yordan.
Shomo tooko enkare eilo erata amu aitanapa nanu ilkurruki pee kintoti iyie teine.
Neaku eshomo ninye te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani. Nelo ninye abik te mbata eilo erata le Kerit te nkalo oloosaen to lkeju le Yordan.
Neyaki ilkurruki ninye imukateni o nkiri tadekenya, neyaki sii teipa, neokisho teilo shorro.
Ore te nkiti kata netoyu ilo shorro, amu meetae apa enchan teinakop.
Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Eliya, nejoki,
“Tudumunye, shomo Serafat e Sidon, nilo abik teine. Ng'ura aitanapa nanu enkoliai teine pee kintoti iyie.”
Neaku etudumunye ninye nelo Serafat. Ore ake pee ebaiki kishomi enkanasa, nedol enkoliai natii ine esotu ilkeek, neipot ninye nejoki, “Iyakaki enkiti are te nkikompe, pee aok.”
Ore eloito ina oliai ayau enkare, neipotu ninye ajoki, “Iyakaki embelati e mukate te nkaina ino.”

Nejoki ina oliai ninye, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, eitu nanu apej toki, emborei enkaina e ntapa ake aata te siang'au o enkiti ilata to ltulet. Naa ore taata, ilkuti keek nanu asotu pee alo ayier te nkaraki kewan ai o enkayioni ai, pee kitum aainosa nikiye.”
Nejoki Eliya ninye, “Miureisho, shomo taasa anaa enitejo, kake tang'asa ntobirakaki enkiti mukate nikiyaki, ore te siadi ina nintoki taa aitobiraki kewan o enkayioni ino.
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Ore ilo siang'au le ntapa metoyu aekata, ore ilo tulet le ilata nemeishunye aekata ometabau ina olong nairriwaki Olaitoriani enchan enkop.’ ”
Nelo ninye aas anaa enatejo Eliya; ore ninye o Eliya olmarei lenye nenya endaa inkolong'i kumok.
Ore ilo siang'au le ntapa neitu aekata etoyu, neitu aekata eishunye ilo tulet le ilata, te risioroto eilo rorei lo Laitoriani oirorie Eliya.
Ore te siadi nena olong'i nemuoyu enkayioni eina oliai. Neitirrishaki emuoyian oleng o metaa meekure eyang.
Nejoki ina oliai Eliya, “Kaa kiaatakinore iyie nanu, lo tung'ani le Nkai? Iewuo iyie enatii pee edamuni eng'oki ai, niyau keeya e nkayioni ai!”
Nejoki Eliya ninye, “Inchooki sii iyie ina ayioni ino.” Neya ninye ina ayioni too nkaik e ng'otonye, nenap ninye aya olgilata le shumata ine apa neirrag ninye, neirragie te ndapash enye makewan.
Neishiraki ninye Olaitoriani ejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai ai, iyaka iyie entorroni shumata ena oliai apa naa ninye aewuo airragaa, aar enkayioni enye metua?”
Neitoriori Eliya te shumata ina ayioni katitin uni, neishiraki Olaitoriani, ejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai, nchoo enkishui ena kerai errinyokino.”
Nening Olaitoriani olkiyioi le Eliya; nerrinyokino ina kerai enkishui enye aitoki, nepiu ninye.
Neya Eliya ina kerai, neitadou aitung'uaa ilo gilata le shumata, neyau olgilata liabori neitarasaki ng'otonye; nejo Eliya, “Ng'ura ajo keishu enkayioni ino.”
Nejoki ina kitok Eliya, “Atayiolo taa taata ajo ira iyie oltung'ani le Nkai, nesipa ororei lo Laitoriani te nkutuk ino.”
Ore te siadi pee eishunye inkolong'i kumok, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Eliya, to lari liokuni, ejo, “Shomo ntoduaai kewan te Ahab, amu kairriwaki nanu enchan enkop.”
Kaae, nelo Eliya aitoduaaya kewan te Ahab. Ore apa ina kata netirrisha olameyu te Samaria.
Neipotu Ahab Obadia laa ninye apa oitasheiki enkaji enye. Naa keyanyit apa Obadia Olaitoriani oleng.
Naa ore ake pee earaa Yesebel iloibonok lo Laitoriani, neya Obadia iloibonok le Nkai iip nelo aisudoo moo onom te nkapune, neitoti ninche too mukateni o te nkare.
Neipotu Ahab Obadia nejoki, “Shomo atua enkop pooki o nchorroi pooki oo nkariak o erat pooki, amu ebaiki nikitum nkujit nikincho mbartan o nyumpui, pee mitianya ake embata oo ng'uesi.”
Neaku etooro apa ninche enkop pokira oaare, pee etum aashom. Nelo Ahab enkae alo nelo Obadia enkae alo openy.
Ore eloito Obadia te nkoitoi, nenang'are Eliya ninye; neyiolou Obadia ninye, nebatata te nkomom abaiki enkop, nejo, “Keyie ele olkitok lai Eliya?”
Newaliki Eliya ajoki, “Ee nanu. Shomo tiaaki olkitok lino, ‘Ng'ura ajo etii Eliya ene!’ ”
Nejoki Obadia ninye, Kaa ng'oki ataasa nanu, eji metaa inchooyo osinka lino apik enkaina e Ahab, maataara nanu matua?

Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, meetae olorere aashu enkitoria neitu eirriwaa olkitok lai ilkiliku king'oru iyie, naa tenejo ninche, ‘Metii ninye ene,’ neinosie olmumai ina kitoria aashu ilo orere, nchere eitu ninche kitum iyie.
Eji ore taata nijo iyie, ‘Shomo tiaaki olkitok lino; Etii Eliya ene.’

Naa tenaaorore nanu iyie nikiya iyie Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani ewueji nemayiolo, niaaku tenalo nanu ajoki Ahab ina, nikilau ninye, naar nanu matua, hoo nayanyita nanu osinka lino Olaitoriani ebaiki telelero ai.
Keitu ining apa olkitok lai enataasa ina kata apa ear Yesebel iloibonok lo Laitoriani, naisudoo nanu iloibonok iip lo Laitoriani, moonom tiatua enkapune, naitoti nanu ninche too mukateni o te nkare?
Eji nijo taata iyie, “Shomo tiaaki olkitok lino, etii Eliya ene.” Pee aar nanu matua.
Nejo Eliya, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani loo lororani, laa te dukuya ninye nanu aitashe, kalo ake aitoduaaya kewan ai to laiguanani taata.”
Kaae, nelo Obadia atumore Ahab, neliki ninye. Nelo Ahab atumore Eliya.
Ore ake pee edol Ahab Eliya, nejoki ninye, “Kaa iyie doi ele, olaitanyamalani loo Siraeli?” Newaliki ninye ajoki,
“Eitu nanu aitanyamal Israel kake iyie oitanyamala, o enkaji e papaai lino, te nkaraki nitalama nkitanapat o Laitoriani, nisujaa Baal.
Ore naa taata shomo nturrurrokoki iltung'ana loo Siraeli to ldoinyo le Karmel. Toriku lelo oibonok pokira iip ong'uan o onom le Baal o lelo oibonok iip ong'uan le Ashera, oodaa te Misa e Yesebel.”
Neipotu Ahab iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, neiturrur iloibonok tenebo to ldoinyo le Karmel.

Nelotu Eliya anyikaki iltung'ana pooki nejoki, “Ibukaashasha kenya o anu too ndamunot are? Tenaa Olaitoriani ninye Enkai, entusuj ninye; kake tenaa Baal nisujaa ninye.” Neitu ewaliki iltung'ana ororei hoo obo.
Neitoki Eliya ajoki iltung'ana, “Nanu ake openy taata otelekua too loibonok lo Laitoriani, kake ore iloibonok le Baal naa iip ong'uan o onom.

Nchoo meishori iyiook iloing'ok oaare naa nchoo ninche metegelaki ate obo, nedung'udung neiteleiki ilkeek, kake emipik enkima ine. Naa kaitobir sii nanu olikae oing'oni naiteleiki ilkeek, nemapik enkima ine.
Nimpotipoto enkarna e nkai inyi, naipot sii nanu enkarna Olaitoriani. Ore Enkai nawalu te nkima naa ninye Enkai.” Newalu iltung'ana pooki aajo, “Enkiroroto sidai.”
Neitoki Eliya ajoki lelo oibonok le Baal “Entegelaki ate oloing'oni obo ning'asing'asa aaitobir, amu intae ilkumok. Nimpotipoto enkarna e nkai inyi, kake emipik enkima.”

Neya ninche oloing'oni obo oishooki ninche, neitobir ninye, neipot enkarna e Baal ebaiki tadekenya ometaa dama, ejo, “Oo Baal tawaliki iyiook!” Kake eitu etumi oltoilo anaa oltung'ani otawala. Neipidipid ninche aaman ilo perere lo lasar apa oitobira.

Ore eipira enkolong neikordod Eliya ninche, ejo “Entabuaku oleng amu enkai ninye, ebaiki negira adamisho oleng, aashu enyamalita, aashu eshomo nkang'itie. Aashu ebaiki neirura naa keishiaakino neinyeyieki.”
Neishir ninche aabuaku, nedung'udung ate too lalema anaa enatiu olkerreti lenye, ometaba anaa nerukunye osarge too seseni lenye.
Ore pee elusoo enkipirrata e nkolong, nelimana ninche aaibonisho ometabau erishata naishoori olasar. Kake meetae oltoilo otoning'oki, metii ewalata, nemetii oltung'ani otishilayie.
Neitoki Eliya ajoki iltung'ana pooki, “Wootu entinyikakaki,” nepuonu iltung'ana pooki aanyikaki ninye. Neitobir ninye ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani apa otigilaki.
Neya Eliya isoito tomon oaare te risioroto e siana oo layiok le Yakobo, laa ninye apa eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii, “Ejo keaku eikiji enkarna ino Isiraeli.”
Ore te lelo soito neshetu olperere lo lasar te nkarna Olaitoriani. Netur ninye engumoto aitaman emanaroto olperer lo lasar, oba te ndapasho anaa ilanterera oaare.

Nepik ilkeek aitobiraki. Nedung'udung ilo oing'oni aitaa ndung'udung'ot neiteleiki shumata lelo keek. Neitoki ninye ajo, “Emputa iltooi oong'uan enkare, nibukokiki olasar opejori, te nchumata oo lkeek.”
Neitoki ajo, “Engilie entubukoki” neigilie ninche eniare. Neitoki ajo, “Engilie ene uni;” neigilie ninche ene uni.
Neruko enkare teilo perere lo lasar, neiput ine negum nemanaa to lperere lo lasar.

Ore te nkata naishoori olasar le nkitukuo, nelotu oloiboni Eliya anyiku nejo, “Oi Olaitoriani, naa Ai e Abraham, o Isaak, o Israel, nchoo eyiolouni ena olong nchere iyie Enkai tiatua Isiraeli. Nara nanu osinka lino, naa te nkarna ino nanu ataasa kuna kitoduaat pooki.
Tawalikiaki nanu Olaitoriani, tawalikiaki pee eyiolou kulo tung'ana nchere, iyie Olaitoriani ora Enkai, naa iyie oibelekenya iltauja lenye.”
Nedou enkima o Laitoriani, nenya ilo asar o lkeek o soito o enterit neishu ina are apa natii ewueji negum nemanaa to lperere lo lasar.
Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana pooki ina, nebatata aaitabaiki inkomomi enye enkop; nejo, “Olaitoriani ninye Enkai, Olaitoriani ninye Enkai.”
Neitoki Eliya ajoki ninche, “Embung'a lelo oibonok le Baal; emincho ninye elo obo.” Neibung'i ninche, neyau Eliya ninche aitadou ayau olchorro le Kishon, near ninche metuata teine.
Neitoki Eliya ajoki Ahab, “Ilepa shomo tadaayu niokisho; amu ening'o oltoilo le nchan eshaita.” Kaae nelo Ahab adaa neokisho.
Neilep Eliya alo enchumata oldoinyo le Karmel, neirrugo abaiki enkop, nepik enkomom enye erishata oo nkung enyena.
Nejoki ninye osinka lenye, “Ilepa taata shomo, ning'or enkalo e naiposha.” Neilep ninye alo neing'or, nejo, “Metii toki.”

Neitoki ajoki, “Nyaaki shomo katitin naapishana.” Ore te nkata e naapishana nejo ninye, “Atoduaa etii enkiti atampoi naikununo anaa enkaina oltung'ani nailepu tiatua enaiposha.” Neitoki Eliya ajoki, “Ilepu shomo tiaaki Ahab, ‘Ntobira engarri ino oo mbartan nidoyio alo, pee mikimbok ake enchan.’ ”
Ore te nkiti rishata neroku shumata too nkatampo o to siwuo, nelotu enchan kitok, neked Ahab engarri enye nelo Yesreel.
Netii apa enkaina Olaitoriani shumata Eliya, nerreten ninye empolos enye nekuet aituruk te Ahab nelo kishomi e Yesreel.
Neliki Ahab Yesebel nena pooki naataasa Eliya. Oina sii natara metuata iloibonok pooki nkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Baal to lalem.
Neitoki Yesebel airriwaki Eliya olkilikuai, ejo, “Maaitaasa nanu inkaitin ina torrono teneitu nanu aitotiu enkishui ino anaa enkishui e lelo oibonok tena saa taisere.”
Neureishoyu Eliya neinyototo aisik, nelo Beer-sheba e Yuda neing'uaa osinka lenye teine.

Kake ore ninye makewan eshomo elototo enkolong nabo ti ong'ota. Nelo aton te ntonata olchani oata oloip. Neomonu pee eye, nejo, “Eiririkine Olaitoriani pee iwuang'ie enkishui ai, amu mara sii nanu supat alang iloo papa.”
Neirrag ninye airura to loip lo lchani, nemaniki pee eiseyie olmalaika ninye nejoki, “Tudumunye inosa endaa.”
Neing'orisho ninye, nedol etii embata e ndukuya enye emukate natapejoki too soito ooirowua, o esiang'au e nkare. Nedaa ninye neokisho, neitoki airrag.
Neitoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani enkata e are, aiseyie ninye, nejoki, “Tudumunye inosa endaa, amu kegolu elototo te iyie.”
Nedumunye Eliya nedaa neokisho, nelo te ngolon eina daa nainosa too nkolong'i artam, o nkewarietin artam, omeshomo Horeb ilo doinyo le Nkai.
Nebau ninye enkapune neirrag ine, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii ninye, nejoki, “Kaa iasita tene, Eliya?”

Nejo ninye, “Aata apa nanu olom to Laitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, amu etanyaita iltung'ana loo Siraeli olning'o lino, nesulaa ilpereren loo lasarri, near iloibonok linono metuata to lalem; metaa nanu ake, nanu ake openy otelekua; neing'oru ninche enkishui ai, pee eiwuang'ie.”

Neitoki ajoki, “Shomo ntasho te nchumata o ldoinyo te dukuya Olaitoriani.” Naa ng'ura eloito Olaitoriani agiroo, nekut olkutati kitok ogol lelo doinyo, nebel ndapidapo aitaa mbelibelat te dukuya Olaitoriani, kake metii Olaitoriani atua olkutati. Ore te siadi olkutati nelotu enkikirikirata enkop, kake metii Olaitoriani atua enkikirikirata e Nkop.
Ore te siadi enkikirikirata enkop nelotu enkima, kake metii Olaitoriani atua enkima. Ore te siadi enkima nelotu oloti toilo obor.
Ore ake pee ening Eliya ina, neimulumul enkomom enye to lkila nelo aitashe te nkutuk e nkapune. Nelotu oltoilo enetii ninye, nejoki, “Kaa iyie iasita tene, Eliya?”

Nejo ninye, “Kaata apa nanu olom te nkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani amu etanyaita iltung'ana loo Siraeli olning'o lino, neuroo ilpereren linono loo lasarri, near iloibonok linono metuata to lalem, netaa nanu ake openy otelekua, neing'oru ninche enkishui ai peyie eiwuang'ie.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Torrinyoyu shomo te nkoitoi ino enkalo e ong'ata e Dameski; ore ake pee ibaya, nilo abukoki eilata Hasael, aput metaa olaiguanani le Siria.
Niput Yehu olayioni le Nimshi metaa olaiguanani loo Siraeli. Ore Elisha olayioni le Shefat le Abel-mehola, nibukoki eilata aput metaa oloiboni le Nkai te rishata ino.
Ore ilo oilanya olalem le Hasael nelo Yehu aar metua. Ore ilo oilany olalem le Yehu nelo Elisha aar metua.
Ore ake eyia kaleku nanu iltung'ana inkalifuni naapishana tiatua Isiraeli, lelo pooki leitu egilaki kung neitu eirrugokino Baal, o pooki leitu eng'utut Baal.”
Kaae, nelo Eliya teine, nelo atum Elisha olayioni le Shefat eturishore ilmong'i tomon oaare. Netii apa ninye tenebo ilo kiteng le tomon oaare. Negiroo Eliya ninye nenang'aki olkila lenye.

Neing'ua Elisha lelo mong'i nekuet asujaa Eliya, nejoki ninye, “Nchooki nanu mashomo ang'utut papaai o yieyioo aisho ole sere, pee aatum atusuja iyie.” Nejoki Eliya ninye, “Torrinyoyu shomo; amu kaa nanu aaitaasa iyie?”

Nerrinyo Elisha aing'uaa Eliya, neitayu nena keek oo murto oo lmong'i neyieng lelo mong'i. Neyier inkiri enye tenebo nkeek oo murto oo lmong'i. Neisho iltung'ana meinosa, nenya ninche. Neitoki ninye adumunye alo asujaa Eliya nelo aisiaai ninye.
Eiturrurro apa olaiguanani Benhadad iltung'ana lenyena tenebo. Netii ilaiguanak tomoni uni oaare tenebo ninye, neeta mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan. Nelo ninye aman Samaria neitayunye olarrabal.
Neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku enkanasa e Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli, nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Benhadad.
‘Ore enkosholai ino o saabu ino naa naainei. Inaainei nkituaak inono o nkera inono.’ ”
Newal olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajo, “Ore anaa enitejo olkitok lai, lo aiguanani, ara nanu olino, o nena pooki naata nanu.”
Neitoki ilkiliku aapuonu ejo “Nji ejo Benhadad ‘Aairriwaka nanu iyie ilkiliku ajo; Iyakaki nanu enkosholai ino, o saabu ino, o nkituaak inono o nkera inono.
Ore ake eyia kaairriwaki nanu isinkan laainei taisere tena saa, naa kepuonu aajur enkaji ino o nkajijik oo sinkan linono, neya pooki toki naitiship ninche.’ ”

Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli aiturrur ilpayiani pooki leina kop, nejoki, “Entisipu taata nidolidolo aajo enyamali eing'oru ele tung'ani. Amu aairriwaka ninye nanu olkilikuai te nkaraki inkituaak aainei o nkera aainei o te nkaraki enkosholai ai o saabu, nemaata nanu entoki natomito.”
Ore lelo payiani o ltung'ana pooki, nejoki ninye, “Mining iyie ninye niminyorraa.”

Kaae, nejoki ninye lelo ooirriwua Benhadad, “Entiaaki olkitok lai olaiguanani, ‘Ore nena pooki e dukuya niyieu tialo osinka lino, kaas nanu, kake ore ena bae maidim nanu ataasa.’ ” Nerrinyo lelo ooirriwuaki neyaki ninye olkilikuai. Neirriwaki Benhadad ninye olkilikuai nejoki,
“Maaitaasa nanu inkaitin ina torrono tenaa kelekuni ninye enterit te Samaria naaiput inkaik ang.”
Newal olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajo, “Entiaaki ninye, ‘Mincho ilo orretenita imasaa enyena o larrabal ewuasa anaa ilo olaku eidipa.’”
Ore ake pee ening Benhadad ilo kilikuai eokisho tenebo ilaiguanak too lng'oborri, nejoki ninye ltung'ana lenyena, “Entijing irrishat inyi to larrabal.” Nejing ninche irrishat enye aarasaki ina anasa.

Nelotu oloiboni le Nkai anyikaki Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli nejoki, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Itoduaa iyie ele orora kitok pooki? Kaishoru ninche apik inkaik inono ena olong; naa ilo iyie ayiolou nchere kara nanu Olaitoriani.”
Neitoki Ahab ajo, “Aitialo ng'ae?” Nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Tialo isinkan loo lbalusuni loo lkerenketi.” Neitoki Ahab ajo, “Kaing'ae oiteru olarrabal?” Newaliki ajo, “Iyie.”
Neitoki ninye aipotu lelo sinkan loo lbalusuni loo lkerenketi, naa iip are ninche o tomoni uni oaare, ore te siadi ninche neitoki aipotu iltung'ana loo Siraeli, nkalifuni naapishana.
Neipang ninche aapuo te nkipirata e nkolong, ina kata eokisho Benhadad too lng'oborri, ninye o lelo aiguanak tikitam oaare apa ootareto ninye.
Ore lelo sinkan loo lbalusuni loo lkerenketi neituruk aapuo. Neirriu Benhadad iltung'ana, nepuo aajoki ninye, “Eilepu iltung'ana aapuonu te Samaria.”
Nejo ninye, “Tenaa ai te seriani eetuo ninche, eyau ninche eishu, naa tenaa ai to larrabal epuonu, eyau ninche eishu.”
Kaae, neipang kulo aapuo te nkanasa, lelo sinkan loo lbalusuni too lkerenketi, o ina jore natusujayie ninche.
Near ake oltung'ani oltung'ani oipirare; neilanyisho iltung'ana le Siria, nesujaa Isiraeli ninche, kake eilanyishe Benhadad olaiguanani le Siria te mbarta tenebo ilakedok loo mbartan.
Nelo olaiguanani loo Siraeli aibung mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan, near iltung'ana le Siria oleng.
Neitoki oloiboni le Nkai alotu anyikaki olaiguanani loo Siraeli, nejoki “Wou, ntagoluoyu, nidamu oleng enilo aas; amu ore telde ari, naa aikilotu olaiguanani le Siria agilunore.”

Nejoki isinkan lo laiguanani le Siria ninye, “Ore inkaitin oo Siraeli naa inkaitin oo ldoinyo, neaku kegol ninche aalang iyiook. Metaa maape iyiook aarare ninche te nkop naisiasha, nemeeta nchere pee eitu kimir ninche.
Naa nji nkuna, iwuang'ie ilaiguanak too wuejitin enye, nipik ilarikok le njore irrishat enye;

nimpotu enjore naikununo anaa enapa natimiraki. Aipirakinye embarta enkae barta o engarri oo mbartan enkae garri oo mbartan; nikipuo iyiook aarare ninche te nkop naisiasha nemeeta nchere pee eitu iyiook kigolu aalang ninche.” Nening ninye enatejo ninche, neas ina.
Ore teina rishata o lari neipotu Benhadad aiturrur enjore e Siria, neilep aapuo Afek, pee earare Isiraeli.

Neipotuni Iltung'ana loo Siraeli, neishori ninche imasaa o larrabal, nepuo aarare ninche. Neun iltung'ana loo Siraeli ilng'oborri te dukuya ninche netiu anaa iluaat are kutiti oo nkineji, kake eiputa iltung'ana le Siria enkop.

Nelotu oltung'ani le Nkai anyiku nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli, Nji; ejo Olaitoriani, Ore amu etejo iltung'ana le Siria eji, “Ore Olaitoriani naa enkai oo ldoinyo, kake mme enkai oo erat ninye,” ore te nkaraki ina, kaishoru nanu ele orora pooki apik inkaik inono, pee itum iyie atayiolo nchere kara nanu Olaitoriani.’ ”

Neun injoreitin pokira ilng'oborri aaipirakinore ate inkolong'i naapishana. Ore te nkolong e naapishana neitutumi olarrabal. Neosh iltung'ana loo Siraeli iltung'ana le Siria, isikarini nkalifuni iip nabo oopuo too nkejek te nkolong nabo.
Neisikaki ilkulikae enkanasa e Afek, neurokino esuntai iltung'ana inkalifuni tikitam e lelo ootelekutua. Neisik sii ninye Benhadad nelo ajing olgilata liatua le nkanasa.

Nejoki isinkan lenyena ninye, “Kitoning'o iyiook nchere, ore ilaiguanak le nkaji e Israel, naa ilaiguanak oata olng'ur. Nchoo iyiook maishopo ilkuniyiani too mpolosi ang, nikipik inkeenta ilukuny ang, nikipuo enetii olaiguanani loo Siraeli; amu ebaiki nikipal iyie inchu.”

Kaae, nerrotian ninche ilkuniyiani too mpolosi enye, nepik inkeenta ilukuny enye, nepuo enetii olaiguanani loo Siraeli, nejoki, “Etejo osinka lino Benhadad, ‘Aatoomono nchooki matobiko aishu.’ ” Nejo ninye, “Keton ake eishu? Olalashe lai ninye.”

Neanyita apa lelo tung'ana pee etum ororei supat, netum ninche nabo kata to laiguanani, nejo ninche, “Ee olalashe lino Benhadad.” Neitoki ninye ajo, “Enchom entoriku ninye.” Nelotu Benhadad enetii Ahab, neisho ninye metijing'a engarri oo mbartan.

Nejoki Benhadad ninye, “Ore nkanasa natooruo papaai lino, kaarrinyoki nanu, nindim iyie atasheta iwuejitin neemirishoreki te Dameski, anaa apa enataasa papaai te Samaria.” Nejo Ahab, “Kaaisho nanu iyie shomo te kulo rorei.” Kaae, neitobir olning'o o ninye neisho meshomo.
Nejoki oltung'ani obo loo layiok loo loibonok olikae te nkitanapata Olaitoriani, “Tooshoki nanu, aatoomono” kake etanya ilo tung'ani eosh ninye.
Neitoki ajoki ninye, “Ore amu itanya ining oltoilo lo Laitoriani, teneaku ishomo nikilo olng'atuny aar tua.” Ore pee elo aing'uaa nenang'are olng'atuny ninye near metua.
Neitoki ilo oiboni atum likae tung'ani, nejoki, “Tooshoki nanu, aatoomono.” Neosh ilo tung'ani ninye nepik olbae.
Kaae nelo ilo oiboni le Nkai nelo aanyu olaiguanani te mbata enkoitoi, eteena too nkarash ilo bae otii olpura le nkomom.

Ore ejo olaiguanani agiroo, neishiraki ninye olaiguanani ejo, “Eshomo osinka lino empolos olarrabal, naa ng'ura, eibelekenye osikari neyau oltung'ani enatii, naajoki nanu, ‘Ng'ura ele tung'ani; naa tenelo neluaya, neinosieki enkishui ino enkishui enye, aashu ilak entalanta e nkosholai.’
Ore enyamalita osinka lino tene o te idie, neluaya ninye.” Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli ninye, “Neijia elo atiu endung'okinoto ino enkiguana, amu iyie makewan otudung'o ina.”
Nesiokisioki aitayu ina arasha natii olpura le nkomom, neyiolou olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajo obo loo loibonok le Nkai.

Nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore te nkaraki ninchoo elo too nkaik inono, ilo tung'ani apa laiteng'elaka enkidaaroto, ore te nkaraki ina, keinosieki enkishui ino enkishui enye. Neinosieki enkishui oo ltung'ana linono enkishui oo ltung'ana lenyena.’ ”
Nelo olaiguanani loo Siraeli enkaji enye te Samaria eiruto neeta osina.
Neeta apa Nabot le Yesreel enkurma oo lng'anayio te Yesreel, te mbata e nkaji e nkitoo e Ahab olaiguanani le Samaria.

Ore nabo olong nejoki Ahab Nabot, “Nchooki nanu enkurma ino oo lng'anayio pee aitaa enkurma oo mbenek, amu ketaaniki enkaji ai. Naa kaaisho nanu enkurma sidai oo sabibu naa tenidol eishiaakino, naaisho elaakinoto enye too mpisai.”
Kake etiaaka Nabot Ahab, “Too loo papa nanu atujung'o ena kurma, oo lng'anayio. Metomito Olaitoriani tenaa kaaisho nanu iyie.”

Nelo Ahab enkaji enye eeta osina netagore te nkaraki ina natiaaka Nabot le Yesreel ninye. Amu etejo ninye, “Maaisho nanu iyie enjung'ore oo loo papa.” Neirrag ninye te ndapash enye, neibelekeny ninye endukuya enye aing'or idia alo neany enya endaa.
Kake eewuo enkitok enye Yesebel enetii ninye nejoki, “Kainyoo pee eeta oltau lino osina eji neaku minya endaa?”

Nejoki Ahab ninye, “Te nkaraki nairorie nanu Nabot le Yesreel, najoki nanu ninye, ‘Timirakaki nanu enkurma ino oo lng'anayio too ropiyiani, aashu tenidol eishiaakino, nawalu nanu tiae kurma oo lng'anayio.’ Newalu ninye ajo, ‘Maaisho nanu enkurma ai oo lng'anayio.’ ”
Nejoki Yesebel ina kitok enye ninye, “Keton aa iyie oitore Israel? Tudumunye inosa endaa, nincho metishipayu oltau lino; amu kaaisho nanu iyie ina kurma oo lng'anayio e Nabot le Yesreel.”
Neiger ninye mpala te nkarna e Ahab, netukuny ninche to lmishire lenye, neirriwaki lelo payiani o ltung'ana kituaak ooboitare Nabot teina anasa enye.
Neiger ninye te nena palaajo, “Embalie enkolong naeni aapukoo, neishori Nabot enkitoo aaitulusoo too ltung'ana.

Nipikipiki iltung'ana oaare atang'orok, meetu aaitang'or ninye. Naa nchoo ninche eishankarrarre ninye ejo, ‘Itediaa iyie Enkai o laiguanani!’ Nimbung'ubung'u taa ninye aaya auluo, ninang'inang'a too soito metua.”
Ore iltung'ana leina anasa, ilpayiani o lkituaak apa oomanya ina anasa, neas anaa enatolikio Yesebel ninche. Anaa enaigeroki te nena pala naaigeroko ninye ninche.
Neibalunye ninche enkolong naeni aapukoo, neisho Nabot enkitoo aaitulusoo too ltung'ana.

Ore ilooti tung'ana oaare aitang'orok, nepuonu aaitang'or ninye, nepuonu lelo le pesho aaishankarrare Nabot te dukuya iltung'ana, ejo, “Etediaa Nabot Enkai o laiguanani.” Neya ninche ninye auluo enkanasa nenang ninye metua too soito.
Neitoki ninche aairriwaki Yesebel olkilikuai ejo, “Etanang'aki Nabot too soito, etua ninye.”

Ore ake ina kata pee ening Yesebel nchere etanang'aki Nabot ometua too soito, nejoki Yesebel Ahab, “Inyo tudumunye, inyo shomo iwa enkurma oo lng'anayio apa nikitomitikio Nabot too mpisai. Amu meekure eishu Nabot, etua ninye.”
Ore ake ina kata pee ening Ahab ajo etua Nabot, nedumunye Ahab adoyio alo aya enkurma oo lng'anayio e Nabot le Yesreel, pee eitaa enenye.
Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Eliya le Tishbi ejo,
“Tudumunye shomo tanang'are Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli, etii ninye Samaria. Ng'ura etii ninye atua enkurma oo lng'anayio e Nabot, neshomo ninye aya ine aitaa enenye.

Shomo iyie tiaaki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani; Itara iyie oltung'ani metua niya ntokitin enyena?’ Nintoki ajoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani; Ore ine wueji apa nemejie ildiein osarge le Nabot, teine epuo ildiein aamej osarge lino.’ ”
Nejoki Ahab Eliya, “Ekinepua nanu lo mang'atinta lai?” Newaliki ajoki, “Ee aainepua, amu itegelaka iyie kewan pee ias mbaa torrok te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Kayau nanu entorroni shumata iyie, kaaiwuang'ie nanu iyie aishie, naiwuang'ie nanu te Ahab pooki lee, tiatua Israel, oloena o lolakuno.
Naa kaitotiu nanu enkaji ino anaa enkaji e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, o enkaji e Baasha olayioni le Ahija, te nkaraki ena goro nikintagoro nanu o te nkaraki sii nitorikoko Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.
Ore tialo Yesebel neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, ‘Kenya ildiein Yesebel too lpolosien le Yesreel.’
Ore pooki ng'ae lo lmarei le Ahab oye tiatua enkanasa nenya ildiein; ore pooki ng'ae oye tiong'ata nenya ilmotonyi.”
Meetae apa oltung'ani otegelaka kewan aas imbaa torrok te dukuya o Laitoriani anaa Ahab oisisayie ninye enkitok enye Yesebel.
