Etaasa ninye ntabo arubare nkitanyaanyukot. Etaasa ninye anaa apa Ilamori, laa ninche eiturrayie Olaitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana loo Siraeli.
Ore ake pee ening Ahab lelo rorei, nepolos nkilani enyena, neishopoki kewan ilkuniyiani, neen ninye apukoo neirrag too lkuniyiani, nelo ninye to sina.
Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Eliya le Tishbi, ejo,

“Itoduaa ajo eitoborro Ahab kewan te dukuya nanu? Ore te nkaraki naitoborro ninye kewan te dukuya nanu, mayau nanu entorroni too nkolong'i enyena. Too nkolong'i oo layiok lenyena nanu ayau entorroni shumata enkaji enye.”
Ore apa too larin okuni netoni iltung'ana le Israel o le Siria te seriani.
Kake ore to lari liokuni nelotu Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda enetii olaiguanani le Israel.
Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli isinkan lenyena, “Iyiololo intae aajo enaang oshi Ramot-gilead, naa eikigira oshi iyiook, mikiyieu nikiya aaoru olaiguanani le Siria?”

Nejoki Ahab Yehoshafat, “Eikiriamariyie iyie nanu pee kipuo olarrabal te Ramot-gilead?” Newaliki Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Atiu ake nanu anaa enitiu, netiu iltung'ana laainei anaa enatiu iltung'ana linono, netiu mbartan aainei anaa ninono.”
Nejoki Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Tang'asa naa nkilikuanu ororei oing'uaa Olaitoriani.”

Neitoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli aiturrur iloibonok le Nkai tenebo, oobaya iip ong'uan, nejoki ninche, “Kalo nanu olarrabal aarare Ramot-gilead anaa aimalo?” Nejo ninche, “Ilepa shomo amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik inkaik o laiguanani.”
Kake enyaaka Yehoshafat ajo, “Aimeekure etii ene likae oiboni lo Laitoriani likinkilikuanishore?”

Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Eton etii oltung'ani obo likindim aaikilikuanishore tialo Olaitoriani. Mikaia olayioni le Imla, kake kaiba nanu ninye amu maaibonoki aekata ninye embae sidai, intorrok ake aaibonoki.” Nejo Yehoshafat, “Mincho olaiguanani ejo neijia.”
Neitoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli aipotu oltung'ani kitok nejoki, “Toriku ntasieku Mikaia olayioni le Imla.”

Ore apa ina kata netonita olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani le Yuda too lorikan lenye le nkitoo, etukusote too lkilani lenye. Netoni ninche te wueji neidong'ishoreki te mbata enkishomi e Samaria. Neibonisho apa iloibonok pooki te dukuya ninche.
Ore Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana neitobiraki kewan imowuarak e sekenkei, nejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Te kuna ipuopuo intae aarrumoo iltung'ana le Siria ometaba anaa neidaaya.’ ”
Neibonisho iloibonok pooki aaiko neijia, nejo ninche, “Ilepa shomo Ramot-gilead timirisho; amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik inkaik olaiguanani.”

Ore ilo tung'ani apa oirriwayioki meshomo aipotu Mikaia nejoki ninye, “Ore irorei loo loibonok pooki naa eisidain tialo olaiguanani; nchoo irorei linono metotiwuo anaa irorei liobo lenye, niro mbaa sidain.”
Kake etejo Mikaia, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, ina naajoki nanu Olaitoriani ninye alo airo.”

Ore ake pee elotu ninye enetii olaiguanani, neikilikuan olaiguanani ninye ajoki, “Mikaia eikipuo iyiook olarrabal te Ramot-Gilead anaa aimikipuo?” Newalu ninye ajo, “Shomo timirisho, amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik inkaik olaiguanani.”
Kake etiaaka olaiguanani ninye, “Ae katitin aja nanu aaikilikuan pee iro esipata ake te nkarna Olaitoriani?”
Nejo ninye, “Atoduaa nanu Isiraeli pooki eidapashate too ldoinyo anaa ntare nemeeta olchekut; nejo Olaitoriani, ‘Meeta kulo olaitasheikinoni, nchoo ake errinyo pooki ng'ae enkang enye te seriani.’ ”
Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Keitu nanu aajoki iyie meibonu ninye embae sidai, kake entorrono eibonu?”
Neitoki Mikaia ajo, “Entoning naa ororei lo Laitoriani: Atoduaa nanu Olaitoriani eton to lorika lenye le nkitoo. Ore olorora pooki le shumata neitashe te mbata enye te nkalo e tatene o te kedianye.
Nejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kaing'ae ilo olo alej Ahab, meilepa ninye alo metaari metua te Ramot-gilead?’ Nejo ake oltung'ani embae nabo nejo olikae enkae bae.
Nelotu enkiyang'et naishu aitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, ‘Kalo nanu alej ninye.’
Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, ‘Eitiaa oitoi?’ Nejo ninye, ‘Kalo nanu aaku ololejisho too nkutukie oo loibonok pooki.’ Nejo ninye, ‘Ilo iyie alej ninye naa ilo aidimu ninye, shomo naa taasa ina.’
“Ore naa taata, etipika Olaitoriani oltau le lejare kulo oibonok pooki, eimaka Olaitoriani embae torrono tialo iyie.”
Nenyiku Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana neosh Mikaia eseder, nejoki, “Kaji eiko Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani tenepuku te nanu nelotu airo te iyie?”
Nejo Mikaia, “Ng'ura, ilo kenya adol teina olong nilo ajing'ie olgilata liaji isudori.”
Nejo ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Embung'a Mikaia eyaki Amon olgafanai le nkanasa, o Yoash olayioni lo laiguanani;
nipuopuo aajo, ‘Nji ejo olaiguanani; Entipik ena tung'ani atua jila nintotiti ninye too mukateni o te nkare ake ometaba anaa narrinyunye te seriani.’ ”
Nejo Mikaia, “Tenirrinyunye iyie te seriani, neitu naa aairorie nanu Olaitoriani.” Neitoki ajo, “Entoning lo tung'ana pooki!”
Kaae, nelo apa olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda Ramot-gilead.
Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Kalo nanu anapa pee alo olarrabal, kake nchopo iyie ilkilani linono le nkitoo.” Nelo olaiguanani loo Siraeli anapa nelo olarrabal.
Neitanap apa olaiguanani le Siria lelo arikok le pokira tomoni uni oaare loo ngarrin oo mbartan, ejo, “Emiaar oltung'ani kitok aashu oloti, kake olkitok loo Siraeli ake entaar.”
Ore ake pee edol lelo akedok loo ngarrin oo mbartan Yehoshafat, nejo, “Kesipa olaiguanani le Israel.” Kaae neibelekenya aarare ninye, neyietu Yehoshafat aishir.
Ore ake pee edol lelo arikok loo ngarrin oo mbartan aajo mme olaiguanani loo Siraeli, nepal eitu eitoki aasujaa ninye.

Kake eteyietuo oltung'ani obo enkawuo enye, neng'or olaiguanani loo Siraeli eripata e long'o enye, to lgoo. Ore te nkaraki ina nejoki olaiguanani ilo arewani le ngarri enye oo mbartan, “Mbelekenyayu, iwaki matung'uai olarrabal, amu aatipikaki olbae.”

Neirowuaju olarrabal ina olong, neigarakino olaiguanani engarri enye eing'or enkalo oo ltung'ana le Siria. Ore pee eaku teipa neye ninye, ore osarge leina ng'oroto neiput oltiren leina garri oo mbartan.
Ore etaa kedoyio enkolong neibulu olkiyioi enkop pooki, eji, “Shomo pooki tung'ani enkanasa enye, nelo pooki tung'ani enkop enye!”
Kaae, neaku etua olaiguanani Ahab neyauni ninye Samaria; nepuoi aanukaa ninye te Samaria.
Nepuoi aaituku ina garri oo mbartan to lchorro le Samaria nemej ildiein ilo sarge lenye, ore inkituaak naaibor onyek neituku ate teilo sarge, te risioroto eilo rorei lo Laitoriani apa oiroro ninye.

Ore nkulie kiaasin e Ahab, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, o ina aji oo lala loo lkanchaoni apa natesheta ninye, o nena anas pooki apa naatesheta ninye, neigero tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.
Kaae, neirura Ahab neye anaa loo menye, neitoreisho Ahasia te rishata enye.
Neiteru Yehoshafat olayioni le Asa aitore Yuda to lari liong'uan le enkitoria e Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli.
Oloo larin tomoni uni o imiet apa Yehoshafat pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam o imiet te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Asuba entito e Shilhi.

Nerubare ninye orrekie le Asa Papaai lenye, eitu ninye eibelekenya apaash easata oo mbaa sidain te dukuya Olaitoriani. Ore ake eyia eitu eyai iwuejitin neeika, ore iltung'ana neitayu ilasarri nepej enkorropil te nena wuejitin neeika.
Eitobira sii apa Yehoshafat osotua o laiguanani loo Siraeli.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoshafat, o ina kidimata enye naitodolua, o ina nashomo olarrabal, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.
Ore olpisiai le lelo ooibor onyek apa ootelekutua too nkolong'i e papaai lenye, neishie ninche teinakop.
Meetae apa olaiguanani te Edom; olaiguanani oti ninye apa etegeluaki
neitobir Yehoshafat imelin e Tarshishi pee epuo Ofir aayau saabu; kake eitu ninche epuo, amu eidaaitie nena melin te Esiong'eber.
Neitoki Ahasia Olayioni le Ahab ajoki Yehoshafat, “Nchoo isinkan laainei epuo tenebo isinkan linono too melin.” Kake eitu enyorraa Yehoshafat.
Neirrag Yehoshafat airura neye anaa loo menye, nenukari te nkurare oo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi nkuyiaa lenye. Neitoreisho Yehoram olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Neiteru Ahasia olayioni le Ahab aitoreisho te Israel te Samaria to lari le tomon oopishana le nkitoria e Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye ilarin oaare te Israel.

Etaasa apa ninye embae torrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, nerubare orrekie le papaai lenye, o rrekie le ng'otonye, o rrekie le Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, laa ninye apa oitapong'oyie Isiraeli metaasa eng'oki.
Eisiaayia apa ninye Baal neserem ninye, neitagor Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, te pooki oitoi apa nataasa menye.
Ore eidipa Ahab atua, negolong'u Moab apaashare Israel.

Nesulunye apa Ahasia to lkitara le nkaji e shumata, te Samaria, neirrag ninye etamuoyia. Neaku eirriwayie ninye ilkiliku ajoki olorere, “Enchom enkilikuanishore Baalsebub, ina ai e Ekron tenaa kaishiu nanu tena muoyian.”

Kake etiaaka olmalaika lo Laitoriani Eliya le Tishibit, “Tudumunye shomo tanang'are ilkiliku lo laiguanani le Samaria, nijoki ninche, ‘Te nkaraki nemeetae Enkai te Israeli pee ishomo aaikilikuanishore Baalsebub, ina ai e Ekron?’
Ore naa taata, nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Mipuku iyie teina dapash nitii, kake esipa iye iyie.’ ” Nelo Eliya.
Nerrinyo lelo tung'ana lo lkilikuai aapuo enetii olaiguanani, nejoki ninye ninche, “Kainyoo intae pee itorrinyunye?”

Nejoki ninche ninye, “Eewuo oltung'ani anang'are iyiook, nejoki iyiook, ‘Entorrinyoto enchom enetii ilo aiguanani oirriwua intae, nijokiki ninye; Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Te nkaraki nemeetae Enkai te Israel pee irriwayie ilkiliku meshomo aaikilikuanishore Baalsebub, ina ai e Ekron? Ore te nkaraki ina midou iyie teina dapash nitii, kake iye iyie.’ ”
Nejoki olaiguanani ninche, “Kaa pukunoto o ltung'ani ilo tung'ani oewuo anang'are intae, nejoki intae kuna baa?”
Newaliki ninche ninye aajoki, “Eishopito enkila oo lpapit neeta enkeene e mpolos te mpolos enye.” Nejo olaiguanani, “Eliya le Tishibit ilo.”

Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaki ninye olkitok le njore loo ltung'ana onom. Neilep ninye alo enetii Eliya, etonita te nchumata e ndoinyo, nejoki ninye, “Lo tung'ani le Nkai, ejo olaiguanani, ‘Tadou wou.’ ”

Kake etiaaka Eliya ilo arikoni le njore loo ltung'ana onom, “Tenaa kara nanu oltung'ani le Nkai, nchoo edou enkima naing'uaa keper, nikinya iyie o lelo tung'ana linono onom.” Nedou enkima naing'uaa keper nenya ilo tung'ani o lelo tung'ana lenyena onom.

Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaki ninye o likae kitok le njore loo ltung'ana onom, tenebo iltung'ana lenyena pokira onom. Neilep ninye alo enetii Eliya nejoki ninye, “Lo tung'ani le Nkai, enkitanapata o laiguanani ena, ‘Tasioki tadou!’ ”

Kake etawalikia Eliya ajoki ninche, “Tenaa kara nanu oltung'ani le Nkai, nchoo edou enkima naing'uaa keper nikinya iyie o kulo tung'ana linono pokira onom.” Nedou enkima e Nkai naing'uaa keper nenya ninye o lelo tung'ana lenyena pokira onom.

Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaa olarikoni le ntukus e uni oo ltung'ana onom, tenebo iltung'ana lenyena onom. Ore ilo arikoni liokuni le njore loo ltung'ana onom, neilep alo. Nelotu agil kung te dukuya Eliya, nesai ninye ajoki, “Lo tung'ani le Nkai, aatoomono iyie, nchoo enkishui ai o enkishui e kulo sinkan linono menoto tipat too nkonyek inono.
Ng'ura ajo etadowuo enkima naing'uaa keper nenya lelo arikok le njore loo ltung'ana maa onom, o lelo tung'ana lenye maa onom. Kake ore naa taata nchoo enkishui ai menoto tipat too nkonyek inono.”
Neitoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ajoki Eliya, “Tadoi shomo tenebo ninye; miureyu iyie ninye.” Nedumunye Eliya nedoyio alo tenebo ninye, enetii olaiguanani.

Nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore te nkaraki irriwayie ilkiliku meshomo aaikilikuanishore Baalsebub, ina ai e Ekron, ke nkaraki nemeetae Enkai te Israel, pee inkilikuanishore too rorei lenyena? Ore te nkaraki ina midou iyie teina dapash nishomo, ajing, kake meeta nchere pee miye iyie.’”

Neaku etua Ahasia te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani oiroro Eliya. Neaku Yoram olalashe lenye olaiguanani te rishata enye, to lari liaare le Yehoram olayioni le Yehoshafat, olaiguanani le Yuda. Amu meeta apa Ahasia olayioni.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Ahasia naataasa ninye, neigero tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.
Ore etaa kejo pee eya Olaitoriani Eliya ailepie keper to lkutati, negira Eliya o Elisha aairiamari te nkoitoi eing'uaa Gilgal.

Nejoki Eliya Elisha, “Totona tene aatoomono amu aairriwayie nanu Olaitoriani Betel.” Kake etejo Elisha, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani o anaa eninchu iyie makewan, maaing'uaa nanu.” Nedoyio ninche aapuo Betel.
Nepuonu ilooiteng'eni loo loibonok le Nkai nejoki Elisha, “Iyiolo iyie ajo keya taata Olaitoriani olkitok lino, nikintung'uaa iyie?” Nejo ninye, “Ee kayiolo, entirring'ata ake intae.”

Neitoki Eliya ajoki Elisha, “Elisha, totona tene, aatoomono amu aairriwayie nanu Olaitoriani Yeriko.” Kake etejo ninye, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, o anaa eninchu iyie makewan, maaing'uaa nanu iyie.” Nepuonu ninche Yeriko.

Ore ilayiok loo loibonok le Nkai ootii Yeriko nepuonu aataaniki Elisha, nejoki ninye, “Iyiolo iyie ajo keya taata Olaitoriani olkitok lino nikintung'uaa iyie?” Newal ninye ajo, “Ee kayiolo, entirring'ata ake intae.”

Neitoki Eliya ajoki ninye, “Totona tene, aatoomono, amu aairriwayie nanu Olaitoriani Yordan.” Kake etejo ninye, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, o anaa eninchu iyie makewan maaing'uaa nanu iyie.” Neaku eiriamari aapuo pokira oaare.
Nepuo iltung'ana onom le lelo ayiok loo loibonok le Nkai, neitashe tenelakuaniki ninche, neitashe ninche pokira oaare te mbata o lkeju le Yordan.
Neitayu Eliya olkila lenye nenunuk, neoshie enkare, neoro enkare neito ena shoto o enda shoto. Neim ninche pokira oaare ine etaa enkop natoyio.
Ore ake pee eidip aatalang, nejoki Eliya Elisha, “Tolimu embae niyieu naaitaas eton eitu aayae aaitung'uaa iyie.” Nejo Elisha, “Aatoomono, ntujung'oki nanu enkiyanget oltau lino kat are.”
Nejoki ninye, “Inkilikuanua iyie embae nagol, kake ore ake eyia, tenikiduaaya nanu aayaitae aaitung'uaa iyie, naa ketiu neijia te iyie, kake tenimikiduaaya iyie, nemetiu neijia.”
Ore epuoito ninche einosaa lomon, ng'ura, nerish ninche pokira oaare engarri oo mbartan e nkima. Nelo Eliya to lkutati keper.

Nedol Elisha ina bae, neishir ajo, “Papaai lai! Papaai lai! Ngarrin oo mbartan e Israel o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan!” Neitu ninye eitoki adol Eliya. Neitoki ninye aibung ilkilani lenyena, nepolos aitaa are.
Nedumu ninye ilo kila apa oitadoyie Eliya, nerrinyo ninye nelo aitashe te mbata olkeju le Yordan.

Neitoki ninye adumu olapa kila le Eliya oitadoikio ninye, neoshie enkare, ejo, “Koree Olaitoriani, Enkai e Eliya?” Ore ake pee eosh enkare, neoro enkare, nelo ena shoto o enda shoto; nelang Elisha alo.

Ore ake pee edol lelo ayiok loo loibonok le Nkai apa ootii Yeriko ninye, nejo ninche, “Etii Enkiyang'et e Eliya Shumata Elisha.” Nepuonu ninche aanang'are ninye, neirrugo aaitabaiki nkomomi enkop te dukuya ninye.

Nejoki ninche ninye, “Etii tenebo isinkan linono iltung'ana onom oogol; aatoomono nchoo ninche epuo aaing'oru olkitok lino, ebaiki neewa ninye Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani nelo anang'aki ninye likae doinyo, aashu epik atua oerata.” Nejo ninye, “Mirriwaa intae ninche.”
Kake ore ake pee eitirrishaki ninye o metaba anaa nedol enkurruna, nejo ninye, “Erriwai.” Neirriwaa ninche iltung'ana onom; ore too nkolong'i uni, neing'oru ninye kake eitu etum ninye.
Nerrinyunye ninche aapuonu enetii Elisha etonita te Yeriko, nejoki ninye ninche, “Keitu nanu ajoki intae emipuopuo?”
Nejoki apa iltung'ana le nkanasa e Yeriko Elisha, “Ng'ura ajo eisidai ena anasa, anaa enidolita olkitok lai; kake eitorrono enkare, nemeisho enkop.”
Nejo ninye, “Eyakaki nanu olbakuli ng'ejuk, nipikipiki emunyan atua.” Neyaki ninche ninye.
Nelo ninye enetii enchorro e nkare neisuaaki emunyan atua, nejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani aitamelono nanu ena are, ore ebaiki ena kata meitokini aekata aatum keeya anaa olkibiroto tialo ena are.”
Neaku eitamelonoki apa ina are ometabaiki ena olong, te risioroto eilo rorei apa oiroro Elisha.
Nedumunye Elisha teine nelo Betel; ore eloito ninye te nkoitoi, nepuonu nkuti ayiok aakueniyie ninye, ejo, “Ilepa shomo iyie olokurro lukunya! Ilepa shomo olokurro elukunya!”
Neibelekenya ninye anang silig, ore ake pee edol ninche, nedek ninche te nkarna o Laitoriani. Neipang'u tiatua entim ilng'arurum oaare le ntim nedung nena ayiok artam o are aaitaa ndung'udung'ot.
Nedumunye teine nelo oldoinyo le Karmel neitoki arrinyo alo Samaria.
Ore to lapa le tomon o isiet le nkitoria e Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, etaa Yehoram olayioni le Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli te nkop e Samaria. Neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oaare.
Etaasa ninye entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani, hoo neitu etiu anaa menye o ng'otonye, amu eiwuang'ie ninye eng'ape e Baal apa naitobira papaai lenye.
Ore ake eyia eibung'are ninye eng'oki e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, apa natorikoko Israel metaasa eng'oki. Eitu ninye eing'uaa ina ng'oki.

Ore apa Mesha olaiguanani le Moab naa olaramatani loo nkerra. Naa ore ake to lari neisho olaiguanani le Israel ilkuoo le kerra nkalifuni iip nabo o lpapit loo nkerra loo lmeregeshi inkalifuni iip nabo.
Kake ore ake pee eye Ahab, negolong'u olaiguanani le Moab apaashare olaiguanani le Israel.
Neaku eshomo apa teina kata olaiguanani Yehoram tiatua enkop e Samaria pooki, neiturrur Isiraeli pooki.

Nelo ninye airriwaki olkilikuai Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, nejoki, “Etogolong'ua olaiguanani le Moab tialo nanu; aimikiriamariye nanu olarrabal le Moab?” Nejoki ninye, “Kalo nanu; atiu nanu anaa enitiu iyie, netiu iltung'ana linono anaa iltung'ana laainei, netiu mbartan aainei anaa mbartan inono.”
Neitoki ninye ajo, “Kaa oitoi iyiook kipuo aaim?” Newal Yehoram ajo, “Enkoitoi e ong'ata e Edom.”

Neaku eshomo olaiguanani le Israel tenebo olaiguanani le Yuda o laiguanani le Edom. Ore ake pee eidip ninche aashom elototo oo nkolong'i naapishana, neishunye enkare naok enjore o enaok ng'uesi apa naasujita ninche.
Neitoki olaiguanani le Israel ajo, “Wooi Ee! Eipotuo Olaitoriani kulo aiguanak pokira okuni pee elotu apik ninche inkaik e Moab.”

Nejo Yehoshafat, “Aimeetae oloiboni le Nkai tene pee kitum iyiook aaikilikuanishore tialo Olaitoriani?” Neitoki osinka obo le lelo sinkan lo laiguanani loo Siraeli awal ajo, “Etii Elisha olayioni le Shefat ene, laa ninye apa otubukoko enkare inkaik e Eliya.”
Nejo Yehoshafat, “Etii ororei lo Laitoriani tenebo ninye.” Nedoyio olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat o laiguanani le Edom aapuo enetii Elisha.

Nejoki Elisha olaiguanani loo Siraeli, “Kainyoo nanu aatakinore iyie? Shomo enetii iloibonok le papaai lino o loibonok le yieyioo lino.” Kake etiaaka olaiguanani loo Siraeli ninye, “A'a; Olaitoriani oipotuo kulo aiguanak pokira okuni apik inkaik e Moab.”
Nejo Elisha, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani loo lororani, laa ninye nanu aisiaai, teneme naaji Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, anaata maashilaa iyie nemaaing'or iyie.
Kake ore naa taata entorikokoki olaranyani.” Ore ake pee eranyisho olaranyani, nelotu engolon o Laitoriani shumata ninye.
Nejo ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore ele erata otoyio kaiput nanu enkare.’
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani ‘Midolidolo intae olkutati anaa enchan, kake ore ele erata pooki naa keiputi enkare, pee itumutumu aatook, intae o nkishu inyi o ng'uesi inyi.’
Embae nalelek ena too nkonyek o Laitoriani; naa keishoru sii Ilmoabu apik atua inkaik inyi.
Naa ipuopuo intae aaibung pooki anasa nasheta isunta, o pooki anasa yioloti, niuroo pooki shani sidai, nimbooyoyo nkonyek oo nkariak pooki, ninyalinyala pooki kop sidai too soito.”
Ore te nkolong nasuju tadekenya, etaa enkata naishoori ilasarri, nelotu enkare naing'uaa enkalo e Edom, o metaba anaa neiput enkare enkop.
Ore ake pee ening Ilmoabu nchere eetuo ilaiguanak aagilunore ninche, ore pooki ooidim aatanap imasaa o larrabal, eiteru to loti o metabaiki to olbotor, neipotuni nepuoi aaibok to lpolosie.
Ore ake pee edumunye ninche tadekenya, neilang enkolong ina are, nedol Ilmoabu enkare te dukuya ninche enyokie anaa osarge.
Nejo ninche, “Osarge ele; esipa etumutakinote ilaiguanak maate, netaarate maate. Ore naa taata, Moab nalo aya iyarunot.”
Kake ore ake pee epuonu ninche, ilng'oborri le Israel, nedumunye Israeli nerasaki Ilmoabu o metaba anaa neipirri aailanyisho te dukuya ninche. Nepuo ninche dukuya ear Ilmoabu too lalema epuoito.

Neibung ninche nkanas, ore te pooki kop sidai, nenang'aki pooki tung'ani osoit ometaba anaa neiput isoito. Neibooyo pooki ong'u naruko enkare, neuroo ilkeek pooki sidain, ometaba anaa neaku isoito ake ootelekutua te Kiharet. Neng'adu ilang'orok loo soito te nkopito ine neisulie.
Ore ake pee edol olaiguanani le Moab ajo etii olarrabal agilunore ninye, neshoroo iltung'ana oata ilalema, iip naapishana pee epuo aagiroo olaiguanani le Edom, kake eitu ninche eidim aashom.

Neitoki ninye ayau olkikau lenye laa ninye ojing te rishata enye te nkitoria, neitayu ninye aitaa olasar opejori te nchumata e suntai. Nejing engoro napi Siraeli, nepuo ninche aaing'uaa ninye nerrinyo aapuo enkop enye.

Ore enkitok e obo le lelo ayiok loo loibonok le Nkai, neishiraki Elisha ajoki, “Etua osinka lino olmoruo lai; niyiolo iyie ajo keure apa osinka lino Olaitoriani. Kake eewuo ilo apa likiaata esile enye aya nkera aainei pokira are aitaa irrindiki lenyena.”
Nejoki Elisha ninye, “Kaa iyieu naitaas nanu? Tolikioki nanu entoki niaata tiatua aji?” Nejoki ninye, “Meeta esinka ino toki tiaji meteleku esiang'au e ilata.”
Neitoki ninye ajo, “Shomo enetii ole latia ino toomonu imasaa e aji to le latia ino pooki, imasaa nemetii toki naa kumok.
Nintoki alo atua aji ninkenoo kewan tiaji o layiok linono, nipik eilata nena masaa pooki, naa teneiput nabo, ninteng'el.”
Neaku eshomo ina oliai aing'uaa Elisha, nelo aikenoo kewan o layiok lenyena. Ore ebukoki ninye eilata, neyau ilayiok lenyena nena kulie masaa aaitinyikaki ninye.
Ore ake pee eiputayu nena masaa, nejoki ninye olayioni lenye, “Nyaaki iyakaki enkae.” Nejoki olayioni lenye ninye, “Meekure etii ae.” Neishunye erukunoto eina ilata.
Neipang'u ninye nelotu aliki ilo tung'ani le Nkai, nejoki Elisha, “Shomo timira ina ilata nilo alak isilen inono, ore iyie o layiok linono ninyanya enkae ilata.”
Ore nabo olong nelo Elisha Shunam, netii ine enkitok karsis naitoomono ninye pee enya endaa. Naa ore apa enkata pooki naim ine nelo anya endaa te nkaji enye.
Nejoki ina kitok olpayian lenye, “Ng'ura ore taata, kamusu nanu ajo, oltung'ani osinya le Nkai ele, oimita ena oitoi ang anaake.
Maitobira iyiook enkiti aji naitushura netii isunta, nikipikaki ninye endapash o emisa o lorika o ltaa, paa ore enkata ake pooki nalotu ninye enikitii, neidim ashomo ine.”
Ore nabo olong nelotu Elisha ine, nelo ninye ilo gilata neyeng'iyeng'a teine.
Nejoki ninye Gehasi osinka lenye, “Mpotu ena kitok e Shunam.” Ore ake pee eipotu ninye, neitashe ina kitok te dukuya ninye.

Nejoki ilo sinka ninye, “Irorie iyie ninye, ng'ura ajo itanyamala iyie oleng te nkaraki iyiook, kaa iyieu nikintaasi iyie? Iyieu neirorieki te rishata ino olaiguanani tenaa olkitok le njore?” Newalu ina kitok ajo, “Atua olorere lang nanu atii.”
Neitoki Elisha ajoki Gehasi, “Kaa naa eitaasi ninye?” Newal Gehasi ajo, “Meeta ninye olayioni, netamorua olpayian lenye.”
Nejoki Elisha, “Mpotu ninye.” Ore ake pee eipotu ninye, nelotu ninye aitashe te kutuk aji.
Nejo Elisha, “Ore tena rishata tenemanu olari naa eitum iyie enkayioni.” Nejo ina kitok, “A'a olkitok lai, lo tung'ani le Nkai, milej iyie esinka ino.”
Kake eiroshiwuo apa ina kitok, neiu enkayioni te rishata naaijo ina, te rishata o loirujuruj anaa apa enatiaaka Elisha ninye.
Ore etubulua ina kerai nelo nabo olong enetii papaai lenye tiatua ilaikesak.
Nejoki ninye papaai lenye, “Oi endukuya ai, endukuya ai!” Nejoki papaai lenye osinka lenye, “Ewaita ninye enetii ng'otonye.”
Ore ake pee edumu ilo sinka ninye, neyau enetii ng'otonye, neton ina kerai too nkejek e ng'otonye o meiulo enkolong, neye.
Nedumu ninye nelo airragie te ndapash o ltung'ani le Nkai, neiken kutukaji, neipang alo.
Neitoki aipot olpayian lenye, nejoki, “Irriwakaki obo loo laisiaayiak o esikiria nabo, pee atum nanu atasiooi ashomo enetii oltung'ani le Nkai, naitoki arrinyunye.”
Nejo ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee iyieu nilo enetii ninye taata? Mme olapa ng'ejuk neme Sabato.” Nejo ina kitok, “Kesidanu mbaa.”
Neirot ninye esikiria, nejoki osinka lenye, “Isiosionie osikiria, nimilo akiti ometaba anaa naajoki.”

Neaku etudumunye ninye nelotu ine netii oltung'ani le Nkai, to ldoinyo le Karmel. Ore ake pee edol oltung'ani le Nkai ina kitok elotu, nejoki ninye Gehasi osinka lenye, ng'ura elotu enkitok e Shunam te idie.
Kueta nabo kata shomo tanang'are ninye, nijoki ninye, Aisidan mbaa tialo iyie? Aisidan mbaa tialo lpayian lino? Aisidan mbaa tialo enkerai ino? Newal ninye ajo, “Aisidain.”

Ore ake pee elotu ina kitok oldoinyo ine netii oltung'ani le Nkai, neibung ninye inkejek enyena, nelotu Gehasi aiwuang'ie ninye. Kake etejo ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Tapala ninye, amu etii ninye atua osina ogol; neisudoyie Olaitoriani tialo nanu. Neitu aaliki nanu.”
Neitoki ina kitok ajo, “Kaatoomono nanu olkitok lai olayioni? Keitu nanu ajo, mikilej nanu?”

Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai Gehasi, “Terretena empolos ino, ninap eng'udi ai te nkaina ino, nilo. Teninang'are oltung'ani nimiroroki ninye, naa tenikiroroki ninye niming'amaa, nilo aiteleiki ena ng'udi enkomom eina kerai.”
Neitoki ng'otonye ina kerai ajo, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani o anaa eninchu iyie makewan maaing'uaa nanu.” Neaku etudumunye ninye nesuj ninye.
Neituruk Gehasi alo neiteleiki ina ng'udi enkomom eina kerai kake eitu etumi enkikashata anaa enkitoduaata e nkishui. Neaku etorrinye alo anang'are Elisha, nejoki ninche, “Eitu einyototo ina kerai.”
Ore ake pee ejing'u Elisha atua ina aji, nedol ina kerai eirrag etua te ndapash enye.
Nelo ninye atua aji neiken kutuk aji neaku ninche ake pokira are tiatua ina aji. Neomon Olaitoriani.

Neilepaki ninye endapash neirrag te nchumata eina kerai, nepik enkutuk enye enkutuk eina kerai, nepik inkonyek enyena inkonyek eina kerai, neiteleiki inkaik enyena inkaik eina kerai, neitoriori ninye te nchumata ina kerai, neirowuaju osesen leina kerai.
Neitoki ainyototo nelo nabo kata amanimanaa tiatua aji, neitoki ailepaki endapash eina kerai, nesing ina kerai katitin naapishana, nebol inkonyek enyena.
Neitanap ninye Gehasi ajoki, “Mpotu ena kitok e Shunam.” Neipotu Gehasi ninye. Ore ake pee elotu ina kitok enetii Elisha, nejoki ninye, “Tudumu enkayioni ino.”
Nelotu ninye nebatata too nkejek enyena, neirrugo abaiki enkop; neitoki adumu enkayioni enye neipang alo boo.
Neitoki Elisha alotu Gilgal naa aisapuk olameyu teinakop. Ore etonita inkera oo loibonok le Nkai te dukuya ninye, nejoki ninye, osinka lenye, “Ntobira emoti sapuk pee iyier endaa te nkaraki ninche.”
Nelo obo lenye ong'ata asotu ilkeek le ntim, netum olchani loo lng'anayio liong'ota, ore teilo shani neitayu ilng'anayio, nelotu adung'udung'oki emoti endaa, nemeyiolo ninye ajo kainyoo lelo.
Neoriki lelo tung'ana meinosa. Kake ore einosita ninche ina daa, neishir aajo, “Lo tung'ani le Nkai, keyaisho ena daa!” Nelaikino ninche aainosa.
Nejo Elisha, “Eyau naa endaa.” Nenang'aki atua ina moti, nejo, “Entooriki iltung'ana, pee etum aainosa.” Neitu eitoki atii entoki torrono atua ina moti.

Nelotu oltung'ani oing'uaa Baal-shalisha, neyaki oltung'ani le Nkai imukateni tikitam e shairi, o lng'osil ng'erng'er le ntapa ootii olbene lenye. Nejo Elisha, “Nchoo kuna iltung'ana pee etum aainosa.”
Kake etejo osinka lenye, “Kaji nanu aiko te naisho kuna iltung'ana iip nabo?” Neigil Elisha ajo, “Nchoo ninche iltung'ana, pee etum aainosa, amu neijia ejo Olaitoriani, ‘kenya ninche neleku.’ ”
Neaku eirragie ninye ina daa te dukuya ninche, nenya ninche, neleku, te risioroto ororei lo Laitoriani.

Ore apa Naaman olkitok le njore o laiguanani le Siria, naa oltung'ani kitok to lkitok lenye netum omom oleng, amu te nkaraki ninye apa eishoo Olaitoriani Siria enkisulata. Oltung'ani apa magilani yioloti, kake keeta apa enkeeya oo lbolot.
Ore apa iltung'ana le Siria te njore enye nabo, neraya enkiti sila aisiaayiani te nkop oo Siraeli, naa enkitok e Naaman apa eisiaai.
Nejoki ina sila ina kitok e Naaman, “Tenaa naaji ketumore olkitok lai oloiboni le Nkai otii Samaria anaata eishiunye ninye teina keeya enye oo lbolot.”
Nelo Naaman atua aji nelo ajoki olkitok lenye, “Nji eiroro ajo ena aisiaayiani naing'uaa enkop oo Siraeli.”
Nejo, olaiguanani le Siria, “Shomo taata, amu kairriwaki nanu empalai olaiguanani loo Siraeli.” Neaku eshomo ninye, neshoroo talanta tomon, o shekeli nkalifuni ile e saabu o ntukusi tomon oo nkilani.
Neyaki ina palai olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neigero ajo, “Tenebau ena palai enitii, tayiolo nchere aairriwaka Naaman osinka lai, pee itum aishiunye ninye teina keeya enye oo lbolot.”

Ore ake pee eisum olaiguanani loo Siraeli ina palai, nepolos inkilani enyena nejo, “Kara nanu Enkai, naar metua neitoki aitopiu, eji metaa kaairriwaki ele tung'ani olkilikuai pee aishiunye oltung'ani oata enkeeya oo lbolot? Tadamu pee idol ajo olarrabal eing'oru te nanu.”

Ore ake pee ening Elisha, ilo tung'ani le Nkai ajo etopolosa olaiguanani loo Siraeli inkilani, neirriwaki olaiguanani olkilikuai, ejo, “Kainyoo iyie pee itopolosa inkilani inono? Nchoo ninye elotu enatii pee eyiolou ajo etii oloiboni le Nkai Israel.”
Neaku eewuo Naaman too mbartan enyena, o ngarrin oo mbartan, neitashe te kutuk aji e Nkaji e Elisha.
Neirriwaki Elisha ninye olkilikuai ajoki, “Shomo ntukuoyu to lkeju le Yordan katitin naapishana pee esidanu osesen lino nilaari aishiu.”
Kake etagore apa Naaman oleng, nelo ejoito, “Kajo duoo nanu kelotu enatii, neitashe, neipot enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai enye, neyuk enkaina enye te shumata ene wueji naaya, neishiu enkeeya oo lbolot.
Amaa Abana o Parpar, lelo kejek le Dameski, aimesidan ninche aalang inkariak pooki e Israel? Aimaidim nanu aitukuore nena naishiu?” Neaku eibelekenye ninye alo te ngoro.
Kake eetuo isinkan lenyena aataaniki nejoki ninye, “Papa lai, amaa tenaa eikintanapa oloiboni le Nkai entoki sapuk, aime anaata itaasa? Kebaa naa elusoo tenetejo ninye, ‘Ntukuoyu pee isidanu?’ ”
Nedoyio Naaman nelo adoiki olkeju le Yordan katitin naapishana, te risioroto o rorei lo ltung'ani le Nkai, neishiu osesen lenye netiu anaa osesen le nkerai kiti nesidanu.

Neitoki ninye arrinyunye alotu enetii oltung'ani le Nkai nejoki, ninye o encholiek enye pooki, nelotu aitashe te dukuya ninye, nejo ninye, “Ng'ura kayiolo nanu ajo meetae Enkai te nkop pooki meteleku te Israeli. Tang'amai naa taata enkishooroto naing'uaa osinka lino.”
Kake etejo Elisha, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, laa ninye nanu aisiaai, mang'amu nanu hoo toki.” Nesai ninye metang'amu kake etanya.

Neitoki Naaman ajo, “Teniming'amaa, aatoomono naa, nchoo naa meishori osinka lino inyumpui are naanap ilolan, amu ore ebaiki ena olong, meigil osinka lino aitayu olasar opejori, anaa olasar liae ai meteleku ake Olaitoriani.

Ore tena bae metapalaki Olaitoriani osinka lino: Tenelo olkitok lai atua enkaji e Rimion aserem teine, naigarakino nanu enkaina ai, nairrugo nanu tiatua enkaji e Rimion, metapalaki Olaitoriani osinka lenye tena bae.” Nejoki Elisha Naaman, “Shomo te seriani.”
Kake ore eidipa Naaman ashomo atung'uai Elisha te nkiti rishata,

ore Gehasi ilo sinka le Elisha, nejo, “Dol ajo etapala olkitok lai ele tung'ani oji Naaman le Siria, neitu eng'amaa te nkaina enye nena tokitin naayawua ninye. Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, kasujaa nanu ninye pee atum toki te ninye.”
Neaku etusujayie Gehasi Naaman. Ore ake pee edol Naaman oltung'ani okuetu asuju ninye, nedou ninye te ngarri oo mbartan nenang'are ninye. Nejo, “Keseriani ake?” Nejo ninye “Eseriani ake.”

Nejo Gehasi, “Aairriwua nanu olkitok lai pee ajoki, ‘Eetuo tena kata enatii nanu ilbarnot ooing'uaa enkop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, ilbarnot oaare loo layiok loo loibonok le Nkai, aatoomono nchoo ninche entalanta e nkosholai o ntukusi are oo nkilani.’ ”

Nejo Naaman, “Tang'amu ntalantani are te nchipai.” Nesai ninye, neineneng nena talantani are e nkosholai too lbenia oaare, tenebo ntukusi are oo nkilani, neiteleiki ninche isinkan lenyena oaare. Neya ninche aanap te dukuya Gehasi.
Ore ake pee epuonu endoinyo, neya Gehasi nena tokitin too nkaik enye, nepik ninche atua enkaji enye, neisho lelo tung'ana meshomo, nedumunye ninche aapuo.
Nejing ninye atua aji nelo aitashe te dukuya olkitok lenye, nejoki Elisha ninye, “Kaji duoo ishomo Gehasi?” Nejo ninye, “Meeta eneshomo osinka lino.”

Kake etiaaka Elisha ninye, “Keitu nanu alo tenebo iyie te nkiyang'et ina kata pee eibelekenya oltung'ani te ngarri enye oo embartan pee kinang'are? Ke nkata ina nang'amarieki mpisai o nkilani o eilata oo loirienito o sabibu, o nkerra o lmong'i o sinkan o nkaisiaayiak?
Ore naa enkeeya oo lbolot e Naaman naa eikimbung iyie, o eishoi ino ntarasi.” Nelo Gehasi teine netii Elisha eeta enkeeya oo lbolot. Neibor anaa soito le nchan.
Etiaakita apa nkera oo loibonok le Nkai Elisha, “Ng'ura ajo eikitii ene wueji nikitii tiabori eutaroto ino.
Nchoo iyiook maape Yordan neyau ake pooki ng'ae te iyiook embokishi, pee kintobir ewueji nikibikie teine.” Newaliki ajo, “Enchom.”
Neitoki obo lenye ajoki, “Tonyorrai shomo tenebo isinkan linono.” Newalu ninye ajo, “Kalo nanu.”
Neaku eshomo ninye tenebo ninche. Ore ake pee epuonu ninche Yordan nedung ilkeek.
Kake ore egira obo lenye auroo olchani nedoiki entolu enye atua enkare, neishir ninye ajo, “Oi olkitok lai! Katoomonuo apa ena tolu.”
Neitoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai ajo, “Eitiaji etadoiyie.” Ore ake pee eitodol Elisha ine wueji, nedung'u ninye enchata nenang'aki ine, nepor ina dukuya e ntolu enkare.
Nejoki ninye, “Intayu.” Neitorioo ilo tung'ani enkaina enye neitayu.
Ore apa earare olaiguanani le Siria Isiraeli, neiguana ninye o sinkan lenyena ejo, “Ore te wueji neje o eneje naun nanu ilng'oborri laainei.”
Kake eirriwaka oltung'ani le Nkai olkilikuai olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajoki, “Toduaa ake migiroo ene wueji, amu etadoitie iltung'ana le Siria aapuo ine.”
Neirriwaa olaiguanani loo Siraeli oltung'ani meshomo ine netiaaka ninye oltung'ani le Nkai. Neaku ninye oikok ninye, neitajeuo ninye kewan katitin naagiroo nabo anaa are.
Nenyamalu oltau lo laiguanani le Siria te nkaraki ena bae; neipotu isinkan lenyena nejoki ninche, “Entoduaaki aajo kalo tiatua ntae otii enkalo o laiguanani loo Siraeli?”

Nejoki obo loo sinkan lenyena, “Meetae, lo kitok lai, olaiguanani kake Elisha ilo oiboni le Nkai otii atua Israel, ninye ojoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli lelo rorei liro iyie tiatua olgilata lino le rruat.”
Nejo ninye, “Enchom entodol enetii ninye, pee airriwaa nanu iltung'ana meshomo aayau ninye.” Nejokini ninye, “Ng'ura etii ninye Dotan.”
Neirriwaa ninye mbartan meshomo ine, o ngarrin oo mbartan o enjore kitok nepuonu ninche kewarie, neman enkanasa aang'adu.
Ore ake pee einyototo osinka lo ltung'ani le Nkai tadekenya, neipang alo boo, nedol etamana duoo enjore oo mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan enkanasa. Nejo ilo sinka, “Oi lokitok lai! Kaa iyiook kiaas?”
Nejoki Elisha ninye, “Miureisho, amu ore lelo ootii tenebo iyiook naa eikumok aalang lelo ootii tenebo ninche.”

Neitoki Elisha aomon nejo, “Olaitoriani, aatoomono iyie tabolo inkonyek enyena pee etum atoduaa.” Nebol Olaitoriani inkonyek eilo barnoti, nedol ninye, naa ng'ura ebore ilo doinyo mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan e nkima naamanita Elisha.

Ore pee epuonu iltung'ana le Siria aagilunore ninye, neomon Elisha Olaitoriani, nejo, “Toosho kulo tung'ana aatoomono, ntamodoo.” Neaku etoosho Olaitoriani aitamodok ninche te risioroto e nkomono e Elisha.
Nejoki Elisha ninche, “Mme enkoitoi ena, neme enkanasa ena; entusujaki nanu, pee arikoki nanu intae ilo tung'ani ling'oruru.” Nerik ninye ninche Samaria.

Ore ake enabaunye ninche Samaria, nejo Elisha, “Olaitoriani, tabolo nkonyek e kulo tung'ana, pee etum aatodolisho.” Nebol Olaitoriani inkonyek enye, nedolishoyu ninche, nedol etii ninche empolos e Samaria.
Ore ake pee edol olaiguanani loo Siraeli ninche, nejoki Elisha, “Papaai lai, aar ninche metuata?”
Aar ninche metuata, “Newal ninche ajo miaar iyie ninche metuata lelo litaarua to lalem lino o too mbaa inono? Nchoo ninche endaa o enkare, pee etum ainosa neok, nepuo enetii olkitok lenye.”

Neitobiraki ninye ninche osirua sapuk; ore ake pee eidip aainosa endaa neokisho, neisho ninche meshomo, nepuo ninche enetii olkitok lenye. Neitu aekata eitoki iltung'ana le Siria aapuonu aarasaki enkop e Israel.
Ore etulusoitie nena neipotu Benhadad olaiguanani le Siria enjore enye pooki, neilep alo aman ang'adu Samaria.

Netii apa olameyu kitok Samaria, ina kata pee eman ninche ninye. Etaa apa ore endukuya o sikiria naa shekeli ntomoni isiet e nkosholai emirieki, ore enkiti pirbil oo nkik e nturkuluo naa shekeli imiet e nkosholai.
Ore apa eloito olaiguanani loo Siraeli te nchumata e suntai, neishiraki ninye enkitok, ejoki, “Taretuoki, olkitok lai olaiguanani!”
Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Amaa teneitu kiret Olaitoriani kaji nanu aiko tenaaret? Te wueji neidong'ishoreki aashu te wueji neironyieki isabibu?”
Neitoki olaiguanani aikilikuan ninye ajoki, “Kainyoo enyamali ino?” Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Aatiaaka nanu ena kitok, ‘Iyau enkerai ino pee kinya ninye taata, ore taisere nikinya enkerai ai.’
Nikiyier iyiook enkerai ai nikinya. Ore pee ekenyu najoki nanu ninye, ‘Iyau enkerai ino, pee kitum aainosa’; neisudoo ninye enkerai enye.”
Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani irorei leina kitok, nepolos inkilani enyena ore ina kata negira ninye alo te nchumata e suntai nedol iltung'ana aajo keishopito ninye ilkuniyiani tiatua nkilani enyena.
Nejo ninye, “Maaitaasa nanu Enkai ena neitulusoo, teneitu edung'ori endukuya e Elisha olayioni le Shefat ena olong.”

Netonita apa Elisha te nkaji enye, netonita ilpayiani tenebo ninye. Neirriwayie apa olaiguanani oltung'ani, kake ore eton eitu ebaiki ilo kilikuai Elisha, nejoki Elisha lelo payiani, “Idolidolo aajo eirriwua ele oitayu iloikop oltung'ani laalotu adung'oo endukuya? Eng'orisho, ore ake pee elotu ilo kilikuai ninkenikene kutukaji, nimbung'ubung'u enkikenet e kutukaji aaibooyo ninye. Aimening'o oltoilo loo nkejek olkitok lenye te siadi ninye?”
Ore eton eirorita ninye o lelo payiani, nedou olaiguanani alotu enetii ninye, nejoki, “Ore ena nyamali naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa! Kainyoo nanu pee aitoki aanyu Olaitoriani?”

Nejoki Elisha toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ore taisere tena rishata, nemiri entemet empirbil entapa napuyiapui te shekeli nabo, ore mpirbili are e shairi te shekeli nabo, te kishomi e Samaria.

Ore ilo kitok le njore laa ninye apa eigarakino o laiguanani, nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Amaa naaji tenaa kebol Olaitoriani ilusien e keper, keitabari ena bae?” Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai ninye, “Ilo iyie adol too nkonyek inono, kake minya iyie.”
Netii apa iltung'ana oong'uan oata enkeeya oo lbolot ootii embata e kishomi; nejokino ninche maate, “Kainyoo iyiook pee kitoni tene o matuata?

Tenikijo iyiook matijing atua enkanasa; netii olameyu atua enkanasa, naa eikipuo aaye teine. Naa tenekitoni tene nikiye ake sii. Maape naa taata ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Siria. Tenetapala ninche iyiook, nimikiye, naa tenetaara iyiook matuata, nikiye naa.”
Nedumunye ninche, pee emirimiru enteipa aapuo ilng'oborri le Siria, kake ore ake pee ebau emanaroto oo lng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Siria nedol aajo metii hoo toki ine.

Amu eishoo apa Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Siria metoning'o oltoilo loo ngarrin oo mbartan, o loo mbartan o ltoilo le njore kitok, neaku etiaakinote maate, “Ng'ura, eipotuo olaiguanani loo Siraeli, aiger o laiguanani le Hiti, o laiguanani le Misiri meetu aarare iyiook.”
Neisik ninche ina teipa aailanyisho, neing'uaa ilng'oborri lenye, o mbartan enye o sirkon lenye, neing'uaa ilng'oborri etiu anaa duoo ake. Neilanyisho aaitajeu enkishui enye.

Ore ake pee epuonu kulo tung'ana ooata enkeeya oo lbolot emanaroto oo lng'oborri, nejing ninche atua olng'obor, nedaa neokisho, neya ninche enkosholai o saabu o nkilani nepuo aaisudoo. Neitoki aapuonu nejing likae ng'obor, neya ntokitin tiatua ilo ng'obor, nepuo aaisudoo.

Neitoki aajokino maate, “Mme embae sidai iyiook kiaasita. Ore ena olong naa enkolong oo lomon supati. Tenikigira iyiook o mekenyu, naa kebaiki iyiook enkitamioto. Ore naa taata, wootu maape aajoki enkaji o laiguanani.”

Nepuonu ninche aaipot ilarripok loo nchomito e nkanasa, neliki ninche aajoki, “Kishomo iyiook ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Siria, ng'ura medoli nemening'i hoo oltung'ani obo teine, meteleku ake mbartan naa ena o sirkon ooena, netiu lelo ng'oborri anaa apake.”
Neipotisho lelo arripok le kishomi, nelimuni ina bae tiatua enkaji o laiguanani.

Nedumunye olaiguanani kewarie, nejoki isinkan lenyena, “Kaliki nanu intae ina naitobira iltung'ana le Siria tialo iyiook. Keyiolo ninche aajo eikisumash; neaku eipang'a ninche too lng'oborri aapuo aaisudori te nkop naisiasha ejo paa, ‘Teneipangu ninche te nkanasa, nikiya iyiook ninche, eishu meshomo eyararoto nikijing atua enkanasa.’ ”

Nejo obo loo sinkan lenyena, “Nchoo ilkuti tung'ana eya nena bartan imiet apa naatelekutua, amu idolitata aajo, ore kulo ootelekutua netiu ake anaa ilo orora pooki le Israel oidaayie. Mairriwuai ninche meshomo aadol.”
Neyau ninche iltung'ana oaare oo kedito mbartan, neirriwaa olaiguanani ninche meshomo aasujaa enjore e Siria, nejoki, “Enchom entodol.”

Nepuo ninche aasujaa ninche ometabaiki olkeju le Yordan; naa ng'ura, ore te nkoitoi pooki, naa mpurdat oo nkilani o ntokitin naaiturraitie iltung'ana le Siria te nkisarrisar. Nerrinyunye lelo tung'ana ooirriwayioki, neliki olaiguanani.

Neipang iltung'ana nepuo aar lelo ng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Siria. Neaku ore empirbil entapa napuyiapui nemiri te shekeli nabo, ore mpirbili are e shairi nemiri te shekeli nabo te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani.

Netegelua apa olaiguanani olkitok le njore laa ninye eisilig, metaa olarriponi le kishomi. Neitunyoo iltung'ana ninye te kishomi o metua, anaa enatejo oltung'ani le Nkai, ina kata pee elotu olaiguanani aduaare ninye.

Amu ore ina kata pee ejoki oltung'ani le Nkai olaiguanani, “Kemirieki mpirbili are e shairi te shekeli nabo, neinosieki empirbil e ntapa napuyiapui shekeli nabo, taisere, tena rishata, te kishomi e Samaria.”

Etawalikia apa ilo kitok le njore oltung'ani le Nkai ajoki, “Amaa naaji tenaa kebol Olaitoriani ilusien te keper, keitabari ena bae?” Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai ninye, “Ilo iyie adol too nkonyek inono, kake minya iyie ina daa.”
Neaku neijia ake etotiwuo te ninye, amu eitunyoitie iltung'ana ninye te kishomi neye.

Etiaaka apa Elisha ina kitok naitopiwuoko enkerai enye, “Inyo tenebo olmarei lino, shomo tamanya ewueji neba anaa enitamanya, amu eipotuo Olaitoriani olameyu, naa kelotu ajing ena kop too larin oopishana.”
Nedumunye ina kitok alo te risioroto o rorei leilo tung'ani le Nkai. Nedumunye ninye o lmarei lenye nelo amany enkop oo Lfilisti ilarin oopishana.
Ore te nkiting'oto oo larin oopishana, eidipa ina kitok atushukunye te nkop oo Filistia, nelo asai olaiguanani te nkaraki enkaji enye.
Negira apa olaiguanani airorie Gehasi osinka lo ltung'ani le Nkai, ajoki, “Tolikioki nanu kuna baa pooki sapuki naataasa Elisha.”

Ore egira ninye aliki olaiguanani eneikuna Elisha pee eitopiu oltung'ani otua, nelotu ina kitok apa naitopiwuoki enkerai enye, nesai olaiguanani te nkaraki enkaji enye o enkurma enye. Nejo Gehasi, “Olkitok lai, lo aiguanani, nena ina kitok naa nena ina kerai enye apa naitopiwuoki.”

Ore ake pee eikilikuan olaiguanani ina kitok, neliki ninye. Negelu olaiguanani oltung'ani kitok te nkaraki ina kitok, ejo, “Torrinyoki ninye entoki pooki nara enenye, tenebo endaa pooki naing'uaa enkurma enye, ebaiki enkolong apa nashomo tena kop o metabaiki taata.”
Eshomo apa Elisha Dameski. Naa kemuoi apa Benhadad olaiguanani le Siria. Ore pee elikini ninye, aajoki, “Etii oltung'ani le Nkai ene,”
nejoki olaiguanani Hasael, “Toshoroi enkishooroto shomo notore oltung'ani le Nkai, ninkilikuanishore Olaitoriani tialo ninye ajoki, ‘Kaishiu nanu tena muoyian?’ ”

Nelo Hasael anang'are ninye, neshoroo enkishooroto, mpukunot pooki oo ntokitin sidain e Dameski, ilolan loo ntamesin onom, ore pee aitashe te dukuya ninye, nejoki, “Aairiwua nanu olayioni lino Benhadad, olaiguanani le Asiria maeu enitii ejo, ‘Kaishiu nanu tena muoyian?’
Nejoki Elisha ninye; ‘Shomo tiaaki ninye; ‘Inchiu iyie kake aaitoduaa nanu Olaitoriani nchere meeta nchere pee miye.”
Neshumu Elisha inkonyek enyena aing'or ninye, ometaba anaa nedol Hasael enkurruna. Neishir ilo tung'ani le Nkai.

Nejo Hasael, “Kainyoo pee eishir olkitok lai?” Newaliki ajoki, “Te nkaraki naiyolo entorroni nilo aitaas iltung'ana loo Siraeli; ilo iyie apejoo isempewueti lenye, nilo aar metuata ilbarnot lenye to lalem, nidung'udung inkera enye aitaa ndung'udung'ot, niaar metuata nena kituaak enye naairoshiutuo.”
Nejoki Hasael ninye, “Kainyoo ninye osinka lino, laa oldia ake, eji metaa keas ena bae sapuk?” Newaliki Elisha ajoki, “Aaitoduaa nanu Olaitoriani nchere ilo aaku olaiguanani le Siria.”
Nelo ninye aing'uaa Elisha, nelo enetii olkitok lenye, nejoki ilo kitok lenye ninye, “Kaa iyie kitiaaka Elisha?” Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Aatiaaka ninye inchiu iyie.”
Kake ore pee ekenyu, nedumu ninye olkarasha le ndapash, neitadoiki enkare neisalaashaki enkomom e Benhadad ometua ninye. Neaku Hasael olaiguanani te rishata enye.
Ore to lari le imiet le nkitoria e Yoram olayioni le Ahab, olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neiteru Yehoram olayioni le Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani le Yuda aitoreisho.
Oloo larin tomoni uni oaare apa ninye pee eiteru aaku olaiguanani, neitoreisho ninye ilarin isiet te Yerusalem.
Neibung ninye orrekie loo laiguanak le Israel, anaa apa enataasa enkaji e Ahab, amu entito e Ahab apa enkitok enye. Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani.
Kake eitu ake eidaikie Olaitoriani Yuda, te nkaraki Daudi osinka lenye, amu eisiligie apa Olaitoriani pee eisho ninye oltaa o layiok lenyena intarasi.
Ore too nkolong'i e Yehoram, neorori Edom te nkitoria e Yuda, negelaki ate olaiguanani lenye maate.

Nelo Yoram agiroo Saair tenebo ngarrin enyena pooki oo mbartan, nedumunye kewarie, ore ninye o lelo kituaak loo ngarrin e njore, near aamut lelo tung'ana pooki le Edom apa oo manita ninye. Kake eilanyishe enjore enye alo ang.
Neaku etoorori apa Edom te nkitoria e Yuda ometabaiki ena olong. Neitoki ake sii Libna aorori teina kata.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoram, o nena pooki naataasa ninye neigeroki te mbuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.
Neirura Yehoram etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukari tenebo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Ahasia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Ore to lari le tomon oaare le nkitoria e Yehoram olayioni le Ahab, olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neitaae Ahasia olayioni le Yehoram olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru aitoreisho.
Oloo larin tikitam oaare apa Ahasia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye olari obo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Atalia, naa nkakuyiaa lenye apa Omri olaiguanani loo Siraeli.
Eibung'a sii apa ninye orrekie le nkaji e Ahab, neas mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, anaa apa enataasa enkaji e Ahab. Amu olaputani apa ninye lo lmarei le Ahab.
Eshomo apa ninye tenebo Yoram olayioni le Ahab aarare Hasael olaiguanani le Siria te Ramot-Gilead nepuo iltung'ana le Siria aapik Yoram olbae teine.

Nerrinyunye olaiguanani Yoram metabaki te Yesreel, lelo baa lenyena ootipika iltung'ana le Siria te Ramot, ina kata apa pee earare Hasael olaiguanani le Siria. Nedoyio Ahasia olayioni le Yehoram, olaiguanani le Yuda alo adol Yoram olayioni le Ahab te Yesreel, amu kemuoi apa ninye.
Neitoki Elisha aipotu obo loo layiok loo loibonok le Nkai nejoki ninye, “Terretena empolos ino, niya ele tulet le ilata, nilo Ramot-Gilead.
Ore ake pee ibaya, ning'oru Yehu olayioni le Yehoshafat olayioni le Nimshi; nijing'aki ninye, nirik ninye aitung'uaa ilchoreta lenyena, nirik ninye enkilepata to lgilata liatua.

Nintoki adumu ilo tulet le ilata, nibukoki eilata endukuya enye, nijo, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, aatubukoko nanu eilata aput aitaa olaiguanani le Israel.’ Nintoki abol kutukaji nisik, mintoki aton teine.”
Neaku eshomo ilo barnoti oiboni Ramot-Gilead.
Ore ake pee elotu ng'ura, etii ilarikok le njore enkiguana, nejo ninye, “Aata olkilikuai lino lo kitok le njore.” Nejoki, Yehu, “Kalo obo te iyiook pooki.” Nejoki ninye, “Iyie lo kitok.”

Nedumunye ninye nelo atua aji, nelotu ilo barnoti abukoki eilata endukuya enye, nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, aatubukoko nanu eilata aaput aitaa olaiguanani loo ltung'ana lo Laitoriani, Isiraeli.
Naa ilo iyie aosh enkaji e Ahab olkitok lino, pee atum nanu aitalaku elap te Yesebel, ilo sarge loo sinkan laainei, lelo oibonok le Nkai o sarge le lelo sinkan pooki lo Laitoriani.
Amu ore ina aji pooki e Ahab naa keidaaya; naa kaiwuang'ie nanu olee pooki aishie o rrindik o lolakuno tiatua Israel.
Naa kaitotiu nanu enkaji e Ahab anaa enkaji e Yeroboam olayioni le Nabat, naitotiu anaa enkaji e Baasha olayioni le Ahija.
Naa kepuo ildiein aanya Yesebel to lpolosie le Yesreel, nemeetae oltung'ani onukaa ninye.” Nebol ilo barnoti kutuk aji neisik.

Ore ake pee eipang'u Yehu alotu enetii isinkan lo lkitok lenye, nejoki ninche ninye, “Aisidain mbaa? Kainyoo pee eewuo ele tung'ani omoda enitii?” Nejoki ninye ninche, “Iyiololo intae ele tung'ani o enkiroroto enye.”
Nejo ninche, “Mesipa ina; toliki iyiook.” Nejo ninye, “Nji o inji aatiaka ninye nanu, nejo, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Kaabukoki eilata aput aitaa olaiguanani loo Siraeli.’ ”
Ore nabo kata neya pooki ng'ae inkilani enyena neirragie tiabori inkejek e Yehu, neosh intarumpetani, neibalunye aajo, “Olaiguanani Yehu.”
Etarresho apa Yehu olayioni le Yehoshafat olayioni le Nimshi pee ear Yoram metua. Ore apa Yoram o Siraeli pooki, nerripisho ninche te Ramot-Gilead te nkaraki Hasael olaiguanani le Siria;

kake etorrinyunye apa olaiguanani Yoram metabaki te Yesreel te nkaraki ilbaa apa ootipika ninye iltung'ana le Siria, ina kata apa pee earare Hasael olaiguanani le Siria. Neaku etejo Yehu, “Tenaa ena endamunoto ino, mincho naa oltung'ani hoo obo eipang te nkanasa alo ainosaa ilomon te Yesreel.”
Neirot Yehu ingarrin enyena oo mbartan, nelo Yesreel, amu teine apa eirragita Yoram. Neewuo apa Ahasia olaiguanani le Yuda abaiki Yoram.

Ore apa olarriponi negira aitashe to ltalet te Yesreel, nedol encholiek e Yehu egira alotu, nejo, “Adolita olturrur,” Nejo Yoram, “Iwa olakedoni le mbarta pee elo anang'are ninche, naa nchoo ninye ejo, ‘Keseriani ake?’ ”

Neaku eshomo oltung'ani okedito embarta anang'are ninye, nejoki, “Nji ejo olaiguanani, ‘Keseriani ake.’ ” Nejoki Yehu, “Kaa iyie intaasa eseriani? Mbelekenyayu tusujuaki.” Nelikioo olarriponi ina ejo, “Etabaikia olkilikuai ninche, kake merrinyunye ninye.”
Neitoki Yoram airriwaa likae kilikuai oewuo ine netii ninche, nejoki, “Nji ejo olaiguanani, ‘Keseriani ake,’ ” neitoki Yehu ajoki, “Kene nyoo eseriani? Mbelekenyayu tusujuaki.”
Neitoki ake olarriponi alikioo ajo, “Etabaikia ninye ninche, kake megira ninye arrinyunye. Ore elotunoto neikununo anaa elotunoto e Yehu olayioni le Nimshi amu kekuetu te ngolon oleng.”

Nejo Yoram, “Entobira engarri ai oo mbartan.” Neipang'u Yoram olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Ahasia olaiguanani le Yuda, meetae ake olemetii engarri enye oo mbartan, nepuo aanang'are Yehu, nepuo aanang'aa te wueji e Nabot le Yesreel.
Ore ake pee edol Yoram Yehu, nejoki ninye, “Keseriani ake Yehu?” Newaliki ajoki, “Kaa seriani etumi, eba nji enkiborra oo nkonyek o esakutore e ng'utunyi Yesebel te nkumoi?”
Neibelekenya Yoram ailanyisho, ejoki Ahasia “Olosek Ahasia!”
Neyietu Yehu enkawuo enye te ngolon enye pooki, neng'or Yoram erishata oo ronyi, nelo embae ang'or oltau lenye, neimis ninye tiatua engarri oo mbartan.

Nejoki Yehu Bidkar olaretoni lenye, “Ilepie ninye nilo aiturraa te wueji e Nabot le Yesreel. Amu idamu iyie enapa kata kiriamari kikedito mbartan te siadi Ahab papaai lenye, nchere eiroro Olaitoriani ena kitanapata tialo ninye:

‘Ore te sipata, anaa enatoduaa ng'ole osarge le Nabot, o sarge loo layiok lenyena Olaitoriani ojo kaitalaku nanu te iyie tene wueji.’ Ore naa taata iwa iyie ninye nilo anang'aa ninye teine wueji te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani.”

Ore ake pee edol Ahasia olaiguanani le Yuda ena, neisik alo enkalo e Bet-hagan. Nesujaa sii Yehu ninye, nejo, “Entang'or sii ninye.” Neng'or ninche ninye etii atua engarri oo mbartan te nkilepata e Guur, te mbata e Iblem. Neisikaki ninye Megido nelo aye teine.
Nenap isinkan lenyena te ngarri oo mbartan neya Yerusalem, nepuo aanukaa ninye te nkurare enye, tenebo loo menye tiatua enkanasa e Daudi.
Ore to lari le tomon oobo le nkitoria e Yoram olayioni le Ahab neiteru Ahasia aitoreisho te Yuda.
Ore apa pee elotu Yehu Yesreel, nening Yesebel ina. Nesir inkonyek enyena, neitobir akus endukuya enye, nerumisho te lusie.
Ore eimu Yehu kishomi, nejo ninye, “Keseriani ake iyie Simri, oloata iloikop lo lkitok lenye?”
Neshumu Yehu inkonyek enyena aing'or elusie, nejo, “Kalo ilo otii embata ai? Kalo?” Ore iltung'ana oaare aashu okuni naa isunashi oogelema neing'or ninye.
Nejoki ninche, “Entusulaki ninye enkop.” Nesulaki ninche ninye enkop; ore embata o sarge lenye neisuaakino esuntai, o mbartan, neitunyoo mbartan ninye.
Neitoki ninye ajing atua aji nedaa neokisho; nejo, “Entodol ena kitok nadiaa, enchom entunukai ninye; amu entito o laiguanani ninye.”
Kake ore ake pee epuo ninche aanukaa ninye, neitu edol toki meteleku ake endukuya o nkejek, o ndapi oo nkaik.

Ore ake pee errinyunye ninche aaliki Yehu, nejo ninye, “Ororei lo Laitoriani ele, apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye Elisha le Tishbi, ejo, ‘Ore to lpolosie le Yesreel naa kenya ildiein inkiri o sesen le Yesebel;
naa ketiu empopok e Yesebel anaa emodiei eirrag tioriong enkop, to lpolosie le Yesreel, ometaa meetae oltung'ani ojo, Yesebel ena.’ ”
Keeta apa Ahab ilayiok ntomoni naapishana te Samaria. Neiger Yehu mpala airriwaa Samaria, airriwaki ilaitoriak le nkanasa, o lpayiani, o laing'urak loo layiok le Ahab, ejo,
“Tenebau ena palai enitii, amu iatata ilayiok lo lkitok linyi tenebo intae, niaatata ngarrin oo mbartan, o mbartan o nkanas naasheta sunta o masaa o larrabal,
entegelu oloisul ogol te lelo ayiok lo lkitok linyi, ninchosho ninye olorika le papaai lenye, nimitutu enkaji olkitok linyi.”
Kake eiruto ninche oleng, nejo, “Ng'ura eitu eigaraa ilaiguanak oaare ninye; kaji naa iyiook kinko tenikintasheikinore ninye?”

Neaku ore ilo aitasheikinoni le nkaji e nkitoo, o laitasheikinoni le nkanasa, tenebo ilpayiani o laing'urak, neirriwaki Yehu olkilikuai aajoki, “Kira iyiook isinkan linono, naa eikiaas pooki nintanap iyiook. Mikintaa iyiook likae tung'ani, olaiguanani; taasa enaba anaa enidol aa sidai too nkonyek inono.”

Neitoki Yehu aigeroki ninche enkae palai e are, ajoki, “Tenaa enkalo ai itii, naa tenaa eikining'ining'i nanu, entudung'oi ilukuny oo layiok lo lkitok linyi, nipuopuo aapuonu enatii taaisere te Yesreel tena rishata.” Ore apa lelo ayiok lo laiguanani pokira ntomoni naapishana, netii tenebo iltung'ana kituaak le nkanasa, laa ninche apa ooitubulu ninche.
Ore ake pee ebau ina palai enetii ninche, neibung ninche lelo ayiok lo laiguanani, near metuata, iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana, nepik ilukuny enye nkikapuni, neyau ninche enetii Yehu te Yesreel.
Ore ake pee elotu olkilikuai ajoki ninye, “Eyautua ninche ilukuny oo layiok lo laiguanani,” nejo ninye, “Erragie ninche too lturrurri oaare te mbata e kishomi o mekenyu.”
Ore tadekenya pee eipang ninye alo boo, neitashe ajoki iltung'ana pooki, “Miatata intae entioto. Nanu apa otarresho olkitok lai, naar ninye metua; kake aing'ae natara metuata kulo pooki?
Entayiolo naa nchere, menya enkop ororei lo Laitoriani, apa oiroro ninye oipirta olmarei le Ahab; amu etaasa Olaitoriani ina apa natejo ninye aimunye osinka lenye Eliya.”
Near Yehu metuata lelo pooki apa ootelekutua te nkaji e Ahab te Yesreel, o ltung'ana lenyena kituaak, o lchoreta lenyena yiolot, o lapolosak lenyena, ometaba anaa neishu pooki.
Neitoki Yehu adumunye nelo Samaria. Ore te nkoitoi etii ninye Beteked ewueji oo lairritak loo ntare,

nenang'are Yehu iltung'ana lo lmarei lenye lo laiguanani le Yuda oji Ahasia, nejoki ninche, “Irara akua?” Newaliki ninche aajoki, “Kira iyiook ilo lmarei le Ahasia, nikietuo iyiook aabaiki iltung'ana le nkaji e nkitoo, o layiok le nkitok o laiguanani.”
Nejo ninye, “Ewaita ninche eishu.” Neyae ninche eishu, nepuo ninche aar metuata te ngumoto e Beteked, iltung'ana artam oaare neitu elekuni obo lenye.

Ore pee edumunye Yehu alo teine, nenang'are Yehonadab olayioni le Rekab elotu anang'are ninye; neiroroki ninye, nejoki, “Ketiu oltau lino te nanu anaa enatiu olalai te iyie?” Nejo Yehonadab, “Ee” Nejoki Yehu, “Tenaa neijia nchooki enkaina ino.” Neisho ninye Yehu enkaina. Neyiataa Yehu ninye apik engarri oo mbartan.
Nejoki ninye, “Wou tusujuaki pee idol enyuaata naata to Laitoriani.” Kaae neked ninye tenebo ninye engarri enye oo mbartan.
Ore ake pee elotu Samaria, near metua lelo pooki apa ootelekutua lo lmarei le Ahab ootii Samaria, ometaba anaa neishu pooki, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani apa otiaka Eliya.
Neitoki Yehu aiturrur iltung'ana pooki, nejoki ninche, “Eisiaayia apa Ahab Baal penyo; kake kelo Yehu aisiaai ninye oleng.

Ore naa taata empotokoki nanu iloibonok pooki le Baal, o laseremak lenyena pooki o lapolosak lenyena pooki; emincho eaku metii ninye olemetii, amu aata olasar kitok laitaiki Baal. Ore oltung'ani lemelotu neari metua.” Etaasa apa Yehu ina te nkalamasisho ejo pee eidaikie ilapolosak le Baal.
Neitanapisho Yehu ajo, “Entobira eumata kitok te nkaraki Baal.” Neaku eibalunye ninche.

Neirriwaa Yehu ilkiliku meshomo Israel pooki, nepuonu ilaseremak pooki le Baal, neaku meetae oltung'ani leitu elotu. Nejing ninche atua enkaji e Baal, neiputayu ina aji e Baal ebaiki esuntai ometabaiki enkae suntai.
Nejoki Yehu ilo laa ninye oitasheiki osanduku oshumishoreki, “Iyau masaa o ntokitin enkisiaayiare te nkaraki eseremare e Baal.” Neyau ninye nena masaa,
nelo Yehu atua ina aji e Baal tenebo Yehonadab olayioni le Rekab; nejoki ilaseremak le Baal, “Entujurru entodol nchere metii osinka lo Laitoriani hoo obo atua intae. Kake ilaseremak le Baal ake.”

Neitoki alo atua aji aishooyo i nkishoorot neitayu ilasarri oopejori. Netipika apa Yehu iltung'ana ntomoni isiet boo, nejoki, “Ore oltung'ani obo te lelo latipika inkaik inono metuluai neiturraa enkishui enye.”

Ore ake pee eidip Yehu aishooi inkishoorot o lasar opejori, nejoki Yehu olarriponi o lkituaak, “Entijing'aki entaar metuata; emincho oltung'ani obo eimisho.” Ore ake pee eidip aatar ninche too lalema, ore ilo arriponi o lkituaak nenang'aki ninche boo, nepuo olgilata li atua te nkaji e Baal.
Neipang'unye ninche ina ng'ape apa natii enkaji e Baal, nepejoo.
Neidaikie ninche ina ng'ape e Baal, neidaikie ina aji e Baal, neitaa enkaji narotokini ometabaiki ena olong.
Neijia eikuna Yehu pee eishie Baal tiatua Israel.
Kake eitu apa eibelekenya Yehu apaash ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa te ninche apa eitapong'oyie Isiraeli, meteserema ilasho le saabu te Betel o te Dan.

Nejoki Olaitoriani Yehu, “Ore te nkaraki nitaasa esidai too nkonyek aainei, nintaasa enkaji e Ahab te risioroto e nena pooki naatii oltau lai, ore ilayiok linono le ishoi e ong'uan, kepuo aatonie olorika le nkitoo too Siraeli.”
Kake mme arriyia apa Yehu te nkibung'ata oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani. Enkai oo Siraeli, to ltau lenye pooki; eitu apa ninye epaash ing'ok e Yeroboam naa ninche eitapong'orie Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.
Ore apa te nena olong'i, neiteru Olaitoriani adung'oo kulie wuejitin e nkop oo Siraeli. Etimira apa Hasael ninche eisulie tialo ilpolosien le Israel pooki.
Ebaiki olkeju le Yordan te nkalo o loo saen, o enkop pooki e Gilead o ene Gad o ene Ruben o ene Manase, ebaiki Aroa, te mbata o erata oji Arnon, aa taa Gilead o Bashan.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Yehu, o nena pooki nataasa ninye o enkidimata enye pooki, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.
Neirura Yehu etua anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye te Samaria. Neitoreisho Yehoahas olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Ore apa enkata naitoria Yehu Isiraeli te Samaria naa ilarin tikitam o isiet.
Ore ake pee edol Atalia ng'otonye Ahasia ajo etua olayioni lenye, nedumunye ninye aidaikie enkaji pooki e nkitoo.

Kake ore Yehosheba, ina tito o laiguanani Yoram, enkanashe e Ahasia, neya Yoash olayioni le Ahasia, nepurroo ninye nelo aisudoo aitung'uaa lelo ayiok lo laiguanani apa ooji pee eari metuata, nepik ninye o enkaibung'ani enye atua olgilata oirragi. Neisudoo ninye te nkaraki Atalia, neaku eitu eari ninye metua.
Neboitare Yoash ninye ilarin ile, eisudoo tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, naa Atalia naitoreisho ina kata teinakop.

Kake ore to lari liopishana neirriwaki olapolosani oji Yehoida olkilikuai lelo aitasheikinok loo larripok le nkaji e nkitoo, nejoki ninche pee epuonu enkaji o Laitoriani. Ore teine neinosie ninche olmumai pee ening'okino ina apa naitobira pee eas. Neitodol ninche olayioni lo laiguanani.
Neitanap ninye ninche ajoki, “Ena bae intae enchom entaas: ore erubata inyi e uni, lelo ooipang'u aaing'uaa enkisiaayiare te nkolong e Sabato, nerrip enkaji o laiguanani
netii enkae rubata e uni kishomi e Suri, ore enkae rubata e uni nelo kishomi natii oriong ilarripok, nerrip lelo enkaji e nkitoo.
Ore ntukusi inyi are naapuonu enkisiaayiare te nkolong e Sabato, nerrip enkaji o Laitoriani,

neman ninche aang'adu olaiguanani, oltung'ani ake eibung'ita imasaa enyena o larrabal te nkaina. Ore pooki ng'ae onyikaki lelo turrurri neari metua. Etaa tenebo o laiguanani teneipang auluo o tenejing'u.”

Neas lelo kituaak le njore te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapishe Yehoida olapolosani neriku ake pooki lenye oltung'ani lenye lemetii enkisiaayiare te nkolong e Sabato, tenebo lelo oopuonu aajing enkisiaayiare te nkolong e Sabato, nepuonu enetii Yehoida olapolosani.
Neyaki ilo apolosani lelo kituaak le njore iremeta o long'oi apa naara ino laiguanani Daudi, naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani;
neitashe lelo arripok neibung'ita ake pooki tung'ani imasaa enyena o larrabal too nkaik enyena, ebaiki enkalo e kopikop e nkaji o metabaiki enkalo e moikuape, neman olperere lo lasar o ina aji.

Neipang'unye ninye ilo ayioni lo laiguanani neishopoki enkopiyia e nkitoo, neisho ninye shakenisho, neibalunyeki ninye aaitaa olaiguanani nebukokini eilata aaput. Neosh ninche inkaik ejo, “Metobikoi olaiguanani.”
Ore ake pee eining'oo Atalia enkilepilep oo larripok tenebo iltung'ana, nelo ninye atua enkaji o Laitoriani ine netii iltung'ana;

nejo aing'orisho, eitashe olaiguanani te mbata e ng'ape, anaa enatiu olkerreti lenye, ore ilarikok le njore o laoshok loo sekekuani ootashare olaiguanani o ltung'ana pooki leina kop, neshipa neosh intarumpetani. Nepolos Atalia nkilani enyena neishir ajo, “Entorroni! Entorroni!”

Neitanap olapolosani Yehoida ilarikok le njore laa ninche apa ooitasheiki esikari ajoki, “Eyau ninye eimunye erishata oo ltimito naa iariara pooki tung'ani osuj ninye to lalem.” Amu etejo apa ilo apolosani, “Mincho eari ninye metua tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.”
Neaku eibung'a ninche ninye; neim ninye erishata e kishomi oo mbartan nelo enkaji o laiguanani, nepuoi aar ninye metua teine.
Neitobir Yehoida olning'o te rishata o Laitoriani o laiguanani o ltung'ana, nchere keaku ninche iltung'ana lo Laitoriani; neitobir sii olning'o te rishata o laiguanani o ltung'ana.

Neitoki iltung'ana pooki leina kop aapuo enkaji e Baal neuroo ninye, o lperereni lenyena loo lasarri. Ore inkitanyaanyukot enyena nebel aaitaa mbelibelat. Near Matan ilo apolosani le Baal metua te dukuya lelo pereren loo lasarri. Nepik ilo apolosani ilarripok ooing'or enkaji o Laitoriani.

Neyau ninye lelo arikok le njore, o laitasheikinok le nkaji e nkitoo o larripok o ltung'ana pooki leina kop; neriku ninche pooki olaiguanani te nkaji o Laitoriani, nepuo aaim kishomi oo larripok, nepuo enkaji o laiguanani. Neton Yehoash to lorika le nkitoo lo laiguanani.
Neshipayu iltung'ana pooki leina kop. Neitirring'a ina anasa ina kata eidipaki aatar Atalia metua to lalem te enkaji o laiguanani.
Oloo larin oopishana apa Yehoash pee eiteru aitoreisho.
Ore apa to lari liopishana le nkitoria e Yehu, neiteru Yehoash aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin artam oaare te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Sibia e Beer-sheba.
Neas Yehoash mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani too nkolong'i enyena pooki, amu eiteng'ena apa olapolosani Yehoida ninye.
Ore ake eyia eitu apa eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika, metaa eshomo iltung'ana dukuya epolosisho nepej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.

Nejoki Yehoash lelo apolosak; Ore kuna pisai pooki oo ntokitin sinyat naayawuaki atua enkaji o Laitoriani, nena pisai naaikenakaki pooki ng'ae - nena pisai naaikenakaki iltung'ana pooki, o nena pisai naadumaki oltau oltung'ani meyau atua enkaji o Laitoriani,
nchoo ilapolosak eya, eya ake oltung'ani te lelo ooyiolo. Naa nchoo ninche eitobir ina aji aaram te nkata ake naba anaa enadoli ewueji nerami.
Kake ore to lari le tikitam ookuni le nkitoria o laiguanani Yehoash, neitu eram ilapolosak ina aji.

Ore te nkaraki ina, neipotu olaiguanani Yehoash Yehoida olapolosani o kulikae apolosak nejoki ninche, “Kainyoo intae pee mintobiriri enkaji aaram? Ore naa taata mintokiki aaya mpisai te lelo liyiolorere, kake enchooi nena pisai pee eitobirieki enkaji e Nkai.”
Nenyorraa lelo apolosak pee meitoki aaya kulie pisai too ltung'ana, nemeitobir ninche aaram ina aji e Nkai.

Neitoki Yehoida ilo apolosani adumu osanduku, nepik enaudoto enkikenet enye, nepik ilo sanduku embata o lperere lo lasar, te nkalo e tatene, te wueji nejing'ieki enkaji o Laitoriani; ore lelo apolosak oorip kutukaji nepik atua ine nena pisai pooki naayawuaki atua enkaji o Laitoriani.
Naa ore ake enkata nadoli aajo aikumok mpisai naatii atua ilo sanduku, nelotu olasirani lo laiguanani o lapolosani kitok, aaiken neenaa ninche too lbenia oo notoki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.
Neisho ninche nena pisai naaidipaki aaikena lelo aasak le siaai ooitasheiki enkaji o Laitoriani; nelaaki ninche lelo aguetak loo nkeek, o lashetak ooshetita ina aji o Laitoriani.
Neisho sii ilashetak loo soito o ladung'ok loo soito. Neinyiang'u sii mbaoi o soito ooitobirieki enkaji o Laitoriani aaram.

Kake eitu eishoori te nkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani ntokitin naaitobirieki, ng'irran e nkosholai o ntokitin naarieki enkima o lbakulini o sekekuani, anaa kulie masaa e saabu, aashu ine nkosholai, te nena pisai apa naayawuaki atua enkaji o Laitoriani.
Amu eishooki apa nena pisai ilaitobirak le nkaji ooramita enkaji o Laitoriani.
Neitu apa eikilikuani metolimu enkikenakinoto te lelo tung'ana ooishooitie nena pisai too nkaik enye, aalaaki lelo aisiaayiak, amu etaasishote apa ninche te nkoitoi naisiligayu.
Ore mpisai o lasar le nkitarruorroto o no lasar le ng'oki, neitu eyauni atua enkaji o Laitoriani; inoo lapolosak nena.
Ore apa teina kata nelo Hasael olaiguanani le Siria aarare Gaat, neya ninye. Kake ore ake pee eibelekenya Hasael aing'or Yerusalem,

neya Yehoash ilo aiguanani le Yuda nena kishoorot pooki apa naaitisinya, Yehoshafat o Yoram o Ahasia, lelo aiguanak apa le Yuda, oara iloo menye. O nena kishoorot naaitisinya ninye makewan, o saabu pooki apa natii atua ilchumat le nkaji o Laitoriani o enkaji o laiguanani neirriwaki nena pooki Hasael olaiguanani le Siria. Nelo Hasael aing'uaa Yerusalem.
Ore apa kulie kiaasin e Yoash, o nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.
Nedumunye isinkan lenyena aarreshisho, near Yoash metua te nkaji e Milo teina oitoi nadoyio alo Sila.

Isinkan lenyena apa, Yasakar olayioni le Shimet o Yehoshad olayioni le Shomer ootanang'ie ninye enkop, neaku etua ninye nenukari tenebo loo menye tiatua enkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Amasia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

Ore to lari le tikitam ookuni le nkitoria e Yoash olayioni le Ahasia, olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Yehoahas olayioni le Yehu aitoreisho te Israel o te Samaria, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oopishana.
Etaasa apa ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani nerubare ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli. Eitu ninye eing'uaa nena ng'ok.
Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani tialo Isiraeli, neishooyo ninche apik inkaik e Hasael olaiguanani le Siria, o nkaik e Benhadad olayioni le Hasael.
Neitoki Yehoahas aishiraki Olaitoriani, nening Olaitoriani ninye; amu etoduaa ninye ina kibookinoto naibookoki Israel enkop, o ina naibooko ninche olaiguanani le Siria enkop.
Ore te nkaraki ina eishoo Olaitoriani Isiraeli olaitajeunoni, neaku etajeutuo ninche too nkaik oo ltung'ana le Siria. Nebik iltung'ana le Israel too nkang'itie enye anaa apa ake.
Ore ake eyia eitu ninche eing'uaa ing'ok e nkaji e Yeroboam, naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli. Kake eibung'a ninye orrekie lenye, neitobik Asher te Samaria.

Amu eitu apa eing'ueikini Yehoahas enjore oo ltung'ana onom loo mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan tomon o ltung'ana nkalifuni tomon oopuo too nkejek. Amu eidaikie apa olaiguanani le Siria ninche neitotiu ninche anaa enterit te wueji neidong'ishoreki.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoahas o nena pooki naataasa neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.
Neaku eirure Yehoahas etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukaa ninche ninye te Samaria neitoreisho Yoash olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Ore to lari le tomoni uni oopishana le nkitoria e Yoash olaiguanani le Yuda neiteru Yehoas olayioni le Yehoahas aitore Israel te Samaria, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon o ile.

Etaasa apa sii ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, eitu ninye epaash ing'ok pooki e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche eitapong'orie Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok. Kake eibung'a ninye orrekie lenye aas ing'ok.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Yoash, o nena pooki naataasa, o ina magilanisho naa ninye etigilunore Amasia olaiguanani le Yuda, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel?
Neaku eirure Yoash etua anaa loo menye, netonie Yeroboam olorika lenye le nkitoo; nenukari Yoash te Samaria tenebo ilaiguanak le Israel.

Ore apa pee ejing Elisha emuoyian naa ninye naawa, nelo Yoash olaiguanani le Israel enetii ninye neishir ninye te dukuya Elisha ejo, “Papaai lai, papaai lai! Ngarrin oo mbartan e Israel o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan”
Nejoki Elisha ninye, “Iwa enkawuo o mbaa;” neya ninye enkawuo o mbaa.
Neitoki ninye ajoki olaiguanani le Israel, “Teyietu enkawuo,” neyietu ninye, neiteleiki Elisha nkaik enyena endukuya o laiguanani.

Neitoki ninye ajo, “Tabolo elusie te nkalo oloosaen,” nebol olaiguanani elusie. Neitoki Elisha ajoki ninye, “Tang'oroi embae,” neng'oroo olaiguanani embae. Nejoki Elisha, “Embae o Laitoriani e nkisulata embae e nkisulata namirieki Siria! Amu ilo aarare Siria te Afek ometaba anaa niishie ninche.”
Nejo Elisha, “Iwa nena baa.” Neya olaiguanani nena baa. Nejoki ninye ilo aiguanani le Israel, “Tooshie nena baa enkop;” neoshie ninye enkop katitin uni, neitirring'a.

Negorokino ilo tung'ani le Nkai ninye, nejoki, “Anaata naaji itooshie enkop katitin imiet anaa ile; naa anaata ilo aar Siria ometaba anaa niishie ninche, kake ore taata katitin uni ake ilo aosh Siria.”
Neaku etua apa Elisha nenukari ninye. Ore ilooti wuampan loo Lmoabu naa kegira apa aarasaki ina kop te rishata o loirujuruj teilo ari.

Ore ina kata enukari oltung'ani otua, nedoli entukus eilo wuampa nenang'akini ilo tung'ani otua atua enkurare e Elisha; eji ore ake pee eiseyie ilo tung'ani iloik le Elisha, nepiu neitashe too nkejek enyena.
Ore apa Hasael olaiguanani le Siria neibooko Isiraeli enkop too nkolong'i pooki e Yehoahas.
Kake eing'urrie Olaitoriani ninche, neibelekenyakino ninche, te nkaraki osotua lenye o Abraham o Isaak o Yakobo, neaku meidaikie ninye ninche; nemearaa ninche aitung'uaa kewan ometabaiki taata.
Ore ake pee eye Hasael olaiguanani le Siria, neaku Benhadad olayioni lenye olaiguanani te rishata enye.
Neitoki Yehoash olayioni le Yehoahas aya te Benhadad olayioni le Hasael nena anas apa naatooruo ninye Yehoas papaai lenye to larrabal. Katitin uni etimira Yoash ninye nerrinyu nena anas oo Siraeli.
Ore to lari liare le nkitoria e Yoash olayioni le Yoahas, olaiguanani le Israel, neiteru aitoreisho Amasia olayioni le Yoash, ilo aiguanani le Yuda.
Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam ooudo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Yeho-adin e Yerusalem.
Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, kake mme sii anaa apa Daudi papaai lenye. Etaasa ninye too mbaa pooki anaa enataasa papaai lenye Yoash.
Kake eitu eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika, eton ake eitayu iltung'ana ilasarri nepej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.
Ore ake pee eidipi aaishoo Amasia enkitoo metaa ninye olaiguanani, near ninye isinkan lenyena metuata, laa ninche apa ootasesekuana menye.

Kake eitu ninye ear inkera e lelo tung'ana oata iloikop, te risioroto e nena naaigeroki te mbuku oo nkitanapat e Musa. Teine apa neitanapishe Olaitoriani ajo, “Meari iloo menye metuata te nkaraki nkera, nemeari nkera metuata te nkaraki loo menye; kake keye ake pooki ng'ae te nkaraki eng'oki enye makewan.”
Etaara apa Amasia iltung'ana le Edom inkalifuni tomon metuata to erata le munyan, neya enkanasa e Sela to larrabal, neisho ninye enkarna ajo Yokteel, naa ninye enkarna enye o taata.
Neitoki Amasia airriwaa ilkiliku meshomo enetii Yoash olayioni le Yehoahas, olayioni le Yehu, olaiguanani le Israel, ajoki, “Wou maing'urata iyiook too nkomomi.”

Neitoki Yehoash olaiguanani le Israel airriwaki olkilikuai olaiguanani le Yuda, nejoki, “Etiaaka apa olkikuei lo ldoinyo le Lebanon oltarakuai, ‘Nchoru entito ino meyama olayioni lai.’ Nelotu eng'ues entim e Lebanon aim ine neituny ilo kikuei.
Kesipa itoosho iyie Edom, nikinting'ida iyie oltau lino. Ndipakinoyu naa iyie te nkitoo ino nintirring'a tiang. Amu kainyoo iyie pee ing'oru enyamali ijo pee ibatata iyie tenebo Yuda.”
Kake eitu ening Amasia ina. Neaku etudumunye Yehoash olaiguanani le Israel alo, ore ninye o Amasia olaiguanani le Yuda neipirakino to larrabal te Bet-shenesh, e Yuda.
Nemir Israel Yuda neisik pooki tung'ani alo enkang enye.

Neibung Yehoash olaiguanani le Israel Amasia ilo aiguanani le Yuda, olayioni le Yehoash, olayioni le Ahasia te Betshe-mesh, nelotu Yerusalem neuroo esuntai e Yerusalem erishata oo ntemat e nkaina iip ong'uan, ebaiki kishomi e Efraim ometabaiki kishomi o lpijata.
Neya ninye saabu pooki o enkosholai, o masaa pooki apa naainepuaki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, o tiatua ilchumat le nkaji o laiguanani o ltung'ana apa ootarayioki, neyau ninche Samaria.
Ore nkulie kiaasin e Yehoash apa naataasa ninye, o enkidimata enye o ina nataarare Amasia olaiguanani le Yuda, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.
Neirura Yehoash etua anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye te Samaria, tenebo ilaiguanak le Israel; neitoreisho Yeroboam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Etobiko apa Amasia olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Yuda, ilarin tomon o imiet, te siadi keeya e Yehoash olayioni le Yehoahas olaiguanani le Israel.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Amasia, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.
Nerresh ninche ninye te Yerusalem, neisikaki enkop e Lakish. Kake eirriwakita ninche iltung'ana le Lakish, nepuo ninche aar ninye metua teine.
Nenapu ninche ninye too mbartan; nepuoi aanukaa ninye te Yerusalem tenebo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi.
Neya iltung'ana pooki le Yuda Asaria, laa oloo larin tomon o ile, neitaa ninye olaiguanani te rishata e papaai lenye Amasia.
Etesheta apa ninye Elat nerrinyoki Yuda, ina kata eidipa olaiguanani atua tenebo loo menye.

Ore to lari le tomon o imiet le nkitoria e Amasia olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Israel aitoreisho te Samaria. Neitoreisho ninye ilarin artam oobo.
Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani. Eitu ninye epaash ing'ok pooki e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli.

Etorrinyuo ninye olpolosie pooki le Israel ebaiki enejing'ieki Hamat ometabaiki enaiposha e Araba, te risioroto eilo rorei lo Laitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye Yona olayioni le Amitai, ilo oiboni le Nkai; oing'uaa Gat-hafer.
Amu etoduaa apa Olaitoriani nchere ore ina kibookinoto e nkop oo Siraeli naa keme, amu meetae hoo obo otelekua, oloena anaa ololakuno, nemeetae oltung'ani oret Isiraeli.
Kake eitu apa ejo Olaitoriani keiwuang'ie enkarna e Israel tiabori keper. Neaku eitajewuo ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkaina e Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash.

Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yeroboam, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, o enkidimata enye, o larrabali lenyena, o ina natorrinyoko Israel Dameski o Hamat, naa ene Yuda apa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.
Neirura Yeroboam etua anaa apa loo menye, lelo aiguanak le Israel. Neitoreisho Sakaria olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Ore to lari le tikitam oopishana le nkitoria e Yeroboam olaiguanani le Israel, neiteru Asaria olayioni le Amasia, ilo aiguanani le Yuda aitoreisho.
Oloo larin tomon o ile apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin onom oaare te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Yekolia e Yerusalem.
Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa Amasia papaai lenye.
Kake ore eyia eitu eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika; neton ake epej iltung'ana enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.

Neosh Olaitoriani ilo aiguanani, neaku ninye ole nkeeya oo lbolot ometabaiki ina olong apa natua ninye. Neton apa ninye te nkaji enye etekepayioki. Naa Yotam apa olayioni lo laiguanani oitasheiki enkaji e nkitoo, neitore iltung'ana leina kop.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Amasia, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.
Neirura Asaria etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukari ninye tenebo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Yatam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Ore to lari le tomoni uni o isiet le nkitoria e Asaria olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Sakaria olayioni le Yeroboam aitoreisho too Siraeli te nkop e Samaria, ilapaitin ile.
Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, anaa apa enataasa papaai lenye. Eitu ninye epaash ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche eitapong'orie Isiraeli.
Nerresh Shalum olayioni le Yabesh Sakaria, neosh ninye abatat te Ibleam, near ninye metua, neitoreisho te rishata enye.
Ore nkulie kiaasin e Sakaria neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.
(Ina apa enkisiligata naishoo Olaitoriani Yehu, ajoki, “Ketonie ilayiok linono olorika le nkitoo le Israel ometabaiki e ishoi e ong'uan,” nelotu aaku ina.)
Eiterua apa Shalum olayioni le Yabesh aitoreisho to lari le tomoni uni o naaudo le nkitoria e Usia olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye olapa obo te Samaria.
Neitoki Menaham olayioni le Gadi alotu eing'uaa Tirsa nelotu Samaria, neosh ninye Shalum olayioni le Yebesh te Samaria near ninye metua, neitoreisho ninye te rishata enye.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Shalum, ina rreshoto natarreshishe neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.
Ore apa teina kata near Manahem Tipua o pooki ootii atua, o lpolosien lenyena ebaiki Tirsa neito idia alo. Etaara apa te nkaraki neitu ninche ebolu ninye, nedanyaa nkoishua nkituaak pooki naairoishi.
Ore to lari le tomoni uni o naaudo le nkitoria e Asaria olaiguanani le Yuda neiteru Menahen olayioni le Gadi aitoreisho te Israel, neitoreisho ilarin tomon te Samaria.
Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani; eitu ninye epaash te nkishui enye pooki ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche eitapong'orie Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.
Nelotu Pul olaiguanani le Asiria aarare ina kop; neisho Menahem Pul ntalantani enkalifu nabo e nkosholai, pee etum ninye ataretu ninye, meitagolo enkitoria enye.

Netasotuo apa Menahem nena pisai te Israel, aa taa, too ltung'ana pooki karsisi. Neitayu ake oltung'ani shekeli onom aisho olaiguanani le Asiria. Neaku etorrinye olaiguanani le Asiria, neitu eitoki aton teinakop.
Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Manahem, nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.
Neirura Mehahem etua anaa apa loo menye, neitoreisho Pekahia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
