Naa ore ilturrurri loo lapolosak o loo Lawi, teina kisiaayiare pooki enkaji e Nkai netii tenebo iyie, neeta ake pooki tung'ani eyieunoto, neeta pooki ng'ae enkarriyiano te pooki kisiaayiare; ore sii ilkituaak o ltung'ana pooki naa kening aakurraki tenintanap ninche.”

Nejoki olaiguanani Daudi ina umata pooki, “Ore Solomon enkerai ai laa ninye openy etegelua Enkai, naa oltung'ani oti lemeeta enkarriyiano, naa eikitok ena siaai, amu ore ena aji nemeaku eno ltung'ani, kake eno Olaitoriani Enkai.

Neaku aishoru nanu ntokitin naashetieki enkaji e Nkai, ai anaa enaidim. Aishorua saabu te nkaraki ntokitin e saabu o enkosholai te nkaraki ntokitin e nkosholai o suyai te nkaraki ntokitin o suyai o esekenkei te nkaraki ntokitin e sekenkei o nkeek te nkaraki ntokitin oo nkeek, ore tenebo nena netii isoito kumok ooji oniks, o soito ooitasheyieki o soito loo muain kumok o mpukunot pooki oo soito oogol enkinyiang'a o ltoto ooibor.

Ore ake tenebo nena tokitin pooki naishorua nanu te nkaraki ina aji sinyati, naata nanu olchumati lai makewan le saabu o enkosholai, naa ore te nkaraki enyorrata ai te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ai, aishoo nanu enkaji e Nkai ai:
ntalantani nkalifuni uni e saabu, ina saabu e Ofir o ntalantani nkalifuni naapishana e nkosholai nasila, pee emurieki isunta eina aji,

o te nkaraki ina siaai pooki naas lelo tung'ana arriyiak, saabu te nkaraki ntokitin e saabu, o enkosholai te nkaraki ntokitin e nkosholai. Kaing'ae naa likae oishoru te yieunoto, neitisiny kewan ena olong, neitisinyaki kewan Olaitoriani?”

Neitoki nena lukuny oo nkajijik o nkajijik oo loo menye aaishoru nena kishoorot enye o lpela, anaa ake sii enataasa ilarikok loo loshon, o larikok le njore loo nkalifuni, o loo maa iip, o lelo kituaak ooitasheiki esiaai o laiguanani.

Neishoru ninche te nkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai ntalantani nkalifuni imiet e saabu o ntalantani nkalifuni tomon e nkosholai o ntalantani nkalifuni tomon oisiet o suyai o ntalantani nkalifuni iip nabo e sekenkei.
Ore pooki ng'ae oata soito oogol enkinyiang'a, nepik ilo shumati le nkaji Olaitoriani, naa Yehiel le Gershon apa olaing'urani.
Neng'idayu apa iltung'ana te nkaraki eitautuo kulo te nyorrata, amu to ltau pooki eishorutua ninche to lpela aaisho Olaitoriani; neng'idayu sii olaiguanani Daudi oleng.
Neitoki Daudi aisis Olaitoriani te dukuya ina umata pooki; nejo Daudi: “Metaa iyie eisisi, iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel papa lang, ntarasi o ntarasi.

Enino, iyie Olaitoriani enkitoo o engolon o enkitoria o enkisulata o enkishiaa; amu ore pooki natii shumata o enkop naa ninono; enino enkitoria, iyie Olaitoriani, naa iyie eilepieki aaitulusoo te pooki.
Ore karsisisho o enkanyit naa iyie eing'uaa, naa iyie oitoreisho te shumata pooki. Enkaina ino etii engolon o enkidimata; naa enkaina ino; naitaa kitok neisho engolon pooki ng'ae.
Ore taata nikincho iyie enashe, Enkai ang, nikisis Enkarna ino kitok.
“Kake kara nanu ng'ae, naa kainyoo olorere lai, eji metaa eikindim aaishoru kuna te yieunoto. Amu iyie eing'uaa ntokitin pooki naa ninono kitorrinyokito iyie.
Amu kira iyiook omon te dukuya iyie, nikira lapuayak anaa apa enatiu loo papa pooki; etiu nkolong'i ang te nkop anaa oloip, nemeetae enebikieki.
Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ang, ore ena kumoi e kuna tokitin nikintaituo pee kishetakinye iyie enkaji te nkaraki enkarna ino sinyati, naa enkaina ino eing'uaa, naa ninono pooki.

Kayiolo nanu, Enkai ai, nchere, ijur oltau, nishipakino enkishui sidai; ore te sidano oltau lino naishorua nanu kuna pooki te nyorrata, natoduaa nanu taata kulikae tung'ana linono, ootoni tene, neishoru te nyorrata o te ng'ida.
Olaitoriani, Na Ai e Abraham o Isaak o Israel, loo papa, tipika ntarasi kuna yieunot o ndamunot atua iltauja loo ltung'ana linono, niutaa iltauja lenye meetu enitii.
Nchoo Solomon enkerai ai meibung'a to ltau lenye nkitanapat inono, pooki o shakenisho ino o nkikoot inono, neitabaya pooki, neshet ninye ine wueji apa naitobira.”

Neitoki Daudi ajoki ina umata, “Esisa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.” Neisis ina umata pooki Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, neirrug ninche ilukuny enye, neserem Olaitoriani, neisho enkanyit aaitaa Olaiguanani.

Neisho ninche Olaitoriani ilasarri, ore te nkolong nasuju, neishooyo ilasarri oopejori to Olaitoriani, iloing'ok enkalifu nabo, o lmeregeshi enkalifu nabo, o lkuoo le kerra enkalifu nabo tenebo ilasarri lenye ooki, o lasaari kumok oleng te Israel pooki;

neokisho ninche nedaa te dukuya Olaitoriani ina olong te ng'ida sapuk oleng. Neitaa ninche Solomon ilo ayioni le Daudi olaiguanani te nkata e are, nebukoki ninche ninye eilata aaput aaitaa olkitok te nkaraki Olaitoriani, neitaa Sadok olapolosani.
Neton Solomon to lorika le nkitoo lo Laitoriani anaa olaiguanani te rishata e Daudi papaai lenye; nebul ninye, nening Israel pooki ninye.
Ore ilarikok pooki o lelo tung'ana magil, o layiok sii le Daudi pooki, nelimu aaibalunye enkirukoto enye to laiguanani Solomon.
Neisho Olaitoriani Solomon metoning'oyu oleng te dukuya Isiraeli pooki, neisho ninye enkitoo neitu aekata eishori likae aiguanani too Siraeli.
Neaku eitoreisho apa Daudi olayioni le Yese te Israel pooki.
Ore apa enkata naitoria ninye Israel naa ilarin artam; eitoreishe ninye ilarin ile te Hebron, neitoreisho ilarin tomoni uni oo kuni te Yerusalem.
Neye ninye aa oltung'ani moruo oleng, oiputakinote nkolong'i eeta karsisisho o enkanyit kitok; neitoreisho Solomon olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

Ore apa nkiaasin o laiguanani Daudi, ebaiki enkiterunoto ometabaiki enkiting'oto, neigeroki too mbukui oo nkatinin oo loibonok okuni, Samuel oladuaani, o too nkatinin e Natan ilo oiboni le Nkai o too nkatinin e Gad oladuaani,
tenebo mbaa pooki e nkitoria enye o mbaa pooki e nkitoria enye o emagilanisho enye o mbaa pooki naaetuo shumata ninye o shumata Israel o shumata nkitoriat pooki oo nkuapi.
Eitagolo apa Solomon olayioni le Daudi kewan te nkitoria enye, netii Olaitoriani Enkai enye tenebo ninye, neitaa ninye kitok oleng.
Neirorie Solomon Isiraeli pooki, neirorie ilarikok le njore loo nkalifuni, o loo maa iip o larishak o larikok pooki loo Siraeli, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye.
Ore Solomon o ina umata pooki natii tenebo ninye, nepuo ine wueji e shumata natii Gibeon; amu ine apa etii olng'obor le Nkai oitobira Musa osinka lo Laitoriani.
Kake eyawua apa Daudi ilo sanduku le Nkai te Kiriat-Yearim neya ine wueji apa neitobiraka, amu etuuno apa ninye olng'obor te nkaraki ninye te Yerusalem.
Kake ore ilo perere lo lasar lo suyai oitobira Besalel olayioni le Uri, olayioni le Huri, netii dukuya ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani. Nesai Solomon o ina umata Olaitoriani.

Neilep Solomon alo ine netii olperere lo lasar lo suyai te dukuya Olaitoriani. Atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo apa etii ilo perere lo lasar, neitayu Solomon ilasarri oopejori enkalifu nabo te nchumata enye.
Ore teina kewarie neipang'aki Enkai Solomon, nejoki ninye, “Toomonu entoki niyieu naaisho.”
Nejoki Solomon Enkai, “Intodolua iyie enyorrata kitok nauno te papaai lai Daudi, nikintaa nanu olaiguanani te rishata enye.
Olaitoriani Enkai, inchoo ina kisiligata ino tialo Daudi papaai lai meitabari taata, amu kintaa iyie nanu olaiguanani te shumata olorere kitok oba anaa enterit e nkop.
Inchooki naa taata nanu eng'eno nagut o eyiolounoto pee aaidim atoriko kulo tung'ana kulo tung'ana, amu aing'ae oidim aitoria ele orere lino kitok?”

Newaliki Enkai Solomon ajoki, “Ore te nkaraki netii ena atua oltau lino, neitu iyie iomonu imasaa, o enkarsisisho, o enkanyit, anaa enkishui e lelo likimba iyie, neitu doi ninye iomonu enkishui naado, kake eng'eno o eyiolounoto te kewan ino, pee itum aitoria lelo tung'ana laainei laa te ninche nanu aaitaa olaiguanani,

kinchooki iyie eng'eno nagut o eyiolounoto. Kaaisho sii karsisisho, o masaa, o enkanyit, neitu aekata etum obo le lelo aiguanak apa ootii dukuya iyie, nemeetae te siadi iyie olotum mbaa naatiu anaa kuna.”
Neitoki Solomon alotu teine wueji e shumata te Gibeon, te dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nelotu Yerusalem. Neitore ninye Israel.
Neiturrur Solomon tenebo ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo-mbartan inkalifuni tomon oaare, laa ninche apa etipika inkanas, oo ngarrin oo mbartan tenebo olaiguanani te Yerusalem.
Neitotiu olaiguanani enkosholai o saabu anaa isoito te Yerusalem neiput iltarakua pooki wueji anaa olng'aboli le Shefela.
Neinyang'u Solomon imbartan naaing'uaa Misiri o enkop naji Kue, ore lelo biasharani lo laiguanani neng'amu ninche te Kue te nkinyang'a.

Naa keinyang'u apa ninche engarri oo mbartan naing'uaa Misiri te shekeli iip ile e nkosholai, neinyang'u embarta te shekeli iip nabo o onom. Neikunaki sii apa neijia aamiraki ilaiguanak pooki le Hiti o laiguanak le Siria.
Neitobir apa Solomon pee eshet enkaji e Nkai te nkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani, neitobiraki kewan enkaji e nkitoo.

Neiteng'el Solomon iltung'ana inkalifuni intomoni naapishana pee enap ilolan, neiteng'el iltung'ana inkalifuni intomoni isiet pee eturu isoito teinakop oo ndonyio, neiteng'el iltung'ana inkalifuni uni o iip ile ooitasheiki ninche.
Neirriwaki Solomon olkilikuai Huram olaiguanani le Tiro: Nejoki, “Ore apa anaa enintaasa Daudi papa, nirriwaki ninye iltarakua ooshetie enkaji enye nabikie, intaasaki sii nanu ina.

“Etaa nanu kajo pee ashet enkaji te nkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ai, naitisinya nanu ninye apejoki enkorropil, o sonkoyoni naarropil te dukuya ninye. Naishoru nanu anaake emukate e nkitoduaaroto, naishoru ilasarri oopejori tedekenya o teipa, too Sabatoni o too lapaitin ng'ejuko, o too siruai gelunot lo Laitoriani Enkai ang, anaa apa enaiteng'elaki intarasi te Israel.
Ore ina aji nalo nanu ashet naa keaku kitok, amu ore Enkai ang naa aikitok alang inkaitin pooki.
Kake aing'ae oidim ateshetaki ninye e nkaji, aa ore keper nalakua oleng nemeishaa ninye? Kara nanu ng'ae oshetaki ninye enkaji, meteleku ake ewueji nepejieki enkorropil te dukuya ninye?

Ore naa taata irriwakaki nanu oltung'ani arriyia te siaai e saabu o enkosholai o suyai o sekenkei, o ltung'ani arriyia too muain pilei o naanyokie o nkilani pusi, o ltung'ani oiteng'enaki te nguetare, pee elo aaku tenebo lelo aisiaayiak arriyiak ootii tenebo nanu te Yuda o te Yerusalem, lelo apa ooishorua Daudi papaai lai.

Irriwakaki sii iltarakua o lkeek oonyaanyukie iltarakua, o mbaoi naaing'uaa Lebanon, amu ayiolo nanu ajo keyiolo isinkan linono aatudungu imbaoi te Lebanon. Naa keaku isinkan laainei tenebo isinkan linono,
pee aaitobiraki nanu imbaoi kumok, amu ore ina aji nalo nanu ashet naa keaku kitok naa enenking'asia.

Naa kaishoru nanu te nkaraki isinkan linono, lelo oodung'u mbaoi, mpirbili inkalifuni tikitam e nkano naidong'o, o mpirbili inkalifuni tikitam e shairi, o mboreitin iip ong'uan oltulet le naisho oo sabibu, o eilata mboreitin iip ong'uan oltulet.”
Neitoki Huram ilo aiguanani le Tiro awal te mpalai naigeroko Solomon, nejo, “Ore te nkaraki nanyor Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, kintaa iyie olaiguanani lenye.”

Neitoki Huram, ajo, “Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, ilo oitobira shumata o enkop, laa ninye oishoo olaiguanani Daudi olayioni ng'en, neiputaki enkarriyiano o eyiolounoto, laa ninye oshetaki Olaitoriani enkaji, neshetaki kewan enkaji e nkitoo.
“Airriwua naa taata nanu oltung'ani arriyia, obore eyiolounoto, Huramabi

olayioni le ntito e Dan, ore apa menye naa oltung'ani le Tiro. Eiteng'enaki ninye pee easishore saabu, o enkosholai, o suyai, o esekenkei, o soito o nkeek, o muain pooki pilei o mpusi, o nkilani naanyokie o kitani napuyiapui. Neas impukunot pooki e nguetare nedamu enkipirunoto ake ninye naishooki ninye meipiru. Keaku lelo tung'ana linono arriyiak tenebo iltung'ana arriyiak lo lkitok lai Daudi papaai lino.
Ore naa taata ina ano o shairi, o eilata o enaisho oo sabibu, naa ninche eimaka olkitok lai, inchoo ninye meirriwaki isinkan linono;
naa aikidung'u iyiook mbaoi naaba anaa iniyieu te Lebanon, nikiyaki iyie too rridat aaimunye enaiposha e Yopa, pee itum iyie aawa Yerusalem.”
Neitoki Solomon aiken iltung'ana pooki dokunot apa ootii enkop e Israel, aiturubare ina kikenare apa naikenishe Daudi papaai lenye. Netumi iltung'ana inkalifuni iip nabo o onom o okuni o iip ile.

Ore intomoni naapishana negelu metanapa ilolan. Ore inkalifuni intomoni isiet nepuo aaturu isoito teinakop oo ldoinyo, ore inkalifuni uni o iip ile neitaa ilaitasheikinok pee etum iltung'ana aataas esiaai.

Neiteru Solomon ashet enkaji o Laitoriani te Yerusalem, te nchumata o ldoinyo le Moria, teine wueji apa neipang'akinye Olaitoriani kewan te papaai lenye Daudi. Teine wueji apa netegelua Daudi, te nchumata ine apa neiutuutishoreki e Ornan ilo le Yebusi.
Neiteru ninye ashet to lapa liare to lari liong'uan le nkitoria enye.
Kuna apa intemeta e Solomon te nchetata e nkaji e Nkai: ore enkadoro naa intemat e nkaina tikitam oopishana, naa ntemeta e nkaina naaudo endapasho.
Ore ine wueji nejing'ieki neba anaa endapasho eina aji. Ore enkadoro oo sunta naa intemat enkaina onom o ong'uan. Ore atua ina aji nemura te saabu nasila.
Ore ilo gilata sapuk neikodo too ltarakua nemura te saabu nasila, neguetakino iltuka, o lpisia.
Eikodo apa olaiguanani ina aji e Nkai too soito sidain oogol enkinyang'a, o te saabu naing'uaa enkop e Paraim.
Neaku etipika apa ninye saabu atua ina aji, ing'apeta enyena, o loom lenyena o sunta enyena.
Neitobir sii ine wueji nesinya aisul, nenyaanyuk enkadoro enye o endapasho eina aji, naa intemeta e nkaina naaudo ake enchoto nabo, nemur ninye te saabu nasila oo ntalantani iip ile.
Ore enkiroishi oo lmushumaani naa shekeli nabo ometabaiki shekeli onom e saabu. Nemur ninye lelo gilat le shumata te saabu.
Ore teine wueji nesinya aisul nepik ilkerubi oaare loo nkeek, nemur ninche te saabu.
Ore inaipuko e lelo kerubi pokira oaare naa intemeta e nkaina are enkadoro.
Ore enaipukoi olkerubi obo nelo atumore enaipukoi e likae kerubi te mpolos e nkaji.
Ore inaipuko e kulo kerubi nebaya te nkadoro intemeta naaudo e nkaina, neitashe ake olkerubi too nkejek enyena eing'or olgos le kutukaji.
Neitobir ilkarash liatua, pusi, o sinteti o loonyokie, o kitani napuyiapui neitobiru ilkerubi.
Ore te dukuya ina aji, neitobir ninye ing'apeta are naa intemeta e nkaina tomon o imiet o lpisiaai enkadoro, nepik inkopiyiani ilukuny naa intemeta imiet e nkaina enkadoro.
Neitobir ninye olpisiai anaa osaei le murt nepik ninche enchumata e nena ng'apeta; neitobir ilgululu iip nabo neripaki ilo pisiai.

Etipika apa ninye nena ng'apeta dukuya ina aji e Nkai, nepik ake nabo enchoto e kopikop nepik enkae enchoto e moikuape; ore ina natii enchoto e kopikop nejo ninye Yakin, ore ina natii enchoto e moikuape nejo Boas.
Eitobira ninye olperere lo lasar lo suyai, naa intemeta e nkaina naaudo enkadoro, naa neijia etiu endapasho, naa intemeta ong'uan olpisiai enkadoro nailep.

Neitoki aitobir olmoti le sekenkei natosholaki, naa intemat are olpisiai enkaina endapasho, naa intemeta ong'uan olpisiai e nkaina endapasho naa intemeta tomon ookuni e nkaina enkamanaa enye. Naa kepurupurana apa.
Ore tiabori ilo moti netii intokitin naaijo ilmong'i ooitashe emanita; naa ilkererin oaare apa ninche.

Neitashe ilo moti te nchumata lelo mong'i, neing'or okuni enchoto e moikuape, neing'or okuni enchoto o loontoluo, neing'or okuni enchoto e kopikop, neing'or okuni enchoto o loosaen, naa ninche apa eiteleikiaki ilo moti, ore inkaloli enye oo lkidong'o naa enchoto e atua etii.
Ore endapasho enye neba anaa endap e nkaina, ore emanaroto enye neikununo anaa enkikompe, netiu anaa entapukai sidai; naa mboreitin inkalifuni uni o ltulet enkare natii.

Neitobir sii imotioo tomon ooitukuoreki, nepik imiet enchoto e kopikop nepik imiet enchoto e moikuape. Kuna apa eitukuyieki irubat e ng'ues naitaae olasar opejori, ore ilo moti naa oloo lapolosak pee eitukuore.
Neitobir ninye inkitasheta oo ltaai anaa enatuutuaki nepik ninche atua ina aji e Nkai, nepik imiet enchoto e kopikop, nepik imiet enchoto e moikuape.
Neitobir sii imisai tomon, nepik ninche atua ina aji e Nkai, nepik imiet enchoto e moikuape.
Neitobir olgoriet loo lapolosak, o lgoriet kitok o enejing'ieki olgoriet,
nemur nena kutukie oo lgorieti to suyai; nepik ilo moti olpijata le nchoto e kopikop eina aji.
Neitobir sii Huram imotioo, o nchempei oo lala o mbakulini. Neaku eidipa apa Huram esiaai pooki nataasaka olaiguanani Solomon te nkaji e Nkai:
nena ng'apeta pokira are, o lbakulini o nena opiyiani naaishopokino o ina siaai oo usin naaripunyeki inkarash are naaimulumulieki nena bakulini naatii nchumat e nena ng'apeta;
o lgululu iip ong'uan ooikodieki ina siaai e ripare oo usin, te nkarasha ake nabo, pee eimulumul nena bakulini pokira are naatii nchumat e nena ng'apeta.
Neitobir sii nkitasheta neiteleiki lelo motioo nena kitasheta.
O ilo moti obo, o lelo mong'i pokira tomon oaare ootii abori enye.
O mbokishi o nchempei oo lala, o masaa pooki naaitobira Huram to suyai oidong'o, aitobiraki olaiguanani Solomon, te nkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani.
Teina kisiashata e nkop e Yuda eipurjaki ninche, teina terit natii erishata e Sukot o Sereda.
Neitobir Solomon kuna tokitin pooki te nkumoi sapuk oleng, o metaa meikenayu enkiroishi o suyai.
Neaku eitobira Solomon intokitin pooki apa naatii atua enkaji e Nkai: olperere lo lasar le saabu, o misai te nkaraki emukate e nkitoduaaroto,
o nkitasheta oo ltaai, o lelo taai lenye le saabu nasila, pee eyupuyup te dukuya ilo gilata liatua osinya, anaa apa enatuutuaki.
O ntapuka o ltaai, o nena tokitin naarieki iltaai e saabu nasila;

o ntokitin naaitobirieki iltaai o mbesheni o ntokitin e nkorropil o mbakulini e nkima e saabu nasila o lgos le nkaji e Nkai ojing'ieki kutukaji o lgilata liatua o metabaiki ine wueji nesinya aisul, ore inkutukie eine nejing'ieki ina aji e Nkai naa ine saabu.

Neidipayu ina siaai pooki apa nataasa Solomon te nkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani. Neyau Solomon aitijing'u nena tokitin apa naaitisinya Daudi papaai lenye, neshum ina osholai o saabu, o masaa pooki teneshumishoreki e nkaji e Nkai.

Neitoki Solomon aiturrur ilpayiani loo Siraeli o lukuny pooki oo loshon, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye too ltung'ana loo Siraeli, te Yerusalem, pee epuo aailepunye osanduku lo lning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani aaitupuku te nkanasa e Daudi, aa taa Sion.
Neiturrurro iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli te dukuya olaiguanani to sirua lo lapa liopishana.
Nepuonu ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli, nenap Ilawi ilo sanduku,
neyau ilo sanduku oilo ng'obor le ntumo, o nena masaa naasinya pooki naatii atua ilo ng'obor; neyau ilapolosak o Lawi ninche.
Ore olaiguanani Solomon o lturrurr pooki le Israel apa oiturrurre te dukuya ninye, netii dukuya ilo sanduku, nepolos nkerra kumok o lmong'i lemeikenayu.
Neaku eyautua ilapolosak ilo sanduku lo lning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani ewueji enye, tiatua olgilata liatua leina aji, tiatua ine wueji nesinya aisul, tiabori inaipuko oo lkerubi.
Amu kelak apa lelo kerubi inaipuko enye te shumata ilo sanduku lo lning'o lo sotua, neaku keitoip lelo kerubi ilo sanduku lo sotua, o mbokishi enyena.
Naa kaadoru apa nena bokishi oleng, ometaa ore ineeiting'ie nelioyu teine wueji sinyati te dukuya olgilata liatua osinya. Kake melioo te boo. Netii ninche ine ometabaiki ena olong.

Metii apa toki atua ilo sanduku meteleku ake nena baoi dapashi oo soito apa naatipika Musa te Horeb, teine apa naitobirie Olaitoriani olning'o lo sotua o ltung'ana loo Siraeli, apa pee eipang'u te nkop e Misiri.
Ore apa pee eipang'u ilapolosak teine wueji sinyati (amu ore apa lelo apolosak pooki ootii ine neitisinya ate, meshilaa ilturrurri lenye).

Ore lelo aranyak pooki le Lawi o Asaf o Heman o Yedutum o layiok lenye o lalashera lenye, neishop ilkilani sidain, neeta inkinantani dapashi o nkai oo sinkolioitin, o lwululi loo usin, neitashe te nchoto o loosaen lo lperere lo lasar, tenebo ilapolosak iip nabo o tikitam ookut intarumpetani.

Naa esiaai apa oo lakutak loo sekekuani, o laranyak pee eitoning'oo ate te nkirukoto o sinkolio eisis neisho enashe Olaitoriani. Naa teneilepieki osinkolio too sekekuani o too nkinantani dapashi, o kulie ake kinantani naaranyishoreki eisisi Olaitoriani, aajo, “Eisupat ninye nebikoo enyorrata enye nauno intarasi” ore ina aji o Laitoriani neiput enkatampoi
ometaa meeidim ilapolosak aaitasho aaisiaaisho amu eiputa apa enkitoo o Laitoriani enkaji e Nkai.
Neitoki Solomon ajo, “Etejo Olaitoriani kebik ninye te misimisi nagut.
Aateshetaka nanu iyie enkaji e shumata, ewueji ino nibikie intarasi.”
Neitoki olaiguanani aibelekenya nemayian ina umata oo Siraeli, eitashe ina umata pooki oo Siraeli.
Nejo ninye, “Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, amu eitabayie ninye te nkaina enye ina apa naisiligie te nkutuk enye Daudi papaai lai, ejo,

‘Ore ebaiki ina olong nayawua nanu iltung'ana laainei aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, eitu nanu agelu enkanasa tiatua Israel pooki, naa ninye eshetieki enkaji, pee etum enkarna ai ataa ine etii. Neitu nanu agelu oltung'ani aitaa kitok te shumata iltung'ana laainei loo Siraeli.
Kake ategelua nanu Yerusalem pee eaku ine wueji aaseremieki, nategelua nanu Daudi pee eitasheiki iltung'ana laainei le Israel.’
Eeta apa Daudi papaai lai to ltau lenye pee eshet enkaji te nkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel.
Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani Daudi papaai lai, ‘Ore hoo niata to ltau lino pee ishet enkaji te nkaraki enkarna ai, intobira amu iata ina to ltau lino;
ore ake eyia, milo iyie ashet ina aji, kake olayioni lino likiikini iyie, ninye olo ashet enkaji te nkaraki enkarna ai.’

Eitabayie taata Olaitoriani ina kisiligata enye apa naisiligishore; amu aitasho nanu te rishata e Daudi, papaai lai, naton to lorika le nkitoo, le Israel, anaa apa enaisiligishore Olaitoriani, atesheta nanu enkaji te nkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel.
Natipika ine osanduku laa ninye etii ilo sotua lo Laitoriani oitobira ninye tenebo iltung'ana loo Siraeli.”
Neitashe Solomon te dukuya ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani te dukuya ina umata pooki neilepie inkaik enyena aitorioo.

Eitobira apa Solomon ewueji o suyai neika intemeta are e nkaina enkadoro o endapasho, naa entemet nabo enkadoro nailep, nepik apa ine wueji olgoriet. Neitashe te nchumata. Neitoki agil kung te nchumata ine te dukuya ina umata pooki oo Siraeli neitorioo inkaik enyena aing'orie shumata,
nejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, meetae Enkai natiu anaa iyie, te keper o te nkop, naibung osotua neitodolu enyorrata nauno too sinkan lenyena oopuo te dukuya iyie too ltauja lenye pooki.
Mbung'a iyie tialo osinka lino Daudi, papaai lai ina apa nimbalakinye ninye; ee iroro iyie te nkutuk ino, nintabayie te nkaina ino nena ena olong.

Ore naa taata, Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, mbung'a to sinka lino Daudi, papaai lai, ina apa nisiligie ninye, ijo: Mikiany ae kata oltung'ani kisiaai iyie te dukuya nanu, pee etonie olorika le nkitoo le Israel, oi duoo tenaa kejurru ilayiok linono inkoitoi enye nepuo too nkitanapat aainei anaa enishomie iyie te dukuya nanu.”
Ore naa taata Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, inchoo eunoyu ilo rorei lino, apa lirorie osinka lino Daudi.
“Kake amaa, kesipa kebik Enkai tenebo iltung'ana te nkop? Ng'ura, ore keper o keper nalakua nemikiishaa iyie; kebaa naa mikiishaa iyie ena aji natesheta nanu!
Toning'o naa enkomono o sinka lino o esayiata enye, Olaitoriani Enkai ai. Toning'o enkishirata o enkomono nayau osinka lino dukuya iyie;
pee etum inkonyek inono aaing'ura ena aji dama o kewarie, ene wueji apa nisiligishore pee ipik enkarna ino, pee itum atoning'o enkomono naomon osinka lino tene wueji.
Toning'o iyie eomonokinoto o sinka lino o enoo ltung'ana linono le Israel, te neomon eing'or ene wueji, ee toning'o iyie itii emanyisho ino te keper, naa te nining nipaliki.
“Teneas oltung'ani eng'oki tialo ole latia enye, neinosieki ninye olmumai te dukuya ele perere lo lasar tena aji,
toning'o naa iyie itii keper, nias, ninguanare isinkan linono, aitalaku entorroni ayau entorroni enye shumata endukuya enye makewan, nimbalunye ilo supat alaaki ninye te risioroto e supatisho enye.
“Tenemiri iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli te dukuya ilmang'ati, te nkaraki nataasa ninche eng'oki te iyie, tenelo neibelekenya ninche aaibalie enkarna ino, neomon, nesaisho tiatua ena aji,
toning'o ake iyie itii keper, nipalaki eng'oki oo ltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, nirrinyu ninche menyaaki aapuonu ina kop apa ninchoo ninche o loo menye.
“Teneikeno keper, nelai enchan te nkaraki nataasa ninche eng'oki tialo iyie, teneomon ninche eing'or ene wueji, neibalie enkarna ino, neibelekenya aaing'uaa ing'ok enye, itoosho iyie ninche,

toning'o naa iyie itii keper, nipaliki eng'oki oo sinkan linono, iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, niutaki ninche enkoitoi sidai naa ninye epuoyie; nirriwaki enchan ena kop ino, naa ninye inchoo iltung'ana linono metaa enjung'ore.

“Tenelotu olameyu enkop anaa olmeitai, anaa erruoyo indaiki naatii nkurman, anaa tenelotu olmaati, anaa enkurto; teneng'adu ilmang'ati lenye ninche te nabo ake ninye oo nkanas enye; o pooki meitai anaa pooki muoyian;
ore ake enkomono pooki o esayiata naomon oltung'ani obo anaa iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, eyiolo ake oltung'ani eoshoto enye o sina lenye, neitorioo inkaik aaing'orie ena aji;
toning'o naa iyie te keper, teina manyisho ino, nipaliki, ore ake pooki tau liyiolo iyie nilaaki te risioroto oo nkoitoi enyena (Amu iyie ake openy oyiolo iltauja loo nkera e tung'ana);
pee kitum ninche aatureita iyie, nepuo too nkoitoi inono, inkolong'i pooki naaishu teinakop apa ninchoo iloo menye.
“Naa tenelotu oltung'ani loo loreren, ilo leme oloo ltung'ana linono loo Siraeli eing'uaa enelakua te nkaraki enkarna ino kitok, o enkarna ino magilani, tenelotu ninye aomon eing'or ena aji,

toning'o iyie itii keper, ina manyisho ino, nias te risioroto e nena pooki nikimpotie ilo tung'ani loo loreren iyie; pee etum iloreren pooki le nkop aatayiolo enkarna ino, nikiureyu iyie, anaa enaasita iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, netum aatayiolo inchere ore ena aji natesheta nanu te nkarna ino naa enkarna ino eipotieki.
“Tenepuo iltung'ana linono olarrabal aagilunore ilmang'ati lenye, ore te pooki oitoi niimie iyie ninche; nikiomon ninche iyie eing'or ena anasa nitegelua, iyie o ena aji natesheta nanu te nkarna ino,
toning'o iyie itii keper enkomono enye o esayiata enye, nintagol ninche.
“Teneas ninche eng'oki te dukuya iyie, amu meetae oltung'ani lemeas ing'ok, nigorokino iyie ninche, ninchooyo ninche aisho lmang'ati lenye nenapi ninche aaya eyararoto enkop nalakua o enataana;
kake tenedamu ninche too ltauja teinakop apa nawaki ninche, neirridu, nikisai ninche iyie teinakop e yararoto enye, ejo, ‘Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, nikitaasa intorrok;’

teneirridu ninche too ndamunot enye pooki o too ltauja lenye pooki teinakop e yararoto enye, apa nawaki ninche, neomon eing'or ina kop enye apa ninchoo iyie iloo menye, o ina anasa nitegelua iyie, o ina aji natesheta nanu te nkaraki enkarna ino,
toning'o iyie itii keper ina manyisho ino, enkomono enye o esayiata enye. Intagolo ninche, nipalaki lelo tung'ana linono ootaasa eng'oki te iyie.
Ore naa taata Enkai ai nchoo eing'or inkonyek inono nening inkiyiaa inono enkomono ene wueji.

“Naa tudumunye taata, Olaitoriani Enkai, shomo ewueji ino enkiyeng'iyeng, iyie oilo sanduku lino le magilanisho. Inchoo ilapolosak linono Olaitoriani Enkai meishopokini enjeunoto ino. Inchoo isinyat linono eshipakino esupatisho ino.
Olaitoriani Enkai, mimbelekeny enkomom ino aitung'uaa ilo lino otubukokoki eilata aaput! Tadamu enyorrata ino nauno te nkaraki Daudi osinka lino.”
Ore ake pee eidip Solomon enkomono enye nedou enkima naing'uaa Keper nenya ilo asar opejori o nkishoorot neiput enkitoo o Laitoriani ina aji e Nkai.
Neitu eidim ilapolosak aatijing atua ina aji o Laitoriani.

Ore ake pee edol inkera pooki oo Siraeli ina kima edou, o enkitoo o Laitoriani te shumata ina aji e Nkai, neirrugo ninche aaitabaiki inkomomi enkop, te ndung'oroto, neserem neisho Olaitoriani enashe ejo, “Amu aisupat ninye, nebikoo enyorrata enye nauno intarasi.”
Neitoki olaiguanani o ltung'ana pooki aaishooyo ilasarri te dukuya o Laitoriani.
Eishorua olaiguanani Solomon olasar ilmong'i inkalifuni tikitam oaare, o nkerra inkalifuni iip o tikitam. Ore olaiguanani, o ltung'ana pooki neitisiny ina aji e Nkai.

Neitashe ilapolosak too wuejitin enye. Neitashe sii Ilawi aaiko neijia, eeta nena kinantani oo sinkolioitin, apa naaitobira olaiguanani Daudi pee eishorieki Olaitoriani enashe - amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno intarasi. Naa teneisis apa Daudi Olaitoriani te nkisiaayiare enye, ore te nda shoto neosh ilapolosak intarumpetani; neitashe Israel pooki.

Neitisiny Solomon empolos e ilo goriet apa otii dukuya enkaji o Laitoriani. Amu teine eitayio olasar opejori, o eilata o lasar le seriani. Amu ore apa ilo perere lo lasar lo suyai oitobira Solomon, nemeishaa olasar opejori o lasar le ntapa, o eilata.
Ore apa ina kata neibung Solomon osirua inkolong'i naapishana o Siraeli pooki tenebo, eumata kitok oleng nabaiki enejing'ieki Hamat ometabaiki oerata le Misiri.
Ore te nkolong e isiet neibung ninche eumata e nkitirring'a; amu eibung'a apa ninche enkitisinyata o lperere lo lasar inkolong'i naapishana, o sirua inkolong'i naapishana.

Ore te nkolong e tikitam oo kuni o lapa liopishana neisho iltung'ana meshomo inkang'itie enye, eng'ida neeta enchipai too ltauja lenye te nkaraki ina supatisho naitoduaa Olaitoriani, Daudi, o Solomon o ltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli.
Neidip Solomon ina aji o Laitoriani, o enkaji o laiguanani e nkitoo o nena pooki apa naaitobira Solomon pee eas te nkaji enye makewan, neitabaya pooki aitobiraki.
Neitoki Olaitoriani aitalioo kewan te Solomon kewarie nejoki ninye, “Atoning'o nanu enkomono ino, nategelua ene wueji te nkaraki kewan ai pee eaku enkaji o lasar.
Tenaiken nanu keper ometaa meetae enchan, anaa aitanap olmaati pee emut enkop, anaa airriu olmeitai atua iltung'ana laainei,

ore ake pee eitadou ate iltung'ana laainei, lelo laa enkarna ai eipotieki, neomon ninche neing'oru enkomom ai, neibelekenya aaing'uaa inkoitoi enye torrok, naa kaning nanu atii keper, napaliki eng'oki enye naishiunye enkop enye.
Ore taa ina kata, nebolo inkonyek aainei neinining inkiyiaa aainei enkomono naomoni tene wueji.
Amu ore taata ategelua nanu, naitisinya ena aji pee etum enkarna ai atobiko tene intarasi; ore inkonyek aainei o ltau lai neaku ine etii inkatitin pooki.
Naa ore tialo iyie, tenilo te dukuya nanu, anaa apa Daudi papaai lino, nias te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa nanu, nimbung inkikoot aainei, o nkiguanat aainei,
naitasheyie nanu olorika lino le nkitoo; anaa apa anatoning'ore Daudi papaai lino, ajoki, ‘Melai aekata te iyie oltung'ani oitoreisho te Israel.’
“Kake tenimbelekenya iyie, ninturraa inkikoot aainei o nkitanapat aainei natipika nanu dukuya iyie; nilo aisiaai kulie aitin, niserem ninche,
naadotu nanu teinakop apa naaishoo; ore ena aji naitisinya nanu te nkaraki enkarna ai, naiturraa aiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei, naitaa nanu endung'et e rashe, o rorei ooimakini tiatua iloreren.
Naa ore tiatua ena aji, naailepieki oleng, ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo neing'asia, nejo, ‘Kainyoo pee etaasa Olaitoriani ena tena kop o tena aji?’

Naa kepuo ninche aajo ‘Te nkaraki natanyaita ninche Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye, apa nayawua ninche aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, neigarakino ninche kulie aitin, neserem ninche, neisiaai ninche; ore te nkaraki ina eyaua Enkai ena torroni pooki shumata ninche.’ ”
Ore te siadi ilarin tikitam laa ninche eteshetie Solomon enkaji o Laitoriani o enkaji enye makewan
neitoki Solomon ashet nena anas apa naaishoo Huram ninye, nepik iltung'ana loo Siraeli ine.
Neitoki Solomon alo Hamatsoba, neisulie ninye.
Neshet ninye Tadamor ti ong'ata o nkanas pooki naashumishoreki apa naatesheta ninye te Hamat.
Neitoki sii ashet Bet-horon e shumata o Bet-horon e abori, inkanas naasheta isunta, o nchomito, naatii isekenke.

Neshet sii Baalat o nkanas naasheta too soito apa naara ine Solomon, o nkanas pooki oo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan, o nkanas oo lakedok lenyena loo mbartan, o pooki toki nayieu Solomon neshetu te Yerusalem, o te Lebanon, o teinakop pooki enkitoria enye.
Ore lelo tung'ana pooki ootelekutua too Lhiti o Lamori o Lperisi, o Lhifi, o Lyebusi, lelo leme iloo Siraeli,
ebaiki iishoritin enye, apa ootelekutua teinakop leitu eidaikie iltung'ana loo Siraeli - neitaa Solomon lelo ilenkisiaayiare nagol, naa neijia etiu o taata.
Kake ore tialo iltung'ana loo Siraeli, eitu eitaa Solomom irrindiki le siaai enye. Isikarini apa ninche, o ltung'ana le nkitoo, o lkituaak le njore loo ngarrin oo mbartan, o lakedok loo mbartan.
Naa kulo apa iltung'ana kituaak le Solomon, iip are o onom, laa ninche oata enkitoria tiatua olorere.

Neyau Solomon entito e Farao aitung'uaa enkanasa e Daudi neriku ina aji apa nateshetaka ninye. Amu etejo ninye, “Meton enkitok ai te nkaji e Daudi olaiguanani loo Siraeli. Amu ore iwuejitin neeyauaki osanduku lo Laitoriani naa kesinya.”
Neitaiki Solomon Olaitoriani olasar opejori te nchumata ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani apa otesheta ninye te mbata e nkaji e Nkai.

Ore anaa enayieuni te nkisiaayiare e pooki olong'i, neitayuni ilasarri terisioroto enkitanapata e Musa too Sabatoni, o too lapaitin ng'ejuko okuni to lari o sirua loo mukateni neitu eisuishieki, o sirua loo wikii, o sirua loo lng'oborri.

Ore te risioroto e nkikoo e Daudi papaai lenye, etegelua ninye ilturrurri loo lapolosak te nkaraki enkisiaayiare enye, o Lawi te nkaraki isiaaitin enye e nkisisa o enkisiaayiare te dukuya ilapolosak metaasa esiaai te pooki olong nayieuni; o ilarripok loo nchomito loo lturrurri lenye too nchomito esiana naje; amu ina apa eitanapishe Daudi osinka le Nkai.
Neitu ninche eibelekenya apaash ina naitanapa olaiguanani ilapolosak o Lawi tialo pooki bae o too lchumat.
Neaku eidipe apa esiaai pooki e Solomon ebaiki ina olong apa napiki olkitamanyunoto le nkaji o Laitoriani o meidipayu ina aji o Laitoriani.
Neitoki Solomon alo Esiong'eber o Elot te mbata e naiposha, te nkop e Edom.

Neirriwaki Huram ninye too sinkan lenyena imelin o sinkan ootamoo enaiposha, nepuo ninche Ofir tenebo isinkan le Solomon. Neyau teine intalantani iip ong'uan o onom e saabu nayaki olaiguanani Solomon.

Ore ake pee ening'oo enkaiguanani e Sheba olning'o le Solomon, nelotu Yerusalem atem ninye too nkikilikuanat naagol. Nelotu ninye eeta ilaisiaayiak kumok o ntamesin naanapita isonkoyoni, o saabu sapuk oleng, o soito oogol enkinyang'a. Ore ake pee elotu enetii Solomon, neliki ninye nena pooki apa naatii oltau lenye.
Newal Solomon inkikilikuanat enyena pooki. Meetae entoki hoo nabo nagol to laiguanani Solomon neitu atawaliki ninye.
Ore ake pee edol ina aiguanani e sheba eng'eno e Solomon, o ina aji natesheta ninye;

o endaa natii emisa enye o ltonei loo lkituaak lenyena, o enkisiaayiare oo sinkan lenyena, o nkilani enye, o lanapak loo nkikompeni enye o nkilani enye, o lasarri lenyena oopejori ooitayio ninye te nkaji o Laitoriani, eitu eitoki ninye aidim atejo ae.
Nejoki ninye olaiguanani, “Ekesipa olkilikuai apa latoning'o nanu te nkop ai makewan tialo mbaa inono o eng'eno ino.
Kake eitu apa nanu anyorraa ilo kilikuai ometaba anaa nalotu adol too nkonyek aainei makewan, naa eitu apa nanu aalikini olpisiai le ng'eno ino. Ilus iyie teilo kilikuai apa latoning'o nanu.
Emunyak siaake inkituaak inono o sinkan linono ooitashe te dukuya iyie anaake nening eng'eno ino!

Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai ino amu kitishipakine ninye iyie nikipik iyie olorika lenye le nkitoo pee iaku olaiguanani te rishata o Laitoriani Enkai ino! Ore amu kenyor Olaitoriani Enkai ino Israel naa keitasheyie ninche intarasi, kintaa ninye iyie olaiguanani lenye, pee itum aiguanayu te sipata o te supatisho.”
Neitoki enkaiguanani e Sheba ninye aisho olaiguanani shekeli iip o tikitam e saabu o sonkoyoni kumok o soito oogol enkinyang'a.
Ore lelo sinkan le Huram o sinkan le Solomon apa ooyautua saabu naing'uaa Ofir neyau sii ilkeek ooji ilmusantali o soito oogol enkinyang'a.

Neitayunye Solomon lelo keek olkedet ojing'ieki enkaji o Laitoriani o enkaji o laiguanani, o lwululi loo usin o nkinantani oo usin, te nkaraki lelo aranyak. Eitu aikata edoli embae naaijo ena te nkop e Yuda.
Neisho Solomon enkaiguanani e Sheba nena pooki naayieu ninye, pooki toki ake ninye natoomonuo metii ntokitin naayaka ninye olaiguanani. Nerrinyo ninye alo enkop enye tenebo ilaisiaayiak lenyena.
Ore apa enkiroishi e saabu nayawuaki enetii olaiguanani Solomon naa intalantani iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile.
Ore nena naayautua ilainyang'ak o lamirak, eyautua sii ilaiguanak pooki le Arabia o lbalusuni leina kop saabu o enkosholai aayaki Solomon.
Neitobir olaiguanani ilong'oi iip are sapuki e saabu naaidong'oki, ore ake elong'o nabo naa shekeli iip ile e saabu naidong'oki.
Neitoki aitobir ilong'oi iip uni e saabu naaidong'oki; naa shekeli iip uni e saabu naidong'oki ake elong'o nabo. Nepik olaiguanani nena long'oi atua ina aji o Sero le Lebanon.
Neitobir sii olaiguanani olorika le nkitoo kitok loo lala loo ltomia, nemur te saabu nasila.

Neeta ilo orika le nkitoo ilkedeta ile o ewueji neiteleikini oo nkejek e saabu, neitatashakini ilo orika le nkitoo, ore ake enkalo nabo eilo orika le nkitoo netii ineeiteleikini Inkaik o lng'atunyo oaare ooitashe too mbat nena wuejitin neeiteleikini inkaik.
Neitashe ake ilng'atunyo tomon oaare teine, neitashe ake obo te nchoto e bayie e pooki kedet e lelo kedeta pokira ile, eitu aekata edoli entoki naaijo ina te pooki kitoria.
Ore intokitin pooki naaokishoreki o laiguanani Solomon naa ine saabu, ore imasaa pooki eina aji entim e Lebanon naa ine saabu nasila. Meikenari apa enkosholai aajo toki too nkolong'i e Solomon.

Amu kepuo apa imelin o laiguanani Tarshishi tenebo isinkan le Huram kata nabo te rishata oo larin okuni, ore nena melin e Tarshishi naa kepuonu apa enapita saabu o enkosholai o lala loo ltomia o yekenyi o motonyi sidain naaijo ilukunkuni.
Neisulu Solomon ilaiguanak pooki le nkop te karsisisho o te ng'eno.
Neing'oru ilaiguanak pooki le nkop enetii Solomon ejo pee ening eng'eno enye natipika Enkai atua endamunoto enye.
Neyau ake pooki lenye enkishooroto, intokitin e nkosholai o ne saabu o lkilani o emanoo o sonkoyoni, o mbartan o nyumpui te pooki ari.

Neeta apa Solomon ilaleta inkalifuni ong'uan loo mbartan, o ngarrin oo mbartan, o lakedok loo mbartan inkalifuni tomon o are, ootamanya nena anas oo ngarrin oo mbartan tenebo olaiguanani te Yerusalem.
Neitore ninye ilaiguanak pooki ebaiki olkeju le Frati, ometabaiki enkop oo Filistia o metabaiki olpolosie le Misiri.
Neitotiu olaiguanani saabu te Yerusalem anaa isoito, nebayu iltarakua te nkumoi anaa ilng'abolo le Shefela.
Neyakini Solomon imbartan naaing'uaa Misiri neing'uaa inkuapi pooki.

Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Solomon ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto neigeroki tiatua embuku oo nkaatini e Natan ilo oiboni le Nkai o tiatua e naibon e Ahija le Shilon, o too nduaat e Ido ilo aduaani, eipirta Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat.
Eitoreishe apa Solomon te Yerusalem neitore Israel pooki ilarin artam.
Neirrura Solomon etua anaa loo menye. Nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye. Neitoreisho Rehoboam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Eshomo apa Rehoboam Shekem, amu eshomo apa iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli Shekem aaitaa ninye olaiguanani.
Ore ake pee ening Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat ina, (amu Misiri apa etii ninye, ine apa neisikaka ailany olaiguanani Solomon) neitoki Yeroboam arrinyunye te Misiri.
Neirriwaa ninche olkilikuai meipotuni ninye. Ore Yeroboam o Siraeli pooki nepuonu aajoki Rehoboam,
“Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto. Ore naa taata nteneneng'a ina kisiaayiare nagol natii shumata iyiook, naa eikisiaai iyiook iyie.”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enyaaki wootu enatii nanu te rishata oo nkolong'i uni.” Nerrinyo iltung'ana aapuo.
Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam aikilikuanishore ilpayiani, laa ninche apa ooitashe te dukuya olaiguanani Solomon papaai lenye, apa eton eishu, ejoki, “Kaa intae kiutakiki matiaaki kulo tung'ana?”
Nejoki ninche ninye, “Tiniaku iyie supat tialo kulo tung'ana, nintiship ninche, niro irorei supati tialo ninche, naa keaku ninche isinkan linono ntarasi.”
Kake etanya ninye ina kikoo oo lpayiani, neing'oru enkikoo oo lbarnot le risiori enye oitashe te dukuya ninye.
Nejoki ninche, “Kaa intae iututu pee kiwaliki kulo tung'ana laatiaakita ninche nanu, ‘Nteneneng'a enchata ang oo murto apa natipika papaai lino shumata iyiook?’ ”

Nejoki lelo barnot le risiori enye ninye, “Nji iyie shomo tiaaki lelo tung'ana likitiaakiata iyie, ‘Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto, kake inteneneng'aki iyie iyiook;’ nji shomo tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore enkilinta ai naa ninye esapuk alang empolos e Papaai lai.

Naa Ore naa taata, teneiteleikia apa papaai intae enchata oo murto nairoishi, naa kaponaa nanu enkiroishi eina shata inyi oo murto. Eitamio intae papaai too nkibokoni, kake kaitame nanu intae too nkolupani.’ ”
Neitoki Yeroboam o ltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli aapuonu enetii Rehoboam te nkolong e uni, anaa enatejo olaiguanani, “Enyaaki wootu enatii nanu te nkolong e uni.”
Newaliki olaiguanani ninche tenkisikong'ata, neany ina kikoo oo lpayiani.

Neirorie olaiguanani ninche te risioroto enkikoo oo lbarnot, nejoki, “Eiroshiyie apa papaai enchata inyi oo murto, kake kaponaa nanu enkiroishi. Eitamio apa intae papaai too nkibokoni, kake kaitame nanu intae too nkolupani.”
Neaku eitu ening olaiguanani iltung'ana amu embae ena nayawua Enkai, pee etum Olaitoriani aitabai ororei lenye, apa oiroro aimunye Ahija le Shilon metoliki Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat.

Ore ake pee edol Isiraeli pooki aajo eitu ening olaiguanani ninche, newaliki iltung'ana olaiguanani aajoki, “Kaa rubata iyiook kiata te Daudi? Mikiata iyiook enjung'ore to layioni le Yese. Shomo pooki ng'ae olng'obor lino, intae Israel! Ing'ura taata enkaji ino makewan Daudi.” Nedumunye Isiraeli pooki aapuo ilng'oborri lenye.
Kake eitoria apa Rehoboam iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli ootii nkanas e Yuda.

Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam airriwaa Hadoram laa ninye apa olaitasheikinoni le siaai nagol, nenang iltung'ana loo Siraeli ninye too soito metua. Neisarrisar olaiguanani Rehoboam alo airot ngarrin enyena oo mbartan, pee eisikaki Yerusalem.
Neaku etekepari Isiraeli te nkaji e Daudi ometabaiki ena olong.
Ore ake pee elotu Rehoboam Yerusalem, neiturrur enkaji e Yuda o ene Benchamen, iltung'ana inkalifuni iip o ntomoni isiet gelunot, pee earare Israel, pee errinyoki Rehoboam enkitoria.
Kake eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Shemaia ilo tung'ani le Nkai, ejo,
“Tiaaki Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon, olaiguanani le Yuda, o Siraeli pooki ootii Yuda, o Benchamen,

‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani, Mipuopuo intae aarare ilalashera linyi. Torrinyoyu pooki tung'ani shomo enkang enye, amu ore ena bae naa nanu eing'uaa.’ ” Neaku etoning'o ninche ororei lo Laitoriani, nerrinyo neitu epuo aarare Yeroboam.
Etobiko apa Rehoboam te Yerusalem neshet inkanas naamitunye kewan tiatua Yuda,
etesheta Betlehem o Etam o Tekoa,
o Betsur o Soko o Adulam,
o Gat o Maresha o Sif,
o Adoraim, o Lakish, o Ashetak,
o Sora o Ahijalon o Hebron, inkanas naasheta isunta naatii Yuda o Benchamen.
Neitagol ninye isempewueti, nepik ilarikok le njore atua ninche, nepik ineeshumieki endaa o eilata o enaisho oo sabibu.
Nepik sii iremeta o long'oi atua nena anas pooki, neitagol ninche oleng. Neaku eeta apa ninye Yuda o Benchamen.
Ore ilapolosak o Lawi apa ootii atua Israel pooki, neing'uaa ninye too wuejitin pooki apa neetii ninche.
Amu etung'uaitie Ilawi iwuejitin enye, o ntokitin enye nepuonu Yuda o Yerusalem te nkaraki nataarayie Yeroboam ninche o layiok lenyena aitung'uaa enkisiaayiare anaa lapolosak lo Laitoriani,
negelu ilapolosak lenyena loo wuejitin neeika, o too wuejitin neeseremieki inkitanyaanyukot, o Nkaitin oo lasho naaitobira ninye.
Ore lelo ootipika iltauja lenye pee eing'oru Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel nepuonu aasuju ninche eing'uaa iloshon pooki loo Siraeli o meetu Yerusalem, aapolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye.
Neitagol ninche enkitoria e Yuda, ore too larin okuni neitaserian ninche Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon, amu eshomo ninche too larin okuni aaibung orrekie le Daudi o Solomon.
Ewa apa Rehoboam aitaa enkitok enye Mahalat entito e Yerimot olayioni le Daudi neji ng'otonye Abihail entito e Eliab olayioni le Yese.
Neiki ninye ilayiok, Yeush, o Shemaria, o Saham.
Ore te siadi ina neitoki aya Maaka entito e Absalom, naa ninye natoikio ninye Abija o Atai, o Sisa, o Shelomit.

Kenyor apa Rehoboam Maaka ina tito e Absalom aitalang nena kituaak enyena pooki, o nkapiak. (Eyama apa ninye inkituaak tomon o isiet o nkapiak ntomoni ile neeta ilayiok tikitam o isiet, o ntoyie ntomoni ile.)
Negelu Rehoboam Abija ilo ayioni le Maaka metaa ninye olkitok tiatua ilalashera lenyena, amu kejo apa pee eitaa ninye olaiguanani.
Neas ninye ine ng'eno, neidapashaki kulikae ayiok lenyena aibulunye enkop e Yuda o Benchamen, eeta ndaiki kumok, neing'uraki ninche inkituaak.
Ore ake pee eitashe enkitoria e Rehoboam negolu, neiturraa ninye o Siraeli pooki enkitanapata o Laitoriani.
Ore to lari le miet nkitoria o laiguanani Rehoboam, te nkaraki nataa ninche ilemeisiligayu to Laitoriani, nelotu Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri arasaki Yerusalem.

Neeta ngarrin oo mbartan enkalifu nabo o iip are, o lakedok loo mbartan nkalifuni ntomoni ile. Nemeikenayu esiana e lelo tung'ana ooetuo tenebo ninye ooing'uaa Misiri, ile Libia o le Sukiim o le Etiopia.
Neya ninye nena anas naasheta sunta e Yuda o meeu abaiki Yerusalem.

Neitoki Shemaia oloiboni le Nkai alotu enetii Rehoboam o lkituaak le Yuda, apa ooiturrurro te Yerusalem te nkaraki Shishak, nejoki ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kitung'uaitie intae nanu, atung'uayie naa sii nanu intae napik intae enkaina e Shishak.’ ”
Ore lelo kituaak loo Siraeli o laiguanani neitobor ate nejo, “Olaitoriani olasipani.”

Ore ake pee edol Olaitoriani ajo eitoborro ate, neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Shemaia ejo, “Eitoborro ninche ate nemaidaikie nanu ninche, kake kaisho nanu ninche enkiti oitoi napokie, nemebukokini engoro ai shumata Yerusalem te Nkaina e Shishak.
Ore ake eyia keaku ninche isinkan lenyena. Pee etum ninche aatayiolo enkisiaayiare ai o enkisiaayiare oo nkitoriat oo nkuapi.”

Neaku eewuo Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri arasaki Yerusalem; neya ninye ilchumat le nkaji o laitoriani o lchumat le nkaji o laiguanani. Ewa ninye pooki toki. Ewa sii nena long'oi e saabu apa naaitobira Solomon.
Neitobir olaiguanani Rehoboam te rishata e nena long'oi ilong'oi o suyai, nepik ninche Nkaik e lelo kituaak le rripore, laa ninche ooing'or kishomi e nkaji o laiguanani.
Naa ore ake tenelotu olaiguanani alo enkaji o Laitoriani nepuonu ilarripok aanap ninche, neyau atua ina aji e rripore.
Ore ake pee eitobir ninye kewan neibelekenya engoro o Laitoriani apaash ninye, pee meidaikieki ninye tukul. Ore ake etiu neijia neme torrok apa mbaa te Yuda.

Neaku eitagolo apa olaiguanani Rehoboam kewan te Yerusalem. Oloo larin artam o obo apa Rehoboam pee eiteru aitoreisho. Eitoreishe ninye ilarin tomon o isiet te Yerusalem, teina anasa apa nategelua Olaitoriani tiatua iloshon pooki loo Siraeli pee epik enkarna enye ine. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Naama, e Amoni.
Neas ninye entorroni amu eitu ninye eing'oru Olaitoriani to ltau lenye.

Ore apa nkiaasin e Rehoboam ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto, neigeroki too mbukui oo nkaatini e Shemaia oloiboni le Nkai o ne Ido oladuaani. Ilarrabali apa lemeish kulo te rishata e Rehoboam o Yeroboam.
Neirura Rehoboam etua anaa loo menye, nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Abija olayioni lenye te rishata enye.
Ore to lari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria o laiguanani Yeroboam, neiteru Abija aitoreisho te Yuda.
Eitoreishe ninye ilarin okuni te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Mikaia, entito e Uriel le Gibea. Netii apa olarrabal erishata e Abija o Yeroboam.

Neipang Abija alo olarrabal eeta enjore oo ltung'ana yiolot to larrabal, iltung'ana inkalifuni iip ong'uan oogeluno. Neitoloku Yeroboam iltung'ana lenyena to larrabal aitoluaaki ninye, naa iltung'ana inkalifuni iip isiet magil, gelunot.
Neitashe Abija te nchumata oldoinyo le Semaraim otii ina kop oo ndoinyio e Efraim, nejo, “Entoning'oki nanu, iyie Yeroboam o Israel pooki!
Aimeishiaakino tiniyiolou nchere, eishoo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, enkitoria oo Siraeli pooki Daudi ntarasi to lmumai le munyan?
Ore Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat ilo sinka le Solomon olayioni le Daudi, nedumunye agilunore olkitok lenye.
Ore ilkulikae tung'ana le pesho, nerrumoki ninche Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon, ilo leton aa oti nemeeta enkarriyiano, metaasa enkarruoisho. Nemeidimaa apa Rehoboam ninche.

“Amaa taata, ijo iyie indim aitasheikinore enkitoria o Laitoriani too Nkaik oo layiok le Daudi, eji te nkaraki nira iyie olorora, kitok, niata nkitanyaanyukot e Nkai oo lasho le saabu, apa naaitobira Yeroboam aitaa nkaitin?

Keitu iyie iaraa aipang'ie ilapolosak lo Laitoriani, ilayiok le Aaron, o Lawi, nintobiraki kewan ilapolosak anaa iltung'ana le kulie kuapi? Ore pooki ng'ae olotu aitisiny kewan to loti oing'oni anaa too lmeregeshi oopishana neaku olapolosani le nena neme Nkaitin.
Kake ore tialo iyiook, Olaitoriani ninye Enkai ang, neitu iyiook kipuo aaing'ua ninye. Kiata iyiook ilapolosak ooisiaaita Olaitoriani laa ilayiok le Aaron, o Lawi te nkaraki enkisiaayiare enye.

Kepolosaki ninche Olaitoriani anaake tedekenya o teipa ilasarri oopejori, o enkorropil o sonkoyoni naarropil, neirragie emukate nasinya te misa e saabu nasila, neing'or nena kitasheta oo ltaai e saabu pee etum iltaai lenyena aayupuyupo anaake teipa. Amu eikimbung iyiook enkitanapata Olaitoriani Enkai ang, kake itanyaita intae ninye.

Etii Enkai tenebo iyiook, ninye orikito iyiook, tenebo ilapolosak eeta sekekuani enye o larrabal pee eosh tenikinteru olarrabal o intae. Nakera, e Israel emiarare intae Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo minyi, amu mimirishosho.”
Neirriu apa Yeroboam iltung'ana olnukata aitaman ninche te siadi. Netii ilturrurri lenyena dukuya iltung'ana le Yuda. Netii lelo tung'ana oonuka siadi ninche.
Ore pee eing'orisho Yuda, ng'ura etii olarrabal dukuya o siadi, neishiraki ninche Olaitoriani nekut ilapolosak sekekuani.
Neitayu iltung'ana le Yuda embuakunoto o larrabal. Ore ake pee ebuaku iltung'ana le Yuda nemir Enkai Yeroboam o Siraeli pooki ootii dukuya Abija o Yuda.
Neilanyisho iltung'ana loo Siraeli te dukuya iltung'ana le Yuda neishoru Enkai ninche apik atua Nkaik e Yuda.
Nesesekuan Abija o ltung'ana lenyena iltung'ana kumok oleng; neaku etuata too Siraeli iltung'ana gelunot nkalifuni iip imiet.
Neidimuni apa iltung'ana loo Siraeli ina kata, neisulu iltung'ana le Yuda, te nkaraki naigarakinote ninche Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.
Nesujaa Abija Yeroboam, neoru ninye inkanas, Betel o nkang'itie enyena kutiti o Yeshana tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti o Efron tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.
Neitu aekata eitoki Yeroboam arrinyu engolon enye too nkolong'i e Abija. Neosh Olaitoriani ninye neye ninye.
Kake etaa Abija magilani, neyam ninye inkituaak tomon oong'uan, netum ilayiok tikitam oaare, o ntoyie tomon o ile.
Ore nkulie kiaasin pooki e Abija, inkoitoi enyena o nkirorot enyena, neigeroki too nkaatini o loiboni le Nkai oji Ido.
Neirura apa Abija, etua anaa loo menye nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi; neitoreisho Asa olayioni lenye te rishata enye. Ore too nkolong'i enyena netum enkop enkiyeng'iyeng ilarin tomon.
Neas Asa imbaa supati naa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai enye.
Eiwuang'ie apa ilpereren loo lasarri loo loreren, o wuejitin neeika, neuroo ing'apeta nedung'oo Asherim aauroo.
Neitanap Yuda pee eing'oru Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, neibung nkitanapat enyena.
Eiwuang'ie sii too nkanas pooki e Yuda iwuejitin neeika, ilpereren oopejieki enkorropil. Netum enkitoria enkiyeng'iyeng too nkolong'i enyena.
Etesheta ninye inkanas naata isunta te Yuda, amu enoto enkop enkiyeng'iyeng. Eitu ninye etum olarrabal te nena olong'i amu eishoo Olaitoriani ninye eseriani.

Nejoki ninye Yuda, “Mateshet iyiook kuna anas, nikintaman isunta o ltaleta, nikipik nchomito oo sekenke; eton aa enaang ena kop, amu king'orutua iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang; king'orutua iyiook ninye, neishoo ninye iyiook eseriani too nkaloli pooki.” Neaku eteshetishote ninche nedupoyu.

Neeta apa Asa enjore oo ltung'ana inkalifuni iip uni le Yuda, ooata ilong'oi o remeta. O ltung'ana nkalifuni iip are o ntomoni isiet oo ltung'ana le Benchamen, ooata ilong'oi o nkai; ore kulo pooki naa iltung'ana magil yiolot.
Nelotu Serak le Etiopia agilunore ninche eeta enjore oo ltung'ana emilion nabo, o ngarrin oo mbartan iip uni, nepuonu o metabau Maresha.
Nelo Asa anang'are ninye, neitolok ilkererin lenye aaluakino olarrabal to erata le Sefata te Maresha.

Neishiraki Asa Olaitoriani Enkai enye ejo, “Olaitoriani, meetae likae likinyaanyukie te retoto, te rishata o lmagilani o loshal. Taretu iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang, amu kingarakino iyiook iyie, naa te nkarna ino kietuo iyiook aagilunore ele orora. Olaitoriani, ira iyie Enkai ang; mincho eisulu likae tung'ani te iyie.”
Neaku etimira Olaitoriani ile Etiopia te dukuya Asa o te dukuya Yuda, neilanyisho ile Etiopia.

Ore Asa o lelo tung'ana apa ootii tenebo ninche, nesujaa ninche o meitabaiki Gerar. Nebatata ile Etiopia o metaa meetae obo otelekua eishu; amu etigilaki ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani o enjore enye. Nenap iltung'ana le Yuda intokitin kumok oleng naataarutua.
Neitoki sii aagil nkanas naamanita Gerar, amu etijing'a euriata o Laitoriani shumata ninche, neya ninche imasaa kumok te nena anas.
Near ilng'oborri le lelo apa oata nchoo, neya nkerrai te nkumoi, o ntemesin. Neitoki taa aarrinyo aapuo Yerusalem.
Eewuo apa Enkiyang'et e Nkai shumata Asaria olayioni le Oded,

neipang ninye alo anang'are Asa. Nejoki ninye, “Toning'oki nanu Asa, o Yuda pooki o Benchamen: Etii Olaitoriani tenebo iyie, eton sii iyie itii tenebo ninye. Tening'oru iyie ninye nitum, kake tening'ua iyie ninye niking'uaa sii ninye iyie.
Ore te nkata naado nemeeta Israel Enkai nasipa. Nemeeta olapolosani oiteng'enisho, nemeeta enkitanapata.
Kake teneibelekenyakino ninche to sina lenye Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, neing'oru ninye nenoto ninche ninye.
Ore apa te nena katitin nemeetae eseriani teilo oipang o teilo ojing'u amu etijing'aka enyamali sapuk lelo oomanya nkuapi.
Eitaaki ninche ng'iligilat. Negilunore olosho olosho, negilunore enkanasa enkanasa, amu eitanyamala Enkai ninche te pooki pukunoto o sina.
Kake ntagoluoyu iyie! Mincho elepori inkaik inono, amu eikilaakini esiaai ino.”

Ore ake pee ening Asa kulo rorei, ina aibon e Asaria olayioni le Aded, neitagoluo, neiwuang'ie nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naa ninche olminong teinakop e Yuda o ene Benchamen, o te nena anas naawa ninye teinakop oo ndoinyo e Efraim. Neitoki ninye aitobir olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani apa otii dukuya olgoriet le nkaji o Laitoriani.

Neiturrur ninye Yuda pooki o Benchamen, o lelo ooing'uaa Efraim o Manase o Simion apa oobikito tenebo ninche, amu iltung'ana kumok ooisikakita ninye eing'uaa Israel, ina kata pee edol aajo etii Olaitoriani Enkai enye tenebo ninye.
Eiturrurrote apa ninche te Yerusalem to lapa liokuni lo lari le tomon o miet le nkitoria e Asa.
Nepolosaki ninche Olaitoriani olasar teina olong, te nena masaa apa naataarutua ninche ilmong'i iip naapishana o nkerra inkalifuni naapishana.
Neibung ninche olning'o lo sotua pee eing'oru Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, too ltauja lenye pooki o te nkishui enye pooki;
naa ore pooki ng'ae lemeing'oru Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, neari metua, aa oti o aa moruo, aa olee anaa enkitok.
Einosie ninche Olaitoriani olmumai to ltoilo sapuk, o te mbuakunoto o too sekekuani, o te oshoto oo mowuarak.

Neshipa Yuda pooki te nkaraki ilo mumai; amu einosa ninche too ltauja lenye pooki, neing'orutua ninche ninye te yieunoto enye pooki, nenoto ninche ninye, neishoo Olaitoriani ninche enkiyeng'iyeng too nkaloli pooki.

Ore Maaka, ng'otonye Asa, eiwuang'ie olaiguanani Asa pee meitoki aata enkitoo enye te nkaraki nataasa embae olminong, aitobir enkitanyaanyukoto e Ashera. Nedung Asa ina kitanyaanyukoto auroo, neidong aitaa irrarrat, nelo apejoo to erata le Kidron.
Kake eitu apa eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika e Israel. Ore ake etiu neijia nemeeta apa oltau le Asa eleyiata too nkolong'i e nkishui enye pooki.
Neyau ninye atua enkaji e Nkai nena tokitin apa naaitisinya menye o nkishoorot naaitisinya ninye makewan, enkosholai o saabu o masaa,
neitu aikata eitokini aata olarrabal o metabau olari le tomoni uni o imiet le nkitoria e Asa.
Ore to lari le tomoni uni o ile le nkitoria e Asa, nelo Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli agilunore Yuda, neshet Rama, ejo pee meipang hoo oltung'ani obo anaa ejing'u alo enetii Asa olaiguanani le Yuda.
Nedumu Asa enkosholai o saabu te lelo shumat le nkaji o Laitoriani, o te nkaji o laiguanani, neirriwaki Benhadad olaiguanani le Siria, apa omanya Damaskas, nejoki,

“Nchoo metijing'a olning'o erishata ai o iyie, anaa enatiu te papaai lai o te papaai lino. Ng'ura kaairriwaki nanu iyie enkosholai o saabu; shomo tigila olning'o lino o Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli; pee aalo aing'uaa nanu.”
Nening Benhadad olaiguanani Asa, neirriwaa ninye ilarikok le njore enye meshomo aagilunore nkanas oo Siraeli, neibung ninche aaisulie Iyon, o Dan, o Abelnaim o nkanas pooki naashumishoreki e Naftali.
Ore ake pee ening Baasha ina neitu eitoki ashet Rama, neitasheyie esiaai enye.
Neitoki olaiguanani Asa aya Yuda pooki, nenap ninche lelo soito le Rama o mbaoi enyena, apa naa ninche eshetishore olaiguanani Baasha, nelo ashetie ninche Geba o Mispa.

Ore apa teina kata nelotu Hanani oladuaani enetii Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, nejoki ninye, “Ore te nkaraki naa olaiguanani le Siria ingarakine, neitu ingarakino Olaitoriani Enkai ino, kitapaashare iyie enjore o laiguanani le Siria.
Amaa enjore e Etiopia o ene Libia, aime enjore kitok naata ngarrin oo mbartan kumok oleng? Eji ore te nkaraki ningarakine Olaitoriani neishoru ninche apik nkaik inono.

Amu ekuet nkonyek o Laitoriani idie o ene tiatua enkop pooki, pee eitodolu enkidimata enye te rishata e lelo lemeeta ileyiat too ltauja lenye tialo ninye. Itaasa iyie ena te modai, amu ore ebaiki ena kata neito idia alo, itum ilarrabali.”
Negorokino Asa ilo aduaani, neikenoo ninye te jila neen to lpisia, amu eibayie ninye te nkaraki ina. Neitoki Asa aitaas mbaa e nkarruoisho kulikae ina kata.
Ore inkiaasin e Asa ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto neigeroki te mbuku oo laiguanak le Yuda o Israel.

Ore to lari le tomoni uni ooudo le nkitoria enye, netum Asa emuoyian too nkejek nerruoyo ina muoyian enye oleng; ore ake teina muoyian enye neitu ninye eing'oru Olaitoriani. Kake eing'orua eretoto too labaak.
Neirrag Asa etua anaa loo menye, neye ninye to lari liartam oobo le nkitoria enye.

Nenukaa ninche ninye te nkurare apa nataguetua ninye, aguetaki kewan te nkanasa e Daudi. Neirragie ninche ninye too sisineta naaiputa ninye ina gumoto nabore mpukunot pooki oo sonkoyoni naaitobiraki te nkarriyiano o laitobirani loo sonkoyoni; neitobir ninche enkima kitok te nkanyit enye.
Neitoki Yehoshafat olayioni le Asa aitoreisho te rishata e papaai lenye, neitagol kewan agilunore Isiraeli.
Nepik ninye iltimito nena anas pooki naasheta isunta e Yuda, nepik iltimito enkop e Yuda, o nkanas e Efraim apa naatarayie Asa papaai lenye.
Etii apa Olaitoriani tenebo Yehoshafat, te nkaraki nashomo ninye aibung olapa rrekie le menye; eitu ninye eserem Baal.
Kake eing'orua Enkai e papaai lenye, nelo too nkitanapat enyena, neitu eibung irrekiei loo Siraeli.
Ore te nkaraki ina neitasheyie Olaitoriani enkitoria te nkaina enye, ore iltung'ana pooki le Yuda neyaki Yehoshafat inkishoorot, netum ninye enkarsisisho sapuk o enkanyit.
Keuno apa oltau lenye tialo nkoitoi o Laitoriani; neiwuang'ie sii iwuejitin neeika e Asherim te Yuda.
Ore to lari liokuni le nkitoria enye neiriwaa ninye iltung'ana lenyena kituaak, Benhail, o Obadia, o Sekaria, o Netanel, o Mikaia, pee epuo aaiteng'enisho too nkanas e Yuda.
Ore tenebo ninche netii Ilawi, Shemaia o Netania o Sebadia o Asahel o Shemiramot o Yehonatan o Adonija o Tobija o Tobadonija. Ore tenebo kulo Lawi netii ilapolosak, Elishama o Yehoram.
Neiteng'enisho ninche te Yuda, eeta embuku oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani tenebo ninche. Nepuo ninche aamanaa too nkanas pooki e Yuda aiteng'enisho tiatua olorere.
Etipika apa Olaitoriani enkuretisho nena kitoriat pooki oo nkuapi naamanita Yuda, neitu ninche eitayunye Yehoshefat olarrabal.
Ore ilkulikae Filisti neyaki Yehoshefat nkishoorot. Neyaki nkishoorot e nkosholai, neyau Ilmarabu ilmeregeshi enkalifu nabo o iip naapishana o loroi enkalifu nabo o iip naapishana.
Neponari Yehoshefat agolu te nkitoria. Neshet ninye te Yuda isempewueti o nkanas naashumishoreki.
Neeta apa ninye ineeshumishoreki sapuki too nkanas e Yuda. Neeta isikarini magil yiolot, te Yerusalem.

Eiturrurroki apa kulo te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye. Ore te Yuda netii ilarikok le njore loo nkalifuni; netii olarikoni le njore e iip oji Adna, tenebo iltung'ana inkalifuni iip uni magil yiolot.
Ore oliare naa Yehohanan ilo arikoni le njore, tenebo iltung'ana inkalifuni iip are o ntomoni isiet,
ore olosujaki naa Amasia olayioni le Sikri, ilo oishorua kewan te nkisiaayiare o Laitoriani, tenebo iltung'ana inkalifuni iip are magil yiolot.
Ore too le Benchamen naa: Eliada, ilo tung'ani magilani yioloti, tenebo iltung'ana inkalifuni iip are oata mbaa o long'oi.
Ore olosujaki naa Yehosabad tenebo iltung'ana inkalifuni iip o ntomoni isiet ootanapate pee epuo olarrabal.
Kulo apa ootii enkisiaayiare o laiguanani, metii lelo apa ootipika olaiguanani nkanas naasheta sunta te Yuda pooki.
Keeta apa Yehoshafat enkarsisisho sapuk o enkanyit, neitobir olning'o te nkaraki enkiyama o ltung'ana le Ahab,

ore te siadi ilkuti arin nedoyio alo enetii Ahab te Samaria. Neyiang'aki Ahab Yehoshafat nkerra kumok o lmong'i tenebo lelo tung'ana apa ootii tenebo ninye, neilejilej ninye pee epuo aagilunore Ramot-Gilead.

Nejoki Ahab, ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, “Eilo iyie tenebo nanu Ramot-gilead?” Newal Yehoshafat ajo, “Atiu nanu anaa enitiu iyie, netiu iltung'ana laainei anaa iltung'ana linono. Aikiaku iyiook tenebo o iyie to larrabal.”
Neitoki Yehoshafat ajoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli, “Tang'asa nkilikuanishore ororei lo Laitoriani.”

Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli aiturrurr iloibonok le Nkai tenebo, iltung'ana iip ong'uan, nejoki ninche, “Aikipuo iyiook olarrabal aagilunore Ramot-Gilead, anaa aimikipuo?” Nejoki ninche, enchom, amu keishoru Enkai apik nkaik o laiguanani.
Kake etejo ninye Yehoshafat, “Aimeetae likae oiboni lo Laitoriani likinkilikuanishore?”

Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli Yehosafat, “Eton etii oltung'ani obo likindim iyiook aaikilikuanishore tialo Olaitoriani, Mikaia olayioni le Imala; kake manyor nanu ninye, amu meibonu aikata isupati tialo nanu, ntorrok ake eibonu.” Nejo Yehoshafat, mincho olaiguanani ejo neijia.
Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli aipotu olkitok obo, nejoki, “Iyau nabo kata Mikaia olayioni le Imala.”

Ore ina kata netonita olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat, olaiguanani le Yuda too lorikan le nkitoo, neishopo ilkilani lenye, netonita ninche te wueji neituutishoreki, te mpolos e kishomi e Samaria; neibonisho iloibonok pooki te dukuya ninche.
Ore Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana neitobiraki kewan imowuarak e sekenkei, nejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Te kuna ilo iyie arrumoo ile Siria o metaba anaa neidaaya ninche.’ ”
Ore iloibonok pooki neibonu ina, nejo, “Ilepa shomo Ramot-gilead pee ilo amirisho amu aikincho iyie Olaitoriani apik enkaina o laiguanani.”

Ore lelo kulikae apa ooshomo aaipotu Mikaia nejoki ninye, “Ore irorei loo loibonok le Nkai pooki neimaki embae nabo supat tialo olaiguanani; nchoo ororei lino etiu anaa ororei le obo lenye, niro te supatisho.”
Kake etejo Mikaia, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, ore ina najo Enkai ai ina nanu airo.”
Ore ake pee ebau enetii olaiguanani, nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Mikaia, eikipuo iyiook Ramot-gilead, olarrabal anaa aikipal?” Newalu ninye nejo, “Ilepa shomo timirisho, kepiki ninche enkaina ino.”
Kake etiaaka olaiguanani ninye, “Ai katitin aja aasai nanu pee iro esipata ake te nkarna o Laitoriani?”

Neitoki ninye ajo, “Atoduaa nanu Isiraeli pooki eidapashakinote ildoinyio anaa nkerra nemeeta olchekut; netejo Olaitoriani, ‘Meeta kulo olaitasheikinoni; nchoo pooki ng'ae errinyo alo enkang enye te seriani.’ ”
Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajoki Yehoshafat, “Keitu nanu aajoki iyie nchere meibonu ninye esidai tialo nanu, kake entorroni ake eibonu?”
Nejo Mikaia, “Toning'o naa ororei lo Laitoriani: Atoduaa nanu Olaitoriani etonita to lorika lenye le nkitoo, ore olorora pooki le shumata, neitashe te nkaina enye e tatene, o te ne kedianye.
Nejo Olaitoriani, ‘Aing'ae olo alej Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli, pee etum ninye ashomo atabatatayu te Ramot-gilead?’ Nejo obo embae nabo, nejo olikae enkae.
Neitoki alotu enkiyang'et neitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, ‘Kalo nanu alej ninye.’ Nejoki Olaitoriani, ‘Tia oitoi?’
Nejo ninye, ‘Kalo nanu, naiko iloibonok pooki le Baal metelejisho.’ Nejo ninye ilo iyie alej ninye, naa ndimu ninye, shomo naa taasa ina.
Ore naa taata etipika Olaitoriani enkiyang'et e lejare nkutukie e kulo oibonok linono; eiroro entorroni tialo iyie.”
Neitoki Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana anyiku neosh Mikaia eseder, nejoki, “Kaji eimua Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani pee epuku te nanu nikilotu airorie iyie?”
Nejo Mikaia, “Ng'ura ajo ilo iyie adol teina olong, tinilo iyie olgilata liatua aisudori.”
Nejo ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Embung'a Mikaia, nirrinyirrinyi ninye aaya enetii Amon ilo balusui le nkanasa, o enetii Yoash ilo ayioni lo laiguanani.
Nilo ajo, ‘Nji ejo olaiguanani, Entipik ena tung'ani atua jila, ninchosho ninye meinosa imukateni naatoito neok enkare, o metaba anaa nashukunye te seriani.’ ”
Nejo Mikaia, “Tenitushukunye iyie te seriani, neitu nanu aairorie Olaitoriani”, neitoki ninye ajo, “Entoning intae lo orere pooki!”
Neaku eshomo Ahab, olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat, olaiguanani le Yuda Ramot-gilead.

Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Kaibelekeny nanu enkishopo ai nalo olarrabal, kake inchopo iyie ilkilani linono le nkitoo.” Neibelekeny olaiguanani loo Siraeli enkishopo enye nepuo ninche olarrabal.
Neitanapa apa olaiguanani le Siria ilkituaak loo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan, ajoki, “Emiarare ake oloti anaa olkitok, kake olaiguanani loo Siraeli ake entaarare.”

Ore ake pee edol lelo kituaak loo ngarrin oo mbartan Yehoshafat nejo ninche, “Olaiguanani loo Siraeli ilo.” Neibelekenya ninche aarare ninye; neyietu Yehoshafat abuaku, neretu Olaitoriani ninye. Neboinaa Enkai ninche aitung'uaa ninye.
Amu etoduaa ake lelo kituaak loo ngarrin oo mbartan aajo mme olaiguanani loo Siraeli ilo nerrinyo te sujata enye.

Kake eteyietuo oltung'ani obo enkawuo enye neng'oroo embae, neng'or olaiguanani loo Siraeli eripata enkila enye esekenkei, to lgoo; ore te nkaraki ina nejoki ninye olarewani lenye le ngarri e mbarta, “Mbelekenyayu ntung'uayioki nanu olarrabal, amu aatipikaki nanu olbae.”
Neirowuaju oleng olarrabal ina olong, neigarakino olaiguanani loo Siraeli eng'arri enye embarta aing'or ile Siria o metaa teipa. Ore ake pee edoyio enkolong neye.
Nerrinyunye te Seriani Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda alotu enkaji enye te Yerusalem.

Kake eshomo Yehu olayioni le Hanani, ilo aduaani anang'are ninye, nejoki ninye olaiguanani Yehoshafat, “Iretu iyie olarruoni ninyor lelo ooiba Olaitoriani? Ore te nkaraki ena, eewuo engoro naing'uaa Olaitoriani te nkaraki iyie.
Ore ake eyia, enotoki kulie baa sidain te iyie, amu indaikie Ashera aishie tena kop, ning'oru Enkai to ltau lino.”
Nebik Yehoshafat te Yerusalem; nelo ninye tiatua olorere, ebaiki Beer-sheba o metabaiki ina kop oo ndoinyio e Efraim, neyau ninche arrinyoki Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.
Negelu ninye ilarishak teinakop tiatua nkanas pooki naasheta isunta e Yuda. Te nkanasa ake o te nkanasa,
nejoki ninye lelo arishak, “Entadamu eniasiasa, amu mme te nkaraki oltung'ani nguanarere, kake te nkaraki Olaitoriani; etii ninye tenebo intae idung'udung'u enkiguana.
Ore naa taata nchoo euriata o Laitoriani eaku tenebo intae; entujurru eniasiasa; amu meetae enkibelekenyata e sipata to Laitoriani Enkai, anaa enyorrakinoto, anaa eng'amunoto oo ntokitin e ropare.”

Ore ake sii te Yerusalem negelu Yehoshafat kulikae Lawi o lapolosak, o lukuny oo lmareita loo Siraeli, pee edung enkiguana te nkaraki Olaitoriani nedung enkiguana tenetii enchankar. Yerusalem apa etii entonata enye.
Neitanap ninye ninche, ejo, “Nji intae enkuna te uriata o Laitoriani, o te nkisiligata, o too ltauja linyi pooki:

Tenelo nelotu enkiguana naing'uaa ilalashera linyi ootii kulie anas, eipirta enkibukoroto o sarge, o enkitanapata, anaa nkikoot, o nkiguanat, ninteng'en iyie ninche, pee meas ake entorroni te dukuya Olaitoriani, melotu ake engoro napi shumata intae o lalashera linyi. Ena intae entaas nimbayuyu intae entorroni.

Naa entayiolo nchere Amaria ilo apolosani kitok otii te shumata intae tialo mbaa pooki o Laitoriani; naa Sebadia olayioni le Ishmael ninye olgafanai le nkaji e Yuda, too mbaa pooki naaipirta olaiguanani; naa Ilawi likisiai iyie anaa iltung'ana kituaak. Taasisho te mpijan naa nchoo eaku Olaitoriani tenebo ilo oitoriori mbaa enyena.”
Ore te siadi ena nepuonu Ilmoabu, o le Amon o kulikae ooing'uaa Meani, nepuonu aarasaki Yehoshafat to larrabal.
Nepuonu kulikae tung'ana aajoki Yehoshafat, “Etii olorora kitok oing'uaa Edom likipuonu aarare, ooing'uaa lido kekun le naiposha, etii ninche Hasasotama” (aa taa Enkedi).
Neureishoyu Yehoshafat, neing'oru Olaitoriani makewan, neitanapisho meteena iltung'ana ate aapukoo te Yuda pooki.
Neiturrurro Yuda aaing'oru eretoto to Laitoriani; eing'uaa nkanas pooki e Yuda nepuonu aaing'oru Olaitoriani.
Neitashe Yehoshafat tiatua eumata e Yuda o Yerusalem, tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, te dukuya ilo goriet ng'ejuk,

nejo ninye, “Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papa, aime iyie Enkai te keper? Aimintore iyie nkitoriat pooki oo loshon? Enkaina ino etii engolon o enkidimata, ore te nkaraki ina meetae oltung'ani likindimaa iyie.
Keitu iyie, Na Ai ang, iaraa lelo apa oomanya ena kop te dukuya iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli; ninchooyie ntarasi aisho eishoi e Abraham ilo shore lino?
Netamanya ninche atua, nikiteshetakita ninche ewueji sinyati, te nkaraki enkarna ino, nejo,

‘Tenelotu entorroni shumata iyiook, olalem, o enkiguana, anaa olmeitai, anaa olameyu, nikintashe iyiook te dukuya ena aji, o te dukuya iyie, amu etii enkarna ino atua ena aji, nikinchiraki iyie tosina lang, nining iyie, nintajeu iyiook.’
“Ore naa taata ng'ura kulo tung'ana le Amon o le Moab o lo ldoinyo le Seir, leitu iyie incho iyie Isiraeli metarasaki ninche, apa eing'uaa enkop e Misiri, netapaasha apa ninche neitu eidaikie.
Toduaa elaakinoto naisho ninche iyiook, epuonu aaraa iyiook aaipang'ie te nkop ino apa ninchoo iyiook matujung.
Na Ai ang aimidung'oki iyie ninche enkiguana? Amu mikiata iyiook engolon tialo ele orora kitok olotu agilunore iyiook. Mikiyiolo iyiook aajo kaa kias, kake iyie eimariri nkonyek ang.”
Ore teina kata neitashe iltung'ana pooki le Yuda te dukuya Olaitoriani, tenebo nkera enye kutiti o nkituaak enye, o nkera enye.
Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata Yahasiel olayioni le Sekaria, olayioni le Yerel, olayioni le Matania, Olawi loo layiok le Asaf, te mpolos eina umata.

Nejo ninye, “Entoning, Yuda pooki o loomanya Yerusalem o laiguanani Yehoshafat: Nji ejoki intae Olaitoriani, ‘Emiureisho nimileporiri te nkaraki ele orora kitok, amu mme olinyi ele arrabal, kake ole Nkai.
Ore taisere tadoi shomo tigilunore ninche; ng'ura keilepu ninche aaimu enkoitoi e Siis; ilo iyie ainepu ninche te nkiting'oto o erata, te nkalo o loosaen tiong'ota e Yeruel.

Meeta tipat niarishore iyie tele arrabal; ntasho ake duoo, ntirring'ayu pee idol enkisulata o Laitoriani, te rishata ino. Iyie Yuda o Yerusalem.’ Miureishoyu nimilepori. Ore taaisere tadoi shomo tigilunore ninche, naa keaku Olaitoriani tenebo intae.”
Neirrugo Yehoshafat aitabaiki enkomom enye enkop, ore Yuda pooki, o lelo oo manya Yerusalem nebatata te dukuya Olaitoriani, neserem Olaitoriani.
Ore Ilawi le Kohat o Lkorati neitashe aaisis Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel to ltoilo sapuk oleng.

Nedumunye ninche tadekenya enasirie, nepuo ong'ata e Tekoa, ore epuoito ninche neitashe Yehoshafat nejo, “Entoning'oki nanu Yuda o intae iloomanya Yerusalem! Eruko Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, pee eitasheyieki intae, entoning iloibonok lenyena pee idupoyuyu.”

Ore ake pee eidip aiguana iltung'ana, negelu lelo oopuo aaranyaki Olaitoriani neisis ninye eishopito ilkilani sinyat, nepuo ninche te dukuya enjore, nejo “Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, amu ore enyorrata enye nauno nebikoo ntarasi.”
Ore ake pee eiteru aaranyisho neisis Olaitoriani, nerasaki Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Amon, o Moab o lo ldoinyio le Seir, laa ninche apa ooetuo aagilunore Yuda, neaku eishieki ninche.
Amu etudumakinote iltung'ana le Amon o le Moab iltung'ana lo ldoinyo le Seir, neidaikie ninche katukul, ore ake pee eishie iltung'ana le Seir, neitoki ninche aaidaakino maate.
Ore pee epuonu Yuda oltalet liong'ota, neing'or ilo orora naa ng'ura! Mpopoki ake naairragaa te nkop. Meetae oloilanyishe.

Ore pee elotu Yehoshafat o ltung'ana lenyena aaya iyarunot enye, netum ninche nkishu kumok, o masaa, o nkilani, o ntokitin naagol enkinyang'a, naawaita ninche o metaba anaa neaku menapayu. Nkolong'i uni eyaita ninche nena yarunot, eikumok apa oleng.
Ore te nkolong e ong'uan neiturrurro ninche to erata le Beraka, ore teine neisis Olaitoriani. Ore te nkaraki ina naa keji enkarna eine wueji oerata le Beraka o metabaiki ena olong.
Neitoki aarrinyo, pooki tung'ani le Yuda o Yerusalem, netii Yehoshafat dukuya ninche, errinyo aapuo Yerusalem te nchipai, amu eishoo ninche Olaitoriani enchipai tialo ilmang'ati lenye.
Nepuonu ninche Yerusalem eeta nkai oo sinkolioitin o lwululi loo usin o sekekuani, nepuo enkaji o Laitoriani.
Neiput enkuretisho e Nkai nena kitoriat pooki e nena kuapi ina kata pee ening nchere, etaarare Olaitoriani ilmang'ati loo Siraeli.
Neaku eitirring'e Yehoshafat te seriani, amu eishoo ninye Enkai enkiyeng'iyeng too nkaloli pooki.

Metaa neijia apa eikuna Yehoshafat te neitore Yuda. Oloo larin tomoni uni o miet apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ilarin tikitam o imiet te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Asuba, entito e Shilhi.
Neibung apa ninye orrekie le Asa papaai lenye, neitu eibelekenya apaash. Etaasa ninye isidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani.
Ore apa iwuejitin neeika neitu eiwuang'ieki; eitu epik iltung'ana iltauja lenye nkaitin e kulikae tung'ana.
Ore nkulie kiaasin e Yehoshafat, ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto, neigeroki too nkatinin e Yehu olayioni le Hanani, apa naatisiraki te mbuku oo laiguanak le Israel.
Ore te siadi ena, neibung'are olaiguanani Yehoshafat Ahasia olaiguanani loo Siraeli, apa oas entorroni.
Neibung'are ninye te nchetata oo melin naapuo Tarshishi, neshetu ninche imelin te Esiong'eber.
Neitoki Eliesa olayioni le Dodawahu le Maresha, aibonisho tialo Yehoshafat, ejo, “Ore te nkaraki nimbung'are Ahasia, keidaikie Olaitoriani ina nitaasa.” Nemuta nena melin neitu ninche epuo Tarshishi.
Neirrag Yehoshafat etua anaa loo menye, nenukari tenebo loo menye tiatua enkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Yehoram olayioni lenye, te rishata enye.
Eeta apa ninye Yehoram ilalashera ile: Asaria o Yehiel o Sekaria o Mikael o Shefatia. Ore apa kulo pooki naa ilayiok le Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda.
Eishoo apa ninche menye nkishoorot sapuki, e nkosholai o saabu, o ntokitin e tipat, tenebo nkanas naasheta isunta e Yuda. Kake Yehoram eishoo enkitoria, amu ninye apa olkikau.
Ore ake pee etonie Yehoram olorika le nkitoo le papaai lenye, nebul, near ilalashera lenyena pooki metuata to lalem, tenebo sii kulikae tung'ana kituaak le Israel.
Oloo larin tomoni uni oaare apa Yehoram pee eiteru aaku olaiguanani, neitoreisho ninye ilarin isiet te Yerusalem.
Neibung ninye orrekie loo laiguanak le Israel anaa apa enataasa Ahab. Amu entito apa e Ahab enkitok enye. Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani.
Kake meidaikie ake Olaitoriani enkaji e Daudi, te nkaraki olning'o lo sotua apa oitobira ninye o Daudi, neisiligishore apa ninye pee eitoreisho eishoi enye, o layiok lenyena ntarasi.
Ore too nkolong'i enkitoria enye, nekepari Edom aing'uaa enkitoria e Yuda, negelaki ninche ate olaiguanani.
Nedumunye Yehoram tenebo ilarikok lenyena le njore, o ngarrin enyena oo mbartan pooki, nepuo kewarie aaidaikie iltung'ana le Edom apa oomanita ninye o lkituaak lenyena loo ngarrin oo mbartan.

Neaku etekepari apa Edom aing'uaa enkitoria e Yuda o metabaiki ena olong. Ore apa teina kata nekepari sii ninye Libna aing'uaa enkitoria enye, te nkaraki natanya ninye Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.
Ore ake sii eshomo ninye aitobir iwuejitin neeika teinakop oo ldoinyio e Yuda, neitapong'oo lelo oomanya Yerusalem metapaasha Olaitoriani, neitapong'oo Yuda.

Nelotu empalai enetii ninye naing'uaa oloiboni le Nkai oji Eliya, ejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Daudi papaai lino, ‘Ore te nkaraki neitu iyie imbung orrekie le Yehoshafat papaai lino, anaa orrekie le Asa olaiguanani le Yuda,

kake orrekie loo laiguanak le Israel iturubare, nintapong'oyie Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem metaasa ing'ok, anaa apa enaitapong'oyie enkaji e Ahab Israel metaasa ing'ok, nitaara sii ilalashera linono metuata, lelo le nkaji e papaai lino, laa ninche supati te iyie.
Ore te nkaraki ena, keyau Olaitoriani olmeitai kitok shumata iltung'ana linono, o nkera inono, o nkituaak inono, o ntokitin inono pooki.
Ore iyie makewan nikijing enkeeya torrono e nkoshoke o metaba anaa nikipuku imonyit te nkaraki ina keeya.’ ”
Neputu Olaitoriani engoro oo Lfilisti o Ilarabu te nkaraki Yehoram. Etaaniki apa lelo Filisti o Ilarabu Etiopia.

Nepuonu ninche aarasaki Yuda, neibung ninye, nenap ninche aaya ntokitin pooki naanoto te nkaji o laiguanani, neya sii ilayiok lenyena o nkituaak enyena, neaku meetae olayioni otung'eikiaki ninye, meteleku ake Yehoahas ilo ayioni lenye oti te pooki.
Ore etulusoitie kuna pooki near Olaitoriani ninye teina keeya nemeishiunoyu enkoshoke enye.

Ore te nkiti rishata etulusoitie ilarin oaare, neipang'u imonyit enyena te nkaraki ina keeya. Neye ninye te mion sapuk. Neitu eitobir iltung'ana lenyena enkima, aaisho ninye enkanyit anaa apa enaitobiraki enkima too loo menye.

Oloo larin tomoni uni oaare apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin isiet te Yerusalem. Eiwuang'a ninye meetae oltung'ani otishilayie. Etunukaitie ninche ninye te nkanasa e Daudi, kake mme too nkuraren oo laiguanak.

Ore lelo oomanya Yerusalem neitaa Ahasia olayioni le Yehoram oti olaiguanani terishata enye. Amu ore ilo wuampa apa loo ltung'ana ooetuo tenebo Ilmarabu atua ilng'oborri, netaara metuata lelo ayiok pooki botoro. Neaku Ahasia olayioni le Yehoram olaiguanani le Yuda ninye oitoreishe.
Oloo larin artam oaare apa Ahasia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye olari obo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Atalia, enkakuyiaa e Omri.
Eshomo sii apa aibung orrekie le nkaji e Ahab, amu ng'otonye apa naiguan metaasa entorroni.
Etaasa apa ninye entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani, anaa enataasa enkaji e Ahab. Amu ore apa te siadi keeya e papaai lenye, ninche ooiguanaki ninche, neitasur ninye.

Etusujayie ninye enkikoo enye, o meshomo ninye tenebo Yehoram olayioni le Ahab, ilo aiguanani le Israel, nepuo aaitayunye Hasael olaiguanani le Siria olarrabal te Ramot-gilead. Nepik iltung'ana le Siria Yoram olbae.

Nerrinyo ninye alo metabaki te Yesreel te nkaraki lelo baa apa ootipikaki ninye te Rama, ina kata apa pee elo aarare Hasael olaiguanani le Siria. Nedoyio Ahasia olayioni le Yehoram, olaiguanani le Yuda alo arum Yoram olayioni le Ahab te Yesreel, amu kemuoi apa ninye.

Kake etegelua apa Enkai pee eyau embatatata e Ahasia tena lototo nashomo ninye abaiki Yoram. Ore apa pee elotu ninye ine, neipang ninye alo anang'are Yehu olayioni le Nimshi, laa ninye apa etubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput pee eidaikie enkaji e Ahab.
Ore edung'ito Yehu enkiguana te nkaraki enkaji e Ahab, netumore ninye ilkituaak le Yuda o layiok loo lalashera le Ahasia, laa ninche apa ooing'orita Ahasia. Near ninche metuata.
