Ore ina siaai e nkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem neitasheyieki; neitashe ometabau olapa liare le nkitoria e Dario olaiguanani le Pasia.
Ore apa iloibonok le Nkai, Hagai o Sakaria olayioni le Ido, neibonoki Ilyahudi ootii Yuda o Yerusalem, te nkarna e Nkai e Israel natii shumata ninche.
Neitoki Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel o Yeshua olayioni le Yehosadak aadumunye neiteru aashet enkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem; ore tenebo ninche netii iloibonok le Nkai, eretito ninche.

Ore teina kata ake nelotu Tatenai, ilo balusui lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkejule Frati o Shetar-bosenai tenebo lelo le ncholuek enye neirorie aajoki nji, “Kaing'ae oishoo ntae enkitanapata nishetietie ena aji nindipidipi olchetiei lenye?”
Enyaakita sii aaikilikuan ninche ena, “Kakua nkarn e kulo tung'ana ooshetita ena aji?”
Kake etii apa enkong'u e Nkai enye shumata lelo payiani loo Lyahudi, neitu ninche eibooyo ninche ometabaiki ilo omoni Dario nerrinyuni ewalata naipirta ina te palai.

Ore entashati eina palai nairriwakita Tatenai, ilo balusui lo lpolosie otii teidia alo olkeju o Shotar-bosnai o lelo le ncholuek enye, lelo balusuni apa ootii olkerenket otii lido kekun olkeju, o Dario olaiguanani;
neirriwaki ninche ninye olomoni, oigerore kuna baa: Enetii Dario olaiguanani, eseriani te pooki.

Nchoo metayiolouni to laiguanani nchere kishomo iyiook olkerenket le Yuda, enkaji e Nkai kitok. Eshetitae ninye too soito sapuki, netipikaki isunta enyena imbaoi, eloito ena siaai dukuya aponari easita to nkaik enye.
Nikintoki iyiook aaikilikuan lelo payiani nikirorie ninche aajoki nji, Kaing'ae oishoo intae enkitanapata pee ishetishete ena aji, nindipidipi olchetiei lenye?
Kinyaakita sii aaikilikuan ninche inkarn enye, pee itum atayiolo, nikitum aaigero inkarn e lelo tung'ana too lukuny enye.

Naa ena apa ninche etawalikitia iyiook, Kira iyiook isinkan le Nkai e keper o enkop, naa eikingil iyiook aashet ena aji apa nateshetaki too larin kumok ootulusoitie, apa natesheta olaiguanani le Israel kitok neidip.

Kake ore te nkaraki apa naitagoro loo papa Enkai e keper, neishooyo ninye ninche apik enkaina e Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, o Lkaldayo, laa ninche apa ooidaikie ena aji neya iltung'ana Babilon.
Ore ake eyia neijia, to lari le dukuya le nkitoria e Sairas olaiguanani le Babilon, neitayu Sairas ilo aiguanani enkitanapata, nchere pee eitokini aashet ena aji e Nkai.

Ore nena masaa e saabu o ne nkosholai e nkaji e Nkai, apa naaitayio Nebukadnesa teina aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, neyau ina aji e nkai e Babilon, eyaua Sairas olaiguanani kuna aitupuku te nkaji e nkai e Babilon nepiki enkaina e obo oji enkarna Sheshbasa, laa ninye apa eitaa olgafanai;
nejoki olaiguanani ninye, Iwa kuna masaa, shomo tipika ninche atua enkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, naa nchoo enkaji e Nkai eitokini aashet te wueji enye.
Neitoki alotu ilo oji Sheshbasa neshet olkitamanyunoto le nkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem; ore ebaiki ina kata o taata eshetitae ina aji, neitu eidipayu.

Ore te nkaraki ina te nelioo aa sidai to laiguanani, nchoo ejurruni to lchumati loo mbaa musan o laiguanani te idie te Babilon, pee edoli tenaa keitayio apa Sairas olaiguanani enkitanapata nashetieki ina aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem. Naa nchoo olaiguanani eirriwaki iyiook enaitiship ninye tialo ena bae.
Neitoki Dario olaiguanani aitayu enkitanapata, nejurruni te Babilon, te nkaji nashumieki mbaa musan, teine apa neshumieki mbaa naaigeroki.
Ore te Ekbatana, teina anasa kitok natii olkerenket le Midia, netumi teine olpiyayati oigerore ena: Embae nadamuni.

Ore to lari le dukuya le nkitoria e Sairas olaiguanani, neitayu Sairas olaiguanani enkitanapata: Naipirta enkaji e Nkai te Yerusalem, nejo, nchoo metesheti ina aji, ine wueji apa neishoorieki ilasarri, neyauni ilasarri oopejori; ore enkadoro enye naa keaku ntemat e nkaina ntomoni ile ore endapasho naa ntemat e nkaina ntomoni ile,
neeta nkererin uni oo soito sapuki, o enkereri nabo oo mbaoi; nchoo elaata e nchetata enye meitayuni to lchumati lo laiguanani.

Ore sii nchoo inapa masaa e saabu o ne nkosholai e nkaji e Nkai naawa Nebukadnesa te nkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, neya Babilon, errinyuni aayau atua ina aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, neyauni ake pooki nabo ewueji enye, nipik ninche atua enkaji e Nkai.

Neirriwaa Dario ena walata; nejo, Ore taata Tetanai, olgafanai lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju o Shetar-bosenai o lelo le ncholuek ino, lelo balusuni ootii olkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju, entalamari;
entalam esiaai ena aji e Nkai; enchoo olgafanai loo lyahudi o lpayiani loo Lyahudi eitoki aashet ena aji e Nkai te wueji enye.

Ore ake sii aitayio nanu enkitanapata naipirta enintaasiasa kulo payiani loo Lyahudi te nchetata ena aji e Nkai; kelaakini kulo tung'ana te nkiputakinoto to lchumati le nkitoo nemeimutieki te kodi naing'uaa olkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju.

Ore entoki pooki nayieuni - ilooti oing'ok, olmeregeshi, anaa nkerra te nkaraki ilasarri oopejokini Enkai e keper o enkano o emunyan o enaisho oo sabibu, anaa eilata, anaa enayieu ilapolosak te Yerusalem, nchoo ninche ina anaake, nemepali,
pee etum ninche aaishooi ilasarri ooitishipisho te Nkai e keper, neomonoki enkishui o laiguanani o layiok lenyena.
Aitayio sii enkitanapata nchere teneibelekeny ake oltung'ani ena limunoto, neiwuang'ieki imbokishi te nkaji enye, nesheyieki ninye, neaku enkaji enye olkiu le modiei.

Ore e Nkai apa naitamanya enkarna enye ine wueji, metusulai pooki aiguanani o ltung'ana ooitorioo inkaik enye aaibelekeny ena, anaa einyal ena aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem. Nanu Dario oitayio ena kitanapata nchoo metaasi neibung'i aakurraki.

Ore te risioroto eilo rorei oirriwayie olaiguanani Sairas, neas Tatenai ilo balusui lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju o Shetar-bosenai o lelo le ncholuek enye, nena pooki naaitanapishe olaiguanani Dario.

Ore ilpayiani loo Lyahudi neshetisho nebul, teina aibon apa e Hagai oloiboni le Nkai o Sakaria olayioni le Ido. Eidipa ninche ina aji enye te nkitanapata e Nkai oo Siraeli o te nkitanapata e Sairas o Dario o Artaseses olaiguanani le Parsia;
neidipe apa ena aji te nkolong e uni o lapa le Adar, to lari le ile le nkitoria o laiguanani Dario.
Ore iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ilapolosak o Lawi, o lelo kulikae apa ootorrinyunye te yararoto, neraposhoki enkitisinyata eina aji e Nkai te nchipai.

Neishooyo ninche teina kitisinyata ena aji e Nkai iloing'ok iip nabo olmeregeshi iip are olkuoo le kerra iip ong'uan, neitayu anaa olasar le ng'oki too Siraeli pooki ilkineji tomon oaare, terisioroto e siana oo loshon loo Siraeli.
Nepik ninche ilapolosak ilturrurri lenye nepik Ilawi irishat enye e siaai, te nkaraki enkisiaayiare e Nkai te Yerusalem anaa enaigeroki too nkitanapat e Musa.
Ore te nkolong e tomon oong'uan o lapa le dukuya, neibung lelo apa ootorrinyunye te yararoto Pasaka.

Amu eitisinya apa ilapolosak o Lawi ate tenebo; etaa apa pooki ilemeiduruk. Neaku eteyiang'a ninche olkuoo lenye le Pasaka te nkaraki lelo pooki ootorrinyunye te yararoto, te nkaraki lelo apolosak alashera lenye, o te nkaraki ninche maate,
einosa apa ina Pasaka iltung'ana loo Siraeli ootorrinyunye te yararoto, o pooki ng'ae oibung'are ninche, neitalam kewan olduruk loo ltung'ana leina kop, neserem Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

Neibung ninche osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuishieki nkolong'i naapishana te nchipai; amu eitishipa ninche Olaitoriani, neibelekenya oltau lo laiguanani le Asiria aibelekenyakino ninche, ometaa etareto ninye ninche te siaai e nkaji e Nkai, Enkai e Israel.
Ore apa te siadi ena, te nkitoria e Artaseses olaiguanani le Pasia, ore Esra olayioni le Seraia, olayioni le Asaria, olayioni le Hilkia,
olayioni le Shalum, olayioni le Sadok, olayioni le Ahitab,
olayioni le Amaria, olayioni le Asaria, olayioni le Merariot,
olayioni le Serahia, olayioni le Usii, olayioni le Buki,
olayioni le Abishua, olayioni le Finehas, olayioni le Eliesa, olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani kitok - neilepu sii ilo Esra eing'uaa Babilon.

Olaigeroni apa Esra arriyia too nkitanapat e Musa, apa naaishorua Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, neisho olaiguanani ninye nena pooki naatoomonuo, amu etii apa enkaina o Laitoriani Enkai enye shumata ninye.

Neilep sii apa aapuo Yerusalem to lapa liopishana le nkitoria e Artaseses olaiguanani, embata oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, o embata oo lapolosak o Lawi, o laranyak o larripok loo nchomito, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai.
Nelotu ninye Yerusalem to lapa le imiet, aa olari liopishana le nkitoria eilo aiguanani;
amu ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le dukuya neiteru ninye alo te Babilon, ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le imiet nelotu ninye Yerusalem, amu etii enkaina supat e Nkai enye shumata ninye.
Amu etipika Esra oltau lenye pee eiteng'enuo enkitanapata o Laitoriani, neas ninye, neiteng'enisho nkiguanat enyena, o nkikoo enyena tiatua Israel.
Ena empalai naishoo olaiguanani Artaseses Esra ilo apolosani, naa olaigeroni ang'eni loo mbaa oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani o nkiguanat enyena tialo Isiraeli:
Artaseses olaiguanani loo laiguanak oirriwaki Esra olapolosani, ilo aigeroni loo nkitanapat e Nkai e keper. Ore taata,
aitobira nanu enkitanapata ore pooki ng'ae too ltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa ilapolosak lenye anaa Ilawi tiatua enkitoria ai, onyorraa alo Yerusalem te yieunoto enye, neidim ashomo tenebo iyie.
Amu kirriwayie iyie olaiguanani o lautarok lenyena oopishana, pee eikilikuan mbaa e Yuda o Yerusalem te risioroto eina kitanapata natii inkaik inono, e Nkai ino,
nimbalunye sii enkosholai o saabu apa naishoo olaiguanani tenebo ilautarok Enkai e Israel, natii emanyisho enye atua Yerusalem,

tenebo enkosholai pooki o saabu nilo iyie atum to lkerenket pooki le Babilon, tenebo nkishoorot o lpela oo ltung'ana o noo lapolosak, naainosaki olmumai pee eishoruni te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai enye natii Yerusalem.

Ore naa te kuna pisai ilo iyie ainyiang'u iloing'ok o lmeregeshi o lkuo le kerra, tenebo ilasarri lenye le ntapa, o lasarri lenye ooki, nilo aishooyo ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar le nkaji e Nkai ino natii Yerusalem.
Ore pooki naba anaa enidol aa sidai te iyie o lalashera linono neasi teina ae osholai o saabu, nindimidimi aataas, te risioroto e yieunoto e Nkai ino.
Ore inapa masaa nikinchooki te nkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai ino, nilo aitayu te dukuya e Nkai e Yerusalem.
Ore pooki naba anaa enayieuni te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ino, niata erishata pee inchoru nindim aishoru te nena naatii olchumati lo laiguanani.

“Ore nanu Artaseses olaiguanani, naitobira enkitanapata too lashumak pooki lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju. Ore pooki nayieu Esra, ilo apolosani, aigeroni loo nkitanapat e Nkai e keper, nchoo easi aakurraki,
neitabaikini ntalantani iip nabo e nkosholai, o rridat iip e nkano, o lbenia iip le nkano, o emunyan neitu eimakini eneba esapuko.
Ore pooki naaitanapishe Enkai e keper, nchoo metaasi aaitabaya te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai e keper, pee melotu ake engoro enye adoiki olaiguanani o layiok lenyena.

Kiliki sii iyie nchere meishiaakino pee eitalaki olapolosani kodi e arakinoto, anaa mpisai o lpolosie, anaa mpisai e nkoitoi, nemeitalaki Ilawi o laranyak o laitasheikinok loo nkutukie oo nkajijik, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, anaa kulikae aisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai.

“Naa ore iyie Esra te risioroto eina ng'eno nagut e Nkai ino niata te nkaina ino, tegelu ilooiguanare o larishak oorish iltung'ana to lkerenket pooki otii lido kekun olkeju, ore lelo pooki naa ilooyiolo inkitanapat Enkai ino: ore lelo lemeyiolo inkitanapat ninteng'en.

Ore pooki ng'ae lemeibung inkitanapat e Nkai ino o nkitanapat o laiguanani, nchoo edung'okini ninye enkiguana narrish, aa te keeya, anaa eiwangieki tiatua olorere anaa, eoruni imasaa enyena, anaa eeni te jila.”
Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loopapa, laa ninye otipika embae naikununo nji atua oltau lo laiguanani, pee eitisidan enkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem,

naa ninye laaitabaikia nanu enyorrata enye nauno te dukuya olaiguanani o lautarok lenyena. O te dukuya iltung'ana pooki magil lo laiguanani. Naagolu nanu oshoke amu etii enkaina o Laitoriani Enkai ai shumata nanu, naiturrur nanu iltung'ana ooisul Isiraeli pee aapuo aairiamariyie.
Kuna apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loomenye, naa kuna inkarn oo ishoritin e lelo apa ooshomo tenebo nanu eing'uaa Babilon, te nkitoria o laiguanani Artaseses.
Ore too layiok le Finehas naa Gershom. Ore too layiok le Itamar, naa Daniel, ore too layiok le Daudi naa Hatush,
ore too layiok le Shekania, o too layiok le Parosh, naa Sekaria, laa te ninye eigeroki ilewa iip o onom.
Ore too layiok le Pahat Moab, naa Elieho-enai olayioni le Serahia, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa iip are o onom.
Ore too layiok le Satu, naa Shekania olayioni le Yehasiel, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa iip uni.
Ore too layiok le Adin, naa Ebed olayioni le Yonatan, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa onom.
Ore too layiok le Elam, naa Yeshaia olayioni le Atalia, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa ntomoni naapishana.
Ore too layiok le Shefatia, o Sebadia olayioni le Mikael, netii tenebo ninye Ilewa ntomoni isiet.
Ore too layiok le Yoab o Obadia olayioni le Yehiel, netii tenebo ninye ilewa iip are o tomon oisiet.
Ore too layiok le Bani, o Shelomit olayioni le Yosifia, netii tenebo ninye ilewa iip o ntomoni ile.
Ore too layiok le Bebai, Sekaria olayioni le Bebai, netii tenebo ninye ilewa tikitam o isiet.
Ore too layiok le Asgat, Yohanan olayioni le Hakatan, netii tenebo ninye ilewa iip o tomon.
Ore too layiok le Adonikam, lelo apa ooetuo te siadi, ore nkarn enye naa Elifalet, Yeuel o Shemaia, netii tenebo ninche ilewa ntomoni ile.
Ore too layiok le Bigfai, Utai o Sakur, netii tenebo ninche ilewa ntomoni naapishana.
Aiturrurro apa nanu ninche te mbata olkeju orukokino Ahafa, ore teine nikibik too lng'oborri nkolong'i uni. Najo nanu ajur iltung'ana o lapolosak, nadol nchere metii Ilawi.

Nairriwaa nanu olkilikuai meipoti Eliesa o Ariel o Shemaia o Elinatan o Yarib o Elnatan, o Natan o Sekaria o Meshulam, lelo arikok, neipotuni sii Yoiarib o Elnatan, laa iltung'ana apa ooata eng'eno nagut neiriwarri ninche meshomo enetii Ido,

ilo arikoni te wueji neji Kasifia, neliki ninche enapuo aajoki Ido o lalashera lenyena lelo sinkan le nkaji e Nkai, te wueji neji Kasifia, aa taa, pee eirriwakini iyiook ilaisiaayiak te nkaraki e nkaji e Nkai.

Ore te nkaraki enkaina supat e Nkai ang, natii te shumata iyiook eyakita ninche iyiook oltung'ani oata enkidimata, too layiok le Mahali, olayioni le Lawi, olayioni le Israel, oji enkarna enye Sherabia, ore tenebo ilayiok lenyena o ltung'ana lo lgilata lenye naa tomon oisiet,
tenebo sii Hashabia, ore tenebo ninye netii Yashabia, too layiok le Merari, ore ninche tenebo iltung'ana lo lgilata lenye o layiok lenye naa tikitam.
Ore tenebo lelo aisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai iip are o tikitam, apa ooiteng'ela Daudi, pee etum aaisiaayia Ilawi, neipotoki kulo pooki too nkarn.

Naitoki nanu aibalunye eenata e mpukoroto to lkeju le Ahafa, pee kitum iyiook aitoborro ate te dukuya Enkai ang, pee king'oru te ninye enkoitoi naitoriori te nkaraki iyiook maate o nkera ang o masaa ang pooki.

Amu atoduaa apa nanu enkurruna tenaomon olaiguanani meishoo iyiook ilkuti sikarini o lakedok loo mbartan, pee emitu iyiook too lmang'ati te nkoitoi, amu kindipa iyiook aatiaaki olaiguanani, “Ore enkaina e Nkai ang naa pee eyaki eretoto lelo pooki ooing'oru ninye. Ore engolon e ng'oro enye napi naa pee egilunore lelo oopaashare ninye.”
Nikiyen iyiook ate aaitupukoo, nikisai Enkai ang tena bae, nening ninye esayiata ang.
Naiteng'el nanu ilapolosak tomon oaare te lelo apolosak kituaak: Sherabia o Hashabia o kulikae tomon loo lgilat lenye tenebo ninche.
Naineneng nanu enkiroishi e nkosholai o saabu o masaa o nena kishoorot te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ang apa naaishorua olaiguanani, o lautarok lenyena o lkituaak lenyena, elulung'a Israel pooki;
naineneng nanu too nkaik enye enkiroishi e shekeli iip naa ntalantani iip ile e nkosholai o masaa e nkosholai naabaya enkinyiang'a enye shekeli iip nabo o saabu ntalantani iip nabo.
O lbakulini tikitam le saabu loo nkiloi isiet enkiroishi enye o masaa are sidain o suyai naanyaanyukie te nkiroishi nena e saabu.
Najoki nanu ninche, “Irara intae sinyat to Laitoriani, naa sinyat kuna masaa, ore enkosholai o saabu naa nkishoorot o lpela naaishori Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi.

Entagolie ninche, ning'oring'oro ninche ometaba anaa nimpimipimi ninche te dukuya ilapolosak kituaak o Lawi o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye te Israel te Yerusalem, tiatua ilgilat le nkaji o Laitoriani.”
Metaa eibung'a ilapolosak o Lawi enkipimore e nkosholai o saabu o masaa, neyau ninche Yerusalem atua ina aji e Nkai ang.

Nikintoki iyiook aadumunye to lkeju le Ahafa te nkolong e tomon oaare o lapa le dukuya, aapuo Yerusalem. Netii enkaina e Nkai ang shumata iyiook, nekordu ninye iyiook te nkaina o lmang'atinta lang o too rresheta te nkoitoi.
Nikibau iyiook Yerusalem nikibik teine nkolong'i uni.

Ore te nkolong e ong'uan tiatua enkaji e Nkai ang, neipimi enkosholai o saabu o masaa aapik inkaik e Meremot olapolosani, olayioni le Uria, netii tenebo ninye Eliesa olayioni le Finehas, netii tenebo ninche Ilawi, Yosabad olayioni le Binui.
Eikenayioki nena pooki aajo keineneng'a, ore enkiroishi e pooki toki neigeri.

Ore teina kata lelo apa ooetuo eing'uaa eyararoto, lelo yararot ootorrinyunye, neishoru ilasarri oopejori aaisho Enkai e Israel, iloing'ok tomon oaare te nkaraki Isiraeli pooki o lmeregeshi ntomoni naaudo o ile o lkuoo le kerra ntomoni naapishana, neitayuni anaa olasar le ng'oki ilkineji tomon oaare: ore kuna pooki naa ilasarri oopejokini Olaitoriani.
Eyautua sii apa empalai naishorua olaiguanani aayaki ilkituaak o lbalusuni lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju; neretu ninche iltung'ana o enkaji e Nkai.

Ore eidipaki aataas kuna baa, nepuonu lelo kituaak enatii nejo, “Ore iltung'ana loo Siraeli o lapolosak o Lawi, neitu egelaa ate aarishu too ltung'ana le kuna kuapi oata olminong oing'uaa ile Kanaan o Lhiti o Lperisi o Ljebusi o Lamoni o Lmoabu o Lmisiri o Lamori.

Amu ewaita ninche embata oo ntoyie enye aayamaki ate o layiok lenye, metaa etushulare ilo osho osinya iltung'ana loo loreren. Ore te nkaraki ena nemeisiligayu ninche, eituruk lelo kituaak o laiguanak eitarruoitie.”
Ore ake pee aning ena, napolos nanu ilkilani laainei, olkila lai oodo, naputu olpapita te ndukuya ai o to lmunyei naton aiputukuny.
Ore lelo pooki ooikirikirate too rorei le Nkai e Israel, te nkaraki nemeisiligayu lelo ootorrinyunye te yararoto, neiturrurro naaman nanu, ina kata aitashe aiputukuny ometabau olasar le nteipa.
Ore to lasar le nteipa nadumunye nanu te enata ai e mpukoroto, aishopito lelo kilani laainei o lkila lai oodo epolosa, nagil nanu kung naitorioo nkaik aainei aitorioki Olaitoriani Enkai ai,
ajo, “Oi Enkai ai, kaata enkurruna tenaashumaki nanu iyie enkomom ai, Enkai ai, amu eilepa entorroni ang shumata alang ilukuny ang, neilepa entorroni ang abaiki keper.

Ore ebaiki nkolong'i oo loopapa o metabaiki ena olong kitii iyiook atua enkitarrurroto sapuk. Naa too nkitarruorrot ang, ewaki iyiook o laiguanak lang o lapolosak lang aapik inkaik oo laiguanak loo nkuapi, nepiki iyiook olalem, nepiki eyararoto, neoruni iyiook imasaa, nepiki iyiook esulare anaa enatiu ena olong.

Kake ore taata te nkiti rishata, neishorua Olaitoriani Enkai ang omom, alekaki iyiook oloti pisiai, neisho iyiook ewueji e seriani, tiatua ewueji enye sinyati. Pee etum Enkai ang aitawang'a nkonyek ang neisho iyiook enkiti piunoto te rrindikisho ang.

Amu kira iyiook iltung'ana le rrindikisho; ore ake eyia eitu eiturraa iyiook Enkai ang te rrindikisho ang. Kake eitabaikia iyiook enyorrata enye nauno, te dukuya le Pasia pee eisho iyiook enkiti kiyagata maitasheyie enkaji e Nkai ang, nikiram iwuejitin neeidaaitie, neisho iyiook emitunoto te Yudea o te Yerusalem.
“Naa ore taata iyie Enkai ang, kaa iyiook kipuo aajo te siadi ena? Amu kinturraitie iyiook nkitanapat inono,

apa nintanapishe aimunye isinkan linono, iloibonok le Nkai, ijo, ‘Ore ina kop nipuopuo aajing, pee iyaya metaa eninyi, naa enkop nemesinya, naata olduruk loo loreren le kuna kuapi, tenebo ilo minong oiputa ninye, ebaiki enkiting'oto o metabaiki enkiting'oto teilo duruk lenye.

Ore te nkaraki ina emincho ntoyie inyi meyama ilayiok lenye, nimiyaya sii ntoyie enye aayamaki ilayiok linyi. Niming'oruru aekata osotua o ninche o karsisisho enye eji pee igolulu, nitumutumu aainosa endaa sidai eina kop nintaa enjung'ore oo nkera inyi ntarasi.’

Ore eidipa kuna pooki aatadoiki iyiook te nkaraki nkiaasin ang torrok o te nkitarruoroto ang kitok, nikidol aajo, iyie Enkai ang naitamio, aitodorropu too nkitarruorot ang, ninchoo iyiook olpisiai loo lekunot oba nji.
Eikingil iyiook aagil nkitanapat inono nikiyama o ltung'ana oas kuna baa o lminong? Aimigorokino iyie iyiook, nimut iyiook ometaa metumi ninye olpisiai loo lekunot, nemeimisho ninye obo?

Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, ira iyie asipani, amu etelekuaki iyiook olpisiaai oimishe, anaa enikitiu ena olong. Ng'ura ajo kitii iyiook dukuya iyie te nkitarruorroto ang, amu meetae oloidim aitasho te dukuya iyie te nkaraki ena.”
Ore eomonito Esra neirridu, neishir, nenang'ie kewan enkop te dukuya enkaji e Nkai, neiturrurrokino ninye eumata sapuk oo lewa o nkituaak o nkera, eing'uaa Israel, amu eishira lelo tung'ana te mion.

Ore Shekania olayioni le Yehiel, loo layiok le Elam, neirorie Esra: ajoki, “Kinturraitie iyiook enkirukoto te Nkai nikiyama nkituaak oo loreren oo ltung'ana lena kop, kake ore ake o taata eetae osiligi too Siraeli hoo netii ena.

Ore te nkaraki ina, maitobira iyiook olning'o lo sotua o Enkai ang, aaiwuang'ie kuna kituaak pooki o nkera enye, te risioroto e nkikoo o lkitok lai o ene lelo ooikirikira te nkaraki enkitanapata e Nkai ang: naa nchoo easi ina te risioroto e nkitanapata.
Tudumunye amu esiaai ino ina, nikitii iyiook tenebo iyie. Ntagoluoyu nias ina.”
Nedumunye Esra neinosie olmumai ilapolosak kituaak o Lawi o Siraeli pooki, pee eas anaa enatejoki. Nenya ninche olmumai.

Neitoki Esra alo te nkaji e Nkai nelo olgilata le Yehobadan olayioni le Eliaship, naa ine eshomo airrag. Neitu enya endaa anaa eok enkare; amu eishiraka apa ninye lelo ooshomo eyararoto lemeisiligayu.
Neitayuni enkitanapata tiatua Yuda pooki o Yerusalem te nkaraki lelo yararot pooki ootorrinyunye, pee epuo ninche aaiturrurro te Yerusalem.
Naa teneitu elotu oltung'ani ake ninye obo too nkolong'i uni, te nkitanapata oo lkituaak o lpayiani, ore imasaa enyena pooki, neyai, ore ninye makewan, neiwuang'ieki te umata o yararot ootorrinyunye.

Ore iltung'ana pooki le Yuda o Benchamen, neiturrurro te Yerusalem too nkolong'i uni, naa olapa lioudo apa ilo e nkolong e tikitam o lapa. Netoni iltung'ana pooki to lkurroto otumoreki te dukuya enkaji e Nkai, eikirikira te nkaraki ena bae o te nkaraki enchan sapuk.
Neitashe Esra ilo apolosani nejoki ninche, “Itigila intae inkitanapat niyama nkituaak oo loreren, nitoponaitie enkitarrurroto te Israel.
Ore naa taata entobira enkirridunoto to Laitoriani Enkai oo loo papaai linyi, niasiasa eyieunoto enye. Entegelari maate entung'uai iltung'ana lena kop, ning'uaa inkituaak enye.”
Newal eumata pooki to ltoilo sapuk aajo, “Neijia etiu, meeta nchere keitu iyiook kiaas anaa enitejo.
Kake aikumok iltung'ana, naa erishata e nchan sapuk, mikindim iyiook aaitasho tena kisiashata. Ore sii ena siaai, neme ene nkolong nabo anaa nkolong'i are, amu kintarruoitie iyiook oleng tena bae.

Nchoo ilkituaak lang eitashe te rishata e umata pooki, naa nchoo pooki tiatua nkanas ang apa oowaita inkituaak oo loreren epuonu too rishat naategeluaki, ore ilpayiani o larishak te pooki anasa neaku tenebo ninche, ometaba anaa neibelekenya engoro napi e Nkai ang aing'uaa iyiook.”
Yonatan ake olayioni le Asahel o Yohaseia olayioni le Tikfa otanya ena, ore Meshulam o Shebetai, ilo le Lawi, neibung'are ninche.

Neas lelo yarunot apa ootorrinyunye ina. Negelu Esra olapolosani iltung'ana, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ore ake pooki ng'ae te ninche neigeri enkarna enye. Ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le tomon netoni ninche pee ejurru ina bae.
Ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le dukuya nebau ninche eneiting'ie lelo lewa apa ooyama inkituaak oo loreren.
Ore too layiok loo lapolosak apa ooyama inkituaak oo loreren, netumi, Maaseia o Eliesa o Yarib o Gedaia, loo layiok le Yeshua olayioni le Yosadak o lalashera lenyena.
Etonyorraitie ninche maate pee eiwuang'ie nena kituaak enye oo loreren, ore apa olasar lenye le nkitarruorroto naa olmeregesh le luaata oo ntare te nkaraki enkitarrurroto enye.
Ore too layiok le Imer netumi Hanani o Sebadia.
Ore too layiok le Harim, netumi Maaseia o Eliya o Shemaia o Yehiel o Usia.
Ore too layiok le Pashur: netumi Elioenai o Maaseia o Ishmael o Natanael o Yosabad o Elasa.
Ore too Lawi: netumi Yosabad o Shimei o Kelaia, (aa taa Kelita) o Petahia o Yuda o Eliesa.
Ore too laranyak, netumi: Eliashib. Ore too larripok loo nchomito netumi: Shalum, o Telem o Uri.
Ore te Israel: too layiok le Parosh netumi: Ramia o Isia o Malkija, o Mijamin o Eleasa o Hashabia o Benaia.
Ore too layiok le Elam netumi: Matania o Sekaria o Yehiel o Abdi o Yeremot o Eliya.
Ore too layiok le Satu netumi: Elioenai o Eliashib o Matania o Yeremot o Sabad o Asisa.
Ore too layiok le Bebai naa Yehohanan o Hanania o Sabai o Atalia.
Ore too layiok le Bani naa Meshulam o Maluk o Adaia o Yashub, o Sheal o Yeremot.
Ore too layiok le Pahat Moab: netumi Adna o Chelai, o Benania o Maaseia o Matania o Besalel o Binui o Manase.
Ore too layiok le Harim: naa Eliesa o Ishija o Malkija o Shemaia o Shimeon
o Benchamen o Maluk o Shemaia.
Ore too layiok le Hashum: naa Matenai o Matata o Sabad o Elifelet o Yeremai, o Manase o Shimei.
Ore too layiok le Bani: naa Maadai o Amram o Uel,
O Benania o Bedeia o Cheluki,
o Fenia o Meremot o Eliashib,
o Matania o Matenai o Yaasil.
Ore too layiok le Binui: naa Shimei,
o Shelania o Natan o Adaia,
o Maknadebai o Sheshai o Sherai
o Asarel o Shelemia o Shemaia,
o Shalum o Amaria o Yosef.
Ore too layiok le Nebor: naa Yeil o Matitia o Sabad o Sebina o Yadai o Yoel o Benaia.
Eyama apa kulo pooki inkituaak oo loreren, neiwuang'ie ninche tenebo nkera enye.
Irorei kulo le Nehemia, olayioni le Hekalia. Ore apa to lapa oji ole Kislep, to lari le tikitam, atii nanu Susa ina ang kitok.

Nelotu Hanani obo loo lalashera laainei tenebo kulikae tung'ana eing'uaa Yuda. Naikilikuan nanu ninche mbaa naaipirta lelo Yahudi ootelekutua, lelo apa ooimishote te yararoto, naikilikuan sii mbaa naapirta Yerusalem.
Naajoki ninche nanu, “Ore lelo lekunot ootii olkerenket apa ooimishote te yararoto, neeta enyamali sapuk o enkurruna. Etuurori esuntai e Yerusalem, ore nchomito enyena netumuta enkima.”
Ore ake pee aning kulo rorei naton aishir, naisinanuo inkolong'i kumok; nabik nanu apukoo naomon te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai e keper.
Najo nanu, “Olaitoriani, Enkai e keper, Enkai kitok naitureisho naibung osotua o enyorrata nauno, te lelo oonyor ninye, neibung inkitanapat enyena.

Nchoo enkiok ino einining, nincho inkonyek inono eing'orisho, pee ining enkomono o sinka lino, naomon taata nanu te dukuya iyie, dama o kewarie, te nkaraki iltung'ana linono le Israel, isinkan linono, airridu ing'ok oo ltung'ana le Israel, nikitaasa iyiook tialo iyie. Ee ore nanu o enkaji e papaai lai nikitaasa eng'oki.
Kitaasa iyiook entorroni oleng tialo iyie, neitu kimbung inkitanapat o nkiguanat o nkikoot apa nintanapa osinka lino Musa.
Tadamu ilo rorei apa lintanapa osinka lino Musa, ijo, ‘Tenirara intae ilemeisiligayu, nalo nanu aidapash intae tiatua iloreren.

Kake tenikirrinyokinono intae nanu nimbung'ubung'u inkitanapat aainei, ore hoo neba enkidapashari inyi anaa nkatampo te lakuani, kaiturur nanu ninche tene, nayau ninche ine wueji nategelua, pee aisho enkarna ai metobiko teine.’
Isinkan linono ninche naa iltung'ana linono, lelo litokordua iyie te ngolon ino kitok, o te nkaina ino nagol.

Olaitoriani, nchoo enkiok ino metoning'o enkomono o sinka lino o enkomono oo sinkan linono ooshipakino euriata e nkarna ino. Nchoo enkishuroto o sinka lino ena olong, nincho ninye olng'ur too nkonyek ele tung'ani.” Kara apa nanu olanapani le nkikompe o laiguanani.

Ore apa to lapa le Nisan to lari le tomon oaare le nkitoria o laiguanani Artaseses, ina kata apa etii enaisho dukuya ninye, naya nanu enaisho alo aisho olaiguanani. Neitu aekata nanu aaku olemeshipa te dukuya Olaiguanani.
Naajoki nanu olaiguanani, “Kainyoo pee eeta enkomom ino osina, nadolita ajo mimuoi? Meeta ae toki osina lo ltau ele.” Nairut nanu oleng.
Najoki nanu olaiguanani, “Metobikoi olaiguanani ntarasi! Kainyoo pee meisinanuo enkomom ai aa ore enkanasa natii nkuraren oo loo papa, netaa olmuaate, ore nchomito enyena, netumuta enkima?”
Naaitoki nanu olaiguanani ajoki, “Paa kainyoo iyie iomonu?” Naomon nanu Enkai e keper.
Najoki nanu olaiguanani, “Tenaa keitiship olaiguanani, naa tenenoto osinka lino omom too nkonyek inono pee kirriwaa nanu mashomo Yuda, ina anasa natii inkuraren oo loo papa, pee alo ashet.”
Naajoki nanu olaiguanani, etii enkitok o laiguanani embata enye etonita, “Ke nkata nabaa iyie ilo naa kanu ishukunye?” Tenaa taa keitiship olaiguanani pee aairriwaa nanu, naa kadung'oki ninye enkata.
Najoki nanu olaiguanani, “Tenaa keitiship olaiguanani, nchoo nanu maaishori mpala nayaki ilbalusuni le lido kekun otii lido kerenket o lkeju, pee aaisho ninche nanu maima ina kop o matabai Yuda;

neishoruni sii imapala naayakini Asaf ilo aing'urani le ntim o laiguanani, pee aatum nanu aishoo mbaoi naitobirie iloom te nkaraki nena shomito o sempewuet le nkaji e Nkai, o esuntai pooki e nkanasa o ina aji nalo nanu amany.” Naaisho nanu olaiguanani nena pooki naatoomonuo, amu ketii apa enkaina supat o laitoriani shumata nanu.
Naitoki nanu alotu ilo kerenket le lelo balusuni ootii lido kekun o lkeju, naisho ninche nena pala o laiguanani. Neirriwayie apa olaiguanani tenebo nanu ilkituaak le njore o lakedok loo mbartan.
Kake ore ake pee ening Sanbalat le Bet-horon ena o Tobia ilo sinka, ilo le Amori, negoro ninche oleng pee ening nchere, eewuo oltung'ani obo aing'oru olmabarishoi loo nkera e Israel.
Metaa aewuo apa nanu Yerusalem naton teine nkolong'i uni.

Naitoki nanu adumunye kewarie, nanu o lkuti tung'ana apa ootii tenebo nanu; neitu nanu aliki oltung'ani hoo obo, ina natipika Enkai ai atua oltau lai, pee alo aitaas Yerusalem. Meetae apa eng'ues natii ine meteleku ake ina apa natakedo alotunye.

Ashomo apa nanu auluo kewarie aim kishomi enkalo enong'oto nalo olchorro loo mbariak o kishomi e Modiei. Naing'or nanu asipu isunta e Yerusalem apa naaturori, tenebo o nchomito enyena apa naatumuta enkima.
Naitoki nanu alo kishomi e nkong'u enkare o lchorro lo laiguanani; kake meetae apa ewueji neeim ina ng'ues nakedito nanu teine.
Naitoki nanu alo kewarie aim embata o erata, naing'or asipu ina suntai. Naitoki nanu aibelekenya najing kishomi natii enkalo o erata. Naitoki arrinyunye.

Neitu apa eyiolou lelo tung'ana kituaak aajo kaji nanu ashomo anaa kaa aasita; neton apa nanu eitu aliki Ilyahudi, o lapolosak o ltung'ana le nkaji e nkitoo o lkulikae kituaak o lelo kulikae laa ninche ooas esiaai.

Naitoki nanu ajoki ninche, “Idolitata ena nyamali nikitii iyiook atua, entodol aajo eirragita Yerusalem aa olmuaate, netapejoki nchomito enyena. Wootu mateshet iyiook esuntai e Yerusalem, pee mikiingil aata esulare.”

Naliki nanu ninche ina aina e Nkai ai oshi natii shumata nanu, naliki sii lelo rorei laairorie nanu olaiguanani. Nejo ninche, “Matudumunye iyiook aashet.” Neaku eitagolo ninche inkaik enye te nkaraki ina siaai sidai.

Kake ore ake pee ening Sanbalat le Heroni o Tobia ilo sinka, le Amoni o Geshem ilo marabui ina, nekueniyie iyiook, nemenaa iyiook nejo, “Kainyoo ena toki niaasitata intae?” Aigolong'akiki intae olaiguanani?

Naitoki nanu awaliki ninche ajoki, “Ore Enkai e keper naa keisho iyiook matudupoto, naa ore iyiook isinkan lenyena aikidumunye aashetisho. Kake ore intae miaatata erubata, anaa esipata, anaa endamunoto te Yerusalem.”

Nedumunye Eliashib ilo apolosani kitok, tenebo ilalashera lenyena, lelo apolosak, neshet ninche kishomi oo nkerra. Neitisiny ninche ina kishomi, nepik inkikeneta enyena. Neitisiny ninche ina kishomi o meitabaiki oltalet le iip nelo abaiki oltalet le Hananel.
Ore enetashare ninye neshet Iltung'ana le Yeriko. Ore enetashare ninche neshet Sakar olayioni le Imri.
Ore ilayiok le Hasena neshet kishomi oo sinkir; eitoluaa ninche iloom, nepik inkikeneta enyena o lmushumaani lenyena o sekenke enyena.

Ore enetashare ninche, neitobir aram Meremot olayioni le Uria, olayioni le Hakos. Ore enetashare ninche neitobir aram Meshulam olayioni le Berekia, olayioni le Meshesabel. Ore enetashare ninche neitobir aram Sadok olayioni le Baana.
Ore enetashare ninche neitobir aaram iltung'ana le Tekoa, kake ore lelo kituaak lenye eitu ninche epik imurto ina siaai o Laitoriani lenye.
Ore Yoida olayioni le Pasea o Mehulam olayioni le Besodia, neitobir aaram enkishomi musana. Nepik iloom lenyena o nkikeneta enyena, o lmushumaani lenyena o sekenke enyena.
Ore enetashare ninche, neitobir aram Melatia le Gebeon o Yadon le Meron o ltung'ana le Gebeon o le Mispa, apa ootii abori enkitoria o lbalusui leilo kerenket te lido kekun o lkeju.

Ore enetashare ninche neitobir aram Usiel olayioni le Harbaia, ilo kunoni. Ore enetashare ninye neitobir aram Hanania, ilo obo loo laitobirak loo sonkoyoni; Neshet ninche Yerusalem o meitabaiki esuntai dapash.
Ore enetashare ninche, neitobir Aram Refaia olayioni le Huri, ilo aitoriani le nchoto e Yerusalem.
Ore olotashare ninche neitobir aram Yedia olayioni le Harumap, ina kipirakinoto e nkaji enye. Ore enetashare ninye neitobir aram Hatush olayioni le Hashabneia.
Ore Malkija olayioni le Harim o Hashub olayioni le Pahat Moab neitobir aaram enkae rishata tenebo oltalet lo lkokuet.
Ore enetashare ninye neitobir aram Shalum olayioni le Halohesh, ilo aitoriani le nchoto nabo e Yerusalem, neshet ninye o ntoyie enyena.

Ore Hanam o lelo oomanya Senoa, neitobir aaram enkishomi o erata; neshetu ninche ninye nepik inkikeneta enyena o lmushumaani lenyena o sekenke enyena, neram ntemat e nkaina e nkalifu nabo e suntai o meitabaiki kishomi e modioi.
Ore Malkija olayioni le Rekab, ilo aitoriani lo lkerenket le Bethashekem, neitobir aram enkishomi e modioi, neitoki ashet ninye nepik inkikeneta enyena o lmushumaani lenyena o sekenke enyena.

Ore Shalum olayioni le Galhose, ilo aitoriani lo lkerenket le Mispa neram aitobir, enkishomi e nkong'u enkare. Etesheta ninye neimulumul nepik inkikeneta enyena o lmushumaani lenyena o sekenke enyena. Neshet ninye esuntai o lchorro le Shela le nkurma o laiguanani, omeitabaiki nkedeta naadoyio aapuo enkanasa e Daudi.

Ore te siadi ninye, neitobir aram Nehemia olayioni le Asbak, ilo aitoriani le nchoto nabo o lkerenket le Betsar o meitabaiki enkipirakinoto oo nkuraren e Daudi o meitabaiki olchorro oitobiruaki o meitabaiki enkaji oo ltung'ana magil.
Ore te siadi ninche neitobir kulo Lawi aaram esuntai: Reham olayioni le Bani; ore te siadi ninye naa Shashabia, ilo aitoriani lo lpisiai lo lkerenket le Keila, neram aitobir olkerenket lenye.
Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aaram ilalashera lenye; Bafai olayioni le Hanadad, ilo aitoriani le nchoto nabo o lkerenket le Keila;
ore olosujaki ninye naa Eser olayioni le Yeshua, ilo aitoriani le Mispa, neitobir aram enkae rishata, enkipirakinoto e wueji neshumieki imasaa o larrabal teine nelojare e suntai.
Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aram Baruk enkae rishata ebaiki elojata e suntai o meitabaiki kutukaji e nkaji e Eliaship ilo apolosani kitok.
Ore te siadi ninye naa Meremot olayioni le Uria, olayioni le Hakos oitobira enkae rishata, ebaiki kutukaji e nkaji e Eliab o metabaiki enkiting'oto, e nkaji e Eliaship.
Ore te siadi ninye naa kulo apolosak, lelo tung'ana le nkisiashata, ooitobira aaram esuntai.
Ore te siadi ninche neitobir aaram Benchamen o Hashab enkipirakinoto oo nkajijiki enye. Ore te siadi ninche neitobir aram Asaria olayioni le Maaseia, olayioni le Anania embata e nkaji enye makewan.
Ore te siadi ninye naa Benui olayioni le Hanadad oitobira aram enkae rishata, ebaiki enkaji e Asaria ometabaiki elojata e suntai nelo abaiki olpijata.

Ore Palal olayioni le Usai neitobir aram enkipirakinoto elojata o ilo talet oipang'u te nkaji e shumata o laiguanani to lgoriet le rripore. Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aaram Pedaia olayioni le Parosh,
tenebo ilaisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai ootii Ofel ewueji neipirakinore kishomi e nkare, te nkalo o loosaen oilo talet oilep shumata.
Ore te siadi ninche neitobir iltung'ana le Tekoa enkae rishata te nkipirakinoto eilo talet oilep shumata o metabaiki esuntai e Ofel.
Ore shumata enkishomi oo mbartan neitobir ilapolosak aaram, oltung'ani ake enkipirakinoto e nkaji enye makewan.
Ore te siadi ninche neitobir aram Sadok olayioni le Imer enkipirakinoto e nkaji enye. Ore te siadi ninye neram Shemaia olayioni le Shekemia, ilo arriponi le kishomi e nkalo o loosaen.

Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aram Hanania olayioni le Shelemia, o Hanam ilo ayioni le ile le Selap neitobir aram enkae rishata. Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aram Meshalam olayioni le Berekia enkipirakinoto e nkaji enye.

Ore te siadi ninye, neshet aram Malkija obo loo lkunono omeitabaiki enkaji oo laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai o ewueji oo lamirak enkipirakinoto e kishomi e rripore o meitabaiki enkaji e shumata natii olpijata.
Ore ebaiki olgilata le shumata o metabaiki kishomi oo nkerra, neitobir aaram ilkunono le saabu.
Ore apa pee ening Sanbalat nchere kishetita iyiook esuntai negoro oleng, neim engoro enye oleng. Nesurdaany ninye Ilyahudi.

Nejo ninye te dukuya ilalashera lenyena o te dukuya enjore e Samaria, “Kainyoo easita kulo Yahudi tashala? Keigil ninche aaitobir ntokitin? Keigil ninche aapolosisho? Keidip ninche te nkolong nabo? Keigil ninche aaiturrur isoito, aaitayu teilo sototi loo suut naapejore.
Netii apa Tobia olayioni le Amori embata enye, nejo ninye, ‘Ee, ore ina nashetita ninche, tenelo embarie shumata ninye, neuroo ina suntai enye oo soito!’”
Naomon nanu najo, “Toning'o na Ai ang, amu etemenaki iyiook; mbelekenya iyie esurdaanyata enye meeu shumata ilukuny enye maate, naa nchoo ninche meitoroki teinakop enye e yararoto.
Mintemoo iyie enkitarruorroto enye, nimincho metujuti eng'oki enye aajutoo aaiwuang'ie too nkonyek inono. Amu kintagoro ninche iyie te dukuya ilashetak.”
Ina pee kishet iyiook esuntai; neiruburuba esuntai pooki tenebo, to lpisiaai le nkadoro enye. Amu keeta apa lelo tung'ana endamunoto pee eas esiaai.
Kake ore ake pee ening Sanbalat o Tobia o Ilarabu o Lamori le Ashdod nchere eloito dukuya eramata e suntai e Yerusalem, netunukaki ilusien enyena, negoro ninche oleng.
Neipiru ninche tenebo pee erasaki Yerusalem neyau olmilo atua ninye.
Nikiomon iyiook Enkai ang, nikipik ilarripok ooibooyo ninche, dama o kewarie.
Kake etejo apa Yuda, “Eishunye engolon oo lanapak loo lolan, naa kumok isuut, mikindim iyiook aateshet esuntai.”
Nejo ilmang'ati lang, “Meyiolou ninche toki anaa edolisho, ometaba anaa nikipuonu empolos enye, nikiaar ninche metuata, nikintasheyie esiaai.”
Ore ake pee epuonu lelo Yahudi apa ootashare ilmang'ati lang, nejoki ninche iyiook katitin tomon, ore too wuejitin pooki neemanya ninche, nepuonu ninche aagilunore iyiook.
Neaku ore too wuejitin neegum oo rishat e oriong e suntai, too wuasin, atipika nanu iltung'ana te risioroto oo lmareita lenye, eeta ilalema o remeta enye o nkai enye.

Naing'orisho nanu, nadumunye, najoki lelo kituaak o larikok, o lkulikae tung'ana, “Emiureyu ninche. Entadamu Olaitoriani, laa ninye olkitok neitureisho, naa ninye omitu ilalashera linyi o layiok linyi o ntoyie inyi o nkituaak inyi o nkang'itie inyi.”
Ore ake pee ening ilmang'ati lang nchere kitayioloito nena kitobirat enye, neibooyie Enkai, nikirrinyokino pooki suntai, nelo ake oltung'ani esiaai enye.

Ore ebaiki ina olong neito idia alo, ore olpisiaai loo laisiaayiak laainei neas esiaai e nchetare, neibung likae pisiai iremeta o long'oi o nkai o nkilani oo lgooitie, neitashe ilarikok tioriong enkaji pooki e Yuda,
laa ninche apa ooshetita esuntai. Ore lelo oonap ilolan, neitanapi te nkaina nabo ilolan ore te nkae aina neibung imasaa o larrabal.
Ore ake obo loo lashetak, neenita olalem te mpolos enye eshetisho. Ore ilo tung'ani apa oosh esekekua naatashare nanu.
Najoki nanu lelo kituaak o larikok o lkulikae tung'ana pooki, “Aisapuk esiaai, netalala oleng, neidapasha iyiook esuntai, kitalamate maate.
Ore te wueji nining'ieng'ie oltoilo le ntarumpeta, enkuetu ene nikitii. Kejing Enkai olarrabal te rishata ang.”
Neaku kitaasishote iyiook teina siaai, ore olpisiaai loo ltung'ana, neibung iremeta ebaiki tadekenya o metaliooto ilakir teipa.
Atiaaka sii apa iltung'ana, “Nchoo pooki tung'ani o sinka lenye eirrag Yerusalem, pee etum aatorrip iyiook kewarie, neidim aataasisho dama.”
Metaa mme nanu, neme lalashera laainei, neme isinkan laainei, neme larripok laasujita nanu, meetae hoo obo oitayio inkilani enyena; neibung'ita ake oltung'ani imasaa enyena o larrabal te nkaina enye.
Nedumunye apa olkiyioi kitok loo ltung'ana o nkituaak enye te nkaraki Ilyahudi alashera lenye.
Amu etii apa lelo oojo, “Ore iyiook tenebo o layiok lang o ntoyie ang naa eikira kumok, maing'oru iyiook entapa pee kitum aainosa pee mikiiye.”
Keetae sii apa lelo oojo, “Kiteena te sile nkurman ang o nkurman ang oo sabibu o nkajijik ang, pee kitum entapa te nkaraki olameyu.”
Netii sii lelo oojo, “Kisilenoitie mpisai te kodi o laiguanani te nkaraki nkurman ang o nkurman ang oo sabibu.

Etotiutuo taata iseseni lang anaa iseseni loo lalashera lang; netotiutuo inkera ang anaa nkera enye; eji neton ake kirrumoki ilayiok lang o ntoyie ang metaa irrindiki; ore kulie oo ntoyie ang neidipaki aaitaa irrindiki; amu mikiaata engolon nikiretunye. Amu ewaita kulikae tung'ana nkurman ang o nkurman ang o sabibu.”
Atagore apa oleng pee aning olkiyioi lenye o kulo rorei.
Aiguane nanu makewan, nadung'oki enkiguana lelo kituaak o larikok. Najoki nanu ninche, “Intulusoitie elaakinoto e dupoto o ltung'ani ake olalashe lenye.” Naibung ina umata kitok agilunore ninche,

najoki ninche, “Ore iyiook anaa enikindim nikinyiang'utua aarrinyu ilyahudi alashera lang apa ootimirakaki iloreren; kake eji imir iyie ilalashera linono eji pee etumi aatimiraki iyiook!” Etigirate ninche neitu etum ororei owalu.
Kaae najo nanu, “Ore ina bae niaasitata intae neme sidai. Aimeishiaakino intae nipuopuo te uriata e Nkai ang, pee imbooyoyo nkinyalat e lelo oshon mang'ati lang?
Ore ake sii nanu o lalashera laainei nikisilenoki ninche mpisai o entapa. Matung'uai iyiook ena dupoto.

Entorrinyoki ninche ena olong taata nkurman enye o nkurman enye oo sabibu o nkurman enye oo loirienito o nkajijik enye o maaip oo ropiyiani enye, o entapa, o enaisho oo sabibu o ina ilata apa niwaita aaitung'uaa ninche.”
Neitoki ninche aajo, “Eikirrinyu iyiook kuna nimikinkilikuanu toki te ninche. Eikiaas iyiook anaa enijo.” Naipotu nanu ilapolosak nainosie ninche olmumai pee eas anaa enaisiligishore.

Naitoki sii aipirripir enkila ai, najo, “Meikuna neijia Enkai aipiripiroo pooki tung'ani te nkaji enye o te siaai enye tenemeitabaya ena kisiligata. Meipiripiri ninye neitoroki.” Nejo eumata pooki, “Eesai” Neisis Olaitoriani. Neas lelo tung'ana aa naa enaisiligishore ninche.

Ore ake sii ebaiki ina kata apa naageluni mataa olgafanai te nkop e Yuda, ebaiki olari le tikitam o metabaiki olari le tomoni uni o are le nkitoria e Arteserses ilo aiguanani, ilarin tomon o are, eitu nanu o lalashera laainei anya ina daa o lbalusui.

Ore lelo balusuni apa le dukuya ootii te dukuya nanu neitanap iltung'ana ilolan ooiroishi, neoru ninche endaa o enaisho oo sabibu, metii shekeli artam e nkosholai. Neitore sii isinkan lenye olorere. Kake eitu nanu aas ina, te nkaraki euriata e Nkai.
Aibung'a sii apa enchetata ena suntai, neitu aing'oru enkop. Ore isinkan laainei pooki neiturrurro teine te nkaraki esiaai.
Ore ake sii etii apa emisa ai iltung'ana iip nabo o oonom oonya endaa tenebo nanu, Ilyahudi o lkituaak metii lelo apa ooetuo enikitii eing'uaa lelo oreren oomanita iyiook.

Ore apa endaa naitobiri te nkolong nabo naa olkiteng obo o nkerra ile gelunot; eitobiraki sii apa ilukunkuni te nkaraki nanu. Ore ake too nkolong'i tomon netii ilbenia le naisho oo sabibu te nkumoi; ore ake etii kuna pooki eitu nanu aikilikuanu endaa naipirare olgafanai, amu keiroishi apa esinkaisho te kulo tung'ana.
Tadamu te nkaraki esupatisho tialo nanu na Ai ai, nena pooki nataasa te nkaraki kulo tung'ana.

Ore apa pee elikini Sanbalat o Tobia le Geshem ilo Marabui o kulikae mang'ati lang nchere atesheta nanu ina suntai nemeekure etii ilusieta, hoo naa ore ebaiki ina kata eton eitu apik inkikeneta e kishomi.
Naairriwaki Sanbalat o Geshem olkilikuai ejo, “Wou manototo tenebo te nkang nabo e nkisiashata e Ono.” Kake keyieu apa ninche naaitaas entorrono.
Airriwaka nanu ninche ilkiliku ajoki, “Aasita esiaai kitok nemaidim aeu. Kainyoo pee eitashe esiaai eji pee alotu enitii?”
Naairriwaki ninche nanu ilkiliku katitin ong'uan aaiko nji, nawaliki ninche aiko nji.
Ore ake teina oitoi neirriu Sanbalat olkilikuai lenye te nkata e imiet, nereu olaisiaayiani lenye eeta empalai nabolo te nkaina enye.

Ore tiatua ina palai neigero, ajo, “Etolimuoki tiatua iloshon, netejo sii Geshem neijia, nchere ore iyie o Lyahudi nintobiritata pee iserriserre ina pee ishetitata esuntai, naa ijo pee iyaku olaiguanani lenye te risioroto eina limunoto.
Itegelua sii iloibonok pee eibalie aalimu mbaa naaipirta Yerusalem, ‘Etii olaiguanani Yuda.’ Ore naa taata kelikini olaiguanani te risioroto e kulo rorei. Ore naa taata wou matoning'oto.”
Nairriwaki nanu olkilikuai ajoki, “A'a, ore nena baa nijoito netaasate, amu iyie oipirua ninche too ndamunot inono.”
Amu keyieu apa pooki neiture iyiook, edamu aajo, “Keidim inkaik enye aatalepori neitiak esiaai, nemeitokini aas” kake ore iyie na Ai ntagolo iyie inkaik aainei.

Ore apa pee alo enkaji e Shemaia olayioni le Delaia, olayioni le Mehatabel, apa oikenoyioki, nejo ninye, “Manototo iyiook tenebo tiatua enkaji e Nkai, tiatua ewueji sinyati, nikinken nkikeneta e nkaji e Nkai; amu aikipuonu ninche aar iyie tua, kewarie kipuonu ninche aar iyie tua.”
Kake atiaaka nanu ninye, “Kaisik ailanyisho to ltung'ani laaijo nanu? Ijo iyie kaitajeu enkishui ai tenalo aisudori tiatua enkaji e Nkai. Maas nanu ina.”
Nayiolou nanu aitisip, nadol ajo eitu eirriu Enkai ninche, kake eibalunye ninye enaibon pee aagilunore nanu, te nkaraki naigero Tobia o Sanbalat ninye.
Te nkaraki ena bae apa eigeroki ninye pee aaitukureti mataasa eng'oki tena oitoi, naatumoki ninche aaishoo enkarna torrono ejo pee aaitongu.
Tadamu Tobia o Sanbalat, na Ai ai te risioroto e kuna baa naataasa ninche o enkoiboni sii naji No-adia o lelo kulikae oibonok laayieu naaitukuret.
Eidipe apa ina suntai te nkolong e tikitam o miet o lapa oji Elul, too nkolong'i onom oaare.
Ore pee ening ilmang'ati lang pooki ina, neirut iloshon pooki oomanita iyiook, neibung oloputukunyi kitok amu etumusutuo aajo etaasaki ena siaai te retoto e Nkai ang.
Ore ake sii apa te nena olong'i, eirriwaitie ilkituaak le Yuda mpala aairriwaki Tobia, neirriwaki sii ninye Tobia ninche mpala.
Amu ore apa iltung'ana kumok te Yuda neinosakinote olmumai o ninye, amu olaputani apa ninye le Shekania olayioni le Ara: naa olayioni lenye Yehohanan apa oyama entito e Meshulam, olayioni le Berekia.
Eimakita sii apa nkiaasin sidain te dukuya nanu, nepuo aaliki ninye irorei latejo. Naairriwaki Tobia mpala ejo pee aaiture.
Ore apa pee eidipayu esuntai natipika nkikeneta oo nchomito, neidipaki aategelu ilarripok loo nchomito o laranyak o Lawi,
naisho nanu olalashe lai Hanani o Hanania meitasheiki Yerusalem amu oltung'ani apa oisiligayu neure Enkai alang ilkumok.

Najoki nanu ninche, “Emincho ake nchomito e Yerusalem eboli ometaba anaa neilepu enkolong; naa ore eton eitashe aarripisho nchoo ninche eiken nepik isekenke ooikenieki nchomito. Entegelu ilarripok tiatua lelo oomanya Yerusalem, neitashe ake pooki ng'ae te rishata enye, neipirare ake oltung'ani enkaji enye.”
Aisapuk apa ina anasa nelala, kake ore iltung'ana ootii atua naa kuti nemetii nkajijik naaidipaki aateshet.
Nepik apa Enkai ndamunot aainei pee aiturrur ilkituaak o larikok o ltung'ana pee eiger pooki anaa ntipati oo lmareita, lelo apa ootang'asa aapuonu, natum nanu eigeroki aaiko nji:
Iltung'ana lo lkerenket kulo apa ooetuo eing'uaa eyararoto e lelo apa ootaarayie Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon nenap aya, etorrinyunye ninche Yerusalem o Yuda nelo ake pooki ng'ae enkang enye.
Eetuo apa ninche tenebo Serubabel o Yeshua o Nehemia o Asaria o Raamia o Nahamani o Mordekai o Bilshan o Misparet o Bigfai o Nehum o Baana. Ore esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel:
lelo ayiok le Parosh, naa nkalifuni are o iip nabo o ntomoni naapishana oaare.
Ore ilayiok le Shefatia naa iip uni o ntomoni naapishana oaare.
Ore ilayiok le Ara, naa iip ile o onomm oaare.
Ore ilayiok le Pahat Moab, aa taa ilayiok le Yeshua o Yoab, naa nkalifuni are o iip isiet o tomon o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onom o oong'uan.
Ore ilayiok le Setu naa iip isiet o artam o miet.
Ore ilayiok le Sakai, naa iip naapishana o ntomoni ile.
Ore ilayiok le Binui, naa iip ile o artam o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Bebai naa iip ile o tikitam o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Asgad, naa nkalifuni are o iip uni o tikitam o are.
Ore ilayiok le Adonikan naa iip ile o ntomoni ile oopishana.
Ore ilayiok le Bigfai naa nkalifuni are o ntomoni naapishana.
Ore ilayiok le Adin naa iip ile o onom o miet.
Ore ilayiok le Ater, a taa ile Hesekia naa ntomoni naaudo o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Hashum naa iip uni o tikitam o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Besai, naa iip uni o tikitam o ong'uan.
Ore ilayiok le Harif naa iip o tomon oaare.
Ore ilayiok le Gibeon naa ntomoni naaudo o miet.
Ore iltung'ana le Betlehem o Netofa naa iip o ntomoni isiet o isiet.
Ore iltung'ana le Anatot naa iip o tikitam o isiet.
Ore iltung'ana le Bet-asmapet naa artam oaare.
Ore iltung'ana le Kiriat-yearim, Kepira o Beerot, naa iip naapishana o artam o kuni.
Ore iltung'ana le Rama o Geb, naa iip ile o tikitam o obo.
Ore iltung'ana le Mikmas naa iip o tikitam o are.
Ore iltung'ana le Betel o Ai, naa iip o tikitam okuni.
Ore iltung'ana le nkae Nebo naa onom o are.
Ore ilayiok le likae oji Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onom o ong'uan.
Ore ilayiok le Harim, naa iip uni o tikitam.
Ore ilayiok le Yeriko naa iip uni o artam o miet.
Ore ilayiok le Lod, Hadid o Ono, naa iip naapishana o tikitam o obo.
Ore ilayiok le Senaa naa nkalifuni naapishana o iip naaudo o tomoni uni.
Ore ilapolosak: lelo ayiok le Yedaia aa taa enkaji e Yeshua, naa iip naaudo o ntomoni naapishana o okuni.
Ore ilayiok le Imer, naa enkalifu nabo o onom o are.
Ore ilayiok le Pashur, naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o artam o oopishana.
Ore ilayiok le Harim naa enkalifu nabo o tomon oopishana.
Ore Ilawi: lelo ayiok le Yeshua, aa taa ile Kadmiel loo layiok le Hedefa, naa ntomoni naapishana o ong'uan.
Ore ilaranyak lelo ayiok le Asaf, naa iip nabo o artam o isiet.
Ore ilarripok loo nchomito: lelo ayiok le Shalum, ilayiok le Ater, lelo ayiok le Talmon, lelo ayiok le Akub, lelo ayiok le Hatita, lelo ayiok le Shobai, naa iip nabo o tomoni uni o isiet.
Ore lelo aisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, lelo ayiok le Siha, lelo ayiok le Hasufa, lelo ayiok le Taabaot,
lelo ayiok le Keros, lelo ayiok le Sia, lelo ayiok le Padon
lelo ayiok le Lebana, lelo ayiok le Hagaba lelo ayiok le Shalmai,
lelo ayiok le Hanan, lelo ayiok le Gidel, lelo ayiok le Gahar,
lelo ayiok le Reia, lelo ayiok le Resin, lelo ayiok le Nekoda,
lelo ayiok le Gesam, lelo ayiok le Usa, lelo ayiok le Pasea,
lelo ayiok le Besai, lelo ayiok le Meunim, lelo ayiok le Nefushesim,
lelo ayiok le Bakbuk, lelo ayiok le Hakufa, lelo ayiok le Hashur,
lelo ayiok le Bashit, lelo ayiok le Mehida, lelo ayiok le Harsha,
lelo ayiok le Barkos lelo ayiok le Sisera, lelo ayiok le Tema,
lelo ayiok le Nesia, lelo ayiok le Hatifa.
Ore ilayiok loo sinkan le Solomon, ilayiok le Sotai, ilayiok le Soferet, ilayiok le Persida,
ilayiok le Yaala, ilayiok le Darkon, ilayiok le Gidel,
ilayiok le Shefatia, ilayiok le, Hatil, ilayiok le Pokeret Lasebaim, lelo ayiok le Amon.
Ore isinkan pooki le nkaji e Nkai o sinkan loo layiok le Solomon pooki naa iip uni o ntomoni naaudo oaare.
Kulo oodukino apa lelo ooetuo eing'uaa Telmela, Telhasha, Keurub, Adon, o Imer, kake meidim apa ninche aaibalie ilmareita loo loo menye aashu ineeikino ninche, tenaa ke ltung'ana le Israel ninche.
Ilayiok le Delaia, ilayiok le Tobia, ilayiok le Nekoda, naa iip ile o artam oaare.
Ore sii ilapolosak: lelo ayiok le Hobaia, lelo ayiok le Hakos, ilayiok le Barsilai, (laa ninye apa oyama entito nabo too ntoyie e Barsilai le Gilead neaku ninche eipotieki).
Eing'orutua kulo enkigeroto oo nkarn enye tenebo lelo ooigeroki too lmareita, kake eitu etumi teine, neaku etundung'oyioki too lapolosak aajo keiduruk;
etiaaka olgafanai ninche pee mejing ninche enkinosata eina daa sinyati aisul, ometaba anaa nedumunye olapolosani oata Urim o Tummim.
Ore apa eumata pooki tenebo naa nkalifuni artam oaare o iip uni o ntomoni ile
metii isinkan lenye lewa o sinkan enye ng'oruo, nera apa ninche nkalifuni naapishana o iip uni o ntomoni ile o opishana; neeta apa ninche ilaranyak iip are o artam o miet, ilewa o ng'oruo.
Ore mbartan enye naa iip naapishana o tomoni uni o ile. Ore inyumpui enye naa iip are o artam o miet.
Ore ntamesin enye naa iip ong'uan o tomoni uni o miet. Ore isirkon lenye naa nkalifuni ile o iip naapishana o tikitam.

Ore apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye neishooyo nkishoorot te nkaraki esiaai. Eishooyie olgafanai apik olchumati nkiloi isiet e saabu o ng'irran onom o lkilani loo lapolosak iip imiet o tomoni uni.
Ore ilkulikae oora ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye neishooyo aapik olchumati le siaai saabu nkiloi iip o ntomoni ile o miet o enkosholai nkiloi enkalifu nabo o iip are o onom.
Ore ilkulikae tung'ana neishooyo saabu nkiloi iip nabo o ntomoni ile o isiet o nkiloi iip nabo o artam e nkosholai o lkilani ntomoni ile oopishana loo lapolosak.

Neaku ore ilapolosak, lelo le Lawi o larripok loo nchomito o laranyak o embata oo ltung'ana o embata oo sinkan le nkaji e Nkai o Siraeli pooki; netoni too nkang'itie enye. Ore pee ebau olapa liopishana, netii nkera e Israel nkang'itie enye maate.

Neiturrurro iltung'ana pooki aatiu anaa oltung'ani obo to lkurroto ooipirakinore enkishomi e Nkare. Nejoki ninche Esra ilo aigeroni pee eyau embuku oo nkitanapat e Musa apa naishoo Olaitoriani Israel.
Ore Esra ilo apolosani neyau nena kitanapat dukuya ina umata, oo lewa o ng'oruo o lelo pooki ooidim aatoning neyiolou, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa liopishana.

Neisum ninye ina kitanapata eing'orita olkurroto eipirare kishomi e Nkare eiteru tadekenya enasirie o metabaiki dama eipire enkolong, te dukuya iltung'ana lelo lewa o ng'oruo o ltung'ana pooki ooidim aatoning'u. Nening'u lelo tung'ana too nkiyiaa enye ina buku oo nkitanapat.

Neitashe Esra ilo aigeroni te nchumata ewueji oo nkeek neeika neitobira iltung'ana te nkaraki ina siaai; ore te mbata enye neitashe Matitia o Shema o Anaia o Uria o Hilkia o Maaseia te nkaina enye e tatene. Neitashe Pedaia o Mishael o Malkija o Hashum o Hashbadana o Sakaria o Meshulam te nkaina enye e kedianye.
Nebol Esra ina buku te dukuya iltung'ana pooki, amu etii apa ninye shumata iltung'ana pooki. Ore ake pee ebol ina buku neitashe iltung'ana pooki.
Neisis Esra Olaitoriani, ina Ai kitok, newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, “Eesai, Eesai,” eilepie inkaik enye; neirrug ninche ilukuny enye neserem Olaitoriani eitabaiki nkomomi enye enkop.

Ore sii Yeshua o Bani o Sherebia o Yamin o Akub o Shabetai o Hodia o Maaseia o Kelita o Asariaf o Yosabad o Hanan o Pelaia lelo apolosak neretu iltung'ana aaitoning'u nkitanapat, ina kata etii iltung'ana iwuejitin enye.
Neisum ninche ina buku, natii nkitanapat e Nkai, aaibalie, neitobiraki neaku etoning'utuo iltung'ana enkisumata.

Ore Nehemia laa ninye apa olgafanai o Esra ilo apolosani naa olaigeroni o Lawi laa ninche ooiteng'en iltung'ana, nejoki iltung'ana pooki, “Ore ena olong naa aisinyati to Laitoriani Enkai inyi; emisinanuo niminchirishiri.” Amu eishira apa iltung'ana pooki ina kata pee ening irorei loo nkitanapat.

Neitoki ninye ajoki ninche, “Enchom iwuejitin, enosa ntokitin naapir, niokioko enaisho oo sabibu namelok nirriwakiki erubata ilo leitu eitobirakini toki, amu ore ena olong naa aisinyati to laitoriani, nimisinanuonuo ntae, amu enchipai o Laitoriani ninye engolon inyi.”
Kaae neitigir Ilawi iltung'ana pooki, ejo, “Entigirata, amu ore ena olong naa aisinyati; emisinanuo.”
Nepuo iltung'ana pooki iwuejitin enye aadaa neokisho, neirriwaa irubat, neitobir osirua kitok le nchipai, amu etoning'utuo ninche lelo rorei ooibalakinyeki ninche.
Ore te nkolong e are, ore ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, too ltung'ana pooki, tenebo ilapolosak o Lawi, nepuonu tenebo enetii Esra ilo aigeroni pee etum aaiteng'enuoto irorei loo nkitanapat.
Netum ninche eigeroki tiatua nkitanapat nchere, eitanapa apa Olaitoriani Musa pee etoni iltung'ana too lng'oborri to sirua to lapa liopishana,

neji pee elimuni aaibalie too nkang'itie enye pooki o te Yerusalem, entejo, “Empang'a enchom ndoinyo niyauu ilng'osil lo loirien o loirien le ntim o lng'osil o ltuka, o kulikae keek eeta mbenek pee eitainyeki ilng'oborri, anaa enaingeroki.”

Neaku eshomo iltung'ana neyau ninche, neitobiraki ate ilng'oborri ore ake oltung'ani neitushur olng'obor lenye o lgoriet lenye, o lgorieti le nkaji e Nkai, o lkurroto otii kishomi e Nkare o lkurroto otii kishomi e Efraim.

Ore ina umata pooki e lelo apa ootorrinyunye te yararoto neitobir ilng'oborri nebik too lng'oborri amu ore ebaiki nkolong'i e Yeshua olayioni le Nuni ometabaiki ina olong eitu aekata eas iltung'ana le Israel ina. Netii apa enchipai sapuk.

Ore too nkolong'i pooki, ebaiki enkolong e dukuya o metabaiki enkolong nabayie, neisum ninye ina buku oo nkitanapat e Nkai. Neibung ninche osirua nkolong'i naapishana; ore te nkolong e isiet neibung'i eumata nasinya, te risioroto eina kiguana.
Ore apa te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan ele apa, neiturrurro iltung'ana le Israel te eenata empukoroto neishop ilkuniyiani, nepik enterit ilukuny enye.
Nekepu ate iltung'ana le Israel aalam iltung'ana leeiking'a, neitashe aaibalie ing'ok enye o entorroni oo loo menye.
Neitashe ninche te wueji enye neisum embuku oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai enye te nkolong e ong'uan: ore tiae rishata e ong'uan nelimu ninche aaibalie ing'ok enye, neserem Olaitoriani Enkai enye.
Ore too nkedeta oo Lawi neitashe Yeshua o Bani o Kadmeil o Shebania o Buni o Sherebia o Bani o Kenani; nebuaku ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

Neitoki Ilawi o Yeshua o Kadmiek o Bani o Hashabneia o Sherebia o Hodia o Shebania o Petahia aajo, “Entasho esisa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, ntarasi o ntarasi. Meisisi enkarna ino kitok neyanyiti oleng too mayianat o te nkisisa.”

Nejo Esra: “Iyie Olaitoriani, iyie ake openy; iyie oitayio keper, o lororani pooki le keper, enkop o pooki naatii oriong enkop; naaiposha o pooki naatii atua ninche, igolie iyie ninche pooki; naa iyie eserem olorora pooki le shumata.
Iyie Olaitoriani, ina Ai nategelua Abraham niyau ninye aitupuku te Uri, oo Lkaldayo ninchoo ninye enkarna ajo Abraham;

nidol iyie ajo keisiligayu oltau lenye te dukuya iyie, nintobir iyie o ninye osotua lo lning'o pee incho eishoi enye enkop oo Lkanaan; o enoo Ihiti o ene Amori o enoo Lperisi, o enoo Lyebusi o enoo Lgirshi, nintabayie iyie ina kisiligata ino, amu ira iyie asipani.
“Nitoduaa apa iyie osina loo loo papa lang te Misiri nining enkomono enye te Enaiposha Nanyokie.

Niaas iyie nkitoduaat o mbaa e nking'asia agilunore Farao o sinkan lenyena pooki o ltung'ana pooki le nkop enye. Amu iyiolo iyie ajo etaasa apa ninche mbaa e nkinyala too loo papa, nintobiraki iyie kewan enkarna, anaa enatiu taata.
Nitirisha iyie enaiposha te dukuya ninche, neaku eshomo ninche aaim empolos e naiposha te nkop natoyio; ninturraa iyie lelo oomirita ninche anang'aki enguton, anaa osoit onang'akini enkare kitok.
Ore te ng'ape e nkatampoi nirikoo iyie ninche dama, ore te ng'ape e nkima nirikoo ninche te nkewarie, pee ilang'ilang'aki ninche ina oitoi naaim.
Itadowuo apa iyie alotu enchumata o ldoinyo le Sinai, nirorie ninche itii keper nincho ninche nkikoot sidain o nkitanapat naasipa, o nkiguanat supati.
Nintayiolo iyie ninche Sabato ino sinyati nintanap ninche nkitanapat o nkikoot o enkitanapata aimunye Musa osinka lino.

“Inchoo iyie ninche imukateni naaing'uaa keper te nkaraki esumash enye, niyaki ninche enkare naing'uaa endapidapoi te nkaraki enkure enye. Nijoki iyie ninche meshomo aaya ina kop apa ninosie olmumai pee incho ninche.
Kake ore ninche o loo papa netaasa mbaa o lwuasa neitagol ilukuny enye, neitu eiruk inkitanapat.

Etanyaita ninche ening, neitu eshilaa nena baa e nking'asia apa nitaasa tiatua ninche. Kake eitagolo ninche ilukuny enye negelu olarikoni pee errinyo aapuo esinkaisho enye te Misiri. Kake ira iyie Enkai nasioki apalaki, osupat, neeta olng'ur, nemesioki agoro nebik te nyorrata nauno neitu iyie inturaa ninche.
Ore doi ninye apa pee eitobiraki ate olashe le saabu nashola nejo, “Ena ninye Enkai inyi apa nayawua intae ailepunye te Misiri,” neas mbaa kituaak e morore.

Ore iyie to lng'ur lino kitok, neitu inturraa ninche tiong'ota. Ore ina ng'ape e nkatampoi apa natorikoyie ninche te nkoitoi, neitu elo aing'uaa ninche te ndama, neitu elo eng'ape e nkima aing'uaa ninche te nkewarie, pee eitawang enkoitoi enye napuo aaim ninche.
Inchoo iyie Enkiyang'et supat meiteng'ena ninche, neitu iyie imbooyo mana ino amitiki ninche enya. Nincho ninche enkare te nkaraki enkure enye.
Ilarin artam iyie intotio ninche ti ong'ata, neitu elau toki neitu emuta nkilani enye neitu ejeyu inkejek enye.
“Ninchoo iyie ninche nkitoriat oo loreren nioriki iyie ninche pooki shoto. Neaku ewaita ninche ina kop e Sihon olaiguanani le Heshbon o enkop e Oog olaiguanani le Bashan,
Itoponayie iyie eishoi enye aitaba anaa ilakir le keper, nitorikuo ninche atua ina kop apa nitolikio loo menye pee ejing aamany.

Metaa eshomo ina ishoi enye aaya ina kop, nipik iyie lelo oomanya ina kop abori enkitoria enye, lelo Kanaani, ninchooyo ninche apik inkaik enye, tenebo ilaiguanak lenye o ltung'ana leina kop. Pee etum aaitaasa ninche anaa enayieu.

Neibung ninche nena anas enye naasheta sunta o enkop sidai. Neya nkajijik naabore ntokitin sidain, o lchorroi ooturo, o nkurman oo sabibu, o loirienito o lkeek loo lng'anayio kumok, nenya ninche neraposho nepiru neshipayu ninche te supatisho ino.

Ore ake eyia eisero ninche nikigolong'aki iyie, nenang'aa nkitanapat inono aainyaaya oriong, near iloibonok linono metuata, laa ninche apa ooikoo ejo pee errinyu ninche enitii, neas ninche mbaa sapuki e morore.

Ore te nkaraki ina inchooyie iyie ninche apik inkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, ooisilisilo ninche, ore teina kata enye o sina, kinchirakitia ninche iyie, nining iyie ninche itii keper. Ore te risioroto o lng'ur lino kitok ninchoo iyie ninche olaitajeunoni oitajeu ninche aitayu te nkaina oo lmang'ati lenye.

Kake ore eidipa ninche aayagie neitoki ninche aas entorroni too nkonyek inono, nintoki iyie aiturraa ninche apik inkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, pee atum aaitoria ninche. Kake ore ake eyia teneibelekenya ninche nikinchiraki iyie, nining iyie ninche itii shumata, naa katitin kumok itokordua iyie ninche te risioroto o lng'ur lino.

Inkoo apa iyie ninche ijo pee itum atorrinyoki ninche nkitanapat inono. Kake etawuasate apa ninche, neitu eibung nkitanapat inono, kake etaasa ninche eng'oki too nkiguanat inono, naa ninche eishuyie oltung'ani teneibung, neisho ninche oriong, neitagol ilukuny enye, neany ening.
Too larin kumok iting'iriakine iyie ninche, ninkok ninche te Nkiyang'et ino, iimunye iloibonok linono; ore ake eyia eitu ninche ening. Ore te nkaraki ina inchooyie iyie ninche apik inkaik oo loreren.
Ore ake eyia te nkaraki olng'ur lino kitok eitu iyie iishie ninche anaa inturraa ninche; amu ira Enkai supat naata olng'ur.

Ore naa taata na Ai ang, Enkai kitok magilani naitureisho, naibung osotua o enyorrata nauno, mincho kuna golikinot naaetuo shumata iyiook elioyu aa kutiti te iyie o shumata ilaiguanak lang, o lkituaak lang o lapolosak lang o loibonok lang, o loo papa, o shumata iltung'ana linono pooki ebaiki enkata oo laiguanak le Siria, o metabaiki ena olong eaku entoki kiti te iyie.
Ore ake eyia itaa iyie asipani te nena pooki naaetuo shumata iyiook, amu itaasishe iyie te sipata nikitaasishote iyiook te ntorroni.
Ore ilaiguanak lang o lkituaak lang, o lapolosak lang o loo papa, neitu eibung inkitanapat inono, o nkikoot inono ninchoo iyie ninche.

Eitu ninche kisiaai iyie te nkitoria enye, naa ore te supatisho ino kitok ninchoo iyie ninche, o te nkop sidai nalala nitipika iyie dukuya ninche, neitu ninche errinyunye aaing'uaa isiaaitin enye torrok.
Idol taata ajo eikira iyiook irrindiki ena olong; tiatua ena kop apa ninchoo loo papa pee eshipakino ilng'anayio lenyena o nkishoorot enyena sidain, ng'ura, kira iyiook irrindiki.

Ore ilng'anayio lenyena nenya lelo aiguanak apa litipika shumata iyiook te nkaraki ing'ok ang; eeta ake sii lelo aiguanak engolon naitoreyie iseseni lang, o nkishu ang, pee eitaas anaa enayieu, nikitii iyiook osina kitok.”
Ore te nkaraki kuna pooki, aikintobir iyiook olning'o lo sotua nikinger. Ore ilkituaak lang, o lawi lang, o lapolosak lang, nepik ilmishiren lenye.
Ore apa lelo ootipika olmishire lenye naa Nehemia ilo gafanai, olayioni le Hekalia o Sedekia,
o Seraia o Asaria o Yeremia,
o Pashur o Amaria o Malkija,
o Hatush o Shebania o Maluk,
o Harim o Meremot o Obadia,
o Daniel o Gineton o Baruk,
o Meshulam o Abijia o Mijomin,
o Maasia o Bilgai o Shemaia. Kulo apa ninche ilapolosak.
Ore Ilawi naa: Yeshua olayioni le Asania o Binui loo layiok le Henadad o Kadimiel,
o lalashera lenye o Shebania o Hodia o Kelita o Pelaia o Hanan,
o Mika o Rehob o Hashabia,
o Sakur o Sherebia o Shebania,
o Hodia o Bani o Bininu.
Ore ilaiguanak loo iltung'ana naa Parosh o Pahat Moab, o Elam o Satu o Bani,
o Buni o Asgad o Bebai,
o Adonija o Bigfai o Adin,
o Ater o Hesekia o Asur,
o Hodia o Hashum o Besai,
o Harif o Anatot o Nebai,
o Magpiash o Meshulam o Hesir,
o Meshesapel o Sadok o Yadua
o Pelatia o Hanan o Hanaia o
Hoshea o Hanania, o Hashub,
o Halohesh o Pilha o Shobek,
o Rehum o Hashabana o Maaseia,
o Ahia o Hanan o Anan,
o Maluk o Harim o Baana.

Ore ilkulikae tung'ana, ilapolosak o Lawi o larripok le kishomi o laranyak o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai o lelo pooki ootekeputua ate aalam iloreren le nena kuapi, aaibelekenyakino nkitanapat e Nkai, tenebo inkituaak enye o layiok lenye o ntoyie enye, lelo pooki oata eng'eno o eyiolounoto,

neibung'are ilalashera lenye o lkituaak lenye, nejing ninche oldeket o lmumai pee eibung inkitanapat e Nkai apa naaishoruaki aaimunye Musa osinka le Nkai pee esipu neas inkitanapat pooki o Laitoriani, Olaitoriani lang o nkikoot enyena o nkiguanat enyena.
Mikincho iyiook intoyie ang meyama kulikae oreren, nimikiyamaki iyiook ilayiok lang ninche:

naa teneyau iltung'ana lena kop ntokitin naamiri o entapa e pooki pukunoto te nkolong e Sabato pee emir, nimikinyiang'u iyiook te ninche, te nkolong e Sabato anaa te nkolong sinyati; nimikitur iyiook nkurman to lari liopishana, nikipalaa pooki sile.
Kinteleikitia sii ate olola pee kintalak ate te pooki ari erubata e uni e shekeli te nkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai

te nkaraki emukate nasinya o lasar le ntapa le anaake o lasar opejori le anaake o Sabatoni o lapaitin ng'ejuko o siruai gelunot o ntokitin sinyat o lasarri le ng'oki ooitobirieki olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki Israel o te nkaraki esiaai pooki e Nkai ang.

Kitoosho sii enkukuo, ilapolosak o Lawi o ltung'ana, te nkaraki nkiri olasar loo lkeek, pee eyauni atua enkaji e Nkai ang, te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo papa, too nkatitin naategeluaki, te pooki ari. Pee einoki te nchumata o lperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ang anaa enaigero too nkitanapat.
Kitudung'okitio iyiook ate, pee kiyau ilng'anayio le dukuya te nkop ang o lng'anayio le dukuya le pooki shani, te pooki ake ari, enkaji o Laitoriani.

Nikiyau sii atua enkaji e Nkai ang, aayaki lelo apolosak ooisiaaisho tiatua enkaji e Nkai ang, ilkikaunot lang o lkikaunot loo nkishu ang, anaa enaigero too nkitanapat o lkikaunot loo nkishu ang o loo ntare ang.

Nikiyaki sii ilapolosak ina tapa ang e dukuya e nkikesare o nkishoorot ang, o lng'anayio le pooki shani o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata nikiya ilgilat le nkaji e Nkai ang, nikiyaki Ilawi ematua e tomon naing'uaa nkurman ang, amu Ilawi oosotu imatuan e tomon, too nkang'itie ang pooki.
Ore olapolosani olayioni le Aron, naa keetii tenebo Ilawi ina kata nang'amu imatuan e tomon neyau Ilawi ematua e tomon oo matuan e tomon e nkaji e Nkai ang nepik ilgilat o mpechen.

Amu keyau iltung'ana le Israel o layiok le Lawi nkishoorot e ntapa o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata atua lelo gilat, ine netii imasaa e wueji sinyati, o lapolosak ooisiaaisho o larripok le kishomi o laranyak. Mikipalaa iyiook enkaji e Nkai ang.
Ore apa ilarikok loo ltung'ana netoni te Yerusalem; ore ilkulikae tung'ana, neosh enkukuo, pee eyau oltung'ani obo te tomon meeu amany Yerusalem ina anasa sinyati, nebik lelo ooudo te kulie ang'itie.
Nemayian apa iltung'ana lelo pooki ootonyorraitie aatoni te Yerusalem.

Kulo apa ilkituaak loo lkerenketi ootamanya Yerusalem; kake ore too nkang'itie e Yuda, etii ake pooki ng'ae enkang enye neton tiatua imasaa enyena: ile Israel o lapolosak o Lawi o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai o le ishoi o laisiaayiak le Solomon.

Netii apa Yerusalem embata oo layiok le Yuda o layiok le Benchamen. Ore too layiok le Yuda naa Ataia olayioni le Usia, olayioni le Sekaria, olayioni le Amaria, olayioni le Shefatia, olayioni le Mahalalel, loo layiok le Peres:
o Maaseia olayioni le Baruk olayioni le Kolhose olayioni le Hasaia, olayioni le Aidaya, olayioni le Yairib, olayioni le Sakaria, olayioni le Shilonit.
Ore ilayiok pooki le Peres apa oomanya Yerusalem naa iip ong'uan o ntomoni ile o isiet, iltung'ana yiolot oopi.
Naa kulo ilayiok le Benchamen: Salu olayioni le Meshulam, olayioni le Yoed, olayioni le Pedaia, olayioni le Kolaia, olayioni le Maaseia, olayioni le Itiel, olayioni le Yeshai.
Nesujaki ninye Gebai o Saalai, iltung'ana iip naaudo o tikitam o isiet.
Yoel olayioni le Sikri apa olaitasheikinoni lenye, naa Yuda olayioni le Hasenua oliare te nkitoria ena anasa.
Ore too lapolosak naa: Yedaia olayioni le Yairib o Yakin,
o Seraia olayioni le Hilkia, olayioni le Meshulam, olayioni le Sadok, olayioni le Merairiot, olayioni le Ahitab, olaitasheikinoni le nkaji e Nkai.

Ore ilalashera lenye oaas esiaai eina aji naa, iip isiet o tikitam o are; ore Adai olayioni le Yeroham, olayioni le Pelalia, olayioni le Amsi, olayioni le Sekaria, olayioni le Pashur, olayioni le Malkija,
o lalashera lenyena, nena lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye naa iip are o artam o are; o Amashai, olayioni le Asarel, olayioni le Asai, olayioni le Meshilemot, olayioni le Imer,
o lalashera lenye, lelo tung'ana magil yiolot, iip o tikitam o isiet; ore olaitasheikinoni lenye naa Sibdiel olayioni le Hagedolin.
Ore too Lawi: naa Shemaia olayioni le Hashub, olayioni le Asrikam, olayioni le Hashabia, olayioni le Buni;
o Shabetai o Yosabad, loo lkituaak loo lawi laa ninche apa ooitasheiki esiaai e oriong e nkaji e Nkai;

o Matania olayioni le Mika olayioni le Sabdi, olayioni le Asaf, laa ninye oiterua enkishooroto e nashe te nkomono o Bakukia laa ninye oliare too lalashera lenyena; o Abda olayioni le Shamaua, olayioni le Falal, olayioni le Yedutum.
Ore Ilawi pooki teina anasa sinyati naa iip are o ntomoni isiet o ong'uan.
Ore ilarripok le kishomi naa: Akub o Talmon o lalashera lenye, laa ninche apa oorrip nchomito, naa iip nabo o ntomoni napishana o are.
Ore ilkulikae Siraeli o lapolosak o Lawi netii nkang'itie e Yuda, etii ake oltung'ani enjung'ore enye.
Kake ore ilaisiaayiak le Nkaji e Nkai nemanya Ofel; naa Siha o Gispa apa ooitasheiki ilaisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai.

Ore apa olaitasheikinoni loo Lawi te Yerusalem naa Usi olayioni le Bani, Olayioni le Hashabia, olayioni le Matania, olayioni le Mika loo layiok le Asaf, lelo aranyak, ooitasheiki esiaai e nkaji e Nkai.
Amu etii apa enkitanapata naing'uaa olaiguanani naipirta ninche o enkitobirata oo laranyak anaa enaiyieuni te pooki olong.
Naa Petahia olayioni le Meshesabel, loo layiok le Sera olayioni le Yuda, ninye apa olaretoni lo laiguanani too mbaa pooki naaipirta iltung'ana.
Ore tialo nkang'itie, etamanya apa embata oo ltung'ana le Yuda Kiriat-arba o nkang'itie enyena o Dibon o nkang'itie enyena o Yekabseel o nkang'itie enyena o
Yeshua o Molada o Betber Betpeler o
Harshulal o Beer-sheba o nkang'itie enyena
o Siklag o Mekona o nkang'itie enyena,
o Enrimon o Sora o Yemut,
o Sanoa o Adulam nkang'itie enyena, o Lakish o nkong'at enyena, a Aseka o nkong'at enyena. Neaku etipika apa ninche ilng'oborri ebaiki Beer-sheba o metabaiki oerata le Hinom.
Ore sii ninche iltung'ana le Benchamen nemany ebaiki Geba neito idia alo, te mbata e Mikmash o Aija o Betel o nkang'itie enyena,
o Anotot o Noab o Anania, o
Hasor o Rama o Gitaim,
o Hadid o Seboim o Nebalot,
o Lod o Ono ilo erata loo laguatak.
Ore ilkulikae turrurri loo Lawi te Yuda neshulare Benchamen.
Kulo ninche ilapolosak o Lawi apa ooetuo tenebo Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel o Yeshua: o Seraia o Yeremia o Esra,
o Amaria o Maluk o Hatush,
o Shekemia o Rehum o Meremot,
o Ido o Ginetoi o Abija,
o Mijamin o Maadia o Bilga,
o Shemia o Yoiarib o Yedaia,
o Sulu o Amok o Hilkia o Yedaia. Kulo ninche apa ilkituaak loo lapolosak o lalashera lenye too nkolong'i e Yeshua.
Ore too Lawi; naa Yeshua o Binui o Kadmiel o Sherebia o Yuda o Matania, laa ore tenebo ilalashera lenyena, naa ninye oitasheiki isinkolioitin le nkishooroto e nashe.
O Bakbukia o Uno, neitashe ilalashera lenye aaipirakinore ninche te nkisiaayiare.
Naa Yeshua apa menye le Yoiakim, naa Yoiakim menye le Eliashib naa Elishiab menye le Yoiada,
naa Yoiada menye le Yonatan, naa Yonatan menye le Yadua.
Ore apa too nkolong'i e Yoiakim, netii ilapolosak oora lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye: te Seraia o te Meraia o te Yeremia o te Hanania.
Ore te Esra naa Meshulam; ore te Amaria naa Yehohanan;
ore te Maluki naa Yonatan; ore te Shebania naa Yosef:
ore te Harm naa Adna; ore te Merariot naa Helkai;
ore te Ido naa Sekaria; ore te Gineton naa Meshulam;
ore te Abija naa Sikri; ore te Miniamin o te Moadia naa Piltai;
ore te Bilga, naa Shamua; ore te Shemaia naa Yehonatan,
ore Yoiarib naa Matenai; ore te Yedaia naa Usi,
ore te Salai naa Kalai; ore te Amok naa Eber,
ore te Hilkia naa Hashabia; ore te Yedaia, naa Natanel.
Ore too Lawi, apa too nkolong'i e Eliashib, o Yoiada o Yohanan o Yadua, kulo apa eigeroki metaa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye; naa ilapolosak sii o metabaiki enkitoria e Dario le Pasia.
Ore ilayiok le Lawi, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, neigeroki te mbuku oo ntepen, o metabaiki nkolong'i e Yohanan olayioni le Eliashib.

Ore ilkituaak loo Lawi naa: Hashabia o Sherabia o Yeshua olayioni le Kadmiel tenebo ilalashera lenye ooipirakinore ninche, pee eisis Enkai neishooyo enashe te risioroto e nkitanapata e Daudi ilo tung'ani le Nkai pee easi aairukokino.
Matania apa o Bakbukia o Obadia o Meshulam o Talmon o Akub ninche ilarripok le kishomi ooitashe aarrip nkajijik naashumishoreki o nchomito.
Ore apa kuna baa naa too nkolong'i e Yoaikim olayioni le Yeshua olayioni le Yosadak, o too nkolong'i e Nehemia ilo balusui o Esra ilo apolosani naa olasirani.

Ore teina kitarasaroto e suntai e Yerusalem, neyauni Ilawi too wuejitin pooki meetu Yerusalem aaraposhoki ina kitisinyata te nchipai o te nkishooroto e nashe o te ranyata e oshoto oo nkinantani o enkawuo oo sinkolioitin o lwululi loo usin.
Ore nkera e lelo aranyak, neiturrurro too manyishoritin enye naamanita Yerusalem o too nkang'itie e Netofati;
neiturrurro sii te Bet-gilgal o te nkop e Geba o Asmafet; amu eteshetakita apa ate ilaranyak inkang'itie aaitaman Yerusalem.
Ore ilapolosak o Lawi neitisiny ate; neitisiny olorere o nchomito o esuntai.

Naitoki nanu aiturrurru ilkituaak le Yuda te nchumata eina suntai, nagelu ilturrurri oaare sapuki ooishooyo enashe nepuo ninche too lkererin. Nelo olturrur obo enkalo e tatene teina suntai ometabaiki kishomi e modioi.
Nesuju ninche Hoshaia o lpisiaai le lelo kituaak le Yuda,
o Asaria o Esra, o Meshulam,
o Yuda o Benchamen o Shemaia, o Yeremia,
o kulikae ayiok loo lapolosak ooata intarumpetani: Sekaria olayioni le Yonatan, olayioni le Shemaia, olayioni le Matamia, olayioni le Mikaia, olayioni le Sakur, olayioni le Asaf;
o ltung'ana lenye, Shemaia o Asarel o Milalai o Gilalai o Maai o Natanel o Yuda o Hanani, eeta nkinantani oo sinkolioitin e Daudi ilo tung'ani le Nkai. Ore Esra ilo aigeroni nelo te dukuya ninche.

Ore te kishomi e nchorro, neitoriori ninche aapuo te dukuya ninche aaim nkedeta e nkanasa e Daudi, te wueji neilepakinyeki esuntai, te shumata enkaji e Daudi; aapuo kishomi e Nkare te nkalo o loosaen.

Ore olikae turrur le lelo ooishooyo enashe, nepuo enkalo e kedianye, nasujaa nanu ninche tenebo olpisiaai le lelo tung'ana ootii enchumata e suntai, te nchumata o ltalet le wueji nepejishoreki o metabaiki esuntai nalala,
o metabaiki kishomi e Efraim o embata e kishomi musana o embata e kishomi o sinkirri o ltalet le Hananel o ltalet le iip o metabaiki kishomi oo nkerra. Nepuonu ninche aaitashe te kishomi oo larripok.
Metaa ore lelo turrurri pokira oaare le lelo ooishooyo enashe neitashe tiatua enkaji e Nkai. Ore nanu o lpisiaai loo nkituaak tenebo nanu;
o lapolosak, Eliakim o Maaseia o Miniamin o Makaia o Elioenai o Sekaria o Hanania, eeta ntarumpetani;
o Maaseia o Shemaia o Eleasa o Empito o Yehoahanan o Malkija o Elam o Eser. Neranyisho ilaranyak erikoo Yesrahia.
Neitayu ninche ilasarri sapuki ina olong, neshipayu amu Enkai naitishipa ninche te ng'ida sapuk; neshipa sii nkituaak o nkera. Nening'ori enchipai e Yerusalem tenelakua oleng.

Ore apa teina olong negeluni iltung'ana ooitasheiki ilgilat ooshumishoreki, oopiki nkishorunot, o lelo ng'anayio le dukuya o matuan e tomon, pee eiturrurri tiatua nena ajijik nena rubat pooki naaishiaakino too nkitanapat te nkaraki ilapolosak o Lawi, te risioroto oo nkurman e nena ang'itie; amu etishipe apa Yuda te nkaraki lelo apolosak o Lawi oisiaaishote.
Etaasa apa ninche esiaai e Nkai enye o esiaai e nkitisinyata anaa enataasa ilaranyak o larripok le kishomi, te risioroto e nkitanapata e Daudi o layioni lenye Solomon.
Amu ore apa too nkolong'i e Daudi o Asaf, tiapa, neetae olkitok loo laranyak, neetae isinkolioitin le nkisisa o enkishooroto e nashe te Nkai.

Ore Israel pooki too nkolong'i e Serubabel o too nkolong'i e Nehemia, neisho erubata e anaake lelo aranyak o larripok le kishomi; neiteng'el ninche ina rubata oo Lawi; neiteng'el ile Lawi ina rubata oo layiok le Aron.
Ore apa teina olong neisum ninche nkitanapat e Musa aaitoning olorere; netumi eigero teina buku nchere meetae Olamori aashu Olmoabui ojing aekata eumata e Nkai;
amu eitu apa ninche enang'are inkera e Israel aaisho endaa o enkare, kake eishoo ninche Balaam mpisai metigilunore ninche nedek ninche, ore ake eyia eibelekenya Enkai oldeket aitaa emayianata.
Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana ina kitanapata, nekepaa ninche aaitung'uaa Israel lelo pooki loo loreren.
Ore apa eng'or ena, ore Eliashib olapolosani laa ninye etegeluaki meitasheiki ilgilat le nkaji e Nkai ang, laa ninye sii apa oyiolore Tobia,

neitobiraki ninye Tobia olgilata olala teine apa netang'asa ninche aapik nkishoorot e ntapa, o ina orropil o masaa o matuan e tomon e ntapa o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata, naa ninche apa eishoruaki te nkitanapata meishori Ilawi, o laranyak o larripok le kishomi, o nkishoorot oo lapolosak.

Ore apa easayu kuna, nematii nanu Yerusalem, amu ore to lari le tomoni uni oaare le nkitoria e Artaserses olaiguanani le Babilon, nashomo nanu enetii olaiguanani. Ore etulusoyie enkiti rishata naomon nanu olaiguanani maaisho mashomo,
nalotu nanu Yerusalem, nairrash nanu ina torroni naitaasa Eliashib Tobia, aitobiraki ninye olgilata too lgorieti le nkaji e Nkai.
Atagore apa nanu oleng nanang'aa imasaa enkaji e Tobia aitupuku boo.
Naitoki nanu aitanapisho neitisinyi ina aji, naitoki nanu arrinyu nena masaa e nkaji e Nkai, tenebo o lasar le ntapa o enkorropil.
