Atayiolo sii ajo eitu eishori Ilawi irubat enye; metaa ore Ilawi o laranyak apa ooasisho, neisika ake pooki ng'ae alo enkurma enye.
Neaku aisikong'a nanu lelo kituaak najoki, “Kainyoo pee etung'uayioki enkaji e Nkai?” Naiturrur nanu ninche tenebo napik iwuejitin enye.
Neya Yuda imatuan e tomon e ntapa, o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata aaya nena ajijik naashumishoreki.

Nagelu nanu metaa ilashumak ooitasheiki nena ajijik naashumishoreki, Shelemia ilo apolosani o Sadok olaigeroni o Pedaia loo Lawi, ore olaretoni lenye naa Hanan olayioni le Sakur, olayioni le Matamia, amu ninche apa eisiligaki. Ore apa esiaai enye naa pee eoriki ilalashera lenye ntokitin.
Tadamuaki nanu, Enkai ai tialo ena, nimijut iyie aiwuang'ie nena kiasin aainei sidain nataasa nanu te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ai o te nkaraki enkisiaayiare enye.

Ore apa te nena olong'i, atoduaa nanu lelo tung'ana te Yuda eironyu enaisho oo sabibu too nkironyeta te nkolong e Sabato, neyau isotot le ntapa neirotoki ninche isirkon; neyau sii enaisho oo sabibu o lng'anayio loo sabibu o lng'abolo o lolan loo mpukunot pooki ooyautua ninche atua Yerusalem te nkolong e Sabato. Aikoo apa nanu ninche teina olong natimira endaa.
Ore sii iltung'ana le Tiro apa ootii ina anasa, neya isinkir o ntokitin oo mpukunot pooki naamiri, nemiraki ninche te nkolong e Sabato iltung'ana le Yuda te Yerusalem.
Naisikong nanu lelo kituaak le Yuda najoki ninche, “Kainyoo ena bae torrono niaasitata, aaisarkionie enkolong e Sabato?
Ketaasa apa iloo papaai linyi ena, naa keitu eyau Enkai ang ena torroni pooki shumata iyiook o shumata ena anasa? Ore ake eyia, iyauu intae engoro kitok shumata Israel, aaisarkionie Sabato.”

Ore ake pee eiteru amisimisu too nchomito e Yerusalem eng'or Sabato, naitanapisho nanu pee eikeni nkutukie oo nkajijik nemeboli ometulusoi Sabato. Napik nanu embata oo sinkan laainei meitasheiki nchomito, pee meetae olola oitijing'uni te nkolong e Sabato.
Ore lelo ainyiang'ak o lamirak loo mpukunot pooki neirrag auluo Yerusalem enkolong nabo anaa nkolong'i are.

Kake aikoo nanu ninche najoki ninche, “Kainyoo intae pee irragirraga tioriong e suntai? Teningiligili aaiko neijia, naibung nanu intae.” Ore ebaiki ina olong neito idia alo eitu ninche eigil aapuonu te nkolong e Sabato.
Naitanap nanu Ilawi pee eitisiny ate nepuonu aarrip nchomito, neitaa enkolong e Sabato Sinyati. Tadamu sii ena te nkaraki nanu, na Ai ai, nikileku nanu te risioroto e nkitoo e nyorrata ino.
Ore sii apa te nena olong'i, atoduaa nanu Ilyahudi ooyama nkituaak e Ashdod o Amon o Moab;
ore olpisiaai loo nkera enye neiro enkutuk e Ashdod, nemeidim ninche aairoro enkutuk e Yuda, kake keidim aairoro nkutukie e lelo tung'ana.

Nailepilepaki nanu ninche, nadek ninche, naidong kulikae lenye nayiet ilpapit lenye, nainosie ninche olmumai te nkarna e Nkai, ajoki, “Mincho iyie ntoyie inono ilayiok lenye, nimiyaki ilayiok linono ntoyie enye, nimiyamiyama intae maate.

Keitu apa eas olaiguanani Solomon eng'oki te nkaraki kuna kituaak? Ore tiatua iloshon kumok meetae olaiguanani otiu anaa ninye, naa kirotet te Nkai enye, neitaa Enkai ninye olaiguanani te shumata Israel pooki; ore ake eyia, etorikokitio inkituaak oo loreren ninye metaasa ing'ok.
Eikining naa iyiook intae nikias ena torroni sapuk aagolong'aki Enkai ang, aayam inkituaak oo loreren?”
Ore apa obo loo layiok le Yehoiada olayioni le Eliashib, ilo apolosani kitok, naa olaputani le Sanbalat le Bet-horon; ore te nkaraki ina aterewa nanu ninye aitalam kewan.
Tadamu ninche, Enkai ai, Amu eisarkionie ninche empolosare o lning'o lo sotua le mpolosare oo lawi.
Naitisiny nanu ninche te pooki toki oo loreren, naitobir mbaa naaipirta, isiaaitin oo lapolosak o Lawi, oltung'ani ake te siaai enye;
naishoru nanu ilkeek oopejorieki olasar, too rishat enye naageluno o too rishat oo lng'anayio le dukuya. Tadamuaki nanu Enkai ai, te mbae supat.
Eetae apa oltung'ani omanya enkop e Us, oji enkarna enye Yob. Naa ore apa ilo tung'ani nemeeta entioto naa oltung'ani oitashe too sipat, neure ninye Enkai oleng, neorunye aing'uaa intorrok.
Eeta apa ninye ilayiok oopishana o ntoyie uni.

Neeta apa ninye intare nkalifuni naapishana o ntamesin inkalifuni uni o lmong'i iip miet ooyietaa enchata emurt o sirkon lipong'a iip miet o sinkan kumok oleng, naa ore apa ele tung'ani meetae olkarsis olang too ltung'ana pooki lo loosaen.
Ore apa ilayiok lenyena naa kepuo aaitayu isiruai too lmareita lenye, meeta ake olemeeta enkolong enye. Neipotu inkanashera enye pokira uni meetu aadaa te nebo neokisho te nebo.

Ore ake pee elusoo inkolong'i o sirua, neinyototo Yob alo aitisiny ninche te dukuya Enkai. Naa keyooki tadekenya alo aitayu olasar opejori terishata oo layiok lenyena pooki; amu kejo apa Yob, “Ebaiki netaasa ilayiok laainei ing'ok, nedek Enkai too ltauja lenye.” Neas Yob ina anaake.
Ore te nkolong nabo nepuonu ilmalaika le Nkai dukuya olaitoriani, nelotu sii ninye Sheitani te nebo ninche.
Nejoki Olaitoriani “Kaji ing'uaa iyie?” Newaliki Sheitani Olaitoriani ajoki, “Aing'uaa ene o idie ti oriong e nkop, naing'uaa sii elototo ai e shumata o abori te shumata ninye.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Sheitani, “Itoduaa osinka lai Yob, olaa meetae likae laaijo ninye te enkop, oltung'ani lemeeta entioto neitashe too sipat, neure Enkai neorunye aing'uaa intorrok?”
Ina pee ewaliki Sheitani Olaitoriani ajoki, “Keure Yob Enkai te mpesho?
A'a keitu doi intaman ninye enkikarrata tenebo enkaji enye o pooki toki naata too nkaloli pooki? Itamayiana esiaai oo nkaik enyena, netoponari imasaa enyena aaiput ena kop.
Kake intorioi sii iyie enkaina ino tenakata iseyie nena pooki naata, naa aikidek ninye aitoriokino enkomom ino.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Sheitani, “Ore pooki naata ninye etii atua engolon ino; ninye ake enkorrok enye mintorioki enkaina ino.” Neaku eshomo Sheitani aing'uaa ine netii Olaitoriani.
Eetae apa enkolong natotona ilayiok le Yob o ntoyie enyena aadaa neok enaisho oo sabibu te nkaji olalashe lenye botor;
nelotu olkilikuai enetii Yob nejoki, “Ore duoo eturito ilmong'i enkurma nedaa isirkon te mbata enye;
nedoiki iltung'ana le Sabea, nereu ninche pooki, near isinkan ootii te nepi olalem; neaku nanu ake oisikua peyie aalotu aliki.”
Ore eton eirorita, nelotu likae nejo, “Etadowuo enkima e Nkai te shumata nepejoo intare te nebo isinkan, neidakie ninche; neaku nanu ake oisikua peyie aalotu aliki.”

Ore eton eirorita ilo, nejing'u likae nejo, “Eitautuo Ilkaldayo iltimito okuni, nepuonu aarare iyiook aaikonyaa intamesin nereu, near isinkan te nepi olalem; neaku nanu ake oisikua peyie aalotu aliki.”
Ore eton eirorita ilo, nelotu likae nejoki, “Ore ilayiok linono o ntoyie edaa duoo neok enaisho oo sabibu tenebo te nkaji olalashe lenye botor;
nelotu osiwuo sapuk odung'u olpurkel, neosh ilpijat pokira oong'uan leina aji, nesulakino ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono, near metuata pooki, neaku nanu ake openy oisikua peyie aalotu aliki.”
Ina pee edumunye Yob, nepolos olkila lenye, nebarn elukunya enye, nebatatakino enkop aserem.
Nejo ninye, atupukuo apa te nguset e yieyio maishopo naa karrinyo alo maishopo. Olaitoriani oishorua naa ninye onyaaka aya. Meisisi enkarna o Laitoriani.
Ore te kuna pooki neitu eas Yob eng'oki aashu eipotoki Enkai entorroni.
Neitokini ake aata ae olong naetuo ilmalaika le Nkai aaitoduaaya ate te dukuya Olaitoriani, nelotu sii ninye Sheitani te nebo ninche aitoduaaya kewan te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Sheitani, “Kaji doi iyie ing'uaa?” Newaliki Sheitani Olaitoriani ajoki, “Aing'uaa idie o idie te nkop, nalilita te shumata o tiabori.”

Nejoki Olaitoriani Sheitani, “Itoduaa osinka lai Yob, olaa meetae olonyaanyukie ninye te nkop o lemeeta entioto naa oltung'ani oitashe too sipat, oltung'ani oure Enkai neibelekenye aing'uaa intorrok? Eton ake eibung'ita enkirukoto enye anaa apake, hoo nikiewuo arrumoki ninye mataarare, meeta ninye enataasa.”
Ina pee ewaliki Sheitani Olaitoriani ajoki, “Olchoni to lchoni! Keitayu oltung'ani pooki toki naata te nkaraki enkishui enye.
Kake intorioi sii iyie enkaina ino tenakata, iseyie sii iyie oloito lenye o sesen lenye, naa aikimor ninye aitoriokino enkomom ino.”
Nejoki Olaitoriani Sheitani, “Ng'ura ajo, etii ninye nkaik inono enkishui enye ake miseyie.”
Metaa eshomo Sheitani aing'uaa enetii Olaitoriani, nelo aisilisil Yob apik inkirondoni torrok naang'u eiteru too ndapi oo nkejek enyena o metabaiki elukunya enye.
Neya Yob embelati e moti oo nkulupuok, nelo aton to lchala loo suut aoj kewan.
Ina pee ejoki enkitok enye, “Keton ake imbung'ita akurraki enkirukoto? Kainyoo pee midek Enkai pee itum atua.”
Kake etiaaka Yob ninye, “Iro iyie anaa nabo oo nkituaak naamoda. Aiking'amu esidai te nkaina Enkai, nimiking'amu intorrok?” Ore te kuna pooki eitu eas Yob eng'oki te nkutuk enye.

Ore ina kata pee ening ilchoreta le Yob okuni ina torroni natijing'aka Yob, nepuonu pooki eing'uaa wuejitin enye, Elifas le Teman o Bildad le Shua o Sofar le Naamat. Negelu pooki olkekun opuonu tenebo aaitobor neitagol sii.
Ore ake pee edol ninche ninye eton elakuaniki, eitu ninche eyiolou ninye; neyietu aaishir nepolos ilkilani lenye neisuaaki enterit ilukuny eing'or keper.
Netoni te nebo ninye te nkop inkolong'i ile o nkewarietin enye; nemeetae hoo obo otaboloko ninye enkutuk airorie, amu etoduaa ninche aajo ore osomit lenye naa aikitok oleng.
Ore te siadi ena, nebol Yob enkutuk enye adek enapa olong natoinyieki.
Nejo Yob:
“Inchoo ina olong apa naatoinyieki eidak, te nebo ina kewarie apa natejoki, ‘Kenutae enkayioni!’
Inchoo ina olong eaku enaimin! Inchoo Enkai e shumata epal eitu enyamaliki ninye, nemeetae ewang'an naitawang'aki ninye.
Inchoo eaku enkolong torrono o enaimin nagut te shumata enye. Meimulumula ninye nkatampo neiwuang'ie enaimin ewang'an.
Ore ina kewarie, inchoo enaimin narok ong'u eibung ninye! Mincho ninye eshipa tiatua nena olong'i o lari. Mincho ninye elotu ajing esiana oo lapaitin.
Ee inchoo ina kewarie eaku olupi; emincho oltoilo le nchipai ening'i tiatua.
Inchoo lelo oodekisho metediaa ina olong, lelo arriyiak oodumu Lefiatan.
Inchoo ilakir lenyena le nkakenya emisimisu nchoo ninye eisiligu ewang'an nemetum nemedol osirua le nkakenya tenewang'u,
Amu eitu een ina olong enguset e yieyio, neitu eisudoo enyamali too nkonyek aainei.
“Kainyoo apa pee eitu aye te nkata e inoto, anaa pee apuku ake te nguset naye.
Aainyoo pee aaibung'a yieyio too nkejek enyena? Anaa pee aaitanaa ilki lenyena?
Amu anaata apa airraga nagira; anaata airure naa anaata ayeng'iyeng'e,
tenebo ilaiguanak o laitoriak le nkop lelo apa ooteshetakita ate inkidaarot.
Aashu ilkituaak ooata saabu, lelo ooiput inkajijik enye enkosholai.
Kainyoo apa pee eitu aaisudori anaa olkibiroto anaa nkiyioitin neitu ae kata edol ewang'an?
Teine eishu ilarruok enyamali, naa teine eyeng'iyeng'ieki iloonaurate.
Teine eyeng'iyeng'a ilooena tenebo; mening ninche ilo toilo lo loitasheiki esiaai.
Etii ine ilooti netii sii ilkituaak, nelakuno osinka to loitore ninye.
“Kainyoo pee eishori ewang'an ilo otii engolikinoto, neishori enkishui ilo oata emion to ltau.
Ilo otayiewua to ltau keeya, nemelotu ninye, neturu ninye oleng alang entoki nagol enkinyang'a naiteng'ela.
Lelo ooshipa te nchipai sapuk oleng, neshipa tenetum ninche enkurare?
Kainyoo peyie eishori ewang'an oltung'ani laa ore enkoitoi enye neisudoro? Ilo oitamana Enkai ninye olpaashe.
Ore osomit lai, naa ninye endaa ai, ore inkishirat aainei nebukunye anaa enkare.
Ore ina toki naure nanu nelotu shumata nanu, naadoiki nanu ina naitureisho.
Maata esidano te nkewan ai, nemaata sii engira, maata enkiyeng'iyeng; kake enyamali nalotu.”
Ina pee ewal Elifas le Teman ajo:
“Amaa tenikishirraki oltung'ani airorie, igoro Naa kaing'ae oidim atigirayu eitu eiro.
Ituutayie lkumok, nintagolo inkaik nemeeta engolon.
Ore irorei linono neitasheyie ilo orrorro nintagolo inkung naashal.
Kake ore taata kitabaikia iyie, nimindim ating'iria; kimbung'a iyie nimimputukuny.
Amaa euriata ino e Nkai aime ninye empijan ino naa enkitashoto sidai oo nkoitoi inono ninye osiligi lino?
“Tadamisho sii iyie, kalo aekata ilo loo supati oidaayie? Anaa aitiaji aekata etudung'oyioki, lelo ooitashe too sipat?
Ore anaa enatoduaa, ore lelo ooun entorroni; neun enyamali naa ninye ejung.
Ore te nkiyang'et e Nkai naa keidak, ore te ndarata e ngoro enye neijori ninche.
Ore ina kikurrukur o lng'atuny, o ilo toilo lo lng'atuny pushati, o lelo ala le lelo ng'atunyo ooti negili.
Ore ilo ng'atuny ogol neish te nkaraki natala entoki nanya, ore inkera e ng'atuny neidapashari.
“Aayakaki olomoni aakurraki, neng'amu enkiok ai ina king'oming'omakinoto.
Tiatua indamunot naaing'uaa induaat e nkewarie, ina kata etijing'a injo naairoishi iltung'ana.
Nelotu shumata nanu enkuretisho sapuk o lokirikiri ina naikirikirie iloik laainei pooki.
Nekut enkiyang'et enkomom ai, ore ilpapit lo sesen lai neitashe.
Neitashe aauno kake eitu nanu amusu eneikununo. Etii apa enkitanyaanyukoto dukuya nkonyek aainei; netii engira, ina pee aning oltoilo:
‘Keidim oltung'ani oye ataa sinyati te dukuya Enkai? Keidim oltung'ani ataa sinyati te dukuya Olaitobirani lenye?
Ore doi ninye too laisiaayiak lenyena mepik ninye osiligi, ore ilmalaika lenyena neikenaki enkitadiaata.
Kebaa elus lelo oomanya inkajijik e sarng'ab laa ore olkitamanyunoto lenye netii atua enterit, lelo oorrarri anaa naiba osina.
Ore teneitoriti entadekenya o enteipa nemuti; neish ninche intarasi meeta hoo oloyiolo.
Nemuti aaya olng'obor lenye aimemuta ninche aaye, neton ake meeta eng'eno nagut?’
“Impotisho taata, ketii hoo obo liking'amaa iyie? Kalo obo loo lmalaika imbelekenyakino iyie?
Kesipa ore enkuretisho nalus naa kear olmodai ore olom near ilo lemeeta eng'eno.
Atoduaa ilo modai enoto ntona, kake atasioko nanu adek emanyisho enye.
Ore ilayiok lenyena nelakuaniki eseriani, etumutaki ninche aaidaikie te kishomi, nemetii hoo obo oitajeu ninche.
Ore enkikesare enye nenya lelo ooata esumash, naa keya doi ninye aitayu tiatua ilkiku; ore ilooata enkure neipang'ipang eing'oru enkarsisisho enye.
Amu ore olosilisili neme enterit epukunye, ore enyamali neme te nkop ebulu.
Kake etoikioki oltung'ani enyamali anaa enailep iltiil le nkima shumata.
“Ore nanu, naa kaing'oru Enkai, naa Enkai apik nanu enkoitoi ai.
Ilo oas isiaaitin sapuki enking'asia nemejurrunoyu te nguton, intokitin kumok enking'asia nemeikenayu;
eisho ninye enchan metashaiki oriong enkop, neirriwaa inkariak metijing'a nkurman.
Nedumu ailepie lelo oobor ore lelo ooishir nedumuni aailepakinye eneserian.
Neitaa pesho nkitobirat e lelo loo losekin, metaa metum inkaik enye hoo dupoto.
Eya ninye lelo ng'eni to losek lenye maate, ore inkitobirat e lelo lo losek neiting'ie asioki.
Ketum ninche enaimin te ndama, neirrapirrapisho enaipirie enkolong, anaa lootii atua enkewarie.
Kake keitajeu lelo okishin too nkutukie enye; ore iloomena neitajeu te nkaina eilo magilani.
Metaa keeta ilo aisinani osiligi, ore imbaa nemetii isipat nenuk enkutuk enye.
“Ing'ura ajo, keshipa ilo tung'ani oisikong Enkai; metaa mimenaa ina kisikong'ata eilo magilani.
Amu kepik ninye olbae, neitoki aen, neoshisho ninye kake aikinchiunye enkaina enye.
Aikintajeu ninye iyie too nyamalaritin ile, ore tenaapishana nemeeta entorroni nikintoki aiseyie.
Ore to lameyu naa aikilaku iyie te keeya, ore to larrabal sapuk nikilaku aitung'uaa engolon eilo alem.
Aikisudori iyie teina kirowuaj e ilo ng'ejep, nimiureyu enkidaaroto tenebau.
Ore te mutata o to lameyu nikueni iyie, nimiureyu nena ng'uesi e nkop.
Amu mikintanyamal isoito te wueji nitur, nimikintanyamal ing'uesi entim.
Iyiolou iyie ina kata ajo keserian olng'obor lino, naa inken intare inono nitum pooki elulung'a.
Iyiolou sii ajo ore iishoritin inono naa keaku kumok, naa neijia etiu inkera eishoi ino, kebayu anaa inkujit enkop.
Ilo kenya enkurare ino itaa olpayian kitok, anaa enkano naku nabaiki ewueji neidong'ieki te nkata enye.
Ng'ura ajo, king'orutua kuna aajurru, naa kesipa. Toning'o, naa tayiolo ninye te nkaraki esidano nikiyaki.”
Neitoki Yob awal ajo,
“Oi duoo tenaa kepiki entemet naineneng'ishoreki isinaitin laainei te nebo enyamali ai pooki aaineneng!
Amu ina kata eiroishiu alang osinyai le naiposha; metaa akuetie irorei laainei,
amu etii imbaa e ilo magilani atua nanu; neok oltau lai esayiet enye; ore nena naaitureisho e Nkai neitoluaaki te dukuya nanu maataarare.
Keru osikiria le ntim eeta olkujita? Anaa olkiteng einosita olkujita?
Amaa ina nemeeta entoki naishamu, keinosayu metii emunyan?
Maata esumash e ndaa naaijo ina, naa ore pooki toki nanya naaitamuoi.
“Oi duoo tenaa katum entoki natoomonuo, naaisho Enkai eyieunoto ai,
peyie eshipakino Enkai pee aapurd nanu, pee eitorioo enkaina enye, naadung'oo nanu aiwuang'ie.
Ena naaku enkitagoloto ai; ekaipid doi ninye te nchipai hoo naata emion, amu eitu amiki lelo rorei Leilo Sinyati.
Kainyoo engolon ai metaa katon aanyu? Naa kainyoo enkiting'oto ai metaa katon ang'iri?
Amaa engolon ai keng'olon oo soito, amaa osesen lai kolo suyai?
Ore te sipata maata nanu eretoto te kewan, naa ore pooki wueji natumie eretoto neterewaki aaitung'uaa enatii.
“Ore ilo oibooyo esupatisho aitung'uaa olchore, naa keing'uaa euriata e ilo magilani.
Ore lalashera laainei, neeta entorroni anaa nena ariak naatoyu neishunye.
Nena naamisimis too soito le nchan, o ine neisudoriyie isoito le nchan ate.
Ore te nkata e nkirowuaj neimin. Ore teneirowuaju, neishunye te wueji enye.
Ore lelo apuayak neing'uaa inkoitoi enye, nepuo ninche olpurkel, neidaaya.
Ore lapuayak le Tema neing'oru, ore lelo apuayak le Sheba neisiligu.
Neidang ninche amu keeta apa osiligi sapuk. Epuonu ninche ine neidang.
Neijia iyie itotiuo tena kata te nanu; idolita osina lai, niureishoyu.
Katejo doi, ‘Entaikiaki nanu enkishooroto?’ Anaa, ‘Entaikiaki nanu te karsisisho inyi entoki nikiropiepie?’
Aashu, ‘Entokorduaki nanu te nkaina e ilo mang'atinta lai?’ Aashu, ‘Entalakuaki nanu te nkaina e ilo laaironyita?’
“Nteng'enaki nanu naa kagira nanu; intayioloki nanu matoning'u enaikuna peyie apong'ori.
Kebaa emion oo rorei oosipa? Kake amaa doi Kainyoo eutu enchankar ino?
Idamu naaji ajo indim aiturrai irorei, aa ore ina kiroroto o ltung'ani oiting'o osiligi naa enkijape?
Indim doi ninye atoosho enkukuo te lelo okishin nining'ore ilamirak amir olchore lino.
“Kake ore taata, tishipakinoyioki niking'or nanu; amu malej enkomom ino.
Imbelekenyunye, aatasayia, mincho entorroni easayu, imbelekenyunye tena kata amu eiting'o osiligi lai.
Ketii olng'ejep lai emonkoi ake ninye pooki? Amaa enkutuk ai aimemusu enyamali?
“Keitu etum oltung'ani esiaai nagol tioriong enkop, naa amaa inkolong'i enyena, aimetiu anaa inkolong'i oltung'ani oigero?
Anaa orrindik oyieu oleng oloip, anaa etiu anaa oltung'ani oigero oing'oru olekoisiayio lenye?
Metaa ore too lapaitin pooki maata toki; naaishooki nanu inkewarieitin o sina.
Ore tenairrag najo, ‘Kanu doi ade adumunye?’ Kake ekeado enkewarie, naibelibelekenya omekenyu.
Ore osesen lai naairuja ilkuru o loirerio, negolu olchoni lo sesen lai, neitoki adanya.
Elang inkolong'i aainei erisioroto oo naipuko o lkurragos, nepuonu aaiting meeta osiligi.
“Tadamu ajo ore enkishui ai naa enkiyang'et, medol aekata enkong'u ai esidano.
Ore ina ong'u e ilo laadol maitoki adol aekata; ore etii inkonyek inono shumata nanu, naa kaish,
anaa enaidapasha enkatampoi neish, neijia etiu ilo olo enemeneng'a meitoki ailepu;
meigil aekata ninye ashukokino enkaji enye nemeitoki ewueji enye ayiolo ninye aekata.
“Metaa maitigir nanu enkutuk ai; ekairo te nkaraki emion o ltau lai. Ekailepilep te nduaran o ltau lai.
Kara nanu enaiposha aashu entiamasi e naiposha, metaa intobira iyie olarriponi te shumata nanu?
Ore tenajo, ‘Ekaaitagol endapash ai, ekeitololong olorika lai enking'unyung'uny ai’;
ina pee kinture nanu too nkidetidetat, nikinture nanu too nduaat.
Metaa kagelu engoroto o keeya aitalang iloik laainei.
Meekure eeta enkishui ai tipat, meekure abikoo intarasi. Entung'uayioki nanu amu ore inkolong'i aainei naa enkiyang'et.
Kainyoo doi oltung'ani metaa ing'orunye ninye toki, nipik endamunoto ino aitorioki ninye;
niparan ninye anaake tadekenya, nitem ninye pooki kata?
Ke rishata naba aa miwuang'ie enkomom ino te nanu, anaa kipal nanu matoijoi nkamulak.
Amaa tenaas eng'oki, kaa aaitaas iyie, iyie olaing'urani loo ltung'ana? Kainyoo peyie kitisirua nanu? Kainyoo peyie ataa olola te iyie?
Kainyoo peyie mikipalaki inkitarruorrot aainei niya aitalamaa intorrok aainei? Amu ore tena kata naa kairrag tiatua enkop tenaye; aiking'oru iyie nanu nematii.”
Neitoki Bildad le Shushi awal ajo:
“Ke rishata nabaaa ijo kuna baa, ore irorei le nkutuk ino nemeata tipat, etiu anaa osiwuo kitok.
Amaa, kemerregel Enkai esipata? Amaa kemerregel Olmagilani enasipa.
Amaa tenetaasa inkera inono eng'oki aaitaas Enkai, eitarasayie ninye ninche apik engolon oo ntorrok enye.
Tening'oru iyie Enkai, nisai iyie ilo Magilani;
tenaa aira sinyati nintashe too sipat, nesipa katukul inchere ekedumunye ninye te nkaraki iyie; nikilaaki ninye iyie te wueji neishaakino nimany.
Neaku ore hoo duoo naa kiti apa enkiterunoto ino, keaku inkolong'i inono naapuonu kumok oleng.
“Aatoomonon inkilikuanu too lporori ooshomo, nijurru ayiolou nena naanoto iloo papa;
amu ore iyiook nikira ile ng'ole, nimikiyiolo pito, amu ore inkolong'i ang ti oriong enkop naa oloip.
“Aimikinteng'en ninche iyie, nikiliki iyie, nelimu irorei tening'unoto enye?
Keidim enarau atubulu te wueji nemetii enkare? Keidim oseyiai atubulu tewueji nemetii enkare?
Ore eton aa entapukai eitu edung'i, netoyu ninche engor ae aitubului ake.
Neijia etiu inkoitoi e lelo pooki oorikino Enkai amu ore osiligi le lelo tung'ana lemeeta Enkai naa keidak.
Ore enkirukoto osiligi lenye negila ina kata naa neijia etiu osiligi lenye le nkaji o lkedi.
Eirishakino ninye enkaji enye nemeitashe ina aji; eibung ninye ina aji enye, kake meitashe.
Ebulu iltung'ana torrok anaa endiati natii ewueji netii enkolong, neibulaa ilukuny aaidapashakino enkurma enye.
Ore intona enye neman aaen isoito, neton ninye tiatua lelo soito akurrakino.
Naa teneari aamut ninye te wueji enye, naa kemiki ninye, ejoki ‘Eitu aekata aadol.’
Ing'ura, ena enchipai enkoitoi enye; nepuku tiatua enkop kulie aabulu.
“Ing'ura ajo, meany Enkai oltung'ani lemeeta entioto, nemeng'amaa enkaina oo laasak loo ntorrok.
Aikintoki ninye aigil aiput enkutuk ino enkuenia nepik enkutuk ino embuakunoto.
Ore lelo likimba iyie naa keishopokini ninche enkurruna, ore ilo ng'obor loo ltorrok, nemeitokini aata.”
Neitoki Yob awal ajo:
“Kesipa kayiolo ajo neijia etiu. Kake kaji eiko oltung'ani teneaku supat te dukuya Enkai?
Amaa teneyieu obo nekeshare ninye, meeta obo oidim atawaliki ninye kata nabo too nkatitin enkalifu nabo.
Aing'en Enkai to ltau, naa magilani te ngolon, aing'ae oidima aitagolo kewan ataarare nemir ninye?
Ilo odotu ildoinyo, nemeyiolo ninche ina, tenenang'aa ninye ninche te ngoro enye,
ilo oigusugusie enkop aitung'uaa ewueji enye, neikirikirie ing'apeta enyena
ilo oitanap enkolong, meitoki ailepu; ilo oitoip ilakir.
Ilo laa ninye ake openy oisalaash keper, neroruaa apurd ilopir le naiposha;
ilo oitobirua intukusi oo lakir naaji: Olng'arurumi, Orion, o Pledes, o entukus oo lakir le kopikop.
Ilo oas isiaaitin sapuki nena naagiroo ening'unoto, o ntokitin enking'asia nemeeta esiana.
Keim embata ai, nemadol ninye; eloolo dukuya, nemaning'u ninye.
Ng'ura, ewuapaa ninye aiwuang'ie, aing'ae oidim aibooi ninye, Aing'ae ojoki ninye, ‘Kainyoo iasita iyie?’
“Meshuk Enkai siadi engoro enye; ore tiabori ninye neirrugo ilaretok le Rahab.
Kaji naa aiko tenawaliki ninye, agelu irorei laainei te nebo ninye?
Ore hoo nemaata entorroni, mawaliki ninye; ekaomonu olng'ur to Laitang'oroni lai.
Tenairorie ninye naawaliki nanu, mairuk ajo keinining'ito ninye oltoilo lai.
Amu kaar nanu to lkutati ogol neponaa ilbaa laainei meeta emporeet.
Maaisho ninye nanu mayagie, kake kaaiput ninye nanu emion.
Ore tenaa ke nkesha engolon, ng'ura ninye! Naa tenaa ke mbae naipirta esipata aing'ae oidim aterewa ninye meshomo?
Ore hoo nemaata entioto, naa keiguanareki enkutuk ai; ore hoo nemaata entioto, naa kaaitaa nanu olopaashari.
Maata nanu entioto; mang'or nanu kewan; meekure aatayie enkishui ai tipat.
Etaa pooki nabo; metaa atejo, emut ninye ilo lemeeta entioto o lelo torrok.
Tenelo neyau olbuket keeya aitasieku, nekueniyie engolikinoto e ilo lemeeta entioto.
Eishooki enkop enkaina e ilo torrono; eimulumul inkomomi oo laiguanak lenyena. Amaa teneme ninye, aing'ae naa ninye?
“Eten inkolong'i aainei aalang oltung'ani oipirri; eisik aailanyisho, medol ninche esidano.
Eish enkishui ai anaa emeli nakuet oleng, anaa olkurragos odoiki aibung entoki nenya.
Tenajo, ‘Madamu nanu enking'unyung'uny ai, ekaiwuang'ie esototo enkomom ai, naaku oloota enchipai’;
naureishoyu oleng te nkaraki inyamalaritin aainei, amu kayiolo ajo, mikintaa iyie nanu olemeeta entioto.
Ekaaku oloiguanareki; kainyoo naa peyie aasisho te mpesho?
Tenaituku kewan te ntoki naibor anaa enturoto, naituku inkaik aainei to sabuni oruko.
Naa aikinang'aki ake iyie nanu engumoto, ore ninye inkilani aainei naaibayu nanu.
Amu ime oltung'ani ninye anaa nanu, metaa kaidim atawaliki ninye, metaa aikipuonu metetemi iyiook te nebo.
Metii olarishani erishata ang, oidim aiteleiki enkaina enye shumata iyiook.
Inchoo ninye eiwuang'ie eng'udi enye te shumata nanu, nimincho engoro enye aaiture nanu.
Ina peyie aaitieu airoro imbaa enyena maata enkuretisho amu ime neijia atiu tiatua enkewan ai.
“Aibayie enkishui ai tukul. Kaing'unyung'uny oleng; ekairo tiatua emion o ltau lai.
Ekajoki nanu Enkai, mikidung'oki nanu enkiguana; intayioloki nanu nchere kainyoo peyie kiarare nanu.
Idol aa sidai te iyie tinikimbooki enkop, pee imenaa esiaai oo nkaik inono, nincho omom inkitobirat e lelo torrok?
Iyata iyie inkonyek o sesen? Idol iyie anaa enadol tung'ani.
Amaa inkolong'i inono ketiu anaa inkolong'i e tung'ani aashu ilarin linono ketiu anaa ilarin le tung'ani?
Metaa ing'oru aturu ing'ok aainei, nijurru ninche.
Ore hoo duoo nayiolo ajo iyiolo nchere maata entioto, nemeetae hoo obo laaidim aitajeu too nkaik inono?
Enkaina ino naaitobirua nanu; nikinyaaka taata aibelekenyakino nanu aidaikie.
Tadamu ajo kintobirua apa nanu anaa esarng'ab, naa aikintoki aigil arrinyoki nanu enterit?
Keitu iyie kibuku nanu anaa kule nikimposhu nanu anaa eng'orno?
Kinchopo nanu to lchoni o too nkiri o sesen nikirip nanu aitutum iloik omorlooishi.
Kinchoo nanu enkishui o enyorrata nauno; ore erripoto ino netorripo oltau lai.
Naa ore nena tokitin nisudoyie tiatua oltau lino; kayiolo ajo ena apa eyieuna ino.
Tenaas eng'oki, nikiut nanu, nimikipalaki nanu entorroni ai.
Naa tenara oltorrono, oi kewan ai. Naa te nara osupat, nemashumu elukunya ai, amu aabore enkurruna, naing'or olosilisili lai.
Naa te nadumu kewan ailepie, niking'oru nanu anaa olng'atuny ore ake sii nias ine nking'asia te nkaraki nanu;
intang'ejuk shakenisho ino te nkaraki nanu, niponaa engoro ino aitubulu te nkaraki nanu, niyau ilororani ng'ejuko maatigilunore nanu.
“Kainyoo peyie kiyawua nanu aitupuku te nguset? Enaikash apa tenatua eitu aadol toki,
natiu anaa aimaatae apa aekata. Aatanapaki te nguset aaya enkurare.
Aimekuti inkolong'i enkishui ai? Tapalaki nanu, pee atum anoto enkiti kiyagata.
Eton eitu alo ine nemashukunore ina kop engoro natii enaimin nagut,
enkop engoro o long'oling'oli naa ore ewang'an netiu anaa enaimin.”
Neitoki Sofar le Naamat awal, ajo:
“Keishori irorei kumok meshomo eitu ewali, neishori oltung'ani oiro oleng esipata?
Ijo doi keitigir enkiroroto ino e pesho iltung'ana, naa tininya kutuk ajo miata entioto, aimeeta obo likintukurru iyie?
Amu ijoito, ‘Ore enkiteng'enare ai naa kesila, nara sinyati te dukuya nkonyek e Nkai.’
Kake ore duoo tenaa keiro Enkai, nikiboloki ninye enkutuk enye,
naa aikiliki ninye iyie inkisudorot e ng'eno nagut! Amu aikitok ening'unoto enye. Tayiolo nchere aikiririki Enkai nkuti nemeba anaa nkitarruorot inono.
“Indim atayiolo intokitin naagut naaipirta Enkai? Indim atayiolo ineebaiki Olmagilani?
Ekeilep oleng aalang keper, kainyoo indim ataasa? Negut alang enemeneng'a, kainyoo indim atayiolo?
Ore entemet enye neado alang enkop, nelala alang enaiposha.
Amaa teneimaa ninye enkop, neenaa olorere, neipotu adung'oki enkiguana aing'ae oidim aibooi ninye?
Amu keyiolo Enkai lelo tung'ana lemeeta tipat; amaa tenedol ninye entorroni, aimeshilaa ninye?
Kake ore oltung'ani omoda naa ketum ening'unoto teneini olkurrarru le ntim aa oltung'ani.
Tenintorioki oltau lino esipata, nilak inkaik inono aitorioki ninye.
Tenetii entorroni enkaina ino, iwuang'ie intalamai, nimincho intorrok emany atua ilng'oborri linono.
Nesipayu katukul ina kata nchere idumu enkomom ino metii entioto; iyaku oloserian, nimiureishoyu.
Naa aikirikino osina lino; idamu ninye anaa inkariak naatulusoitie.
Ore enkishon ino newang'u alang enaiwulie enkolong; ore enaimin enye netiu anaa entadekenya.
Naa aitum empijan amu ketii osiligi; naa aikirripi nilo ayeng'iyeng'a te seriani.
Irrag iyie airura, nemeetae likae likinture; naa keomonu ilkumok omom ino.
Kake ore inkonyek o ltorrono nemeitoki aadolisho. Ore enkoitoi pooki naisikie naa keimin te ninche, ore osiligi lenye neiting.”
Neitoki Yob awal ajo,
“Irara iltung'ana, naa keish eng'eno nagut te ntae teniyeye.
Kake kaata ening'unoto anaa ntae; madou sii doi nanu te ntae. Aing'ae lemeyiolo intokitin naaijo kuna?
Kara nanu entoki nakueniyieki too ilchoreta laainei, nanu, ilo oipoto Enkai naawaliki ninye nanu, oltung'ani supat lemeeta entioto, ataa entoki nakueniyieki.
Ore tiatua ndamunot oo ltung'ana lemeeta enyamali naa olmena te lelo ootijing'a olbuket ore te ninye, oltung'ani oata olbuket ake obatata.
Ore ilng'oborri loo laikonyak neeta eseriani, ore lelo ooitagor Enkai neserian, lelo oonap enkai enye aapik inkaik enye.
“Kake inkilikuana ing'uesi, naa aikinteng'en ninche iyie, ore nena motonyi o loing'ang'e, naa aikiliki ninche iyie;
aashu inkaitubulu e nkop, naa aikinteng'en iyie; ore lelo sinkir le naiposha naa aikimbalakinye iyie.
Kaa te kuna pooki nemeyiolo ajo, enkaina Olaitoriani nataasa ena.
Etii atua enkaina enye enkishui e pooki toki naishu, netii enkiyang'et e pooki tung'ani.
Aimetem enkiok irorei, anaa enaishamisham olng'ejep endaa?
Ketii eng'eno nagut atua emoruao, ore ening'unoto netii atua enkadori oo nkolong'i.
Atua Enkai etii eng'eno nagut o emagilanisho; keeta eutaroto o ening'unoto.
Tenesulaki enkop, nemeetae oloidim atesheta; teneikenoo oltung'ani tiatua, meetae oloidim atabolo.
Teneibooyo inkariak, netoyu pooki; teneirriwaa aipang'ie, nenum enkop.
Atua ninye etii engolon o eng'eno nagut; ore ilo oleji o lolejisho naa ilenyena.
Eiwuang'ie ilautarok meeta toki, neitaa ilarishak ilmoda.
Eitadoyio ilaiguanak, neitaa ninche ilooena, neeniki impolosi enye inkeenta o mpolosi.
Etorikoyie ilapolosak meeta toki nenang'aa lelo magil.
Emitiki enkiroroto lelo oisiligayu neya aoru emusunoto lelo tung'ana kituaak.
Ebukoki enkurruna lelo kituaak, neitololong ina keene e mpolos e ilo ogol.
Eibalunye nena naagut e naimin, neyau enaimin nagut apik ewang'an.
Eitaa ninye iloreren kituaak, neitoki aidakie ninche, eitasapuk iloreren, nerikoo aiwuang'ie.
Keya aiwuang'ie ening'unoto too laiguanak le nkop, neisho ninche metilimanata to lpurkel lemetii enkoitoi.
Keirrapirrapisho ninche te naimin metii ewang'an neimerrimer anaa olamerani.”
Toning'o, etoduaa enkong'u ai kuna pooki, etoning'o enkiok ai netoning'uo.
Ore ina niyiolo nayiolo sii nanu, mara oti te yie.
Kake ekairorie Olmagilani, nayieu naishankarrarre Enkai te mbae ai.
Ore iyie, nikitumuraki te nturoto e lejare irara intae pooki ilabaak le pesho.
Oi duoo tenaa intirring'a agira, naa keaku ina eng'eno ino nagut!
Inining'u tena kata embae najo, nining'u olkiyioi oing'uaa enkutuk ai.
Indim airoro emonkoi aipirie Enkai niro to losek te nkaraki ninye?
Indim aitodolu olkep te ninye? Indim atoomonu ororei te ninye?
Kesipa aisidai te iyie te nikituru ninye iyie aing'oru? Aashu aindim ateleja ninye, anaa enalej oltung'ani olikae?
Aikisikong ninye iyie katukul tenaa intodolu olkep too nkisudorot.
Amaa enkitoo enye aimikinture iyie, o engoro enye tinikibatatakino iyie?
Ore indung'eta inono e rashe kumok netiu anaa inkuruon, ore enchankar ino netiu anaa enterit.
“Tigirayu pee kincho airo, naa inchoo aatum pooki naaba anaa inaatum.
Ekapik enkishui ai batisho, nchoo aiwuang'ie enkishui ai.
Ng'ura ajo kaar ninye matua, aaiting'o osiligi kake kamitu inkoitoi aainei te dukuya enkomom enye.
Ena naaku enjeunoto ai, nchere melotu oltung'ani lemeeta Enkai dukuya ninye.
Inining'u tukurraki irorei laainei, nincho embae nalimu aibalie ejing inkiyiaa inono.
Toning'o, aitobira enkiguana ai; kayiolo ajo kaata esipata.
Aing'ae ilo laalotu akeshare nanu? Amu ina kata agira nanu naye.
Intokitin are ake inchooki nanu, nemaitoki aisudoo kewan te nkomom ino:
iwuang'ie enkaina ino intalamai te nanu, nimincho olkirutoto lino aaiture nanu.
Nimpotisho iyie, naawaliki nanu, oi inchooki nanu mairoro, nikiwaliki iyie nanu.
Kaja esiana oo ntorrok aainei o ng'ok aainei? Intayioloki nanu intorrok aainei o eng'oki ai.
Kainyoo peyie isudoo enkomom ino, nikinkenaa nanu anaa olmang'atinta lino?
Isujaa iyie embeneyio nayaita osiwuo, nimir errarrati natoyio?
Amu ing'ero iyie mbaa e mion te nkaraki nanu, nikintijing nanu entorroni e kitisho ai.
Itipika nkejek aainei ilpisia, ning'or inkoitoi aainei pooki, itipika ienat ndapi oo nkejek aainei.
Keidaaya tung'ani anaa entoki natong'ua anaa enkila nainosa olasai.”
Ore oltung'ani otoiwuo enkitok naa oloo nkolong'i kuti, nebore enyamali.
Kepuku abulu anaa entapukai, netoyu, nelo anaa oloip, nemebikoo.
Naa ibol inkonyek inono aboloki olaaijo ilo, niyau ninye atua enkiguana ino.
Aing'ae oidim aitayu entoki nemeiduruk tiatua enaiduruk?
Ore amu etuutuaki aaibalie inkolong'i enyena, ore esiana oo lapaitin lenyena niata iyie, nituutua ineebaiki metaa meidim aida.
Mintoki aing'or ninye, tapala ninye inchoo ninye eshipakino enkishui enye nagol, tenaa keidim.
Keeta olchani otudung'oki osiligi, tenedung'i, naa keitoki abulu, nemetoyu intapuka enyena.
Ore hoo tenemusanu intona enyena tiatua enkop, netoyu aye olchani lenye tiatua enkop.
Kake ore ake peyie etum enkiti are nepok; nepuku ilng'osil anaa enkiti aitubului.
Kake keye oltung'ani, neirragieki aaitadoyio tiabori; neyang oltung'ani enabayie, naa koree ninye?
Ore anaa enaish inkariak te naiposha, neish oreyiet netoyu,
neijia etiu oltung'ani eirrag nemeitoki adumunye; o metaa meetae keper, meitoki adumunye, aashu edumuni aaitung'uaa injo enyena.
Oi naaji tenaa aikisudoo nanu te nemeneng'a, nikisudoo nanu ometogiroi engoro ino, metaa aikigelaki nanu erishata niyiolo, nikidamu nanu!
Amaa teneye oltung'ani keitoki apiu aigil? Ore inkolong'i aainei pooki e siaai ai naa kaanyu. Ometabau elakunoto ai.
Impotisho iyie naa kaairuk nanu iyie, iyieu oleng esiaai oo nkaik inono.
Amu ina kata inken iroruat aainei, nimintoki aing'or ing'ok aainei;
ore intorrok aainei neripari aaikenoo to lbene, naa intemoo aimulumulaa ing'ok aainei.
“Kake kesulunye ildoinyo nerrarra aaishunye, neitayuni indapidapo too wuejitin enye.
Neoroo inkariak isoito, neoroo oloirrag le nkare enterit, metaa iishie iyie osiligi le tung'ani.
Itimira oltung'ani nitii shumata ninye ntarasi. Itumuguta enkomom enye nireu ninye aitalamaa.
Kepuonu ilayiok lenyena aayanyit, nemeyiolo ninye; eyawuaki ninche abori, neitu emusu aayiolou.
Emion ake osesen lenye ening'ito, naa kewan ake eishiraki.”
Neitoki Elifas le Tema awal ajo:
“Amaa oltung'ani ng'en, keishiaakino newal te ng'eno e nkijape, neiput kewan te nkijape o loosaen?
Keishankarra ninye te nkiroroto nemeeta tipat, aashu too rorei lemeidim aitaasa ae sidai?
Kake igira aitalamaa ina uriata e Nkai, nimbooyo enkibirribirrata te dukuya Enkai.
Amu ing'ok inono naaiteng'en enkutuk ino, nigelu olng'ejep le lejare.
Enkutuk ino makewan nikidung'oki iyie enkiguana, mme nanu, nikinchakenoki iyie enkutuk ino makewan.
“Aiyie doi apa oltung'ani le dukuya otoiwuoki? Aashu aikiyawuaki apa eton meetae ildoinyo?
Inining'ishe iyie tiatua enkiguana e Nkai? Naa amaa eng'eno nagut intodorrop aiririki enkorrok ino ake?
Kainyoo doi iyiolo iyie nimikiyiolo iyiook? Kainyoo doi ining'u iyie nimikining'u te iyiook?
Eboitare iyiook lelo ooibor lukuny, tenebo lelo kituaak te iyiook. Ilaa aikituaak ninche te papaai lino:
Amaa enkilejilej e Nkai aikiti te iyie? Oo ilo rorei likirorie iyie te mborron?
Kainyoo peyie incho oltau lino mikitanapa aitalamaa, naa kainyoo peyie incho inkonyek inono eirriap?
Nimbelekeny oltau lino aarare Enkai, nincho irorei ootiu neijia epuku te nkutuk ino?
Kainyoo doi oltung'ani metaa keidim ataa olemeiduruk? Aashu ilo otoiwuo enkitok, metaa keidim ataa supat?
Toning'o, mepik Enkai osiligi isinyat lenyena, nemesinya keper too nkonyek enyena;
kebaa eng'oroto e ilo lo lminong, naa arruoni, oltung'ani ook intorrok anaa enkare!
“Ekaaitodol nanu iyie, inining'oki nanu; ore ina natoduaa naa kaibalunye.
(Ina natolimutuo iltung'ana le ng'eno nagut, neitu eisudoo iloomenye,
ilo laa ninye ake eishooki ina kop, nemeetae olomoni oimayie ninche.)
Ketoyu oltung'ani torrono te mion enye too nkolong'i enyena pooki, tiatua lelo arin pooki ooirragieki, te nkaraki ilo lemeeta olng'ur.
Etii inkiyiaa enyena iltoiloishi ooitureisho; ore etudupe, nelotu oloidaikie shumata ninye.
Meiruk ninye ajo keitoki arrinyo aing'uaa enaimin. Naa olalem elo ninye aitingoki.
Elimana ninye te nkop pooki eing'oru endaa ejo, ‘Kaji etii?’ Keyiolo ajo etabawua enkolong e naimin, etabaikia ninye;
ore osina o emion neiture ninye; nebaiki ninye anaa olaiguanani otanape pee elo olarrabal.
Amu eitorioyie ninye enkaina enye aarare Enkai, neyaki esarkionisho ilo Magilani.
Ekuetiki ninye te ngolong'akinoto aarare ninye, neibung elong'o enye nairrusha o lwuasa.
Amu eteijia enkomom enye te mpiron neirrag enkurriny too lairakuj lenyena.
Netamanya inkanas mijoonto, atua nkajijik nememanya, apa naatudung'okoki enkiguana metaa osototi loo suut;
meaku ninye karsis, nemebikoo karsisisho enye nemetum intona tiatua enkop.
Meilany ninye enaimin, ore olang'at le nkima neitoi imbenek enyena ore enkipilipil enye naa kekutaa osiwuo.
Mincho ninye epik osiligi lenye entoki nemeetae, alej kewan; amu ore entoki nemeetae naa keaku elaakinoto enye.
Ekelaki te lulung'ata eng'or enkata enye, ore olng'osila lenye nemenyoriju.
Keipiripiroo ninye lelo sabibu lenyena leitu eku, anaa ilo shani lenye, neiturraa adung'oo esidano enye anaa oloirien.
Amu ore encholiek e lelo lemeeta Enkai naa koolupi. Naa keidaikie enkima ilo ng'obor lo loropisho.
Enutayu ninche too ntorrok, neiu ing'ok ore oltau lenye neitobiru elejare.”
Ina peyie ewal Yob ajo:
“Atoning'o nanu intokitin kumok naatiu neijia; irara pooki ilaitagolok te nkata o sina.
Amaa irorei lemeata tipat keeta enkiting'oto? Aashu kainyoo doi nikintagoro peyie iwalu?
Ekaidim sii nanu airoro anaa yie, tenaa naaji itii erishata ai anaata aitulus irorei tenebo pee aagilunore naigusugusie elukunya ai te iyie.
Ekaaitagol iyie te nkutuk ai, ore enkitagoloto e nkiroroto ai neiwuang'ie emion ino.
“Tenairo nemeish emion ai, naa amaa tenang'iri, kebaa emion naaing'uaa nanu?
Kesipa taata aatalepuo Enkai tukul; eitomijoono ninye encholiek ai pooki.
Kimbung'a iyie nanu akurraki; ira iyie olmang'atinta lai. Kara nanu endapana o loik neibung'a iltung'ana ina pee eishakenoki entorroni ai.
Aatopolosa ninye te ng'oro enye, naaibayu nanu; etoonyo ninye ilala te nkaraki nanu. Ore olmang'atinta lai naakurraki inkonyek enyena.
Aatusukenya iltung'ana nanu too nkutukie enye, aatoosho ninche nanu eseder, eiturrurrote pooki peyie aarare nanu.
Aaishooyie nanu Enkai aitarasaki lelo lemeure Enkai, naanang'aki nanu nkaik e lelo arruok.
Atonita apa te seriani, kake aaibung'a ninye nanu olgos, naadung'udung aitaa ndung'ot. Aaitasheyie ninye nanu aitaa enkipirta enye.
Aamanita nanu imbaa enyena naatang'oruo te pooki shoto, etang'oro apolol ilairakuj laainei, nemepal, nebukoki olodua lai enkop.
Aarasaki ninye naapik ilbaa katitin kumok naakuetiki ninye nanu anaa olmurrani.
Atiripaka ilkuniyiani osesen lai, neirragie engolon ai tiatua enterit.
Etodoro enkomom ai te nkishirata, netiu inkonito aainei oo nkonyek anaa enaimin nagut;
ore hoo nemetii olarrabal inkaik aainei, naa kesila enkomono ai.
Na kop, minukaa osarge lai, nimincho enkishirata ai etum eneyeng'iyeng'are.
Ore doi ninye tena kata etii olchakeni lai keper, peyie eitashe terishata ai.
Kaasurdaany ilchoreta laainei; ore inkonyek aainei nebukoki Enkai ilkiyio.
Metaa ekeitasheyie esipata e tung'ani o e Nkai, anaa ina oltung'ani tenebo ole latia enye.
Amu ore eetuo ilkuti arin, ekalo aim enkoitoi nemaitoki ashukunye.
“Etigile oltau lai, eishunye inkolong'i aainei, etataana enkurare te nanu.
Kesipa etii tenebo nanu ilasukenyak, ore inkonyek aainei netii esukeny enye.
Irragie elakunoto ai te kewan ino; kalo likae oidim aishoru elakunoto te nkaraki nanu.
Ore amu inkeno indamunot enye peyie mening'u, mincho naa ninche meisula.
Ore ilo okaldaa ilchoreta lenyena too mpisai, pee etum erubata oo masaa enye, naa kemodoku nkera enyena.
Aaitaa ninye nanu entoki naimakini too loreren; nara obo le lelo oonotaki iltung'ana.
Eiliilaitie inkonyek aainei te nkaraki olkiyioi lo sina, ore irubat o sesen lai netiu anaa oloip.
Ore lelo ooitashe too sipat neing'asia tena, ore ilo lemeeta entioto neitagor kewan te lelo lemeure Enkai.
Kake ore isupati nekurraki enkoitoi enye, ore ilo oata inkaik nemeiduruk nebulaa agolu.
Kake ore intae enyaaki wootu intae pooki, nematum nanu oltung'ani ng'en te ntae pooki.
Etulusoitie inkolong'i aainei, ore nkitobirat aainei netudung'oyioki aaituraa, o nena yieunot o ltau lai.
Eitaa ninche enaimin endama; ‘Ore ewang'an, anaa enajo ninche, netaaniki enaimin.’
Tenaing'oru enemeneng'a aitaa enkaji ai, tenaisalaash olorika lai te naimin,
Tenajoki enkurare, ‘Ira iyie papa lai’ najoki ilo kurto, ‘Ira yieyio lai,’ aashu ‘Enkanashe ai,’
koree naa teine osiligi lai? Aing'ae odol osiligi lai?
Kelo ninye atua ine netii kutukaji e nemeneng'a? Amaa aikidoyio pokira aapuo atua enterit?”
Neitoki Bildad le Shua awal, ejo:
Ke nkata nabaa iyie ing'oru irorei? Tujurru, ina peyie kiro.
Kainyoo peyie eikenari iyiook anaa nkishu? Kainyoo peyie kira iyiook lmoda te dukuya iyie?
Iyie ilo opolos kewan te ngoro ino, keing'uari enkop te nkaraki iyie, aashu eiwuang'ieki endapidapoi aaitung'uaa ewueji enye?
Ee, ore ewang'an oo ltorrok netaaraki. Ore enkiyupyup e nkima enye nemeitoki awang.
Ore ewang'an naa kemisimisu to lng'obor lenye, ore oltaa otii shumata enye neari.
Ore iroruat enyena naagol neitodorropi, ore inkoitoi enyena nenang'aa ninye.
Amu etanang'akaki atua orreshet too nkejek enyena, nelo te nkoitoi nebatatakino.
Keibung orreshet entutunyo enye, neirrag orreshet oibung ninye.
Keisudoro olgosoi lenye tiatua enkop, orreshet otii enkoitoi enye.
Emanita ninye inaaitureisho te pooki alole, nemir ninye too nkejek enyena.
Ore engolon enye apa, netaa taata olameyu te ninye, netinyikaka ninye engolikinoto pee error.
Ore te nkaraki emuoyian netumute osesen lenye ore olkikau le keeya netumuta irubat o sesen lenye.
Etopolosaki ninye teilo ng'obor apa oisilig neyauni ninye aayaki ilo aiguanani oitureisho.
Netii olng'obor lenye ina neme enenye; nebore enkima aidapashakino emanyisho enye pooki.
Etoito intona enyena tiabori netoyu imbenek enyena too lukuny.
Neish endamunoto enye te nkop, nemeeta enkarna too nkoitoi naalala.
Eturrumoyioki ninye te wang'an aanang'aki enaimin, nerewi aaitung'uaa enkop.
Meeta ninye eishoi aashu iishoritin tiatua olorere, nemeetae oloishu teine apa nemanya.
Ore lelo oomanya oloontoluo, neing'asiate teina olong enye, neibung ninche olkirutoto lo loosaen.
Kesipa imanyishoritin kuna e lelo lemeure Enkai, ewueji ene eilo lemeyiolo Enkai.
Neitoki Yob awal ajo:
“Ke nkata nabaa kisilisil iyie nanu, nikigiligil aitaa ndung'ot too rorei?
Kindipa atipika nanu enkurruna kuna katitin tomon, aimidol iyie enkurruna tenikinyal nanu?
Naa tenaa kesipa doi inchere aitarruoyie, etii enkinyala ai atua enkorrok ai.
Tenesipa tukul ajo irup kewan kiarare nanu, nintaa emborron ai, enchankar nikiarare nanu;
tayiolo naa ajo aatipika Enkai nanu atua entorroni, naaitamana nanu orreshet lenye.
Toduaa, aishira abuaku ajo ‘Olarrabal!’ Kake eitu aawalikini; aipotishe to ltoilo sapuk, kake metii esipata.
Etipika Enkai esuntai enkoitoi ai, metaa maidim aima, netipika enaimin inkoitoi aainei.
Aatooruo ninye nanu enkitoo ai, neya te nanu enkopiyia e nkitoo te ndukuya ai.
Aagiligil nanu too nkaloli pooki, netaa aisha, neitayio ninye osiligi lenye anaa olchani.
Einuaa ninye engoro enye napi peyie aarare, naaikenaa nanu aitaa olmang'atinta lenye.
Eirriwua ninye iltimito lenyena maataarare netur ninche iloong'elu, naarresh ninche eman olng'obor lai.
Eitalamayie ninye iltung'ana maatung'uai ataa olomoni te lelo pooki laayiolo nanu.
Aatung'uaitie iltung'ana laainei le sotua tenebo ilchoreta laainei.
Ore ilomon ootii enkaji ai nemaadamu ninche nanu; ore inkaisiaayiak aainei naaikenaa anaa olomoni; ataa nanu olomoni too nkonyek enye.
Aipoto nanu osinka lai, kake eitu ninye aawaliki; meeta nchere pee masai nanu ninye te nkutuk ai.
Ataa kereek te nkitok ai, naatonyimo ilayiok lang'arie kina.
Ore ninye nkera kutiti naatemenaitie nanu, ore tenainyototo neimaki imbaa olmena te nanu.
Ore ilchoreta laainei likinyorra oleng naaing'or ninche to lmena, ore lelo apa lanyor naaibelekenyakinote aarare.
Ore osesen lai netimite aaku iloik ake o lchoni, naa te mpesho nanu ailanya keeya aimisho.
Eng'urrieki nanu, eng'urrieki nanu, intae lo shoreta laainei, amu aatoshoroyie nanu enkaina e Nkai!
Kainyoo iyie pee kisujaa nanu anaa Enkai? Kainyoo iyie pee mikindip enkisilisiloto o sesen lai?
Oi naaji tenaa keigeroki te mbuku! Nedamuni pooki aiger te mbuku.
Naa tenaa keigeroki te nkalamu e sekenkei naata esipil! Pee eguetakini endapidapoi ntarasi!
Amu kayiolo ajo eishu olalakunoni lai, naa ore te siadi neitashe ti oriong enkop;
neaku ore eidipaki aatumut osesen lai, naitoki ake adol Enkai to sesen lai,
ilo ladol etii enkalo ai, naa kadol too nkonyek aainei; neme too ne likae. Eiterre oltau lai tiatua nanu!
Naa tinijo, ‘Kaji kinko tinikisuj ninye!’ Naa ‘Ore esipata embae netumi tiatua ninye,’
turia ilo alem, amu keyau engoro napi enkitamioto to lalem, peyie itum atayiolo inchere keetae endung'okinoto enkiguana.”
Neitoki Sofar le Naamat awal ajo,
“Metaa aatawalikitia indamunot aainei nanu, te nkaraki nakuetiki imbaa te nkewan ai.
Atonig'o enkisikong'ata ino aainyal nanu, ore te ning'unoto ai naawaliki nanu enkiyang'et.
Keitu apa iyiolou ena te musano, anaa apa peyie epiki tung'ani oriong e nkop,
nchere ore enkisulata eilo torrono naa dorrop, ore enchipai e ilo lemeeta Enkai naa enkiti kata?
Ore hoo duoo neilep anaa ildoinyo aabaiki keper enkadori enye, nebaiki elukunya enye inkatampo;
keish ninye intarasi anaa inkik enyena; ore lelo ootoduaa ninye naa kejo, ‘Koree doi ninye?’
Ekelo ninye alusoo anaa enkidetidet, nemetumoyu; kearari ninye aitalamaa anaa enduaata e nkewarie.
Ore nena onyek apa naatoduaa ninye, nemeitoki aekata aaigil aadol, nemeigil aekata ewueji enye adol ninye.
Ore nkera enyena neing'oru omom teilo aisinani, ore inkaik enyena nerriny aaishooyo enkarsisisho enye.
Ore iloik lenyena nebore engolon e kitisho, kake keirrag ninche tenebo ninye tiatua enterit.
Ore hoo duooo nemelok intorrok te nkutuk enye, ore hoo duoo neisudoo ninye tiabori olng'ejep lenye,
ore hoo nemeyieu ninye nepal, nemuk ninye te nkutuk enye,
kake keibelekenyi ake aaitaduar endaa enye te nkoshoke, keduaru naleng anaa enduaran e pooki sayiet.
Keijoo ninye enkarsisisho neitoki alopu; kenang'aa ninche Enkai te nkoshoke enye.
Keibibi ninye esayiet, olng'ejep le nturbubua olo aar ninye.
Melo ninye aing'or lelo kejek, nena shorroi naaruko inaishi o kule.
Kerriny ninye aishooyo ilng'anayio le siaai enye, nemeitoki aekata ninye aijoo, ore dupoto e biashara enye nemeshipakino ninye,
amu etupurda ninye neing'uaa lelo aisinak, eibung'a ninye aikonyaa enkaji neitu eshet.
Ore amu meeta olorok lenye enkiyagata, meleku ninye ae toki hoo nabo nashipakino.
Meetae entoki natelekua eidipa ninye atadaayu neaku mebikoo karsisisho enye.
Ore enkiputakinoto e raposhoi enye, naa osina, kelotu engolon pooki o sina shumata ninye.
Neiput enkoshoke enye aitaraposh, keirriu Enkai engoro enye napi shumata ninye neitashaiki shumata ninye anaa endaa.
Keisik ninye aing'uaa emasaai o larrabal e sekenkei neng'or ninye embae o suyai neipang.
Etushutuaki ina bae nepuku to sesen lenye, ore ine wueji neimerlel neipang'u to lodua lenye, neiput ninye enkuretisho.
Ore ilchumat lenyena pooki nepuo aajing enaimin nagut, enkima neitu einoki nalo amut ninye, ore ina natelekua to lng'obor lenye nemuti.
Neibalunye keper ing'ok enyena pooki, nedumakino enkop aarare ninye.
Ore imasaa e nkaji enye nenapi aaya neing'irtitori aaya teina olong e ngoro napi e Nkai.
Ena erubata o ltung'ani torrono naing'uaa Enkai, enjung'ore naibalakinye ninye Enkai.”
Neitoki Yob awal ajo:
Inining'o tisipu irorei laainei, nincho ina eaku enkitagoloto ino.
Ting'iria nchooki nanu mairoro, ore peyie aidip airoro, nikisukeny.
Amaa nanu, ke ltung'ana aing'unyung'unyaki? Kainyoo peyie maidim ating'iria?
Ing'uraki nanu, nimimputukuny, nipik enkaina ino enkutuk ino.
Ore tenelo nadamu naing'asia oleng, neiput olokirikiri osesen lai.
Kainyoo peyie eishu lelo ooas intorrok, nebaiki moruao, nebul aaku magil te ngolon?
Etubula inkera enye te dukuya ninche, netodua ninche iishoritin enye too nkonyek enye.
Ore inkajijik enye neserian nemetii enkuretisho, nemeetae eng'udi Enkai natii shumata ninche.
Kedumu iloing'ok lenye nkishu nemedung; eisho nkishu enye, nemeye ilasho.
Eiguran nkera enye anaa lkuoo le kerra, neiguran nkera enye aaipid.
Eranyisho ninche neosh entampuri, olwulul loo usin, neshipa tenening oltoilo le ndule.
Kebikoo te nkishui oo nkolong'i enye eeta enkarsisisho nalulung'a, nedoyio aapuo enemeneng'a te seriani.
Kejoki ninche Enkai, “Shomo tung'uai iyiook! Miking'uar ina ng'eno oo nkoitoi inono.
Aing'ae doi ilo Magilani, onarikino nikisiaai ninye?” Naa kainyoo kitum tinikiomon ninye?
Toduaa!, Aimetii inkaik enye ina dupoto? Ore enkiguana oo larruok naalakuaniki nanu.
“Keari aekata oltaa le ilo torrono? Pee edoiki entaboi enye ninche? Neitame Enkai ninche te ngoro enye.
Ketiu ninche anaa olkujita otoyio to lkutati, netiu anaa isuut naakutaa osiwuo?
Ijo iyie, ‘Etushuma Enkai ing'ok enye aitaany ilayiok lenyena.’ Inchoo ninye elaaki ninche peyie etum aatayiolo.
Inchoo inkonyek enye metoduaa enkidaata enye, naa nchoo ninche metooko ina goro e ilo Magilani.
Amu kainyoo eshilaa ninche too nkajijik enye etulusoitie ninche eidipaki aaitodorropa esiana oo lapaitin lenye.
Ketii obo oidim aiteng'ena Enkai eng'eno, idol ajo eiguanare ninye lelo ootii shumata?
Keye obo eeta enkarsisisho nalulung'a, eidipakine neserian.
Nebore osesen lenye empiron neruko entolit oo loik lenyena.
Neye likae te mion oltau, eitu aikata eishamisham esidano.
Neirrag ninche enyaanyuk tiatua enterit, neiruj ninche ilkuru.
“Kayiolo nanu indamunot inono, nkitobirat nikinyalie nanu.
Amu ijo iyie, ‘Koree enkaji olkitok? Koree ilo ng'obor otonie ilo torrono?’
Keitu iyie inkilikuan lelo oopuo too nkoitoi naalala, naa keitu iyie ing'amaa shakenisho enye,
inchere etelekuaki ilo tung'ani torrono teina olong e nyamali, inchere eitajeuoki ninye teina olong engoro napi?
Aing'ae oidim aibalakinye ninye enkoitoi enye? Naa aing'ae oitalaku te ninye teina nataasa.
Ore tenenapi ninye aaya enkurare, neing'ori aarrip enkurare enye.
Esujaa ilkumok osesen lenye epuoi aanukaa, ore enterit e nkop neirrag aitirring'a aitemoo osesen lenye.
Kaji naa inko iyie tinikintagol nanu te mpesho narok? Meetae toki natelekua too walat inono neme elejare ake.”
Neitoki Elifas le Teman awal ajo:
“Keidim oltung'ani ataa oloata tipat te Nkai? Kesipa ore ilo ng'en neeta tipat te kewan enye.
Ke sikar to Lmagilani tenira asipani anaa ke dupoto te ninye tenira olemeeta eleyiata too nkoitoi inono?
Te nkaraki euriata niure iyie ninye peyie kisikong'a ninye, niking'uanare ninye iyie?
Aime sapuk enkarruoisho ino? Meeta intorrok inono enkiting'oto.
Intagolikio ilalashera linono te sile nitoning'okinote nioru ninye nkilani meshomo meishopo.
Keitu iyie incho enkare ilo onaure, nitomitikio endaa ilo oata esumash.
Ore ilo tung'ani ogol naa ninye oya enkop, ore ilo tung'ani onyorri nemany.
Inchoo nkolia epuo too nkaik naarook, ore inkaik e lelo okishin nigil.
Ore te nkaraki ina kintamanaki irresheta, nikijing aluam olkirutoto.
Eitomisimisoki ewang'an ino pee midolisho, nikimulumula iyie oloirrag le nkare.
Aimetii Enkai shumata keper? Neing'or ilakir tiabori hoo naa shumata etii.
Metaa itejo iyie kainyoo eyiolo Enkai? Keidim ninye aiguanare enaimin narok ong'u?
Eimulumulayie ninye enkatampoi nairrusha, metaa meidim atoduaa ninye nelo ninye te rishata e keper o enkop.
Iton aibung ilo rrekie musana, naa ninye apa eima ilarruok?
Etawuapayioki ninche aaiwuang'ie eng'or enkata enye; etooroyioki aaiwuang'ie olkitamanyunoto lenye.
Etiaakita ninche Enkai, ‘Shomo tung'uai iyiook’ naa ‘Kaa eidim ilo Magilani aitaasa iyiook?’
Ore ake etiu neijia eiput ninye nkajijik enye ntokitin sidain, kake ore eutaroto e lelo torrok naalakuaniki nanu.
Kedol lelo supati neshipa; nekueni ilemeeta entioto tenedol ilarruok eitamei;
kejo, kesipa etudung'oyioki aaiwuang'ie ilmang'ati lang, ore ilekunot netumuta enkima.
“Toning'ore Enkai, pee itum eseriani, pee epuonu isupati enitii.
Tang'amai enkiteng'enare te nkutuk enye, nishum ororei lenye tiatua oltau lino.
Tinishukokino ilo Magilani nintobor kewan, tiniwuang'ie intorrok pooki aitalam olng'obor lino,
tinirragie saabu te nterit, aashu inang'aa saabu naisul too lturot ootoito
naa teneaku ilo Magilani ninye saabu ino, naa ninye enkosholai ino naata tipat;
nitum taa atishipakinoyu ilo Magilani, nidumu enkomom ino ashumaki Enkai.
Niomon iyie ninye naa aikining ninye iyie; nilak iyie ilmuma linono.
Keaku idung iyie embae alimu, netiu neijia, naa kewang'u ewang'an too nkoitoi inono.
Amu keitadou Enkai lelo oowuasa, neitajeu lelo oobor.
Keitajeu Enkai ilo tung'ani lemeeta entioto; aikintajeuni iyie te nkaraki inkaik inono nemeiduruk.”
Neitoki Yob awal ajo,
“Ore sii taata ena olong naa keme enking'unyung'uny ai, ekeiroshi enkaina enye hoo naigorito nanu.
Ore naaji tenaa kayiolo ewueji natumie ninye, pee elotu doi ninye olorika lenye!
Nairragie enkiguana ai te dukuya ninye, naiput enkutuk ai inchankarri.
Nayiolou ina naawaliki ninye nanu, naning'u ina naajoki ninye nanu.
Kaagilunore ninye nanu te nkitoo e ngolon enye? A'a, ekaaning ninye nanu.
Ore oltung'ani oitashe too sipat neirorie ninye, naalaku olarishani lai intarasi.
Ng'ura ajo aloito dukuya, kake metii ninye ine; nashuko siadi, kake mamusu nanu ninye.
Ore te nkaina e kedianye naing'oru ninye kake madol ninye; naibelekenyakino enkalo e tatene, kake madol nanu ninye.
Kake keyiolo ninye enkoitoi nalo aim; ore peyie aaidip atetema nanu, nalotu apuku atisile anaa saabu.
Etuunokinote nkejek aainei iroruat enyena; aibung'a enkoitoi enye neitu apaash.
Eitu aing'uaa inkitanapat e nkutuk enye; atushuma tiatua oltau lai irorei le nkutuk enye.
Kake meibelekenya ninye, naa kaing'ae oidim aibelekenya ninye? Ore ina nayieu ninye naa ina eas.
Amu keitabaya ninye ina naategelaka nanu; ore intokitin kumok naaijo nena netii endamunoto. Netii atua endamunoto enye mbaa naaijo nena.
Metaa airuto nanu te dukuya ninye, ore peyie adamu, naa kaure ninye.
Eiterreyie Enkai oltau lai; aaituria Olmagilani nanu;
amu aatiripakine enaimin, neitemoyie enaimin nairrusha enkomom ai.
“Kainyoo pee meiteng'el Olmagilani nkolong'i e nkiguana, naa kainyoo paa ore lelo ooyiolo ninye nemedol aekata inkolong'i enyena?
Keiwuang'ie iltung'ana ilpolosien; neibung iluaat oo ntare aapurroo nepuo aaramat.
Neya ninche osikiria le ilo okishi; neya olkiteng le nkoliai alakie esile enye.
Kerrumoo ninche ilo aisinani aaiwuang'ie te nkoitoi ore ilaisinak pooki le nkop neisudoo ate.
Ng'ura etiu ninche anaa isirkon le ntim to lpurkel epuo te nkisiayiare enye nagol eing'oru eng'ues naibung tiong'ota, pee enya inkera enye.
Keitururr ninche endaa enye tiong'ota, nesot isabibu too nkurman oo larruok.
Keirrag ninche enkewarie pooki meeta nkilani, nemeeta entoki naitoipore te nkijape.
Keshal ninche te nchan oo ldoinyio, nepetikino endapidapoi eyieu eneshurie.
Ketii lelo oowuapaa enkerai okishi aaoru ilki, neya pee elakie esile enye enkerai o laisinani.
Emanimanaa ninche meishopo, meeta nkilani neisumash enap irridat le nkano.
Tiatua intukusi oo loirienito easisho ninche; eironyu enaisho too sabibu, neton ake eeta enkure.
Tiauluo enkanasa eigor ilo oye neishiru oltau le ilo otipikaki olbae eretoto. Ore ake eyia, meshilaa Enkai ina omono.
“Ketii lelo oogolong'u eiba ewang'an, lelo leitu emoku inkoitoi enyena, nemetoni too nkoitoi enyena.
Kedumunye ilarruok te naimin, pee etum aataarr metua ilo aisinani o ilo oata osina; ore kewarie netiu anaa olapurroni.
Keanyu sii enkong'u e ilo ololoito metomisimiso, ejo ninye, ‘meeta enkong'u naadol nanu’; neimulumul enkomom enye.
Ore te naimin netur inkajijik; ore dama neikenoo ate, nemeyiolo ninche ewang'an.
Amu enaimin nagut entadekenya enye pooki; amu ilchoreta ninche lo lkirutoto le naimin nagut.
“Itejo, ‘Eitasiooyioki ninche aaya shumata nkariak; etediaaki erubata enye te nkop; meetae ololo nkurman enye oo sabibu.
Eshol olameyu o enkirouaj neishu aitoi enkare nataa osoit le nkirobi neijia sii eiko enemeneng'a lelo ooas ing'ok.
Medamuni ninche too lkurrot ootumoreki le nkanasa, meekure edamuni nkarn enye, neaku etigilaki entorroni anaa olchani.’
“Kedaa ninche too nkajijik oo nkituaak olupin, nemeitaas inkolia mbaa supati.
Ore ake eyia, keitoodor Enkai nkolong'i e ilo Magilani te ngolon enye. Kedumunye ninche etapalari te nkishui.
Keisho ninche erripoto neretuni sii; ore nkonyek enyena neing'or nkoitoi enye.
Eilepieki ninche te nkiti kata, neitoki aaish; etoyu ninche neish anaa endiati pooki kedung'ori ninche anaa ilukuny e ntapa.
Naa te neme neijia etiu, aing'ae ooidim aitisipa nchere kara olalejani, neitodolu ajo meetae esipata te pooki natejo nanu?”
Neitoki Bildad le Shua awal ajo,
“Ene Nkai enkitoria o euriata, eitobir ninye eseriani te shumata enye e keper.
Keeta enjore enye esiana? Aing'ae meilepaki ewang'an enye?
Kaji naa eiko oltung'ani teneaku sinyati te dukuya Enkai? Kaji eiko ilo otoiwuo enkitok teneton meiduruk.
Ng'ura ajo mewang doi ninye olapa nemewang aasila ilakir te dukuya ninye.
Oo naa duoo oltung'ani, laa oloti kurto, o enkerai o ltung'ani laa enkurto!”
Neitoki Yob awal ajo:
“Kebaa eretoto nitareto ilo lemeeta engolon! Intajewuo ina aina nemeeta engolon!
Inkoo ilo lemeeta eng'eno nagut, nincho ninye te leng'on eng'eno sapuk.
Ai te retoto e ng'ae iyie iroro irorei naa ae te nkiyang'et e ng'ae etupukutuo te iyie?
Keikirikira iloipi liabori, o nkariak o lelo oomanya.
Meishopo enemeneng'a te dukuya Enkai, nemeeta Abadon (ewueji e mutata) entoki naitoipieki.
Eisalaash moikuape aisalaashaki olng'am neik enkop aililioki olng'am.
Keen inkariak too nkatampo naairrusha, nemepolosa inkatampo tiabori ninche.
Keitoip ninye olapa neisalaashaki ninye enkatampoi enye.
Etuutua olokelel tioriong inkariak, to lpolosie le rishata ewang'an o enaimin.
Keikirikira ing'apeta e keper, neirut aaiputukuny te nkisikong'ata enye.
Keitigir enaiposha te ngolon enye; te ng'eno enye etoosho Rahab.
To lkutati lenye eitisidanaki keper; nerem enkaina enye olasurai oilanyisho.
Ng'ura ajo, ore kuna naa nkuti ake oo nkoitoi naa kebaa enkitisho e nking'oming'om oo mbaa enyena nikitoning'o! Naa amaa endarata e ngolon enye, aing'ae oidim atoning'u?”
Neitoki ake Yob airo nejo:
“Ore anaa enaishu Enkai, ilo laaitung'uayie esipata ai, o ilo Magilani, ilo otipika oltau lai emion;
ore ake ninye aishu, netii enkiyang'et e Nkai nkumeishin aainei,
mairo te nkutuk ai mbaa e lejare, nemeibalie olng'ejep lai enemesipa.
Metalakuana te nanu elimunoto nchere, itisipa intae, ore omatua, maiwuang'ie aekata enkitashoto ai e sipata.
Ekaibung akurraki esinyatisho ai, nemaitiak, maaitukurru oltau lai too nkolong'i aainei pooki.
“Metanyaanyukie olmang'atinta lai olarruoni, nincho ilo laadumakino aarare etiu anaa olemeeta esipata.
Amaa kainyoo osiligi le ilo lemeure Enkai teneiwuang'ie Enkai ninye, teneiwuang'ie Enkai enkishui enye?
Kening Enkai enkishirata enye, tenebaiki ninye enyamali?
Keshipakino ninye ilo Magilani? Keipot ninye Enkai pooki kata?
Ekaaiteng'en nanu iyie enkipirta e nkaina e Nkai; ore pooki natii atua Olmagilani nemaisudoo.
Ng'ura ajo, indipa pooki aatodol maate, kainyoo naa pee itaa pooki ilo oiro mbaa e pesho?
“Ena erubata o ltung'ani torrono te Nkai, naa ina enjung'ore nang'amu ilo oitorogonyisho te ilo Magilani:
Teneponari inkera enyena, naa kemut olalem, ore eishoi enye nemetum endaa naraposh.
Ore lelo ootelekutua neye to lmeitai ore nkolia enye nemeidim aaishira.
Ore hoo neiturrurr enkosholai anaa enterit, nerup inkilani anaa esarng'ab;
keidim aiturrurro, kake lelo supati ooishop, ore lelo lemeeta entioto neor enkosholai.
Ore enkaji nashet ninye netiu anaa enkaji o lkendi, anaa olng'obor oitobiru olarriponi.
Kelo ninye endapash aa karsis, neyooki ainyototo eishunye karsisisho enye kebol inkonyek enyena, nenyorriki eshomo enkarsisisho enye.
Keipang'aki ninye oloputukunyi anaa oloirrag le nkare; ore kewarie nenap ninye osiwuo sapuk.
Kedumu ninye olkutati lo loo saen neya; eoroo ninye aitung'uaa ewueji enye.
Kekut olkutati ninye meeta olng'ur ina kata etem ninye ailany engolon enye.
Keoshoki olkutati ninye nkaik, neiture ninye aitupuku te wueji enye.”
Kesipa ketii ewueji neturunyeki enkosholai, netii ewueji nesilieki saabu.
Keitayuni esekenkei te nkop, nesholuni osuyai te nterit enye.
Keishie tung'ani emisimisi nelimana aaing'oru ilo soit ogol enkiny'ang'a otii olpolosie olakua te naimin nagut.
Ketur ineeimi too nong'ot nemetaaniki iltung'ana; meekure edamu ninche lelo apuayak. Keililio ninche too neelakuaniki iltung'ana neyuko inkaloli pooki.
Enkop ninye epukunye endaa; kake ore tiabori ninye neibelekenyi aitaa enkima.
Ore isoito lenyena neeta ewueji oo soito sidain, neeta enterit e saabu.
“Ore ina oitoi nemetii olmotonyi onya nkiri oyiolo, neitu edol enkong'u o lmotonyi odolisho oleng.
Ore ng'uesi naawuasa, neitu eitunyoo ine; neitu eim olng'atuny shumata enye.
“Ketur iltung'ana osoit ogol oleng, neibeleleng'oo ildoinyo too ntona enye.
Keturu ineeimi too ndapidapo, nedol enkong'u enye pooki toki sidai.
Keen ninye inchorroi pooki pee meitoki aaitong, ore entoki naisudoro neyau atua ewang'an.
“Kake ai tiaji etumi eng'eno nagut? Naa koree ewueji ening'unoto?
Meyiolo oltung'ani enkoitoi nalo ine, nemetumi ninye te nkop oo looishu.
Kejo enguton, ‘ime nanu etii’; nejo enaiposha ime nanu etii.
Metumi ninye te saabu, nemeineneng'i enkosholai metaa elaata enye.
Metemieki ninye saabu e Ofir, nemetemieki enkosholai sidai.
Ore saabu o enkosholai nemerisiore ninye, nemewalunyeki isoito le saabu nasila.
Meitasimi aatemaki isoito oogol enkinyiang'a, ore enkinyiang'a e ng'eno nagut nelang isoito oogol enkinyiang'a.
Ore isoito oogol enkinyiang'a ooji Topas le Etiopia, nemeitanyaanyukieki ninye, nemeitanyaanyukieki ninye saabu nasila.
“Kaji naa doi eing'uaa eng'eno nagut? Naa koree ewueji e ning'unoto?
Eisudoyioki too nkonyek e pooki toki naishu; nenukari pee medol imotonyi o loing'ang'e.
Nejo Abadon o keeya, ‘Kitoning'o iyiook olmarenke too nkiyiaa ang.’
“Keyiolo Enkai enkoitoi nalo ine, neyiolo ewueji enye.
Amu keing'or ninye inkiting'ot e nkop, nedol pooki toki natii abori keper.
Ore pee eisho enkijape enkiroishi enye, neyiolou eneba endapasho e naiposha.
Neitobiru too rorei enchan, neitobiru enkoitoi enkiwuang'ata e ndarata;
nedol ninye neibalie ninye; neitasheyie ninye, neing'oru ninye.
Nejoki ninye oltung'ani, ‘Ng'ura ajo ore, euriata Olaitoriani naa ninye eng'eno nagut, naa tining'uaa ntorrok naa ninye ening'unoto.’ ”
Neitoki ake Yob airo nejo:
“Oi naaji tenaa katiu anaa enatiu ilapaitin liapa, anaa too nkolong'i apa naatorripo Enkai nanu;
ina kata apa eitawang'aki oltaa lenye endukuya ai, ore te wang'an enye nalo aim enaimin.
Anaa apa enatiu too nkolong'i e nkiputakinoto ai, ina kata etii shoruetisho e Nkai shumata olng'obor lai.
Ina kata eton etii Olmagilani tenebo nanu ina kata aamanita inkera aainei nanu.
Ina kata eisuji iroruat aainei te kule, naabukoki ina dapidapoi inchorroi e ilata!
Tenaipang nanu alo auluo enkishomi e nkanasa, ina kata naitobir nanu olorika lai to lkurroto otumoreki.
Naadol lelo barnot neilanyisho, neinyototo ilpayiani kituaak neitashe;
negira lelo kituaak eitu eitoki aairo, nepik inkaik enye inkutukie enye aaibung,
negira oltoilo le lelo yiolot nerep ilng'ejepa lenye inoreti enye.
Ore te nening enkiok naaipot nanu ajo olomayiana, ore peyie edol enkong'u naaishakenoki ninye;
amu aitajewuo nanu ilo aisinani oishira o ilo okishi lemeeta hoo obo oretu ninye.
Ore emayianata e ilo letaa keidaaya nelotu shumata nanu, naretu nkolia menoto eseriani.
Aishopoko kewan esupatisho, naaitoip ninye nanu. Ore esipata ai netiu anaa olkila o enkarasha e lukunya.
Kara apa nanu nkonyek tialo olmodooni, nara nkejek to lmaima.
Kara apa nanu menye ilo aisinani, naturu aing'oru aretu ilo lemaayiolo.
Atigila ilala le ilo oas ing'ok, naitiakie ninye ina nainosita too lala lenyena.
Ina peyie adamu ajo, kaye nanu tiatua enkaji ai, naa kaponaa inkolong'i aainei aitaba anaa osinyai.
Kepuo intona aainei aaidapashakino inkariak, netii enkoilielio enkewarie pooki ilng'osil laainei.
Ore enkisisa ai naa ng'ejuk te nanu, ore enkawuo ai naa ng'ejuk anaake te nkaina ai.
“Aainining'o nanu iltung'ana naanyu, negira einining enkikoo ai.
Ore peyie aidip airoro, eitu eitoki ninche aairo, nebaiki ororei lai ninche.
Aataanyutua ninche nanu anaa enaanyu enchan, nebol inkutukie enye anaa enchan oloirujuruj.
Aatakweniyie ninche nanu ina kata meeta enkitieunoto; ore ina wang'an enkomom ai neitagol ninche.
Ategelua nanu enkoitoi enye, naton anaa olautaroni, naton anaa olaiguanani tiatua oltim lenye, natiu anaa ilo oitagol lelo ooishir.”
Kake kaakueniyie taata ninche nanu, iltung'ana ooti te nanu, laa ore apa loo menye, naa iltung'ana le pesho, ilaa maaidim ninye aitaboitaki ildiein laainei oorrip intare.
Kainyoo nanu aidim anoto te ngolon oo nkaik enye, iltung'ana ooisha engolon enye?
Ore to sina o te sumash nagol, naa kenyaal intona naatoito.
Kedung'u ninche mbenek e ntim, o ntona o lpurkel aaitaa endaa.
Etaarayioki ninche aaitung'uaa iltung'ana, nebuaku iltung'ana emirita ninche anaa iloosujaa olapurroni.
Ilbaat loo ndapidapo epuo ninche aamany, ingumot enkop o olkutot loo ndapidapo.
Keru ninche anaa ng'uesi tiatua ntimi, neiturrurro tenebo too loipi.
Ilmoda ninche, le ishoi oo larruok, etaarayioki ninche aaipang'ie te nkop.
Nataa taata nanu osinkolio lenye meekure aata tipat te ninche.
Aaibaitie nanu naatalama nanu; meingash ninche aanotaki tenaadol.
Ore te nkaraki natalaa Enkai enkeene ai naaitobor nanu, aaibelekenyakinote ninche nanu te ngoro enye pooki.
Ore te nkaina ai e tatene neinyoito ilmang'ati, naareu ninche nanu aarrumoo, naapikaki nanu aaraki inkoitoi enye e nkidaaroto.
Keinyal ninche enkoitoi ai, neitubulaa ninche engolikinoto ai, metii hoo obo omitiki ninche.
Kepuonu ninche anaa iloim elusie nalala naapuonu aasulakino nanu aapurd.
Aaibelekenyakaki nanu olkirutoto ore enkisisa ai nemirareki anaa enamirita enkijape ore karsisisho ai neisha anaa enkatampoi.
Ore taata neiting'ieki enkishui ai te nanu; aaineputua nanu inkolong'i osina aaibung.
Ore enkewarie pooki neme iloik laainei, ore emion naaitame nanu nemeyagaa.
Ore to larrabal neibung ninye olkila lai, naaen nanu anunuk anaa enkila.
Aatanang'aka nanu Enkai atua esarng'ab, natotiwuo anaa enterit o nkuruon.
Aaishiraka nanu iyie neitu kiwaliki nanu, aitasho nanu nimikining iyie nanu.
Kimbelekenyakine nanu agorokino; te nkidimata enkaina ino kitaarare iyie nanu.
Kidumu iyie nanu aya shumata enkijape, nikincho iyie matakedo ninye nikimposhiposh iyie nanu te nkikurrukur olkutati.
Ee, kayiolo nanu ajo aikipik iyie atua keeya, o atua ina aji nategelakaki lelo pooki oishu.
Naa amaa obo to lturrur le nkidaata aimeitorioo enkaina enye, ore te mutata enye neishiru eretoto.
Keitu nanu aishiraki ilo laa ore enkolong enye netagolikio, keitu eishir oltau lai to sina te nkaraki lelo aisinak?
Kake tenaing'oru nanu esidano, nepuonu ntorrok; naa tenaanyu ewang'an, nelotu enaimin.
Ketii oltau lai osomit, nemeitirring'a aekata, naatabaikitia inkolong'i o loisilisili nanu.
Kaloolo aaitorokaki, neme te nkolong, aitashe tiatua olturrur naishiru eretoto.
Kataa nanu olalashe loo mbariak nataa ole choliek oo Sidan.
Eibelekenye olchoni lai aroku naaitoki aing'uaa, ore iloik laainei neyupuyup te nkirowuaj.
Eibelekenyaki olwulul lai loo usin, metaa enkishirata o sina ore oltoilo le ndule ai neibelekenyaki metotiwuo anaa oltoilo le lelo ooishir.
“Aitobira olning'o too nkonyek aainei; kaji naa aiko tenaitoki ang'uar eselenkei nemeyiolo olee?
Kainyoo erubata ai naing'uaa Enkai natii shumata, naa kainyoo enjung'ore ai te ilo Magilani le shumata?
Aimedoiki ingolikinot lelo torrok, netum emutata lelo aasak loo ntorrok?
Aimedol ninye inkoitoi aainei, neiken iroruat aainei pooki?
Amaa tenaa kashomo nanu tenebo iloolejisho, neisarisara enkeju ai alo alejisho.
(Inchoo maineneng'i te ntemet naineneng'ishoreki nemeeta emonkoi naa inchoo Enkai eyiolou enkitashoto ai!)
Tenaa keibelekenye eroruata apaash enkoitoi neshomo oltau lai arubare nkonyek aainei, naa teneibung'a oltipoto ake ninye pooki inkaik aainei;
nchoo naa aaku oloun, nenya likae; naa inchoo ina nabulu aa enaai eturuni aaitayu.
“Tenetang'uarra oltau lai enkitok ole latia ai, nairraga aanyisho te kutukaji ole latia ai,
inchoo enkitok ai eyieraki likae lee, naa inchoo ilkulikae eirrugokino ninye.
Amu keaku ina embae torrono oleng, neaku entorroni naiguanare neitame ilarishak.
Amu keaku ina enkima namut pooki toki, nepejoo too ntona pooki toki ai natum.
Tenatanya nanu aning enyamali o laisiaayiani lai aashu enkaisiaayiani ai, enkata nayautua olong'unyung'unyi te nkaraki nanu.
Kainyoo naa alo aas teneinyototo Enkai? Amaa teneikilikuanisho, kaa nanu awaliki ninye?
Amaa ilo laaitobirua nanu te nguset aime ninye oitobirua ninye? Naa aime ilo obo oitobirua iyiook te nguset.
“Tenatomito nanu ae toki nayieu olaisinani, aashu tenaishirie nanu enkoliai,
aashu tenainosa nanu endaa ai openy eitu ang'arie likae, neitu ang'arie ilo okishi
(amu ore eiteru te nkitisho enye naitubulua nanu ninye anaa menye ore epuku aing'uaa enguset e ng'otonye natuutayie nanu ninye);
te natoduaa nanu obo lenye eidaaya, te nkaraki meeta inkilani o sesen, aashu oltung'ani aisinani lemeitoipo,
teneitu ninye aamayian nanu, naa teneitu eirowuajieki too lpapit loo ntare aainei,
tenatudumua enkaina ai aarare lelo okishin amu atoduaa eretoto te kishomi;
neaku inchoo inkaik aainei epuku aaing'uaa oloililai lai, naa inchoo enkaina ai eorunye te rubata enye.
Amu kara apa oloure enyamali naing'uaa Enkai nemaitieu aibelekenyakinoyu aing'ura enkitoo enye.
“Tenaitaa nanu saabu osiligi lai, aashu tenetaa saabu nasila aigarakino;
tenatishipe nanu te nkaraki naa sapuk enkarsisisho ai, aashu te nkaraki nanoto enkaina ai imasaa kumok;
tenaing'ura nanu enkolong ewang oleng, aashu olapa elo te sidano enye,
neeni oltau lai too nkisudorot mayiolo, netung'ututa enkutuk ai enkaina ai;
ore sii ninye ena naa eng'oki naitame ilarishak amu ataa olalejani te Nkai e shumata.
“Tenatishipakine nanu enkidaata e ilo laaiba, aashu ashipa ina kata peyie eidimu ninye entorroni.
(Eitu nanu aisho enkutuk ai eas eng'oki, pee aomonu enkishui enye to ldeket);
teneitu ejo iltung'ana lo lng'obor lai, ‘Kalo otii ine leitu etum aiputakinoyu te ndaa enye?’
(Ore ilo omoni eitu eirrag enkoitoi nalala e nkanasa; ataboloko nchomito aainei lelo apuayak);
tenaisudoyie aitemoo enkarruoisho ai too ltung'ana anuk intorrok aainei to lgoo lai,
amu aitasho nanu te nkuretisho sapuk aure olturrur, naaiture nanu enkiba oo lmareita, metaa atigire neitu aipang aim inchomito.
Oi naaji duoo tenaa kaata obo laaning nanu! (Nena entukunyata olkimojino lai! Inchoo Olmagilani aawaliki nanu!) Oi naaji tenaa kataa enesirare imbaa aainei naaigero ilo mang'atinta lai!
Kesipa anaata nanu anap to loililai lai; anaata aeniki kewan anaa enkopiyia e nkitoo.
Ekaisho nanu ninye imbaa aainei pooki oo roruat aainei; ekalo nanu enetii ninye te nkanyit naishori oltung'ani kitok.
“Teneishira enkop ai, te nkaraki nanu, naa teneishira ineeturo enkurma tenebo;
te nainosa ilng'anayio lenyena eitu alak, aashu ayaka keeya iloopeny,
inchoo ilkiku ebulu te rishata enkano, o endiati te rishata e shairi.” Neishunye irorei le Yob.
Metaa eitu eitoki kulo tung'ana pokira okuni aawaliki Yob amu aisupat ninye too nkonyek enyena makewan.
Neitoki Elihu olayioni le Berakel le Busi lo lmarei le Ram agoro. Etagorokine ninye Yob amu eitaa kewan olemeeta entioto, neaku Enkai eiteleiki entorroni.
Etagorokine sii lelo shoreta le Yob pokira okuni amu eitu eitoki aatum ewalata nawaliki Yob, hoo neibalie aajo etapong'ori Yob.
Etaanyua apa Elihu peyie eirorie Yob amu aibotoro apa ninche te ninye.
Ore peyie edol Elihu ajo meekure eetae ewalata te lelo lewa pokira okuni, negoro.
Newal Elihu olayioni le Barakel le Busi ajo, “Kara nanu oti too larin, nitamorua iyie metaa kaata duoo nanu enkuretisho aibalunye enduaata ai te yie
Atejo nanu, ‘Nchoo eiro nkolong'i, ore ilarin kumok neiteng'enisho eng'eno nagut.’
Kake ina kiyang'et natii tung'ani, enkiyang'et e ilo Magilani, ninye naidimie ninye metoning'u.
Aimme lelo moruak ooata eng'eno nagut, neme ilkituaak ooning'u esipata.
Metaa ajo nanu, ‘Toning'oki; nchooki sii nanu maibalie enduaata ai.’
“Ataanyua nanu irorei linono, atoning'o nanu nkirorot inono eng'eno nagut, ina kata ing'oru enijo.
Aaishoo iyie enkiok ai, nemetii hoo nabo neitu ewalu Yob, aashu olotawalua irorei lenyena te ntae.
Eng'ura ake ate pee mijojo ‘Kinoto eng'eno nagut; Enkai ake naidim atawalaki Yob amu italaikinote.’
Eitu ninye aaitorioki irorei lenyena agilunore nanu, nemawaliki nanu ninye too nkirorot inono.
“Etunumate ninche, meekure eeta enawalu; meekure ninche eeta ororei ojo.
Naa katon nanu aanyisho, eji amu meiro ninche, amu eitashe ninche teine nemeekure ewalu?
Ekaishoru sii nanu ewalata ai; naa kaibalie sii nanu enduaata ai.
Amu kaabore nanu irorei naarrumito oltau lai mairoro.
Etiu oltau lai anaa enaisho oo sabibu napising'a, etiu anaa olbene le naisho oo sabibu ng'ejuk, netaa kedanya.
Ekairo nanu peyie atum ayagie, ekabol enkutuk ai awalu.
Maitodolu nanu olkep te likae, aashu asukeny likae tung'ani,
amu mayiolo nanu atusukenyisho, pee maapik ake Olaitobirani lai enkiting'oto.
“Kake ore naa taata toning'o enkiroroto ai iyie Yob, nining'u irorei laainei pooki.
Atabolo enkutuk ai; eirorita olng'ejep le nkutuk ai.
Eibalunye irorei laainei esupatisho o ltau lai, ore nena naayiolo enkutuk ai neiro te sipata.
Aaitobirua nanu enkiyang'et e Nkai naaisho nanu enkiyang'et e ilo Magilani enkishui.
Tawalikiaki nanu tinindim; intobiru irorei linono te dukuya nanu; inyo mbalie enkitashoto ino.
Tayiolo ajo ara sii nanu ole Nkai anaa iyie; aaitobiruaki sii apa nanu te nterit.
Mincho enkuretisho ai kinture iyie. Mesapuku enkitirrishakinoto ai te iyie.
“Kesipa, iroro iyie aning'ito, natoning'o nanu oltoilo loo rorei linono.
Itejo, iyie ‘Kara nanu sinyati, maata enaitapong'o, maata eleyiata nemetii entorroni atua nanu.
Ng'ura ajo etum ninye inkitolonyat naaisikong'ie nanu, naaikenaa nanu aitaa olmang'atinta lenye.
Etipika nkejek aainei ilpisia aen neing'or inkoitoi aainei pooki.’
“Ng'ura ajo ore tena nimira asipani. Ekaawaliki nanu iyie, aikitok Enkai alang oltung'ani.
Kainyoo iyie pee ikeshare ninye; ijo, ‘Mewalu ninye hoo obo loo rorei laainei?’
Amu keiro Enkai te nkoitoi nabo, o tiare hoo nememusu oltung'ani ninye.
Te nkidetidet o nduaat e kewarie, ina kata najing injo naairoishi iltung'ana ina kata eyietaa njo too ndapashi enye,
nebol ninye inkiyiaa oo ltung'ana, neiture ninche too nkikoot.
Peyie etum ninye atoboina oltung'ani aitung'uai nkoitoi enyena, neiwuang'ie olwuasa to ltung'ani;
negolie oltau lenye aibooyo mejing engumoto o enkishui enye pee meidak to lalem.
“Keutari sii oltung'ani te nkitamioto e muoyian te ndapash enye, neponaa emion too loik lenyena.
Metaa meitoki enkishui enye ang'uar endaa ore enkoshoke enye nemeitoki ayieu endaa.
Neibibiari osesen lenye ometaa meekure elioo; ore iloik apa lemelioo nepuku aaibalayu.
Nenyikaki oltau lenye enemeneng'a, nenyikaki enkishui enye lelo ooyau keeya.
Tenetii olmalaika tenebo ninye, Olaitutumoni obo te nkalifu, pee eibalakinye oltung'ani enasipa te ninye;
neeta olng'ur te ninye ejoki, ‘Intajeu ninye mincho edoyio alo enemeneng'a, anoto elakunoto;
inchoo osesen lenye esika nejing kitisho inchoo ninye errinyokino inapa olong'i e ngolon e kitisho;’
eomon oltung'ani Enkai, neng'amu Enkai ninye, elotu ninye enetii Enkai te nchipai. Neliki iltung'ana enjeunoto enye,
neranyisho te dukuya iltung'ana ejo: ‘Ataasa eng'oki, natakordilo ina apa nasipa, neitu apa aaitalaki nanu.
Etalakua ninye oltau lai, pee medoyio alo atua enemeneng'a, naa kedol enkishui ai ewang'an.’
“Ng'ura ajo Enkai naas kuna pooki, kat are, kat uni tenebo oltung'ani.
Pee eyau arrinyu oltau lenye aitung'uaa enemeneng'a, pee etum ninye atoduaa ewang'an e nkishui.
Irrugu enkiok, iyie Yob, toning'oki; tigirayu peyie atum airoro.
Tiniata embae niyieu nijo, tawalikiaki; iroro amu kayieu oleng naaisho iyie esipata.
Naa te neme neijia, toning'oki nanu; tigirayu, amu kaaiteng'en iyie eng'eno nagut.”
Neitoki Elihu ajo:
“Entoning irorei laainei, intae iltung'ana ng'eni, nikirrugokiki enkiok, intae ooyiolo;
amu etem enkiok irorei, anaa enaishamisham olng'ejep endaa.
Emategelu iyiook ina nasipa; ematujurru tiatua ate ina sidai.
Amu etejo Yob, ‘Maata nanu entioto, kake Enkai naawa esipata ai;
Ore hoo naata esipata aaikenayioki aajo olaimonkoni; meishiunoyu olbae lai, hoo nemaata entorroni.’
Kalo tung'ani onyaanyukie Yob ook esurdaanyata anaa enkare,
ilo olo te ncholiek oo laasak loo ntorrok, neiriamariyie iltung'ana arruok?
Amu etejo ninye, ‘Meeta toki natum oltung'ani teneshipakino Enkai.’
“Metaa, entoning'oki, intae iltung'ana ooata ening'unoto, metalamari ina te Nkai, tenaa keas ninye enkarruoisho, metalamari to Lmagilani tenaa keas ninye entorroni.
Amu ore te risioroto e siaai e tung'ani keitalakuni te ninye, naa ore te risioroto oo nkoitoi enyena nelaaki ninye.
Ore te sipata meas Enkai entorroni, nemeboin Olmagilani esipata.
Kaing'ae oishoo ninye metaa olaitasheikinoni le nkop? Naa kaing'ae otipika ninye meitasheiki enkop pooki?
Tenerriny ninye enkiyang'et enye makewan, neiturrurroki kewan enkiyang'et enye,
neidaaya iseseni pooki tenebo nerrinyokino oltung'ani atua enterit.
“Tiniata eyiolounoto, toning'u ena; toning'o ina najo nanu.
Amaa ilo lemenyor esipata, keitoreisho? Idung'oki iyie enkiguana ilo asipani naa magilani
aing'ae ojoki olaiguanani, ‘Miata tipat’ nejoki ilkituaak, ‘Irara arruok;’
ilo lemeitodolu olkep too lkituaak, nemeshilaa ilo karsis aitalang ilo aisinani, amu ore ninche pooki naa esiaai oo nkaik enyena?
Ore te nkiti kata neye ninche; ore te mpolos e nkewarie neari metuata ore lelo magil neyae ninche nemme too nkaik e tung'ani.
“Amu etii nkonyek enyena shumata nkoitoi e tung'ani, nedol ninye iroruat enyena pooki.
Metii osina aashu enaimin nagut, ine neisudoriyie ilaasak loo ntorrok ate.
Amu eitu eutu enkata te pooki tung'ani pee elo dukuya Enkai te nkiguana.
Eiwuang'ie ninye lelo magil eitu eng'as ajurru, nepik kulikae iwuejitin enye.
Ore amu keyiolo ninye isinaitin lenye, keibeleleng'oo ninche te nkewarie, nepurdi ninche.
Keosh ninye ninche te nkaraki enkarruoisho enye edolita pooki tung'ani.
Amu eibelekenyate ninche aany esuj ninye nemeikenaa hoo enkoitoi enye nabo,
pee etum aaishoo olkiyioi le ilo aisinani elotu enetii, netoning'o ninye enkishirata e ilo oata enyamali.
Amaa tenegira, kaing'ae oidim aiguanare? Amaa teneisudoo enkomom enye, kaing'ae oidim atoduaa ninye, aa olo losho ora anaa oltung'ani?
Meitoreisho iltung'ana lemeure Enkai, pee mepik iltung'ana orreshet.
“Ketii obo otiaaka Enkai, ‘Anoto enkitamioto oleng,’ maitoki aekata aitadiak.
Inteng'enaki nanu ina nemadolita; tenataasa nanu entorroni, nemaitoki aekata aigil aas?
Keitobir ninye ina ninyorraa iyie, amu itanya iyie ninye? Amu meeta nchere pee meyie ogelu; neme nanu ogelu metaa imbalie ina niyiolo.
Ekaajoki nanu iltung'ana le ning'unoto, ore lelo tung'ana ng'eni laainining'ito nanu nejo,
‘Ekeiro Yob meeta eng'eno, ore irorei lenyena nemetii eng'eno nagut.’
