Enaikash tenetemi Yob o meiting'o, amu kewal ninye anaa iltung'ana torrok.
Amu keponiki ninye engolong'u ing'ok enyena, keosh inkaik enyena tiatua iyiook, neponaa irorei lenyena akeshare Enkai.”
Neitoki Elihu ajo,
“Idamu iyie ena nijo kesipata? Ijo iyie, ‘Esipata ai ena te dukuya Enkai,’
amu inkilikuanu ajo, ‘Kainyoo tipat naata nanu? Kaa sipata nanu aata alang tenataasa eng'oki?’
Ekaawaliki nanu iyie tenebo ilchoreta linono likiboitare.
Ing'ura keper pee idol, naa ng'ura nena atampo, naatii shumata oleng shumata iyie.
Amaa tinitaasa eng'oki, kainyoo indim ataasa pee igilunore ninye? Naa amaa te netoponari intorrok inono, kaa iyie intaas ninye?
Amaa tinira iyie asipani kainyoo inchoo ninye; aashu kainyoo doi eng'amu ninye te nkaina ino?
Ore intorrok inono naa oltung'ani laaijo iyie eipirta ore esupatisho ino naa enkerai e tung'ani.
“Ore te nkaraki nena kibookinot kumok e nkop e tung'ani neishir iltung'ana; keipotu ninche eretoto te nkaraki enkaina e ilo Magilani.
Kake metii olojo, ‘Koree Enkai Olaitobirani lai, ilo oishoru isinkolioitin te nkewarie;
ilo oiteng'en iyiook alang nena ng'uesi enkop neiteng'en iyiook aitalang imotonyi o loing'ang'e?’
Keishir ninche te idie, mewaliki ninye ninche, te nkaraki ilo wuasa loo ltung'ana torrok.
Kesipa tukul mening Enkai enkishirata e pesho, nemeshilaa ilo Magilani ninye.
Kebaa naa elus tenijo midolita ninye, inchere etii enkiguana dukuya ninye, naa ninye iyie iyanyu!
Neaku ore naa taata amu meitameisho engoro enye, nemeinining'u ninye oleng intorrok.
Kebol Yob enkutuk enye te nkiroroto e pesho, neponaa irorei lemeeta eng'eno.”
Neitoki Elihu alo dukuya nejo:
“Nyaaki ting'iria penyo peyie aatum aitoduaa, amu eton ake aata enajo te rishata e Nkai.
Ekayau nanu eng'eno ai tenelakua, naisho esipata Olaitobirani lai.
Amu kesipa tukul ore irorei laainei neme elejare; ore ilo oiputakine eng'eno netii tenebo iyie.
“Aimagilani Enkai, nemeeta ninye olomenaa, aimagilani ninye te ngolon eyiolounoto.
Meisho ninye lelo torrok ebikoo, kake keisho lelo ooitanyamali esipata enye.
Meiwuang'ie ninye inkonyek te lelo supati, kake ore too laiguanak te nkitoo enye, neitasheyie ninche intarasi, neyanyituni ninche.
Naa teneeni ninche too lpisia neibung'i too lgoso le nkisilisiloto e mion,
neibalakinye ninye ninche esiaai enye, tenebo enkarruoisho enye, inchere keasita ninche mbaa o lwuasa.
Kebol ninche inkiyiaa enye aaning enkiteng'enare, neitanapisho ajo metung'uai ninche intorrok enye.
Tenening ninche ninye neisiaai ninye, neishu ninche inkolong'i enye te dupoto, ore ilarin lenye nebore enchipai.
Kake tenemening ninche, naa keidaikieki to lalem neye meeta eng'eno.
Ore ilo lemeeta Enkai to ltau, nenyor engoro; meishiru ninche eretoto teneen ninye ninche.
Keye ninche eton aa ooti, neiting enkishui enye te nkurruna.
Keitajeu ninye lelo ooitamei aitung'uaa nyamalaritin enye, nebol inkiyiaa enye too ngolikinot.
Aikilaku sii ninye iyie too sinaitin, nikipik ewueji nelala nemetii batisho, ore ina natipikaki emisa ino nebore olkar.
Kake kibore iyie enkiguana e ilo torrono, kimbung'a akurraki enkiguana o esipata.
Toduaa ake mikien engoro aeniki esurdaanyare; nimincho ina sapuko elakunoto kimbelekeny.
Amaa enkishirata ino aikindim aitayu tiatua osina, aashu engolon enkidimata ino pooki?
Mianyu iyie enkewarie, ina kata nadung'ori iltung'ana aaiwuang'ie te wueji enye.
Toduaa kewan mimbelekenyakino intorrok amu ena ninye itegelua eitu igelu olosilisili.
Ng'ura ajo, Eisisaki Enkai te ngolon enye; aing'ae olaiteng'enani onyaanyukie ninye.
Aing'ae otuutaka ninye enkoitoi enye, aashu aing'ae oidim atejo, ‘itaasa entorrono?’
“Tadamu ilepie esiaai enye, ina nataranyakita iltung'ana.
Eing'ura iltung'ana pooki ninye; neing'or oltung'ani ninye te nelakua.
Ng'ura ajo, aikitok Enkai, nimikiyiolo iyiook ninye; mejurrunoyu esiana oo larin lenyena.
Amu keitadou ninye ilkitong'at le nchan, neirriu ninye enkinuku te nkata e nchan.
Ina nabukunye enchan te shumata, neshaiki iltung'ana te nkumoi.
Keidim likae atayiolo enkisalaashata oo nkatampo, o endarata e keper enye?
Ng'ura ajo keidapash ninye enkiwuangata enye aitaman kewan, nenuk inkonyek oo naaiposha.
Amu te kuna eiguanare ninye iloreren; neishooyo endaa te leng'on.
Keimulumul ninye inkaik enyena te nkiwuang'ata, neitanap ninye metoosho ine neyieu.
Kelim endarata elotunoto e Nkai, neyiolou sii ing'uesi elotunoto enye. Ilo oata olom o engoro eiba entorroni.
“Ore ake sii tena neikirikira oltau lai, nepuku aing'uaa ewueji enye.
Toning'o endarata o ltoilo lenye o endarata napuku te nkutuk enye.
Abori keper pooki eimie ninye ina darata, ore enkiwuang'ata enye, neisho meshomo ilpijat pooki le nkop.
Ore pee elusoo neikurrukurr oltoilo lenye; nedaru ninye to ltoilo lenye le nkitoo nemeibooyo ninye inkiwuang'at tenening'i oltoilo lenye.
Kedaru Enkai te nking'asia to ltoilo lenye; keas ninye imbaa sapuki nimikindim aatoning'u.
Amu kejoki ninye enkare nataa osoit te nkirobi, ‘Tadoiki enkop;’ nejoki enkirujuruj tenebo enchan, ‘Entagol.’
Enuk ninye inkaik e pooki tung'ani pee etum iltung'ana pooki aatayiolo esiaai enye.
Ina pee epuo ing'uesi entim irrumati lenye, neitirring'a too lkutot lenye.
Nepuku olkutati te wueji enye, o enkijape to lkutati le nkidapash.
Te nkiyang'et Enkai eishoruni isoito le nchan, ore nkariak naalala neitaa enkare osoit.
Eirotoki ninye enkatampoi nairrusha enkare; ore nkatampo neidapash enkiwuang'ata enye.
Eipila ninche aamanaa te utaroto enye, pee etum aaitabai nena pooki naaitanapa ninche, tioriong eina kop namanyayu.
Enkai nairriu enchan metashaiki enkop, keidim airriu meitamio iltung'ana, anaa eitodol ninche enyorrata enye.
“Toning'o ena iyie Yob; intasho ineneng'a nena siaaitin e nking'asia e Nkai.
Iyiolo iyie eneikunaki Enkai enkitanapata enye ntokitin, neisho ina kiwuang'ata enkatampoi enye metawang'a?
Iyiolo iyie enkiroishi oo nkatampo, nena baa e nking'asia e ilo oata eng'eno nalulung'a.
Iyie laa ore nkilani enyena keirowua ina kata eitirring'e enkop, te nkaraki olkutati le kopikop?
Indim iyie anaa ninye aisalaasha keper, aitagolo anaa enking'uret nasholuno?
Inteng'ena iyiook enikipuo aajoki ninye, mikindim iyiook aayau ororei lang te nkaraki enaimin.
Kejokini ninye nchere ekairo nanu? Ketang'uarra aekata oltung'ani ajo keishiaakino neijori ninye?
“Ore taata meidim iltung'ana aaing'ura ewang'an, ina kata aa sapuk ewang'an te keper ina kata eidipa olkutati aimai neor.
Kelotu te moikuape esikar e saabu; eishopokino Enkai enkitoo enking'asia.
Ore ilo Magilani, mikiindim aanoto ninye, kitok ninye te ngolon o too sipat ore esupatisho natimitunye mepal ninye.
Ore te nkaraki ina keure iltung'ana ninye; meshilaa hoo lelo oojo aing'eni te lejare enye maate.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani awaliki Yob to lkutati:
“Aing'ae ele oitomisimis enkikoo too rorei lemetii eng'eno?
Intasho anaa olee, kaaikilikuanishore nanu iyie, naa aikimbalakinye iyie nanu.
“Kaji apa itii iyie ina kata napik olkitamanyunoto le nkop? Tolikioki, tena iata eyiolounoto.
Aing'ae oibalie ntemat o lkitamanyunoto le nkop Kesipa iyiolo iyie! Aashu aing'ae oyietaa ilo gosoi aitaman olkitamanyunoto le nkop?
Kainyoo naitasheyie ng'apeta enyena, aashu aing'ae oitasheyie osoit lenye lo lmairroto,
ina kata eranyisho ilakir le ntadekenya tenebo, nebuaku ilmalaika pooki le Nkai te nchipai?
“Aashu aing'ae oiken ina aiposha too nkikeneta, ina kata nadanya aing'uaa enguset;
tenaitaa nanu nkatampo olkila lenye, naitaa enaimin enkimulumulet enye,
nautaki ninye ilpolosien, napik iloom ooikenieki nchomito,
najo, ‘Ene taa ilotu abaiki, nimigiroo, naa ene ebaiki olwuasa loo lopir linono’?
“Intanapa ae olong entadekenya anaa ninteru nkolong'i inono, nincho entadekenya metayiolo ewueji enye.
Peyie etum aibung'a ineeiting'ie enkop, neipiripirori iltorrok aaitung'uaa ninye?
Keibelekenyi ninye anaa enterit natii abori olmishire, neibelekenye emua enye anaa enkila.
Ore too ltorrok neibooki ewang'an enye, ore enkaina enye natudumuaki aailepie negili.
“Itijing'a oshi aikata atua nkonyek e naiposha aashu ilo tiatua enegut enaiposha too nkejek?
Aikintoduaaki iyie inchomito e keeya, anaa itodua iyie inchomito e naimin nagut?
Itoning'uo iyie asipu endapasho enkop? Imbalunye tiniyiolo kuna pooki.
“Koree doi ina oitoi nalo emanyisho e wang'an, naa koree emanyisho e naimin
peyie itum aitabaiki ninye olpolosie lenye, peyie itum atumusu atayiolo nena oitoi naapuo enkang enye?
Iyiolo iyie amu kitoiwuoki apa ina kata, ore esiana oo nkolong'i inono naa kumok!
“Itijing'a iyie ilkompen ooshumieki enkare nataa osoit le nkirobi, anaa itodua iyie nena ajijik naashumishoreki oo soito le nchan,
lelo apa laiteng'ela nanu te nkaraki enkata enyamali, te nkolong o larrabal o enjore?
Koree enkoitoi nalo ine wueji neidapashieki ewang'an aashu ewueji neidapashieki olkutati lo loo saen tioriong enkop?
“Aing'ae otuturo olbaata oim enkare enchan, neitobir enkoitoi te nkaraki endarata.
Pee eyau enchan enkop ine nemetii oltung'ani, ilo purkel lememanya oltung'ani.
Pee eitaraposh ina kop mijooni nememanya, neisho enkop metubulaki nkujit?
“Keeta enchan papaai lenye, naa aing'ae ilo oitobirua ilkitong'at le nkoileelio?
Ke nguset e ng'ae etupukunye isoito le nchan, naa aing'ae otoiwuo isoito le nchan le shumata?
Etoyu nkariak negolu anaa soito, ore oriong eng'uton netoyu agolu te nkirobi.
“Indim iyie ateena ilpisia loo lakir, anaa intololong ieneta e orion?
Indim iyie atuutai ilakir too nkatitin enye, aashu indim iyie atorikoi olng'arurumi tenebo ilkuoo lenyena?
Iyiolo iyie nkiguanat e keper? Indim iyie aitasheyie enkitoria enye te nkop?
“Indim iyie atudumu oltoilo lino aitabaiki nkatampo, pee kitum oloirrag loo nkariak aaitoipoi iyie?
Indim iyie airriwai inkiwuang'at pee etum aashom, nikijoki ninche iyie, ‘Noona iyiook?’
Aing'ae otipika eng'eno nagut atua oltau lo ltung'ani, aashu aing'ae naishoo elukunya o ltung'ani ening'unoto?
Aing'ae oidim aikena nkatampo te ng'eno nagut? Anaa aing'ae oidim atipika ilbenia le nkare.
Ina kata eibung'a enterit aaku esarng'ab, neibung'a pooki aaku nabo?
“Indim iyie atarreshoki olng'atuny entoki nanya, aashu intaraposho enkoshoke oo nkiyioitin o lng'atuny,
ina kata eisudori too nkapuniaa enye, aashu eirrag aanyisho too rrumati lenye?
Aing'ae oitoti ilkurruki, ina kata eishiraki inkiyioitin enye Enkai, nemanimanaa eitu etum endaa?
“Iyiolo iyie enkata naisho nkineji oo ldoinyio? Itodua iyie enkolii eisho?
Indim iyie aikena ilapaitin ooitabaya ninche, niyiolou enkata napuo aaisho?
Iyiolo iyie enkata nairrugo neiu nkera enye?
Ore nkera enye neiteru aagolu nebulu too nkisiashat; nepuaya nemeitoki aarrinyokino ninche.
“Aing'ae oishoo iloitikoishi meidapashari aapuaya? Aing'ae otalaa ieneta e nkurrarru naten.
Aishoo ninche olpurkel metaa emanyisho enye, ore enkop emunyan neaku emanyisho enye.
Kelam ninche inkanas naabore enkilepilep, nemeetae oltung'ani oidim aitoborro ninche, neisiaaishore ninche.
Nchumat oo ldoinyo ninche ndaat enyena, nelimana aaing'oru pooki toki nanyori.
“Keyieu olkiteng le ntim nikisiaai iyie? Keirrag ninye ilo ale lino?
Indim iyie aibung'a ninye te nkeene mikituturoki enkurma, aashu incho ninye mikitaaraki ilboro te nkurma ino?
Indim iyie aisiliga ninye te nkaraki naa sapuk engolon enye, naa aing'ueiki iyie ninye esiaai ino?
Isilig iyie ninye ajo keshukunye, neyau entapa ino olkurroto oidong'ishoreki?
“Eyuko inaipuko e sidai to lwuasa; kake amaa, keeta ninche olng'ur?
Amu keing'uaa ninye ilmosor lenyena te nkop, neisho ninche eirowuajieki te nkop,
nerikino ajo keidim enkeju atadanya ninche, ore ng'uesi entim neitunyoo ninche.
Meing'urrie ninye nkera enyena, meitaas ninche anaa nkera enyena; ore hoo tenaa enepesho esiaai enye, meureisho ninye;
amu eishoo Enkai ninye metorikinoyu eng'eno nagut, neitu eoriki ninye erubata e ning'unoto.
Ore tenedumunye ninye aisik, nekueniyie embarta olokedito ninye.
Incho embarta engolon enye? Ieniki emurt enye engolon?
Incho ninye eipid alo anaa olmaati? Ore enkitoo enye o ltoilo oitayu neitureisho.
Ketur ninye atua nong'ot, neng'idare engolon enye, neipang ninye alo ong'ata anang'are te ngolon olarrabal.
Kekueniyie ninye enkuretisho, nemeirut ninye; nemeibelekenya ninye apaashare olalem.
Eikirikirie emootian to loililai lenye neeta empere naimerlel.
Ore te mpijan o te ngoro sapuk neijoo ninye enkop; meidim ninye aitasho aitirring'ayu te nkorui e ntarumpeta.
Ore teneru esekekua, nejo ninye ‘Aha!’ Keing'uaya ninye olarrabal tenelakua endarata e lelo kituaak le njore, o nena buakunot.
“Ai te ng'eno ino nagut eyiolou le nkalem ailepa shumata oleng, nelak inaipuko enyena aipirie kopikop?
Ai te nkitanapata ino edumunye olkurragos alo ashet enkaji enye te shumata?
Te ndapidapoi eton aitobiraki kewan enkang, neitaa ineepi oo soito osempewuet lenye.
Keing'oru ninye entoki nanya, nedol inkonyek enyena ninye tenelakua.
Ore nkiyioitin enyena neibibiu osarge; ore ewueji pooki neteyieng'ishoreki, ine etii ninye.”
Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Yob:
“Keidim oloing'oru entorroni atekeshare ilo Magilani? Ore ilo oishankarrare Enkai, inchoo ninye ewal ina.”
Neitoki Yob awaliki Olaitoriani, ejo:
“Ng'ura ajo mara toki naikenaroyu; kainyoo nanu aawaliki iyie? Atipika nanu enkaina ai anuk enkutuk ai aiken.
Airoro apa te nkata nabo, nemaitoki awal; kat are, nemaitoki alo dukuya.”
Newaliki Olaitoriani Yob to lkutati ejo:
“Terretena empolos ino anaa olee; kaaikilikuanishore nanu iyie, nikimbalakinye nanu.
Aikipik sii nanu enkitapong'oto? Aikidung'oki iyie nanu enkiguana peyie itum aitaa kewan olasipani?
Iyata iyie enkaina natiu anaa ene Nkai? Naa indim iyie atadara to ltoilo laaijo olenye?
Tukusoyu te nkitoo o te nkanyit. Inchopoki kewan enkitoo o esikar.
Tubuku intayu ina goro ino nadooyo, ning'or pooki ng'ae owuasa, nintadoyio ninye.
Ing'ura pooki ng'ae owuasa, nintadou ninye, nintunyoki enkop lelo torrok te pooki neitasheyie.
Isudoi ninche pooki tenebo tiatua enterit, nkenoi inkomomi enye te nkop e abori.
Naalotu sii nanu anyorraa, nchere enkaina ino e tatene makewan nayau enkisulata.
“Ing'ura sii iyie ina kukuu naji Behemot ina naitobirua nanu anaa pee aaitobirua iyie; kenya ninye olkujita anaa olkiteng.
Naa ng'ura, empolos enye etii engolon enye, netii engolon enye nkirnyany e nkoshoke enye.
Neitagol ninye olkidong'oe lenye anaa oltarakuai; ore isinigi loo nkejek enyena neibung'a tenebo.
Ore iloik lenyena netiu anaa indulen o suyai; netiu inkejek enyena anaa ing'apeta e sekenkei.
Ninye ene nkiterata too siaaitin pooki Enkai; inchoo ilo oitobirua ninye eitinyiku olalem lenye!
Amu too ldoinyio epuku endaa enye, teine neiguranie ng'uesi pooki entim.
Eirrag ninye tiabori entim oo lkiku, tiatua ine netii iseyia to lbalbal.
Amu tiabori lelo oipi loo lkiku elo ninye ashur; neman ninye nchorroi oo nkariak.
Ing'ura, tenenang'unye oreyiet nemeiture ninye; meeta enkuretisho hoo tenenang'unye olkeju le Yordan.
Keetae oloidim aawa ninye too ntokitin naibung'ieki isinkir? Aashu een enkume enye to rreshet?”
Indim iyie aibung'a aitupuku Lefiatan to rreshet loo sinkir? Aashu ikurraki olng'ejep lenye enkeene?
Indim iyie atipika olgosoi enkume enye: aashu iremoki olboony lenye orreshet oololo?
Aikiyaki ninye esayiata sapuk aikirorie ninye iyie te mborron?
Aikining'ore ninye iyie? Pee iya ninye metaa olaisiaayiani lino ntarasi?
Inguranie iyie ninye anaa eninguranie emotonyi aashu intaa entoki naiguranie inkaisiaayiak inono?
Keimaki ilainyang'ak enkinyang'a enye? Keorrioor ninche ninye aaoriki ilainyang'ak?
Indim aiputa olchoni lenye iltidii loo sinkir; aashu ipik elukunya enye entoki naibung'ieki isinkir?
Imbung'a sii iyie ninye; tadamu sii olarrabal, mintoki aigil aas!
Ore osiligi lo ltung'ani naa pesho; eitadouoki ninye teina duaata enye.
Meetae hoo olopi oleng oidim atuputu ninye aing'ae naa doi ilo oidim aitasho te dukuya nanu?
Aing'ae laishoo nanu, metaa kalaaki nanu ninye? Ore pooki toki natii abori e keper naa enaai.
Magirakino nanu eitu alimu irubat oo nkejek enyena, aashu engolon enye, aashu ilo ning'o lenye.
Aing'ae oidim aitayu olkila lenye lioriong? Aing'ae oidim ataremo ina kila enye nagol.
Aing'ae oidim atabolo iltagiligil lenyena? Emanita ninye ilala lenyena ooitureisho.
Ore enkoriong enye neitobiruaki too long'oi naaripakino, neripakino oleng anaa inaamishirakino.
Etiripaki ninche aaitinyik oleng, ometaa meim enkijape erishata enye.
Eibung'ieki aitutum tenebo; eibungieki metaa meekure erishayu.
Ore pee esing ninye neidapashaa ewang'an, ore nkonyek enyena netiu anaa entadekenya nawang'u.
Kepuku te nkutuk enye ilkilang'ilang'eta le wang'an neng'orunye iltiil le nkima teine.
Nepuku too nkumeishin enyena empuruo, naikununo anaa empuruo oo suut naayupuyup tiabori emoti.
Ore enkiyang'et enye neinok inkuk enkima, nepuku olng'ejep le nkima te nkutuk enye.
Etii emurt enye engolon, neiture ninye pooki odol ninye.
Ore ngilat o lchoni lo sesen lenye neibung'a tenebo, ekurrakino pooki ninye metaa meigusugus.
Kegol oltau lenye anaa osoit, agol anaa osoit oturuno to lodo le nkop.
Ore tenedumu kewan ailepie neirut lelo magil; ore te nkaraki enkuretisho enye, nemilo.
Ore hoo nebaiki ninye olalem nemedung ninye; aashu eremet o embae o empere naado, naji mataarie naaijo eremet.
Kedol ninye esekenkei etiu anaa olkujita, ore osuyai netiu anaa oltiapurusi.
Meiture ninye embae meilanyisho; amu ore isoito oonang'ieki ninye netiu anaa nguetat.
Ore irinkan te ninye netiu anaa olkujita, ekueniyie ninye eng'ororoto e mpere.
Ore ilpala lenyena le nkoshoke netiu anaa mbelibelat e moti oo nkulupuok, ekur ninye enkop neitaa esarng'ab.
Eitokitokie ninye enguton anaa emoti; neitotiu enaiposha anaa emoti e ilata.
Ore etulusoyie ninye neing'uaa ewang'an te nkoitoi, neibelekeny enaiposha aiborrie anaa olaburra.
Ore tioriong enkop meeta ninye enanyaanyukie, ore ninye naa entoki nemeeta enkuretisho.
Keing'or ninye pooki toki natii shumata; naa ninye olaiguanani oitore nkera pooki o lwuasa.
Neitoki Yob awaliki Olaitoriani ejo,
“Kayiolo nanu ajo indim ataasa pooki toki, nayiolo ajo meeta eyieunoto ino nemeitabari.
‘Kaing'ae ele oisudoo enkikoo meeta eng'eno?’ Ore te nkaraki ina atejo imbaa neitu aning'u, intokitin e nking'asia te nanu, neitu apa aidip atayiolo.
‘Toning'o amu kairo nanu; kaaikilikuanishore nanu iyie, nikimbalakinye iyie nanu?’
Aatoning'oyie nanu iyie te ning'oto e nkiok, kake ore tena kata naadolita too nkonyek aainei.
Ore te nkaraki ina atemenayie nanu kewan tukul, nairridu te nterit o too nkuruon.”

Ore pee eidip Olaitoriani airorie Yob te kulo rorei, nejoki Olaitoriani Elifas le Teman: “Eyupuyupieki engoro ai te nkaraki iyie tenebo lelo shoreta linono pokira aare; amu eitu iroro intae tialo nanu imbaa naasipa anaa enairoro osinka lai Yob.

Ore naa taata iwa iloing'ok oopishana o lmeregeshi oopishana, nilo enetii osinka lai Yob, nilo aitayu teine te nkaraki kewan ino olasar opejori; pee kiomonoki osinka lai Yob, amu kang'amaa enkomono enye nemaaitaas nanu iyie terisioroto emodai ino amu eitu iro te nanu ina nasipa anaa enairoro osinka lai Yob.”
Metaa eshomo Elifas le Tema tenebo Bildad le Shua tenebo Sofar le Naaman aas ina natiaaka Olaitoriani ninche, neng'amaa Olaitoriani enkomono e Yob.
Neitoki Olaitoriani arrinyoki Yob imasaa enyena, ina kata eomonoki ilchoreta lenyena. Neisho Olaitoriani Yob katitin are oo ntokitin apa pooki naata te dukuya.

Neitoki aapuonu enetii ninye ilalashera lenyena pooki o nkanashera o lelo pooki apa ooyiolo ninye te dukuya, nenya ninche endaa tenebo ninye te nkaji enye; neing'urrie ninche ninye neitagol too ntorrok pooki apa naayaka Olaitoriani ninye; ore pooki lenye neisho ninye mpisai tenebo olpisiai le saabu.

Nemayian Olaitoriani nkolong'i e siadi e Yob oleng alang ine dukuya; neeta apa ninye intare nkalifuni tomon oong'uan o ntamesin nkalifuni ile o lmong'i ooturishore enkalifu nabo osirkon enkalifu nabo.
Eeta sii ninye apa ilayiok oopishana o ntoyie uni.
Nedung'oki enkarna enkikau enye ajo Yemima; ore eniare neipot ajo enkarna enye Kesia, ore eneuni nedung'oki enkarna ajo Karen Happuk.
Naa ore teinakop pooki, meetae apa ntoyie naainepu intoyie e Yob te sidano; neitujung menye pooki tenebo lalashera lenye.
Ore pee eidipayu ena, enyaaka Yob abik ilarin iip o artam, nedol ilayiok lenyena o layiok loo layiok lenyena, iishoritin ong'uan.
Neirura Yob, etaa olpayian kitok otobikoyie nkolong'i kumok oleng.
Emayiana ilo tung'ani lemelo enkiguana oo ltung'ana torrok, nemeitashe te nkoitoi oo laing'okok, nemeton to lturrur le lelo loo lderrat torrok,
kake ore eng'ida enye naa enkitanapata o Laitoriani, naa enkitanapata eibirribir ninye dama o kewarie.
Eikununo ninye anaa olchani otuunoki te mbata e nkare e nchorro, oiu ilng'anayio lenyena te rishata enye, nemetoyu imbenek enyena. Ore te nena pooki naas ninye, nedupoyu.
Mme neijia etiu lelo torrok, kake keikununo anaa suut naakutaa osiwuo.
Ore te nkaraki ina etudung'okoki enkiguana lelo torrok, negeluni aaitalam olturrur le lelo supati
amu keyiolo Olaitoriani enkoitoi e lelo supati, kake ore enkoitoi e lelo torrok naa keidak.
Kainyoo pee eitobirita iloshon enkarruoisho? Kainyoo pee eitobir iloreren nkitobirat enye e ntorroni e pesho?
Eiturrurrote ilaiguanak le nkop, neiguana lelo ooitoreisho te nebo, aagilunore Olaitoriani o ilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput, ejo,
“Matalak ienat enye nabo kata, nikinturraa nkeenta enye aaitalam ate.”
Ore ilo oton te shumata nekueni; neikordod nena kitobirat enye e pesho.
Naa keitoki ninye airorie ninche te ngoro enye napi, neiture ninche te ngoro namutisho, ejo,
“Atipika nanu olaiguanani lai shumata Sion, ilo doinyo lai sinyati.”
Kalikioo nanu ina natejo Olaitoriani: Aatiaaka ninye nanu, “Ira iyie enkerai ai, ore ena olong, aatoiwuo nanu iyie.
Toomonoki nanu, naa kaitaa nanu lelo oshon enjung'ore ino, naitaa ineeiting'ie enkop iwuejitin inono.
Nigil iyie ninche te ng'udi e sekenkei, nintaa ninche mbelibelat anaa emoti oo nkulupuok.”
Ore naa taata, lo aiguanak, entaa ng'eni; nchoo eikoki intae lo aitoriak le nkop.
Esiaayia Olaitoriani te nkuretisho, te nkikirikirata,
entung'utut inkejek enyena, megoro ake, nindaayaya te nkoitoi; amu keyupuyup engoro enye asioki. Emayiana lelo pooki oosaru ninye.
Iyie Olaitoriani, meikenayu ilmang'ati laainei! Aatudumakinote nanu ilkumok aagilunore;
ejoito ilkumok tialo nanu, metii eretoto naing'uaa Enkai te nkaraki ninye.
Kake ore iyie Olaitoriani, ira elong'o naamanita nanu, iyie enkitoo ai, naa iyie likincho emirishoi nikintagol.
Atabuakua nanu aishiraki Olaitoriani, naawaliki ninye nanu te ilo doinyo lenye sinyati.
Airraga nanu nairura; naitoki ainyototo, amu Olaitoriani laarripito.
Maure nanu iltung'ana inkalifuni tomon, lelo laatudumakinote nanu aarare naamuat.
Inyo, iyie Olaitoriani! Tokorduaki nanu na Ai ai! Amu itoosho iyie ilmang'ati laainei pooki isederi, itigila iyie ilala le lelo arruok.
Eno Laitoriani enkordunoto, meetu naa imayianat inono shumata iltung'ana linono.
Tawalikiaki nanu te naaipot, iyie na Ai e sipata ai! Kinchoo iyie nanu erishata ina kata atii atua osina. Ing'urrieki nanu, nining enkomono ai.
Lo tung'ana, ekintukurrurru kenya o anu? Inyorrurru intae irorei le pesho o anu, nirubarere elejare?
Kake tayiolo nchere, etegelaka Olaitoriani kewan ilo oure ninye; kening Olaitoriani te naipot nanu ninye.
Entagoroto kake emiaas ing'ok enguanata too ltauja linyi too ndapashi inyi, nigirara.
Ntayu ilasarri oosipa nipik osiligi lino atua Olaitoriani.
Etii ilkumok oojo, “Oi naaji tenaa eikidol iyiook embae sidai. Ng'urrie iyiook, Olaitoriani!”
Itipika iyie eng'ida kitok oltau lai nalang eng'ida naata ninche teneponari entapa enye o enaisho oo sabibu.
Te seriani nanu airrag airura, amu iyie ake Olaitoriani likincho matobiko te seriani.
Toning'o irorei laainei, iyie Olaitoriani; toduaa ndamunot aainei o ltau.
Toning'o oltoilo le nkishirata ai, Olaiguanani lai naa Enkai ai, amu iyie aomon nanu.
Iyie Olaitoriani, ining iyie oltoilo lai tadekenya; ore tadekenya naaitobiraki nanu iyie olasar, naton aanyisho.
Amu mira iyie Enkai nashipakino entorroni; nemeton entorroni te nebo iyie.
Meidim ilo oitokoos aitasho te dukuya inkonyek inono; imba iyie ilaasak loo ntorrok pooki.
Indaikie iyie lelo ooiro elejare; neitame Olaitoriani lelo oata enkure o sarge o laimonkok.
Kake ore nanu te nkaraki ina nyorrata ino sapuk nauno, naa kajing atua enkaji ino; kaseremisho nanu aipirare ina aji ino sinyati te uriata ino.
Torikoyioki nanu Olaitoriani te supatisho ino, te nkaraki ilmang'ati laainei; ntorioi enkoitoi ino te dukuya nanu.
Amu metii esipata nkutukie enye; ore iltauja lenye naa enkidaata, ore inaajo naa monko naapuo enkidaata, neikordodisho too lng'ejepa lenye.
Nchoo ninche enap enkitarruorroto enye, iyie Enkai; nchoo ninche ebatata too nkiguanat enye maate; ore te nkaraki nkitarruorot enye kumok taarai ninche mpang'ie, amu kitogolong'akita ninche iyie.
Kake nchoo lelo pooki likisaru iyie meting'idata, nchoo ninche metaranyisho anaake te ng'ida; naa tomitu iyie ninche, paa ore lelo pooki oonyor enkarna ino niking'idakino iyie.
Amu imayian iyie ilo asipani, iyie Olaitoriani; nintushur iyie ninye te nyorrata ino anaa elong'o.
Iyie Olaitoriani, mikisikong nanu te ngoro ino, nimikintame nanu te ngoro ino napi.
Ing'urrieki nanu iyie Olaitoriani, amu ataa oloishunye nanu: Olaitoriani, nchiunyeki, amu etororonyate iloik laainei.
Netanyamala sii oltau lai. Kake amaa iyie Olaitoriani, o anu kenya?
Mbelekenyunye Olaitoriani, ntajeu enkishui ai; tokorduaki nanu te nkaraki ina nyorrata ino nauno.
Amu ore tiatua keeya nimikintokini aadamu iyie; amaa, tiatua enemeneng'a kaing'ae likisis iyie?
Atalepori nanu te nkishirata ai; ore pooki kewarie neibalubalu ilkiyio laainei te ndapash, neilibilib endapash ai too lkiyio.
Eiliilaitie inkonyek aainei te nkaraki osina, eimisiloitie te nkaraki ilmang'ati laainei.
Enchom entung'uayioki, intae pooki aasak loo ntorrok; amu etoning'o Olaitoriani oltoilo le nkishirata ai.
Etoning'o Olaitoriani enkomono ai, etang'amayie Olaitoriani enkomono ai.
Keitukurruni ilmang'ati laainei pooki, neitanyamali, keibelekenya ninche aarrinyo, neitukurruni te nkata nabo.
Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai, iyie nanu asaru; ntajewuoki nanu te lelo mang'ati pooki laasujita, nikikordu nanu,
maaibung ake anaa olng'atuny, naaing'irtitoo aanya, metii hoo obo laamitu.
Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai, te nataasa nanu ena, te netii entorroni nkaik aainei,
tenaa katalaaka nanu olchore lai te ntorroni, tenaa kaitajewuo nanu ilo mang'atinta lai pesho,
nchoo ninye ilo mang'tinta lai aasuj naainepu nanu, naa nchoo ninye eitunyoki enkishui ai enkop, neipurrupur oltau lai.
Tudumunye Olaitoriani te ngoro ino, ntaisheikinore tigilunore ina pushuna oo lmang'ati laainei; inyo na Ai ai; amu itudung'o iyie enkiguana.
Nchoo eumata oo ltung'ana kinturrurrokino iyie, aaman; ore te shumata tipika olorika lino.
Olaitoriani oiguanare loreren; nguanareki nanu iyie Olaitoriani, te risioroto oo sipat aainei, o te risioroto e ina biotisho e supatisho ai.
Nchoo eiting entorroni e lelo torrok, kake ntubulai ilo supat, iyie ilo otem ndamunot o ltauja, iyie Enkai oo sipat.
Enkai ninye elong'o ai, ninye oitajeu ilo supat to ltau.
Enkai olaiguanani loo sipat, naa Enkai naata engoro nkolong'i pooki.
Te nemeirridu oltung'ani, neii Enkai olalem lenye, eteyietuo ninye enkawuo enye;
neitobira ninye nena masaa enyena o larrabal torrok, nepik mbaa enyena esayiet napi.
Ore ilo tung'ani torrono nedamu entorroni, nenuta ninye too ntabo, neiu elejare.
Neitobiru ninye engumoto aturu, nedoiki atua ina gumoto.
Ore ina taboi enye nerrinyokino enkorrok enye makewan, naa endukuya enye makewan edoiki entaboi enye.
Kaisho nanu Olaitoriani enashe nairirikino esupatisho enye, naranyaki nanu te nkisisa enkarna o Laitoriani, Ilo otii shumata Aisul.
Iyie Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lang, kebaa enkitoo e nkarna ino te nkop pooki! Ore enkisisa e nkitoo ino nebaiki keper
too nkutukie oo nkera kutiti o naanakita, intobira iyie olkitamanyunoto le negol, te nkaraki ilmang'ati linono, pee imbooyo ilo mang'atinta o ilo oitalaku elap.
Te naing'or nanu keper ino, ina siaai oo lkimojik linono, olapa o lakir litipika iyie;
kainyoo oltung'ani lilo iyie ashilaa, o enkerai e tung'ani ligolie iyie ninye?
Nintaa iyie ninye kiti penyo te kewan, ninchopoko iyie ninye enkitoo o enkanyit.
Inchoo iyie ninye enkitoria te shumata isiaaitin oo nkaik inono; itipika iyie ntokitin pooki abori nkejek enyena,
nkerra pooki o lmong'i o ng'uesi sii e ong'ata.
Imotonyi o loing'ang'e o sinkir le naiposha, pooki toki ake ninye nalo tiatua enaiposha.
Iyie Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lang, kebaa enkitoo e nkarna ino tiatua enkop pooki!
Kaaisho nanu iyie Olaitoriani enashe to ltau lai pooki; kalikioo nena kiaasin inono e nking'asia.
Kang'ida nanu naa kaaranyaki iyie, karanyisho nanu te nkisisa e nkarna ino, iyie Olotii Shumata Aisul.
Te neibelekenya ilmang'ati laainei, kerrorro neidaaya te dukuya iyie.
Amu intasheyie iyie esipata ai; itotona iyie to lorika le nkitoo ninguana te sipata.
Isikong'a iyie iloshon, ndaikie iyie lelo torrok; itujutoyie iyie aiwuang'ie enkarna enye ntarasi o ntarasi.
Eisha ilmang'ati te nkidaata oo ntarasi; nitadotuo iyie nkanas enye; ore endamunoto enye neisha.
Kake eton Olaitoriani to lorika le nkitoo ntarasi, neitasheyie olorika lenye le nkitoo pee etum atudung'o enkiguana;
nedung'oki ninye enkop enkiguana te sipata, nedung'oki iloreren enkiguana too nkiririkinot.
Olaitoriani ninye osempewuet le ilo oitorogonyi, osempewuet too nkatitin e nyamali.
Ore lelo ooyiolo enkarna ino nepik osiligi lenye atua iyie, amu ore iyie Olaitoriani, neitu inturraa lelo likisilig iyie.
Entaranyaki enkisisa Olaitoriani, ilo oton te Sion! Entolikioi tiatua iloreren inkiaasin enyena!
Amu ore ilo oitalaku elap o sarge, nedamu ninche; merikino ninye olkiyioi le ilo oata osina.
Ing'urrieki nanu Olaitoriani! Toduaa enyamali naata te nkaraki lelo laaiba. Iyie ilo laadumu nanu aitung'uaa nchomito e keeya,
pee atum atolimu enkisisa ino, paa ore too nchomito e Yerusalem, nang'idakino nanu enkordunoto ino.
Eimiso iloshon tiatua ina gumoto natuturo ninche; ore te ilo rreshet oisudoitie ninche nerruesh inkejek enye maate.
Eibalunye Olaitoriani kewan, etudung'o ninye enkiguana; etijing'a lelo torrok orreshet tiatua esiaai oo nkaik enye maate.
Kepuo lelo torrok aajing enemeneng'a, lelo oshon pooki lemedamu Enkai.
Ore ilaisinak nemeitokini aapalaa anaake ore osiligi loo laisinak nemeimin ntarasi.
Tudumunye Olaitoriani! Mincho oltung'ani meisula; nchoo iloreren eiguanareki te dukuya iyie!
Tipika ninche atua enkuretisho, Olaitoriani! Nchoo iloreren eyiolou aajo iltung'ana ake ninche!
Kainyoo pee intashe alamari, iyie Olaitoriani? Kainyoo iyie pee isudoo kewan too nkatitin oo ngolikinot?
To lwuasa emir lelo torrok ilaisinak; nchoo meibung'a ninche lelo rresheta ooitobira.
Amu keitokoos ilo torrono too yieunot o ltau lenye, ore ilo tung'ani oata olorok loo masaa nemenaa Olaitoriani.
Ore to lwuasa le nkomom enye nemeing'oru ninye Enkai; ore too ndamunot enyena pooki naa, “Meetae Enkai.”
Nebul too nkoitoi enyena inkatitin pooki; ore nkiguanat inono netii shumata, mebaiki ninye; ore ilmang'ati lenyena pooki neikordod ninche.
Nedamu ninye to ltau lenye ajo, “Maaigusugusieki nanu; ore tiatua iishoritin pooki matum nanu batisho.”
Kebore enkutuk enye ildeketa o elejare o enkitorogonyare; ore abori olng'ejep lenye netii ntabo o entorroni.
Neton ninye to lnukata too nkang'itie, ore tiatua iwuejitin neeisudoriyie nesesekuan lelo supati. Neikitalan lelo ooshal,
neirrag ninye to lnukata lenye anaa olng'atuny, pee etum aibunga ilo aisinani, neibung ninye ilo aisinani te nemiraki ninye atua orreshet lenye.
Nerrarri ilo oshal, neimisieki te nkop, nebatata te ngolon enye.
Nejo ilo torrono to ltau lenye, “Etorikine Enkai, eisudoyie ninye enkomom enye, medol toki.”
Tudumunye, iyie Olaitoriani, iyie Enkai, tudumu enkaina ino; mincho kirikino ilo oata osina.
Kainyoo pee eany ilo torrono Enkai, nejo to ltau lenye, “Maaitame ninye nanu!”
Idol iyie enyamali o sina, pee itum iyie aiwuang'ie too nkaik inono; ore ilo oshal naa iyie eigarakino; iyie otaa olaretoni loo lokishin.
Tigila iyie engolon e ilo torrono o eno larruoni; tusuja entorroni enye o metaba anaa neishunye.
Olaitoriani ninye olaiguanani ntarasi o ntarasi; keidak iloshon te nkaina enye.
Iyie Olaitoriani, ining iyie eyieunoto eilo obor; nintagol iyie ninye oshoke nirrugoki enkiok ino
pee inguanare te sipata ilo okishi o ilo oibookoki enkop, paa ore ilo tung'ani le nkop nemeigil ae kata aitureisho.
Atua Olaitoriani nanu asaru; kaji iyie inko pee kijoki nanu, “Isika anaa emotonyi shomo ildoinyo;
amu eteyietutuo lelo torrok enkawuo enye, etipika ninche embae enye empito, pee etum aatang'or te naimin ilo supat to ltau.
Amaa te neidaikieki ilkitamanyunot kaa eas ilo supat?”
Etii Olaitoriani atua enkaji enye sinyati, etii olorika le nkitoo lo Laitoriani keper; neing'orisho too nkonyek enyena, netem too nkonyek enyena, nkera e tung'ani.
Ketem Olaitoriani ilo supat o ltorrono, neiba to ltau lenye olarruoni.
Ore te lelo torrok, naa keitashaiki nkuk e nkima o enchan oo soito; o lkutati opejisho olo aaku erubata e nkikompe enye.
Amu aisupat Olaitoriani, nenyor ninye nkiaasin supati; ilo oata oltau sidai odol enkomon enye.
Taretu iyiook, Olaitoriani: amu meekure eetae hoo obo oata euriata e Nkai; amu eishunye ilooisiligayu tiatua nkera e tung'ani.
Eiro pooki ng'ae elejare tialo ole latia enye; to lkoroj o te nkilelemare eiro ninche.
Metudung'oi Olaitoriani nkutukie pooki naaikorojisho lelo ng'ejepa le nkitokoos kitok,
lelo oojo, “Ore to lng'ejep lang nikisulie, ore kiaata nkutukie ang, kaing'ae naitore iyiook?”
“Ore te nkaraki naitorogonyaki olaisinani, o enkaraki naigorito ilo oata osina kadumunye taata nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo; “Kapik nanu ninye atua ina seriani naa ninye eng'uar.”
Ore nkisiligat o Laitoriani naa nkisiligat naasila, naaikununo anaa enkosholai natisilaki to lkokuet te nkop, nesili katitin naapishana.
Torripo iyie iyiook Olaitoriani, torripo iyiook anaake tena ishoi.
Ore too nkaloli pooki, nemanimanaa anaa olng'atuny lelo torrok anaa enatudumunye entorroni aponari tiatua inkera e tung'ani.
Ke nkata nabaa iyie Olaitoriani, kirikino iyie nanu? Ke nkata nabaa isudoo iyie enkomom ino te nanu?
Kanap nanu emion to ltau lai o anu, naisinanuo to ltau lai endama pooki? Keitokoos kenya olmang'atinta lai tialo nanu o anu?
Ing'uraki nanu, nikiwaliki, iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai ai; ntawang'a inkonyek aainei, pee mairura ake too njio e keeya;
pee mejo ake olmang'atinta lai, “Aisula nanu te ninye,” pee meng'ida ake ilo mang'atinta lai te nkaraki embatata ai.
Kake aisiliga nanu ina nyorrata ino nauno; naa keng'ida oltau lai te nkaraki enjeunoto ino.
Karanyaki nanu Olaitoriani, amu aaitaasa ninye nanu ine supatisho te nkumoi.
Kejo ilo modai to ltau lenye, “Meetae Enkai.” Etarruoitie ninche, neas mbaa o lminong, meetae hoo obo oas imbaa sidain.
Keing'or Olaitoriani kop etii keper, neing'or inkera e tung'ani pee edol tenaa ketii oloasisho te ng'eno, ilo oing'oru Enkai.
Eshomo ninche pooki aapong'ori, nenyaanyuk pooki; meetae hoo obo oas isupati, meetae, metii hoo obo.
Aimeeta ninche eng'eno, kulo aasak loo ntorrok pooki, oonya iltung'ana laainei, anaa enanya ninche endaa, nemeserem ninche Olaitoriani?
Ore teine kepuo ninche aajing olkirutoto sapuk, amu etii Enkai te nebo ina ishoi e lelo supati.
Inyalinyala intae nena kitobirat e ilo aisinani, kake Olaitoriani esarunoto enye.
Oi siaake elotu enkordunoto e Israel eing'uaa Sion! Te neitopok Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, naa keng'ida Yakobo, neshipayu Israel.
Iyie Olaitoriani, kaing'ae olo aton to lng'obor lino? Kaing'ae olo amany Sion, ilo doinyo ilo sinyati.
Ilo olo meeta entioto, neas isupati, neiro esipata to ltau lenye;
nemeiro mbaa e nkiteenikino to lng'ejep lenye, nemeitaas entorroni olchore lenye, nemekur aitubulaa olmarenke teilo le latia enye;
laa ore too nkonyek enyena nemenaa ilooiba Enkai, neyanyit lelo ooure Olaitoriani, ilo onya olmumai nemeibelekenya;
nemeitayu mpisai enyena te nkaraki dupoto, nemeng'amaa ninye entoki e ropare pee einyal esipata. Ore ilo oas kuna baa nemeigusugusieki ae kata.
Tagolieki nanu Enkai ai, amu iyie nanu asaru.
Atiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, “Ira iyie Olaitoriani lai; ore pooki toki sidai naata naa iyie eing'uaa.”
Ore tialo lelo sinyat ootii enkop, naa ile tipat ninche, laa ninche nanu ashipakino.
Ore lelo oogelu ae kitanyaanyukoto oo nkaitin neponaa isinaitin lenye; ore lelo asarri lenye lo sarge nemaibukoo nanu, nemaipot inkarn e nena kitanyaanyukot te nkutuk ai.
Olaitoriani ninye laaisho pooki toki, mbung'ita iyie enkishui ai.
Kebaa enking'asia oo nkishoorot inono te nanu, kebaa esidano enye!
Kaisis nanu Olaitoriani laa ninye laaikok, ore sii te nkewarie naaiteng'en oltau lai.
Kapik nanu anaake Olaitoriani dukuya ai; amu etii ninye enkaina ai e tatene, maaigusugusieki nanu.
Ore te nkaraki ina, keng'ida oltau lai, neshipa enkishui ai; neton sii osesen lai te seriani.
Amu eitu iyie kipalaa mashomo atua enemeneng'a, neitu ncho ilo oure Enkai edoiki engumoto.
Ekintodol iyie nanu enkoitoi e nkishui; ore enitii iyie, netii eng'ida nabore, ore enkaina ino e tatene netii ntokitin sidain ntarasi o ntarasi.
Toning'o esipata, iyie Olaitoriani; toning'o enkishirata ai! Nchoo enkiok ino ening enkomono ai naing'uaa enkutuk ai nemetii elejare!
Nchoo eaku iyie eing'uaa esipata ai! Nchoo inkonyek inono edol esipata!
Ti nitem iyie oltau lai, nikimutan iyie nanu kewarie, nikijur iyie nanu, nimitum iyie entorroni tiatua nanu; eitu apong'ori too nkirorot aainei.
Ore tialo isiaaitin e tung'ani ore to rorei lino, natapaasha nanu inkoitoi oo larruok.
Ore roruat aainei neibung'a inkoitoi inono, eitu eideketari inkejek aainei.
Aaipoto nanu iyie, amu eikiwaliki iyie, Enkai ai; irrugokoki enkiok ino, toning'o irorei laainei.
Ntodolu enyorrata ino nauno te mpukunoto e nking'asia, iyie Olaitajeunoni le lelo likisaru, too lmang'ati lenye te nkaina ino e tatene.
Tagolieki nanu anaa enerok e nkong'u; isudoyioki nanu to loip loo naipuko inono,
te nkaraki ilo torrono laainyal nanu, lelo mang'ati laainei laamanita nanu.
Neitagol ninche iltauja lenye; pee meitoki aata olng'ur, ore too nkutukie enye neiro te nkitokoos.
Naasuj ninche nanu; naatamana taata ninche; naaing'or nanu pee aatum aatanang'ie enkop.
Keikununo ninche anaa olng'atuny oibung eng'ues, etiu anaa olkuoo lo lng'atuny erreshito eng'ues.
Tudumunye, Olaitoriani! Intoriokinoyu ninche taarare, tanang'ai ninche! Tokordu enkishui ai tialo ilo torrono to lalem lino,

tokorduaki too ltung'ana te nkaina ino, iyie Olaitoriani, tialo lelo tung'ana laa ore erubata enye te nkishui naa ena kop. Ntamio ninche teilo sina litushumaka ninche, menoto inkera enye o sina olang ilo, metelekakini ilo sina nkera oo nkera enye.
Ore nanu naa kaing'or enkomom ino te supatisho, te nainyototo, naraposho te nduaata ino.
Kaanyor nanu iyie, iyie Olaitoriani, iyie engolon ai.
Olaitoriani ninye endapidapoi ai, osempewuet lai, naa olakordunoni, Enkai ai, endapidapoi ai naa ninye asaru, elong'o ai, naa emowuo e njeunoto ai, naa ninye osempewuet lai.
Aipoto nanu Olaitoriani, laa ninye eishiaakino neisisi, naaitajeuo nanu too lmang'ati laainei.
Aatamana nanu inkeenta e keeya, naaiputukunyie nanu oloirrag le nkare le ntorroni.
Aatamana nanu inkeenta e nemeneng'a, naaipirakinore nanu irresheta le keeya.
Ore tiatua osina lai naipoto Olaitoriani; Enkai ainanu aishiraka maataretu. Ore etii enkaji enye sinyati nening oltoilo lai, ore ina kishirata naishiraka ninye nelo abaiki inkiyiaa enyena.
Neikirikira taa enkop neigirigiro; ore sii ilkitamanyunot loo ldoinyo neikirikira, nejing enkop olokirikiri te nkaraki natagore ninye.
Nepuku empuruo too nkumeishin enyena, nepuku enkima nanyaisho te nkutuk enye, o nkuk naaishu naapuku te ninye.
Neirrugu ninye shumata, nedou alotu enkop; netii emisimisi kitok abori inkejek enye.
Neked ninye enchumata olkerubi, nelo tiaai, nelo too naipuko o siwuo.
Neitaa ninye enaimin enkimulumulet, ore enkitushuret enye naa nkatampo naairrusha naabore enkare.
Ore teina wang'an e nkiwuang'ata natii dukuya ninye, nepuku isoito sapuki le nchan o nkuk e nkima.
Etadara sii Olaitoriani to loing'ang'e, ore Ilo otii Shumata Aisul neitayu oltoilo lenye, neitayu enchan oo soito o nkuk naaishu.
Neirriwaa ninye mbaa enyena, neidapash ninche; neyau nkiwuang'at o enkimerlel, neidapash ninche.
Neliooyu inkoitoi e nkare tiatua enaiposha, ore ilkitamanyunot le nkop neibalayu aalioyu, te mbuakunoto ino, Olaitoriani, te nkutata e nkiyang'et oo nkumeishin inono.
Naabaiki ninye atii enkop, naaya nanu, naaitayu ninye nanu tiatua nkariak kumok.
Naakordu ninye nanu te ilo mang'atinta lai ogol, o te lelo laaiba nanu; amu kegol ninche oleng te nanu.
Eetuo ninche shumata nanu teina olong o sina lai, kake Olaitoriani ninye entonata ai.
Aayaua ninye ewueji nelala; aatokordua ninye nanu amu aatishipakine nanu.
Aatalaaka nanu Olaitoriani te risioroto oo sipat aainei; te risioroto e sinyatisho oo nkaik aainei aatalaaka ninye nanu.
Amu aibung'a nanu inkoitoi o Laitoriani, neitu nanu alo aing'uaa Olaitoriani Enkai ai te ntorroni.
Amu ore nkiguanat enyena pooki netii dukuya nanu, ore nkikoot enyena neitu nanu aiwuang'ie aitalam kewan.
Maata apa nanu eleyiata te dukuya ninye, naitalam nanu kewan inkitadiat.
Ore te nkaraki ina, aatalaaka nanu Olaitoriani te risioroto e supatisho ai, te risioroto e sinyatisho oo nkaik aainei, te dukuya ninye.
Ore te lelo supati nintodolu esupatisho ino, ore to ltung'ani lemeeta entioto nintodol esinyatisho ino.
Ore te ilo lemeiduruk nintodol ajo minduruk iyie; ore te ilo otolo nintodol entoloi ino.
Amu ikordu iyie lelo oobor; kake ore lelo oowuasa nerup ate nintadou.
Ee, inok iyie oltaa lai; Olaitoriani Enkai ai oitawang enaimin ai.
Ee, ore te nkaraki iyie namir oltim loo lmang'ati; ore te nkaraki Enkai ai naidim aida esuntai.
Ore ena Ai, nesipa enkoitoi enye; ore enkisiligata o Laitoriani neuno asipayu; elong'o ninye te lelo pooki oosaru ninye.
Amu kaing'ae Enkai neme Olaitoriani? Naa, kaing'ae endapidapoi neme Enkai ang?
Ina Ai naaterretena nanu te ngolon, neitaserian enkoitoi ai.
Neiteneneng inkejek aainei anaa entarakuet, naaitaserian ninye nanu too neeika.
Neitaarriyian ninye inkaik aainei to larrabal, neaku keidim inkaik aatokoriny enkawuo o suyai.
Kinchoo iyie nanu elong'o e njeunoto ino, ore enkaina ino e tatene naaitagol nanu, ore eretoto ino naaitaa nanu kitok.
Kinchoo iyie nanu ewueji nelala te nkaraki inkejek aainei, neitu eideketari inkejek aainei.
Atimira nanu ilmang'ati laainei nainepu ninche; neitu nanu arrinyo o metaba anaa neidaaya ninche.
Atoosho ninche anang'ie enkop nemeigil ninche aadumunye nebatata ti abori inkejek aainei.
Amu kiterretena iyie nanu te ngolon, te nkaraki olarrabal; ninchoo ilmang'ati laainei meimiso tiabori nanu.
Iyie oishoo ilmang'ati laainei meibelekenyata aailanyisho, ore lelo apa laaiba naidaikie nanu ninche.
Eishira ninche eing'oru eretoto, kake meetae oloitajeu ninche, eishirakita ninche Olaitoriani kake eitu ninye ewaliki ninche.
Aidong'o nanu ninche metotiwuo anaa enterit te dukuya; atanang'ayie nanu ninche anaa esarng'ab oo nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa.
Kitokordua iyie nanu aitung'uaa enkesha oo ltung'ana, kintaa iyie nanu endukuya oo loshon; ore iloreren apa lemayiolo naaisiaai nanu.
Ore ake pee aaning ninche nanu naairuk ninche; ore iltung'ana omon naayanyitu nanu.
Etalepori iltung'ana omon, nepuonu ninche eikirikira eing'uaa isempewueti lenye.
Keishu Olaitoriani; meisisi ina dapidapoi ai, meitaae kitok Enkai e njeunoto ai,
ina Ai naitalaku elap nepik iloreren abori nanu;
ilo laakordu nanu too lmang'ati laainei; ee, eikilepunye iyie aitulusoo too lmang'ati laainei; kitokordua iyie nanu too ltung'ana lo larrabal.
Ore te nkaraki ena kaarrep nanu iyie, Olaitoriani tiatua iloreren, narany arrep enkarna ino.
Eishoo ninye enkisulata kitok ilo aiguanani lenye, neitodolu enyorrata nauno te ilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput, Daudi o eishoi enye ntarasi.
Keitodolu keper enkitoo o Laitoriani; ore oloing'ang'e neitodolu esiaai oo nkaik enyena.
Ore enkolong o enkolong neinosakino lomon, ore enkewarie o enkewarie neibalunye eng'eno.
Meetae enkiroroto, nemeetae irorei; mening'o iltoiloishi lenye;
ore ake eyia, nelo oltoilo lenye aim enkop pooki, ore irorei lenye nebaiki ineeiting'ie enkop. Etipikaka Enkai enkolong manyisho enye to loing'ang'e
ina olong nailepu anaa oloyamisho eipang'u te nkaji enye, o anaa oltung'ani ogol okuet ailanyisho te ng'ida.
Ore enkilepunoto enye naa ineeiting'ie keper eing'uaa, ore imanarot enyena nelo ineeiting'ie ninche, nemeetae entoki naisudoyioki te nkirowuaj enye.
Ore enkitanapata o Laitoriani naa keikishiaan, neitopiu oltau; ore shakenisho o Laitoriani naa kedede, neiteng'en olmodai.
Ore nkikoot o Laitoriani naa sidain, neiting'id oltau; ore nkitanapat o Laitoriani naa kesila, nepik inkonyek ewang'an.
Ore euriata o Laitoriani nemeiduruk, nebikoo ntarasi, ore nkiguanat o Laitoriani nesipa naa supati pooki.
Neng'uarrayu ninche oleng aalang saabu, aalang ninye saabu sidai, nemelok sii aalang enaisho oo lootorok nelang olkenkei ooisul.
Naa ninche eikokieki osinka lino; ore te nkibung'ata enye netii olerrinyore kitok.
Kake kaing'ae omusu nkitarruorot enyena? Ntisinyaki iyie nanu too nkitarruorot naaisudoro.
Imbooi iyie osinka lino too ng'ok o lwuasa, mincho ninche etum engolon tiatua nanu! Pee atum ataa maata entioto nasinyayu too nkitarruorot sapuki.
Nchoo irorei le nkutuk ai o nkibirribirrat o ltau lai, eng'amaroyu too nkonyek inono, iyie Olaitoriani, endapidapoi ai, naa olakordunoni lai.
Mikitawaliki Olaitoriani iyie te nkolong e nyamali! Mikitorripo enkarna e Nkai e Yakobo!
Mikirriwaki ninye iyie eretoto naing'uaa enkaji enye sinyati, mikintagolo ninye iyie teina golon naing'uaa Sion!
Metadamu ninye ilasarri linono pooki, neing'or te nyorrarota ilasarri linono oopejori!
Mikinchoo ninye iyie iyieunot o ltau lino, neitabaya nkitobirat inyi pooki!
Nchoo iyiook matabuaku te ng'ida te nkaraki enkisulata ino, ore te nkarna e Nkai ang nikiun iyiook inankan ang e nkisulata! Meitabai Olaitoriani iomonunot inyi pooki.
Kayiolo taata nanu ajo keretu Olaitoriani ilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput, kewaliki ninye teine wueji sinyati te shumata, eeta nkisulat sapuki naaisula te nkaina enye.
Eng'idare kulikae ngarrin oo mbartan, neng'idare kulikae mbartan; kake king'idare iyiook enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ang.
Keurori ninche aabatata; kake kidumunye iyiook nikintashe aaitoriori.
Nchoo olaiguanani meisula, Olaitoriani; tawaliki iyiook ti nikimpot iyie.
Te ngolon ino eng'ida olaiguanani, iyie Olaitoriani; naa te retoto ino eisula ninye oleng.
Inchoo iyie ninye eyieunoto o ltau lenye neitu iyie imbooyo eomonunoto e nkutuk enye.
Amu inang'are iyie ninye too mayianat sidain, ninchopoki ninye enkopiyia e nkitoo e saabu nasila endukuya enye.
Neomonu ninye enkishui te iyie, nincho iyie ninye, nkolong'i kumok ntarasi o ntarasi.
Eisapuk enkitoo enye te nkaraki eretoto ino; inchopoko iyie ninye enkikodo o enkitoo.
Ee, intaa iyie ninye olomayiana oleng intarasi, ninting'id iyie ninye te dukuya enkomom ino.
Amu Olaitoriani eisilig olaiguanani; naa ore te nkaraki ina nyorrata nauno e Ilo otii Shumata Aisul, nemeigusugusuieki ninye.
Ore enkaina ino, ninye nalo aing'oru ilmang'ati linono pooki; neing'oru enkaina ino e tatene lelo pooki likimba.
Nintotiu iyie ninche anaa olang'at le nkima te liooto ino. Keijoo Olaitoriani ninche te ngoro enye; nenya ninche enkima.
Nindaikie iyie eishoi enye te nkop, niwuang'ie inkera enye aishie tiatua ltung'ana.
Ti nikintobiraki ninche iyie entorroni, te neipiru entaboi nemedupore ninche.
Amu incho iyie ninche mekueta aailanyisho, nimul iyie inkomomi enye too mbaa inono.
Nchoo kisisi iyie Olaitoriani, te nkaraki engolon ino! Aikiranyisho iyiook nikisis engolon ino.
Enkai ai, Enkai ai, kainyoo pee kitung'uayie? Kainyoo pee kitalama nanu eitu kiret, nilam irorei laainei le nkigoroto?
Iyie na Ai ai, aaishiraka nanu dama kake eitu iyie kiwaliki; naaishiraki kewarie, kake eitu nanu atum enkiyeng'iyeng.
Kake ira iyie sinyati, niton iyie te nkitoo e nkisisa e Israel.
Iyie apa eisiliga loo papa; kisiliga apa ninche, nitokordua iyie ninche.
Iyie apa eishirakita ninche, neitajeuni; iyie apa eisiliga ninche, neitu eitukurruni.
Kake kara nanu olkurto, mara oltung'ani; naaikordod iltung'ana, naamen iloreren.
Ore pooki laaing'or nanu naakueniyie, naadasaki enkine, neipirripir ilukuny;
nejo, “Eisiliga ninye Olaitoriani; nchoo eitajeu ninye, nchoo ekordu ninye, amu ninye eshipakino!”
Ore ake sii, iyie apa likintayio te nguset e yieyio lai; kintaseriana iyie nanu atii ilki le yieyio.
Shumata iyie apa aatanang'akaki ebaiki pee aaini, ore anaa naaiu yieyio lai ira iyie Enkai ai.
Mikilam iyie nanu, amu etataana enyamali nemeeta likae laaretu.
Aatang'adutua nanu iloing'ok kumok, aatamana nanu iloing'ok oogol le Bashan;
naang'aki nanu inkutukie enye, netiu anaa olng'atuny oikurrukur.
Aaibukoyioki nanu anaa enkare, netirishate iloik laainei pooki too rubat; netotiwuo oltau lai anaa enkapoi, etoshole oltau lai tiatua olgoo lai;
etoyio engolon ai anaa oleleo le moti, neterepa olng'ejep lai ntakul aainei; nikirragie iyie nanu te nterit e keeya.
Ee, aamanita nanu ildiein; aatang'adua nanu olturrur loo laasak loo ntorrok, etaremo ninche ndapi oo nkaik aainei o nkejek -
kaidim nanu aikena iloik laainei pooki - aaing'orita ninche naashil;
eorikino ninche ilkilani laainei maate, ore to lkila lai neosh ninche enkukuo.
Kake, ore iyie Olaitoriani, mikilakuaniki! Iyie laaretoni lai, tasieku taretoki!
Tokordu oltau lai to lalem, nikordu enkishui ai aitung'uaa engolon e ilo dia.
Ntajewuoki nanu te nkutuk o lng'atuny, ntajeu ele tau lai oata osina too mowuarak o losokuan!
Kaibalunye nanu enkarna ino too lalashera laainei, naaisis iyie te mpolos e umata:
Esisa Olaitoriani intae ilooure ninye! Ore intae ilayiok pooki le Yakobo, entaa ninye kitok, nintasheshe te uriata enye, intae ilayiok pooki le Israel!
Amu eitu ninye emenu aashu eiteeng lelo ooata osina; neitu ninye eisudoo enkomom enye te ninye, kake etoning'o ninye ina kata pee eishiraki ninye te nkaraki eretoto.
Iyie eing'uaa enkisisa ai tiatua eumata kitok; naa kalak nanu olmumai lai te dukuya lelo ooure ninye.
Kedaa ilo oata osina neraposho, ore lelo ooing'oru ninye neisis Olaitoriani! Metaa keishu iltauja linyi ntarasi!
Kepuo aadamu ineeiting'ie enkop pooki, neibelekenyakino Olaitoriani; neserem ilmareita pooki loo loshon te dukuya ninye.
Amu eno Laitoriani enkitoria, neitore ninye iloshon.
Ee, ninye epuo aairrugokino lelo pooki oowuasa lena kop; te dukuya ninye epuo aairrugo lelo pooki oopuo enkop, o ilo lemeidim aitopiu oltau lenye.
Naa kelo eishoi enye aisiaai ninye, nepuo iltung'ana aaimaki Olaitoriani too ishoritin naapuonu,
neibalunye enkordunoto enye too ltung'ana leton meino, nchere ninye otaasa ina.
Olaitoriani ninye olchekut lai, maang'oriki nanu toki.
Aairragie ninye nanu too nkujit naanyori, naarikoo ninye nanu te nkiyopata oo nkariak naaitirring'a
neitagol ninye oltau lai. Naarikoo ninye nanu te nkoitoi oo sipat te nkaraki enkarna enye.
Tenaa naaji ninye kalo aim oerata lo loip le keeya, nemaure entorroni; amu itii iyie te nebo nanu; eng'udi ino o rinka lino ninche naaitagol nanu.
Intobira iyie emisa te dukuya nanu, teine netii ilmang'ati laainei; nibukoki endukuya ai eilata, nipik enkikompe ai metaa kedooyo.
Kesipa kaasuj esidano o lng'ur inkolong'i pooki e nkishui ai, naa kabik nanu tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani ntarasi.
Eno Laitoriani enkop o ntokitin pooki naabore o lelo oomanya;
amu ninye oitamanyua too naaiposha, neitasheyie too lkejek.
Kaing'ae olo aked ilo doinyo lo Laitoriani? Naa kaing'ae olo aitashe te wueji enye sinyati?
Ilo osinya nkaik neeta oltau owang, ilo lemedumaki oltau lenye entorroni, nemenya olmumai le lejare.
Keng'amu ninye emayianata naing'uaa Olaitoriani, neng'amu esupatisho naing'uaa Enkai e njeunoto enye.
Ore ilaaijo kulo, naa eishoi e lelo ooing'oru ninye, lelo ooing'oru enkomom e Nkai e Yakobo.
Entaboloto na shomito! Entaboloto intae na shomito musan! Pee etum Olaiguanani le nkitoo atijing'u.
Kaing'ae Olaiguanani le nkitoo? Olaitoriani ogol magilani, Olaitoriani magilani to larrabal!
Entushumu ilukuny inyi na shomito! Nidumunyenye intae, na shomito musan! Pee etum Olaiguanani le nkitoo atijing'u.
Kaing'ae Olaiguanani le nkitoo? Olaitoriani loo lororani, ninye Olaiguanani le nkitoo!
Iyie nanu Olaitoriani aserem.
Na Ai ai, iyie nanu aisilig, mincho aaitukurruni nanu; mincho ilmang'ati laainei eng'ida te nkaraki nanu.
Ee, mincho hoo obo likingarakino iyie meitukurruni; nchoo meitukurruni lelo aitang'orok le pesho.
Ntayioloki nanu inkoitoi inono, Olaitoriani; nteng'enaki nanu inkoitoi inono.
Torikoki nanu tiatua esipata ino, nikinteng'en nanu, amu ira iyie Enkai e njeunoto ai; amu iyie nanu aanyita endama pooki.
Tadamuaki nanu to lng'ur lino, Olaitoriani, o te nyorrata ino nauno, amu eetae apa ninche ebaiki moitie.
Midamu iyie ing'ok e kitisho ai, anaa nkitarruorot aainei; ore te risioroto e nyorrata nauno, tadamuaki nanu, te nkaraki esupatisho ino Olaitoriani!
Aisupat naa asipani Olaitoriani; ore te nkaraki ina neiteng'en ninye ilaing'okok te nkoitoi.
Nerikoo ninye lelo oobor te nkoitoi sidai, neiteng'en lelo oobor te nkoitoi enye.
Ore nkoitoi pooki o Laitoriani naa enyorrata nauno o esupatisho, te lelo ooibung olning'o lenye lo sotua o shakenisho enye.
Ore te nkaraki enkarna ino, Olaitoriani, tapalakaki entorroni ai, amu aisapuk.
Kalo tung'ani oure Olaitoriani? Ore ilo tung'ani keiteng'en Olaitoriani ninye te nkoitoi nagelu.
Ore ninye makewan neton te nkiputakinoto, ore nkera enyena nejung enkop.
Ore shoruetisho o Laitoriani naa ene lelo ooure ninye, neitayiolo ninye ninche olning'o lenye lo sotua.
Etii inkonyek aainei dukuya Olaitoriani anaake, amu keitayu ninye inkejek aainei to rreshet.
Torrinyokinoyioki Olaitoriani, niking'urrie nanu, amu kaliyio naata osina.
Nchooki enkiyagata te nyamali o ltau lai, nikintupuku nanu tiatua isinaitin laainei.
Ing'ura osina lai o enyamali ai, nikipalaki ing'ok aainei pooki.
Ng'ura eneba ilmang'ati laainei, o eneba enkiba naaiba ninche nanu te ntoloi.
Torripo siaake enkishui ai, nikikordu nanu; mikincho nanu aaitukurruni, amu iyie nanu asaru.
Nchoo aagolie nanu esupatisho o emborron, amu iyie nanu aanyu.
Talaku Israel, Iyie Enkai, tiatua inyamalaritin enyena pooki.
Inguanareki nanu, iyie Olaitoriani, amu ashomo nanu te supatisho ai, naaisiliga nanu iyie Olaitoriani metii enking'aing'ai.
Tujurroki nanu Olaitoriani nikitem; tetema oltau lai o ndamunot aainei.
Amu etii ina nyorrata ino nauno dukuya inkonyek aainei, nalotu nanu te sipata enitii.
Maton nanu te nebo iltung'ana torrok, nemashulare nanu isunkuro.
Kaiba nanu encholiek o laasak loo ntorrok, nematon nanu te nebo ilarruok.
Naa kaituku inkaik aainei ajo maata entioto, nalo aman olasar lino, iyie Olaitoriani,
abuaku aranyita osinkolio le nashe, nalimu nkiaasin inono e nking'asia.
Olaitoriani, kanyor nanu emanyisho e nkaji ino, o ewueji netii enkitoo ino.
Mikindaikie nanu aiwuang'ie tenebo laing'okok, teleku enkishui ai te lelo ooata enkure o sarge
iltung'ana laa ore inkaik enye nebore osarge, ore inkaik enye e tatene nebore ntokitin e ropare.
Kake ore nanu naa te supatisho ino alo; talakuaki nanu niking'urrie nanu.
Eitashe inkejek aainei te wueji neitoriori; ore tiatua eumata kitok naisis nanu Olaitoriani.
Olaitoriani ewang'an ai naa enjeunoto ai; kaing'ae nanu aure? Olaitoriani osempewuet le nkishui ai; kaing'ae naa aure?
Te nepuonu ilarruok shumata nanu, aanya nkiri o sesen lai, lelo mang'ati laainei o larak, nerrorro ninche nebatata.
Ore ninye te naamuat olorora aaman nemeureishoyu oltau lai; te naadumakino ninye nanu enjore, ore ake etiu neijia naisiliga nanu Olaitoriani.

Entoki nabo nanu atoomono Olaitoriani naa ninye nanu aing'oru; nchere pee abik nanu tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ai, pee aaing'or enkishiaa o Laitoriani, naikilikuanisho tiatua enkaji enye sinyati.
Amu kaaitushur ninye nanu tiatua olng'obor lenye, te nkolong e nyamali; naaikenoo ninye nanu tiabori o lng'obor lenye, naailepie ninye nanu apik shumata endapidapoi.

Naa keshumuni endukuya ai aailepie neitulusori te lelo mang'ati laainei laamanita, naa kalo nanu aishooyo tiatua olng'obor lenye, ilasarri te mbuakunoto o te ng'ida; naa karanyisho nanu narrep Olaitoriani.
Toning'oki iyie Olaitoriani, te nabuaku nanu aishir, ing'urrieki nanu nikiwaliki nanu!
Itejo iyie, “Ing'oru iyie enkomom ai.” Nikijoki oltau lai iyie, “Enkomom ino, Olaitoriani, ninye nanu aing'oru.”
Mikisudorie nanu enkomom ino. Mirriny iyie osinka lino te ngoro, iyie apa otaa eretoto ai. Mikinturraa nanu, miking'uaa nanu, Na Ai e njeunoto ai!
Amu aatung'uaitie nanu papa o yieyio, kake kaadumu nanu Olaitoriani.
Nteng'enaki nanu enkoitoi ino, iyie Olaitoriani; nikirikoo nanu te neserian, te nkaraki ilmang'ati laainei.
Mikinchooyo nanu too lmang'ati laainei, amu aatudumakinote nanu ilchakenini le lejare, neipang'ipang ninche te ntorroni.
Kairuk nanu ajo kadol esupatisho o Laitoriani, teina kop oo looishu!
Taanyu Olaitoriani; ntagoluoyu, nintagol oltau lino, ee, taanyu Olaitoriani!
Iyie nanu aipoto Olaitoriani; endapidapoi ai, mikigirare nanu, amu ti nikigirare iyie nanu natiu anaa lelo oopuo aadoiki Engumoto.
Toning'o oltoilo le nkomono ai, enkata naaishiraki nanu iyie te nkaraki eretoto, ina kata ailepie nanu inkaik aainei, aing'orie ewueji ino sinyati aisul.
Mikiya iyie nanu te nebo larruok, te nebo lelo aasak loo ntorrok, ooiro eseriani te nebo lelo le latia enye, ore too ltauja lenye neeta entorroni.
Ntalaa ninche te risioroto e siaai enye, o te risioroto oo nkiaasin e ntorroni enye, ntalaa ninche te risioroto e siaai oo nkaik enye, nchoo ninche olerrinyore oiririkino.
Ore te nkaraki meshilaa ninche isiaaitin o Laitoriani, anaa esiaai oo nkaik enye, kegil ninye ninche nemeigil aekata ashetu ninche.
Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu etoning'o ninye oltoilo le nkomono ai.
Olaitoriani ninye engolon ai naa elong'o ai; ninye eisilig oltau lai; naataretuo ninye nanu, ore te nkaraki ina neting'ide oltau lai, naa kaisho nanu ninye enashe to sinkolio lai.
Olaitoriani ninye engolon oo ltung'ana lenyena, iyie enjeunoto nasaru ilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput.
Ntajeu iltung'ana linono, nimayian enjung'ore ino; laa iyie olchekut lenye ninap ninche ntarasi.
Enchoo Olaitoriani enkisisa, intae ntokitin pooki e shumata, enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo o engolon.
Enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo e nkarna enye; enteserem Olaitoriani te nkishiaa e sinyatisho enye.
Etii oltoilo lo Laitoriani shumata nkariak; etadara Enkai e nkitoo, Olaitoriani te shumata nkariak kumok.
Kegol oltoilo lo Laitoriani, ebore oltoilo lo Laitoriani enkitoo.
Egil oltoilo lo Laitoriani iltarakua, egil Olaitoriani iltarakua le Lebanon.
Keisho ninye Lebanon meipido anaa olashe, neipidie oldoinyo le Harmon anaa oloing'oni oti.
Keeta oltoilo lo Laitoriani enkimerlel o lng'ejep le nkima.
Keikirikirie oltoilo lo Laitoriani olpurkel, keikirikirie Olaitoriani olpurkel le Kadesh.
Keikirikirie oltoilo lo Laitoriani ilkeek, near entim aisiashayie, naa tiatua enkaji enye sinyati eishir pooki aajo, “Enkitoo!”
Etonita Olaitoriani to lorika lenye le nkitoo te shumata nkariak; etonita Olaitoriani to lorika le nkitoo aaku olaiguanani ntarasi.
Meishoo Olaitoriani engolon iltung'ana lenyena! Metamayiana Olaitoriani kulo tung'ana lenyena aisho eseriani!
Kaaisis nanu iyie, iyie Olaitoriani, amu kitudumua iyie nanu ailepunye, neitu incho ilmang'ati laainei aang'idakino.
Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai, iyie nanu aishiraka pee kiretu, nikinchiunye iyie nanu.
Olaitoriani, ilepunye iyie oltau lai aitupuku te nemeneng'a, nikirrinyoki nanu enkishui tiatua lelo ooshomo aadoiki Engumoto.
Entaranyaki Olaitoriani enkisisa, intae isinyat lenyena, ninchosho enkisisa enkarna enye sinyati.
Amu ore engoro enye naa enkata kiti, ore omom enye naa ene nkishui pooki. Eruko ilkiyio te nkewarie, kake ore tadekenya nelotu eng'ida.
Ore nanu, atejo apa te nkitumurrunoto ai, “Maaiwuang'ieki aekata nanu.”
Ore te nkaraki nanoto nanu omom te iyie, Olaitoriani, nikintagolo iyie nanu anaa oldoinyo; kisudorie iyie nanu enkomom ino, natum osina.
Iyie nanu Olaitoriani aishiraka, naa Olaitoriani ayaka enkomono ai;
“Kaa retoto eeta keeya ai, te nadoyio ajing Engumoto? Eikisis iyie enterit? Kelimu ninye esupatisho ino?
Toning'oki, Olaitoriani, niking'urrie nanu! Olaitoriani, taa iyie Olaretoni lai!”
Imbelekenya iyie enkishirata ai aitaa osinkolio le ng'ida; italaayie iyie ilkuniyiani laainei nikinchopoki nanu eng'ida,
pee kitum oltau lai aisisa iyie nemegira. Olaitoriani Enkai ai, kaaisho nanu iyie enashe ntarasi.
Tiatua iyie nanu Olaitoriani aing'oru esarunoto; mikincho iyie nanu maaitukurruni aekata; ore te supatisho ino tokorduaki nanu!
Irrugokoki nanu enkiok ino, tasaruaki nanu tasioki! Taa iyie endapidapoi nasaru nanu, osempewuet lajeunye nanu.
Ee, ira iyie endapidapoi o sempewuet lai; ore te nkaraki enkarna ino torikoyioki nanu nikiutaa nanu,
ntayioki nanu tiatua orreshet oisudoyioki te nkaraki nanu, amu ira iyie esarunoto ai.
Inkaik inono nanu apik enkishui ai, kintajewuo iyie nanu Olaitoriani, na Ai oo sipat.
Imba iyie lelo ooserem nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin, kake Olaitoriani nanu aisilig.
Kang'ida nanu nashipa te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno, amu itoduaa iyie osina lai, nitoduaa iyie ilmang'ati laainei,
neitu iyie kinchooyo nanu apik enkaina o lmang'atinta; itipika iyie inkejek aainei ewueji nelala.
Ing'urrieki nanu Olaitoriani amu atii atua osina; etimitari inkonyek aainei te nkaraki osina, o ltau lai o sesen lai sii.
Amu eisha enkishui ai to sina, neishunye enkishui ai te nkishirata, eishunye engolon ai te nkaraki osina lai, netororonyate iloik laainei.
Ataa nanu entoki nailapi too lmang'ati laainei, ataa enkitureisho too le latia ai, entoki naitureisho too lchoreta laainei; ore lelo laadol nanu te nkoitoi naaipirri aailany.
Aiwuang'a nanu too ndamunot anaa oltung'ani otua; atotiuo nanu anaa entoki natebele.
Ee, aning'ito nanu enking'oming'om oo lkumok - etii enkuretisho pooki shoto - aaiguanare ninche nanu pee eitayu enkishui ai.
Kake iyie nanu aisiliga, Olaitoriani, atejo nanu, “Ira iyie Enkai ai.”
Etii nkatitin aainei inkaik inono, tokorduaki nanu too nkaik oo lmang'ati laainei o lelo laaisilisil nanu!
Nchoo enkomom ino meitawang'aki osinka lino; ntajewuoki iyie nanu teina nyorrata ino nauno!
Mikincho nanu aaitukurruni, amu iyie Olaitoriani nanu aipoto; nchoo ilo arruoni meitukurruni, nchoo ninche edoyio aapuo enemeneng'a.
Nchoo nena kutukie e lejare metunukata, amu ninche naairo te ntorroni tialo ilo asipani, to lwuasa o te ngogong'i.
Oi kebaa esapuko e supatisho ino, nirragakinye lelo likiure iyie, nintaas iyie lelo likipuonu aasaru, te dukuya nkera e tung'ani!
Naa isudoo iyie ninche te seriani e ine nitii, intaserian iyie ninche tiabori olchurie lino, te nkaraki nena kirorot torrok.
Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu eitodolua ninye te nking'asia ina nyorrata enye nauno tialo nanu, ina kata apa pee aaibung'i anaa enkanasa natang'aduaki aaman.
Atejo nanu to lkirutoto lai, “Aaterewaki nanu aaitalamaa too nkonyek inono.” Kake itoning'o iyie osayia lai, ina kata pee aaishiraki nanu te nkaraki eretoto.
Entonyor Olaitoriani intae isinyat lenyena! Kegolie Olaitoriani lelo ooisiligayu, kake kelaaki te nkumoi lelo ooas to lwuasa.
Entagoluoto, niminchosho iltauja linyi elepori, intae pooki oanyu Olaitoriani!
Emayiana ilo otapalakaki ing'ok enyena, ilo oimulumulayioki ing'ok enyena.
Emayiana ilo lemeikenaki Olaitoriani entorroni, laa ore atua enkishui enye metii elejare.
Te neitu nanu alimu eng'oki ai aibalunye, neibiitiari osesen lai te nkaraki enkishirata ai e mion endama pooki.
Amu ore te ndama o te nkewarie naa keiroishi enkaina ino te nanu; netoyu engolon ai anaa enainosa enkolong te nkata e nkirowuaj.
Aaibalakinyie nanu iyie eng'oki ai neitu nanu aisudoo entorroni ai; atejo nanu, “Kairridu nkitarruorot aainei to Laitoriani;” nikitapalaka iyie esuujisho e ng'oki ai.
Ore te nkaraki ina, nchoo pooki ng'ae lo rrekie le Nkai, kiomon iyie. Ore te nkata o sina o enang'unoto oo nkariak kituaak, nemebaiki ninye.
Ira iyie ewueji enkisudoroto te nanu, eikigolie iyie nanu te ngolikinoto nikintaman nanu enkordunoto.
Kaaitaarriyian nanu iyie naaiteng'en enkoitoi niim. Kaaiguan nanu iyie etii inkonyek aainei shumata iyie.
Mitiu iyie anaa embarta anaa enyumpu nemeeta ndamunot e ning'unoto, naa keeni te nkeene nepiki olgisoi pee eitoborri, naa te nemeikoni neijia nimikirukorukore ninye iyie.
Eikumok nkitamiot naatum lelo torrok kake ore enyorrata nauno nemanita ilo oisilig Olaitoriani.
Enting'idata tiatua Olaitoriani, nishipapa intae lelo supati, nibuakuku te ng'ida, intae pooki lelo sidain iltauja!
Enting'idata tiatua Olaitoriani, intae lelo supati! Keishiaakino enkisisa lelo sidain iltauja.
Esisa Olaitoriani to lwulul loo usin enterrep ninye to lkerempe te nkawuo oo sinkolioitin naata iusin tomon!
Entaranyaki ninye osinkolio ng'ejuk, entoosh iusin e nkinanta te nkarriyiano, too mbuakunot kituaak.
Amu keitoriori ororei lo laitoriani; ore isiaaitin enyena pooki naa keisiligayu.
Kenyor ninye esupatisho o esipata; kebore enkop pooki enyorrata nauno o Laitoriani.
Ore to rorei lo Laitoriani neitobiruaki apa keper, o lorora lenye pooki te nkiyang'et e nkutuk enye.
Neiturrur ninye inkariak e naiposha anaa enkare natii atua oltulet; nepik ninye enguton atua ilaleta ooshumishoreki.
Nchoo enkop pooki eureyu Olaitoriani, nchoo lelo pooki oomanya enkop meitasho te nkanyit te dukuya ninye!
Amu eiroro apa ninye, netabayie ina natejo; neitanapishe ninye, netuune ina.
Eitaa Olaitoriani nkiguanat oo loshon pesho; neitukurru ninye nkitobirat oo loreren.
Ore enkiguana o Laitoriani neitashe ntarasi, ore ndamunot o ltau lenye nebaiki iishoritin pooki.
Kemayiana ilo osho laa Enkai Olaitoriani lenye, ilo orere otegelua ninye aitaa enjung'ore enye!
Keing'or Olaitoriani kop etii keper, nedol ninye inkera e tung'ani.
Ore etii ninye ine wueji e nkitoo neing'orisho, neing'or lelo pooki oomanya enkop,
ninye ilo oitobirua iltauja lenye pooki, nejurru nkiaasin enye pooki.
Meitajeuni olaiguanani te nkaraki enjore enye kitok; mejeu olmurrani te nkaraki engolon enye kitok.
Pesho osiligi le mbarta o larrabal te nkisulata, ore te ngolon enye kitok nemeitajeusho.
Ng'ura ajo etii enkong'u o Laitoriani shumata lelo ooure ninye, shumata lelo ooisilig enyorrata enye nauno,
naa keidim ninye atokordu enkishui enye te keeya, nemeisho ninche eye te nkata o lameyu.
Olaitoriani eanyu enkishui ai; ninye eretoto o elong'o ang.
Ee, keng'ida enkishui ang tiatua ninye, te nkaraki nikisiliga iyiook enkarna enye sinyati.
Nchoo ina nyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, meeu shumata iyiook, anaa enikisilig iyiook iyie.
Kaisis nanu Olaitoriani nkatitin pooki; etii enkisisa enye enkutuk ai anaake.
Olaitoriani ninye eng'idare oltau lai, nchoo ilo oata osina ening neng'ida.
Embalunye enkitoo o Laitoriani te nebo nanu, nikirrep enkarna enye te nebo!
Aing'orua nanu Olaitoriani naawaliki ninye, naakordu ninye nanu te nkuretisho ai pooki.
Eng'ura ninye pee iwang'ung'u; nemeitoki ae kata enkurruna atii nkomomi inyi.
Eishira ele tung'ani aisinani, nening Olaitoriani ninye, neitajeu Olaitoriani ninye aitung'uaa ingolikinot enyena pooki.
Keman olmalaika lo Laitoriani aitushur lelo pooki ooure ninye, nekordu ninche.
Wootu enchamishama pee idolidolo aajo eisupat Olaitoriani! Kemayiana ilo tung'ani osaru ninye!
Entureita Olaitoriani intae isinyat lenyena, amu ore lelo ooure ninye nemeng'oriki toki!
Keng'oriki inkiyioitin o lng'atuny netum esumash, kake ore lelo ooing'oru Olaitoriani nemelau ntokitin sidain.
Wootu, nakera, entoning'oki nanu, kaiteng'en nanu intae euriata o Laitoriani.
Kalo tung'ani te ntae oyieu enkishui, neng'uar nkolong'i kumok pee etum atishipakinoyu isupati?
Ntalama olng'ejep lino entorroni, nimincho enkutuk ino eiro elejare.
Talama entorroni nias isupati, ing'oru eseriani, nisuj ninye.
Eing'orita inkonyek o Laitoriani lelo supati, neinining'ito nkiyiaa enyena enkishirata enye.
Keiba enkomom o Laitoriani lelo ooas intorrok, neiwuang'ie ninche meitokini aadamu te nkop.
Te neishir oltung'ani supat te nkaraki eretoto, nening Olaitoriani, nekordu ninye aitayu tiatua enyamali enye pooki.
Ketaaniki Olaitoriani lelo ootigilate ltauja, neitajeu ninye lelo ooisha osiligi.
Eikumok isinaitin le ilo supat, kake kekordu Olaitoriani ninye aitung'uaa te pooki.
Negolie iloik lenyena pooki; meisho ninye metigilayu obo.
Kear entorroni ilo arruoni; ore lelo ooiba osupat nedung'okini enkiguana.
Kekordu Olaitoriani enkishui oo sinkan lenyena, meetae obo le lelo oosaru ninye otum oldeket.
Olaitoriani tigilunore, lelo laagilunore nanu; taarare lelo laarare nanu!
Tudumu elong'o ino o emasaai ino o larrabal, taretuoki nanu!
Ntayu empere ino taarare lelo laasujita! Tiaaki oltau lai, “Kara nanu ilo likikordu!”
Nchoo meitukurruni neitadouni lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai! Nchoo meibelekenyata ninche nekurru lelo ooiguanu entorroni te nkaraki nanu!
Ntotiwuo ninche anaa suut naakutita osiwuo, ereuta olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninche!
Nchoo emisimisu enkoitoi enye neideketu, esujita olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninche!
Amu ore metii emporeet neisudoo ninche irresheta lenye te nkaraki nanu; ore metii emporeet netuturo ninche engumoto te nkaraki enkishui ai.
Nchoo ninche metaluama enkidaata! Naa nchoo ilo rreshet oisudoitie ninche meibung'a ninche; nchoo ninche metadoiki enkidaata!
Keng'idakino oltau lai Olaitoriani, neshipakino enjeunoto enye.

Nejo iloik laainei pooki, “Iyie Olaitoriani, kaing'ae likinyaanyukie, iyie okordu ilo omena aitajeu aitung'uaa ilo ogol oleng alang ninye, nintajeu ilo oshal naa aisinani aitung'uaa ilo oitorogony ninye?”
Etudumunye ilchakenini le lejare; naaikilikuan ninche mbaa nemayiolo nanu.
Naalaaki ninche ntorrok too supati naitaasa ninche, etalepori oltau lai.
Kake ore nanu, enkata namuoi ninche - naishop ilkuniyiani, naitame kewan te enata e mpukoroto naomon nanu eirruge elukunya ai abaiki olgoo
natiu anaa oltung'ani oishiraki olchore anaa olalashe; namanimanaa anaa oltung'ani oishiraki ng'otonye, nairrugo te nkishirata o sina.
Kake ore te rrorroto ai neiturrurro ninche aashipa, naaiturrurrokino aagilunore ilmaiman lemayiolo, naasukeny ninche metii enkiyagata;
nesukenyisho ninche too siruai, neony ninche ilala lenye te nkaraki nanu.
Ke nkata nabaa Olaitoriani iton iyie aing'or? Tokorduaki nanu te rasakinoto enye, tokordu enkishui ai te lelo ng'atunyo!
Naa kaaisho nanu iyie enashe tiatua eumata kitok; ore tiatua olorora kitok naaisis iyie.
Mincho lelo mang'ati laainei eng'ida te nkaraki nanu, nimincho lelo ooimul inkonyek aaiba nanu pesho.
Amu meiro ninche ine seriani, kake lelo oobor te nkop egilunore neipiru ninche irorei le lejare.
Naaboloki ninche nkutukie enye aagilunore; nejo ninche, “Aha-ha! Etoduaa nkonyek ang ninye!”
Olaitoriani, itoduaa iyie, migira! Olaitoriani, mikilam iyie nanu!
Tuputunye, tudumunye te nkaraki esipata ai, te nkaraki ewalata ai, Enkai ai naa Olaitoriani lai!
Nguanareki nanu, Olaitoriani, Enkai ai, te risioroto e supatisho ino; nimincho ninche eng'ida te nkaraki nanu!
Mincho ninche ejokino maate, “Aha, kinoto iyiook eyieunoto oo ltauja lang!” Mincho ninche ejo, “Kitoijoitie iyiook ninye.”
Nchoo ninche meitukurruni nepiki olmilo te nebo, lelo oong'ida te nkaraki enyamali ai! Nchoo ninche meishopokini enkurruna o esulare lelo oojukaa ate laaitainore!
Nchoo lelo oong'uar esupatisho ai metabuaku te ng'ida, neshipa, nejo ntarasi moitie, “Aikitok Olaitoriani, neshipakino ninye eseriani o sinka lenye!”
Netum taa olng'ejep lai atolimu esupatisho ino o enkisisa ino endama pooki.
Ore enkarruoisho neiro tiatua ilo arruoni, te nguton o ltau lenye; metii euriata e Nkai dukuya nkonyek enyena.
Amu kelej ninye kewan nchere meyiolouni entorroni enye neibayuni.
Ore irorei le nkutuk enye naa ntorrok o lejare; meekure ninye easisho te ng'eno neas isupati.
Ntorrok edamu ninye te ndapash enye; nepik ninye kewan enkoitoi neme sidai; nemeiturraa entorroni.
Ore ina nyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, nelo abaiki shumata, ore esupatisho ino nelo abaiki nkatampo.
Etiu esupatisho ino anaa ildoinyo le Nkai, eikununo nkiguanat inono anaa enguton kitok; Olaitoriani, iyie oitajeu oltung'ani o eng'ues.
Kebaa esidano e nyorrata ino nauno, iyie Enkai! Oloip loo naipuko inono esaru nkera e tung'ani.
Nedaa ninche te nena naabore enkaji ino, nincho iyie ninche entoki naok te ilo keju lino le ng'ida.
Amu iyie etii enkong'u e nkishui; te wang'an ino iyiook kidol ewang'an.
Nchoo ebikoo ina nyorrata ino nauno te lelo likiyiolo iyie, nebikoo enjeunoto ino te lelo loo ltauja sidain!
Mincho lelo oowuasa maatarasaki, nimincho enkaina e ilo torrono aarrumoo nanu.
Etabatatakinote lelo arruok enkop, etanang'ieki enkop nemeigil aadumunye.
Ming'aing'ai te nkaraki ilo torrono, niming'uar lelo aasak loo ntorrok.
Amu kesioki ninche aaishunye anaa nkujit, netiu anaa mbenek naatoito.
Isiliga Olaitoriani nias esidai; pee itum atobiko tena kop, nitum eseriani.
Tishipakinoyu Olaitoriani, naa aikincho ninye iyieunot o ltau lino.
Rishaki nkoitoi inono Olaitoriani; isiliga ninye, amu eikintaas ninye.
Amu keibalunye ninye esipata ino anaa ewang'an, o enchunet ino aitotiu anaa dama.
Ntirring'ayu te dukuya Olaitoriani, nianyu ninye te ng'iriata; ming'aing'ai te nkaraki ilo odupoyu te nkoitoi enye, te nkaraki ilo tung'ani olo too nkoitoi enyena oo nkitobirat torrok!
Talama engoro ninturraa eserserisho! Mintanyamal kewan, amu entorroni ake eyau ina.
Amu ore ilo torrono naa kedung'ori; ore lelo oanyu Olaitoriani naa kejung ina kop.
Kake ore te nkiti rishata, nemeitoki ilo torrono atii; ore ninye te ning'oru oleng te wueji enye, metii ninye ine.
Kake ilo obor olo ajung enkop, neshipakino ninche ina kumoi e dupoto.
Kepik ilo torrono orreshet ilo supat, neony ilala te nkaraki ninye;
kake kekueniye Olaitoriani ilo torrono, amu edolita ninye nchere kelotu enkolong enye.
Etushututua ilarruok ilalema lenye neyietu nkai enye, pee ear metuata lelo aisinak o loomena;
kejing ilalema lenye atua iltauja lenye maate, ore nkai enye naa kegila.
Enaikash enkiti toki naata oltung'ani supat alang nkumok o ltung'ani torrono.
Amu kegili inkaik e ilo torrono; kake kegolie Olaitoriani ilo supat.
Keyiolo Olaitoriani nkolong'i e ilo lemeeta entioto; ore enjung'ore enye nebikoo ntarasi;
meitukurruni ninche too nkatitin e ntorroni, ore too nkatitin o lameyu neeta ninche enkiputakinoto.
Kake keidak ilo torrono; ore lelo mang'ati lo Laitoriani neikununo anaa olari loo nkujit, keish ninche - ore anaa empuruo keishari ninche.
Keisilenisho oltung'ani torrono, nemelak ninye esile, kake keleng ilo supat neishooyo;
amu ore lelo ootamayiana Olaitoriani naa kejung enkop, ore lelo ootediaa ninye naa keiwuang'ieki.
Olaitoriani eing'uaa iroruat e tung'ani naa keitubul ilo oitiship enkoitoi enye;
ore ninye te nebatata nemepetikino enkop amu Olaitoriani oibung enkaina enye.
Kara apa nanu oti, nara taata moruo; ore ake eyia, eitu nanu adol oltung'ani supat eiturrayioki anaa eomonu nkera enyena endaa.
Keeta ninye olng'ur anaake neishooyo te sile, ore nkera enyena neaku emayianata.
Talama entorroni, nias esidai; pee itum atobikoi ntarasi.
Amu kenyor Olaitoriani esupatisho; meiturraa ninye lelo sinyat lenyena. Kegolieki ilo supat ntarasi, kake ore nkera eilo torrono naa keiwuang'ieki.
Ilo supat olo ajung enkop, nemany ina kop ntarasi.
Ore enkutuk eilo supat neiro ine ng'eno, neiro olng'ejep lenye isipat.
Netii enkitanapata e Nkai enye atua oltau lenye; nemeideketari too roruat enyena.
Ore ilo torrono nejurru ilo supat, neing'oru eneiko pee ear ninye metua.
Mepalaa Olaitoriani ninye aisho metijing'a enkaina o lmang'atinda, aashu eisho metudung'okini ninye enkiguana te neyauni aaiguanare.
Taanyu Olaitoriani nimbung inkoitoi enyena, amu eikincho ninye esipata nilo ajung'ie enkop; naa ilo iyie aing'or enkidaata e ilo torrono.
Atoduaa nanu oltung'ani torrono te ntorroni enye, nebul netiu ninye anaa oltarakuai le Lebanon.
Najo nanu agiroo, meekure etii; ore hoo natejo nanu aing'oru, meekure etumi.
Tisipu tujurru ilo tung'ani supat, ning'or ilo oitoriori nkoitoi enyena, amu ore enkiting'oto e ilo tung'ani naa eseriani.
Kake ore lelo agilak loo nkitanapat naa keidaikieki pooki te nebo; ore ilng'anayio le ilo torrono naa kedung'ori.
Ore enjeunoto eilo supat naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa; ninye esarunoto enye te nkata e e ngolikinoto.
Olaitoriani oretu ninche nekordu ninche; nekordu ninche te ilo torrono, neitajeu ninche; te nkaraki natasarutua ninche ninye.
Iyie Olaitoriani, mikisikong nanu te ngoro ino, nimikintame nanu te mpijan e ngoro ino!
Amu aaibitakinote nanu mbaa inono, naatadoikio nanu enkaina ino.
Metii embiotisho atua osesen lai, te nkaraki engoro ino; metii embiotisho iloik laainei te nkaraki eng'oki ai.
Amu eshomo ntorrok aainei aalus te ndukuya ai; olola oiroishi oleng ninche te nanu.
Eishikishik ilbaa laainei netong'ueita, te nkaraki emodai ai.
Airruge nanu oleng abaiki enkop; nalo nanu aishirita endama pooki.
Amu eiputa empolos ai emion, nemetii embiotisho osesen lai.
Aidaayie nanu natarrarre, nayietu aishir te nkaraki emion o ltau lai.
Olaitoriani, iyiolo iyie eyieunoto ai pooki, nemeisudoro emion ai te dukuya iyie.
Keitiko oltau lai, neishunye engolon ai; ore ewang'an oo nkonyek aainei - neishunye sii te nanu.
Ore ilchoreta laainei o encholiek ai, naaitashe aalam to lmeitai lai, ore iltung'ana laainei le mudong neitashe te nelakua.
Ore lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai neirragie aaitolok irresheta lenye, ore lelo ooing'oru enkitamioto ai neiro ine nkidaata, neibirribir ninche elejare endama pooki.
Kake atiu nanu anaa oltung'ani ming'ani, maning'isho nanu, atiu anaa oltung'ani otoonye enkutuk lemeidim airoro.
Ee, aikununo nanu anaa oltung'ani ming'ani lemetii enkutuk enye ilomon torrok.
Amu iyie Olaitoriani nanu aanyita; iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai likiwaliki.
Amu aatoomono, “Mincho ninche meting'idata te nkaraki nanu, lelo ooitokoos tiatua nanu te neideketari enkeju ai!”
Amu etaa nanu kabatata, neton ake aata emion ai.
Aibalunye nanu entorroni, aainosua nanu eng'oki ai.
Ore lelo mang'ati laaiba nanu metii emporeet, naa eimagil, naa ilkumok laaiba nanu too mbaa nemesipa.
Ore lelo laalaaki nanu too ntorrok aitaasa nanu ninche isupati, naa ilmang'ati laainei te nkaraki nasujita isupati.
Miking'uaa nanu iyie Olaitoriani! Iyie Na Ai, mikilam nanu!
Taretuoki nanu tasioki, iyie Olaitoriani, enjeunoto ai!
Atejo nanu, “Kagolie nkoitoi aainei, pee maas eng'oki to lng'ejep lai; kaen nanu enkutuk ai, enkata naba anaa enatii iltorrok ewueji natii nanu.”
Atunuke nanu agira, naitirring'a nanu eitu ajo ae, neponari emion ai,
neirowuaju oltau lai tiatua nanu. Ore anaa enadamisho, neyupuyup enkima; nairo nanu to lng'ejep lai:
“Olaitoriani, ntayioloki nanu enkiting'oto ai, o eneikununo enkikenata oo nkolong'i aainei; ntayioloki nanu enkisarrisar e nkishui ai!
Ng'ura ajo intaba iyie nkolong'i aainei anaa nkuti temat e ndap e nkaina, ore nkolong'i e nkishui ai naa pesho too nkonyek inono. Kesipa keitashe pooki tung'ani aa enkijape ake!
Kesipa, kemanimanaa oltung'ani aa oloip ake, naa enepesho ake enkuretisho enye; eiturrurru oltung'ani imasaa nemeyiolo ololo adupore!
“Naa amaa, taata, Olaitoriani, Kainyoo nanu aanyu? Atua iyie etii osiligi lai.
Tokorduaki nanu matung'uai nkitarruorot aainei pooki. Mikintaa nanu olorojareki te lelo oomoda!
Atigire nanu, mabol enkutuk ai; amu iyie otaasa ina.
Iwuang'ie eoshoto ino te nanu; aisha nanu te oshoto e nkaina ino.
Ti nintame iyie oltung'ani te nkisikong'ata oo ng'ok, nintotiu anaa entoki nainosa oriri ina kirotet te ninye; esipa ore pooki tung'ani naa enkiyang'et ake!
“Toning'o enkomono ai, Olaitoriani, nining olkiyioi lai migirare ilkiyio laainei! Amu kara nanu olomoni lino olo, nara olalotoni anaa loo papa pooki.
Miking'ode nanu, pee atum atayiolo enchipai, eton eitu alo nemaitoki atii.”
Ataanyua nanu Olaitoriani te ng'iriata; naairrugokino ninye nening enkomono ai.
Aaitayio ninye nanu tiatua engumoto e ntorroni, tiatua oloonyionyi le sarng'ab, neitasheyie inkejek aainei te nchumata e ndapidapoi, neitaserian inkejek aainei.
Nepik osinkolio ng'ejuk enkutuk ai, osinkolio le nkisisa te Nkai ang. Kepuo ilkumok aadol neureishoyu, nepik osiligi lenye Olaitoriani.
Emayiana oltung'ani oitaa Olaitoriani osiligi lenye, ilo tung'ani lemeibelekenyakino lelo oowuasa, alo enetii lelo oopong'ori esujaa inkaitin oo nkitanyaanyukot!
Itoponayie iyie, Olaitoriani Enkai ai, nkiaasin inono e nking'asia o ndamunot inono tialo iyiook; meetae olikinyaanyukie iyie! Tenaa naaji kaibalunye alimu ninche, naa eikumok oleng meikenayu.
