Ming'uar iyie ilasarri o nkishoorot; kake kinchoo iyie enkiok naning'isho Ore ilasarri oopejori o lasar loo ng'ok eitu iyie ing'uar.
Najo nanu, “Ng'ura aeuo; ore to lpiyayati le mbuku nesira inaaipirare nanu:
Kang'ida nanu aas eyieunoto ino, Na Ai; etii enkitanapata ino atua oltau lai.”
Atolikioyie nanu ilomon supati le nkordunoto tiatua eumata sapuk; eitu nanu agira, anaa eniyiolo iyie, Olaitoriani.
Eitu nanu aisudoo ina retoto ino naitajeusho tiatua oltau lai, atolimuo nanu esupatisho ino o enjeunoto ino; eitu nanu anuk ina nyorrata ino nauno o esupatisho ino, aaibalakinyie nanu te umata sapuk.
Mimbooyo iyie Olaitoriani olng'ur lino tialo nanu, nchoo ina nyorrata ino nauno o esupatisho ino aagolie nanu anaake!
Amu aatamuata nanu ntorrok nemeikenayu; aaidimutua nanu ntorrok aainei, o metaba anaa neaku meekure aidim atodolisho; eikumok intorrok aainei aalang ilpapit te ndukuya ai, netalepori oltau lai.
Tonyorrai, Olaitoriani, tokorduaki nanu! Olaitoriani, taretuoki nanu tasioki!
Nchoo lelo ooing'oru pee eiwuang'ie enkishui ai meitukurruni nemiloyu, nchoo ninche meibelekenyi neitadouni lelo ooing'oru pee aainyal!
Nchoo meirriang'ieki ninche te nkaraki enkurruna enye, lelo laajoki nanu, “Aha-ha.”
Kake ore lelo pooki liking'oru iyie nchoo eng'idayu neshipa tiatua iyie; nchoo lelo pooki oonyor enjeunoto ino emooki aajo, “Eikitok Olaitoriani!”
Ore nanu, kara aisinani namena, kake Olaitoriani laagolie. Ira iyie eretoto ai olakordunoni lai; mimutie iyie, na Ai ai!
Emayiana ilo oiken olaisinani! Kekordu Olaitoriani ninye te nkolong e nyamali;
kemitu Olaitoriani ninye neitopok; keji olomayiana te nkop; minchooyo iyie ninye apik eyieunoto oo lmang'ati lenyena.
Keitagol Olaitoriani ninye te ndapash enye; ore te muoyian enye nishiunye ninye pooki leyiata.
Ore tialo nanu, atejo, “Olaitoriani, ing'urrieki nanu; nchiunyeki nanu, amu ataasa nanu eng'oki tialo iyie!”
Keiro ilmang'ati laainei entorroni tialo nanu, ejo, “Kanu kenya eye ninye, pee eish enkarna enye!”
Naa tenaalotu oltung'ani aduaare neiro ninye irorei le pesho, nesot ntorrok to ltau lenye; ore pee eipang alo neidapashaki enkop pooki.
Ore lelo pooki laaiba nanu neing'oming'om te nebo aaimaki nanu; nemusu ninche ntorrok tialo nanu.
Nejo ninche, “Etijing'a ninye entaboi; meekure aekata edumunye teine neirragie.”
Ore ninye olchore lai lo ltau apa laisiliga nanu, oshi onya endaa ai, naatudumakine ninye nanu.
Kake ing'urrieki iyie, Olaitoriani, tudumuaki nanu pee atum aitalaku elap te ninye!
Tena nanu ayiolou nchere, ekishipakino iyie nanu, nchere eitu eisulu olmang'atinta lai te nanu.
Kimbung'a iyie nanu te nkaraki naas isupati, nikipik nanu dukuya ino ntarasi.
Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ntarasi o ntarasi! Eesai, Eesai.
Ore anaa enayieu enkolii enkare naruko neijia etiu oltau lai, kiyieu iyie, Enkai.
Keeta oltau lai enkure te nkaraki Enkai, Enkai naishu. Kanu kenya alotu aing'or enkomom e Nkai?
Etaa ilkiyio laainei ninche endaa ai dama o kewarie, aajoki nanu iltung'ana anaake, “Koree Enkai ino?”
Tenadamu nanu kuna baa nelepori oltau lai tiatua nanu, amu ashomo nanu arikoo olorora nikipuo e nkaji e Nkai, too mbuakunot e nchipai o sinkolioitin le nashe, neitobir ilo orora osirua.
Kainyoo pee itapalari iyie, lo tau lai, naa kainyoo pee itanyamala iyie tiatua nanu? Isiliga Enkai; amu kaitoki ake aisis ninye, ninye eretoto ai naa Enkai ai.
Etalepori oltau lai tiatua nanu, ore te nkaraki ina kaadamu nanu iyie, ebaiki enkop e Yordan o ene Harmon, ebaiki oldoinyo le Misar.
Eishiraka enguton e nguton te mbuakunoto oo nkariak inono; ore ndoorot oo nkariak o lopir le nkare naaitemoitie nanu.
Ore te ndama neitanap Olaitoriani enyorrata enye nauno, ore te nkewarie netii osinkolio lenye te nebo nanu, enkomono e Nkai e nkishui ai.
Atiaaka nanu Enkai, endapidapoi ai, “Kainyoo pee mikidamu nanu? Kainyoo nanu pee alo aishirita, te nkaraki enkitorogonyata naaitorogony olmang'atinta?”
Etotiutuo anaa ilbaa torrok to sesen lai, imorot oo lmang'ati laainei, aajoki ninche anaake, “Koree e Nkai ino?”
Kainyoo iyie pee itapalari, lo tau lai, naa kainyoo iyie pee itigire tiatua nanu? Isiliga Enkai, amu kaitoki ake aisis ninye, eretoto ai naa Enkai ai.
Mbalie na Ai nchere maata entorroni nikimitu nanu. Tokorduaki nanu too lalejak o te lelo lemeitoriori!
Amu ira iyie Enkai naa ninye nanu asaru; Kainyoo iyie pee kinturrayie nanu? Kainyoo nanu pee alo aishirita, te nkaraki enkitorogonyata o lmang'atinta lai?
Oi irriu ewang'an ino o esipata ino; nchoo ninche maatorikoi nanu, nchoo ninche maatoriku nanu ilo doinyo lino sinyati o emanyisho ino!
Pee atum nanu ashomo olperere lo lasar le Nkai, alo enetii Enkai naa ninye eng'ida ai nadooyo; naa kaalo nanu arrep iyie to lwulul na Ai, Enkai ai.
Kainyoo iyie pee itapalari lo tau lai, naa kainyoo iyie pee itanyamala tiatua nanu? Isiliga Enkai, amu kaitoki ake aisis ninye, eretoto ai naa Enkai ai.
Kitoning'o iyiook too nkiyiaa ang, iyie Enkai, etolikitio iyiook iloo papa, nena kiaasin apa nitaasa iyie too nkolong'i enye, apa moitie:
iyie makewan oturrumoyie iloshon te nkaina ino, kake intubula olorere lino; nipik iloreren osina, kake nchoo olorere lino etoni te seriani;

amu mme to lalem lenye apa eisulie ninche ena kop, neme enkaina enye maate naishoo ninche metimirisho; kake enkaina ino e tatene, ee enkaina ino, o ewang'an e nkomom ino; amu itishipakine iyie ninche.
Ira iyie Olaiguanani lai o Enkai ai, naa iyie oisho Yakobo metimirisho.
Te iyie iyiook kisula too lmang'ati lang; te nkarna ino iyiook kintunyoo lelo oogilunore iyiook.
Amu mme enkawuo ainanu aisilig, nemaaidim olalem lai aitajeu.
Kake intajewuo iyie iyiook too lmang'ati lang, nitipika olmilo lelo ooiba iyiook.
Enkai kiting'idare iyiook anaake, naa eikinchooyo enashe te nkaraki enkarna ino ntarasi.
Ore ake eyia, inturrayie iyie iyiook nintadou iyiook, neitu iyie ilo airiamariyie njorin ang.
Inchoo iyie iyiook maibelekenyata aailany ilmang'ati lang; ore lelo mang'ati lang neibung aaraya masaa ang.
Intotiuo iyie iyiook anaa ntare naayieng'i, nindapashaka iyiook iloreren.
Itimira iltung'ana linono neitu inosie toki, eitu iyie ing'oru enkinyiang'a nagol te nkaraki ninche.
Itipika iyie iyiook elap too lmang'ati lang, neikordod neyiet iyiook lelo oomanita iyiook.
Ntaa iyie iyiook endung'et e rashe tiatua iloreren, entoki nakueniyieki tiatua iloshon.
Ore endama pooki netii esulare ai dukuya nanu, neimulumula enkurruna enkomom ai,
te nkaraki irorei le ilo oikordodisho nemorisho, te nkaraki ilo mang'atinta o ilo oitalaku elap.
Eetuo kuna pooki shumata iyiook, hoo neitu kipal mikidamu iyie, neitu kipong'ori to lning'o lino.
Eitu eibelekenya iltauja lang, neitu elam iroruat ang enkoitoi ino,
nitigiligila iyiook tiatua ewueji oo mbariak, nimulumul iyiook te naimin namisimis.
Amaa naaji tenaa ketorikine iyiook enkarna e Nkai ang, anaa eikintoriokito inkaik ang enkai omoni,
aimeirrash Enkai ena? Amu keyiolo ninye nkisudorot o ltau.
Ee, te nkaraki enkorrok ino pee eari iyiook endama pooki, neikoni iyiook anaa nkerra naayieng'i.
Tuputunye! Minturraa iyiook ntarasi Kainyoo pee irura, iyie Olaitoriani? Tudumunye, minturraa iyiook anang'aki enelakua.
Kainyoo iyie pee isudoo enkomom ino? Kainyoo iyie pee kitorikine osina lang o enkitorogonyata ang?
Eirrugote iltauja lang aabaiki enkop; eirragita iseseni lang te nkop.
Tudumunye, wou taretu iyiook! Tokordu iyiook te nkaraki ina nyorrata ino nauno!
Eiputa aadooyo to ltau lai ilomon supati; naliki nanu olaiguanani irorei lo sinkolio lai; eikununo olng'ejep lai anaa enkalamu o lasirani arriyia.
Ira iyie sidai too nkera e tung'ani; etubukokoki empiris enkutuk ino; ore te nkaraki ina, kitamayiana Enkai ntarasi.
Teena olalem lino te mpolos ino, iyie ele magilani, tiatua enkitoo ino o enkishiaa!
Ore te nkishiaa ino shomo isula te nkaraki esipata nimitu ilo asipani; nchoo enkaina ino e tatene mikinteng'ena nkiaasin naaitureisho!
Kepi mbaa inono, netii atua iltauja loo lmang'ati lo laiguanani, nebatata iloreren ti abori iyie.
Ore ilo orika lino le nkitoo, Enkai, nebikoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Ore ina ng'udi ino e nkitoria naa eng'udi oo sipat;
inyor iyie esupatisho nimba enkarruoisho. Metaa ore Enkai, ina Ai ino kitubukoko eilata aput teina ilata e ng'ida nikintulusoo too lchoreta linono.
Ore ilkilani linono neitorropili te nkorropil o too sonkoyoni o erropili o sinantei ore tiatua nena ajijik e nkitoo oo lala loo lkanchaoni, netii nkinantani oo usin nikintishipieki iyie.
Ore ntoyie oo laiguanak netii te nebo nena kituaak inono naayanyiti; ore te nkaina ino e tatene neitashe enkaiguanani eishopito saabu naing'uaa Ofir.
Toning'o, iyie natito, tadamu, nirrugu enkiok ino; nchoo kirikino olorere linyi o enkaji e papaai lino,
pee etum olaiguanani atishipakinoyu enkishiaa ino. Ore amu olkitok lino ninye, irrugokinoyu ninye;
ore iltung'ana le nkop e Tiro neyau nkishoorot, lelo karsisi aalang iltung'ana pooki,
eeta enkarsisisho oo mpukunot pooki. Eikodoki entito o laiguanani to lgilata lenye te nkaji e nkitoo, too ilkilani lenyena ooripuno too usin e saabu.
Ore etukuse too lkilani loo muain kumok, nerikokini olaiguanani, te nebo nena selenken naairukurukore ninye.
Nerikuni ninche te nchipai o te ng'ida, ina kata ejing atua ina aji e nkitoo o laiguanani.
Ore te rishata oo loo papaai linyi naa keaku ilayiok linono; naa ilo iyie aitaa ninche kituaak te nkop pooki.
Kaisho nanu enkarna ino metoning'oyu too ishoritin pooki, metaa eikisis iyie iloreren ntarasi o ntarasi.
Enkai osempewuet lang naa engolon ang, eretoto nataana ninye te nkata e nyamali.
Ore te nkaraki ina mikiureisho hoo duoo ninye tenaa keibelekenya enkop, hoo duoo ninye tenaa keikirikira ildoinyo te mpolos e naiposha;
hoo tenaa keikurrukur inkariak e naiposha neitayu labur, hoo tenaa keikirikira ildoinyo te nkaraki olarrabal.
Etii olkeju oitiship nchorroi enyena enkanasa o Laitoriani, ina manyisho sinyati e ilo Otii Shumata Aisul.
Etii Enkai atua ina anasa, nemeigusugusieki ninye; keretu Enkai ninye tadekenya.
Etagorote iloshon, neikirikirate nkitoriat; neiro ninye to ltoilo lenye, neshola enkop.
Etii Olaitoriani loo lororani te nebo iyiook; Enkai e Yakobo ninye esarunoto ang.
Wootu eng'ura isiaaitin o laitoriani, eneikuna ninye pee eitomijoon enkop.
Ninye oishie ilarrabali o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop; ninye ogil enkawuo nedot empere, nepejoo ngarrin oo mbartan te nkima!
“Ntirring'ayu, niyiolou nchere nanu Enkai. Kara nanu kitok tiatua iloshon, aaitaaki nanu kitok te nkop!”
Etii Olaitoriani loo lororani te nebo iyiook; Enkai e Yakobo ninye esarunoto ang.
Entoosh inkaik te ng'ida lo oreren pooki! Esisa Enkai too mbuakunot oo sinkolioitin.
Amu ore Olaitoriani, ilo Otii Shumata Aisul, naa keitureisho, ninye olaiguanani kitok te nkop pooki.
Ninye oyau iloshon apik abori iyiook, nepik iloreren abori inkejek ang.
Ninye otegelaka iyiook enjung'ore ang, ina kishiaa e Yakobo otonyorra ninye.
Eilepa Enkai shumata te mbuakunoto, te mbuakunoto e sekekua.
Entaranyaki Enkai enkisisa, entarany enkisisa! Entaranyaki Olaiguanani lang entarany enkisisa!
Amu Enkai olaiguanani le nkop pooki; entaranyaki osinkolio le nkarriyiano oiteng'enisho!
Enkai naitoreisho too loreren; etonita Enkai to lorika lenye le nkitoo sinyati.
Eiturrurrote ilkituaak loo loreren anaa iltung'ana le Nkai e Abraham. Amu ine Nkai ilong'oi pooki e nkop; neishori ninye enkitoo sapuk!
Eikitok Olaitoriani naa keisisi ninye oleng tiatua enkanasa e Nkai ang! Te ilo doinyo lenye sinyati
sidai te nkadoro enye, naa ninye eng'ida e nkop pooki. Etii oldoinyo le Sion enelakua te moikuape, ina anasa o laiguanani kitok.
Ore tiatua nkajijik enyena neitodolua Enkai kewan nchere ninye omitu.
Amu, eiturrurrote laiguanak, nepuonu te nebo.
Ore ake pee edol ninche ina, neing'asia, neirut ninche, nedumunye aaisik;
neibung ninche olokirrikiri teine, o emion naaijo ene nkitok nasaisai.
Ore to siwuo le nkilepunoto e nkolong nigil imelin e Tarshishi.
Ore anaa enikitoning'o, ina kitoduaa iyiook tiatua enkanasa o Laitoriani loo lororani, tiatua ina anasa e Nkai ang, apa naitasheyie Enkai ntarasi.
Kitadamutua iyiook teina nyorrata ino kitok, Olaitoriani, te mpolos e nkaji ino.
Ore anaa enatiu enkarna ino, na Ai, neijia etiu enkisisa ino, elo abaiki ineeiting'ie enkop. Neeta enkaina ino e tatene enkisulata;
nchoo oldoinyo le Sion eng'idayu! Nchoo nena toyie e Yuda eng'idayu te nkaraki nkiguanat inono!
Shomo tamanai te Sion, shomo tamana ninye, nkena iltaleta lenyena,
entadamu entisipu isunta enyena o nkajijik enyena, pee itumutumu aatiaaki eishoi nasuju,
nchere Enkai ena, ninye Enkai ang ntarasi o ntarasi. Ninye oaku olarikoni lang ntarasi.
Entoning ena lo oreren! Enchoru nkiyiaa, intae pooki oomanya enkop,
o liabori o le shumata, olkarsis o laisinani te nebo!
Keiro enkutuk ai ine ng'eno nagut; ore nkibirribirrat o ltau lai naa keaku eyiolounoto.
Kairrugoki nanu enkiok ai endung'et e rashe; nawalu nanu oloyiote lai te oshoto o lwulul.
Kainyoo nanu pee aureisho te nkata e nyamali, te naaman nanu entorroni oo laisilisilok laainei,
lelo tung'ana ooisilig karsisisho enye, neitokoos te nkaraki enkumoi oo masaa enye?
Kesipa meetae oltung'ani okordu kewan, anaa oloisho Enkai enkinyiang'a e nkishui enye,
amu ore enkordunoto e nkishui o ltung'ani naa kegol, nemeidimi aekata aainyiang'u,
pee etum oltung'ani ataa keishu ntarasi, nemejing ae kata Engumoto.
Ee, kedol ninye nchere, ekeye sii ninye ilo ng'en, ore ilo modai o lkiminchali naa keidaaya te nebo neing'ueiki ina arsisisho enye ilkulikae.
Nkuraren enye ninche nkang'itie enye ntarasi, ninche imanyishoritin enye tiatua iishoritin pooki, hoo neipot ninche nkuapi aajo nkunenye.
Mebikoo oltung'ani te nkitoo enye, keikununo ninye anaa eng'ues naidaaya.
Ena enkoitoi e lelo oomoda, enkiting'oto e lelo ooshipakino erubata enye.
Etiu ninche anaa ntare naayae enemeneng'a, neaku keeya olchekut lenye; neitoriori ninche aadoiki Engumoto, ore esidano e nkitobirunoto enye neidaaya aish; neaku enemeneng'a enkang enye.
Kake kekordu Enkai enkishui ai aitung'uaa engolon e Nemeneng'a, amu kaang'amu ninye nanu.
Mirut iyie te neaku oltung'ani karsis aashu te neponari enkitoo e nkaji enye,
amu te neye ninye nemenap toki, melo enkitoo enye asujaa ninye.
Ore hoo neikenaa kewan ajo keshipa eton eishu, anaa hoo netum oltung'ani enkisisa te neitaas kewan esidai,
keyooki ake alo enetii ilporori loo loo menye, lelo lemeigil ai kata aadol ewang'an.
Mebikoo oltung'ani tiatua enkitoo enye, etiu ninye anaa eng'ues naidaaya.
Ilo magilani, Olaitoriani Enkai, ninye oiro neipotu enkop ebaiki enkilepunoto e nkolong o metabaiki endoyioroto.
Ore te Sion, teine neiting'ie e nkishiaa, neitawang Enkai.
Kelotu Enkai ang, nemegira ninye, ore te dukuya ninye naa enkima nanyaisho, ore oriong ine nemanita ninye naa osiwuo kitok.
Neipot shumata e keper o abori kop, pee etum ninye aiguanare iltung'ana lenyena:
“Enturrurrokoki nanu lelo ooisiligayu laainei; lelo ooitobira olning'o lo sotua o nanu to lasar!”
Eibalunye shumata esupatisho enye, amu Enkai kewan nadung enkiguana.
“Entoning lo tung'ana laainei, amu kairo nanu, iyie Israel, kaaishakenoki nanu iyie. Kara nanu enkai, Enkai ino.
Eitu nanu aaisikong iyie te nkaraki ilasarri linono; ore lelo asarri linono oopejori netii anaake dukuya nanu.
Mang'amaa olasar loo loing'ok oing'uaa enkaji ino, nemang'amaa olkine oing'uaa eluaata ino.
Amu ore pooki ng'ues tiatua entim naa enaai, o nena kishu inkalifuni naatii ndoinyo.
Kayiolo nanu imotonyi pooki o loing'ang'e, ore pooki toki nalo ti oriong enkop naa enaai.
“Tenaa naaji esumash aata, nemaaliki iyie; amu enaai enkop o pooki toki natii.
Kanya nanu inkiri oo loing'ok, anaa aok osarge loo nkineji?
Nchoo iyie Enkai olasar le nashe, nilaaki ninye nkishoorot inono ilo otii Shumata Aisul;
nikimpot nanu te nkata e nyamali; kaakordu nanu iyie, nikiisis iyie nanu.”
Kake ore te ilo arruoni, ejo Enkai: “Kaa sipata iyie iata nilimunye nkitanapat aainei, anaa iya olning'o lai lo sotua te nkutuk ino?
Amu mba iyie eutaroto, ninang'aa irorei laainei aidie kewan.
Te nidol iyie olapurroni, niaku olchore lenye, nira o le ncholiek oo loo loloito.
“Nipalaa enkutuk ino too nkirorot torrok, neitobiru olng'ejep lino elejare.
Iton iyie airo entorroni tialo olalashe lino, ninteeniki enkerai ning'arie kina.
Kuna baa oshi iasita natigirakine nanu; itejo apa iyie kara obo otiu anaa iyie, kake kaaisikong taata nanu iyie, naibalunye mbaa te dukuya iyie.
“Entisipu naa ena, intae ilemedamu Enkai, pee mayooki ake apolos intae, nemetumi hoo obo oitajeu!
Ore ilo oyau olasar le nashe ninye laayanyit nanu; ore ilo oitorioo inkoitoi enyena, naa kaitodol nanu enjeunoto e Nkai!”
Ing'urrieki nanu iyie Enkai, te risioroto e nyorrata ino nauno; ore te risioroto o lng'ur lino kitok, tujutoi inkitarruorot aainei.
Ntukuoki nanu tukul meishunye entorroni ai, nikintisiny too ng'ok aainei!
Amu kayiolo nanu nkitarruorot aainei, netii ing'ok aainei anaake dukuya nanu.
Tialo iyie ake ataasa nanu eng'oki, naas ina torrono too nkonyek inono, metaa ira iyie asipani te nkiguana ino, nimiaata entioto te nkiguana ino.
Tiatua ntorrok nanu aatoiwuoki, naa tiatua ing'ok aatoiwuo yieyio.
Esipata e atua oltau iyieu iyie; ore te nkaraki ina inteng'enaki nanu eng'eno nagut tiatua enkisudoroto o ltau lai.
Ntisinyaki nanu te hisopo, pee asinyayu; ntukuoki, pee awang'u alang enturoto.
Mputaki nanu eng'ida o enchipai, nchoo lelo oik apa litigila iyie meting'idata.
Isudoi enkomom ino too ng'ok aainei, nijutoo ntorrok aainei pooki.
Ntobiru tiatua nanu oltau sidai, iyie Enkai, nipik enkishui ng'ejuk sidai atua nanu.
Mikinturraa nanu aitung'uaa ine nitii, nimiwuang'ie ina kiyang'et ino Sinyati tiatua nanu.
Torrinyokoki nanu eng'ida e njeunoto ino, nikimbung nanu to ltau le yieunoto ino.
Pee atum aiteng'ena ilaitarruorrok inkoitoi inono, nikirrinyokino ilaing'okok aapuonu enitii.
Iyie Enkai, tokorduaki nanu te nkibukoroto o sarge iyie Enkai e njeunoto ai, naa kerany olng'ejep lai te mbuakunoto e nkordunoto ino.
Olaitoriani, tabolo iyie enkutuk ai pee eibalunye enkutuk ai enkisisa ino.
Amu mishipakino iyie ilasarri; te naitayu ninye olasar opejori nimikintiship iyie.
Ore olasar ong'amaroyu te Nkai naa oltau obor; ore oltau obor neitadou kewan, mimenaa iyie Olaitoriani.
Ntaasa Sion esidai te supatisho ino; teshetu isunta e Yerusalem.
Pee itum taa atishipakinoyu ilasarri oodede, o lasarri oopejori o lasarri oolulung'a oopejori; nitum taa aitayu ilasarri loo loing'ok, to lperere lino lo lasar.
Kainyoo iyie pee intokoos, lo tung'ani magilani, te nkaraki entorroni naitaasaki ilo tung'ani le Nkai?
Ore endama pooki, intobirita iyie enkidaata. Eikununo olng'ejep lino anaa olmurunya opi, iyie olaitobirani le nkeleekisho.
Inyor iyie entorroni aitalang esupatisho, o elejare alang esipata.
Inyor iyie irorei oomutisho, iyie lo ng'ejep olejisho
kake eikigiligil iyie Enkai ntarasi; nikimbung ninye iyie nikipolos tiatua olng'obor lino; nikidotu ninye iyie aitung'uaa enkop oo looishu.
Ore lelo supati naa kedol, neureishoyu, nekueniyie ninche ninye, ejo,
“Eng'ura oltung'ani lemeitaa Enkai esarunoto enye, laa enkumoi oo masaa enyena eisiliga, nelo ninye aing'oru enesaru tiatua imasaa enyena!”
Kake aikununo nanu anaa oloirien onyori mbenek tiatua enkaji e Nkai. Aisiliga nanu ina nyorrata nauno e Nkai ntarasi o ntarasi.
Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe ntarasi, amu itaasa iyie ena. Kaibalunye nanu enkarna ino amu eisidai, te dukuya lelo ooure Enkai.
Ejo olmodai to ltau lenye, “Metii Enkai.” Etarruoitie ninche, neas olminong torrono, meetae ninye obo oas isidain.
Neing'or Enkai kop etii keper, aing'or inkera e tung'ani pee edol tenaa ketii obo ng'en oing'oru Enkai.
Etorrinyote pooki aapuo siadi, etarruoitie pooki; meetae hoo obo oas esidai, a'a, metii hoo obo.
Aimeeta kulo ooas intorrok indamunot, kulo oonya iltung'ana laainei anaa endaa, nemeipotu ninche Enkai?
Etijing'a ninche olkirutoto kitok, olkirutoto leitu aekata etumi! Amu keidapash Enkai iloik le lelo lemeure Enkai, keitukurruni ninche, amu etanya Enkai ninche.
Oi elotu enkordunoto e Israel eing'uaa Sion! Ina kata errinyu Enkai iltung'ana lenyena, neng'idayu Yakobo neshipayu Israel.
Ntajewuoki nanu, iyie Enkai, te nkarna ino, nguanareki nanu te nkidimata ino.
Toning'o enkomono ai, iyie Enkai; tipika enkiok ino kulo rorei le nkutuk ai.
Amu aatudumakinote nanu iltung'ana omon aagilunore, eing'oru iltung'ana lemeeta olng'ur enkishui ai, nemeiturukie ninche Enkai too mbaa enye.
Kesipa Enkai ninye olaretoni lai; Olaitoriani ninye olaibung'ani le nkishui ai.
Keitalaku ninye entorroni too lmang'ati laainei; ore te supatisho ino nting'ie ninche.
Ore too lasarri lo lpela kaapolosaki nanu iyie; kaisho nanu enkarna ino enashe, iyie Olaitoriani, amu aisidai ninye.
Amu kitokordua iyie nanu aitung'uaa pooki nyamali, netoduaa nkonyek aainei enkisulata ino too lmang'ati laainei.
Toning'o te nkiok ino enkomono ai, na Ai; nimisudoo kewan te nkomono ai!
Toning'oki nanu, nikiwaliki; aaidimua nanu engolikinoto ai, atalepunye nanu,
te nkaraki ilo toilo lo lmang'atinta, te nkaraki ina kibookinoto enkop eilo torrono amu keyau ninche enyamali shumata nanu; ore te ngoro neitobir ninche mang'atisho tialo nanu.
Etamio oltau lai tiatua nanu, neewuo olkirutoto le keeya shumata nanu.
Eewuo olkirutoto o lokirikiri shumata nanu, naaibulayie nanu enkiputukuny.
Najo nanu, “Oi naaji tenaa kaata inaipuko anaa enturkuluo, anaata aipirri enelakua ayeng'iyeng'a;
ee, anaata alo enelakua, nalo nanu airrag ong'ata,
anaata aipirri alo aing'oru olng'obor aing'ataa olemua o lkutati kitok.”
Ndaikie iyie nkitobirat enye, Olaitoriani, nipik olmilo ilng'ejepa lenye amu adolita nanu olarrabal o enchankar tiatua enkanasa.
Ore dama o kewarie, nemanaa ninche too sunta enyena; netii enkarruoisho o enyamali atua ninye.
Etii enkidaata empolos enye, nemepuku enkibookinoto e nkop o esunkuroisho te wueji enye nemirishoreki.
Mme olmang'atinta laatusukenya nanu, amu anaata nanu airisha; mme ilo laaiba oitokoos tialo nanu - amu anaata nanu ashomo aisudori.
Kake iyie, ele, larisiore, iyie ole ncholuek ai, ele shore lai latamoo.
Eikiaata apa iyiook nkirorot naamurru te nebo; ore tiatua enkaji e Nkai nikipuo apa iyiook te nchula.
Meeu keeya shumata ninche, metadoi ninche aapuo enemeneng'a eishu, meshomo ninche to lkirutoto aajing atua nkuraren enye.
Kake kaipot nanu Olaitoriani; naa kaaitajeu nanu Olaitoriani.
Ore teipa o tadekenya o te ndama nairo nanu enyamali ai naisinanuo, naa kening ninye oltoilo lai.
Kekordu ninye oltau lai te seriani te ilo arrabal laatoluaakine, amu ilkumok laakeshare nanu.
Kening Enkai, neitobor ninche, ilo apa ototonie olorika le nkitoo ebaiki moitie, te nkaraki nemeibung ninche nkitanapat, nemeure ninche Enkai.
Eitorioyie ilo le ncholuek ai enkaina enye agilunore ilchoreta lenyena, etigila ninye olning'o lenye.
Kenana enkiroroto enye anaa eng'orno, kake keeta olarrabal to ltau lenye; nenana irorei lenyena anaa eilata, kake eikununo ninche anaa lalema ootushutuaki.
Nteleiki Olaitoriani olola lino, naa aikintagol ninye iyie; menyorraa aekata ninye meiwuang'ieki ilo asipani.

Kake, ore iyie, Enkai, inang'aa ninche aitadou meetu abori tiatua engumoto nagut. Ore lelo tung'ana lo sarge o esunkuroisho metaa mebikoo ninche eishu to lpisiai le nkishui enye kake kaaisilig nanu iyie.
Ing'urrieki nanu, iyie Enkai, amu aaitunyokito iltung'ana enkop; ore endama pooki naaisilisil nanu iltung'ana.
Aaitunyokito ilmang'ati laainei enkop endama pooki, amu ilkumok laarare nanu te nkitokoos.
Te naureishoyu nanu napik osiligi lai atua iyie.
Atua ina Ai naisisita nanu ororei lenye, Enkai naisiligita metii enkuretisho. Kaa nanu aaidim tung'ani aitaasa?
Ore endama pooki neing'oru ninche pee eibelekeny irorei laainei; ore ndamunot enye pooki naa nanu egilunore te ntorroni.
Neiturrurro ninche te nebo, neisudori, neing'or iroruat aainei. Ejo pee aar matua
ntalaa ninche te nkaraki enkarruoisho enye; ore te ngoro ino, iyie Enkai, tusulaki ninche enkop!
Nkena iyie enkirrang'irrang ai; tipika iyie ilkiyio laainei oltulet lino! Aimetii ninche atua embuku ino?
Naa kerrinyi ilmang'ati laainei siadi teina kata naaishiraki nanu iyie. Kayiolo nanu ena, nchere ketii Enkai enchoto ai.
Ore te nkidimata e Nkai naa kaisis nanu ororei lenye, Ore te nkidimata o Laitoriani naa kaisis nanu ororei lenye.
Enkai aisilig nanu, maata enkuretisho. Kaa nanu aaidim tung'ani aitaasa?
Ore lelo muma laainei te iyie naa kaitabaya, kaishoru nanu olasar le nashe te iyie.
Amu itokordua iyie enkishui ai te keeya, ee, nintajeu inkejek aainei te mbatatata, pee atum nanu ashomo te dukuya Enkai tiatua ewang'an e nkishui ai.
Ing'urrieki nanu iyie Enkai, ing'urrieki nanu, amu iyie esaru oltau lai; oloip loo naipuko inono nanu asaru, o metaba anaa nelusoo ilo kutati te nkidaata.
Aishiraka nanu Enkai natii shumata aisul, Enkai naitabaya eyieunoto enye te nanu.
Ninye oirriu olkilikuai te keper naaitajeu nanu; keitukurru ninye lelo laaitunyoki nanu enkop. Keirriu Enkai ina nyorrata enye nauno o esupatisho enye!
Airrag nanu te mpolos oo lng'atunyo oonya te nkowuarisho inkera e tung'ani iremeta o mbaa ilala lenye, naa ilalema oopi ilng'ejepa lenye.
Mikisisi iyie Enkai, aaitulusoo te keper! Nchoo meibulu enkitoo ino enkop pooki!
Etipika ninche orreshet inkejek aainei; neirrugi oltau lai aaing'orie enkop. Etuturutuo ninche engumoto te nkoitoi ai, kake etusulakinote ninche maate.
Iyie Enkai, eitashe oltau lai auno, euno oltau lai! Karany nanu naosh olkerempe!
Tudumunye lo tau lai! Tudumunye na awuo oo sinkolioitin o lwulul loo usin! Kainyeyie nanu entadekenya!
Ekaaisho nanu iyie enashe, iyie Olaitoriani, tiatua iloshon; kaaranyaki nanu iyie enkisisa tiatua iloreren.
Amu ore ina nyorrata ino nauno naa eikitok o metabaiki keper, nebaiki esupatisho ino nkatampo.
Nchoo mikisisi iyie, Iyie Enkai aaitulusoo te shumata nkatampo! Nchoo enkitoo ino eibulu enkop pooki!
Kesipa, lo kituaak, idung'udung'u intae enkiguana te sipata? Inguanarere intae inkera e tung'ani too sipat?
A'a, ore tiatua iltauja linyi nidamumu ntorrok; niasiasa ntorrok too nkaik inyi te nkop.
Ore lelo torrok netapong'ori apa ake ebaiki etii enguset, etapong'ori apa ebaiki pee eini neiro elejare.
Keeta ninche esayiet naaijo eno lasurai, eikununo ninche anaa enturbubua ming'ani nemening'isho,
nemening oltoilo loo lasakutok anaa oltoilo loo laitobirak loo ntaleng'o ng'eni hoo neibonisho ninche te nkarriyiano.
Iyie Enkai tigila ilala lenye too nkutukie enye; Olaitoriani, tadotu iltagiligil loo lkuoo loo lng'atunyo!
Nchoo meishunye ninche anaa enkare naruko; nchoo meitunyokini ninche enkop anaa nkujit naatoito.
Nchoo ninche metotiwuo anaa osambulal otoshole, nchoo metaa olkibiroto leitu aekata edol enkolong.
Ore eton eitu ening imotioo inyi enkima oo lkiku, naa kaitayu nanu ninche to siwuo akutaa, oloshal o lotoyio!
Kelo ilo supat ang'idayu te nedol enkitalakunoto e lap, nelo ninye aituku inkejek enyena to sarge le lelo arruok.
Naa kejo iltung'ana, “Kesipa keetae elaakinoto teilo supat, kesipa keetae Enkai nadung'oki enkop enkiguana.”
Tokorduaki nanu too lmang'ati laainei, iyie Enkai, Tomituoki nanu te lelo laadumakino aagilunore,
tokorduaki nanu te lelo ooitobir entorroni, nikintajeu nanu too ltung'ana ooata enkure o sarge.
Amu keirrag ninche pee aarresh nanu aar matua, neiturrurro lelo pushunot te nebo pee aar nanu. Neme te nkaraki enkitarruorroto ai anaa eng'oki ai, Olaitoriani,
ore ninye maata enataasa, nekuet ninche aapuo aanapa. Tudumunye, wou taretoki nanu, ning'orisho!
Iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, iyie Enkai e Israel. Tudumunye ntamio iloshon pooki; mileku ninye obo le lelo ooipiru entorroni.
Ore too nteipan nerrinyunye ninche, nebuak anaa ildiein neman enkanasa.
Ng'ura ninche, eimujumuj inkutukie enye, netiu inkutukie enye anaa lalema - nejo ninche, “Kaing'ae oning iyiook?”
Kake ore iyie, Olaitoriani, ikueniyie ninche; ninkoroj iyie iloreren pooki.
Na golon ai, kaaranyaki nanu isinkolioitin le nkisisa; amu ore, iyie Enkai, iyie osempewuet lai.
Ore Enkai teina nyorrata enye nauno naa kelotu enatii; kaaisho nanu Enkai ai matoduaa enkishuroto too lmang'ati laainei.
Miar ninche metuata, merikino ake iltung'ana laainei. Ndapasha ninche te ngolon ino, nintadou ninche, Olaitoriani, iyie elong'o ang!
Ore te nkaraki eng'oki oo nkutukie enye, lelo rorei lenye, nchoo ninche metijing'a orreshet lo lwuasa lenye. Te nkaraki ildeketa o elejare naitayu ninche,
tumuta ninche te ngoro ino, tumuta ninche o metaba anaa neishunye, pee etum iltung'ana aatayioloito nchere Enkai naitoreisho tiatua Yakobo o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.
Ore too nteipan nerrinyunye ninche, nebuak anaa ildiein neman enkanasa.
Nemanimanaa ninche aaing'oru endaa, neing'unyung'uny enkewarie pooki te neitu eraposho.
Kake karanyaki nanu emagilanisho ino karany nanu abuaku isinkolioitin le nyorrata ino tadekenya. Amu itaa iyie osempewuet te nanu, itaa esarunoto ai te nkolong o sina lai.
Na golon ai, kaaranyaki nanu iyie isinkolioitin le nkisisa, amu iyie, iyie Enkai, osempewuet lai, iyie Enkai naaitodol nanu enyorrata nauno.
Iyie Enkai, inturrayie iyie iyiook, nitigila iltimito; itagore iyie, tokordu siaake iyiook.
Iyie oikirikirie enkop, iyie oiperra abol; tarama ine netabee, amu keikirikira.
Itipika iyie iltungana linono, osina kitok inchoo iyie iyiook enaisho oo sabibu naitemerisho.
Ituuno iyie enanka te nkaraki lelo likiure, pee etumi aaitoduaai te nkaraki esipata.
Pee etumi aatokordu ilo lino linyor, nchooo iyiook enkisulata te nkaina ino e tatene, niwaliki iyiook!
Eiroro Enkai tiatua enkaji enye sinyati: “Naa kaor nanu Shekem te ng'ida kitok, narishu ierat le Sukot.
Enaai Gilead; enaai Manase; ore Efraim naa enkopiyia ai o larrabal; ore Yuda naa eng'udi ai e nkitoo.
Ore Moab naa embakuli ai naitukuore; shumata Edom nanu aiteleiki ina amuke ai; naa te shumata Filistia nanu abuaku te nkisulata.”
Kaing'ae laayau nanu atua ina anasa nasheta? Kaing'ae laarik nanu Edom?
Keitu iyie inturraa iyiook, iyie Enkai? Miloito iyie, iyie Enkai, tenebo njoreitin ang.
Nchoo iyiook engolon te nkaraki ilmang'ati lang, amu pesho eretoto e tung'ani!
Ore te retoto e Nkai nikiaas iyiook mbaa sapuki, amu ninye olo aitunyoo ilmang'ati lang.
Toning'o enkishirata, iyie Enkai, inining'o enkomono ai;
ore too neeiting'ie enkop naaipot nanu iyie, elepori oltau lai. Torikoyioki iyie nanu mashomo ina dapidapoi naado alang nanu;
amu iyie enkisudoroto ai, iyie ewueji negol nasaru too lmang'ati laainei, oltalet ogol lagilunore ilmang'ati laainei.
Nchooki nanu matobiko tiatua olng'obor lino ntarasi! Ee, pee atum ataseriana tiabori inaipuko inono!
Amu itoning'o, Enkai, ilmuma laainei, kinchoo iyie nanu enjung'ore e lelo ooure enkarna ino.
Ntobikoi olaiguanani; metabaiki ilarin lenyena iishoritin pooki!
Meitotonieki ninye olorika le nkitoo ntarasi te dukuya Enkai; irriu enyorrata nauno o esupatisho metorripo ninye!
Naa karany enkisisa e nkarna ino anaake.
Enkai ake eanyu oltau lai te nkitirring'ata; ninye eing'uaa enjeunoto ai.
Ninye ake openy endapidapoi ai naa enjeunoto ai, ninye osempewuet lai, nemaaigusugusieki.
Ke nkata nabaa kenya imbung'ubung'u oltung'ani pee itumutumu aataar pooki te nebo, nitiuu anaa esuntai netaa keurori, anaa olpaashe letaa keurori?
Neitobir ninche pee esulaa ninye aaitadou to lorika lenye. Neshipakino ninche entorroni. Nemayian too nkutukie enye, ore tiatua iltauja lenye nedekisho.
Amu Enkai ake eanyita oltau lai te nkitirring'ata, amu atua ninye etii osiligi lai.
Ninye ake endapidapoi ai naa enjeunoto ai, ninye osempewuet lai, maaigusugusieki nanu.
Enkai etii enkordunoto ai o enkitoo ai; ninye endapidapoi ai, Enkai esarunoto ai.
Esiliga ninye nkatitin pooki lo tung'ana; entabol iltauja linyi te dukuya ninye; Enkai ninye esarunoto te iyiook.
Ore iltung'ana li abori naa enkijape ake, ore iltung'ana le nkitoo naa elejare; te nejing ninche orrantili, ore ninche pooki naa keneneng aalang enkijape.
Misilig enkitorogonyare nimipik osiligi empurrorre; te neponari karsisisho, mipik oltau lino ine.
Eiroro apa Enkai; atoning'o nanu ena katitin are, nchere Enkai eing'uaa engolon,
naa iyie sii, Olaitoriani, ina nyorrata nauno. Amu ilaaki iyie oltung'ani te risioroto e siaai enye.
Na Ai, ira iyie Enkai iyie nanu aing'oru, iyie eetayie oltau lai enkure; kaiterre nanu te yieunoto ino, atiu anaa oltung'ani otii enkop natoyio nemetii enkare.
Neaku, aaing'orua nanu iyie tiatua ine wueji ino sinyati, naing'or engolon ino o enkitoo ino.
Amu ore ina nyorrata ino nauno, naa eisidai alang enkishui, kaaisis nanu iyie te nkutuk ai.
Naa kaaisis nanu iyie anaa naishu; kailepie nanu inkaik aainei naipot enkarna ino.
Etaraposhe oltau lai te mpiron o te ilata, nikisis enkutuk ai te ng'ida,
te naadamu nanu iyie te ndapash ai, naibirribir mbaa inono airragita kewarie;
amu itaa apa iyie eretoto ai, naa tiabori oloip loo naipuko inono nanu aranyisho te ng'ida.
Iyie eigarakino oltau lai, enkaina ino e tatene naairishu nanu.
Kake ore lelo ooing'oru pee eidaikie enkishui ai, naa kedoyio aapuo olodo le nkop;
keishoori ninche aapik engolon o lalem, keaku ninche endaa oo mbariak.
Kake keng'idakino olaiguanani Enkai; ore lelo oonya olmumai te ninye neaku kituaak; amu ore nkutukie e lelo alejak naa keitigiri.
Toning'o oltoilo lai, le nkilepilep ai, iyie Enkai, tagolie enkishui ai te mbatisho e ilo mang'atinta,
isudoyioki nanu ntung'uayioki ilnukat le ilo torrono, ntung'uayioki mpuot oo laasak loo ntorrok,
lelo ooitotiu ilng'ejepa lenye anaa lalema, lelo ooing'oru irorei oopi anaa mbaa,
neng'or etii atua ilnukat ilo asipani, neng'or ninye aaluam metii enkuretisho.
Neibung ninche aakurraki nena kitobirat enye torrok, neimaki ninche pee eirragie irresheta loo nkisudorot, edamu aajo, “Aing'ae oidim atoduaa iyiook?
Kaing'ae oidim aing'oru nkitarruorot ang? Kitadamutua iyiook nikintobir olnukata te ng'eno.” Amu ore endamunoto e atua oltau le tung'ani naa kegut!
Kake keng'or Enkai ninche te mbae enye, nepiki ninche ilbaa nabo kata.
Ore te nkaraki nkirorot enye, kelo ninye aidaikie ninche; ore pooki oodol ninche neipirripir ilukuny enye.
Netum taa iltung'ana pooki aatureita; nelimu ninche ina nataasa Enkai, nedamu ina nataasa ninye.
Nchoo ilo asipani eng'ida tiatua Olaitoriani, nisaru ninye! Nchoo lelo pooki sidain iltauja menoto enchipai sapuk.
Kinchiaakino enkisisa te Sion, iyie Enkai; naa iyie einosieki ilmuma,
iyie ele oning enkomono! Enitii elotu pooki toki naishu,
te nkaraki ing'ok enye. Te neidimu iyiook nkitarruorot ang, nipalaki iyie iyiook.
Emayiana ilo litegelua iyie niyau aitinyiku, pee eton tiatua indung'orot inono! Eikindipakino iyiook te supatisho e nkaji ino, ina aji ino sinyati!
Ore too nkiaasin naaitureisho niwaliki iyie iyiook te nkordunoto, iyie, iyie Enkai Ai e njeunoto ang, iyie osiligi loo wuejitin pooki neeiting'ie enkop, o naaiposha naalakua;
laa te ngolon ino intasheyie ildoinyo, irretenita enkidimata ino.
Iyie oitirring'ie enkikurrukur oo naaiposha, ina kikurrukur oo lopir lenye, ilo oilepilepi loo ltung'ana;
neaku etureishote lelo oomanya ineelakua te nkop, te nkaraki nkitoduaat inono; nchoo iyie ineelusorie enkakenya o enteipa metabuaku te ng'ida.
Iyie omutan enkop nibukoki enkare, iyie oitubulu oleng; kebore ilo keju le Nkai enkare; iyie oisho ninche enkurma enye, amu neijia iyie intobira aiko.
Iyie opik ierat lenyena enkare, nintobir anuk ilbaat pooki, nintanana enterit te nkirujuruj, nebulu emayianata.
Inchopoko iyie olari esupatisho ino, ore pooki wueji niim netii dupoto.
Ore ndaat oo nchoo ti ong'ata neitong, ore ildoinyo nemanita eng'ida.
Ore nkong'at naaisiasha neiput nkerrai, neiput enkurma ierat, nebuaku ninche te nebo aarany te ng'ida.
Tabuaku taranyaki Enkai te ng'ida, na kop pooki;
entaranyaki enkitoo e nkarna enye; enchoo ninye enkisisa e nkitoo!
Entiaaki Enkai, “Kebaa eitureisho nkiaasin inono! Naa kitok engolon ino o metaa kepuonu ilmang'ati linono aaborru te dukuya iyie.
Iyie eserem enkop pooki; nikiranyaki iyie isinkolioitin le nkisisa, nerany enkisisa te nkaraki enkarna ino.”
Wootu entodol inaataasa Enkai: keitureisho nkiaasin enyena tiatua iltung'ana.
Keibelekeny ninye enaiposha aitaa enkop natoyio; nepuo iltung'ana aaim olkeju too nkejek. Teine iyiook kiting'idakinote ninye,
ilo oitoreisho te nkidimata enye ntarasi, ilo laa nkonyek enyena naaing'or iloshon - mincho lelo oogolong'u eisis ate.
Esisa Enkai ang, lo oreren, nchoo metoning'ori oltoilo le nkisisa enye,
ilo apa otagolie iyiook te nebo ilooishu, neitu eisho nkejek ang metarrorroto.
Amu itetema iyie iyiook, Enkai, itetema iyie iyiook anaa enkosholai, anaa enkosholai natemi.
Itipika iyie iyiook orreshet; nieniki mpolosi ang olola oiroishi;
inchoo iyie iltung'ana meitunyoi ilukuny ang; kishomo iyiook aaim atua enkima o atua enkare; kake iyaua ake iyie iyiook enkop nalala.
Kalotu nanu atua enkaji ino aata ilasarri oopejori; kaalaaki nanu iyie ilmuma laainei,
apa lairoro nanu te nkutuk ai, naisiligishore apa nanu te nkutuk ai atii enyamali.
Kaaitaiki nanu iyie olasar opejori loo ntokitin naapir, te nebo empuruo o lasar loo lkerra; kaitobir nanu olasar loo loing'ok o nkineji.
Wootu entoning intae pooki ooure Enkai, naa kalimu nanu ina naaitaasa ninye.
Aishiraka nanu ninye abuaku, neisis olng'ejep lai ninye.
Tenaa kaata apa nanu entorroni to ltau lai, anaata maaning nanu Olaitoriani.
Kake kesipa aatoning'o nanu Olaitoriani, etoning'o ninye oltoilo le nkomono ai.
Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu eitu ninye eany enkomono ai, neitu eiwuang'ie ina nyorrata enye nauno te nanu.
Meing'urrie iyiook Enkai nemayian iyiook neitawang'aki iyiook te nkomom enye,
pee etumi aatayiolo enkoitoi ino te nkop pooki, neyiolouni ina golon ino naitajeusho too loshon pooki.
Nchoo mikisisa iyie iltung'ana, na Ai; nchoo loreren pooki mikisisa iyie!
Nchoo meting'idata iloshon nerany te ng'ida, amu inguanare iyie te nkaraki entorroni nirikoo iloshon ootii oriong enkop.
Nchoo loreren mikisisa iyie, na Ai, nchoo loreren pooki mikisisa iyie!
Etoponayie enkop ilng'anayio lenyena; Ore Enkai, Enkai ang etamayiana iyiook.
Etamayiana iyiook Enkai; nchoo ineeiting'ie enkop pooki metureita ninye!
Nchoo Enkai metudumunye, nchoo meidapashata ilmang'ati lenyena; nchoo lelo ooiba ninye meisika te dukuya ninye.
Ore anaa enakutari empuruo tukutai ninche, nkuna neijia; anaa enashola enkapoi te nkima nchoo ilarruok meidaai te dukuya Enkai.
Kake nchoo lelo supati meting'idata; nchoo ninche meting'idata te dukuya Enkai; nchoo ninche metishipata oleng!
Entaranyaki Olaitoriani, entarany enkisisa e nkarna enye; elepie osinkolio entaranyaki ninye, ilo olo te shumata nkatampo; ore enkarna enye naa Olaitoriani, enting'idata te dukuya ninye!
Menye le lelo okishin, naa olamitunoni loo nkolia, Enkai teine wueji enye sinyati.
Enkai naisho ilo lemeeta ang ewueji nemany, nerikoo lelo ooena metudupoto; kake ore lelo maisero netoni te nkop natoyio.
Iyie Enkai, ore apa pee ilo arikoo iltung'ana linono, ore apa pee ilo iyie aim olpurkel,
neikirikira enkop, neshau shumata enkare, teine netii Enkai; eikirikire oldoinyo le Sinai te dukuya Enkai, ina Ai e Israel.
Irriwua iyie enchan kitok, Enkai, nintagol enjung'ore ino enaurate;
netum inkerra inono emanyisho tiatua ninye; te supatisho ino, na Ai, intoti iyie ilaisinak.
Eishorua Olaitoriani enkitanapata; eikitok olorora le lelo oonap ilomon supati:
“Ore ilaiguanak loo njorin, neilanyisho aaisik!” Ore nkituaak naaing'uari ti ang neor nena yarunot
ore hoo neirrag ninche tiatua imuatat, eikununo inaipuko enye anaa ine nturkuluo naamura te nkosholai, ore nkopir enye neiyia anaa saabu nanyori.
Ore te neidapash olmagilani lelo aiguanak, nedoiki empaso Salmon.
Lo doinyo le Nkai, lo doinyo le Bashan; lo doinyo loo mowuarak kumok, lo doinyo le Bashan!
Kainyoo iyie pee ing'or to lom, lo doinyo loo rruka kumok, ilo doinyo oyieu Enkai neitaa emanyisho enye, ee, ine nelo Olaitoriani abikie ntarasi?
Too ngarrin oo mbartan magil, nkalifuni tomon katitin are, nkalifuni o nkalifuni, apa eeunye Olaitoriani eing'uaa Sinai, nelotu atua ine wueji sinyati.
Ilepa iyie alo shumata oleng, nirik lelo yarunot araya, ning'amaa nkishoorot too ltung'ana, ning'amaa sii ine lelo torrok, pee etum Olaitoriani Enkai atobiko teine.
Meisisi Olaitoriani, laa ninye onap iyiook anaake; Enkai ninye enjeunoto ang.
Enkai ang ninye Enkai e njeunoto; naa eno Laitoriani, Enkai, enkordunoto te keeya.
Kepurd Enkai ilukuny oo lmang'ati lenyena, o enkopiyia naju e nkitoo e ilo olo too nkoitoi enyena torrok.
Etejo Olaitoriani, “Karrinyu nanu ninche aitung'uaa Bashan, Karrinyu nanu ninche aitung'uaa ineegut e naiposha,
pee itum iyie aitukuo nkejek inono to sarge, ore ilng'ejepa loo ldiein linono netum erubata enye te lelo mang'ati.”
Kelioo ilotot inono, iyie Enkai, nena gilakinot e Nkai ai, Olaiguanani lai, elo atua ewueji sinyati -
etii ilaranyak dukuya, netii ilaoshok loo ntampurini siadi, ore erishata enye netii ntoyie naakut ndulen:
“Meisisi Olaitoriani tiatua eumata kitok, ee, iyie, Olaitoriani, amu iyie entalipa e Israel!”
Etii Benchamen, ilo oti te ninye, dukuya, netii lelo kituaak le Yuda iwuejitin enye, o lelo kituaak le Sebulon o lelo le Naftali.
Iyie Enkai, mpotu enkidimata ino; ntodolu engolon ino, iyie Enkai, amu iyie apa oitaasa iyiook ene nking'asia.
Te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai te Yerusalem, teine kiyaki iyie ilaiguanak nkishoorot.

Tabuaaki iyie nena ng'uesi naatii atua enarau, o ina luaata oo loing'ok natii te nebo ilasho le tung'ana. Nkirikirie tiabori nkejek inono lelo oong'uar kodi; ndapasha lelo oreren ooshipakino olarrabal.
Nchoo meyauni osuyai te Misiri; nchoo Etiopia metasioki aitorioki Enkai nkaik enyena.
Entaranyaki Enkai na kitoriat pooki e nkop; entaranyaki Olaitoriani enkisisa,
ninye ilo okedito nkatampo te keper, ina keper e apa moitie; ng'ura, neirriu ninye oltoilo lenye, ilo toilo lenye magilani.
Embalunye engolon e Nkai, ilo otii enkidimata enye shumata Israel, netii engolon enye atua nkatampo.
Keitureisho Enkai tiatua ine wueji enye sinyati, ina Ai e Israel, neisho ninye engolon o enkidimata iltung'ana lenyena.
Ntajewuoki nanu, iyie Enkai! Amu aatabaikitia nkariak emurt.
Aimiso nanu tiatua esarng'ab teine nemetii ewueji napik enkeju; atijing'a nanu nkariak naagut, naaya nanu oloirrag le nkare.
Anaure nanu te nkishirata ai; aatirridate ilgoso. Neiliilaitie inkonyek aainei, aanyita Enkai ai.

Eikumok aalang ilpapit le ndukuya ai lelo laaiba nanu pesho metii emporeet; eimagil lelo laaidim nanu aaidaikie, lelo laarasaki nanu te lejare. Amaa, ina neitu nanu apurroo, kaaitalaki nanu matorrinyo taata?
Iyie Enkai, iyiolo iyie emodai ai; ore ntorrok nataasa, meisudoro te iyie.
Mincho lelo likisilig iyie meitukurruni te nkaraki nanu, Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani; mincho lelo liking'oru iyie etum enkurruna te nkaraki nanu, iyie Enkai e Israel.
Amu te nkaraki iyie pee anoto esulare, neiputa enkurruna enkomom ai.
Atotiwuo nanu anaa oltung'ani omoni too lalashera laainei, naaku ole boo too nkera e yieyio.
Amu aainosa nanu olom te nkaraki enkaji ino, ore nena sukenyat e lelo likisukeny iyie, naatadoikitio nanu.
Te naitobor nanu oltau lai te mpukoroto, neaku ina enkurruna.
Te naitaa nanu ilkuniyiani nkilani aainei, naaku nanu entoki naimakini te ninche.
Etaa nanu ederrie lelo ootoni te kishomi, netaa nanu eokore ilamerak.
Kake ore nanu, naa iyie airriwaki enkomono ai, Olaitoriani. Ore te nkata nang'amaroyu, iyie Enkai, tang'amayioki nanu teina nyorrata ino nauno.
Teina retoto ino naisiligunoyu tokorduaki nanu maimis tiatua esarng'ab; nchooki nanu manoto enkordunoto too lmang'ati laainei, o too nkariak naagut.
Mikincho nanu maawa oloirrag le nkare, anaa aaijoo nanu ina guton, anaa aagamaa engumoto.
Tawalikiaki nanu, Olaitoriani, amu ore ina nyorrata ino nauno naa eisidai; ore te risioroto o lng'ur lino, mbelekenyunye enatii nanu.
Misudoo enkomom ino to sinka lino; amu atii nanu atua osina, tasioki tawalikiaki nanu.
Tataanikiaki nanu, tokorduaki nanu, talakuaki nanu, te nkaraki ilmang'ati laainei!
Iyiolo iyie esulare ai, o esulare ai o enkurruna ai; iyiolo iyie ilmang'ati laainei pooki.
Etigila imorot oltau lai, neaku atapalari nanu, naing'oru olaaing'urrie, kake metii obo; naing'oru olaaitagol oshoke, kake eito nanu atum obo.
Aaishoo ninche esayiet aaitaa endaa, ore aata enkure naaisho ninche siki.
Nchoo emisa enye te dukuya ninche metaa orreshet; nchoo lelo siruai lenye loo lasarri metaa entoki narruesh ninche.
Nchoo meitamodoki nkonyek enye pee medolisho; neikirikira mpolosi enye anaake.
Tubukoki engoro ino shumata ninche, nincho ina goro ino nayupuyup metumurutu ninche.
Metomijoono enkang enye, metaa metumi aekata olojing ilng'oborri lenye.
Amu keisilisil ninche ilo litoosho, o ilo litipika iyie olbae, neponiki ninche ninye emion oleng.
Toponiki ninche nkitamiot te shumata nkitamiot; metaa metum aekata ninche elaaroto te iyie.
Nchoo metujuti nkarn enye aaiwuang'ie tiatua embuku oo looishu; nchoo metaa meigeri ninche te nebo lelo supati.
Kake aata nanu osina naata emion; nchoo enjeunoto ino, iyie Enkai maatudumu nanu ailepunye!
Kaisis nanu enkarna e Nkai to sinkolio; narrep nanu ninye te nkishooroto e nashe.
Keitiship ena Olaitoriani alang olkiteng anaa oloing'oni loo mowuarak neeta loisotok.
Nchoo ilo oitorogonyaki metoduaa ena neng'idayu, ore intae lelo ooing'oru Enkai, enchoo epiu iltauja linyi.
Amu kening Olaitoriani ilo oata enyamali nemerikino lelo lenyena ooena.
Nchoo shumata o enkop meisisa ninye, o enaiposha o pooki toki naatii atua.
Amu keitajeu Enkai Sion, neigil ashetu nkanas e Yuda; nepuo isinkan lenyena aamany ine, neya ine;
ore nena kera oo sinkan lenyena naa kejung ine, ore lelo oonyor enkarna enye nepuo aamany ine.
Tonyorrai iyie Enkai, tokorduaki nanu! Olaitoriani, tasioki taretuoki nanu!
Nchoo metukurru nemilo lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai! Nchoo meibelekenyi ninche nesuli, lelo ooyieu naainyal!
Nchoo meing'asiata ninche te nkaraki enkurruna enye, lelo oojo, “Alda, Alda!”
Nchoo lelo pooki liking'oru iyie meting'idata neshipa tiatua iyie! Nchoo lelo pooki oonyor enjeunoto ino metejo ntarasi, “Eikitok Enkai!”
Kake kara nanu aisinani namena; tasieku enatii, iyie Enkai! Iyie eretoto ai naa iyie likikordu; Olaitoriani, mimutie!
Iyie nanu asaru, Olaitoriani; mikincho aekata nanu maaitukurruni!
Ore te supatisho ino tokorduaki nanu nikintajeu; irrugokoki enkiok ino, nikintajeu nanu!
Taa iyie te nanu endapidapoi e sarunoto, osempewuet ogol laaitajeu nanu, amu ira iyie endapidapoi ai nira osempewuet lai.
Tokorduaki nanu na Ai ai te nkaina e ilo torrono, te nkibung'ata e ilo ogogong.
Amu ore iyie Olaitoriani, ira osiligi lai, iyie enkisiligata ai, Olaitoriani, ebaiki kitisho ai.
Iyie nanu aisiliga ebaiki apa pee aaini, iyie apa likintayio nanu te nkoshoke e yieyio. Iyie nanu aisis anaake.
Atotiwuo nanu anaa enking'asia too lkumok, kake ira iyie esarunoto ai nagol.
Eiputa enkutuk ai enkisisa ino, o enkitoo ino endama pooki.
Mikinturraa nanu te nkata e moruao; mikinturaa nanu te neishunye engolon ai.
Amu nanu eimaki ilmang'ati laainei, ore lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai neiguana te nebo,
nejo ninche, “Eiturrayie Enkai ninye; enepu embung'a ninye, amu meetae olokordu ninye.”
Na Ai ai, mikilam iyie nanu; iyie Enkai, tasioki taretuoki nanu!
Nchoo meitukurruni lelo aitang'orok laainei nemuti; meitoipo ninche enkurruna o esulare, lelo ooing'oru pee aainyal.
Kake kaaisilig nanu iyie anaake, naa kaaisis kenya o kenya.
Neibalunye enkutuk ai nena kiaasin inono supati, nena kiaasin inono e njeunoto endama pooki, amu etogiroitie esiana enye eng'eno ai.
Too nkiasin magil o Laitoriani Enkai nanu alotu, naa kaaisis nanu esupatisho ino, esupatisho ino ake.
Na Ai, ore ebaiki kitisho ai kinteng'ena iyie nanu, neton ake aibalunye nkiasin inono e nking'asia.
Neaku, ore ninye te moruao o te naaiborru endukuya, na Ai, mikinturraa nanu, o metaba anaa naibalunye enkidimata ino, too ishoritin pooki naapuonu.
Ore engolon ino o esupatisho ino, na Ai, nebaiki shumata. Iyie otaasa mbaa sapuki, na Ai, kaing'ae likinyaanyukie?
Iyie likintoduaa nanu isinaitin kumok, iyie likintopiu nanu; ore te nguton e nkop naa eikilepunye iyie.
Iponaa iyie enkanyit ai, nikintoki nanu aitagol oshoke.
Kaaigil nanu aisis iyie te nkawuo oo sinkolioitin te nkaraki esupatisho ino, na Ai ai, kaaranyaki nanu arrep to lwulul loo usin, iyie Lo Sinyati le Israel.
Kabuaku te nkutuk ai te ng'ida, te naaranyaki nanu isinkolioitin le nkisisa, neng'idayu sii oltau lai, ilo apa litokordua.
Neimaki olng'ejep lai ina retoto ino e supatisho, endama pooki, amu eitukurruaki ninche nesuli, lelo apa ooing'oru pee aainyal.
Nchoo olaiguanani esipata ino, na Ai, nincho esupatisho ino ilo le nkaji e nkitoo!
Nchoo ninye meiguanaki iltung'ana linono te supatisho, neiguanaki lelo aisinak te sipata!
Nchoo enkop meitumurru dupoto, neyau ndoinyo esupatisho!
Metomitu ninye ewalata e lelo aisinak le tung'ani, nchoo enkordunoto lelo oomena, nirrar ilo oitorogonyisho!
Metobikoi ninye anaa enkolong, metobikoi ninye nkolong'i nabaa anaa ino lapa, tiatua iishoritin pooki.
Metotiwuo ninye anaa enchan nashaiki nkujit naatudung'oki, netiu anaa enkoirujuruji naitipitipaki enkop.
Meibulai esupatisho too nkolong'i enyena, metuunoyu eseriani nkolong'i naabaa anaa inaabik olapa.
Meitoria ninye ebaiki enaiposha o metabaiki enkae aiposha, neitoreisho ebaiki Olkeju le Frati o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop!
Meirrugoto ilmang'ati lenyena te dukuya ninye, metamejo ilmang'ati lenyena enterit!
Meitaiki ilaiguanak le Tarshishi o lelo loo lepolosi ninye nkishoorot, nchoo meyau ilaiguanak le Sheba o Seba nkishoorot!
Metabatatata ilaiguanak pooki te dukuya ninye, nchoo meisiaaiyia iloshon pooki ninye.
Amu kekordu ninye ilo onyamal te neishiraki, neretu ilo aisinani o ilo lemeeta olaretoni.
Keing'urrie ninye ilo oshal nemena, neitajeu enkishui e lelo oonyamal.
Kekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkitorogonyata o entorroni; naa eikirotet osarge lenye too nkonyek enyena.
Metobikoi ninye eishu, nchoo meyakini ninye saabu e Sheba! Nchoo metoomonokini ninye anaake, meetu imayianat shumata ninye nkatitin pooki!
Meiputa endaa enkop; nchoo meipiripiro ninye te nchumata oldoinyo; metotiutu ilng'anayio lenyena anaa Lebanon; naa nchoo ebul iltung'ana too nkanas aabayu anaa nkujit e ong'ata.
Metobikoi enkarna enye ntarasi, metaa ning'oti enkarna enye anaa enkolong! Nchoo metamayiana iltung'ana ate te ninye, neipot iloshon pooki ninye aajo olomayiana!
Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, laa ninye ake oas mbaa e nking'asia.
Meisisi ina arna enye nabore olng'ur ntarasi; meiputa enkitoo enye enkop pooki! Eesai, Eesai!
Ena enkiting'oto e nkomono e Daudi, olayioni le Yese.
Kesipa aisupat Enkai te ilo oitoriori nkoitoi enyena, te lelo sidain iltauja.
Kake ore tialo nanu eyieu errorro nkejek aainei, eyieu eideketari nkejek aainei.
Amu kaata nanu olom te lelo ooitokoos, ina kata pee adol nanu dupoto e lelo arruok.
Amu meeta ninche emion, negol naa sidain iseseni lenye.
Meeta ninche enyamali anaa enaata iltung'ana, nemeitamei ninche anaa ilkulikae tung'ana.
Ore te nkaraki ina, olwuasa ninye osaei lenye le murt, olarrabal oimulumul ninche anaa olkila.
Kebuku iltauja lenye intorrok, netulusoitie mbaa enye aalang iltauja lenye.
Neikordodisho ninche, neiro mbaa torrok; ore te nkitokoos neiro mbaa naaitorogonyie ilkulikae.
Nebol ninche nkutukie enye aaing'orie shumata, neidapashaki ilng'ejepa lenye enkop.
Ore te nkaraki ina neibelekenya iltung'ana aaisis ninche; nemetumie ninche entioto.
Nejo ninche, “Kaji eiko Enkai te neyiolou? Keeta eng'eno Ilo otii Shumata Aisul?”
Ng'ura ajo iltung'ana torrok kulo; neisikarra ninche anaake, neponari ninche te karsisisho.
Pesho ake nanu aitisinya oltau lai, naituku inkaik aainei te sinyatisho.
Amu ore endama pooki naatooshoki nanu, naaitamei nkakeny pooki.
Naa te najo nanu, “Kalimu kuna,” anaata maaku asipani te ishoi oo nkera aainei.
Naa te nadamu nanu ajo ayiolou kuna, naa enyamali te nanu.
Ore ake pee alo atua ewueji sinyati e Nkai, namusu taa enkiting'oto enye.
Esipa itipika iyie ninche iwuejitin neeideket; nchoo iyie ninche metabatatata aaidaaya.
Kaji eikunakaki ninche enkidaaroto nabo kata, eishieki ninche tukul te nkiputukuny.
Etiu ninche anaa enkidetidet te neinyototo oltung'ani, te nidumunye iyie, Olaitoriani, niwuang'ie ina golon enye.
Te netum oltau lai emion, te neitagori oltau lai,
naa kamoda apa nanu mayiolo toki, natiu apa nanu anaa eng'ues tialo iyie.
Ore ake eyia natii nanu te nebo iyie; kimbung'a iyie enkaina ai e tatene.
Iyie likitorikoyie nanu te nkiguana ino, ore te siadi niking'amaa nanu te nkitoo ino.
Kaing'ae nanu aata te keper leme iyie? Nemetii ai toki natii oriong enkop nang'uar nanu naadutie.
Keidim inkiri o sesen lai o ltau lai aaishunye, kake Enkai engolon o ltau lai naa erubata ai ntarasi.
Ore lelo likilamita iyie naa keidaaya; inting'ie iyie lelo arruok tialo iyie.
Kake ore nanu eisidai te nataaniki Enkai; aitaa nanu Olaitoriani Enkai esarunoto ai, pee atum atolimu isiaaitin inono pooki.
Na Ai, kainyoo iyie pee inturraa iyiook ntarasi? Kainyoo pee epuru engoro ino too ntare e luaata ino?
Tadamu olturrur lino apa litegelaka kewan moitie, ilo apa litokordua pee eaku enjung'ore ino! Tadamu oldoinyo le Sion apa litobikie.
Ntorioki iroruat inono iwuejitin neeidaaitie; einyala olmang'atinta pooki toki te wueji ino sinyati!
Eikurrukurro ilmang'ati linono te mpolos e ine wueji sinyati; neun ninche inankan enye pee eaku olmonekie lenye le nkisulata.
Ore te njing'et e shumata nedung'udung ninche nkeenta too ntoluo.
Ore nena keek naagueta negiligil too nyuntui.
Nepejoo ninche ine wueji ino sinyati, nepik olduruk ine wueji ino sinyati o metabaiki enkop.
Nejo ninche maate, “Eikimut iyiook ninche katukul;” etapejoitie ninche iwuejitin pooki e Nkai neetumoreki tiatua ena kop.
Meekure iyiook kiaata ilmonek lang, meekure eetae oloiboni hoo obo, nemeetae hoo obo tiatua iyiook oyiolo ajo ke nkata nabaa.
Ke nkata nabaa, Olaitoriani, eikoroj iyiook olmang'atinta? Kesukeny olmang'atinta enkarna ino ntarasi?
Kainyoo iyie pee inunuk enkaina ino, kainyoo iyie pee ipik enkaina ino olgoo?
Ore eyia, Enkai Olaitoriani lai aiteru apake, neitobir ninye enjeunoto te mpolos e nkop.
Iyie otooro enaiposha te nkidimata ino; itadanya iyie endukuya o lasurai tiatua nkariak.
Itupurda iyie ilukuny e Lefiatan, nincho iyie ninye ing'uesi e ntim meitaa endaa.
Iyie oipirua nkonyek oo nkariak o erat; iyie oitoyio nkonyek oo nkariak naaruko.
Enino endama naa enino enkewarie; iyie oitobira ewang'an o enkolong.
Iyie otipika ilpolosien pooki le nkop; iyie oitobira enkata e nkirowuaj o enkata e nkirobi.
Tadamu ena, Olaitoriani, ng'ura olmang'atinta eikorojisho, ore iltung'ana oomoda nesukeny enkarna ino.
Minchooyo oltau le ina turkuluo ino aisho ing'uesi e ntim; mincho kirikino enkishui e ilo tung'ani lino aisinani ntarasi.
Tishilai olning'o lino; amu ore iwuejitin neemisimis e nkop nebore imanyishoritin e nkarruoisho.
Mincho ilo oitorogonyaki meitukurruni, nchoo ilo aisinani omena meisisa enkarna ino.
Tudumunye, Na Ai, tomitu kewan; tadamu ena nikinkordod ilo omoda endama pooki!
Mincho kirikino oltoilo loo lmang'ati linono, ilo odoo loo nchankarri oilep anaake.
Kincho iyiook iyie enashe, Enkai, kinchoru enashe; kimpot iyiook enkarna ino nikinken nkiaasin inono e nking'asia.
Ore teina kata nategeluaki, naa kaiguana nanu too sipat.
Te neikirikira enkop o lelo pooki oomanya, nanu ilo oitasheyie ing'apeta enyena.
Atiaaka nanu ilo owuasa, “Mintoki awuasa,” najoki ilo torrono, “Tapala olwuasa;
Miwuasayu iyie, anaa iro imolesh emurt.”
Amu mme oloo saen, neme oloo ntoluo, neme ong'ata enkilepata;
kake Enkai naiguana te sipata; neitadou obo neilepunye olikae.
Amu enkaina o Laitoriani etii enkikompe, etii enaisho naitokitok naing'oling'olaki aaitobiraki, nepiku ninye, neok lelo aarruok pooki.
Kake kang'ida nanu ntarasi, karanyaki enkisisa e Nkai e Yakobo.
Ore nena mowuarak pooki e ilo torrono naa kedung'oo ninye, ore mowuarak e ilo supat naa keilepieki.
Keyioloi Enkai tiatua Yuda, eikitok enkarna enye tiatua Israel.
Neteshetaki emanyisho enye te Salem, ewueji enye nebikie te Sion.
Teine wueji etigila ninye mbaa, o elong'o o lalem o masaa o larrabal.
Ira iyie kitok, niata enkishiaa, alang lelo doinyo loo ntarasi.
Ore lelo lenye oogol tauja, netooruoki pooki naata, neirragaitie ninche aaye; ore lelo tung'ana pooki lo larrabal, meidim aataasishore inkaik enye.
Ore te nkisikong'ata ino, Na Ai e Yakobo, neirrag aaye pokira, olakedoni o embarta.
Kake, ore iyie, naa intoreisho, kaing'ae oidim aitasho te dukuya iyie te nedumunye engoro ino nabo kata.
Ore itii keper nidung enkiguana ino, neureishoyu enkop neitirring'a,
ena kata edumunye Enkai aitobir enkiguana, pee eitajeu lelo pooki ooitorogonyaki te nkop.
Kesipa eikisis iyie engoro e tung'ani; ore ilo pisiai le ngoro nien anaa enkeene e mpolos.
Entobira ilmuma linyi to Laitoriani Enkai inyi, nintabayaya ninche; nchoo lelo pooki oomanita ninche meyau nkishoorot aayaki ilo ourei,
naa kedung ninye iltauja le lelo kituaak, ilo laa ninye eure ilaiguanak pooki le nkop.
Aishiraka nanu Olaitoriani te mbuakunoto nabuaaki Enkai pee aatum atoning'o nanu.
Ore te nkolong e ngolikinoto ai, naing'oru nanu Olaitoriani; ore teina kewarie neitoriori enkaina ai menauru, neany oltau lai eitigiri.
Kadamu nanu Enkai, naisina; naibirribir naiminie osiligi.
Iyie obol inkonyek aainei pee meikeno; atanyamala nanu neaku maidim airoro.
Atadamua nanu nkolong'i e apa, nadamu ilarin liapa moitie.
Naibirribir to ltau lai kewarie: nalimana adamisho to ltau lai.
“Amaa, keiturraa iyiook Olaitoriani ntarasi, nemeitoki aata esupatisho katukul?
Keishunye enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi? Keeuo enkiting'oto oo nkisiligat enyena nkatitin pooki?
Ketorikine Olaitoriani olng'ur? Keibooyie ninye olng'ur lenye te ngoro enye?”
Najo nanu, “Osina lai ele, ore enkaina e tatene e Ilo otii Shumata Aisul neibelekenye.”
Kapik nanu ndamunot aainei nena kiaasin e nking'asia o Laitoriani; ee, kadamu nanu nena apa e nking'asia nitaasa.
Kadamu nanu isiaaitin inono pooki, naing'asia te nena kiasin magil.
Kesinya enkoitoi ino, Olaitoriani, kaa ai kitok anaa Enkai ang?
Iyie Enkai naas ine nking'asia, naa iyie oibalunye emagilanisho ino tiatua iloreren.
Iyie otokordua iltung'ana te nkaina ino, lelo ayiok le Yakobo o Yosef.
Ore ake pee kidol iyie nkariak, Olaitoriani, ore ake pee kidol iyie nkariak, neureishoyu ninche, ee, neikirikira enguton.
Nebuku nkatampo enkare; neitayu oloing'ang'e enkikurrukur; neimerlel mbaa inono te pooki shoto.
Etii oltoilo le ndarata ino atua oleimua; ore nkiwuang'at inono neitawang enkop; neikirikira enkop, neigirigiro.
Netii apa enkoitoi ino atua enaiposha, neim enkoitoi ino atua inkariak kumok; nemelioo sii iroruat inono.
Iyie otorikoyie iltung'ana linono anaa eluaata oo ntare, te nkaina e Musa o Aron.
Entuun inkiyiaa lo tung'ana laainei te nkiteng'enare ai; entuun inkiyiaa inyi too rorei le nkutuk ai!
Kabol nanu enkutuk ai te nkitanyaanyukoto, nalimu nkirorot musan e apa,
ntokitin apa nikitoning'o nikiyiolou, nena apa naatolikitio iyiook loo papa.
Mikisudorie iyiook inkera enye, kake eikiliki iishoritin naapuonu, nena kiasin kituaak o Laitoriani o enkidimata enye, o nena e nking'asia apa naataasa ninye.
Eteshetua ninye shakenisho tiatua Yakobo, negelu enkitanapata tiatua Israel, ina apa naitanapa loo papa pee eiteng'en inkera enye;
pee etum eishoi nasuju aaitayiolo ninche nena kera neton meino, nedumunye ninche aaliki inkera enye,
pee etum ninche aatipik osiligi lenye Enkai, nemerikino isiaaitin e Nkai, kake pee eibung nkitanapat enyena;
nemetiu sii anaa loo menye, ilo porror apa ogolong'u torrono, ilo porror apa lemeuno iltauja lenye, ore enkishui enye meisiligayu te Nkai.
Ore lelo le Efraim ootanapate too nkai, neibelekenya te nkolong o larrabal.
Eitu ninche eibung olning'o le Nkai, kake etanyaita epuo te risioroto e nkitanapata enye.
Nerikino ninche ina nataasa ninye, o ina apa e nking'asia naitoduaa ninye ninche.
Ore apa too nkonyek oo loo menye neas ninye enenking'asia, tiatua enkop e Misiri, ti ong'ata e Sion.
Etooro ninye enaiposha neisho ninche meima atua, neisho enkare meturupayu anaa olkiu.
Ore dama nerikoo ninye ninche te nkatampoi, naa ore kewarie pooki nerikoo ninche te wang'an kitok.
Neiper ninye ndapidapo to lpurkel, neisho ninche metooko enkare sapuk naba anaa eno lchorro.
Neisho ninye nchorroi oo nkariak metupuku te ndapidapoi, neisho enkare meturukoyu anaa olkeju.
Ore ake eyia, netaasa ninche ing'ok oleng tialo Olaitoriani, negolong'aki apa ninche Ilo otii Shumata Aisul to lpurkel.
Netem ninche Enkai too ltauja lenye, eikilikuanu endaa too ng'uarrat enye.
Neiro ninche entorroni tialo Enkai, ejo, “Keidim Enkai aisalaashaki iyiook emisa tene tiong'ota.
Etoosho ninye endapidapoi nerukunye enkare, neruko ilkejek aadooyo. Keidim sii ninye aishoru imukateni, anaa eisho iltung'ana lenyena inkiri?”
Ore te nkaraki etoning'o ake Olaitoriani ina neiput engoro; neyupuyupieki engoro metigilunore Yakobo, neitashe engoro enye te shumata Israel;
te nkaraki nemeeta ninche enkirukoto te Nkai, neitu eisilig ina golon enye naitajeusho.
Ore ake eyia eitanapa ninye nkatampo te shumata, nebol ildirishani le keper;
neitashaiki ninye ninche mana pee enya, neisho ninche enkurma e shumata.
Nenya iltung'ana endaa oo lmalaika, neirriwaki Enkai ninche endaa te nkumoi.
Eishoo ninye olkutati lo loosaen metukutu te keper, ore te ngolon enye nerikoo osiwuo le kopikop;
neshau inkiri te shumata ninche anaa enterit, motonyi naata naipuko naaba anaa osinyai loo naaiposha;
neisho ninye ninche metadoiki empolos oo lng'oborri lenye, te manaroto pooki e manyisho enye.
Nenya ninche neraposho oleng, amu eishoo ninye ninche ina natang'uarra.
Kake ore eton eitu eisho ninche ing'uarrat enye, eton etii ina daa nkutukie enye,
nedumakino engoro o Laitoriani ninche, near ninye metuata lelo lenye oogol aaisul, neirragarie lelo gelunot le Israel.
Ore ake etii kuna pooki neton ake eas ninche ing'ok; ore hoo netii nena baa enyena e nking'asia eitu ninche eiruk.
Ore te nkaraki ina neishie ninye nkolong'i enye anaa enkiyang'et, neishie ilarin lenye te nkuretisho.
Ore ake pee ear ninye ninche metuata, neing'oru ninche ninye; neirridu ninche neing'oru Enkai oleng.
Nedamu ninche aajo Enkai endapidapoi enye Enkai natii shumata aisul olalakunoni lenye.
Kake eikordodaitie ninche ninye too nkutukie enye, nelej ninche ninye too lng'ejepa lenye.
Meuno iltauja lenye te ninye, medede ninche to lning'o lenye.
Kake ore eyia te nkaraki olng'ur lenye, etapalaka nkitarruorot enye, neitu ninye eidaikie ninche; neibooyo ninye engoro enye nkatitin pooki, neitu ninye eputu engoro enye pooki.
Nedamu ninye ajo iseseni ake ninche, enkijape naloito nemeigil arrinyunye.
Ae katitin aja apa etogolong'akita ninche ninye ti ong'ata, neitagor ninye to lpurkel!
Etetema ninche ninye aaigiligil, neitagor ninche Ilo Sinyati le Israel.
Eitu ninche epik ndamunot enye engolon enye, neitu edamu ina olong apa naitajeuo ninye ninche too lmang'ati lenye;
ina kata apa pee eas ninye nkitoduaat enyena te Misiri, o mbaa enyena e nking'asia naataasa ti ong'ata e Sion.
Eibelekenya ninye ilkejek loo lmisisiri aitaa osarge, pee meitoki ninche aaok nena Shorroi enye.
Neirriwaki ninye ninche emus oo lojong'a ooinosa ninche, o ntuaan naa ninche naaidaikie ninche.
Eishoo ninye endaa enye meinosa olkurto, neisho ilng'anayio le siaai enye meinosa olmaati.
Neinyal ninye isabibu lenye te nchan oo soito, near iretet lenye te nkirobi.
Neisho nkishu enye metaara enchan oo soito, near inkerrai enye endarata.
Neitadoiki ninye ninche ina pijan e ngoro enye, o engoro o empushuna o sina, te nebo entukus oo lmalaika ooidaikie ninche.
Neitobir ninye enkoitoi te nkaraki engoro enye; eitu ninye emitiki ninche metuata, kake eishoo ninye enkishui enye olmeitai.
Near ninye metuata lelo kikaunot pooki le Misiri, lelo ng'anayio lenye le dukuya tiatua olng'obor le Haam.
Neitoki arikoo iltung'ana lenyena anaa nkerra, nerikoo ninche ti ong'ata anaa eluaata oo ntare.
Nerikoo ninye ninche te seriani, pee meureishoyu; kake eimisie enaiposha ilmang'ati lenye.
Neriku ninye ninche atua ina kop sinyati, enetii ilo doinyo oisulie ninye te nkaina enye e tatene.
Nearaa ninye iloshon te dukuya ninche, neoriki ina kop enye iltung'ana lenyena neitamany iloshon le Israel ilng'oborri lenye.
Kake ore eyia, etetemishote ninche, negolong'aki ilo otii Shumata Aisul, neitu eshilaa shakenisho enye,
kake eibelekenyate ninche neas mbususi anaa apa loo menye; nemerregela ninche anaa enkawuo torrono.
Amu eitagoro ninche ninye te nena wuejitin enye neeika; nepik ninche ninye olom te nena kitanyaanyukot enye naaguetuno.
Ore ake pee ening Enkai ina, neiput ninye engoro, neany ninye tukul Israel.
Neing'uaa ninye emanyisho enye te Shilo, ilo ng'obor apa otii ninye tiatua iltung'ana,
neya ninye engolon enye atua eyararoto, neya enkitoo enye atua enkop oo lmang'ati.
Neishooyo ninye iltung'ana lenyena metaari to lalem, nepik ninye engoro enye shumata ina jung'ore enye.
Nenya enkima ilbarnot lenye, ore ntoyie enye, nelau kiyama.
Ore lapolosak lenye nebatata too lalema, ore nena olia enye nemeishir.
Neitoki Olaitoriani adumunye anaa oltung'ani oirura, anaa oltung'ani ogol te nebuaku etemere.
Neosh ilmang'ati lenyena arriny siadi; nepik ninche enkurruna oo ntarasi.
Etanya ninye olng'obor le Yosef, eitu ninye egelu olosho le Efraim;
kake etegelua olosho le Yuda, o ilo doinyo le Sion otonyorra ninye.
Neshet ninye ina aji enye sinyati anaa keper, neitotiu anaa ewueji neitobiraki ntarasi.
Etegelua ninye Daudi osinka lenye, neya ninye aitung'uaa eluaata oo ntare;
neitung'uaa ninye eramatata e lelo kuoo apa oonakita ooyakaki ninye, pee atum ataa olchekut le Yakobo lelo tung'ana lenyena, o Israel ina jung'ore enye.
Ore te mborron o ltau lenye neramat ninye ninche, nerikoo ninche te nkaina e nkarriyiano.
Na Ai, eetuo lelo limikiyiolo aajing atua enjung'ore ino; etipika ninche olminong atua enkaji ino sinyati; eitaa ninche Yerusalem olmuaate.
Eishoo ninche mpopoki oo seseni loo sinkan linono, ilmotonyi lo loing'ang'e meitaa endaa, ore lelo sinyat linono nenya ing'uesi e nkop nkiri oo seseni lenye.
Eibukoitie isargeta lenye anaa enkare te manaroto pooki e Yerusalem, nemeetae hoo obo onukaa ninche.
Kitaa iyiook entoki nailapi te lelo le latia ang, nesukenyi neikuyukuyaki lelo oomanita iyiook.
Ke nkata nabaa Olaitoriani? Igoro iyie ntarasi? Keyupuyup ina goro o lom lino anaa enkima?
Tubukoki engoro ino lelo oshon limikiyiolo iyie, o shumata nena kitoriat nemeipot enkarna ino!
Amu eidaikie ninche Yakobo, neitomijoon emanyisho enye.
Midamu te iyiook entorroni oo loo papa; nchoo olng'ur lino metasieku anang'are iyiook, amu eitadouoki iyiook oleng.
Taretu iyiook, Na Ai e njeunoto ang, te nkaraki enkitoo e nkarna ino; tokordu iyiook, nipalaki iyiook ing'ok ang, te nkaraki enkarna ino!
Kainyoo pee ejo iloshon, “Koree Enkai enye?” Nchoo ina lap, apa enkibukoroto o sarge loo sinkan linono metayiolouni too loshon pooki te dukuya nkonyek ang!
Nchoo ilo kiyioi le lelo ooena meeu dukuya iyie; ore te risioroto e ngolon ino kitok tagolie lelo ootudung'okoki keeya!
Ntalaa katitin naapishana lelo le latia ang too lgooitie lenye nena kilapat apa nikilapa ninche iyie, Olaitoriani!
Ore taa iyiook iltung'ana linono, ina luaata e nkirrita ino, nikincho iyie enashe ntarasi; ore ebaiki iishoritin o ishoritin, nikilimu enkisisa ino.
Nchoru enkiok Lo Airritani le Israel, iyie ilo orikoo Yosef anaa eluaata oo ntare! Iyie ilo otii olorika le nkitoo te nchumata oo lkerubi,
nintawang'isho te dukuya Efraim o Benchamen o Manase. Tuputu enkidimata ino, nilotu aitajeu iyiook!
Torrinyu iyiook, Na Ai; nchoo enkomom ino ewang'u, pee etumi aaitajeu iyiook!
Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, ke nkata nabaa iyie igorokino enkomono oo ltung'ana linono?
Nintotio iyie ninche te mukate oo lkiyio, nincho ninche metooko ilkiyio te nkumoi.
Nintaa iyiook ilmang'ati too le latia ang; ore ilmang'ati lang nekueni maate.
Torrinyu iyiook, Na Ai oo lororani; nchoo enkomom ino metawang'a, pee etumi aaitajeu iyiook!
Iyie oyaua isabibu aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri; iyie otaarayie iloshon niun ilo sabibu.
Iyie oitukut enkop te nkaraki ninye; neibung ntona naapuo atua enkop neiput enkop.
Neitoip oloip lenye ildoinyo, neitoip ilng'osil lenyena iltarakua sapuki;
nereu ilng'osil lenyena aitabaiki enaiposha, neitabaiki ntona enyena olkeju.
Kainyoo naa iyie pee itigila enkikarrata enye, neaku ore pooki oogiroo aaim enkoitoi, neng'osilu ilng'anayio lenyena?
Neinyala ilbitiro le ntim ninye, ore nena pooki naapuo ti ong'ata nenya ninye.
Nyaaki mbelekenyunye, Na Ai oo lororani! Ing'ura kop itii shumata, nidol, tishilai ele sabibu,
ilo shani lituuno iyie te nkaina ino e tatene.
Etapejoitie ninche ninye te nkurma, netudung'o ninche aauroo; meidaai ninche te nkisikong'ata e nkomom ino!
Kake nchoo enkaina ino elotu shumata ilo le nkaina ino e tatene, ina kerai e tung'ani nintagolo iyie te nkaraki kewan ino!
Nemikiingil ae kata iyiook aaibelekenya aaing'uaa iyie; nchoo iyiook enkishui, pee kitum aaipoto enkarna ino!
Torrinyu iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani! Nchoo enkomom ino metawang'a, pee etumi aaitajeu iyiook!
Entabuaku entaranyaki Enkai engolon ang; entabuaaki te ng'ida Enkai e Yakobo!
Elepie osinkolio, nioshiosho enkinanta, ina kinanta e nkopito sidai e nkorui o endule.
Entoosh esekekua te nduaata o lapa, te nepurupuranayu olapa, teina olong ang o sirua.
Amu enkitanapata ina te Israel, elimunoto e Nkai e Yakobo.
Eibalunye apa ninye te Yosef, ina kata apa pee eipang ninye alo te nkop e Misiri. Aning'ito nanu oltoilo leitu ayiolou:
“Aiwuang'ie nanu olola to loililai lino; eyeng'iyeng'ate inkaik inono te napata e nkikapu.
Ore te nkata o sina kimpoto iyie nanu, naatokordua nanu; aatawalikia nanu iyie teine wueji e nkisudoroto e ndarata; aatetema nanu iyie too nkariak e Meriba.
Entoning, lo tung'ana laainei, te naikok nanu intae! Oo Israel, oi siaake tenaa eikining nanu!
Mejing enkai omoni atua intae; emirrugo aaserem enkai omoni.
Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo apa likiyaua aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri. Tang'a enkutuk ino pee aaiput nanu.
“Kake eitu ening iltung'ana laainei oltoilo lai; nemaayieu nanu Israel.
Neaku aishooyie nanu teina golon oo ltauja lenye, metusuja nkiguanat enye.
Oi naaji tenaa kaaning iltung'ana laainei, pee etum Israel ashomo too nkoitoi aainei!
Etaa nanu kasioki amir ilmang'ati lenye, naibelekenyaki nanu enkaina ai ilmang'ati lenye.
Ore lelo ooiba Olaitoriani nepuonu aaitoborruo te dukuya ninye, ore ina kitamioto enye nebik intarasi.
Kaaitoti nanu iyie te nkano sidai aisul, ore teina aisho naing'uaa endapidapoi naaitaraposh iyie.”
Etii Enkai ewueji enye tiatua eumata enye; ore te mpolos oo nkaitin neiguana ninye:
“Ke nkata nabaa iyie inguana too ntorrok, nintodolu olkep te ilo torrono?
Nguanaki te sipata ilo omena o ilo okishi; mbung'a esipata e ilo oata osina o ilo okishi.
Tokordu ilo oshal o ilo aisinani; tokordu ninche ntung'uai enkaina e ilo torrono.”
Meeta ninche eng'eno nemedamisho, nepuo ninche aamanimanaa te naimin; eikirikirate ilkitamanyunot pooki le nkop.
Najo nanu, “Irara intae inkaitin, inkera e ilo Otii Shumata Aisul, intae pooki;
ore ake eyia, iyeye intae anaa iltung'ana, nibatatata anaa pooki tung'ani kitok.”
Tudumunye, iyie Enkai, nguanare enkop; amu ilinono iloreren pooki!
Na Ai ai, mintoki iyie agira; migira nemintirring'a, Iyie Enkai!
Amu ng'ura ajo ebuakita ilmang'ati linono; neilepie ilukuny lelo likimba iyie.
Neitobir nkitobirat torrok too ltung'ana linono, neiguanakino te nebo pee ear lelo litomituo iyie.
Nejo ninche, “Wootu, matujutu ninche aaishie anaa olosho, nchoo enkarna e Israel eaku meigili aekata aadamu!”
Ee, neiguanakino ninche to ltau obo; neitobir ninche olning'o pee kitum aataarare iyie -
o lelo ng'oborri le Edom o le Ishmael, o le Moab o le Hagari,
o Gebal o Amon o Amaleki, o Filistia te nebo lelo oomanya Tiro;
eibung'are sii Asiria ninche; ninche engolon oo nkera e Lutu.
Intaasa ninche enapa nintaasa Midian, o Sisera o Yabin to lkeju le Kishon,
lelo apa ooidakieki te Endor, lelo otaa nkik te nkop.
Intotiwuo lelo kituaak lenye anaa Orebu o Seebu, nintotiu ilkituaak lenye pooki anaa Seba o Salmuna,
lelo apa ootejo, “Mawaita ena kop e Nkai aaitaa enaang.”
Na Ai ai, ntaa ninche enterit, nchoo etiu anaa suut naakutaa osiwuo.
Ore anaa enaaibung enkima entim, o anaa enalo olng'ejep le nkima enchumata o ldoinyo,
neijia nkuna, tusujai ninche to lkutati lino, nturia ninche to lemua lino!
Mputa nkomomi enye enkurruna, pee etum ninche aaing'oru enkarna ino, iyie Olaitoriani.
Nchoo ninche meitukurruni, neidang ntarasi; nchoo ninche meidaai te sulare.
Nchoo ninche metayiolo nchere iyie ake openy eji enkarna Olaitoriani, iyie Otii Shumata Aisul te nkop pooki.
Kebaa esidano e nkaji ino, Olaitoriani loo lororani!
Keyieu oltau lai, ee, naa keiterriakino enkaji o Laitoriani; neranyaki te ng'ida oltau lai o sesen lai Enkai naishu.
Enoto sii ninye esarampala ewueji enye, netum enkomerei enkaji, ewueji neirragakinyie inkera enyena, too lpereren linono loo lasarri, iyie Olaitoriani loo lororani, Olaitoriani lai naa Enkai ai.
Emayiana ilo obik tiatua enkaji ino, nebik aarany enkisisa ino!
Emayiana lelo tung'ana laa atua iyie etii engolon enye, lelo ooteretenate too ltauja lenye, teina lototo kitok e Sion.
Ore epuoito ninche aaim oerata le Baka, neitotiu ninche ine anaa nkonyek oo nkariak; ore ilkisirat le dukuya le nchan neiput ine ilchorroi.
Nepuo ninche eponari engolon enye ore ina Ai oo nkaitin nepuoi aadol te Sion.
Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai, iyie Enkai oo lororani, toning'o enkomono ai; irrugu enkiok, iyie Enkai e Yakobo!
Toduaa iyie Enkai, na long'o ang, ing'ura enkomom e ilo lino litubukoko eilata aput!
Amu enkolong nabo tiatua enkaji ino naikash alang nkolong'i enkalifu nabo te dikae. Enaikash nanu te naaku olarriponi te kutuk aji e nkaji e Nkai ai, alang te nabik too lng'oborri le nkarruoisho.
Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai naa enkolong naa elong'o; naa keishoru ninye omom o enkitoo. Meetae entoki sidai namit Olaitoriani te lelo oopuo too ltauja sidain.
Olaitoriani loo lororani, emayiana ilo tung'ani likisilig iyie.
Olaitoriani, ira apa iyie supat te nkop ino; itorrinyuo iyie olpisiai le Yakobo.
Itapalaka iyie entorroni oo ltung'ana linono, nipalaki iyie ing'ok enye pooki.
Itorrinyo iyie engoro ino pooki; nimbelekenya iyie aing'uaa ina goro ino napi.
Ngila torrinyu iyiook, Iyie Enkai e njeunoto ang, niwuang'ie engoro ino te iyiook!
Igorokino iyie iyiook intarasi? Intoodor iyie engoro ino aitabaiki iishoritin pooki?
Eimingil iyie aitopiu iyiook, pee etum iltung'ana linono aating'idata te iyie?
Ntoduaa iyiook enyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, nincho iyiook enjeunoto ino.
Nchooki nanu matoning'o enajo Olaitoriani Enkai, amu keiro ninye eseriani too ltung'ana lenyena, too sinyat lenyena o te lelo ooibelekenyakino ninye too ltauja lenye.
Esipa ketaana enjeunoto enye te lelo ooure ninye, pee etum enkitoo atobiko te nkop ang.
Ketumo enyorrata nauno o esupatisho, neng'ututa esupatisho o eseriani te nebo.
Nebulu ailepu te nkop esupatisho, neirrugo esupatisho te shumata aing'or enkop.
Ee, keishoru Olaitoriani ina sidai, ore enkop ang neiu ilng'anayio kumok.
Kelo esupatisho te dukuya ninye, neitaa iroruat enyena enkoitoi.
Tuuno enkiok ino, iyie Olaitoriani, nikiwaliki nanu, amu kara nanu aisinani namena.
Tagolie enkishui ai, amu kara nanu olaseremani le Nkai; ntajeu osinka lino likisilig iyie.
Ira iyie Enkai ai; ing'urrieki nanu, Olaitoriani, amu iyie nanu aishiraki endama pooki.
Ntishipa oltau lo sinka lino, amu iyie nanu, Olaitoriani, aserem.
Amu iyie, iyie Olaitoriani osupat, nipalaki ing'ok, nibik te nyorrata nauno te lelo pooki likimpot iyie.
Toning'o, Olaitoriani, enkomono ai; toning'o enkomono ai e sayiata.
Ore te nkolong ai oo ngolikinot, aaipoto nanu iyie, amu eikiwaliki iyie nanu.
Meetae likae likinyaanyukie iyie tiatua nkaitin, Olaitoriani, nemeetae kulie siaaitin naanyaanyukie ininono.
Ore lelo oreren pooki lintobira iyie naa kepuonu, neirrugo te dukuya iyie, Olaitoriani, naa keisis ninche enkarna ino.
Amu ira iyie kitok nias mbaa e nking'asia, iyie ake openy Enkai.
Nteng'enaki nanu enkoitoi ino, Olaitoriani, pee atum nanu ashomo te sipata ino; nchoo oltau lai meturia enkarna ino.
Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe, Olaitoriani, Enkai ai, to ltau lai pooki, naa kaisis nanu enkarna ino ntarasi.
Amu aikitok ina nyorrata ino nauno tialo nanu, itokordua iyie enkishui ai aitung'uaa enguton e nemeneng'a.
Iyie Enkai, aatudumakinote nanu iltung'ana oowuasa aarare; eing'oru entukus oo ltung'ana arruok enkishui ai, nimikishilaa ninche iyie.
Kake ore iyie Olaitoriani, ira Enkai o lng'ur niata osotua, nimisioki agoro, nibik te nyorrata nauno, nira oloisiligayu.
Mbelekenyayu ng'uraki nanu, niking'urrie nanu; nchoo osinka lino engolon ino, nintajeu ina kerai e sinka ino.
Ntoduaaki nanu olmonekie le omom ino, paa ore lelo laaiba nanu nedol nekurru, amu iyie, Olaitoriani, likitareto nanu nikintagol nanu.
Enchumata eilo doinyo sinyati etii ina anasa nateshetua Enkai.
Kenyor Olaitoriani enkanasa e Sion, aitalang ae wueji pooki te Israel.
Mbaa e nkitoo eimakini tialo iyie, na anasa e Nkai.
Ore te lelo laayiolo nanu, aimaki Rahab o Babilon; ng'ura, etii Filistia o Tiro o Etiopia - nejo ninche, “Etoiwuoki ele teine.”
Naa ore tialo Sion naa keji, “Ore ele o elde netoiwuoki tiatua ninye”; amu Ilo otii Shumata Aisul olo aitasheyie ninye.
Keiken Olaitoriani nesir iltung'ana, “Ore ele netoiwuoki apa teine.”
Ore lelo aranyak o looiguran, nejo, “Ore nchorroi aainei pooki naa atua iyie etii.”
Olaitoriani lai, Enkai ai, iyie nanu aipot taretuoki dama; naishir nanu kewarie te dukuya iyie.
Nchoo enkomono ai meeu dukuya iyie, tuuno enkiok ino toning'o enkishirata ai!
Amu eiputa oltau lai enyamali; netataanikia enkishui ai enemeneng'a!
Aaikenakaki nanu lelo oodoiki engumoto; kara nanu oltung'ani lemeeta engolon,
atotiwuo anaa oltung'ani oiturrayioki tiatua ilootuata, anaa oltung'ani otaraki metua neirragieki te ngumoto, anaa ltung'ana lemeekure edamuni, amu eiwuang'ieki ninche te nkaina ino.
Kitipika iyie nanu atua enguton e ngumoto, iwuejitin neemisimis negut.
Eirragita engoro ino nairoishi te shumata nanu, nikindaikie nanu too lopir lo siwuo lino.
Nchoo iyie lelo le ncholiek ai maaitiaa nanu, kintaa iyie nanu entoki naitureisho te ninche. Aaikenoyioki nanu metaa maidim atuluai,
eiliilaitie nkonyek aainei te nkaraki osina. Ore nkolong'i pooki naipot nanu iyie Olaitoriani, Nailepie aitorioo inkaik aainei te nkomono.
Ias iyie mbaa e nking'asia too lootuata? Eikinyototo iloipi aaisis iyie?
Keibalunyeki ina nyorrata ino nauno tiatua enkurare, anaa esupatisho ino te Abadon?
Keyioloi mbaa inono e nking'asia tiatua enaimin, anaa ina retoto ino naitajeusho te nkop nemedamuni?
Kake ore nanu, Olaitoriani, iyie aishiraka; ore tadekenya nelotu enkomono ai dukuya iyie.
Olaitoriani, kainyoo pee kinturrayie nanu? Kainyoo iyie pee kisudorie nanu enkomom ino?
Aainosa nanu osina neyieu aye apa ebaiki kitisho ai, aisilisile nanu too nkituriat inono; ataa nanu pesho.
Aaisiasha nanu engoro ino; aaidaikie nanu ioshot inono.
Aatamana ninche anaa oloirrag le nkare endama pooki; naaman ninche aang'adu te nebo.
Inchoo iyie ilchoreta laainei laning'ore maaitiaa nanu, netaa enaimin ake aisiritore.
Karany nanu osinkolio leina nyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, ntarasi; ore te nkutuk ai, naa kalimu nanu esupatisho ino tiatua iishoritin pooki.
Amu ore ina nyorrata ino nauno neitasheyieki ntarasi, ore esupatisho ino nemeigusugusieki, etiu anaa keper.
Itejo iyie, “Aitobira nanu olning'o lai te nebo ilo lai gelunoti, ainosie nanu Daudi osinka lai olmumai:
‘Kaitubul nanu eishoi ino ntarasi, nashetu olorika lino le nkitoo too ishoritin pooki.’ ”
Nchoo keper meisisa mbaa inono e nking'asia, iyie Olaitoriani, o esupatisho ino tiatua eumata e lelo sinyat!
Amu kaing'ae to loing'ang'e eidimi aaitanyaanyukie Olaitoriani? Kaing'ae tiatua lelo le keper onyaanyukie Olaitoriani.
Iyie Enkai naurei tiatua enkiguana e lelo sinyat, kitok neitureisho, nelusoo ninye te lelo pooki oomanita ninye?
Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, kalo olmagilani anaa iyie, Olaitoriani, nikimanita iyie esupatisho ino?
Iyie oitore engolon e naiposha, naa te nedumunye ilopir lenyena, nintirring'ie ninche.
Iyie otarrarra Rahab anaa empopok, iyie oidapasha ilmang'ati linono te nkaina ino.
Enino keper naa enino enkop; o pooki toki natii atua, iyie oitobirua ninche.
Ore moikuape o kopikop iyie oitobirua ninche; ore Tabori o Harmon neisis enkarna ino te ng'ida.
Iata iyie enkaina magilani; kegol enkaina ino, neado enkaina ino e tatene.
Esupatisho o esipata ninche olkitamanyunoto lo lorika lino le nkitoo; nelo esupatisho o enyorrata nauno te dukuya iyie.
