Kemayiana lelo tung'ana ooyiolo embuakunoto o sinkolio lo sirua, lelo, Olaitoriani oopuo te wang'an e nkomom ino,
lelo oong'ida te nkaraki enkarna ino endama pooki, neisis ninche esupatisho ino.
Amu iyie enkisisa e ngolon enye; ore te nkaraki omom ino neishur iyiook emowuo.
Amu ore elong'o ang naa eno Laitoriani, ore olaiguanani lang naa oleilo Sinyati le Israel.
Ore tiapa, nirorie iyie te nduaata, ilo lino oisiligayu nijo, “Atipika nanu enkopiyia e nkitoo endukuya e obo magilani, aishoo nanu enkitoo ilo otegelutua iltung'ana.
Anoto nanu Daudi osinka lai; atubukoko nanu ninye eilata sinyati aput;
pee etum enkaina ai ataa te nebo ninye, neitagol sii enkaina ai ninye.
Memir aekata ilmang'ati ninye, nemelo ilo torrono aitore ninye.
Karrar nanu ilmang'ati lenyena te dukuya ninye, naosh anang'ie enkop lelo ooiba ninye.
Ore esupatisho ai o enyorrata ai nauno naa keaku te nebo ninye, ore te nkarna ai neishur emowuo enye.
Kalo nanu apik enkaina enye enchumata e naiposha, napik enkaina enye e tatene shumata ilkejek.
Kaaishiraki ninye nanu, ejo, ‘Ira iyie Papa, Enkai ai o endapidapoi e njeunoto ai.’
Naa kaitaa nanu ninye olkikau lai, ole shumata too laiguanak le nkop.
Kaibung nanu tialo ninye ina nyorrata ai nauno ntarasi, ore olning'o lai nemeigusugus tialo ninye.
Kaitubul nanu eishoi enye ntarasi, nebikoo olorika lenye le nkitoo anaa inkolong'i e keper.
Te neany inkera enyena enkitanapata ai, nemepuo te risioroto oo nkikoot aainei,
te nepaashare ninche nkikoot aainei, nemeibung inkitanapat aainei,
naa kaitame nanu nena kitarruorot enye te ng'udi; naitame entorroni enye te nkitamioto nairowua;
kake maiwuang'ie nanu te ninye ina nyorrata ai nauno, aashu ariat esupatisho ai.
Magil nanu olning'o lai lo sotua, anaa aibelekeny ilo rorei otupukuo te nkutuk ai.
Atimitunye nanu anya olmumai te sinyatisho ai; malej nanu Daudi.
Kebikoo eishoi enye ntarasi, nebikoo olorika lenye le nkitoo anaa enkolong te dukuya nanu.
Ketiu anaa olapa, keitasheyieki ntarasi; keitashe ninye auno anaa enabik oloing'ang'e.”
Kake ore taata inturrayie iyie, nimbayie; kimputa iyie engoro te nkaraki ilo lino litubukoko eilata aput.
Itanya iyie olning'o te nebo osinka lino, nimpurupuro iyie enkopiyia enye e nkitoo te nterit.
Ituuroyie iyie isunta enyena pooki; intomijoono iyie lelo sempewueti lenyena.
Ore lelo pooki oogiroo nepur ninye, etaa ninye entoki nakueniyie ile latia enye.
Ntagolo iyie enkaina oo lmang'ati lenyena; ntishipa iyie ilmang'ati lenyena pooki.
Imbelekenya iyie empijan o lalem lenye, neitu incho ninye meitasho to larrabal.
Iwuang'ie iyie eng'udi e nkitoria te nkaina enye, ninang'aki olorika lenye le nkitoo enkop.
Ntodorropa iyie nkolong'i enyena e kitisho, nimulumula ninye te nkurruna.
Ke nkata nabaa, Olaitoriani, isudoo iyie kewan, ae ntarasi? Ke nkata nabaa eyupuyup engoro ino anaa enkima?
Tadamu Olaitoriani eneba entemata e nkishui, ae te nyoo iyie intobira nkera pooki e tung'ani!
Kalo tung'ani obik eishu nemedol aekata keeya? Kalo oidim atokordu oltau lenye aitung'uaa engolon e nemeneng'a?
Olaitoriani, koree enapa nyorrata ino nauno, enapa ninosie iyie olmumai o Daudi te nkaraki esupatisho ino?
Tadamu, Olaitoriani, ina nakueniyie osinka lino; anapita nanu to lgoo lai imorot e tung'ani,
nena naamor ilmang'ati, linono Olaitoriani, nena naamorie iroruat e ilo lino otubukokoki eilata aaput.
Meisisi Olaitoriani ntarasi! Eesai, Eesai.
Olaitoriani, iyie emanyisho ang, tiatua iishoritin pooki.
Ore apa eton eitu eitobiruni ildoinyo, aashu enkop pooki, ebaiki ntarasi o ntarasi, iyie Enkai.
Irrinyoki iyie tung'ani meshomo enterit, nijo, “Entorrinyoto, nakera e tung'ana
Amu ore ilarin enkalifu nabo too nkonyek inono netiu anaa ng'ole te nelusoo, aashu anaa erripore e nkewarie.
Ioroo iyie iltung'ana aiwuang'ie; netiu ninche anaa enkidetidet, netiu anaa nkujit naaipilipil tadekenya;
ore tadekenya neitapuku neipilipil, ore teipa nemuguta netoyu.
Amu eidaikie iyiook engoro ino; ore te nkaraki engoro ino nikiruto iyiook.
Itipika iyie nkitarruorot ang dukuya iyie, ore nena ng'ok ang naaisudoro netii dukuya nkonyek inono.
Amu etulusoitie nkolong'i ang pooki tiabori engoro ino, naa keiting ilarin lang anaa enkiyang'ata.
Ore ilarin te nkishui ang naa ntomoni naapishana, naa ntomoni isiet te nikigol; ore too lelo arin naa enkisiaayiare ake o sina; nalusoo aasiooyo, nikipuo sii iyiook aish.
Aing'ae oiguanare engolon e ngoro ino, o empushuna ino te risioroto e uriata ino?
Nteng'ena naa iyiook enkikenata oo nkolong'i ang, pee kitum aanoto oltau le ng'eno nagut.
Torrinyunye, Olaitoriani, O anu kenya? Ing'urrie isinkan linono!
Ntaraposho iyiook anaake tadekenya teina nyorrata ino nauno, pee kitum aating'idata nikishipa too nkolong'i ang pooki.
Nting'ida iyiook too nkolong'i kumok naaba anaa ininosie iyiook osina, too larin ooba anaa ilikitodolie entorroni.
Nchoo meibalunyeki esiaai ino too sinkan linono, neibalunyeki ina golon ino kitok too nkera enye.
Nchoo esupatisho o Laitoriani Enkai ang elotu shumata iyiook, nintagol iyie esiaai oo nkaik ang te shumata iyiook, ee, ntagolo iyie esiaai oo nkaik ang.”
Ore ilo obik to lng'obor le ilo otii Shumata aisul; ilo obik tiatua oloip lo lmagilani,
kelo ajoki Olaitoriani, “Esarunoto ai naa osempewuet lai; Enkai ai naa ninye aisilig.”
Amu eikikordu ninye iyie aitayu te ilo rreshet lo larreshoni, o too lmeita torrok.
Eikimulumul ninye too naipuko enyena, ore ti abori inaipuko enyena nitum esarunoto; ore esupatisho enye naa elong'o o emitunoto.
Mitum iyie enkuretisho kewarie, nimikitum embae nang'oruni dama,
anaa olmeitai olo tiatua enaimin, anaa te nkidaata namutisho te ndama.
Keidim aatabatata iltung'ana enkalifu nabo te mbata ino, nebatata nkalifuni tomon te nkalo ino e tatene, kake mikinyikaki iyie.
Ing'or ake too nkonyek inono, nidol elaakinoto oo larruok.
Ore te nkaraki nintaa Olaitoriani esarunoto ino, nintaa Ilo Otii Shumata Aisul emanyisho ino,
meetae entorroni nalotu enitii, meetae olmeitai onyikaki olng'obor lino.
Amu keisho ninye olmalaika lenye mikitagolie iyie, nikirrip too nkoitoi inono pooki.
Nikinap ninche too nkaik enye, pee minkob ake osoit te nkeju ino.
Ilo iyie aroro olng'atuny o enturbubua, intuny iyie olng'atuny o lasurai too nkejek inono.
Ejo Olaitoriani, “Ore te nkaraki naatonyorra ninye nanu, kakordu nanu ninye; kamitu nanu ninye, te nkaraki nayiolo ninye enkarna ai.
Te naaipot ninye nanu nawaliki nanu ninye; kaaku nanu te nebo ninye te nkata e nyamali, kamitu nanu ninye nayanyitu ninye.
Naitaraposh ninye te nkishui naado, naitodol ninye enjeunoto ai.”
Eisidai te neishori Olaitoriani enashe, pee eranyi enkisisa e nkarna ino, iyie Olotii shumata Aisul;
pee eibalunyeki ina nyorrata ino nauno tadekenya, o esupatisho ino te nkewarie,
to sinkolio le nkinanta o usin o enkawuo oo sinkolioitin o to lkerempe lo lwulul loo usin.
Amu iyie, Olaitoriani, likintishipa nanu te siaai ino; ore too siaaitin oo nkaik inono narany nanu te ng'ida.
Kebaa enkitoo oo siaaitin inono, Olaitoriani! Kegut oleng indamunot inono!
Meyiolou oltung'ani omoda, mening'u olkiminchali kuna baa:
nchere, ore hoo nebul ilarruok anaa olkujita, nedupoyu ilarruok pooki, enkidaata ninche epuo ntarasi,
kake ore iyie, Olaitoriani, itii shumata ntarasi.
Amu ng'ura ilmang'ati linono, Olaitoriani, ng'ura, keidak ilmang'ati linono, ore lelo arruok naa keisardakieki.
Amu kintagoloo iyie anaa olosokuan; nikitubukoko nanu eilata ng'ejuk.
Etoduaa nkonyek aainei embatatata oo lmang'ati laainei, etoning'o nkiyiaa aainei entorroni e lelo mang'ati laainei.
Kebul ilo supat anaa oltukai, nebulu anaa oltarakuai le Lebanon.
Etuunoki ninche tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, nebul ninche too lgorieti le Nkai ang.
Neton ake eiu ninche ilng'anayio te moruao enye, nebulu ninche aalitu inenyori anaake,
pee eitodolu nchere eisupat Olaitoriani; ninye endapidapoi ai, nemetii entorroni atua ninye.
Olaitoriani oitoreisho; eishope ninye te nkitoo; eishope Olaitoriani, neterretene ninye aishop engolon. Ee, eitasheyieki enkop, nemeigusugusieki aekata;
eitasheyieki olorika lino le nkitoo apa moitie; itii iyie ebaiki apa ntarasi.
Etudumutua inaaiposha iltoiloishi lenye, iyie Olaitoriani nedumu ninche oltoilo lenye o enkikurrukur.
Magilani ninye alang indarat oo nkariak kumok, kitok alang ilopir le naiposha, Ore Olaitoriani otii shumata naa magilani.
Esipa nkitanapat inono eishiaakino esinyatisho enkaji ino iyie Olaitoriani, ntarasi.
Olaitoriani, ira iyie Enkai e lap, Iyie Enkai e lap, tawang'a!
Tudumunye, lo adung'oni le nkiguana le nkop, nchoo lelo oowuasa inaairirikino ninche!
Iyie Olaitoriani, o anu kenya errup ate kulo torrok, o anu kenya eisulie kulo torrok.
Neruku ninche irorei lenye le pesho, neitokoos ninche te ntorroni pooki.
Nerratany ninche iltungana linono, Olaitoriani, neisilisil enjung'ore ino.
Near ninche metua enkoliai o ilo tung'ani omoni, nesesekuan ilo okishi.
Nejo ninche, “Medol Olaitoriani; memusu Enkai e Yakobo.”
Tayiolo, ele omoda aisul! Lo moda, kanu kenya ing'enunu?
Amaa, ilo oitobira enkiok, ae mening'isho ninye? Amaa, ilo oitobira enkong'u, ae medolisho ninye?
Amaa ilo oitame iloshon, ae meitameisho ninye? Amaa ilo oiteng'en iltung'ana te ng'eno ijo pasa aimeeta eng'eno nagut?
Keyiolo Olaitoriani ndamunot oo ltung'ana nchere enkijape ake.
Kemayiana ilo tung'ani lintame iyie, Olaitoriani, ilo linteng'en iyie too nkitanapat inono
pee incho ninye enkiyeng'iyeng'ata te nkata e nyamali, o metaba anaa neturokini ilo torrono engumoto.
Amu meituraa Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena; meing'uaa ninye enjung'ore enye;
amu kelotu esipata enetii lelo supati, ore lelo pooki sidain iltauja, nesuj.
Kalo odumunye te nkaraki nanu agilunore ilo torrono? Kalo oitashe te rishata ai agilunore ilaasak loo ntorrok?
Te neme Olaitoriani otaa eretoto ai, anaata etobiko enkishui ai te nkop e ngira.
Te nadamisho nanu, “Neideketari enkeju ai,” enyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, ninye naaibung'ita.
Ore te nkumoi oo ndamunot aainei, naa enkitagoloto ino naaitagol oshoke.
Keidim ilarikok arruok aaibung'ata o iyie, lelo ooitobiru ntabo te nkoitoi oo nkitanapat?
Keiturrurro ninche te nebo aagilunore ilo supat, nedung'oki ilo asipani enkiguana e keeya.
Kake etaa Olaitoriani osempewuet lai, etaa Enkai ai endapidapoi e sarunoto ai.
Kerrinyoki ninye ninche ntorrok enye, nejut ninche aiwuang'ie te nkaraki enkarruoisho enye; kejutoo Olaitoriani Enkai ang ninche aiwuang'ie.
Wootu mataranyaki Olaitoriani matishipakinoto endapidapoi e njeunoto ang!
Wootu maape dukuya enkomom enye kiaata enashe; mataranyaki iyiook ninye kiata eng'ida, too sinkolioitin le nkisisa!
Amu ore Olaitoriani naa ninye Enkai kitok, naa Olaiguanani kitok te shumata nkaitin pooki.
Etii nkaik enyena enguton e nkop, naa enenye sii enkadoro oo ldoinyo.
Enenye enaiposha amu ninye oitobira, naa nkaik enyena naaitobira enkop natoyio.
Wootu mateserem nikirrugokino, matigil kung te dukuya Olaitoriani oitobira iyiook!
Amu ninye Enkai ang, nikira iyiook iltung'ana le nkirrita enye, o nkerra e nkaina enye. Te nining'ining'i taata oltoilo lenye!
Emintagol iltauja linyi, anaa apa te Meriba, anaa apa te nkolong e Masa ti ong'ata,
ina kata apa pee aatem iloo papaai linyi, naaineneng ninche nanu, hoo netoduaa ninche esiaai ai.
Too larin artam nanu aaitagoro ina ishoi, najo nanu, “Iltung'ana ootapaashaitie iltauja, nemeshilaa ninche nkoitoi aainei.”
Neaku, ainosa nanu olmumai te ngoro ai, pee mejing ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata ai.
Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk; entaranyaki Olaitoriani nakop pooki!
Entaranyaki Olaitoriani, esisa enkarna enye; entolimu enjeunoto enye nkolong'i pooki.
Embalunye enkitoo enye tiatua loshon, embalunye isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia tiatua iloreren!
Eikitok Olaitoriani, naa keisisi ninye oleng; keureyuni ninye aaitulusoo too nkaitin pooki.
Amu ore nkaitin pooki oo loreren naa nkitanyaanyukot; kake Olaitoriani oitobira keper.
Etii enkanyit o enkitoo dukuya ninye; etii engolon o enkishiaa atua ewueji enye sinyati.
Enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo, intae ilmareita loo ltung'ana, enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo o engolon!
Enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo nairirikino enkarna enye; eyau enkishooroto, nipuonunu atua ilgorieti lenyena!
Enteserem Olaitoriani te sinyatisho e nkishiaa enye, inkirikirayu te dukuya ninye, nakop pooki!
Tejo tiatua iloshon, “Olaitoriani oitoreisho! Ee, eitasheyieki enkop, nemeigusugusieki aekata; kelo ninye aiguanare iloshon te sipata.”
Nchoo metishipayu keper, naa nchoo enkop meting'idayu; nchoo enaiposha meikurrukurro o nena pooki naabore atua;
nchoo metishipayu enkop, o pooki toki natii atua! Neranyisho taa ilkeek pooki le ntim te ng'ida
te dukuya Olaitoriani, amu elotu ninye pee eiguanare enkop. Keiguanare ninye enkop te supatisho, neiguanare iloreren te sipata enye.
Olaitoriani oitoreisho; nchoo metishipayu enkop; nchoo metishipata iloomanaa le naiposha!
Emanita nkatampo o emisimisi nagut ninye; esupatisho o esipata ninche olkitamanyunoto lo lorika lenye le nkitoo.
Nelo enkima te dukuya ninye, nepejoo lelo mang'ati oomanita ninye.
Nkiwuang'at enyena naaitawang enkop; nedol enkop neikirikira.
Etosholate ildoinyo netiu anaa nkapo te dukuya Olaitoriani, te dukuya Olaitoriani le nkop pooki.
Eibalunye keper esupatisho enye; neing'or iloreren pooki enkitoo enye.
Eitukurruaki lelo aseremak pooki loo nkitanyaanyukot, lelo oowuasare nkitanyaanyukot e pesho; neirrugo nkaitin pooki te dukuya ninye.
Nening Sion neshipa, neng'ida nena toyie e Yuda, te nkaraki nena kiguanat inono, Enkai.
Amu ore iyie, Olaitoriani, itii shumata aisul te nkop pooki; nikilepieki aaitulusoo too nkaitin pooki.
Kenyor Olaitoriani lelo ooiba enkarruoisho, negolie ninye enkishui oo sinyat lenyena; nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkaina e ilo arruoni.
Ewang'an naitawang ilo asipani, netum enchipai ilo oata oltau sidai.
Ting'idayu tiatua Olaitoriani, iyie ilo ora asipani, nincho enashe enkarna enye sinyati.
Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk, amu etaasa ninye mbaa e nking'asia! Ore ina aina enye e tatene, o ina aina enye sinyati, netimirishe.
Eibalunye Olaitoriani enkisulata enye, eibalunye ninye enkitoo te dukuya iloreren pooki.
Etadamua ninye ina nyorrata enye nauno o esupatisho enye te nkaji e Israel. Ore nkiting'ot e nkop pooki netoduaa enkisulata e Nkai ang.
Entaranyaki Olaitoriani te ng'ida, nakop pooki; entabuaku to sinkolio le nchipai entarany te nkisisa!
Entaranyaki enkisisa Olaitoriani to lwulul loo usin, to lwulul loo usin o to ltoilo lo sinkolio!
Entayu oltoilo le nchipai too sekekuani o to ltoilo le mowuo te dukuya Olaiguanani, laa ninye Olaitoriani!
Nchoo eikurrukur enaiposha o pooki toki natii atua; o enkop o pooki oomanya!
Ilugoyu enaiposha te nchipai; nchoo eranyisho ildoinyo te ng'ida te nebo,
te dukuya Olaitoriani, amu kelotu ninye aiguanare enkop. Keiguanare ninye enkop te supatisho neiguanare iloreren too sipat.
Olaitoriani oitoreisho; nchoo meikirikirata loreren! Etonita ninye to lorika le nkitoo too lkerubi; nchoo meikirikirayu enkop!
Eikitok Olaitoriani te Sion; etii ninye shumata iloreren pooki.
Nchoo meisisa loreren ina arna ino kitok naitureisho! Ninye osinyati!
Olaiguanani magilani, onyor isipat; intasheyie iyie esipata; ninguana iyie te sipata o te supatisho tiatua Yakobo.
Esisa Olaitoriani Enkai ang; enteseremisho too nkejek enyena! Ninye osinyati!
Musa o Aron apa ilapolosak lenyena, etii sii apa Samuel lelo ooipot enkarna enye. Eishirakita ninche Olaitoriani, newaliki ninye ninche.
Eirorie ninye ninche te ng'ape e nkatampoi; neibung ninche shakenisho enye, o nena kiguanat apa naaishoo ninche.
Olaitoriani Enkai ang, itawalikia iyie ninche; ira iyie Enkai napalaki ninche, hoo sii nira oloitalaku ntorrok enye.
Esisa Olaitoriani Enkai ang, niserememe to ldoinyo lenye sinyati; amu kesinya Olaitoriani Enkai ang!
Entaranyaki Olaitoriani te ng'ida, na kuapi pooki!
Esiaayia Olaitoriani te nchipai! Wootu dukuya ninye to sinkolio!
Entayiolo nchere Olaitoriani ninye Enkai! Ninye oitobira iyiook, nikira iyiook ilenyena; kira iyiook iltung'ana lenyena, o nkerra e nkirrita enye.
Eimutu nchomito enyena inchooyoyo enashe, entijing ilgorieti lenyena te nkisisa! Enchoo ninye enashe, nisisisisi enkarna enye!
Amu eisupat Olaitoriani; nebik enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi, nebikoo esupatisho enye too ishoritin pooki.
Karanyisho nanu te nkaraki enkirukoto o esipata; iyie Olaitoriani nanu aranyaki.
Kaibung nanu ina oitoi oo nkitoriorot. Oi kanu kenya ilotu enatii?
Mapik nanu dukuya nkonyek aainei entoki ake pooki torrono. Kaiba nanu esiaai e lelo ooibelekenyate aaing'uaa Enkai; manyikaki nanu.
Nchoo elamari oltau lo lwuasa te nanu; maata nanu enaporoki enkarruoisho.
Ore ilo okur aitong'u ole latia enye too nkisudorot naa kaidakie ninye. Ore ilo tung'ani oitokoos newuasa to ltau lenye, magirakino nanu.
Kaisho nanu omom lelo ooisiligayu te nkop, pee etum ninche aatobik te nebo nanu; ore ilo olo te nkoitoi nemetii entioto ninye laaisiaai nanu.
Meetae oltung'ani oas esunkuroisho obik tiatua enkaji ai; meetae oltung'ani oiro elejare oton te dukuya nanu.
Ore too nkakeny pooki naa kaidakie nanu lelo pooki torrok te nkop, aiwuang'ie lelo pooki torrok te nkop aitung'uaa enkanasa o Laitoriani.
Toning'o enkomono ai, Olaitoriani; nchoo enkishirata ai meeu enitii!
Mikisudorie iyie nanu enkomom ino te nkolong o sina lai! Irrugokoki enkiok ino tawalikiaki nanu tasioki teina olong naipotisho!
Amu kelusoo nkolong'i aainei anaa empuruo, neyupuyup iloik laainei anaa olkokuet.
Etooshoki oltau lai aapurd anaa olkujita netoyu, naarikino enkinosata e ndaa ai.
Ore te nkaraki embuakunoto e nkishirata ai, neibiitiari osesen lai.
Atotiwuo nanu anaa olkurragos li ong'ata onyaisho, anaa emotonyi oo nkiyiaa oo wuejitin neeliyio,
kairrag nanu nemaapuku njo, atiu nanu anaa emotonyi naliyio te nchumata e nkaji.
Ore endama pooki naainyal nanu ilmang'ati laainei, ore lelo laasukeny nanu neitaa enkarna ai oldeket.
Amu nkuruon nanu anya aitaa endaa, naitushulaki ilkiyio laainei ina naok.
Ore te nkaraki empushuna ino o engoro ino; amu kitudumua nanu nikinang'aa.
Etotiwuo nkolong'i aainei anaa oloip le nteipa; atoyio nanu atiu anaa nkujit.
Kake ore iyie Olaitoriani, itii olorika le nkitoo ntarasi; nebaiki enkarna ino iishoritin pooki.
Idumunye iyie aing'urrie Sion; etabawua enkata pee incho ninye omom, etabawua enkata apa nategeluaki.
Amu ile tipat isoito lenyena too sinkan linono, neing'urrie ninche enterit enye.
Kepuo iloshon aaureyu enkarna o Laitoriani, neureyu ilaiguanak pooki enkitoo ino.
Amu kelo Olaitoriani ashet Sion, neliooyu ninye te nkitoo enye;
neshilaa ninye enkomono e ilo aisinani, nememenaa ninye enkomono enye.
Nchoo meigeri kuna too ishoritin naapuonu, pee etum lelo tung'ana lemeino aaisisa Olaitoriani:
nchere eing'ura ninye abori teine wueji e shumata nesinya, te keper eing'ura Olaitoriani enkop,
pee etum atoning'o olkiyioi loo looena, pee etum atalaai lelo ooigerokoki keeya;
pee etum iltung'ana te Sion aaibalunyie enkarna o Laitoriani, neibalunyie enkisisa enye te Yerusalem,
te neiturrurro iloreren te nebo, o nkitoriat, pee eserem Olaitoriani.
Etigila ninye engolon ai te mpolos; eitodorropu ninye nkolong'i aainei.
“Na Ai ai,” atejo nanu, “Mikiya nanu tene, te mpolos oo nkolong'i aainei, iyie olobikoo ilarin lenyena tiatua iishoritin pooki!”
Apa moitie iyie itipika olkitamanyunoto le nkop, ore keper naa esiaai oo nkaik inono.
Neidaaya ninche, kake ibikoo iyie; keidaaya ninche pooki anaa ilkilani. Imbelekeny iyie ninche anaa nkilani neishari ninche.
Kake mimbelekenya iyie, nemeeta ilarin linono enkiting'oto.
Ketoni nkera oo sinkan linono te seriani, ore eishoi enye naa keitasheyieki te dukuya iyie.
Isisa Olaitoriani, iyie lo tau lai, o pooki natii atua nanu, isisa enkarna enye sinyati!
Isisa Olaitoriani, iyie lo tau lai, nimincho kirikino nkitaasat enyena pooki,
ninye likipalaki nkitarruorrot inono pooki, ninye likinchiunye imuoyiaritin inono pooki.
Ninye okordu enkishui ino aitung'uaa engumoto, ninye likinchopoki enyorrata enye nauno o lng'ur.
Ninye likintaraposh iyie too supati enkata naba anaa eninchu, metaa keitang'ejuki kitisho ino nitiu anaa olkurragos.
Olaitoriani oas isupati neisho isipat lelo ooitorogonyi.
Ninye oitayiolo Musa nkoitoi enyena, neitayiolo iasat enyena iltung'ana le Israel.
Keeta Olaitoriani olng'ur naa kaaipirisioni, mesioki agoro neeta enyorrata nauno.
Meisikong'isho ninye anaake, nemeibung engoro enye ntarasi.
Meitaas ninye iyiook te risioroto oo ng'ok ang, nemeosh ninye iyiook te risioroto oo nkitarruorrot ang.
Amu ore eneba anaa enalakuaniki keper enkop, neijia eba enkitoo e nyorrata enye nauno te lelo ooure ninye.
Ore anaa enalakuaniki oloosaen oloontoluo, neijia eiko ninye aitalamaa nkitarruorrot ang te iyiook.
Ore anaa enaing'urrie olpayian inkera enyena, neijia eiko Olaitoriani eing'urrie lelo ooure ninye.
Amu keyiolo ninye enkitobirunoto ang, edamu ninye ajo kira iyiook enterit.
Ore tialo tung'ani, etiu nkolong'i enyena anaa nkujit; kebul ninye anaa entapukai e ong'ata;
amu kekutaa osiwuo nedung'ori alo, ore ewueji enye nemeitoki ayiolou.
Kake ore ina nyorrata nauno o Laitoriani naa enoo ntarasi o ntarasi te lelo ooure ninye, neton esupatisho enye too nkera oo nkera enye,
te lelo ooibung olning'o lenye nedamu aaibung nkitanapat enyena.
Etipika Olaitoriani olorika lenye le nkitoo keper, naa enkitoria enye naitoreisho te pooki.
Esisa Olaitoriani intae lo malaika lenyena, intae kulo magil ooas enajo ororei lenye, entoning oltoilo lo rorei lenye!
Esisa Olaitoriani, o lororani lenyena pooki lelo aisiaayiak lenyena oas eyieunoto enye!
Esisa Olaitoriani, nasiaitin enyena pooki, too wuejitin enyena pooki e nkitoria enye, isisa Olaitoriani lo tau lai!
Isisa Olaitoriani lo tau lai! Olaitoriani Enkai ai, ira iyie kitok! Kinchopokoki iyie enkanyit o enkitoo,
iyie oishopoki kewan ewang'an anaa olkila, iyie oisalaasha keper anaa olng'obor,
iyie otipika ing'apeta e nkaji ino shumata nkariak, nintaa nkatampo engarri ino oo mbartan, niked inaipuko o siwuo,
nintaa osiwuo ilkiliku linono, nintaa olang'at le nkima ilaisiaayiak linono.
Iyie otipika enkop ilkitamanyunot lenyena, pee meigusugus ae kata.
Nimulumul te nguton anaa olkila; neitashe nkariak too nchumat oo ldoinyo.
Ore te mbuakunoto ino neilanyisho ninche, ore to ltoilo le ndarata ino neilanyisho ninche.
Neilepu ildoinyo, nedoyio ierat aagutu nepuo iwuejitin nitegelaka ninche.
Itipika iyie ilpolosien lemegiroo ninche, pee meigil ninche aaiput enkop.
Nchoo iyie nkonyek oo nkariak meturukunye too erat; nenang'ari aaim irishat oo ldoinyo,
neitook pooki ng'ues e ong'ata; neishu iloitikoishi enkure.
Embata enye etipika motonyi emanyisho enye; neranyisho ninche tiatua ilng'osil lenyena.
Ore te wueji ino neika nintook ildoinyo enkare; netaraposhe enkop too lng'anayio le siaai ino.
Iyie oitubulu nkujit te nkaraki nkishu, o nkaitubulu te nkaraki iltung'ana, pee etum ninye aitayu endaa te nkop,
o enaisho oo sabibu pee eitiship oltau le tung'ani, o eilata pee eitawang enkomom enye, o endaa pee eitagol enkishui e tung'ani.
Etipikaki ilkeek lo Laitoriani enkare aaitaraposh, lelo tarakua le Lebanon apa ootuuno ninye.
Te ninche eshetu motonyi nkajijik; neeta ntilagosi nkajijik too lkeek sapuki oonyori.
Netii nkineji oo soito ildoinyo adoru, netii nkijijuri ndapidapo.
Intobira iyie olapa pee eutu irishat; eyiolo enkolong erishata enye nadoyiorie.
Intobir iyie enaimin neaku kewarie, ina kata eikurtutari ing'uesi entim aapuo.
Neipur ilkuoo loo lng'atunyo erreshisho, eing'oru endaa enye naing'uaa enetii Enkai.
Ore ake pee eilepu enkolong nepuo ninche, neirrag ninche too rrumati lenye.
Nelo tung'ani esiaai enye neas esinkaisho enye o memuto.
Olaitoriani, kebaa enkumoi oo siaaitin inono! Te ng'eno iyie intobira pooki; ebore enkop seuseu oo ntokitin inono.
Idie etii enaiposha, naa kitok nelala, neuma ntokitin tiatua nemeikenayu ntokitin naaishu sapuki o nkutiti.
Nepuo imelin teine, o enkukuu naji Lefiatan nintobira iyie pee eiguran teine.
Iyie eing'or kuna pooki, pee incho ninche endaa enye too rishat enye.
Ore te nincho iyie ninche, neiturrur ninche, te nilak iyie enkaina ino neiput ninche ntokitin sidain.
Te nisudoo iyie enkomom ino, neidang ninche, ti niya enkiyang'et enye, neye ninche nerrinyokino enterit enye.
Ti nirriu iyie Enkiyang'et lino, neitobiri ninche; nintang'ejuk iyie oriong enkop.
Metobikoi enkitoo o Laitoriani ntarasi, metishipayu Olaitoriani too siaaitin enyena,
ilo laa te neing'or enkop neikirikira, ilo laa te neiseyie ildoinyo neitupuru!
Karanyaki nanu Olaitoriani nkolong'i pooki naishu; arany nanu enkisisa e Nkai eton aata enkishui.
Inchoo mikintishipa inkibirribirrat aainei amu Olaitoriani nanu ang'idakino.
Nchoo ilaing'okok metumuti te nkop, naa inchoo ilarruok eishieki! Isisa Olaitoriani lo tau lai! Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, empoto enkarna enye, embalunye nkiaasin enyena tiatua iloreren!
Entaranyaki ninye, entaranyaki ninye enkisisa, embalunye nkiaasin enyena pooki e nking'asia.
Enting'idata tiatua enkarna enye sinyati; nchoo iltauja le lelo ooing'oru Olaitoriani meting'idata.
Eng'orutu Olaitoriani o engolon enye, eng'orutu entasho te dukuya ninye anaake!
Entadamu isiaaitin e nking'asia naataasa ninye, mbaa enyena e nking'asia, o nkiguanat naairoro ninye.
Na ishoi e Abraham osinka lenye, lo ayiok le Yakobo, lo gelunot lenyena!
Ninye Olaitoriani Enkai ang; etii nkiguanat enyena enkop pooki.
Keibung ninye olning'o lenye ntarasi, te ilo rorei apa oitanapishe, too ishoritin naabaya enkalifu nabo,
ilo ning'o apa oitobira ninye o Abraham, ilo mumai apa oinosa te nkaraki Isaak,
ilo apa oitudupayie te Yakobo pee eaku enkikoo, te Israel neaku olning'o loo ntarasi,
ejo, “Kaaisho iyie enkop e Kanaan metaa erubata e njung'ore ino.”
Ore apa aa kuti ninche oleng, neme toki, naa ilomon teinakop e Kanaan,
nelimana ninche too loshon pooki, nepuo te nkitoria o metabaiki likae orere,
eitu ninye eisho oltung'ani meitorogonya ninche, eisikong'a ninye ilaiguanak te nkaraki ninche,
ejo, “Miseyie ele lai ootubukokoki eilata aaput, minyal iloibonok laainei!”
Te neipotu Olaitoriani olameyu meeu enkop, neiwuang'ie endaa pooki,
neirriwayie ninye oltung'ani dukuya ninche, Yosef, ilo apa otimiraki aaitaa orrindik.
Einyala ilpisia le enata nkejek enyena, nepiki emurt enye engotoo e sekenkei;
ore anaa nebaya ina apa natejo ninye eitisipa ororei lo Laitoriani ninye.
Neirriwaa olaiguanani olkilikuai metalakuni ninye, ore ilo oitore iloreren neisho ninye meshomo;
eitaa ninye olkitok le nkaji enye, o Laitoriani loo masaa enyena pooki,
pee eiteng'en ilkituaak lenyena anaa enayieu, neiteng'en ilpayiani lenye eng'eno.
Nelotu sii Israel Misiri; nemany Yakobo enkop e Ham.
Neitubul Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, neitagol ninche aitalang ilmang'ati lenye.
Neibelekeny ninye iltauja lenye meibai iltung'ana lenyena, nepik isinkan lenyena olosek te nkeleekisho.
Eirriwayie Musa osinka lenye o Aron laa ninye etegelua.
Neyau nkitoduaat enyena atua iltung'ana, neyau inenking'asia atua enkop e Ham.
Neirriu ninye enaimin neitomisimis enkop, negolong'u ninche aany irorei lenyena.
Neibelekeny ninye inkariak enye aitaa osarge, near isinkir lenye metuata.
Neiput enkop enye ntuaan e nkare, o metijing'a nkajijik oo laiguanak lenye.
Eiroro ninye nelotu emus oo lojong'a, o lashe enkop enye pooki.
Eirriwaka ninye ninche enchan oo soito o enkimerlel e nkima tiatua enkop enye pooki.
Etoosho ninye isabibu o lng'abolo near ilkeek le nkop enye.
Eiroro ninye nelotu olmaati, o nkiyioitin o lmaat nemeikenayu;
naa ninche naaidaikie pooki toki nanyori te nkop, nenya ilng'anayio le nkop enye.
Etoosho ninye ilkikaunot pooki le nkop enye, ilo ng'anayioi le dukuya le ngolon enye.
Neitoki ninye arikoo Israel te nkosholai o te saabu, nemeetae obo te lelo loo loshon lenyena otarrorre.
Neng'idayu Misiri ina kata pee edumunye ninche aapuo, amu etijing'a enkuretisho te nkaraki ninche.
Neirriu Enkai enkatampoi meitushura ninche, o enkima naitawang'aki ninche te nkewarie.
Eikilikuanutua olorere endaa neirriwaki ninche nkurlen, neisho ninche imukateni kumok naaing'uaa keper.
Etabolo ninye endapidapoi neng'orunye enkare; neruko aim olpurkel anaa olkeju.
Amu etadamua ninye enkisilgata enye sinyati, o Abraham osinka lenye.
Neaku etorikoyie Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena te ng'ida, nerikoo lelo gelunot lenyena to sinkolio.
Neisho ninye ninche nkuapi oo loreren; neya ninche aajung ilng'anayio le siaai oo ltung'ana,
pee etum ninche aaibung'a nkiguanat enyena, nejurru nkitanapat enyena. Meisisi Olaitoriani.
Meisisi Olaitoriani! Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, amu eisupat ninye; amu ore enyorrata enye nauno nebikoo ntarasi!
Kaing'ae oidim aimaki mbaa e nking'asia o Laitoriani, aashu aitodolu enkisisa enye pooki?
Emayiana lelo ooing'oru isipat, lelo ooing'oru isipat nkatitin pooki!
Tadamuaki nanu, Olaitoriani, tinintodolu omom too ltung'ana linono; taretoki nanu ti nikordu ninche;
pee atum atoduaa dupoto e lelo gelunot linono, pee atum ating'idayu te nchipai o losho lino, pee atum ating'idare enjung'ore ino.
Ore iyiook o loo papa kitaasa eng'oki; kitaasa entorroni, kintarruoitie iyiook.

Ore apa etii loo papa enkop e Misiri, neitu eshilaa isiaaitin inono e nking'asia; eitu ninche edamu eneba enyorrata ino nauno, kake etogolong'akita ninche Ilo otii Shumata Aisul te Enaiposha Nanyokie.
Kake eitajewuo ninye ninche te nkaraki enkarna enye, pee etum aibalunye engolon enye magilani.
Eisikong'a ninye Enaiposha Nanyokie, netoyu; nerikoo ninye ninche aimie enguton etotiwuo anaa olpurkel.
Neaku eitajewuo ninye ninche te nkaina o lmang'atinta lenye, nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa engolon o lmang'atinta.
Neimulumul inkariak ilmang'ati lenye; eitu ninye elo obo.
Neiruk taa ina kata irorei lenyena; nerany enkisisa enye.
Kake etorikine ninche nabo kata isiaaitin enyena; neitu ninche eanyu enkiguana enye.
Kake etijing'a ninche ing'uarrat torrok ti ong'ata, nepuo aatem Enkai to lpurkel;
eishoo ninye ninche nena naatoomonutuo, kake eirriwaka ninche emuoyian e saso.
Ore ina kata too lng'oborri pee etum iltung'ana olom te nkaraki Musa o Aron, ilo sinyati lo Laitoriani,
neng'a enkop enkutuk neijoo Datan, neimisie encholiek e Abiran.
Eipang'aka sii enkima ina sholiek; nepejoo olang'at le nkima ilarruok.
Eitobirutua ninche olashe te Horeb, neserem ina kitanyaanyukoto nasholuno.
Eibelekenya ninche enkitoo e Nkai aaitaa enkitanyaanyukoto o lkiteng onya nkujit.
Eitu ninche edamu Enkai Olaitajeunoni lenye, laa ninye apa otaasa mbaa sapuki te Misiri,
o isiaaitin e nking'asia tiatua enkop e Ham, o mbaa naaitureisho te mbata e naiposha Nanyokie.
Neaku etejo ninye, keidaikie ninche - keitu ninye eitashe Musa, ilo gelunoti lenye, te dukuya ninye, pee eibelekeny ina goro enye napi pee meidaikie ninche.
Nemenaa ninche ina kop sidai, nemeeta ninche enkirukoto too nkisiligat enyena.
Neing'unyung'uny ninche too lng'oborri lenye, neitu ening oltoilo lo Laitoriani.
Ore te nkaraki ina eilepie ninye enkaina enye neiro olmumai tialo ninche nchere keisho ninche metabatatata ti ong'ata,
neisardaikie sii eishoi enye tiatua loreren, aidapashaki ninche nkuapi.
Neitoki ninche aaibung'are Baal e Peor, nenya nkishoorot naatopolosakaki ilootuata;
neitagor ninche Olaitoriani too nkiaasin enye, nedoiki olmeitai ninche.
Neitashe Finehas asaisho, neiwuang'ieki olmeitai.
Neikenakini ninye ina aajo esipata too ishoritin pooki ntarasi.
Neitagor ninche ninye too nkariak e Meriba, netum Musa enyamali te nkaraki ninche;
amu etipika ninche enkishui enye emion, neiro ninye irorei le ngoro.
Neitu ninche eidaikie iltung'ana, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninche,
kake etushulare ninche nkuapi neitamok ate easata anaa enataasa ninche.
Neisiaai ninche nena kitanyaanyukot enye, naa ninche naataa orreshet te ninche.
Neyieng aapolos ilayiok lenye, o ntoyie enye aapolosaki iloiriruani;
neibukoo ninche osarge lemeeta eleyiata, ilo sarge loo layiok lenye o ntoyie enye, apa naatopolosakitia nkitanyaanyukot e Kanaan, neisarkionieki ina kop te nkaraki ilo sarge.
Neaku etaa mesinya te nkaraki nena kiasin enye, neiborrie ninche onyek too nkiasin enye.
Neirowuaju engoro o Laitoriani te nkaraki iltung'ana lenyena, neibayu ninye enjung'ore enye;
neishooyo ninye ninche apik inkaik oo loreren, pee etum ilapa ooiba ninche aaitoria ninche.
Neibooki ilmang'ati lenye ninche enkop, neyauni ninche aapik abori engolon enye.
Ore nkatitin kumok netokordua ninye ninche, kake etogolong'utua ninche too otikinot enye, neitadouni ninche te nkaraki ntorrok enye.
Ore ake eyia etishilayie ninye osina lenye, ina kata pee eishir ninche.
Etadamua ninye te nkaraki ninche osotua lenye, neirridu ninye te risioroto e nyorrata enye nauno.
Eishoo ninche meing'urrieki, lelo pooki apa ooibung'a ninche.
Ntajeu iyiook, Olaitoriani Enkai, ninturrurru iyiook aaitayu too loreren, pee kitum aaishoo enashe enkarna ino sinyati niking'idare enkisisa ino.
Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, taata o ntarasi! Naa nchoo ejo iltung'ana pooki, “Eesai!” Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, amu aisupat ninye; amu ore enyorrata enye nauno nebikoo ntarasi!
Nchoo lelo ootokordua Olaitoriani metejo neijia, lelo ootokordua ninye aitayu tiatua enyamali
neiturrur aitung'uaa nkuapi, aitung'uaa oloosaen o loo ntoluo, neitung'uaa moikuape o kopikop.
Etilimanate embata aairrang'irrang to lpurkel, neitu etum enkoitoi nalo enkanasa nayeng'iyeng'areki.
Ore te nkaraki esumash o enkure, neiminie osiligi tiatua ninche.
Neishiraki ninche Olaitoriani tiatua enyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa osina lenye;
etorikoyie ninye ninche aimie enkoitoi naitoriori, o metabaiki enkanasa napuo aamany.
Nchoo eisho ninche Olaitoriani enashe, te nkaraki enyorrata enye nauno, te nkaraki isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia too nkera e tung'ani!
Keitaraposh ninye ilo oata enkure, ore ilo oisumash neiputaki ntokitin sidain.
Etotona embata tiatua enaimin o tiatua oloip le keeya, neikenori tiatua isinaitin too sekenke,
amu etogolong'akita ninche irorei le Nkai, nemenaa nkitanapat e Ilo otii Shumata Aisul.
Neisinanuo iltauja lenye te nkaraki enkisiaayiare nagol; nebatata ninche, nemeetae oloret ninche.
Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani te nyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche aitayu tiatua isinaitin lenye;
eyawua ninye ninche aitupuku tiatua enaimin o loip le keeya, negil iyenat enye tukul.
Nchoo eisho ninche Olaitoriani enashe te nyorrata enye nauno, te nkaraki isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia too nkera e tung'ani!
Amu etigila ninye nchomito o suyai nedung aitaa are eng'udi e sekenkei.
Etamuoyia embata te nkaraki ing'ok enye, o te nkaraki entorroni enye netum isinaitin;
neibayu iltauja lenye empukunoto pooki e ndaa, nenyikaki ninche kishomi e keeya.
Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani te nyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa osina lenye;
neirriu ninye ororei lenye, neishiunye ninche, nekordu ninche aitung'uaa enkidaata.
Nchoo eisho ninche Olaitoriani enashe te nkaraki enyorrata enye nauno, te nkaraki isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia too nkera e tung'ani!
Naa nchoo ninche eishooyo ilasarri le nashe, nelimu nkiasin enyena too sinkolioitin le ng'ida!
Eshomo embata enaiposha too melin, amirisho neinyangisho ti oriong inkariak sapuki;
nedol ninche nkiaasin o Laitoriani, isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia te enguton.
Amu eitanapa ninye, neinyeyie olkutati ogol, otudumua ilopir le naiposha.
Neilep ninche shumata, nedoyio aapuo enguton; nelepori iltauja lenye te nkaraki osina;
nepuo ninche te nkiesies neimerrimerr anaa lamerak, neiting enkarriano enye.
Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani te nyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche to sina lenye;
neitigir ninye olkutati, neitirring'ieki ilopir le naiposha.
Neng'idayu ninche te nkaraki naitirring'ieki, neyau ninye ninche ewueji enye neyieu.
Nchoo eisho ninche Olaitoriani enashe te nkaraki enyorrata enye nauno, te nkaraki isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia too nkera e tung'ani!
Nchoo eisis ninche ninye te umata oo ltung'ana, neisis ninye tiatua eumata oo lpayiani.
Keibelekeny ninye ilkejek aitaa olpurkel, neibelekeny nchorroi aitaa enkop oo lbaat,
neibelekeny enkop sidai aitaa ewueji e munyan nemebulu toki, te nkaraki enkarruoisho oo loomanya.
Neibelekeny ninye olpurkel aitaa nchorroi oo nkariak, neibelekeny enkop natoyio oo lbaat aitaa nchorroi oo nkariak.
Neitamany ninye ine lelo oata esumash, neshetu ninche enkanasa nabikie.
Etuuno ninche nkurman, neun nkurman oo sabibu netum enkikesare sapuk.
Ore te mayianata enye nebul ninche oleng; nemeisho ninche nkishu enye eaku kuti.
Ore pee eaku kuti nedoyio esiana enye, te nkaraki enkibookinoto e nkop, o enyamali o osina,
nebukoki ninye olmena lelo kituaak, neisho ninche metilimanata too nkoitoi misili;
kake kedumu ninye aitasheyie olomena aitayu tiatua osina, neitaba ilmareita lenye anaa iluaat oo ntare.
Ore lelo supati nedol neshipayu; ore lelo torrok neidang.
Ore pooki ng'ae ng'en, nchoo ening'u kuna baa; nchoo iltung'ana edamu enyorrata o Laitoriani nauno.
Etuune oltau lai, Iyie Enkai, etuune oltau lai! Karanyisho nanu, naosh olkerempe! Tuputunye lo tau lai!
Tuputunye na auo oo sinkolioitin o endule! Kainyototo nanu enasirie!
Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe Olaitoriani, tiatua olorere, kaaranyaki nanu iyie enkisisa tiatua nkuapi.
Amu ore enyorrata ino nauno naa eikitok te keper, nebaiki isipat inono keper.
Nchoo kirrepi iyie, Iyie Enkai, te keper! Nchoo enkitoo ino meeu shumata enkop pooki!
Pee etumi aatokordu ilo kirotet lino, nchoru eretoto te nkaina ino e tatene, tawalikiaki nanu!
Eisiligishore Enkai te wueji enye sinyati: ejo, “Ore te nkisisa kaor nanu Shekem, naorrior oerata le Sukot.
Enaai Gilead; enaai Manase; enkopiyia ai nagol nashurie Efraim; eng'udi ai e nkitoria Yuda.
Embeshen ai naitukuoreki Moab; shumata Edom nanu aiteleiki inkejek aainei; te Filistia nanu abuaku te nkisulata.”
Kaing'ae laariku nanu enetii enkanasa nasheta? Kaing'ae laarik nanu Edom?
Keitu iyie iyany iyiook Iyie Enkai? Milo iyie, Olaitoriani, te nebo ilmang'ati lang.
Nchoo siaake iyiook eretoto te nkaraki ilmang'ati lang, amu ene pesho eretoto e tung'ani!
Ore etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyiook naa eikiaas mbaa sapuki; Olaitoriani ninye oitunyoki enkop ilmang'ati lang.
Migira, iyie Enkai e nkisisa ai!
Amu etaboloki nkutukie torrok e lejare te nkaraki nanu, pee eiro tialo nanu mbaa e lejare.
Naaitang'or ninche too rorei le nkiba, naarasaki ninche pesho.
Enkitang'oroto ninche aalaakinye enyorrata ai, hoo duoo ninye te naomonoki ninche.
Neaku aatalaakita ninche enkiba te nyorrata, o mang'atisho te nyorrata ai.
Tegelu oltung'ani torrono metigilunore ninye, nchoo eiguanare ninye olaitang'oroni.
Te neiguanareki ninye nchoo etumieki ninye enkitadiaata; nchoo enkomono enye eikenari aajo eng'oki!
Metaa kuti nkolong'i enyena; metaa likae oya imasaa enyena!
Metaa okishin inkera enyena, neaku enkoliai enkitok enye!
Metaa iloorook kutukie inkera enyena; metaarari ninche aaipang'ie to lmuaate omanya!
Meibung'a oloisileno apa ninye ntokitin enyena pooki, meidaikie ilomon ilng'anayio le nkinyinyiret enye!
Metaa meetae hoo obo otumie ninye omom, anaa obo ninye oing'urrie nena kera enyena okishin!
Meishieki eishoi enye; meimisieki enkarna enye te ishoi e are!
Metadamuni entorroni oo loo menye te dukuya Olaitoriani, naa nchoo eaku meiwuang'ieki eng'oki e ng'otonye aajutoo.
Nchoo ninche eaku ketii dukuya Olaitoriani anaake; nchoo eiwuang'ieki endamunoto enye te nkop!
Amu eitu apa ninye edamu aitodolu esupatisho, kake etusujayie ninye olaisinani o ilo omena, o ilo otalepori oltau aar metuata.
Enyor apa ninye atedekisho; nchoo ldeketa epuonu shumata ninye! Menyor apa ninye imayianat; metalama ninche ninye!
Eishopoko ninye kewan ildeketa anaa olkila lenye, meibulu ninche osesen lenye anaa enkare, meima iloik lenyena anaa eilata!
Metotiwuo anaa olkila oimulumulare ninye, metotiwuo anaa enkeene e mpolos naa ninye erretenare anaake!
Metaa ena elaakinoto oo laitang'orok laainei naing'uaa Olaitoriani, te lelo ooiro ntorrok tialo enkishui ai!
Kake ore iyie, Olaitoriani Enkai ai, taasisho te rishata ai te nkaraki enkarna ino; amu eisupat enyorrata ino nauno, tokorduaki nanu!
Amu ara nanu aisinani namena, netalepori oltau lai tiatua nanu.
Aisha nanu anaa oloip le nteipa; aaipiripiroyioki nanu anaa olmaati.
Etashala nkung aainei te nkaraki eenata e mpukoroto e kewan; netasasa osesen lai aaku iloik ake.
Etaa nanu eikordodaa lelo laaitang'or; te naadol ninche nanu neipirripir ilukuny enye.
Taretoki, Olaitoriani Enkai ai! Ntajewuoki te risioroto e nyorrata ino nauno!
Nchoo ninche metayiolo nchere enkaina ino ena; iyie, Olaitoriani otaasa ena!
Nchoo ninche edekisho, kake eikimayian iyie! Nchoo lelo ainyalak laainei meitukurruni; metishipayu osinka lino.
Meishopokini ilaitang'orok laainei esulare; meimulumula ninche enkurruna enye anaa olkila.
Ore te nkutuk ai kaisho Olaitoriani enashe sapuk; kaisis nanu ninye tiatua eumata.
Amu keitashe ninye te nkaina e tatene e ilo omena, pee eitajeu ninye te lelo oiguanare pee ear metua.
Etiaaka Olaitoriani olkitok lai: “Totona te nkaina ai e tatene, o metaba anaa napik ilmang'ati linono, abori nkejek inono.”
Eirriwua Olaitoriani eing'uaa Sion eng'udi ino e nkitoria, intoreisho te mpolos oo lmang'ati linono!
Ore iltung'ana linono neishoru ate te nyorrata teina olong nirikoo olorora lino te ilo doinyo sinyati. Eiteru tadekenya enasirie ore anaa enkoileelio, kelotu kitisho ino aikununye neijia.
Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai, nemeibelekenya ninye, “Ira iyie olapolosani ntarasi, to lkerreti le Melkisedek.”
Etii Olaitoriani enkaina ino e tatene; near ninye ilaiguanak te nkolong e ngoro enye.
Kedung'oki ninye nkuapi enkiguana, neiput nkuapi mpopoki; near ninye ilaiguanak teina kop nalala.
Keokisho ninye too nchorroi naatii embata e nkoitoi; ore te nkaraki ina keraposhu ninye endukuya enye.
Meisisi Olaitoriani. Kaisho nanu Olaitoriani enashe to ltau lai pooki, tiatua eumata oo supati, tiatua olturrur.
Eikituaak isiaaitin o Laitoriani, neiteng'ena pooki ooshipakino.
Ebore enkanyit o enkitoo isiaaitin enyena, nebikoo esupatisho enye ntarasi.
Eishoo ninye metadamuni isiaaitin enyena sidain; kaaipirisioni Olaitoriani neeta olng'ur.
Neisho ninye endaa lelo ooure ninye; merikino aekata ninye osotua lenye.
Eitoduaa ninye iltung'ana lenyena isiaaitin enyena, aisho ninche enjung'ore oo nkuapi.
Ore esiaai oo nkaik enyena naa isipat o supati; ore nkiguanat enyena naa keirukoyu.
Eitasheyieki ntarasi o ntarasi, pee easi te sipata o te supatisho.
Eirriwaka ninye enjeunoto iltung'ana lenyena; neitanapisho ninye to sotua lenye ntarasi. Eisinyati neitureisho enkarna enye!
Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa ninye enkiterunoto e ng'eno nagut; keeta eyiolounoto lelo pooki oasishore. Kebikoo enkisisa enye ntarasi!
Meisisi Olaitoriani. Emayiana ilo tung'ani oure Olaitoriani, ilo oshipakino oleng inkitanapat enyena!
Keaku eishoi enye magilani te nkop; ore eishoi e lelo supati naa kemayiani.
Ketii dupoto o karsisisho atua enkaji enye; ore esupatisho enye nebikoo ntarasi.
Keilepaki ewang'an tiatua enaimin ilo supat; kaaipirisioni Olaitoriani, neeta olng'ur naa asipani.
Eisupat ilo tung'ani oasisho te leng'on neishooyo te sile, ilo oas mbaa enyena too sipat.
Amu meiwuang'ieki aekata olasipani; kedamuni ninye ntarasi.
Meure ninye elimunoto oo lomon torrok; keitashe oltau lenye auno, aisilig Olaitoriani.
Keitirring'a oltau lenye, meureisho ninye, o metaba anaa nedol eyieunoto enye too lmang'ati lenyena.
Eishooyie ninye pesho, eishoo ninye ilo aisinani; kebikoo esipata enye ntarasi; keishur emowuo enye te nkisisa.
Nedol oltung'ani torrono ina negoro; neony ilala nelepori; ore eyieunoto oltung'ani torrono naa keish.
Meisisi Olaitoriani! Esisa, intae, isinyat lo Laitoriani, esisa enkarna o Laitoriani!
Meisisi enkarna o Laitoriani ebaiki ena kata o ntarasi!
Ebaiki enkilepunoto e nkolong o metabaiki endoyioroto, keisisi enkarna o Laitoriani!
Olaitoriani otii shumata alus too nkuapi pooki, nelusoo enkitoo enye te keper!
Kaing'ae onyaanyukie Olaitoriani Enkai ang, natonita te shumata,
neing'or ninye enkop elakuaniki ore etii keper neing'or enkop.
Ninye odumu olaisinani too nkulupuok, nedumu olomena aitung'uaa olchala loo nkuruon,
pee eisho ninche metotona te nebo ilkituaak, te nebo ilkituaak loo ltung'ana lenyena.
Neisho ninye enkitok olupi ang, neitaa ninye entomononi nashipa naata nkera. Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Ore apa pee epuo Isiraeli aaing'uaa Misiri, nelo enkaji e Yakobo aing'uaa olorere oiro enkutuk neme enenye,
etaa Yuda ewueji enye sinyati, neaku Israel enkitoria enye.
Neing'orisho enaiposha neilanyisho, nerrinyo olkeju le Yordan alo siadi.
Neitigiran ildoinyo anaa ilmeregeshi, neitigiran ndoinyo anaa ilkuoo le kerra.
Kainyoo nikinosita iyie, naaiposha, pee isikita? O iyie, Yordan, eji pee itorrinye siadi?
O intae, ildoinyo, pee ntigiranana anaa ilmeregeshi? O intae, ndoinyo, pee intigiranana anaa ilkuoo le kerra?
Nkirikirayu na kop, te dukuya Olaitoriani, te dukuya e Nkai e Yakobo,
laa ninye oibelekeny endapidapoi aitaa enchorro e nkare, neitaa oltotoi ogol enkong'u e nkare.
Mme iyiook, Olaitoriani, mme iyiook, kake enkarna ino nchoo enkisisa, te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno o sipat inono!
Kainyoo pee ejo loshon, “Koree Enkai enye?”
Etii Enkai ang keper, neas ninye anaa enayieu.
Ore nkitanyaanyukot enye naa enkosholai o saabu, esiaai oo nkaik e tung'ana.
Neeta nkutukie kake meiro; neeta nkonyek kake medolisho.
Neeta nkiyaa kake mening'isho; neeta nkumeishin kake meing'uaisho.
Neeta nkaik kake meirrapirrapisho, o nkejek, kake meyiolo aashom; nemeitayu oltoilo too lng'ejepa lenye.
Ore lelo ooitobira nenyaanyukie ninche; naa neijia etiu lelo pooki ooisilig ninche.
Iyie Israel, isiliga Olaitoriani! Ninye eretoto inyi naa ninye elong'o inyi.
Na aji e Aron, tipika osiligi lino Olaitoriani! Ninye eretoto inyi naa ninye elong'o inyi.
Ntae kulo ooure Olaitoriani, esiliga Olaitoriani! Ninye eretoto inyi naa elong'o inyi.
Etadamua Olaitoriani iyiook; kemayian ninye iyiook; kemayian ninye enkaji e Israel; kemayian ninye enkaji e Aron.
Kemayian ninye lelo ooure Olaitoriani, ilooti o lkituaak.
Metopona intae Olaitoriani, intae o nkera inyi!
Metamayiana intae Olaitoriani, laa ninye oitobira keper o nkop!
Ore keper naa eno Laitoriani, kake ore enkop neishoo ninye nkera e tung'ani.
Meisis ilootuata Olaitoriani, nemeisis hoo obo le lelo oodoyio aapuo engira.
Kake eikisis iyiook Olaitoriani ebaiki ena kata taata o ntarasi. Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Kanyor nanu Olaitoriani amu etoning'o ninye oltoilo lai o enkomono ai,
amu aairrugoko ninye nanu enkiok enye. Ore te nkaraki ina kaipot nanu ninye inkolong'i naaba anaa inaishu.
Aatang'adutua nanu irresheta le keeya; aaibung'a nanu nkeenta emion kitok e nemeneng'a; natum nanu osina o emion.
Naitoki nanu aipot enkarna o Laitoriani: “Olaitoriani, aatasayia nanu, ntajeu enkishui ai!”
Kaaipirisioni Olaitoriani, naa asipani; neeta Enkai ang olng'ur.
Kegolie Olaitoriani olobor; ore pee aaibookini enkop, naaitajeu ninye.
Torrinyokinoyu lo tau lai enkiyeng'iyeng ino; amu kimpirisie iyie Olaitoriani.
Amu itokordua iyie enkishui ai te keeya, o nkonyek aainei too lkiyio, o nkejek aainei te rrorroto.
Kalo nanu te dukuya Olaitoriani tiatua enkop oo looishu.
Aibung'a nanu enkirukoto ai, hoo ninye te natejo, “Aaisilisiloki nanu oleng”.
Natejo nanu te siokinoto ai, “Ile pesho iltung'ana pooki.”
Kainyoo nanu aisho Olaitoriani too nkishoorot enyena pooki naaishoo nanu?
Kang'amaa nanu enkikompe e njeunoto, naipot enkarna o Laitoriani,
nalaaki Olaitoriani olmumai lai te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena pooki.
Ene tipat te dukuya Olaitoriani keeya oo sinyat lenyena.
Olaitoriani, kara nanu osinka lino, kara osinka lino, olayioni le nkaisiaayiani ino. Iyie otalaa ienat aainei.
Kaaisho nanu iyie olasar le nashe naipot enkarna o Laitoriani.
Kalak nanu ilmuma laainei to Laitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena pooki,
too lgorieti le nkaji o Laitoriani, te mpolos ino, iyie Yerusalem. Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Esisa Olaitoriani iloreren pooki! Esisa ninye intae iltung'ana pooki!
Amu eikitok enyorrata enye nauno tialo iyiook; ore esipata o Laitoriani nebikoo intarasi. Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, amu aisupat ninye; nebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi!
Nchoo Israel ejo, “Kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”
Nchoo enkaji e Aron ejo, “Kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”
Nchoo lelo ooure Olaitoriani ejo, “Kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”
Tiatua osina lai nanu aipoto Olaitoriani; naawaliki nanu Olaitoriani naalaku nanu.
Ore etii Olaitoriani enkalo ai maureisho nanu. Kaa nanu aaidim oltung'ani aitaasa?
Etii Olaitoriani enkalo ai pee aaretu nanu, kaing'or nanu te nkisulata lelo laaiba nanu.
Enaikash te nesaruni Olaitoriani alang te neisiligi iltung'ana.
Enaikash te nesaruni Olaitoriani alang te neisiligi ilkituaak.
Aatamana nanu iloreren pooki aamuat; ore te nkarna o Laitoriani namir nanu ninche!
Aatamana ninche nanu aamuat, naaimu too nchot pooki; ore te nkarna o Laitoriani namir nanu ninche!
Aatamana ninche anaa lotorok, neyupuyup anaa enkima oo lkiku; ore te nkarna o Laitoriani namir nanu ninche!
Aaturrumoyioki nanu oleng, eyieu arriaa, kake aatareto Olaitoriani.
Olaitoriani engolon ai naa osinkolio lai; etaa ninye enjeunoto ai.
Enining'o isinkolioitin sidain le nkisulata tiatua ilng'oborri le lelo sinyat: “Te nkaina enye e tatene eas Olaitoriani enking'asia,
eilepieki enkaina e tatene o Laitoriani, te nkaina enye e tatene eas Olaitoriani inenking'asia!”
Maye nanu, kake kalo aishu, naiken nkiasin o Laitoriani.
Aaitamio nanu Olaitoriani oleng, kake eitu ninye aapalaa matua.
Tabolokoki nanu nchomito oo sipat, pee atum nanu aima ninche nalo aisho Olaitoriani enashe.
Ena ninye kishomi o Laitoriani; ninye eimu ilo asipani.
Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe amu kitawalikia nitaa iyie enjeunoto ai.
Ore ilo soit otanyaita ilashetak netaa ole ndukuya olmairroto.
Enkiaas o Laitoriani ena; enking'asia too nkonyek ang.
Enkolong ena naitobira Olaitoriani; matishipakinoto niking'ida te ninye.
Ntajeu iyiook, kitasayia iyie, Olaitoriani! Olaitoriani, kitasayia iyie, nchoo iyiook dupoto!
Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani! Kimayian iyie too mayianat naaing'uaa enkaji o Laitoriani.
Olaitoriani ninye Enkai, neishoo ninye iyiook ewang'an. Embung'a ilng'osil too lkererin ipuopuo, o entabaiki imowuarak o lperere lo lasar!
Ira iyie Enkai ai, kaaisho nanu iyie enashe; ira iyie Enkai ai, naa kaarrep nanu iyie.
Oi enchoo Olaitoriani enashe amu aisupat ninye; nebikoo enyorrata enye nauno intarasi.
Emayiana lelo lemeeta ileyiat too nkoitoi enye, lelo oopuo too nkitanapat o Laitoriani!
Emayiana lelo ooibung shakenisho enye, lelo ooing'oru ninye too ltauja lenye pooki.
Lelo lemeas entorroni, kake nkoitoi enyena epuoyie!
Intanapishe iyie too nkitanapat inono pee eibung'i ninche aakurraki.
Oi naaji te neitashe nkoitoi aainei te nkibung'ata oo nkitanapat inono!
Nemaaitukurruni naa nanu, amu aipirakinye nkoitoi aainei nkitanapat inono.
Kaaisis nanu iyie to ltau sidai te nayiolou nkiguanat inono naasipa.
Kasuj nanu nkitanapat inono; mikinturraa nanu tukul!
Kaji eiko olbarnoti pee eitaasidan inkoitoi enyena? Tenegolie ninye te risioroto o rorei lino.
To ltau lai pooki nanu aaing'oru iyie; mikincho nanu matalamari aing'uaa nkitanapat inono!
Atushuma nanu ororei lino to ltau lai, pee maas ake eng'oki tialo iyie.
Mikisisi iyie Olaitoriani; nteng'enaki nanu nkitanapat inono!
Te nkutuk ainanu aibalunye nkiguanat pooki naaing'uaa enkutuk ino.
Too nkoitoi e shakenisho ino nanu ashipa anaa te neshipakinoi karsisisho sapuk.
Kaibirribir nanu nkiguanat inono, naipirakinye nkonyek aainei inkoitoi inono.
Kashipakino nanu nkitanapat inono; maarikino nanu ororei lino.
Ntaasa mbaa supati osinka lino, pee atum nanu ataa kaishu, nasuj ororei lino.
Taboloki nkonyek aainei pee atum atoduaa mbaa e nking'asia naaing'uaa enkitanapata ino.
Kara nanu olomoni te nkop, mikisudoriyie nanu nkitanapat inono.
Etalepori oltau lai te yieunoto oo nkiguanat inono nkatitin pooki.
Iyie oisikong'a iloowuasa, lelo oodiaa, lelo oolimana aaing'uaa nkitanapat inono.
Iwuang'ie te nanu elap enye o lmena lenye, amu aibung'a nanu shakenisho ino.
Ore sii eirragita ilkituaak aarreshito nanu, nkiguanat inono ninche eibirribir osinka lino.
Shakenisho ino naaitiship nanu, ninche naaiguen nanu aautaa.
Eirruge oltau lai abaiki enkop; ntopiwuoki nanu te risioroto o rorei lino!
Te nairo nanu aimaki nkoitoi aainei, nikiwaliki iyie nanu; nteng'enaki nanu nkiteng'enat inono!
Nchooki nanu matayiolo asipu nkitanapat inono, naa kaibirribir nanu isiaaitin inono e nking'asia.
Etalepori oltau lai te nkaraki osina; ntagoloki nanu te risioroto o rorei lino!
Ntalamaki nanu nkoitoi e lejare; ore te mpiris ino nteng'enaki nanu nkitanapat inono!
Ategelua nanu enkoitoi oo sipat, atipika nanu nkiguanat inono dukuya nanu.
Aigarakine nanu shakenisho ino, Olaitoriani; mikincho nanu maaitukurruni!
Kalo nanu aipirri te nkoitoi oo nkitanapat inono ti nikintalalaki nanu eyiolounoto ai!
Nteng'enaki nanu, Olaitoriani, enkoitoi oo nkitanapat inono; naa kaibung nanu o metabaiki enkiting'oto.
Nchooki nanu eyiolounoto, pee atum aibung'a enkitanapata ino, nasipu to ltau lai pooki.
Torikoyioki nanu te nkoitoi oo nkitanapat inono, amu ninye ashipakino.
Ntonyorra oltau lai shakenisho ino, nimintonyor dupoto.
Mbelekenya nkonyek aainei pee meing'or mbaa e pesho, nikincho nanu enkishui too nkoitoi inono.
Ntudupa to sinka lino enkisiligata ino, naa ninye ene lelo likiure iyie.
Mbelekenya ntung'uayioki ina sulare naure, amu eisupati nkitanapat inono.
Ng'ura ajo kanyok aibung inkitanapat inono; ore te supatisho ino nchooki nanu enkishui!
Nchoo ina nyorrata ino nauno elotu enatii nanu, Olaitoriani, nchoo enjeunoto ino elotu te risioroto e nkisiligata ino;
pee atum taa ewalata te lelo laaikordod, amu ororei lino nanu aisilig.
Nimiwuang'ie ororei le sipata te nkutuk ai, amu ore osiligi lai netii atua nkiguanat inono.
Kaibung nanu nkitanapat inono anaake, ntarasi o ntarasi;
naa kalo nanu te lakunoto, amu aing'orua nanu nkitanapat inono.
Kalo sii airo shakenisho ino te dukuya ilaiguanak, nemaaitukurruni nanu;
amu too nkitanapat inono nanu atum enchipai, amu ninche nanu anyor.
Kayanyit nanu nkitanapat inono, amu ninche anyor, naa kaibirribir nanu nkitanapat inono.
Tadamu ororei lino to sinka lino, laa ninye nanu kinchoo maisiliga.
Ena ninye enkitagoloto ai te nkata o sina, nchere kaaisho nanu enkisiligata ino enkishui.
Aasukenyita nanu oleng lelo lemeure Enkai, kake maibelekenya nanu aing'uaa enkitanapata ino.
Te nadamu nanu nkiguanat inono ebaiki apa moitie, naitagoluo nanu, Olaitoriani.
Aaibung'a nanu emion oleng te nkaraki lelo arruok, lelo ootanyaita nkitanapat inono.
Nkitanapat inono naataa isinkolioitin laainei tiatua ena kop nara omoni.
Kadamu nanu enkarna ino kewarie, Olaitoriani, naibung nkitanapat inono.
Aatadoikio nanu ena mayianata, nchere aibung'a nanu nkitanapat inono.
Olaitoriani ninye erubata ai; atonyorrayie nanu ajo kaibung nkitanapat inono.
Ore to ltau lai pooki atonyuaa nanu aing'oru omom ino; ng'urrieki nanu te risioroto e nkisiligata ino.
Tenadamu nanu inkoitoi inono, naibelekeny inkejek aainei aipirie enkoitoi ino;
naisarrisar nanu eitu aimutie aibung nkitanapat inono.
Ore ninye te naarresh nkeenta e ilo torrono, maarikino nanu enkitanapata ino.
Ore te mpolos e nkewarie naainyototo nanu aisis iyie, te nkaraki inkitanapat inono naasipa.
Kara nanu ole ncholiek e lelo likiure iyie, ole lelo ooibung nkitanapat inono.
Ore enkop pooki, Olaitoriani, ebore enyorrata ino nauno; nteng'enaki nanu nkikoot inono!
Ntaasa iyie osinka lino isupati, Olaitoriani, te risioroto o rorei lino.
Nteng'enaki nanu enkiguana sidai o eng'eno, amu airuko nanu nkitanapat inono.
Ore apa eton eitu aaitamei natapong'ori nanu; kake aibung'a taata ororei lino.
Ira iyie supat nias isupati, nteng'enaki nanu nkoitoi inono.
Ore lelo lemeure Enkai naaiteenikitia ninche elejare, kake aibung'a nanu to ltau lai pooki nkitanapat inono;
meeta kulo tung'ana ening'unoto kake kashipakino nanu nkitanapat inono.
Eisidai apa te naaitamioki nanu, pee atum atayiolo nkitanapat inono.
Ore enkitanapata naing'uaa enkutuk ino naa eisidai alang inkalifuni e saabu o enkosholai.
Inkaik inono naaitautuo nanu naaitobiru; nchooki nanu eyiolounoto pee atum aiteng'enuo too nkitanapat inono.
Ore lelo likiure iyie naadol nanu neng'idayu, te nkaraki naisiliga nanu ororei lino.
Kayiolo nanu, Olaitoriani, nchere nkiguanat inono naasipa, nayiolo nchere te sipata iyie kintamio nanu.
Nchoo enyorrata ino nauno etaanu pee aaitagol nanu, te risioroto e nkisiligata nisiligie osinka lino.
Nchoo olng'ur lino elotu enatii, pee atum nanu ataa kaishu, amu nkitanapat inono naaitiship nanu.
Nchoo meitukurruni lelo lemeure Enkai, amu aaiteenikitia ninche elejare; ore nanu, naa nkitanapat inono ninche aibirribir.
Nchoo lelo likiure iyie aaibelekenyakino nanu, pee etum aatayiolo shakenisho ino.
Metaa meeta oltau lai entioto too nkitanapat inono, pee maaitukurruni nanu.
Etalepori oltau lai eyieu enjeunoto ino; ororei lino nanu aisiligita.
Eiliilaitie nkonyek aainei aanyita enkisiligata ino; naikilikuanu ajo, “Kanu kenya kintagol nanu?”
Atotiwuo nanu anaa olbene le naisho oo sabibu otii atua empuruo, kake eitu ake aarikino nkitanapat inono.
Ke nkata nabaa eng'iri eanyisho osinka lino? Kanu iyie inguanare lelo laaisilisil nanu?
Aatuturokito lelo lemeure Enkai ngumot, lelo tung'ana lemeibung nkitanapat inono.
Ore nkitanapat inono pooki naa kesipa, naaisilisil nanu iltung'ana te lejare; taretuoki nanu!
Enkiti wueji pee eitu aaishie nanu te nkop; kake eitu nanu aiturraa nkitanapat inono.
Ore teina nyorrata ino nauno telekuaki nanu pee atum aibung'a shakenisho e nkutuk ino.
Kebikoo ororei lino, Olaitoriani, ntarasi te keper.
Ore esupatisho ino nebaiki iishoritin pooki; iyie oitayio enkop nintasheyie ninye.
Ore te nkitanapata ino neitashe ntokitin pooki o metabaiki ena olong; amu ore ntokitin pooki naa iyie eisiaai.
Te neme apa nkitanapat inono naaitiship nanu, anaata nanu aidaaiyie te nkitamioto ai.
Maarikino aekata nanu nkitanapat inono; amu te ninche nanu kinchoo iyie enkishui.
Kara nanu olino, ntajewuoki; amu aing'orua nanu nkiteng'enat inono.
Eirragita ilarruok pee aaidaikie nanu; kake atadamua nanu shakenisho ino.
Atoduaa nanu eng'orikinoto oo ntokitin pooki sidain, kake meeta inkitanapat inono eng'orikinoto.
Kebaa enyorrata nanyor nanu nkitanapat inono! Ninye nanu aibirribir endama pooki.
Enkiteng'enata ino naaiteng'en nanu matalang'a ilmang'ati laainei, amu etii te nebo nanu nkatitin pooki.
Kaata nanu eyiolounoto alang ilaiteng'enak laainei pooki, amu iutarot inono ninche nanu aibirribir.
Kaning'u nanu mbaa oleng alang oltung'ani moruo, amu aibung'ita nanu nkitanapat inono.
Narishie nanu nkejek aainei pooki oitoi torrono, pee atum aibung'a ororei lino.
Maibelekenya nanu apaash nkitanapat inono, amu kinteng'ena iyie nanu.
Kemelok oleng irorei linono te naishamisham, kemelok aalang enaisho te nkutuk ai!
Ore too nkitanapat inono natum nanu eyiolounoto; ore te nkaraki ina, kaiba nanu pooki oitoi torrono.
Ore ororei lino naa oltaa loo nkejek aainei naa ewang'an te nkoitoi ai.
Ainosa nanu olmumai naitadedeyie pee atum atisipu inkitanapat inono naasipa.
Anoto nanu osina kitok; nchooki nanu enkishui, Olaitoriani, te risioroto o rorei lino!
Tang'amu nkishoorot aainei e nkisisa, Olaitoriani, nikinteng'en nanu inkitanapat inono.
Aibung'ita nanu enkishui ai te nkaina ai anaake, kake eitu nanu aarikino nkitanapat inono.
Aatipikaka nanu oltorrono orreshet, kake mapaashari nanu alam inkitanapat inono.
Shakenisho ino ninye enjung'ore ai ntarasi; ee, ninche eng'ida o ltau lai.
Aibelekenya nanu oltau lai aipirie nkitanapat inono, ntarasi o metabaiki enkiting'oto.
Kaiba nanu iltung'ana ooing'ashing'ash, kake kanyor nanu inkitanapat inono.
Ira iyie enkisudoroto ai o elong'o ai; ororei lino nanu aisiliga.
Entalamaki nanu intae ilarruok, pee atum aibung'a nkitanapat e Nkai ai.
Mbung'aki nanu te risioroto e nkisiligata ino, pee aton aishu, nimikincho nanu manoto enkurruna to siligi lai!
Mbung'aki nanu ilepieki, pee atum ataseriana, natum atishilai nkitanapat inono nkolong'i pooki!
Itanya iyie lelo oopaash nkitanapat inono; ee, ore enkeleekisho enye naa pesho.
Ore ilarruok pooki le nkop niwuang'ie anaa isuut; ore te nkaraki ina kanyor nanu shakenisho ino.
Eikirikira osesen lai kiure iyie, naure nanu nkiguanat inono.
Ataasa nanu embae nasipa naishiaakino; mikipalaki nanu ilaitorogonyak laainei.
Taa iyie olaitaishekinoni lo sinka lino te nkaraki isupati; mincho lelo lemeure Enkai aaibooki enkop.
Eiliilaitie nkonyek aainei aing'orita enjeunoto ino, naing'or enkitabaroto e nkisiligata ino supat.
Ntaasa osinka lino te risioroto e nyorrata ino nauno, nikinteng'en nanu inkitanapat inono.
Kara nanu osinka lino; nchooki nanu eyiolounoto, pee atum atayiolo shakenisho ino!
Etaa enkata naasisho Olaitoriani, amu etigilaki inkitanapat inono.
Kanyor nanu inkitanapat inono, aitalang saabu nasila.
Ore te nkaraki ina aiturubare nanu iroruat aainei nkiguanat inono pooki; aiba nanu pooki oitoi torrono.
Ene nking'asia shakenisho ino; ore te nkaraki ina neibung oltau lai ninche.
Ore embolokinoto o rorei lino neyau ewang'an, neitaarriyian ilo lemeeta eng'eno.
Aipang'ipang nanu ang'aita enkutuk, amu aanyita inkitanapat inono.
Mbelekenyayu ing'uraki, niking'urrie nanu, anaa oshi ake enintaas lelo oonyor enkarna ino.
Ntirring'ie iroruat aainei te risioroto e nkisiligata ino, nimincho entorroni maaitoria nanu.
Talakuaki nanu too ltung'ana laaibooki enkop, pee atum aibung'a nkitanapat inono.
Nchoo meitawang'aki enkomom ino osinka lino, nikinteng'en nanu nkitanapat inono.
