Itegelua iyie shakenisho ino too sipat o te supatisho pooki.
Aainosita nanu olom, te nkaraki nemeshilaa ilmang'ati laainei irorei linono.
Ore enkisiligata ino netetemaki oleng, nenyor osinka lino ninye.
Kara nanu oti naatemenaki, kake maarikino nanu inkitanapat inono.
Ore esipata ino nesipa ntarasi, ore inkitanapat inono nesipa.
Eewuo enyamali o sina shumata nanu, kake inkitanapat inono naaitiship nanu.
Kesipa shakenisho ino ntarasi; nchooki nanu eyiolounoto pee aton aishu.
Aishirita nanu to ltau lai pooki; tawalikiaki nanu Olaitoriani! Kaibung nanu inkitanapat inono.
Aaishiraka nanu iyie; ntajewuoki nanu; pee atum atisipu shakenisho ino.
Adumunye nanu aishir enamanarie enkakenya, naishir te nkaraki eretoto; naisilig nanu irorei linono.
Maaiken nanu nkonyek enkewarie pooki, pee atum aibirribirra enkisiligata ino.
Toning'o oltoilo lai te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno; Olaitoriani, ore te nkaraki isipat inono tagolie enkishui ai.
Etinyikutua lelo laaisilisil nanu too ntorrok; kelakuaniki ninche nkitanapat inono.
Kake itaana iyie, Olaitoriani, nesipa nkitanapat inono pooki.
Atayiolo apa nanu moitie te shakenisho ino nchere intobira apa ninche ntarasi.
Ing'ura iyie osina lai, nikikordu nanu, amu maarikino nanu enkitanapata ino.
Taa iyie liking'or nikilaku nanu; nchooki nanu enkishui te risioroto e nkisiligata ino!
Elakuaniki enjeunoto ilarruok, amu meing'oru ninche inkiguanat inono.
Eikitok olng'ur lino, Olaitoriani; nchooki nanu enkishui te risioroto oo sipat inono.
Kumok ilaisilisilok laainei o lmang'ati laainei; kake malimana nanu apaash shakenisho ino.
Kaing'or nanu lelo lemeisiligayu te ngoro, amu meibung ninche inkitanapat inono.
Toduaa eneba enyorrata nanyor nanu inkiguanat inono Olaitoriani! Tagolie enkishui ai te risioroto e nyorrata ino nauno.
Ore esiana o rorei lino naa esipata, ore pooki ng'ae loo sipat oo inkiguanat inono nebikoo ntarasi.
Kaaisilisil nanu ilkituaak metii emporeet, kake keitashe oltau lai eanyit irorei linono.
Kashipakino nanu ororei lino, anaa oltung'ani onoto imasaa kumok.
Kaiba nanu namen entorroni, kake kanyor inkitanapat inono.
Katitin naapishana nanu aaisis iyie te nkolong te nkaraki inkiguanat inono naasipa.
Keeta eseriani kitok lelo oonyor enkitanapata ino; meetae entoki narror ninye.
Aisiligita nanu enjeunoto ino, Olaitoriani, naas nanu inkitanapat inono.
Keibung oltau lai shakenisho ino; nanyor nanu shakenisho ino oleng.
Kaibung nanu inkiguanat inono o shakenisho ino, amu etii nkoitoi aainei pooki dukuya iyie.
Nchoo enkishirata ai elotu dukuya iyie, Olaitoriani; nchooki nanu ening'unoto te risioroto o rorei lino.
Nchoo enkomono ai elotu dukuya iyie; tokorduaki nanu te risioroto o rorei lino.
Kelimu enkutuk ai enkisisa ino amu kinteng'en nanu inkiteng'enat inono.
Kerany olng'ejep lai irorei linono, amu ore inkitanapat inono pooki nesipa.
Nchoo enkaina ino etaanu pee aaret nanu, amu ategelua nanu nkiguanat inono.
Kaanyita nanu enjeunoto ino, Olaitoriani, naa nkitanapat inono naaitiship.
Nchooki nanu enkishui, pee aatum aisisa, naa nchoo nkiguanat inono aaret nanu.
Ashomo nanu apong'ori anaa enker naimina; ing'oru osinka lino, amu maarikino nanu inkitanapat inono.
Ore to sina lai aishiraka nanu Olaitoriani, pee aatum atawaliki nanu.
“Tokorduaki nanu, Olaitoriani, too ltung'ana le lejare, teilo ng'ejep olejisho.”
Kainyoo kenya kinchori iyie? Naa kainyoo kenya kintokini aaitaas, iyie lo ng'ejep le lejare?
Mbaa naapi o lang'oroni, naaitagoloki too nkuk naaishu o lchani!
Oi nanu, olomanya atua Meshek, obikito too lng'oborri le Kedar!
Atobiko te nkata naado tiatua lelo ooiba eseriani.
Kanyor nanu eseriani; kake te nairo mbaa eseriani naa lo larrabal ninche.
Karaposhu nanu nkonyek aainei aing'or ildoinyo. Kaji eing'uaa eretoto ai?
Olaitoriani eing'uaa eretoto ai, laa ninye oitobira keper o enkop.
Nemeisho ninye meigusugusieki enkeju ino, ore ilo likirrip iyie nemeimug.
Kesipa ore ilo orrip Israel nemeimug nemeirura.
Olaitoriani ninye olarriponi lino; Olaitoriani ninye oloip lino te nkalo enkaina ino e tatene.
Nimikiar iyie enkolong te ndama, anaa olapa te nkewarie.
Olaitoriani likirrip iyie too ntorrok pooki; naa kerrip ninye enkishui ino.
Kerrip Olaitoriani enkipang'ata ino o enjing'unoto ino, ebaiki ena kata o ntarasi.
Atishipe pee aajoki ninche, “Maape enkaji o Laitoriani!”
Eitasheito nkejek ang too nchomito inono, iyie Yerusalem!
Yerusalem nateshetaki anaa enkanasa, naibung'a tenebo,
naa ninye eilep iloshon aapuo, lelo oshon lo Laitoriani, anaa apa enaitanapaki Israel, pee eisho enkarna o Laitoriani enashe.
Eirragieki ilorikan le nkiguana teine, lelo orikan le nkitoo le nkaji e Daudi.
Entoomon te nkaraki eseriani e Yerusalem! “Metubula lelo likinyor iyie!
Meeu eseriani isunta inono, nelotu erripoto atua iltaleta inono!”
Ore too lalashera laainei o le ncholiek ai, najo nanu, “Metijing'a eseriani atua Yerusalem!”
Ore te nkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai ang, ekaing'oru nanu esupatisho ino.
Iyie nanu araposhoki inkonyek aainei, iyie olotonita to lorika le nkitoo te keper!

Ore anaa enaing'or inkonyek oo sinkan olkitok lenye, anaa enaing'or inkonyek enkaisiaayiani enkaina eina naitore ninye, neijia etiu inkonyek ang eing'or Olaitoriani Enkai ang, o metaba anaa neing'urrie ninye iyiook.
Ing'urrie iyiook, Olaitoriani, ing'urrie iyiook, amu kinoto iyiook nkisilisilot naalus.
Te nkata naado etusukenya iyiook lelo ooisikarra, nemenaa iyiook lelo oowuasa.
Te neme apa Olaitoriani otii enkalo ang nchoo taa Israel ejo tena kata -
te neme taa apa Olaitoriani otii enkalo ang, ina kata pee edumakino iyiook iltung'ana aagilunore,
anaata etoijoitie ninche iyiook kinchu, ina kata pee eyupuyup engoro enye tialo iyiook;
naa anaata etooroyie iyiook oloirrag le nkare, anaata eimisie iyiook enkare;
anaata eima ilopir le nkare shumata iyiook.
Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu eitu ninye eishooyo iyiook matotiu anaa eng'ues natarreshoki te rishata oo lala lenye.
Kilanyishote iyiook anaa emotonyi te ilo rreshet lo larreshoni etigile orreshet, nikilanyishote iyiook.
Etii eretoto ang atua enkarna o Laitoriani, laa ninye oitobira keper o enkop.
Ore lelo ooisilig Olaitoriani netiu anaa oldoinyo le Sion, lemeidimi aaigusugusie, kake kebik ninye ntarasi.
Ore anaa enamanita ildoinyo Yerusalem, neijia etiu Olaitoriani emanita iltungana lenyena, ebaiki ena kata o intarasi.
Meitoriesho ilarruok te nkop oo supati pee meitorioo ake isupati inkaik enye aas intorrok.
Ntaasa isupati, Olaitoriani, lelo oonyor isupati, o lelo supati too ltauja lenye!
Kake ore lelo ooibelekenya aapuo aaim inkoitoi enye naalojiloja, nelo Olaitoriani arikoo ninche tenebo lelo torrok! Meeu eseriani Israel!
Ore apa pee errinyu Olaitoriani lelo ootaarayioki le Sion, nikitiu iyiook anaa ilooidetidet.
Nikikueni oleng, nikibuaku te ng'ida; nejo ninche tiatua nkuapi, “Etaasa Olaitoriani mbaa sapuki te nkaraki ninche.”
Etaasa Olaitoriani mbaa sapuki te nkaraki iyiook; kitishipate iyiook.
Torrinyoki iyiook Olaitoriani engolon ang, meikununye anaa nchorroi e Negeb!
Nchoo lelo oounisho too lkiyio eikesu too mbuakunot e ng'ida!
Ore ilo olo eishirita, enapita olantererai olo aun, nelotu ang too mbuakunot e ng'ida, enapita enkikesare enye.
Te neitu eshet Olaitoriani enkaji, ore lelo ooshet, pesho eekenya. Te neitu errip Olaitoriani enkanasa, ore lelo oorrip pesho eshololo.
Te mpesho edumunyenye intae tadekenya, nimutietie eitu ipuopuo aairura, ipuopuo aaing'oru endaa ninyanya; amu keisho Olaitoriani ilo onyor lenye njo.
Ore nkera naa ninche enjung'ore naing'uaa Olaitoriani, ore nkera naa nkishoorot naaing'uaa ninye.
Ore nkera naatum oltung'ani te kitisho, netiu anaa mbaa te nkaina o lmurrani
Kemayiana ilo tung'ani oiputa emootian enye mbaa! Medol ninye enkurruna te neirorie ilmang'ati lenyena te kishomi.
Kemayiana pooki ng'ae oure Olaitoriani, ilo olo too nkoitoi enyena!
Amu inya iyie ilng'anayio le nkisiayiare oo nkaik inono; ishipayu iyie neaku sidain mbaa tialo iyie.
Naa ketiu enkitok ino anaa olchani loo lng'anayio tiatua enkaji ino; netiu nkera inono anaa inkaitubulu oo loirienito emanita emisa ino.
Neijia eikunakini emayianata eilo tung'ani oure Olaitoriani.
Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani etii Sion, toduaa iyie dupoto e Yerusalem, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino!
Tobikoi toduaa nkera oo nkera inono! Meeu eseriani Israel!
“Aaisilisilo ilmang'ati laainei nkatitin kumok ebaiki kitisho ai,” nchoo Israel ejo -
“Aaisilisilo ninche nkatitin kumok ebaiki kitisho ai, kake eitu aidimu ninche.
Ore ilaturok netuturo ninche enkoriong ai, neitoodor ninche ilbaat lenye.”
Ore Olaitoriani naa olasipani; etudung'o ninye nkeenta e ilo arruoni.
Ore lelo pooki ooiba Sion, nchoo meitukurruni nerrinyi siadi!
Metotiwuo ninche anaa olkujita otii shumata e nkaji, ilo otoyu eton eitu ebulu,
ilo lemeiput enkaina o ladung'oni, lemeaku erridata te ilo oenisho.
Ore lelo oogiroo nemejo ninche, “Meeu emayianata o Laitoriani shumata iyie! Kimayian intae te nkarna o Laitoriani!”
Tiatua enguton aaishiraka nanu, Olaitoriani!
Olaitoriani, toning'o oltoilo lai! Nchoo nkiyiaa inono meinining'o oltoilo le sayiata ai!
Amaa, tenaa inken intorrok ang, Olaitoriani, kanaata aa ng'ae oidim aitasho?
Kake iata iyie empalikinoto pee kitumi aatureita.
Aanyita nanu Olaitoriani, ninye eanyu oltau lai naa ororei lenye nanu aisiliga.
Eanyita oltau lai Olaitoriani alang eanyunoto naanyu ilarripok enkakenya, elusoo te anyunoto naanyu ilarripok enkakenya.
Iyie Israel, isiliga Olaitoriani! Amu Olaitoriani etii enyorrata nauno, naa ninye etii enkordunoto kitok.
Naa kekordu ninye Israel too ntorrok enye pooki.
Olaitoriani, eitu epashipashu oltau lai, neitu eshumunye nkonyek aainei aaing'or shumata. Maitanyamal nanu kewan too mbaa kituaak o too mbaa e nking'asia te nanu.
Kake aitirring'ie nanu naitobor oltau lai, anaa enkerai naitigiraki to lkina le ng'otonye; etotiwuo oltau lai anaa enkerai naitigiraki.
Iyie Israel, isiliga Olaitoriani ebaiki ena olong o ntarasi.
Tadamu, Olaitoriani, te nkaraki Daudi, ilo sina pooki apa onoto ninye;
einosa ninye olmumai to Laitoriani, nenya ninye olmumai te ilo magilani le Yakobo,
“Majing nanu atua enkaji ai nemajing endapash ai;
maaiken nanu nkonyek aainei airura nemaimug aimul inkonyek aainei,
o metaba anaa naing'uraki Olaitoriani ewueji, ewueji nebikie ina Ai magilani e Yakobo.”
Kitoning'o iyiook aajo etii Osanduku lo sotua Efrata, nikitum iyiook too nkong'at e Yaar.
“Maape iyiook emanyisho o Laitoriani; mateserem iyiook ti abori nkejek enyena!”
Tudumunye, Olaitoriani, shomo ewueji ino e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata, iyie o sanduku lino le nkidimata.
Nchoo meishopokini ilapolosak linono esupatisho, naa nchoo isinyat linono metabuaku te ng'ida.
Ore te nkaraki osinka lino Daudi mimbelekeny enkomom e ilo lino otubukokoki eilata aaput.
Einosa Olaitoriani tialo Daudi olmumai le dede, nemeitoki ninye aibelekenya te ilo mumai: “Ore obo loo layiok lo sesen lino naa kaitotonie nanu olorika lino le nkitoo.
Te neibung ilayiok linono olning'o lai o shakenisho ai nalo nanu aiteng'en ninche, ore sii kepuo ilayiok lenye aatonie olorika lino le nkitoo ntarasi.”
Amu etegelua Olaitoriani Sion; etonyorra ninye aitaa emanyisho enye:
“Ewueji ai nayeng'iyeng'are ena ntarasi; ene nanu abikie amu atonyorra nanu ene.
Naa kamayian nanu ndaiki enyena oleng; naitaraposh lelo aisinak lenyena too ndaiki.
Ore ilapolosak lenyena naisho enjeunoto, ore isinyat lenyena naisho mbuakunot e ng'ida.
Ore teine naisho nanu oinoti obo le Daudi meishuro; aitobira nanu oltaa te nkaraki ilo otubukokoki eilata aaput.
Ore ilmang'ati lenyena naishopoki enkurruna, kake ore te dukuya enye neishopokini enkopiyia e nkitoo naikishiaan.”
Ng'ura Kebaa esidano o enchipai te netoni ilalashera to lning'o!
Etiu anaa eilata nagol enkinyang'a te ndukuya, eruko ajing olmunyei, ajing olmunyei le Aron, eruko adoiki emurt o lkila lenye!
Etiu anaa enkoileelio e Harmon, nadoiki ildoinyo le Sion! Amu teine eitanapishe Olaitoriani imayianat, e nkishui ntarasi.
Wootu, maisisa Olaitoriani, intae isinkan pooki lo Laitoriani, lelo ooitashe kewarie tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani!
Elepie nkaik inyi teine wueji sinyati, esisa Olaitoriani!
Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani etii Sion, ilo oitobira keper o enkop!
Meisisi Olaitoriani! Meisisi enkarna o Laitoriani, enchoru enkisisa intae isinkan lo Laitoriani,
intae lelo ooitashe tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, too lgorieti le nkaji e Nkai ang!
Esisa Olaitoriani, amu aisupat Olaitoriani; enterrep enkarna enye, amu kaaipirisioni ninye!
Amu etegelaka Olaitoriani kewan Yakobo, etegelua Israel aitaa olenye.
Amu ayiolo nanu ajo aikitok Olaitoriani, nayiolo nchere etii Olaitoriani lang te shumata nkaitin pooki.
Ore enaba anaa enayieu Olaitoriani neas ninye te keper o te nkop, tiatua inaaiposha o too neegut pooki.
Ninye oishoo nkatampo meilepa too neeiting'ie enkop, ninye oitobira nkiwuang'at te nkata e nchan neyau olkutati aitung'uaa nkajijik enyena naashumishoreki.
Ninye apa otara ilkikaunot le Misiri metuata, iloo ltung'ana o loo ng'uesi,
ilo laa ore tiatua empolos ino, iyie Misiri, neirriu nkitoduaat e nking'asia, agilunore Farao o sinkan lenyena pooki.
Ninye apa ilo otoosho nkuapi kumok nesesekuan ilaiguanak magil:
Sihon, olaiguanani le Amori o Oog, olaiguanani le Bashan, o nkitoriat pooki e Kanaan.
Neishooyo enkop enye aitaa enjung'ore, enjung'ore too ltung'ana lenye loo Siraeli.
Kebikoo enkarna ino, Olaitoriani, ntarasi o ntarasi, ira iyie ning'oti tiatua iishoritin pooki.
Amu keitasheyie Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena too sipat, neing'urrie isinkan lenyena.
Ore nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin oo nkuapi naa enkosholai o saabu eitobirunyeki, isiaaitin oo nkaik e tung'ani.
Keeta ninche nkutukie, kake meiro, keeta nkonyek kake medolisho.
Keeta nkiyiaa kake mening'isho, nemeeta enkiyang'et too nkutukie enye.
Metotiwuo anaa ninche lelo ooitobiru ninche! Ee metotiwuo neijia pooki ng'ae oisilig ninche!
Na aji e Israel, esisa Olaitoriani! Na aji e Aron, esisa Olaitoriani!
Na aji e Lawi, esisa Olaitoriani! Intae kulo ooure Olaitoriani, esisa Olaitoriani!
Esisa Olaitoriani te Sion, ilo obikito le Yerusalem! Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe amu eisupat ninye, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.
Enchoo enashe Enkai oo nkaitin, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.
Enchoo enashe Olaitoriani loo laitoriak, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
ilo laa ninye ake oas ine nking'asia sapuki, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
ilo oitobira keper te nkarriyiano, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
ilo oisalaasha enkop natoyio te shumata nkariak, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
ilo oitobira iwang'aritin sapuki, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
neitobir enkolong meitoria endama, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
neitobir olapa o lakir meitoria enkewarie, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
ilo apa otara metuata ilkikaunot le Misiri, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.
Neipang'unye Isiraeli aitung'uaa atua ninche, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
te nkaina nagol naitoriori, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.
Ilo oiperra Enaiposha Nanyokie aitaa are, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
neisho Isiraeli meima atua ninye, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
kake etooroyie Farao o lorora lenye tiatua Enaiposha Nanyokie, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.
Ilo otorikoyie iltung'ana lenyena ti ong'ata, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.
Ilo otasesekuana ilaiguanak kituaak, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
near to lalem ilaiguanak ning'ot, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
Sihon, olaiguanani le Amori, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
o Oog, olaiguanani le Bashan, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
neishooyo enkop enye metaa enjung'ore, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
enjung'ore to sinka lenye Israel, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.
Ninye otadamua iyiook apa kishal, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
nekordu iyiook aitung'uaa ilmang'ati lang, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;
ninye oisho endaa ntokitin pooki naaishu, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.
Enchoo enashe Enkai e keper, amu kebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.
Too mbat oo lkejek le Babilon iyiook kitotona, teine iyiook kinchira kidamu Sion.
Too lkeek ootaaniki ine kitiika iyiook inkinantani ang.
Amu ore apa teine, ore lelo ootaaraitie iyiook, neyieu nikiranyaki ninche osinkolio, ore lelo ooisilisil iyiook, nejo, “Entaranyaki iyiook obo loo sinkolioitin le Sion!”
Kaji iyiook kinko te nikirany osinkolio lo Laitoriani te nkop eiking'a?
Te naarikino nanu iyie, Yerusalem, nchoo enkaina ai e tatene etoyu!
Meibung'a olng'ejep lai enoret e nkutuk ai, te nemaadamu nanu iyie, te nemapik nanu Yerusalem aitulus te nchipai ai pooki!
Tadamu, Olaitoriani, tialo iltung'ana le Edom, ina batatata apa e Yerusalem, etejo apa ninche, “Endakie ninye, endakie ninye! Entigil o metabaiki olkitamanyunoto!”
Oi iyie Babilon, iyie naainyalani! Emayiana ilo oing'oru te iyie ina apa nintaasa iyiook!
Emayiana ilo oitayu nkera inono kutiti nenang'ie ninche endapidapoi!
Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe, Olaitoriani, to ltau lai pooki; ore te dukuya nkaitin narany nanu enkisisa ino.
Airrugo nanu aing'or enkaji ino sinyati naisho enashe enkarna ino te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno o esupatisho ino; amu ilepie aitulus te pooki enkarna ino o rorei lino.
Ore te nkolong naaipoto nanu, nikitawalikia, ore engolon ai o ltau nikitoponikia.
Ore ilaiguanak pooki le nkop naa eikisis iyie, Olaitoriani, amu etoning'o ninche irorei le nkutuk ino;
naa kepuo ninche aarany isinkolioitin loo nkoitoi o Laitoriani, amu aikitok enkitoo o Laitoriani.
Ore hoo netii Olaitoriani shumata, keing'or ninye ilo obor; ore ilo owuasa neyiolo ninye elakua.
Ore ninye te nalo aim empolos e nyamali, igolie ake enkishui ai; intorioo iyie enkaina ino aibooyo engoro napi oo lmang'ati laainei, naa enkaina e tatene naakordu nanu.
Keitabaya Olaitoriani enyorrata enye te nanu; ore enyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, kebikoo ntarasi. Minturraa iyie esiaai oo nkaik inono.
Olaitoriani, kitujurro iyie nanu nikitayiolo nanu!
Iyiolo iyie enkata naton o enkata nadumunye; imusu iyie ndamunot aainei ilakua.
Ijurru iyie enkoitoi ai o enkirragata ai, niyiolo iyie oleng inkoitoi aainei pooki.
Ore ninye eitu elotu ororei ajing olng'ejep lai, Olaitoriani, iyiolo iyie pooki.
Kitamana iyie nanu te siadi o te dukuya, ninteleikia enkaina ino shumata nanu.
Ore ena ng'eno naa eikitok oleng te nanu; etii shumata, maidim nanu aibung'a.
Kaji nanu alo pee aailany Enkiyang'et ino? Anaa kaji nanu alo pee aailany iyie?
Te nailep nanu alo shumata, itii iyie ine! Te naitobir nanu endapash ai te nemeneng'a itii iyie ine!
Tenalo nanu too naipuko e nkakenya, nalo amany enaiposha
ore sii teine naa enkaina ino naarikoo, naa enkaina ino e tatene naaibung nanu.
Te najo nanu, “Ncho maaitemoi nanu enaimin, ore ewang'an naamanita nanu neaku enkewarie,”
ore ninye enaimin nememisimis te iyie, kewang enkewarie anaa endama; amu etiu enaimin anaa ewang'an te iyie.
Iyie oitobira osesen lai liatua, iyie likiruburuba nanu tiatua enkoshoke e yieyio.
Kaaisis nanu iyie amu iyie eurei naa iyie ole nking'asia. Ine nking'asia isiaaitin inono! Kiyiolo iyie nanu oleng;
meisudoro irubat o sesen lai te iyie, ina kata pee aaitobiruni nanu te nkisudoroto, ina kata aaitubuluni nanu te nguton e nkop.
Naaing'or nanu inkonyek inono eton eitu aaku toki; neigero te mbuku ino inkarn e pooki, nena olong'i pooki naategeluaki eton eitu ebau.
Kebaa tipat oo ndamunot inono te nanu, iyie Enkai! Kebaa enkumoi enye!
Te naiken nanu ninche, nelang osinyai. Te nainyototo nanu, natii ake te nebo iyie.
Oi naaji tenaa isesekuan olarruoni, Iyie Enkai, pee aatum nanu iltung'ana lo sarge aatalam,
lelo tung'ana torrok likikeshare iyie, lelo ooilepie ate te ntorroni likigilunore te ntorroni!
Aimaiba nanu lelo likimba iyie, Olaitoriani? Aimamen nanu lelo likigilunore iyie?
Kaiba nanu ninche oleng, aitaa nanu ninche ilmang'ati laainei.
Tujurroki nanu, iyie Enkai, niyiolou oltau lai! Ineneng'aki nanu niyiolou indamunot aainei!
Nidol tenaa ketii enkoitoi torrono atua nanu, nikirikoo nanu te nkoitoi intarasi!
Tokorduaki nanu, Olaitoriani, too ltung'ana torrok, tagolieki nanu too ltung'ana lo larrabal,
te lelo ooitobir nkitobirat torrok too ltauja lenye, nedumu ninche olarrabal anaake.
Keng'orisho ilng'ejepa lenye anaa ilasuriaa, ore nkutukie enye netii esayiet oo nturbubuani.
Torripoki nanu, Olaitoriani, too nkaik eilo torrono; tagolieki nanu too ltung'ana lo larrabal, te lelo ooitobira pee eitapong'oo nkejek aainei.
Eisudoitie lelo oowuasa orreshet te nkaraki nanu, neitoluaa ninche too nkeenta orreshet, ore te mbata e nkoitoi aatipikakita ninche orreshet.
Atiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, ira iyie Enkai ai; toning'o oltoilo le nkomono ai, Olaitoriani!
Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lai, olakordunoni lai ogol, intoipo iyie endukuya ai te nkolong o larrabal.
Minchooyo iyie, Olaitoriani, iyieunot eilo torrono; mintabaya ina yieunoto enye e ntorroni!
Ore lelo laamanita nanu neshumu ilukuny enye, nchoo ina torroni oo nkutukie enye meibung'a ninche!
Nchoo metusulakinoto ninche nkuk naairowua! Nchoo ninche metusulakini ngumot, nemeigil aekata aailepu!
Nchoo ilo oiro mbaa torrok eaku megolu aekata te nkop; nchoo entorroni metanang'ie enkop oltung'ani lo larrabal!
Kayiolo nanu ajo keitobir Olaitoriani mbaa eilo oata osina, nedung enkiguana eilo omena.
Kesipa keisho ilo supat enkarna ino enashe; ore ilo supat nebik ninye te dukuya iyie.
Aaipoto nanu iyie, Olaitoriani, tasieku enatii nanu! Toning'o oltoilo lai, te naaipot nanu iyie!
Nchoo enkomono ai meikenari anaa enkorropil te dukuya iyie, ore enkilepata oo nkaik aainei neikenari anaa olasar le nteipa!
Ng'ura enkutuk ai, Olaitoriani, torripo enkutuk ai, Olaitoriani!
Mincho oltau lai metonyorra entorroni, pee aitanyamal kewan too nkiasin torrok te ncholiek oo ltung'ana oas ntorrok; nimikincho nanu mainosa ndaiki enye e sikar!
Nchoo oltung'ani supat maatoosho, naaisikong te supatisho, kake mincho aekata eilata e ilo torrono metipiki endukuya ai, amu ore enkomono ai e anaake negilunore nkiasin enye torrok.
Ore te neishoori ninche aaitarasaki lelo oodung'oki enkiguana, nepuo taa aayiolou nchere kesipa ororei lo Laitoriani.
Ore anaa osoit oidong'ishoreki te neiper enkop, neijia etiu iloik lenye eidapasha te nkutuk e nemeneng'a.
Kake iyie eing'or inkonyek aainei, Olaitoriani Enkai; te iyie nanu aing'oru esarunoto; miking'uaa nanu maata olaamitu!
Ntalamaki nanu ilo rreshet laairragakinye ninche nanu, o too rresheta loo laasak loo ntorrok!
Nchoo ilarruok metadoiki pooki rresheta lenye maate, napuku nanu ailanyisho.
Aaishiraka nanu to ltoilo lai, Olaitoriani, ore to ltoilo lai naomon Olaitoriani.
Atubukuo nanu osina lai te dukuya ninye, nalimu nanu enyamali ai te dukuya ninye.
Te naiminie osiligi, niyiolo iyie enkoitoi ai! Aatipikakita ninche orreshet enkoitoi naim nanu.
Aing'ura nanu enkalo e tatene, naing'orisho, kake metii hoo obo laaing'or nanu, meetae esarunoto te nanu, meetae oltung'ani laashilaa nanu.
Aaishiraka nanu iyie, Olaitoriani; najo, Ira iyie esarunoto ai, ira erubata ai te nkop oo looishu.
Toning'o enkishirata ai; amu aaitadoyioki nanu oleng! Tokorduaki nanu te lelo laaisilisil; amu kegol ninche oleng te nanu!
Ntupukuoki nanu tiatua enyamali o ltau, pee atum aishoru enashe te nkaraki enkarna ino! Naaman nanu lelo supati; amu kintaasa iyie isupati o ne leng'on.
Toning'o enkomono ai, Olaitoriani; nchoo metoning'o nkiyiaa inono eomonokinoto ai! Ore te nkaraki isipat inono tawalikiaki nanu tiatua esupatisho ino!
Minguanare iyie osinka lino, amu meetae oltung'ani hoo obo oishu oata esipata te dukuya iyie.
Amu aatimira nanu olmang'atinta; negiligil enkishui ai aoshie enkop; naaisho ninye matotona te naimin anaa lootuata apa.
Ore te nkaraki ina, naiminie osiligi neiputukuny oltau lai.
Adamu nanu nkolong'i e apa, naibirribir nanu nena apa nitaasa; naing'asia te siaai oo nkaik inono.
Naaitorioki nanu inkaik aainei; nikiatayie oltau lai enkure anaa enkop natoyio.
Tasioki tawalikiaki nanu, Olaitoriani! Amu aiminie osiligi! Mikisudorie nanu enkomom ino, matiu ake anaa lelo oopuo aajing engumoto.
Nchooki nanu matoning'o tadekenya ina nyorrata ino nauno, amu iyie nanu atipika osiligi lai. Nteng'enaki nanu enkoitoi naaim, amu iyie nanu ailepakinye oltau lai.
Tokorduaki nanu, Olaitoriani, too lmang'ati laainei! Iyie nanu akuetikia asaru!
Nteng'enaki nanu mataasa eyieunoto ino, amu ira iyie Enkai ai! Nchoo oltau lino supat maatorikoi nanu te nkoitoi naitoriori!
Ore te nkaraki enkarna ino, Olaitoriani, tagolie enkishui ai! Ore te supatisho ino ntayioki nanu tiatua enyamali!
Naa ore te nyorrata ino nauno iwuang'ie ilmang'ati laainei, nindaikie ilmang'ati laainei pooki, amu kara nanu osinka lino.
Meisisi Olaitoriani, endapidapoi ai, laa ninye oitaarriyian inkaik aainei to larrabal, neitayiolo ilkimojik laainei olarrabal.
Endapidapoi ai naa osempewuet lai, enkisudoroto ai naa olakordunoni lai, elong'o ai naa ninye ilo lasaru nanu, laa ninye opik iloreren abori nanu.
Olaitoriani, kainyoo tung'ani lishilaa ninye, anaa enkerai e tung'ani eji nidamu ninye?
Etiu oltung'ani anaa enkiyang'et, etiu inkolong'i enyena anaa oloip oloito.
Irrugu keper ino, Olaitoriani, nilotu adou! Iseyie ildoinyo pee epuru!
Imerlelie inkiwuang'at nindapashaa ninche, ning'oru mbaa inono aitanyamal ninche!
Ntorioi enkaina ino te keper, tokorduaki nanu nikintayu nanu tiatua nkariak kumok, ntung'uayioki inkaik oo leeiking'a,
lelo ooiro elejare too nkutukie enye, laa ore enkaina enye e tatene, naa enkaina e tatene e lejare.
Naa kaaranyaki nanu iyie osinkolio ng'ejuk, Iyie Enkai; te nkawuo oo sinkolioitin naata iusin tomon nanu aaranyaki iyie,
iyie oisho ilaiguanak meisula, iyie otokordua Daudi osinka lino.
Tokorduaki nanu te ilo alem torrono, nikikordu nanu aitung'uaa enkaina e lelo leeiking'a, lelo ooiro elejare too nkutukie enye, laa ore enkaina enye e tatene naa enkaina e tatene e lejare.
Metotiwuo ilayiok lang te lelero enye anaa inkaitubulu naatubulutua aabaya. Metotiutu ntoyie ang anaa ing'apeta oo lmairrot, naatudung'uoki pee eshetieki enkaji e nkitoo o laiguanani.
Metaboreita nkajijik ang naashumishoreki, meiputa mpukunot pooki oo ntokitin; metubula nkerrai ang, aaku nkalifuni o nkalifuni tomon too ndaat;
metaraposhoto nkishu ang neisho, nemetum olkibiroto anaa ae torroni; metaa metumi olkiyioi lo sina too nkoitoi ang!
Emayiana lelo tung'ana ootum ena mayianata! Emayiana iltung'ana laa Enkai ninye Olaitoriani lenye!
Kaarrep nanu iyie, Enkai ai naa Olaiguanani, naisis enkarna ino ntarasi o ntarasi.
Ore nkolong'i pooki naaisis nanu iyie, naisis enkarna ino ntarasi o ntarasi.
Kitok Olaitoriani, naa kitok enkisisa enye, ore enkitoo enye nemelimunoyu.
Neinosakino iishoritin o lajijik isiaaitin inono, neibalunye ninche nkiasin inono sapuki.
Naibiribir nanu enkishiaa e nkitoo ino o enking'asia oo siaaitin inono.
Neibalunye iltung'ana enkidimata oo nkiasin inono, naibalunye nanu enkitoo ino.
Neinosaa ninche ening'oi e supatisho ino, nerany ninche aabuaku isinkolioitin le supatisho oo sipat inono.
Kaaipirisioni Olaitoriani neeta olng'ur, mesioki agoro nebore enyorrata nauno.
Eisupat Olaitoriani te pooki, ore olng'ur lenye netii shumata nena pooki naaitobira ninye.
Ore intokitin pooki nintobira naa eikincho iyie enashe, Olaitoriani, ore isinyat pooki nikiisis iyie!
Neiro ninche aaimaki enkitoo e nkitoria ino, nelimu engolon ino,
neitayiolo inkera e tung'ani inkiasin inono e ngolon, o enkishiaa kitok e nkitoria ino.
Ore enkitoria ino naa enoo ntarasi, nebikoo enkitoo e nkitoria ino too ishoritin pooki. Kaasipani Olaitoriani too rorei lenyena pooki, naa kaaipirisioni too nkiasin enyena pooki.
Keibung Olaitoriani airishu lelo pooki oobatata, nedumu ailepunye lelo pooki oolepokino enkop.
Iyie eing'or inkonyek e pooki, nincho iyie ninche endaa too rishat enye.
Ilak iyie enkaina ino, nintaraposh pooki toki naishu.
Kaasipani Olaitoriani too nkoitoi enyena pooki, naa supat too iasat enyena pooki.
Ketaana Olaitoriani te pooki ooipot ninye, te pooki ooipot ninye te sipata.
Keitabaya ninye iyieunot e pooki ooure ninye, nening sii olkiyioi lenye, neitajeu ninche.
Kegolie Olaitoriani lelo pooki oonyor ninye, kake ore iltorrok pooki naa keidaikie ninye.
Keiro enkutuk ai enkisisa o Laitoriani, nchoo pooki naaishu eisis enkarna enye sinyati ntarasi o ntarasi.
Meisisi Olaitoriani! Isisa Olaitoriani lo tau lai!
Kaisis nanu Olaitoriani inkolong'i naaba anaa inaishu; karany nanu enkisisa e Nkai ai eton aishu.
Mipik osiligi lino ilkituaak, mipik atua tung'ani lemetii eretoto atua ninye.
Te nepuku enkiyang'et enye nerrinyokino ninye enkop; ore teina olong neish inkitobirat enyena.
Kemayiana ilo laa Enkai e Yakobo ninye eretoto enye, laa Olaitoriani Enkai osiligi lenye,
ilo oitobira keper o nkop, o enaiposha o pooki naatii atua; ilo ooibung enkirukoto ntarasi;
ilo oiguanare too sipat oloitorogonyaki; ilo laa ninye oitoti olooisumash. Olaitoriani olaaya ilooena.
Olaitoriani obol ilmodook inkonyek. Olaitoriani odumu ailepunye ilooibookoki enkop; kenyor Olaitoriani ilo asipani.
Kerrip Olaitoriani ilo omoni, neibung ninye enkoliai o ilo lemeeta menye, kake ore enkoitoi e ilo torrono neyau ninye enkidaata.
Olaitoriani olo aitoreisho ntarasi, Enkai ino, iyie Sion, too ishoritin pooki. Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Meisisi Olaitoriani! Amu eisidai te neranyakini enkisisa e Nkai ang; amu kaaipirisioni, naa keishiaakino osinkolio le nkisisa.
Olaitoriani oshet Yerusalem; neiturrurru ilooidapashari apa le Israel.
Neishiunye ilootigilate iltauja, neen ilbaa lenye.
Neiken ninye neyiolou esiana oo lakir, neisho ninche pooki inkarn enye.
Aikitok Olaitoriani lang naa kitok engolon enye; ore eng'eno enye nemeimakinoyu.
Kedumu Olaitoriani oloitunyokoki enkop, nenang'ie olarruoni enkop.
Entaranyaki Olaitoriani ninchosho enashe; entaranyaki Olaitoriani to lwulul loo usin kumok!
Keimulumul ninye keper too nkatampo, neitobir ninye enchan pee eshaiki enkop, neitubulu ninye nkujit too ldoinyo.
Ninye oisho ing'uesi e ntim indaiki enye, neisho nkiyioitin oo motonyi naaishir endaa.
Ore enchipai enye neme engolon e mbarta, neme nkejek e tung'ani eng'idare;
kake lelo ooure ninye eshipakino Olaitoriani, lelo ooisilig enyorrata enye nauno.
Isisa Olaitoriani, iyie Yerusalem! Isisa Enkai ino, iyie Sion!
Amu ninye oitagol isenkenke oo nchomito inono; ninye omayian ilayiok linono ootii atua iyie.
Ninye oitaserian ilpolosien linono; ninye oiputaki intae enkano sidai.
Ninye oirriwaki enkop inkitanapat enyena; nelo ororei lenye asiooyo.
Neishoru empaso naikununo anaa enturoto; neisalaashaki enkinuku enkop anaa nkuruon.
Neyau ninye isoito le nchan anaa ilbelibelat, kalo oidim aitasheiki enkirobi enye?
Ninye oirriu ororei lenye, neshol lelo soito; neisho osiwuo lenye metukutunye, neruko nkariak.
Eibalakinye ninye Yakobo ororei lenye, eibalakinye inkiguanat o nkitanapat enyena Israel.
Eitu ninye eas ena te likae osho, meyiolo ninche nkitanapat enyena. Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Meisisi Olaitoriani! Meisisi Olaitoriani te keper, meisisi ninye te wueji e shumata!
Esisa ninye ilmalaika lenyena pooki, esisa ninye ilororani lenyena pooki!
Esisa ninye enkolong o lapa, esisa ninye intae ilakir pooki oowang!
Isisa iyie keper nalakua, o intae inkariak naatii shumata keper!
Nchoo ninche eisis enkarna o Laitoriani! Amu ninye apa oitanapishe, neitobir ninche.
Naa ninye oitasheyie ninche ntarasi o ntarasi, naa ninye oitayio enkitanapata enye nemeibelekenya.
Meisisi Olaitoriani te nkop, o iyie enaiposha o ntokitin pooki naatii atua,
enkima o enchan oo soito o empaso, o lkutati lo siwuo oitabaya enkitanapata enye!
Ildoinyo o ndoinyo pooki, ilkeek loo lng'anayio o ltarakua!
Ing'uesi o nkishu pooki, ntokitin naaiserpepiari te nkop o motonyi naapuo tiaai!
Ilaiguanak le nkop o ltung'ana pooki, ilkituaak o laitoriak le nkop pooki!
Ilbarnot o selenken te nebo, iltung'ana moruak o nkera te nebo!
Nchoo ninche eisis enkarna o Laitoriani amu enkarna enye ake nara kitok; etii enkitoo enye shumata keper o enkop.
Eishoo ninye meishuro emowuo oo ltung'ana lenyena, esisa te nkaraki isinyat lenyena pooki, te nkaraki iltung'ana loo Siraeli ootaaniki ninye. Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Meisisi Olaitoriani! Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk, entarany enkisisa enye te umata oo supati!
Nchoo Israel eshipakino ilo oitobira ninye, nchoo ilayiok le Sion eshipakino Olaiguanani lenye!
Nchoo ninye eisis enkarna enye neinoe, neranyaki ninye te ntampuri o to lwulul loo usin kumok.
Amu keshipakino Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena; neikod ninye olobor te nkisulata.
Nchoo lelo supati metishipata te nkitoo; nchoo ninche eranyisho te ng'ida too ndapashi enye.
Nchoo enkisisa kitok e Nkai ejing iltoiloishi lenye, nejing ilalema oopi nkaloli pokira oo nkaik enye,
pee eitalaku elap too loshon neitame lelo lemeure Enkai,
pee een ilaiguanak lenye too lpisia neen lelo kituaak lenye too sekenke,
pee edung'oki ninche enkiguana naigero! Enkitoo ena te lelo pooki lenyena supati. Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Meisisi Olaitoriani! Meisisi Enkai tiatua ewueji enye sinyati; meisisi ninye to loing'ang'e lenye kitok!
Meisisi ninye too nkiasin enyena sapuki; meisisi ninye te risioroto e nkitoo enye sapuk!
Meisisi ninye to ltoilo le ntarumpeta; meisisi ninye te ndule o te nkawuo oo sinkolioitin!
Meisisi ninye te ntampuri o te nkinoyata o sinkolio; meisisi ninye too usin o te nkinanta nakuti!
Meisisi ninye te nkinanta naru oleng; meisisi ninye te ndarata e nkinanta!
Nchoo pooki toki naata enkiyang'et eisis Olaitoriani! Meisisi Olaitoriani!
Indung'eta e rashe kuna e Solomon, olayioni le Daudi, olaiguanani le Israel.
Etisiraki kuna dung'eta e rashe pee etum iltung'ana aatayiolo eng'eno o enkiteng'enare, nening'u irorei oogut le ng'eno,
neng'amu enkiteng'enare te ng'eno naretisho, neng'amu esipata o enkiguana nasipa o emborron
pee etumi aishoo eng'eno sidai olmodai netum ilbarnot eng'eno nayiolounye eneikunari te nkishon.
Ore sii ninye oltung'ani ng'en nening neponaa eyiolounoto, ore oltung'ani oata ening'unoto, netum anoto enkarriyiano sapuk
pee itum atoning'u endung'et e rashe o enkipirta enye o lelo rorei loo lang'eni o loyietiaa lenye.
Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa ninye enkiterunoto e ng'eno, keany ilmoda eng'eno o utarot.
Toning'o enkerai ai enkikoo e papaai lino, nimiany enkiteng'enare e yieyioo lino;
amu keaku nena utarot enkishili te ndukuya ino, neaku olpisiai te murt ino.
Enkerai ai, tinikilejaa ake ilaasak loo ng'ok, minyorraa mikitelejari.
Naa tinikijoki ninche, “Wou tenebo iyiook mairraga aanyu osarge likimbukoo. Matarresh kisudori aaluam ilo lemeeta entioto;
anaa enemeneng'a matoijoi ninche eishu, nelulung'a, anaa lelo oopuo aadoiki engumoto;
aikitum imasaa pooki e tipat, nikimput inkajijik ang intokitin nikitaarutua;
tipika sii iyie erubata ino atua iyiook neaku olbene obo kiata.”
Enkerai ai, miim ina oitoi tenebo ninche, mboo enkeju ino pee meim inkoitoi enye;
amu kekuetiki inkejek enye aas intorrok, nesiooyo aaibukoo osarge.
Te mpesho isalaash orreshet, edolita imotonyi,
Kake ore lelo tung'ana keirrag aanyisho naa osarge lenye erreshoo, enkishui enye ninye erreshoo.
Neijia etiu inkoitoi e lelo pooki ootum dupoto te nkikonya; keitayu enkishui aaitung'uaa iloopeny.
Keishir eng'eno abuaku te nkoitoi dapash e nkanasa, neitayu oltoilo lenye too wuejitin neemirishoreki.
Ore te nchumata oo sunta eishira abuaku; neiro too nchomito enkanasa ejo:
“Ke rishata nabaa, intae iloo moda inyorraa aaku ilmoda? Ke rishata nabaa enyor iloo lderrat torrok aaimaki ilderrat torrok. Neiba ilmoda eng'eno?
Embung'a intae enking'odiata ai o eutaroto; eng'ura, kabukoki intae iutarot oo ndamunot aainei naa kaitayiolo intae irorei laainei.
Amu aipotishe nianyianya kining'ining'i, aitorioyie enkaina ai nemetii hoo obo otishilayie,
neitu ishilaa enkikoo ai pooki, neitu ishilaa enking'odia ai o utarot aainei pooki.
Ekaakueniyie sii nanu intae te nkata e ngolikinoto inyi, naa kasurdaany intae te neosh intae olkirutoto,
te neosh intae olkirutoto anaa olkutati, nelotu engolikinoto inyi anaa osiwuo torrono te nelotu osina o emion shumata intae.
Neaku kaapuonu ninche aaipot nanu, nemawaliki nanu ninche; naa kaaing'oru ninche nanu oleng nemaatum nanu.
Amu keiba ninche eng'eno, neitu egelu euriata o Laitoriani.
Meyieu enkikoo ai hoo nabo, netemenaitie enkisikong'ata o eutaroto ai pooki.
Metaa kenya ninche ilng'anayio le nkoitoi enye, neitarruoo inkoitoi enye maate.
Amu etaara engogong'i enye ilmoda metuata, ore enkiyagata oo lmoda neidaikie ninche;
kake ore ilo laaning nanu naa kebik eserian, naa keyeng'iyeng'a eton, meeta enkuretisho e ntorroni.”
Enkerai ai, tining'amaa irorei laainei, nishum aiteng'el inkitanapat aainei tenebo iyie,
nincho inkiyiaa inono einining aasipu eng'eno, nirrugu oltau lino aaku oloyiolou.
Ee tininchiru aomonu ening'unoto oo rorei oogut, nidumu oltoilo lino aaku oloning'u.
Tining'oru ninye anaa enkosholai, nijurru aing'oru ninye oleng anaa enoshi toki e tipat naisudoro.
Neaku iyiolou iyie euriata o Laitoriani, nitum eng'eno e Nkai.
Amu Olaitoriani ninye oishoru eng'eno; enkutuk enye epukunye eng'eno o eyiolounoto.
Eiteng'ela ninye eng'eno sidai te lelo ooitashe too sipat; ninye elong'o e lelo oopuo te mborron.
Kerrip inkoitoi oo sipat negolie enkoitoi oo sinyat lenyena.
Ina pee indimidimi aatayiolo esipata o enkiguana e sipata o emborron o pooki oitoi sidai.
Amu kelotu eng'eno atua oltau lino, ore eyiolounoto neaku aisidai tiatua oltau lino.
Aikirrita iyie eng'eno, nikirrip eyiolounoto iyie.
Nikintajeu iyie aitung'uaa enkoitoi oo ntorrok, aitung'uaa iltung'ana ooiro nkirorot torrok,
lelo oing'uaa inkoitoi e nkitashoto sidai aaim inkoitoi e naimin.
Neshipa te neas intorrok, neshipakino ina kiminata e ntorroni,
iltung'ana laa ore inkoitoi enye nemeitoriori nepaashaa neimin ninche tiatua inkoitoi enye.
Aikintajeuni iyie teina kitok naibor onyek, ina kitok nairo te nkutuk enye irorei oomelook.
Ina kitok apa natung'uayie olpayian lenye le lelero, nerikino ninye osotua le Nkai enye.
Amu ore enkaji enye naa keimis adoiki keeya, ore inkoitoi enyena nepuo enetii ilootuata.
Meeta ololo enetii ninye oitoki ashukunye aashu etum enkoitoi e mpuaan.
Metaa ilo iyie te nkoitoi oo ltung'ana supati, nimbung nena oitoi oo lasipak.
Amu lelo ooitashe too sipat oomany ena kop, ore iltung'ana oobor naa kebikoo tiatua,
kake kedung'ori ilarruok teina kop, ore ilaitang'orok nedotuni too ntona.
Enkerai ai, mincho kirikino inkiteng'enat aainei kake inchoo oltau lino eibung inkitanapat aainei.
Amu keaku inkolong'i kumok o larin le nkishui ino, nikincho enkiputakinoto e enkishon.
Mincho esujata oo sipat o enkirukoto kiorore; teeniki ninche emurt ino, tisira ninche tiatua oltau lino.
Metaa itum omom o enkisisa sidai te dukuya Enkai o ltung'ana.
Isiliga Olaitoriani to ltau lino pooki, nimipik osiligi le ng'eno ino metaa ninye nikirik.
Ore too nkoitoi inono pooki imbalie ninye naa keitorioo ninye inkoitoi inono pooki.
Mishilaa ake eg'eno ino makewan, turia Olaitoriani, nimbelekenya aing'uaa ntorrok.
Keaku enkishiunoto to sesen lino, neaku olchani too loik linono.
Iyanyita Olaitoriani too ntokitin inono, o too lng'anayio le dukuya le nkurma ino.
Naa teina eiput ilkompen linono entapa, neiput imalasin inono enaisho oo sabibu nedooyo.
Enkerai ai, mimenaa enkitamioto e utaroto nikiosh Olaitoriani; aashu inauru te rerioroto nikirere,
amu kererioo Olaitoriani ilo onyor anaa olpayian orerioo enkerai enye nanyor.
Emayiana oltung'ani otum eng'eno nagut, ilo tung'ani otum eyiolounoto.
Amu ore dupoto enye nelang dupoto e nkosholai ore sii dupoto enye nelang saabu.
Keeta ninye tipat alang isoito oogol enkinyang'a, nemeeta entoki ning'uar aitanyaanyukie ninye.
Etii enkishui naado atua enkaina enye e tatene, ore atua enkaina enye e kedianye netii enkarsisisho o enkanyit.
Ore inkoitoi enyena naa inaaitishipisho, ore nkoitoi enyena pooki naa eseriani.
Ore ninye naa olchani le mpuaan te lelo ooibung ninye; ore lelo oibung aakurraki naa keji ilooshipa.
Eitobira Olaitoriani enkop te ng'eno nagut, ore te yiolounoto eitasheyie keper o ntokitin naatii.
Te ng'eno enye eitayio ineegut, ore inkatampo neitadou enkoileelio.
Enkerai ai, imbung'a eng'eno sidai o eyiolounoto; mincho ninche kisik aaing'uaa,
naa keaku enkishui to ltau lino, naa emasaai sidai e murt ino.
Neaku ilo te nkoitoi ino iserian, nemerrorro enkeju ino.
Tinilo niton, nimiata enkuretisho; tinirrag airura, naa kemelok injo inono.
Miure olkirutoto likiluam, aashu emutata oo larruok te nelotu.
Amu keaku Olaitoriani osiligi le nkitashoto ino, naa kerrip enkeju ino pee meibung'i.
Mimitiki isidain ilooishaakino ina kata aa iyie oata enkidimata pee ias.
Mijoki olelatia lino, “Shomo pee intoki ashukunye, ekaaisho metabaiki” – ti niata ina kata ina toki.
Mintobiraki ole latia ino entorroni ainyal, lelo ootoni kisilig te mbata ino.
Miarare oltung'ani metii esipata eitu kintaas iyie entorroni.
Ming'uar oltung'ani onyor olarrabal, nimigelu hoo nabo oo nkoitoi enyena.
Amu ore oltung'ani arruoni naa olminong to Laitoriani, kake ore lelo ooitashe too sipat netii atua enkisiligata enye.
Etii oldeket lo Laitoriani shumata enkaji oo larruok, kake kemayian ninye emanyisho oo supati.
Ore lelo oomenisho naa kemenaa ninye, kake ore ilo obor neisho omom.
Ore oltung'ani ng'en naa kejung enkanyit, kake ore ilmoda netum enkurruna.
Entoning inkiteng'enat e papaai linyi inkera aainei, nining'ining'i aasipu pee itumutumu aanoto eng'eno nagut.
Amu kaaisho iyie iutarot sidain; miorore enkiteng'enata ai.
Ore apa ara enkiti kerai nanana atii tenebo papa lai, naa nanu ake eeta yieyio.
Naaiteng'ena papa lai nanu, naajoki, “Inchoo oltau lino eibung akurraki irorei laainei, tushuma inkitanapat aainei pee iton inchu.
Mincho kirikino, nimimbelekenya aing'uaa irorei le nkutuk ai. Noto eng'eno nagut, noto sii ening'unoto.
Mimenaa ninye, naa aikirrip ninye iyie; tonyora ninye naa aikirrip ninye iyie.
Ore enkiterunoto e ng'eno naa ena; noto eng'eno nagut, naa ore pooki nitum, noto sii ening'unoto;
tonyorra ninye oleng, naa aikintaa ninye iyie kitok; aikianyitu ninye iyie tininbung'are ninye.
Kepik ninye endukuya ino enkishili e nkisisa nikipik sii enkopiyia sidai e nkitoo.”
Toning'o enkerai ai, ning'amaa irorei laainei, pee etum ilarin le nkishui ino aataa kumok.
Aaiteng'ena nanu iyie nkoitoi e ng'eno; aatoriko iyie too nkoitoi naaitoriori.
Ore pee ilo iyie, nemetum enkeju ino olkob, naa tinikuet nimirrorro.
Imbung'a tukurraki iutarot, mincho kipuo aing'uaa; torripo ninche, amu ninye enkishui ino.
Mijing enkoitoi oo larruok nimiim ina oitoi e lelo tung'ana torrok.
Tapaasha ninye, milo aim ninye; imbelekenyunye tung'uai milo agiroo.
Amu meidim ninche aairurata o metaasa entorrono; meeta ninche injo ometaba anaa nerrorr obo metabatatayu.
Amu enya ninche endaa e nkarruoisho, neok enaisho oo sabibu naikonyuno te ngolon.
Kake ore enkoitoi oo supati netiu anaa ewang'an e nkakenya, ina naponari awang'u newang'u o metaa dama.
Ore nkoitoi oo ltorrok netiu anaa enaimin nagut; meyiolo ninche aajo aitenyoo etarrorrote.
Enkerai ai, inining'u tukurraki irorei laainei, irrugu enkiok ino inining'u inkikoot aainei.
Mincho ninche kilany aaing'uaa enkomom ino; tushuma ninche tiatua oltau lino.
Amu enkishui ninche teilo otum ninche naa biyotisho o sesen lenye pooki.
Ing'ura oleng tagolie oltau lino, amu ninye epukunye inchorroi e nkishui.
Intalama kewan nkirorot torrok, nishurtu inkirorot torrok te iyie.
Inchoo inkonyek inono eing'or aaitoriokino dukuya; neaku enking'urata ino naitoriori te dukuya iyie.
Ing'ura tagolie enkoitoi oo nkejek inono, pee eunoyu inkoitoi inono pooki.
Nimiwuang alo tatene aashu kedianye; tushuku enkeju ino intung'uai entorroni.
Enkerai ai inining'u tukurraki eng'eno ai, irrugu enkiok ino inining'u eng'eno ai.
Pee itum atorripo te yiolounoto naiguana, ore enkutuk ino nerrip eng'eno.
Amu ore enkutuk enkitok naibor onyek nemelok anaa olkenkei, ore ilomon lenyena nepuiyiapui aalang eilata;
kake ore te nkiting'oto nedua anaa esayiet nepi anaa olalem opi imbat pokira.
Ore inkejek enyena nepuo aadoiki keeya; nesujaa iroruat enyena enkoitoi e nemeneng'a;
meshilaa ninye enkoitoi e puaan, eirrang'irrang inkoitoi enyena, nemeyiolo ninye.
Neaku ore naa teina kata inkera aainei, entoning'oki nanu nimipuopuo aaing'uaa irorei le nkutuk ai.
Intalama enkoitoi ino enenye nimilo anyikaki kutuk aji e nkaji enye;
pee mincho ake enkisisa ino ilkulikae, nimincho ilarin linono lelo le meeta olng'ur,
pee meiput ate ilomon te ngolon ino ore isiaaitin inono nepuo enkaji o lomoni.
Ore te nkiting'oto e nkishui ino ninchir, etumutaki inkiri o sesen lino,
naa ijo, “Ekaiba apa enkitamioto naautarieki netanya oltau lai ererioroto!
Eitu apa ainining'u oltoilo loo laiteng'enak laainei aashu airrugoki enkiok ai ilautarok laainei,
atinyikaka apa nanu embata e nkidaaroto tiatua eumuta o lorere!”
Tooko enkare naing'uaa enchorro ino makewan, ina are narukunye aing'uaa enchorro ino.
Keidapasha inkonyek inono oo nkariak tiong'ota, inchorroi enkare too nkoitoi dapashi?
Inchoo ninche eaku ininono aa iyie ake, neme pee eaku enino olomon likiboitare.
Inchoo enchorro ino emayiani, nishipakino enkitok e lelero ino.
Inchoo enyorrata enye kimput iyie, inkatitin pooki te nchipai, inchoo enyorrata enye kidumu anaake.
Aainyo enkerai ai pee incho enyorrata e nkitok naibor onyek kidumu? Nimbung olgoo le ntang'oroi?
Amu ore inkoitoi oltung'ani netii dukuya Olaitoriani, naa keing'orita ninye irrekiei lenyena pooki.
Ore enkarruoisho oo larruok naa kerresh ninye, neibung'i ninye te siaai oo ng'ok enyena.
Neye ninye meeta enkitamioto e utaroto, ore te nkaraki emodai enye sapuk neimina ninye.
Enkerai ai, tinitonyorrayie te nkutuk ino aitasheiki ole latia ino te sile enye, ninosa olmumai te nkaraki olomoni;
tinitarresho kewan to rorei lintayio te nkutuk ino, tinikimbung'a ororei le nkutuk ino,
neaku taasa naa ena, enkerai ai pee intajeu kewan, amu itijing'a inkaik ole latia ino; shomo tasioi tasayia ninye pee kilaku.
Mincho inkonyek inono meirurata, nimincho nkonyek inono meimugo;
intajeu kewan anaa enkolii nailanya olang'oroni, anaa emotonyi natunuta olarreshoni.
Shomo enetii enkalaoni, iyie lo tashalai; ing'ura inkoitoi enyena, nitum eng'eno.
Inemeeta olaiguanani lenye o laitasheikinoni aashu oloitore,
eshum ninche endaa enye te nkata enkirowuaj neiturrurru endaa enye te nkata e nkikesare.
Ke nkata nabaa iton iyie airrag teine? Kanu kenya inyototo too njo inono?
“Ekaitoki airura penyo, kaimug penyo,” ejo ninye “Ekashuk inkaik aainei ayeng'iyeng'a penyo.”
Ore eirura nebaiki ninye aisinanisho anaa olkirikoi o esumash anaa oltung'ani otanape.
Ore oltung'ani lemeeta tipat naa oltung'ani arruoni, neloolo einosaa ilomon le lejare.
Nerojisho too nkonyek enyena, neirorie oltung'ani too nkejek, neutisho too lkimojik lenyena.
Ore to lwuasa lo ltau lenye neun intorrok, eunito anaake ninye empeu e mang'atisho.
Neaku kepulusokino ninye engolikinoto aluam; ore te nkiti kata naa kegila enemeishiunoyu.
Etii intokitin ile naaiba Olaitoriani, mbaa naapishana naa olminong te ninye:
Inkonyek olwuasa o lng'ejep olejisho o inkaik naaibukoo osarge lemeeta entioto,
oltau oipiru indamunot torrok, inkejek naasioyo aakuetiki enetii entorroni.
Olchakeni le lejare olimu te nkutuk elejare, oltung'ani oun empeu e ngogong'i tiatua ilalashera.
Enkerai ai, imbung'a inkitanapat e papaai lino, niming'uaa enkiteng'enare e yieyioo lino.
Teeniki ninche oltau anaake; teeniki ninche emurt ino.
Ore tinilo te nkoitoi, naa aikirikoo ninche iyie; naa tinirrag airura, naa aikirrip ninche iyie, ore tininyototo neiro ninche tenebo iyie.
Amu ore enkitanapata naa oltaa ore iutarot naa ewang'an, naa ore inkitamiot oo utarot naa ninche enkoitoi e nkishui.
Pee kirrip teina kitok torrono, teilo ng'ejep opuyiapui le ina tang'oroi.
Ming'uar esidano enye to ltau lino, nimincho ninye kimbung too nkonyek enyena.
Amu eidimi ainyiang'u enkitok naibor onyek te mukate nabo, kake eishu enkitok naloloito entonata e nkishui o lee.
Keidim olee atanapa enkima to lgoo lenye, nemepejoo inkilani enyena?
Anaa keidim oltung'ani ashomo aitunyoi inkuk naaishu, aimenya indapi enyena enkima?
Metaa neijia sii etiu ilo olo aloloitore enkitok ole latia enye, meetae hoo obo oibung ninye olo eitu eitamei.
Aimeiba iltung'ana olapurroni te nepurrisho, pee eitaraposh enkoshoke enye eeta esumash?
Naa te neibung'i, kelak katitin naapishana; ekeishooyo imasaa pooki e nkaji enye.
Ore ilo ololoito nemeeta elukunya sidai; ore ilo oas ina neidaikie kewan.
Etum ilbaa torrok netum sii enkarna torrono nemejutoyu enkurruna enye tukul.
Amu eitaa olom oltung'ani oloarisho, nemepalaki te nelo neitalakisho elap.
Meng'amaa ninye elaata ake ninye pooki; meetae enkumoi oo nkishoorot naaidim aitoborro ninye.
Enkerai ai, imbung'a irorei laainei, nishum inkitanapat aainei tiatua iyie.
Imbung'a inkitanapat aainei pee inchu, tagolie nkiteng'enat aainei anaa enerok enkong'u ino.
Teeniki ninche ilkimojik linono, ing'ero ninche to ltau lino.
Tiaaki eng'eno, “Ira iyie enkanashe ai nimpot eng'eno nagut ajo olchore lai oleng;
pee kitum atagolie teina kitok naibor onyek, teina aitang'oroni napuyiapui irorei”.
Ore nabo olong narumisho te lusie e nkaji ai aing'or boo,
nadol tiatua ilmoda, nadol olbarnoti obo tiatua ilbarnot lemeeta eng'eno
eim enkoitoi dapash e nkanasa embata e nkaji e ina kitok naibor onyek, eibung enkoitoi alo enkaji enye
pee mirimiru e nteipa, te nkata enkewarie o enkata enaimin.
Namaniki pee enang'are ninye enkitok, naishope anaa emulayoi, neeta enareuta.
Neiro ninye meeta enkuretisho, metoni inkejek enyena tiang;
etii teina kata enkoitoi dapash e nkanasa netii tena kata enemirishoreki, ore te pooki lojata oo nkoitoi neton ninye aanyisho.
Neibung ninye ang'utut, ore inkonyek enyena nekurraki ninye:
nejoki ninye, “Aidipa atalaa ilasarri, neaku ore ena olong atalaa ilmuma laainei”.
Metaa ore taata aaewuo atumore, aaing'orua iyie oleng, neaku aanoto.
Aitobira endapash ai too lkarash oopuyiapui le kitani naing'uaa Misiri.
Aitorropilo endapash ai te manoo o esonkoyo o sinantei.
Wou, maiputa ate enchipai ang omekenyu; matishipakinoto ate te nyorrata
amu metii olpayian lai ang eshomo enelakua.
Neewa olbene loo ropiyiani nelo naa keshukunye kenya ang te mpolos o lapa.
Ore too rorei kumok le mpakasata, nearaki ninye; ore too rorei lenyena oopuyiapui neidimu ninye.
Ore ina kata ake, nesuj ninye ninye, anaa olkiteng opuoi aayieng aashu enkolii najing atua orreshet.
Ometaba anaa neng'or embae oltau lenye. Anaa emotonyi nakuetiki ajing atua orreshet; meyiolo duoo ajo keinosie enkishui enye.
Ore naa taata, nakera aainei, entoning'oki nanu niakuku ilooning'u lelo rorei le nkutuk ai.
Mincho oltau lino eibelekenya asuj inkoitoi e nkitok naaijo ina, mipong'okino inkoitoi enyena;
amu eitayio ninye ilmeneng'a kumok lemeikenayu. Ee, ore ilmeneng'a lenyena naa olorora kitok.
Ore enkaji enye naa enkoitoi nalo enemeneng'a, nedoyio alo ilgilat le keeya.
Aimeipotisho eng'eno, aimedumu eyiolounoto o ltoilo lenye?
Ore too neerupa o mbat e nkoitoi, ore too nkoitoi neitashe ninye.
Ore te mbata oo nchomito te dukuya enkanasa, o te kishomi neipotisho ninye ejo:
“Intae taa doi iltung'ana aipotito, naa ore enkishirata ai naa intae inkera oo ltung'ana eipirta”.
Lo moda kulo entamoo ate eng'eno; intae iltung'ana oo moda, enining'o enajo.
Entoning amu kaimaki imbaa e tipat, naapuku te nkutuk ai imbaa naasipa.
Amu eibalunye enkutuk ai esipata; ore intorrok naa olminong te nkutuk ai.
Ore irorei pooki le nkutuk ai naa esupatisho; metii entoki nabo namonira anaa enakordilo te ninche.
Keitoriori teilo oyiolo, naa keitoriori te lelo oonoto eng'eno.
Imbung'a iutarot aainei aitalang enkosholai, o eng'eno alang saabu gelunoti.
Amu aisidai eng'eno nagut alang isoito oogol enkinyiang'a ore pooki naaba anaa ining'uar, meidimi aaitanyaanyukie ninye.
Ore nanu eng'eno nagut, natii atua enkidimata e ning'unoto e ng'eno, naa katum eng'eno o eyiolounoto.
Ore euriata o Laitoriani, naa enkibayunoto e ntorroni. Ore olwuasa o enkitokoos o enkoitoi e ntorroni, o nkirorot naapaashaa naa kaiba.
Aata enkikoo o eng'eno sidai, naata eng'eno nagut, naata engolon.
Te nanu eitoreisho ilaiguanak, neibalunye ilooitoreisho ina nasipa.
Te nanu eitoreisho ilkituaak, ore ilaitoriak neitore enkop.
Kanyor lelo laanyor nanu, ore lelo laaing'oru nanu te nyuaata naa kaatum.
Etii enkarsisisho o enkanyit tenebo nanu, imasaa naabikoo o puaan.
Ore olng'anayioi lai nelang saabu, saabu ninye nasila. Ore ntumot aainei nelang enkosholai gelunoti.
Alo nanu te nkoitoi e supatisho, too nkoitoi oo sipat enkiguana.
Naitujung karsisisho lelo laanyor nanu, neiput ilchumat lenye masaa.
“Aaitobiriua Olaitoriani nanu, te nkiterunoto e siaai enye, esiaai e dukuya enye te pooki musana”.
Ore too lporori ootulusoitie aaitasheyieki, te nkiterunoto eng'or enkiterunoto e nkop.
Ore eton meetae ineegut aaitobiruaki nanu, ore eton meetae inchorroi naatii enkare.
Ore eton eitu eitamanyuni ildoinyio, ore eton meetae indoinyo naaitobiruaki nanu.
Ore eton eitu eitobiru ninye enkop tenebo nkong'at enyena aashu enterit e dukuya e nkop.
Ore pee eitasheyie ninye keper, atii nanu ine Atii apa ina kata pee eitasheyie ninye keper. Ore pee eigeru olokelel tioriong e nguton e nkop.
Ina kata pee eitasheyie oloing'ang'e le shumata, ina kata pee eitayu nchorroi e nguton.
Ina kata pee epik enaiposha olpolosie metaa megil inkariak enkitanapata enye. Ina kata pee epik olkitamanyunoto le nkop.
Natii apa tenebo ninye anaa olaitobirani arriyia; nara anaake enchipai enye, ashipa te dukuya ninye anaake.
Ashipakino enkop enye namanyi, nashipakino inkera oo ltung'ana.
Ore naa taata nakera aainei, entoning'oki nanu; emayiana lelo ooimbung inkoitoi aainei.
Toning'o enkikoo pee ing'enu, nimiorore ninye.
Eshipa oltung'ani laaning nanu, oing'or anaake nchomito aainei, laanyu too mbat oo nkutukie oo nkajijik aainei.
Amu ore ilaatum nanu netum enkishui; netum omom to Laitoriani.
Kake ore ilo laapong nanu, nepik kewan olbae; ore lelo laaiba nanu nenyor keeya.
Etesheta eng'eno enkaji enye, eitasheyie ing'apeta enyena pokira naapishana.
Neteyieng'a nkishu enyena, eitushula enaisho enye oo sabibu, neitobira sii emisa enye.
Eirriwayie ninye nkaisiaayiak enyena meipotisho, too wuejitin neeika e nkanasa ejo,
Ore ilo pooki omoda, inchoo eibelekenyunye alotu ene o ilo lemeeta ndamunot, ejo ninye,
wou, inosa endaa ai, niok ina aisho oo sabibu naitushula.
Tung'uai emodai pee ibikoo inchu, nilo te nkoitoi e ng'eno nagut.
Ore ilo orerioo olasukenyani netum ninye emoroto, naa ore oloisikong oltung'ani torrono netum olbae.
Minkok olasukenyani aashu kimbayu iyie; inkoo oltung'ani ng'en naa aikinyorru ninye iyie.
Inchoo enkiteng'ena oltung'ani ng'en, naa keponaa eng'eno oleng, inteng'ena oltung'ani supat naa keponaa eng'eno enye.
Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa ninye enkiterunoto e ng'eno, naa ore eng'eno e ilo Sinyati naa ening'unoto.
Amu te nanu eponari inkolong'i inono, aikiponikini iyie ilarin le nkishui.
Tenaa ira iyie ng'en, naa aira ng'en te nkorrok ino; naa tinisukenyisho, naa iyie ake openy onap.
Ore enkitok namoda neilepilep; nemeutaroyu, nemeeta enkurruna nadol.
Eton te nkutuk e nkaji enye, neton too wuejitin neerupa e nkanasa.
Eipotu lelo oogiroo ine, lelo oopuo inkoitoi enye maate,
ore pooki ng'ae omoda, inchoo eibelekenyunye alotu ene, ore pooki ng'ae lemeeta endamunoto nejoki,
“Ore enkare napurruno naa kemelok, ore emukate nainosi too nkisudorot naa aisidai.”
Kake meyiolo ninye ajo etii keeya ine, inchere ore ilomon lenyena netii ineegut e nemeneng'a.
Ore enkerai ng'en neitiship menye, kake ore enkerai namoda naa osomit te ng'otonye.
Ore imasaa naatumi te nkoitoi torrono nemeeta dupoto kake aikilaku esupatisho aitung'uaa keeya.
Meisho Olaitoriani isupati epuo eisumash, kake ore iyieunot e lelo torrok neitalamaa.
Ore enkaina nashal neyau aisinanisho kake ore enkaina o larriyia neyau enkarsisisho.
Ore oltung'ani osotisho te nkata e nkirowuaj naa aing'en, kake ore oltung'ani oirura te nkata e nkikesare neyau enkurruna.
Etii imayianat endukuya e ilo supat kake ore enkutuk eilo torrono nemuk enapiak.
Ore indamunot oo supati naa emayianata; kake ore enkarna o ltorrono naa keng'uoyu.
Ore eng'eno o ltau naa kening'u inkitanapat, kake ore olmodai loo rorei kumok naa keidaaya.
Ore ilo olo te nkoitoi naitoriori nelo te seriani, kake ore ilo oibelekeny inkoitoi enyena naa keirrashi.
Ore ilo orojisho te nkong'u enye aitunyoo esipata neyau enyamali, kake ore ilo oibalie te mpijan esipata neyau eseriani.
Ore enkutuk o supat naa enchorro e nkishui, kake ore enkutuk o ltorrono nenuk entorroni.
Keyau enkiba enchankar sapuk, kake ore enyorrata neimulumul inkitarruorrot pooki.

Ore enkoitoi nalala eilo oitashe too sipat nepaash entorroni; ore ilo orrip enkoitoi enye, negolie enkishui enye.
Eng'asunye olwuasa nesuju enkidaaroto, naa neijia etiu oltau oisis kewan eng'asunye nesuju embatatata.
Enaikash ti niata oltau obor te nebo ilaisinak alang tiniorioro iyarunot te nebo iloowuasa.
Ore ilo oning'u ororei naa kebulaa, neshipa oleng ilo oisilig Olaitoriani.
Ore ilo ng'en to ltau naa keji oltung'ani odolu mbaa, naa ore ilomon ooitishipisho neponaa enkarriyiano.
Ore eng'eno naa enkong'u enchorro e nkishui teilo oata, kake ore emodai naa enkitamioto oo lmoda.
Ore endamunoto o lng'en neitaa ilomon lenyena ile nkiguana, neponaa enkarriyiano te nkutuk enye.
Ore irorei ooitishipisho netiu anaa olkenkei le naisho, emeloni tiatua oltau naa embiotisho tiatua osesen.
Etii enkoitoi nalioo to ltung'ani aa sidai, kake ore enkiting'oto enye naa enkoitoi e keeya.
Errumoki esumash olaisiaayiani metaasisho oleng, ore ina sumash enye nerrumoki ninye metaasisho.
Ore oltung'ani lemeeta tipat neitobiru enkarruoisho, ore ilomon lenyena netiu anaa enkima nadalisho.
Ore oltung'ani loo ntorrok neidapashaa olomang'ati, naa ore oltung'ani lo lmarenke neor ilchoreta ooning'o oleng.
Ore oltung'ani otolo neitapong'oo olelatia enye, nerikoki ninye enkoitoi neme sidai.
Ore ilo orojisho too nkonyek enyena nenyor ataasa nkitobirat naapaashaa, ekurraki enkutuk enye ayau imbaa torrok.
Ore ilpapit ooibor te ndukuya naa enkopiyia e nkitoo, etumi ninche te nkishui naitoriori.
Ore ilo lemesioki agoro neikash alang ilo ogol, ore ilo oitore oltau lenye elang ilo oya enkanasa.
Eosh iltung'ana enkukuo aaing'oru enayieu, kake ore ewalata naa Olaitoriani oishoru pooki.
Enaikash tininya enkiti mukate natoyio iata eseriani, alang ti niata emasho sapuk tiatua enkaji nabore enchankar.
Ore osinka oas ineng'eno naa keitore olayioni inoti oas inenkurruna, naa ketum sii ninye ematua e njung'ore anaa obo le lelo alashera.
Etemi enkosholai te moti, netemi saabu to lkokuet, kake iltauja etem Olaitoriani.
Ore olaasani loo ntorrok nening nkirorot torrok; ore olalejani neinining olng'ejep arruoni.
Ore pooki ng'ae osukeny ilo aisinani, naa olaitobirani lenye etusukenya; ore ilo oshipa te ngolikinoto nemelo eitu eitamei.
Ore inkera oo nkera naa ninche enkopiyia enkitoo, ore enkisisa oo layiok naa loo menye.
Ore ilomon sidain nemeishaakino olmodai, nemeiro ilomon le lejare olayioni lo laiguanani.
Etiu eropet anaa osoit le ntasim too nkonyek eilo oropisho; ore pooki wueji neibelekenyakino nebul.
Ore ilo opalaki enkitarruorroto neing'oru enyorrata, kake ore ilo oigil embae tiaekata, neorore olchore oning'ore.
Ore enkisikong'ata nejing'aa oleng oltung'ani oata ening'unoto, alang ioshot iip naaoshi olmodai.
Ore oltung'ani torrono neing'oru ake ine nkarruoisho, keirriwakini ninye olkilikuai otolo metigilunore ninye.
Enaikash tininang'are olng'arurumi otooruoki inkiyoitin enyena, alang tininang'are olmodai oreuta emodai enye.
Tenerrinyu oltung'ani entorroni te sidai, nemeigut intorrok te nkaji enye.
Ore enkiterunoto e nchankar netiu anaa oltung'ani oboloo emugur e nkare; metaa shomo tung'uai eton eitu ebau olarrabal.
Ore ilo oirukoki lelo torrok e sipata, oilo oiguanare lelo supati, ore pokira naa olminong to Laitoriani.
Kainyoo tipat pee eeta olmodai enkinyang'a te nkaina enye nainosie eng'eno nagut, nemeeta ninye endamunoto?
Ore olchore nenyorrisho te pooki kata, ore olalashe netoiwuoki te nkaraki ingolikinot.
Ore oltung'ani lemeeta endamunoto, neitayu enkisiligata, neaku ninye oitasheiki esile olelatia enye.
Ore ilo onyor inkitadiat nenyor enchankar; ore ilo oilepie kutuk aji enye oleng, neing'oru enkidaaroto.
Ore oltung'ani lemeitoriori ndamunot nemebulaa, ore sii ilo oata olng'ejep opaashaa nebatatakino atua engolikinoto.
Ore enkerai namoda naa osomit te menye; ore menye ilo modai nemeeta enchipai.
Ore oltau oshipa naa olmairo sidai, kake ore oltau otigile neitoi iloik.
Ore oltung'ani torrono nenyoraa eropet to lgoo lenye, pee etum aiminie inkoitoi e sipata.
Ore oltung'ani oata ening'unoto neitorioki enkomom enye eng'eno, kake ore inkonyek olmodai netii nkiting'ot enkop.
Ore enkerai namoda naa osomit te menye, naa emion nadua teina kitok natoiwuo ninye.
Imesidai tiniaraki oltung'ani supat metalaa entoki nemesipa, aitorrono te neitamei nkasisin.
Ore ilo oibooyo irorei lenyena neeta eng'eno, ore ilo oata oltau obor naa oltung'ani oata ening'unoto.
Ore doi ninye olmodai ogira meiro neji aing'en; ore pee eiken enkutuk enye nedoli ajo aing'en.
Ore ilo okepari makewan naa iyieunot enyena eing'oru, pee etum atoorunye te pooki kiguana nasipa.
Meshipakino olmodai embae naning'unoyu meteleku embae enye ake eibalie.
Tenelotu entorroni nelotu sii enkurruna ore te nebo enkurruna netii sii esulare.
Ore irorei le nkutuk o ltung'ani naa nkariak naagut; ore enkong'u e ng'eno naa enchorro naitokitoku enkare.
Meishaakino tinijing enkoriong o ltung'ani arruoni, aashu imitiki oltung'ani supat esipata.
Ore enkutuk o lmodai neyau enchankar, ore enkutuk enye neipotu ioshot.
Ore enkutuk o lmodai naa enkidaaroto enye, ore enkutuk enye naa orreshet te ninye.
Ore irorei le nking'oming'om netiu anaa embelati e mukate namelok, nejing'aa atua osesen lenye.
Ore ilo oshal te siaai enye, naa olalashe le ilo oidaikie.
Ore enkarna o Laitoriani naa oltalet ogol, ekuetiki oltung'ani supat neserianu.
Ore imasaa o lkarsis naa enkanasa enye nagol, netiu anaa esuntai naado namitu ninye.
Eisis oltau lo ltung'ani kewan eton eitu ebau emutata, kake eng'asunye emborron nesuju enkanyit.
Teneishooyo oltung'ani ewalata eton eitu ening'u, naa emodai enye o enkurruna.
Eng'iri oltau lo ltung'ani emuoyian; paa amaa oltau otigile aing'ae oidim ating'iria?
Ore endamunoto oltung'ani ng'en netum eng'eno, ore enkiok oltung'ani ng'en neing'oru eng'eno.
Iyieu nitumore oltung'ani kitok? Iyaki ninye enkishooroto naa kelelek itum ninye.
Ore ilo ong'as airo te dukuya nelioo aa kesipa enkiroroto enye o metaba anaa nelotu likae ajur ninye.
Ore eoshoto e nkukuo neiting'ie enchankar nerishu autu ilo ogol ooishankarra.
Ore olalashe otaretoki netiu anaa enkanasa nagol, kake ore enchankar, netiu anaa iasheta oo sekenke o sempewuet.
Eraposho oltung'ani too lng'anayio le nkutuk enye neitaraposhi too naing'uaa enkutuk enye.
Etii keeya o enkishui atua engolon o lng'ejep, ore lelo oonyor ninye naa kenya ilng'anayio lenyena.
Ore ilo otum enkitok nenoto entoki sidai, nenoto omom to Laitoriani.
Ore te neiro oltung'ani aisinani, naa keomonisho to sayia, kake ore olkarsis newal te ngolon.
Etii ilchoreta oitaakuno ilchoreta, kake etii olchore likimbung'are anyikaki alang olalashe.
Enaikash oltung'ani aisinani olo too sipat enyena alang ilo oitadiak too nkirorot enyena naa olmodai sii.
Meishaakino oltung'ani te nemeeta eng'eno, naa ore ilo oitasiooyo nkejek enyena, nepong enkoitoi enye.
Ore te nerikoki emodai oltung'ani enkoitoi enkidaaroto, negorokino oltau lenye Olaitoriani.

Ore olchakeni lemesipa nemelo eitu eitamei, naa ore ilo oiro elejare nemeilanyisho aisik.
Eing'oru ilkumok omom o ltung'ani aminin, ore pooki tung'ani naa olchore le ilo tung'ani oishooyo inkishoorot.
Ore ilalashera pooki lo laisinani naa keibayu ninye, kebaa pasa elakuani nepuo ilchoreta lenyena aalam ninye! Kesuj ninye ninche too rorei, nemetum ninye ninche.
Ore ilo oata eng'eno nagut naa kenyor kewan; ore ilo oiteng'el ening'unoto naa kebul.
Ore olchakeni lemesipa nemelo eitu eitamei, ore ilo oiro inelejare naa keimin.
Meishaakino olmodai teneton tiatua olkar, naa neijia sii etiu orrindik meitore ilaiguanak.
Ore endamunoto sidai nemeitasieku engoro o ltung'ani, naa enkisisa te ninye te neitunyoo entorroni.
Ore engoro napi o laiguanani netiu anaa enkikurrukur o lng'atuny, kake ore omom enye netiu anaa enkoileelio natii inkujit.
Ore olayioni omoda naa enkidaaroto te menye, ore enkitok enchankar netiu anaa enkirujuruj e nchan.
Ore enkaji o enkarsisisho naa enjung'o naing'uaa iloo papa, kake ore enkitok ng'en naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa.
Keyaki enchalan oltung'ani injo naairoishi, ore oltung'ani oshal naa ketum esumash.
Ore ilo oibung inkitanapat nerrip enkishui enye; ore ilo omenaa ororei naa keye.
Ore ilo oitanana oshoke too laisinak naa Olaitoriani eisilenoko, naa kelaaki olaitoriani ninye enkias enye.
Intamio tuutai enkerai ino eton eetae osiligi; mincho oltau lino ejing errorroto enye.
Ore oltung'ani le ngoro napi naa kelak enkitamioto enye; amu tinilaku ninye taata, naa iyiooki ake aigil alaku.
Toning'u enkikoo ning'amaa enkiteng'enare, pee itum anoto eng'eno too nkolong'i naapuonu.
Etii nkitobirat kumok endukuya o ltung'ani, kake ina nayieu Olaitoriani ninye ake naitashe aaku.
Ore entoki nayieuni to ltung'ani naa enkanyit, naa olaisinani oikash alang olalejani.
Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa aikirikoki enkishui; naa ore ilo oata neyeng'iyeng'a etaraposhe, melotu entorroni enetii ninye.
Ore oltashalai, nenukaa enkaina enye tiatua embakuli nati endaa, nemeitoki hoo ninye ayau apik enkutuk enye.
Toosho ilo asurdaanyani, ore ilo modai neyiolou ine ng'eno; intodua elde oata ening'unoto, naa ketum eng'eno.
Ore ilo oarare menye, nearaa ng'otonye tiang, naa olayioni oyau esulare neyau sii enkurruna.
Ore tiniminining'u nkiteng'enat aainei enkerai ai, nipong'ori alo apaash irorei le ng'eno.
Ore olchakeni lemeeta tipat te likae nekueniyie enkiguana nasipa, ore enkutuk oltorrono naa keijoo intorrok.
Eidipaki endung'okinoto e nkiguana te lelo oosukeny isipat o oshot too nkoriong'i oo lmoda.
Enkasukenyani enaisho oo sabibu naa embuaaroto enaisho napi, naa ore pooki ng'ae oitapong'oyie enaisho nemeng'en.
Ore engoro naitureisho o laiguanani, netiu anaa enkikurrukur o lng'atuny. Ore ilo oitagor ninye neiturraa enkishui enye.

Ore ilo aiguanani oton to lorika le nkiguana, negel asilu ntorrok pooki te nedol too nkonyek.
Aing'ae oidim atejo, “Aitukuo nanu oltau lai; kara nanu sinyati maata eng'oki?”
Ore ntemeta e nkiroishi naapaashipaasha o ntemeta naapaasha nenyaanyuk pokira, olminong to Laitoriani.
Ore doi ninye enkerai neyiolouni too yasat enyena, tenaa ore ina naas naa sinyati nesipa.
Ore enkiok naning'isho te nebo enkong'u nadololisho, Olaitoriani oitobirua pokira.
Minyorru injo, aashu ijing atua osina; tabolo inkonyek inono naa itum endaa sapuk.

Etii saabu o soito kumok oogol enkinyang'a, kake ore enkutuk naata eng'eno naa osoit ogol enkinyang'a.

Ore ilo oloolo ainosaa olmarenke, neibalie imbaa naaisudoro, metaa mintaa encholiek ilo oiro te modai.
Ore ilo odek menye aashu ng'otonye, netiu enkishui enye anaa oltaa otaaraki.
Ore enjung'ore nanotoki aasioki te nkiterunoto, neaku te siadi ene memayiana.
Mijo ake, “Ekaitalaku intorrok,” taanyu Olaitoriani naa aikiretu ninye.
Ore isoito ooineneng'ishoreki oopaashaa naa olminong to Laitoriani, ore intemeta e nkiroishi e lejare nemesidain.
Ore iroruat oltung'ani naa Olaitoriani oitore; kaji naa eiko oltung'ani te nening'u enkoitoi enye?

Ore olaiguanani ng'en nesilu iltorrok nereu enkeju e ngarri aitunyoo ninche.
Ore enkiyang'et o ltung'ani naa oltaa lo Laitoriani ojur oleng pooki toki e atua enye.
Olning'o o enkanyit naaisho olaiguanani metobikoi, ore enkitoria enye neitasheyieki te sipata.

Ore oltau lo laiguanani naa enkaina o Laitoriani etii, keutaa ninye pooki wueji neyieu anaa ereyiet e nkare.
Ore pooki oitoi to ltung'ani naa sidai too nkonyek enyena, kake Olaitoriani ninye oineneng oltau.
Easata oo supati o esipata, ninye nang'amaroyu too nkonyek o Laitoriani alang enkitayunoto o lasar.
Ore nkonyek o lwuasa tenebo oltau owuasa, o ltaa loo ltorrok naa ing'ok.
Ore nkitobirat e ilo oata enyuaata osipa erikoki ninye puaan te nkumoi, kake ore pooki osioki neiting ake te yieunoto.
Ore olchumati litum to lng'ejep olejisho, netiu anaa enkinuku nasiooyo aish naa orreshet le keeya.
Ore enkinyala oo ltorrok naa keoroo ninche aishu, amu etanyaita eas ina nasipa.
Ore enkoitoi eilo torrono naa kekordilo, kake ore olkuaak leilo supat naa aisidai.
Enaikash tinimany olpijata le nchumata enkaji, alang tinitii enkaji e nkitok naata ororei.
Ore oltau leilo torrono neyieu intorrok, metum olelatia enye olng'ur too nkonyek enyena.
Ore te neitamei olasurdaanyani, neng'enu olmodai ore te neutari oltung'ani ng'en, netum eng'eno.
Ore isupati neing'or enkaji eilo torrono; enang'akini iltorrok enkidaaroto.
Ore ilo oiken enkiok enye pee mening enkishirata e lelo aisinak, naa keishir sii ninye nemeetae oloning ninye.
Ore enkishooroto naishoruni too nkisudorot naa keshuk engoro; ore eropare oo nkishoorot neitigir engoro sapuk.
Ore teneasi esipata, naa enchipai too supati, naa enking'asia too laasak loo ntorrok.
Ore oltung'ani olo aing'uaa enkoitoi e ning'unoto netum eneyeng'iyeng'are to lturrur loo lootuata.
Ore ilo tung'ani onyor esikar naa keaku oltung'ani aisinani ore ilo onyor enaisho o ila nemeaku karsis.
Ore ilo torrono naa elakunoto eilo supat, ore olemeisiligayu naa elakunoto oloitashe too sipat.
Enaikash tiniton te nkop o lpurkel natoyio, alang tiniboitare enkitok naata enchankar o lkwenyi.
Ore imasaa naagol enkinyang'a naa kebik te nkaji eilo oata eng'eno, kake ore olmodai naa keijoo.
Ore ilo osuj isipat o enanai e oshoke naa ketum enkishui o enkanyit.
Ore oltung'ani ng'en, neyiolo enaikunakino enkanasa o logol, negil isunta naaisilig ninche.
Ore ilo oiken enkutuk enye neibooyo olng'ejep lenye, neitapaash kewan enyamali.
Ore olasurdaanyani, ninye enkarna o ltung'ani owuasa neitokoos, ilo oas imbaa to lwuasa le nkitokoos enye.
Ore eyieunoto o ltashalai naa kear ninye, metua amu keany inkaik enyena eitayu esiaai.
Keng'uarrisho iltorrok endama pooki, kake ore isupati keishooyo nememit.
Ore olasar leilo torrono naa olminong, kebaa elusoo eitayio to ltau torrono?
Ore olchakeni lemesipa naa keimin, kake ore ororei le ilo oning'isho naa kebikoo.
Ore oltung'ani torrono neitodolu enkomom e mpijan, kake ore oltung'ani oitashe too sipat neing'or inkoitoi enyena.
Ore enemetii eng'eno nagut, nemetii ening'unoto nemetii enkikoo, keidim ayau eanyata Olaitoriani.
Kerreteni embarta eitaanyuni ina olong e njore, kake ore enkisulata naa eno Laitoriani.
Enaikash te negeluni enkarna sidai, alang enkarsisisho sapuk, naa ore omom nelang enkosholai o saabu.
Ore olkarsis o ilo aisinani naa ketumo te nebo, Olaitoriani ninye olaitobirani le pooki.
Ore oltung'ani ng'en naa kedolu batisho neisudoo kewan; kake ore olmodai naa kelo dukuya netum enkitamioto.
Ore olerrinyore le mborron o euriata o Laitoriani, naa enkarsisisho o enkanyit o enkishui.
Etii ilkiku o rresheta enkoitoi eilo otapong'ori; ore ilo orrip kewan naa kelam ninche.
Inteng'ena enkerai enkoitoi naaim, ore pee eaku moruo nemeing'uaa ina oitoi.
Ore olkarsis naa ninye oitore ilo aisinani, ore ilo oisilenu naa osinka le ilo oisilenoko.
Ore ilo oun inemesipa naa keikesu eng'olikinoto, ore eng'udi e ngoro enye napi naa keish.
Ore ilo tung'ani aminin naa kemayiani, amu keng'arie endaa enye ilaisinak.
Intupuku impang'ie ilo oimaki intorrok, naa aikipuku enchankar aing'uaa, ore olarrabal o emorore naa keish.
Ore ilo onyor esinyatisho o ltau, neeta ilomon oomelook naa keaku olchore lo laiguanani.
Etii nkonyek o Laitoriani shumata eng'eno, kake kenang'aa ninye lelo rorei le lelo lemeeta enkirukoto.
Ejo olturuai, “Etii doi olng'atuny auluo: kaari matua too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa!”
Ore enkutuk e nkitok naibor onyek naa engumoto nagut; ore ilo otagorokine Olaitoriani naa kesulakino atua ninye.
Eenaro emodai tiatua oltau le nkerai, kake ore eng'udi e nkitamioto nearaa ninye aitalamaa.
Ore oloibooki enkop olaisinani pee eponaa enkarsisisho enye, aashu eisho lelo karsisi ake, naa kelotu ake sii ninye aaku olaisinani.
Irrugu enkiok ino inining'u irorei lo lang'eni, nintorioki indamunot inono eng'eno ai;
amu keaku esidano tinishum ninche tiatua iyie, te netii pooki atua enkutuk ino.
Pee etum osiligi lino ataa Olaitoriani etii, aaitayiolo iyie ninche taata ena olong, aa iyie taa.
Keitu aasiraki iyie inkirorot tomoni uni, imbaa enkikoo o ne ng'eno,
peyie aaitodol iyie embae naitoriori nesipa, pee itum aishoo ewalata naitoriori nesipa lelo likirriwaa iyie?
Misim olaisinani eji amu kaaisinani, aashu irony oloata osina te kishomi;
amu keng'or Olaitoriani ninche, neinyal enkishui e lelo ooinyal ninche.
Mintaa olchore oltung'ani omanang'u, aashu iriamariyie oltung'ani osioki agoro.
Pee miyiolou inkoitoi enyena, nipik kewan atua orreshet.
Miaku obo le lelo ooisiligie ilkulikae imbaa, ilo oaku oloitasheiki esile e kulikae.
Amaa tinimiata entoki nilakie, Kainyoo doi pee inyorraa meewai endapash ino?
Midotu ake entoki naitodolu olpolosie musana ina apa natipika iloo papaai lino.
Idol oltung'ani arriyia te siaai enye? Keitashe te dukuya ilaiguanak; meitashe te dukuya iltung'ana misili.
Tenelo niton anya endaa te nebo oloitoreisho, ing'ura tisipu oleng ina natii dukuya iyie;
naa tenaa ira oltung'ani oulu, nipik enkalem olgos lino.
Ming'uar intokitin enyena naamelook, amu endaa ina nikipikieki olosek.
Teng'ena miar kewan amutakino ing'oru enkarsisisho, teng'ena pee imbooyo.
Ore pee ikurraki inkonyek inono enkarsisisho, neimin; amu ketum ninye asioki inaipuko, neilep anaa olkurragos olo te keper.
Minya endaa o ltung'ani opiak, ming'uar indaiki enyena sidain.
Amu ore ninye netiu anaa ilo limikiyeu to ltau, aikijoki ninye, “Inosa doi niok!” Kake metii oltau lenye te nebo iyie.
Irrugumu nena belat pooki oo mukateni nindipa ainosa, neimin lelo rorei linono oomelook.
Miro ake te wueji nening'ie olmodai amu kemenaa irorei le ng'eno o rorei linono.
Mintayu ake ina toki musana natii olpolosie, aashu ijing nkurman e lelo lemeeta iloo menye;
amu ore olalakunoni lenye naa kegol; naa keikilikuanu ninye te iyie.
Intorioki endamunoto ino enkiteng'enare, nipik enkiok ino irorei le ng'eno.
Mimbooyo enkitamioto e rerioroto te nkerai; amu tinindong ninye te ng'udi nemeye.
Tinindong ninye te ng'udi, naa intajeu enkishui enye te nemeneng'a.
Enkerai ai, tenaa aing'en oltau lino, naa keshipa sii ninye oltau lai;
naa te neiro enkutuk ino inaasipa, naa keshipa oltau lai.
Mincho oltau lino eng'uar ilaing'okok kake shomo inkolong'i pooki tiatua euriata o Laitoriani.
Esipa katukul etii imbaa sidain dukuya iyie, nemedung'ori osiligi lino katukul.
Toning'o enkerai ai niaku ng'en, nintorioki endamunoto ino ina oitoi.
Miaku ole ncholiek oo laokok le naisho, aashu ole encholiek olooisepe te nkinosata oo nkiri.
Amu ore olamerani o loisepe naa keaku aisinak, neaku ore elepori e merai neishopoki oltung'ani mpurdat.
Toning'o papaai lino ilo apa likitoiwuo, nimimenaa yieyio ino te neaku moruo.
Inyang'u esipata nimimir ake, inyang'u eng'eno nagut, e nkiteng'enare; o ening'unoto.
Ore menye ilo supat naa keshipa oleng; ore ilo otoiwuo olayioni ng'en naa keshipakino ninye.
Inchoo papaai lino o yieyioo ino eshipa, inchoo ina nikitoiwuo eshipa.
Enkerai ai nchooki nanu oltau lino, naa inchoo inkonyek inono eing'or inkoitoi aainei.
Amu ore enkitok naibor onyek naa engumoto nagut; ore ina tang'oroi naa enchorro napirik.
Neirrag ninye aanyisho anaa olaisimani, neponaa ilewa kumok aitaa ilemeisiligayu.
Aing'ae ilo oishir ajo wooi? Aing'ae ilo oata osomit? Aing'ae ilo oata olarrabal? Aing'ae ilo oing'unyug'uny? Kalo ilo oata ilbaa nemeeta eneyopakaki? Kalo ilo odo onyek?
Lelo le meirura eok enaisho, lelo oopuaya aatem enaisho naitushula.
Ming'or enaisho te nyokieni, ina kata eitokitoku te nkikompe, nedoyio aitobirari too lgoso.
Ore te siadi nikiony anaa olasurai, niking'or anaa enturbubua.
Ore inkonyek inono nedol intokitin neitu aekata edol, ore indamunot inono neimaki intokitin naaitapong'oo.
Nitiu anaa oltung'ani oirragita te mpolos e naiposha, anaa ilo oirragita te nchumata e ng'ape e meli.
Ilo iyie ajo, “Aatoosho ninche nanu, kake eitu aning emion; aaidong'o nanu, neitu aning emion. Kanu doi ade ainyototo? Pee alo aing'oru ae aisho naok.”
Ming'uar lelo tung'ana torrok, niming'uar aitaa ninche encholiek.
Amu ore indamunot enye neipiru olarrabal neiro too nkutukie enye imbaa e nkarruoisho.
Te ng'eno eshetuni enkaji naa te ning'unoto eitasheyieki.
Te ng'eno eiputi ilgilat pooki, too ntokitin pooki sidain naagol enkinyang'a.
Ore oltung'ani ng'en naa kegol alang oltung'ani ogol, naa neijia etiu ilo oata eng'eno kelang ilo oata eng'olon.
Amu te rikoto e ng'eno indim aipiru enjore, naa tiatua enkumoi oo lautarok etumi enkishuroto.
Ore eng'eno nagut naa kelakuaniki oleng olmodai, mebol ninye enkutuk enye te kishomi.
Ore ilo oitobiru pee eas ine nkarruoisho, naa keipoti aajo oloitobir enkarruoisho.
Ore enkipirunoto e modai naa eng'oki, naa ore ilo asukenyani naa olminong too ltung'ana.
Ore tininterre te nkolong e nyamali, naa aikiti eng'olon ino.
Intajeu lelo ooyae meshomo keeya; imbooi lelo oorrorrokino keeya.
Tinijo “Ng'ura, eitu duoo iyiook kiyiolou ena,” keitu emusu ilo oineneng oltau ina? Amaa ilo likirrip oltau aimeyiolo ninye? Naa aimelaaki ninye pooki tung'ani anaa enaikununo esiaai enye?
Enkerai ai, inosa enaisho amu aisidai, ore ilkitong'at lo lkenkei naa kemelook tininchamisham;
tayiolo naa ajo neijia etiu eng'eno nagut tiatua oltau lino; tinitum ninye naa itum eseriani too nkolong'i naapuonu, nemedung'ori osiligi lino katukul.
Mirrag arreshisho anaa oltung'ani torrono aarare emanyisho oosupati; miarare enkang enye,
amu kebatata oltung'ani supat kat naapishana, neitoki ake adumunye; kake kemut oltorrono eng'olikinoto.
Mishipa te nebatata olmang'atinta lino, nimincho oltau lino eshipa te nebatata ninye;
pee medol ake Olaitoriani nemeshipa, negoro, neiwuang'ie engoro aitung'uaa ninye.
Mintanyamal kewan te nkaraki ilaasak loo ntorrok, niming'uar ilarruok.
Amu meeta oltung'ani torrono esidano oo nkolong'i naapuonu; amu keari oltaa loo ltorrok.
Enkerai ai turia Olaitoriani o laiguanani, nimigolong'aki hoo obo lenye.
Amu kedumunye emutata te ninche asieku, naa aing'ae oyiolo emutata nalotu eing'uaa pokira?
Ore sii kuna naa nkirorot o lang'eni: ore olkep te nkiguana nemesidai.
Ore ilo ojoki oltung'ani torrono inchere, “Miata iyie entioto,” naa kedek iloreren ninye, neibayu iloshon ninye.
Kake ore ilo oisikong oltorrono naa ketum enchipai, naa kelotu emayianata sidai shumata ninye.
Ore ilo oishoru ewalata nasipa, neng'utut inkonito enkutuk.
Intobira esiaai ino tiauluo niyau pooki toki niyieu enkurma ore pee indip ina nitum taa atesheta enkaji.
Miaku olchakeni oarare olelatia ino miata eniporoki, nimilejisho te nkutuk ino.
Mijo taa ake, “Ekaitaas ninye ina naaitaasa nanu, Ekalaaki ilo tung'ani ina naaitaasa.”
Ashomo nanu agiroo olokeri lo ltashalai, embata enkurma oo sabibu oltung'ani lemeeta endamunoto.
Naa ng'ura, etubulakita ninye ilkiku; ore enkop nebore endiati; ore esuntai enye o soit neturori.
Ina pee aing'or nashilaa ayiolou; aing'ura nang'amu enkiteng'enare.
Kang'as airura penyo, kang'as aimug penyo. Kang'as anunuk inkaik penyo ayeng'iyeng'a.
Nikijing'aki osina iyie o esumash anaa olaisimani, nikijing'aki osina anaa oltung'ani otanape.
Ore sii kuna naa indung'eta e rashe e Solomon naatisira iltung'ana le Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda.
Enkitoo enkisisa te Nkai te neisudoo ninye imbaa, kake enkitoo too laiguanak, te nejurru imbaa aaibalie.
Ore anaa eneba elakuani e keper o eneba enguton e nkop neijia etiu indamunot oo laiguanak mejurrunoyu.
Tooju endoron ti oriong e nkosholai, netum olkunoni entoki naitainyie entoki sidai.
Iwuang'ie lelo torrok te dukuya olaiguanani naa keitasheyieki olorika lenye le nkitoo te sipata.
Mipik kewan dukuya ine netii olaiguanani aashu doi intashe teine wueji olkitok.
Enaikash tinikijokini, “wou ilepu ene” alang tinikintadoyiori te netii olaiguanani.
Ore ina natoduaa inkonyek inono, misioki aisosion ayau atua enkiguana; anaa kaa ias te siadi; tinikilo ole latia ino aitukurru?
Iimaki olomoni liyieu te nebo olelatia makewan, nimilo aboloo imbaa naaisudoro e likae.
Meyau ake ilo oning enkurruna shumata iyie, nitum enkurruna nemeeta enkiting'oto.
