Ore ororei otolimuoki aaitobiru netiu anaa olng'anayioi le saabu oikodokino enkosholai.
Ore anaa enatiu olgisoi le saabu aashu emasaai e saabu, neijia etiu ilo ng'en oisikong enkiok naning'isho.
Ore olkilikuai oisiligayu, neitagol ilo oirriwaa ninye, etiu anaa enkare nairobi, te nkirouaj enkata e nkikesare.
Ore anaa enatiu inkatampo o lkutati lemeeta enchan, neijia etiu ilo owuasare enkishooroto nemeyieu neishooyo.
Te ng'iriata eidimi aailejileja olaiguanani le nkop, naa ore olng'ejep omelok naa kegil oloito.
Tinitum enaisho oo lotorok inosa ake enikiririkino iyie, amu indim ainosa esapuk nintoki alopu.
Mimoku enkaji o lelatia ino, pee miyek ake, nikiyiooki aibayu.
Ore ilo oishakenu embae nemesipa te nkaraki ole latia enye, netiu anaa orinka lo larrabal aashu olalem, aashu embae napi.
Ore enkisiligata oltung'ani lemeisiligayu te nkata enyamali, netiu anaa olalae oigusugus aashu enkeju tarush.
Ore ilo oranyaki osinkolio oltau oata osina, netiu anaa oltung'ani ooru kewan enkila te nkolong nairobi; netiu sii anaa tinipik enaisho naisuisho ewueji netii olbae.
Teneeta olmang'atinta lino esumash, inchoo ninye endaa nanya, naa te neeta enkure, inchoo ninye enkare naok.
Amu inteleikia ninye inkuk naaishu enchumata endukuya enye, naa aikilaaki iyie Olaitoriani.
Ore olkutati oing'uaa moikuape naa keyau enchan; ore olng'ejep okurrisho neyau engoro.
Enaikash tinimany olpijata le nchumata enkaji, alang tiniboitare te nkaji enkitok naata enchankar.
Ore anaa enatiu enkare nairobi to ltau oata enkure, neijia etiu ilomon supati ooing'uaa enkop nalakua.
Ore anaa enatiu enchorro natii esarng'ab, aashu enkong'u enkare naing'ola, neijia etiu oltung'ani supat oisho kewan oltung'ani torrono.
Mme sidai tininya enaisho oo lotorok sapuk, metaa mitem aing'oru enkisisa sapuk.
Ore oltung'ani lemeeta enkibooroto e kewan, netiu anaa enkanasa natigilaki neing'uari meeta isunta.
Ore anaa enatiu isoito le nkirobi te nkata enkirowuaj aashu enchan te nkata enkikesare, neijia etiu enkanyit meishaakino olmodai.
Mikimbung ildeketa iyie aashu te naa iyata enikiporoki, etiu anaa motonyi naapuo to loing'ang'e nemedou aekata aaitirring'a.
Eoshieki elishie embarta, ore olgisoi nepiki enkume o sikiria, ore eng'udi naa ene nkoriong oo lmoda.
Miwaliki olmodai te risioroto e modai enye, aashu iyaku sii iyie olonyaanyukie.
Tawaliki olmodai te risioroto enaikununo emodai enye, pee meng'enu ake too nkonyek enyena makewan.
Ore ilo oirriwaa olkilikuai te nkaina olmodai, nedung'oo nkejek enyena makewan, neok enapiak.
Anaa enatiu inkejek olmaima eililio pesho, neijia etiu endung'et e rashe te nkutuk olmodai.
Anaa enatiu oltung'ani oeniki osoit enkopito, neijia etiu ilo oisho olmodai enkanyit.
Anaa enatiu olkikuei ojing atua enkaina olamerani, neija etiu endung'et e rashe natii atua inkutukie oo lmoda.
Anaa enaikununo olang'oroni le nkawuo opik ilbaa pooki ng'ae, neijia etiu ilo oisho olmodai ogiroo esiaai aashu olamerani.
Anaa oldia orrinyokino irrugumat enyena, neijia etiu olmodai oigil emodai enye.
Itoduaa oltung'ani ng'en too nkonyek enyena makewan, eeta olmodai osiligi sapuk alang ninye.
Ejo oltashalai, “Etii olng'atuny ina oitoi! Etii olng'atuny nena oitoi naalala enkanasa!”
Ore anaa kutuk aji nabolo too enat enyena, neijia sii etiu oltashalai te ndapash enye.
Kenukaa oltashalai inkaik enyena tiatua esaani; nenauru ninye te neshuku arrinyoki enkutuk enye.
Aing'en oltashalai too nkonyek enyena makewan, alang iltung'ana oopishana ooidim aatawal te nkarriyiano.
Ore ilo ojing'aki olarrabal lemenyikita, netiu anaa ilo olo aibung inkiyiaa o ldia ogiroo.
Ore anaa enaikununo oltung'ani lo loirirua onang'aa ilkeek le nkima ooyupuyup o mbaa o keeya,
neijia etiu oltung'ani olej olelatia enye, nejo, “Ekaiguran taa ake!”
Ore pee elai ilkeek neye enkima; naa ore enemetii olaing'oming'omani neish enchankar.
Ore anaa enatiu inkuk tiatua olang'at le nkima o lkeek te nkima, neijia etiu oltung'ani le nchankar einuaaya enchankar aitudupaa.
Ore irorei le nking'oming'om naa kemelook, anaa mbelat e mukate, nedoyio aapuo atua ilkutot lo sesen.
Ore anaa enatiu enkimerlel natumurieki emoti e nterit, neijia etiu irorei sidain ooirori neme sidai oltau lo loiro.
Ore ilo oisunkur te nkiba neiro to yieta kake eisudoo aibok elejare to ltau lenye;
te neiro too rorei le mpiris miruk ninye, amu etii oltau lenye olminong katitin naapishana
ore hoo netem aitoipoo enkiba enye te nkeleekisho, ekeibalunyeki intorrok enyena to lturrur.
Ore ilo otur engumoto naa kesulakino naa keibeleleng'okino osoit shumata ilo oitera aibeleleng'oo.
Ore olng'ejep olejisho neiba ilmang'ati lenyena te lejare. Ore enkutuk nailelemisho neyau enkidaata.
Miwuasa te nkaraki ine ntaaisere, amu miyiolo inaayooki ina olong ayau.
Inchoo likae kisis iyie kake mme enkutuk ino makewan, olomoni, neme enkutuk ino.
Ore osoit naa keiroishi, ore sii osinyai neiroshi, kake ore engoro olmodai neiroshi alang pokira.
Egogong engoro napi, ore engoro nemutisho, kake aing'ae oidim aitasho te dukuya olom.
Enaikash enkisikong'ata nikinchori naibala alang enyorrata naisudoro.
Eisiligayu ilbaa likipik olchore, naa kumok ing'ututat olmang'atinta.
Ore ilo otaraposhe naa keany enaisho oo lotorok, kake ore te ilo oata esumash, naa kedol ninye ina pooki nadua anaa kemelok.
Anaa emotonyi nalo aing'uaa enkaji enye, neijia etiu oltung'ani olo aing'uaa enkang enye.
Ore eilata o esonkoyo neitiship oltau, kake kepolos enyamali oltau.
Ming'uaa olchore lino o olchore le papaai lino, nimilo enkaji olalashe lino te nkolong e ngolikinoto ino. Enaikash olelatia lino otaana, alang olalashe lino olakua.
Teng'ena enkerai ai nintiship oltau lai pee atum atawalaki ilo laaing'oru nanu aitukurru.
Ore oltung'ani ng'en nedolu batisho neisudoo kewan; kake ore ilo omoda nelo adoiki netum enkitamioto.
Iwa enkila oltung'ani te neitayio ajo kelak esile o lomoni, nimbung ninye to rorei le nkutuk enye nchere keitasheiki olomoni te sile.
Ore ilo omayian ole latia enye to ltoilo sapuk, einyototo ayooki enasirie, naa keikenari aajo oldeket.
Etiu enkitok e nchankar anaa oloirujuruj te enkolong e nchan.
Ore tinimbok ninye netiu anaa tinimbok osiwuo aashu imbung emborei e ilata, te nkaina enye e tatene.
Eii esekenkei aitipij esekenkei, neitipij oltung'ani o likae tung'ani.
Ore pooki ng'ae oramat olng'aboli naa kenya ilng'anayio lenyena, naa ore ilo orrip olkitok lenye naa keyanyituni.
Ore anaa enaibalunye enkare enkomom ino tining'or, neijia etiu endamunoto oltung'ani eutu ilo tung'ani enatiu.
Ore enemeneng'a o mutata nemeraposho aekata, nemeraposho aekata inkonyek o ltung'ani.
Etemi enkosholai te moti, netemi saabu to lkokuet, netemi oltung'ani te nkisisa enye.
Ore hoo tinipurd olmodai te ntoki naidong'ishoreki, nindong ninye tenebo enkurma naidong'i, melo hoo emodai enye aing'uaa ninye.
Tayiolo katukul enaikununo intare inono, niramat nena kishu inono oleng.
Amu mebikoo taa enkarsisisho intarasi, naa ama kebikoo sii enkopiyia e nkitoo too ishoritin pooki intarasi?
Ore teneishunye nkujit nebulu kulie, nesotuni nkaitubulu oo ldoinyo,
nitum inkilani too lkuoo linono le kerra, nitumie nena kineji enkurma.
Ketumi kule nikibaiki too nkineji inono, neaku endaa o lmarei lino pooki o enintotiyie nkaisiaayiak inono.
Keilanyisho lelo torrok meeta oltung'ani omirita, kake ore isupati naa kepi ninche anaa olng'atuny.
Ore teneas enkop intorrok, neeta ilaitoriak kumok, kake ore iltung'ana oata ening'unoto o eng'eno, naa keitasheyie ninche ninye te nkata naado.
Ore oltung'ani aisinani oibooki enkop ilo aisinani, netiu anaa enchan naar endaa nemeleku.
Ore lelo oomenaa inkitanapat neisis lelo torrok, kake ore lelo ooibung inkitanapat nearare ninche.
Ore iltung'ana torrok nemening'u esipata, kake ore lelo ooing'oru Olaitoriani naa kening'u katukul.
Enaikash oltung'ani aisinani olo te ng'eno enye, alang oltung'ani karsis laa torrok inkoitoi enyena.
Ore ilo oibung ena kitanapata naa enkerai ng'en, kake ore ololo aisiritore oltung'ani olubo naa keitukurru menye.
Teniaku karsis intalaku dupoto too ltung'ana, nelo karsisisho ino aaku, eno ltung'ani onana oshoke too laisinak.
Tenelo neitoming'an oltung'ani enkiok enye pee mening ina kitanapata, neaku ore ninye enkomono enye naa olminong to Laitoriani.
Ore ilo oitapong'oo ilo supat autaki atua enkoitoi torrono, naa kesulakino engumoto enye makewan, kake ore ilo lemeeta entioto naa ketum enjung'ore sidai.
Ore oltung'ani karsis naa aing'en too nkonyek enyena makewan, kake ore oltung'ani aisinani oata endamunoto naa kejur ninye oleng.
Ore te nemirisho isupati, naa ketumi enkisisa sapuk, kake te neinyototo iltorrok, neisudoo iltung'ana ate.
Ore ilo oisudoo ing'ok enyena nemebul, kake ore ilo oibalie neing'uaa ninche naa ketum olng'ur.
Emayiana ilo tung'ani oure Olaitoriani anaake; kake ore ilo oitagol oltau lenye naa kebatatakino atua ingolikinot.
Ore anaa enatiu enkikurrukur o lng'atuny, aashu olng'arurumi okuetu, neijia etiu oloitoreisho torrono too ltung'ana aisinak.
Ore oloitoreisho lemeeta ening'unoto naa olaironyani ogogong; kake ore ilo oiba imasaa naapurruno naa keitoodor inkolong'i enyena.
Teneitanyamal oltung'ani osarge le ilo tung'ani apa otara, inchoo ninye elimana o metua naa inchoo melo ake oltung'ani hoo obo aretu ninye.
Ore ilo olo te sipata naa keitajeuni, kake ore ilo opong'ori too monko too nkoitoi enyena naa kesulakino eng'umoto.
Ore ilo otur enkurma enye naa ketum endaa sapuk, kake ore ilo osuj imbaa nemeeta tipat naa ketum aisinanisho sapuk.
Ore oltung'ani oisiligayu naa ketum imayianat kumok. Kake ore ilo osioki aaku olkarsis nemelo eitu eitamei.
Tinintodolu olkep neme sidai; kake keidim oltung'ani ataasa ntorrok te nkaraki enkiti daa.
Ore oltung'ani lo lorok neing'oru enkarsisisho nasieku, nemeyiolo ajo kelotu osina enetii ninye.
Ore ilo oisikong oltung'ani, ore te siadi naa keitoki atum omom, alang ilo opakas ninye too rorei lo lng'ejep lenye oopuyiapui.
Ore pooki ng'ae opur menye aashu ng'otonye nejo, “Imme enkitarruorroto ina katukul,” naa ole ncholiek e ilo tung'ani amutani.
Ore oltung'ani lo lorok neinyeyie olarrabal, kake ore ilo oisilig Olaitoriani naa keitaae karsis.
Ore ilo oisilig endamunoto enye naa olmodai, kake ore ilo olo te ng'eno nagut naa kekorduni.
Ore ilo oleng too laisinak, nemeng'oriki hoo toki ninye, kake ore ilo oisudoo inkonyek enyena netum ildeketa kumok.
Ore te nedumunye iltorrok, neisudoo iltung'ana ate, kake te neidaaya neponari iltung'ana supati.
Tenikirerei anaake nintagol elukunya ino, niyiooki nabo olong agila, nimintoki aishiu.
Ore te netii isupati enkitoria, naa keshipa iltung'ana, kake te neitoreisho iltorrok naa kenyamalu neing'unyung'uny olorere.
Ore ilo onyor eng'eno nagut naa keitiship menye, kake ore ilo oitaa inkituaak naaibor onyek encholiek naa keishang'itie imasaa enyena.
Te sipata eisho olaiguanani enkop enkitashoto, kake ore ilo oisimaa nkishoorot neidaikie enkop enye.
Ore oltung'ani opakas ole latia enye, naa inkejek enyena eisalaashaka orreshet.
Ore oltung'ani torrono naa keibung'i too ntorrok enyena, kake ore oltung'ani supat eranyisho neshipa sii.
Ore oltung'ani supat neyiolo sipat eilo aisinani; ore oltung'ani torrono nemening'u ine ng'eno.
Ore lelo asurdaanyak naa keinuaaki enkanasa enkima, kake kerriny iltung'ana ng'eni engoro napi.
Tenelo neishankarra oltung'ani ng'en o lmodai, naa kegoro ake olmodai neitoki akueni nemegira.
Ore iltung'ana ooata enkure o sarge naa keiba ilo lemeeta entioto neing'oru lelo torrok enkishui enye.
Ore olmodai naa keiro alimu engoro enye pooki, kake ore oltung'ani ng'en neitirring'a aibooyo.
Ore te neinining olarikoni le nkop imbaa e lejare, naa keaku ilooitoreisho lenyena pooki torrok.
Etumo olaisinani o ilo aironyani lenye tenebo; neisho Olaitoriani ninche pokira nkonyek enye ewang'an.
Teneiguanare olaiguanani ilo aisinani te sipata, naa keitasheyieki enkitoria enye ntarasi.
Ore eng'udi tenebo enkisikong'a e nkikoo naa keyau eng'eno nagut, kake ore enkerai natapalayioki naa keyaki ng'otonye enkurruna.
Ore te nejing iltorrok enkitoria, naa keponari ntorrok, kake keanyu lelo supati aadolu embatatata enye.
Toosho tarerioi enkerai ino tuutai naa aikincho ninye enkiyeng'iyeng; naa keisho enchipai oltau lino.
Ore ine nemetii enaibon e Nkai nebatata iltung'ana amu meeta enasujita. Kake emayiana ilo oibung inkitanapat.
Merere olaisiaayiani irorei ake le nkutuk, ore hoo duo nening'u, menyorraa aibung asuj.
Itodua oltung'ani okuetiki aimaki irorei lenyena? Eeta olmodai osiligi sapuk alang ninye.
Ore tinincho osinka lino pooki toki nayieu te keraisho, niyiooki amaniki etaa olajung'oni lino.
Ore oltung'ani le ng'oro napi naa kedumu olarrabal, naa ore oltung'ani oata engoro naa keyau ntorrok kumok.
Keitadoyio olwuasa lo ltung'ani oltung'ani, kake ore ilo obor to ltau naa ketum enkanyit.
Ore ilo oitaa olapurroni encholiek naa keiba enkishui enye makewan; ening ilo deket, nemeeta entoki naibalie.
Ore euriata o ltung'ani neyau orreshet. Kake ore ilo oisilig Olaitoriani neserian.
Eing'oru ilkumok omom o loitoreisho, kake to Laitoriani etum oltung'ani esipata.
Ore oltung'ani leme asipani naa olminong te lelo supati, kake ore ilo oitoriori enkoitoi enye naa olminong te lelo torrok.
Irorei kulo le Agur olayioni le Yake le Masa, etiaaka ilo tung'ani Itiel, Itiel tenebo Ukai.
Kesipa tukul kamoda oleng mara oltung'ani. Maata ening'unoto o ltung'ani.
Eitu aitamok kewan eng'eno nagut, aashu doi ninye aata eng'eno eilo sinyati.

Aing'ae oilepa alo keper neitoki adou abori? Aing'ae ilo oiturrurro osiwuo too nkaik enyena? Aing'ae ilo otununuko inkariak tiatua enkila? Aing'ae ilo oitasheyie inkiting'ot ena kop? Keji ng'ae enkarna enye, naa keji enkarna e nkerai enye ng'ae? Kesipa iyiolo iyie!
Ore pooki rorei le Nkai neibala ajo kesipa; ninye elong'o e lelo oosaru ninye.
Miponaa ake irorei lenyena anaa kisikong iyie, nikiyiookini aatum aajo ira olalejani.
Intokitin are aaikilikuan iyie mikimitiki ake ninche nanu eton eitu aye:
Intayu te nanu intalamai mbaa e ntorroni o elejare; mikincho nanu aisinanisho aashu enkarsisisho. Intotioki teina daa naishiaakino naata.
Pee maraposho ake naayooki aany iyie, najo, “Aing'ae doi ilo aitoriani?” Anaa aaku aisinani, naaku olopurrisho, naisarkionie ina arna e Nkai ai.
Milo aitang'or osinka te dukuya olkitok lenye, anaa kiyiooki adek iyie, niaku oloata entorroni.
Etii lelo oodek iloomenye, nememayian sii noo ng'otonye.
Etii lelo oodol aajo meeta ntiot too nkonyek enye maate, neitu eisujari ilduruki lenye.
Etii lelo oodamu aajo aisidain ninche oleng, ee, eji kejo ninche aisidain oleng!
Etii lelo laa ore ilala lenye naa ilalema, ore ilala lenye naa inkalema, pee etum aainosa ilaisinak aaitung'uai ena kop, o ilo omena tiatua iltung'ana.
Eeta olchutai intoyie are, naaishir aajo: “Nchooki, nchooki.” Eetae intokitin uni nemeitaraposhoyu aekata, ong'uan nemejo aekata, “Ataraposhe.”
Enemeneng'a, ina kitok olupi, enkop naata anaake enkure eyieu enkare, o enkima nemejo aekata “Ataraposhe.”
Ore enkong'u e ilo omen menye neany eyanyit ng'otonye, naa kedumu ilkurruki lo yerata, nenya ilkurragoso.
Etii intokitin uni naa enking'asia te nanu; ong'uan nemaning'u.
Enkoitoi olkurragos to loing'ang'e, enkoitoi olasurai te ndapidapoi, enkoitoi emeli te mpolos oo naaiposha o enkoitoi olee eboitare eselenkei.
Nena enkoitoi eina naloloito: Kenya ake, nejut enkutuk enye, nejo, “Eitu aas entorrono.”
Ore tiabori intokitin uni neikirikira enkop; ore tiabori ong'uan nemeidim ating'iria:
Osinka te neaku olaiguanani, olmodai oata pooki nanya naraposh;
o ina kitok naibae te netum olpayian o enkaisiaayiani najung ewueji e ina kitok naitore ninye.
Etii intokitin ong'uan enkop naa aikutiti, kake kelus oleng eng'eno enye.
Inkalao: naa mme iltung'ana oogol, neitaiki ake ate endaa neshum te nkata enkirowuaj.
Inkijujurri: neme iltung'ana oogol ninche, kake eitobir inkang'itie enye tiatua isoito.
Olmaati: lemeeta olaiguanani, kake epuo pooki aairiamari to lturrur obo.
Empur naa imbung too nkaik inono, kake etii ninye atua iwuejitin enkitoo oo laiguanak.
Etii intokitin ong'uan naadeenyari tenepuo olotiei sidai.
Olng'atuny: ogol te pooki ng'ues, nemerrinyo siadi tiae toki;
Olukunku o Loro, olaiguanani elo te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena.
Tinitomode aaku oloisis kewan, aashu tinitaa oloun intorrok, tipika enkaina ino enkutuk ino.
Amu tinimposh kule naa itum eng'orno, naa tiniosh enkume e likae nepuku osarge, naa tinimposh olkwenyi neiu enchankar o lomang'ati.
Irorei kulo le Lemuel olaiguanani le Masa, ooiteng'ena ng'otonye ninye:
Ira iyie enkerai ai, enkerai e nguset ai, ewalet enkomono ai, ainyoo enkerai ai?
Miishaki engolon ino o mali inono inkituaak, ninche naaidakie ilaiguanak.
Mme enoo laiguanak, iyie Lemuel, eokoto enaisho, aashu too laitoriak pee eyieu enaisho napi.
Eokisho ake nerikino ninche nkitanapat, nemeitoki aasuj esipata e lelo ooinyalaki.
Ore enaisho napi naa ene lelo oogira aaye o lelo ooata emion sapuk tiatua iltauja lenye.
Inchoo ninche metooko pee erikino osina lenye, nemeitoki aadamu osina lenye.
Inchoo enkutuk ino eiro te rishata e lelo lemeyiolo aairoro, niro esipata e lelo pooki ootung'uayioki oopeny.
Inchoo enkutuk ino eiguana anaa olarishani osipa, torripo isipat e lelo aisinak o lelo oomena.
Aing'ae oidim anoto enkitok nadupa naishiaakino enkanyit? Amu eeta ninye tipat oleng alang isoito oogol enkinyang'a.
Keisilig oltau lo lpayian lenye ninye, nemelau aekata ninye dupoto.
Keitaas ninye olpayian lenye isupati neme entorrono, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui enye.
Neing'oru ninye aitobiru inkilani too lpapit loo ntare tenebo o kitani neasisho too nkaik to ltau le nyorrata.
Etiu ninye anaa melin o lamirani, eyau ninye endaa enye te nelakua.
Einyototo ninye eton aa kewarie, neitobiraki enkaji enye pooki endaa nanya, neing'uraki inkaisiaayiak enyena esiaai naas.
Eing'oru ninye enkurma neinyang'u; ore too lng'anayio loo nkaik enyena neun enkurma oo sabibu.
Erreten ninye empolos enye te ngolon, neitagol inkaik enyena.
Edol ajo ore pooki toki naitobiru amir neeta dupoto; nemeye oltaa lenye kewarie.
Epik inkaik enyena ina toki naitobiru o lpiyayoi, neibung too nkaik enyena ina garri naripunyeki inkilani.
Eitorioki ilaisinak inkaik enyena, neitoti too nkaik enyena ilaisinak.
Meure ninye enkata e nkirobi tenebau amu ore enkaji enye pooki, neeta nkilani naairowua.
Eitobiraki enkaji enye ilkarash le rruat; ore inkilani enyena naa ine kitani napuiyiapuy pilei.
Keyioloi olpayian lenye too nchomito neyioloi te neton tiatua lelo payiani le ina kop.
Eitobir ninye nkilani naapuyiapuy e kitani nemir ninche; eisho ilamirak inkeenta o mpolosi meinyang'u.
Ore inkilani enyena naa engolon o enkanyit, nekueni too nkolong'i naapuonu e dukuya.
Ebol ninye enkutuk enye te ng'eno, ore enkiteng'enata o esupatisho netii olng'ejep lenye.
Eing'or ninye aramat imbaa pooki o lmarei lenye, nemenya ninye endaa neitu eisiayu.
Einyototo inkera enyena neipot ninye aajo enamaiyiana; neijia sii ejo olpayian lenye, eisis ninye ejo:
“Etaasa inkituaak kumok imbaa sidain oleng: kake ore iyie ilang ninche pooki.”
Ore entilare naa kelejisho, ore esidano naa enepesho, kake ore enkitok naure Olaitoriani naa ninye natum enkisisa.
Inchoo ninye olng'anayioi loo nkaik enyena, nincho esiaai enye eisis ninye te nena shomito.
Irorei kulo lo laikooni, olayioni le Daudi, olaiguanani te Yerusalem.
Ine pesho, ine pesho, ejo olaikooni, ine pesho ine pesho. Ine pesho pooki toki.
Kainyoo etum oltung'ani te siaai enye pooki natanauri kia, ina natanaurikia tiabori enkolong?
Kelusoo eishoi, nelotu ae ishoi, kake kebik ake enkop intarasi.
Keilepu enkolong neitoki adoyio, nesiooyo alo ine neilepunye.
Kekutari olkutati alo Kopikop, nemanaa alo enkalo e moikuape; Neiulo aiulo elo, ore teina kiuloto enye nerrinyokino eneing'uaa.
Kerukokino inchorroi pooki enaiposha, kake meboreyu aekata enaiposha. Neshukokino enkare irreyieta neitoki aigil arukokino inaaiposha.
Keitanaurisho pooki toki, meidim tung'ani aimaki ninye. Meraposho enkong'u eing'orisho, nemeiput sii enkiok imbaa naaning.
Ore ina natii apa naa ninye naitoki atii, naa ore ina naataasaki naa ninye eitokini aas; nemeetae ae toki ng'ejuk tiabori enkolong.
Ketii entoki natejoki, “Ing'ura, aing'ejuk ena?” Ketii apake too nkatitin e moitie eton eitu eini iyiook.
Meetae endamunoto oo ntokitin naatulusoitie, nemeitokini aekata aata enadamunyeki ntokitin neton etii dukuya naasayu te lelo oopuonu te siadi.
Ore nanu ele aikooni nataa apa olaiguanani oitasheiki Isiraeli te Yerusalem.
Napik endamunoto ai aing'oru aturu eng'eno e nena pooki naasi tiabori keper; esiaai nemetii enchipai apa eishoo Enkai inkera oo ltung'ana metanyamaliki.
Atoduaa pooki toki naasitae tiabori enkolong; nanyorriki ajo ore pooki naa ine pesho. Etiu anaa osiwuo ake emirareki.
Ore ina natakordile nemeidimi aaitorioi, ore ina nemeetae nemeikenayu.

Najoki nanu kewan, “Aing'orua nanu eng'eno sapuk nagut, nalang lelo apa pooki ooitasheikito Yerusalem te dukuya nanu; neeta endamunoto ai enkarriyiano e ng'eno nagut eng'eno oo mbaa nataasa o eyiolounoto.”
Napik endamunoto ai ayiolou eng'eno nagut nayiolou olkuenyi o emodai. Nanyorriki ajo ore sii ninye ena naa osiwuo ake emirareki.
Amu ore eng'eno nagut sapuk, nepik inyamalaritin kumok oltau naa ore ilo oponaa eyiolounoto neponaa sii emion o sina.
Najoki nanu kewan to ltau, “Wou taata amu katem esidano o lkar; ntumurru, ndipakinoyu.” Kake atoduaa ajo ore sii ninye apa ena naa ene pesho.
Atejo sii ena aimaki enkuenia “Ene modai”, ore olkar nemeeta enikintaas sidai.

Aing'orua oleng te ndamunoto ai enaiko te naitiship osesen lai te naisho oo sabibu neton ake aarikito endamunoto ai arikoo te ng'eno nagut o enaiko te natum aibung emodai o metaba anaa nadol ina apa naji aisidai too nkera oo ltung'ana neas tiabori keper te nena kuti olong'i e nkishui enye.
Ataasa isiaaitin sapuki; atesheta inkajijik, naunoki kewan inkurman oo sabibu
naitobiraki kewan inkurman o wuejitin neeyeng'iyeng'areki, naun te ninche impukunot pooki oo lkeek loo lng'anayio.
Naitobiraki kewan ilturot lapikie ina tim oo lkeek nabulu enkare.
Ainyiang'ua irrindiki, ilewa o ng'oruo, naata apa irrindiki ootoiwuoki te nkaji ai; naata sii apa iluaat kumok oo nkishu o ntare, alang pooki ng'ae apa otii dukuya nanu te Yerusalem.
Atushumaka sii kewan enkosholai o saabu o lchumati pooki loo laiguanak, loo lkirinen. Anoto sii ilaranyak, ilewa o ng'oruo o nkapiak kumok oleng, inkituaak kumok naayieu olee neeta.
Metaa ataa apa kitok oleng nagiroo pooki apa laatii te dukuya te Yerusalem; naata ake sii eng'eno nagut tiatua nanu.
Ore pooki nang'uar inkonyek aainei neitu alau ninche. Atipika oltau lai atua esikar, amu ore oltau lai nenoto esikar te eekenyata ai pooki, naa ena apa olekoisiaayio le nauri ai pooki.
Nalotu asipu nena apa pooki naataasa inkaik aainei o eekenyata nanoto aasita ina, nadol ajo ore pooki naa ine pesho naa osiwuo ake amirare, nemeetae hoo toki naata dupoto tiabori enkolong.
Metaa aibelekenyakine aineneng eng'eno nagut o lkuenyi; kainyoo eas oltung'ani olotu te siadi olaiguanani? Ina ake naidipaki aataas.
Metaa atoduaa ina ng'eno nagut ajo kelus te sidano emodai anaa enalus ewang'an te sidano enaimin.
Kedol oltung'ani oata eng'eno nagut eneloito, kake ore olmodai nelo te naimin; nayiolo ake ajo etum pooki olbuket obo.
Ina peyie ajoki kewan, “Ore ina natum olmodai naa katum sii nanu; Kainyoo naa peyie ataa nanu ng'en oleng?” Najoki kewan ore sii ninye ena naa empesho.
Meetae oltung'ani odamu ilo ng'en, nemeetae olodamu olmodai, amu ore too nkolong'i naapuonu nerikinisho pooki. Keye ake ilo ng'en anaa ilo modai!
Metaa aibayie apa enkishui amu ore nena naasi tiabori enkolong naa torrok te nanu; amu ine pesho pooki netiu anaa osiwuo ake emirareki.
Ekaiba apa eekenyata ai pooki nateekenye tiabori enkolong tenadamu ajo kaing'ueki ninche ilo tung'ani olotu te siadi nanu,
naa aing'ae oyiolo te naa keaku oltung'ani ng'en aashu olmodai. Naa keaku ake oloitore nena pooki natanyamalaka aasishore eng'eno ai nagut tiabori enkolong. Ore sii ninye ena naa empesho.
Metaa aibelekenye aisho oltau lai meiting'o osiligi too siaaitin pooki aainei nataasa tiabori enkolong.

Amu ore tiaekata, ore oltung'ani otaasishe te ng'eno nagut o te yiolounoto o te nkarriyiano, neing'uaa pooki metishipakinoyu ilo leitu enyamaliki ninye. Ore sii ninye ena naa empesho naa entorroni sapuk.
Kainyoo eeta oltung'ani too siaaitin o enauri natum easisho tiabori enkolong?
Amu ore nkolong'i enyena pooki nebore emion, ore esiaai enye pooki naa oltau eiroshiyie; neijia ninye etiu kewarie meyeng'iyeng'a indamunot enyena. Ore sii ninye ena naa empesho.
Meetae entoki naikash te tung'ani alang te nenya neok netum enchipai te ekenyata enye. Atoduaa sii ena ajo inkaik e Nkai eing'uaa;
amu teneme Enkai aing'ae oidim ainosa aashu aing'ae oidim atishipakinoyu?

Ore ilo tung'ani oitiship ninye neisho Enkai ninye eng'eno nagut o eyioulounoto o eng'ida; kake ore olaing'okoni, neisho ninye ina siaai e sotore neiturrur peyie eisho ilo oitiship Enkai. Ore sii ninye ena naa empesho netiu anaa osiwuo ake emirareki.
Ore te pooki toki neetae enkata enye, neetae enkata e pooki toki tiabori keper:
Keetae enkata naini, neetae enkata naye, neetae enkata e unore, neetae enkata e nkesare.
Keetae enkata naari metua, neetae enkata naishiunyeki; neetae enkata nagili, neetae enkata nasheti.
Keetae enkata naishiri, neetae enkata nakueni; neetae enkata e nkishirata o sina, neetae enkata o sinkolio
Keetae enkata nanang'ari isoito, neetae enkata naiturrurri isoito tenebo; neetae enkata naibung'ae aaitamuata inkaik, neetae enkata nemeibung'ae aaitamuata inkaik.
Keetae enkata naing'oruni, neetae enkata naiminieki, neetae enkata nashumi, neetae enkata naiturrarri.
Keetae enkata napolosi, neetae enkata naripi neetae enkata nagirae, neetae enkata nairori.
Keetae enkata e nyorrata, neetae enkata e nkiba; neetae enkata o larrabal, neetae enkata e seriani.
Kainyoo dupoto natum olaisiaayiani te eekenyata enye?
Atoduaa ina siaai naishorua Enkai aisho nena kera e tung'ani metanyamaliki ninche.

Eitaa ninye pooki toki sidai te nkata enye; netipika ninye tung'ani yieuna nayiolounye mbaa neitu easa, ore etiu neijia nemeidim ninye atayiolo ina nataasa Enkai te nkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto.
Ayiolo ajo meetae ae toki sidai te ninche alang teneitiship ate neng'ida too nkolong'i pooki naaishu ninche.
Enkishooroto sii e Nkai to ltung'ani nchere ore pooki ng'ae nenya, neok, neisikarra te ekenyata enye pooki.
Ayiolo ajo ore pooki naas Enkai neitashe ntarasi; meetae ae toki naponikini ninye; nemeetae toki naiwuang'ieki te ninye; eitaa Enkai metotiwuo neijia, peyie etum iltung'ana aatureita ninye.
Ore ina natii, netii apake, ore ina naitoki atii, netii apake, neing'oru Enkai ina naterewaki aaitalamaa.
Ore tenebo ina atoduaa ake sii tiabori enkolong teine wueji neutarieki esipata ajo etii ake sii ninye ine nkarruoisho, ore ine wueji e supatisho, netii ake sii ninye enkarruoisho.
Najo tiatua oltau lai, ekeiguanare Enkai lelo supati neiguanare lelo torrok, amu etegelua ninye enkata te nkaraki pooki toki, o pooki siaai.
Najo to ltau lai tenena naaipirta nkera oo ltung'ana inchere Enkai natemita ninche pee eitodol ninche nchere ing'uesi ninche.

Amu ore eneiting'oki iltung'ana naa ninye sii eiting'oki ng'uesi; ore anaa enaye nabo neye ake sii ninye enkae. Keeta pooki enkiyang'et nabo nenyaanyuk, nemeeta oltung'ani enelang'ie nena ng'uesi; amu ore pooki naa empesho.
Epuo pooki ewueji nebo; amu enterit eing'uaa pooki nerrinyokino pooki enterit aaigil.
Aing'ae oyiolo tenaa ore enkiyang'et oltung'ani neilep alo shumata, ore enkiyang'et eng'ues nelo abori atua enkop?
Metaa atoduaa ajo metii toki naikash alang teneshipakino oltung'ani esiaai enye, amu ina doi esiaai enye; aing'ae oidim ayau ninye metoduaa imbaa naasuju ninye eidipa atua?

Atoduaa ake sii nena baa pooki e nkitorogonyata naasitae tiabori enkolong. Nadol ilkiyio le lelo ooitorogonyitai, nemeetae hoo obo oilejilej ninche! Ore lelo ooitorogonyisho neeta engolon, nemeetae hoo obo oilejilej lelo ooitorogonyi.
Nadamu ajo ore lelo ooidipa aatuata nemunyak ninche oleng aalang lelo leton eishu;
neikash oleng te pokira ilo leton eitu eini neitu edol nena baa torrok naasi tiabori enkolong.
Nadol ajo ore eekenyata pooki o enkarriyiano pooki e siaai nelotu aimu olom oata oltung'ani to le latia enye. Ore ake sii ninye ena naa empesho netiu anaa osiwuo ake emirareki.
Keany olmodai eas esiaai, neisho kewan meinosa esumash.
Enaikash emborei e nkaina nabo etii emborron atua alang inkaik are naabore eekenyata, emirata osiwuo.
Ore ake sii natoduaa empesho tiabori enkolong;

atoduaa oltung'ani oton openy, aa taa olayioni aashu olalashe, nemeeta ake enkiting'oto iekenyat enyena pooki nemeraposho aekata inkonyek enyena te nkarsisisho, metaa meikilikuanu aekata ajo, “Aing'ae doi aekenyaki pee amitiki kewan enchipai.” Ore sii ninye ena naa empesho naa esiaai nemetii enchipai.
Enaikash aare alang obo, amu keeta olerrinyore sidai te nkaraki eekenyata enye.
Amu tenelo nebatata pokira, naa kedumu obo olikae; kake oi ilo laa ninye ake openy tenelo nebatata nemeeta likae odumu ninye aitasheyie.
Ore ake sii, teneirrag aare tenebo, naa keirowuaju; kake kaji eiko obo teineirowuaju aa ninye ake?
Ore hoo neidim oltung'ani atigilu olikae laa ninye ake, keidim aare aairisha ninye. Ore enkopito natasha uni, nemelelek edung'i.
Enaikash olbarnoti aisinani ng'en alang olaiguanani moruo omoda, lemeekure eyieu enkikoo,
hoo neshomo aing'uaa jila ajing olorika le nkitoo aashu etoiwuoki te nkitoria enye aa olaisinani.
Atoduaa nena pooki naaishu naapuo tiabori enkolong, tenebo ilo barnoti ilo apa olotu aitashe te wueji enye;

nemeetae apa enkiting'oto te nkumoi oo ltung'ana; etii apa ninye shumata e pooki. Kake ore lelo oopuonu te siadi nemeshipakino ninye. Kesipa, ore sii ninye ena naa empesho netiu anaa osiwuo emirareki.
Irrita iroruat inono ina kata iloito enkaji Enkai, enaikash tininyikaki ainining alang tinintayu ilo asar loo lmoda; amu meyiolo ninche aajo entorrono easita.
Mikuetiki airo te nkutuk ino, nimincho oltau lino ekuetiki airo irorei te dukuya Enkai, amu etii Enkai keper, nitii iyie oriong enkop; metaa inchoo irorei linono eaku kuti.
Amu kelotu enkidetidet too siaaitin kumok, ore oltoilo lo lmodai naa too rorei kumok.
Teninya olmumai te Nkai ajo intayu toki, mimutie ake eitu ilak; amu meeta ninye enchipai too lmoda. Talaa ina ninosie olmumai.
Enaikash tiniminya olmumai alang tininya nimilak.
Mincho enkutuk ino kintadoiki atua eng'oki, nimijo ake te dukuya olkilikuai eji enkitadiaata ake duo, ainyoo peyie egoro Enkai te nkaraki oltoilo lino; neinyal esiaai oo nkaik inono?
Amu teneponari enkidetidet, neaku irorei kumok lemeeta tipat: kake turia iyie Enkai?

Tinidol to lkerenket lelo aisinak eitorogonyi neoruni esipata naishaakino te ng'olon, ming'asia ake teina bae; amu ore ilo kitok neing'orita likae kitok alang ninye, neetae ake sii kulikae ooilep te ninche.
Kake ore te pooki, ore olaiguanani neisilig sii ninye inkurman naaturi.
Ore ilo onyor iropiyiani nemeraposho aekata too ropiyiani; neijia sii etiu ilo onyor enkarsisisho e dupoto; ore sii ninye ena naa empesho.
Ore teneponari intokitin neponari sii lelo oonya ninche; naa kainyoo dupoto to lopeny aime pee edol ninche too nkonyek enyena?
Kemelok injo o laisiaayiani, oi aa kiti entoki nanya aashu aa sapuk; kake ore enkuretisho e ilo karsis nemeisho eirura.
Etii entaboi torrono natoduaa nanu tiabori enkolong; ore karsisisho nashum oltung'ani naa kewan ake eshumaki batisho.
Neimin pooki to lbuket, nemeleku toki naisho inkera enyena.
Ore anaa enatupukuo te nguset e ng'otonye neijia ake eitoki aiko elo, meishopo anaa apa pee elotu, nemeeta toki e siaai enye naya ninye anap too nkaik enyena.
Ore sii ena naa entaboi torrono anaa apa pee elotu, neijia ake sii eikunari; neaku ainyoo dupoto nanoto ilo oekenyare osiwuo.
Neton te nkishui enye pooki tiatua enaimin o sina sapuk, te nyamali sapuk o ltau, te muoyian o te nkiba.

Airrasha ajo, aisidai neiririkino naa pee idaa niokisho ning'oru enchipai te eekenyata pooki naekenya oltung'ani tiabori enkolong te nena kuti olong'i enyena e nkishui enye naishoo Enkai ninye, amu ninye erubata enye.
Ore pooki tung'ani oishoo Enkai imasaa o enkarsisisho o engolon, inchoo eshipakino ninche, neng'amaa erubata enye netum enchipai te siaai enye. Ore ena naa enkishooroto e Nkai.
Amu medamu oleng nena olong'i e nkishui enye amu eishoo Enkai ninye enchipai tiatua oltau lenye.
Etii entorroni natoduaa nanu tiabori enkolong, neteeka oleng iltung'ana.

Ore oltung'ani oisho Enkai enkarsisisho o masaa o e nkanyit, metaa meeta toki nalau e pooki ake naba anaa enayieu, nemeisho ake sii Enkai ninye engolon metishipakinoyu ninche, kake olomoni olotu ashipakino ninche; ore sii ena naa empesho; naa olosilisili sapuk.

Teneiu oltung'ani inkera iip nabo, nebikoo ilarin kumok oleng, metaa ore inkolong'i oo larin lenyena naa kumok oleng, kake meshipakino intokitin sidain e nkishui, nemetum sii enukaroto, ajo nanu enaikash enkerai naibiruoki alang ninye,
amu kelotu meeta tipat nerrinyo alo atua enaimin, neitoipori enkaina enye te naimin.
Ore ake sii, eitu doi ninye edol enkolong aashu eyiolou toki; netum ake enkiyeng'iyeng alang ninye.
Ore hoo tenaa kebikoo oltung'ani ilarin inkalifuni are, neitu ake eshipakino toki aime ewueji nebo epuo ninche pokira?
Ore eekenyata pooki o ltung'ani naa te nkaraki enkoshoke ake, nemeraposho ake te sumash enye. Kainyoo elang'ie ilo ng'en olmodai?
Anaa kainyoo eeta ilo tung'ani ng'en nalang'ie olaisinani otayiolo eneikunaa kewan te dukuya lelo ooishu?
Enaikash ina nidolita too nkonyek alang ina niyieu nimiata; ore sii ninye ena naa empesho netiu anaa osiwuo ake emirareki.
Ore pooki naewuo aaku neidipaki apa aaipoto, neyioloi enatiu tung'ani, neyioloi aajo meidim ataarare obo ogol alang ninye.
Ore teneaku irorei kumok, neaku empesho sapuk, naa ainyoo eikashie oltung'ani?

Anaa aing'ae oyiolo ajo ainyoo esidai te tung'ani eton eishu tenena kuti olong'i naaishu ninye te nkishui enye e pesho, nena naagiroo ninye anaa oloip? Anaa aing'ae oidim atoliki oltung'ani imbaa naasayu te siadi ninye tiabori enkolong?
Enaikash enkarna sidai alang eilata nagol enkinyang'a; neikash enkolong nitua alang enkolong apa nikitoiwuoki.
Enaikash tinilo ina aji nabore olkiyioi, alang tinilo ina aji o sirua, amu ena enkiting'oto e pooki tung'ani. Nenare neshum lelo ooishu ina too ltauja.
Enaikash osina alang enkuenia, amu to sina o enkiroishi o ltau eitishipi oltung'ani.
Ore oltau le ilo ng'en, netii atua ina aji, olkiyioi; kake ore ilo tau loo lmoda netii ina aji e nkuenia.
Enaikash oltung'ani oning enkisikong'ata eilo ng'en, alang tenening osinkolio loo lmoda.
Ore anaa enadar ilkiku einosita enkima tiabori e moti, neijia etiu enkuenia e lelo moda; ore sii ninye ena naa empesho.
Kesipa ore enkitorogonyata neitomod oltung'ani ng'en, naa keinyal eropare oltung'ani indamunot.
Enaikash enkiting'oto entoki alang enkiterunoto enye; neikash ilo ong'iri to ltau alang ilo owuasa to ltau.
Migoro asioki, amu ore engoro neirrag to lgoo loo lmoda.
Mijo ake, “Kainyoo apa pee eikash inkolong'i naatulusoitie te kuna?” Amu mme te ng'eno inkilikuanu ena.
Aisidai eng'eno etiu anaa enjung'ore naa dupoto te lelo ooishu.
Amu ore erripoto e ng'eno nagut netiu anaa erripoto oo mpisai; naa ore dupoto e yiolounoto naa ina ng'eno nagut nagolie ina kishui eilo oata.
Tadamu esiaai e Nkai: aing'ae oidim aitorioi ina naidipa atakordilo?
Ore teina olong ninoto karsisisho, ting'idayu; ore teina olong e nyamali nidamu Enkai naitobira obo anaa olikae, metaa metum oltung'ani ae toki nalotu asuju ninye.
Ore te nkishui ai e pesho, natoduaa pooki toki; eetae oltung'ani supat orrorri te sipata enye, neetae oltung'ani torrono oitoodor enkishui enye te yasata enye torrono.
Miaku supat aitulus, nimintaa sii kewan ololus te ng'eno, ainyoo peyie imut kewan ainyal?
Miaku sii olarruoni aitulus, nimiaku sii olmodai; ainyoo pee iye iyie eng'or enkata ino?
Enaikash tinimbung ena akurraki, ore teina nimimuat enkaina ino; amu ore ilo oure Enkai nepuku tenena pooki.
Keisho eng'eno engolon ilo tung'ani ng'en alang ilaiguanak tomon ootii atua enkanasa.
Kesipa meetae te nkop oltung'ani supat oas isupati nemeas aekata ing'ok.
Mishilaa nena baa pooki naajo iltung'ana, pee melo ake nining osinka lino kidekita iyie;
neyiolo oltau lino ajo ore too nkatitin kumok nitedia sii iyie ilkulikae.
Atetema kuna pooki te ng'eno nagut; najo, “Ekaaku ng'en”, kake ekaalakuaniki apa nanu.
Ore ina natii, naa kelakua oleng negut, kegut oleng; aing'ae oidim anoto?
Naibelekeny endamunoto ai ayiolou naing'oru aturu naing'oru eng'eno nagut o esiana oo ntokitin, nayiolou nena torrok e modai o ina modai aa ninye olkuenyi.

Natum emion oleng alang keeya teina kitok naa ore oltau lenye naa orreshet oibung'isho, naa ore inkaik naa entoki naibung'isho; ore ilo oitiship Enkai neilany ninye, kake ore olaing'okoni neya ina kitok ninye.
Ng'ura, ena nanu airrasha, ejo olaikooni, intushulaki entoki enkae peyie itum esiana enye,
naa ninye eing'orua endamunoto ai aigil neton ake eitu atum. Oltung'ani obo anoto tiatua enkalifu kake eitu atum enkitok te pooki.
Airrasha nanu ena: inchere eitayio Enkai oltung'ani meitasho te nkitashoto sidai, kake eing'orutua ninche inkoitoi kumok nemesipa.
Aing'ae otiu anaa oltung'ani ng'en? Naa aing'ae oyiolo ina kibelekenyata e ntoki pooki? Ore eng'eno nagut e tung'ani neitawang enkomom enye, ore ina golon enkomom enye neibelekeny.
Imbung'a enkitanapata o laiguanani, naa ore te nkaraki olmumai sinyati miureishoyu;
shomo tung'uai enkomom enye; mimutie eton mesidai esiaai amu keas ninye ina nayieu pooki.
Amu ore ilo rorei lo laiguanani naa aisapuk,
naa aing'ae oidim atiaaki ninye, “Kaa doi iasita iyie?” Ore ilo oyanyit enkitanapata nemetum enkitamioto, naa ore ina damunoto o ltung'ani ng'en neyiolo enkata neyiolo enkoitoi.
Ore pooki bae neeta erishata enye o enkoitoi naasieki, hoo naa ore enyamali o ltung'ani naa keyek ninye.
Amu meyiolo ninye ina nayooki aaku, anaa aing'ae oidim atoliki ninye enayooki aaku?
Meetae oltung'ani oata engolon naibokie enkiyang'et, aashu eeta engolon naitoreyie ina olong e keeya; olarrabal ilo limikiilany, nemeitajeu intorrok lelo oishooki ninye.
Atoduaa kuna pooki ina kata apikita endamunoto ai nena pooki naasi tiabori enkolong, enkop naata kulikae engolon, neitorogony ilkulikae ootii abori ninche.
Nadol lelo tung'ana torrok enukari; lelo apa oojing nepuku aaing'uaa ewueji sinyati, neisisi tiatua enkanasa teine netaasie imbaa naaijo nena. Ore sii ninye ena naa empesho.
Medung'okini ina torroni enkiguana aasioki, ore oltau le nena kera oo ltung'ana netumuta pee eas entorroni.
Ore hoo neas olaing'okoni entorroni katitin iip nabo neitoodor enkishui enye, kake ayiolo ake ajo kesidanu oleng te lelo ooure Enkai, amu keureisho te dukuya ninye;
Kake mesidanu te lelo arruok, nemeitoodor inkolong'i enyena anaa oloip, amu meeta enkuretisho te dukuya Enkai.

Etii empesho naasa te nkop, etii iltung'ana supati laa ninche eitaasi nena siaaitin naaipiru lelo torrok, netii iltung'ana torrok laa ninche eipang'aki iyiasat naas lelo supati. Atejo sii ore ena naa empesho sii ninye.

Nanyorraa nanu enkitumurrunoto, amu meeta tung'ani toki sidai tiabori enkolong kake pee edaa, neokisho neshipakino kewan, amu keiriamariyie ena eekenyata enye tiatua nena olong'i e nkishui naishoo Enkai ninye tiabori enkolong.
Ore pee apik endamunoto ai aitayiolo kewan eng'eno nagut, nadol esiaai naasitae tioriong enkop, nadol ajo metum oltung'ani injo dama aashu kewarie;

nadol teine isiaaitin pooki e Nkai, inchere meyiolou oltung'ani nena naasa tiabori enkolong. Ore hoo neturu oleng oltung'ani aekenya eing'oru, meyiolou hoo ninye pito; hoo nenya kutuk oltung'ani ng'en ajo keyiolo. Meyiolou hoo ninye pito.

Aibirribirra nanu kuna pooki to ltau, najur aineneng pooki, enetiu lelo supati o lelo ng'eni o siaaitin enye, etii pooki enkaina e Nkai; tenaa kenyorrata aashu enkiba meyiolo tung'ani. Ore pooki toki natii dukuya enye naa empesho,

amu kebatatakino pooki enyamali nabo aa lelo supati o lelo torrok; lelo lemeeta oloirerio o lelo ooiduruk, ilo oitayu olasar o ilo lemeitayu olasar. Ore anaa enatiu to ltung'ani supat, neijia etiu olaing'okoni; anaa enatiu te ilo onya olmumai neijia etiu te ilo lemenya olmumai.

Entorroni ena te pooki naasi tiabori enkolong, nchere nebo eiting'oki pooki, ore sii iltauja loo ltung'ana pooki nebore enkarruoisho, netii olkuenyi iltauja lenye eton eishu ninche. Ore te siadi ina nepuo enemeneng'a.
Kake ore ilo oitutumoki o lelo pooki ooishu neeta osiligi, amu enaikash oldia oishu alang olng'atuny otua.
Keyiolo lelo ooishu inchere keyooki aaye, kake meyiolo ilootuata ae toki, nemeeta ae laakinoto; kake ore endamunoto enye neimin.
Ore enyorrata enye o enkiba enye o olom lenye neidipa pooki aisha, nemeekure eetaae ntarasi erubata e pooki naasi tiabori enkolong.
Shomo nosa endaa ino te nchipai, niok enaisho ino oo sabibu te nchipai o ltau; amu eidipa Enkai atonyorrai pooki nias.
Inchoo ilkilani linono eiborru anaake; nimincho eilata elai te ndukuya ino.

Tishipakinoyu enkishui tenebo o enkitok ino ninyor, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino empesho nikinchoo ninye iyie Enkai tiabori enkolong, amu ninye erubata ino tena kishui te ekenyata niekenya tiabori enkolong.
Ore pooki naibung enkaina ino aas, taasa ninye te ngolon ino pooki; amu metii esiaai anaa endamunoto anaa eng'eno anaa eng'eno nagut atua enemeneng'a naa ninye ilo.

Atoduaa ake sii tiabori enkolong ajo ore ina kesha neme ene lelo ake ooten, neme ene lelo ake oogol to larrabal, neme enoo lang'eni ake endaa, neme enoo lkarsisi ake eng'eno, neme ene lelo ake arriyiak too siaaitin omom; kake eipang'aki ake erishata e munyani ninche pooki.

Amu meyiolo oltung'ani enkata enye. Ore anaa isinkir ooibung'aki to rreshet torrono, anaa imotonyi naaibung'aki tiatua orreshet neijia etiu inkera oo ltung'ana eibung'i to rreshet te nkata torrono, ina kata napulusokino adoiki ninche.
Atoduaa sii ena kitanyaanyukoto e ng'eno nagut tiabori enkolong, nelioo aa sapuk te nanu.
Eetae apa enkiti anasa natii ilkuti tung'ana atua, nelotu olaiguanani kitok aarare ninye neman aibung, nepik iltimito aitaman agilunore ninye.
Kake enotoki tiatua ina anasa oltung'ani aisinani ng'en, neitajeu ilo tung'ani te ng'eno enye enkanasa. Nemeetae hoo obo otadamua ilo tung'ani aisinani;
kake ajo ake enaikash eng'eno nagut alang engolon hoo netemenaiyioki eng'eno nagut eilo aisinani neitu eshilari irorei lenyena.
Keikash irorei lo ltung'ani ng'en ooning'i te mborron alang imbuakunot oloitoreisho tiatua ilmoda.
Keikash eng'eno nagut alang imasaa o larrabal, kake ore olaing'okoni obo nemut intokitin sidain kumok.
Ore ilojong'a ootuata neidim aaitong'ua eilata narropil. Naa ore enkiti modai neidimu eng'eno nagut o enkanyit.
Ore oltau lo ltung'ani ng'en neboiniki ninye meitoriokinoyu esipata, kake ore oltau lo lmodai neboiniki entorroni.
Ore doi ninye olmodai tenelo te nkoitoi, nemeeta endamunoto, naa ketayiolo pooki ng'ae ajo olmodai.
Tenelo ake nikidumakino engoro e ilo oitoreisho, milo ake aing'uaa ewueji ino e siaai, amu ore nena torrok naa aikindimi aatapalaki tinigira aitirring'a.
Etii enkarruoisho natoduaa tiabori enkolong, enkitarruoroto naing'uaa ilo oitoreisho.
Eishori iltung'ana oomoda ilorikan le shumata; netoni lelo karsisi too wuejitin e abori.
Atoduaa irrindiki ekedito imbartan nadol iltung'ana kituaak epuo too nkejek anaa irrindiki.
Ore ilo otur engumoto nedoiki ninye; naa keony olasurai ilo otur elusie te suntai.
Ore ilo oturu isoito naa kear isoito ninye; naa ore ilo oiper olchata nepik kewan bata.
Tenaa ming'ani entolu ino, neitu iii ninye, neishaakino niponaa engolon oleng; kake eng'eno nagut naretu oltung'ani meisula.
Teneonyisho olasurai eton eitu esiri te ntaleng'oi, naa keaku pesho tenesiri eidipa atoonyisho.
Ore irorei le nkutuk leilo ng'en, neisho ninye omom, kake ore enkutuk o lmodai nemut ninye.
Ore enkiterunoto oo rorei le nkutuk enye naa emodai, naa ore enkiting'oto e nkiroroto enye naa olkuenyi torrono.
Eponaa olmodai irorei oleng, hoo nemeeta oltung'ani oyiolo ajo ainyoo naaku, naa aing'ae oidim atoliki ninye ina naaku te siadi ninye?
Ore eekenyata o lmodai neitanaur ninye, metaa meyiolo ninye ina oitoi nalo enkanasa.
Oi iyie na kop, tenaa ore olaiguanani lino naa enkerai, ore ilkituaak linono nenya osirua lenye tadekenya!
Ishipa iyie na kop, tenaa ore olaiguanani lino naa olayioni lo ltung'ani olakuno, ore ilkituaak linono nenya osirua te nkata naishaakino, te nkaraki eng'olon, neme te nkaraki emerai!
Ore te nkaraki enturuaisho neurunye shumata enkaji, ore te nkaraki enchalan neo enkaji.
Ore endaa neitobiraki te nkaraki enkuenia, ore enaisho oo sabibu neitiship enkishui, newal impisai pooki toki.
Midek ake olaiguanani, too ndamunot inono, nimidek to lgilata lirrag ilo karsis; amu ore imotonyi o loing'ang'e neya oltoilo lino, aashu eboloo kulie nyaun oo naipuko ina bae.
Nteng'ela imasaa inono too nkuapi, ore te nkata nalotu nitum dupoto.
Tooro olchumati lino kat naapishana aashu isiet, amu miyiolo ajo kaa torroni napukoki enkop.
Tenebore inkatampo enkare, neshaiki enkop; naa teneurokino olchani kopikop aashu moikuape, ore ine nesulakino olchani neirrag teine.
Ore ilo ojurru enkijape nemeunisho; naa ore ilo oisilig inkatampo nemekesisho.
Ore anaa enimiyiolo eneikunakino enkiyang'et iloik tiatua enguset e nkitok nairoishi, neaku miyiolo esiaai e Nkai naitobir pooki toki.
Tuuno tadekenya ilanterera linono, ore teipa niun ake aitoki; amu miyiolo ajo kakua oobulu, kulo ashu kuldo, aashu eidim pokira aatisidana.
Kemelok ewang'an, naa keitiship inkonyek tening'or enkolong.
Amu tenebikoo oltung'ani ilarin kumok, inchoo ninye eshipakino pooki; kake inchoo edamu ninye ajo ore inkolong'i e naimin naa keaku kumok. Ore ina pooki nalotu naa empesho.

Tishipayu iyie lo barnoti, tiatua kitisho ino, nincho oltau lino kinting'id iyie too nkolong'i pooki e kitisho ino; shomo too nkoitoi o ltau lino o too nduaat oo nkonyek inono. Kake tayiolo ajo ore te kuna baa pooki naa aikiyau iyie Enkai atua enkiguana.
Iwuang'ie enkuretisho too ndamunot inono, niwuang'ie aitalamaa emion to sesen lino; amu ore kitisho o enkakenya enkishui naa empesho.
Tadamu naa ilo Likintobirua too nkolong'i e kitisho ino, eton eitu epuonu inkolong'i torrok, nenyikaa ilarin oleng, paa ina kata ilotu ajo, “Meekure aatayie tipat enkishui.”
Tadamu sii ilo Likintobirua eton eitu eitomisimisi enkolong o lapa o lakir neton eitu esoto inkatampo aayau enchan.
Ina olong naikirikira inkaik nikirripito, ore nkejek neton egol neshalu. Neaku lala linono kuti te nkutuk ometaa mitum entoki ninyaalishore, ore nkonyek neiliilari neaku medolisho oleng.
Ina olong naikeno nkutukie oo nkiyiaa inono ometaa mining oltoilo le nkidong'ore aashu eranyare kake ekidumu ake oltoilo le motonyi kewarie.

Iureyu atakedo iwuejitin neeika, niureishoyu te nkoitoi; neitapuku aipilipil olchani oji olmolosi neraposho ilmaat kake mitum iyie yieuna elo oltung'ani ewueji enye nebikie intarasi, ore lelo aishirak nepuaya too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa.

Eton eitu eitir ina opito e nkosholai aashu ebela olbakuli le saabu. Ore emoti naokunyeki enkare nebela te nkong'u e nkare aashu egila ina keju e ngarri te nchoto naokunyeki enkare nerrinyo iseseni aaku enterit anaa enatiu apa te dukuya,
nerrinyokino enkiyang'et Enkai ina apa naishorua ninye.
Empesho, empesho ore pooki toki naa empesho.
Ore hoo naa ng'en olaikooni, eitengena sii apa iltung'ana. Neineneng neisum neiturrurru iloyietiaa te nkarriyiano sapuk.
Etetema olaikooni aing'oru irorei ooitishipisho; neiger aitobiraki irorei oosipa.
Ore inkirorot e ilo ang'eni netiu anaa iltuleta neikununo anaa ilmushumaani ootooshokoki aaitagol naa ore inkirorot naatasotuoki netiu anaa olchekut obo.
Enkerai ai, tujurru oleng pooki toki nalus te kuna. Ore enkigeroto oo mbukui kumok nemeeta eneiting'ie, naa ore enkisuma sapuk naa osesen lino eek.
Ore enabayie tena bae, te nena pooki nitoning'o: turia Enkai, nimbung inkitanapat enyena, amu ena elulung'ata e siaai pooki e tung'ani.
Amu keyau Enkai pooki siaai atua enkiguana, o pooki toki oo nkisudorot, aa sidai aashu aa torrono.
Osinkolio loo sinkolioitin laa ole Solomon.
Oi duoo tenaa aiking'utut too ng'ututata e nkutuk ino! Amu ore enyorrata ino nelang enaisho oo sabibu.
Ore iila inono naaputishoreki naa kerropil oleng, ore enkarna ino naa eilata nabukuno; metaa aikinyor iyie intoyie.

Iwaki nanu tenebo iyie matasiooi aaipirri. Aayawua nanu Olaiguanani atua ilgilat lenyena, aikishipa niking'ida tenebo, nikishipakino enyorrata ino aaitalang enaisho oo sabibu, ina pee kinyor ninche pooki!
Kara oltung'ani orok oleng, nara sii sidai, natoyie e Yerusalem, atiu anaa lelo ng'oborri le Kedar, anaa lkarash le Solomon.

Mayieu niking'or nanu to lmena te nkaraki narok, amu aainosa enkolong oleng. Ore ilayiok le yieyio naatagorokinote nanu, aaitaa ninche nanu olaramatani loo sabibu; kake ore osabibu lai makewan neitu aramat!

Tolikioki iyie nanu, iyie ilo onyor oltau lai, Ine nirritayie imasaa inono, Ine nincho meirraga enaipirie enkolong; kainyoo peyie atiu anaa obo oloolo lemeeta enetii te mbata oo nkerrai e kulikae shekuti?
Tinimiyiolo iyie, iyie nara sidai tiatua nkituaak, Tusuja irrekiei le nena kerrai, nilo airrita ilkuoo linono, te mbata oo lng'oborri loo lchekuti.
Aaitanyaanyukie nanu iyie enanyor ai, embarta oo ngarrin e Farao.
Aisidain ntakul inono edou imuna, naa sidai emurt ino ebore imasaa.
Aikintobiraki iyiook iyie imasaa e saabu, naaripakino enkosholai.
Ore apa ina kata eirrag olaiguanani to lorika lenye dapash, neitorropil esonkoyo ai ine.
Ore olanyor lai netiu anaa embene e nkorropil te nanu, ina nairrag te mpolos oo lki laainei.
Ore olanyor lai netiu te nanu anaa entukus oo ntapuka, tiatua enkurma oo sabibu e En-gedi.
Ng'ura ajo ira iyie sidai enanyor ai, ng'ura ajo ira sidai; ore nkonyek inono netiu anaa ine nturkuluo.
Ng'ura ajo inkishiaan iyie, olanyor lai, esipa ira sidai. Ore olorika lang dapash naa kenyori.
Ore mbokishi e nkaji ang naa iltarakua, ore irishinani naa olchani onyaanyukie oltarakuai.
Ara nanu entapukai e Sharon, entapukai oo erat.
Ore anaa entapukai natii atua ilkiku, neijia etiu enyorrata ai too ntoyie.
Anaa enatiu olchani loo lng'anayio tiatua entim, neijia etiu olanyor lai tiatua iltung'ana ooti. Atotona te nchipai sapuk tiatua oloip lenye, nemelok olng'anayioi lenye te nkutuk ai.
Aatorikuo ninye nanu enkaji o sirua, naadumaki ninye nanu aitaman oltaa le nyorrata.
Intasheyie eng'olon ai te ndaa oo lng'anayio, nikintagol too lng'anayio; amu kaata nanu emuoyian e nyorrata.
Oi duoo tenetii enkaina enye e kedianye abori elukunya ai, ore enkaina enye e tatene naaibung!
Esiligieki intae natoyie e Yerusalem, enosa olmumai too ntarakueti naaten, inchere mipututu enyorrata ometabau erishata naishaakino.
Aning'ito oltoilo lo lanyor lai elotu, edoku too ldoinyo, elang'u ildoinyo.
Etiu olanyor lai anaa enkolii, aashu oloing'oni le nkolii. Ng'ura ajo nelido oitashe tioriong esuntai ang, eing'or atua enkaji te lusie, eing'orisho too lusien.
Airorie nanu olanyor lai naajoki ninye. “Inyo enanyor ai, ina nanyor aisul, naa wou tung'uai;
Amu ng'ura, ore ina kirobi netulusoyie eishunye enchan neshomo alusoo.
Etubulutua ntapuka tioriong enkop, netabawua enkata e ranyare, netoning'oki oltoilo loo nturkuluoni te nkop ang.
Ore olng'aboli neitayio ilng'abolo, ore osabibu neitapuka eitayu olng'usil orropil. Inyo, enanyor ai, enaikishiaan ai wou tupuku.

Oi iyie enturkuluo ai natii atua olbaata le ndapidapoi, natii olbaata le marti, inchooki matoduaa enkomom ino, inchooki matoning'o oltoilo lino, amu ore oltoilo lino naa kemelok, naa sidai enkomom ino.
Imbung'aki iyiook mbariak, nena bariak kutiti, nena naainyal inkurman ang oo sabibu, amu ore inkurman ang oo sabibu neitapuka.”
Ore olanyor lai naa olalai nara nanu enenye, eirrita ninye ntare enyena tiatua ntapuka.
O metaba anaa nemanaa, nelusoo enkewarie imbelekenyunye olanyor lai, totiwuo anaa enkolii aashu itiu anaa oloing'oni le nkolii te nchumata oldoinyo osur.
Ore te nchumata e rruat ai kewarie, aing'orua ilo onyor oltau lai, aing'orua nanu ninye oleng neitu atum ninye; aipotuo ninye, kake eitu aaisho ninye nanu ewalata.
“Kadumunye alo aman enkanasa, atua inkoitoi naalala e nkanasa o lkurrot ootumoreki, ekaing'oru nanu ilo onyor oltau lai.” Aing'orua ninye, kake eitu nanu atum.
Aanoto nanu ilarripok, ina kata emanimanaa te nkanasa, naikilikuan nanu ninche ajoki “Itoduaa intae ilo onyor oltau lai?”
Ore aa enagirorie ninche, natum ilo apa onyor oltau lai. Naibung ninye, nemaisho ninye elo, o metaba anaa nayau ninye enkaji e yieyio, o maitijing'a ninye ilo gilata apa le ina naatoiwuo nanu.
Enosa olmumai intae natoyie e Yerusalem, enosa olmumai too ntarakueti naaten, inchere mipututu enyorrata ang, o metaba anaa nebau erishata enye.
Ainyoo ina nailepu to lpurkel, natiu anaa empuruo naitorropiloki te manoo o te nkorropil, te rropili pooki e nena sonkoyoni oo lbiasharani?
Ng'ura ajo enapitae Solomon to lorika lenye le nkitoo, nemanita ninye iltung'ana magil ntomoni ile magil te Israel.
Neenita pooki ilalema, naa arriyiak to larrabal, meeta hoo obo lenye lemeenita olalem, nerripisho te nkewarie.
Etanapaki olaiguanani Solomon to lorika le nkitoo, ilo oitobirunyeki ilkeek le Lebanon.
Eitobirua ing'apeta enyena te nkosholai, ore oriong enye naa ene saabu, ore olorika lenye naa morijoi; neripuno atua te nkarriyiano, intoyie e Yerusalem naatiriputua te nkarriyiano.
Enchom intae natoyie e Sion, pee ing'oring'oro Olaiguanani Solomon, eeta enkopiyia e nkitoo apa naishopoko ng'otonye. Teina olong apa e nkiyama enye, teina olong e nchipai oltau lenye.

Ng'ura ajo ira iyie sidai enanyor ai, ng'ura ajo ira iyie sidai! Ore nkonyek inono netiu anaa ine nturkuluo, eiwariwaru te nkarasha naitoipieki enkomom. Ore ilpapit linono netiu anaa eluaata oo nkineji, edou abori to loshong'ishong'i le Gilead.
Ore ilala linono neibor anaa isupeni e kerra naabarno, nena naaetuo eing'uaa enkisujata, neeta pooki ilmao, nemeetae hoo nabo natua olkuoo.
Ore nkonito e nkutuk ino netiu anaa empito nanyokie, naa sidai enkutuk ino. Ore ntakul inono netiu anaa indung'ot are o lng'anayioi oji kukumanka, eiwariwaru te nkarasha naitoipieki enkomom.
Etiu emurt ino anaa oltalet le Daudi, napurupurana nepuyiapui, nebore imankek naaikununo anaa ilong'oi oo lmurran enkalifu.
Ore ilki linono pokira netiu anaa nkoliin, ilmao le nkolii oodaa too ntapuka.
Ometamanai enkakenya nelusoo enkewarie, o teina doinyo e nkorropil.
Ira iyie sidai oleng enanyor ai, miaata iyie eleyiata.

Wou tenebo nanu tung'uai Lebanon, esiankiki ai; wou tenebo nanu tung'uai Lebanon. Wou tung'uai entopij oldoinyo le Aman, tung'uai entopij e Senir o Hamon, tung'uai inkapuniaa oo lng'atunyo, tung'uai lelo doinyo loo lowuarak kerin.
Iwa iyie oltau lai te ngolon, enkanashe ai esiankiki ai, iwa iyie oltau lai te nking'urata oo nkonyek inono, to soit obo ogol enkinyang'a le murt ino.
Kebaa emeloni e nyorrata ino, enkanashe ai, esiankiki ai! Kebaa eikash enyorrata ino alang enaisho oo sabibu! Ore ina rropili oo ila inono nelang kulie naarropil.
Eitong'u too nkonito e nkutuk ino enaisho namelok, esiankiki ai; etii enaisho olkenkei o kule abori olng'ejep lino; Ore olng'usil loo nkilani inono netiu anaa olng'usil le Lebanon.
Ore enkurma naikenoro naa enkanashe ai, esiankiki ai, enkurma naikenoro enchorro naripa.
Ore nkaitubulu inono netiu anaa enkurma o lng'anayio ooji kukumanka, eeta ilng'anayio pooki gelunot, hena o nardo.
Eeta ninye Nardo o Saparon o sinantei, o lkeek pooki oorropil, o emanoo o sonkoyoni tenebo isonkoyoni pooki naaisul.
Ira iyie enchorro e nkurma, enchorro e nkare naishu, o nchorroi naarukunye e Lebanon.
Inyo iyie lo kutati le moikuape! Nilotu iyie lo kutati le kopikop. Tukuta enkurma ai, inchoo erropili enye eibulaa. Inchoo enanyor ai elotu enkurma enye, nenya ilng'anayio lenyena gelunot.

Aewuo nanu enkurma ai, enkanashe ai, esiankiki ai, aiturrurruo nanu emanoo ai tenebo esonkoyo ai, ainosa nanu olchankaroi naelie olkenkei le naisho, naok enaisho oo sabibu o kule. Enosa lo shoreta niokioko; entookisho oleng intae iloonyorri!

Airure nanu kake eitu eirura oltau lai. Toning'o! Eoshioshito olanyor lai kutuk aji. “Taboluoki, enkanashe ai, enanyor ai, enturkuluo ai, enemeeta eleyiata ai; Amu keshal elukunya ai, te nkolielio, ore ilpapit laainei neshal te nkolielio e nkewarie.”
Aitayio nanu nkilani aainei, naa kaji aiko tenaitoki aishop? Aisuja nkejek aainei, kaji aiko tenaitoki aroro enterit?
Nepik olanyor lai enkaina enye enkikenet e kutuk aji, neng'idayu oltau lai tiatua nanu.
Nainyototo abolu olanyor lai, nebore inkaik aainei emanoo, neitong ilkimojik laainei teina manoo naruko, aibung inkikeneta e kutuk aji.
Nabolu olanyor lai, kake eibelekenye olanyor lai nelo, neisinanuo oltau lai pee eiro ninye. Naing'oru ninye neitu atum ninye; aipotuo ninye, kake eitu aawalaki nanu.
Naatum ilarripok nanu, ina kata emanaa te nkanasa; naar nanu, naapik nanu olbae, naaoru nanu enkila ai, lelo arripok le nena sunta.
Enosa olmumai intae natoyie e Yerusalem, tinitumutumu ake olanyor lai, nilikiki ninye aajoki ekamuoi te nyorrata.
Ainyoo elang'ie ina ninyor ino enkae ninyor? Oi ina sidai tiatua inkituaak? Kainyoo elang'ie ilo linyor lino olikae linyor eji pee intanapa iyiook ena?
Ore olanyor lai naa aisidai oleng negol, keibala too nkalifuni tomon.
Ore endukuya enye naa Saabu nasila; ore lpapit lenyena naa sidain, kerook anaa olkurruk.
Netiu nkonyek enyena anaa ine nturkuluo, te mbata oo nchorroi enkare, naaisujaki te kule, naaitobirakino entonata.
Naa sidain intakul enyena anaa ineeitobirieki isonkoyoni neitayu olng'usil orropil, ore nkonito e nkutuk enye netiu anaa ntapuka, naitong'u emanoo naruko narropil.
Ore nkaik enyena netiu anaa saabu nairina, naikodoki too soito oogol enkinyang'a. Ore osesen lenye netiu anaa ilala ooitobiraki loo lkanchaoni, neikodoki too iila naarropil oleng.
Ore nkejek enyena netiu anaa ing'apeta e Alabata naaikodoki te saabu. Ore tening'or ninye netiu anaa iltarakua le Lebanon.
Ore enkiroroto enye naa kemelok oleng, naa ore ninye pooki naa keng'uarrayu, olanyor lai ele naa olchore lai ele, natoyie e Yerusalem.
Kaji eshomo ilo lino linyor, iyie enaisul inkituaak? Kaji eibelekenyakine olinyor lino alo, pee kitum iyiook aaing'oru ninye tenebo iyie?
Etadoyie olanyor lai alo enkurma enye, ine neitobirieki isonkoyoni, alo airrita eluaata oo ntare enyena too nkurman, nesotu ntapuka.
Ara nanu eno lanyor lai, ore olanyor lai naa olalai; eirritita ntare enyena too neetii intapuka.
Ira iyie sidai anaa Tirsa, olanyor lai ira sidai anaa Yerusalem, keitureisho anaa enjore naata inankan.
Imbelekenya inkonyek inono intung'uayioki, amu kaaitanyamal ninche nanu, ore ilpapit linono netiu anaa eluaata oo nkineji, naadou to loshong'ishong'i le Gilead.
Etiu ilala linono anaa eluaata oo supeni e kerra, nena naaetuo aailepu te nkisujata, neeta pooki ilmao, meetae nabo natua olkuoo.
Ore ntakul inono netiu anaa isashat o lng'anayioi oji kukumanka, tiatua ina arasha naimulumulieki enkomom.
Eetae inkaiguanak ntomoni ile, neetae nkapiak intomoni isiet, o nkaisiaayiak nemeikenayu.

Na turkuluo ai, enemeeta eleyiata ai, naa nabo ake, ina nanyor ng'otonye enye, ina kirotet te ng'otonye. Etoduaa ninye nkaisiayiak neipot ninye aajo enashipa; ore nkaiguanak o nkapiak neisis sii ninche ninye.
“Aing'ae ele otiu enduaata enye anaa entadekenya, newang anaa olapa, anaa enkolong, neitureisho anaa enjore naata inankan.
Atadoyie alo ine netii enkurma oo lng'anayio aing'or nena tapuka naatii oerata, aing'uraa tenaa keimarrimar ilkeek loo sabibu, tenaa keitapuka ilng'anayio ooji kukumanka.
Ore apa eton mayiolo naayau oltau lai, tiatua engarri oo mbartan te mbata olkitok lai.”
Tushukunye, tushukunye iyie lo Shulami, tushukunye tushukunye pee kitum aing'ura iyie. Ainyoo peyie ing'or iyie ilo Shulami, anaa oloipidipid aiguran te dukuya injorin are?
Kebaa enare inamuka inkejek inono? Iyie nasiankiki o laiguanani! Nepurupurana nkupesir inono anaa isoito oogol enkinyiang'a, esiaai oo nkaik o laitobirani arriyia.
Ore osororua lino netiu anaa olbakuli, ilo lemelau aekata enaisho oo sabibu naitushula, ore enkoshoke ino netiu anaa osototi le nkano omanita intapuka.
Etiu ilki linono pokira anaa ilmao le nkolii.
Netiu emurt ino anaa oltalet lo lalae lo lkanchaoi, ore nkonyek inono netiu anaa lturot ootii Heshbon, te mbata e kishomi e Batrabbin. Etiu enkume ino anaa oltalet le Lebanon, ilo oing'or Dameski.
Ore endukuya ino neitashe aitobiraki anaa oldoinyo le Karmel, ore nena enat inono oo lpapit naaisiong'a netiu anaa nkilani pilei, netil olaiguanani tiatua ina sidano.
Kebaa enkishiaa o esidano niaata iyie, iyie enanyor ai, kebaa elulung'a enyorrata ino.
Isiriri iyie anaa oltukai netiu ilki linono, anaa nkimarrat enyena.
Atejo nanu kaked ilo tukai, naitayu ilng'anayio lenyena nchoo ilki linono metotiwuo anaa nkimarrat o sabibu, ore olng'usil le nkiyang'et ino netiu anaa olng'usil loo lng'anayio oonyaanyukie ilama.
Ore ng'ututat inono netiu anaa enaisho sidai oo sabibu. Ina nalo adoyio aitobirari, naisotuni te nkutuk neim irishat oo lala.
Ara nanu eno lanyor lai, naa ore eyieunoto enye naa nanu.
Wou, olanyor lai, maape nkong'at, nikirrag nena ang'itie;
matayooki aapuo nena kurman oo sabibu, nikipuo aaing'uraa tenaa keitapuka isabibu, tenaa ketabolote intapuka oo sabibu neitapukita sii ninche kukumanka. Ore teine naa kaaisho nanu enyorrata ai.
Ore enkaitubului nanyaanyukie enchiliwa neitayio olng'usil orropil ore ilng'anayio pooki sidain netii embata e kutukaji, ilng'ejuko tenebo o lmusan, lelo laatushumaka nanu iyie, iyie olanyor lai.
Oi naaji tenaa iaku olalashe lai, ilo otanaa ilki le yieyio! Tenaainepu nanu iyie te boo, naa kaang'utut, nemeetae hoo obo laamenaa nanu.
Ekaarik nanu iyie o maaitijing'a enkaji e yieyio, olgilata le ina apa naatoiwuo nanu, Naaisho nanu iyie enaisho oo sabibu natii enkorropil tooko, ina are oo lng'anayio le kukumanka.
Oi naaji tenaa ketii enkaina enye e kedianye abori endukuya ai, naamuataki enkaina enye e tatene!
Enosa olmumai intae natoyie e Yerusalem, inchere mipututu enyorrata ai, o metaba anaa neyieu openy.
Aing'ae lido olotu to lpurkel, eirishakino olonyor lenye? Tiabori olchani onyaanyukie olamai aatuputuo iyie. Teine apa earita ng'utunyi enkop kiini iyie, teine apa earita enkop ina nikitoiwuo.

Intaaki nanu matotiwuo anaa olmishire tiatua oltau lino, anaa olmishire otii enkaina ino; amu ore enyorrata naa kegol anaa keeya, ore olom netolo anaa enkurare. Ore inkiwuang'at enyena naa nkiwuang'at e nkima, enkima napejisho oleng to lang'at.
Mear inkariak kumok enyorrata, nemeidim oloirrag le nkare aawa ninye. Teneing'oru oltung'ani enyorrata, too masaa pooki e nkaji enye, naa kemenari tukul.
Kiata enkiti anashe, neitu ebulu ilki. Kaa kintaas enkanashe ang, teina olong nasai ninye?
Tenaa kesuntai ninye, naa aikishetaki te shumata ninye oltalet le nkosholai, kake tenaa aikutukaji ninye, nikiripaa ninye too mbaoi o ltarakuai.
Ara apa nanu esuntai, netiu apa ilki laainei anaa iltaleta; neaku atii atua nkonyek enyena, anaa ilo oyau eseriani.
Eeta apa Solomon enkurma oo sabibu te Baalhamon; neishooyo enkurma oo sabibu aisilenoki ilaramatak; ore ake pooki lenye te lelo ng'anayio mpisai enkalifu nabo e nkosholai.
Ore enkurma ai oo sabibu, ina naa enaai ake, naa enaai makewan, ore iyie Solomon indim aawa ina alifu nabo, ore ilaramatak lo lng'anayioi netum iip are.
Oi intae oomanya atua nena kurman, einining'ito ile ncholiek ai oltoilo lino; nchooki matoning'o ninye.
Tasioki isarisara olanyor lai, totiwuo anaa enkolii aashu oloti oing'oni le nkolii, otii oldoinyo loo sonkoyoni.
Ore ena buku e Isaya, naa keeta olkilikuai oipirta Yuda o Yerusalem anaa enaitoduaa Enkai Isaya olayioni le Amos, too nkolong'i e Usia o Yotam o Ahas o Hesekia, aiguanak apa le Yuda.
Toning'o, iyie keper, ninchoru enkiok na kop; amu eiroro Olaitoriani: “Aitotio nanu inkera naitubulu, naatogolong'akita ninche.
Keyiolo olkiteng olopeny, neyiolo osikiria ewueji neitotiyieki kake meyiolo ninye Israel, mening ninche iltung'ana laainei.”

Ee, olosho loo laing'okok, olorere onapita enkarruoisho, eishoi oo larruok, ilayiok oas inemeitoriori! Etung'uatie ninche Olaitoriani, etemenaitie ninche Ilo Sinyati le Israel, etapong'ori ninche tukul.
Kainyoo pee iyieuu neoshi intae, eji metaa ipuopuo dukuya aagolong'u? Kemuoi endukuya pooki, neiterre oltau pooki.
Ore ebaiki entutunyo e nkeju o metabaiki endukuya, metii embiotisho, kake ilbaa o ldututa o nkirondoni naaruko nkimek; neitu eironyuni, aashu eeni, neitu eelieki eilata.
Eirragita enkop inyi aa mijooni, netapejoyioki inkanas inyi te nkima; te dukuya intae idolitata, einosa iltung'ana leeiking'a enkop inyi; netomijoono ninye, anaa ina nainyala iltung'ana leeiking'a.
Etung'uayioki Yerusalem anaa olng'obor tiatua enkurma oo sabibu, anaa olkirragarie tiatua enkurma entoki naaijo nkaimalasia anaa enkanasa natang'aduaki.
Te neme Olaitoriani loo lororani otelekaka iyiook oloti pisiai, anaata kitotiutuo anaa Sodom, nikitiu anaa Gomora.
Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani, intae ilaitoriak le Sodom! Enchoo enkiok enkiteng'enare e Nkai ang intae iltung'ana le Gomora!

“Kainyoo te nanu enkumoi oo lasarri linyi? Olaitoriani ojo; Ataraposhe nanu ilasarri oopejori loo lmeregeshi o eilata e lelo kerra linyi oopir; mashipakino nanu osarge loo loing'ok, aashu loo lkerra aashu o loo lkineji.
Amu ore oshi ti nipuonunu aaitalioo ate te dukuya nanu, aing'ae naikilikuan intae tinipuonunu aaituny indung'orot aainei.
Mintokiki aayau ilasarri le pesho; olminong enkorropil inyi te nanu. Ore olapa ng'ejuk o Sabato o enkipototo e umata - maidim nanu aing'ura ena torroni o eumata.
Ore lelo apaitin linyi ng'ejuko o lelo siruai linyi oogeluno, keiba oltau lai; netaa ninche olola te nanu, atanaure aibookino ninche.
Ti nintorioo inkaik inyi te nkomono, naisudoo inkonyek aainei te ntae; ore hoo niomonono katitin kumok, mainining nanu; kebore nkaik inyi osarge.
Entukuo ate, entobira ate; ewuang'ie entorroni oo nkiaasin inyi, te dukuya inkonyek aainei; entapal entorroni.
Entamoo ate easata oo mbaa sidain; eng'oru esipata, entapal enkibookinoto e nkop, entomitu ilo okishi, entasaru ina nara enkoliai.

Wou naa matoning'oto te nebo, Olaitoriani ojo; ore hoo neyia ing'ok inono anaa enkarasha nanyokie, keyooki aaiboru netiu anaa kule. Ore hoo nedo anaa osarge, keyooki aaiborru anaa ilpapit loo ntare naaibor.
Ti ninyoraa nikirukuruku, ninyanya olkar le nkop;
kake ti nikianyianya nigolong'ung'u, nemuti intae to lalem; amu enkutuk o Laitoriani nairoro.”
Kaji eikuna ina anasa naisiligayu, pee etaa enaibor onyek, ore apa ina nabore esipata! Naa enkiguana nasipa naton tiatua ninye, kake ore taata netaa ilarak.
Etaa enkosholai ino isuut, netushulare enaisho ino enkare.
Ore ilkituaak linono netogolong'utua, naa ile ncholiek oo lapurrok. Nenyor ake pooki te ninche eropare nekuet aasujaa inkishoorot. Memitu ninche ilo okishi, nemeshilaa ninche enyamali oo nkolia.
Ore te nkaraki ina, Olaitoriani ojo, Olaitoriani loo lororani, ilo magilani le Israel: “Ee kaitalaku nanu engoro ai too lmang'ati laainei, kaitalaku nanu makewan te lelo laaiba.
Kaaipirakinye nanu enkaina ai Naasil anaa enasil olkunoni esekenkei, naiwuang'ie nanu oloirerio lino pooki.
Naa kaitasheyie nanu ilarishak linyi anaa apake o lelo arikok linyi anaa apake te nkiterunoto. Ore te siadi ina neaku eikiji, enkanasa e supatisho, ina anasa naisiligayu.”
Kekorduni Sion te sipata, ore lelo ootii atua nekorduni te supatisho.
Kake ore lelo oogolong'u o laing'okok, neidaikieki te nebo, ore lelo ootanyaita Olaitoriani nemuti.
Iyookiki aakurru te nkaraki lelo keek apa laaijo ilng'abolo lishipakinono, neitukurruni intae te nena kurman apa nitegelutua.
Iyookiki intae aatiu anaa olchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli otoyu imbenek enyena, aashu anaa nkurman nemetii enkare.
Ore ilo tung'ani ogol netiu anaa isuut, ore esiaai enye netiu anaa isuut naapiki enkima neyupuyup te nebo, nemeetae oltung'ani oidim aibooi ina kima.
Ele rorei etoduaa Isaya olayioni le Amos eipirta Yuda o Yerusalem.
Keyooki alotu too nkolong'i e siadi, paa ore ilo doinyo le nkaji o Laitoriani neitasheyieki aaitoodor too ldoinyo, neilepieki aaitogiroo too ldoinyo, ore iloshon pooki nerukokino ninye,

naa kepuonu iltung'ana kumok aajo: “Wootu, maape oldoinyo lo Laitoriani, maape enkaji e Nkai e Yakobo; pee etum ninye aiteng'ena iyiook inkoitoi enyena, nikitum iyiook aashom too nkoitoi enyena.” Amu Sion ninye epukunye enkitanapata, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani eing'uaa Yerusalem.

Kelo ninye aiguanare iloreren, naa kemut ninye nabo tialo iloshon kumok, naa keitaa ninche ilalema lenye inchempei, neitaa iremeta enye ilalema le nkikesare, nemeitoki olosho adumakino olikae osho to lalem, nemeitoki aekata ninche aata olarrabal.
Wou iyie na aji e Yakobo, maape iyiook tiatua ewang'an o Laitoriani.

Amu itung'uayie iyie iltung'ana linono, ina aji e Yakobo, te nkaraki nabore ninche ilaitumusumusok ooing'uaa oloosaen, o lelo aitumusumusok anaa iltung'ana loo Filistia, neoshore ninche inkaik iltung'ana leeiking'a.
Eiputa enkop enye enkosholai o saabu, nemeeta ilchumat lenye eneiting'ie; neiputa enkop enye imbartan, nemeeta eneiting'ie ngarrin enye oo mbartan te nkumoi.
Eiputa enkop enye inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin, neirrugokino ninche ina siaai oo nkaik enye, ina naitobira inkaik lenye.
Keitoborri iltung'ana, neitadouni iltung'ana - mipalaki ninche!
Tijing'a atua endapidapoi, nilo aisudori tiatua enterit ailany ina kituriata o Laitoriani, nilany ina kitoo e nkisisa enye.
Ore ina kitokoos oo ltung'ana naa keitadouni, ore ilo wuasa loo ltung'ana naa keitoborri; neaku Olaitoriani ake eitaae kitok teina olong.
Keeta Olaitoriani loo lororani enkolong nagilunore ilo pooki owuasa neitokoos, agilunore ina pooki nailepieki aadumu;
agilunore lelo tarakua pooki le Lebanon, lelo adoru ooilepieki shumata, negilunore lelo keek oogol le Bashan;
negilunore lelo doinyo adoru pooki, negilunore nena doinyo naaitokoos pooki;
negilunore pooki wueji neika o pooki suntai nasheta;
negilunore imelin pooki e Tarshishi, negilunore pooki toki e nkarriyiano.
Ore enkitokoos oo ltung'ana neitadouni, ore ilo wuasa loo ltung'ana neitadouni abori; neaku Olaitoriani ake eitaae kitok teina olong.
Ore nena aitin naaguetuno neishieki tukul.
Nejing iltung'ana inkapuniaa oo ndapidapo o ngumot e nkop, aailany ina kituriata o Laitoriani, neilany ina kitoo e nkisisa enye, te nedumunye aiture enkop.

Ore kenya teina olong nenang'aa iltung'ana aaiturraa nena kitanyaanyukot enye e nkosholai o nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin e saabu, apa naaitobirakita ate pee eserem, nenang'aki ilkirrumun o sarampalani,
pee etum aatijing ilbaat loo ndapidapo o nkapuniaa oo soito sapuki aailany ina kituriata o Laitoriani o ina kitoo e nkisisa enye, te nedumunye ninye aiture enkop.
Mintoki aisilig tung'ani laa ore nkumeishin enyena netii enkiyang'et, Amaa kaa tipat eeta ninye?
Ng'ura ajo ore Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa keiwuang'ie te Yerusalem o te Yuda, ina naisiligi o ina naishuyieki, eneisiligi te ndaa o enkare;
ilo tung'ani magilani o sikari o larishani o loiboni le Nkai o laitumusumusoni o lpayian kitok
ilo arikoni le njore e onom o ilo tung'ani oata enkitoo, ilo arikoni o ilo arriyia too nkitoduaat, o ilo arriyia te naibon.
Naa kaitaa nanu ilayiok ilkituaak lenye, naa inkera kutiti naapuo aaitore ninche.

Naa kepuo iltung'ana aaibookino enkop maate, neitorogony ake oltung'ani olikae oltung'ani ake ole latia enye; neitokoos olbarnoti te dukuya olpayian, neitokoos oltung'ani li abori te dukuya ilo kitok.
Kelotu enkata naibung oltung'ani olalashe lenye tiatua enkaji e menye, ejo, “Iata iyie olkila; iyie olo aaku olarikoni lang, ore ele sototi pooki le nkidaata naa keaku abori enkitoria ino.”
Ore teina olong naa keiro ninye ajo, “Maaku nanu olabaani, ore atua enkaji aimetii endaa nemetii olkila; mikintaa intae nanu olarikoni loo ltung'ana.”
Amu etarrorre Yerusalem, netabatate Yuda; te nkaraki naa ore nkirorot enye o nkiaasin enye negilunore Olaitoriani, nemor dukuya nkonyek enyena.
Ilo kep lenye oishakenoki ninche; keibalunye ninche ing'ok enye anaa Sodom, meisudoo ninche. Woi ninche Amu eyautua entorroni shumata ate.
Tiaaki lelo asipak inchere aisidain imbaa tialo ninche, amu kenya ninche ilng'anayio loo nkiaasin enye.
Woi ilo tung'ani torrono! Kerruoyo mbaa te ninye, amu ore enaba anaa enataasa inkaik enyena, ina eyookini aaitaas ninye.
Ore too ltung'ana laainei, inkera naaitorogony ninche, naa nkituaak naaitore ninche. Lo tung'ana laainei, eitapong'oitie intae ilarikok linyi, neitapong'oo inkoitoi inyi.
Eitasho Olaitoriani pee eishankarra, eitasho pee eiguanare iltung'ana lenyena.
Etijing'a Olaitoriani enkiguana aiguanare ilpayiani o lkituaak loo ltung'ana lenyena: “Intae apa ooinosa enkurma oo lng'anayio, ore nena nitoorutuo intae ilaisinak netii atua inkajijik inyi.
Kainyoo intodolulu pee intorogonyonyo iltung'ana laainei, nindong'idong'o aarepeny inkomomi e lelo aisinak?” Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani ojo.
Etejo Olaitoriani: Ore te nkaraki naitokoos intoyie e Sion nepuo te nkitaragirag neing'orisho to lwuasa, neyagiyag epuoito eipidie inkejek enye.
Keosh Olaitoriani to lpepedoi nena lukuny oo ntoyie e Sion, naa keibalunye Olaitoriani emasipaisho enye.
Ore kenya teina olong naa keiwuang'ie Olaitoriani nena masaa naang'idare,
o lmiintoni o lkataarri o nkarash oo murto; o nkarash
oo lukuny o sekenke oo nkaik o ntoren o ltuleta le sonkoyo o ntaleng'o
o lelo giso oomishira o lgiso loo nkumeishin;
o lelo kilani loo siruai, lelo karash lioriong o lelo kilani o lbenia loo nkaik;
o lelo kilani oobebek, o lelo kilani oopuyiapui o nkarash oo lukuny o lelo karash ooimulumulieki inkonyek.

Ore te rishata e rropili naa eng'uan; ore te rishata e nkeene e mpolos naa olgosoi; naa ore te rishata oo lpapit ooitobiraki, naa enkurroto; naa ore te rishata o olkila sidai naa enkishopo oo lkuniyiani; naa ore te rishata e nkikishaan naa enkurruna.
Ore ilewa linyi naa kebatat olalem nemuta lelo lewa linyi magil to larrabal.
Ore nchomito e nkanasa neyietu aaishir; neirrag ninye te nkop meishopo.
Naa keibung kenya inkituaak naapishana olee obo teina olong ejo, “Eikinya iyiook endaa ang maate nikinchop inkilani ang maate, nchoo ake duoo eipotieki iyiook enkarna ino, iwuang'ie enkurruna ang.”
Ore kenya teina olong kesidanu olng'osila lo Laitoriani, ore ilng'anayio le ina kop naa keaku esikar o enkitoo e ilo pisiai otelekua loo Siraeli.
Naa ore ilo otelekua te Sion neton te Yerusalem, neipoti aajo sinyati, pooki ng'ae ake ninye oigeroki enkarna enye te nkaraki puaan te Yerusalem,
ina kata eidipa Olaitoriani aitukuo olduruk too ntoyie e Sion neitukuoo iltipot lo sarge le Yerusalem, aiwuangie te mpolos enye, to ltau le nkiguana o to ltau le mpejoroto.

Netum taa Olaitoriani aitobira te shumata o ldoinyo pooki le Sion o te shumata ilturrurri lenyena pooki enkatampoi te ndama o empuruo o enkimerlel e nkima te nkewarie, amu ore te shumata naa kelo atii enkitushurata o lng'obor.
Keaku ninye oloip te ndama te nkaraki enkirowuaj o te nkaraki sii enesaruni o enelutori te nkaraki olkutati o enchan.
Ntasho mataranyaki nanu olanyor lai osinkolio le nyorrata oipirta enkurma enye oo sabibu: keeta apa ilo lanyor enkurma oo sabibu te ndoinyo sidai enterit.

Etuturo ninye neiwuang'ie isoito, neun isabibu ooshiluno; neshetu oltalet orripishoreki te mpolos e nkurma, neitobiru eneironyishoreki teine; neton aanyu metoiu enkurma isabibu, kake isabibu le ntim etoiwuo.
Ore naa, intae iloomanya Yerusalem o ltung'ana le Yuda, atoomono intae, enguanareki nanu o ina kurma ai oo sabibu.
Kainyoo nanu aitong'oro eitu aas te nkurma ai oo sabibu? Ore pee aanyu nanu metoiu ilng'anayio, kaainyoo pee aa isabibu le ntim etoiwuo?
Ore naa taata kaaliki nanu enalo aitaas enkurma ai oo sabibu, kaiwuang'ie nanu enkikarrata enye, pee eidaikieki; naa kagil nanu isunta enyena pee eitunyori.
Kaitaa nanu ninye mijooni; meikesuni ae kata te ninye nemeturi naa kebulunye endiati o lkiku; naa kaitanap sii inkatampo pee meshaiki enchan ninye.

Amu ore ina kurma oo sabibu o Laitoriani loo lororani naa enkaji e Israel, ore lelo tung'ana le Yuda ninche enkurma natuunoki naitiship ninye; neing'oru ninye esipata, kake ng'ura, enkibukoroto osarge natii; neing'orua esupatisho, naa ng'ura, olkiyioi otii!
Wooi ninche lelo ooruk inkajijik, lelo ooponiki ate ilchampai, o metaba anaa neishunye pooki wueji, nikintaae iyie oloton openy te mpolos e nkop.
Einosa Olaitoriani loo lororani olmumai aning'ito too nkiyiaa aainei: “Kesipa kemijoonu inkajijik kumok, nena ajijik sidain sapuki nememanya.
Amu ore iekai tomon oo lng'anayio naa iltuleta isiet ake eitayu le naisho oo sabibu, ore enkikapu nabo oo lanterera naa emborei nabo empirbil ake entapa eitayu.”
Woi ninche lelo ooinyototo aayooki tadekenya, pee etum aakuet aatusujai inaishi naapi, lelo ootoni oleng o metaa kewarie o metaba anaa neidimu ninche enaisho!
Neeta ninche inkinantani o nkai oo sinkolioitin, o ndulen o naishi too siruai lenye; kake meshilaa ninche inkiaasin o Laitoriani, anaa edol ina siaai oo nkaik enyena.
Ore te nkaraki ina kepuo iltung'ana laainei eyararoto te nkaraki emodai enye; kemut olameyu ilkituaak lenye, nemuta olorere lenye pooki te nkure.
Neaku eibung'a enemeneng'a esumash, netang'a enkutuk enye aitulus, ore enkitoo e Yerusalem o ilo orora lenye, naa kepuo aadoyio, olorora lenye o ilo ong'idare.
Eirrugoki tung'ani aaing'orie enkop, neitadowuoki iltung'ana aayau kop, ore inkonyek e ilo oitokoos neitoborraki.
Kake ore Olaitoriani loo lororani, neitaaki kitok te sipata, ore Enkai Sinyati neitodolu kewan te sinyatisho te sipata.
Ore ilkuoo le kerra, nedaa anaa ilootii endaata enye, ore ilkuoo le kineji nedaa to lmuaate.
Woi ninche lelo ooyietu enkarruoisho too nkeenta e lejare, lelo ooyietu ing'ok anaa too nkeenta e ngarri,

lelo oojo: “Nchoo ninche eisarrisar, nchoo ninche eitasiooyo esiaai enye pee kitum iyiook aatodol; nchoo eyiolounoto e Ilo Sinyati le Israel etaanu, naa nchoo ninye elotu, pee kitum iyiook aatayiolo!”

Woi ninche lelo oojo entorroni eisidai nejo esidano entorroni, nepik enaimin erishata e wang'an, nepik ewang'an erishata e naimin, lelo oopik enduaran erishata e meloni nepik emeloni erishata e nduaran!
Woi ninche lelo ooiteng'enuo too nkonyek enye maate, lelo ooitaa ate kalamasi!
Woi ninche lelo oorup ate te neokieki enaisho, lelo arriyiak te nkitushulata oo naishi naapi,
lelo oolaaya olarruoni te nkaraki eropata, neoru ilo asipani esipata enye!

Neaku, ore anaa enamut olng'ejep le nkima isuut o anaa enaibung inkujit naatoito olng'ejep le nkima, neijia etiu ntona enye, ketiu anaa entoki natong'ua apurda, ore te rishata naitapuku, netiu anaa enterit; te nkaraki natanyaita ninche enkitanapata Olaitoriani loo lororani, netemenaitie ninche ororei le Ilo Sinyati le Israel.

Ore te nkaraki ina eyupuyupo engoro o Laitoriani tialo iltung'ana lenyena, neitorioyie ninye enkaina enye, aarare ninche neosh ninche, neikirikira oldoinyo; netiu mpopoki enye anaa isuut too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa. Amu ore te kuna pooki meibooroyu engoro enye, neton ake eitoriori enkaina enye.
Neyuku ninye olosho olakua, neisulu ninye aipotu meetu aaing'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop; naa ng'ura, nekuetu te ngolon oleng!
Meetae obo lenye onauru, meetae obo lenye orrorro, meetae oloimug neirura, meetae olololong'u enkeene e mpolos, nemedung'o enkeene e namuke enye;
naa kepi mbaa enye, neteyietuoki nkai enye, negol iloisotok loo mbartan enye anaa soito, ore nkejek oo ngarrin enye nepuo anaa osiwuo.
Neikununo enkikurrukur enye anaa eno lng'atuny, neikurrukur ninche anaa ilkuoo loo lng'atunyo; keikurrukur ninche neibung'isho, neripaa ninche ina ng'ues naibung'a, nemeetae ololo arrinyu.

Ore kenya teina olong naa keikurrukurroki ninche nena naaibung'a, te nkikurrukur naaijo ene naiposha. Naa te neing'or oltung'ani enkop, nedol enaimin ake o osina; ore ewang'an neitomisimis inkatampo enyena.
Ore teilo ari apa otuayie olaiguanani oji Usia, nadol nanu Olaitoriani etonita to lorika le nkitoo. Neilepieki ninye oleng. Ore olkila lenye neiput enkaji e Nkai.
Ore te shumata ninye neitashe iserafi. Neeta ake obo inaipuko ile. Ore inaipuko are neimulumulie enkomom enye, ore are neimulumulie inkejek enyena, ore are nelotie tiaai.
Eipoto ake maate ejo: “Sinyati, Sinyati, Sinyati Olaitoriani loo lororani; eiputa enkop pooki enkitoo enye.”
Neikirikira olkitamanyunoto le Nkaji e Nkai te nkaraki ina buakunoto, neiput ina aji empuruo.
