Najo nanu: “Woi kewan ai! Amu aimina nanu; amu kara nanu oltung'ani loo nkirorot torrok; naton tiatua iltung'ana loo nkirorot torrok; amu etoduaa inkonyek aainei Olaiguanani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani!”
Nelotu obo le lelo serafi enatii, neibung'ita te nkaina enye enkukuo naishu, nayawua to lperere lo lasar.
Neiseyie enkutuk ai, nejo, “Ng'ura ajo eiseyie ena enkutuk ino; eiwuang'ieki entorroni ino, nikitapalakaki ing'ok inono.”
Naning nanu oltoilo lo Laitoriani ejo, “Kaing'ae nanu airriwaa, naa kaing'ae olo te nkaraki iyiook?” Najo nanu, “Nele nanu! Irriwayioki.”
Ejo ninye, “Shomo, tiaaki ele orere: ‘Ining'ining'i, kake miyiolouu; Idolidolo kake mimususu.’

Iroishiyie iltauja le kulo tung'ana, nintiming'ana inkiyiaa enye, ninkeno inkonyek enye; pee medolisho too nkonyek enye, nemening'isho too nkiyiaa enye, neyiolou too ltauja lenye, neibelekenya pee eishiunyeki.”
Naitoki nanu ajo, “Oi anu, Olaitoriani?” Nejo ninye: “O metaba anaa nemijoonu nkanas memanya toki o nkajijik metii iltung'ana, ore enkop neliyioyu tukul.
Neiwuang'ie Olaitoriani iltung'ana aitalamaa oleng, neaku ilmuaateni kumok te mpolos e nkop.

Ore hoo duoo ninye te neleku ematua nabo e tomon, keitokini aapejoo, ketiu ninye anaa enkobei o lchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli naing'uari eitashe, eidipaki aatuuroi.” Ilo antererai sinyati ninye ina obei.

Ore apa too nkolong'i e Ahas olayioni le Yotam, olayioni le Usia, olaiguanani le Yuda, nelotu Resin olaiguanani le Siria o Peka olayioni le Remalia, ilo aiguanani le Israel, Yerusalem pee eitainye olarrabal. Kake eitu ninche emir ninye.
Ore ake pee elikini enkaji e Daudi nchere, “Eibung'ate Siria o Efraim,” neikirikira oltau lenye o ltauja loo ltung'ana lenyena anaa ilkeek le ntim ookutita osiwuo.

Nejoki Olaitoriani Isaya, “Shomo tanang'are Ahas, iyie o Shearyashub olayioni lino, amu inang'arere ninye te nkiting'oto o lkiperrata le nkare o lchorro le shumata, te wueji oo laitobirak loo nkilani.
Nijoki ninye, ‘Terretenayu, ntirring'ayu, nimiureishoyu, nemishalu te nkaraki nena oben are e nkima netaa keimisiloo, te nkaraki engoro e Resin o Siria o layioni le Remalia.
Ore te nkaraki naipirutua Siria, te nebo Efraim entorroni te nebo olayioni le Remalia, ejo;
Maape iyiook aaitayunye Yuda olarrabal, nikinture ninye, nikisulie iyiook aaya, nikipik iyiook olayioni le Tabel metaa olaiguanani tiatua ninye,
nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Meitashe ina, nemeaku aekata.
Amu ore entonata e Siria naa Dameski, ore entonata e Dameski naa Resin. (Ore te rishata oo larin ntomoni ile o imiet naa keitaae Efraim mpurdat o metaa meitoki aaku olorere.)
Megol Israel alang Samaria nemegol Samaria alang olaiguanani Peka. Tinimirukuruku, intae, meeta nchere pee intasheito aaitobiraki.’ ”
Neitoki Olaitoriani airorie Ahas,
nejoki, “Ing'oru olmonekie to Laitoriani Enkai ino; nchoo egutu anaa enemeneng'a aashu eado abaiki keper.”
Kake etejo Ahas, “Maikilikuanu nanu, nematem nanu Olaitoriani.”
Neitoki Isaya ajo, “Toning'o naa, naaji e Daudi! Kentoki nalelek ena pee intanaururu intae iltung'ana, nintokiki sii aaitanaur Enkai ai?
Ore naa, Olaitoriani makewan oisho intae olmonekie. Ng'ura, kenutayu eselenkei neiu enkayioni naa keisho ninye enkarna aajo Emanuel.
Naa keaku ninye, nenya eng'orno o enaisho, te neyiolou atirisha intorrok o supati.
Amu ore eton eitu eyiolou ina kerai atanya entorroni negelu ina sidai, ore ina kop e lelo aiguanak pokira oaare ooiture intae naa kepuoi aaing'uaa.
Keyau Olaitoriani shumata iyie o shumata iltung'ana linyi, o shumata e nkaji e papaai lino nkolong'i neitu aekata etumi ina olong apa nalo Efraim te Yuda - ilo aiguanani le Asiria.”
Ore kenya teina olong naa keipotu Olaitoriani te nkisulata lelo oopuonu anaa lojong'a ooing'uaa nchorroi e Misiri o ilo olotu anaa olotoroki oing'uaa enkop e Asiria.
Naa kepuonu ninche pooki nemany ineegum oo erat, o nkapuniaa oo ndapidapo o sanagi pooki loo lkiku, o wuejitin pooki neenyori.
Ore kenya teina olong naa kelo Olaitoriani abarnisho to lmurunya oisilenuoki te lido kekun o lkeju - to laiguanani le Asiria. Nebarn endukuya o lpapit loo nkejek enye, nebarn sii olmunyei tukul.
Ore kenya teina olong naa keramat oltung'ani enkashe o nkerra are;
naa ore te nkaraki enkumoi e kule naata ninche, kenya ninye eng'orno; amu ore pooki ng'ae otelekua teina kop naa kenya eng'orno o enaisho.
Ore kenya teina olong, ore pooki wueji netii apa isabibu enkalifu nabo ooata enkinyang'a e shekeli enkalifu nabo e nkosholai, naa keaku entim oo lkiku.
Kepuonu iltung'ana ine eeta nkai o mbaa amu keaku enkop pooki entim oo lkiku.
Ore nena doinyo apa naaturi too nchempei nimintokiki intae aapuonu ine iurere entim oo lkiku; kake keaku nene wuejitin ineeidapashakino nkishu o nkerra.
Naaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki nanu, “Iwa embao dapash ngero too sirat sapuki, ‘Ene Maher-shalal-hash-bas.’ ”
Natum nanu olchakeni osipa, Uria ilo apolosani o Sakaria olayioni le Yeberekia, pee aaishakenoki.
Nalo nanu aboitare enkitok ai, nenutayu ninye neiu enkayioni. Naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani ajoki, “Tejo enkarna e ina ayioni Maher-shalal-hash-bas;
amu ore eton eitu eyiolou ina kerai atejo ‘Mpapa’ aashu ‘Nini’, ore ina arsisisho e Dameski o nena apa naataarutua Samaria naa keyae eduaaya olaiguanani le Asiria.”
Naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani airorie, naajoki,
“Ore te nkaraki natanyaita ele orere inkariak e Shiloa naaruko akiti, netalepori ninche eure Resin olayioni le Remalia;
ore te nkaraki ina, kerewaki Olaitoriani aitaar ninche nkariak o Lkeju le Frati, ilo aiguanani le Asiria o enkitoo enye pooki; naa kenang'ari ninche aaimu imartin nepuo aaim mbat o lkeju.
Naa keor nena ariak Yuda, nenang'ari neruko aapuo, neitabaiki olorere murto. Naa te nelak inaipuko enyena neibulu enkop ino pooki, iyie Emanuel.”
Entaa nabo intae iloreren niureishoyuyu; entoning intae nakuapi naalakua; enterreten ate niruturutu.
Enguanata te nebo, kake meaku ina toki; eimaki ororei kake melo auno, amu ketii Enkai te nebo iyiook.
Nji aatiaka Olaitoriani, nchere eiteleikia ina aina enye nagol shumata nanu, naaikok pee maibung orrekie le kulo tung'ana, naajoki:
“Mijo iyie nena kitobirat torrok, nena pooki naajo kulo tung'ana nkitobirat torrok, nimiureyu iyie ina naure ninche, nimimputukuny.
Kake ore Olaitoriani loo lororani, ninye ake intaa sinyati, nchoo eaku ninye iure, nchoo eaku ninye oloputukunyi lino.
Naa keaku ninye ewueji sinyati, neaku osoit oluaa, neaku endapidapoi e rrorroto too nkajijik pokira e Israel. Neaku eloket o rreshet te lelo oomanya Yerusalem.
Naa kerrorrokino ilkumok enchumata enye, nebatata negila, nerreshi ninche neyae.”
Ore ntae ilooiteng'eni laainei, eng'ura nintubulaa ina kiteng'enare naishoo Enkai.
Kaanyu nanu Olaitoriani, laa ninye oisudoo enkomom enye aitung'uaa enkaji e Yakobo, naa kaisilig ninye.
Ore nanu o kuna kera naaishoo Olaitoriani nikira iyiook olmonekie o embae e nking'asia tiatua Israel, eing'uaa Olaitoriani loo lororani obik te nchumata oldoinyo le Sion.
Naa tenejoki ninche intae, “Enkilikuanishore ilaitumusumusok o lasakutok ooing'oming'om neyietu,” aimeikilikuanishore iltung'ana Enkai enye? Ke lootuata ninche eikilikuanishore te rishata oo looishu?
Tawaliki ninche, tiaaki, “Entoning ina naiteng'en intae Olaitoriani! Emining ilaitumusumusok - ore enajoki ninche intae nemeret intae.”
Naa kepuo ninche aadung enkop, eeta osina kitok o esumash; naa ore te neisumashu, negoro nedek olaiguanani lenye o Enkai enye, nedumu nkomomi enye aaing'orie shumata;
neitoki aaing'or enkop, kake ng'ura, osina ake o enaimin, ina misimisi o sina. Naa kenang'akini ninche atua enaimin narok ong'u.

Kake meetae osina teina apa naata emion. Ore too nkatitin e dukuya neishoo ninye metemenari enkop e Sebulon o enkop e Naftali, kake ore too nkolong'i e siadi naa keisho ninye meitaai kitok ina oitoi e naiposha, ina kop natii lido kekun le Yordan, Galilaya oo loreren.
Ore lelo tung'ana apa oopuo te naimin netoduaa ewang'an kitok; ore apa lelo oomanya enegut e misimisi, neitawang'aka ninche ewang'an.
Itoponayie iyie olorere itoponikia iyie eng'ida enye; neng'ida ninche te dukuya iyie te ng'ida naaijo ene nkikesare, neikununo anaa tene ng'ida lewa eor nena naataarutua.
Amu ore ina shata e murt e ilo ola lenye, o ina shata o loililai lenye, ina ng'udi e ilo aitorogonyani, nitigila iyie anaa te nkata e Midian.
Amu ore enamuke ake pooki e ilo otii enjore naa kemut enkima, ore pooki kila oata oltipoti lo sarge naa kepejori anaa ilkeek le nkima.

Amu etoikioki iyiook enkerai, eishooki iyiook enkayioni, naa keaku oloililai lenye etii enkitoria, naa kepuoi aajo enkarna enye, “Olaiguanani le Nking'asia, Enkai Magilani, Papa loo Ntarasi, Olkitok le Seriani.”

Ore emponaroto e nkitoria enye o eseriani, nemeeta enkiting'oto, to lorika le nkitoo le Daudi, o te shumata enkitoo enye, pee eitubulaa, neitasheyie te sipata o te supatisho, ebaiki ena kata taata oo ntarasi moitie. Olokiyo lo Laitoriani loo lororani oitabaya ena.
Eirriwayie Olaitoriani olkilikuai lo larrabal te nkaraki Yakobo, naa kelo aitawang'aki Israel.
Naa kepuo iltung'ana pooki aayiolou, aa taa, Efraim o lelo oomanya Samaria, lelo oojo to lwuasa o te nkitokoos oo ltauja:
“Etusulari isoito loo nkajijik kake eikishet iyiook too soito oogueta; etuuroyioki oreteti aadung, kake eikipik iyiook iltarakua erishata enye.”
Neaku kedumaki ninche Olaitoriani ilmang'ati, neputu ilmang'ati lenye.
Ore lelo le Siria ootii enkalo o loo saen o lelo le Filistia ootii enkalo o loo ntoluo, kepuo aamut te nkutuk nang'a. Amu ore te kuna pooki eitu eiwuang'ieki engoro enye neitorioyioki enkaina enye.
Eitu eibelekenyakino iltung'ana ilo otoosho ninche, neitu eing'oru Olaitoriani loo lororani.
Ore te nkaraki ina etudung'oyie Olaitoriani te Israel endukuya o lkidong'oi; nedung ilng'osil loo ltuka o seyia te nkolong nabo -
lelo payiani kituaak ooyanyit ninche endukuya, ore ilo oiboni oibonisho te lejare ninye olkidong'oe;
amu ore lelo oorikoo ele orere naa keitapong'oo ninche, ore lelo oorikori naa keijori.

Ore te nkaraki ina meshipakino Olaitoriani elelero enye, nemeetayie olng'ur lelo okishin o nkolia; amu ore pooki ng'ae lenye nepaashare orrekie le Nkai naa laasak loo ntorrok, ore pooki kutuk neiro ine modai. Ore te kuna pooki neitu eiwuang'ieki engoro enye neitorioki enkaina enye.
Amu eyupuyupito entorroni anaa enkima, nenya isuut o lkiku; nenya isanagi le ntim, neilep ninche shumata te mpuruo kitok.
Tiatua engoro o Laitoriani loo lororani etapejoki enkop, netotiutuo iltung'ana anaa ilkeek le nkima; meetae oltung'ani oing'urrie olalashe lenye.
Kewuapaa ninche too ntateniaa, neton ake eisumash, nedaa ninche too nkedienyaa, kake eitu eraposho; nenya ake oltung'ani nkiri e ilo le latia enye.
Nenya Manase Efraim, nenya Efraim Manase, ore ninche pokira nedumakino Yuda. Ore te kuna pooki neitu eiwuang'ieki engoro o Laitoriani, Neitorioki enkaina enye.
Woi ntae ilelo ooitorogonyisho neipiru inkiguanat naaitorogonyisho,
neibelekeny ilo omena aaitapaash esipata neoru ilo aisinani loo ltung'ana laainei esipata enye, neitaa ninche nkolia entoki nataarutua, netum aaibung'a nena okishin aawaita!
Kaa kenya intae iasiasa teina olong e nkitamioto, te ilo kutati olotu eing'uaa enelakua? Kaing'ae iyie isaru mikitaretu, naa kaing'ae iyie ing'ueiki karsisisho ino?

Meleku toki, meteleku ake pee isukudo te nebo lelo ooena, aashu ibatata te nebo lelo ootasesekuanaki. Amu ore te kuna pooki eitu eiwuang'ieki engoro enye neton ake etudumuaki enkaina enye pee eoshisho.
Ee, Asiria, ninye esiare e ngoro ai, ninye orinka le mpijan e ngoro ai!
Airriwua nanu metaarare ilo osho lemeure Enkai, naitanapa nanu ninye te nkaraki ilo orere laaitagoro, pee eibung aaraya ntokitin enye, neitunyoki enkop anaa esarng'ab e nkoitoi.
Kake mme ina eyieu ninye, neme ina edamu ninye; kake ore ndamunot enyena naa pee einyalisho, nedung'oo iloshon leme kuti;
amu ejo ninye: “Aime ilaiguanak pooki ilarikok laainei?
Aimetiu kulo anaa Karkemish? Aimetiu Hamat anaa Arpad? Aimetiu Samaria anaa Dameski?
Amaa anaa enatabaikia enkaina ai nkitoriat oo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin, naa ore nkitanyaanyukot enye naaguetuno naa aikituaak aalang nena naatii Yerusalem o Samaria,
aimaitaas nanu Yerusalem o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enyena anaa enaitaasa Samaria o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enyena.”
Ore ake pee eidip Olaitoriani esiaai enye pooki to ldoinyo le Sion o te Yerusalem, naa keitame ilo owuasa o ina kitokoos o laiguanani le Siria o ina kitaragirag enye.

Amu ejo Ninye: “Te ngolon e nkaina ai ataasa nanu ena o te ng'eno ai, amu kara nanu ng'en; naiwuang'ie nanu ilpolosien loo loreren, nataarayie nanu ilchumat lenye; atusulua nanu lelo ootoni too lorikan le nkitoo anaa oloing'oni.

Eibung'a enkaina ai anaa enkaji e motonyi karsisisho oo loreren; naa ore anaa enasotu iltung'ana ilmosor ootung'uayioki, neijia aikuna asotu enkop pooki; nemeetae hoo obo oiwuang'ie enaipukoi, aashu obol enkutuk, aashu eyietu.”
Keaku entolu kitok alang ilo oasishore, aashu keisis esoo kewan te ilo odung'ishore? Eji netiu anaa eng'udi nadumu oltung'ani! Anaa etiu anaa eng'udi nadumu ilo leme enchata.
Ore te nkaraki ina, ore Olaitoriani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani, kelo airriwaki esaso lelo murran lenyena oopir, ore ti abori enkitoo enye neinoki enkiyupuyup, naaijo enkiyupuyup e nkima.
Ore ina wang'an e Israel naa keaku enkima, ore ilo lenye sinyati neaku olng'ejep le nkima, naa kenya ninye nemut lelo kiku lenyena o suut pooki te nkolong nabo.
Ore ina kishiaa e ntim enye o ene ina kop enye nalepo, naa keidakie Olaitoriani pooki; osesen o enkishui, netiu anaa oltung'ani omuoi te nemenayu.
Ore olpisiai le lelo keek lenyena ooleku naa keaku kuti, o metaa ninye keidim enkerai aikena.

Ore kenya teina olong ilo pisiai le Israel o lelo oolekuni le nkaji e Yakobo, nemeitoki aairishakino ilo orere leyieu ear ninche amut, kake Olaitoriani eirishakino ninche. Ilo Sinyati le Israel eirishakino te sipata.
Olpisiai olo arrinyunye, ilo pisiai le Yakobo orrinyokino Enkai magilani.
Amu ore hoo neba iltung'ana linono le Israel anaa osinyai le naiposha olpisiai ake lenye orrinyunye. Etudung'okoki enkiguana e nkidaata te sipata.
Amu ore Olaitoriani loo lororani naa kelo aiting'ie anaa enatudung'oki tiatua enkop pooki.

Ore te nkaraki ina, nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani: “Lo tung'ana laainei, kulo oomanya Sion, emiureyu ile Asiria te neoshisho te ng'udi aashu te nedumu orinka lenye aar intae anaa apa enaikuna ile Misiri.
Amu ore te nkiti rishata naa keish engoro ai, neibelekenyakino engoro ai enkidaata enye.
Nedumu Olaitoriani loo lororani eng'udi agilunore ninche anaa apa pee eosh Midian te ndapidapoi e Oreb. Ore eng'udi enye kelo shumata enaiposha, naa kedumu ninye anaa apa enaikuna te Misiri.
Ore teina te neiwuang'a ilo ola lenye to loililai lino, negili ina shata enye emurt nanapishoreki te murt ino.”
Eilepa ninye alo Rimon, eewuo ninye Aiat; etudung'o ninye enkop e Migron, ore te Mikmash neshum ninye olola lenye.
Etalang'a ninche te lang'ata, neirrag Geba enkewarie nabo, neikirikira Rama, ore Gibea e Saul neilanyisho.
Teyietu nchira, natito e Galim! Entoning lo tung'ana le Laisha! Tawaliki ninye, iyie, Anatot!
Eisikita Madmena, ore lelo oomanya Gebin neilanyishote aaing'oru enesaru.
Ore ena olong kelo ninye aitashe te Nobu, nelo aikirikirie enkaina enye te ilo doinyo le nkidaata le Sion, teilo doinyo le Yerusalem.
Ng'ura ajo ore Olaitoriani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani, kedung lelo ng'osil te ngolon naitureisho; ore ilo magilani oado naa kedung'i, ore lelo oorup ate neitadouni.
Kedung ninye ina asuri e ntim te ntolu, ore Lebanon o lelo keek lenyena sidain neurori.
Kepuku enkaitubului te nkobei e Yese, nebulu olng'osila te nena tona enyena.
Naa ketonie Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata ninye, enkiyang'et e ng'eno o enkarriyiano, enkiyang'et e utaroto o enkidimata, enkiyang'et e ng'eno o euriata o Laitoriani.
Ore enchipai enye naa euriata o Laitoriani. Nemedung ninye enkiguana too naadol inkonyek enyena, aashu edung too naaning too nkiyiaa enyena;
kake too sipat ninye eiguanare ilaisinak, neikok ninye te mborron lelo oobor ootii enkop; naa kear ninye enkop te ng'udi e nkutuk enye, near ilo arruoni metua te nkiyang'et e nkutuk enye.
Esipata naaku enkeene e mpolos enye, naa ina kisiligata naisiligayu ninye naaku enkeene narreten ninye.
Neton osuyiani te nebo olkuoo le ker, neirrag olowuaru keri te nebo olkuoo le kine, ore olashe o lng'atuny neirrag te nebo nerikoo enkiti kerai ninche.
Ore enkiteng o lng'arurumi ng'iro nedaa te nebo; ore lasho lenye neirrag te nebo, ore olng'atuny neaku nkujit enya anaa olkiteng.
Neiguran enkerai nanakita te nkutuk e ngumoto o lasurai, nepik enkerai kiti enkaina enye enkutuk e engumoto e nturbubua.
Meiko ninche ae nemeinyal tiatua ilo doinyo lai pooki sinyati; amu keiput enkop eyiolounoto o Laitoriani, anaa enaiputa inkariak enaiposha.
Ore kenya teina olong naa keitashe entonai e Yese anaa enkitoduaaroto too loreren; keaku ninye eing'oru iloreren, ore emanyisho enye neaku ewueji e nkitoo.

Ore kenya teina olong naa keitorioo Olaitoriani enkaina enye aigil eniare, pee errinyu ilo pisiai apa otelekua loo ltung'ana lenyena, aitung'uaa Asiria o Misiri o Patros o Etiopia o Elam o Shina o Hamat, neitung'uaa sii olomanaa le naiposha.
Naa kedumaki ninye nkuapi olmonekie pee eiturrurru lelo apa ooidapashari le Israel, neiturrur lelo ooidapashari le Yuda meetu aaing'uaa ilubot pokira ong'uan e nkop.
Keiwuang ilo lom le Efraim, ore lelo ooiture Yuda neiwuang'ieki; meigil Efraim aatayie olom Yuda, nemeigil Yuda aiture Efraim.
Naa keor ninche ebaiki oloililai loo filisti te nkalo o loo ntoluo, neibung'a ninche te nebo aaidaikie iltung'ana lo loosaen. Nepik ninche inkaik enye enkop e Edom o Moab, ore ile Amon neiruk ninche.

Naa keishie Olaitoriani katukul olkina le naiposha e Misiri; naa keyuk ninye enkaina enye te shumata olkeju le frati, te ilo kutati lenye opejisho, naa keosh ninye aitaa inong'ot naapishana pee eim iltung'ana anaa enkop natoyio.
Naa keaku keetae enkoitoi kitok naing'uaa Asiria, te nkaraki ilo pisiai otelekuaki loo ltung'ana lenyena, ina kata apa pee epuonu ninche eing'uaa enkop e Misiri.
Ijo kenya teina olong: “Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe, Olaitoriani, amu ore hoo nikitagorokine iyie nanu, neibelekenye engoro ino, nikintagolo iyie nanu.
“Ng'ura, Olaitoriani Enkai ninye enjeunoto ai; kaisilig nanu ninye, nemaureishoyu; amu Olaitoriani Enkai ninye engolon ai o sinkolio lai, netaa ninye enjeunoto ai.”
Ore te ng'ida nilo iyie aoku enkare naing'uaa lelo shorroi le njeunoto.
Nilo iyie ajo teina olong: “Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, empoto enkarna enye, embalunye nkiaasin enyena too loreren, embalunye nchere eikitok enkarna enye.
“Entaranyaki Olaitoriani te nkisisa, amu etaasa ninye ine nkitoo; nchoo eyiolouni kuna tiatua enkop pooki.
Entabuaku entarany te ng'ida, intae iloomanya Sion, amu eikitok ilo omanya atua intae, Ilo Osinya le Israel.”
Ele olkilikuai oipirta Babilon apa otabolokoki Isaya olayioni le Amos.
Ore te nchumata e ndoinyo naisiasha tudumu olmonekie tabuaku nchiraki ninche; iyuku ninche te nkaina metijing'u nena shomito oo lkituaak.
Aitanapa nanu makewan lelo gelunot laainei, aipotuo nanu lelo tung'ana laainei magil, pee eitalaku engoro ai te lelo latagorokine.
Toning'o embuakunoto too ldoinyo eba anaa eno lorora kitok! Toning'o, embuakunoto oo nkitoriat, e lelo oshon oosoto te nebo! Olaitoriani loo lororani oitobirita olarrabal.
Kepuonu ninche eing'uaa enkop nalakua, eing'uaa enkiting'oto e keper, nelotu Olaitoriani eeta iruparen enyena pee eidaikie enkop pooki.
Enteyietu enchira amu etataana enkolong o Laitoriani; pee elotu ina kidaata naing'uaa olmagilani!
Ore te nkaraki ina kelepori inkaik pooki, neiropijaa empijan e pooki tung'ani.
Naa keiputukuny ninche. Nejing ninche emion naikununo anaa ene nkitok nasaisai. Neing'ura ninche maate to lkirutoto; neiput enkurruna nkomomi enye.
Ng'ura ajo kelotu enkolong o Laitoriani, ina olong torrono e ngoro o empijan e mpushuna, pee eitaa enkop olmuaate neidaikie lelo aing'okok lenyena aishie.
Amu ore ilakir le keper, nemeitoki aaishoru ewang'an enye; nemisimisu enkolong eilepu nemeitoki olapa aitawang'isho te wang'an enye.
Kaitame nanu enkop te nkaraki eng'oki enye, naitame lelo arruok te nkaraki enkarruoisho enye; kaiting'ie nanu ilo wuasa le lelo ooitokoos, naitadou nanu olwuasa le lelo ooing'ola.
Kaitaa nanu iltung'ana iloodoorieki anaa saabu nasila netiu iltung'ana anaa saabu e Ofir.
Ore te nkaraki ina kaikirikirie nanu keper, neigusugusieki enkop teine wueji enye, teina goro o Laitoriani loo lororani teina olong e ngoro enye napi.
Ore anaa entarakuet narreshitoi, aashu anaa nkerra nemeetae oltung'ani oiturrur, keibelekenyakino ake oltung'ani olorere lenye, neisik ake oltung'ani alo enkop enye.
Ore oloba anaa oloinepuni neari metua; ore oloba anaa oloibung'i nebatata to lalem.
Ore nkera enye kutiti naa kedung'udung'i te dukuya inkonyek enye, keibung'i nkajijik enye, ore nkituaak enye neikonyi.
Ng'ura ajo kaputu nanu lelo le Amedi metarasaki ninche, lelo lemeshilaa enkosholai; nemeshipakino saabu.
Inkai enye naar ilbarnot metuata; nemeing'urrie ninche ina natii enkoshoke e ng'otonye; ore nkonyek enye nemeeta olng'ur too nkera kutiti.
Ore Babilon, ina kitoo oo nkitoriat, ina kishiaa nawuasare Ilkaldayo, nelo atiu anaa Sodom o Gomora ina kata te nenang'aa Enkai ninche.
Meigili aekata aamany ninye aashu aatoni tiatua ninye too ishoritin pooki; meetae Olmarabui oigil aun olng'obor lenye teine; nemeetae ilairritak loo ntare ooigil aairragie nkerrai enye teine.
Kake ing'uesi e ntim naapuo aairrag teine, ore inkajijik enye neiput inkeenta enkop; nemany isidan ine, neitigiran ntarakueti teine.
Nekueni ilng'ojiniaa too ltaleta lenyena, nebuaku mbariak too nkajijik sidain e nkitoo; etataana ina kata enye, nemeimutieki nena olong'i enyena.
Keing'urrie Olaitoriani Yakobo naa keitoki ninye agelu Israel, nepik ninche atua enkop enye. Naa kepuonu iltung'ana loo loreren aashulare ninche neidikidikore enkaji e Yakobo.

Naa kepuonu iltung'ana aaya ninche neriku ninche ewueji enye. Ore ina aji e Israel neng'amaa ninche te nkaina o Laitoriani aaitaa irrindiki. Neya ninche aaraya lelo apa ootaaraitie ninche, neitore ninche lelo apa ooibooki ninche enkop.
Ore kenya teina kata nikilo Olaitoriani aisho enkiyagata teina mion o to sina lino, o teina kisiaayiare nikitipikaki isiaaisho,
teyietai olaiguanani le Babilon. Tejo: “Eng'ura eiting'ieki ilo apa aitorogonyani, eng'ura eiting'ieki enkisikong'are!
Etigila Olaitoriani eng'udi eilo torrono, ina ng'udi e nkitoo oo looitoreisho,
ilo apa otoosho iltung'ana te ngoro te nena oshot nemeish, ilo apa oitoria iloshon te ngoro o to losilisili metii olng'ur.
Eitirring'e enkop pooki neyagaa; neranyisho ninche.
Kiting'idakinote iyie ilkeek laaijo iltarakua, ore lelo tarakua le Lebanon, nejo, ‘Ore ebaiki ina kata apa nikirragieki aaitadou, meetae oladung'oni loo lkeek olotu adung.’

Etudumunye enemeneng'a to lodo le nkop pee kinang'are te nilotu, etudumua ninye iloipi pee kiroroki iyie, ee, lelo pooki oora ilarikok le nkop; etudumunye too lorikan lenye le nkitoo le lelo apa oora ilaiguanak loo loshon.
Eikirorie ninche pooki iyie aajoki, ‘Itashala sii iyie anaa iyiook! Itanyaanyukie sii iyie iyiook!’
Eitadoyioki enkishiaa ino aaya enemeneng'a, ina orui oo nkinantani inono; eisalaashaki aaitadoyio abori iyie, ore ilkuru nikimulumul iyie.
“Kaji iyie inkuna pee itusulunye te keper iyie lo Akira le Nkakenya, enkerai e Nkakenya! Ng'ura ajo kitudung'oki aapudaki enkop, iyie olapa oitadowuo iloreren kop!
Itejo apa iyie to ltau lino, ‘Kailep alo keper; teidia alo ilakir le Nkai kapik olorika lai le nkitoo shumata oleng; katon nanu to ldoinyo le umata te nelakua te nkalo e moikuape.
Kailep nanu alo teidia alo nkatampo, kaitotiu nanu kewan anaa Ilo Otii Shumata aisul.’
Kake kintadowuoki aayau enemeneng'a, nenen neegut e nemeneng'a eululu.
Ore lelo likidol iyie nikishumaki nkonyek, nikiimaki iyie, ejo: ‘Kele tung'ani apa oikirikirie enkop, neigusugusie nkitoriat,
oitaa enkop olpurkel neibelekeny nkanas enyena, neitu eisho lelo ooena meshomo ang?’
Ore lelo aiguanak pooki loo loreren neirrag te nkitoo, olaiguanani ake tiatua enkurare enye.

Kake kitanang'ayioki iyie aaiturraa, aaitalam enkurare ino, anaa enkaitubului nemeyieuni, neitemori too mpopoki e lelo ootuata, te lelo ootaaraki to lalem, lelo oosulakino isoito le ululu, anaa empopok naitunyi too nkejek.
Mikinukari iyie aaitaboitaki ninche te nkaraki nindaikie enkop ino, itara iyie iltung'ana linono metuata. “Ore eishoi e lelo aasak loo ntorrok, nchoo eaku meigili ai kata aaipot!
Entobira esesekuanata oo layiok lenyena te nkaraki entorroni oo loo menye, pee mebul ake neibung enkop, neiput oriong enkop nkanas.”
“Kadumunye nanu aitayunye ninche olarrabal,” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, “naa kaiwuang'ie nanu te Babilon enkarna o lpisiai, olmarei, Olaitoriani ojo.
Naa kaitaa nanu ina kop emanyisho oo lkirrumun, naitaa ilturot le nkare, naa kaor nanu te oret e nkidaata, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.”
Einosa Olaitoriani loo lororani olmumai: “Ore anaa enaitobira nanu, neijia elo atiu, naa ore anaa enatudung'o, neijia etiu keunoyu,

nchere kalo nanu agil ilo le Asiria tiatua enkop ai, ore te shumata lelo doinyo laainei naitunyoki nanu ninye enkop too nkejek; ore ina shata enye oo murto neiwuang'a te ninche, o ilo ola lenye otii oloililai.”
Ena ninye ina yieunoto natuutuaki eipirta enkop pooki; naa ena ninye ina aina naitorioyioki te shumata iloshon pooki.
Amu etuutua Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa aing'ae oiwuang'ie ina? Eitorioyioki enkaina enye, naa aing'ae oshuk?
Ore apa te ilo ari otanang'a olaiguanani Ahas, nelotu ele kilikuai ojo,
“Ming'ida iyie Filistia, o intae pooki, eji nchere, etigile ina ng'udi apa natoosho intae; amu te eishoi o lasurai epuku olasurai torrono aisul, ore olng'anayioi lenye naa olasurai olo tiaai.
Ore ilo kikau lo laisinani nedaa, ore ilo oata osina neirrag te seriani; kake kamut nanu entonai eishoi ino to lameyu, ore ilo pisiai lino naar nanu to lalem.
Teyietu, na kishomi; nchira, na anasa; talepori to lkirutoto, iyie Filistia, intae pooki! Amu kelotu empuruo eimu moikuape, nemeetae oloisiadu to ltim lenye.”
Kainyoo ewaliki oltung'ani olkilikuai loo loshon? “Olaitoriani oitobirua Sion, naa ore tiatua ninye netum lelo tung'ana lenyena apa ooisilisiloki esarunoto.”
Ele Olkilikuai oipirta Moab: te nkaraki naitomijoonoki enkanasa e Aar teina kewarie apa naishieki Moab o te nkaraki naitomijoonoki enkanasa e Kir, teina kewarie apa, naishieki Moab.
Eshomo ina tito e Dibon iwuejitin neeika aishir; aishiraki Nebo neishiraki Medeba, eishirita Moab. Etabarnoki ilukuny enye o lmunyo lenye.
Ore too nkoitoi neishopo ilkuniyiani; ore too nchumat oo nkajijik o too nkisiajat eishirita pooki ng'ae netashala too lkiyio.
Eishirita Heshbon o Eleale, etoning'e oltoilo le nkishirata enye te Yahas; ore te nkaraki ina keishir lelo lewa le Moab ooata iruparen aabuaku; Eikirikire oltau lenye.

Eishirita oltau lai te nkaraki Moab; ekuetikitia lelo aisikak lenyena Soar, eshomo Eglat-shelishia. Amu ore eilepaki Luhit, nepuo ninche eishir, ore eimita ina oitoi nalo Horonaim neyietu enkishirata e nkidaaroto;
etoito nchorroi e Nimrim; netoito nkujit nemeetae inaabulu, meekure eetae inkaitubulu.
Ore te nkaraki ina, ore nena tokitin kumok apa naanoto ninche o nena apa naatushuma ninche, keyae ninche aaitalang nchorroi o seyiai.
Amu eshomo olkiyioi, aibulu enkop e Moab; etabaikia enkishirata Eglaim, etabaikia enkishirata Beerelim.
Amu eiputa nkariak e nkanasa e Dibon osarge, ore ake eyia kaitoki nanu ayau shumata Dibon embae torrono oleng. Keari aamut pooki ng'ae oing'uari te Moab.
Eirriwakita ninche ilkuoo le kerra ilo oitore enkop, eing'uaa Sela eimunye ina oitoi o lpurkel, aayau ilo doinyo le Yerusalem.
Etotiutuo nena toyie e Moab anaa motonyi naaidapashari tiaai, anaa nkajijik oo motonyi naaidapasha too mpoorri o lkeju le Arnon.
“Nchoru eutaroto, tudung'o enkiguana te sipata; ntotiwuo oloip lino anaa enkewarie te nkata e nkipirata e nkolong; isudoi lelo ootarayioki aaipang'ie, mincho meibung'i lelo aisikak.

Nchoo lelo le Moab ootaarayioki aaisikie metamanyisho te nebo iyie, taa enkisudoroto te ninche te lelo ooidaikie ninche. Te neishieki kenya ilo aitorogonyani neish enkidaata, ore te neiwuang'ieki ilo oibooki ninche enkop teina kop,
netumi taa aaitotona olorika le nkitoo te nyorrata nauno, ore te shumata e ilo orika neton ninye te sipata tiatua ilo ng'obor le Daudi, ilo obo oiguana te sipata amu keneneng ninye pee eas esipata.”
Kitoning'oitie iyiook ilo wuasa le Moab, enetiu apa olwuasa lenye; ore enkilashilash enye o lwuasa lenye o ina goro enye - ore enkitokoos enye naa elejare.
Ore te nkaraki ina nchoo Moab eyietu aishir, nchoo pooki ng'ae eyietu aishiraki Moab. Enchira to sina kitok te nkaraki nena mukateni oo sabibu e Kir-Hareseti.

Amu etoito nena ong'at e Heshbon o lelo sabibu le Sibma; ore lelo kituaak loo loshon netudung'o ilng'osil lenyena, lelo apa oopuo aabaiki Yaser, neidapashaki olpurkel; ore lelo ng'osil lenyena nepuo aaidapashari nelang enaiposha.

Ore te nkaraki ina, kaishir nanu te nkishirata e Yaser te nkaraki ilo sabibu le Sibma; kaaitashaiki nanu ilkiyio laainei, iyie Heshbon o Eleale; amu ore shumata ilng'anayio linono o nkikesare ino netadoikio embuaakinoto o larrabal.

Neiwuang'ieki eng'ida o enchipai teina kop sidai; ore te nkurma oo sabibu nemetii osinkolio oranyi, meetae mbuakunot naabuakuni; meetae olaironyani oirony isabibu te nkironyet; eitigiraki ina buakunoto e nkikesare.
Ore te nkaraki ina keishir oltau lai anaa olwulul loo usin aishiraki Moab, neishiraki oltau lai Kir-heres.
Naa te nelotu Moab aibalunye kewan, naa te neitanaur kewan too wuejitin neeika, te nelotu ninye atua ine wueji enye sinyati pee eomon, meret ninye ina.
Ororei ele oing'uaa Olaitoriani oipirta Moab too nkolong'i naatulusoitie.
Kake ore taata ejo Olaitoriani, “Too larin okuni, anaa larin le nkigeroto o ltung'ani, keitaae ina kitoo e Moab pesho, hoo duoo naa olorora kitok ninche. Ore lelo ooleku naa lkuti oleng leme toki.”
Olkilikuai oipirta Dameski. Meitoki Dameski aaku enkanasa, naa keaku ninye osototi loo suut.
Kepuoi aaing'uaa nkanas enyena o kenya; neaku ninche ndaat oo nkerrai, neirragie ninche ine nemeetae entoki naiture.
Keiwuang'a ina ang nagol aitung'uaa Efraim, neiwuang'a enkitoo aitung'uaa Dameski; ore ilo pisiai oleku le Siria netiu anaa enkitoo oo nkera e Israel, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.
Ore kenya teina olong neitadouni enkitoo e Israel aaitabaiki enkop, ore ina karsisisho enye neitaae emenai.
Naa ketiu ninye anaa te neikesisho olaunoni, negilu ilng'osil le nkurma, netiu anaa ina kurma naitashe te nesuli ilng'osil lenyena netiu anaa oerata le Refaim.

Ina natung'uayie olaikesani ake naleku, anaa te neikes olaunoni ilng'anayio neing'uaa oaare anaa okuni ootii shumata oleng, aashu oong'uan anaa imiet too lng'osil lo lchani loo lng'anayio, Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel ojo.
Ore kenya teina olong neaku keshilaa iltung'ana Ilo oitobira ninche, ore too nkonyek enye neing'or Ilo Sinyati le Israel;
meitoki ninche aaisilig ilpereren loo lasarri, ina siaai oo nkaik enye, nemeitoki ninche aaing'or ina naitobira ilkimojik lenye, aa Asherim aashu ilpereren le nkorropil.
Ore kenya teina olong nena anas enye naagol, nepuo aatiu anaa nene wuejitin neeisikieki oo le Hafi o le Amori, nenen apa neeisikie ninche te nkaraki nkera oo Siraeli. Nepuo aaku ilmuaateni.
Te nkaraki nikitorikine iyie Enkai e njeunoto ino, neitu iyie idamu ina dapidapoi e sarunoto ino; te nkaraki ina pee ituno iyie inkaitubulu sidain, nipik iyie ntokitin oo nkaitin omon.
Ore hoo nintubulu iyie ninche ina olong ake nituuno ninche, nincho ninche meitapuka pee ekenyu ake, ore ake eyia, kelo aimin enkikesare, teina olong o sina o ina mion nemeishiuni.
Kening'o oltoilo loo ltung'ana kumok, eikurrukur ninche anaa enkikurrukur e naiposha! Kuaak! Enkikurrukur oo loreren, eikurrukur ninche anaa enkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok!
Keikurrukur iloshon anaa enkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok, kake kelo Enkai aisikong ninche, neilanyisho ninche aaisik, nepuo ninche anaa suut too ldoinyio netiu anaa enterit nakutita olkutati.
Ore teipa, nelotu olkirutoto! Ore eitu eaku tadekenya meekure eetae ninche! Ena ninye erubata e lelo ooibung iyiook aaraya, elaakinoto e lelo ooisim iyiook.
Etii enkop natii lido kekun loo ilkejek le Etiopia naning'o enkikurrukur oo naipuko;

ina nairriwaa ilbalusuni lenyena aimie olkeju le Nail, too mpeuti naaitobiraki te narau oo nkujit naapor inkariak! Enchom intae, intae olkilikuai oneneng ina kop e lelo adoru oosipa seseni, enetii ilo orere ourei te netaana o te nelakua, ilo osho magilani otimirishe, odung ilkejek enkop enye.
Ore intae kulo ootii enkop pooki, intae lelo oomanya enkop, te nedumuni olmonekie too ldoinyo, entodol! Te neoshi emowuo, entoning!
Amu nji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani: “Kaitirring'a nanu aing'orisho te manyisho ai, kaing'or asipu anaa te ndama eirowuaja, anaa enkatampoi e nkolielio te nkata e nkikesare eirowuaju.”
Amu ore eng'or enkikesare, eidipa enkurma aitapuka, neibelekenya ntapuka aaku ilng'anayio, nedung'oo ninye lelo ng'osil to lalem odung'ishoreki, ore lelo ng'osil ooluaari nedung'oo.

Neing'uari ninche pooki, meinosa nena motonyi e ong'ata naatoni too ldoinyo, neing'ueikini ing'uesi e ntim. Neked ilmotonyi shumata ninche te nkata e nkirowuaj, netonie ing'uesi e ntim ninche te nkata e nkirobi.

Ore kenya teina kata neyauni nkishoorot aaisho Olaitoriani loo lororani, naaing'uaa lelo tung'ana adoru nesipa seseni, lelo tung'ana oourei te netaana o te nelakua, ilo osho magilani omirisho, odung ilkejek enkop enye, o metabaiki oldoinyo le Sion, ine wueji e nkarna o Laitoriani loo lororani.

Olkilikuai oipirta Misiri. Ng'ura, ekedito Olaitoriani enkatampoi nakuet, naa Misiri elotu; naa keikirikira nena kitanyaanyukot e Misiri oo nkaitin te dukuya ninye, nelepori iltauja loo ltung'ana le Misiri tiatua ninche.
Naa kaputu nanu ile Misiri metudumakinoto maate, nearare ninche oltung'ani ake olalashe lenye, nearare oltung'ani olayioni le latia enye, nearare enkanasa enkanasa, nearare enkitoo enkitoo.
Ore olokiyo loo le Misiri tiatua ninche, neishieki katukul, nainyal nanu nkitobirat enye; naa kepuo ninche aaikilikuanishore nena kitanyaanyukot oo laitumusumusok o loosh nkidong'i o lasakutok;
naa kaishooyo nanu ile Misiri apik inkaik o laitasheikinoni ogogong, naa olaiguanani otolo olo aitore ninche, Olaitoriani loo Lororani ojo.
Ore nkariak e ilo keju le Nail neitoi, ore ilo keju netoyu.
Ore nena nong'ot neing'usilu, ore ilkejek ooibung'are ilo keju le Nail le Misiri nemitari aatoyu, ore oseyiai o lkujita netoyu.
Keaku iorro mbat o lkeju le Nail, ore nena tokitin apa naatuunoki te mbata o lkeju netoyu, nekutaa osiwuo.
Ore lelo arreshok loo sinkir neishir te mion o sina, lelo pooki oonang'aki irresheta lenye olkeju le Nail, neyietu ninche aaishir, lelo pooki ooisalaashaki irresheta lenye shumata enkare.
Ore lelo aitobirak loo nkilani naapuyiapui nepalari, o lelo ooitobir nkilani naaibor.
Ore lelo laa ninche ing'apeta enkop nerratanyi, ore lelo oas esiaai oo ropiyiani netum osina.
Ore ilkituaak le Soan naa ilmoda; ore lelo ang'eni aikook le Farao neishooyo enkikoo e modai. Kaji iyie inko pee ijoki Farao, “Kara nanu olayioni lo lang'eni, olayioni lo laiguanani li apa moitie?”
Koree naa lelo ang'eni linono? Nchoo ninche mikitoliki neisho metayiolouni, ina naiguanua Olaitoriani loo lororani pee egilunore Misiri.
Ore lelo kituaak le Soan netaa ilmoda, ore lelo kituaak le Memfis neteleja ate; ore lelo apa laa ninche eitasheyie iloshon lenye, neitapong'oitie Misiri.
Eishoo Olaitoriani ninche olmilo; neisho Ilmisiri meyukuyukori too nkiaasin enyena pooki, anaa enayukuyukori olamerani elopisho.
Meetae oltung'ani otii misiri, karsis ashu olaisinani yioloti anaa mme yioloti ooidim aaitayu eretoto.
Ore kenya teina olong, naa ketiu ile Misiri anaa ng'oroyiok, neikirikira te dukuya ina aina naikirikirie Olaitoriani loo lororani ninche.
Ore ina kop e Yuda naa keaku entoki naiture ile Misiri; ore pooki tung'ani oba anaa ololikini neureishoyu, te nkaraki ina naiguanua Olaitoriani pee egilunore ninche.

Ore kenya teina olong naa keaku keetae inkanas imiet tiatua enkop e Misiri, naairo enkutuk e Kanaan. Nenya olmumai pee eiruk Olaitoriani loo lororani. Ore nabo e kuna naa kepuoi aajo Enkanasa e Nkolong.
Ore kenya teina olong naa keaku keetae olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani te mpolos e nkop e Misiri o eng'ape o Laitoriani to lpolosie lenye.

Naa keaku ina olmonekie o shakenisho o Laitoriani loo lororani tiatua enkop e Misiri; ina kata te neishiraki ninche Olaitoriani te nkaraki lelo ooibooki ninche enkop, neirriwaki Olaitoriani ninche olaitajeunoni. Nemitu, nekordu ninye ninche.

Neisho Olaitoriani metayiolouni ninye too le Misiri. Neyiolou lelo le Misiri Olaitoriani teina olong, neserem ninye to lasar o too nkishoorot o lasar opejori. Nenya ninche olmumai te nkaraki Olaitoriani, neitabaya.
Naa kelo Olaitoriani aosh Misiri, neosh neitoki ashukunye, naa kerrinyokino ninche Olaitoriani, nening ninye esayiata enye neishiunye ninche.
Ore kenya teina olong naa keaku keetae enkoitoi kitok nadumunye te Misiri alo Asiria. Nepuonunye ile Misiri Asiria, nepuo ile Misiri aaseremisho te nebo ile Asiria.
Ore kenya teina olong naa keaku Israel ene uni te nebo Misiri o Asiria, neaku ninche emayianata te mpolos e nkop.
Naa ninche emayian Olaitoriani loo Lororani ejo, “Metamayiani Misiri, olorere lai o Asiria ina siaai oo nkaik aainei, o Israel enjung'ore ai.”
Ore apa te ilo ari oyewunye ilo kitok le njore, oirriwua Sargon ilo aiguanani le Asiria meeu Ashdod, neitainye olarrabal neya ninye.

Ore teina kata neirorie Olaitoriani Isaya olayioni le Amos, ejoki, “Shomo, talaku ilo kuniyia lirrotianita te mpolos nidotu inamuka too nkejek inono,” netaasa apa ninye ina alo meishopo nemeeta namuka.
Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ore anaa enashomo osinka lai Isaya meishopo nemeeta namuka too larin okuni anaa olmonekie le ngolon ogilunore Misiri o Etiopia,

neijia naa elo atiu olaiguanani le Asiria erikoo lelo le Misiri ootarayioki o le Etiopia epuo eyararoto. Ore ndung'ot pokira, ilooti o lkituaak nepuo meishopo nemeeta namuka. Nemeeta toki too ltuli neaku enkurruna e Misiri.
Naa keitukurruni ninche te nkaraki Etiopia naisiligie osiligi lenye Misiri natawuasare.

Ore lelo oomanya olomanaa le naiposha nepuo kenya aajo teina olong, ‘Ng'ura, ena nataase te kuldo laa ninche apa kisiliga, naa ninche kisikakita aaing'orunyie eretoto pee ekordu iyiook aitung'uaa ilo aiguanani le Asiria! Kaji naa kinko iyiook pee kiimisho?’ ”
Olkilikuai oipirta Babilon. Ore anaa enadumunye olkutati te Negeb neor enkop, eing'uaa olpurkel, ina kop torrono oleng.
Aatolikioki nanu te nduaata entoki torrono; keisimisho olaisimani, neinyalisho olainyalani. Ilepa shomo iyie Elam, irraga kitang'aduaki, iyie Media; ore lelo sinaitin pooki ooyaua ninye kaishie nanu.
Ore te nkaraki ina aaiputa nanu olkirutoto; aaibung'a nanu emion naikununo anaa ene nkitok nasaisai; atashala nanu o metaa meekure aning'isho, airuto nanu o metaa meekure adolisho.
Aaisurito endukuya, aaiputa nanu olkirutoto, ore enteipa duoo naanyita neibelekenye aaku enkiputukuny.
Eitobira ninche emisa, eisalaasha ninche ilkarash oopiki oltiren, nedaa ninche neokisho. Entudumunye intae, lo kituaak, eelie long'oi eilata!
Amu nji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani: “Shomo ngero olarriponi, nchoo ninye elimu aibalunye ina nadol.
Te nedol ninye ilakedok, lelo akedok loo mbartan epuo maare o lakedok loo sirkon o lakedok loo ntamesin, nchoo ninye einining'isho asipu, nchoo esipu oleng.”
Ore ilo otoduaa neyietu ajo: “Te nchumata oltalet orripishoreki nanu aitashe, anaake te ndama iyie o Laitoriani. Ore te siaai ai natii nanu nkewarietin pooki.
Ore kiti kata nadol epuonu ilakedok, nadol ilakedok loo mbartan epuonu maare!” Newal ninye ajo, “Etabatate, etabatate Babilon, ore nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin, netarrarrakinote enkop.”
Lo tung'ana laainei, kulo ooidong'oki neipiripiri, ore ina natoning'o nanu to Laitoriani loo lororani, ina Ai e Israel, atolikio nanu intae.
Olkilikuai ele oipirta Edom. Etii obo oipotisho te Seir, nejo, “Lo arriponi, kejaa enkewarie? Lo arriponi, kejaa enkewarie?”
Nejo ilo arriponi: “Kelotu enkakenya nelotu sii enkewarie. Tenaa ilo aikilikuanisho, nkilikuanisho; nyaaki torrinyunye.”
Olkilikuai oipirta Arabia. Too sanagi le Arabia intae ipuopuo aairrag, na tamesin oo le Dedan.
Eyaki enkare ilo oata enkure, entanang'are lelo aisikak endaa, intae kulo oomanya enkop e Tema.
Amu eisika ninche aaing'uaa ilalema, aailany ina shutati o lalem, neilany ina awuo nakurruno, neilany ilo arrabal otirrisha.
Amu inji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani, “Ore te rishata o lari obo, te risioroto oo larin le nkigeroto, ore ina kitoo pooki e Kedar naa keiting;
ore lelo ooleku, le lelo tung'ana magil oong'oroo mbaa Kedar naa keaku kuti; amu Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, nairoro.”
Olkilikuai oipirta oerata le nduaata. Kainyoo ena? Eji ishomo intae shumata, ishomo pooki nchumat oo nkajijik,
iyie enabore enkilepilep, na anasa ena nailugo, na ang ena nabore eng'ida? Ore lelo tung'ana linono ootaraki neme to lalem, neme to larrabal etuata.
Eisika ilaitoriak linono pooki te nebo, eibung'aki eitu ninye eng'oroo embae. Ore intae pooki ooinepuaki neibung'aki, hoo neisika ninche aapuo enelakua.
Ore te nkaraki ina atejo nanu: “Mbelekenyayu miking'or nanu, nchooki nanu maishira olkiyioi le mion; mintanaur kewan kintigir nanu, te nkaraki enkidaata o lorere lang.”
Amu Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani neeta enkata e nkiputukuny o enkitunyoto o enkinyalata tiatua ilo erata le nduaata, nena naauroo isunta e nkanasa, nebaiki embuaakinoto ildoinyo.
Ore Elam nenap imootiani ekedito ngarrin oo mbartan, ore Kir nebolu ilong'oi.
Ore lelo erat linono sidain neiput ngarrin oo mbartan, ore ilakedok loo mbartan netumoki nkitashot too nchomito.
Eiwuang'ie ninye elong'o e Yuda. Ore apa teina olong ning'oru iyie iruparen te nkaji e ntim.
Nidol ajo eikumok ilusien e nkanasa e Daudi, nioku enkare too lchorroi li abori,
ninken inkajijik e Yerusalem, nigil inkajijik pee ishet esuntai aitagol.
Nintobir olchumati le nkare te rishata e nena sunta pokira are. Kake eitu ing'or ilo apa oitobira ilo shorro, neitu ishilaa ilo oipirua kuna pooki apa moitie, laa ninye oishoo metaa.
Ore apa teina olong neipotu Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani olkiyioi o enkishirata, nebarni iltung'ana te nkaraki osina neishop ilkuniyiani;
naa ng'ura, eng'ida o enchipai o eyieng'ata oo lmong'i o lkerra, enkinosata oo nkiri o eokoto e naisho oo sabibu. Ijojo: “Matadaata iyiook nikiokisho, amu ore taaisere nikiye.”
Eibalunye Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani kewan too nkiyiaa aainei: “Kesipa ore ena kitarruorroto mikipalakini iyie o metaba anaa niye.” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.
Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, “Wou, shomo enetii ele aitasheikinoni, shomo enetii Shebna laa ninye oitasheiki enkaji, nijoki ninye:
Kainyoo iasita tene? Naa kaing'ae iata iyie tene, kaing'ae nikitonyorrikia taguetaki kewan enkurare. Ee, iyie, ilo oturu enkurare te wueji e Shumata, niguetu enimany te ndapidapoi?
Tayiolo ajo eikinang'aa iyie Olaitoriani aiturraa, lo tung'ani ele ogol. Ekimbung ninye akurraki,
nikiyuk ninye aitamanaa anaa empira anang'aki enelakua; nilo aye teine. Naa ine epuo aatii nena garrin inono oo mbartan, iyie ilo ora enkurruna e nkaji o lkitok lino.
Kaanang'aa nanu iyie teine niaasishore, nikintadouni te ilo orika le shumata.
“Ore kenya teina olong naa kaipotu nanu osinka lai Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia,
naishopoki nanu ninye olkila lino, narreten nanu ninye te nkimeita ino, ore enkitoria ino naitarasaki nanu ninye. Naa keaku ninye papa te lelo oomanya Yerusalem o te nkaji e Yuda.
Naiteleiki nanu oloililai lenye olbolet le nkaji e Daudi; ore enebol ninye nemeetae oloiken, ore eneeiken nemeetae olobol.
Naa kaitasheyie nanu ninye netiu anaa encheitoi nauno oleng, neaku ninye olorika le nkitoo te nkaji e papaai lenye.
Neitanapi ninye olola le nkaji e papaai lenye pooki, eishoi pooki o nkera, ebaiki nkikompeni o metabaiki nkukurto e nkare.
Ore kenya teina olong, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, ore ina sheitoi apa natuunoki oleng nelolong'u, nedotunye asulunye; ore ilo ola apa oikare nesulunye adou, amu Olaitoriani oiroro.”
Olkilikuai ele oipirta Tiro. Enteyietu enchira na melin e Tarshishi, amu eitomijoonoki Tiro neaku metii enkaji aashu ewueji neitasheyieki! Ore ebaiki enkop e Kupro eibalakinyeki ninche.
Entirring'ata intae kulo oomanya olomanaa le naiposha, lo ainyiang'ak le Sidon, etalang'a apa lelo lirriwaitie intae enkare nepuo ninche aaim inkariak kumok;
ore ropiyiani inyi naa ina tapa e Shihor, ina kesare o lkeju le Nail; iyie apa olbiasharai loo loreren.
Tukurru iyie Sidon, amu eiroro enaiposha, ine nerripieki enaiposha ejo, “Eitu nanu atum emion e saisai neitu aisho, neitu nanu aitubulu ilayiok aashu intoyie.”
Te nelotu ilo omoni Misiri, nejing ninche osina te nkaraki ilo omoni oipirta Tiro.
Entulusoi enchom Tarshishi, enteyietu enchira, intae lelo oomanya olomanaa le naiposha.
Kena ninye enkanasa ino e ng'ida, naa ore enkiterunoto enye naa apa moitie, ore nkejek enyena netanapa ninye meshomo amanyisho te nkop nalakua?
Kaing'ae oipirua ena, agilunore Tiro, naa ninye naishooyo maupen e nkitoo. Ore apa lelo ainyiang'ak lenyena naa eikituaak, ore lelo amirak lenyena naa ilooyanyiti te nkop?
Eipirua Olaitoriani loo Lororani ina pee einyal ilo wuasa ena kitoo pooki, nesul ilo pooki oyanyiti te nkop.
Iremo enkop ino anaa olkeju le Nail, natito e Tarshishi; meekure eetae entoki nikimbooyo.
Eitorioyie ninye enkaina enye aitalang enaiposha, eigirigirie ninye nkitoriat; eishorua Olaitoriani enkitanapata naipirta Kanaan, pee eidaikie lelo sempewueti lenyena.
Nejo ninye: “Mingil aekata iyie ang'ida natito ena natusulaki e Sidon; tudumunye shomo Kupro, ore ake sii teine milo atum enkiyeng'iyeng.”

Ng'ura ina kop oo Lkaldayo! Ilo orere apa, mme ile Asiria, oopuo aaishooyo Tiro metaa enoo lowuarak le ntim. Neirrag ninche aang'adu ninye, nerasaki nena ajijik enyena e nkitoo, neing'uaa ina anasa etaa enkidaata.
Teyietu nchira iyie Tarshishi, amu ore osempewuet lino neitomijoonoki.

Ore kenya teina olong, nemeitokini aadamu Tiro too larin ntomoni naapishana, naaba anaa nkolong'i o laiguanani obo. Ore te siadi lelo arin ntomoni naapishana netiu te Tiro anaa enatiu te ilo sinkolio le mulayoi:
“Tudumu enkawuo oo sinkoliotin, tamanimanai te nkanasa, na mulayoi ena nemedamuni! Taranyisho to ltoilo sidai, taranya isinkolioitin kumok, pee kitumi aatadamu.”
Ore te siadi ilarin ntomoni naapishana naa kelotu Olaitoriani abaiki Tiro. Naa kerrinyokino ninye olekoisiaayio lenye, nelo aiborrie onyek te nena kitoriat e nkop naatii oriong e nkop.

Ore ina biashara enye o lekoisiaayio lenye neiteng'elakini Olaitoriani; meshumi ninye nemeirragieki aaisudoo, kake ore ina biashara enye kelo ainyiang'u endaa sapuk o nkilani sidain ainyang'aki lelo ootoni te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Ng'ura ajo kelo Olaitoriani ainyal enkop neitaa mijooni, naa kelo aibelekeny neidapash lelo oomanya.

Naa ore ina nalo atiu too ltung'ana, naa neijia etiu to lapolosani; ore enatiu to rrindik, neijia etiu to lkitok lenye, ore enatiu te nkaisiaayiani, neijia etiu teina naigero ninye, ore enatiu te ilo oinyang'isho, neijia etiu te ilo omirisho, ore enatiu te ilo oisilenisho neijia etiu te ilo oisilenokini, ore enatiu te ilo oishooyo esile, neijia etiu te ilo oisilenokini.
Keitomijooni enkop katukul neitarruorri oleng; amu eiroro Olaitoriani ele ororei.
Eishirita enkop neisha, etemene enkop nalulung'a neisha, etemene shumata amitari te nebo o enkop.
Etaa enkop olminong, ti abori lelo oomanya; amu etigila ninche nkitanapat, negolong'aki nena kikoot, negil ilo ning'o loo ntarasi.
Ore te nkaraki ina keibung oldeket enkop, ore lelo oomanya kemeyu te nkaraki enkitarruorroto enye; ore naa kepejori lelo oomanya enkop, naa ilkuti ake elekuni.
Eishirita enaisho oo sabibu, ore olchani loo sabibu netasara, ore lelo apa oong'ida nejing osina.
Ore oltoilo le nkinanta netigire, ore ilo toilo le nchipai netigire, ore oltoilo lo lwulul loo usin neitigiraki.
Meigil aekata aaok enaisho oo sabibu eranyisho; keduaru ina aisho napi te lelo ook.
Ore ina anasa naing'oling'ole neturori ninye, eikenoki pooki aji metaa meetae olojing.
Etasapuka olkiyioi too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa, eiting'o enaisho oo sabibu; neishieki eng'ida pooki; neishieki enchipai pooki e nkop.
Eitomijoonoki enkanasa, etigilaki nchomito aainyal.
Amu ena nalo aaku te mpolos e nkop, tiatua loshon, ore anaa enaigusugusieki oloirien, o anaa enasotuni ilng'anayio to sabibu.
Neilepie ninche iltoiloishi lenye, neranyisho te ng'ida; ore te nkitoo o Laitoriani kebuaku ninche te nkalo o loo ntoluo.
Ore naa te nkalo o loo saen nchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo; ore to lomanaa le naiposha nchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo, Enkai e Israel.

Ore too neeiting'ie enkop nikining'oo isinkolioitin le nkisisa, le nkitoo te ilo Obo Osipa. Kake atejo nanu, “Aibiitiari nanu, aibiitiari nanu. Woi kewan ai! Amu ore lelo aitang'orok netarasutua, etarasutua ilaitang'orok oleng.”
Olkirutoto o engumoto o rreshet shumata iyie, shumata iyie ilo omanya enkop!
Ore ilo oilanyisho to ltoilo lo lkirutoto, naa kelo adoiki engumoto; naa ore ilo oilepu te ngumoto neibung orreshet. Amu etaboloki ilusien e shumata, ore olkitamanyunot le nkop neikirikira.
Etigiligilaki enkop tukul, etabee neaku mbelibelat, eikirikirieki enkop oleng.
Eyukuyukori enkop anaa olamerani, etotiwuo anaa enkaji nakutita osiwuo; etii nkitarruorot enyena shumata ninye, naa kenang'aa ninye nemeigil adumunye.
Ore kenya teina olong naa kelo Olaitoriani aitame olorora le shumata te keper, nelo aitame ilaiguanak le nkop teinakop.
Neiturrurri ninche te nebo anaa ilooena te ngumoto; neikenori ninche te jila, ore te siadi nkolong'i kumok neitamei ninche.
Neitomisimisi olapa nemeitoki enkolong awang'u; amu Olaitoriani loo lororani olo aitoreisho to ldoinyo le Sion o te Yerusalem, naa ore te dukuya ilpayiani lenyena nelo ninye aibalunye enkitoo enye.
Iyie Olaitoriani, ira iyie Enkai ai; kaarrep nanu iyie, kaisis nanu enkarna ino; amu itaasa iyie mbaa e nking'asia, intabayie te sipata nena kitobirat inono e apa moitie.
Amu intaa iyie ina anasa osototi le nkidaata ore ina anasa nagol nintaa olmuaate; ore apa ina aji e nkitoo oo ltung'ana leeiking'a meigili ae kata aashet.
Ore te nkaraki ina eikisis iyie iloreren oogol; ore nkanas e lelo oshon lemeeta olng'ur naa eikiureyu iyie.

Amu itaa iyie osempewuet le ilo aisinani, itaa osempewuet le ilo onyamal te nyamali enye; olchurie to lkutati naa oloip te nkirowuaj, amu ore eoshoto e ilo lemeeta olng'ur neikununo anaa olkutati oipony esuntai
eikununo anaa enkirowuaj te wueji netoyio Intigira iyie oltoilo loo lmang'ati lang; anaa enkirouaj ti abori oloip le nkatampoi, neaku eishieki osinkolio le ilo lemeeta olng'ur.

Ore tele doinyo, kelo Olaitoriani loo lororani aitobiraki olorere pooki osirua loo ntokitin naapir, osirua le naisho oo sabibu, osirua loo ntokitin naabore eilata o enaisho oo sabibu, osirua loo ntokitin naabore eilata o enaisho oo sabibu nasila oleng.
Naa kelo ninye aidaikie tele doinyo ina kimulumulet apa natanang'akaki shumata iloreren pooki, ilo karasha apa oidapashakaki shumata iloshon pooki.
Keinyal Olaitoriani keeya ntarasi, nejutoo Olaitoriani Enkai ilkiyio too nkomomi pooki, ore ina sulare oo ltung'ana lenyena neiwuang'ie ninye te nkop pooki; amu Olaitoriani oiroro.
Kepuoi kenya aajo teina olong, “Enkai ang ena; kitaanyutua apa iyiook ninye, pee elotu aitajeu iyiook. Olaitoriani ele, kitaanyutua iyiook ninye, mating'idata iyiook nikishipakino enjeunoto enye.”
Kemitu enkaina o Laitoriani oldoinyo le Sion, naa kepuoi aaitunyoki Moab enkop te wueji enye anaa enaitunyi olkujita te wueji olokidong'oi.
Naa kelo ninye aitorioo inkaik enyena te neitorit ninye, anaa enaitorioo inkaik oltung'ani oisompira te nkare, kake kelo Olaitoriani airragie ilo wuasa lenye te nebo ina arriyiano oo nkaik enyena.
Ore nena sunta adoru e nkang enye nesulu ninye, neitadou, nenang'aki enkop, neitabaiki enterit.
Ore kenya teina olong nepuoi aarany ele sinkolio te nkop e Yuda: “Kiata iyiook enkanasa nagol; eishoo ninye iyiook enjeunoto naikununo anaa sunta enkang nagol
Entabol nchomito, pee etum ilo osho loo sipat oibung enkirukoto aimu.
Nchoo iyie meitiring'ayu te seriani, ilo laa iyie edamu te nkaraki nikisiliga ninye iyie.
Isiliga Olaitoriani ntarasi, amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai, naa endapidapoi oo ntarasi.
Amu eitadowuo ninye lelo ooilepie ate ina anasa naitokoos. Eitadowuo ninye, etanang'aka ninye enkop, nenang'aki enterit.
Eitunyito nkejek ninye, nkejek e lelo aisinak, iroruat e lelo oomena.”
Keitoriori enkoitoi e ilo asipani; itooro iyie enkoitoi e ilo asipani.
Ina oitoi oo nkiguanat inono kiaanyunyie iyiook, iyie Olaitoriani; ina arna nikidamunye iyie, ninye eyieunoto oo ltauja lang.
Iyie eng'uar oltau lai kewarie, ore enkishui ai tiatua nanu naa iyie eing'oru. Ore enkata natii nkiguanat inono enkop, neiteng'enuo lelo oomanya enkop te sipata.
Tenaa keitoduaaki ilo torrono olng'ur, meyiolou aekata ninye esipata; ore tiatua enkop oo sipat, neas ake ntorrok, nemedol enkitoo o Laitoriani.
Yie Olaitoriani, eilepieki enkaina ino, kake medol ninche. Nchoo ninche metoduaa olom too ltung'ana linono, nekurru ninche. Nchoo ina kima te nkaraki ilmang'ati linono enya ninche.
Iyie Olaitoriani, intobiraki iyie iyiook eseriani, iyie oishoo iyiook nena siaaitin ang pooki.
Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ang, eitoria apa iyiook kulikae aitoriak leme iyie, kake enkarna ino ake kewan kiyiolo iyiook.
Etuata ninche, nemeitoki aapiu, etaa ninche iloipi, nemeigil ninche aaitashe; ore teina, itaara iyie ninche aishie, niwuang'ie ninche pee meigili ai kata aadamu.
Kake itoponayie iyie ilo orere, Olaitoriani, itoponayie iyie ele orere; kintaaki iyie kitok; intalala iyie ilpolosien lena kop.
Iyie Olaitoriani, ore to sina niking'oru ninche iyie, nebuku ninche enkomono, ina kata etii enkitamioto shumata ninche.
Ore anaa entuaa natashala, neyietu aishir te mion e saisai, neijia iyiook kitiu te nkaraki iyie, Olaitoriani;
kitunutate apa iyiook, kitasaisayia, kitotiutuo anaa eikitoiutuo enkijape. Mikiaata enkordunoto nikiyautua enkop, ore lelo oomanya enkop neitu ebatata.

Ore lelo linono ootuata naa kepiu kedumunye aaitashe iseseni lenye. Lo tung'ana kulo oomanya atua enterit, enyoito entaranyisho te ng'ida! Amu ore ina oileelio ino naa enkoileelio e wang'an, ore teina kop e nemeneng'a naa ilo iyie aitopiu ninche.
Wootu lo tung'ana laainei, entijing ilgilat linyi, ninkenikene nkutukie oo nkajijik, esudori intae maate te nkiti rishata o metaba anaa nelusoo ina goro.

Kelotu Olaitoriani aipang'u te wueji enye pee elotu aitame lelo oomanya enkop te nkaraki enkarruoisho enye. Ore enkop nelo aibalunye ilo sarge apa oibukoyioki ti oriong ninye, nemeigil ae kata aitemoo lelo apa ootaraki metuata.

Ore kenya teina olong eibung'ita Olaitoriani ilo alem lenye kitok ogol, nelo ninye aitame Lefiatan, ilo asurai oisikita, ilo asurai oji lefiatan omerregela, near ninye metua ina tiamasi natii atua enaiposha.
Ore teina olong: “Neranyaki enkurma sidai oo sabibu ninye!
Nanu Olaitoriani olaing'urani lenye; kabukoki nanu enkare pooki kata. Melotu ake likae tung'ani ainyal, karrip nanu kewarie o dama.
Maata nanu engoro. Tenaa naaji kaata nanu ilkiku o endiati pee airragakinye ninche, anaata apejoo ninche pooki.
Anaa nchoo ninche eibung esarunoto ai, nchoo ninche eitobir osotua o nanu, nchoo ninche eitobir osotua o nanu.”
Ore too nkolong'i naapuonu neibung eishoi e Yakobo ntona, neitapuku neiu intilitan neiput enkop pooki ilng'anayio lenyena.
Ketoosho Olaitoriani ninche anaa apa enatoosho lelo mang'ati lenye? Anaa ketasesekuana ninye ninche anaa apa enatasesekuanaki lelo asesesekuanak?
Te nkiririkinoto iyie intamio ninche, areu ninche meshomo eyararoto; iwuang'ie ninche te ngoro ino napi, teina olong o lkutati lo loosaen.

Ore te nkaraki ina naa kepalakini enkitarruorroto e Yakobo naa kelo ena aaku olng'anayioi olulung'a le nkitayunoto e ng'oki enye: te nelo ninye aitobir isoito pooki loo lperereni loo lasarri, nerrorro anaa ilboro le nturoto, meitoki atii Asherim anaa ilasarri le nkorropil ooitoki aaitashe.
Amu ore ina anasa nasheta netomijoono, emanyisho apa naidurrieki nepuoi aaing'uaa, etotiwuo anaa ong'ata, teine edaa lasho, neirrag teine negil ilng'osil lenyena.

Ore kenya te netoyu lelo ng'osil lenyena, negili; nepuonu nkituaak aaitayunye enkima. Amu olorere ele lememuso; ore te nkaraki ina, ore ilo oitobira ninche meduaaki ninche olng'ur, ore ilo oitobirua ninche meisho ninche omom.
Ore kenya teina olong, ebaiki olkeju le Frati o metabaiki oerata le Misiri, naa keiturrur Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena moobo, anaa oltung'ani oitayu isuut te nkano.
Naa ore kenya teina olong kepuoi aaosh esekekua kitok, ore lelo apa ooimina te nkop e Asiria o lelo oopuonu ootarayioki Misiri nepuonu aaserem Olaitoriani te nchumata ele doinyo sinyati te Yerusalem.
Woi ninye ilo owuasa oata enkopiyia e nkitoo oo lamerak le Efraim, o ina tapukai natoyio oshi nara enkishiaa enye; naa ninye natii endukuya e ilo erata oleng le lelo ooidimua enaisho!
Ng'ura ajo keeta Olaitoriani ilo obo magilani negol; ore anaa olkutati le nchan oo soito otiu anaa olkutati le nkidaata netiu anaa enkare nagol nadooyo, kelo ninye anang'aki enkop te ngoro.
Ore ilo oata enkopiyia e nkitoo loo lamerak le Efraim, naa kepuoi aaitunyoki enkop too nkejek.

Ore ina tapukai natoyio enkishiaa enye, natii endukuya e ilo erata oleng, naa ketiu anaa ilng'abolo le dukuya ooton eng'or te nkata e nkirowuaj: te nedol oltung'ani ilo ng'anayioi nenya nabo kata anaa ake pee eibung te nkaina.
Ore kenya teina olong naa Olaitoriani loo lororani olo aaku enkopiyia e nkitoo, neaku enkishili e nkishiaa te ilo pisiai loo ltung'ana lenyena;
o ltau le sipata te ilo oton te nkiguana o engolon te ilo oibelekeny olarrabal te kishomi.

Etarruoitie sii iloibonok o lapolosak te naisho, neyukuyukori te merai e naisho napi, ore olapolosani o loiboninetarruoitie te naisho; etomilote ninche te naisho neyukuyukori ninche te merai e naisho napi, etapaashari ninche te nduaata, nerrorro ninche edung enkiguana.
Neiputa imisai pooki ilopat, meetae ewueji nemetii olduruk.
“Kaing'ae ninye elo aiteng'en aitaarriyian, naa kaing'ae elo ninye ainosaki ilo kilikuai? Lelo ooereki, lelo lemeekure enakita?
Amu enkiteng'enata te shumata nkiteng'enat, enkitanapata te shumata enkitanapata, olkereri te shumata olkereri, etii enkiti ene netii enkiti idie.”
A'a, kake too ltung'ana ooiro nkutukie nemeyioloi, neiro too lng'ejepa loo loreren, kelo Olaitoriani airorie iltung'ana lenyena,
laa ninche apa etiaaka, “Ena enkiyeng'iyeng inyi, enchoo eyeng'iyeng'a ilo onaure, naa ena enkiyagata inyi”; kake ore eyia mening'isho ninche.

Ore te nkaraki ina kelo ororei lo Laitoriani aaku te ninche, enkiteng'enata te shumata nkiteng'enat, enkiteng'enata te shumata enkiteng'enata, olkereri te shumata olkereri, olkereri te shumata olkereri, enkiti tene o enkiti te idie; pee etum ninche aashom, nebatatakino siadi, negila, nerreshi, neibung'i aaya.
Ore te nkaraki ina, entoning naa ororei lo Laitoriani intae iloomenisho, intae lelo ooitore kulo tung'ana le Yerusalem!

Amu itejo apa intae, “Kintobira iyiook olning'o o keeya, ore enemeneng'a nikitoning'ote; te nelotu enkidaata nemeeta eneiko iyiook; amu kintaa iyiook elejare esarunoto ang, naa lomon lemesipa kilutoo iyiook”.
Ore naa, nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Kairragie nanu te Sion osoit oaku olkitamanyunoto, osoit otujurruoki aatem, osoit ogol enkinyiang'a lo lmairroto: ‘Ore ilo oiruk ninye nemeigusugusieki.’
Naa kaitaa nanu esipata olgiita naitaa esupatisho ina temet e nkitorioroto; naa keoroo enchan oo soito ina lejare o mbaa nemesipa, neya enkare ilo ng'obor olutori.”
Ore ilo ning'o linyi o keeya neaku parmetii, ore ina nitoning'okinote o enemeneng'a nemeitoki auno; te nelotu enkidaata, naa eikiosh iyie.
Naa ore ake enkata naba anaa enalotu nikiya iyie, amu kelotu ninye anaake tadekenya o endama o enkewarie; ore eyiolounoto e ilo kilikuai naa olkirutoto ake.
Amu kedorropu endapash te neitorioo oltung'ani nkejek, naa ronkai olkarasha te nejo oltung'ani aitoipore.
Kedumunye Olaitoriani anaa apa to ldoinyio le Perasim, naa kegoro ninye anaa apa to erata le Gibeon; pee atum ataasa enkiaas enye, napaashaa, neas esiaai enye, ina siaai enye nemeyioloi!
Ore naa taata entapal olmena pee meitirrishi ake ienat inyi, amu atoning'oyie nanu endung'okinoto e nkiguana e mutai, eing'uaa Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, eipirta enkop pooki.
Nchoru enkiok, toning'o oltoilo lai; toning'isho, naa toning'o enajo.
Amaa ilo oturisho pee eunisho keturisho anaake? Ketur ninye enkop enye neitupuyiapui enterit anaake?
Amaa te neidip ninye aitobira enterit, emeisuaaki ninye enkop ilanterera lenyena loo mpukunot pooki, neun enkano too lkererin nepik shairi ewueji enye, neitobiraki enerishare?
Amu eiteng'enaki ninye aaitobiraki; Enkai enye naiteng'en ninye.
Meidong'i ilmomo to soit oituutishoreki, nemeimieki ilanterera laaijo lelo enkeju e ngarri; amu ore ilmomo o lanterera laaijo lelo naa te ng'udi eidong'i.
Keidong'i enkano aitaa entapa oo mukateni, kake meidong'i o kenya; te nereu oltung'ani enkeju e ngarri enye te shumata e nkano eyiataa embarta, nemeidong ninye ainyal.
Olaitoriani loo Lororani sii eing'uaa ena; ole nking'asia ninye too nkikoot, naa arriyia aisul te ng'eno.
Woi ninye Ariel, Ariel, ina anasa apa natamanya Daudi, Toponai ake to lari o to lari; nchoo siruai emanikino.
Kapik nanu Ariel osina, nelo aaku olkiyioi o enkishirata, nelo ninye atiu te nanu anaa Ariel.
Naa kaalo nanu aman ang'adu too nkaloli pooki, naang'adu nanu too ltaleta naaitaman nanu iyie enkang.
Neaku te negut te nkop ilo iyie airo, abori enterit eimu irorei linono; enkop eimu oltoilo lino anaa oltoilo, neing'oming'om oltoilo lino eimu enterit.
Nebayu ilmang'ati linono anaa enterit napuyiapui, ore olorora loo larruok nebayu anaa suut. Naa keluamisho ninche too nkaitin,
ekibaiki iyie Olaitoriani loo lororani te ndarata o te nkikirikirata e nkop o to ltoilo kitok o to siwuo o to lkutati o te nkima nanyaisho.
Ore ilo orora loo loshon pooki, oitayunye Ariel olarrabal, lelo pooki oarare ninye o wuejitin enyena neesheta, nepik ninye osina, nepuo aatiu anaa enkidetidet, enduaata e kewarie.

Ore anaa te neidetidetu oltung'ani oata esumash einosita endaa, neinyototo te sumash enye eitu eraposho, aashu anaa te neidetidetu oltung'ani oata enkure eokito enkare neinyototo ninye te nkure enye eitu eok enkare, neaku neijia epuo aatiu ilororani loo loshon, lelo oarare oldoinyo le Sion.
Entaa ate ilmoda, ninyanya kutukie, entaa ate ilemedolisho nimodokuku! Entaa lamerak, neme te naisho; eyukuyukori neme enaisho napi itooko!
Amu etubukoko intae Olaitoriani oltau loo njio naairoishi, neikeno ninye nkonyek inyi intae iloibonok, neikeno lukuny inyi lelo aduaak.

Ore enduaata ena pooki netotiwuo te iyie anaa irorei le mbuku natimishiraki aaiken neishooyo oltung'ani meisuma ilo oyiolo aisuma, ejo, “Isuma ena,” nejo ninye, “Maidim nanu, amu etimishiraki aaiken.”
Naa te neisho ninche embuku oltung'ani lemeyiolo aisuma nejo, “Isuma ena,” nejo ninye, “Mayiolo aisumayu.”

Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Ore te nkaraki naanyikaki naanyor nanu kulo tung'ana too nkutukie naayanyit ninche nanu too nkutukie, kaalamita iltauja lenye, ore euriata enye te nanu naa enkitanapata oo ltung'ana nayiolo ake too lukuny;
Ore te nkaraki ina, kaigil nanu aitaas mbaa e nking'asia kulo tung'ana, mbaa e nking'asia sapuki; ore ina ng'eno oo lang'eni lenye neish, ore ina musunoto e lelo amusumusok lenye neishieki.”
Woi ninche lelo ooturoki enkop aaisudoriyie Olaitoriani mbaa enye, lelo ootii mbaa enye enaimin, lelo oojo, “Kaing'ae nadol iyiook? Kaing'ae nayiolo iyiook?”

Imbelekenyenye intae mbaa e atua aayau oriong! Amaa olaitobirani loo motioo oo nkulupuok, keitanyaanyukieki nkulupuok; eji metaa kejoki entoki naitayioki ilo oitayio, “Eitu ninye kintayu nanu,” aashu ejoki entoki naitobiraki ilo oitobira, “Meeta iyie entoki niyiolo”?
Aime enkiti rishata nang'or pee eitaa Lebanon enkurma naleng, ore ina kurma naleng neibelekenyi aaitaa entim?
Ore kenya teina olong naa kelo ilo ming'ani aning irorei le mbuku, ore te misimisi o enaimin nedolishoyu nkonyek e ilo modooni.
Ore ilo obor neng'amu ninye eng'ida ng'ejuk naing'uaa Olaitoriani, ore olaisinani aisul iltung'ana nelo ashipakino Ilo Sinyati le Israel.
Ore ilo lemeeta olng'ur naa keishieki neiting'ieki ilo oitokoos, ore lelo pooki ooing'or pee eas entorroni nedung'ori aaiwuang'ie,
lelo ooitapong'oo iltung'ana too rorei aaitasur, nepikaki orreshet ilo oisikong'isho te kishomi, ore to sayia le pesho neibelekeny arriny ilo asipani.
Ore naa, nji ejo Olaitoriani laa ninye apa otokordua Abraham tialo enkaji e Yakobo: “Meigil aekata Yakobo adol enkurruna, nemeigil aekata enkomom enye aipusu.
Amu te neing'or ninye inkera enyena, ina siaai oo nkaik aainei tiatua ninye, neitisiny ninche enkarna ai; neitisiny ninche ilo Osinya le Israel.
Ore lelo oopong'ori too ltauja nepuonu aayiolou, ore lelo ooing'unyung'uny neng'amaa nkitanapat.”
“Woi ninche nena kera naagolong'u,” Olaitoriani ojo, “Lelo ooitobir enkitobirata neme enaai; lelo ooitayu mbaa enye nemetii oltau lai, pee etum ninche aatoponai eng'oki te shumata eng'oki;
lelo oonapa pee edoyio aapuo Misiri nemaaikilikuanishore ninche, pee epuo aasaru emitunoto e Farao, nepuo aaing'oru eneigara to loip le Misiri!
Ore te nkaraki ina, keibelekenya ina mitunoto e Farao aaku enkurruna, ore ine ningarara to loip le Misiri, neibelekenya aaku osina linyi.
Amu ore hoo netii ilkituaak lenyena Soan nepuo ilbalusuni lenyena aabaiki Hanes,
kepuonu ake aakurru pooki tialo ilo orere lemeidim aataret ninche, nemeyau eretoto aashu dupoto, kake enkurruna ake o esulare.”

Ele olkilikuai oipirta ing'uesi naatii Negeb: ina kop pooki natii enyamali o sina, ine nepukunye elipong o lng'atuny o lng'atuny, entara o enturbubua, nenap ninche karsisisho enye too nkoriong'i nenap ilchumat lenye too ntamesin aayaki ilo orere lemeret ninche.
Ore eretoto e Misiri naa pesho, ina pee atejo nanu ninye, “Rahab ina naton aitirring'a.”
Ore naa taata, shomo ngero ina te dukuya ninche too soito dapashi oogueta nintoki asiraki ninye embuku, pee etum ataa te nkata nalotu shakenisho ntarasi.
Amu olorere kiseruti ninche, inkera naalejisho, inkera nemening ninche enkiteng'enare o Laitoriani;
lelo oojoki iladuaak, “Emidolisho” nejoki iloibonok, “Emimbonoki iyiook esipata; entoliki iyiook mbaa nemeitureisho, embonu mbaa o lng'am,
tung'uai enkoitoi, mbelekenyayu tapaasha orrekie. Mincho kintoki iyiook aaning mbaa e Ilo Osinya le Israel.”
Ore naa, nji ejo Ilo Osinya le Israel, “Ore te nkaraki nitemenaitie intae ele rorei, nisiligigi olwuasa o enkiseroto, ningarakino ninche,
ore te nkaraki ina, kelo ena ng'oki atiu te ntae anaa olbaata le suntai naado netaa kejo pee eurori, naa ore euroroto enye naa nabo kata;
ore embelata nalo abela netiu anaa emoti oo nkulupuok naitiaaki aaotiki ore mbelat enyena nemeitoki asotunoyu, meitokini ninye aatum embelati nayayieki enkima aashu naokunyeki enkare to lchorro.”
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Ilo Osinya le Israel, “Ti nishukunye ayeng'iyeng'a nikintajeuni; te nkitirring'ata o te nkisiligata elotu engolon ino.” Nimiyieuu intae.
Kake itejo, “A'a! Eikiikuet iyiook too mbartan,” ore te nkaraki ina, ikuetikuete aapuo, “Ore iyiook nikikuetie mbartan aakuet oleng,” neaku keten oleng lelo oosuj intae.
Keisik aailanyisho ilkulinyi oora enkalifu te nebuak oltung'ani obo, ore te mbuakunoto oo ltung'ana imiet nikuet ailanyisho o mikitung'uari, nitiu anaa enchata naunieki enanka te nchumata oldoinyo.
Ore naa kiaanyita iyie Olaitoriani pee king'urrie; neaku keisisi ninye, pee etum aing'urrie intae. Amu ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai oo sipat. Kemayiana lelo pooki ooanyu ninye.
Lo tung'ana le Sion, kulo oomanya Yerusalem; mingiligili aekata aaishir. Kesipa keing'urrie ninye intae teina kishirakinoto inyi; te nening ninye ilo kiyioi linyi, naa kewaliki intae.
Naa ore hoo neisho intae Olaitoriani endaa e nyamali o enkare o sina, meigil Olaiteng'enani linyi aisudoo kewan, kake kedol inkonyek inyi Olaiteng'enani linyi.
Ore nkiyiaa inyi te siadi intae, nening oltoilo ojo, “Nena enkoitoi, eima intae ine,” ti nimbelekenyanya intae aapuo enkalo e tatene aashu enkalo e kedianye.
Nipikipiki intae olduruk nena kitanyaanyukot naapising'a te nkosholai o nena naasholuno e saabu. Nindapashaa intae ninche anaa ntokitin nemesinya; nijokiki intae ninche, “Enchom nimiitutu!”
Naa keirriwaki intae Olaitoriani enchan te nkaraki lelo anterera lituuno o ina kurma nabulu te nkop, nalo aisho te nkumoi. Ore kenya teina olong naa kepuo nchoo inyi aadaa too ndaat naalala.
Ore ilmong'i o sirkon ooturisho nenya olkujita otudung'oki oisukutieki.
Ore te pooki doinyo oado o pooki doinyo naikarere, naa kejing inkonyek oo nkariak ina olong kenya eyiang'are kitok te neurori iltaleta.

Ore ake sii naa kelo ewang'an o lapa atiu anaa ewang'an e nkolong. Ore ewang'an e nkolong neaku katitin naapishana, anaa ewang'an oo nkolong'i naapishana, teina olong kenya nalo Olaitoriani aen olbae too ltung'ana lenyena, neishiunye lelo baa apa le oshoto enye.
Ng'ura ajo kelotu enkarna o Laitoriani eing'uaa enelakua, neyupuyup engoro enye netii empuruo kitok; ore enkutuk enye nebore engoro, ore olng'ejep lenye neikununo anaa enkima nanyaisho.

Ore enkiyang'et enye neikununo anaa enchorro naruko adooyo neilepu enkare o metaa keitabaiki oltung'ani olgos; pee esil ina are lelo oshon te silet e nkidaata entorroni, nepiki nkutukie oo loreren nkeenta naaitapong'orieki.
Ipuopuo intae aatiu anaa ilooata osirua osinya kewarie iranyishosho. Nitumutumu eng'ida o ltau nitiuu anaa te neoshi enkinanta pee epuoi oldoinyo lo Laitoriani, ina dapidapoi e Israel.
Naa keisho Olaitoriani ilo toilo lenye le nkitoo metoning'o pooki ng'ae, ore ina oshoto e nkaina enye nedou metodoli te ngoro napi o te nkima namutisho, te nebo olkutati o enchan oo soito.
Ore lelo le Asiria naa keiput enkiputukuny o lkirutoto te nening ilo toilo lo Laitoriani, ina kata eoshisho ninye te ng'udi enye.
Ore eosh Olaitoriani ninche aigil, netoni iltung'ana lenyena aaranyisho too lwululi o too nkai oo sinkolioitin. Enkai makewan naarare ile Asiria.

Eidipaki apa aaitobira ewueji neyupuyup; ee te nkaraki ilo aiguanani, eitobiraki endapasho o enguton, netii ilkeek kumok o enkima kitok. Naa Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani naikununo anaa enkima nakutu isoito.

Woi ninche lelo oodoyio aapuo Misiri aaing'oru eretoto, neisilig mbartan, lelo oong'idare ngarrin oo mbartan eji amu aikumok, o lelo akedok loo mbartan eji amu kegol ninche oleng, kake meisilig ninche Ilo Sinyati le Israel, aashu eikilikuanishore ninye!
Naa ng'en ake sii ninye neyau enkidaata, merrinyokino ninye irorei lenyena, kake kedumakino ninye ina aji oo larruok, nedumakino lelo aretok le lelo oas entorroni.

Ore lelo le Misiri naa iltung'ana, mme Enkai; ore nena bartan enye naa nkiri, mme nkiyang'eta. Te neitorioo Olaitoriani enkaina enye, neikirikira ilo oretisho, ore ilo oretitoi nebatata, neidaaya pooki te nebo.

Amu nji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani, “Ore anaa enaikurrukur olng'atuny anaa olkuoo lo lng'atuny teina ng'ues natara, naa te neipotuni olturrur loo lairritak meetu aarare ninye, nemeiture ninye nena buakunot enye aashu eirutie enkilepilep enye, neijia eikununye Olaitoriani te nedou alotu aitayu olarrabal te nchumata oldoinyo le Sion, o te shumata endoinyo enye.
Ore anaa enaitoip emotonyi inkera enyena neijia eiko Olaitoriani loo Lororani emitu Yerusalem; kerrip neitajeu ninye, kemitu nekordu ninye.”
Embelekenyakinoto ilo apa litogolong'akita oleng, lo tung'ana loo Siraeli.
Amu ore kenya teina olong, naa kenang'aa pooki ng'ae nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin e nkosholai, o nkitanyaanyukot e saabu, apa naaitobirutua nkaik inyi too ng'ok, te nkaraki intae.
“Naa kebatata ile Asiria to lalem leme ole tung'ani; keidakie ilo alem leme ole tung'ani ninye; naa kelo ninye ailany ilo alem, ore elelero enye nepuoi aapik esinkaisho.

Ore ilo oitaa ninye endapidapoi neisik to lkirutoto, ore lelo kituaak lenyena neilanyisho aaing'uaa inankan enye te nkiputukuny.” Neijia ejo Olaitoriani otii enkima enye Sion netii olkokuet lenye atua Yerusalem.
Kepuku olaiguanani oitoreisho too sipat, nepuo ilkituaak aaitoreisho too nkiguanat naasipa.
Kelo ake atiu te pooki lenye anaa eneigarae te nkaraki olkutati, olchurie te nkaraki olkutati, netiu anaa nchorroi oo nkariak te nkop natoyio, netiu anaa oloip le ndapidapoi kitok te nkop e nauri.
Ore nkonyek e lelo oodol nemeitokini aaiken, ore nkiyiaa e lelo ooning nening.
Ore oltau le ilo opuny netum mbarakinot, ore olng'ejep le ilo oiramiram neiro aitorioki.
Nemeigili aajo oltung'ani omoda kedupa, nemeji lelo aisimak eji keleng.

Amu mbaa e modai eiro olmodai nedamu mbaa e ntorroni to ltau lenye; pee etum ataasa ntorrok, neiro mbaa naapaashaa tialo Olaitoriani, neing'uaa lelo ooisumash meeta toki, nemitiki ilo oata enkure enkare.
Ore enkeleekisho e ilo kiminchali naa entorroni, entorroni eipiru ninye pee einyal ilo omena too rorei le lejare, hoo duoo ninye tenaa kesipa ewalata e ilo omena.
Kake ore ilo supat neiro mbaa e supatisho, ore too mbaa e supatisho neitashe ninye.
Enyoito intae kuna kituaak naaisikarra, entoning oltoilo lai; natoyie kuna nemeshilaa toki, entoning enkiroroto ai.
Ore te nkiti rishata naba anaa olari obo, nipuopuo intae aatum enyamali, intae kuna naaiputakinote amu meitoki aatii ilng'anayio, meitoki atii enkikesare oo lng'anayio.
Enkirikirata intae nakituaak kuna naaisikarra, entayu nkilani metaa minchopopo, nirretenene ilkuniyiani.
Entooshiosh ilgooitie linyi te nkaraki nena kurman sidain, te nkaraki nena kurman oo sabibu naatoishete oleng.
Ore teina kurma oo ltung'ana laainei nebulu ilkiku o endiati ee too nkajijik e nchipai teina anasa e ng'ida.

Amu kepuoi aaing'uaa ina aji e nkitoo, neing'uari ina anasa naning'o; ore endoinyo o ine nerripishoreki nepuo aaku iwuejitin oo ng'uesi ntarasi, ewueji neitigiranie iloitikoishi, neaku ndaat oo nkerrai;
ometaba anaa nebukokini iyiook Enkiyang'et naing'uaa shumata, nesidanu olpurkel aaku enkop naisho oleng, ore nkuapi naadupa neaku ijo ntimi.
Netum taa esupatisho atamanya ina ong'ata, nemany eseriani atua ina kurma naisho.
Ore esupatisho neiu eseriani, ore esupatisho neyau enkitirring'ata o nkirukoto ntarasi.
Kepuo iltung'ana laainei aabik te manyisho e seriani ntarasi, tiatua ewueji e nkirrita oo wuejitin neeitirring'areki aayeng'iyeng'are.
Ore entim neurori katukul, neurori katukul ina anasa.
Imayianana intae lelo oounisho te mbata oo nkariak pooki, lelo ooisho ilmong'i o sirkon eidapashari aapuo.

Woi iyie ora olainyalani neitu kinyali iyie, niaata enkeleekisho, neitu iyie kintaasi embae e nkeleekisho! Ore ake pee indip ainyalisho nikinyali sii ninye iyie; ore pee indip mbaa inono e nkeleekisho nikintaasi iyie ine nkeleekisho.
Olaitoriani ing'urrie iyiook, iyie iyiook kiaanyita. Taa engolon ang anaake tadekenya, niaku enjeunoto ang te nkata e nyamali.
Ore to ltoilo le ndarata neisik iltung'ana, ore ti nidumunye iyie neidapasha loreren.
Naa kearari intokitin inono neishunye anaa enaishu ilmaat enkop; ore anaa enaitiam olmaati te nkop, neitiam iltung'ana te nkop.
Keisisi Olaitoriani, amu etii ninye shumata oleng; keiput ninye Sion esipata o esupatisho.
Naa ninye olo aaku enkitashoto too nkatitin inyi, neaku kitok enjeunoto o eng'eno o eyiolounoto; naa euriata o Laitoriani ninye olchumati lenye.
Ng'ura lelo oing'ok, eishirita ninche ti auluo; ore lelo balusuni le seriani, neishirita te mion.
Etoliyiote inkoitoi sapuki meekure eetae olalotoni. Etigile olning'o, netemenayioki ilchakenini, meetae oltung'ani oshilaa olikae.
Eishirita enkop netalepori to sina; etumute Lebanon netoyio; etotiwuo Sharon anaa olpurkel, ore Bashan o Karmel neipiripiroitie mbenek enye.
“Kadumunye nanu taata,” Olaitoriani ojo, “Ore taata kaitashe nanu; naa kaayiolouni nanu taata.
Intobiribiri intae mbaa naaijo suut, nipuopuo aayau mbaa e pesho; ore enkiyang'et inyi naa enkima namut intae.
Netiu olorere anaa ilootapejoyioki aaitaa enkuruoni, netiu anaa ilkiku ootudung'oki nepejori te nkima.”
Entoning intae lelo oolakua, ina nataasa nanu; ore intae kulo oolakua, entayiolo enkidimata ai.
Ore lelo aing'okok ootii Sion neiruto; eibung'a olokirikiri lelo lemeyiolo Enkai: “Kalo tiatua iyiook oidim atotona te nkima nanyaisho? Kalo tiatua iyiook oidim atobiko te nkima oo ntarasi?”

Ore ilo olo too nkoitoi naaitoriori neiro sipat, ilo omenaa tumoto e nkitorogonyare, ilo oipirripir inkaik enyena meibung ntokitin e ropare, ilo oiken inkiyiaa enyena pee mening enkibukoroto o sarge; neiken inkonyek enyena pee meing'or entorroni.
Ilo ninye olo aton too wuejitin e shumata; ore ewueji e nkirrita naa isempewueti too soito; nepuoi aaisho ninye endaa o enkare.
Keyooki inkonyek inono aaing'or olaiguanani te nkishiaa enye; neing'or ninche ina kop dapash oleng.
Nepuo indamunot inyi aaing'asia te ilo kirutoto, nijojo, “Koree ninye ilo apa oikenisho, Koree ninye ilo apa oineneng atem kodi? Koree ninye ilo apa oiken iltaleta?”
Mingiligili aekata aadol lelo tung'ana leeiking'a, lelo tung'ana limiyiololo intae enkutuk enye nimindimidimi aatoning'u ooiramiram te nkutuk nimining'ung'u.

Eng'ura Sion, ina anasa gelunoti nikipolosishore iyiook! Kepuo inkonyek inono aadol Yerusalem, ina manyisho naitirring'a, ilo ng'obor lemeigusugus, lemedotunye aekata nena sheito naaunore, nemedung'o nena keenta naaenare.
Ore teine nelo Olaitoriani te nkitoo aaku te nebo iyiook ewueji ine netii ilkejek dapashi o erat, nemeim ine imelin e nkitoo.
Olaitoriani ninye olarishani lang, Olaitoriani ninye olo aitore iyiook, Olaitoriani ninye olaiguanani lang; keitajeu ninye iyiook.
Eitololong'ita nkeenta e meli; meitirrishayu ninche. Ore nena masaa kumok neori, keyae o mewaita ilmaiman.
Nemeetae obo omanya ina kop ojo, “Kamuoi nanu”; ore lelo tung'ana oomanya ine naa kepalakini ing'ok enye.
Entinyiku intae lo oreren, pee ining'ining'i, entuun nkiyiaa intae lo tung'ana! Nchoo metoning'o enkop o nena pooki naatii atua. Nchoo metoning'o enkop o nena pooki naapuku tiatua enkop.
Etagorokine Olaitoriani iloshon pooki netagorokine ilmang'ati lenye, eiturrayie ninye ninche, eishooyie ninche aisho lelo oomut ninche.
Kenang'ari mpopoki ong'ata, nerupa mpopoki enye eidapashakino enkop, neruko osarge lenye aim nchumat oo ldoinyo.

Ore olorora le keper nerrarra aaku enterit. Ore oloing'ang'e pooki nepiyaya anaa endapana ore ilo orora pooki nerrarrunye anaa enasulunye mbenek o lng'aboli, anaa enasulunye ilng'abolo ooto to lchani.
Etudumunye olalem lai netaraposhe te shumata; ng'ura ajo kesulakino ninye Edom te nkiguana, lelo tung'ana latudung'oko nanu enkiguana.

Keeta Olaitoriani olalem oiputa osarge, neimulumulita eilata, te nebo osarge loo lkerra o lkineji, te nebo enkurriny oo lairakuj oo lkerra, amu kelo Olaitoriani aibung olasar te Bosara, kelo ninye aitayu esesekuanare kitok te Edom.
Naa kedoiki ilosokuani ninche te nebo ilmong'i o loing'ok magil. Ore ina kop enye neiput osarge, ore ina kop enye nenyilu te ilata.
Amu keeta Olaitoriani enkolong e lap, ina olong nalo aitalaku elap te nkaraki Sion.
Ore ilkejek le Edom neibelekenya aatiu anaa enkoronko, neaku enkulupuoni enye enkima nakutu isoito neaku ina kop enkoronko nayupuyup.
Ore dama o kewarie nemeye ina kima; neilep empuruo enye alo shumata ntarasi. Ore too ishoritin pooki neaku ina kop mijooni; nemeitoki oltung'ani aim ntarasi o ntarasi.
Kake kelo aaku lenkalem o iyai ootii ina kop, ore emotonyi oo nkiyiaa o lkurruk nemany ine. Neitorioki Olaitoriani olmilo ina kop nedoiki enyamali lelo kituaak lenyena.
Neipoti ine aajo, “Enemetii enkitoria”, ore lelo kituaak lenyena pooki neaku pesho.
Nebulaki ilkiku lelo sempewueti lenyena, nebulaki olkurushashi o suut lelo sempewueti lenyena o nkang'itie enyena naagol. Nelo ine aaku emanyisho oo mbariak ewueji nemany isidan.
Nepuo mbariak aashulare ilng'ojiniaa, neipotu oloirirua le ntim olikae, nejokino, ee, eisidai enkewarie tene, neing'uraki kewan ewueji neyeng'iyeng'are.
Teine elo emotonyi aitobir enkaji enye, nepik inkiyioitin enyena abori oloip lenye; ee teine epuo aaiturrurro ilkurragoso epuo maare.
Ing'oru isuma te mbuku o Laitoriani; meetae hoo nabo e kuna nemetii; nemeetae ake enemelotu eboitare enkae. Amu enkutuk o Laitoriani naitanapishe, naa Enkiyang'et enye naiturrurro pooki.
