Etooshoko ninye ninche enkukuo, enkaina enye natoorikia ninche rubat enye too lkererin; kepuo ninche aaya ina kop ntarasi. Ore too ishoritin naa kepuo ninche aamany ina kop.
Keng'idayu olpurkel o enkop natoyio, neng'idayu ilo purkel neleng'u oleng; neiput ntapuka.
Keleng'u ninye oleng, neranyisho te ng'ida. Ore ina kitoo e Lebanon neishori ninye, ore ina kitoo o enkishiaa e Karmel o Sharon nedol enkitoo o Laitoriani, ina kitoo e Nkai ang.
Ntagolo nena aik naatalepori, ntasheyie ilo oikirikira te nkuretisho.
Tiaaki lelo ootureishote, “Entagoluoto, emiureishoyu! Eng'ura Enkai inyi elotu te lap, kelotu ninye amut ilmang'ati linyi, Kelotu ninye aitajeu intae.”
Ore ilo modooni neboli inkonyek enyena, neitoning'ishoi ilo ming'ani;
neipid olmaima anaa enkolii, neranyisho olng'ejep lo lemeyiolo airoro te ng'ida. Amu keijirrijirru inkariak to lpurkel, neiput inkonyek oo nkariak enkop natoyio.
Ore ilo sinyai oirowua naa kelo aaku olchorro, ore ina kop oo lbaat neijirrijirru enkare, ore ina manyisho oo mbariak nelo aaku engilata naleng, netiu nena kujit anaa oseyiai o enarau.
Nejing enkoitoi kitok ine, naji Enkoitoi Sinyati; nemepuo aaim ine iltung'ana lemesinya, ore ilmoda nemepong'okino ine.
Nemejing olng'atuny ine, nemelotu ae ng'ues ake ninye torrono; metumi ninche teine, kake lelo ootokorduaki ake oopuo aaim ine.
Naa lelo ooinyiang'ua Olaitoriani ake oopuo aarrinyunye, nepuonu Sion eranyisho; nejing eng'ida oo ntarasi shumata ninche; nepuo ninche aatum enchipai o eng'ida, nemeitoki aatum emion o sina.
Ore to lari le tomon oong'uan le nkitoria e Hesekia, nelotu Senakerib ilo aiguanani le Asiria nena anas pooki naasheta e Yuda, neibung ninche.

Ore ilo aiguanani le Asiria neirriwaa olkitok obo le nkitoria enye te Lakish meshomo enetii olaiguanani Hesekia te Yerusalem eeta enjore kitok. Nelo ninye aitashe te mbata olchorro le shumata, teina oitoi natii olaisujani loo nkilani.
Nelotu Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia enetii ninye laa ninye apa oitaisheiki ina aji e nkitoo. Nelotu sii Shebna ilo aigeroni, o Yoa olayioni le Asafu laa ninye oikenisho.
Nejoki ilo kitok le njore ninche, “Entiaaki Hesekia, ‘Nji ejo ilo aiguanani kitok, ilo aiguanani le Asiria: Kainyoo iyie ing'idare?
Ijo iyie keaku irorei ake duoo enkoitoi nagol napuoyieki olarrabal? Kaing'ae taata iyie ingarakino, eji peyie kimpirakinore nanu?
Ng'ura ajo Misiri iyie ingarakino, naikununo anaa eng'udi o ltiyani natigile, nerem enkaina e pooki ng'ae otirman ninye.

Kake tinikijoki iyie: Olaitoriani Enkai ang iyiook kingarakino: mme ilo otii ilpereren lenyena loo lasarri shumata, eiwuangie Hesekia lelo pereren nejoki Yuda o Yerusalem; Ipuopuo intae aaserem te dukuya ele perere lo lasar?
Wou naa taata, toning'ore olkitok lai, ilo aiguanani le Asiria, amu kaaisho nanu mbartan nkalifuni are, tenaa indim iyie te nkalo ino anoto ilakedok pee eked ninche.
Kaji naa iyie inko pee intukurru ilo arikoni obo le njore tiatua lelo kulikae aisiaayiak ti abori, eji isiligita Misiri, mikirriwaki mbartan oo ngarrin o lakedok lenye.
Amaa, ijo kaewuo nanu ena kop metii Olaitoriani aidaikie nainyal? Aatiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, Shomo taarare ena kop, ninyal ninye.’ ”
Neitoki Eliakim o Shebna o Yoa aajoki ilo kitok le njore, “Kitoomono iyie, irorie isinkan linono te nkutuk e Aramea, mirorie iyiook te nkutuk e Yuda metoning'o iltung'ana ootii esuntai.”

Kake etejo ilo kitok le njore, “Kaairriwua nanu olkitok lai maeu airorie olkitok linyi, o intae, nemairorie lelo ootoni te suntai, laa ore ninche te nebo nipuopuo aanya inkik inyi niokioko nkulak inyi?”
Neitoki ilo kitok le njore aitashe nebuaku to ltoilo kitok te nkutuk oo ltung'ana le Yuda, ajo, “Entoning irorei lo laiguanani kitok, ilo aiguanani le Asiria!
Nji ejo olaiguanani, ‘Emincho Hesekia meteleja intae, amu meidim ninye atokordu intae.
Emincho Hesekia ejoki intae eji maigarakinoto Olaitoriani, eji ejo; Kelo Olaitoriani akordu iyiook: ore ena anasa nemelo ninye ajing inkaik o laiguanani le Asiria.

Emining intae Hesekia, amu nji ejo olaiguanani le Asiria. Entobira intae osotua o nanu nipuonunu enatii nanu, pee etum pooki ng'ae te intae ainosa isabibu lenyena o lng'abolo lenyena, neok pooki ng'ae te intae enkare o lchorro lenye;
o metaba anaa nalotu nanu aya intae ina kop nanyaanyukie enkop inyi, ina kop e ntapa o sabibu, ina kop natii endaa o lng'anayio.
Enteng'enuoto melej ake intae Hesekia ejo: Kelo Olaitoriani akordu iyiook. Keetae aekata enkai oo loshon natokordua enkop aitung'uaa enkaina o laiguanani le Asiria?
Koree nena aitin e Hamat o Arpadi? Koree nena aitin e Serfarfaim? Ketokordutua ninche Samaria aaitayu te nkaina ai?
Kaa too nkaitin pooki e kuna kuapi natokordua enkop enye aitayu te nkaina ai, eji metaa kelo Olaitoriani akordu Yerusalem te nkaina ai?’ ”
Kake etigirate apa ninche neitu ewaliki olomoni hoo obo, amu ore apa enkitanapata o laiguanani naa, “Eming'amaa intae ninye.”

Neitoki Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia laa ninye olaitasheikinoni le nkaji e nkitoo o Shebna, laa ninye olaigeroni o Yoa olayioni le Asafu, ilo aikenani, aapuonu enetii Hesekia etopolosa ilkilani lenye. Neinosaki ninye irorei le ilo kitok le njore.
Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani Hesekia ina, nepolos ilkilani lenyena, neimulumul kewan too lkuniyiani, nelo ajing atua enkaji o Laitoriani.
Neirriwaa Eliakim laa ninye apa oitasheiki ina aji e nkitoo o Shebna ilo aigeroni o lelo apolosak kituaak, eishopito ilkuniyiani meshomo enetii oloiboni le Nkai Isaya, olayioni le Amos.
Nejoki ninche ninye, “Nji etejo Hesekia, ‘Ore ena olong naa enkolong o sina, enkolong e moroto o esulare; etaa keini inkera nemeetae engolon naiunyeki.

Ebaiki netoning'o Olaitoriani Enkai ino irorei le ilo kitok le njore, oirriwua olkitok lenye, ilo aiguanani le Asiria meeu asukeny Enkai naishu, nesurdaanyisho te lelo rorei ootoning'o Olaitoriani Enkai ino. Ore te nkaraki ina intirrisha enkomono ino te nkaraki ilo pisiai otelekua.’ ”
Ore ake pee epuonu ilaisiaayiak lo laiguanani Hesekia enetii Isaya,
nejoki Isaya ninche, “Entiaaki olkitok linyi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Emiureishoyu te nkaraki lelo rorei litoning'o, laa ninche aaisikong'ie osinka lo laiguanani le Asiria.
Kapik nanu ninye enkiyang'et nelo aning olmarenke, nerrinyokino ninye enkop enye makewan, naa kaisho nanu ninye metua to lalem oibung'ita ninye te nkaina enye makewan.’ ”
Nerrinyo ilo kitok le njore, nelo ainepu olaiguanani le Asiria earare Libna; amu etoning'o apa ninche aajo eshomo olaiguanani aing'uaa Lakish.
Nening ilo aiguanani mbaa naaipirta Tihaka olaiguanani le Etiopia nchere, “Kirriwaka ninye olkilikuai pee kilotu aarare.” Ore ake pee ening ninye ina neirriwaki ilkiliku Hesekia, ejo,
“Nji enchom entiaaki Hesekia ilo aiguanani le Yuda, ‘Mincho kilej ina Ai ino naa ninye isiligita, ejo esiligie olorere ajo meishoori Yerusalem aapik atua nkaik o laiguanani le Asiria.
Itoning'o enaitaasa ilaiguanak le Asiria nkuapi pooki, neinyal ninche aaidaikie katukul. Eikipuoi doi aakordu iyie?
Ketokordutua nena aitin oo loshon ninche, lelo oshon apa ooidaikie loo papa, Gosan o Haran o Resef o lelo tung'ana le Eden apa ootii Telasar?
Koree taata olaiguanani le Hamat, o laiguanani le Arpad o laiguanani le nkanasa naji Sefarfaim o laiguanani le Hena aashu olaiguanani le Efaa?’ ”
Neng'amaa olaiguanani Hesekia ina palai te lelo ooirriwuaki, neisum ninye, Neilep Hesekia alo enkaji o Laitoriani, nelo aisalaash ina palai te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Neomon Hesekia Olaitoriani, nejo,
“Olaitoriani loo lororani, na Ai e Israel, itonita to lorika lino le nkitoo te shumata ilkerubi, naa iyie Enkai, iyie ake, ore too nkitoriat pooki e nkop nintobira iyie shumata o enkop.
Irrugu enkiok ino, Olaitoriani, toning'o, nibol inkonyek inono Olaitoriani aing'or; nining kulo rorei pooki le Senakerib, ooirriua ninye pee emor Enkai naishu.
Ore te sipata Olaitoriani, eitomijoono laiguanak le Asiria iloshon pooki o nkuapi pooki.
Netanang'akita nkaitin enye atua enkima; amu mme nkaitin apa ninche, kake esiaai oo nkaik e tung'ana, nkeek o soito; neaku eidaikieki apa ninche.
Ore naa taata Olaitoriani Enkai ang, ntajeu iyiook te nkaina enye, pee etum nkitoriat pooki enkop aatayiolo nchere iyie ake Olaitoriani.”
Neitoki Isaya olayioni le Amos airriwaki Hesekia olkilikuai ejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel: Ore te nkaraki nikitoomono iyie nanu te nkaraki Senakerib olaiguanani le Asiria,
ele ninye ilo rorei oiroro Olaitoriani eipirta ninye: ‘Eikimen ninye iyie, eikisukeny ninye iyie - Yerusalem; neipirripir endukuya enye te siadi iyie - na tito e Yerusalem.
Kaing'ae doi ilo litamoro nisurdaany? Kaing'ae ilo litabuaka nishumaki nkonyek inono to lmena? Aime Ilo Osinya le Israel!

Ore tialo isinkan linono nitamoro Olaitoriani, nitejo iyie, ore too ngarrin aainei kumok oo mbartan, nashomo nanu ailep enchumata oo ldoinyo, o atua Lebanon; naturoyie nanu ltarakua lenyena adoru, lelo keek lenyena sidain; ashomo nanu abaya shumata aisul, ina tim enye nasur.
Atuturuo nanu ilchorroi naok nena ariak, natunuka too ndapi oo nkejek aainei nena onyek oo nkariak pooki e Misiri.
Keitu iyie ining nchere aterretena apa nanu moitie? Ina taata nalotu aas, eji nipuopuo intae aaitaa nkanas naasheta osototi loo mauti.
Ore apa meeta lelo oomanya ine engolon, neiruto neiputukuny, netiu ninche anaa nkaitubulu e ong'ata, netiu anaa nkujit naanana netiu anaa nkujit naatii shumata e nkaji, naaidaikieki eitu ebulu.
‘Ayiolo nanu emanyisho ino o eninkunari te nimpang o ti nijing'u, o ina nikigorokino nanu.

Ore te nkaraki nikitagorokine iyie nanu neewuo ilo wuasa lino abau inkiyiaa aainei, kapik nanu olororoi lai nkumeishin inono, napik esekenkei enkutuk ino, naaibelekeny iyie aipirie ewueji duoo ning'uaa.’

“Naa kelo ena aaku olmonekie te iyie: ore tele ari inosa pooki toki nabulu openy. Ore to lari li are inosa ina nabulu aikununye neijia; ore to lari liokuni tuunisho, ninkesisho, niun isabibu, ninya ilng'anayio lenye.
Ore ilo pisiai oleku le nkaji e Yuda, neitoki aaibung ntona ti abori, neiu ilng'anayio te shumata.
Amu te Yerusalem eipang'u ilo pisiai naa oldoinyo le Sion eimu ina tukus e lelo ooleku. Amu Olaitoriani loo lororani olo aitabaya ena.
“Ore te nkaraki ina, nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo ilo aiguanani le Asiria. Melotu ninye ajing'u atua ena anasa, anaa eng'oroo embae teine, aashu elotu anyikaki eeta elong'o aashu eng'adu ninye.
Ina oitoi naimu ninye eigil aim errinyo, nemelotu ninye ajing'u atua ena anasa, Olaitoriani ojo.
Amu kamitu nanu ena anasa aitajeu, te nkaraki kewan ai o te nkaraki osinka lai Daudi.”

Nelo olmalaika lo Laitoriani, nelo aar metuata iltung'ana inkalifuni iip o ntomoni isiet o imiet te lelo ng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Asiria. Ore ake pee einyototo iltung'ana tadekenya ng'ura, etaa duoo kulo pooki mpopoki.
Neitoki Senakerib ilo aiguanani le Asiria arrinyo nelo aton te nkang enye te Ninawi.

Ore eseremisho ninye te nkaji e Nisrok, ina ai enye, nepuonu Adramalek o Shereser, lelo ayiok lenyena aasesekuan ninye to lalem, neisik aapuo oldoinyo le Ararat. Neitoreisho olayioni Esar-hadon te rishata enye.
Ore apa te nena olong'i nemuoyu Hesekia eneyieu eye. Nelo ilo oiboni le Nkai Isaya olayioni le Amos enetii ninye, nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani; Ntobira enkaji ino, amu iye iyie, miinchiu.”
Neibelekenyakino Hesekia esuntai neomon Olaitoriani nejo,
“Tadamu taata Olaitoriani, aatasayia inchere ashomo nanu te dukuya iyie te nkisiligata pooki o to ltau pooki nataasa nanu ina sidai too nkonyek inono.” Neishir Hesekia oleng.
Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Isaya, nejo,
“Shomo tiaaki Hesekia, Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Daudi papaai lino: Atoning'o nanu enkomono ino, natoduaa nanu ilkiyio linono; kaponiki nanu enkishui ino ilarin tomon o miet.
Kaakordu nanu iyie o ena anasa aitung'uaa inkaik o laiguanani le Asiria, namitu ena anasa.
“Ele olmonekie te iyie oing'uaa Olaitoriani, nchere kelo Olaitoriani aas ena naisiligishore:
Karrinyu nanu oloip iroruat tomon, teine netabaikia te wueji nekedi e Ahas.” Neaku etorrinye apa enkolong siadi iroruat tomon te wueji duoo netabaikia.
Enkomono naigeri ena e Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda, ina kata apa etamuoyia ninye nenyaaka aishiu:
Atejo nanu eitoritote nkolong'i aainei etaa kalo; aipirakinore nanu kishomi enemeneng'a, too larin pooki le nkishui ai.
Najo nanu, madol Olaitoriani teina kop oo looishu; maigil aekata nanu adol iltung'ana tiatua lelo oomanya enkop.

Etadotuoki emanyisho ai neiwuang'ieki te nanu, eikunaki anaa olng'obor lo lchekut; atununuko nanu enkishui ai anaa endapana, aaikuna nanu anaa enkila naitobiri te wueji neripishoreki; ore dama o kewarie nikiyau iyie nanu enkiting'oto.
Aishira nanu o mekenyu aing'oru eretoto; negiligil ninye iloik laainei pooki anaa olng'atuny; ore dama o kewarie nikiyau iyie nanu enkiting'oto.
Nabuaku nanu anaa emotonyi aishirita anaa enturkuluo, enaurate nkonyek aainei aimariri shumata. Iyie Olaitoriani, aaisoruoki nanu, taa iyie esarunoto ai!
Kake kaa nanu ajo? Amu aairorie ninye nanu, netaasa ninye makewan ina. Eidurra njo aainei pooki te nkaraki ina mion o ltau lai.
Iyie Olaitoriani, te kuna baa eishu iltung'ana, ore enkishui o ltau lai netii atua kuna pooki. Ooi, torrinyokoki nanu embiotisho nikincho manyaaki aishu!
Kesipa te nkaraki eseriani ai apa pee anoto emion sapuk kake imbooyie iyie enkishui ai arishie ina gumoto e nkidaata, amu itanang'aka iyie ng'ok aainei oriong ino.
Amu mikindim iyie enemeneng'a aishoo enashe, mikindim keeya aterrepa iyie. Ore lelo oopuo aadoiki engumoto nemeidim aaisiligisho, te nkaraki ina supatisho ino.
Ore ilo oishu, ilo oishu, ninye likincho enashe, anaa enaasita nanu ena olong; neitayiolo menye nkera enyena esupatisho ino.
Kaaitajeu nanu Olaitoriani, naa eikipuo aaranyisho too nkinantani oo usin too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ang te nkaji o Laitoriani.
Netejo apa Isaya, “Nchoo ninche eya olkitushulati loo lng'abolo neelie ninche ilo dututai pee etum ninye aishiu.”
Netejo sii ninye Hesekia, “Kainyoo olmonekie nchere kalo nanu Enkaji o Laitoriani?”
Ore apa teina kata neirriu Merodek-baladan olayioni le ilo aiguanani le Babilon olkilikuai eeta mpala o enkishooroto nayaki Hesekia, amu etoning'o apa ninye nchere etamuoyia nenyaaka aishiu.

Neitoomon Hesekia ninche; neitodol ninche ina aji enye nashumishoreki; neitodol enkosholai o saabu o eilata nagol enkinyang'a o kulie tokitin te nebo imasaa o ruparen o nena pooki apa naatii atua ina aji enye nashumishoreki. Meetae apa entoki hoo nabo natii atua enkaji enye aashu ina ang enye pooki neitu eitodol ninche.

Neitoki oloiboni Isaya alotu enetii olaiguanani Hesekia nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo etejo kulo tung'ana? Naa kaji eing'uaa pee epuonu enitii?” Nejo Hesekia, “Eetuo ninche eing'uaa enkop nalakua, Babilon eing'uaa.”
Nejo ninye, “Kainyoo ninche etoduaa te nkaji ino?” Newal Hesekia ajo, “Etodua ninche nena pooki naatii atua enkaji ai; meetae entoki natii atua enkaji ai neitu nanu aitodol ninche.”
Neitoki Isaya ajoki Hesekia, “Toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani loo lororani:
Kepuonu nkolong'i naa ore nena pooki naatii atua enkaji ino o nena pooki apa naatushuma loo papaai linyi o metabaiki ena olong, naa kenapi aaya Babilon, meetae entoki naleku, Olaitoriani ojo.
Ore embata e lelo ayiok linono likitoikioki naa keyai sii ninche. Naa kepuo aaku isunashi oogelema tiatua enkaji o laiguanani le Babilon.”
Neitoki Hesekia ajoki Isaya, “Ore ilo rorei lo Laitoriani liroro iyie naa eisidai.” Amu etejo apa ninye, “Ketumi eseriani too nkolong'i aainei.”
Ntagolo iltung'ana laainei, ntagolo iltung'ana laainei, Olaitoriani ojo.

Irorie Yerusalem te mborron, ninchiraki ninye tiaaki eishunye olarrabal lenye, netapalakaki ninye ing'ok enyena, amu etang'amua apa ninye te nkaina o Laitoriani enkitalakunoto oo ng'ok enyena katitin are.
Ening'o oltoilo oishirita: “Ore ti ong'ata ntobira enkoitoi o Laitoriani, Ntorioi to lpurkel enkoitoi te nkaraki Enkai ang.
Ore pooki nong'oto nagum neilepunyeki, ore pooki doinyo o ewueji nerupa neitadouni; ore ewueji nemeitoriori neitoriori, ore ewueji nemeisiasha neisiashayieki.
Amu kepuoi aaibalunye enkitoo o Laitoriani, nedol iltung'ana pooki te nebo, amu enkutuk o Laitoriani nairoro kuna.”
Ejo ilo toilo, “Nchira!” Najo nanu, “Kaishir ajo aa?” Ore pooki naata osesen netiu anaa nkujit, ore ina kishiaa enye pooki netiu anaa entapukai e ong'ata.
Ketoyu nkujit, nerrarrarri ntapuka, te nekut Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani ninye; kesipa ketiu iltung'ana anaa nkujit.
Ketoyu nkujit nerrarrarri intapuka; kake ore ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai ang neuno intarasi.

Ilepa iyie shomo enchumata o ldoinyo oado, Iyie Sion, ntadarai lelo omon supati; ilepunye oltoilo lino te ngolon, Oo Yerusalem, ntadarai lelo omon supati, ilepie oleng, miureshoyu; tiaaki nena anas e Yuda, “Eng'ura Enkai inyi!”
Kelotu Olaitoriani Enkai te ngolon, naa enkaina enye nalotu aitoreisho; ng'ura etii enkishooroto enye te nebo ninye, netii nchuneti enyena dukuya ninye.
Keirrita ninye eluaata enye anaa olchekut, neibung ninye ilkuoo too nkaik enyena, nenap ninche to lgoo lenye, nerikoo maakutiti nena oijoo.
Kalo otetema enkare te ndap e nkaina enye netem shumata te nkitorioroto e nkaina enye, neishaki enterit e nkop pooki te ntemet neineneng ildoinyo o ndoinyo to rratili.
Kalo otuutayie Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani, aashu kalo otaa olaikooni lenye neiteng'en ninye?
Kaing'ae eikilikuanishore ninye pee etum ataarriyiana, naa aing'ae oiteng'ena ninye teina neitodol ninye enkoitoi e yiolounoto?
Kesipa etiu iloshon anaa olkitong'ati le enkare naitong to ltoo, eikununo nkuapi anaa enkinyi terit napuyiapui; ng'ura ajo kedumu ninye lemankale pooki anaa enkinyi terit napuyiapui.
Meidip ilkeek le Lebanon enkima, nemeidip ing'uesi enyena pooki olasar opejori.
Etiu iloshon pooki anaa pesho te dukuya ninye, eikenayie ninye ninche anaa pesho, aashu olng'am.
Kaing'ae naa kintanyaanyukie Enkai, aashu kainyoo narisiore ninye?
Ke nkitanyaanyukoto e Nkai Ina naitobirua oltung'ani? Ina namur olkunoni te saabu, nepik ninye ilpisia le nkosholai.
Ore ilo omena lemeidim ainyiang'u olasar, negelu olchata lemeitiapurus; neing'uraki kewan olaguetani arriyia, ounoki enkitanyaanyukoto nemeigusugus.
Keitu iyie iyiolou? Keitu iyie ining? Keitu apa kilikini iyie te nkiterunoto? Keitu apa iyiolou iyie ebaiki olkitamanyunoto le nkop?
Ninye ilo oton te shumata enkop, ore lelo oomanya enkop neikununo anaa ilmaat; kaing'ae ilo oisalaash shumata anaa olkarasha, nelak anaa olng'obor olo amany.
Ninye ilo oitadou ilkituaak, aitaa pesho ore lelo aitoriak le nkop neitaa pesho.
Penyo netuunoki ninche, penyo neibung'a ntona enkop, te nekut Olaitoriani ninche to siwuo netoyu, neya osiwuo ninche anaa suut.
Kaing'ae naa intae kintanyaanyukiekie nanu? Eji pee atiu nanu anaa ninye? Ilo Sinyati Obo ojo.

Tushumu nkonyek inono toduaa shumata; kaing'ae oitobirua kuna pooki? Ilo oyau ilo orora lenye te nkumoi, neipotu ninche pooki too nkarn enye, teina kitoo e nkidimata enye, naa ore te nkaraki nagol ninye oleng meimin ninye nabo.
Kainyoo pee ijo iyie Yakobo, niro iyie Israel ajo, “Eisudoyie Olaitoriani enkoitoi ai, ore esipata ai neitu eshilaa Enkai ai?”
Keitu iyie iyiolou? Keitu iyie ining? Ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai oo ntarasi, ninye oitobira ineeiting'ie enkop. Menauru ninye nemelepori, ore eyiolounoto enye nemejurrunoyu.
Keisho ninye engolon ilo oiterria, ore ilo lemeeta enkidimata neponiki engolon.
Keiterre doi ninye elelero nenauru nebatata iltung'ana ooti te nauri;
kake ore lelo oanyu Olaitoriani naa keitang'ejuki engolon enye, keilep ninche too naipuko anaa lkurragoso, nepuo aakuet nemenauru, nepuo ninche kake meiterre te nauri.
Entirring'ata entoning'oki nanu na kuapi, kuna o lmanie le naiposha; nchoo iltung'ana eitang'ejuk engolon enye; nchoo ninche enyiku, netum taa aairoro; maigutu pooki te nebo aanyikaki enkiguana.

Kaing'ae otuputuo ilo obo oing'uaa enkalo o loosaen, laa ore ake enelo neisulu? Nepalaa ninye iloreren te dukuya ninye, pee etum ninye aitunyoi ilaiguanak atupudaki enkop; neitotiu ninye ninche anaa enterit to lalem lenye, netiu anaa isuut naatang'oroyioki te nkawuo enye.
Nesujaa ninye ninche nelo agiroo te seriani, teina oitoi neitu aekata eroro nkejek enyena.
Kalo ilo otaasa ena bae, aing'ae oitobira rishat o nkatitin? Nanu, Olaitoriani, ilo le dukuya, nara ole siadi; Nanu ilo.
Etoduaa nkuapi o lomanaa le naiposha neureishoyu, eikirikira ineeiting'ie enkop; eetuo ninche aanyiku.
Etaretuo ake oltung'ani ole latia enye, nejoki olalashe lenye, “Ntagoluoyu!”
Neitagol olaguetani loo nkeek olkunoni oshoke, ore oloiutuutisho neitagol oshoke ilo oidong'isho; ore te nkiruburubare nejo ninche, “Eisidai,” neitirrish ninye too lmushumaani pee meing'unung'un.
Kake ore iyie Israel, osinka lai, Yakobo lategelua nanu, ina ishoi e Abraham, olchore lai;
iyie apa layaua nanu aitung'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop, naaipotu too neelakua oleng, aajoki nanu iyie, “Ira iyie osinka lai, aategelua nanu iyie, nemaanang'aa nanu aiturraa.”
Miureishoyu amu atii nanu te nebo iyie, ming'aeng'ae amu kara nanu Enkai ino; kaaitagol nanu iyie, kaaretu nanu iyie, kaaibung nanu iyie te nkaina ai e tatene naata engolon.
Ore lelo pooki likitagorokinote naa keitukurruni nemiri; ore lelo ooekenya te nkaraki iyie naa kepuo aaku pesho, neidaaya.
Ilo iyie aing'oru lelo likikeshare, kake midol ninche; ore lelo likintayunye olarrabal naa kepuo aaku pesho.
Amu nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, likimbung enkaina e tatene; nanu ilo likijoki iyie, “Miureisho, kaaretu nanu.”
Miureishoyu Yakobo, hoo niba anaa olkurto, lo tung'ana le Israel! Karetu nanu intae, Olaitoriani ojo; Ilo Osinya le Israel ninye okordu intae.
Ng'ura ajo kaaitaa nanu iyie entoki nadung'ishoreki, ng'ejuk, nepi, neeta lala; naa ilo iyie adung ildoinyo niuroo ninche, nintotiu iyie oldoinyo anaa suut.
Naa ilo iyie aipirripir ninche neya osiwuo, neidapash olkutati ninche. Nilo iyie ang'ida tiatua Olaitoriani; tiatua Ilo Obo Osinya le Israel, ilo iyie ang'ida.
Te neing'oru lelo aisinak enkare nelau, netoyu ilng'ejepa lenye te nkure, nawaliki Nanu Olaitoriani ninche, ore Nanu, Enkai e Israel nemaiturraa ninche.
Kabolu nanu ilkejek le nkare too ldoinyo, o nkonyek oo nkariak tiatua ierat; kaisho nanu ong'ata metaa olchorro le nkare, ore enkop natoyio neruko nkariak.
Kaun nanu to lpurkel iltarakua, o ltepes o loirienito, kaitubulu nanu te nkop natoyio, ilkeek kumok lo supuko,
pee etum iltung'ana aatodol neyiolou, nedamu neyiolou te nebo, nchere enkaina o Laitoriani nataasa ina, Ilo Osinya le Israel oitobira ina.
Iyau lomon linono, Olaitoriani ojo; iyau shakenisho ino, Olaiguanani le Yakobo ojo.

Nchoo ninye meyau, neliki iyiook ina nalotu aaku, entoliki iyiook mbaa e apa eneikununo pee kitum iyiook aaiguanare ninche, pee kitum iyiook aatayioloito enepukoki ninche, aashu eibalakinye iyiook mbaa naayooki aapuonu.
Entoliki iyiook mbaa naayooki aapuonu, pee kiyiolou iyiook nchere irara nkaitin; entaas esidai anaa entorroni pee kimputukuny iyiook nikiureishoyu.
Mira iyie toki, naa pesho esiaai ino; naa pesho entoki nikitegelua iyie.

Atuputuo nanu ilo obo te nkalo e moikuape, neewuo ninye, eewuo ninye eing'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong, naa kelotu ninye aipot enkarna ai; naa kelotu ninye aituny lelo aitoriak anaa esarng'ab, anaa enaipurj olaitobirani loo motioo oo nkulupuok esarng'ab.

Kaing'ae apa oibalunye te dukuya, pee kitum iyiook aatayiolo, nelimu eng'or enkata, pee kitum iyiook aatejo, “Etisipa ninye”? Metii apa hoo obo oibalunye ina, meetae olotolimuo, meetae olotoning'o irorei linono.
Atang'asa apa nanu aibalakinye Sion, naisho nanu Yerusalem olkilikuai loo lomon supati.
Kake te naing'orisho nanu, metii hoo obo, tiatua oidim ataa olaikooni, laa te naikilikuanisho newalu.
Ng'ura ajo pesho kuna pooki, naa pesho esiaai enye; ore nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin naatosholuaki naa enkijape e pesho.
Lele osinka lai laitagol nanu, ilo gelunoti lai, oshipakino oltau lai; atipika nanu enkiyang'et ai shumata ninye, naa kelo ninye aiguanaki iloshon too sipat.
Meishir ninye nemebuaku, aashu ening'i ninye too nkoitoi.
Megil ninye entiyani nailenye nemekut aar oltaa oiliilayie; keyau ninye aitobiru enkiguana nasipa.
Melaikino ninye ae toki nemepalari o metaba anaa neibulunye esipata enkop; ore iloomanaa le naiposha neanyu enkitanapata enye.

Nji ejo Enkai, Olaitoriani, ilo oitayio shumata neisalaash, ilo olak enkop aitorioo o pooki naimu ninye, ilo oisho enkiyang'et lelo tung'ana ootii oriong enkop, neisho enkishui lelo oopuo ti oriong enkop.
“Kara nanu Olaitoriani, aaipoto nanu iyie te supatisho, aaibung'a nanu iyie enkaina naagolie; aaishorua nanu iyie taa olning'o too loreren, ore te iyie naa kayaki nanu ewang'an iloshon.
Ilo aitodolisho ilmodook, nilo alaaya lelo ooena te naimin, nintayu ilooena aitung'uaa olgilata liatua jila nintayu te jila lelo ootoni tiatua enaimin.
Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ina enkarna ai, ore enkitoo ai nemaisho nanu likae, nemaisho enkisisa ai nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naaguetuno.
Ng'ura ajo etulusoitie ntokitin e apa, naa kaibalunye taata nanu ntokitin ng'ejuko; ore eton eitu eipang'u aaliooyu naa kaaliki nanu ninche.”
Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk, nchoo enkisisa enye eimu ilubot e nkop pooki! Nchoo eikurrukur enaiposha o nena naabore atua oloomanaa le naiposha o lelo oomanya ninche.
Nchoo enkop natoyio o nkanas enye eilepunye iltoiloishi lenye, o nena ang'itie naamanya Kedar; nchoo lelo oomanya Sela eranyisho te ng'ida, nchoo ninche ebuaku too nchumat oo ldoinyo.
Nchoo ninche eisho Olaitoriani enkitoo, neibalunye enkisisa enye too loomanaa le naiposha.
Kelo Olaitoriani anaa oltung'ani magilani, nepush anaa oltung'ani lo larrabal; neyietu aishir, nebuaku, neitoduaaya kewan ajo aimagilani alang ilmang'ati lenyena.
Ore te nkata naado natigire nanu, aitirring'e nanu naibooyo kewan, ore taata kaishir nanu anaa enkitok nasaisai, kaipang'ipang nanu naiyiogiyiog.
Kaitomijoon nanu ildoinyo o ndoinyo, naitoi nanu nkujit o lkeek; naitaa nanu ilkejek enkop natoyio, naitoi ilchorroi.

Nalo nanu arikoo lelo modook teina oitoi apa neitu eyiolou ninche, aimie atua ina oitoi nemeyiolo ninche karikoo nanu ninche. Kaibelekeny nanu ina aimin natii dukuya ninche aitaa ewang'an, naisiashayie iwuejitin neesur. Kuna baa nanu aas, nemalo nanu aing'uaa ninche.
Kerrinyuni ninche neitukurruni katukul, lelo ooisilig inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naaguetuni, lelo oojoki nkitanyaanyukot naasholuni, “Irara intae inkaitin ang.”
Entoning intae ilming'anta, ning'oring'oro intae ilmodook, pee itumutumu aatodolisho!
Kalo olmodooni leme ilo sinka lai, aashu kalo olming'ani anaa ilo kipaaret lairriwaa nanu?
Kedol ninye ntokitin kumok kake mesipu; nebolo nkiyiaa enyena kake mening'isho ninye.
Eitiship apa Olaitoriani, te nkaraki esupatisho enye makewan, pee eibalunye enkitanapata enye neitaa kitok.
Kake iltung'ana kulo ootupurroyioki nerayae, etarreshoki ninche pooki too ngumot neisudori tiatua jila; meeta ninche oltung'ani okordu ninche, nemeetae ololo arrinyu ninche?
Kalo te intae olo aning ena, nelo ajing ine ainining'isho te nkaraki ina kata nayooki alotu.

Kaing'ae apa oishooyie Yakobo meibung'i aaya, neisho Israel ilapurrok? Aime Olaitoriani, laa te ninye kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, laa inkoitoi enyena etanyaita ninche, ore nkitanapat enyena neitu ninche eiruk?
Neaku etubukoko shumata ninye engoro enye, o larrabal kitok; nepik ninye enkima aitaman kake eitu ninye emuso ayiolou; nepej ina kima ninye, kake eitu edamu to ltau lenye.
Kake ore taata, nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo likintayio iyie Yakobo, ilo likintobirua Israel: “Miureishoyu amu aatokordua nanu iyie, Aaipotuo nanu iyie te nkarna ai, ira iyie olalai.
Tinilo iyie aim atua nkariak, naaku nanu te nebo iyie; naa ti nilang ilkejek nimikiya ninche; naa ti nilo iyie aim atua enkima nimikipej iyie, nimikinya iyie olng'ejep le nkima
Amu kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, Ilo Sinyati le Israel, Olaitajeunoni lino. Aishorua nanu Misiri pee kitajeu iyie, naishooyo Etiopia o Seba pee aawalunye iyie.
Ore te nkaraki nira iyie kirotet too nkonyek aainei, nikiyanyitaki, naatonyorra nanu, aishooyie nanu iloreren pee aawalunye iyie, aishooyie iloreren awalu enkishui ino.
Miureishoyu, amu atii nanu te nebo iyie; kayau nanu eishoi ino aitung'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong, nalo aiturrur intae te nkalo o loo ntoluo.
Kalo nanu ajoki ina kop e moikuape, nchoru, najoki kopikop, mimbooyo iyie; ilayiok laainei ooing'uaa enelakua o nena toyie aainei naaing'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop,
Ore pooki ng'ae ake ninye oipotieki enkarna ai, ilo oitayioki te nkaraki enkitoo ai, ilo laitobirua nanu naitaa.”
Iyau lelo tung'ana modook hoo neeta nkonyek, lelo ming'anta hoo neeta nkiyiaa!

Nchoo loreren pooki eiturrurro te nebo, ntutumo loshon pooki. Kalo tiatua ninche oidim aibalunye ena, neitodol iyiook mbaa e apa? Nchoo ninche eyau shakenisho enye pee eitisip kuna, naa nchoo ninche ening nejo, Ee ekesipa.

“Irara intae ilchakenini laainei,” Olaitoriani ojo, “Nirara ilo sinka lai lategelua nanu, pee kitumutumu aatayiolo nikirukuruku nanu, niyiolouu nchere nanu ilo. Ore apa te dukuya nanu meetae ae ai naitobiruaki, nemeetae enaitokini aata te siadi nanu.
Kara nanu Olaitoriani, nemeetae likae Aitajeunoni leme nanu.
Aibalie apa nanu, naitajeu, nalimu, ina kata metii enkai omoni atua intae, nirara intae ilchakenini laainei,” Olaitoriani ojo.
“Kara nanu Enkai, naa neijia atiu o kenya; Meetae oloidim atokordu te nkaina ai; kaasisho nanu, naa kaing'ae oidim aibooi ina siaai?”

Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo okordu intae, ilo Sinyati le Israel, “Ore te nkaraki intae, kairriwaa nanu olkilikuai Babilon, meshomo agil inchomito pooki, ore ina buakunoto oo Lkaldayo, neibelekenyi aaitaa enkishirata.
Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ilo Sinyati linyi, ilo Aitobirani le Israel, Aiguanani linyi.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo oitobir enkoitoi tiatua enaiposha, nepik enkoitoi atua nkariak kumok,
ilo oyau ngarrin o mbartan o lakedok o enjore; neirragie te nkop, nemeitoki aadumunye, neiliilaa ninche anaa oltaa:
“Mintoki adamu mbaa e apa, niminguanare mbaa musan.
Ng'ura ajo aasita nanu embae ng'ejuk, egira taata ninye ailepu, aimimusu iyie? Kaitobir nanu enkoitoi ti ong'ata, napik ilkejek olpurkel.
Ore ng'uesi e ntim naayanyitu ninche nanu, mbariak o sidan; te nkaraki naisho nanu ninche enkare ti ong'ata, napik ilkejek olpurkel, pee aisho nanu lelo gelunot laainei eneokishore,
lelo tung'ana apa laitobiraka kewan, pee etum ninche aaibalunye enkisisa ai.
“Ore ake eyia, eitu iyie kimpot nanu Yakobo; kake inaure iyie tialo nanu, Israel!
Eitu iyie kiyaki inkerra inono o lasar opejori, neitu kiyanyitu nanu too lasarri linono. Eitu nanu aaek too lasarri, anaa aaitanaur te nkorropil.
Eitu iyie kinyiang'aki nanu enkorropil too mpisai, neitu kintaraposh eilata oo lasarri linono. Kake kiteeka iyie too ng'ok inono, kintanaura iyie nanu te nkarruoisho ino.
“Nanu ilo ojutoo nkitarruorot inono, te nkaraki kewan ai, nemaitoki nanu adamu ing'ok inono.
Tipikaki nanu ndamunot, maishankarrata iyiook te nebo; iyau enkiguana ino, pee kitumi aaitisipa nchere iata esipata.
Etaasa apa papaai lino le dukuya eng'oki, ore lelo aitutumok linono naatapaashare nanu.
Ore te nkaraki ina, aisarkionie nanu lelo kituaak le wueji sinyati, nayaki Yakobo enkidaata naitaa Israel oldeket.
“Toning'o iyie Yakobo lo sinka lai, Israel laa iyie ategelua!
Nji ejo Olaitoriani ilo likintobira, ilo likintobirua te nkoshoke e ng'utunyi naa ninye likilo aret. Miureishoyu iyie, Yakobo lo sinka lai, Yeshurun laa iyie ategelua.
Amu kabukoki nanu enkare ina kop e nkure, napik inkonyek oo nkariak ina kop natoyio. Kabukoki nanu Enkiyang'et ai shumata eishoi inyi, nabukoki imayianat aainei eishoi inyi.
Kebulu ninche anaa nkujit naatii atua enkare, anaa iseyia oobulu too reyieta naaruko
Nejo ake oltung'ani, ‘Kara nanu olo Laitoriani,’ ore olikae neipotie kewan enkarna e Yakobo, ore olikae neiger te nkaina enye ajo, ‘Olo Laitoriani,’ nedung'oki kewan enkarna metaa keji Israel.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo aiguanani le Israel naa ninye Olakordunoni lenye, Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Kara nanu ole dukuya nara ole nkiting'oto, meetae ae Ai neme nanu.
Kalo otiu anaa nanu? Nchoo ninye elimu aibalunye, nchoo ninye meibalunye neitodolu te dukuya nanu. Kaing'ae apa otolimuo aibalunye mbaa naapuonu? Nchoo ninche eliki iyiook mbaa naayooki aapuonu.
Miureishoyu nimimputukuny; keitu apa nanu aliki intae aibalakinye? Nirara intae ilchakenini laainei! Keetae ae Ai neme nanu? Meetae likae ora endapidapoi; mayiolo nanu likae.”
Pesho lelo pooki apa ooitobira nkitanyaanyukot, ore nena tokitin naang'idare ninche nemeret ninche. Ore ilchakenini lenye nemedolisho nemeyiolo, pee etumi aaitukurru ninche.
Aing'ae oitobiru nkaitin oo nkitanyaanyukot nemeret hoo toki?

Ore lelo tung'ana lenyena pooki naa keitukurruni. Ore lelo aguetak arriyiak naa iltung'ana ake; nchoo ninche pooki esoto, nchoo ninche eitashe, kepuo ninche pooki aairut, kepuoi aaitukurru ninche te nebo.

Keidong'u olkunoni ninye, neitobiru te nchumata oo nkuk, neitobiru too sekenke ooidong'ishoreki, neidong'u ninye teina aina enye nagol; netir ninye esumash neishunye engolon enye, naa te nelau enkare naok neiterre.

Keitorioo olaguetani olkereri, nesir te nkalamu; neitobiru ina naguetu too ntokitin naaguetishoreki, nesir te ntoki natemishoreki neitobiru entoki naikununo anaa oltung'ani, nepik enkishiaa e tung'ani, pee etum atipika enkaji enye.
Nedung ninye iltarakua; anaa egelu ilkulikae keek, neisho ninche metubulu tiatua ilkeek le ntim, neun ninye iltarakua neitubulu enchan.

Neitoki aaku ilkeek le nkima, neya oltung'ani embata nelo aij, neinok ninye ina kima nepej emukate, neitoki sii aitobiru enkai te ilo shata neserem ninye. Neitobiru ninye enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai neserem ninye, neitobiru ninye enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai nagueta neirugokino ninye.
Ore olpisiai lenye nepejoo ninye te nkima, ore to likae pisiai neinosie ninche inkiri. Nepej inkiri nenya neraposho; neij sii enkima neitoki ajo, “Ee, airowuaja nanu, atoduaa nanu enkima!”

Ore enkae rubata pooki neitobirunye ninye enkae ai, ina kitanyaanyukoto enye, neirugokino ninye ina kitanyaanyukoto aserem. Neomon ninye ina kitanyaanyukoto ejo, “Tokorduaki nanu, amu ira iyie enkai ai!”
Meyiolo ninche nememuso; amu eikeno Olaitoriani nkonyek enye, pee medolisho ninche o ndamunot enye pee meyiolou ninche.

Meetae hoo obo oshilaa, aashu olojurru ayiolou nemusu ajo, “Etapejoki olpisiai lenye te nkima, atapejo sii imukateni too nkuk enyena, natapejie nanu nkiri nainosa ninche. Paa amaa lelo ootelekutua, kaitaa nanu entoki olminong? Kairugokino nanu osototi loo lkeek?”
Nkuruon enya ninye; ore ina ng'eno enye nemelulung'a neitapong'oyie ninye, nemeidim ninye aitayu kewan anaa atejo, “Ae metii elejare enkaina ai e tatene?”
Tadamu kuna tokitin, iyie Israel, ira iyie osinka lai; aaitobira iyie, ira iyie osinka lai Oo Israel, maarikino aikata nanu iyie.
Atikinyayie nanu nkitarruorot inono anaa enkatampoi, aishie ing'ok inono anaa enkinuku; torrinyunye wou enatii nanu, amu aatokordua nanu iyie.

Taranyisho, iyie shumata, amu etaasa Olaitoriani ina; Entabuaku intae ineegut e nkop; entang'amai entaranyisho intae ildoinyo, o iyie natim o pooki shani otii atua! Amu etokordua Olaitoriani Yakobo, naa kepuoi aaitaa ninye kitok te Israel.

Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo likikordu iyie, laa ninye apa likintobirua te nkoshoke e yieyioo lino: “Ara nanu Olaitoriani, ilo oitobira ntokitin pooki, ilo apa oisalaasha keper openy, ilo oisalaasha enkop - Kaing'ae apa otii te nebo nanu? -
Ilo oibooyo enaibon oo laimonkok, neitaa pesho iloibonok le lejare; ilo oibelekenyu ilang'eni arrinyu, neitaa ina ng'eno enye emodai;

ilo oun ororei lo sinka lenye, neitabaya enkiguana oo lkipaareta lenyena; ilo ojo tialo Yerusalem, ‘Kepuoi aamany ninye,’ nejo tialo nkanas e Yuda, ‘Kepuoi aashet ninche, naitasheyie nanu ineeturori apa,’
ilo ojoki ewueji negut, ‘Toyio, kaitoi nanu ilkejek linono’;
ilo ojoki Sairas, ‘Olchekut lai ninye, naa keitabaya ninye eyieunoto ai’; ejo tialo Yerusalem, ‘Kepuoi aashet,’ ore tialo ina aji e Nkai, nejo, ‘Kepuoi aaitamanyu olkitamanyunoto lino.’ ”

Nji etiaaka Olaitoriani ilo otubukoko eilata, aput, ilo oji Sairas, ilo laibung'a nanu enkaina enye e tatene, pee elo ninye aitore iloreren te dukuya ninye neoru ilaiguanak imasaa enye, nebol nkutukie oo nkajijik te dukuya ninye pee meitoki nkutukie oo nkajijik aaikeno:
“Kalo nanu te dukuya iyie naitorioo ildoinyio, kagiligil nanu nena shomito o suyai nagiligil nena shomito e sekenkei.
Kaalo nanu aisho iyie ilo shumati le naimin o nena naaisudoro, pee itum iyie atayiolo nchere, ee nanu Olaitoriani, ina Ai e Israel, nikimpotuo iyie te nkarna ino.
Ore te nkaraki osinka lai Yakobo o Israel ilo gelunoti lai, aaipoto nanu te nkarna ino aaipoto nanu enkarna ino hoo nimikiyiolo iyie.
Kara nanu Olaitoriani, nemeetae likae, meetae ae Ai neme nanu; kaarripito nanu hoo nimikiyiolo iyie nanu,
pee etum lelo tung'ana le nkilepunoto e nkolong, o lo loontoluo aatayiolo nchere meetae ae Ai neme nanu; nanu Olaitoriani nemeetae likae.
Aitobirua nanu ewang'an naitayu enaimin, nanu oyau emayianata o enkidaata, nanu Olaitoriani oas kuna baa pooki.
“Tasha iyie shumata, e keper, naa nchoo shumata eshau esupatisho; naa nchoo enkop eng'amaa, pee etum enjeunoto aibulai, naa nchoo eitubulu esupatisho; nanu Olaitoriani oitobirua ina.

“Woi ninye ilo okeshare oloitayio ninye, keishankarrare emoti oo nkulupuok ilo oitobira! Keikilikuan enterit ilo oitobir ajoki, ‘Kainyoo iyie intobirita?’ Aashu ejoki, ‘Meeta ena toki ino ineeibung'i?’
Woi ninye ilo ojoki menye, ‘Kainyoo iyie pee kitoiwuo?’ Aashu ilo ojoki enkitok, ‘Kainyoo iyie nikintasaisai?’ ”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Ilo Osinya le Israel, ilo oitayio ninye: “Eikinkilikuanishore nanu tialo nkera aainei, anaa eikisikong nanu tialo esiaai oo nkaik aainei?
Aitobira nanu enkop, naitayu oltung'ani apik oriong enkop; nkaik aainei apa naaisalaasha shumata, naitaisheiki nanu lelo ororani lenye pooki.

Ailepunye nanu Sairas te sipata, naa kaitorioo nanu nkoitoi enyena pooki; kelo ninye ashet enkanasa ai ore lelo tung'ana laainei ooena nelaaya meshomo, neme te nkaraki enkishooroto anaa olerrinyore,” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore ina arsisisho e Misiri o ina kinyang'a e Etiopia, o lelo tung'ana le Sabean adoru, naa kepuonu enitii neaku linono, nikipuo ninche aasujaa iyie; kepuonu ninche enitii eena too lpisia nikipuonu aairrugokino iyie. Eikipuo ninche aasai iyie ejo, ‘Etii Enkai te nebo iyie ake, meetae ae Ai neme ninye ake.’ ”
Kesipa ira iyie Enkai naisudoo kewan, iyie na Ai e Israel, Olaitajeunoni.
Eitukurruaki ninche pooki netusulaki, ore lelo aitobirak loo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nepuo to lmilo te nebo.
Kake eitajewuo Olaitoriani Israel, te njeunoto oo ntarasi; mikintukurruni iyie nimikisuli o kenya.

Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo oitobira shumata - ninye Enkai! Ilo oitobirua enkop neitayu (ninye oitotona; eitu ninye eitobir olmuaate, eitayio ninye pee emanyi!): “Kara nanu Olaitoriani nemeetae likae.
Eitu apa nanu airo too nkurrat, tiatua ewueji nemisimis; eitu apa nanu ajoki eishoi e Yakobo, ‘Eng'oruaki to lmuaate.’ Kairo nanu Olaitoriani esipata, naibalunye ina nasipa.
“Enturrurrunye nipuonunu, entinyiku wootu te nebo, intae lo pisiai loo loshon! Meyiolo ninche toki lelo oonap inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye oo nkeek, netoni aaomon ina ai nemeidim aitajeusho.

Iyau lomon linono nimbalunye; nchoo ninche eiguana te nebo! Kaing'ae apa otolimuo ena te musano? Kaing'ae apa oibalunye? Aime nanu Olaitoriani? Nemeetae ae Ai neme nanu, Enkai nairo too sipat naa Olaitajeunoni; meetae ae Ai neme nanu.
“Embelekenyata wootu enatii pee eitajeuni intae; intae ilubot pooki e nkop! Amu kara nanu Enkai, nemeetae ae.
Inosa nanu olmumai te kewan ai, eimua enkutuk ai te sipata ilo rorei lemaaitoki arrinyokino: ‘Ore nanu kaagilakini pooki kung'u, nenya pooki ng'ejep olmumai.’
“Tiatua Olaitoriani ake, epuoi aajo tialo nanu, isipat o engolon. Ore lelo laaiba neitukurruni ninche.
Ore tiatua Olaitoriani kelo ina ishoi pooki e Israel amirisho netum enkitoo.”
Etusulari Beli, neijulujule Nebo, etii inkitanyaanyukot enye shumata ng'uesi o nkishu; ore kuna tokitin ninapinapa naa keiroishi anaa lolan ooek ing'uesi.
Neijulujula ninche, nesulunye te nebo, meidim ninche aataretu ilo ola, kake ore ninye nkorroki enye kepuo eyararoto.
“Toning'oki nanu, na aji e Yakobo, o ele pisiai pooki le nkaji e Israel, apa laatoikioki nanu ebaiki pee eini intae, oowaki apa ebaiki itii nguseti;
ore ninye o te moruao inyi Nanu ake Ilo, ore eiborrita intae lukuny naa kanap intae. Aitobira nanu intae naa kanap intae; kaya nanu intae naa kalo agolie intae.
“Kaing'ae intae kintanyaanyukiekie nikintorisiokiki, nikidutietie intae pee kinyaanyuku?
Ore lelo oobuku saabu too lbenia, neineneng enkosholai too ntemet e nkiroishi naa keiger olkunoni, neitayunye nena enkai; paa keitoki aabatata aaserem!

Nedumu ninche ina kitanyaanyukoto aaiteleiki iloilila lenye, nenap ninye, nepuo aapik ewueji enye, neitasheyie teine, nemeidim ninye ashomo teine. Naa te neishiraki oltung'ani ninye, nemeidim atawaliki, aashu eitajeu ninye te nyamali enye.
Tadamu ena ninguanare, tadamu nkitarruorot inono,
tadamu inapa baa e apa musan; amu kara Olaitoriani nemeetae likae; kara nanu Olaitoriani nemeetae likae laanyaanyukie,
naibalunye nanu mbaa e nkiting'oto te nkiterunoto o ebaiki apa moitie naibalunye nena neton eitu eaku, ajo, ‘Kelo enkiguana ai aitashe, naa kalo nanu aitabaya iyieunot aainei pooki.’
Kaipotu ilo motonyi oinosisho te nkalo o loosaen, o ilo tung'ani le nkiguana ai meeu te nkop nalakua. Airoro nanu naa kaitabaya; kaiguana nanu naa kaas ina.
“Entoning'oki nanu intae ilo ogol onyek, intae kulo oolakuaniki enkordunoto.
Aitataanua nanu enkordunoto ai, meekure elakua, nemeekure eimutie enjeunoto ai; naa kapik nanu enjeunoto atua Sion, te nkaraki Israel ina kitoo ai.”
Tadou iyie totona te nterit na anasa e Babilon; totona te nkop metii olorika le nkitoo, Amu meekure aekata kingili aajo, enasipa osesen naisikarra
Iwa lelo soito ooiutuutishoreki, ndong'u entapa, iwuang'ie ilo karasha limulumulare, intayu ilo kila lino, ting'ishai too nkejek inono, iima atua lkejek talang'a.
Kepuoi aaibalunye ina masipaisho ino, nepuoi aadol enkurruna ino. Kaitalaku nanu elap, nemaleku oltung'ani.
Ore Ilo okordu iyiook - naa Olaitoriani loo lororani, ninye enkarna enye - ninye Ilo Osinya le Israel.
Totona ntirring'ayu, nilo atua enaimin, natito oo Lkaldayo; amu mikingili aekata aajo enkaiguanani oo nkitoriat
Atagorokine apa nanu iltung'ana laainei, aisarkionie nanu enjung'ore ai; aaishorua nanu apik atua nkaik inono, neitu iyie ing'urrie ninche; ore lelo payiani nintanapa iyie olola oiroishi oleng.
Itejo apa iyie, “Kaaku nanu enkaiguanani ntarasi,” ore te nkaraki ina eitu iyie ipik kuna baa atua oltau lino, aashu idamu nkiting'ot enye.
Ore naa taata toning'o ena, iyie ena aisikarrani, ena naton eidipakine, ina najo to ltau lino, “Atii nanu, nemetii ae naaijo nanu; maton nanu anaa enkoliai nemeye nkera aainei.”
Eikitum iyie kuna baa pokira, te nkata nabo, te nkolong nabo; ore keeya oo nkera inono o enkoliasho naa eikitum iyie te nkiputakinoto hoo niata iloibonok kumok o engolon kitok oo lasakutok.
Indipakine apa iyie tiatua entorroni ino, nijo, “Maadolita nanu oltung'ani;” ore eng'eno ino o enkarriyiano ino nikintapong'oyie, nijo iyie to ltau lino, “Atii nanu, nemetii likae.”
Kake kelotu entorroni shumata iyie, nemindim iyie aibooi; kelotu enkidaata shumata iyie, nimindim iyie aitukuoi; nelotu enkidaata enitii nabo kata, neitu aekata idamu.
Ntasho tuunoyu tiatua esakutore ino o lelo oibonok linono kumok, laa ninche itanyamalikia ebaiki kitisho ino; keidimayu pee imirisho, keidimayu pee intureisho.
Inaure iyie te nena kiguanat inyi kumok, nchoo naa ninche eitashe pee kintajeu, lelo oor shumata, ootoni aing'or ilakir, laa ore te nedoli olapa neibonu ina nayooki alotu.
Kesipa eikununo ninche anaa suut, nenya enkima ninche; meidim ninche aaitajeu ate teina golon o lng'ejep le nkima. Mme inoshi kuk kuna naaiji, neme enkima nanyikakinoyu!
Neijia etiu te iyie tialo nena baa apa nitanyamalikia, naa ninche apa iyie imbung'are tiatua enkishui ino pooki; kelo ake oltung'ani aim enkoitoi enye; meetae hoo obo likilo aitajeu iyie.

Toning'o ena, na aji e Yakobo, intae ilooipotieki e nkarna e Israel, lelo oora ile ishoi e Yuda; oonya olmumai te nkarna o Laitoriani, nelimu aaibalunye Enkai e Israel, kake mme te sipata neme te nkitorioroto.
Amu ina anasa sinyati ninche eipotie ate, neisiligie ate ina Ai e Israel; Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye.
“Ore ntokitin e apa naibalunye apa nanu te musano, neipang'u nena aaimu enkutuk ai naisho nanu metayiolouni; naitoki taa nabo kata aas naitabaya.
Kayiolo apa nanu ajo igolong'u iyie, nikigol emurt anaa esekenkei netiu enkomom ino anaa osuyai,

atolimuo apa nanu aibalunye te musano, ore eton eitu ebaya, naaitoning'o iyie aibalakinye, pee milo ake ajo, ‘Enkitanyaanyukoto ai nataasa kuna, ina kitanyaanyukoto ai naguetuni, o ina naipurjuno nayawua kuna.’
“Itoning'o apa iyie; toduaa naa taata kuna pooki; ai milo naa iyie aibalunye? Ore ebaiki ena kata neito idia alo, kaaitoning nanu iyie mbaa ng'ejuko, mbaa naaisudoro neitu aekata iyiolou.
Taata eitobiraki ninche, mme apa; ore apa neitu ae kata iyie ining ninche, pee milo ake ajo, ‘Ng'ura, atayiolo apa nanu.’

Eitu ae kata ining, eitu ae kata iyiolou, ore ebaiki apa eitu ae kata ebolokini enkiok ino. Amu atayiolo apa nanu ajo iasisho iyie te nkeleekisho, naa ore ebaiki pee kiini nira iyie oloipotokoki enkiseroto.
“Ore te nkaraki enkarna ai aibooyie engoro ai, ore te nkaraki enkisisa ai aiwuang'ie nanu te iyie, pee maaiwuang'ie nanu iyie.
Ng'ura ajo aatisila nanu iyie, kake mme anaa enkosholai; aatetema nanu iyie to lkokuet loo nkisilisilot.
Te nkaraki kewan ai, te nkaraki kewan ai ake, ataasa nanu ina, amu kaji eiko pee eisarkionieki enkarna ai? Ore enkitoo ai maisho nanu likae.
“Toning'oki nanu, iyie Yakobo, o Israel, apa laipoto nanu iyie! Nanu ilo, nanu ole dukuya, naa nanu ole siadi.
Enkaina ai nairragie olkitamanyunoto le nkop, naa enkaina ai e tatene naisalaasha oloing'ang'e te naipot nanu ninche, neitashe pooki te nebo.
“Enturrurroto intae pooki pee ining'ining'i! Kalo tiatua ninche apa oibalunye kuna baa? Kenyor Olaitoriani ninye; naa kelo ninye aas eyieunoto o Laitoriani te Babilon, nelo agilunore lelo Kaldayo.
Nanu, ee, nanu oiroro naipotu ninye, ayawua nanu ninye naa kelo ninye adupoyu te nkoitoi enye.

Entinyikakaki nanu, entoning ena: ore ebaiki apa te nkiterunoto eitu nanu airo too nkisudorot, ore ebaiki ina kata apa neewuo ina aaku, atii apa nanu ine.” Ore taata naairriua nanu Olaitoriani Enkai te nebo Enkiyang'et enye.
Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Ilo likikordu iyie, Ilo Osinya le Israel: “Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo likinteng'en iyie tudupoyu, ilo likinkoo iyie te nkoitoi nilo aim.
Oi apa tenaa itoning'o nkitanapat aainei, amu anaata etotiwuo eseriani ino anaa olkeju, netiu esupatisho ino anaa lopir le naiposha;
anaata etaba eishoi ino anaa osinyai, ore lelo litoiwuo iyie nebayu anaa soito lo sinyai; ore enkarna enye nemeiwuang'ieki aekata aashu eishieki te dukuya nanu.”
Shomo tung'uai Babilon, isika ilanya Ilkaldayo, mbalunye ena te mbuakunoto e ng'ida, embalunye ena, nchoo elo abaya ina enkiting'oto e nkop; tejo, “Etokordua Olaitoriani osinka lenye Yakobo!”
Eitu apa ninche etum enkure ina kata erikito ninche aimie ilpurkeli; eishoo enkare meturukunye te nkaraki ninche eing'uaa endapidapoi; etoosho ninye endapidapoi nerukunye enkare.
“Meetae eseriani too ltorrok,” Olaitoriani ojo.
Entoning'oki nanu, intae ilmanien le naiposha, nining'ining'i intae iloreren oolakua. Aaipotuo apa nanu Olaitoriani atii enkoshoke, ore atii enkoshoke e yieyio neipot ninye enkarna ai.
Eitaa ninye enkutuk ai anaa olalem opi, naarrip ninye nanu te nkaina enye; aaitaa ninye nanu embae nayopiroki, naapik atua emootian enye aisudoo.
Naajoki ninye nanu, “ira iyie osinka lai, Israel, laa te ninye aitaae nanu kitok.”
Kake atejo nanu, “Aisiaaishe pesho, ataasishore nanu engolon ai te pesho o to lng'am; kake ore ake eyia, etii esipata ai te nebo o Laitoriani, ore ole koisiayio lai neeta Enkai ai.

Ore taata nejo Olaitoriani, ilo apa laaitobirua nanu te nkoshoke pee aaku osinka lenye, pee ayau nkera oo Siraeli arrinyoki ninye, netumi sii aaiturrurroki Israel ninye, amu aayanyitaki nanu too nkonyek o Laitoriani, netaa Enkai ai engolon ai.”

Ejo ninye, “Entoki nalelek oleng ena nchere iaku iyie osinka lai, pee idumu iloshon le Yakobo nirrinyu lelo ootelekutua le Israel; kaaisho nanu iyie taa ewang'an too loreren, pee etum enjeunoto ai atabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.”

Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo okordu Israel naa Ilo Sinyati, ajoki ilo otemenayioki oleng too ltung'ana, ilo oiba oleng iloshon, ilo sinka loo laitoriak: “Eikidol ilaiguanak nedumunye; ore ilarikok nikirugokino, te nkaraki Olaitoriani oisiligayu ninye, Ilo Sinyati obo le Israel, laa ninye likitegelua iyie.”

Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore te nkata naishiaa aatang'amayie nanu iyie, ore te nkolong e njeunoto aatareto nanu iyie; aatorripo nanu iyie naaishooyo aaitaa olning'o too ltung'ana, pee idumu ena kop, pee ioriki enjung'ore lelo ooliyio;
nijoki lelo ooena, ‘Entupuku,’ nijoki lelo ootii enaimin, ‘Entaliooto.’ Nepuo ninche aadaa too mbat oo nkoitoi, ore nkisiashat pooki naaika neaku endaata enye.
Mepuo ninche aatum esumash o enkure, nemeitoki olkutati anaa enkolong napi aar ninche, amu ore ilo oing'urrie ninche naa ninye olo arikoo ninche, naa too nchorroi oo nkariak erikoo ninche.
Naitaa nanu ildoinyo laainei pooki enkoitoi, ore nena oitoi aainei kituaak naa keilepieki shumata.
Ng'ura ajo kepuonu kulo eing'uaa enelakua, nepuonu kulie eing'uaa moikuape, neing'uaa oloo ntoluo, neing'uaa kulie enkop e Sinim.”
Taranyisho te ng'ida, iyie shumata, nishipayu na kop; entaranyisho intae lo doinyo! Amu eitagolo Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, naa kelo aing'urrie lelo apa ooisilisiloki.
Kake etejo Sion, “Aaiturrayie nanu Olaitoriani, meekure aadamu Olaitoriani lai.”
“Keidim atorikinoyu enkitok enkerai enye nanakita, eji metaa meitoki aing'urrie ina kerai e nataoiwuo openy?” Ee keidim atorikinoyu, kake maarikino nanu iyie.
Ng'ura ajo aatisira nanu too ndapi oo nkaik aainei, etii isunta inono anaake dukuya nkonyek aainei.
Etumuruto ilashetak linono lelo apa likitigila, ore apa lelo likintomijoon nikipuo aaing'uaa iyie.

Tushumu nkonyek inono ntamanai ing'orisho; eiturrurrote pooki, nepuonu ninche enitii. Ore anaa enaishu nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, ilo iyie aishop ninche pooki anaa emasaai, nienikino ninche anaa enaenikino esiankiki narikori imasaa enyena.
“Kesipa ore ilmuateni linyi o wuejitin apa neetomijono o ina kop inyi apa nainyalaki - naa kepuo aapiriku te lelo oomany; ore apa lelo ootoijoitie intae naa kelamari oleng.
Ore nena kera apa naatoiwuoki te nkata o sina, nepuo sii ninche aajo ining'itoto, ‘Kepirik ene wueji te nanu; ing'urakaki ewueji namany.’

Nilo ajo to ltau lino: ‘Kaing'ae laatoikio nanu kuna? Aatung'uayioki apa aa nanu ake nara olupi, nashomo eyararoto naayae enelakua, kake aing'ae naitubulua kuna? Aatung'uayioki apa aa nanu ake; Kaji naa eimutua kuna?’ ”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Kailepakinye nanu iloshon enkaina ai, naisho olmonekie lai iloreren; neyau ninche ilayiok linyi too lgooitie lenye, ore intoyie inyi nepuoi aanap too loilila lenye.

Kepuo ilaiguanak aaku loo papaai linyi ooitubulu intae, ore nkaiguanak enye neaku ninche naaing'or intae aaitoti. Neitabaiki ninche nkomomi enye enkop eirrugokino intae, nemej ina terit oo nkejek inyi. Nilo taa ayiolou nchere kara nanu Olaitoriani; ore lelo laanyu nanu nemeitukurruni.”
Keidimi aawaita entoki naibung'ita ilo ogol, anaa keidimi aawaita ilo oibung'aki otii nkaik e ilo torrono?
Kesipa, Olaitoriani ojo: “Ekeidimi ninye aawaita lelo ooena le ilo ogol, neidimi aatokordu ina naibung'ita ologol, amu kagilunore nanu lelo oogilunore intae; naa kaitajeu nanu nkera inyi.

Kaisho nanu lelo ooitorogony intae metumutakinoto maate aara, nemera eok isargeta lenye anaa ilootooko enaisho oo sabibu. Netum taa pooki toki naishu atayiolo nchere kara nanu Olaitoriani, Olaitajeunoni linyi, nara ilo Okordu intae, Ilo Magilani le Israel.”

“Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Amaa tenaa kataarayie iltung'ana laainei anaa enaara olmoruo enkitok enye, koree naa empalai nataarieki enkiyama? Anaa kalo te lelo laatakinore esile apa atimiraka intae? Te nkaraki ntorrok inono apa pee kitimiraki iyie, naa te nkaraki engilata ino oo nkitanapat apa pee etaarayioki ng'utunyi.

Kainyoo naa, amaa apa pee alotu, keitu ninye ainepu oltung'ani obo? Amaa pee aipotisho, aimeetae ninye oltung'ani oirukisho? Keitodorropaki enkaina ai eji metaa meidim atokordu likae? Anaa aimaata nanu engolon naitajeunye? Ore te nkisikong'are ai, naitoi nanu enaiposha, naitaa nanu ilkejek enkop natoyio; neng'uoyu isinkir lenye etalaita enkare, neye te nkure.
Kaitomisimis oloing'ang'e, naishopoki ilkuniyiani lo lkiyioi.”

Aaishoo nanu Olaitoriani Enkai olng'ejep te nkaraki lelo ooiteng'eni, pee atum nanu aitagolo to rorei ilo otalepori. Ore anaake tadekenya, naaputu ninye matoning'o te nkiok ai, matoning'o anaa lelo ooiteng'eni.
Etabolo Olaitoriani Enkai enkiok ai, neitu nanu agolong'aki; eitu nanu arrinyo siadi.
Aishoo nanu enkoriong lelo ooshisho, naisho isederi lelo laayiet olmunyei; eitu nanu aisudoo enkomom ai pee maasuli anaa aanotakini.
Amu Olaitoriani Enkai laaret nanu; ore te nkaraki ina, eitu nanu aing'aeng'ae neaku aitirring'e nanu, nayiolo nanu ajo maaitukurruni nanu.
Ore ilo laailepie nanu naa ketaana. Kalo laagilunore nanu maitasheikinoto te nebo? Kalo olmang'atinta lai? Nchoo ninye aalotu anyikaki.
Olaitoriani Enkai laaret nanu; kalo laadung'oki nanu enkiguana? Keishunye ninche pooki anaa enkila: kenya ninche olasai.
Kalo tialo intae oure Olaitoriani neiruk oltoilo lo sinka lenye, lelo oopuonu te naimin metii ewang'an, kake ore eyia, neisilig enkarna o Laitoriani neigarakino Enkai enye?

Ore intae pooki ooinok enkima, lelo ooinok ilkilang'ilang'eta! Ipuopuo te wang'an e nkima inyi, o te lelo kilang'ilang'eta linuaa intae! Ipuopuo intae aatum ena te nkaina ai: ipuopuo intae aairrag to sina le mion.
“Entoning'oki nanu intae ilooing'oru enkordunoto, intae kulo oing'oru Olaitoriani; eng'ura intae ina dapidapoi apa naa ninye etaguetunyeki intae, o ina gumoto oo soito apa natuturunyeki intae.
Eng'ura Abraham papaai linyi o Sara apa natoiwuo intae; amu ore apa eton aa nabo aipotuo nanu ninye, namayian nanu ninye naitaa kumok.

Kelo Olaitoriani aitagol Sion; nelo aitagol nene wuejitin pooki apa neeinyalaki, neitotiu ilo purkel lenye anaa Eden, netiu ilo purkel anaa enkurma o Laitoriani; keaku eng'ida o enchipai etumi tiatua ninye, o enkishooroto e nashe o ltoilo lo sinkolio.
“Entoning'oki lo tung'ana laainei, nikinchosho nanu enkiok, lo orere lai; amu kelotu enkitanapata naing'uaa enatii, o esupatisho naaku ewang'an too ltung'ana.
Kenyiku enkordunoto ai asieku, eeuo enjeunoto ai, naa kelo enkaina ai aitore iloreren, nanu eanyita lelo ootii ilmanien le naiposha, naa enkaina ai eisiligita ninche.

Entudumu nkonyek inyi eng'ura shumata, nirrugogo aaing'or enkop ti abori; amu keish shumata anaa empuruo, neish enkop anaa olkila, ore lelo oomanya ninye naa keye anaa lojong'a; kake keaku enjeunoto ai enoo ntarasi, ore ina kordunoto ai nemeish aekata.
“Entoning'oki nanu intae ilooyiolo esipata, kulo tung'ana ootii enkitanapata ai iltauja lenye; emiureyu imorot oo ltung'ana, niming'aeng'ae te neinyal intae nesukeny.
Amu kenya ninche olasai anaa nkilani, nenya ninche olkurto anaa ilpapit loo nkerra; kake ore enkordunoto ai naa enoo ntarasi, ore enjeunoto ai naa enoo ishoritin pooki.”
Tudumunye, tudumunye, ntagoluoyu, Na golon o Laitoriani; tudumunye anaa apa, te nena ishoritin e apa moitie. Aime iyie apa otudung'udung'o ina kukuuu e naiposha naji Rahab aitaa ndung'ot?
Aime iyie apa oitoyio enaiposha, nena ariak e ine wueji kitok negut; aime iyie apa oitaa enguton e naiposha enkoitoi, pee etum lelo ootokorduaki aaima?

Naa keshukunye lelo ooinyang'ua Olaitoriani aapuonu Sion eranyisho; nelotu eng'ida nemeeta enkiting'oto shumata lukuny enye; kepuo ninche aang'amu eng'ida o enchipai, ore osina o somit nepuo aailanyisho.
“Nanu, nanu ilo oitagol intae ira iyie ng'ae eji metaa iure oltung'ani laa keye, ina kerai e tung'ani naitayioki anaa nkujit,

nikirikino Olaitoriani, Ilo likintobirua, Ilo laa ninye oisalaasha oloing'ang'e nepik olkitamanyunoto le nkop, niureishoyu endama pooki te nkaraki ina goro napi e ilo oitorogonyisho, ina kata te nelotu ninye amutisho? Koree naa ina goro napi e ilo oitorogonyisho?
Ore ilo oibookoki enkop naa kelaari nabo kata; meye ninye nedou alo atua engumoto, nemeishunye aekata endaa enye.
Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo oputu enaiposha o metaa keikurrukur ilopir lenyena - Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye.
Natipika nanu irorei laainei enkutuk ino, naaisudoo iyie tiatua oloip le nkaina ai, naisalaash oloing'ang'e naitobir olkitamanyunoto le nkop, najoki Sion, ‘Irara intae iltung'ana laainei.’ ”
Tushumunye, tushumunye, ntasho, iyie Yerusalem, iyie anaa ina natookishe te nkaina o Laitoriani teina kikompe e ngoro enye, iyie enatookishe to lbakuli amera, niyukuyukori.
Meetae hoo obo orikoo ninye tiatua lelo ayiok pooki ooitoiwuo; meetae oltung'ani oibung enkaina tiatua lelo ayiok pooki ooitubulua.
Kitijing'a kuna tabo pokira are - kaing'ae likintigir iyie? - Eliyio o enkidaata, o lameyu o lalem; kaing'ae likintagol iyie?
Eiterritia ilayiok linono, eirragaa te dukuya pooki oitoi anaa entarakuet natijing'a orreshet; ebore ninche engoro o Laitoriani, ina kisikong'ata e Nkai ino
Ore te nkaraki ina, entoning ena, intae kulo ooinosa osina, kulo ootemerate neme te naisho:
Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani Enkai ino Ilo ogolie ltung'ana lenyena: “Ng'ura ajo aiwuang'ie nanu te nkaina ino ina kikompe e merai nikiyukuyukie; ina bakuli e ngoro ai mingil aekata iyie aok;
naa kalo nanu apik inkaik e lelo aisilisilok linono, lelo apa likitiakita, ‘Irrugoyu pee kitum iyiook aashom’; nintotiu iyie enkoriong ino anaa enkop netiu anaa enkoitoi naaim ninche.”
Tuputunye, tuputunye, ntagoluoyu iyie Yerusalem; nchopo lelo kilani linono sidain, iyie Sion, na anasa sinyati, amu meigil aekata alotu enitii ilo lememurata o ilo oiduruk.
Mpiripiroi ina terit natii osesen lino, tuputunye; iyie ena naena, Yerusalem; ntololong'a nena keenta naatii emurt ino, iyie Yerusalem.
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Etimiraki apa intae pesho, naa kepuoi sii aakordu intae metii enkinyang'a.
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Etang'asa apa iltung'ana laainei aadoyio aapuo Misiri aamany ine, neisomit lelo le Asiria ninche pesho.
Amaa naa taata kainyoo nanu aata teine, Olaitoriani ojo, idolita ajo ewaki iltung'ana laainei pesho? Kedar lelo aitoriak lenye, Olaitoriani ojo, ore endama pooki anaake nemenaa ninche enkarna ai.
Ore te nkaraki ina kepuo iltung'ana laainei aayiolou enkarna ai; neaku ore teina olong naapuo ninche aayiolou nanu ilo oirorita; nele nanu.”

Kebaa esidano tenidol ilelo ooyau ilomon supati too nchumat oo ldoinyo, lelo oolimu aaibalunye eseriani, lelo ooyau ilomon supati le seriani, lelo oolimu aaibalunye enjeunoto, lelo oojoki Sion, “Enkai ino naitoreisho.”
Entoning ilarripok linyi eilepie iltoiloishi lenye, eranyisho ninche te nebo te ng'ida; amu etoduaa ninche too nkonyek ina rrinyunoto o Laitoriani elotu Sion.
Entijing pooki osinkolio te nebo, intae iwuejitin apa neeinyalaki e Yerusalem; amu eitagolo Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, etokordua ninye Yerusalem.
Etudumua Olaitoriani engolon sinyati te dukuya nkonyek oo loshon pooki; naa kedol ineeiting'ie enkop pooki enjeunoto e Nkai ang.
Enchom, enchom, empang'a enchom idie, eminyikaki ake entoki nemesinya; empang'a entung'uai ninye, entisinya ate, intae lelo oonapita imasaa o Laitoriani.
Amu mipuopuo intae te nkisarrisar, nimipuopuo te nkisikata, amu Olaitoriani olo te dukuya intae, naa Enkai e Israel naing'or intae te siadi.
Ng'ura ajo kelo osinka lai adupoyu, keitaae ninye kitok neilepieki, naa kelo ninye shumata oleng.
Ore anaa enaing'asiate ilkumok te nkaraki ninye - ore emua enye, neibelekenya, aaku menyaanyukie enkomom o ltung'ani, ore empukunoto enye neibelekenya arruoyo alang ene tung'ani.
Neaku keing'asiayie ninye iloshon kumok; nenuka ilaiguanak nkutukie te nkaraki ninye; amu ore ina neitu elikini ninche naa kepuo aadol, ore ina neitu aekata ening nepuo aayiolou.
Kaing'ae otonyorrayie ina nikitoning'o? Naa ae ng'ae otoduaa engolon o Laitoriani tena?

Amu etubulua ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani anaa enkaitubului kiti, o anaa entonai te nkop natoyio; meeta ninye enkishiaa anaa eneing'ori, eji metaa aikiing'or iyiook ninye, nemeeta esidano eji metaa eiking'uar.
Etanyaita apa nemenaa iltung'ana ninye, oltung'ani loo sinaitin ninye netamoo osina; ore anaa obo lemeyieu iltung'ana neing'or, netemenayioki, neitu iyiook kishilaa ninye.
Kesipa etanapa ninye emion ang nenap isinaitin lang; ore ake eyia nikidol ninye etooshoki, etoosho ninye Enkai, neisilisil.

Kake etipikaki ninye olbae te nkaraki nkitarruorot ang, eitamorroojoki ninye te nkaraki ntorrok ang. Shumata ninye etii enkitamioto naa ninye naishiunye iyiook, naa too oshot enyena eishiunyeki iyiook.
Kitiu iyiook pooki anaa nkerra naaimina, kishomo aaidapashari; kimbelekenyakinote oltung'ani ake enkoitoi enye; neiteleikia Olaitoriani shumata ninye entorroni ang pooki.

Eitorogonyaki apa ninye neisilisili, kake eitu ebol enkutuk enye; ore anaa olkuoo le ker opuoi aayieng, o anaa enker natii dukuya lelo oodung ilpapit lenyena, mebol enkutuk, neijia sii apa eikuna ninye, eitu ebol enkutuk.

Ore te nkitorogonyata e ndung'okinoto e nkiguana, newaki ninye; naa ore to lporror lenye aing'ae otishilayie, nchere eiwuang'ieki ninye teina kop e lelo ooishu, etooshoki te nkitarruoroto oo ltung'ana laainei?
Neitobir ninche enkurare enye te nebo lelo arruok etunukayioki ninye te nebo ilkarsisi, hoo duoo ninye nemeeta entorroni nataasa, neitu aekata ejo elejare te nkutuk enye.

Kake eyieunoto apa Olaitoriani pee epik ninye olbae; etipika Olaitoriani ninye osina; neitaa ninye kewan olasar loo ng'ok, nelo adol eishoi enye, neitoodori nkolong'i enyena; kelo eyieunoto o Laitoriani adupoyu te nkaina enye;
kelo ninye adol ilng'anayio le mion o ltau lenye neshipayu; ore te yiolounoto enye ilo osipa, ilo sinka lai, keisho ilkumok meikenakini isipat; naa kenap ninye nkitarruorot enye.

Ore te nkaraki ina kaoriki ninye erubata te nebo lelo kituaak, neor ninye nena naataaruaki te nebo lelo oogol; te nkaraki natubukoko ninye enkishui enye keeya, neikenakini lelo arruok. Ore te nkaraki ina netanapa ng'ok oo lkumok, neaku oloomonoki lelo aitarruorrok.
“Taranyisho iyie na olupi, ina neitu eisho; tabuaku taranyisho to ltoilo sapuk, iyie ina neitu aekata esaisayu! Amu ore nkera e ina apa naiturrayioki naa eikumok aalang ina nayama, Olaitoriani ojo.
Ntalala ewueji o lng'obor lino, nincho lelo karash le manyisho ino elaari; minunuk, ntoodoro nkeenta inono nintagol incheito inono
amu ilo iyie aponari te tatene o te kedianye, naa kelo eishoi ino aya iloreren nepuo aamany nena anas apa naatung'uayioki.
“Miureishoyu amu mikipuoi aaitukurru; ming'aing'ai amu mikintukurruni; amu mingil aekata adamu enkurruna e kitisho ino, ore ilo sina lino apa ira enkoliai nimingil aekata adamu.
Ilo Likintobira iyie ninye olpayian lino, Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye; naa Ilo Sinyati le Israel Olakordunoni lino, naa keji ninye Enkai e nkop pooki.
Amu kimpoto iyie Olaitoriani, itiu anaa enkitok nataarayioki netum osina to ltau, anaa esiankiki naiturrayioki, Enkai ino najo.
Te rishata dorrop apa aaiturrayie nanu, kake to lng'ur kitok aaiturrur nanu.
Te ngoro nadooyo nanu aisudoyie enkomom ai te iyie, te nkiti rishata, kake te nyorrata oo ntarasi nanu aaing'urrie iyie, Olaitoriani ojo, Ilo akordunoni lino.
“Kelo ena atiu anaa nkolong'i e Noa te nanu: ore anaa apa enainosa olmumai nchere meigil inkariak e Noa aapuonu enkop, ainosa sii olmumai nchere maaigil aekata agorokino, nemaaigil aekata aisikong.

Keidim ildoinyo aaidurra, neidimi aaiwuang'ie ildoinyo, kake melo aekata ina nyorrata ai nauno aing'uaa intae, ore ilo sotua lai le seriani nemeiwuang'ieki, Olaitoriani ojo, ilo oata olng'ur tialo iyie.
“Oi Iyie Yerusalem, ena nainosa osina, ena natara olkutati neitu eitagoli, kairragie nanu isoito linono aitobiraki, naitobir ilkitamanyunot linono too ltoto oogol enkinyang'a ooji safira.
Naitobir nanu iltaleta linono too soito ooji agate, naitobir nchomito inyi too ltoto ooji almasi, naitobir isunta inono pooki too soito oogol e nkiyiang'a.
Ore layiok linono pooki naa Olaitoriani olo aiteng'en, naa kepuo lelo ayiok linono aadupoyu oleng.
Naa kepuoi aaitubul intae te sipata; nipuopuo aalakuaniki olosilisili, amu mintokiki intae aaureishoyu; ore too ntabo, nemenyikaki ninche intae.
Te nedumakino intae likae tung'ani neme nanu eing'uaa ina; ore ilo oba anaa olodumakino intae nebatata te nkaraki intae.
Ng'ura ajo aitobira nanu olkunoni laa ninye okut enkima oo nkuk, neitobiru imasaa o larrabal pee easishoreki. Aitobira sii ilo oitalaku elap pee eidaikie;

meetae iruparen naaitobiraki pee earieki intae naapuo aaku, ore pooki ng'ejep odumakino intae te nkiguana, nintukurrurru. Ena ninye enjung'ore oo sinkan lo Laitoriani naa kailepie nanu ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.”
“Wou pooki ng'ae oata enkure, wootu entook inkariak; wou, iyie ilo lemeeta mpisai inyang'u endaa inosa! Wou, inyang'u enaisho o kule, wou, miata ropiyiani, itum pesho.

Kainyoo pee inchang'itie iropiyiani teina neme endaa? Kainyoo pee inchang'itie ole koisiaayio lino teina nimikiraposh? Toning'oki nanu nias ina naajoki, pee itum ina daa sidai aisul, nishipakino nena naapir.
Irrugokoki nanu enkiok nilotu enatii; toning'o pee etum oltau lino atopuaa; pee aitobir nanu te nebo iyie osotua loo ntarasi, ilo sotua lai ouno te nkaraki Daudi.
Ng'ura ajo aitaa apa nanu ninye shakeni too loreren, pee eaku olarikoni o Laitoreisho too loreren.
Ipuopuo intae aaipotu lelo oreren limiyiololo intae, ore lelo oreren lemeyiolo intae nekuetiki intae, te nkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi o Ilo Osinya le Israel, amu eitaa ninye intae olosho kitok.
“Eng'oru Olaitoriani eton etumoyu, empoto ninye eton etaana;

nchoo ilo torrono epaash nkoitoi enyena torrok, ore ilo lemeas isipat nepal ndamunot enyena; nchoo ninye errinyokino Olaitoriani, pee etum Olaitoriani aing'urrie ninye, nchoo errinyokino Enkai ang, amu kepalaki ninye oleng.
Ore ndamunot aainei neme ndamunot inyi, ore nkoitoi aainei neme nkoitoi inyi, Olaitoriani ojo.
Ore anaa enalakuaniki keper enkop, neijia etiu inkoitoi aainei elakuaniki nkuninyi, o ndamunot aainei elakuaniki ndamunot inyi.
“Ore anaa enadou enchan o enkinuku eing'uaa keper, nemerrinyo kake kepuo aaitashal enkop, neitubulu nkaitubulu, neisho ilanterera lelo oounisho neisho endaa ilo onya,
neijia sii etiu ilo rorei lai oimu enkutuk ai; maarrinyokino nanu erok, kake kelo aitabaya ina nayieu, nelo aitubul ina toki apa nairriwaka.
“Impang'ipang'a intae aapuo te ng'ida, nerikori intae te seriani; ore lelo doinyio o ndoinyio naatii dukuya intae, nebuaku aaranyisho, ore lelo keek pooki li ong'ata neosh inkaik.

Ore erishata nabulu ilkiku naa iltarakua oobulu, ore erishata nabulu endiati naa olchani onyaanyukie olarrashi ore ena to Laitoriani naa kelo aaku entoki nadamuni, olmonekie loo ntarasi lemeiwuang'ieki aekata.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Embung'a esipata niasiasa nena sidain, amu kelotu enjeunoto ai asieku, ore enkordunoto ai neibalunyeki.
Kemayiana ilo tung'ani oas ena nemayiana ilo oibung akurraki Sabato, nemeisarkionie, neibooyo kewan pee meas entorroni ake pooki.”
Mincho ake ilo leeiking'a oewuo aibung'are Olaitoriani ejo, “Kesipa kaakepu nanu Olaitoriani too ltung'ana lenyena.” Naa mincho ake ilo sunash ejo, “Kara olchani otoyio.”
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore lelo sunashi oogelema ooibung Sabato ai, lelo oogelu mbaa naaitiship nanu neibung aakurraki olning'o lai lo sotua,
naa kalo nanu aisho tiatua enkaji ai o tiatua isunta e nkaji ai, entoki nadamunyeki sidai nalang ilayiok o ntoyie; kaisho nanu ninche enkarna oo ntarasi nemeiwuang'ieki aekata.

“Ore lelo tung'ana leeiking'a oopuonu aaibung'are Olaitoriani pee eisiaai ninye, pee enyorru enkarna o Laitoriani, pee eaku isinkan lenyena, ore pooki ng'ae ooibung Sabato, nemeisarkionie ninye, neibung olning'o lai lo sotua akurraki

kariku nanu kulo Sion, ilo doinyio lai sinyati, naisho nanu ninche meting'idata tiatua ina aji ai e nkomono; ore lelo asarri lenye oopejori o nkishorunot enye, naa kepuoi aang'amaa te nchumata ilo perere lai lo lasar; amu kepuoi aajo enkaji ai enkaji enkomono too loreren pooki.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ilo oiturrur lelo apa ooiturrayioki le Israel, kaigil nanu aiturrur kulikae te nebo lelo ooidipaki aaiturruro.”
Na ng'uesi kuna pooki e ong'ata wootu enosa - kuna ng'uesi e ntim pooki.
Aimodook ilarripok lenyena naa ilmoda pooki; ildiein oomoda ninche pooki, meidim aatabuak, ooidetidet eirrag oonyor aaimugo.
Keeta lelo diein enkului kitok, meraposho aekata ninche. Ore sii lelo shekuti naa kemoda; eibelekenyakinote pooki nkoitoi enye maate, oltung'ani enkoitoi enye nadupore, neijia eikuna pooki.
Nejo ninche, “Wootu”, “Matook enaisho, maitaraposho ate te naisho napi; ore taaisere naa ketiuu anaa ena olong, keaku kitok alus.”
Keidak iltung'ana supati nemeetae oltung'ani oshilaa; eiwuang'ieki lelo tung'ana le Nkai aaya, enemetii oltung'ani oyiolo, amu ewaki ilo tung'ani supat aaitung'uaa entorroni.
Ore lelo oopuo te supatisho nejing ninche atua eseriani; neyeng'iyeng'a ninche too rruatin enye.
Kake ore intae, entinyiku wootu ene, intae ilayiok loo lasakutok, eishoi oo looibor onyek o mulayoni.
Kaing'ae ilo linguranienie intae? Kaing'ae ilo libolokiki nkutukie aakueniki, nintarasusu ilng'ejepa? Aimirara intae inkera e nkitarruoroto, eishoi e lejare,
intae lelo ooata enkiyupuyup o lng'uarra tiatua lkeek, ti abori pooki shani onyori; intae lelo ooyieng inkera enye too erat, ti abori indapidapo sapuki?
Atua lelo soito oopuyiapui lo earata ninye erubata ino; ninche, eluaata ino; amu ninche iyie itubukoko olasar ooki, iyaua iyie olasar le ntapa. Kaaitiship nanu kuna tokitin?
Shumata oldoinyo oado etii erruat ino, naa ine iyie ilepa alo aitayu olasar.

Ore te njoolata e kutuk aji o ng'apeta e kutuk aji nitipika iyie nkitanyaanyukot inono; amu kitung'uaitie, niwuang'ie ilkarash loo ndapashi inyi, nikedikede intae nena rruatin dapashi; nipuopuo intae aainyang'a maate o ninche, nitonyorra intae ina dapash enye, ning'ura intae ina masipaisho.
Itudumunye iyie alo aserem enkai naguetuno naji Molek iata eilata, niponaa iyie enkorropil ino, nirriwaa iyie olkilikuai lino enelakua, nirriwaa enelakua omeshomo enemeneng'a.
Iteekenye iyie te nkadoro e lototo ino, kake eitu iyie ijo, “Metii osiligi”; inoto iyie enkishui ng'ejuk nikinyaaka aitagol, neaku eitu iyie interre.
Kaing'ae apa ilo liurere, neaku itelejishe, neitu kidamu nanu, eitu ninye kipik indamunot? Keitu nanu ang'iri ena kata pooki, neitu ake kiureyu nanu?
Kalikioo isipat inono o yasat inono, kake mikiret.

Ti ninchir iyie, nchoo ilo sototi lino loo nkitanyaanyukot mikitokordu! Kenap ninche osiwuo aya, keya ninche enkiyang'et. Kake ore oloisudori tiatua nanu naa kelo aya ina kop, nelo ajung ilo doinyo lai sinyati.
Naa kepuoi kenya aajo, “Teshetu, teshetu, ntobira enkoitoi, iwuang'ie pooki toki naikobisho te nkoitoi oo ltung'ana laainei.”

Amu nji ejo ilo otii shumata osinya, ilo obik intarasi neji enkarna enye Osinyati: “Aamanya nanu ewueji e shumata sinyati te nebo ilo oata oltau supat obor, pee etum aitopiu enkiyang'et e ilo obor, neitopiu oltau le ilo supat nebor.
Amu magilunore nanu ninche ntarasi, nemagorokino nanu ninche anaake; amu nanu eimu enkiyang'et, naitobira nanu ina kiyang'et e nkishui.
Te nkaraki eng'oki enye o lorok apa pee atagore nanu, atoosho nanu ninye, naisudoo enkomom ai te ngoro, kake eshomo ninye siadi aitalaaya too nkoitoi o ltau lenye makewan.
Atoduaa nanu nkoitoi enyena, kake kaishiunye nanu ninye; karikoo nanu ninye naitagol ninye, naitigir lelo ooishir.
Eseriani to lolakua o to lotaana, Olaitoriani ojo; naa kaishiunye nanu ninye.
Kake ketiu ilo torrono anaa enaiposha nailugo, ore enkare enye neilugu isuut o esarng'ab.
Meetae eseriani too larruok, Olaitoriani ojo.”
“Teyietu nchira, nimigira, tabuaku ilepunye oltoilo lino anaa entarumpeta; mbalakinye iltung'ana laainei nkitarruorot enye, mbalakinye Isiraeli ing'ok enye.

Ore eyia, kaaing'oru ninche anaake, neng'ida ninche te neyiolou nkoitoi aainei, eji netiu anaa olosho oas isupati, leitu epuo aaing'uaa nkiguanat e Nkai enye; kaaikilikuan ninche nkiguanat naasipa, neng'ida ninche etaaniki Enkai.

‘Kainyoo pee kiteena iyiook ate, aaitupukoo? Nimidol iyie. Kainyoo pee kintoborro iyiook ate, neitu iyie ishilaa ina?’ Ng'ura, ore te nkolong e enata ino, ning'oru iyie murruna ino makewan, nintorogony ilaisiaayiak linono pooki.
Ieniene intae ate pee itumokiki aailepilepa nintayuyu olarrabal. Ore eenata naaijo ena inyi ena olong, nemeisho iltoiloishi linyi metoning'i te shumata.

Kena enata empukuroto ategelua nanu, ina olong naitobor oltung'ani kewan? Ke nkolong nairrug oltung'ani endukuya enye anaa enkujita, neisalaash ilkuniyiani o nkuruon ti abori ninye? Ilo iyie ajo ena eenata e mpukuroto, naa enkolong nang'amaroyu to Laitoriani?
“Aime ena eenata e mpukoroto nategelua nanu: pee elaari ienat e ntorroni, neitololong'i nkeenta e nchata too murto, ore ilo oitorogonyaki nelaari meshomo, negili pooki shata oo murto?
Aime pee ing'arie endaa ino ilo oisumash, niyau ilo aisinani lemeeta ang atua enkaji ino; ore pee idol ilo lemeishopo ninchop, neme pee isudoo kewan te lelo tung'ana laaijo iyie?
Netum taa ewang'an ino atotiwuo anaa enkakenya, ore enkishiunoto ino nelotu asieku; ore esupatisho ino nelo te dukuya ino, ore enkitoo o Laitoriani neaku ninye nikirrip te siadi.
Tinimpotisho iyie, nikiwaliki Olaitoriani; ore pee inchiru iyie eretoto, nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.” “Tiniwuang'ieng'ie tiatua ate enkitorogonyareo o pooki mena o pooki rorei le nkarruoisho,
ti nipukokiki intae maate lelo ooisumash, nintaraposhosho eyieunoto e ilo oata osina, netum taa ewang'an inyi ailepu te naimin ore emisimisi inyi netiuu anaa enkipirata e nkolong.

Nikirikoo iyie Olaitoriani anaake, nikintaraposh Olaitoriani iyieunot inono too mbaa sidain, neitagol iloik linono, nitiu iyie anaa enkurma natubukokoki enkare, nitiu anaa enchorro e nkare, nemeishunye aekata.
“Ore wuejitin inono apa naaidaikieki nesheti; naa ilo iyie adumu olkitamanyunoto loo ishoritin kumok; nikipuoi aajo olaramani too lusien olaitobirani loo nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa.

“Ntisinya enkolong e sabato. Tapaasha isiaaitin inono te nkolong ai sinyati, nintaa iyie Sabato enkolong e nchipai o enkolong sinyati o Laitoriani nayanyiti; ti niyanyitu iyie ina olong, nimilo too nkoitoi inono makewan, anaa ing'oru enchipai ino makewan, anaa iro mbaa e pesho;

nitumoki taa atishipakinoyu ina olong o Laitoriani, naaisho nanu iyie shomo too wuejitin e shumata e nkop; naaitoti nanu iyie teina jung'ore e Yakobo papaai lino, amu enkutuk o Laitoriani nairoro kuna.”
Kasip inchere eitu edorropu enkaina o Laitoriani eji metaa meekure eidim aitajeu, anaa eitoming'anaki enkiok enye, eji metaa meekure ening'isho;
kake entorroni inyi nayawua eoro, te rishata inyi o Enkai inyi, naa ng'ok inyi naaisudoitie enkomom enye te intae, o metaa meekure ening intae.
Amu eisarkionieki inkaik inyi to sarge neisarkionieki ilkimojik linyi te ntorroni; eiroro nkutukie inyi elejare, neitobiru ilng'ejepa linyi entorroni.
Meetae hoo obo olo enkiguana te sipata, meetae ololo aiguana te sipata, osayia le pesho eng'idare ninche, neiro elejare, neipiru ninche esuujisho neyau entorroni.
Neiu ninche ilmosor le nturbubua neitobiru ninche orreshet te nkaji e surusuri; ore ilo onya lelo mosor neye, ore ilo mosori odanyi nedanyuni olasurai.
Ore lelo rresheta ooshetu ninche nemeaku inkilani, meimulumul iltung'ana ate te nena naaitobiru ninche. Ore esiaai enye naa esiaai e ntorroni, netii nkiasin o larrabal inkaik enye.
Nekuetiki nkejek enye enkarruoisho, neisarisaraki aaibukoo osarge lemeeta entioto; ore ndamunot enye naa ndamunot e nkarruoisho, eliyio o enkidaata naatii nkoitoi enye.
Meyiolo ninche nkoitoi e seriani, nemetii esipata nkoitoi enye; meetae oloim nena oitoi oyiolo eseriani.
Ore te nkaraki ina kelakuaniki iyiook esipata, nemeinepu aekata iyiook esupatisho; king'oru iyiook ewang'an, naa ng'ura, enaimin kitum, king'oru ewang'an kake te misimisi kipuo.

Nikirrapirrapu iyiook esuntai kipuo anaa iltung'ana modook, nikirrapirrapisho anaa iltung'ana lemeeta nkonyek; nikirrorro dama nikitiuu anaa iloopuoito te nkinuku, ore tiatua lelo tung'ana oogol kitotiutuo anaa iltung'ana ootuata.
Kinkurrukur pooki anaa ilng'arurum le ntim nikinchir aayietu anaa nturkuluoni; niking'oru esipata, kake meetae, niking'oru enjeunoto, kake kelakuaniki iyiook.
Amu etoponari nkitarruorot ang te dukuya iyie, ore ing'ok ang neishakenoki iyiook; ore nena kitarruorot ang netii te nebo iyiook, nikiyiolo iyiook intorrok ang;
kitigila nkitanapat nikiany Olaitoriani, nikimbelekenyate aaing'uaa esujata Enkai ang, kiimaki enkitorogonyare o engolon e nkong'u, nikidamu too ltauja nikiro ilomon le lejare.
Eibelekenyaki esipata, ore esupatisho netalakuana; amu eimina esipata too umat oo ltung'ana, ore enkitoriori nemetumi.
Metii esipata, ore ilo oiwuang'a te ntorroni nepik kewan batisho. Etoduaa Olaitoriani ina, neitu eitiship ninye nchere eji meetae esipata.
Etoduaa ninye ajo metii oltung'ani, neing'asia pee edol ajo meetae oltung'ani omitu ilo oitorogonyitae, neaku enkaina enye kewan nayaka ninye enkisulata, ore esipata enye neitasheyie ninye.
Eishopo ninye esipata anaa enkila o lgoo, neishop enkopiyia e njeunoto te ndukuya enye; neishop ninye ilkilani le lap, neimulumul kewan te mpushuna napi.
Te risioroto oo nkiasin enye elo ninye aitalak ninche, neitalak te ngoro lelo mang'ati lenyena; ore lelo ootii olmanie le naiposha neitalaku te ninche.
Naa kepuo ninche aaureyu enkarna o Laitoriani o enkitoo enye te nkalo o loo ntoluo o metabaiki moikuape, amu kelotu ninye anaa enkare o lkeju nanang'unye
“Naa kelotu ninye Sion anaa olalakunoni too lelo le nkaji e Yakobo ooibelekenya aaing'uaa enkitarruoroto, Olaitoriani ojo.

“Naa ore tialo nanu, ele olning'o lai lo sotua o ninche, Olaitoriani ojo. Ore ina kiyang'et ai natii shumata iyie o lelo rorei laainei latipika nanu enkutuk ino, nemepuku ninche te nkutuk ino, aashu too nkutukie oo nkera inono, Olaitoriani ojo, ebaiki ena kata neito idia alo o ntarasi.”
Tudumunye, tawang'a, amu eeuo ewang'an ino, negira enkitoo o Laitoriani awang'u te iyie.
Ng'ura ajo kelotu enaimin aiput enkop, neiput enaimin kitok olorere; kake kedumunye Olaitoriani tialo intae, nedoli enkitoo enye te shumata intae.
Naa kepuonu iloshon ina wang'an inyi, nepuonu ilaiguanak ina kitawang'ata e nkilepunoto inyi.
Tushumu iyie nkonyek inono ntamanai, toduaa; eiturrurrote ninche pooki te nebo, nepuonu enitii; kepuonu ilayiok linono eing'uaa enelakua, naa kenapi ntoyie inono too nkaik.
Ore pee idol iyie ina ning'idayu, neiput oltau lino enchipai, amu ore ina kumoi e naiposha naa ekimbelekenyakini iyie, kelotu ina arsisisho oo loshon enitii.
Keimisie intae olorora loo ntamesin, nena tamesin kutiti e Midian o Efa; kepuonu nekua pooki naaing'uaa Sheba. Keyau ninche saabu o enkorropil, neibalunye ninche enkisisa o Laitoriani.

Ore nena luaat pooki oo ntare e Kedar, nikinturrurrokini iyie, ore lelo meregeshi le Neba-iot nikipuo aaisiai iyie; kepuonu ninche eng'amaroyu to lperere lai lo lasar, ore ina aji ai e nkitoo naitaa kitok.
Kakua kulo oopuo tiaai anaa enkatampoi, netiu anaa nturkuluoni eim ilusien enye?

Amu kaanyu nanu ilmanien loo naaiposha, ore nena melin e Tarshishi neng'as aayau lelo ayiok linyi ooing'uaa enelakua, neyau enkosholai enye o saabu enye te nebo ninche, te nkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai ino, o te nkaraki Ilo Osinya le Israel, amu kintaa ninye iyie kitok.
Kepuonu iltung'ana leeiking'a aashet isunta inono, nikipuonu ilaiguanak lenye aaisiai iyie; amu ore apa te ngoro ai naatoosho nanu iyie, kake ore te nyorrata ai naaing'urrie nanu iyie.
Keaku kebolo nchomito inono anaake, dama o kewarie nemeikeni ninche; pee kitum iltung'ana aayaki iyie ina arsisisho oo loshon, eriku ilaiguanak lenye erukunye aapuonu.
Amu ore ilo osho o enkitoria nimikisiai iyie neidaaya; ore lelo oshon naa keidaikieki katukul.
