Kelotu ina kitoo e Lebanon enitii, o lelo keek pooki sidain, pee epuonu aapik esidano ene wueji e nkaji ai; ore ene wueji neitasheyie nkejek aainei naitaa kitok.

Ore layiok le lelo apa ooitorogony intae naa kepuonu enitii eirrugo; ore lelo pooki apa oomen intae nepuonu aairrugo too nkejek inyi; naa keipot ninche intae aajo Na anasa o Laitoriani, Sion e Ilo Sinyati le Israel.
Ore kinturrayioki apa nikimbayuni, nemeetae obo oim atua iyie, kaaitaa nanu iyie kitok te nkishiaa ntarasi, eng'ida oo ishoritin pooki.
Ilo iyie anaku kule oo loshon, nilo iyie anak ilki loo laiguanak, naa ilo ayiolou nchere, nanu, Olaitoriani, Olaitajeunoni lino, naa nanu Olalakunoni, Ilo Magilani le Yakobo.

Ore te rishata o suyai naa kayau nanu saabu, ore te rishata e sekenkei naa kayau nanu enkosholai; ore te rishata e nchata nayau osuyai, ore te rishata oo soito nayau esekenkei. Kaitaa nanu lelo aitasheikinok linono eseriani, naitaa lelo likintore te ngolon esupatisho.
Meigili aekata aaning olarrabal te nkop ino, nemening'i eliyio aashu enkinyala too lpolosien linyi; impotipoto intae isunta inyi aajo Enjeunoto, nijojo nchomito inyi Enkisisa.
Meigil aekata enkolong aaku ewang'an inyi dama, anaa eaku ewang'an o lapa itum kewarie; kake Olaitoriani olo aaku ewang'an ino oo ntarasi, naa Enkai ino naaku enkitoo ino.
Meigil aekata enkolong adoyio te iyie, nemeigil olapa aaku enaimin, amu Olaitoriani olo aaku ewang'an ino oo ntarasi, ore nkolong'i inono e nkishirata neishieki.
Ore iltung'ana linono naa keaku pooki supati; naa keya ninche ena kop aaitaa enenye ntarasi, ina aitubului natuuno nanu, ina siaai oo nkaik aainei, pee aatumi aaitaa kitok.
Ore ilo oti te ninche naa kelo aaku olmarei kitok, ore ilo oti aisul neaku olosho magilani; Kara nanu Olaitoriani; ore te nkata enye naa kaitasieku nanu ina.

Etii Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani Enkai shumata nanu, amu aatubukoko nanu Olaitoriani eilata aput pee ayaki lomon supati lelo aisinak. Aairriwayie ninye nanu pee alo aitagol lelo ootigilate iltauja, pee aibalunye elakunoto te lelo ooena, o emboloroto te lelo ooikenoro te jila.
Pee aibalunye ajo etabawua olari lo Laitoriani, o enkolong e lap e Nkai ang; pee aitagol lelo pooki ooishir;

pee aisho lelo ooishir tiatua Sion - olmarisian te rishata oo nkuruon, o ina ilata e ng'ida te rishata osina, o olkila le nkisisa te rishata e lepori o ltau; pee etumi aatejo ninche ilkeek le supatisho, ina unore o Laitoriani, pee etumi aaitaa ninye kitok.
Naa kepuo ninche aaigil aashet iwuejitin apa neeidaaitie neshetu ninche nene wuejitin apa neetomijoonito, neram ninche nena anas apa naaidaitie, ina mijoonisho oo ishoritin kumok.
Naa keitashe iltung'ana leeiking'a aairrita nkerrai inyi, naa iltung'ana loo loreren oopuo aaku ilaturok linyi o laitobirak loo sabibu;
kake keipoti intae aajo ilapolosak lo Laitoriani, keimaki intae iltung'ana aajo ilaisiaayiak le Nkai ang; ipuopuo intae aanya olkar loo loshon, ore karsisisho enye nipuopuo intae aaisikarrare.

Ore te rishata e nkurruna inyi naa itumutumu intae erubata katitin are, ore te rishata e sulare nipuopuo intae aang'idakino ewueji enye; metaa ore tiatua ina kop inyi naa ipuopuo aatum erubata katitin are, nitumutumu eng'ida oo ntarasi.
Amu ore nanu Olaitoriani naa esipata ayieu, kaiba empurrore o enkitarruoroto; kalo nanu aisho ninche elaakinoto nasipa, nalo aitobir osotua loo ntarasi o ninche.
Ore eishoi enye naa kepuo aaku yiolot tiatua loshon, neyiolouni nkera enye tiatua iloreren; ore pooki oodol ninche neyiolou ninche nchere olorere ele otamayiana Olaitoriani.

Kang'ida nanu oleng tiatua Olaitoriani, keshipa oltau lai tiatua Enkai ai; amu aaishopo ninye nanu to lkila le njeunoto, aaimulumula ninye nanu to lkila le supatisho, anaa oloyamisho te nekus kewan too mporro, anaa esiankiki narikori te neikod kewan too masaa enyena sidain.
Amu ore anaa enaiu enkop inkaitubulu enyena, aashu anaa enaitubulu enkurma entoki natuunokoki neijia eiko Olaitoriani, Enkai; keitubulu esupatisho o enkisisa, te dukuya iloshon pooki.
Ore te nkaraki Sion magira nanu, naa ore te nkaraki Yerusalem mayeng'iyeng'a nanu, o metaba anaa neibalayu esipata enye anaa ewang'an, netiu enjeunoto enye anaa oltaa oilang'isho oleng.
Kepuo iloshon aadol ina kilepunoto e sipata, nedol ilaiguanak pooki enkitoo ino, naa eikipuoi aaisho iyie ina arna ng'ejuk, naa enkutuk o Laitoriani naishoru.
Ilo iyie aaku enkopiyia e nkishiaa te nkaina o Laitoriani, niaku enkishili e nkitoo te nkaina e Nkai ino.

Mikingili aekata aajo “Enaiturrayioki”, nemeigili aekata aajo enkop ino “Olmuaate”; kake keaku eikiji iyi “Enatii eng'ida ai atua ninye”, naa keji enkop inyi “Enayamaki”; te nkaraki nashipakino Olaitoriani intae, ore enkop inyi neaku keyama.
Ore anaa enaayam olmurrani eselenkei, neijia eiko ilayiok linyi keyam intae, ore anaa enang'idakino oloyamisho esiankiki enye, neijia eiko Olaitoriani eng'idakino intae.
Shumata isunta inono iyie Yerusalem, atipika nanu ilarripok; endama pooki o enkewarie pooki, nemegira aekata ninche. Ore intae lelo oodamu Olaitoriani nemiyeng'iyeng'ang'a,
neminchosho ninye enkiyagata o metaba anaa neitasheyie Yerusalem, neitaa ninye enkisisa te nkop.

Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai te nkaina enye e tatene o te nkaina enye magilani, nejo, “Maaigil nanu aishooyo entapa inyi metaa endaa oo lmang'ati linyi, nemeok iltung'ana leeiking'a ina aisho inyi oo sabibu naa ninye itanaurikitia;
kake ore lelo ooikesu ina tapa ninche oonya neisis Olaitoriani, ore lelo oosotu ilng'anayio ninche ook tiatua ilgorien le nkaji ai.”
Shomo iima, shomo iima nchomito, ntobiraki iltung'ana enkoitoi; ntobira, ntobira enkoitoi kitok, iwuang'ie isoito, tudumu olmonekie metoduaa iloreren.
Eibalunye Olaitoriani aitabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop: Tiaaki Yerusalem, “Ng'ura ajo eewuo enjeunoto ino; neeta ninye olerrinyore lenye te nebo ninye neeta olekoisiayio lenye te dukuya ninye.”
Naa keipoti ninche aajo “Iltung'ana sinyat”, “Ilookorduno lo Laitoriani”; naa kepuoi aajo intae “Ilooing'oruaki” enkanasa neitu “Eing'uari”.
Kalo ele olotu eing'uaa Bosara te Edom oishopito ilkilani oonyokie? Kalo ilo olotu eishopo ilkilani le nkitoo, olotu te nkitoo o te ngolon? “Nanu ilo oibalunye esipata, Olmagilani oitajeusho.”
Kainyoo pee enyokioo ilkilani linono, neikununo ilkilani linono anaa ileilo olo aim eneironyieki isabibu?

“Aitunyo nanu enkironyet oo sabibu openy, ore too ltung'ana nemetii hoo obo otaa te nebo nanu; naitunyoo nanu ninche te ngoro ai, naitame nanu ninche te mpushuna ai; ore ilo sarge lenye neisuaakino ilkilani laainei, naaidurukie nanu ilkilani laainei pooki.
Amu etii apa ina olong e lap atua oltau lai, ore ilo ari lai le nkordunoto netabawua.
Aing'ura nanu, kake meetae hoo obo laaretu, naing'asia amu meetae hoo obo laatijing'a enkoriong, neaku te nkaina ai ake anoto enkishuroto, naaitasheyie nanu empushuna ai.
Aitunyoyie nanu olorere te ngoro ai, naitemer nanu ninche te ngoro ai napi, nabukoki nanu osarge lenye enkop.”

Kalimu nanu ina nyorrata o Laitoriani nauno, ina kisisa o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki naaishoo iyiook Olaitoriani o ina supatisho kitok te nkaji e Israel, apa naishoo ninye ninche te risioroto o lng'ur lenye o te risioroto e ina kitoo e nyorrata enye.
Amu etejo ninye, Kesipa iltung'ana laainei ninche, inkera aainei nemeeta elejare; netaa ninye Olaitajeunoni lenye.

Ore to losilisili lenye pooki, neisilisiloki ninye, naa ilo malaika otii te nebo ninye oitajewuo ninche; te nyorrata enye o to lng'ur lenye eitajewuo ninye ninche; etudumua ninye ninche nenap ninche nkolong'i pooki ti apa.
Kake etogolong'utua ninche nepik osina Enkiyang'et enye Sinyati; neaku eibelekenye ninye aaku olmang'atinta lenye, ore ninye openy negilunore ninche.
Neitoki ninye adamu nkolong'i e apa moitie, e Musa ilo sinka lenye. Koree ilo apa oyawua ailepunye te naiposha lelo shekuti loo nkerrai enyena? Koree ilo opik atua ninche enkiyang'et enye Sinyati,
ilo oisho ina aina enye e nkitoo meshomo te nkaina e tatene e Musa, ilo apa otooro nkariak te dukuya ninche, pee eitobiraki kewan enkarna oo ntarasi.
Kaing'ae otorikoyie ninche aimie ine negut? Anaa embarta naimita olpurkel, eitu apa ninche errorro.
Anaa nkishu naadoyio aapuo oerata, eishoo ninche Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani enkiyeng'iyeng'ata. Neaku itorikoyie apa iyie iltung'ana linono, pee intobiraki kewan enkarna e nkitoo.
Ng'ura kop te shumata, toduaa teine wueji ino enkitoo nasinya. Koree olokiyo lino o enkidimata ino? Ore eyieunoto ino o lng'ur lino neiboori te nanu.
Amu ira iyie Papa lang, hoo nemeyiolo iyiook Abraham nemelimu iyiook Israel; ore iyie, Lo Aitoriani, ira Papa lang, ore enkarna ino, Olokordu iyiook ebaiki apa moitie.
Olaitoriani, kainyoo iyie pee incho iyiook matapaash inkoitoi inono nintagol iltauja lang metaa mikiure iyie? Torrinyunye te nkaraki isinkan linono, lelo oshon le njung'ore ino.
Ore lelo tung'ana linono sinyat netujung'o enkaji ino sinyati te nkiti rishata; neitunyo ilmang'ati lang ina aji ino sinyati.
Kitotiutuo iyiook anaa iltung'ana leitu aekata ing'as aitore, kitotiutuo anaa iltung'ana lemeipotieki enkarna ino.
Oi naaji tenaa ipolos oloing'ang'e alotu enkop, pee etum ildoinyo aaikirikirata te dukuya iyie -
neikirikira anaa emoti naitokitok pee eibalieki enkarna ino too lmang'ati linono, netum iloreren aikirikirata te dukuya iyie!
Ore apa pee ias iyie mbaa naaitureisho neitu iyiook king'oru, nidou alotu enkop, neikirikira ildoinyo te dukuya iyie.
Ore ebaiki apa moitie meetae oltung'ani otoning'o, aashu olotumusuo te nkiok, nemeetae olotoduaa te nkong'u Enkai nikinyaanyukie iyie, naasisho te nkaraki lelo ooisilig ninye.

Intoomon iyie ilo oshipakino easata oo supati, lelo likidamu ninche too nkoitoi inono. Ng'ura, itagore apa iyie, nikitaasa iyiook eng'oki; kitobiko iyiook tiatua ng'ok ang te nkata naado, naa amaa, keitajeuni iyiook?
Kitotiutuo iyiook pooki anaa oltung'ani oiduruk, ore esupatisho ang pooki netotiwuo anaa olkila loo lkereu. Kitoito pooki anaa embeneyio netiu entorroni ang anaa osiwuo, nekutaa iyiook aya enelakua.
Ore te nkaraki ina meetae hoo obo oipot enkarna ino, meetae oliking'oru aibung'are, amu isudoyie iyie enkomom ino te iyiook, nitanapua iyie iyiook apik enkaina oo nkitarruorot ang.
Kake ore ake eyia, Olaitoriani ira iyie Papa lang, kira iyiook nkulupuok, nira iyie olaitobirani loo nkulupuok; kira iyiook pooki esiaai oo nkaik inono.
Migorokino iyie iyiook oleng, Olaitoriani, nimidamu nkitarruorot ang ntarasi. Ng'ura, tadamu nchere kira iyiook pooki iltung'ana linono.
Etotiutuo nena anas inono sinyat anaa ong'ata, etotiwuo Sion anaa ong'ata, etaa Yerusalem olmuaate.
Ore ina aji ang sinyati naa sidai, naa atua ninye apa kisisie loo papa, netapejoyioki te nkima, ore nene wuejitin ang pooki sidain neidaaitie.
Imbooyo iyie kewan te kuna baa, Olaitoriani? Eigira iyie nintame iyiook aitulus?
Aanyita nanu maaing'oru lelo apa leitu aaikilikuanu nanu, aanyita nanu maanoto lelo apa leitu aaing'oru nanu, atejo nanu, “Nele nanu, nele nanu,” teilo osho apa leitu eipot enkarna ai.
Aitorioko nanu inkaik aainei endama pooki aipotu olorere oogolong'u, lelo oopuo te nkoitoi nemesidai, esujaa mbaa enye maate;
iltung'ana laaitagor, ninche oas mbususi anaake te dukuya nkonyek aainei, epolosisho tiatua nkurman neinok enkorropil te shumata isoito;
ilootoni ninche too nkuraren, netoni te nkewarie too lnukat lenye; lelo oonya nkiri oo lbitiro, ore motori o lminong netii iltooi lenye;
nejo ninche, “Talamari minyiku, mikinyikaki nanu, amu aaiteng'elaki nanu aaitalam iyie.” Empuruo naimu nkumeishin aainei ena, enkima nayupuyup endama pooki.
Ng'ura ajo eigeroki te dukuya nanu aajo, “Magira nanu, kake kaitalaku nanu, ee, kaitalaku nanu too lgooitie lenye,

te nena kitarruorot enye o too nkitarruorot oo loo menye te nebo, Olaitoriani ojo; te nkaraki apa natapejo ninche enkorropil too nchumat oo ndoinyo, naasukeny ninche nanu te nchumata oo ldoinyo, katemaki nanu ilgooitie lenye elaakinoto oo nkitarruorot enye e apa.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore anaa enatiu isabibu te nkimarrimarrati, nejo iltung'ana, Minyal ninye, amu etii emayianata atua ninye, neijia alo aas te nkaraki osinka lai, nemaidaikie ninche pooki.
Kayau nanu ina ishoi e Yakobo o ene Yuda, lelo ajung'ok lo ldoinyo lai; lelo gelunot laainei oopuo aajung ine, nepuo lelo sinkan laainei aabik teine.
Kelo Sharon aaku endaata oo nkerra, ore Oerata le Akor neaku ewueji neirragie nchoo, e lelo tung'ana laainei laaing'oru nanu.
Kake kaa aitaas intae ilelo ooany Olaitoriani, lelo lemedamu oldoinyo lai sinyati Sion, lelo oooserem enkai na Gadi neisho olasar le naisho enkai naji Meni?

Karewaki nanu intae olalem, nipuopuo intae pooki aairrugokino ilo oar intae entuata; amu ore apa pee aipotisho, neitu irukishosho, ore pee airo, neitu ining'ining'i, kake itaasa intae ina torrono too nkonyek aainei, nitegelutua ina nemaaitiship.”

Ore te nkaraki ina nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Kepuo isinkan laainei aadaa, kake ilo iyie aisumashu; Kepuo isinkan laainei aaokisho, kake ketir intae enkure; Kepuo isinkan laainei aang'idayu, kake kepuoi aaitukurru intae;
Kepuo isinkan laainei aaranyisho te ng'ida o ltau, kake ipuopuo intae aaishir te mion o ltau, niyietutu aaishir te nkaraki emion o ltau.
Ning'ueikiki intae enkarna inyi lelo gelunot laainei meitaa oldeket, naa kear intae Olaitoriani Enkai entuata; kake ore lelo sinkan lenyena naa keipot ninye ti ae arna.

Neaku ore ilo omayian kewan tena kop, nemayian kewan te Nkai e sipata, ore ilo onya olmumai te nkop, nenya te Nkai nasipa; amu meekure edamuni inyamalaritin e apa, neisudoyioki ninche too nkonyek aainei.
“Kaitobiru nanu oloing'ang'e ng'ejuk o enkop ng'ejuk; nemeitokini aadamu ntokitin musana e apa katuk.
Kake tishipayu ning'idayu ntarasi te nkaraki ina naitobiru; amu kaitobiru nanu Yerusalem natii eng'ida, ore lelo tung'ana lenyena neiput enchipai.
Kang'idakino nanu Yerusalem, nashipakino iltung'ana laainei; meigili aekata aaning tiatua ninye oltoilo le nkishirata, anaa olkiyioi lo sina.
Meigil aekata nkera kutiti aaye tiatua ninye, nemeitokini aata iltung'ana kituaak lemebikoo, amu keaku keye enkerai aa enoo larin iip, ore olaing'okoni loo larin iip netum oldeket.
Keaku keshet ninche nkajijik nemany ninche; neun ilkeek loo lng'anayio nenya ilng'anayio lenye.

Meigil ninche aashetisho nepuonu kulikae aamany; nemeigil ninche aaunisho nepuonu ilkulikae aanya; amu ketiu nkolong'i oo ltung'ana laainei anaa nkolong'i o lchani naa kepuo lelo gelunot laainei aashipakino te nkata naado ina siaai oo nkaik enye.
Mepuo ninche aanauru pesho anaa eiu nkera to sina; amu keaku ninche eishoi e ilo omayiana to Laitoriani o nkera enye te nebo ninche.
Ore eton eitu eipotisho ninche nawaliki nanu ninche, ore eton eirorita ninche naning nanu.

Naa kelo olkuoo le ker o osuyiani aadaa te nebo, nenya olng'atuny nkujit anaa olkiteng; neaku enterit endaa o lasurai. Nemeitoki ninche aata batisho anaa einyalisho te ilo doinyo lai sinyati, Olaitoriani ojo.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Olorika lai le nkitoo keper naa ewueji oo nkejek aainei enkop. Kaji eikununo enkaji nikindim ateshetaki nanu? Kaji eikununo ewueji ai nayeng'iyeng'are?
Ore kuna tokitin pooki naa enkaina ai naitobira, metaa inaainei kuna tokitin pooki, Olaitoriani ojo. Kake ele tung'ani nanu aing'oru, ilo obor neirridu to ltau lenye, neikirikira eure ororei lai.

“Ore ilo oyieng olkiteng nenyaanyukie ilo osesekuan oltung'ani; ore ilo opolos olkuoo le ker nenyaanyukie ilo ogil oldia emurt; ore ilo oitarasu olasar le ntapa, nenyaanyukie ilo oitarasu osarge le mbitir; ore ilo oitobir olasar le ndamunoto le nkorropil, nenyaanyukie ilo omayian enkitanyaanyukoto oo nkaitin. Etegelutua kulo nkoitoi enye maate, ore iltauja lenye neshipakino nena baa o lminong.

Kagelaki sii nanu ninche enkitamioto metadoiki ninche, nayau enkuretisho shumata ninche; amu ore apa pee aipotisho, nemeetae hoo obo oirukishe, ore pee airo nanu nemeetae hoo obo laainining'o, kake etaasa ninche ina torrono too nkonyek aainei, negelu ninche nena nemaaitiship nanu.”

Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani, intae lelo ooikirikira te nening ororei lenye: “Etejo lelo alashera linyi ooiba intae, nenang'aki intae auluo te nkaraki enkarna ai, ‘Enchoo meisisi Olaitoriani pee kitum iyiook aatodol eng'ida ino’; kake ninche epuoi aaitukurru.
“Toning'o ina kilepilep te nkanasa! Ilo toilo oing'uaa enkaji e Nkai! Ilo toilo lo Laitoriani, eitalaku elap too lmang'ati lenyena!
“Etiu enkanasa ai sinyati anaa entomononi natoishe eitu ang'as asayusayu?

Kaing'ae aekata otoning'o entoki naikununo nji? Kaing'ae aekata otoduaa ntokitin naikununo nji? Keidimi aatoiu olosho te nkolong nabo? Keidim olosho ataa te nkata nabo? Amu etasaisayia ake Sion nabo kata neiu ilayiok lenyena.
Kaisho nanu ninche metoini nemaretu? Olaitoriani ojo, Amaa, nanu ilo oretu kaiken enguset? Enkai ino najo.
“Ting'idayu te nebo Yerusalem, nishipa te nkaraki ninye, intae pooki oonyor ninye; tishipayu te nebo ninye te ng'ida, intae lelo pooki ooishiraki ninye;
pee itumutumu aatanak niraposhosho, lelo ki lenyena ooitigirisho; pee itumutumu aatook ishipakinono ina kumoi e nkitoo enye.”

Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Kaiputaki nanu ninye enkarsisisho anaa olkeju, naiputaki enkarsisisho oo loshon anaa olkeju odooyo enkare; nipuopuo intae aanak, nenapi intae te nkoriong enye, neipoipoi intae too nkejek enyena.
Ore anaa enkerai nailejilej ng'otonye, kaailejilej nanu iyie aiko neijia; eikipuoi aaitigir iyie te Yerusalem.

Ipuopuo intae aadol neng'idayu iltauja linyi; nebulu iloik linyi anaa nkujit; naa kepuoi aayiolou nchere etii enkaina o Laitoriani te nebo isinkan lenyena, ore engoro enye negilunore ilmang'ati lenyena.
“Ng'ura ajo kelotu Olaitoriani te nkima, ore ngarrin enyena nepuonu anaa olkutati, pee eitalaku engoro enye te mpijan, neisikong'isho too lng'ejepa le nkima.
Amu te nkima edung Olaitoriani enkiguana, naa to lalem edung'oki enkiguana pooki tung'ani; ore lelo ooar Olaitoriani to lalem naa keaku kumok.

“Ore lelo ooitukuo neitisiny ate pee etum aashom atua enkurma esujaa ilo otii empolos enye, nenya inkiri oo lbitiro, nenya olminong, nenya ilkirrumun, kelotu enkiting'oto enye nabo kata, Olaitoriani ojo.
“Amu kayiolo nanu isiaaitin enye o ndamunot enye, naa kalotu nanu aiturrur iloshon pooki o lng'ejepa; naa kepuonu ninche nedol enkitoo ai,

naa kapik nanu olmonekie atua ninche. Naa ore te ninche naa kairriwaa nanu ilo pisiai oleku meshomo iloreren, meshomo Tarshishi o Puti o Ludi, lelo tung'ana oyietu nkai, nepuo Tubal o Yafan, nepuo iloomanaa le naiposha oolakua, lelo leitu ening enkisisa ai o enkitoo ai tiatua iloshon.

Naa kepuo ninche aayau lelo alashera linyi pooki ooing'uaa iloshon pee eaku olasar lo Laitoriani, nepuonu too mbartan o too ngarrin oo mbartan o too ngarrin naaimulumula o nyumpui o ntamesin ilo doinyo lai sinyati, Yerusalem, Olaitoriani ojo, aaikununye anaa ake duoo Israeli te neyau olasar lenye le ntapa too ngirran nemeiduruk atua enkaji o Laitoriani.
Ore sii ilkulikae lenye, naya aitaa ilapolosak o Lawi, Olaitoriani ojo.
“Amu ore anaa enabikoo ina keper ng'ejuk o enkop ng'ejuk nalo nanu aitobiru, Olaitoriani ojo, neijia elo atiu iishoritin inono o enkarna ino, kepuo aabikoo.
Ore ebaiki olapa ng'ejuk o metabaiki olikae apa o ebaiki Sabato o metabaiki enkae Sabato, kaapuonu iltung'ana pooki aaserem, Olaitoriani ojo.
“Naa kepuo ninche aadol impopoki oo ltung'ana apa laatogolong'akita, amu meye aekata olkurto onya ninche, nemeyagaa enkima enye, naa keaku ninche entoki naitureisho too ltung'ana pooki.
Irorei kulo le Yeremia, olayioni le Hilkia, loo lapolosak apa ootii Anatot tiatua enkop e Benchamen,
laa ninye eirorie Olaitoriani too nkolong'i e Yosia olayioni le Amon, olaiguanani le Yuda, to lari le tomon ookuni le nkitoria enye.

Eirorie sii too nkolong'i e Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda, ometabaiki enkiting'oto o lari le tomon oobo le Sedekia, olayioni le Yosia olaiguanani le Yuda, ometabaiki ina kata apa nawaki iltung'ana le Yerusalem eyararoroto to lapa le miet.
Aairorie apa Olaitoriani naajoki,
“Ore apa eton eitu aaitobiru iyie te nguset e yieyioo lino aatayiolo nanu iyie naa ore apa eton eitu kiini naaiteng'ela nanu iyie; aategelua nanu iyie aitaa oloiboni le Nkai too loreren.”
Najo nanu, “Ee Olaitoriani Enkai! Mayiolo nanu airoro amu kara ake olbarnoti.”
Kake aatiaka nanu Olaitoriani, “Mijo iyie, ‘Kara ake olbarnoti’; amu ore lelo pooki laairriwaki iyie naa ilo. Ore pooki naba anaa enaaitanap iyie naa ilo airo.
Miureyu iyie ninche, amu atii nanu tenebo iyie pee aakordu iyie, Olaitoriani ojo.”
Neitorioo Olaitoriani enkaina enye neiseyie enkutuk ai; naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Atipika nanu irorei laainei atua enkutuk ino.
Ngura ajo, aatipika nanu iyie ena olong shumata iloreren o shumata nkitoriat, pee idotu nisulaa, pee iinyal nisulie, pee ishet niun.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii ejo, “Yeremia, kainyoo idolita?” Najoki nanu, “Adolita olng'osila lo lchani laaijo oseki.”
Naaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki, “Itoduaa iyie aitobiraki, amu arripito nanu ororei lai pee aitabaya ninye.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani, enatii nanu te nkata e are ejo, “Kainyoo idolita?” Najoki nanu, “Adolita emoti naitokitok, eing'orita enkalo e moikuape.”
Najoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Moikuape eipang'unye entorroni alotu shumata lelo pooki oomanya enkop.

Amu, ng'ura kaipotu nanu iloshon pooki loo nkitoriat e moikuape, ejo Olaitoriani, naa kepuonu ninche ore ake pooki te ninche nepik olorika lenye le nkitoo tenejing'ieki nchomito e Yerusalem, aaigaraki isunta enyena pooki naamanita neman sii nkanas pooki e Yuda.
Naa kairo nanu endung'okinoto ai enkiguana tialo ninche, teina torroni enye pooki aatung'uaitie nanu; etapejokito ninche enkorropil kulie aitin, neserem esiaai oo nkaik enye maate.
Kake ore iyie, terretena empolos ino; tudumunye tiaaki ninche entoki pooki naba anaa enaaitanap iyie. Mincho kinture ninche maaiture ake nanu iyie te dukuya ninche.

Ore nanu, ng'ura, kaaitaa nanu iyie ena olong enkanasa nasheta sunta, eng'ape e sekenkei, o sunta o suyai, pee igilunore enkop pooki, o ilaiguanak le Yuda, o ilkituaak lenyena, o lapolosak lenyena o lelo tung'ana leina kop.
Eikiarare ninche iyie; kake mikimir ninche iyie, amu atii nanu tenebo iyie, ejo Olaitoriani, peyie aakordu iyie.”
Aairorie Olaitoriani naajoki,

“Shomo inosai metoning'i te Yerusalem ena natejo Olaitoriani, adamu nanu eseremata e kitisho ino, enyorrata ino anaa esiankiki narikori, ina kata kisujita nanu tiong'ota, tiatua ina kop neitu eunishoreki.
Eisinyati apa Israel to Laitoriani, ninche ilng'anayio le dukuya le nkikesare enye. Ore pooki ooitarruoitie ninye netum entorroni; eewuo entorroni shumata ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.”
Toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani iyie enkaji e Yakobo, olmareita pooki le nkaji e Israel.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani: “Kaa torroni enotito loo papaai linyi te nanu pee aashomo aalam nanu, nepuo aasujaa empesho, neaku pesho?

Eitu ninche ejo, ‘Koree Olaitoriani laa ninye oilepunye iyiook aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri. Laa ninye otorikoyie iyiook tiong'ota, tiatua enkop olpurkel o ngumot, tiatua ina kop olameyu o enaimin nagut, tiatua enkop nemedung hoo ng'ae, nemetii hoo oltung'ani omanya.’
Nayau nanu intae atua enkop sidai, pee ishipakinono ilng'anayio lenyena o ntokitin enyena sidain. Kake ore pee ipuonunu atua ninturujuju enkop ai, nintaa enjung'ore ai olminong.

Eitu ejo ilapolosak, ‘Koree Olaitoriani?’ Ore kuldo loo nkitanapat neitu aayiolou nanu; aatogolong'akitia nanu ilaitoriak; ore ilo oibonisho neibonisho te Baal, nepuo aasujaa nena tokitin nemeretisho.
“Metaa eton aatakinore iyie, Olaitoriani ojo, ore nkera oo nkera inono naatakinore.
Tudung'o shomo olomanaa le Kupro toduaa, aashu irriwaa olkilikuai Kedar metujurru asipu; toduaa tenaa kenotoki aekata entoki naikununo nji.
Keibelekenya olosho nkaitin enyena, hoo duoo ninye neme nkaitin? Kake eibelekenya iltung'ana laainei enkitoo enye, teina nemeretisho.
Mputukunyo iyie shumata, tena iruto, ingasiayu tukul, Olaitoriani ojo.
Amu etaasa iltung'ana laainei ntorrok are: aatung'uaitie nanu, ina ong'u oo nkariak naaishu, neguetaki ate ilmotioo, ilmotioo oodanya lemeidim aatushum enkare.
“Ko rrindik Israel? Kosinka oino liang? Kainyoo naa pee etaa ninye olorreshitoi?
Eipurrokito ilng'atunyo ninye, eipurrokito aabuaku. Neitaa ninche enkop enye mitil; neidaaitie nkanas enyena, metii iloomanya.
Ore sii etadanya iltung'ana le Memfis o Tafnhel olmarisian le nkitoo le ndukuya ino.
Aime kewan iyie iyaka ena te nking'uaroto o Laitoriani Enkai ino, ina kata pee kirikoo ninye te nkoitoi?
Amaa taata kainyoo dupoto nitum tenilo Misiri, aok nkariak o lkeju le Nail? Aashu kainyoo dupoto nitum tenilo Asiria, aok nkariak e o lkeju le Frati?

Entorroni ino nikintame iyie, naa ina kibelekenyata nimbelekenye niking'uanare iyie. Tayiolo nidol nchere entorroni naa kedua te iyie tening'uaa Olatoriani Enkai ino; metii euriata ai atua iyie, Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani ojo.

“Itigila apa iyie Israel enchata ino e murt nilak ienat inono, nijo iyie ‘Maisiaaisho nanu.’ Ee, te nchumata oldoinyo oodo oleng o tiabori pooki shani onyori oleng irrugokine iyie nkaitin anaa emulayoi.
Ore eyia naatuuno nanu anaa osabibu gelunoti, entipat nadupa tukul kaji naa iyie nkuna pee mbelekenye niaku osabibu liong'ata?
Ore hoo nintukito kewan te munyan niaasishore osabuni sapuk, ore ilduruki le ntorroni ino neton etii dukuya nanu, Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.
Kaji iyie inko pee ijo ‘Eitu aaisarkionieki nanu, eitu nanu alo asujaa noo Baal?’ Ng'ura enkoitoi ino to eyarata; tayiolo ina nitaasa itiu iyie anaa entames lipong, naipirri nkaloli pooki,
esikiria e ong'ata natamoo olpurkel, ore pee eyieu oloing'oni neisugaa osiwuo! Kaing'ae oidim aibooi eng'uarrata enye? Meetae ilooyieu ninye o inaur ate, ore too lapaitin lenyena neinepu ninye.
Torripo nkejek inono milo ake miata namuka, olgos lino pee mikitir enkure. Kake itejo iyie, ‘Meetae osiligi, amu atonyorra nanu ilomon, naa ninche nanu asujaa.’
“Ore anaa enakurru olapurroni teneibung'i, neijia etiu sii enkaji e Israel keitukurruni: ninche, o laiguanak lenye, o lkituaak lenye o lapolosak lenye, o loibonok lenye.

Ninche ootiaakita olchani, Ira iyie papa lang, nejoki osoit, Itoiwuo iyie iyiook. Amu aaibelekenyakita ninche enkoriong enye, neitu aaibelekenyaki enkomom. Kake ore tenkata enyamali enye nejo ninche, ‘Tudumunye ntajeu iyiook!’
Kake koree nkaitin inono nena nintaikia kewan? Nchoo ninche edumunye, tenaa eikindim ninche aaitajeu iyie, tenkata ino enyamali; amu ore eneba nkang'itie inono neijia eba nkaitin inono, iyie Yuda.
“Kainyoo pee kilepilepaka iyie nanu? Kitogolong'akitia intae pooki, Olaitoriani ojo.
Pesho nanu ataara nkera inono, eitu ninche eitoriori, olalem lino kewan oinosa iloibonok linono anaa olng'atuny otupusha.

Naa ore iyie, naishoi ena, toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani. Kataa nanu olpurkel te Israel, aashu enkop e misimisi kitok? Kainyoo naa pee ejo iltung'ana laainei, ‘Kilakuno iyiook, meekure iyiook kingil aapounu enitii?’
Kerikino entito imasaa enyena, aashu esiankiki narikori ilkilani lenyena? Kake maadamu nanu iltung'ana laainei too nkolong'i nemeikenayu.
Iyiolo oleng aitobira nkoitoi inono aing'oru enyorrata! Neaku ore ninye nkituaak arruok ninteng'en inkoitoi inono.
Ore olkila lino netii osarge le nkishui e lelo aisinak lemeeta entioto; eitu iyie inepu ninche egilita nkajijik, kake ore etii kuna tokitin pooki
nijo iyie, ‘Maata nanu entioto; kesipa eibelekenye engoro enye te nanu.’ Ng'ura, kaayau nanu iyie enkiguana teina nitejo, ‘Eitu nanu aas eng'oki.’
Kebaa eleleki nilotie iyie, mbelekeny enkoitoi ino! Eikipik iyie Misiri enkurruna anaa apa enikitipika Asiria enkurruna.
Ninye iyie ilotu aing'uaa etii nkaik inono shumata endukuya ino, amu etanya Olaitoriani lelo laa ninche iyie isilig, nimidupoyu iyie te ninche.

“Amaa tenearaa olee enkitok enye nelo ninye aing'uaa ninye neaku enkitok e likae lee, keitoki ilo apa lee ashukokino ninye? Aimeitarruoo ina enkop oleng? Itaa iyie emulayoi nitaboitare ilewa kumok naa aikintoki arrinyokino nanu? Olaitoriani ojo.
Taraposhu nkonyek inono ing'ura nena kisiashat naaika, eitiaaji eitu kiboitareki iyie? Ore too mbat oo nkoitoi niton aanyu ilewa, anaa Emarabui ti ong'ota. Intarruoyie enkop ino teina mulayaisho ino.
Ore te nkaraki ina eibooki oloirujuruj, ore enchan oo nkokua neitu elotu, kake ore eyia eton ake inkununo anaa e mulayioi itanya iyie ikurru.
“Keitu iyie taata kimpot nanu ajo ‘Papa lai, ira iyie olchore eleleleroisho ai
kegoro ninye ntarasi, kebikoo engoro enye o kenya? Ng'ura iroro iyie, kake itaasa iyie entorroni pooki naba anaa enindim.”

Aatiaka nanu Olaitoriani too nkolong'i o laiguanani Yosia, “Itoduaa iyie ina nataasa ninye, ina nemeisiligayu Israel, ina nashomo ailep shumata endoinyo pooki naika o abori pooki shani onyori, ore teine neas anaa emulayoi?
Najo apa nanu, ‘Ore pee eidip ataasa kuna pooki naashukokino nanu kake eitu ninye eshukunye,’ ore ina anashe enye nemeisiligayu Yuda nedol ina.

Etoduaa nchere ore te nkiborra enye enkong'u nemeeta enkirukoto, Israel, nadung'oki nanu enkiguana eyararoto, ore eyia, ore ina anashe enye Yuda nemeisiligayu neitu eureishoyu, kake eshomo sii ninye aaku emulayoi.
Ore te nkaraki naa kelelek enkiborra enkong'u te ninye, neitarruoyie ninye enkop, aloloito to soit o to lchani.
Ore eyia te kuna pooki, ore ina anashe enye nemeisiligayu, Yuda, neitu eshukunye enatii nanu to ltau lenye pooki, kake te nkitaakuno, Olaitoriani ojo.”
Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Ore Israel nemeisiligayu neitodolua kewan ajo aikiti enkitarruorroto enye alang Yuda nemeisiligayu.
Shomo, ntudupai kulo rorei te nkalo e moikuape, ijo, ‘Tushukunye Israel nemeisiligayu, Olaitoriani ojo. Maaing'or nanu iyie te ngoro, amu kara ololng'ur, Olaitoriani ojo; magoro nanu ntarasi.

Tonyorrai ake duoo iyie enkitarruoroto ino, nchere itogolong'aka Olaitoriani Enkai ino nindapashaa enyorrata ino tiatua ilomon tiabori pooki shani onyori, o ina neitu ining oltoilo lai, Olaitoriani ojo.
“ ‘Entushukunye, intae nkera nemeeta enkirukoto, Olaitoriani ojo; amu ara nanu olkitok linyi; kaya nanu intae, obo aitung'uaa enkanasa oaare aitung'uaa olmarei, nayau nanu intae Sion.
Naa kaisho nanu intae ilchekuti laaitiship oltau lai, ooitoti intae te ng'eno o te yiolounoto.

Ore ake pee iponariri niakuku kumok teinakop, te nena olong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, nemeitoki ninche aajo, “Osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani.” Melotu ina damunoto, aashu eetayieki tipat, nemeitokini aaigil aaitayu.

Ore teina kata Yerusalem neaku keji olorika le nkitoo lo Laitoriani, neitururrokino nkuapi pooki ninye, ine netii Olaitoriani te Yerusalem, nemeitoki aekata aasuj te ngolong'u enye o ltau lenye torrono.
Ore te nena olong'i neibung'are enkaji e Yuda enkaji e Israel, ore tenebo nepuonu ninche aaing'uaa enkop e Moikuape aapuonu ina kop apa naishoo nanu loo papaai linyi metujung'o.
“ ‘Atejo apa nanu kebaa ayieu nanu naapik atua ilaiyiok laainei, naaisho iyie enkop sidai, ina jung'ore nalang nkuapi pooki. Najo nanu eikijo iyie papa lai, nimimbelekenyanya te sujata ai.
Esipa ore anaa enaing'uaa enkitok nemeisiligayu olmoruo lenye, neijia sii iyie itotiwuo aaku misiligayu te nanu, iyie na aji e Israel, Olaitoriani ojo.’ ”
Etoning'oki oltoilo le nena kisiashat naaika, lelo ayiok ooishirita nesaisho le Israel, te nkaraki natapong'o ninche enkoitoi enye etorikine ninche Olaitoriani enkai enye.
Entushukunye intae ilayiok lemeisiligayu kaishiunye nanu ina nimisiligayuyu intae kietuo iyiook enitii iyie, amu ira iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ang.
Metii eretoto eseremata too nchumat oo ldoinyo esipa atua Olaitoriani enkai ang etii enjeunoto e Israel.
“Kake ore ebaiki leleroisho ang neidaikie ina toki e nkurruna nena pooki naaisiaayutua loo papa, nkerrai enye o nchoo enye, ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye.

Mairraga iyiook tiatua enkurruna ang nchoo esulare ang eitoip iyiook, amu kitaasa iyiook eng'oki to Laitoriani Enkai ang, iyiook o loo papa, ebaiki kitisho ang ometabaiki ena olong; neitu iyiook kining oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ang.”
“Tinirrinyunye iyie, Israel, Olaitoriani ojo, naa nanu irrinyokino. Tiniwuang'ie iyie ilo minong lino, aitung'uaa enatii, nimintoki aing'aing'ai,
Naa tininya iyie olmumai, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani,’ tiatua esipata, tiatua enkitorisiokinoto o tiatua enkitorioroto, naa kemayian nkuapi ate te ninye, naa te ninye ewuasa ninche.”
Amu nji ejoki Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem: “Entutur nena kurman inyi nemeturo nimiunishosho tiatua ilkiku.

Entumurataki ate Olaitoriani ewuang'ie isuaaten oo ltauja linyi, intae iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem; mepuku ake engoro ai anaa enkima, neyupuyup nemeeta hoo aetoki narr te nkaraki entorroni oo nkiaasin inyi.”
Embalie tiatua Yuda, nintudupaa tiatua Yerusalem, nijojo, “Toosho esekekua tiatua enkop pooki; nchira tabuaku nijo, ‘Enturrurroto, maape iyiook atua nena ang'itie naasheta sunta!’
Tudumu enanka ing'orie enkalo e Sion. Isika ing'oru eseriani, miton ake amu kayau nanu entorroni aitung'uaa enkalo e moikuape o enkidaata kitok.
Eilepa olng'atuny alo to sanag lenye, etii ilo oidakie nkuapi enkoitoi enye eshomo ninye teine wueji enye pee eitaa enkop ino mitil; neidaikieki inkanas inyi metaa meetae olomanya.
Neaku terretena kewan too lkuniyiani te nkaraki osina nchira niyietu; amu ina goro napi o Laitoriani neitu eibelekenya aing'uaa iyiook.”
“Ore kenya teina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, naa keing'uaa empijan olaiguanani o lkituaak; neiputukuny ilapolosak neing'asia iloibonok.”
Naitoki nanu ajo, “Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, esipa iteleja apa iyie kulo tung'ana o Yerusalem, ijo, ‘Kesidanu te intae,’ aa olalem otabaikia enkishui enye katukul.”
Ore kenya teina kata nejokini kulo tung'ana o Yerusalem, “Osiwuo oirowua oing'uaa inkisiashat naaika to lpurkel eing'or enkalo oo ltung'ana laainei neme pee ekut aashu esil.
Ore ilo siwuo olotu te nkitanapata ai naa kegol oleng te nanu. Naa Nanu ilo oiro tendung'okinoto e nkiguana enye.”
Ng'ura, elotu olmang'atinta ailepu anaa nkatampo, neikununo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan anaa olkutati, neneneng mbartan enyena aalang ilkurragoso - oi iyiook, amu kindaaitie!
Iyie Yerusalem, ntukuoi entorroni to ltau lino, pee kitumi aaitajeu. Keton kenya endamunoto ino torrono tiatua iyie o anu?
Amu eibalunye oltoilo oing'uaa Dan neitudupaa entorroni ebaiki oldoinyo le Efraim.
Enkoo iloreren nchere kelotu ninye; embalunye te Yerusalem nchere kepuonu lelo oomuat aaman enkang te nkop nalakua, nebuaaki ninche nkanas e Yuda.
Neman ninche Yerusalem anaa larripok le nkurma te nkaraki naatanya Yerusalem nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.
Ore nkoitoi inono o nkiaasin inono nikintadoikitio iyie ena, entorroni ino makewan ena, naa kedua, etabaikia atua oltau lino kewan.
Emion ai, emion ai! Aainosita emion! Oi mbat o ltau lai keng'oring'oro oltau lai oleng; maidim nanu atigirayu; amu aning'ito oltoilo le ntarumpeta, oltoilo lo larrabal.
Esujita enkidaata enkidaata ore enkop pooki neirragita metii toki nabo kata einyalaki ilng'oborri laainei ilkarash laainei tenkata nabo.
Kaing'or nanu enanka o anu naning oltoilo le ntarumpeta?
“Amu kemoda iltung'ana laainei, nemaayiolo ninche nanu; nkera naakilo ninche, meeta ninche ening'unoto. Arriyiak ninche te asata oo ntorrok, kake ore eneiko teneas esidai meyiolo ninche.”
Aing'ura nanu oriong enkop, naa ng'ura keliyio naa mitil; o shumata, nemeeta ninye ewang'an.
Aing'ura nanu shumata ildoinyo, naa ng'ura, keikirikira ninche, ore ndoinyo pooki nepuo idie o idie.
Aing'orishe nanu, naa ng'ura, metii apa hoo oltung'ani, ore motonyi pooki oloing'ang'e neisika.
Aing'orishe nanu, naa ng'ura, ore ina kop oo lng'anayio etaa olpurkel, ore nkanas enyena pooki neirragaa eidaaitie, te dukuya Olaitoriani, te dukuya ina goro enye napi.
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Keaku enkop pooki mitil; ore eyia maitaa nanu enkiting'oto.
Amu keishir ena kop, ore shumata neroku; amu airoro nanu, atootikio nanu eitu nanu aainosu nemashuko siadi.”

To ltoilo lo lakedoni le mbarta o ltung'ani le nkawuo eilany nkanas pooki o larrabal, nejing ninche ntimi; neked nchumat oo ndapidapo; etung'uayioki nkanas pooki nemetii oltung'ani oton tiatua ninche.

Naa ore iyie, ena nara mijooni, kainyoo intodolu nchere, eji nchopo iyie too nkilani sinteti, nchere inkod iyie kewan too masaa e saabu, nchere isir iyie nkonyek inono? Te mpesho iyie ikus kewan kimen iyie ilmao linono; eing'oru ninche enkishui ino.

Amu atoning'o nanu enkishirata naaijo ene nkitok nasaisai, naishirita te mion anaa enaiu enkerai enye e dukuya, enkishirata e Yerusalem eng'a enkutuk pee etum enkijape, neitorioo nkaik enyena, “Woi nanu!; Ekaiterre nanu te dukuya lelo ooitayu loikop.”

Kueta nikuetu too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem, ing'orisho niyiolou! Tujurru olkurroto lenye otumoreki toduaa tenaa indim iyie anoto oltung'ani obo, obo oas te nkitorioroto neing'oru esipata pee atum nanu atapalaki ninye.
Ore hoo nejo ninche, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani,” kake ore eyia, enya ninche olmumai le lejare.

Olaitoriani, aime esipata eing'oru nkonyek inono? Itoosho iyie ninche, kake eitu ninche emeyu; indaikie iyie ninche, kake etanyaita ninche engamaa ererioroto. Eitagolito ninche nkomomi enye aaitulus te endapidapoi; etanyaita ninche eirridu.
Najo nanu, “Ore kulo naa laisinak ake, meeta ninche endamunoto; amu meyiolo ninche enkoitoi o Laitoriani, enkitanapata e Nkai enye.
Kalo nanu enetii lelo kituaak, pee airorie ninche; enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai enye.” Kake enyaanyuk pooki, etigila enchata oo murto, etalaa ninche ilidat oo enat.

Metaa kear ninche olng'atuny oing'uaa entim metuata, keidaikie ninche osuyiani oing'uaa olpurkel. Erreshito olkinya lasho nkanas enye, ore pooki ng'ae ooipang tiatua ninche nepolosi aaitaa ndung'udung'ot; amu aikumok nkitarruorrot enye, ore nchukot enye errinyo siadi naa aikumok.

“Kaji nanu aiko tenaapalaki iyie? Aatung'uaitie nanu nkera inono neinosa olmumai te nena neme nkaitin ore aidipa nanu aitotio ninche aitaraposho, neloloito ninche neiturrurrokino nkajijik oo mulayioni.
Eikununo ninche anaa lamuyeishi pushunot ootaraposhote meetae ake olemeishir eyieu enkitok olelatia enye.
Ai maitame nanu ninche te kuna baa? Olaitoriani ojo; naa aimaitalaku nanu to losho laaijo ele?
“Elepa enchom atua ilkererin lenye loo sabibu enyiala kake minyialinyala katukul; entong'osilu ilng'osil lenye, amu mme ilo Laitoriani ninche.
Amu ore enkaji e Israel o enkaji e Yuda neitu ninche tukul ening'isho tialo nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.
“Amu eiroro ninche te lejare tialo Olaitoriani, nejo ninche, ‘Meeta ninye enaas; meetae entorroni nalotu shumata iyiook, nimikidol olalem aashu olameyu.
Netiu iloibonok anaa enkijape; metii ororei atua ninche. Neijia eitaasi ninche!’ ”

Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani: “Ore te nkaraki nairoro ninche ele rorei, ng'ura, kaitaa nanu irorei laainei tiatua enkutuk ino enkima, ore kulo tung'ana neaku ilkeek, nenya enkima ninche.

Ng'ura, kayau nanu shumata iyie, iyie na aji e Israel, olorere oing'uaa enelakua, Olaitoriani ojo. Olorere ogol ninche olorere li apa ninye olorere laa ore enkutuk enye miyiolo iyie nimiyiolou enajo ninche.
Netiu emootian enye anaa enkurare nabolo, iltung'ana magil ninche pooki.

Kenya ninche ina ninkesu ino o endaa ino, nenya ninche ilayiok linyi o ntoyie inyi; nenya ninche nkerrai inyi o nchoo inyi nenya ninche isabibu linyi o lng'abolo linyi; ore nkang'itie inyi naasheta isunta naa ninche isiligigi naa keidaikie ninche.”
“Kake ore ake sii te nena olong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, maamut nanu iyie katukul.

Ore pee ejo iltung'ana linono, kainyoo pee eitaasa Olaitoriani Enkai iyiook kuna baa pooki? Nijokiki intae ninche, ‘Ore anaa enikitung'uaitie intae nanu nisiaayiayia nkaitin oo loreren tiatua enkop inyi, neaku ipuopuo aisiaai iltung'ana leeiking'a teinakop neme eninyi.’ ”
Mbalunye ena tiatua enkaji e Yakobo, ntudupai tiatua Yuda.
“Entoning ena intae iltung'ana oomoda lemedamisho, lelo oata nkonyek kake medolisho lelo oata nkiyiaa, kake mening'isho.

Aimikiurere intae nanu? Olaitoriani ojo; Aiminkirikirara intae te dukuya nanu? Atipika nanu osinyai aitaa olpolosie le naiposha, olpolosie loo nkolong'i pooki lemeidim ninye atogiroi; ore hooneilugo lopir le naiposha, meidim ninche aaima ore hoo neikurrukur meidim aaima shumata enye.
Kake eeta kulo tung'ana oltau ogol le ngolong'u; eibelekenyate ninche aapuo.
Mejo ninche too ltauja lenye, ‘Matureita iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang, laa ninye oishoru enchan terishata enye, enchan oo nkokua o enchan oltumuret, nepikaki iyiook nkatitin naageluno enkikesare.’
Eibelekenya entorroni inyi kuna aiwuang'ie, neitalamaitie ing'ok inyi mbaa supati aitung'uaa intae.
Amu etii iltung'ana torrok atua iltung'ana laainei; nerreshisho anaa larreshok ooirrag aarreshisho neitayu ninche orreshet; neibung ninche iltung'ana.
Ore anaa enabore imotonyi orreshet ebore nkajijik enye enkeleekisho; neaku etaa ninche kituaak nekarsisu,
etopiro ninche nesipayu netuluso too inkiaasin enye entorroni meiguanare ninche te sipata ororei leilo lemeeta menye, pee eitaa ninye karsis, nememitu ninche isipat e ilo omena.
Aimaitame nanu ninche te kuna tokitin? Olaitoriani ojo, naa aimaitalaaki nanu kewan to lorere leeijo ele?”
Entaboi torrono oleng nataase tiatua ena kop;
eibonisho iloibonok te lejare neitoreisho ilapolosak te nena naayieu ninche; ina enyor iltung'ana laainei, kake kaa iyie ias tenebau enkiting'oto?.

Enkuet eng'oru eseriani, intae iltung'ana le Benchamen, entung'uai empolos e Yerusalem! Entoosh esekekua te Tekoa, nidumumu olmonekie te Bet-hakerem; amu edakunye entorroni aipang'u te nkalo e moikuape, o enkidaata kitok.
Ore ina sidai naata enkishaa kaidakie nanu Yerusalem,
ore lchekuti tenebo nkerrai enye nepuonu aarare ninye neun ninche ilng'oborri lenye aaitaman ninye, neirritisho ninche, oltung'ani ake te wueji enye.
“Ntobira olarrabal taarare ninye; matudumunye, pee kirasaki te nkipirata enkolong! Woi iyiook, amu etinyikayie enkolong, amu etoodorita iloipi le nteipa!”
“Matudumunye, matarasaki kewarie, nikindaikie inkajijik enyena e nkitoo!”
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, “Entudung ilkeek lenyena; nimuatimuata aaman Yerusalem. Enkanasa ena nemeeta nchere pee meitamei; metii ae toki neme enkibookinoto enkop atua ninye.
Ore anaa enashum olchorro enkare enye neijia sii ninye eiko ashum entorroni enye; emarmalisho o enkidaata naning'o tiatua ninye; etii emuoyian o lbaa dukuya nanu anaake.
Toningu ena kikoo, iyie Yerusalem, pee maaorieki ake iyie; pee maaitaa ake olmuaate enkop, nememanya.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, “Kesotuni anaa isabibu olpisiai le Israel, anaa olasotunoni loo lng'anayio nyaaki ntogiroi enkaina ino shumata ilng'osil.”
Kaing'ae nanu airorie naikok, pee etum ninche aatoning ng'ura eikeno nkiyiaa enye meidim ninche aatoning'isho; ng'ura, ore ororei lo Laitoriani te ninche netiu anaa emoroto, meshipakino ninche ninye.

Neaku aabore nanu engoro napi o Laitoriani; anaure aibookino. “Tubukoki ninye shumata nkera te nkoitoi nalala enkanasa o shumata sii iumat oo lbarnot; neyae olpayian o enkitok, lelo payiani olelo kituaak lenye.
Ore nkajijik enye neibelekenyakini ilkulikae, inkurman enye o nkituaak enye tenebo; amu kaitorioo nanu enkaina ai aarare lelo omanya ena kop.” Olaitoriani ojo.
“Amu ore ebaiki oloti o metabaiki olkitok lenye, meetae ake olemeng'uar dupoto e lejare; ore ebaiki oloiboni ometabaiki olapolosani, meetae ake olemeas inelejare.
Eishiunye ninche olbae loo ltung'ana laainei te nkitaakunoto, ejo, ‘Eseriani, eseriani’ nemetii eseriani.

Ketukurrutua apa ninche ina kata apa pee eas mbaa olminong? Aa, eitu ninche ekurru tukul; menya ninche orere. Neaku kebatata ninche tenebo lelo oobatata; ore teina kata naitame nanu ninche, kenang'ari ninche,” Olaitoriani ojo.

Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Entashoito too nkoitoi naalaa ning'orishosho, ninkilikuanunu nkoitoi e apa, ine apa netii nkoitoi sidain, niimiimi intae atua nitumutumu enkiyeng'iyeng too ltauja linyi. Kake etejo ninche, ‘Mikiim iyiook atua ninye.’
Atipika nanu ilarripok shumata intae, ejo, ‘Entoning oltoilo le ntarumpeta’ Kake etejo ninche, ‘Mikinining iyiook.’
Metaa entoning, intae iloshon, niyiolouu, intae ilturrurri, ina nayooki atiu te ninche.
Toning'o iyie enkop; ng'ura kayau nanu entorroni shumata kulo tung'ana, ilng'anayio loo mbaa enye torrok, te nkaraki neitu ninche ening irorei laainei; ore tialo enkitanapata ai, etanyaita ninche.
Ai te nkaraki nyoo naa nanu aayakini enkorropil naing'uaa sheba, aashu esonkoyo naarropil naing'uaa enkop nalakua? Ore lasarri linono oopejori meng'amaroyu, nemaaitiship nanu nkishorunot inono.
Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani: ‘Ng'ura, kairragakinye nanu kulo tung'ana iloketa naa ninche errorrore ninche; iloomenye o layiok tenebo, ore olelatia olchore neidaaya.’ ”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ng'ura, epuonu iltung'ana ooing'uaa enkop e moikuape, eilepu olosho kitok eing'uaa enelakua oleng otanape te nkaraki olarrabal.

Eirraga ninche eibung'ita nkai o mperria, kegogong ninche nemeeta olng'ur, ore oltoilo lenye neikununo anaa enaiposha naikurrukur; neked ninche mbartan, nenapa ninche anaa oltung'ani le njore, pee kiarare iyie, Yerusalem!”
Kitoning'o iyiook olomoni lenye, nelepori inkaik ang; neibung iyiook osina o emion anaa enkitok nasaisai.
Emimpang aapuo ong'ata, aashu ipuopuo te nkoitoi; amu eeta olmang'atinta olalem, etii olkirutoto pooki shoto.
Intae lo tung'ana laainei, terretenayu too lkuniyiani, nimperipera too nkuruon; nchira anaa enatua olayioni obo oata, to lkiyioi le mion oleng, amu nabo kata nelotu olamutani shumata iyiook.
Aaitaa nanu iyie entemet o esilet tiatua iltung'ana laainei, pee itum atayiolo nitem nkoitoi enye.
Kegolong'u ninche pooki, nepuoopuo too nkiteenikinot; osuyai ninche o esekenkei, eas ninche pooki ine ntorroni.
Eyupuyup olkokuet oleng nenya enkima olduruk lioriong, ore ilo oshol esekenkei, pesho ake eshol amu eitu eiwuang'ieki entorroni.
Enkosholai nemeeta tipat ninche, amu etanya Olaitoriani ninche.
Eirorie Olaitoriani Yeremia nejoki:
“Ntasho te kishomi e nkaji o Laitoriani, nilikioo teine ele rorei, nijo, Entoning ororei lo laitoriani, intae iltung'ana pooki le Yuda ooimu kuna shomito aaserem Olaitoriani.
Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, embelekenya nkoitoi inyi o nkiaasin inyi, naa kaisho nanu intae ibikibiki teine wueji.
Emisilig kulo rorei le lejare: ‘Enkaji Olaitoriani ena, enkaji Olaitoriani, enkaji o Laitoriani.’
“Embelekenyata intae entung'uai nena oitoi inyi o nkiaasin inyi. Entaasata enaishiaa te sipata olikae o likae.
Tinimimbookiki enkop ilo omoni, ilo lemeeta menye aashu enkoliai aashu imbukoo osarge leilo lemeeta entioto tene wueji, nimintokiki aasujaa kulie aitin te nkitamioto inyi,
naa kaisho nanu intae entobik tene wueji, tiatua ena kop apa naishoo nanu loo papaai linyi ntarasi.
“Ng'ura, isiligigi intae irorei le lejare lemeeta eretoto.
Ipurrisho iyie, nintayu iloikop, niloloito, ninya olmumai le lejare, nipejoki Baal enkorropil, nirubare kulie aitin neitu iyiolou,
paa intokiki aapuonu aaitashe te dukuya nanu tena aji, naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, nijojo, ‘Etokorduaki iyiook!’ Nipuopuo dukuya iasiasa kuna pooki olminong?
Ketaa ena aji, naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, enkapune oo lapurrok too nkonyek inyi? Ng'ura ajo atoduaa nanu enkorrok ai ina, Olaitoriani ojo.
Enchom taata ine wueji ai apa netii shilo, naa ine aishoo enkarna ai metobikie te dukuya; pee idolidolo enaitaasa ninye te ntorroni oo ltung'ana laainei Israel.
Ore taata, te nkaraki nitaasa intae kuna baa pooki, Olaitoriani ojo, ore pee airorie intae aitirrishaki neitu ining'ining'i, ore pee aipot intae neitu irukishosho, kake itanyita irukishosho,
neaku kaitaas nanu ina aji naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, naa ninye isiligigi, oine wueji apa naishoo nanu intae o loo papaai linyi anaa enaitaasa Shilo.
Naa kanang'aa nanu intae too nkonyek aainei, anaa enatanang'ayie nanu ilalashera linyi o eishoi pooki e Efraim.
“Ore iyie miomonoki kulo tung'ana, aashu ilepiepie olkiyioi aashu enkomono te nkaraki ninche nimiomonoki te nanu, amu maaning nanu iyie.
Aimidol iyie inaasita ninche too nkanas e Yuda o too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem?
Esotu nkera ilkeek, neinok loo menye enkima, neipurj nkituaak enkurma, pee eitobiraki imukateni enkai ng'oruoi e shumata; nebukoki ninche ilasarri ooki kulie aitin, pee aaitagor nanu.
Ainanu ninche eitagor? Olaitoriani Enkai ojo. Aime ate, to lmilo lenye!
Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ‘Ng'ura keibukori engoro ai o engoro ai napi tene wueji, te shumata oltung'ani o eng'ues, shumata ilkeek liong'ota olng'anayio le nkop: keyupuyup ninye nemearayu.’ ”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani Enkai e Israel: “Entoponai nkishoorot inyi oo lasarri oopejori, ninyanya nkiri.
Amu ore apa teina olong nayawua nanu ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, eitu nanu airorie loo papaai linyi aashu aaraki ninche tialo nkishorunot naapejori o lasarri.

Kake ena kitanapata nanu aishoo ninche; ‘Entoning oltoilo lai, naa kaaku nanu Enkai inyi, niakuku intae iltung'ana laainei; nipuopuo teina oitoi pooki naitanapa nanu intae, pee etum atisidana te intae.’
Kake eitu ninche ening aashu eishoru enkiok enye, kake eshomo ninche too ndamunot enye o engolon oo ltauja lenye torrok, nepuo siadi neitu epuo dukuya.

Ore ebaiki ina olong apa napuonu loo papaai linyi aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri ometabaiki ena olong, aitirrishaka nanu airriwaa isinkan laainei pooki lelo oibonok le Nkai enetii ninche te nkolong ake o te nkolong,
ore eyia neitu ninche aainining nanu, aashu eishoru enkiok enye, kake eitagolo lukuny enye. Etaasa ninche ntorrok aalang loo papaai lenye.
“Neaku ilo iyie aliki ninche kulo rorei pooki, kake mikining ninche iyie. Impot iyie ninche kake mikiruk ninche iyie.
Naa ilo iyie ajoki ninche, ‘Olosho ele leitu ening oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai enye, neitu eng'amu enkitamito e rerioroto; eidaayie esipata; eiwuang'ieki too nkutukie enye.’
“Entudung'oi ilpapit linyi ninturraa to sina, elepie olkiyioi too nkisiashat naaika; amu etanya Olaitoriani netung'uayie ina ishoi e ngoro enye napi.’
“Amu etaasa ilaiyiok le Yuda entorroni too nkonyek aainei, Olaitoriani ojo; etipika ninche ilo minong lenye atua enkaji naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, pee eisarkionie ninye.

Netesheta ninche olperere lo lasar te wueji neika neji Tofet, ina natii oyarata lo layioni le Hinom, pee etum aatapejoi ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye tiatua ina kima neitu nanu aitanap ninche neitu elotu atua ndamunot aainei.

Metaa, ng'ura ajo kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, nemeitokini aajo Tofet, aashu oyarata lo layioni le Hinom, kake oyarata le sesekuanare amu te Tofet ninche enukaa ilootuata, te nkaraki metii erishata dikae.
Ore mpopoki e kulo tung'ana neaku endaa too motonyi o loing'ang'e o too ng'uesi enkop; nemeetae oloiture ninche meshomo.
Naa kaitobir nanu meishunye too nkanas e Yuda o too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem, oltoilo le nkuenia o ltoilo le nchipai o ltoilo lo loyamisho, oltoilo le nayami; amu keaku enkop mijooni.

“Ore kenya teina kata, Olaitoriani ojo, ore iloik loo laiguanak le Yuda o loik loo lkituaak lenyena o loik loo lapolosak o loik loo loibonok le Nkai o loik le lelo oomanya Yerusalem neyauni aitung'uaa nkuraren enye;

neidapashi ninche te dukuya enkolong o lapa o te dukuya olorora pooki le keper, naa ninche apa etonyorra ninche neisiaai, aa ninche apa etusujaitie, aa ninche eing'orutua neserem; nemeiturrurri ninche aashu enukari; netiu ninche anaa modiok ti oriong enkop.
Kenyorrarri kenya keeya aaitudutie enkishui ilo pisiai oleku lele marei torrono too wuejitin pooki naterewa nanu ninche, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.
“Ijoki iyie ninche, nji ejo Olaitoriani, Amaa tenebatata oltung'ani aimeitoki ninye adumunye? Amaa teneibelekenya oltung'ani alo, aimeitoki ninye ashukunye?
Kainyoo naa pee eibelekenyate kulo tung'ana aapuo siadi? Neibung ninche aakurraki elejare, neany ninche eshukunye.

Ainining'o nanu, kake eitu ninche eiro aaitorioki; meetae oltung'ani oirridu te ntorroni enye, ejo ‘Kainyoo nanu ataasa?’ Eibelekenyakino ake pooki ng'ae nkoitoi enyena, anaa embarta nakuetiki olarrabal.
Ekeyiolo ninye entilagos te shumata nkatitin enyena; ore enturkuluo o emotoroki, o enkaileeri neibung nkatitin enye naapuonunye; kake meyiolo iltung'ana laainei nkitanapat Olaitoriani.
“Kaji intae inkoko tenijojo, ‘Aikira iyiook ng'eni, ore enkitanapata O Laitoriani netii tenebo iyiook?’ Ngura ajo eibelekenya.
Ore lelo tung'ana ng'eni naa keitukurruni, keidang'ieki ninche neyae; Oi, etanyaita ninche ororei lo Laitoriani, naa kaa ng'eno natii atua ninche?

Neaku kaisho nanu nkituaak enye ilkulikae naisho nkurman enye lelo ooisulu, te nkaraki naa ore ebaiki oloti ometabaiki olkitok eeta pooki ng'ae olorok le dupoto te nkoitoi elejare. Eiteru to loiboni le Nkai o metabaiki olapolosani meetae ake ole measisho te lejare.
Eishiunye ninche olbae loo ltung'ana laainei te nkitaakunoto ejo, ‘Eseriani, eseriani’, nemetii eseriani.

Ketukurrutua ninche ina kata pee eas olminong A'a, eitu ninche ekurru katukul; menya ninche orere. Neaku kebatata ninche tiatua lelo ootabatatate; ore ake pee aitame ninche, nenang'ari ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.
“Ore tenajo aiturrur ninche; Olaitoriani ojo, nemetii ilng'anayio o sabibu aashu ilng'abolo olng'aboli etoito ninye mbenek, ore apa ina naishoo nanu ninche netulusoyie alo aing'uaa ninche.”

Kainyoo pee kitoni iyiook aaitirring'a enturrurroto tenebo, maape iyiook atua nena anas naasheta, pee kindaaya teine; amu etudung'oko iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang enkidaata, neishoo iyiook enkare natii esayiet matook, te nkaraki nikitaasa iyiook eng'oki to Laitoriani.
Kisiligu iyiook eseriani kake meetae esidai naewuo, enkata enkishiunoto, kake ng'ura, enkuretisho.

“Ore enkikurrukur oo mbartan enye nening'o te wueji neji Dan. Ore to ltoilo loo mbartan enye e njore neikirikira enkop pooki. Kepuonu ninche aaidaikie enkop o pooki toki nabore, enkanasa o lelo oomanya atua.
Amu ng'ura, kairriu nanu tiatua intae ilasuriaa o nturbubuani naata esayiet nemeibooyo intaleng'o, naa keony ninche intae.” Olaitoriani ojo.
Meishiunoyu osina lai? Kemuoi oltau lai.

Toning'o olkiyioi loo ltung'ana laainei eing'uaa enkadoro o endapasho enkop. “Aimetii Olaitoriani atua Sion? Aimetii olaiguanani lenye atua ninye?” Kainyoo pee aaitagoro ninche too nkitanyaanyukot enye naaguetuno, o too nkitanyaanyukot enye omon?
“Etulusoyie enkikesare; eishunye enkata enkirowuaj, neitu eitajeuni iyiook.”
Amu ore ilo bae leina tito oo ltung'ana laainei naa oltau lai etipikaki olbae, aishir nanu, naaiputa nanu enking'asia.
Aimetii olchani atua Gilead? Aimetii olabaani ine? Kainyoo naa pee eitu eishiunyeki iltung'ana laainei?
Oi naaji aa olmoti le nkare endukuya ai, neijirrijirru ilkiyio too nkonyek aainei, pee atum nanu aishira dama o kewarie te nkaraki esesekuanata oo ltung'ana laainei!
Oi naaji aa kaata to lpurkel ewueji neirragari pee atum nanu atung'uai iltung'ana laainei nalo enelakua aing'uaa ninche! Amu ile loloito ninche pooki, olturrur loo ltung'ana lemeisiligayu.
Nekordil irorei lenye lenye anaa nkai, elejare neme esipata natubulayie tiatua ena kop; amu kepuo ninche dukuya te ntorroni o te ntorroni, nemaayiolo ninche nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.
Enchoo pooki ng'ae erripo to le latia lenye nemepik osiligi atua likae alashe; amu ore pooki alashe naa olairrikinoni amu ore pooki le latia enye neloolo ainosaa olmarenke.
Kelej pooki ng'ae ole latia enye, nemeetae oloiro esipata; eitamoo ninche ilng'ejepa lenye meiroro elejare neas ninche ntorrok neshal oleng te nkirridunoto.
Nesot enkibookinoto e nkop te shumata enkibookinoto e nkop, o elejare te shumata elejare, neany ninche aayiolou nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.
Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Ng'ura ajo kashol nanu ninche natem ninche, amu kaa ae naas nanu, te nkaraki iltung'ana laainei?”
Embae e sayiet olng'ejep lenye; keiro ninye te lejare; ore too nkutukie enye meetae ake olemeirorie olelatia enye te seriani, kake ore tiatua oltau lenye neitobiraki ninye orreshet.
Aimaitame nanu ninche te kuna baa, Olaitoriani ojo; naa aimaitalaaki nanu kewan to lorere laaijo ele.

Teyietu nchiraki ldoinyo ninchiraki to sina ndaat e ongata te nkaraki naitaaki mitil neaku meetae oltung'ani oim atua, ore enkorui oo nkishu nemening'o ore imotonyi o loing'ang'e o ng'uesi neisika aapuo.
Kaitaa nanu Yerusalem osototi loo suut, olmuaate, emanyisho oo mbariak naitaa nanu nkanas e Yuda mijoonito, meetae olomanya.

Kaing'ae ilo tung'ani ng'en oleng oidim atayiolo ena: laa ninye eirorie enkutuk o Laitoriani, pee etum ninye aibalunye? Kainyoo pee einyalaki enkop aaidaikie anaa ong'ata, metaa meetae hoo obo ooim atua?
Nejo Olaitoriani: “Te nkaraki natung'uaitie ninche enkitanapata ai apa natipika nanu dukuya ninche, neitu ening oltoilo lai, aashu epuo te risioroto enye,
kake te ngolong'akinoto etusujaitie iltauja lenye maate neshomo aasujaa nena aitin e Baal, anaa enaiteng'ena loo menye ninche.
Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, kaitoti nanu kulo tung'ana te sayiet, naisho ninche enkare natii esayiet metooko.
Kaidapashaki nanu ninche iloshon leitu apa eyiolou ninche aashu loo menye; naitoki nanu airriwaa olalem aitusuj ninche ometaba anaa namut nanu ninche.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Entadamu, nimpotutu nena kituaak naaishir meetu; erriu nena kituaak arriyiak meetu.
Nchoo ninche eisarisaru neilepakinye iyiook olkiyioi pee etum nkonyek ang aaturukoto too lkiyio, neshalu nchonito oo nkonyek te nkare.
Amu etoning'oki oltoilo lo lkiyioi te Sion. ‘Eneikunakaki iyiook enkidaata! Eitukurruaki iyiook oleng, te nkaraki nikitung'uaitie iyiook ina kop, te nkaraki naturoitie ninche imanyishoritin ang.’ ”

Entoning, intae na kituaak, ororei lo laitoriani, ninchosho nkiyia inyi eng'amu ororei le nkutuk enye; enteng'ena ntoyie inyi enkishirata, oltung'ani ake neiteng'en enelatia enye olkiyioi linchirishiri.
Amu eilepua keeya alotu atua ilusien ang, etijing'ua ninye iwuejitin ang e nkitoo etaara metuata nkera too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa, o lbarnot too lkurrot ootumoreki.
Eroro, “Inji ejo Olaitoriani: ‘Ore mpopoki oo ltung'ana naa keirragaa anaa modiok too nkisiashat, anaa suut enkano te siadi olaikesani nemeetae oloiturrur ninche.’ ”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Minchosho ilo tung'ani ng'en eng'idare eng'eno enye, minchosho ilo tung'ani magilani eng'idare emagilanisho enye, minchosho ilo tung'ani karsis eng'idare karsisisho enye;

tenetii oltung'ani oyieu newuasa, nchoo ewuasare ena, nchere kaayiolo nanu, nchere kara Olaitoriani, ilo ooibung enyorrata nauno, esipata, o enkitorioroto tiatua enkop; amu te kuna tokitin ashipa nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.”
“Kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee aitame nanu lelo pooki oomurata too seseni ake,
Misiri, o Yuda, o Edom, lelo ayiok le Amon, o Moab o lelo pooki, oomanya olpurkel oiriri ilpapit lenye! Amu ore kulo oshon pooki nememurata, ore enkaji pooki e Israel nememurata iltauja.”
Entoning ilo rorei oirorie intae Olaitoriani, intae naaji e Israel.
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Emisuj nkoitoi oo loreren niming'asiasia ake too nkitoduaat loing'ang'e amu eing'asiate loreren te ninche,
amu ore ilkuaaki le kulo tung'ana naa eitorrok. Kedung'i olchani te ntim, neguetu oltung'ani arriyia enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai te ntolu too nkaik.
Neikod iltung'ana te nkosholai o te saabu; neitirrishi ninye te nyuntu o too lmushumaani, pee mepuku ashurtunye.

Ore nkitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin neikununo anaa nkitanyaanyukot oo ltung'ana naaitasheyieki metorripo nkurman, nemeidim aairoro; kenapi ninche, amu meidim aashom. Miureyu iyie ninche, amu meidim aataas entorrono, nemeidim ninche aataas hoo nabo sidai.”
Metii likae likinyaanyukie iyie Olaitoriani; ira iyie kitok, naa kitok enkarna ino te magilanisho.
Kaing'ae limikiureyu iyie, Iyie Olaiguanani loo loreren? Amu erishata ino ena; amu ore tiatua lelo pooki ng'eni loo loreren otiatua nkitoriat enye pooki meetae likae likinyaanyukie.
Ilkilo pooki nemoda; ore enkiteng'enare enye oo nkitanyaanyukot naa nkeek ake!

Eyauaki enkosholai naidong'o aaitung'uaa Tarshishi, neyauni saabu aaitung'uaa Ufas. Esiaai oltung'ani arriyia ninche o enoo nkaik olaitobirani le saabu; ore nkilani enye naa pilei o sinteti; esiaai oo ltung'ana arriyiak pooki.
Kake ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai nasipa; ninye Enkai naishu olaiguanani loo ntarasi naa te ngoro enye eikirikira enkop, nemeidimu iloshon engoro enye.
Nji iyie tiaaki ninche, “Ore nena aitin neitu eitayu shumata o enkop naa keidak te nkop o tiabori enkop.”
Olaitoriani ninye oitobira enkop te ngolon enye, ninye oitasheyie enkop pooki te ng'eno enye nagut, naa te yiolounoto enye eitorioyie shumata.

Teneitayu ninye oltoilo lenye netii enkikurrukur oo nkariak shumata neisho ninye enkinuku metunukunye too neeiting'ie e nkop. Neitayu ninye nkiwuang'at e nchan, neyau ninye osiwuo aitung'uaa nkajijik enyena naashumishoreki.
Kekilo pooki tung'ani nemeeta eng'eno, eitukurruaki pooki aitobirani le saabu too nkitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin; amu ore nkitanyaanyukot enyena naa ine lejare, nemetii enkiyang'et atua ninche.
Ine pesho ninche, esiaai e lejare, ore te nkata enkitamioto enye naa keidaaya ninche.
Metiu Enkai e Yakobo anaa ena kitanyaanyukoto amu ninye oitamanyua intokitin pooki, ore Israel naa olosho le njung'ore enye; Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye.
Eturrurro ilolan linyi empung'o te nkop, intae lelo otamanaki!
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ng'ura kanang'aa nanu boo lelo oomanya ena kop tena kata, nayau nanu osina shumata ninche, pee etum ninche aatayiolo.”
Oi nanu te nkaraki enkitamioto ai! Ore olbae lai naa olo sina, kake ore nanu atejo, “Esipa olosilisili ele lemeeta nchere pee mangiriakino nanu.”
Eidaikieki olng'obor lai, ore nkeenta aainei pooki netudung'ote; naashomo aaing'uaa nkera aainei metii ninche; metii hoo obo oigil akas olng'obor lai, nepik ilkarash laainei.
Amu kemoda ilchekuti loo ntare nemeikilikuanishore Olaitoriani; neaku eitu edupo ninche, ore luaat enye pooki neidapashate.
Inining'o, olmarenke! Ng'ura elotu! Embuakunoto sapuk naipang'u te nkop e moikuape, pee eitaa nkanas e Yuda ilmuateni, emanyisho oo mbariak.
Kayiolo nanu Olaitoriani, nchere ore oltung'ani nemeata engolon e nkishui enye, nchere meetae oltung'ani ooidim aitoria enkishui enye.
Ntorioyioki nanu, Olaitoriani kake te sipata; neme te ngoro ino, pee mikintaa ake nanu olemetii.
Tubukoki engoro ino napi shumata lelo oreren limikiyiolo ninche, o shumata lelo tung'ana lemeipot enkarna ino; amu etara ninche Yakobo; nemut ninye, neitomijoono ninche emanyisho enye.
Nelotu ororei enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:
‘Toning'o irorei lele ning'o lo sotua, nirorie iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem.
Tiaaki iyie ninche, nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: ediaa ilo tung'ani lemening irorei lele ning'o lo sotua.

Ilo laitanapa apa iloo papaai linyi pee ayau nanu ninche aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, aitung'uaa ilo kokuet le sekenkei, ajo, ‘Entoning oltoilo lai, niasiasa nena pooki naitanap nanu intae. Pee iyakuku intae iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai inyi,
pee atum ataasa olmumai lai apa lainosa nanu too loo papaai linyi, pee aisho nanu ninche enkop naruko kule o naishi, anaa enatiu ometabaiki ena olong.” Nawal nanu ajo, “Metotiwuo neijia Olaitoriani.”
Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Ntudupai kulo rorei pooki tiatua nkanas e Yuda o too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem. Entoning irorei lele ning'o lo sotua niasiasa.
Amu aikoo nanu loo papaai linyi akurraki ina kata apa pee ayau nanu ninche ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, naikok aitirrishaki o tena olong, ajo, entoning oltoilo lai.

Ore eyia eitu ninche ening kake eshomo ake pooki ng'ae te ngolon oltau lenye torrono. Neaku ayawua nanu shumata ninche irorei pooki lele ning'o lo sotua apa laitanapa nanu ninche metaasa, kake eitu ninche eas.”
Naaigil nanu Olaitoriani ajoki, “Etii engolong'u atua iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem.

Eibelekenyate ninche aashukokino ntorrok oo loo kakuyiaa lenye, apa ootanyaita ening irorei laainei; eshomo ninche aasujaa kulie aitin pee eisiaai ninche; etudung'o enkaji e Israel o enkaji e Yuda osotua lai apa laitobira nanu tenebo loo papaai lenye.
Neaku, nji ejo Olaitoriani, ng'ura kayau nanu entorroni shumata ninche nemeidim aatapaashare; ore hoo naaishiraki ninche nanu, maning nanu ninche.
Nepuo nkanas e Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem aaishiraki nena aitin naapejoki ninche enkorropil, kake meidim ninche aaitajeu ninche te nkata e nyamali enye.

Amu etaa kumok nkaitin inyi anaa nkanas inyi, iyie Yuda; naa kumok anaa nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem lpereren loo lasarri nintobira pee intukurrurru ate te lelo pereren loo lasarri oopejokinyeki Baal enkorropil.
“Metaa miomonoki iyie kulo tung'ana, aashu ilepie enkishirata aashu enkomono te rishata enye, amu mainining nanu tenaaipot ninche nanu tenkata enye enyamali.
Kaa sipata eeta ina nanyor nanu tiatua enkop ai, eidipa ataasa nkiaasin torrok? Keidim ilmuma o nkiri naaitaikiaki olasar aaiwuang'ie enkidaata ino? Eikintiship naa iyie ina?
Kimpoto apa iyie Olaitoriani ajo, ‘Oloirien onyori, obore ilng'anayio sidain;’ kake te nkikurrukur e ndarata sapuk epik ninye atua enkima, ore ilng'osil lenyena nemut enkima.
Ore Olaitoriani loo lororani, laa ninye apa likituuno iyie, kitudung'oko iyie entorrono, te nkaraki ina torrono nataasa enkaji e Israel o enkaji e Yuda, naaitagor nanu aapejoki Baal enkorropil.”
Naaitayiolo nanu Olaitoriani nayiolou nanu; nikintoki iyie aitodol nanu nkiaasin enye torrok.

Kake atiu apa nanu anaa olkuoo le ker obor oriki aapuo aayieng. Eitu apa nanu ayiolou ajo nanu eitobiraki ninche entorroni ejo, “Mainyala iyiook olchani tenebo ilng'anayio lenyena, matudung iyiook aaiwuang'ie te nkop oo looishu, pee meitokini ae kata aadamu enkarna enye.”
Kake ore, iyie Olaitoriani loo lororani, oiguana te sipata, ilo otem oltau o ndamunot nchooki nanu matoduaa elap ino te shumata ninche, amu iyie nanu aigarakine too mbaa aainei.
Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo lelo tung'ana le Anatot, lelo ooing'oru enkishui ino nejo, “Mimbonisho te nkarna Olaitoriani, aashu iye te nkaina ang”
neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Ng'ura, kaitame nanu ninche; keye lelo barnot to lalem; ore layiok lenye o ntoyie enye neye to lameyu;
nemeetae obo lenye oleku. Amu kayau nanu entorroni shumata iltung'ana le Anatot, teilo ari le nkitamioto enye.”
Ira iyie asipani, Olaitoriani, tenaaishankarrare nanu iyie; ore eyia kaitirrish nanu ororei lai te dukuya iyie. Kainyoo pee edupoyu enkoitoi oo larruok? Kainyoo pee edupoyu iltung'ana le nkeleekisho?
Iun iyie ninche, neibung ninche ntona; nebulu ninche neiu ilng'anayio; nitaana iyie too nkutukie enye nilakua too ltauja lenye.

Kake ore iyie, Olaitoriani, kiyiolo nanu, kidolita iyie nanu, nitem endamunoto ai tialo iyie. Teyietai ninche mpang'ie anaa nkerra naapuoi aayieng, nirragie ninche aiteng'el aitaany ina olong e yiang'are.

Keishir kenya enkop o anu? Netoyu nkujit e pooki ong'ata. Te nkaraki entorroni e lelo oomanya atua ore ng'uesi o motonyi nejutori aaishie te nkaraki natejo iltung'ana, “Medol ninye ae kiting'oto ang.”
“Amaa tenikueta akeshare iltungana too nkejek, nikintanaura ninche kaji naa inko tenikeshare mbartan? Naa amaa tenibatata te nkop naserian kaji naa inko tiatua osero lo lkeju le Yordan?
Amu ore ninye ilalashera linono o enkaji e papaai lino, eji kitakaldaitie sii ninche, miruk ninche, hoo neiro irorei supati te iyie.”
Aiturrayie nanu enkaji ai, naiturrayie enjung'ore ai aishooyie nanu ina nanyor to ltau lai, apik atua nkaik oo lmang'ati lenyena.
Etotiwuo enjung'ore ai te nanu anaa olng'atuny tiatua entim, eilepunye ninye oltoilo lenye aarare nanu; neaku kaiba nanu ninye.
Ketotiwuo enjung'ore ai anaa emotonyi narreshitoi, kemanita ninye motonyi naareshito too nkaloli pooki? Shomo inturrurro ing'uesi pooki e ntim iyau ninche meetu aapolol aanya.
Einyala ilairritak kumok loo ntare enkurma ai oo sabibu eitunyokito ninche enkop erubata ai, eitaa ninche ewueji ai sidai e ong'ata mitil.
Eitaa ninche ninye mitil; naaishiraki nanu ina nataa mitil eitaaki enkop pooki mitil kake meetae oltung'ani oshilaa.
Ore nena kisiashat pooki naaika to lpurkel neetuo lelo ooidaikie; amu kenya olalem lo Laitoriani enchoto nabo e nkop o metabaiki enkae; meetae o loata eseriani.
Etuuno ninche enkano neikesu ilkiku, eitanaurita ninche ate kake eitu edupore toki. Keitukurruni ninche te nkikesare enye te nkaraki engoro O Laitoriani napi.

Nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo, kulo le latia ai pooki torrok ooinyal ina jung'ore naishoo nanu iltung'ana laainei Israel metujung'o: “Ng'ura, kadotu nanu ninche aitung'uaa enkop enye, naa kadotu enkaji e Yuda aitung'uaa ninche.
Ore peyie aaidip nanu ataarai ninche, naitoki nanu aing'urrie ninche, naayau pooki ng'ae ewueji e enjung'ore enye o pooki ng'ae enkop enye.

Naa kelotu aaku teneibung ninche aakurraki nkoitoi oo ltung'ana laainei, pee enya olmumai te nkarna ai, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani,’ anaa sii apa enaiteng'ena ninche iltung'ana laainei meinosa olmumai te Baal, naa keshetuni ninche tiatua iltung'ana laainei.
Kake tenetii olosho lemening'isho, naa kadotu nanu tukul naidaikie ninye, Olaitoriani ojo.”
Nji aatiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, “Shomo inyang'u enkarasha e kitani, nipik empolos ino nimintadoiki ake atua enkare.”
Nainyang'u enkarasha empolos te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani naen te mpolos ai.
Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii nanu te nkata e are ejo,
“Iwa ina arasha e mpolos ninyang'ua naena te mpolos ino, nidumunye alo olkeju le Frati, nisudoo ina arasha teine to lbaata le ndapidapoi.”
Nalo nanu, naisudoo te Frati, anaa enaaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani.
Ore etulusoitie inkolong'i kumok naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Tudumunye, shomo Frati, ntayu teine enkarasha empolos apa naaitanapa iyie isudoi teine.”
Nalo nanu Frati, naturu, naitayu ina arasha teine wueji apa naisudorie ninye. Naa ng'ura, etarruoyie apa ina arasha e mpolos; meekure apa eeta tipat.
Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii ejo:
“Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Neijia aiko ainyal olwuasa le Yuda o ilo wuasa kitok le Yerusalem.

Ore kulo tung'ana torrok, oany ening irorei laainei, oosuj te ngolon enkong'u iltauja lenye maate neshomo aasujaa kulie aitin pee eisiaai ninche neserem ninche ketiu anaa ena arasha empolos naidaaie, nemeeta tipat.

Amu ore anaa enaenikino enkarasha empolos oltung'ani, neijia aikuna enkaji pooki e Israel o enkaji pooki e Yuda maateenikinoto ninche nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, pee etum ninche aataa te nanu iltung'ana o enkarna o enkisisa o enkitoo te nanu, kake mening'isho ninche.

“Irorie iyie ninche ele rorei, tiaaki, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel: Keiputi pooki siang'au e naisho oo lsabibu.’ Naa eikijoki ninche iyie, ‘Eimikiyiolo iyiook aaitisip aajo keiputi pooki siang'au e naisho oo lsabibu?’
Nitum iyie atiaaki ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Kaiput nanu emerai lelo pooki oomanya ena kop: lelo aiguanak ootonie olorika le Daudi le nkitoo o lapolosak o loibonok o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem.
Naitaar nanu ninche oltung'ani ake o likae, iloo menye o layiok lenye tenebo, Olaitoriani ojo. Maing'urrie nanu aashu aleku, aashu aitananaki oshoke pee mainyal nanu ninche.’ ”
Entoning ninchoruru enkiok; emiwuasa, amu eiroro Olaitoriani.

Enchoo enkitoo Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, eton eitu eyau ninye enaimin eton eitu errorro nkejek inyi te nchumata ildoinyo ooitomisimisoki, ore ing'oru iyie ewang'an neibelekeny ninye aitaa emisimisi neitaa ninye enaimin nagut.
Kake tenimining iyie, neishir oltau lai te nkisudoroto te nkaraki olwuasa lino; neishir nkonyek aainei te mion nerukunye ilkiyio, te nkaraki nataraiyioki eluaata Olaitoriani.
Tiaaki Olaiguanani o ng'otonye “Entadou ate too lorikan linyi le nkitoo, amu etadowuo enkopiyia ino e nkitoo sidai aing'uaa endukuya ino.”
Eikenoki nkanas e Negeb, nemeetae olobol ninche. Ewaki Yuda pooki eyararoto, etarayioki tukul.
Tushumu nkonyek inono toduaa lelo oopuonu ooing'uaa moikuape. Koree ina luaata apa nikinchooki iyie, ina luaata ino sidai?
Kaa iyie ijo tenepik ninche ate shumata iyie lelo apa laa iyie makewan oiteng'ena? Pee eaku ilchoreta te yie? Eimikimbung iyie emion, anaa emion enkitok nasaisai?
Naa tenijo iyie to ltau lino, kainyoo pee eetuo kuna baa shumata nanu? Te nkaraki esapuko e ntorroni ino pee eng'ishari ilkilani linono, nikisomiti iyie.
Keidim oltung'ani aibelekenya olchoni lo sesen lenye aashu olowuaru keri aibelekenya iltipot lenyena? Tenaa keidim, ore naa ntae laa ntorrok ake eas naa indimidimi aatayiolo aataas isidan.
Kaaidapash nanu iyie anaa suut, naayaita olkutati oing'uaa olpurkel.
Erubata ino ena, erubata naategelaka nanu iyie, Olaitoriani ojo, amu meekure kidamu iyie nanu nisiliga elejare.
Kangishaa nanu makewan olokesena lino apik shumata enkomom ino, naa kedoli enkurruna ino.
Atoduaa nanu olminong lino, o eloloito ino o enkisiishore ino o lduruk le loloito ino too nchumat oo ldoinyo o too nkong'at. Oi iyie, Yerusalem! Ibik kenya o anu, eton eitu kintaai sinyati.
Ele rorei lo Laitoriani oewuo enetii Yeremia eipirta olameyu:
“Eishirita Yuda neishirita nkanas enyena; neishir iltung'ana lenyena etoni te nkop neilep olkiyioi le Yerusalem alo shumata.

Ore lelo kituaak lenyena neirriwaa isinkan lenye meyau enkare; nepuonu ninche nchorroi nelau ninche enkare, nerrinyo ninche too motioo neemeti ae toki, etukurrutua ninche neidang'a neimulumul ilukuny enye.
Ore te nkaraki enkop natabee, te nkaraki neitu eshaiki enchan enkop netukurrutua ilaramatak, neimulumul ilukuny enye.
Keituraa ninye enkolii enkuo enye amu meetae nkujit.
Neitashe isirkon ti ong'ata too nkisiashat naaika, neipang'ipang aaok enkijape anaa mbariak neiliilaa nkonyek enye, amu meetae nkujit.
Ore hoo neishakenoki iyiook entorroni ang, taasa, iyie Olaitoriani te nkaraki enkarna ino, amu eikumok nchukot ang e siadi, kitaasa iyiook ing'ok tialo iyie.
Iyie osiligi le Israel, Olaitajeunoni lenye te nkata e nyamali kainyoo iyie pee itiu anaa olomoni te nkop, anaa olalotoni oun olng'obor lenye te nkaraki enkewarie.
Kainyoo iyie pee itiu anaa oltung'ani oidang'a, anaa oltung'ani ogol lemeidim aitajeu? Ore eyia, iyie Olaitoriani, itii empolos ang, neipotoki iyiook te nkarna ino; ming'uaa iyiook.

Nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo kulo tung'ana: ‘Etonyorra ninche aaidapashari aaiko nji, eitu ninche eibooyo nkejek enye; neaku meng'amu ninche Olaitoriani, kedamu ninye entorroni enye neitame ing'ok enye.’ ”
Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Miomon te nkaraki olmabarishoi le kulo tung'ana.

Ore hoo neen ate aaitupukoo, maning nanu olkiyioi lenye, naa ore hoo neishoru ninche ilasarri oopejori o lasar le ntapa, mang'amu nanu ninche; kake kamut nanu ninche to lalem o to lameyu o tolmeitai.”
Najo nanu; “Oi Olaitoriani Enkai, ng'ura, ejoki iloibonok ninche, ‘Midolidolo intae olalem aashu itumutumu olameyu, kake kaisho nanu intae eseriani nadede tiatua ene wueji.’

Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani: ‘Elejare eibonu lelo oibonok te nkarna ai: eitu nanu airriwaa ninche, neitu nanu aitanap ninche aashu airorie ninche. Kimbonokito ninche iyie enduaata e lejare o enaibon e pesho o elejare oo ndamunot enye.
Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo lelo oibonok ooibonisho te nkarna ai hoo neitu nanu airriwaa ninche o lelo oojo melotu olalem aashu olameyu ena kop: to lalem o to lameyu emuti lelo oibonok.

Ore lelo tung'ana laa ninche eibonoki nenang'ari boo tiatua nkoitoi e Yerusalem, pee ear ninche olameyu o lalem, metii hoo obo onukaa ninche o nkituaak enye, o layiok lenye o ntoyie enye. Amu kabukoki nanu entorroni enye shumata ninche.

“Tiaaki iyie ninche ele rorei: ‘Nchoo nkonyek aainei enang'ari too lkiyio kewarie o ndama, naa nchoo ninche eaku medung'o aekata, amu ore ina selenkei oo ltung'ana laainei netooshoki aapik olbae sapuk te oshoto sapuk oleng.
Tenaipang nanu alo ong'ata, nadol lekua ootaraki to lalem! Tenajing nanu enkang, nadol ilootara olameyu! Amu ore pooki oiboni o lapolosani neas biashara enye te nkop pooki, nemeeta eng'eno.’ ”

Olaitoriani itanya iyie Yuda katukul? Ketonyimo oltau lino Sion? Kainyoo iyie pee itoosho iyiook, ometaa meetae olmairo te yiook? King'oru iyiook eseriani, kake meetae esidai naewuo; kisiligu enkata enkishiunoto, naa ng'ura oloputukunyi.
Kimbalie iyiook entorroni ang, iyie Olaitoriani o entorroni oo loo papa lang, amu kitaasa iyiook eng'oki tialo iyie.
Ore te nkaraki enkarna ino, minturaa iyiook. Mintadou olorika lino le nkitoo; tadamu nimigil olning'o lino lo sotua tenebo iyiook.

Ketii kulie tiatua nena aitin e lejare oo loreren naaidim aayau enchan? Aashu tenaa keidim shumata aishoru enkirujuruj? Aimira iyie ninye, Olaitoriani Enkai ang? Kipik iyiook osiligi lang iyie, amu ias iyie kuna baa pooki.

Naaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki nanu, “Ore naaji ninye teneitashe Musa o Samuel te dukuya nanu, meibelekenya oltau lai aing'or kulo tung'ana. Taarai ninche meshomo too nkonyek aainei, naa nchoo ninche meshomo!

Ore ake pee kinkilikuan ninche iyie, aajoki, ‘Kaji iyiook kipuo?’ Nijoki iyie ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani:’ “Ore lelo lo lmeitai nepuo olmeitai, ore lelo laa ilo lalem nepuo enetii olalem ore lelo; laa ilo lameyu, nepuo enetii olameyu, ore lelo laa ile yararoto nepuo eyararoto.
“Kagelaki nanu shumata ninche mpukunot ong'uan oo looidaikie, Olaitoriani ojo: olalem oar, ildien oopolos, olmotonyi lo loing'ang'e o ng'uesi enkop pee emut ninche aaidaikie.
Naa kaitaa nanu ninche entoki naitureisho too nkitoriat pooki enkop te nkaraki ina nataasa Manase olayioni le Hesekia, olaiguanani le Yuda tiatua Yerusalem.
“Kaing'ae liking'urrie iyie oo Yerusalem, aashu kaing'ae likinchiraki iyie? Kaing'ae oibelekenya aikilikuanu olmabarishoi lino?
Kitanya iyie nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, iton arrinyo siadi; neaku aaitorioki nanu enkaina ai pee aagilunore naaidaikie iyie, anaure nanu te nkibooroto engoro ai.
Atisila nanu ninche te silet nasilishoreki, too nkang'itie pooki eina kop; aishirie nanu ninche, aidaikie nanu iltung'ana kumok; neitu ninche eibelekenya aaing'uaa nkoitoi enye.
Aitaa nanu esiana oo nkolia enye kumok alang osinyai loo naaiposha; ayaka nanu noo ng'otonye ilmurran ooti olainyalani te nkipirata e nkolong; aishoo nanu emion o lkirutoto metadoiki ninche aluam.

Ore ina natoiwuo nkera naapishana neiterre; etadoyie enkolong enye eton aa dama; eitukurruaki netusulaki. Ore inkera naatelekutua, naisho metaari to lalem te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye, Olaitoriani ojo.”
Woi nanu, yieyio lai, amu kitoiwuo nanu, oltung'ani o ekenya okeshare enkop pooki, neitu aisilenisho, kake aadekita ninche pooki.
Metaa nchoo etiu neijia, Olaitoriani, teneitu nanu aaisiaai aitobiraki teneitu nanu aasai iyie terishata oo lmang'ati laainei etii ninche atua enyamali o sina.
Ketii obo oidim atigila esekenkei naing'uaa moikuape o suyai?
“Ore karsisisho ino o lchumati lino naa kaisho metarrari, metii enkinyang'a, te nkaraki ing'ok inono pooki, tiatua enkop ino pooki.
Kaaisho nanu iyie isiaayia ilmang'ati linono tiatua enkop nimiyiolo, amu ore te ngoro ai neinuaaki enkima nayupuyup ntarasi.”
Olaitoriani iyiolo iyie; tadamuaki nanu nikibaiki nanu, nintalaku elap tialo nanu too laisilisilok laainei. Ore te ng'iriata ino mikiya nanu; tayiolo ajo te nkaraki iyie pee anap imorot.
Anoto irorei linono, naibirribirra nanu ninche, neaku irorei linono te nanu eng'ida o enchipai o ltau lai; amu te nkarna ino aaipotoki nanu, Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani.
Eitu nanu aton to lturrur loo looshipa, ang'ida; atotona nanu openy, amu etii apa enkaina ino shumata nanu, amu kimputa nanu engoro.
Kainyoo pee meish emion ai. Nemeishiunoyu olbae lai, ketanya eishiunyeki? Itiu iyie te nanu anaa ereyiet nalejisho (nadudung'o nkariak), anaa nkariak naaishunye?
Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani: “Tenishukunye, naang'amu nanu, naa intashe iyie te dukuya nanu. Teniro iyie ina sidai, neme ina nara pesho, nitiu iyie anaa enkutuk ai.
Naa kaaitaa nanu iyie te kulo tung'ana esuntai nasheta osuyai; aikiarare ninche iyie, kake mikimir ninche iyie, Olaitoriani ojo.
Kaakordu nanu iyie aitung'uaa enkaina eilo torrono, naalaku iyie aitung'uaa enkibung'ata eilo lemeeta olng'ur.”
Aarorie Olaitoriani naajoki:
“Miyamisho aashu iiu ilayiok aashu ntoyie tene wueji.
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo ilayiok o ntoyie naaini tene wueji o tialo ntomonok naatoiwutuo ninche o lpayian ooiu ninche tiatua ena kop:

keye ninche too nkeyaitin torrok. Meishirakini ninche, aashu enukari; ketiu ninche anaa emodiei ti oriong enkop, keidak ninche to lalem o to lameyu, ore mpopoki enye neaku endaa too lmotonyi lo loing'ang'e, o too lowuarak le ntim.
“Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: Mijing enkaji naishirieki, aashu ilo aishir, aashu aishiraki ninche, amu aiwuang'ie nanu eseriani ai te kulo tung'ana, Olaitoriani ojo, enyorrata ai nauno o lng'ur.
