Meetae entorroni enye nabo naataasa naitokini aadamu te nkaraki ninye; ore tesupatisho nataasa nemeeta nchere, meton eishu.
Kaatayie nanu enchipai keeya e ilo torrono, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, neme nchere pee eibelekenya ninye te nkoitoi enye neton eishu?

Kake teneibelekenya oltung'ani supat aing'uaa ina supatisho enye neas ing'ok neas nena bususi olminong pooki naasita ilo tung'ani torrono, keidim atotona eishu ninye? Meetae nabo oo siaaitin naataasa supati naitokini aadamu; amu ore te nkitapong'oto nataayie ninye olarruoni o te ng'oki nataasa ninye, naa kee.
“Nijo ake, ‘Ore ina oitoi Olaitoriani nemesipa!’ Inining'o tena kata, iyie naaji e Israeli: Amaa enkoitoi ai aimesipa? Aime inkoitoi inyi nemesipa?
Ore teneibelekenya oltung'ani supat aing'uaa esupatisho enye, neas ing'ok, naa keye te nkaraki ina; keye te nkaraki ina ng'oki nataasa.
Ake sii, ore teneibelekenyunye oltung'ani aing'uaa nena torrok naataasa neas ina naishiaakino nesipa, naa keitajeu enkishui enye.
Amu etujurruo neibelekenyunye aing'uaa ntorrok pooki naataasa, meeta nchere peyie meton eishu, meye ninye.
Nejoito ake enkaji e Israel, ‘Ore enkoitoi o Laitoriani nemesipa!’ Iyie na aji e Israel, amaa nkoitoi aainei aimesipa? Aime nkoitoi inono nemesipa?

“Metaa ekaaiguanare iyie, iyie na aji e Israel, pooki ng'ae te risioroto oo inkoitoi enyena, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai. Irridu nimbelekenya aing'uaa intorrok inono pooki, aashu eyaku ing'ok inono enkidaaroto ino.
Taarai intung'uai kewan intorrok pooki nena nitaasa kigilunore nanu, nitumokiki ate oltau ng'ejuk o enkiyang'et ng'ejuk! Kainyoo peyie iye naaji e Israel?
Amu maata enchipai e keeya e pooki ng'ae ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; metaa imbelekenyunye pee inchu.”
Ore iyie tudumu enkishirata adumaki ilkituaak le Israel,
nijo: Kaa lipong apa olng'atuny ng'utunyi tiatua ilng'atunyo! Eitubulua ing'atunyo kutiti tiatua ilng'atunyo.
Eitubulua nabo oo ng'atunyo enyena, neaku oloti ng'atuny, neitamok kewan eneiko teneibung ing'uesi, nenya ninye iltung'ana.
Ore iloreren nening'oo ninche, nerreshi ninye te ngumoto enye neyau ninche ninye too lala oogamishoreki, aayau enkop e Misiri.
Ore pee edol ng'otonye ajo eisulieki, netaa eiting'o osiligi lenye, neya ninye likae kuoo, too lkuoo lenyena, neitaa oloti ng'atuny.
Neloolo ninye tiatua ilng'atunyo, neaku oloti ng'atuny; neitayiolo kewan eneiko teneibung ing'uesi; nenya iltung'ana.
Nemut aidaikie isempewueti lenye, neitomijooni inkanas enye; ore enkop neiputukuny o lelo pooki oomanya ninye, to ltoilo le nkikurrukur enye.
Ina peyie edumakino ninye iloreren aarare ninye, nepik irresheta pooki alo; neisalaashaki orreshet lenye shumata enye; neyae ninye atua engumoto enye.

Ore too lala oololo nepiki ninye osanduku, oibung'ieki nenapieki ing'uesi neyakini ninye olaiguanani le Babilon; nenapi ninye atua ewueji neikenorieki, peyie meitokini aekata aaning oltoilo lenye, te shumata lelo doinyo le Israel.
Etiu apa ng'utunyi anaa osabibu le nkurma, otuunokoki embata enkare, oiu ilng'anayio nebore sii ilng'osil, te nkaraki enkare sapuk.
Ore enchata enye e mpolos neaku eng'udi o laiguanani; etubulua ninye alus pooki, tiatua nenen neesur oo lng'osil; nedoli enkadori enye, tiatua enkumoi oo lng'osil lenyena.

Kake etadotuoki olchani loo sabibu te ngoro napi, aanang'aki enkop, ore olkutati loo loo saen neitoi ninye; ore ilng'anayio lenyena nedung'ori, ore entonata o lchani ogol neitoi, nemut ninye enkima aidaikie.
Enyaakaki taata aaun to lpurkel, te nkop natoyio nemetii enkare.

Neshomo enkima aing'uaa entonata enye, nemut ilng'osil lenyena olng'anayio, metaa metii enetelekua te ninye teina tonata nagol, nemeetae eng'udi o laiguanani. Ore ena naa enkishirata, netaa enkishirata.
Ore to lari le naapishana, to lapa le imiet te nkolong e tomon o lapa, nepuonu embata oo lpayiani le Israel aaikilikuanu mbaa to Laitoriani, netoni te dukuya nanu.
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

“Enkerai e tung'ani, irorie ilpayiani le Israel nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Ainanu ipuonunu aaikilikuanishore pee ietuo? Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, mikinkilikuanishorere nanu.
Aiminguanare iyie ninche, enkerai e tung'ani, aiminguanare iyie ninche? Ina pee inchosho ninche metayiolo olminong loo loo menye,

nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong apa nategelua Israel, nanya olmumai teina ishoi e nkaji e Yakobo, naitayiolo kewan ninche teina kop e Misiri, ainosa apa olmumai teninche ajo, Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

Ore teina olong nainosa olmumai te nkaraki ninche inchere kayau ninche aitupuku teina kop e Misiri aya ninche ina kop naing'uraka ninche, enkop naruko kule o enaisho, enkop sidai aisul too nkuapi pooki.

Najoki nanu ninche, entayu enturrai intokitin torrok naadaare nkonyek inyi, pooki ng'ae te intae, nimintokiki aaisarkionie ate too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu e Misiri; Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

Kake etaa ninche kiseruti te nanu nemaaning nanu; eitu eitayu aipang'ie ong'ata pooki tung'ani intokitin torrok naaing'or nkonyek enye neitu eiturraa nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu e Misiri. “Nadamu nanu ajo kabukoki engoro ai napi shumata ninche, naishoru engoro ai aarare ninche tiatua enkop e Misiri.
Kake ataasa enataasa te nkaraki enkarna ai, peyie meisarkionieki te dukuya iloreren lelo oomanya atua, lelo laibalakinye kewan edolita aitupuku ninche teinakop e Misiri.
Metaa atorikoyie ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri nayau ninche atua olpurkel.
Naisho ninche nkiguanat aainei naitodol ninche nkitanapat aainei, laa ore pooki tung'ani ogolie asuj ninche, neton eishu.
Ore ake sii aishoo ninche isabatoni aainei, anaa olmonekie te rishata ai o ninche, peyie etum aatayiolo aajo nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninche.

Kake ore enkaji e Israel netaa kiseruti te nanu to lpurkel, eitu ninche epuoyie nkiguanat aainei kake etanyaita nkitanapat aainei, naa tenesuj oltung'ani ninche neton eishu; ore isabatoni aainei neisarkionie oleng. “Ina peyie adamu ajo kabuku engoro ai abukoki shumata ninche to lpurkel peyie atum aishie ninche tukul.
Kake ataasishe te nkaraki enkarna ai, peyie meisarkionieki ninye te dukuya iloreren, laa ninche aitupukunye ninche edolita.
Ore ake sii nainosa olmumai te nkaraki ninche to lpurkel inchere mayau ninche ina kop naishoo ninche, enkop naruko kule o enaisho, enkop naisul te sidano.
Ore amu etanyaita ninche nkiguanat aainei neitu epuoyie ninche nkitanapat aainei, neisarkionie isabatoni aainei; amu etusuja iltauja lenye nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu.
Ore ake eyia, eing'urrie enkong'u ai ninche, neaku eitu amut ninche aidaikie aashu aiting'ie ninche tiong'ota.
“Najoki nanu nkera enye tiong'ota, emipuoyie nena kitanapat o loo papaai linyi, aashu isujusuju inkiguanat enye, aashu indurukiekie ate too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu.
Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; enchomie nkitanapat aainei ning'oring'oro oleng aajurru nkiguanat aainei,
niyanyititi isabatoni aainei peyie etum aataa olmonekie te rishata ai o intae, peyie iyiolouu aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

Kake ore nena kera netaa kiseruti te nanu; eitu ninche epuoyie nkiguanat aainei, neitu ejurru aaing'or inkiguanat aainei, naa te njurrunoto najurruni eishu oltung'ani; eisarkionie ninche isabatoni aainei. “Ina peyie adamu ajo kairriu engoro ai napi shumata ninche naitorioki engoro ai agilunore ninche ti ong'ata.
Kake aibooyie nanu enkaina ai, naasisho te nkaraki enkarna ai, peyie meisarkionieki ninye te dukuya iloreren, laa too nkonyek enye aipang'unye nanu ninche.
Ore ake sii ainosie ninche olmumai tiong'ata inchere ekaisardakie ninche tiatua iloreren naidapashaa ninche too nkuapi,
amu eitu eas ninche nkiguanat aainei, kake etanyaita nkitanapat aainei neisarkionie isabatoni aainei, ore nkonyek enye neitoriokino nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu oo loo menye.
Ore ake eyia naishoo ninche nkitanapat nena nemesidain o nkiguanat naa te ninche meidim aanoto enkishui;

naisarkionie nanu ninche te nena kishoorot enye, aisho ninche meishooi to lasar le nkima lelo kikaunot lenye, pee atum aituria ninche; ataasa nanu ina pee etum ninche aatayiolo nchere Kara nanu Olaitoriani.
“Metaa, nakerai e tung'ani, irorie enkaji e Israel nijoki ninche, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore ake sii, nena ae toki naatamorie iloo papaai linyi, amu eitarruoitie ninche te dukuya nanu.

Ore apa peyie ariku ninche ina kop apa nainosie olmumai ajo kaisho ninche, neaku ore pooki doinyo oodo odol aashu olchani ake ninye pooki oata imbenek, neishooyo ninche teine ilasarri lenye, neitarasaa ninche teine olasar le ngoro; neirriwaa teine olasar le ngoro ooki.
(Naikilikuan nanu ninche, kaji ine wueji neika nipuopuo? Neaku keji enkarna e ine Bama o metabaiki ena olong.)
Neaku naa tiaaki enkaji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Indurukiekie ate anaa enaikuna iloo papaai linyi nipong'oriri aasuj nena tokitin enye naaiduruk?

Ore tinintayuyu inkishoorot inyi nintayuyu inkera inyi too lasarri le nkima, nindurukiekie ate too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin inyi nemeishu pooki o ena olong. Naa aikindimidimi intae aaikilikuanishore nanu, na aji e Israel? Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, mikinkilikuanishorere intae nanu.
“Ore ina natii indamunot inyi nemeaku aekata ina damunoto, ‘Matotiu anaa iloreren anaa iloshon loo nkuapi, nikiserem inkeek o soito.’
“Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, esipa te nkaina magilani o te nkaina naitoriori, o te ngoro natubukuoki, kaaku nanu Olaiguanani te shumata iyie.
Ekaaitayu iyie aitupuku tiatua iloreren naiturrurru intae aitung'uaa nkuapi nena nindapashakinote, te nkaina magilani o te nkaina naitoriori, o te ngoro nabukuni,
naa kayau nanu intae ongota too loshon, najing teine enkiguana tenebo intae king'ura too nkomomi.
Anaa enatijinga enkiguana tenebo iloo papaai linyi tiong'ota enkop e Misiri, naa kajing enkiguana tenebo intae, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
Ekaimie intae abori eng'udi, naisho intae entijing atua te nkikena.
Ekaisujaa lelo kiseruti tiatua intae, o lelo ooas intorrok aagilunore nanu; ekaitupuku ninche teina kop nashomo kake mejing ninche enkop e Israel. Ina peyie iyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

“Ore te iyie, iyie naaji e Israel, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Shomo pooki ng'ae isiayia inkaitin oo nkitanyaanyukot inono nemeishu, tenakata o te siadi ena, tinimikining'ining'i nanu; kake ore enkarna ai sinyati mintokiki aikata aaisarkionie too nkishoorot inyi oo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu.

“Amu ore te shumata oldoinyo lai sinyati, too nchumat oo ldoinyo le Israel, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, teine aaisiai enkaji pooki e Israel pooki ng'ae, akaaisiaiai nanu teina kop; naa kang'amaa nanu ninche teine, naa teine aikilikuanu inkishoorot inyi o ntokitin sidain oo nkishoorot inyi, tenebo lasarri linyi oosinya.

Anaa esong'uana narropil ekang'amaa intae, ina kata naitupuku intae too loreren, naiturrurru intae aitung'uaa nena kuapi pooki naaidapashakaki intae; naa kaibalunye esinyatisho ai tiatua intae edolita iloreren pooki.
Niyiolouu aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nayau intae enkop e Israel, ina kop apa nainosie iloo papaai linyi olmumai ajo kaisho ninche
ore teine naa idamumu inkoitoi inyi o pooki nitaasa te nena nindurukie ate, naa igorokinono ate te pooki torrono nitaasa.

Naa iyiolouu inchere Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata naitaas intae ina te nkaraki enkarna ai, neme te nkaraki inkoitoi inyi torrok neme te nkaraki isiaaitin inyi torrok, iyie naaji e Israel, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino enkalo e kopikop tolikioi ororei tigilunore kopikop,

nimbonoki agilunore entim e nkop e Negeb ijoki: entim e Negeb toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ekaainuaaki iyie enkima, naa kemut pooki shani onyori otii atua iyie o pooki shani otoyio; ore ilo olang'at le nkima nemearaiyu, ore inkomomi pooki eiteru te kopikop o metabaiki moikuape naa keilang ninye.
Ore iseseni pooki naa kedol aajo nanu Olaitoriani oinuaa ninye nemeari ninye.”
Ina peyie ajo, “Aha, Olaitoriani Enkai! Aajoki ninche nanu, ‘Aime hoo nkitanyaanyukot ake elimu ele?’ ”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino enkalo e Yerusalem niliki ororei aarare nena wuejitin sinyat; imbonoki tigilunore enkop e Israel
nijoki ina kop e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani: Ing'ura ekaarare iyie, naa kaaitorioki iyie olalem lashutu te nchashur enye, nadung'oo tiatua iyie lelo supati o ltorrok.
Ore amu kadung'oo te iyie lelo supati o lelo torrok, neaku kepuku olalem lai aing'uaa enchashur enye aarare iltung'ana pooki eiteru te kopikop o meshomo moikuape;
neyiolou iltung'ana pooki aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani otushutua olalem lai te nchashur; nemeitokini aaigil aashukoki olalem enchashur.
Iyagie naa, enkerai e tung'ani; iyagie oltau omu keeta osina to ltau le mion te dukuya nkonyek enye.

Naa tinikinkilikuan ninche aajoki, ‘Kainyoo peyie iyagie?’ Naa ijoki, ‘Te nkaraki lelo kiliku oopuonu. Ore peyie ebau, naa kelepori pooki tau ore nkaik pooki naa keshalu, ore pooki tau neiterre neshalu nkung pooki anaa enkare. Ing'ura, ajo kelotu naa keitabari ninye.’ ” Ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki,
“Enkerai e tung'ani, imbonisho nijo, Ena ejo Olaitoriani: Olalem, eiyoki olalem, neiutuutoki aasik,
aaii te nkaraki eyieng'are, netisikaki meimerlela anaa enkiwuang'ata! Aashu aikintobiru enkuenia? Itemenayie eng'udi, enkerai ai, o pooki toki e nchata.
Metaa eishooyioki olalem metisiki, peyie etumi aaibung'a neiyoki nesiki, peyie etumi aatipik ina aina oloyieng'isho.

Inchira niyietu nakerai e tung'ani, amu kegilunore ninye iltung'ana laainei; kegilunore ninye iltung'ana pooki kituaak le Israel; etipikaki ninche pooki olalem tenebo iltung'ana laainei. Toosho naa enkupes ino.
Amu meaku ninye entemata kaa keas ninye tinimenaa iyie engudi?” Ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
“Imbonisho naa, enkerai e tung'ani, toosho inkaik inono nincho olalem meeu adou katitin are, ee kat uni, ilo alem le lelo ooari metuata; olalem leyieng'are kitok, laa ninye oman ninche,
peyie etum iltauja lenye aatalepori, nebatata ilkumok too nchomito enye. Aishorua ilo alem oimerlel; Aha! Eitobiruno ninye anaa enkiwuang'ata, netisikaki peyie etum ateyiengisho.
Tudung'o oleng tatene o kedianye ine wueji netuutakaki enepi olalem.
Ekaosh sii nanu inkaik aainei, naa kaitaraposh engoro ai; nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.”
Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, tuutu inkoitoi are te nkaraki ilo alem le ilo aiguanani le Babilon olotu; epuonu pokira are teinakop. Nintobiriri embao nautu eneimi, nipik ninye dukuya ina oitoi nalo enkanasa;
tuutu enkoitoi naaim ilo alem alo Raba oo Lamoni o meshomo Yuda o meshomo Yerusalem ina ang nasheta isunta.

Amu eitasho olaiguanani le Babilon teine neorore inkoitoi te rishata e nena oitoi are, easishore enaibon; neikirikirie mbaa, neikilikuanishore enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Terafi, neing'or emoinyua eina ng'ues naibonishore.

Ore atua enkaina enye e tatene nepuku enkukuo e Yerusalem pee ebol enkutuk enye te nkishirata, peyie eilepie oltoilo te mbuaata, pee eitorioki isekenke naagilieki nchomito neitasheyie nenen neesheta te ng'olon neshetu iltaleta ooibung'ishore.
Kake ore te ninche, netiu anaa enaibon elejare; einosa ninche ilmuma oogol; kake eyau ninye eng'oki enye metadamuni, peyie etumi aaibung'a.

“Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu intaa ing'ok inono inaadamuni, teina nemeekure eisudoroyu intorrok inono, neaku ore too siaaitin inono pooki naa keibalayu ing'ok inono; amu ieuo iyie adamu; naa aikiya ninche iyie.
Ore iyie, intae iltung'ana torrok lemesinya, olkitok le Israel, ilo oewuo enkolong enye, erishata enkitamioto ino nabayie,
inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Intayu enkarasha endukuya, nintayu ina maupe enkitoo; meitoki intokitin aatiu anaa enaikununo; isisa ina nidol etii abori, nintadou ina natii shumata.
Enkidaata, enkidaata, kaitobiru nanu enkidaata; metumi ninye eneima ninye o meeu ninye aa enenye esipata; naa ninye aisho nanu.

“Ore iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, imbonisho nijo: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai tialo Ilamoni, neipirta sii enkurruna enye; tejo, Olalem, olalem etushurtuaki peyie eyieng'ishoi, netisikaki meimerlela anaa enkiwuang'ata,

ore edol ninche te ntae induaat elejare ina kata eibonoki ninche intae elejare, peyie eeniki imurto e lelo tung'ana lemesinya torrok, lelo ootabaikia ninche enkolong enye enkata enkitamioto enye nabayie.
Tushukoki olalem enchashur enye. Teine wueji nikintobirieki iyie, teinakop apa ning'uaa ekaaiguanare nanu iyie.
Naa kabukoki shumata intae engoro ai; nakutaki intae enkima engoro ai; naa kapik intae inkaik oo ltung'ana arruok meidaikie.
Iakuku intae ilkeek le nkima; ore osarge linyi nejing empolos e ina kop; meitokini aekata aadamu intae; amu nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.”
Ore ake sii eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani ine natii naajoki:
“Nakerai e tung'ani, aiminguanare iyie, aiminguanare iyie enkanasa osarge? Nimbalakinye ninye nena baa pooki olminong enyena.
Naa ijoki, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore enkanasa naibukoyie osarge te rishata enye; peyie etum enkata enye aeu, neitobiru nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu aidurukie kewan!

Itaa iyie torrono te nkaraki osarge limbukoitie; ninduruko te nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu nintobirutua, niyautua aaitinyiku enkolong inyi etabawua ina kata nageluno oo larin linyi. Neaku aaitaa iyie enkurruna too loreren, nikisurdaanyi iyie too nkuapi pooki.
Ore lelo ootaana o lelo oolakua te iyie naa aikisurdaany iyie, iyie neme toki, nebore enking'oling'ol.
“Ng'ura ajo ore lelo kituaak le Israel netii atua iyie, pooki ng'ae te ngolon enye, netemerregelaki to sarge oibukori.
Ore papa o yieyio neitaasaki ino lmena tiatua iyie; ore olomoni otii atua iyie neisimaki te rishata ino; ore nkokishin o nkolia tiatua iyie neinyalaki.
Itemenayie iyie intokitin aainei sinyat, nisarkionienie isabatoni aainei.
Etii iltung'ana ootii atua iyie ooiro imbaa enkarruoisho pee eibukori osarge, oltung'ana tiatua iyie oodaa too nchumat oo ildonyio; iltung'ana ooas enkarruoisho tiatua intae.
Ore tiatua iyie neoru iltung'ana iloo menye ilkilani, ore tiatua iyie neibung inkituaak te rishata enye o lapa.
Eas obo olminong te nkitok ole latia enye; ore likae neotiki te nkoitoi torrono ainyal enkitok olayioni lenye; ore likae tiatua iyie neinyal enkanashe enye, entito e papaai lenye.
Ore ake tiatua iyie neya iltung'ana eropare peyie eibukoo osarge; niyaya ilaat emponaroto e dupoto inyi too lelatia linyi ironyironyo; nemeekure kidamumu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
“Ing'ura, ore naa, atoosho inkaik aainei tenebo teina dupoto e lejare nintobirua o te ilo sarge otii erishata ino.
Keidim engolon ino e oshoke atobikoi, aashu keidim inkaik inyi aatagol, te nena olong'i naalotu aarare iyie? Nanu Olaitoriani oiroro, naa kaas ina.
Ekaaidapash iyie tiatua iloreren naisardakie iyie too nkuapi, namut ilduruki linono te iyie.
Naa kaaisarkionieki nanu te dukuya iyie tiatua iloreren; niyiolou ajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, ore enkaji e Israel netupuruko oleng te nanu, ninche pooki. Ore enkosholai o suyai o empirbil o esekenkei o risasi otii atua olkokuet, netupuruko pooki.
Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu itupuruko pooki, neaku ing'ura ekaiturrur intae te rishata e Yerusalem.

Ore anaa enaiturrurru iltung'ana enkosholai o suyai o esekenkei o risasi o empirbil nepik atua olkokuet peyie ekutaki ninche enkima shumata ninye peyie etum aatoshol ninye; neaku kaiturrurru intae te ngoro ai o te ngoro ai napi, napik intae atua ashol intae.
Ekaiturrur intae nakutaki intae enkima engoro ai napi, naa kesholi intae te rishata enye.
Anaa enasholi enkosholai to lkokuet, naa kesholi intae te rishata enye; naa iyiolouu ajo nanu Olaitoriani otubukoko engoro ai shumata inyi.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani tiaaki ninye, ira iyie enkop nemesinya, aashu natashaikia teina olong e ng'oro.

Ore ilkituaak ootii atua ninye netiu anaa olng'atuny oikurrukur opolos eng'ues, etumuta enkishui oo ltung'ana; ewaita ninche ilchumat o ntokitin naagol enkinyiang'a; eitaa ninche inkituaak kumok inkolia.

Ore ilapolosak lenye netaasa ine nkikonya too nkitanapat aainei neisarkionie intokitin aainei sinyat; eitu ninche erishu intokitin sinyat o ntokitin e pooki ng'ae, neitu eitamok olorere enepaashare entoki naiduruk o esidai, netemenaitie ninche isabatoni aainei, metaa aaisarkionieki nanu tiatua ninche.

Ore ilkituaak ootii erishata enye netiu anaa isuyian oopolos inkiri e ng'ues naibung'a, neibukoo osarge, neishu enkishui peyie etum nena kishoorot nemesipa. Ekairriu enchan sapuk oleng, isoito sapuki le nchan, nelotu olkutati kitok oleng.
Ore iloibonok lenye netumura te nturoto e monkoi, nedol induaat nemesipa, neibonoki ninche elejare ejoki: ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai’, eitu ninye eiro Olaitoriani.
Etaasa iltung'ana lena nkop entorrono, netaasa ine nkikonya; eironya ninche ilaisinak o loomena, netaasa ine mesipa too ldokunot eitu ejurru enyamali enye.
Naing'oru oltung'ani tiatua ninche olo ashet ina suntai neitashe teina lusie e suntai te dukuya nanu te nkaraki ina kop, peyie matum aidaikie ninye; kake eitu atum hoo obo.
Metaa atubukuo nanu engoro ai shumata ninche; atumuta nanu ninche te nkima engoro ai napi; ore enkoitoi enye eitalakua too lukuny enye, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki;
“Enkerai e tung'ani, etii apa inkituaak are naa intoyie enkitok nabo;
neiborrie apa onyek te Misiri; neas ine nkiborra oo nkonyek te kitisho, neirrag ilki lenye, neirrapirrapi ilgooitie lenye.
Keji apa enkarna eina botor Ohola neji enkarna enkanashe enye Oholiba. Neaku ninche inaainei, neiu ninche ilayiok o ntoyie. Ore too nkarn enye ore Ohola naa Samaria ore Oholiba naa Yerusalem.
“Eiborrie ong'u Ohola aa enaai ninye, netonyarra ninye isintan lenyena, le Asiria,
ilmurran ooishopo inkilani naata emua morijoi, ilaitoriak o laitasheikinok, laa ore pooki naa ilbarnot oo ng'uarri oleng, nekedito ninche imbartan.
Eishoo ninye kewan ninche anaa emulayoi lelo gelunot pooki le Asiria; neidurukie kewan too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin e pooki ng'ae otaasie ine nkiborra oo nkonyek.

Eitu ninye epal esiaai enye enkiborra oo nkonyek ina apa nataasa eiteru too nkolong'i naatiiyie Misiri; amu ore apa te kitisho enye netaboitare ilewa ninye, neibung'a olgoo, netaboitare ninye etonaa eselenkei te mulayaisho nebukoki ninye enkiborra enye oo nkonyek.
Metaa atanang'aka nanu ninye atua inkaik oo sintan lenyena, inkaik oo le Asiria lelo apa ootonyorra te nkiborra oo nkonyek.
Nebolu lelo emasipaisho enye; neibung ilayiok lenyena o ntoyie enyena; ore tenebo ninye nedung to lalem; neaku ninye entoki naimakini tiatua inkituaak ina kata nadung'okini ninye enkiguana.
“Ore enkanashe enye Oholiba netoduaa ena naa torrono apa ninye oleng alang enkanashe enye te nkiborra oo nkonyek.
Eiborrie ninye onyek too le Asiria, ilkituaak o larikok, ilmurran ooishopo too masaa olarrabal, ilookedito imbartan, laa ore pooki naa ilbarnot oong'uarrayu.
Nadol apa ajo eidurukieki ninye; neim pokira orrekie obo.
Kake etanapa ninye enkiborra enye oo nkonyek aitulus; etoduaa ninye ilewa, ootaguetakaki inkitanyaanyukot enye isunta nena kitanyaanyukoto oo Ilkaldayo ooela to rankii oonyokie,
nerretena impolosi enye too nkeenta oo mpolosi o nkarash natii ilukuny enye netiu pooki anaa ilkituaak, empisha oo Ilbabilon laa ore enkop enye naa Ilkaldayo.
Ore peyie edol ninye ninche neiborrie onyek te ninche neirriwaki ilkiliku ninche too Ilkaldayo.
Nejing'aki Ilbabilon ninye tiatua endapash enye enyorrata, neidurukie ninye to lng'uarra lenye; ore peyie eidip ninche aaisarkionie ninye, nelo ninye aing'uaa ninche te ngoro.
Ore teneas ninye inenkiborra oo nkonyek meeta enkuretisho neboloo emasipaisho enye aaibelekenya te ngoro aing'uaa ninye, anaa peyie aibelekenya aing'uaa enkanashe enye.
Kake etoponayie ake ninye enkiborra oo nkonyek, edamu inkolong'i enyena e kitisho, ina kata eiborrie onyek te nkop e Misiri.

Neiborrie ninye onyek te lelo mao lenyena ooba irubat oo seseni lenye anaa inoo sirkon neeta esing'ate oo lamuyeishi loo mbartan oonyaanyukie isirkon, neikununo eneing'uaa anaa enetiu eneing'uaa imbartan.
Neaku neijia etiu eyieunoto e ntorroni oo lbarnot linono ina kata kimbung Ilmisiri olgoo lino neirony ilki linono kutiti.”
Metaa, oi iyie Oholiba, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ing'ura ajo kadumakino ilmao linono limbelekenyakine te ngoro mikitigilunore iyie eing'uaa nkaloli pooki.

Ore ile Babilon tenebo Ilkaldayo pooki o Pekod o Shoa o Koa, tenebo ile Asiria pooki tenebo ninche o ltung'ana pooki ooti sidain, ilaiguanak o laitoriak pooki tenebo, ilarikok o lmurran, ekedito pooki imbartan.

Naa aikipuonu aarare iyie eing'uaa enkalo e moikuape too ngarrin oo imbartan o ngarrin o lorora kitok lo lorere; keiturrurro ninche peyie kiarare too nkaloli pooki eeta ilong'oi kutiti o sapuki o nkopiyiani o larrabal, naa kapik enkiguana atua ninche, naa keiguanare intae anaa enatiu enkiguana enye.

Naa kaibelekenyaki intae engoro ai aarare intae, peyie atum ataarare intae te ngoro napi. Kedung'oo ninche inkumeishin inyi o nkiyiaa inyi, ore ilekunot linyi nebatatakino olalem. Naa keibung aaya ilayiok linyi o ntoyie inyi, ore ilekunot linyi nemuti te nkima.
Keoru sii intae inkilani inyi neya te intae isoito linyi linkasiesie.
Neaku neijia aiko tenaiting'ie enkiborra inyi oo nkonyek ina niyautua te nkop e Misiri; metaa mintokiki aaraposhoki nkonyek inyi Ilmisiri aashu intokiki aadamu ninche.
Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kapik intae atua inkaik e lelo limbaba, atua inkaik e lelo limbelekenyanya aaing'uaa te ngoro;

naa kearare ninche intae te nkiba, neya ninche aaitung'uaa intae ilng'anayio pooki le siaai inyi, neing'uaa intae irara imasipa nemeishopo, ore emasipaisho inyi o enkiborra oo nkonyek inyi neboluni. Ore olng'uarra lino tenebo enkiborra ino oo nkonyek
ninye nayawua ena shumata iyie, amu itaasa enkiborra oo nkonyek tenebo iloreren, nindurukie ate too nkitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin.
Itusuja iyie ina oitoi enkanashe ino; metaa kapik enkikompe enye enkaina ino.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Iok iyie enkikompe enkanashe ino, ina nagut naa sapuk; aikikueneiyieki iyie nikimenuni, amu keeta ninye esapuk;
aikimputi iyie emerei o sina Enkikompe enkuretisho sapuk o emutata, ina kikompe enkanashe ino Samaria;
iok iyie ninye nimitu pooki aishu, nidotu kewan ilpapit, nidung ilki linono; amu airoro nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ore amu kitorikine iyie nanu, nikinyaaya oriong ino, neaku tanapa naa enyamali ino olng'uarra lino o enkiborra ino oo nkonyek.”
Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani: “Enkerai e tung'ani, inguanare iyie Ohola o Oholiba? Neaku imbalakinye naa ninche imbaa enye olminong.
Amu etaasa ninche ine nkiborra oo nkonyek, netii osarge atua inkaik enye; ore too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu netaasa eloloito; neishoo doi ninye endaa lelo ayiok laa nanu etoikitio.
Ore ake sii eyia aaitaasa ninche nanu ena: eisarkionie ninche ewueji ai sinyati teina olong ake neisarkionie isabatoni aainei.

Amu ore peyie eidip aateyieng inkera enye te mpolosare too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu, ore teina olong ake neetuo ninche atua ewueji ai sinyati aaisarkionie ninye. Naa ing'ura ena etaasa ninche te nkaji ai.
Eipotutuo doi ninye iltung'ana meetu tenelakua naa nepuonu. Amu tiatua ninche isuja iyie kewan, niyel inkonyek inono, nikus kewan too masaa;
nitonini intae te shumata olorika sidai, niata emisa natipikaki dukuya iyie naa ninye itipika iyie enkorropil ai tenebo eilata ai.
Netii atua ninye oltoilo loo lororani lemeshilaa toki; tenebo ilewa ookishore tenebo ootorikuoki tiong'ota, nepik ninche ilkataarri inkaik e nena kituaak o maupen enkitoo sidain too ilukuny enye.
“Ina peyie ajo, aimeasita tena kata ilewa eloloito teneas enkiborra oo nkonyek tenebo ninye?
Amu etijing'akita ninche ninye, anaa enajing'aki ilewa enkitok naibor onyek. Neaku neijia eikunakinote ninche Ohila o Oholiba peyie eas ine nkiborra oo nkonyek.
Kake ore iltung'ana supati naa kedung'oki ninche enkiguana oo iltung'ana ooiborr onyek, tenebo o enkiguana oo nkituaak naaibukoitie osarge; amu inaaibor onyek ninche, netii osarge inkaik enye.”
Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Iyau olorora taarare ninche, nintaa ninche entoki naitureisho naaruno.
Naa kenang olorora ninche too soito neiwuang'ie ninche too lalema lenye; naa keyieng ninche ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye nepejoo inkajijik enye.
Neaku neijia aiko tenaiting'ie enkiborra enye oo nkonyek te nkop peyie etum ing'oruo pooki aaibung'ie ina inkiyiaa nemeitoki aas ine nkiborra oo nkonyek anaa enitaasa iyie.
Ore enkiborra inyi oo nkonyek naa keitalakuni te intae, ninapinapa elaakinoto te nkaraki eng'oki oo inkitanyaanyukot inyi oo nkaitin nemeishu; niyiolouu aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Ore to lari le naaudo to lapa le tomon, te nkolong e tomon o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani ing'ero enkarna ena olong, etamuata olaiguanani le Babilon Yerusalem.
Niro endung'et e rashe te nkaraki ina aji kiserut nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai:
Intasheyie ina moti, intasheyie ninye, tubukoki ninye enkare; tipika ninye indung'ot oo nkiri, nena dung'ot pooki sidain, enkupes o orony; nimput ninye too loik sidain gelunot.
Iwa enker naisul eluaata, nipik ilkeek le nkima abori enye; nintokitokie indung'ot enyena, nintokitokie sii iloik lenyena tiatua.

“Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Woi iyie ina anasa osarge, ina nanyaanyukie emoti nainosa enkop, neton ake eitu eing'uaa ninye oloirerio lenye! Intayu te ninye indung'ot iitu, miata enigelu te nkukuo.
Amu ore osarge oibukoyie ninye neton ake etii atua erishata enye; eiteleiki ninye enchumata endapidapoi nasipa eitu ninye ebukoki pee eitoipoo enterit.
Peyie edumu engoro ai napi, peyie aitalaku, atipika ninye shumata endapidapoi nasipa ilo sarge oibukoyie ninye peyie meitoipori ake.
Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Wooi iyie ina anasa naibukori osarge! Kaitaa sii nanu osototi loo lkeek sapuk.
Turupa ilkeek ninok enkima, nintokitokie oleng nena kiri nibuku nena tokitin naapiki ndaiki, nincho iloik epejori.
Nintasheyie ninye metii toki te shumata nkuk, peyie etum airowuaja, ore osuyai lenye nepeji peyie aa ore oloirerio lenye nesholi tiatua ninye, nemuti kutu enye.
Te mpesho aitanaura nanu kewan, ore ina kutu enye nairrusha nemeim enkima.
Ore ina kutu enye naa olduruk le nkiborra ino oo nkonyek. Amu anaata apa aaitukuo iyie neitu eitukuori olduruk lino. Mikintokini aaituku iyie aaigil o metaba anaa naidip aishu engoro ai te iyie.

Nanu Olaitoriani oiroro; naa kelotu aasayu ina, ekaas nanu; marrinyo nanu siadi, maaleku nanu, mairridu nanu; ore te risioroto oo inkoitoi inono o siaaitin inono ekaaiguanare nanu iyie ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Ore ake sii eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki,
“Enkerai e tung'ani, ng'ura ajo etaa kaya enchipai oo nkonyek inono peyie aaitung'uaa iyie te oshoto, niminchir hoo aashu isinanuo nemedou ilkiyio linono.
Iyang'a kake mibuaku; minchiraki ake lelo meneng'a. Teena enkarasha ino elukunya, nipik inkejek inono inamuka; niminuk ake enkutuk ino, aashu inya endaa e lelo ooishir.”
Neaku airorie nanu lelo tung'ana tadekenya, ore teipa neye enkitok ai, ore enkolong entadekenya nasuju naas ina naaitanapaki.
Naajoki nanu iltung'ana, “Aimiliki iyiook enautu kuna baa te iyiook, paa ninche iasita?”
Ina peyie ajoki ninche, “Aairorie Olaitoriani naajoki:

‘Tiaaki ina aji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ng'ura ajo kaisarkionie ewueji ai sinyati o lwuasa le ng'olon ino o enchipai oo nkonyek inono o eyieunoto oltau lino; ore ilayiok linono tenebo ntoyie inono nena nitung'uayie te siadi naa kebatata to lalem.
Naa ias iyie anaa ina nataasa; minuk iyie enkutuk ino, aashu inya endaa e lelo ooishir.
Ore inkarash inono e lukunya naa ketii ilukuny inyi netii inamuka nkejek inyi; nimisinanuonuo aashu inchirishiri, kake iishunyenye aamuta te nkaraki ing'ok inyi ning'orokinono maate.
Neaku neijia etiu Esekiel te iyie aaku olmonekie; te risioroto e nena pooki naataasa ias sii iyie. Ore peyie elotu ena naa iyiolouu taa aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai!’

“Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani, ore teina olong naya aitung'uaa ninche isempewueti lenye, enchipai enye o enkitoo enye o enchipai oo nkonyek enye o iyieunot oo ltauja lenye, tenebo sii ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye,
ore teina olong naa keisiku olaishirani ayaki intae lelo omon.
Ore teina olong naa ibolokiki ilo aishirani nkutukie inyi neaku iroro nimintokiki aaku ilemeidim aairoro. Neaku iakuku intae olmonekie te ninche; neyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki,
“Enkerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino enkalo oo Lamoni, imbonisho tigilunore ninche.

Tiaaki Ilamoni: Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai: Ore amu itejo ‘Aha!’ Te nkaraki ewueji ai sinyati ina kata peyie eisarkionieki ninye o te nkaraki ina kop e Israel ina kata peyie eitaa ninye mitil o te nkaraki ina aji e Yuda ina kata peyie elo eyararoto;

neaku kaaitarasaa iyie aitarasaki iltung'ana le nkalo o loosaen peyie iaku emasaai enye, naa keitasheyie ninche ilng'oborri lenye tiatua intae neitobiru imanyat enye tiatua intae; naa kenya ninche ilng'anayio linyi, neok ninche kule inyi.
Ekaitaa Raba olokeri loo ntamesin, ore nkanas oo Lamori emuatata oo ntare. Niyiolouu taa aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ore amu itoosho inkaik inyi nioshieshie inkejek inyi enkop nishipapa te nkaraki intorrok pooki naatii atua intae te nkaraki enkop e Israel,

metaa, neaku aitorioyie nanu enkaina ai aagilunore iyie naa kaaitarasaa iyie anaa iyarunot aitarasaki iloreren; naa kaadung'oo iyie aaitung'uaa loreren; naaisho iyie ndaai too nkuapi; ekaaidaikie iyie. Pee itum iyie atayiolo ajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu etejo Yuda, ing'ura ajo ore ina aji e Moab netiu anaa ilkulikae oreren pooki,
neaku kaboloo inkanas oo lpolosien le Moab eiteru too nkanas naatii ilpolosien lenyena o ina kop e Beteshimot o Baalmeon o Kiriatai.
Ekaishooyo ninye tenebo ile Amoni o metabaiki iltung'ana le nkalo o loo saen metaa enjung'ore, metaa meitokini aekata aadamu too loreren.
Naa kadung'oki Moab enkiguana; ina peyie etum aatayiolo nchere Kara nanu Olaitoriani.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu etaasa Edom entorrono aarare enkaji e Yuda, naaitagoro ninye aitalaku elap te ninche.
Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ekaitorioo enkaina ai aarare Edom, nadung'oo tiatua ninye tung'ani o eng'ues; naa kaitaa ninye mitil; eiteru te Teman o metabaiki Dedan naa kebatata ninche to lalem.
Naa kapik elap ai shumata Edom te nkaina oo ltung'ana laainei Isiraeli; naa keas ninche te Edom anaa enatiu engoro ai anaa enatiu; naa keyiolou ninche elap ai, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ore amu eitalakutua Ilfilisti elap neya ina to lwuasa lo ltau pee eidaikie teilo omang'ati lemeish;
neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kaitorioo enkaina ai agilunore Ilfilisti, naa kadung'oo ile Kereti, namut iloomanaa le naiposha.
Ekairriu elap sapuk shumata ninche te ngoro sapuk e nkitamioto. Ina pee eyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata naiteleiki elap ai shumata ninche.”
Ore to lari le tomon oobo, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

“Enkerai e tung'ani, ore amu etejo Tiro embae naipirta Yerusalem ejo, ‘Aha, ore ina kishomi oo loreren netigilaki, etabole tukul aisiu te nkaraki nanu; ekaaitasheyieki nanu, ore naa amu eitomijoonoki,’
neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kaarare iyie, iyie Tiro, naa kayau iloshon kumok mikitaarare iyie, anaa enayau enaiposha ilopir lenyena.
Kemut ninche isunta e Tiro, negil auroo iltaleta lenyena; naa keoroo enterit aitung'uaa ninye neitaa ninye endapidapoi nasipa.
Keaku ketii ninye empolos e naiposha ewueji neisalaashieki irresheta; amu airoro nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; naa keaku ninye entoki naaruno too loreren.
Ore intoyie enyena naatii enkop natoyio naa keyieng'i to lalem. Ina peyie eyiolou aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.

“Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo ekayau shumata e Tiro eiteru te moikuape Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, olaiguanani loo laiguanak, eeta imbartan oo ngarrin enye tenebo ilakedok loo mbartan tenebo olorora loo sikarini kumok.
Kear ninye to lalem intoyie inyi naatii enkop natoyio; naa kemuat aaman ninche esuntai nagol nikiarare, nashetaki intae oltim aagilunore intae, neitasheyie ilchureta o long'oi aarare intae.
Ekeitorioki ninye intae imasaa oo sekenke agilunore isunta inyi ore too ntoluo enyena naa keuroo iltaleta linyi.

Keaku kumok oleng imbartan enyena metaa ore enterit enye neitoipoo intae; ore isunta inyi naa keigusugus te ilo toilo le lelo akedok loo mbartan tenebo ngarrin oo mbartan, tenejing atua inchomito inyi anaa oltung'ani ojing enkanasa natumutaki naata ilusien too sunta.
Ore too loisotok loo mbartan enyena naa keituny inkoitoi dapashi e nkanasa inyi naa kear iltung'ana linyi to lalem; ore ing'apeta inyi kituaak naa kesulakini enkop.

Keitaa ninche iyarunot e karsisisho inyi imasaa enye; anaa eng'ues entim imasaa inyi e biashara naa kesulaa ninche isunta inyi neinyal inkajijik inyi sidain; ore isoito linyi o mbaoi o enterit naa kenang'akini empolos oo nkariak.
Naa kaitasheyie eranyare oo sinkolioitin linyi, ore oltoilo loo wululi loo usin inyi nemeitokini aekata aaning.
Ekaitaa intae endapidapoi nasipa nemetii toki; iakuku intae ewueji neisalaashieki irresheta; nemeitokini aekata aashet intae; amu nanu Olaitoriani oiroro, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki Tiro: amaa olmanie le naiposha aimeikirikira tenening embuaata e mbatatata ino, ina kata naigor ilo otipikaki olbae, ina kata etii lelo ootipikaki ilbaa atua erishata inyi?

Neaku ore lelo kituaak leina aiposha tenedou aaing'uaa ilorikan lenye le nkitoo, neitayu ilkilani lenye, neng'ishaa nena kilani enye naaikodo; naa keishopoki ate enkuretisho; Eketoni ninche te nkop neikirikira anaa adake, neureyu intae oleng.

Naa kedumu enkishirata aaishiraki intae, nejoki intae ‘Kaji inkuna peyie iisha too naaiposha, iyie na anasa yioloti, ina apa magilani teina aiposha, iyie o lelo likimanya, lelo ooikonyu olkirutoto lino, tiatua enkop natoyio!
Eikirikira ile mankale teina olong ino embatata; ee, lelo loo lemankale ootii enaiposha neing'asia ina kata niishunye!’
“Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai. Ore ake peyie aitaa enkanasa ino, anaa inkanas nememanya, ore peyie ayau ailepunye enegut peyie aaitoip iyie nikintoip iyie nkariak sapuki,

neaku kaanang'aki iyie abori tenebo lelo oodoyio aapuo engumoto, ine netii iltung'ana liopa, naaitaa iyie olobik to lodo le nkop, tenebo lelo apa ooidaaitie te dukuya tenebo lelo oopuo abori ina gumoto, metaa mikintokini aamanya aashu iatata ewueji te nkop oo looishu.
Kaayau iyie apik enkiting'oto torrono, nimintoki aekata atii; hoo naa aiking'oruni iyie, kake mikintokini aekata aatum aaigil, ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:
“Ore tena kata nakerai e tung'ani tudumu enkishirata nchiraki Tiro nijoki ninye,
nijoki Tiro, ina naton namanya enejing'ieki enaiposha, olbiasharai le lelo tung'ana to loomanaa loo naaiposha, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ‘Oi Tiro, itejo iyie, atimitunye nanu te nkishiaa.’
Ore ilpolosien linono netii empolos oo naaiposha; ore ilashetak linono netimitunye kinkishiaanie iyie.
Eitobirutua ninche imbaoi inyi pooki too lkeek ooing'uaa Semir; neyau iltarakua aaitung'uaa Lebanon nikintobiraki iyie eng'ape naado.

Ore too lkeek oonyaanyukie ilng'abolo le Bashan, nintobiru ilkurteta le meli; neitobiru ewueji ino neitasheyieki too nkeek olchani oing'uaa olomanaa le naiposha e Kupro, nepik ine ilala loo lkanchaoni.

Tenebo enkitani sidai naikodo naing'uaa Misiri, naa ninye apa olkarasha oreu emeli, naa ninye naitashe anaa enanka ino; enkarasha pus o emorijoi naing'uaa olomanaa le naiposha e Elisha, naa ninye apa enchuret ino.
Ore lelo oomanya Sidon o Arfad naa ninche ilarewak linono loo melin, ore iltung'ana linyi arriyiak le Semer netii apa atua intae, ninche apa ilarewak linyi loo melin.

Ore lelo ashetak le meli, le Gebal o ltung'ana arriyiak netii atua iyie, kinukaki ilbaat loo melin inono. Ore nena melin pooki e naiposha tenebo isikarini le naiposha netii atua iyie, eitawalaa imasaa inono e biashara.
“Ore apa Pasia o Lud o Put netii atua enjore inyi anaa iltung'ana linyi lo larrabal; neik ninche nena long'oi enye tenebo imaupen tiatua iyie; neisho ninche intae esidano enye.

Ore lelo tung'ana le Arfad o Helek netii apa isunta inyi aamanita, ore iltung'ana le Gamad netii sii ninche iltaleta linono; neik ninche ilong'oi enye too isunta inono aaitaman; neitisidan aitaa bayarot enkishiaa inyi.
“Ore Tarshishi nikitoning'ore te siaai e biashara enye amu iata imasaa kumok e pooki pukunoto; enkosholai o esekenkei, empirbil o risasini. Eitawalunye ninche imasaa inyi e biashara.
Ore Yafan o Tubal o Meshek netimirishote tenebo iyie; eitawalunye ninche iltung'ana nena masaa o suyai aawalunye imasaa inyi.
Ore Betogarma newalunye imasaa inyi mbartan olarrabal o nyumpui.
“Ore lelo tung'ana le Rode netaasa biashara tenebo intae; iloomanaa loo naaiposha iwuejitin inyi nimirishorere, eyakita intae te laata ilala loo lkanchaoni o nkeek oltiasika.

Ore Edom nikitoning'ore te siaai e biashara, te nkaraki enkumoi oo masaa inono; eitawalunye ninche imasaa inyi isoito oonyori o nkilani morijo, intokitin naaikodo, kitani naapuyiapui, o sikira le naiposha o soit oji agate.
Ore Yuda o ina kop e Israel netimirishote tenebo iyie; einyang'utua imasaa inyi emirare te nkano, too loirienito o lng'abolo le dukuya, o inaishi o ila, o lchani oji Seri.
Ore Dameski netijing'a esiaai e biashara tenebo iyie te nkaraki enkumoi oo masaa inono, te nkaraki enkumoi ino oo masaa e pooki pukunoto; enaisho oo sabibu e Helbon, o ilpapit ooibor loo ntare,
o enaisho oo sabibu naing'uaa Usal newalunye ninche too ntokitin inyi; isekenke naasika, o enkaitubului naji mdalasini, o enkaitubului naji mchai naatii apa atua imasaa inono e biashara.
Ore Dedan netaasa esiaai e biashara tenebo iyie too nkilani naarewueki imbartan.
Ore Arabia tenebo ilkituaak pooki le Kedar naa ilamirak linono linyor too ilkuoo linono le kerra, o lmeregeshi tenebo inkineji; neaku te nena apa etaasa biashara tenebo iyie.
Ore ilbiasharani le Sheba o Rama netaasa biashara tenebo iyie; newalunye ninche imasaa inyi e nkorropil oo mpukunot pooki naaisul te sidano o soito pooki oogol enkinyang'a, o saabu.
Ore Haran, o Kane, o Eden o Ashur tenebo Kilmad netaasa esiaai e biashara tenebo iyie.

Etaasa ninche biashara too nkilani sidain, te nena kilani pusi o nkilani naaikodo, o too ilkarash ooisalaashi tiatua iltirenito loo muain kumok neteenaki too lgoso aaitirrish; naa te kuna apa etaasie ninche biashara tenebo iyie.
Ore imelin e Tarshishi nepuo te nkaraki intae enapita imasaa inyi nimirimiri. “Metaa kimputaki apa iyie nikiroishiyieki oleng tiatua ineegut oo naaiposha.
Ore ilarewak linono loo melin nikintupukutuo iyie aapik inaaiposha naado. Ore olkutati lo loosaen nikitoosho amut te mpolos oo naaiposha.

Ore enkarsisisho ino, o masaa inono, o ntokitin inono e biashara, o sikarini linono le naiposha o lelo arewak le meli, lelo aripak linono le meli o lbiasharani linono, o ltung'ana linono pooki lo larrabal otii atua iyie, tenebo olorora lino pooki, lelo ootii atua erishata ino. Nedoiki pooki empolos oo naaiposha, teina olong ino enkidaaroto.
Ore to ltoilo le nkishirata lo lkiyioi loo larewak linono le meli ore nkuapi naamanita neikirikira,
ore tiabori imelin enye, mepuonu lelo pooki aaing'uaa. Ore lelo sikarini le naiposha tenebo pooki ootii atua emeli o larewak loo melin, neitashe pooki te nkop natoyio
nikinchiraki ninche iyie to ltoilo sapuk, neishir too lkiyio le mion. Nepik enterit ilukuny enye neiperipera too nkuruon;
nebarn ninche ilukuny enye te nkaraki iyie, neen ate too lkuniyiani neishiraki intae oleng te mion sapuk oltau, te nkishirata sapuk e mion.
Ore to lkiyioi lenye, nikidumaki iyie enkishirata, nikinchiraki iyie ejo; ‘Aing'ae aekata eidaikieki anaa Tiro, te mpolos e naiposha?
Ore tenepuku imasaa inyi too naaiposha, nintaraposh iyie iltung'ana kumok; te nkumoi ino oo masaa e biashara ino, inkarsisiyie lelo aiguanak le nkop.
Ore taata nikitumutaki aaidaikie too naaiposha, too neegut e nena ariak; ore imasaa inono pooki nimirita tenebo iltung'ana linono pooki liaata neimiso pooki tenebo iyie.’
“Ore lelo pooki oomanya olomanaa le naiposha, neing'asiate te nkaraki iyie; ore ilaiguanak lenye neiruto oleng, ore inkomomi enye netanyamala.
Ore lelo biasharani otii atua iltung'ana neisulisho te nkaraki iyie; ieuo iyie enkiting'oto torrono oleng nimikintokini aekata aata intarasi.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

“Enkerai e tung'ani, tiaaki ilo kitok le Tiro, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ore amu kewuasa oltau lino, nitejo iyie, ‘Ara nanu Enkai. Aton nanu te ilo orika loo nkaitin, te mpolos oo naaiposha; nira ake sii tung'ani, nimira Enkai, hoo naa idol kewan anaa ira ng'en anaa Enkai.
Ijo doi iyie ira ng'en alang Daniel? Metii entoki naisudoro te iyie;
teng'eno ino o tening'unoto ino inotoko kewan imasaa, ninturrurruo saabu o enkosholai apik atua arsisisho ino;
teng'eno ino nagut e biashara itoponayie imasaa inono, netawuase oltau lino too masaa inono,
neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu idol kewan anaa olotiu anaa Enkai te ng'eno,
neaku, ing'ura, ekayau nanu ilomon atua iyie lelo ooitureisho oleng loo loreren, naa keshutu ninche ilalema lenye aarare esidano eng'eno ino nagut neisarkionie esikar ino.
Naa kenang'aki ninche intae engumoto niyeye intae enkeeya e lelo ooyieng'i te mpolos oo naaiposha.
Eton ake ijo: Ara nanu enkai! Te dukuya lelo likiyieng iyie, hoo nira tung'ani neme Enkai, tiatua inkaik e lelo likipik iyie ilbaa?
Iye iyie aya enkeeya e ilo lememurata te nkaina oo ltung'ani leeiking'a, ilo omoni, amu airoro nanu ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.’ ”
Ore ake sii eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

“Enkerai e tung'ani, teyietu olkiyioi intorioki olaiguanani le Tiro, nijoki ninye, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ira apa iyie enkitanyaanyukoto bayaroti, kibore apa eng'eno nagut, nitimitunye te nkishiaa.

Itii apa iyie Eden, ina kurma e Nkai; ore apa pooki soit ogol enkinyang'a naa ninye intoipore, isoito ooji Karnelian o Topas o Yaspa o Krisolit o Beril o Oniks o Safire o Karbunkol o emerald; ore saabu nasiluno naa ninche apa ininono, ninche apa isoito liguetiguete, ore teina olong apa nikintobiruaki iyie ina kata eitobiruaki sii ninche.
“Aaitaboitaka iyie olmalaika likirrip. Itii apa iyie enchumata oldoinyo sinyati le Nkai, nishomo aimaa isoito le nkima.
Miata apa iyie entioto too nkoitoi inono, eiteru teina olong apa nikintobiruaki o menoti ing'ok tiatua iyie.

Ore te nkumoi e biashara ino nikibore apa iyie olarrabal, nias iyie eng'oki; neaku aatanang'ayie iyie anaa entoki naisarkionieki aaitung'uaa oldoinyo le Nkai, ore ilo kerubi arriponi nikiaraa iyie aipungie ong'ata aitung'uaa empolos e lelo soito ooimerlel.
Ore apa oltau lino naa kewuasa te nkaraki enkishiaa ino; inyala iyie eng'eno ino nagut te sikar ino. Aatanang'aka iyie enkop; aataboloyie iyie te dukuya ilaiguanak meitaraposho nkonyek enye te iyie.

Ore te nkumoi oo ing'ok inyi, teina nemetii esipata biashara inyi nisarkionie iwuejitin inono sinyat, neaku ayawua atua iyie enkima aitung'uaa erishata ino; nikinya ninye iyie amut, naaibelekeny iyie aitaa nkuruon tioriong enkop, te dukuya lelo pooki likitoduaa iyie.
Ore lelo pooki likiyiolo iyie too loreren neing'asia te iyie, itabaikia iyie enkiting'oto torrono, nimintoki atii intarasi.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino enkalo e Sidon, nimbonoki aarare ninye

nijo inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kaarare iyie, oi iyie Sidon, naa kaibalie enkitoo ai tiatua iyie, naa keyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nayau inkiguanat shumata ninye, naibalunye esinyatisho ai tiatua ninye;

amu kairriu olmeitai atua ninye, nairriwaki osarge inkoitoi enyena naalala enkanasa; ore lelo oari to lalem nebatata tiatua ninye, te ilo alem oarare ninye too nkaloli pooki. Ina pee eyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.
“Ore teina aji e Israel nemeitokini aata ilkiku oorem aashu eitame lelo oomanita ootaarare ninche. Ina pee eyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.

“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore tenaiturrur ina aji e Israel tiatua lelo oreren ooidapashakaki ninche, naibalie esinyatisho ai tiatua ninche te dukuya lelo oreren pooki, neaku kepuo aatoni te nkop enye maa teina naishoo apa osinka lai Yakobo.

Naa ketoni tiatua ninye te seriani naa keshet ninche inkajijik neun inkurman oo sabibu. Naa ketoni tiatua te seriani, ina kata nayau adung'oki enkiguana shumata lelo le latia enye lelo ootarare ninye te ng'oro sapuk. Ina peyie eyiolou aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye.”
Ore to lari le tomon, lo lapa le tomon, te nkolong e tomon aare o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, impirare taarare Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, nimbonoki aarare ninye niarare sii Misiri pooki.

Irorie nijo, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ing'ura ajo kaarare iyie, Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, ilo asurai kitok olejisho, te mpolos oo nchorroi enyena, ina najo, ‘Ore olkeju le Nail naa olalai ake; nanu oitobirua ninye.’
Ekaapik ilala oololo iltagiligil linono, naisho lelo sinkir loo nchorroi inyi mikimbung'a iyie akurraki, naa kaaitayu iyie aitupuku te mpolos oo inchorroi inono, nena nikimbung iyie.

Naa kaanang'aki iyie ong'ata, iyie tenebo lelo sinkir pooki loo nchorroi inono; isulakinono enkoriong e ong'ata naisiasha, nemeiturrurri intae aapuo aanukaa. Meinosa intae ing'uesi e ina kop o montonyi o loing'ang'e, aaishooyie iyie taa endaa enye.
“Ina peyie eyilou lelo pooki oomanya Misiri aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani. Amu itaa apa iyie eng'udi entiyani te nkaji e Israel.
Ore tinikimbung ninche iyie te nkaina, nigiligili, nipolososo iloilila lenye pooki; naa tenepetaa ninche intae, nigiligili, ninchosho impolosi enye pooki meikirikirata.
Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo, ekayau olalem shumata iyie, naa kadung'oo te iyie oltung'ani o eng'ues;
ore ina kop e Misiri neaku mitil nemeeta toki natii. Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo Kara Olaitoriani. “Ore amu itejo iyie ore olkeju le Nail naa olalai, nanu oitobira,
neaku ing'ura ajo kaarare iyie; naarare inchorroi inono, naa kaitaa enkop e Misiri enkop mitil nemetii toki, eiteru te Migdol ometabaiki Siene o meshomo abaiki olpolosie le Etiopia.
Meetae enkeju e tung'ani naim atua ninye, nemeetae enkeju e ng'ues naim atua ninye; keaku ninye mitil ilarin artam.

Naa kaitaa enkop e Misiri enkop mitil tiatua nkuapi mitili; ore inkanas enyena neaku mijoonito ilarin artam tiatua nena anas naaidaikieki. Ekaidapashaki Ilmisiri iloreren, naidapash ninche too nkuapi.
“Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore te nkiting'oto oo larin artam naa kaiturrurru Ilmisiri too loreren, lelo pooki ooidapashakaki ninche;
naa kashukoki Misiri entonata enye e apake, nashukoki ninche ina kop e Patros, ina kop naa ninye apa eing'uaa; neaku ninye teine enkitoria nashal.
Keaku ninye enkitoria nashal too nkitoriat pooki nemeitoki aekata aigil ailepie kewan too loreren; naa kaitaa ninche kiti oleng metaa meitoki aekata aaitore iloreren.
Nemeitoki aekata aaku osiligi leina aji e Israel, edamu ing'ok enye, ina kata eibelekenyakino ninche eing'oru eretoto enye. Ina peyie eyiolou aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Ore to lari le tikitam o naapishana to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e dukuya olapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

“Enkerai e tung'ani, ore Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon neishoo enjore enye metaasisho oleng earare Tiro, ore pooki dukuya netabarnoki ore pooki oililai netujutoki aasip; ore ake eyia eitu hoo etum ninye aashu enjore enye ae toki naing'uaa Turopeyie elak ina siaai nataasa earare ninye.

Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kaisho ina kop e Misiri Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon; naa kenap ninye arsisisho enye neitaa ninye enaaruno neidaikie ninye; naa keaku elaata enjore enye.
Aishoo ninye ina kop e misiri metaa olerrinyore teina naisiayua, amu nanu eisiaayia ninche, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
“Ore teina olong naa kaitubulu emowuo tiatua enkaji e Israel, naa kabol inkutukie inyi tiatua ninche. Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii; naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, imbonisho nijo, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Teyietu nchira, ‘Woi ina olong!’
Amu etinyikua ina olong! Etinyikua ina olong o Laitoriani; keaku enkolong oo nkatampo enkata enkidaaroto too loreren.
Kelotu olalem shumata Misiri, nejing oloputukunyi sapuk Etiopia, ina kata nabatata lelo ooyieng'i te Misiri, nenapi karsisisho enye aaya, ore ilkitamanyunot nepolosi aauroo.
“Ore Etiopia o Put o Lud o Arabia pooki, o Libya o iltung'ana pooki le nkop ooibung'are, naa kebatata te nebo to lalem.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani: Ore lelo ooretu Misiri naa kebatata, ore olwuasa lenye le ngolon enye nedou; eiteru te Migdol o meshomo Siene kebatatakino ninye to lalem, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
Neaku ninye mitil tiatua nena kuapi mitili, ore inkanas enyena nejing empolos e nena anas naaitomijoonoki.
Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nainuaaki enkima Misiri, ore ilaretok lenye pooki negili.
“Ore teina olong nepuo lelo kiliku ooisarrisar ooing'uaa enatii, aaiture lelo le Etiopia meiteiki. Nejing ninche emion o sina teina olong e nkidaata e Misiri, amu ng'ura ajo etabawua!
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekaiting'ie karsisisho e Misiri, teina aina e Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon.
Ore ninye tenebo iltung'ana lenyena, inkuapi torrok oleng too loreren, eyauni ninche meidaikie ina kop; naa keshurtu ninche ilalema lenye aarare Misiri, neiput ina kop lelo meneng'a.
Naa kaitoi nanu olkeju le Nail, namiraki ina kop inkaik oo ltung'ana torrok; Kayau ina kop aitaa mitil o pooki toki natii atua ninye teina aina oo ltung'ana leeiking'a nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.

“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekaidaikie nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu, naiting'ie nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naatii Memfis; meitoki atii aekata olkitok ina kop e Misiri; neaku kapik enkuretisho ina kop e Misiri.
Ekaitaa Patros mitil, naisuroki enkima Soan nayau inkiaasin enkiguana shumata Tebes.
Naa kabukoki engoro ai shumata Pelusium ilo sempewuet le Misiri, nadung'oo olorora le Tebes.
Naa kaisuroki enkima Misiri; ore Pelusium neigor enkigoroto kitok; ore Tebes nepiki ilusien, ore isunta enyena neurori aasulaki enkop.
Ore ilbarnot le On o Pibeset, nebatatakino ilo alem; ore inkituaak nepuo e yararoto.
Ore te Tehafnehes keaku ina olong enaimin, ina kata nagil teine enkitoria e Misiri, ore ina golon enye olwuasa nebaiki enkiting'oto; keitoipi ninye te nkatampoi, ore ntoyie enyena nepuo eyararoto.
Neaku neijia aikunaki endung'okinoto enkiguana shumata e Misiri, Ina peyie eyiolou aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.”
Ore to lari le tomon oobo, to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e naapishana o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

“Enkerai e tung'ani, atigila ina golon e Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, naa ing'ura, eton eitu erubi ninye, peyie eishiunyeki ninye te enata enkarasha, peyie metum ninye atagolo peyie meidim ayuko olalem.

Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo, kaarare nanu Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, naa kagil inkaik enyena, pokira are, aa ina nagol o ina natigile; naa kaisho olalem lenye epuku te nkaina enye.
Ekaidapashaa Ilmisiri tiatua iloreren, naidapashaa ninche tiatua iloreren tiatua inkuapi.
Naa kaitagol enkaina e ilo aiguanani le Babilon, napik enkaina enye olalem lai; kake kagil nena aik e Farao naa keigor te dukuya ninye anaa oltung'ani otipikaki olbae aaidop.

Ekaitagol nena aik o laiguanani le Babilon, kake ore nena aik e Farao naa kebatata; naa keyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani. Ore ina kata napik olalem lai inkaik olaiguanani le Babilon, naa keitorioo ninye aarare ina kop e Misiri;
naa kaidapashaki Ilmisiri atua iloreren, naidapashaa meshomo too nkuapi pooki. Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.”
Ore to lari le tomon oobo, to lapa liokuni, te nkolong e dukuya olapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, tiaaki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri o lororani lenyena inchere: “Aing'ae doi inyaanyukie iyie te sapuko ino?
Ing'ura, ekaaitanyaanyukie iyie oltarakuai otii Lebanon, oata ilng'osil sidain, neeta oloip le ntim, naa keado oleng, ore enkadori enye netii nkatampo.

Ore inkariak neitoti ninye, ore eng'uton enye neisho ninye metoodoro neitaa lelo kejek lenyena ilooruko, neitaman ine wueji netuunieki, neidapashaa inchorroi enyena, aidapashaki lelo keek pooki le ntim.
Metaa eilepa ninye oleng alus ilkeek pooki le ntim, ore ilng'osil lenyena sapuki nebul aasapuku; neado ilng'osil lenyena, te nkaraki enkare sapuk too ntona enyena.

Ore imotonyi pooki o loing'ang'e, neitobira isinkin enye too lng'osil lenyena sapuki; ore abori ilng'osil lenyena netii ing'uesi pooki e ong'ata, neisho teine aaiu inkera enye; ore abori oloip lenye, netii iloreren kituaak.
Aisidai apa oleng te sapuko enye; o te nkadori oo lng'osil lenyena; amu eshomo intona enyena abori, ine netii inkariak kumok.

Ore iltarakua ootii enkurma e Nkai nemekeshare ninye, nemerisiore lelo keek oonyori ilng'osil lenyena; ore lelo keek oorisiore naa pesho, tinintanyaanyukie ilng'osil lenyena; meetae olchani te nkurma Enkai onyaanyukie ninye te sidano.
Aitobira ninye aikishiaan, te nkumoi oo lng'osil lenyena, ore lelo keek pooki le Eden neng'uar ninye, lelo ootii apa enkurma e Nkai.
“Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu etubulua ninye ajing atua inkatampo, ore oltau lenye newuasa te nkaraki enkadori enye.
Ekapik ninye atua enkaina e ilo magilani loo loreren naa kearare ninye anaa enatiu ing'ok enyena, atanang'ayie ninye ong'ata.

Ore lelo omon torrok oleng loo loreren, naa kedung ninye aauroo neing'uaa. Edoiki inchumat oo ldoinyo o nong'ot pooki ilng'osil lenyena, ore lelo ng'osil lenyena sapuki neirrag too wuejitin pooki neeim inchorroi eina kop; ore iloreren pooki le nkop nepuo aaing'uaa oloip lenye aaing'uaa ninye.
Ore teina kidaaroto enye netonie imotonyi pooki oloing'ang'e, ore atua ilng'osil lenyena, netonie ing'uesi pooki oo nkong'at.

Ore kuna pooki naa inchere peyie meeta ilkeek le mbata enkare oobulu aaika oleng te shumata aashu epik ilukuny enye inkatampo, nemeetae likae shani ook enkare ebaiki shumata ninche te nkadori; amu eishooki ninche pooki metuata, teinakop oo lmeneng'a natii tung'ani oye, tenebo lelo oopuo olodo le nkop.

“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore peyie elo abori enemeneng'a, naa kaitaa enegut pee eishir te nkaraki ninye, naibok lelo kejek lenyena pooki, ore inkariak kumok nedung'i; naishopoki Lebanon osina te nkaraki ninye, ore ilkeek pooki liong'ota netoito te nkaraki ninye.

Ekaisho iloreren meikirikirata to ltoilo le mbatata enye, ina kata nanang'aki ninye abori enemeneng'a tenebo lelo oopuo tenebo engumoto; ore lelo keek pooki le Eden, lelo ooisul gelunot sidain le Lebanon, lelo pooki ook enkare, neitagoli to lodo le nkop.
Ekepuo sii ninche abori enemeneng'a tenebo ninye, ine netii lelo ootaraki to lalem; ee, lelo ootoni tiabori oloip too loreren naa keish.

Ira naa iyie ng'ae onyaanyuke te nkisisa o te nkitoo tiatua lelo kejek le Eden? Aikintadoyiori iyie tenebo lelo keek le Eden aaya olodo le nkop; nirrag iyie tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo ootaaraki to lalem. “Ore ele naa Farao tenebo olorora lenye pooki, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Ore to lari le tomon aare, to alapa le tomon aare, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

“Enkerai e tung'ani, teyietu inchiraki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri nijoki ninye: “Itadamua iyie aitaa kewan olng'atuny tiatua iloreren, kake itiu iyie anaa olasurai otii inaaiposha; idanya iyie apuku too lkejek linono, nintanyamal inkariak too nkejek inono, nindurukie ilkejek lenye.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ekanang'aki orreshet lai shumata iyie; tenebo olorora sapuk loo ltung'ana; naa kaaikurtutaa iyie tiatua orreshet lai.
Naa kaanang'ie iyie enkop, ore te nkong'ata naisiasha naayieng iyie naisho ilmotonyi pooki lo loing'ang'e mikitadoiki iyie, naitaraposh ng'uesi enkop te iyie.
Naidapashaki inkiri inyi inchumat oo ldoinyo, naiput inong'ot too mpopoki inono.
Naa kaitadooyo osarge lino te nkop o too ldoinyo; nimput iyie lelo shorroi.
Ore peyie aajutoo iyie, naa kaitoip keper o loing'ang'e lenye, naitomisimis ilakir lenye; naa kaitoip enkolong te nkatampoi, nemeitoki olapa aitayu ewang'an enye.
Ore ilkilang'ilang'eta pooki le shumata na kaitomisimis te shumata iyie, napik enaimin shumata enkop ino ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
“Ekaitanyamal sii iltauja loo ltung'ana kumok, ina kata naaya iyie eyarunoto tiatua iloreren, naapik iyie inkuapi neitu iyiolou.

Ekaisho iltung'ana kumok meing'asiata te nkaraki iyie, ore ilaiguanak lenye neilanyisho te nkaraki iyie, ina kata naiwul olalem lai te dukuya ninche; naa keikirikira pooki kata, pooki ng'ae te nkaraki enkishui enye, teina olong embatatata ino.
Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore ilo alem lo laiguanani le Babilon naa kelotu shumata iyie.
Ekaitaa olorora linyi metabatatata too lalema loo lmagil, ninche pooki lelo torrok oleng too loreren. “Naa kayau aitaa olemeetae ilo wuasa le Misiri, ore ilororani lenyena pooki naa keish.
Kaidakie nanu ing'uesi enyena pooki, too nkiyopat oo nkariak kumok; nemeetae enkeju e tung'ani naitoki aitanyamal ninche aigil, nemeitoki lelo oisotok loo ng'uesi aaitanyamal ninche.
Ina peyie aitaa nkariak enye inaasila, naisho ilkejek lenye meturukoto anaa eilata, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
Ore ina kata naitaa enkop e Misiri mitil, o ina kata nakinyi enkop te pooki nabore, o ina kata naosh lelo pooki ootii atua ninye, naa keyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.
Ore ele naa osinkolio lo lkiyioi opuoi aarany; ore nena toyie oo loshon nepuo aaranyaki; Misiri tenebo lelo pooki ororani lenyena, kepuo ninche aarany ilo sinkolio ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Ore to lari le tomon o are, to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, inchiraki ilo orora le Misiri nirriwaa ninche abori, ninye tenebo nena toyie kituaak oo loreren, ine olodo le nkop, enetii lelo ooshomo abori enemeneng'a ijoki ninye:
‘Aing'ae doi italang'a iyie te nkishiaa? Shomo abori, nikirragieki iyie tenebo ilememurata.’
“Kebatatakino ninche erishata e lelo ootaraki to lalem, ore tenebo ninye neirrag olorora pooki lenye.
Ore ilaiguanak magil naa keimaki imbaa naaipirta ninche, tenebo ilaretok lenye, tiatua empolos e nemeneng'a ejo: ‘Etadoutuo ninche abori, neirrag aaitirring'a, lelo lememurata, ootaraki to lalem.’
“Etii sii Asiria ine, tenebo olorora lenye pooki, nemanita ninye inkuraren enye, lelo pooki ootaraki, ootumutaki to lalem;
lelo ootipikaki nkuraren enye nene wuejitin neegut oleng e nemeneng'a nemanita olturrur lo lorora enkurare enye, etaraki pooki aabatat to lalem, ilo oidapashaa olkirutoto tiatua ina kop oo loishu.

“Eti sii Elam ine, nemanita ninye olorora lenye pooki enkurare enye; netaaraki pooki, aabatat to lalem, lelo lememurata ooshomo atua olodo le nkop, lelo oidapashaa olkirutoto teinakop oo looishu, neya enkurruna enye tenebo lelo oopuo abori eng'umoto.

Eitobirakita ninye endapash tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem tenebo olorara nemanita ninye inkuraren enyena, lelo pooki lememurata lelo ootaaraki to lalem; amu eidapashakaki olkirutoto lenye ninche ina kop oo looishu, nenap ninche enkurruna enye tenebo lelo oopuo adoyio aapuo eitaboitakaki ninche lelo ootaraki to lalem.
“Etii sii ine Meshek o Tubal, tenebo olorora lenye pooki, emanita inkuraren enye ninche, lelo pooki lememurata, ootaraki to lalem; amu eidapasha ninche olkirutoto teinakop oo loishu.

Nemeirrag ninche tenebo lelo ootabatatate magil liopa lelo ooshomo abori enemeneng'a tenebo imasaa enye olarrabal, lelo ooiteleikiaki ilalema lenye abori ilukuny enye, ore ilong'oi enye neiteleikino iloik lenye; amu ore olkirutoto le lelo tung'ana magil netii enkop e lelo ooishu.
Metaa aikigili iyie nikirragieki tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem.

“Etii sii Edom ine o ilaiguanak lenyena tenebo ilkituaak lenye pooki, laa ore te ngolon enye pooki neirragieki tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem; neirrag ninche tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo oopuo abori enemeneng'a.

“Etii sii ilkituaak le moikuape ine ninche pooki tenebo ile Sidon pooki lelo ooshomo abori te nkurruna tenebo lelo ootaraki, tenebo ina kirutoto pooki nayautua te nkaraki olkirutoto lenye eirragie ninche memurata tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem, nenap enkurruna enye tenebo lelo oodoyio aapuo enemeneng'a engumoto.
“Ore peyie edol Farao ninche, neilejilej kewan to lorora lenye pooki, ore Farao tenebo enjore enye pooki naaraa to lalem, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
Amu eidapashayie olkirutoto te nkop oo looishu; metaa keirragieki ninye tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem, Farao tenebo olorora lenye pooki, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, irorie iltung'ana linono nijoki ninche, tenelo nayau olalem shumata enkop, negelu iltung'ana oltung'ani obo tiatua ate, neitaa ninye olarriponi lenye;
naa tenedol ninye olalem elotu shumata enkop neosh esekekua aitayiolo iltung'ana.
Neaku ore pooki ng'ae otoning'o ilo toilo leina tarumpeta neitaa parmetii, nelotu olalem aar ninye, ore osarge lenye naa shumata endukuya enye etii.
Etoning'o ninye ilo toilo leina tarumpeta, neitu esuj ina naitayioloki ninye; ekeaku etii osarge lenye shumata enkorrok enye. Kake tenetusuja ina naitayioloki, anaata eitajewuo enkishui enye.

Kake te nedolu olarriponi olalem elotu nemeosh ninye ina tarumpeta, metaa eitu eitayioloi iltung'ana, nelotu olalem, neya ake ninye obo lenye; ore ilo tung'ani newaki too ng'ok enyena, kake ore osarge lenye naa kaikilikuanu too nkaik e ilo arriponi.
“Metaa ore iyie enkerai e tung'ani, aaitaa iyie olarriponi te nkaraki enkaji e Israel; ore pooki kata nining ororei oing'uaa enkutuk ai, naa intayiolo ninche olkilikuai oing'uaa enatii.

Tenelo najoki ilo torrono, Oi iyie ele tung'ani torrono, meeta inchere pee miye neitu iyie irorie ilo torrono aitayiolo meibelekenyunye aing'uaa enkoitoi enye, ore ilo tung'ani torrono naa keye tiatua ing'ok enyena, kake ore osarge lenye naikilikuanu too nkaik inono.
Kake tinintayiolo ilo torrono pee eibelekenyunye te nkoitoi enye, neitu eibelekenyunye ninye te nkoitoi enye; naa keye ninye too ng'ok enyena, kake intajewuo iyie enkishui ino.

“Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani, tiaaki ina aji e Israel, Inji itejo iyie: ‘Ore inkitarruorot ang tenebo ing'ok ang netii shumata iyiook, nikiishunye iyiook pesho te nkaraki ninche, kaji naa kinko tinikinchu?’

Tiaaki ninche, ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, maata nanu enchipai te keeya e ilo torrono, kake peyie eibelekenya ilo torrono te nkoitoi enye peyie eishu; imbelekenyunye, imbelekenyunye too nkoitoi inono torrok; ainyoo doi peyie iye iyie, oi naaji e Israel?

Ore iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, tiaaki iltung'ana linono, ore esipata e ilo supat nemeitajeu ninye teneas entorroni; naa ore teina torroni e ilo torrono nemebatata te ninye teneibelekenyunye te nkitarruorroto enye; ore ilo supat nemeitoki aidim atotona te supatisho enye teneas eng'oki.

Ore hoo natiaaka ilo supat meeta inchere peyie meton ninye eishu, kake ore ake peyie eisilig ninye esipata enye neas intorrok, meetae hoo nabo oosiatin enyena esupatisho naaitokini aadamu; kake ekeye ninye tiatua ina ng'oki nataasa.
Ore ake sii, hoo natiaaka ilo torrono, ‘Meeta inchere aimiye,’ kake ilo teneibelekenyunye too ng'ok enyena, neas ina nasipa naishaakino.
Tenelo neshuku ilo torrono ina nainosie apa olmumai, neshuku ina apa nawa te nkikonya, nelo too nkoitoi enkishon, nemeitoki aas enkarruoisho; naa kesipa keton katukul eishu, nemeye ninye.
Meetae hoo eng'oki nabo oo naataasa apa ninye naitokini aadamu te nkaraki ninye; etaasa ninye ina naishaakino nesipa, nemeeta inchere pee meton ninye eishu.
“Kake ejoito ake sii iltung'ana linono inchere, ‘Ore enkoitoi o Laitoriani nemetii esipata;’ naa inkoitoi enye maate metii esipata.
Ore teneibelekenya osupat aing'uaa esipata enye makewan, neas enkarruoisho, naa keye ninye te nkaraki ina.
Naa teneibelekenya ilo torrono aing'uaa entorroni enye, neas ina naishaakino neas nasipa, neton eishu teina.
Nijojo ake sii, ‘Ore ina oitoi o Laitoriani nemesipa’; iyie na aji e Israel, ekaiguanare pooki ng'ae linyi terisioroto oo nkoitoi enyena.”
Ore to lari le tomon aare le yararoto ang, to lapa le tomon, te nkolong e imiet o lapa nelotu oltung'ani oisikua aing'uaa Yerusalem enatii nanu naajoki: “Etabatate enkanasa.”

Etii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata nanu ina teipa eng'or elotunoto e ilo oisikua; netabolo ninye enkutuk ai teina kata naewuo ilo tung'ani enatii tadekenya; metaa etaboloki apa enkutuk ai, nemeekure ara olemeiro.
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

“Enkerai e tung'ani, ore lelo oomanya kunen neetumutaki te nkop e Israel, nejoito; ore apa Abraham naa oltung'ani obo ake, kake enoto ninye aitaa ina kop enenye, nikira iyiook kumok, esipa tukul eishooki iyiook enkop maitaa enaang.”

Neaku, tiaaki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Inyanya intae inkiri tenebo osarge, nidumakiki inkonyek inyi inkitanyaanyukot oo inkaitin inyi nemeishu, nimbukoo osarge; intokiki ake aaku iloopeny ena kop?
Ipikipiki ilo alem aaitaa osiligi linyi, niasiasa inolminong, ore pooki ng'ae linyi neidurukie enkitok ole latia enye; ijojo iakuku iloopeny ena kop?

Tiaaki ena ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore anaa enaishu nanu, esipa tukul ajo ore lelo ootii iwuejitin neidaaitie naa kebatata to lalem; ore ilo otii enkong'ata naisiasha naa kaisho ninye ing'uesi entim meinosa, ore lelo ootii isempewueti o lootii nkapuniaa naa keye to lmeitai.
Naa kaitaa ina kop mitil naidaayie, ore ina golon enye nawuasare nebaiki enkiting'oto; ore lelo doinyo le Israel neaku mitili oleng metaa meetae hoo oloim empolos enye.
Ina pee eyilou aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani ina kata naitaa ina kop enkop mitil naitomijoon naa ene pesho te nkaraki nena baa olminong lenye pooki naataasa ninche.

“Ore te iyie, enkerai e tung'ani, ore iltung'ana linyi ooiro tenebo te nkaraki iyie too sunta, o too nkutukie oo nkajijik, ejokino ninche maate, pooki ng'ae ejoki olalashe lenye, ‘Wou sii iyie toning'o ajo kalo rorei ilo olotu eing'uaa Olaitoriani.’

Nepuonu enitii anaa enapuonu iltung'ana enitii, netoni te dukuya intae anaa iltung'ana laainei; neinining ina nijo iyie kake meas ninche ina amu eibalunye oleng too nkutukie enye enyorrata sapuk, kake ore iltauja lenye netii atua dupoto enye.
Naa, ing'ura, itiu iyie te ninche anaa ilo oranyaki isinkolioitin le nyorrata, to ltoilo sidai oleng neosh te nkarriyiano e nkinanda, amu ening ninche ina nijo, kake meas ninche ina.
Ore peyie elotu ena, naa kelotu ninye, ina peyie eyiolou aajo etii apa oloiboni atua ninche.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii, naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, imbonoki taarare lelo airritak le Israel, imbonoki tiaaki ninche, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Oi ilairritak le Israel lelo ooitotito ate! Amaa ilairritak aimeitoti intare?
Inyanya intae nena naapir, ninchopokiki ate inkilani oo lpapit loo ntare, niyieng'iyieng'e nena naaisul te mpiron; kake mintotiti intae nena tare.

Ore nena naashal neitu intagoligolo, ore nena naamuoi neitu inchiunyenye, ore nena ng'ojiniaa neitu iruburubu, ore nena naatapong'ori neitu irrinyunyu, ore inaaimina neitu ing'oruru, neaku te ngolon o te nking'odia intoria ninche.
Metaa eidapashate ninche, amu metii apa olairritani; neaku ninche endaa oo ng'uesi pooki e ntim.
Eidapashaki apa intare aainei, nepuaya ninche too ldoinyo pooki, o te pooki doinyo naado; ore intare aainei neidapashi te nkoriong enkop pooki, meetae obo oikilikuanua aashu oing'oru ninche.
“Metaa, entoning intae lo airritak ororei lo Laitoriani enajo:

Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ore amu etaa intare aainei entoki nainosi, netaa intare aainei endaa nanya ing'uesi pooki entim, anaa ae metii olairritani; neaku ore amu eitu eing'oru ilairritak laainei intare aainei, kake eitotito ate ilairritak, neitu eitoti intare aainei;
neaku entoning intae ilairritak ororei lo Laitoriani:

Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ing'ura ajo kaarare lelo airritak; naa kayieu nanu intare aainei too nkaik enye, naiting'ie te ninche ina kitotio enye oo ntare; meigil aekata ilairritak aaitoti ate. Ekaitajeu nanu intare aainei too nkutukie enye, peyie meitoki aaku endaa te ninche.
“Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, nanu, nanu kewan oing'oru intare aainei, nalilitu ninche.

Anaa enaing'oru olchekut intare enyena ina kata naidapashate kulie tare enyena too neelakua, neaku kaing'oru sii nanu ntare aainei; naa kaitajeu ninche too wuejitin pooki neeidapashakaki teina olong natii inkatampo netii sii enaimin narok ong'u.

Naa kaitupuku ninche too loreren, naiturrurru ninche too nkuapi naa kayau ninche enkop enye maate; naa kaitoti ninche too ldoinyo le Israel, too nkiyopat e nena shorroi, o too wuejitin pooki neemanyae eina kop.

Kaitoti ninche too wuejitin neeleng, o too nchumat oo ldoinyo le Israel, keaku ninche ndaat enye; ore teine neiperipera ninche teine te neleng sidai, o too wuejitin neebore olkujita, ekedaa ninche too ldoinyo le Israel.
Ore nanu makewan naa kaaku olchekut loo ntare aainei, naa kaisho ninche meirraga, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
Ekaing'oru ina naimina, naa karrinyu ina natapong'ori, naa karub ina ng'ojine, naa kaitagol ina natashala, ore ina napir o ina nagol naa kaing'or; naa kaitoti ninche te sipata.
“Ore intae intare aainei, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, ekaiguanare enker o enker, naiguanare ilmeregeshi o loroi.
Aimebaiki intae entadaata too neeleng sidain eji metaa intunyoo ake too nkejek inyi olokeri pooki; niokioko enkare nasila, peyie intunyoo inkulie too nkejek inyi?
Naa kenya intare aainei nena nintunyoitie too nkejek inyi, neok ina are ning'ola too nkejek inyi?
“Metaa, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki ninche; ing'ura, ore nanu, nanu makewan ekapik enkiguana erishata oo nkerra naapir o nkerra sasin.
Amu irrumoo te murte o too ronyi, nimponyaa nena pooki naashal too mowuarak inyi, o metaba anaa nindapashakiki ninche pooki wueji,
ekaitajeu nanu intare aainei, meitoki aekata aaku inaanya ing'uesi; naa kaiguanare erishata e nker o enker.
Aa kaitasheyie olchekut obo oitasheiki ninche, osinka lai Daudi, naa keitoti ninye ninche: ekeitoti ninye ninche neaku ninye olchekut lenye.
Ore nanu, Olaitoriani, naa kaaku Enkai enye, ore osinka lai Daudi neaku olkitok tiatua ninche; nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.
“Ekaitobir tenebo ninche osotua le seriani, naishu ing'uesi pooki entim teinakop, peyie etum aatobik ninche te seriani ti ong'ata neirrag atua entim.
Naa kaitaa ninche o nene wuejitin pooki neemanita ildoinyo laainei e mayianata; naa kairriu aitadou enchan te rishata enye; naa ninye enkoirujuruji e emayianata.

Ore lelo keek liong'ota neiu ilng'anayio lenye, ore enkop neiu ilng'anayio lenyena, naa keaku ninche ilooserian te nkop enye; neyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nagil iloom le nchata enye oo murto, nalaku ninche aitung'uaa inkaik e lelo ooitaa ninche isinkan.
Meitoki aaigil aekata aaku eng'ues nainosi iloreren, nemeitoki ilowuarak le ina kop aapolol ninche; eketoni ninche te seriani, nemeeta entoki naitoki aiture ninche.
Naa kaisho ninche embularoto oo ndaiki metaa meitoki amut ninche esumash teinakop, nemeitoki aatum enyamali enkurruna oo loreren.
Naa keyiolou aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, atii nanu tenebo ninche, naa ore ninche, ina aji e Israel naa iltung'ana laainei, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
Nirara intae intare, intare o lokeri lai, nara nanu Enkai inyi, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, impirare oldoinyo le Seir, nimbonoki aarare ninye.
Nijoki ninye, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; Ing'ura ajo, kaarare iyie oldoinyo le Seir, naa kaaitorioki enkaina ai aarare iyie, naa kaaidapash iyie naaidaikie naitaa ene pesho.
Ekaidaikie inkanas inono niaku iyie mitil; ina pee iyiolou ajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.
Amu inyor iyie emang'atisho e anaake, ninchoo lelo tung'ana le Israel engolon o lalem te nkata e ngolikinoto enye, te nkata e mutata enye nabayie;
metaa, ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, asip ajo kianyita keeya nemeeta enilanyaki te nkaraki ilo sargelimbukoyie. Neaku kesuj intae ilo osarge.
Ekaitaa oldoinyo le Seir olemetii toki, naitaa mitil; naa kadung'oo te ninye lelo pooki oopuonu atua aaparan nepuo.
Naa kaiput ildoinyo linyi impopoki; o too ndoinyo inyi o too nong'ot inyi o iyarat o lashepak linyi pooki kebatata nena pooki to lalem.
Naa kaitaa intae mitili anaake, ore inkanas inono nemeitokini aamany. Ina peyie iyiolou ajo Kara nanu ilo Aitoriani.
“Ore amu itejo, ‘Ore kulo oshon pokira o kuna kuapi pokira naa keaku inaainei, naa aikintaa ninche inkunaang,’ ore hoo netii apa Olaitoriani ine,

neaku, ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ekaitaas intae anaa enatiu engoro o enkiba nintodolua te nkaraki enkiba aarare ninche; naa kaitayiolo nanu kewan tiatua intae, ina kata naiguanare intae.
Naa iyiolouu aajo nanu, Olaitoriani otoning'o nena baa pooki torrok nitejo iararere lelo doinyo le Israel, ijojo, ‘Eitaaki ninche mitili, eishooki iyiook maidakie.’
Nirupurupu intae ate oleng kiararere nanu too nkutukie inyi, niponaa irorei aitaa kumok kiararere nanu; natoning'o nanu ina.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore te nkaraki enchipai enkop pooki ekaaitaa iyie mitil.

Ore anaa enitishipakine ina jung'o enkaji e Israel, amu aimitil apa ninye, neaku kaarare sii nanu iyie; iaku sii iyie mitil, oldoinyo le Seir o Edom pooki, pooki elulung'a. Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.
“Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani imbonoki lelo doinyo le Israel, nijoki; intae ildoinyo le Israel, entoning ororei lo Laitoriani.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; ore amu etejo ilo mang'atinda te iyie ‘Aha! Ore iwuejitin e apa neeika netaa enaang.’

Neaku imbonoki nijoki, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore te nkaraki naitaa ninche intae mitili nepurd intae too nkaloli pooki, metaa itaa intae entoki e kulie kuapi, nitaa intae enkiroroto o entorroni olmarenke loo ltung'ana;

metaa, oi intae ildoinyo le Israel, entoning ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai: Inji ejoki Olaitoriani Enkai lelo doinyo o ndoinyo, o lashepak o nenen neeidurrieki o nkanas naaidurraki aaing'uaa, nena naataa entoki nanya pooki toki netaa enameni iloreren pooki oomanita;

metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekairo nanu to lom lai oirowua aarare ilkulikae oreren, naarare Edom pooki, lelo ooishoo enkop ai ate metaa enenye te nchipai oltau neimaki ino lmena, pee etum aawaita ninye te ngolon.

Metaa imbonoki ina kop e Israel, nijoki lelo doinyo o nena doinyo, lelo ashepak o yarat, tiaaki: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Ing'ura ajo, ekairo nanu to lom le ngoro ai, amu itaa intae iloonoto enkurruna too loshon;
metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, anya olmumai ajo ore iloshon oomanita intae naa ketum ninche enkurruna.
“Kake ore intae ildoinyo le Israel, naa keitubulu ninche ilng'osil lenye, neiki ilng'anayio linyi iltung'ana laainei Israel; amu kepuonu ninche aasieku ang.
Ing'ura ajo enkalo inyi atii, naa kaaibelekenyakino iyie naa aikituri nikiuni;
naa kaponaa iltung'ana te iyie, enkaji pooki e Israel, ninye pooki; ore nena anas naa kemanyi, ore iwuejitin mijoonito nesheti;

naa kaponaa te iyie iltung'ana o ng'uesi; naa keponari ninche neisho oleng; naa kaaitaa iyie enamanyae anaa apa inkolong'i naatulusoitie, naa kaaitaas iyie esidai eneitu apa aekata aaitaas. Ina peyie iyiolouu aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.
Ee, ekaisho iltung'ana meshomo tiatua iyie, o ltung'ana laainei Israel; naa keya ninche intae, iyakuku intae enjung'ore enye, nemeitoki aekata inkera ang aatum osina.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu kejoki intae iltung'ana, ‘Inyanya intae iltung'ana, nioruru olosho linyi inkera,’
neaku mintokiki aekata aanya iltung'ana nimintokiki aaoru olosho linyi inkera, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai;
