nimintokiki intae aainining aekata enkurruna e lelo oreren, nimintokiki aekata aanap esulare oo ltung'ana nimintoki aaisho olorere linyi metorrorroto, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

“Enkerai e tung'ani, ore peyie emany enkaji e Israel enkop enye, neisarkionie ninye too nkoitoi enye o too nkiaasin enye; ore olkuaak lenye te dukuya nanu netiu anaa oloirerio le nkitok te nkata e nkiduruk enye.
Metaa atubukoko nanu engoro ai shumata ninche te nkaraki osarge oibukoitie ninche te nkop, te nkaraki nena aaitin nemeishu naisarkionie ninche.
Aidapasha ninche tiatua iloreren, neidapashari ninche tiatua inkuapi, te risioroto oo lkuaaki lenye, ore too siaaitin enye naiguanare nanu ninche.

Kake tenepuonu ninche iloreren, ore pooki wueji neetuo ninche, neisarkionie ninche enkarna ai sinyati, ore teina nejo iltung'ana te nkaraki ninche, ‘Ore kulo tung'ana naa iltung'ana lo Laitoriani, naa kepuku ake aapuo aaing'uaa enkop enye.’
Kake kaata endamunoto te nkaraki enkarna ai sinyati, ina naitaa enkaji e Israel enaisarkionieki tiatua iloreren laa ninche eing'uaa.

“Metaa tiaaki ina aji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: mme te nkaraki intae, na aji e Israel, peyie etaa kaas ena, kake te nkaraki enkarna ai sinyati ina nisarkionie intae tiatua lelo oshon lietuo.

Naa kaibalie esinyatisho enkarna ai kitok, ina apa naisarkionieki tiatua iloreren, naa intae oo isarkionie intae tiatua ninche; neyiolou iloreren ina kata aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ina kata naibalie esinyatisho ai aimaa intae te dukuya nkonyek enye.
Amu kaitupuku nanu intae aitung'uaa iloreren, naiturrurru intae too nkuapi pooki nayau intae atua enkop inyi maate.
Kaisuaaki nanu intae enkare nasila niakuku sidain too ntorrok inyi pooki, o too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin inyi pooki ekaisuj nanu intae.
Naisho nanu intae oltau ng'ejuk, naisho intae enkiyang'et ng'ejuk napik atua intae; naitayu aitung'uaa iseseni linyi ilo tau lo soit, naisho intae oltau le nkirring'o.
Naa kapik enkiyang'et ai atua intae, naitaa intae iloopuo too nkiguanat aainei nijurrurru oleng aaing'or nkikoot aainei.
Imanyimanya ina kop naishoo iloo papaai linyi; niakuku intae iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai inyi.
Naa kaitajeu intae too loirerioni linyi pooki; naitanap entapa naitaa sapuk nemaitoki aiteleiki intae olameyu.
Naa kaponaa ilng'anayio naitubul enkurma ino peyie mintokiki aekata aatum enkurruna o lameyu tiatua iloreren.
Ina peyie idamumu inkoitoi inyi torrok; o siaaitin inyi neme sidain; nimbayuyu ate te nkaraki ing'ok inyi, o lminong linyi litaasa.
Mme te nkaraki iyie peyie aas ina, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; inchoo ina eyiolounoyu te iyie. Tukurru nimilo too nkoitoi inono, iyie na aji e Israel.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong naaituku iyie too ntorrok inono pooki, naa kaisho inkanas inono metamanyi, ore iwuejitin nememanya nesheti.
Ore ina kop apa nememanyae neturi, alang enaitoki aaku mitil te lelo pooki oogiroo ninye.
Naa kejo ninche: Ore apa ena kop mitil netotiwuo anaa ina kurma e Eden; ore nenen mijoonito naa mitil nememanya o nkanas naaidaitie, nemanya taata nesheta osempewuet.

Ore ina kata lelo oreren ootung'uayioki likimanita iyie neyiolou aajo nanu Olaitoriani, otesheta nene wuejitin apa neeidaitie, naun ine apa netung'uayioki aa olmuaate; Nanu, Olaitoriani oiroro, naa kaas ina.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore sii ena naa kaisho ina aji e Israel maaikilikuana nanu maitaasa ninche; peyie aponaa ilewa lenye anaa inkerrai.

Anaa inkerrai naaitainyieki ilasarri anaa nena kerrai e Yerusalem te lelo siruai lenye gelunot, metaa keaku keiputayu nena anas apa mijoonito too ntukusi oo ltung'ana. Ina peyie eyiolou aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.”
Etii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata nanu, naaitupuku nanu te Nkiyang'et o Laitoriani, naaitoton nanu te mpolos e nong'oto; naa kebore apa ninye iloik.
Naarik nanu aitaman ninche; nadol ajo ketii apa ina nong'oto iloik kumok oleng; netoito ninche oleng.
Naajoki ninye nanu “Enkerai e tung'ani, keidim kulo oik aatopiu?” Nawaliki ajoki, “Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai, iyiolo iyie.”
Naaitoki ake ajoki nanu, “Imbonoki kulo oik, nijoki ninche, intae kulo oik ootoito, entoning ororei lo Laitoriani.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki kulo oik: eng'ura ajo kapik intae enkiyang'et najing atua intae, nipiuu.
Naa kapik intae imorlooishi, naisho nkiri metijing'a intae, neitoip intae to lchoni lo sesen, napik intae enkiyang'et, nipiuu; niyiolouu aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.”
Metaa aibonoko anaa enaaitanapaki; ore ina kata aibonisho, nelotu oltoilo nadol enkop eikirikira; nepuonu lelo oik aaibung'a maate, oloito ake o loito lenye.
Ore aingorisho netii ninche imorlooishi, neetuo nkiri osesen aaibung'are ninche, neitoip olchoni ninche; kake metii apa enkiyang'et atua ninche.

Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, “Imbonoki enkiyang'et, imbonoki, enkerai e tung'ani, nijoki enkiyang'et, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Wou too nkaloli pokira ong'uan enkijape, iyie na kijape, niyang'aki kulo ootuata, peyie etum ninche aatopiu.”
Metaa aibonoko ninche anaa enaaitanapa ninye nanu, nelotu enkiyang'et atua ninche, nepiu ninche neitashe too nkejek enye, olorora kitok oleng.
Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore kulo oik naa enkaji pooki e Israel. Ing'ura ajo ninche ‘Etoito iloik lang, neiting'o iyiook osiligi; etudung'oyioki iyiook katukul.’
Metaa imbonoki ninche nijoki, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kabol inkuraren inyi, naitopiu intae too nkuraren inyi, intae lo tung'ana laainei; naa kayau intae ang atua ina kop e Israel.
Niyiolouu aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nabol inkuraren inyi, naitopiu intae too nkuraren inyi, intae iltung'ana laainei.
Naa kapik nanu atua intae enkiyang'et ai, nipiuu intae, napik intae enkop inyi maate; ina peyie iyiolouu inchere Nanu ilo Aitoriani, oiroro, nataasa ina, ejo Olaitoriani.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

“Enkerai e tung'ani iwa eng'udi nisir ninye ajo, ‘Ene Yuda o nkera e Israel o entalipa enye;’ nintoki aya ae ng'udi nisir ninye te dukuya enye, ‘Te nkaraki Yosef (ina ng'udi e Efraim) o enkaji pooki e Israel o entalipa enye;’
nintutum ninche te nebo aitaa eng'udi nabo, peyie etum aataa nabo te nkaina ino.
Ore peyie kijoki iltung'ana linono, ‘Aimintodol iyie iyiook enautu ena?’

Tiaaki ninche, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, etinyikua peyie aya ina ng'udi e Yosef (ina natii ina aina e Efraim) o loshon le Israel ooboitare ninye; naitutumoki ninye ina ng'udi e Yuda, naitaa ninche eng'udi nabo peyie etum aataa ninche nabo te nkaina ai.
Ore nena keek nisirishore naatii enkaina ino te dukuya inkonyek enye,

ina peyie ijoki ninche, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo, kaya iltung'ana le Israel aitupuku te lelo oshon apa ooshomo, lelo ootijing'a ninche, naiturrurru ninche too nkaloli pooki, nayau ninche enkop enye maate;
naa kaitaa ninche olorere obo te nkop o too nchumat e lelo doinyo le Israel, naa olaiguanani obo oitasheiki ninche pooki; nemeitoki aaku ninche iloshon aare, nemeitoki aaoro aaku inkitoriat are.

Nemeitoki aaisarkonie ate aaigil too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye o ntokitin enye torrok, aashu te pooki ake ninye ng'oki enye nabo; kake kaitajeu ninche te pooki rrinyoto enye narrinyo siadi teina ng'oki nataasa ninche, naa kaituku ninche; naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai enye.
“Naa keaku osinka lai Daudi olaiguanani lenye oitore ninche; naa keaku ninche ilo lchekut obo. Naa kesuj ninche inkitanapat aainei, neing'or oleng aasuj inkiguanat aainei.

Ekebik ninche te nkop apa natotonie iloo papaai linyi ina apa naishoo osinka lai Yakobo; ninche te nebo nkera enye o nkera oo nkera enye etoni ninche teine ntarasi; ore Daudi osinka lai neaku olkitok lenye intarasi.

Ekaitobiru olning'o le seriani tenebo ninche; naa keaku ninche olning'o lo sotua intarasi tenebo ninche; naa kamayian ninche naitaa ninche kumok, naitasheyie tiatua ninche enkaji ai sinyati intarasi o ntarasi.
Ore emanyisho ai neaku tenebo ninche; naa kaaku nanu Enkai enye, neaku ninche iltung'ana laainei.
Ore iloreren neyiolou aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny Isiraeli, ina kata etii ewueji ai sinyati atua ninche intarasi pooki.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:
“Enkerai e tung'ani, impirare Gog, leina kop e Magog, ilo arikoni kitok le Meshek o Tubal, nimbonoki agilunore ninye
ijoki ninye, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo ekaarare iyie, iyie Gog, olarikoni kitok le Meshek o Tubal,

naa kaaboin iyie arriny apik ilala oololo intakul inono; naa kaitupuku intae, tenebo enjore inyi pooki, imbartan o lakedok loo mbartan eishopo pooki imasaa o larrabal kitok oleng ninche pooki, eeta pooki ilong'oi kutiti, ilong'oi sapuki o lalema.
Etii iltung'ana le Pasia o Kus o Put tenebo ninche, neeta pooki ilong'oi o nkopiyiani oo sekenke.
Etii gomer tenebo ilturrurri lenyena pooki; o Bet-togaiman eing'uaa enkalo nalakua oleng e moikuape tenebo ilturrurri lenyena pooki o ltung'ana kumok tenebo iyie.
“Terretenayu niton irretena, iyie tenebo lelo ororani pooki ooiturrurro tenebo iyie, niaku olarriponi te nkaraki ninche.

Ore eishunye inkolong'i kumok naa aikipuonunui aabaiki iyie, ore too larin le siadi nilo agilunore enkop, ina kop nanyaaka aaku olosho eishunye olarrabal, ina kop naiturrurrore olorere oing'uaa kulikae oreren too ldoinyo le Israel, netaa te nkata naado mitil; ore iltung'ana lenyena neyauni aaitupuku too loreren, netoni taata ninche pooki te seriani.
Inyikakiki ninche anaa olkutati nitiuu anaa enkatampoi naitoipito enkop, iyie tenebo ilturrurri linono pooki, tenebo iloreren kumok tenebo iyie.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong naa kepuonu atua iyie indamunot atua endamunoto ino, naa intobiruru endamunoto torrono.
Nijojo, ‘Ekalo ailepaki aarare ina kop nemetii isunta inkang'itie; naa kabatatakino shumata lelo tung'ana ooitirring'a te seriani lelo oomanya enemetii isunta nemeeta isekenke aashu inchomito;’
peyie aaibung iyarunot nanap nena naibung'aki; naim nenen pooki nemeekure emanyae tenebo lelo tung'ana ooing'uaa iloreren, lelo ooata inkishu o masaa, lelo oomanya empolos enkop.

Ore Sheba o Dedan o lbiasharani le Tarshishi tenebo inkang'itie enye pooki naa kejoki intae, ‘Iyetuo intae aaibung iyarunot? Inturrurro ilororani linono peyie enap aaya iyarunot, peyie enap aaya enkosholai tenebo saabu, neya nkishu tenebo imasaa, nenap iyarunot kumok?’
“Metaa, enkerai e tung'ani, imbonoki Gog tiaaki, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong etoni iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli te seriani, aimiyiolouu intae?

Idumumu ate nipuonunu aaing'uaa ewueji inyi aaing'uaa nene wuejitin neelakua e moikuape, ntae tenebo olorora loo ltung'ana kumok tenebo iyie, ekedito ninche pooki mbartan enye o lorora kitok, enjore sapuk.

Ipuonunu aailepu aagilunore aarare iltung'ana laainei Israel, nimulumululu enkop anaa enkatampoi. Ore too nkolong'i naasuju naa kayau intae entaarare enkop ai, peyie aatum iloreren aatayiolo nanu, aa te iyie Gog aitoduaaya nanu esinyatisho ai te dukuya ninche.

“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ai iyie ilo apa laimaka too nkolong'i naatulusoitie too sinkan laainei, lelo aidetidetak le Israel, laa ore te nena olong'i eibonishe te ninche too larin ejo kaayau iyie taarare ninche.”
“Kake ore teina olong, ina kata nalotu Gog aarare ina kop e Israel, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, naa kedumuni engoro ai.
Amu to lom lai o te ngoro ai napejisho atumuta, ore kenya teina olong naa ketumi olokirikiri sapuk tiatua enkop e Israel.

Ore isinkir le naiposha o motonyi o loing'ang'e o ng'uesi e ong'ata o ntokitin pooki naaiserpepiari tioriong e nkop, o ltung'ana pooki ootii oriong enkop, naa keilanyisho pooki te dukuya nanu, ore ildoinyo naa kenang'uni abori, ore imartin nesulari, ore pooki suntai naa keurokino enkop.
Kaipotu olkirutoto pooki metaarare Gog, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; ore pooki alem lo ltung'ani nearare olalashe lenye.

To lmeitai o te nkibukoroto o sarge ajing'aki ninye enkiguana, naa kashaiki shumata ninye te nebo ilororani lenyena o tenebo iltung'ana kumok ootii tenebo ninye, enchan sapuk tenebo isoito le nchan, enkima o enkibiriti nayupuyup.
Metaa kaitodolu nanu enkitoo ai tenebo esinyatisho ai, naitayiolo kewan te dukuya inkonyek oo loreren kumok. Ina peyie eyilou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.”
“Ore iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, imbonoki tigilunore Gog, nijoki: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ekaarare iyie, iyie Gog, ilo arikoni kitok le Meshek o Tubal;
naa kaaibelekeny iyie naareu iyie dukuya, naayau iyie shumata aitung'uaa inkiting'ot pooki e moikuape, naarik iyie taarare lelo doinyo le Israel;
naa kaosh enkawuo ino te nkalo e nkaina ino e kedianye, naisho imbaa inono metadoiki enkop te nkaina ino e tatene.

Ibatatakino iyie enchumata oo ldoinyo le Israel, iyie tenebo ilturrurri linono pooki tenebo iltung'ana pooki likiboitare iyie; ekaaisho iyie lelo motonyi oonya nkiri le pooki pukunoto tenebo nena ng'uesi e ong'ata peyie kinya.
Ibatata iyie te nkong'ata naisiasha; amu airoro nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
Ekairriwaki enkima Magog, tenebo lelo ootoni te seriani to lomanaa le nkiyopata e naiposha; naa keyiolou ninche aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani.

“Ore enkarna ai Sinyati naa kaibalie ninye te rishata oo ltung'ana laainei Isiraeli; nemaitoki aisho enkarna ai sinyati eitokini aaisarkionie; neyiolou iloreren aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani, ilo Sinyati le Israel.
Kelotu ina olong abau, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai. Ina olong ina naimaka.

“Neaku ore lelo oomanya nena anas e Israel naa kepuo dukuya neitobiru inkimaitie too masaa olarrabal nepejoo ninche, ilong'oi sapuki o long'oi kutiti o inkai o mbaa, irinkan o mperria. Naa keitobiru inkimaitie te ninche too larin oopishana;

metaa meitoki ninche aayieu neya ilkeek le nkima aaitung'uaa olokeri aashu edung'u too ntimi, amu keitobiru enkima enye too masaa enye o larrabal; ekeinyal ninche lelo ooinyal ninche, nemut lelo oomut ninche ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

“Ore teina olong naa kaisho Gog ewueji nanukarieki te Israel, ina nong'oto oo lapuayak te nkalo o loosaen le naiposha; keibooyo ninye ilapuayak, amu keaku teine eturori Gog o lorora lenye pooki naa keipoti ninye aajo oyarata le Hamon-gog.
Ore too lapaitin oopishana, keaku keturoo ina aji e Israel ninche peyie etum aaipoo ina kop.
Ore iltung'ana pooki leina kop naa keturoo ninche; naa keyanyiti ninche teina olong naitodolu enkitoo ai, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

Keitasheyie ninche iltung'ana ooim atua ina kop inkatitin pooki peyie epuo aanukaa lelo ootelekutua ti oriong e nkop, peyie etum aaipoo ninye; ore te nkiting'oto oo lapaitin oopishana neitoki aaing'oru impopoki aajurru.
Naa ore teneim atua ina kop nedol ake obo oloito loo ltung'ani, naa kepik ninye olmonekie lenye o metaba anaa neturoo lelo aturorok ninye teina nong'oto e Hamon-gog.
(Etii sii enkanasa e Hamona netii sii ninye ine). Neaku neijia eiko teneipok ina kop.

“Ore te iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Irorie imotonyi e pooki pukunoto o pooki pukunoto eng'ues e ong'ata: Enturrurrunye wootu, enturrurroto too nkaloli pooki, enturrurrokinoto ina masho o lasar ilo laitobiraki intae, emasho kitok oleng o lasar te nchumata e lelo doinyo le Israel, naa inyanya inkiri niokioko osarge.
Inyanya nena kiri e lelo magil niokioko osarge loo lkituaak le nkop, o loo lmeregeshi, o loo lkuoo le kerra, o loo lkineji o loo loing'ok, lelo pooki oopir le Bashan.
Naa inyanya nena pooki naapir o entaraposhoto, niokioko osarge o entemerata, teina masho olasar naitobiraki intae.
Naa iraposhosho intae te misa ai te nena bartan o lakedok lenye, tenebo iltung'ana magil o ilmurran loo mpukunot pooki; ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
“Naa kaitasheyie enkitoo ai tiatua iloreren; naa kedol iloreren pooki enkiguana ai, ina nayawua, o enkaina ai naiteleikia ninche.
Ore enkaji e Israel naa keyiolou aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, eiteru ina olong nelo dukuya.

Naa keyiolou iloreren aajo eshomo apa enkaji e Israel eyararoto te nkaraki ing'ok enye, amu etaasa ninche ine nkarruoisho oleng te nanu metaa aisudoyie nanu enkomom ai aitung'uaa ninche naisho ninche metijing'a inkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, nebatata ninche pooki to lalem.
Aaitaasa ninche te risioroto olduruk o nkitarruorrot enye, naisudoo enkomom ai aitung'uaa ninche.
“Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore tena kata naa kashukoki Yakobo imayianat enyena, natum olng'ur te nkaji pooki e Israel; naaku oloota olom te nkaraki enkarna ai sinyati.
Kerikino ninche enkurruna enye o mbaa pooki torrok naataasa ninche aagilunore nanu, ina kata etoni te seriani te nkop enye meeta likae oiture ninche,
ina kata nayau ninche ashuku too loreren naiturrurru ninche aitung'uaa ilmang'ati le nkop enye, naa tiatua ninche aibalie esinyatisho ai edolita iloreren kumok.

Ina peyie eyiolou aajo Kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye amu aterewa ninche eyararoto tiatua iloreren, naitoki aiturrurroki ninche enkop enye maate. Maing'uaa hoo obo lenye eton tiatua iloreren aitoki;
nemaitoki aikata aisudoo enkomom ai aigil te ninche, ina kata nabuku Enkiyang'et ai abukoki ina aji e Israel, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

Ore to lari le tikitam o miet le yararoto ang, te nkiterunoto o lari te nkolong e tomon o lapa, to lari le tomon oong'uan eidipaki aaibung'a enkanasa, teina olong; netii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata nanu.
Naayau nanu Enkai too nduaat atua enkop e Israel naaitoton ninye nanu te nchumata oldoinyo oodo oleng, netii shumata enye olchetiei laaijo enkanasa naipirare nanu.

Ore peyie aayau ninye ine, nadol oltung'ani, laa ore empukunoto enye netiu anaa osuyai, neeta te nkaina enye enkopito natemishoreki o entiyani natemishoreki te nkaina enye; neitashe ninye te nkalo kishomi.

Naajoki nanu ilo tung'ani, “Enkerai e tung'ani ing'ura, too nkonyek inono, nining too nkiyiaa inono, nipik indamunot inono nena pooki naaitodol iyie, amu kitorikuoki ene peyie aatum aitoduaa iyie ninye; imbalakinye nena pooki nidol enkaji e Israel.”

Nadol esuntai namanita ine wueji e oriong netii enkaji e Nkai, ore enkadori e ina tiyani natemishoreki natii enkaina e ilo tung'ani naa intemat ile enkaina enkadori, ore pooki nabo enye naa entemata enkaina nabo o endap te nkadori; metaa etetema ina kirrushai eina suntai, naa entiyani nabo.
Neitoki ninye alo ina kishomi naipirare oloosaen, eilep too nkedeta enyena, neipim entonata eina kishomi, entiyani nabo enguton; o lgilat oomanita, entiyani nabo enkadori.

Ore ilgilat loo mbat naa entiyani nabo enkadoro ore erishata e lelo gilat loo mbaat naa ntemeta imiet e nkaina; ore ine neitasheyie ina kishomi te mbata o lgoriet tenejing'ieki kishomi naa entiyani nabo.
Neitoki ninye atem olgoriet le kishomi, intemat enkaina isiet;
tenebo ineeitasheyie enyena, intemeta are enkaina; ore olgoriet le kishomi netii enkalo enkiting'oto e atua e kishomi.
Netii ilgilat pokira okuni loo mbaat inkaloli pokira e kishomi oloosaen; ore nena pokira uni nerisio pooki; ore ing'apeta oo nkaloli pokira nerisioro.
Ina peyie etem endapasho eine nebolieki kishomi, intemeta tomon; o endapasho e ina kishomi, intemeta tomon ookuni.
Netii apa enerisha dukuya lelo gilat okuni loo mbat naa entemet nabo enkaina te pooki shoto.
Ina peyie atem ina kishomi tioriong enkalo olgilata obo ometabaiki oriong olikae, neeta endapasho o ntemat imiet o ntemeta tikitam eiteru te kutuk aji ometabaiki enkae kutuk aji.
Neitoki ake sii atem olgoriet, intemete tikitam enkaina; ore ine emanaroto e ilo goriet netii olodung'oro.
Ore te dukuya ina kishomi teine nejing'ieki o metabaiki ine enkiting'oto olgoriet liatua leina kishomi naa intemeta onom.

Ore ine wueji nejing'ieki kishomi neeta ilusien naamanita naapirik ijing atua nena ng'apeta enye tiatua lelo gilat loo mbat, neeta ake sii ilo goriet ilusien naamanita tiatua, ore too ng'apeta e kutuk aji netii iltuka.
Naariku nanu atua endung'oroto e oriong; nadol etii ilgilat olgos oomanaa teilo odung'oro; ilgilat tomoni uni ootii dukuya ilo gos.
Neim ilo gos embata nena shomito, eipirare ina adori e nena shomito; ele apa olgos le abori.
Neitoki ninye atem enkadori eiteru tiatua te nkalo e dukuya enkalo e atua eina kishomi e abori o metabaiki oriong te nkalo e dukuya ea atua olgoriet, intemat iip nabo enkaina.
Neituruk ninye te dukuya nanu alo enkalo e moikuape, nadol enkishomi naing'orita enkalo e moikuape, enaa ene nkalo olodung'oro lioriong. Netem enkadori enye o endapasho enye.
O lgilat lenyena loo mbat, okuni ake te pooki matua o ng'apeta enyena tenebo o lgorieti lenye laa erisiori o nekua e kishomi e dukuya; ore enkadori naa intemat enkaina onom o imiet.

Ore ilusien enyena o lgorieti lenyena, tenebo iltuka lenyena naa erisiori nabo anaa lelo leina kishomi ina naing'orita enkalo oloosaen; naa inkedeta naapishana ninche naailepaki ine; netii olgoriet atua ine.
Ore te nkae alo naipirare kishomi te nkalo e moikuape, anaa enatiu te nkalo o loo ntoluo netii enkishomi natii atua olgoriet; netem eiteru te kishomi o metabaiki kishomi, intemat e nkaina iip nabo.
Naarik ninye nanu enkalo e kopikop, nadol enkishomi enkalo e kopikop; netem ninye ing'apeta enyena tenebo ilgilat lenyena; neeta apa pooki erisiori nabo anaa ilkulikae.
Netii apa ilusien naamanita tiatua olgoriet lenye, anaa ilusien e kulie; ore enkadori enye naa intemat e nkaina onom, ore endapasho enye naa intemat tikitam o imiet.

Netii apa inkedeta naapishana naailepaki ninye, ore olgoriet lenye netii enkalo e atua; neeta apa iltuka too ng'apeta enye, obo ake te nkalo e atua; neeta apa ilkeek loo ltuka too ng'apeta enye, obo ake te nkalo nabo too nkaloli pooki.
Netii apa enkishomi te nkalo e kopikop te nkalo e atua olodung'oro; netem ninye eiteru te kishomi o meshomo kishomi te nkalo e kopikop, intemat e nkaina iip nabo.
Ina peyie aariku nanu atua olodung'oro li atua te nkalo e kishomi e kopikop, netem ninye ina kishomi e kopikop; nerisio apa o nkulie.
Ore ilgilat lenyena loo mbat o ing'apeta enyena, olgorieti lenye nerisio o nena kulie; netii apa ilusien naamanita tiatua tenebo olgilata lenye; ore enkadori naa intemat enkaina tikitam o imiet.
Netii ilgorieti oomanita, intemeta e nkaina tikitam o imiet enkadori naa intemeta imiet endapasho.
Ore olgoriet lenye neipirare olodung'oro li oriong netii iltuka ing'apeta enyena, ore enekedieki enye neeta inkedeta isiet.
Ina peyie aariku nanu oliatua lo lodung'oro te nkalo oloosaen, netem ninye ina kishomi; nerisiore nena kulie.

Ore ilgilat lenyena loo mbat o ing'apeta enyena tenebo ilgorieti lenyena naa erisiori o lkulikae; netii atua ilusien naamanita tiatua tenebo olgoriet lenye, ore enkadori enye naa intemat enkaina onom, ore endapasho enye naa intemat e nkaina tikitam o imiet.
Ore olgoriet lenye neipirare ilo odung'oro li oriong, neeta apa iltuka too ng'apeta enyena, obo ake te pooki shoto; ore enekedieki enye neeta inkedeta isiet.
Ina peyie aariku nanu enkalo e kishomi e moikuape, netem ninye; naa kerisioro o nkulie.
Ore ilgilat lenyena loo mbat, o ng'apeta enyena, tenebo ilgorieti lenyena nerisioro o lkulikae; neeta ilusien naamanita, ore enkadori enye naa intemat e nkaina tikitam o imiet.
Ore olgoriet lenye neipirare olodung'oro lioriong, neeta iltuka too ng'apeta enyena, obo ake te pooki shoto; ore enekedieki enye neeta inkedeta isiet.
Netii apa olgilata sapuk oata kutuk aji enye to lgoriet le kishomi, naa teine apa eisuji ilo asar opejori.
Ore tiatua ilo goriet le kishomi netii enkishomi natii imisai are too nkaloli pokira, naa ninche eyieng'ieki ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le ng'oki o lasarri le nkitarruorroto.
Ore tioriong ilo goriet te nkalo najing'ieki e kishomi moikuape, netii imisai are, ore te nkae alo eilo goriet eina kishomi netii imisai are.
Netii apa imisai are atua, netii imisai ong'uan oriong, te nchoto e ina kishomi, imisai isiet, naa te nchumata enye eyieng'ieki ilasarri.

Netii sii apa imisai ong'uan oo soito oogueta te nkaraki olasar opejori entemata enkaina nabo o lpisiai enkadori, naa entemata nabo olpisiai endapasho, naa entemata nabo enkaina enkilepata, laa ninye eiteleikini intokitin pooki naayieng'ishoreki laa teine eteyieng'ieki olasar opejori.
Ore ilala oololo, naa ore enkadori enye naa endap e nkaina, neenikino atua ninye tiatua. Ore te nchumata e nena misai naa ine eiteleikini nena kiri naaitaini metaa olasar.

Ina peyie aariku nanu tiauluo aitijing'u atua olodung'oro liatua, etii apa ilgilat aare sapuki otii atua olodung'oro liatua, ore obo naa ole nkishomi e moikuape naipirare kopikop, ore enkae neipirare enkalo e kishomi naing'orita moikuape.
Naajoki ninye nanu, ore ele gilata oipirare enkalo e kopikop naa enelelo apolosak ooitasheiki enkaji e Nkai.

Ore olgilata oipirare moikuape naa olgilata loo lapolosak ooing'or olperere lo lasar; naa kulo ninche ilayiok le Sadok, laa ninye openy tiatua ilayiok le Lawi eishoro enyikaki Olaitoriani aaisiyiai ninye.
Netem ninye ina dung'oroto, intemat e nkaina iip nabo enkadori o ntemat iip nabo endapasho, nerisio inkaloli pokira ong'uan; netii olperere dukuya ina aji Enkai.

Ina peyie aariku nanu olgoriet le nkaji e nkai, netem ing'apeta olgoriet, naa intemat imiet enkaina too nkaloli pokira; ore endapasho eina kishomi naa intemat e nkaina tomon oong'uan ore isunta enchoto naa intemat e nkaina uni te pooki shoto.
Ore enkadori o lgoriet naa intemat e nkaina tikitam ore endapasho naa intemat e nkaina tomon aare naa inkedeta tomon naailepaki; netii apa inkitotoneta embata oo ng'apata too nkaloli pooki.
Naariku nanu atua olgilata le polos, netem ninye ing'apeta enyena, ore ake te nchoto nabo naa intemat enkaina ile apa endapasho oo ntoneta eng'ape.

Ore endapasho e ine nejing'ieki naa intemat e nkaina tomon; ore isunta e ine nejing'ieki naa intemat imiet too nkaloli pokira; netem ninye enkadori e ilo gilata naa intemat e nkaina artam ore endapasho enye naa intemat e nkaina tikitam.
Ina peyie ejing atua olgilata liatua netem ing'apeta e kutuk aji, intemat are; o endapasho eina kutuk aji, intemat ile; o suntai natii embata e kutuk aji intemat naapishana.
Netem enkadori e ilo gilata, intemat e nkaina tikitam o endapasho enye, intemat e nkaina tikitam, tinigiroo olgilata le polos. Naajoki ninye nanu, ore ene naa ewueji sinyati aisul.
Ina peyie etem ina suntai enkaji e Nkai, intemat ile enkirrushai; ore endapasho oo lgilat le nchoto, naa intemat e nkaina ong'uan, eman ina aji e Nkai.

Ore ilgilat le nchoto neidikidikokino inkajijik uni te shumata, neipirare ake obo likae, tomoni uni ake te nkaji nabo natii shumata enkae. Netii ineeipiku naamanita ina suntai e nkaji e Nkai aa ninche naairishaa nena ajijik too nchot pooki kake meshetakino.

Ore lelo gilat loo mbat nepuo aalalau anaa enaailep enkaji. Ore ina aji natashare enkaji e Nkai neteshetaki too nkilepat metaa kelalau ilgilat anaa enaailep enchetata e nkaji. Netii nkedeta naailep eiteru te nkaji e abori o metabaiki eneshumata eim ene polos.
Atoduaa sii ajo ore enkaji e Nkai neeta eneika namanita; ore ilkitamanyunot loo lgilat le nchoto naa entiyani nalulung'a oo ntemat ile naalulung'a enkadori.
Ore enkirrushai eina suntai e oriong to lgilata le nchoto naa intemat e nkaina imiet. Ore enchoto e ine neika nemetii toki, naa intemat enkaina imiet, ore te rishata e ine neika e ina aji e Nkai,
o lgilat lo lodung'oro naa endapasho oo ntemat tikitam eman ina aji e Nkai te pooki shoto.
Eeta apa lelo gilat loo mbat inkutukie naabolo, nabo naing'or moi kuapa o nkae naaing'or kopikop, ore endapasho eine wueji natung'uayioki metii toki naa intemat imiet emanita.

Ore ina aji apa naipirare olodung'oro leina aji e Nkai te nkalo oloontoluo naa intemat intomoni naapishana elalai; ore ina suntai eina aji naa intemat imiet te nkirrushai emanita, ore enkadoro naa intemat intomoni naaudo.
Netem ninye ina aji e Nkai, intemat enkaina iip nabo enkadori; o lodung'oro tenebo ina aji o sunta enyena, intemat iip nabo enkadori;
tenebo endapasho te nkalo oloontoluo te dukuya enkaji e Nkai, tenebo olodung'oro intemat enkaina iip nabo.

Netem enkadori eina aji eipirare ilo odung'oro otii enkalo oloontoluo o sunta enyena too nkaloli pooki, intemat e nkaina iip nabo. Ore ilo gilata olala leina aji e Nkai o lgilata liatua oilo lioriong neeta ineerupa.
Ore emanaroto e pokira okuni neeta ilusien o ng'apeta. Ore te ntonata naipirare enetonie enkaji e Nkai nerupa too nkeek emanita, eiteru to ltiren o meilepaki ilusien (ore ilusien naa kemura),

o metabaiki ine nemetii toki te shumata kutuk aji o tenebo ilo gilata liatua o te nkalo e oriong; Ore too sunta pooki naamanita tiatua olgilata liatua o ilo gilata sapuk liatua neguetuno te nkitanyaanyukoto o lkerubi,
o lchani loo ltuka, netii ake oltukai erishata o lkerubi o lkerubi.
Neeta ake olkerubi obo inkomomi are: enkomom o ltung'ani oipirare oltukai te nkalo nabo, o enkomom oloti ng'atuny eipirare oltukai te nkae alo. Neguetakino ninche enkaji pooki e Nkai te manaroto.
Ore eiteru to ltiren o meshomo shumata e kutuk aji naguetakino olkerubi o ltukai ina suntai.
Ore nena molinkaishi e kutuk aji e ilo gilata nerisioro pooki aloli. Ore te dukuya ine wueji sinyati netii entoki nanyaanyukie olperere loo nkeek,

intemat e nkaina uni enkadoro enkilepata, intemat are enkadori, intemat are endapasho; ore ilpijat lenyena entonata enye o sunta enyena naa inoo nkeek. Naajoki ninye nanu, “Nena ina misa natii dukuya Olaitoriani.”
Ore ilo gilata liatua tenebo ine wueji sinyati neeta ake nabo kikenet naidikidiko katitin are.
Neeta nena kikeneta imatuan are, imatuan are naamanaa too eneta te pooki kikenet.
Ore te nena kikeneta e ilo gilata neguetakino ilkerubi o ltuka, anaa lelo ooguetakino nena sunta; netii ilkeek kumok oonukita ilo gilata lioriong.
Netii ilusien enchoto e ilo gilata too nkaloli pokira, neikodoki nena sunta too lkeek lo ltukai.
Ina peyie aariki nanu atua olgoriet liatua le nkalo e moikuape, naariku nanu atua ilgilat ooipirare enkalo olodung'oro le nkaji e Nkai netii sii enkae alo eina aji natii moikuape.
Ore enkadori eina aji natii enkalo e moikuape naa intemeta iip nabo, ore endapasho enye naa intemat onom.
Neibung'are intemeta e nkaina tikitam naatii atua olodung'oro liatua, neipirare enkiyopata naimi enkaji e oriong olodung'oro. Oltapeet le nkaji oipirare olikae too nkajijik uni naakedo aaidikidiko.
Ore eitu ijing lelo gilat netii enkoitoi najing atua, intemat enkaina tomon endapasho o ntemat e nkaina iip te nkadori netii inkutukie oo nkajijik enye enkalo e moikuape.
Ore ilgilat le shumata naa aironkeni, amu ewaita iltapeeti le shumata erishata sapuk aalang ilgilat liabori o le mpolos e nkaji.
Amu inkajijik apa uni naakedo, nemeeta apa ing'apeta anaa ing'apeta ololodung'oro liauluo; metaa ore ilgilat le shumata neingat enkop aalang ile abori o le polos.
Netii apa esuntai boo naipirare lelo gilat te nkalo olodung'oro lioriong; eipirare lelo gilat, intemat enkaina onom enkadori.
Ore ilgilat lolodung'oro lioriong naa intemat onom te nkadori, ore lelo ootii enkae alo enkaji e Nkai naa intemat iip nabo enkadoro.
Ore tiabori lelo gilat netii kutuk aji te nkalo naing'or oloosaen, najing'unye iltung'ana eing'uaa olodung'oro le boo.
Ore sii te nkalo e kopikop, eipirare olodung'oro o eipirare sii ina aji; etii ilgilat oata enejing'ieki te dukuya ninche;
nenyaanyukie ninche lelo gilat ootii enkalo e kopikop, nabo enkadoro o endapasho, neeta ewueji nebo neipang'ieki, naa nabo o nkutukie oo nkajijik.
Ore tiabori ilgilat le kopikop netii enejing'ieki te nkalo oloosaen, teine nejing'ieki ina oitoi, ore te nkalo e kurum netii esuntai narish esuntai.

Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ilgilat le nkalo e moikuape o lgilat le kopikop lelo ooipirare ilo odung'oro naa lgilat Sinyat, laa teine epuo lelo apolosak oopuonu enetii Olaitoriani aanya lelo asarri sinyat oleng: ilo asar le ntapa, ilo asar le ng'oki, o ilo asar le nkitarruoroto, amu ore ine wueji naa aisinyati.

Ore tenejing ilapolosak ine wueji sinyati, nemeipang auluo teine aapuo ina dung'oroto e auluo eitu eitayu teine nena kilani enye a enkisiaayiare, amu aisinyat kuna; neishop ninche kulie kilani eton eitu epuo aanyikaki ewueji netti iltung'ana.”
Ore peyie eidip atetema atua ine wueji e nkaji e Nkai, naarik nanu aipang'ie teina kishomi naipirare enkalo oloosaen, netem ewueji e nkaji e Nkai aman.
Netem enkalo oloo saen te ntiyani natemishoreki intemat enkaina iip imiet te ntiyani natemishoreki.
Neitoki aibelekenya netem enkalo e moikuape, intemat enkaina iip imiet te ntiyiani natemishoreki.
Neitoki aibelekenya netem enkalo e kopikop, intemat iip imiet e nkaina teina tiyani natemishoreki.
Neitoki aibelekenyakino enkalo oloontoluo, netem, intemat iip imiet e nkaina teina tiyani natemishoreki.

Etetema ninye too nkaloli pokira ong'uan. Neeta apa esuntai namanita ninye, intemat enkaina iip imiet te nkadori, o ntemat iip imiet e nkaina endapasho, pee etum atirishu ewueji sinyati o ene pooki ng'ae.
Ore te siadi naayau ninye nanu kishomi, ina kishomi naipirare enkalo o loosaen.
Eeuo enkitoo e Nkai e Israel eing'uaa enkalo oloosaen; ore oltoilo le lotunoto enye netiu anaa oltoilo loo nkariak kumok; newang'u enkop te nkitoo enye.
Ore ina duaata natoduaa, netiu anaa enduaata apa natoduaa apa ina kata nalotu aidaikie ina anasa, netiu anaa enduaata apa natoduaa te mbata o lkeju le Kebar; nabatata te nkomom ai.
Ore ejing'ita enkitoo o Laitoriani atua ina aji e Nkai eimu ina kishomi natii enkalo o loosaen,
naadumu nanu Enkiyang'et ailepie, naayau atua olgoriet liatua; neiputa enkitoo o Laitoriani ina aji e Nkai.
Ore eitashe ilo tung'ani te mbata nanu, naning obo laairorie nanu tiatua enkaji e Nkai; naajoki ninye nanu,

“Enkerai e tung'ani, ore ene wueji naa ewueji olorika lai le nkitoo, naa ewueji oo ndapi oo nkejek aainei, ewueji namany tiatua iltung'ana le Israel intarasi. Nemeitoki aekata enkaji e Israel aaisarkionie enkarna ai Sinyati, nemeitoki ninche, aashu ilaiguanak lenye, teina kiborra enye oo nkonyek, o too mpopoki oo laiguanak lenye ootuata

eitasheyie ineeidong'ishoreki enye te wueji ai neidong'ishoreki, o ntaloishin e kutuk aji enye te mbata oo ntaloishin e kutuk aji aainei, metaa esuntai ake natii erishata e nanu o ninche. Eisarkionie ninche enkarna ai sinyati teilo minong otaasa ninche, metaa atumuta nanu ninche te ngoro ai.
Inchoo taata eitalamaa ninche enkiborra enye oo nkonyek o mpopoki oo laiguanak lenye ootuata aaitalamaa te nanu, naa kamany nanu atua ninche intarasi.
“Ore iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, toliki ina aji e Israel enkaji e Nkai o enaikununo o enaikununi, peyie etum aatukurru too ntorrok enye.

Naa tenaa kekurru te pooki nataasa ninche, imbalie enkaji e Nkai, enkitobirata enye neeipang'ieki, o ineejing'ieki enyena o pooki kitamanyunoto enye nintayiolo ninche pooki nkiguanat enye o nkitanapat enyena pooki; ninger ninche edolita, peyie etum aatujurru neibung inkitanapat pooki tenebo nkiguanat pooki.
Ena ninye enkitanapata e Nkaji e Nkai: ina kop pooki namanita te shumata e ilo doinyo keaku enasinya oleng. Ing'ura ajo ena ninye enkitanapata e nkaji e Nkai.

“Kuna ninche ntemeta o lperere lo lasar too ntemeta adoru (entemet e nkaina nalulung'a o ndapasho enkaina.) Ore entonata enye naa keaku entemet e nkaina nabo eilep naa entemet e nkaina nabo endapasho, tenebo enkamanaa nabo namanita osegel lenye. Naa ena ninye naaku enkadori olperere lo lasar.

Ore eiteru te ntonata enkop o metabaiki enkedet enye e abori, naa intemeta are e nkaina, neeta endapasho e ntemet e nkaina nabo; ore eiteru te nkedet kiti o metabaiki enkedet sapuk, naa intemeta ong'uan e nkaina, neeta endapasho entemet enkaina nabo.
Ore ewueji e nkima o lperere lo lasar, naa intemeta ong'uan e nkaina; ore epuku te wueji e nkima o lperere lo lasar eilep shumata naa imowuarak ong'uan entemet nabo e nkaina eilep.
Ore ine wueji e nkima o lperere lo lasar naa keaku kerisioro pooki intemeta tomon aare e nkaina enkadoro, naa intemeta tomon oaare e nkaina endapasho.

Ore sii ninye enkedet naa kerisioro te pooki aloli, intemeta e nkaina tomon oong'uan enkadoro, naa intemeta e nkaina tomon oong'uan endapasho, neeta enkamanaa namanita ninye olpisiai le ntemet e nkaina endapasho, ore entonata enye naa entemet nabo e nkaina emanita. Ore inkedeta e ilo perere lo lasar neipirare enkalo o loosaen.”

Naajoki Olaitoriani nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Kuna ninche inkitanapat naaipirta olperere lo lasar: Ore teina olong naitasheyieki ninye peyie eitaini olasar opejori te shumata ninye o pee ebukokini osarge shumata ninye,
inchoo ilo apolosani loo Lawi lo lmarei le Sadok, ilo laanyikaki nanu aaisiai, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, inchoo oloing'oni meitainyie olasar le ng'oki.

Naa iya iyie embata osarge lenye, nipik ninye nena mowuarak ong'uan o lperere lo lasar, nipik ilpijat oong'uan le nkedet, nipik ina amanaa aitaman neaku neijia inko tinimpok olperere lo lasar aitisiny, nintayu olning'o lo sotua te ninye.
Iya sii ilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki, nepeji ninye teine wueji negeluno e nkaji e Nkai, tiauluo ine wueji nesinya.
Ore te nkolong e are nintayu oloro lemeeta entioto te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki; naa keipoki olperere lo lasar, anaa apa peyie eipoki te ilo oing'oni.
Ore peyie indip aipoo ninye, nintayu oloing'oni lemeeta entioto o lmeregesh oing'uaa intare nemeeta entioto.
Ninchooyo ninche te dukuya Olaitoiriani, naa keisuaaki ilapolosak emunyan shumata ninche neitayu ninche anaa olasar opejori aitaiki Olaitoriani.
Ore too nkolong'i naapishana, naa intayu anaake enkine te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki, tenebo oloing'oni o tenebo olmeregesh oing'uaa intare, lemeeta entioto, ninye eitaini.
Neitayu ninche olasar lo lning'o lo sotua too nkolong'i naapishana te nkaraki olperere lo lasar aipok ninye aitisiny, neiteng'elakini ninye.

Ore peyie eishu kuna olong'i, neaku ore te nkolong e isiet nepuo dukuya aaitayu ilapolosak to lperere lo lasar lelo asarri linyi oopejori tenebo ilasarri linyi le seriani, naa kang'amaa intae, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”
Naaitoki ariku nanu ina kishomi e auluo e ine wueji sinyati, naipirare enkalo oloosaen, naa keikeno apa.
Naajoki ninye nanu, “Keton ena kishomi eikeno; meboli ninye, nemeeta oltung'ani ojing'u aimu ina kishomi; amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, naa ine etijing'unye, neaku keton ninye eikeno.
Olkitok ake oton tiatua ninye peyie etum ainosa emukate te dukuya Olaitoriani; naa kejing ninye atua te nkoitoi olgilata le kishomi, neitoki ake aipang teina oitoi.”
Naariku ninye nanu aimunye enkalo e kishomi e moikuape omatabaiki enkalo e dukuya e nkaji e Nkai, naing'or naa ng'ura, eiputa enkitoo Olaitoriani e nkaji o Olaitoriani; nabatata te nkomom ai.

Naajoki Olaitoriani nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, tujurru oleng, toduaa too nkonyek inono, nining too nkiyiaa inono nena pooki naaliki iyie naaipirta inkitanapat pooki e nkaji o Laitoriani tenebo nkitanapat enyena pooki; nijurru oleng ayiolou lelo pooki ooishori metijing'a enkaji e Nkai o lelo pooki oodung'ori tewueji sinyati.
Nijoki ina aji kiserut, ina aji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Naaji e Israel, inchoo eish ilo minong lino pooki,

teine ning'amaa ilomon ilememurata too ltauja o seseni, peyie ejing ewueji ai sinyati, neisarkionie ninye, ina kata nikinchosho nanu endaa ai, nena naapir o ilo sarge. Itigila intae olning'o lai lo sotua, tenebo ilo minong linyi pooki.
Neitu iramatata intokitin aainei sinyat; kake itipika ilomon meing'ura atua ewueji ai sinyati.
“Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Meetae olomoni, olememurata oltau o sesen lenye, o pooki omoni lelo ootii atua iltung'ana le Israel, oojing ewueji ai sinyati.
“Kake ore lelo le Lawi laashomo aalam nanu, ootapong'ori te nanu aasuj nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin ina kata peyie epong'ori Israel, naa kenap enkitamioto enye maate.

Keaku ninche ilaisiaayiak te wueji ai sinyati, neitasheiki too nchomito e nkaji e Nkai, neisiaaisho te nkaji e Nkai; naa keyieng ninche olasar opejori te nkaraki iltung'ana, naa keramat ninche olorere, eisiaai ninche.

Amu eisiaayia ninche te dukuya inkaitin enye oo nkitanyaanyukot neaku ninche ilo oibooyo ng'ok te nkaji e Israel, neaku ainosa olmumai te ninche, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, inchere kenap ninche maate enkitamioto enye.

Maapuonu ninche aanyikaki nanu aaisiai nanu anaa ilapolosak, aashu epuonu aanyikaki intokitin aainei sinyat o ntokitin naa sinyat oleng; kake kenap ninche enkurruna enye, te nkaraki ilo minong otaasa ninche.
Ore ake sii naa kagelu ninche meitasheiki ina aji e Nkai, peyie atum aas esiaai pooki naasi tiatua ninye.

“Kake ore ilapolosak loo Lawi, lelo ayiok le Sadok, lelo oogolie ewueji ai sinyati, ina kata nashomo iltung'ana le Israel aapong'ori aaing'uaa nanu, kepuonu ninche enatii aanyiku peyie aasiai nanu, naa kaaisiaai nanu aaitaiki nanu nena naapir tenebo ilo sarge, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai;
naa kejing ninche ewueji ai Sinyati, naa kejing ninche emisa ai, peyie aaisiai nanu, naa keibung ninche enkitanapata ai.

Ore peyie ejing ninche atua inchomito o lgoriet liatua, naa keishop ninche inkilani e kitani naapuyiapui; meishop hoo ninche toki naitobiruno too lpapit loo ntare, ina kata aaisiaai too nchomito o lgoriet tiatua aji.
Naa keishop ninche inkarash e kitani too lukuny enye o surualini e kitani too mpolosi enye; merrotian ninche ae toki naitaar ninche enkima.

Naa tenebo eipang aapuo olodung'oro lioriong, enetii iltung'ana, naa keitayu nena kilani nena apa naaisiaaishore, neirragie ninche too lgilat sinyat; neishop ninche kulie kilani, pee mepik ake esinyatisho iltung'ana too nkilani enye.
Nemebarn ninche ilukuny enye aashu eisho ilpapit lenye ebulu aadoru, keisor ake ninche ilpapit lenye loo lukuny enye.
Meetae olapolosani ook enaisho oo sabibu, ina kata ejing olgoriet liatua.
Meyam ninche enkoliai, aashu enkitok natung'uayie o lpayian lenye, kake eselenkei ake o lorere le nkaji e Israel, aashu enkoliai naa enkoliai o lapolosani.
Keiteng'en ninche iltung'ana laainei enepaashare ina nasinya o ina nemesinya, neitodol ninche eneiko tenerishu ina naiduruk o enemeiduruk.

Ore te mbae pooki natii enchankar, neaku ninche ilarishak te risioroto oo nkiguanat aainei. Keibung ninche inkitanapat aainei tenebo inkiguanat too siruai laainei pooki gelunot, neitisiny isabatoni aainei.
Eisarkionie ninche ate aapuo aanyikaki olmeneng'ani; ore ake eyia, te papaai aashu yieyioo, to layioni aashu te ntito, to lalashe aashu teina anashe nemeyama keidim aaisarkionie ate.
Ore peyie eidip aiduruko, neikenaki kewan nkolong'i naapishana neaku ninye olemeeta olduruk.
Ore teina olong nalo ninye ine wueji sinyati, atua olgoriet liaatua, peyie aaisiai tiatua ewueji sinyati, naa keitayu ninye olasar lenye le ng'oki, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
“Meitoki ninche aata enjung'ore; nanu enjung'ore enye; nimincho ninche toki naitaa enenye tiatua Israel; ara nanu emasaai enye.
Kenya ninche olasar le ntapa, olasar le ng'oki tenebo olasar le ntorroni; ore pooki toki te Israel naiteng'elaki neaku enenye.

Ore pooki ng'anayio le dukuya le pooki pukunoto o pooki kishooroto e pooki pukunoto too nkishoorot inono pooki, naa keaku inoo lapolosak; nincho sii ninche lelo apolosak olng'anayioi lino le dukuya le mukate, peyie etum emayianata atotona te nkaji ino.
Menya ilapolosak pooki toki, aa emotonyi aashu eng'ues, ina natua makewan aashu enataara nkulie.

“Ore tenelo niorikinono enkop aaya, entooriki Olaitoriani erubata teinakop metaa enkop sinyati. Intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet enkadoro; o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam endapasho, naa keaku sinyati te pooki nebaiki pooki.
Ore teina kurma nedung'uni ewueji nerisioro inkaloli pooki oo ntemeta e nkaina iip imiet neaku ine wueji sinyati neeta intemat onom enkaina e wueji nemetii toki namanita ninye.
Ore teinakop sinyati nirishu aoru erubata intemat nkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadoro o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te ndapasho, naa ninche ejing ina aji sinyati, ewueji sinyati oleng.

Keaku ninye esashati sinyati teina kop; naa keaku enelelo apolosak ooasisho tiatua ine wueji sinyati; nejing ine wueji sinyati aaisiai Olaitoriani; naa keaku ninye ewueji oo nkajijik enye, naa ewueji Sinyati te nkaraki ina Aji sinyati.

Ore enkae sashati, intemat e nkaina nkalifuni tikitam o imiet tenkadoro naa ntemat e nkaina nkalifuni tomon endapasho, naa keaku enoo le Lawi lelo ooisiaisho te nkaji e Nkai, pee eaku ewueji oo nkanas enye naamany.

“Ore ake sii teina sashati natudung'uoki aitaa enkop nasinya, nidung'u aitaa ewueji e nkanasa, enkop oo ntemat nkalifuni imiet te ndapasho naa ntemat enkaina inkalifuni imiet te nkadoro neaku ene nkaji pooki e Israel.

“Naa keaku eno lkitok enkop pooki natii nkaloli pokira ina kop sinyati o ine wueji e nkanasa, emanita ine wueji sinyati o ine wueji enkanasa, te nkalo oloontoluo o te nkalo o loosaen, eipirarete nkadoro nabo sashati olorere, nenyikaa eiteru te nkalo o loontoluo o meshomo oloo saen lo lpolosie leina kop. Keaku ina enkop enye te Israel.
Ore ilkituaak laainei nemeitoki aekata airony iltung'ana laainei; kake keisho ina aji e Israel menoto ina kop te risioroto oo loshon lenye.

“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: itaasa ing'ok, lo kituaak le Israel! Ewuang'ie enkikonya o enkitorogonyare, nimbalilie esipata o esinyatisho; entapal eyararoto oo ltung'ana laainei, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
“Entaa ilooata intemat naasipa naaineneng'ishoreki, efa nemetii emonkoi, o bati nemetii emonkoi.
Ore efa tenebo e bati naa erisiori nabo, ore bati neeta ematua nabo e tomon e Homa, ore efa ematua nabo e tomon e Homa; neaku ore Homa ninye erikorieki enkiroishi pooki.
Ore shekeli naa keaku gera tikitam; ore shekeli imiet neaku shekeli imiet, ore shekeli tomon neaku shekeli tomon, ore mina neaku shekeli onom.
“Ena ninye enkishooroto naa ninye intayu; ore ematua nabo e ile e efa te pooki homa e nkano e ematua nabo e ile e pooki homa e shairi,
o erubata nauno e ilata, ematua nabo e tomon bati te pooki Kori (ore kori netiu anaa homa, eeta bati tomon);

ore enker nabo te luaata oo nkerrai iip are, too lmarei pooki le Israel. Ena ninye enkishooroto te nkaraki olasar le ntapa, olasar opejori, o lasar le seriani, peyie itum aitobira olasar lo lning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninche, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
Ore iltung'ana pooki leina kop, neisho ena kishooroto ilo kitok otii atua Israel.

Keaku esiaai o lkitok peyie eitobir ilasarri oopejori, ilasarri le ntapa, o lasarri ooki, te lelo siruai, teina rishata nadoli olapa too Sabatoni, o te lelo siruai pooki gelunot le nkaji e Israel: keitayu ninye ilasarri le ng'oki, o lasarri le ntapa, o lasarri oopejoro, o lasarri le seriani, peyie etum aitaiki olning'o lo sotua ina aji e Israel.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ore to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, niyaya oloti oing'oni lemeeta entioto, nimpok ine wueji sinyati.

Naa keya olapolosani oloti sarge lo lasar le ng'oki nepik ninye intaloishin e kutuk aji eina aji e Nkai, nepik sii inkedeta pokira ong'uan o lperere lo lasar, o ng'apeta e kishomi e ine wueji olgoriet liatua.
Niasiasa ina te nkolong e naapishana o lapa te pooki ng'ae otaasa eng'oki te ntorroni aashu te modai; metaa intayuyu olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai.
“Ore to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e tomon oong'uan o lapa, naa ishipakinono ilo sirua le ng'iroroto oji Pasaka ore too nkolong'i naapishana naa kenyae emukate neitu eisiujieki.
Ore teina olong naa keitayu olkitok te nkaraki enkewan enye tenebo iltung'ana pooki leina kop oloti oing'oni te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki.

Ore te nena olong'i naapishana e ilo sirua, naa keitaiki anaa olasar opejokini Olaitoriani iloing'ok ooti oopishana o lmeregeshi oopishana lemeeta entioto, te pooki olong e nena naapishana; o loro pooki olong te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki.
Naa keitayu anaa olasar le ntapa e efa te pooki oing'oni, e efa te pooki meregesh, o hini e ilata te pooki efa.

Ore to lapa le liopishana, te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa o too nkolong'i naapishana e ilo sirua, naa keitobiri ina kishorunoto te nkaraki olasar loo ng'ok, ilasarri oopejori, o lasarri le ntapa o le ilata.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore kishomi o lodung'oro liatua oipirare oloo saen naa keikeni te nena olong'i ile naasishoi; kake ore te nkolong e Sabato o enkolong nadoli olapa naa keboli.

Kejing olkitok eimu olgoriet leina kishomi eing'uaa auluo, neitashe ninye te mbata entaloishi e kishomi. Neitayu ilapolosak ilasarri lenye oopejori, ilasarri lenyena le seriani, neseremisho te mpolos e kishomi, neipang alo auluo, kake meikeni kishomi o metaa teipa.
Ore iltung'ana leina kop neseremisho te nejing'ieki ina kishomi te dukuya Olaitoriani too Sabatoni te nedoli olapa.
Ore ilo asar opejori oitayio ilo kitok aitaiki Olaitoriani teina olong e Sabato naa keaku ilkuoo le kerra ile lemeeta entioto, o lmeregesh lemeeta entioto;
o lasar le ntapa te nebo olmeregesh neaku e efa, te nebo olasar le ntapa tenebo ilkuoo, keaku ake duoo anaa enaidim, tenebo eilata te pooki efa.
“Ore teina olong nadoli olapa naa keitayu ninye oloti oing'oni lemeeta entioto, olkuoo le kerra o lmeregesh, lemeeta entioto;
anaa olasar le ntapa neitayu e efa tenebo oloing'oni tenebo e efa tenebo olmeregesh, tenebo olkuoo le kerra anaa enaidim aitayu, tenebo hini e ilata te pooki efa.
Ore peyie ejing olkitok, nejing'u atua eimu ilo goriet le kishomi, naa ina oitoi ake naimua eitoki aim.

“Ore peyie epuonu iltung'ana leina kop dukuya o Laitoriani te lelo siruai oogeluno, ore ilo ojing'u te kishomi e moikuape aseremisho neipang alo te kishomi e kopikop; ore ilo ojing'u te kishomi e kopikop neipang auluo te kishomi e moikuape; meetae oltung'ani oshuko aipang eimaa kishomi natijing'ie, kake keipang ake pooki ng'ae aitoriori alo dukuya.
Ore peyie ejing ninche atua naa kejing olkitok atua tenebo ninche; naa teneipang ninche boo neipang sii ninye boo.

“Ore te lelo siruai o nena rishat naageluno, ore olasar le ntapa tenebo oloti oing'oni naa keaku efa nabo, ore tenebo olkuoo le ker naa efa, ore tenebo ilkuoo le kerra anaa ake duoo enaidim oltung'ani aishoru, tenebo hini e ilata te efa.

Teneitayu olkitok enkishooroto to lpela aa olasar opejori aashu olasar le seriani anaa enkishooroto o lpela to Laitoriani, ore ina kishomi naipirare oloo saen naa kebolokini ninye; naa keitayu ninye olasar lenye opejori aashu olasar lenye le seriani anaa enaas ninye te nkolong e Sabato. Naa keipang ninye auluo, ore peyie eipang ninye auluo, neikeni kishomi.
“Naa keitayu ninye olkuoo le ker lo lari obo lemeeta entioto metaa olasar opejori to Laitoriani anaake; tadekenya eitayu ninye.

Neitayu tenebo ninye olasar le ntapa anaake tadekenya, ematua nabo e ile e efa, o ematua nabo e uni e hini e eilata peyie eitashal ina tapa, anaa olasar le ntapa lo Laitoriani; ena ninye enkitanapata naipirta ilo asar opejori le anaake.
Neaku neijia eikununi ilo kuoo le ker tenebo olasar le ndaa tenebo eilata eitaini, anaake tadekenya metaa olasar ouno anaake.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Tenelo neitayu olkitok enkishooroto aitaiki obo loo layiok lenyena tiatua enjung'ore enye, naa keaku enoo layiok lenyena, entoki nara enenye te njung'ore.

Kake tenelo neitayu enkishooroto aitaiki obo loo sinkan lenyena neaku enenye o metabaiki ilo ari le lakunoto; nerrinyokino aaku enolkitok; keaku ilayiok lenyena ake ooidim aatushum enkishooroto te njung'ore enye.

Meya olkitok enjung'ore hoo nabo oo ltung'ana nemerrumoo ninche te wueji enye; keisho ninye ilayiok lenyena enjung'ore enye teine wueji enye makewan, metaa meetae hoo obo loo ltung'ana laainei ooruni entoki enye.”

Ina peyie aaitijing'u nanu te wueji najing'ieki, ina apa naatii embata eina kishomi, te nkalo e moikuape oo lgilat sinyat tenkaraki ilapolosak; ore teine nadol ewueji te bayie o loontoluo te nkiting'oto enye.

Naajoki ninye nanu, “Nena ewueji nepejie ilapolosak enkishooroto o lasar le nkitarruorroto tenebo enkishooroto o lasar le ng'oki naa teine sii epej olasar le ntapa peyie metum ninche aayau ninche aaitupuku ine wueji olgoriet le boo, neitabaiki esinyatisho olorere.
“Naariku nanu dukuya atua ilo goriet lioriong naarik nanu ilpijat pokira oong'uan lo lgoriet; ore te pooki pijata lo lgoriet netii olgoriet
ore tiatua nena matuan pokira ong'uan o lgoriet netii kulie gorieti dung'orot, intemeta enkaina artam te nkadoro o ntemeta enkaina tomoni uni endapasho; ore nena pokira ong'uan nerisioro.
Ore tiatua, ine nemanita lelo gorieti pokira oong'uan, netii isoito oogueta netii ewueji neinokieki enkima namanita.
Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, ‘Ore kuna naa iwuejitin neeyierie lelo oasisho te nkaji e Nkai ilasarri ooishorutua iltung'ana.’ ”

Naariku nanu arrinyu oriong e kutuk aji e nkaji e Nkai; nadol epuku enkare tiabori ine neitasheyie enkaji e Nkai te nkalo oloosaen (amu ore enkaji e Nkai neipirare oloosaen); neruko enkare abori naing'uaa kopikop o eneitasheyie ina aji e Nkai, kopikop olperere lo lasar.
Naaipang'unye ninye nanu te nkalo e kishomi e kopikop, naarik nanu aitaman oriong ina kishomi e oriong, ina naipirare enkalo oloosaen; nepuku enkare te nkalo e kopikop.
Ore eloito enkalo o loo saen eeta enkopito te nkaina enye, netem ilo tung'ani intemat enkaina enkalifu nabo, naarik nanu aimie atua ina are; naa oloure kokoyo ebaiki eng'uton enye.
Neitoki atem intemat enkaina enkalifu, naarik nanu aimie atua enkare; naa enkung'u ebaiki eng'uton, neitoki atem intemat enkalifu, naarik nanu aimie atua enkare; nebaiki empolos ai ina are.
Neitoki atem intemat enkaina enkalifu, naa olkeju lemaidim aima atalang'a, amu eilepua enkare; ekegut apa oleng enaa indim aisompirayu tiatua olkeju lemelang'ayu.
Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, itoduaa iyie ena?” Naarriny nanu aimie enkiyopata o lkeju.
Ore arrinyo, nadol te nkiyopata olkeju ilkeek kumok te nchoto nabo o te nkae.
Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ena are nerukokino enkalo enkop oloosaen, nelo arukokino atua Araba; ore peyie ejing atua nkariak nemeruko e naiposha, nesilayu ina are.
Ore pooki wueji neim ilo keju naa keishu impukunot pooki o ng'uesi o sinkir. Neitaa ilo keju inkariak e naiposha naaisukut inaasila, neaku meye hoo toki teine nerukokino ilo keju.

Ore lelo arreshok loo sinkir neitashe te nkiyopata enaiposha; eiteru te En-gedi, ometabaiki Eneglaim, keaku ewueji neidapashieki irresheta; ore isinkir lenyena naa keaku iloo mpukunot kumok, anaa isinkir le naiposha kitok.
Kake ore olng'arua o lkishankual lenye; nemesila asidanu ekeing'uaa ninche metaa emunyan.

Ore too nkiyopat o lkeju too lkekuno pokira lo lkeju, naa kebulu impukunot kumok oo lkeek aaku endaa. Metoyu mbenek enye aashu elau ilng'anayio lenye, kake keiu ilng'anayio sidain te pooki apa, amu ore ina are enye nerukunye aing'uaa ine wueji sinyati. Ore ilng'anayio lenye naa keaku ile ndaa ore imbenek enye neaku olmairo oishiunye olorere.
“Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Kulo ninche ilpolosien laa ninche iorie enkop te njung'ore tiatua lelo oshon loo Siraeli tomon aare. Ore Yosef naa ketum irubat are.
Naa ior iyie ninye aitoris; ainosa apa olmumai ajo kaisho ninye iloo papaai linyi, naa keaku ena kop te intae enjung'ore.
“Keaku ena olpolosie leina kop: ore te nkalo e moikuape, eiteru te Naiposha kitok te nkalo enkoitoi e Hetlon, o metabaiki ine nejing'ieki e Hamat, o te nkalo e Sedad, o Berota,
o Sibraim (ina natii olpolosie orish Dameski o Hamat) o metabaiki Haseratikon, ina natii olpolosie le Hauran.
Metaa kepuku olpolosie le naiposha e Hasarenon, ina natii moikuape olpolosie le Dameski, tenebo olpolosie le Hamat o meshomo moikuape. Keaku ena enkalo e moikuape.

“Ore te nkalo oloosaen, naa kepuku olpolosie te Hasarenom te rishata Hauran o Dameski; eimaa Yordan te rishata e Gilead o enkop e Israel; o meshomo enkalo oloosaen enaiposha o metabaiki Tamau. Keaku ina enkalo oloosaen.
“Ore te nkalo e kopikop, naa kepuku te Tamar o metabaiki nena ariak e Meribatkadesh, o meshomo lelo motioo le Misiri, o metabaiki enaiposha kitok. Keaku ina enkalo e kopikop.
“Ore te nkalo o loontoluo, ore ina aiposha kitok neaku ninye olpolosie o metabaiki ewueji enkae alo ine nejing'ieki Hamat. Keaku ina enkalo oloontoluo.
“Neaku iorioro ena kop tiatua intae te risioroto oo loshon le Israel.

Idung'okiki ate metaa enjung'ore te ntae o tenebo ilomon oomanya atua intae netoiutuo nkera tiatua intae. Keaku ninche te intae olayioni oino loo layiok le Israel; ore tenebo intae naa keishori enjung'ore tiatua iloshon le Israel.
“Ore te pooki ake ninye osho omanya ilo omoni, neaku teine idung'okiki ninye enjung'ore enye, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

“Kuna ninche inkarn oo loshon: Eiteru to lpolosie le moikuape, eiteru te naiposha te nkalo enkoitoi e Hetlon o meshomo enejing'ieki Hamat, o metabaiki Hasarenon (ina natii olpolosie le moikuape e Dameski o metabaiki Hamat), nepuku te nkalo oloo saen o metabaiki oloontoluo, Dan erubata nabo.
Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Dan, eiteru te nkalo oloosaen o metabaiki Asheri, naa erubata nabo.
Ore epuku to lpolosie le nkop e Asheri, te nkalo oloosaen o metabaiki oloontoluo, naa Naftali, naa erubata nabo.
Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Naftali, eiteru tenkalo oloo saen o metabaiki oloontoluo naa Manase, erubata nabo.
Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Manase, eiteru te nkalo oloo saen o metabaiki enkalo oloontoluo, naa Efraim, erubata nabo.
Ore eiteru to lpolosie le Efraim, eiteru te nkalo oloosaen o metabaiki oloontoluo naa Ruben, erubata nabo.
Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Ruben, eiteru tenkalo oloosaen o metabaiki oloontoluo naa Yuda, erubata nabo.

“Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Yuda, eiteru te nkalo o loosaen, o metabaiki oloontoluo, naa keaku erubata naitaini aaiteng'el, intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet e ndapasho, ore tenkadori nerisiore eneba nabo e nena rubat olosho, eiteru tenkalo oloo saen o metabaiki oloontoluo, etii ewueji sinyati empolos enye.
Ore ina rubata ninteng'elakiki Olaitoriani, naa keaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadori, o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam tendapasho.

Kuna ninche naaku iorot ewueji sinyati, naa keishori ilapolosak eoroto nabaiki intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkalo e moikuape, intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te ndapasho te nkalo oloontoluo, intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te nkalo oloo saen o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadoro te nkalo e kopikop, netii ewueji sinyati o Laitoriani eneitorit.
Keaku ena enoo lapolosak ooitisinyaki lelo ayiok le Sadok, lelo ooibung'a enkitanapata ai, lelo leitu epuo aapong'ori ina kata napuo iltung'ana le Israel aapong'ori, anaa enataasa ile Lawi.
Naa keaku enenye anaa erubata e tipat naing'uaa ine wueji sinyati eina kop, e wueji neisul te sinyatisho eiteru to lpolosie le Lawi.

Ore te mbata ina kop oo lapolosak keaku keeta Ilawi ewueji oo ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadori naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon endapasho. Ore enkadori enye pooki naa keaku intemat e nkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet ore endapasho naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam.
Nememir aashu ewalaa ina rubata enkop ake pooki, amu aisinyati ninye to Laitoriani.

“Ore ina naleku, intemat enkaina inkalifuni imiet te ndapasho, o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadori, naa keaku ene pooki siaai teina anasa eiana anasa, ee nemanyi oe wueji nemetii toki. Ore te mpolos enye netii enkanasa;

naa kuna ninche intemet enyena: ore enkalo e moikuape naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni ong'uan o iip imiet, ore enkalo e kopikop intemat enkaina inkalifuni ong'uan o iip imiet, ore te nkalo oloontoluo naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni ong'uan o iip imiet.

Naa keeta enkanasa enkop nalala: ore te nkalo e moikuape intemat e nkaina iip are oo onom, ore te nkalo e kopikop naa intemat enkaina iip are o onom, ore tenkalo o loontoluo naa intemat enkaina iip are o onom.

Ore ina adori natelekua ina natashare ine wueji sinyati naa keaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te nkalo oloosaen, naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te nkalo o loontoluo, naa keaku enatashare ina rubata sinyati. Ore ina naiu ninye naa keaku endaa e lelo aisiaayiak le nkanasa.
Ore ilaisiaayiak le nkanasa, too loreren pooki le Israel, naa ketur ninye.
Ore ine wueji pooki ninteng'el naa keaku intemat e nkaina nkalifuni tikitam o imiet erisioro nkaloli pooki, aa taa, ina rubata nasinya tenebo nena tokitin naara ineina anasa.

“Ore enaleku te pooki alo eina rubata sinyati o ina nara ene nkanasa naa keaku ino lkitok. Eiteru too ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet eina rubata nasinya o meshomo olpolosie lo loosaen, neito oloontoluo eiteru too ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet o meshomo olpolosie lo loontoluo, ine neshepita isashat oo loshon, naa keaku eneilo kitok. Ore inewueji sinyati tenebo ina aji sinyati Enkai natii empolos enye,
tenebo ina nara enoo le Lawi, tenebo ina nara ene nkanasa, naa keaku enatii empolos eina nara enoo lkitok. Ore erubata eilo kitok naa keaku enatii ilo polosie le Yuda olpolosie le Benchamen.
“Ore tenkaraki ilkulikae oshon: Eiteru te nkalo oloosaen o meshomo oloo ntoluo, naa Benchamen, erubata nabo.
Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Benchamen, eiteru te nkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloontoluo, naa Simion, erubata nabo.
Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Simion, eiteru te nkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloontoluo, naa Isaakar, erubata nabo.
Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Isaakar, eiteru te nkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloo ntoluo naa Sebulon, erubata nabo.
Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Sebulon, eiteru tenkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloo ntoluo naa Gad, erubata nabo.
Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Gad o meshomo kopikop, naa kepuku olpolosie te Tamar o meshomo nkariak e Meribatkadesh, aa keim enkiyopata ina shorro e Misiri o metijing'a enaiposha kitok.
Ore ena naa enkop nidung'oki metaa enjung'o tiatua iloshon le Israel, naa kuna ninche irubat enye ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.
“Keaku keetae ineepukunyeki enkanasa: Ore te nkalo e moikuape ina naaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o ong'uan o iip imiet te ntemet, inchomito uni,
e nkishomi e Ruben, e nkishomi e Yuda, o enkishomi e Lawi, ore nchomito enkanasa naa keipotieki iloshon le Israel.
Ore te nkalo oloosaen, ina naaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni oong'uan o iip imiet, naa inchomito uni, kishomi e Yosef, kishomi e Benchamen, o kishomi e Dan.
Ore te nkalo e kopikop, ina naaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni ong'uan o iip imiet te ntemet, naa inchomito uni, kishomi e Simion, kishomi e Isaakar, o kishomi e Sebulon.
Ore te nkalo oloo ntoluo ina naaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni ong'uan o iip imiet naa nchomito uni, kishomi e Gad, o kishomi e Asheri, o kishomi e Naftali.
Ore emanaroto e nkanasa naa keaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon o isiet. Ore enkarna e nkanasa eiteru teina kata nelo dukuya naa keji, Etii Olaitoriani ine!”
Ele rorei apa eishoo Olaitoriani Hosea, olayioni le Beeri, too nkolong'i e Usia o Yotam o Ahas o Hesekia ilaiguanak le Yuda, o too nkolong'i e Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Israel.

Ore apa pee eng'as Olaitoriani airo eimunye enkiroroto enye Hosea, nejoki Olaitoriani Hosea, “Shomo, iyamaki kewan enkitok naibor onyek, niiu inkera e nkiborra oo nkonyek, amu eiborrie ena kop onyek oleng aing'uaa Olaitoriani.”
Nelo ninye ayam Gomer ina tito e Diblaim, neiroshiu ninye neiki ninye olayioni.
Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Tejo enkarna enye Yesreel; amu enkiti kata ake nang'or pee aitame nanu enkaji e Yehu te nkaraki osarge le Yesreel, naa kaishie nanu enkitoria e nkaji e Israel.
Ore kenya teina olong, nagil nanu enkawuo e Israel to erata le Yesreel.”
Neitoki ina kitok anutayu neiu entito. Nejoki Olaitoriani Hosea, “Tejo enkarna enye Enemeing'urrieki, amu maigil nanu aing'urrie enkaji e Israel, mapalaki ninche katukul.

Kake kaing'urrie nanu enkaji e Yuda naa kakordu ninche to Laitoriani e Nkai enye; makordu nanu ninche te nkawuo aashu to lalem, nemakordu to larrabal, aashu too mbartan aashu too lakedok loo mbartan.”
Ore pee eoru Gomer ilki, “Enemeing'urrieki,” nenutayu neiu olayioni.
Nejo Olaitoriani, “Tejo enkarna enye ‘Mme iltung'ana laainei’, amu mirara intae iltung'ana laainei nemara nanu Enkai inyi.”

Kake ore esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel naa kebayu anaa osinyai le naiposha, lemeidimi aatetem anaa aaikena, naa ore to ine wueji apa netiakinyeki ninche, “Mirara iltung'ana laainei,” keaku keji ninche, “Nkera e Nkai naishu.”
Ore iltung'ana le Yuda o ltung'ana le Israel nepuo aaiturrurr te nebo negelaki ate o lkitok obo; naa keilep ninche aapuo teina kop, amu eikitok kenya ina olong e Yesreel.
Tejo olalashe lino, “Iltung'ana laainei,” nijo enkanashe ino, “Enanoto olng'ur.”
“Tasayia ng'utunyi, tasayia amu mme enkitok ai ninye, nemara nanu olpayian lenye pee etum aiwuang'ie enkiborra oo nkonyek te nkomom enye, neiwuang'ie eloloito enye to lki lenyena;
pee masul ake aoru ilkilani naitotiu ninye anaa ina olong apa naini, naitotiu ninye anaa ong'ata, naitotiu ninye anaa enkop natoyio, naar ninye te nkure.
Ore sii ti alo nkera enyena maing'urrie nanu amu inkera e nkiborra oo nkonyek ninche.

Amu eiborrie ng'otonye onyek; ore ina natunute ninche netaasa embae enkurruna. Amu etejo ninye, ‘Kalo arubare isintan laainei, laa ninche laaisho nanu emukate ai o enkare ai o enkila ai napuyiapui o kitani ai o eilata ai o enaisho oo sabibu.’
“Ore te nkaraki ina kanuk nanu enkoitoi enye too lkiku; nashetaki nanu esuntai, pee metum ninye irrekiei lenyena.
Kemir ninye isintan lenyena, kake meinepu; neing'oru ninche, kake metum ninche. Neitoki ninye ajo, ‘Kalo nanu narrinyokino olapa moruo lai le dukuya, amu keikash apa ina kata te nanu alang taata.’
Neitu eyiolou ninye inchere nanu apa ilo oishoo ninye entapa, o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata, naiputaki ninye enkosholai o saabu naa ninche etaasishore te seramere e nkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Baal.
“Ore te nkaraki ina ekarriny ilpaek laainei te nkata enye, o enaisho ai oo sabibu te rishata enye, narriny nanu ina kila ai napuyiapui o kitani, naa ninche apa naaitemoo emasipaisho enye.
“Ore taata naa kasul nanu ninye aoru nkilani te dukuya lang'at lenyena, nemeetae olokordu ninye aitayu te nkaina ai.
Naa kaishie nanu isiruai lenyena pooki, o mashoi, o lapaitin lenyena ng'ejuk o Sabatoni enyena, o siruai lenyena pooki gelunot.
Nainyal nanu isabibu lenyena o lkeek loo lng'anayio, laa ninche ejo ninye, ‘Elaakinoto ai kulo, laa ninche aaishoo isanchan laainei.’ Kaitaa nanu ninche entim, naa kenya ninche ing'uesi e ntim.

Naa kaitame nanu ninye te nkaraki nena olong'i o sirua le nkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Baal ina kata apa pee epejoki enkorropil ninche, nekuso ninye too lgiso o too masaa, nelo asujaa isintan lenyena, nemaadamu ninye nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.
“Ore enkaraki ina, ng'ura, kalejaa, narik ninye ong'ata, nairorie ninye te mborron.
Ore teine naisho enkurma enye oo sabibu, naitaa ilo erata le Akor elusie o siligi. Ore teine newal ninye anaa apa too nkolong'i e kitisho enye, anaa apa pee eipang'u aing'uaa enkop e Misiri.
“Naa ore kenya teina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, nikimpot iyie nanu ijo, ‘Olpayian lai,’ nimikingil iyie ajo, ‘Baal ai.’
Amu kaiwuang'ie nanu nkarn e nkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Baal te nkutuk enye, nemeigili aekata aaipot ninche katukul.

Naa kaaitobiraki nanu iyie osotua teina olong te nebo ing'uesi e ntim, o ntaritik o loing'ang'e o ng'uesi naaiserpepiari te nkop; naiwuang'ie nanu enkawuo, o lalem, o larrabal tena kop; naaisho nanu iyie irraga te seriani.
Naa kaasiraki nanu iyie kewan ntarasi; kaasiraki nanu iyie kewan ai te supatisho o te sipata, te nyorrata nauno o to lng'ur.
Kaasiraki nanu iyie kewan ai te nkitisipata; naa eyiolou iyie Olaitoriani.
“Naa ore kenya teina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, kawaliki nanu keper newaliki sii ninche enkop;
newaliki sii ninye enkop ilpaek o sabibu o eilata, naa kewaliki sii ninche Yesreel;

naa kaun nanu ninye, aunoki kewan tiatua ena kop. Naa kaing'urrie nanu ina naji ‘Enemeing'urrieki’, naa kajoki nanu lelo leme iltung'ana laainei, ‘Irara intae iltung'ana laainei,’ nejo ninye, ‘Ira iyie Enkai ai.’ ”

Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Nyaaki shomo tonyorra ina kitok nanyor olang'ata lenye, naa enaibor onyek, tonyorra anaa enanyor Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Israel, hoo neibelekenyakino ninche kulie aaitin nenyorru imukateni o sabibu naatoito.”
Neaku ainyang'ua nanu ninye te shekeli tomon o imiet e nkosholai o ntemet nabo e shairi o lpisiai le ntemet e shairi.
Najoki nanu ninye, “Meeta nchere pee mibik ira enaai too nkolong'i kumok; mintoki aiborrie onyek, aashu iaku ene likae lee; neijia sii nanu atiu te iyie.”
Amu kebik inkera oo Siraeli nkolong'i kumok meeta olaiguanani aashu olkitok, meeta olasar aashu eng'ape, meeta enkila o lgoo aashu enkitanyaanyukoto.
Ore te siadi nerrinyunye nkera e Israel neing'oru Olaitoriani Enkai enye, o Daudi olaiguanani lenye; naa kepuonu ninche te nkuretisho enetii Olaitoriani o esupatisho enye too nkolong'i e siadi.
Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani lo tung'ana le Israel; amu keeta Olaitoriani olarrabal too ltung'ana lena kop. Metii esipata aashu esupatisho, nemetii eyiolounoto e Nkai ena kop.
Etii enkinosata o lmumai o elejare o esesekuanare o empurrorre o eloloito; elang'u ninche ilpolosien pooki neitusuj iloikop iloikop.
Ore te nkaraki ina neishir enkop, ore pooki ootii atua neye, o ng'uesi e ong'ata o ntaritik o loing'ang'e, ore sii isinkir le naiposha neiwuang'ieki.
Ore ake eyia mincho hoo ng'ae ekesha, nimincho hoo ng'ae eitang'orisho amu iyie etii enkesha ai, lo apolosak.
Irrorrorro intae dama, nerrorro sii oloiboni te nebo intae kewarie, naa kaar nanu ng'utunyi.

Eidaikieki iltung'ana laainei te nkaraki nemeeta eng'eno te nkaraki nitanyaita intae eng'eno, aatanya nanu iyie pee miaku olapolosani te nanu. Naa ore anaa enikitorikine enkitanapata e Nkai ino madamu sii nanu inkera inono.
Ore anaa enatoponari, neponari aas ing'ok ti alo nanu; kaibelekeny nanu enkisisa enye metaa enkurruna.
Keitoti ninche ate too ng'ok oo ltung'ana laainei; neeta ninche olorok too ntorrok enye.
Naa ketiu ake anaa enatiu too ltung'ana, to lapolosani, kaitame nanu ninche te nkaraki inkoitoi enye, naitalaku te ninche nkiaasin enye.
Kedaa ninche nemeraposho; neiborrie ninche onyek, kake meponari; amu etung'uaitie ninche Olaitoriani ejo pee eitumurru eloloito.
Ore enaisho musana o eng'ejuk, neoru iltung'ana indamunot.
Entoki e nchani eikilikuanishore iltung'ana laainei, neisho eng'udi oo nkitanapat. Amu eitapong'oyie ninche oltau le nkiborra oo nkonyek, neitung'uaitie ninche Enkai enye aapuo aaiborrie onyek.

Keitayu ninche ilassarri too nchumat oo ldoinyo, neitobir nkishoorot too nchumat oo ldoinyo ti abori ilkeek sapuki amu eisidan iloipi lenye. Neaku keibor onyek ntoyie inono, ore siankikin inono naayama neloloito.

Maitame nanu ntoyie inyi te nkiborra enye oo nkonyek, aashu nena siankikin inono naayama te neloloito; amu ore lelo lewa maate nepudariyie nkituaak naaibor onyek neitayu ilasarri te nebo nkituaak naibor onyek naa kepuonu olorere lemeeta eyiolounoto aaidak.
Ore hoo nikimbor onyek, iyie Israel, mincho Yuda etiu neijia. Mijing atua Gilgal, nimilep alo Bet-afen, niminya olmumai ajo, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani.”
Ore anaa enkashe nape, kepe Siraeli; keidim sa Olaitoriani aitotio ninche anaa olkuoo le ker to lokeri olala?
Eibung'are Isiraeli inkitanyaanyukot, talama ninche.
Olturur loo lamerak, eishooitie ate te nkiborra oo nkonyek; kenyor ninche enkurruna alang enanyor enkitoo enye.
Etununukoyie ninye osiwuo too naipuko enyena, naa kekurru ninche te nkaraki ilpereren lenye loo lasarri.
Entoning ena, intae ilapolosak! Enchoru enkiok, na aji e Israel! Toning'o na aji o laiguanani! Amu intae eipirta ena kiguana; amu itaa intae orreshet te Mispa o orreshet ooisalaashakaki Tabor.
Neituguto ninche engumoto e Shitim, kake kaitame nanu ninche pooki.
Kayiolo nanu enetiu Israel, meisudori ninye te nanu, amu Eiborrie ninye onyek, neidurukie Israel.
Meisho ninche nkiasin enye errinyokino Enkai enye. Amu etii oltau le nkiborra oo nkonyek atua ninche, nemeyiolo ninche Olaitoriani.
Ore olwuasa le Israel neishakenu enkomom enye; kelo Efraim arrorro te ntorroni enye; kerrorro sii Yuda te nebo ninche.
Kepuo ninche te nebo iluaat enye oo nchoo o noo nkerrai, aaing'oru Olaitoriani, kake metum ninye, etung'uayie ninye ninche.
Eitaasa ninche Olaitoriani inemeishiaa; amu etoiutuo ninche nkera oo naataluno. Ore taata ele apa ng'ejuk kemut ninche te nebo o nkurman enye.
Toosho emowuo tiatua Gibea, toosho esekekua tiatua Rama, te Bet-afen; nkirikirayu iyie Benchamen!
Keaku Efraim olmuaate teina olong e nkitamioto; tiatua lelo oshon le Israel aibalunye nanu ina nasipa.
Etotiutuo ilkituaak le Yuda anaa iltung'ana ooiwuang'ie ilpolosien; ore shumata ninche, kabukoki nanu ninche engoro ai anaa enkare.
Eibookoki Efraim enkop, neidimuaki te nkiguana, te nkaraki nateenikine ninye asujaa entoki nemeetae, olng'am.
Ore te nkaraki ina, atotiwuo nanu anaa olasai te Efraim natiu anaa oltiapurusi te nkaji e Yuda.
Ore pee edol Efraim emuoyian enye nedol Yuda olbae lenye, neitoki Efraim alo Asiria, neirriwaki olkilikuai ilo aiguanani kitok; kake mikindim ninye atabaa iyie aashu aishiunye olbae lino.
Amu katiu nanu anaa olng'atuny te Efraim, natiu anaa olng'atuny oti te nkaji e Yuda. Amu nanu, ee nanu, opolos nalo aing'uaa nanu aya, nemeetae olokordu.
Naa kaitoki nanu arrinyokino ewueji ai, o metaba anaa neirridu entorroni enye neing'oru enkomom ai, naa ore tiatua osina lenye naaing'oru ninche nanu, ejo.
“Wootu, matorrinyokinoto Olaitoriani; amu etopolosa ninye iyiook pee etum aishiunye iyiook; etoosho ninye iyiook naa kelo aen iyiook.
Ore te siadi nkolong'i are neitopiu ninye iyiook; ore te nkolong e uni nedumu ninye iyiook maitasheito, pee kitum aataa aikinchu te dukuya ninye.
Matayiolo iyiook, matonyok aapuo dukuya, aayiolou Olaitoriani; Ore elotunoto enye, esipa kelotu ninye anaa enkakenya anaa enchan o loirujuruj naitashal enkop.”
Kaa nanu aaitaas iyie Efraim? Kaa nanu aaitaas iyie Yuda? Etiu enyorrata ino anaa enkatampoi o sina, anaa enkoileelio nasiooyo aishunye.
Ore te nkaraki ina atudung'udung'o nanu ninche too loibonok laainei, atara nanu ninche metuata too rorei le nkutuk ai, naa keipang'aki ninche enkiguana ai anaa ewang'an.
Amu enyorrata nauno nanu ayieu, mme olasar, eyiolounoto e Nkai alang nkishorunot.
Kake ore ana enatigila Adam olning'o netigila sii ninche olning'o; ore teine naaitaasa nanu ninche ine nkeleekisho.
Ore Gilead naa enkanasa oo larruok, naitunyokino osarge.
Ore anaa enairrag ilapurrok aanyu oltung'ani, neijia eikununo ilapolosak eibung'ate te nebo; neitayu iloikop te nkoitoi e Shekem, ee, neas mbaa torrok oleng.
Ore tiatua enkaji e Israel atoduaa nanu embae busus oleng; ine etii eloloito e Efraim, neidurukie Isiraeli.
Ore sii ti alo iyie Yuda, kitegelakaki enkikesare Ina kata te narrinyu nanu lelo tung'ana laainei te sinkaisho.
Te najo nanu aishiunye Israel, neibalunyeki entorroni enye o nkiasin torrok e Samaria; amu te ntorroni easisho ninche, egil olapurroni inkajijik, ore ilaisimak neisimisho ti ong'ata.
Kake mejo ninche nchere kadamu nanu esiaai enye pooki torrono. Etang'adutua inkiasin enye ninche, etii dukuya enkomom ai.
Ore te ntorroni enye neitiship olaiguanani o lkitok le lejare enye.
Keibor onyek ninche pooki; eikununo ninche anaa ewueji nepejieki imukateni nainuaaki, ore ilo oasishore nepal eitu ekut ebaiki ina kata naipurji o metabaiki ina kata naisuishieki.
Ore teina olong o laiguanani lang etamuoyia lelo kituaak te mpijan e naisho; neitorioo ninye enkaina enye te nebo lelo torrok.

Amu ore anaa enatiu ewueji nepejieki imukateni, neijia eikununo iltauja lenye eyupuyup erreshisho; ore enkewarie pooki etiu engoro enye anaa olang'at le nkima ore tadekenya neyupuyup anaa ilng'ejepa le nkima.
Ore ninche pooki naa keirowua anaa olkokuet, nemut ninche ilaitoriak lenye. Ore ilaiguanak lenye pooki netabatatate nemeetae hoo obo lenye laaipot nanu.
Eitushulaka Israel kewan iloreren; ore ninye naa emukate neitu eibelekenyi.
Einosa iltung'ana loo loreren eng'olon enye, nemeyiolo ninye; eisuaaki ilpapit ooibor shumata ninye, nemeyiolo ninye.
Ore olwuasa le Israel neishakenoki te dukuya ninye; ore eyia merrinyokino ninche Olaitoriani Enkai enye, nemeing'oru ninye te kuna pooki.
Eikununo Israel anaa enturkuluo namoda nemeeta endamunoto naipotu Misiri, neloito Asiria.
Ore epuo naitaman ninche to rreshet lai, naitadou ninche anaa ntaritik o loing'ang'e naitame ninche too nkiasin enye torrok.
Woi ninche, amu aashomo aaing'uaa nanu! Enkidaata te ninche, amu aatogolong'akita ninche! Anaata naaji akordu ninche, kake kelejisho ninche tialo nanu.
Maaishiraki nanu ninche too ltauja, kake keyietu ninche aaishir too ndapashi enye; ore te nkaraki enkurma o enaisho nedung ate, naagolong'aki ninche aapaashare nanu.
Ore hoo naitaarriyiana naitagol nanu inkaik enye, entorroni aaipiraki ninche nanu.

Eibelekenyakinote ninche enkai naguetuno naji Baal; etotiutuo ninche anaa enkawuo nemeisiligayu, ore lelo kituaak lenye, naa kepuo aabatata to lalem te nkaraki ina keilasilas ilng'ejepa lenye. Keaku te ninche ena embae e nakueniyieki te nkop e Misiri.
Toosho esekekua ino, amu eewuo olkurragos shumata enkaji o Laitoriani, te nkaraki natigila ninche olmumai lai, negil inkitanapat aainei.
Nanu eishiraki ninche aajo, Enkai ai, kiyiolo iyiook Israel iyie.
Etanya Israel ina sidai; kelo olmang'atinta asujaa ninche.
Kegelu ninche ilaiguanak, kake mme nanu eikilikuan. Negelu iltung'ana kituaak, kake metii eyiolounoto ai. Ore te nkosholai enye o saabu neitobir ninche nkitanyaanyukot naaidakie ate.
Atanya nanu ilo ashe lino oserem iltung'ana le Samaria. Keyupuyup engoro ai tialo ninche. Ketoni kenya o anu, pee esinyayu ninche ti alo Israel?
Olaitobirani oitayio, mme Enkai. Ore ilo ashe oseremi le Samaria, kepuoi aabel metaa imbelibelat.
Amu etuuno ninche enkijape, naa kepuo ninche aaikesu olkutati.
Etoijoyioki Israel, eidipa aatotiu tiatua iloreren anaa emasaai nemeeta tipat.
Amu eilepa ninche aapuo Asiria eikununo anaa osikiria li ong'ata olimana openy; einyang'ua Israel isintan.
Ore hoo neinyang'ua ninche iltung'ana leeiking'a tiatua iloreren, kaiturrur nanu ninche asioki. Naa keitirring'a ninche te nkiti kata eitu eitoki aaput olaiguanani o ilkituaak.
Te nkaraki natoponayie Efraim ilpereren lo lasarri le yasata oo ng'ok, etaa lelo asarri ing'ok te ninye.
Tenaa naaji ninye kaigeroki nanu ninye nkitanapat aainei naa nkalifuni tomon, keitaae ake entoki ng'ejuk nemeyioloi.
Kenyor ninche olasar; neitayu ninche olasar loo nkiri nenya; kake meshipakino Olaitoriani ninche. Ore taata kedamu ninye entorroni enye neitame ing'ok enye; kerrinyo ninche aapuo Misiri.
Amu etorikine Israel ilo oitobira ninye neshet inkajijik e nkitoo; netoponayie Yuda inkang'itie naagol; kake kairriwaa nanu enkima shumata nena anas enyena. Nemut isempewueti lenyena pooki.
Ming'ida iyie Israel! Nimishipa te ng'ida anaa loreren; amu imborrie iyie onyek, ning'uaa Enkai ino. Itonyorra iyie olekoisiaayio le nkiborra oo nkonyek too wuejitin pooki neeiutuutishoreki.
Ore eneituutishoreki o eneironyieki ilng'anayio meitoti ninche.
Nemetum ninche enaisho ng'ejuk. Nebik ninche tiaatua ina kop o Laitoriani; kake kerrinyo Efraim alo Misiri, nepuo ninche aanya endaa nemesinya te Asiria.

Meigil ninche aabukoki Olaitoriani ilasarri ooki le naisho oo sabibu; nemeitiship ninye too lasarri lenye. Ore imukateni enye naa ketiu anaa imukateni o lkiyioi; ore naa pooki onya ninche neisarkioneki amu ore imukateni enye naa keaku inesumash enye ake; meyauni atua enkaji o Laitoriani.
Kaa kenya iasiasa teina olong o sirua o teina olong o sirua lo Laitoriani?
Amu ng'ura kepuo Asiria; keiturrur Misiri ninche; nenukaa Memfis ninche. Nebulaki endiati nena masaa enye sidain e nkosholai; nejing ilkiku atua ilng'oborri lenye.

Eetuo inkolong'i e nkitamioto, eetuo inkolong'i e nkitalaata; naa keyiolou Israel ina. Kemoda ilo oiboni, ore ilo tung'ani le nkiyang'et neeta oloirirua, te nkaraki ina arruoisho ino kitok o enkiba kitok.
Ore ilo oiboni, naa olarriponi le Efraim, lelo tung'ana le Nkai ai, ore eyia netii orreshet laaijo olo larreshoni loo motonyi inkoitoi enyena pooki, netii enkiba atua enkaji e Nkai enye.
Neisarkionie ninche ate oleng anaa too nkolong'i e Gibea: keyooki ninye adamu entorroni enye nelo aitame ing'ok enye.

Anoto apa Israel eikununo anaa isabibu ti ong'ata. Nadol iloo papaai linyi eikununo anaa ilng'anayio lo lng'aboli le nkiterata. Kake eetuo apa ninche enetii Baal-peor, neitisinyaki ate enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Baal, neaku ninche enkitagoroto anaa nena tokitin naatonyorra ninche.
Ore ina kitoo e Efraim naa kelo aaing'uaa ninye anaa emotonyi meitoki atii eishoi, nemetii enutai, nemetii enkibung'aroto.
Ore ninye te neitubulu ninche nkera, naoru nanu ninche o metaba anaa metii enaleku. Woi ninche te nalo nanu aing'uaa ninche!
Ore ilayiok le Efraim anaa enatoduaa nanu, nepuoito enkidaata; meeta nchere merik Efraim ilayiok lenyena enepuoi aar metuata.
