Nchoo ninche iyie Olaitoriani, kainyoo incho iyie? Nchoo ninche olkibiroto le nguset o lki oo toito.

Ore pooki arruoisho enye netii Gilgal; teine apa nanu atang'asa aibayu ninche. Ore te nkaraki entorroni oo nkiasin enye kaaraa ninche aaitung'uaa enkaji ai. Maigil nanu anyorru ninche; ore lelo kituaak lenye pooki naa ilarruok.
Etooshoki Efraim, etoito ntona enye, meitoki aaiu ilng'anayio. Ore hoo duoo ninye neisho ninche, kaar nanu metuata nena kera enye kiroteti.
Keiturraa Enkai ai ninche, ore te nkaraki neitu ening ninche ninye; keaku ninche ilapuayak tiatua iloreren.
Olchani loo sabibu Israel oiu ilng'anayio lenyena. Ore anaa enaponari ilng'anayio lenyena neponaa ashet ilpereren loo lasarri kumok; ore anaa enaponari enkop enye asidanu, neponaa ing'apeta enyena.
Etelejishote iltauja lenye; meeta taata nchere meitalaki entorroni enye. Kegil Olaitoriani lelo pereren lenye loo lasarri, neparripar nena ng'apeta enye.
Amu kepuo taata ninche aajo: “Mikiaata iyiook olaiguanani, amu mikiure iyiook Olaitoriani, amaa olaiguanani, kaa eidim ninye aitaasa iyiook?”
Eiro ninche irorei le pesho; ore too lmuma le lejare keitayu osotua; nebulu nkiguanat enye anaa sayieti naabulu too nkong'at e nkurma.

Keikirikira lelo oomanya Samaria te nkuretisho, te nkaraki ilo ashe oitanyaanyukieki nkaitin e Babel. Keishiraki iltung'ana lenyena ninye, ore lelo apolosak lenyena ooserem inkitanyaanyukot neyietu aaishiraki ninye, teina kitoo enye nashomo aing'uaa ninye.
Ee kenapi ina toki aaya Asiria, pee eaku enkishooroto te ilo aiguanani kitok. Keitukurruni Efraim, nekurru sii Israel te nkaraki enkitanyaanyukoto enye.
Ore ilo aiguanani le Samaria naa kelo aidaaya, anaa olaburra ti oriong enkare.

Ore nene wuejitin e shumata e Afen, ina ng'oki e Israel, naa keidaikieki. Kebulu ilkiku o laimerrerruani te nchumata lelo pereren lenye loo lasarri; naa kepuo ninche aajoki ildoinyo, Entemoi iyiook, nejoki indoinyo, enturokinoto iyiook.
Ore apa ebaiki nkolong'i e Gibea itaasa eng'oki, iyie Israel; ore teine neshomo ninche aas ing'ok. Ae meinepu ninche olarrabal te Gibea?
Kalotu nanu aarare kulo tung'ana aing'okok pee aitame ninche, naa keiturrurro iloshon aarare ninche, neitame ninche te nkaraki ina ng'oki enye natatashe.

Ore Israel netiu anaa enkashe apa naitamooki meidong'o entapa. Naitajewuo apa nanu ina murt enye sidai, kake kalo nanu apik Efraim enchata e murt. Meeta nchere pee meturisho Yuda, Meeta nchere meitupuyiapui Yakobo enkulupuoni makewan.

Entuunoki ate esupatisho, ninkesusu ilng'anayio le nyorrata nauno; entutur ina kulukuoni inyi nayeng'iyeng'ieki amu etabawua enkata naing'orunyeki Olaitoriani, pee etum ninye aeu aitashaiki enjeunoto shumata intae.
Ituuno apa intae entorroni, ninkesusu enkarruoisho, inosa intae ilng'anayio le lejare. Amu isiliga apa intae ngarrin inyi o larrabal o ina siamo oo lmurran linyi.

Ore te nkaraki ina, kejing olarrabal atua iltung'ana linono, ore lelo sempewueti linono neidaikieki, anaa apa enaidaikie olaiguanani Shalaman enkanasa e Bet-arbelon teina olong o larrabal; nedung'udung'i nkera o noo ng'otonye.
Ena ninye eyookini aaitaas intae, iyie na aji e Israel, te nkaraki ina torroni ino kitok. Ore enasirie neishieki ilo aiguanani le Israel katukul.
Ore apa aa enkerai Israel atonyorra nanu ninye, ore te Misiri naipotuo nanu enkerai ai.
Ore anaa enaipotu nanu ninche, naapuo ninche aaing'uaa nanu; netotoni ninche epolosaki enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Baal nepejoki nkitanyaanyukot enkorropil.
Ore eyia nanu apa oitamoo Israel meshomo, atudumua nanu ninche too nkaik aainei; Kake eitu ninche eyiolou nchere aishiunye nanu ninche.
Atorikoyie nanu ninche too nkeenta o lng'ur, too enat e nyorrata, natiu nanu te ninche anaa ilo oitololong enchata too iltagiligil lenye too murto enye, nairrugokino nanu ninche naitoti ninche.
Kerrinyo ninche aapuo enkop e Misiri, naa kelo Asiria aaku olaiguanani lenye, te nkaraki natanyaita ninche aarrinyokino nanu.
Olalem olo ashurt nena anas enye, neidaikie ninche tiatua nena wuejitin enye neegol.
Eteenikinote iltung'ana laainei enkibelekenyakinoto pee aapuo aaing'uaa nanu; neaku etegelakaki ninche enchata e murt nemeetae ololaku.

Kaji nanu aiko tenapalaa intae; iyie Israel? Kaji nanu aiko tenaaing'uaa intae; iyie Israel! Kaji nanu aiko te naitanyaanyukie intae o Adama! Kaji nanu aiko te naitaas intae anaa Seboim! Eibelekenye oltau lai tiatua nanu, eirowuaja olng'ur lai neborru.
Maasishore nanu engoro ai napi, maigil nanu aidaikie Efraim amu Kara nanu Enkai mara oltung'ani Ilo Sinyati otii atua intae, nemalotu nanu aidakie.
Kepuo ninche aasujaa Olaitoriani, naa keikurrukur ninye anaa olng'atuny, ee keikurrukur, ore layiok lenyena nepuonu eikirikira eing'uaa enkalo o loo ntoluo.
Nepuonu ninche eikirikira anaa ntaritik naaing'uaa Misiri, o anaa nturkuluoni eing'uaa enkop e Asiria; naa karriny nanu ninche meshomo inkang'itie enye, Olaitoriani ojo.
Aatang'adutua nanu iltung'ana le Israel te lejare, naang'adu enkaji e Israel too monko; kake eton eyioloi iltung'ana le Yuda te Nkai, naa keisiligayu ninye te ilo Osinya.
Osiwuo eirrita Efraim, nemirare ninye olkutati lo loosaen endama pooki; neponaa ninche elejare o larrabal; nening'ore ninche te nkinyang'a enkop e Asiria, nenapi eilata aaya Misiri.
Eeta Olaitoriani enaikilikuanu tialo Yuda, naa kelo aitame Yakobo te risioroto oo iasat enyena, neitalak ninye te risioroto oo nkiaasin enyena.
Ore tiatua enkoshoke e ng'otonye neibung Yakobo olalashe lenye entutunyo, ore etaa oltung'ani kitok nekeshare Enkai.
Etekeshare ninye olmalaika neisulu, eishira ninye neing'oru omom enye. Enotore ninye Enkai te Betel, neirorie ninye Enkai teine.
Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, Olaitoriani ninye enkarna enye:
“Neaku ore iyie te retoto e Nkai ino, tushukunye, mbung'a enyorrata o esipata tukurraki nibik aanyu Enkai ino.”
Olbiasharai oata entemet e lejare te nkaina enye.
Eji etejo Efraim, “Ee kara nanu karsis, anotoko kewan imasaa.” Kake ore ina arsisisho enye, nemeiwuang'ie enkarruoisho oo ng'ok enyena.
Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, aitupukuo apa intae te nkop e Misiri; naa kaigil areu intae entobik too lng'oborri; anaa apa too nkolong'i o sirua otegeluaki.
Airorie apa nanu iloibonok; nanu apa ilo otoponayie induaat, ore too loibonok naishoru nkitanyaanyukot.
Tenaa ketii entorroni Gilead meeta nchere pee mepuonu ninche aaku pesho; Tenaa kepolosi iloing'ok te Gilead, ore lelo pereren lenye naa kepuo aatiu anaa sotot loo soito too nong'ot e nkurma.
(Eisikaka apa Yakobo enkop e Aram, ore teine neisiaisho Israel te nkaraki enkitok, naa ore te nkaraki enkitok neirrita nkerra.)
Oloiboni le Nkai etaasishore Olaitoriani ailepunye Israel aitung'uaa Misiri; naa to loiboni le Nkai eitagolieki ninye.
Eyaua Efraim embae naitagorisho oleng; neaku ore Olaitoriani lenye, keing'uaa ina kitarrurroto o sarge te shumata ninye, nerrinyoki ninye ina kurruna enye.
Teneiro apa olosho le Efraim, neikirikira iltung'ana; eilepieki apa ninye tiatua kulikai oshon le Israel; kake etaasa ninye entorroni aserem enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Baal, neye.

Ore taata neponaa ninche aas ing'ok, neitobiraki ate nkitanyaanyukot naasholuni, o nkitanyaanyukot naaitayuni te nkarriyiano te nkosholai enye, ore ninche pooki naa esiaai oo ltung'ana arriyiak. Nejo, “Entopolosaki kuna. Neng'utut iltung'ana inkaitin oo lasho.”
Ore te nkaraki ina ketiu ninche anaa enkinuku e nkakenya, aashu anaa enkoileelio nayooki aishunye, anaa suut naakutaa osiwuo te wueji neidong'ishoreki aashu anaa empuruo naipang'u te lusie.
Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino ore apa te nkop e Misiri; miyiolo ae Ai neme nanu, nemetii likae aitajeunoni leme nanu.
Nanu apa ilo laatayiolo ti ong'ata, tiatua ina kop o lpurkel;
kake ore apa pee edaa ninche aaraposho, neiputakino ninche, ore iltauja lenye nedumunye; neaku aatorikinote ninche nanu.
Ore enkaraki ina katiu nanu te ninche anaa olng'atuny, karresh ninche te mbata e nkoitoi anaa olowuaru keri.
Kadoiki nanu ninche anaa olng'arurumi otooruoki nkera enyena, kapolos nanu olgoo lenye, ore teine naidaikie nanu ninche anaa olng'atuny, anaa enaiko enkukuu.
Kaidakie nanu intae, Israel; kaing'ae oidim atareto intae?
Koree taata olaiguanani lino pee kintajeu; koree lelo kituaak linono pooki pee kimitu lelo apa litejo iyie, “Inchooki nanu olaiguanani o ilkituaak?”
Aaishoo nanu iyie olaiguanani te ngoro, naiwuang'ie ninche te ngoro ai.
Ore enkarruoisho e Efraim netirridaki, ore eng'oki enye netushumaki te mpere.
Etabawua emion esaisai te nkaraki ninye, kake olayioni omoda ninye, amu ore o taata melotu ninye aimu enguset e ishoi.
Kakordu nanu ninche te ng'olon e nemeneng'a? Kainyang'u nanu ninche aitung'uaa keeya? Nakeeya, koree ilmeita linono? Nemeneng'a koree enkidaata ino? Eiwuang'ieki olng'ur too nkonyek aainei.

Ore hoo duoo ninye tenaa kebul ninye anaa oseyiai kelotu olkutati oing'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong, kelotu olkutati lo Laitoriani, ailepu eing'uaa olpurkel; ore inkonyek enyena oo nkariak netoyu, ore nchorroi enyena neishieki; neishie ilo kutati olchumati lenye te pooki toki e tipat.
Kelo Samaria anap enkitarruoroto enye, te nkaraki natogolong'aka ninye Enkai enye; kepuo ninche aabatata to lalem, ore nkera enye kutiti neitaa ndung'udung'ot, ore nkituaak naanuta, nebuli nkoishuaa.
Tushukunye iyie Israel, torrinyokinoyu Olaitoriani Enkai ino amu itarrorre iyie te nkaraki enkarruoisho ino.
Shomo iata rorei nirrinyokino Olaitoriani; tiaaki ninye, “Iwuang'ie enkarruoisho pooki; tang'amai ina sidai naa ekinchoru iyiook ilng'anayio loo nkutukie ang.
Meitajeu iyiook Asiria, mikipuo iyiook aaked mbartan; nimikingil aekata aajo, ‘Enkai ang, too siaaitin oo nkaik ang. Tiatua iyie etum enkerai okishi olng'ur.’ ”
Kaishiunye nanu ina golong'akinoto enye; kanyorru nanu ninche to ltau lai, amu eibelekenye engoro ai aing'uaa ninche.
Katiu nanu anaa enkoileelio te Israel; naitupuku ninye anaa entapukai, naa keibung ntona anaa olchani onyaanyukie olchartuyian,
neisuaa ilng'osil lenyena; netiu esidano enye anaa oloirien, ore erropili enye netiu anaa iltarakua ootii Lebanon.
Kerrinyunye ninche nepuonu matorripo nanu ninche, naa kebul ninche anaa enkurma nebul anaa osabibu, nepuo ninche aaning'oyu anaa enaisho e Lebanon.
Kejo Israel, kaa nanu aporokinore nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin? Nanu doi ilo likiwaliki nikigolie iyie. Atiu nanu anaa olchani onyori, onyaanyukie oltarakuai, nanu eing'uaa ilng'anayio linono.
Ore ilo ora ng'en, nchoo eyiolou kuna baa; ore ilo ojurrisho, nchoo eyiolou ninche; amu keitoriori nkoitoi o Laitoriani, ore ilasipak neim ninche, kake kerrorro ilaitarruorok te ninche.
Ororei lo Laitoriani ele oirriwaka Enkai Yoel olayioni le Petuel.
Entoning ena intae iltung'ana moruak, nining'ining'i intae iloomanya ena kop! Ketaase aekata embae naikununo nji too nkolong'i inyi, anaa too nkolong'i oo loo papaai linyi?
Entoliki nkera inyi, naa nchoo nkera inyi metoliki nkera enye, neliki nkera enye eishoi enye.

Ore entoki naleku ilo maati odung'isho, nenya ina mus oo lmaat. Ore entoki naleku ina mus oo lmaat, nenya olmaati le mpukunoto oo ntargeet ore entoki naleku ilo maati le mpukunoto oo ntargeet nenya ilo maati le nkidaata.
Enyoito intae ilamerak; enchira intae ilaokok le naisho, ook ina aisho namelok, amu eiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa nkutukie inyi.
Amu eewuo emus oo lmaat agilunore enkop ai, negol nemeikenayu te nkumoi; netiu ilala lenyena anaa ilala lo lng'atuny, neeta iltagiligil le lipong o lng'atuny.
Eitomijoono ninche ilkeek laainei loo sabibu, neidaikie ninche ilng'abolo laainei, etikinyutua ninche nkabobok enye nenang'aki enkop; eiborrieki ilng'osil lenye.
Nchira anaa esila naishopokoki ilkuniyiani, eishiraki keeya eilo ojo pee eyam ninye.
Ore olasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki neiwuang'ieki, te nkaji o Laitoriani. Eishira ilapolosak, lelo aisiaayiak lo Laitoriani.
Eitomijoonoki nkong'at, neishir enkop; te nkaraki naidaikieki entapa, etoito isabibu neishunye eilata.
Esinanuoto intae ilaturok le nkop, enchira intae ilooata nkurman oo sabibu, enchiraki enkano o shairi amu eidaayie enkikesare e nkurma.
Etoyio olchani loo sabibu, netoyio olng'aboli, ore kukumanka o ltukai, o lchani loo lng'anayio, netoito pooki. Neiting'o enchipai too nkera e tung'ana.

Enchopo ilkuniyiani, niyietutu aaishir intae ilapolosak. Enteyietu enchira intae ilaisiaayiak lo lperere lo lasar. Entijing'u intae, entotoni enkewarie, pooki nchopitoto ilkuniyiani, intae ilaisiaayiak le Nkai ai! Amu ore olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki, neiwuang'ieki te nkaji e Nkai inyi.
Entisinya eenata inyi e mpukoroto, empotu eumata nasinya enturrurro ilpayiani, o lelo pooki oomanya ina kop meetu enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai inyi; nipuonunu aaishiraki Olaitoriani.
Oi ina olong! Amu etataana ina olong o Laitoriani, nalotu anaa enkidaaroto naing'uaa ilo magilani.
Keitu eiwuang'ieki endaa aaitung'uaa dukuya nkonyek ang, neiwuang'ieki eng'ida o enchipai te nkaji e Nkai ang?
Etumutate ilanterera te nkop natoyio, netomijoonito nkajijik naashumishoreki neinyalate ilkompen te nkaraki nemeetae entapa.
Eng'ura eneba olkiyioi loo ng'uesi! Ore iluaat oo nchoo neidang'a te nkaraki nemeetae ndaat. Ore sii iluaat oo nkerrai netanyamala.
Aaishiraka nanu iyie Olaitoriani. Amu etumuta enkima ndaat e ong'ata, nenya olng'ejep le nkima ilkeek pooki liong'ata.
Eikinchiraki sii ninche ing'uesi e ntim, amu etoito nchorroi oo nkariak, netumuta enkima ndaat e ong'ata.
Entoosh esekekua te Sion; entoosh entadara teilo doinyo lai sinyati! Nchoo eikirikira lelo pooki oomanya ena kop, amu kelotu enkolong o Laitoriani, netataana.

Enkolong e naimin o sina, enkolong oo nkatampo o enaimin nagut! Ketiu anaa erokan eisalaashakino ildoinyo, olmaati kitok ogol, eitu aekata etumi enanyaanyukie ninche ebaiki apa moitie, nemetumi aekata enanyaanyukie ena too larin loo ishoritin pooki naapuonu.

Kemutisho enkima te dukuya ninche. Ore te siadi ninche neinosisho olang'at le nkima. Keikununo ina kop anaa enkurma e Eden te dukuya ninche, kake ore te siadi ninche naa ong'ata nememanya, nemeetae entoki naidim ailanya ninche.
Ore empukunoto enye neikununo anaa mbartan, nekuet ninche anaa mbartan o larrabal.
Ore oltoilo netiu ana ngarrin oo mbartan, neipid ninche too nchumat oo ldoinyo, anaa endarata enkima nanya isuut, anaa enjore nagol, natoluaakine olarrabal.
Ore te dukuya ninche neirut olorere, neipusu inkomomi enye.
Nerasaa ninche anaa ilmurran, neked isunta anaa sikarini, nepuo ninche dukuya oltung'ani ake te nkoitoi enye, meibelekenya ninche aapaash nkoitoi enye.
Meetae olorruesh olikae, enkoitoi enye ake eibung pooki ng'ae, neim erishata o masaa o larrabal, nemeibooroyu.
Neipid ninche te nchumata eina anasa, nekuet too nchumat oo sunta; neked nkajijik, neim ilusien anaa ilapurrok.
Neikirikira enkop te dukuya ninche, neikirikira shumata. Neitomisimisi enkolong o lapa, nemeitokini aata ewang'an oo lakir.

Neitayu Olaitoriani oltoilo lenye, te dukuya enjore enye, amu aikitok oleng olorora lenye ore ilo olimu ororei lenye neeta engolon. Amu ore ina olong o Laitoriani naa kitok neitureisho oleng, aing'ae oidim ating'iriakinoyu?
“Ore ake sii o taata,” Olaitoriani ojo, “Torrinyunye wou enatii to ltau lino pooki, te enata e mpukoroto o te nkishirata o to sina.
Nipolososo iltauja linyi, mme ilkilani linyi.” Torrinyokinoyu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, amu aisupat ninye neeta olng'ur, mesioki agoro, neeta enyorrata nauno, neirridu entorroni.
Kalo oyiolo tenaa keibelekenya ninye neirridu, neing'uaa emayianata etulusoyie ninye, olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki, te nkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai ino?
Entoosh esekekua te Sion. Entisinya eenata e mpukoroto; empotu eumata nasinya;
enturrurro iltung'ana. Entisinya eumata; enturrurro ilpayiani; enturrurro nkera ometabaiki nkutiti naanakita. Nchoo oloyamisho eing'uaa olgilata lenye neing'uaa ina nayami olgilata lenye.

Ore te rishata e kutukaji o lperere lo lasar, nchoo ilapolosak lelo aisiaayiak lo Laitoriani eishir, nejo, “Teleku iltung'ana linono, Olaitoriani, nimintaa enjung'ore ino enkurruna, entoki naimakini tiatua iloreren. Kainyoo pee ejo ninche tiatua iloreren, ‘Koree Enkai enye?’ ”
Neitoki Olaitoriani atum olom te nkaraki enkop enye, neing'urrie iltung'ana lenyena.
Newal Olaitoriani nejoki iltung'ana lenyena, “Kairriwaki nanu intae entapa o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata. Naa ipuopuo intae aaraposho; nemaigil aekata nanu aitaa intae enkurruna too loreren.

“Kaiwuang'ie nanu ilo maati le moikuape aitung'uaa intae, nareu nanu ninye empusel mitil. Ore lelo lenye le lukunya nepuo enaiposha o loosaen, ore lelo le siadi nepuo atua enaiposha o loo ntoluo; ore olng'usil o eng'uan enye nedumunye, amu etaasa ninye mbaa sapuki.
“Miureishoyu iyie na kop tishipayu iyie ning'ida, amu etaasa Olaitoriani mbaa sapuki.
Emiureishoyu intae ing'uesi e ong'ata, amu kenyori ndaat e ong'ata; eiu olchani ilng'anayio lenyena, neiu olng'aboli o sabibu ilng'anayio lenye te nkumoi.

“Entishipata intae ilayiok le Sion, ning'idakinono Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; amu eitasiekuo ninye enchan te nkaraki intae. Eitashaikia ninye intae olari seur; eirriwua enchan naituruku o ene siadi anaa apake.
“Keiput entapa ilkurrot ooidong'ishoreki, nedooyo enaisho oo sabibu o eilata too lbenia.
Kaarrinyoki nanu iyie, ilarin apa ooinosie emus olmaati enkop, o ntargeet, o enamutisho, o enadung'isho ina jore ai kitok o lmaat nairriwua nanu atua intae.
“Inya iyie endaa, sapuk nikiraposh, nilo aisis Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo laa ninye otaasa inenking'asia te nkaraki iyie. Maigil aekata aaitukurru iltung'ana laainei.
Iyiolouu intae nchere atii nanu atua Israel, naa nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi nemetii likae. Nemeigili aekata aaitukurru iltung'ana laainei.
“Naa kepuonu inkolong'i te siadi ena, naa kabukoki nanu enkiyang'et ai pooki tung'ani; ore ilayiok linyi o ntoyie inyi neibonisho, ore ilpayiani linyi neidetidet ore ilbarnot linyi nedol induaat.
Ore isinkan linyi lewa o sinkan inyi ng'oruou, kenya te nena olong'i, naa kabukoki nanu enkiyang'et ai.
“Naa kaishoru nanu nkikoot te keper o te nkop, osarge o enkima, o empuruo nairrusha.
Keitomisimisi enkolong, nedoru olapa anaa osarge, eng'or ina olong kitok o Laitoriani naitureisho.

Naa keaku ore pooki ng'ae oipot enkarna o Laitoriani, nekorduni. Amu ore to ldoinyo le Sion o te Yerusalem netii lelo oopuo aaimisho, anaa enatejo Olaitoriani; ore te lelo ooleku, ninche netii lelo ooipot Olaitoriani.
“Ore kenya te nena olong'i, o teina kata, tenarrinyu nanu lelo ootarayioki le Yuda o le Yerusalem,

naa kaiturrur nanu iloreren pooki, nayau ninche aitadou oerata le Yehoshafat, naiguanare nanu ninche te nkaraki iltung'ana laainei o enjung'ore e Israel amu eidapashakaki apa ninche atua iloreren, netooro ninche enkop ai.
Netooshokito ninche iltung'ana laainei enkukuo, neishooyo ninche enkayioni aainosie emulayoi, nemir entito aainosie enaisho oo sabibu, netooko ninche ina aisho.

“Ira iyie nyoo te nanu iyie Tiro o Sidon, o kulo kirinen le Filistia? Kaa toki kirrinyoki nanu alaaki? Tenaa eikilaaki iyie nanu, naitalaku nanu enkias ino te nchumata endukuya ino makewan, te wuapunoto o te nkisarrisar.
Amu iwa iyie enkosholai ai o saabu ai, nitanapa iyie ilchumat laainei le karsisisho atua nkajijik oo nkaitin inyi.
Itimiraka iyie iltung'ana le Yuda o le Yerusalem Ilgiriki, niya ninche aitalamaa oleng to lpolosie lenye.
Kake ore taata kaputu nanu ninche teine wueji nitimiraka ninche, naitalaku nanu enkias ino te ndukuya ino makewan.
Kamir nanu ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono apik nkaik oo layiok le Yuda, naa kepuo ninche aamiraki lelo oshon le Sabea, oolakua, amu Olaitoriani oiroro.”
Entolimu ena embalie tiatua iloshon: entobira olarrabal, entuputu iltung'ana magil. Nchoo iltung'ana pooki lo larrabal enyiku, nchoo ninche epuonu aailepu.
Endong'o ilchempei linyi metaa lalema, nintaa ilalema linyi oodung'ishoreki iremeta; nchoo ilo oshal ejo, “Kara nanu olmurrani.”
Entasieku ootu, intae iloreren pooki ootaana, enturrurro ate teine. Ntadou ilmurran linono, iyie Olaitoriani.
Nchoo iloreren eputu ate, nepuonu oerata le Yehoshafat; amu teine nanu alo aton adung'oki enkiguana, lelo oreren pooki ootaana.
Tudumu olalem oololo amu eo enkikesare. Entijing'u entunyo amu eipute enkironyet. Eilogilog iltooi aadooyo, amu aikitok entorroni enye.
Etii olorora, olorora kitok, oerata odung'ieki enkiguana. Amu etinyikua enkolong o Laitoriani tiatua ilo erata odung'ieki enkiguana.
Keitomisimisi enkolong o lapa nemeitoki atii ewangan oo lakir.
Neikurrukur Olaitoriani te Sion neitayu oltoilo lenye te Yerusalem, ore keper o enkop neikirikira. Kake Olaitoriani esarunoto too ltung'ana lenyena, osempewuet too ltung'ana lenyena le Israel.
“Metaa ilo iyie ayiolou ajo kara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo obik te Sion, to ldoinyo lai sinyati. Naa keaku Yerusalem sinyati, nemeigil aekata iltung'ana omon aaim atua ninye.

“Ore kenya teina olong neitong'u ildoinyo enaisho oo sabibu namelok, neruko ndoinyo te kule, ore inong'ot pooki e Yuda neruko enkare; nerukunye enchorro e nkare naing'uaa enkaji o Laitoriani, neiput oerata le Shitim enkare.
“Kelo Misiri aaku olmuaate, neaku Edom ong'ata mitil te nkaraki enkarruoisho apa naitaasaki iltung'ana le Yuda, amu eibukoitie apa osarge lemeeta entioto te nkop enye.
Kake kemanyi Yuda ntarasi nememanyi Yerusalem too iishoritin pooki.
Kaitalaku nanu osarge lenye, naiwuang'ie nanu entorroni enye, amu Kebik Olaitoriani te Sion.”

Kulo irorei le Amos, apa laa obo loo lairritak loo ntare le Tekoa. Etoduaa apa ninye kuna naaipirta Israel too nkolong'i e Usia olaiguanani le Yuda o too nkolong'i e Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Israel ilarin oaare eng'or enkikirikirata e nkop.
Nejo ninye: “Eikurrukur Olaitoriani te Sion, neitayu oltoilo lenye te Yerusalem; eishir ndaat oo lairritak loo ntare, netoyu enchumata e Karmel.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore te nkaraki nkitarruorrot kumok e Dameski, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye; Amu eironya ninche Gilead too nkironyeta e sekenkei.
Neaku kairriwaki nanu enkima shumata enkaji e Hasael, naa kemut ninye isempewueti le Benhadad.

Kagil nanu esekenkei e Dameski naiwuang'ie lelo oomanya aitung'uaa oerata le Afen, naiwuang'ie ilo oibung'ita eng'udi e nkitoo aitung'uaa Besedan; naa kepuo iltung'ana le Siria eyararoto te Kir, Olaitoriani ojo.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore te nkaraki nkitarruorrot kumok e Gasa, maiwuang'ie enkitamioto enye; amu ewaita ninche eyararoto olosho olulung'a pee eyaki ninche Edom.
Neaku kairriwaki nanu enkima shumata esuntai e Gasa, naa kenya isempewueti lenye.
Kaiwuang'ie nanu lelo oomanya Ashdod, o ilo oibung'ita eng'udi e nkitoo aitung'uaa Ashkelon; kaibelekeny nanu enkaina ai aarare Ekron ore ilo pisiai loo Lfilisti neidaaya.” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore te nkaraki nkitarruorrot kumok e Tiro, maiwuang'ie enkitamioto enye; Amu etokordutua eyakita ninche olosho olulung'a le Edom, neitu edamu osotua loo lalashera.
Neaku kairriwaki nanu enkima shumata esuntai e Tiro, naa kenya isempewueti lenyena.”

Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore te nkaraki nkitarruorrot kumok e Edom, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye; amu etimira ninye olalashe lenye to lalem, neiturraa olng'ur pooki, neibung ninye engoro anaake, neshum engoro napi ntarasi.
Neaku kairriwaa nanu enkima shumata Teman, naa kenya lelo sempewueti le Bosra.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore te nkaraki nkitarruorrot kumok oo Lamoni, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye; amu etadanya ninche inkoshuaa oo nkituaak e Gilead, pee etum ninche aaitalala olpolosie lenye.
Naa kainok nanu enkima te suntai e Raba, naa kenya isempewueti lenyena too mbuakunot e ina olong o larrabal to sina teina olong olemua te ilo arrabal oikununo anaa osiwuo.
Ore olaiguanani lenye o lkituaak lenye nepuo eyararoto,” Olaitoriani ojo.
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore te nkaraki nkitarruorrot kumok e Moab, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye, amu etapejo ninye aitaa nkuruon iloik lo laiguanani le Edom.
Neaku kairriwaa nanu enkima shumata Moab, naa kenya isempewueti le Keriot, naa keye Moab te mpolos e enkishirata te mpolos e mbuaata o to ltoilo le ntarumpeta.
Kaiwuang'ie nanu olaiguanani te mpolos e Moab, naar metuata ilkituaak lenyena te nebo ninye Olaitoriani ojo.”

Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore te nkaraki nkitarruorrot kumok e Yuda, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye, amu etanyaita ninche nena kitanapat o Laitoriani, neitu eibung nkiguanat enyena, kake eitapong'oiyie ninche elejare enye, naa ninye etusuja iloo menye.
Neaku kairriwaki nanu enkima shumata Yuda, naa kenya isempewueti le Yerusalem.”
Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore te nkaraki nkitarruorrot kumok e Israel, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye; amu kemir ninche ilo asipani te nkosholai, nemir ilo omena aainosie inamuka are.
Ninche lelo ooitunyoki endukuya o laisinani enterit e nkop, neibelekeny enkoitoi eilo oibookoki enkop; nelo olayioni o menye ayiaya enkitok nabo, neidurukie ninche enkarna ai sinyati.
Neirrag ninche te mbata e pooki perere lo lasar, too nkilani naalakieki isilen; naa ore tiatua enkaji e Nkai enye neok ninche enaisho oo sabibu e lelo ooitalaaki esile.
“Ore eyia aidaikie apa nanu Ilamori te dukuya ninche, ooba enkadoro enye anaa enkadoro oo ltarakua negol oleng anaa ilkeek sapuki; aidaikie nanu ilng'anayio lenyena te shumata, o ntona enyena te kop.
Ayaua sii nanu intae aitayu te nkop e Misiri, narik intae ilarin artam tiong'ota, pee ipuonunu aaya enkop oo Lamori.
Aitaa nanu embata oo layiok linyi iloibonok le Nkai, ore embata oo lbarnot linyi Ilnasari, aimesipa ena, lo tung'ana le Israel?” Olaitoriani ojo.
“Kake intooko intae Ilnasari enaisho oo sabibu, nintanapinapa iloibonok le Nkai aajoki ‘Emimbonisho’.
“Karogonyaki nanu intae enkop te wueji inyi, anaa enarogony enkop engarri nabore lolan.
Keimin enkuetata te ilo oneneng, ore ilo ogol nemeitoki aata engolon enye; nemeitoki ilo magilani aidim aitajeu enkishui enye.
Ore ilo oibung enkawuo nemeitashe, ore ilo oneneng too nkejek nemeitajeu kewan, nemeitajeu ilo oked embarta enkishui enye;
naa ore ilo ogol tau tialo lelo magil naa keyooki aisik ailanyisho meeta nareta o larrabal teina olong.” Olaitoriani ojo.
Entoning ele rorei laa ninye eiroro Olaitoriani tialo intae: lo tung'ana le Israel, ilo osho pooki apa lailepunye nanu aitayu tiatua enkop e Misiri.
“Intae ake atayiolo nanu nataramata too loshon pooki le nkop; neaku kaitame nanu intae te ntorroni inyi pooki.
“Amaa keiriamari iltung'ana oaare te nebo te neitu ening'o?
Amaa, Keikurrukur olng'atuny te ntim eitu ninye eibung toki, Keikurrukur olkuoo lo lng'atuny te nkapune enye meeta ninye toki?
Amaa kedoiki emotonyi orreshet te nkop, eitu epikakini ninye orreshet? Kegamisho irresheta te nkop eitu eibung toki?
Amaa keoshi esekekua te nkanasa nemeirut iltung'ana? Kejing entorroni enkanasa te neme Olaitoriani oyaua?
Esipa meeta enaas Olaitoriani Enkai, eitu eibalunye enkisudoroto enye too sinkan lenyena, lelo oibonok lenyena.
Eikurrukurro olng'atuny; ai ng'ae lemeureishoyu: Eiroro Olaitoriani Enkai; aing'ae lemeibonisho?”

Enosai too sempewueti te Asiria, o too sempewueti tiatua enkop e Misiri, nijojo, “Enturrurroto maate te nchumata oldoinyo le Samaria, eng'ura embuakunoto o lkiyioi tiatua ninye, o enkitorogonyare tiatua ninye.”
“Meyiolo ninche eneiko teneas esipata.” Olaitoriani ojo. “Kulo ooshum ilchumat le ntorroni e nkikonya too sempewueti lenye.”
Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Kelotu olmang'atinta airin enkop, neibung imasaa nimitunyenye ate neraya intokitin naatii isempewueti linyi.”

Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore anaa enasaru olchekut loo ntare nkejek are aashu endung'oti e nkiok naatelekua olng'atuny, neijia etiu iltung'ana le Israel oomanya Samaria, ilkuti ake ooleku, oi ninche oogira aairura too rruatin sidain.”
“Entoning naa, ninchakenokiki enkaji e Yakobo” Olaitoriani Enkai, Enkai oo lororani, ojo.
Nchere teina olong naitame nanu Israel te nkitarruorroto enye, naa kaitame nanu ilpereren loo lasarri le Betel, ore mouarak o lperere lo lasar nedung'ori nesulakini enkop.
Kagil nanu enkaji e nkata enkirobi o enkaji enkata enkirouaj; ore nkajijik naaikodo too lala loo lkanchaoni nerruoyo, ore nkajijik kituaak neidaaya,” Olaitoriani ojo.
“Entoning ele rorei, intae nakituaak e Samaria, nena naatopiro anaa nkishu e Bashan, nena naaibooki olaisinani enkop, neitorogony olomena, nena naajoki ilpayiani lenye, ‘Eyau enaisho matook!’

Einosa Olaitoriani Enkai olmumai te sinyatisho enye, nchere, ng'ura kepuonu nkolong'i shumata intae, peyie eyau intae too lala ooloolo, netiu pooki ng'ae te ntae, anaa osinkiri oibung'aki to rreshet ooololo.
Naa ipuopuo intae aaim esuntai nataaraki, neitashe pooki ng'ae te dukuya ninye, nepuoi aanang'aki intae Harmon,” Olaitoriani ojo.
“Wou Betel, tigila nkitanapat, Wou Gilgal, toponai engilata oo nkitanapat; iyau ilasarri linono anaake tadekenya, o matuan inono e tomon te pooki olong e uni.
Intayu olasar le nashe; eina naisuijieki, nimbalie inkishorunot e mpiris nilikioo ninche; amu inyorrinyorro aaikuna neijia, lo tung'ana le Israel!” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.
“Nanu oyaua olameyu atua nkanas inyi pooki, naiko endaa meishunye too nkajijik inyi pooki, ore ake eyia neitu intae kishukokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.

“Naa nanu sii oibooyie enchan meshaiki intae, eton eng'or ilapaitin okuni le nkikesare nairriwaki; nanu enchan shumata e nkanasa nabo napal enkae anasa atashaikia ewueji nebo, ore ewueji neitu eshaiki netoyu;
neaku ore iloo nkanas are aashu uni nepuo enkanasa nabo pee eok enkare, nemeishunye ninche enkure; ore eyia neitu intae kirinyokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.
“Ataara indaiki inyi te nkeeya, naitomijoon inkurman inyi aitoi isabibu linyi; ore ilng'abolo o loirienito linyi nenya olmaati; ore eyia neitu kishukokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.

“Airriwaka nanu atua intae olmeitai anaa apa enaikununo te Misiri; naar nanu ilbarnot linyi to lalem; naya nanu imbartan inji aiwuang'ie naya nanu olng'usil loo lng'oborri linyi apik nkumeishin inyi; ore eyia eitu intae kishukokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.
“Aidakie nanu ilkulikae te ntae, anaa apa pee eidaikie Enkai Sodom o Gomora, nitiuu apa anaa olmishire oitayioki tiatua enkima nayupuyup; ore eyia eitu intae kishukokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.
“Neaku ena nanu aaitaas, iyie Israel; ore enkaraki naa kaas nanu ena, terretenayu pee itumore Enkai ino iyie Israel!”
Amu ore ilo oitobira ildoinyo neitayu osiwuo, neibalakinye iltung'ana enaikununo endamunoto enye; ilo oitomisimis enkakenya neroro ineeika enkop – Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, ninye enkarna enye!
Entoning ele rorei lajo nanu te nkishirata te nkaraki intae na aji e Israel:
“Etabatate nemeigil aekata adumunye, ina selenkei e Israel; eiturrayioki te nkop enye nemeetae olodumu ninye.”
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ore enkanasa napukunye iltung'ana enkalifu nabo iip ake ooleku, ore ina napukunye iltung'ana iip, tomon ake oolekaki enkaji e Israel.”
Amu nji ejoki Olaitoriani enkaji e Israel: “Eng'oruaki nanu pee ipokipoko;
kake emiking'oruru intae te Betel, nimiking'oruru te Gilgal aashu idung'udung'u aapuo Beer-sheba; amu meeta nchere melo Gilgal eyararoto, naa keaku Betel entoki nemeetae.”
Eng'orutu Olaitoriani pee ipokipoko, pee melotu ake ninye anaa enkima ajing enkaji e Yosef, nenya ninye nemetii oloar ninye te Betel,
Intae kulo ooibelekeny esipata aaitaa esayiet, nenang'aki esipata enkop!

Ore ilo oitobira ilakir, Pledes o Orion, neibelekeny enaimin nagut aitaa enkakenya, neitomisimis endama aitaa enkewarie, ilo oipotu nkariak e naiposha neitashaiki ninche shumata oriong e nkop, Olaitoriani ninye enkarna enye,
ilo oyau enkidaaroto anaa enkiwuang'ata egilunore ilo ogol, neaku kelotu enkidaaroto shumata ine negol.
Eiba ninche ilo oisikong'isho te kishomi neinyal ilo oiro esipata.

Neaku ore enkaraki nimbookiki olaisinani enkop, nioruru ninye enkano enye, itesheta intae nkajijik oo soito oogueta, kake mibikiekie intae ninche; ituno intae isabibu sidain, kake miokioko enaisho enye.
Amu ayiolo nanu eneba nkitarruorrot inyi o enaba esapuko oo ng'ok inyi, intae ilooibooki enkop olasipani, niyaya ntokitin e ropare, nimbelekenyenye ilo omena aarriny te kishomi.
Neaku ore ilo ng'en negira te nkata naikununo nji; amu enkata e ntorroni.
Eng'orutu isidain, mme ntorrok, pee ipokipoko; pee etum Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani ataa te nebo intae, anaa enitejo intae.
Embai entorroni, ninyorrurru esupatisho, nintubulaa esupatisho te kishomi; amu eidimayu to Laitoriani, Enkai oo lororani pee eing'urrie Enkai olpisiaai le Yosef.

Nji naa ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkoitoi pooki kituaak naa keaku enkishirata; ore too nkoitoi pooki nejo ninche, ‘Aha, aha!’ Naa keipotu ninche ilaturok le nkurma meetu aaishir, neyietu lelo arriyiak te nkishirata,
ore too wuejitin pooki oo sabibu naa keaku e nkishirata, amu kaim nanu atua empolos inyi.” Olaitoriani ojo.
Intae lelo oong'uar enkolong o Laitoriani! Kainyoo pee iyieuu intae enkolong o Laitoriani? Enaimin ninye neme ewang'an;
ketiu anaa oltung'ani okuet ailany olng'atuny, nenang'are olng'arurumi, aashu elo atua aji neigaraki enkaina enye esuntai neony olasurai ninye.
Aime enaimin enkolong o Laitoriani neme ewang'an, o emisimisi nemewang?
“Kaiba nanu, namen isiruai linyi, nemashipakino lelo turrurri linyi.
Ore hoo nikintaikiki nanu ilasarri linyi oopejori o lasarri le nkurma, mang'amaa nanu ninche, ore lelo asarri linyi le seriani loo nchoo inyi naapir, maning'ore nanu.
Ewaita entung'uayioki nanu enkilepilep oo sinkolioitin linyi; mainining nanu oltoilo loo nkinantani inyi.
Kake enchoo esipata erukunye anaa nkariak, nerukunye esupatisho anaa enchorro nemetoyu aekata.
“Amaa eikiyakita apa intae ilasarri o nkishoorot to lpurkel too lapa arin artam, naaji e Israel?
Iteserema intae nkaitin naaguetuno naaji Sakuti, enkai aiguanani inyi, o Kaiwana ina ai inyi o lakira o nkitanyaanyukot inyi apa nintobirakita ate;
neaku kaya nanu intae enchom eyararoto teidia alo Dameski,” Olaitoriani ojo, laa ore enkarna enye naa Enkai oo Lororani.
“Oi lekua ooisikarra te Sion, o lekua oodol eserian to ldoinyo le Samaria, lelo tung'ana ning'ot le dukuya too loshon, laa ninche esaru olosho le Israel!
Entalang enchom entodol enkanasa e Kalne; nidumunyenye teine aapuo Hamat kitok; nintokiki aapuo Gat oo Lfilisti. Keikash ninche aalang kuna kitoriat pooki? Aashu aisapuk enkop enye alang enkop inyi.
Intalakuanana intae enkolong e ntorroni, niyauu aaitataanu entonata o larrabal?
“Oi lekua ooirrag too ndapashi naaikodo too lala loo lkanchaoni, neitoriori too lorikan dapashi, nenya ilkuoo le kerra too luaat nenya ilasho to lale;
lelo oorany isinkolioitin le pesho to ltoilo le nkinanta, neitobiraki ate ntokitin oo sinkolioitin anaa Daudi;
ook enaisho too lbakulini neeyel ate te ilata sidai oleng, kake meisina ninche te nkidaata e Yosef!
Neaku keaku taata ninche ile dukuya te lelo oopuo eyararoto, ore isiruai linyi o sikarri inyi neishunye.”
Einosa Olaitoriani Enkai olmumai te kewan enye (Olaitoriani ojo, Enkai oo lororani): “Kaiba nanu olwuasa le Yakobo, naiba isempewueti lenye; naa kaishooyo nanu enkanasa o pooki natii atua.”
Naa te neleku iltung'ana tomon te nkaji nabo neye ninche.

Naa ore oltung'ani opejoo olalashe lenye, te neitayu loik lenye tiatua aji, nejoki ilo otii atua aji, “Keton etii likae tung'ani te nebo iyie?” Nejo ninye “A'a nejo, tigirayu! Mikintoki iyiook aaipot enkarna o Laitoriani.”
Amu ng'ura, eitayu Olaitoriani enkitanapata, neari enkaji sapuk aaitaa mbelibelat, neitaae enkaji kiti irrarrat.
Amaa, kekuet mbartan te nchumata indapidapo? Ketur oltung'ani enaiposha too lmong'i? Kake mbelekenya intae esipata aaitaa esayiet o lng'anayio le sipata, nintaa olchani odua,
intae kulo oong'ida te Mpesho, oojo, “Keitu iyiook te ngolon ang maate kiya Karnaim?”
“Amu ng'ura, kadumaki nanu intae olosho, lo tung'ana le Israel, Olaitoriani ojo, Enkai oo lororani; naa keibooki ninche intae enkop ebaiki enejing'ieki Hamat o metabaiki Ereyiet e Araba.”
Ena nanu aaitoduaa Olaitoriani Enkai, ng'ura, eitobirita ninye olmaati te nkiterunoto embulunoto e ndaa natuunoki to loirujuruj, naa ng'ura embulunoto e are eidipa olaiguanani atudung'o.
Ore pee eidip ilo maati ainosa inkujit e ina kop, najo nanu, “Olaitoriani Enkai, tapalaki ninche, aatasayia iyie! Kaji naa eiko pee eitashe Yakobo? Eikiti ninye oleng!”
Neirridu Olaitoriani ena bae; Meekure eaku, Olaitoriani ojo.
Ena nanu aaitoduaa Olaitoriani Enkai, neipotu Olaitoriani Enkai enkiguana e nkima, nenya ina kima ineegut oleng, nenya sii enkop.
Naitoki nanu ajo, “Olaitoriani Enkai, tapala, aatasayia iyie! Kaji naa eiko pee eitashe Yakobo? Eikiti ninye oleng!”
Neirridu Olaitoriani ena; “Meitoki sii ena atiu,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.
Aaitoduaa ninye ae duaata: nadol eitashe Olaitoriani te mbata e suntai nateshetaki te ntemet e nkitorioroto, eibung'ita entemet te nkaina enye.

Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Amos, kainyoo iyie idolita?” Najoki nanu: “Entemet e nkitorioroto.” Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo. “Ng'ura, kapik nanu entemet e nkitorioroto empolos oo ltung'ana laainei Israel; maigil aekata nanu agiroo ninche;
ore iwuejitin neeika e Isaak naa keitomijooni, ore iwuejitin e Israel neeseremishoreki neitomijooni, naa kadumakino nanu enkaji e Yeroboam to lalem.”

Neitoki Amasia olapolosani le Betel airriwaki olkilikuai Yeroboam olaiguanani le Israel, ejoki, “Eitobirita Amos entorroni tialo iyie te mpolos e nkaji e Israel; meidimaa ena kop ilomon lenyena pooki.
Amu nji apa etejo Amos, ‘Keye Yeroboam to lalem, nemeeta nchere pee melo Israel eyararoto aing'uaa enkop enye.’ ”
Nejoki Amasia Amos, “Iyie oladuaani shomo, isika shomo enkop e Yuda, inosa endaa teine, nimbonisho teine;
kake mingil aekata aibonisho te Betel, amu enkaji o laiguanani naseremishore naa enkaji e nkitoo naseremieki Enkai.”
Neitoki Amos awaliki Amasia ejo, “Mara nanu oloiboni le Nkai olaakini nemara olayioni lo loiboni, kake kara olairritani o laitobirani loo lkeek oonyaanyukie ilng'abolo,
naaya apa nanu Olaitoriani aitung'uaa esujata oo ntare, naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Shomo, mbonoki iltung'ana laainei Israel.’
“Ore naa taata toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani. Ijo iyie ‘Mimbonoki Israel, niminosu ilomon le nkikoo tialo enkaji e Isaak?’

Nji naa ejo Olaitoriani: ‘Keaku enkitok ino enaiborrie onyek tiatua ena anasa, ore ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono naa kebatata to lalem, ore olokeri lino naa kedung'i aaorrior to lgosoi, ore iyie makewan naa iye te nkop nemesinya, nemeeta nchere pee melo Israel eyararoto aing'uaa enkop enye.’ ”
Ena nanu aaitoduaa Olaitoriani Enkai, enkikapu nabore ilng'anayio le nkata e nkirowuaj.

Naajoki ninye, “Amos, kainyoo iyie idolita?” Najoki nanu, “Enkikapu nabore ilng'anayio le nkata e nkirowuaj.” Naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani ajoki, “Etabaikia enkiting'oto iltung'ana laainei Israel; maigil aekata nanu agiroo ninche.
Ore isinkolioitin le nkaji e Nkai naa keaku olkiyioi teina olong,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo; “Ore mpopoki oo ltung'ana ootuata naa keaku kumok; ore te pooki wueji naa kepuoi aaiturraa ninche egirae.”
Entoning ena, intae ilooibooki iloomena enkop, niyauu lelo aisinak le nkop aaishie,

ijojo, “Kanu eishunye olapa ng'ejuk, pee kitum aatimir enkurma. Keishunye Sabato, pee kitum aatimir enkano, pee kitum aaterepeny entemet naji eta nikiponaa shekeli, nikilej iltung'ana too ntemat e lejare,
Pee kitum iyiook aainyang'u olaisinani te nkosholai ore olomena nikinyang'u too namuka are, nikimir isuut e nkano?”
Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai te nkaraki olwuasa le Yakobo: “Esipa maarikino aekata hoo nabo oo nkiasin enye.
Aimeikirikira enkop te nkaraki ena, Neishir to sina pooki ng'ae omanya atua ninye, nedumunye ninye pooki anaa olkeju le Nail, neilugo neitoki aimis, anaa olkeju le Nail te Misiri?”
“Naa ore kenya teina olong.” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo, “Naitadoyio nanu enkolong te nkipirata enkolong, naitomisimis enkop dama.

Kaibelekeny nanu isiruai linyi aitaa osina, ore isinkolioitin linyi pooki neaku olkiyioi; karrotianaki nanu inkilani o lkuniyia pooki tung'ani, napik enkurroto pooki lukunya; kaitotiu nanu anaa enkishirata naishirakini olayioni obo, laa ninye ake eetae ore enkiting'oto enye netiu anaa enkolong nadua.
“Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo, “Nairriwaki nanu enkop olameyu; mme olameyu le ndaa aashu olameyu le nkure e nkare, kake oloning'ieki ororei lo Laitoriani.
Kelimana ninche ebaiki enaiposha o metabaiki enaiposha, moikuape o metabaiki enkilepunoto e nkolong; kekuet ninche aapuo neitu, aaing'oru ororei lo Laitoriani, kake metum ninche.
“Ore kenya teina olong isilan sidain o lbarnot naa keiterre te nkure.
Ore lelo oonya olmumai te Ashima e Samaria, nejo ‘Ore anaa enaishu enkai ino, Dan;’ naa ‘Ore anaa enaishu enkoitoi e Beer-sheba;’ kebatata ninche nemeigil aekata aadumunye.”

Atoduaa nanu Olaitoriani eitashe te mbata olperere lo lasar, nejo ninye: “Toosho lukuny oo ng'apeta e nkaji e Nkai, o meikirikirata ntonat oo ng'apeta, tebelibelaki ninche inchumat oo ilukuny oo ltung'ana pooki; ore ilooleku lenye naar nanu ninche to lalem; melo ninye obo lenye aisik nemeimisho ninye obo lenye.
“Ore hoo naaji ninye te netur enkop aapuo enemeneng'a, naa keitayu ake enkaina ai ninche teine; ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa keilep aapuo shumata, naa kaitadou nanu ninche teine.

Ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa keisudori te nchumata oldoinyo oji Karmel, naa kaing'oru nanu ninche naitayu ninche; naa ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa keisudori too nkonyek aainei aapuo abori enaiposha, naa kairriwaa nanu olasurai ine metoonyo ninche.
Naa ore naaji tenaa kepuo ninche eyararoto te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye, naitanap nanu olalem teine pee ear ninche naa kaing'or nanu ninche te ntorroni neme te sidai.”
Ore Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, ilo laa te neiseyie enkop neshola, ore lelo pooki oomanya atua neishir to sina nedumunye pooki anaa olkeju le Nail, neitoki adou, anaa olkeju le Nail te Misiri;
ilo oshet enkaji enye e shumata te keper nepik olkitamanyunoto lenye shumata enkop ilo oipotu nkariak e naiposha nebukoki ninche shumata oriong e nkop Olaitoriani ninye enkarna enye.

“Aimitiuu intae anaa Olosho le Etiopia te nanu, intae lo tung'ana le Israel?” Olaitoriani ojo. “Keitu nanu aitayu ailepunye Israel aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, naitung'uaa Ilfilisti Kafta naitung'uaa Siria Kir?
Ng'ura, etii nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai shumata enkitoria oo ng'ok, naa kaidakie nanu aitung'uaa oriong e nkop; Meteleku ake nchere maidaikie nanu tukul enkaji e Yakobo,” Olaitoriani ojo.
“Amu ng'ura, kaitanapisho nanu, pee aipirripir asilu nanu enkaji e Israel tiatua loreren pooki anaa enasil oltung'ani te silet, kake meetae olantererai odoiki enkop.
Ore lelo aing'okok loo ltung'ana laainei pooki naa keye to lalem, lelo oojo, ‘Meinepu aekata entorroni iyiook aashu etum iyiook.’
“Ore kenya teina olong naitasheiyie nanu enkaji e Daudi apa naturori naitobir nanu ineetarruoitie, nashumu nanu ineeturori, naitoki nanu ashet metotiuo anaa apa;
Pee etum ninche aawaita olpisiai le Edom o lelo oreren pooki ooipoti te nkarna ai,” Olaitoriani ilo oas ena, ojo nji.

“Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i,” Olaitoriani ojo, “ore ilo oturisho neinepu ilo oikesisho ore ilo oirony ilng'anayio neinepu ilo ounisho; ore ildoinyo neitong'u enaisho namelok, neruko too ildoinyo pooki.
Kashuku nanu imayianat oo ltung'ana laainei Israel naa keshet ninche nkanas apa naaidaaitie nemany ninche; keun ninche isabibu neok enaisho enye; naa keitayu ninche nkurman neya ilng'anayio lenye.
Kaun nanu ninche te nkop enye, nemeigili aekata aadotu ninche, aaitayu tiatua ina kop naishoo nanu ninche,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.

Ena enduaata e Obadia. Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai tialo Edom: Kitoning'o iyiook ilomon supati ooing'uaa Olaitoriani, neirriwuaki olkilikuai atua iloreren. “Tudumunye! Matudumakinoto iyiook Edom to larrabal!”
Idol ajo kaaitaa iyie kiti tiatua iloreren, eikipuoi aamenu iyie oleng.
Kiteleja iyie ilo wuasa lo ltau lino, iyie ilo omanya enemanita endapidapoi nagol, laa keika oleng emanyisho enye, ilo ojo to ltau lino, “Kaing'ae laaitadou nanu ayau enkop!”
Ore hoo nilepa alo shumata anaa olkurragos, ore hoo naa atua lakir etii enkaji ino, kaayau ake aitadou enkop, Olaitoriani ojo.
Amaa te nepuonu ilapurrok enitii kewarie, kebaa enkidaata nikindakieki iyie! Aimepurroo ninche ina ake naaidip ninche? Amaa te nepuonu ilasotok loo sabibu, aimeleku ninche embata?
Kebaa elilituni Esau, neing'oruni ilchumat lenyena!

Kiteleja lelo pooki lining'ore, kitimiraitie ninche aareu olpolosie; ore apa lelo liatayie eseriani nikitimira ninche; ore lelo shoreta linono lisilig netipika orreshet abori iyie embae nemeyiolounoyu ina.
Amaa kenya teina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, aimaidaikie nanu lelo tung'ana ang'eni te Edom, o eyiolounoto to ldoinyo le Esau?
Ore lelo tung'ana linono magil, Teman, neitukureti, o metaa ore pooki oing'uaa oldoinyo le Esau neiwuang'ieki aar metua.
Ore te nkaraki ina kinyalata nainyalaki olalashe lino Yakobo, eikimulumul iyie enkurruna, naa eikiwuang'ieki ntarasi.
Ore apa teina olong nintasho aitirring'a, ore apa teina olong nawaita iltung'ana leiking'a imasaa enyena, neimu ilmang'ati nchomito enyena, neoshoki enkukuo Yerusalem, nitotiwuo iyie anaa obo lenye.

Enyor apa neitu ishipakino ina olong o lalashe lino teina olong apa natijing'a ninye olbuket; enyor apa neitu ing'idakino ina olong e lelo tung'ana le Yuda, teina olong e nkidaata enye; enyor apa neitu iwuasayu teina olong o sina.

Enyor apa neitu ijing kishomi oo ltung'ana laainei, teina olong o sina lenye; enyor apa neitu ing'idakino ashil enkidaata enye, te nena olong'i e nkidaata enye; enyor apa neitu imbung imasaa enyena teina olong e nkidaata enye.
Enyor apa neitu intashe te rishata oo nkoitoi pee imbung lelo ooisik; enyor apa neitu iyau ilo pisiai lenye teina olong o sina.
Amu etataama ina olong o Laitoriani te shumata iloreren pooki. Ore anaa enitaasa, ina eyookini aitaas intae, keshukokino nkiaasin inyi shumata ilukuny inyi maate.

Amu ore anaa enitoo intae enkikombe nadua e nkitamioto te nchumata e ilo doinyo lai sinyati, keokisho sii ninche lelo oshon pooki oomanita ntae keokisho ninche neimisiloo, netiu ninche anaa keitu aekata eng'as aaku.
Kake Oldoinyo le Sion epuo aatii lelo ooilanyisho, naa keaku sinyati ine; ore enkaji e Yakobo neya wuejitin enye.
Neaku enkaji e Yakobo enkima, ore enkaji e Yosef olang'at le nkima, neaku enkaji e Esau nkabobok; nepej ninche neishu ninche, nemetum hoo obo oleku te nkaji e Esau; amu Olaitoriani oiroro.
Ore lelo le Negeb naa keya oldoinyo le Esau, ore lelo le Shefela neya enkop oo Filistia; neya ninche ina kop e Efraim o enkop e Samaria neya Benchamen Gilead.
Ore lelo aisikak le Hala laa ilo lorere le Israel, neya Foinike o metabaiki Serefait; ore lelo ooibung'aki le Yerusalem ootii atua Sefarad nepuo aaya nena anas e Negeb.
Keilep ilaitajeunok aapuo Oldoinyo le Sion aaitore Oldoinyo le Esau; neaku enkitoria eno Laitoriani.
Eishoo Olaitoriani Yona olayioni le Amitai ele rorei, nejoki,
“Tudumunye, shomo Enkanasa kitok e Ninawi, ninchiraki ninye; amu aatabaikia entoroni enye.”

Kake etudumunye Yona aisikaki Tarshishi ailany Olaitoriani. Nedoyio ninye alo Yopa netum emeli naloito Tarshishi; nelak entikiti emeli nejing, pee elo te nebo ninche Tarshishi, enelakua ailany Olaitoriani.
Kake eirriwua Olaitoriani olkutati sapuk shumata enaiposha, nejing enkilugo kitok enaiposha o metaa kejo emeli pee egila.

Neiputukuny lelo ootii emeli, neishiraki pooki tung'ani enkai enye; nenang'aki ninche lelo olan apa ootii emeli atua enaiposha, pee eiteneneng. Kake eshomo apa Yona adoyio alo olgilata liabori emeli neirrag, neirura aitayu njo.
Nelotu olkitok le meli nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee irura? Tuputunye, impoto enkai ino! Eidimayu pee edamu iyiook ina ai pee mikindaaya.”
Nejokino ninche maate, “Wootu, matoosh enkukuo, pee kitum aatayiolo ajo kaing'ae eimua ena torroni naewuo shumata iyiook.” Neosh ninche enkukuo, nedoiki enkukuo Yona.
Neitoki ninche aajoki ninye, “Toliki iyiook ajo kaing'ae eimua ena torroni naewuo shumata iyiook? Kainyoo esiaai ino? Naa kaji ing'uaa? Kaa enkop inyi? Naa eira iyie oli alo orere?”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kara nanu Olburaniai; naure nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai e keper, laa ninye oitobira enaiposha o enkop natoyio.”
Neitoki lelo tung'ana aairut oleng, nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo ena nitaasa iyie!” Amu etayioloito iltung'ana nchere keisikita apa ninye ailany Olaitoriani, te nkaraki natolikio ninye ninche.
Neitoki ninche aajoki ninye, “Kaa iyiook kintaas iyie, pee etum enaiposha aitirring'ayu te iyiook?” Amu etoponari enaiposha ailugo oleng.
Nejoki Yona ninche, “Entudumuaki nanu entanang'akaki atua enaiposha; pee etum enaiposha aitirring'ayu te intae; amu ayiolo ajo te nkaraki nanu pee eewuo ele kutati sapuk shumata intae.”
Ore ake eyia neijia netonyuaa lelo tung'ana aajo kireu emeli meeu enkop natoyio, kake etalaikinote amu etoponari enaiposha ailugo oleng oleng ti alo ninche.

Neaku eishirakitia ninche Olaitoriani, ejo, “Kisai iyie, Olaitoriani, mincho iyiook kindak te nkaraki enkishui ele tung'ani, niminteleiki iyiook osarge lemeeta entioto; amu itaasa iyie Olaitoriani anaa enikintiship iyie.”
Nedumu ninche Yona nenang'aki ninye atua enaiposha; neitirring'a enaiposha te nkilugoto enye.
Neureyu lelo tung'ana Olaitoriani oleng, neitaiki ninche Olaitoriani olasar, nenya olmumai.
Neirriu Olaitoriani osinkirri sapuk metoijoi Yona; netii apa Yona enkoshoke o sinkirri nkolong'i uni o nkewarieitin uni.
Neomon Yona Olaitoriani Enkai enye tiatua enkoshoke e ilo sinkirri,
ejo, “Aipoto nanu Olaitoriani, tiatua osina lai, naawaliki ninye nanu; tiatua enkoshoke e nemeneng'a aishira nanu, nitoning'o iyie oltoilo lai.
“Amu kitanang'aka nanu atua enguton, atua enguton oo naaiposha, naaman nanu nkariak pooki wueji; ore lopir pooki o nang'arot oo nkariak neim shumata nanu.
“Najo nanu, ‘Aatanang'ayioki aaiturraa aaitung'uaa dukuya ino; kaji pasa nanu aiko pee aigil adol enkaji ino sinyati?’
“Aaimulumulaitie nanu nkariak, aatamana nanu enguton inkaloli pooki; neteene olarampai le nkare aman endukuya ai,
too ntonat oo ldoinyo. Nadoyio nanu alo ina kop naaikenorieki nanu ntarasi; ore ake eyia neijia, niyaua iyie enkishui ai ailepunye tiatua engumoto, Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai.
“Ore paa aiting osiligi, nadamu nanu Olaitoriani; nelotu enkomono ai enitii tiatua enkaji ino sinyati.
“Ore lelo ooyanyit inkaitin naaguetuno e pesho neituraa enkisiligata enye nasipa.
“Kake ore nanu to oltoilo le nkishooroto e nashe naa kaapolosaki iyie olasar; ore ina nainosie olmumai kalak nanu. Eno Laitoriani enkordunoto!”
Neirorie Olaitoriani osinkirri, nelopu ilo sinkirri Yona te nkop natoyio.
Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Yona enkata e are, nejoki,
“Tudumunye shomo Ninawi, ina anasa kitok, nimbalakinye ninye ilo kilikuai laaliki nanu iyie.”
Nedumunye Yona nelo Ninawi, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani. Ore apa Ninawi naa enkanasa kitok oleng, elototo oo nkolong'i uni.
Neiteru Yona alo atua ina anasa, nelo elototo e nkolong nabo. Neishir ninye ajo, “Nkolong'i artam ake naang'or pee eidaikieki Ninawi!”
Neiruk iltung'ana le Ninawi Enkai; neibalie ninche eenata e ate e mpukoroto, neishop ilkuniyiani, ebaiki olkitok lenye o metabaiki oloti lenye.
Nebaiki lelo omon olaiguanani le Ninawi, nedumunye ninye to lorika lenye le nkitoo, neitayu olkila lenye, neimulumul kewan too lkuniyiani, netonie nkuruon.

Nedung'u ninye enkitanapata neitubulaa tiatua Ninawi pooki ejo, “Ore te nkitanapata o laiguanani o lkituaak lenyena: Mincho oltung'ani aashu eng'ues, o nchoo aashu nkerrai eishamisham hoo toki; inchoo ninche etoni medaa, aashu eok enkare,

kake nchoo oltung'ani o eng'ues eimulumuli too lkuniyiani, naa nchoo ninche eishiraki oleng Enkai; ee nchoo pooki ng'ae eibelekenya aing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono neing'uaa ina torroni nataasa too nkaik enyena.
Kaing'ae nayiolo nchere keidim Enkai neibelekenya teina goro enye napi, pee mikindaaya iyiook?”
Ore ake pee edol Enkai ina nataasa ninche, ina naibelekenyate ninche aaing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono, neibelekeny Enkai ina torroni apa natejo ninye aitaas ninche; neitu ninye eas ina.
Kake eitu eitiship ena Yona tukul, etagore ninye oleng.

Eomon ninye Olaitoriani nejo, “Aatoomono nanu iyie, Olaitoriani, aime ena apake nanu atejo eton atii enkop ang? Te nkaraki ena apa pee aisarisara nanu aisikaki Tarshishi; amu atayiolo apa nanu nchere ira iyie Enkai osotua niata olng'ur, nimegoro asioki, nikibore enyorrata nauno, nipalaki entorroni.
Ore naa taata, Olaitoriani, intayu enkishui ai intung'uayioki nanu, aatasayia iyie, amu enaikash te nanu te naye alang te naishu.”
Nejo Olaitoriani, “Amaa, itaasa iyie esidai itagore?”
Neitoki Yona aipang alo auluo en kanasa neton te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong e ina anasa neitobiraki kewan olng'obor teine. Neton ninye ti abori oloip o metaba anaa nedol enapukoki ina anasa.

Negelu Olaitoriani Enkai enkaitubului neisho ninye metubulu te shumata Yona, pee etum ataa oloip te shumata endukuya enye, pee eitajeu ninye te nkirowuaj e nkolong. Neshipayu Yona oleng te nkaraki ina aitubului.
Kake ore ake pee emanaa enkakenya te nkolong e are, negelu Enkai olkurto oinosa ina aitubului, neaku etoyio.

Ore ake pee eilepu enkolong, neirriu Enkai olkutati oirowua oing'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong, near enkolong endukuya e Yona o meiterria, neikilikuanu ninye pee eye, nejo, “Enaikash nanu te naye alang te naishu.”
Kake etiaaka Enkai Yona, “Itaasa iyie esidai ti nigorokino enkaitubului?” Nejo ninye, “Ataasa nanu esidai agoro, atagore ene keeya.”
Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ing'urrie iyie ina aitubului neitu iasaki esiaai, neitu iyie intubulu ninye, ina naaku kewarie neidaaya te nkewarie.
Aimaing'urrie naa nanu Ninawi, idia anasa kitok, natii atua ninye ilkumok oogiroo inkalifuni iip o tikitam lemeyiolo ninche aaitirrisha enkaina enye e tatene o ene kedianye, netii sii nchoo kumok?”
Ororei lo Laitoriani ele oibalakinyeki Mika le Moreshet, too nkolong'i e Yotam o Ahas o Hesekia, lelo aiguanak le Yuda. Etoduaa apa ninye kuna baa naaipirta Samaria o Yerusalem.
Entoning intae, lo oreren pooki; toning'o na kop o pooki naatii atua, naa nchoo Olaitoriani Enkai eaku olchakeni tialo intae, Olaitoriani oiro teina aji enye Sinyati.
Amu ng'ura, kelotu Olaitoriani aipang'u teine wueji enye, nedou alotu aituny iwuejitin neeika e nkop.
Neshola ildoinyo tiabori ninye, neaku ierat iwululuni, netiu anaa suut te dukuya enkima, netiu anaa nkariak naatubukokoki enegut.
Ore ena pooki naa te nkaraki enkitapong'oto e Yakobo, o ng'ok e nkaji e Israel. Kainyoo enkitapong'oto e Yakobo? Aime Samaria? Naa kainyoo eng'oki e nkaji e Yuda? Aime Yerusalem?
Ore enkaraki ina kaitaa nanu Samaria osototi te nkop naisiaja, ewueji neunieki isabibu; naa kabukoki nanu isoito lenyena atua oearata, nanuk ilkitamanyunot lenyena.

Ore nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin neidong'i aaitaa mbelibelat, ore nena tokitin e marmalisho nepejori te nkima. Ore nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin neirrag te mijoonisho. Amu too mpisai e mulayoi etasotuo ninye ninche, naa nena pisai e mulayoi errinyokino ninye.
Ore te nkaraki ena kayietu nanu aishir; kalo nanu maishopo nemaata namuka; kaitayu nanu enkishirata anaa mbariak, naishir anaa isidan.
Amu meishiunoyu olbae lenye neewuo Yuda, etabawua kishomi oo ltung'ana laainei, eewuo Yerusalem.
Milimu ena te Gat minchir aitasim ore tiatua Betlefara mperiperayu te nterit.
Eima enkoitoi inyi iloomanya Shafir, te masipaisho o te nkurruna; mepuonu lelo oomanya Saanan emipuonu aaipang'u; Ore enkishirata e Betesel naa kaiwuang'ie te iyie enkitashoto enye.
Amu ore lelo oomanya Marot neanyisho te yieunoto oleng amu etoduaa entorroni eing'uaa Olaitoriani nelotu nchomito e Yerusalem.
Enteen ingarrin oo mbartan iloomanya Lakish; intae apa enkiterunoto oo ng'ok nirikokiki Yerusalem, amu tiatua iyie enotoki inkitarruorrot e Israel.
Ore enkaraki ina ilo iyie aisho nkishoorot ole sere Moreshetgat; ore nkajijik e Akisib naa keaku entoki nalejisho, too laiguanak le Israel.
Kaigil nanu ayau oloisulie shumata intae, iloomanya Maresha; ore enkitoo oo Siraeli nelotu Adulam.
Entabarn ilukuny inyi inchirakiki nena kera ninyorrinyorro; nchoo esipayu ilukuny inyi, anaa ilkurragoso, amu kepuo inkera inyi eyararoto.
Woi ninche lelo ooipiru entorroni neas entorroni too rruatin enye! Ore ake pee ekenyu neas ina naiguanutua, amu engolon oo nkaik enye etii.
Eng'uar ninche nkurman neya ninche; neng'uar nkajijik neya ninche; eibooki ninche oltung'ani enkop o enkaji enye, o ltung'ani o enjung'ore enye.
Ore enkaraki ina nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura kagilunore nanu ele marei aipiru entorroni ometaa mindimidimi aaibelekenya imurto inyi. Nimintokiki aapuo te nkitokoos amu keaku enkata e ntorroni.

Ore teina olong nerany ninche osinkolio le nkitumusumuset te nkaraki iyie, neishir ninche te nkishirata e mion ejo, “Eidaikieki iyiook katukul, eibelekenya ninye erubata oo ltung'ana laainei; eiwuang'ie ninye te nanu! Tiatua lelo ootaraitie iyiook etooro ninye nkurman ang.”
Ore enkaraki ina mintoki aata hoo obo onang'aa enkopito te oshoto e nkukuo, tiatua eumata o Laitoriani.
“Mintoki naa alimu irorei le naibon.” Ejo ninche elimu ilomon, “Meishiaakino nelimu oltung'ani ilomon le kuna baa; meinepu iyiook esulare.”
Keimakini ena na aji e Yakobo? Aimeeta Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani eng'iriata? Ke nkiaasin enyena kuna? Aimeeta enaitaas irorei laainei ilo olo too sipat?
Kake itudumakine iyie iltung'ana laainei anaa olmang'atinta; nioru olkila ilo oata eseriani, lelo oopuo eisiligayu lelo lemeeta ndamunot o larrabal.
Ore nkituaak oo ltung'ana laainei, niaraa boo, aitung'uaa ninche nkajijik enye sidain, nintung'uaa ninche nkera enye kutiti, nintung'uaa enkitoo ai ntarasi.
Tudumunye shomo amu mme ewueji neyeng'iyeng'areki ene, te nkaraki olduruk omutisho, te nkidaaroto torrono.
Tenelo oltung'ani airo mbaa e nkijape o elejare, ejo, “Kaaibonoki nanu iyie enaisho oo sabibu o enaisho napi?” Neidim ninye ataa olalikioroni lele orere!
Esipa kalo nanu aiturrur intae Yakobo, kaiturrur nanu ilo pisiai loo Siraeli kapik nanu ninche te nebo anaa eluaata nabo, anaa ntare te ndaata te nkilepilep olorora loo ltung'ana.
Ore ilo obol elusie, neituruk alo te dukuya ninche, nepuo ninche aaim kishomi, neipang auluo aaim ine. Olaiguanani lenye nelo dukuya ninche, Olaitoriani otii endukuya enye.
Atejo nanu: entoning intae ilukuny e Yakobo o larikok le nkaji e Israel! Aimeishiaakino intae niyiolouu esipata,
intae ilooiba esupatisho ninyorrinyorro entorroni, intae ilooyieng iltung'ana laainei, nirishushu nkiri enye too loik lenye
intae ilooinos nkiri oo ltung'ana laainei, nenang'aa ilonito lenye aaidie ninche, nigiligili iloik lenye aaitaa ng'iligilat, nigiligil anaa iloik oopiki emoti, netiu anaa nkiri naatii emoti.
Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani, kake mewaliki ninye ninche; eisudoo ninye enkomom enye te ninche teina rishata, enkaraki naitaa ninche nkiaasin enye torrok.
Nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo lelo oibonok ooitapong'oo iltung'ana laainei. Lelo ooishir aajo, “Eseriani” ina kata eeta ninche endaa nainos, neitayu olarrabal te ilo lemeeta endaa naisho meinosa.
Ore enkaraki ina, kemutu te ntae nimintokiki aata nduaat nemisimisu te ntae nimintokiki aata nkitumusumusot. Kedoyio enkolong too loibonok, neman emisimisi ninche;
ore lelo aduaak netusulaki, neitukurruni lelo aitumusumusok; kepuo pooki aaiken nkutukie enye, amu metii ewalata naing'uaa Enkai.
Kake ore nanu, aaiputa engolon, o Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani, te sipata o te nkidimata, pee aibalakinye Yakobo enkitapong'oto enye, naibalekinye Israel eng'oki enye.
Entoning ena, intae ilarikok le nkaji e Israel, intae ooibooyo esipata, nimbelekenyenye enkiguana nasipa.
Ilo oshet Sion to sarge neshet Yerusalem te ntorroni.

Edung ilarikok lenye enkiguana te ropare, neiteng'enisho ilapolosak lenye te laakinoto, neibonisho iloibonok lenye too ropiyiani; eji neigarakino ake sii Olaitoriani ejo, “Aimetii Olaitoriani atua iyiook? Meetae entorroni nalotu shumata iyiook.”
Ore naa te nkaraki iyie kepuoi aatur Sion anaa enkurma; keaku Yerusalem osototi le nkidaata; neaku ilo doinyo le nkaji entim.
Ore too nkolong'i e siadi, ore ilo doinyo le nkaji o Laitoriani neitasheyieki anaa oldoinyo ooado aisul neilepieki aaitulusoo too ldoinyo nepuo iltung'ana kumok ine.

Naa kepuonu iloshon kumok nejo: “Wootu mailepa aapuo oldoinyo lo Laitoriani, maape enkaji e Nkai e Yakobo; pee etum ninye aiteng'ena iyiook nkoitoi enyena, nikipuo iyiook too rrekiei lenyena.” Amu Sion epukunye enkitanapata, neing'uaa ororei lo Laitoriani Yerusalem.

Keiguanare ninye iloreren kumok nedung'oki enkiguana iloshon oogol oo lakua; neidong ninche ilalema lenye aaitaa ntokitin naaturishoreki neitaa iremeta enye ntokitin naasilieki enkurma; nemeitoki olosho adumaki olosho olalem, nemeigil aekata aaitamok ate olarrabal.
Kake kelo ake pooki tung'ani oton tiabori osabibu lenye o tiabori olng'aboli lenye, nemeetae oloiture ninche; amu enkutuk o Laitoriani loo lororani nairoro.
Amu epuoito iltung'ana pooki, oltung'ani ake te nkarna e Nkai enye. Kake eikipuo iyiook te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ang ntarasi o ntarasi.
Ore kenya teina olong Olaitoriani ojo, naa kalo nanu aiturrur ilmaiman, naiturrur lelo apa ootarayioki o lelo apa laaisilisilo.
Ore lelo maiman naitaa nanu olpisiai oleku; ore lelo apa ooiturrayioki, naitaa olorere ogol; nelo Olaitoriani aitore ninche to ldoinyo le Sion; ebaiki ena kata o ntarasi.
Naa ore iyie lo talet loo ntare, na doinyo e Yerusalem, iyie kenya epukunye, iyie epukunye enkitoria nalotu, ina kitoria e ntito e Yerusalem.
Kainyoo naa pee inchir abuaku? Aimetii olaiguanani atua iyie keidaa olautaroni lino, eji metaa kitijing'a emion anaa enkitok nasaisai?

Temerregelayu ning'or aishir, Yerusalem, anaa enkitok nasaisai; amu ore taata naa ilo aing'uaa ena anasa, nilo abik teinakop naisiaja ilo iyie Babilon. Naa teine kipuoi aakordu, teine kilo Olaitoriani alaku iyie aitung'uaa nkaik oo lmang'ati linono.
Eiturrurrote taata iloshon kumok, pee kigilunore iyie ejo, “Nchoo ninye eisarkionieki, naa nchoo nkonyek ang eing'or Sion.”
Kake meyiolo ninche ndamunot o Laitoriani, mening'u ninche nkitobirat enyena nchere eiturrurro ninche anaa suut to lkurroto oidong'ishoreki.

Tudumunye ndong'o ninche Yerusalem, amu kaitaa nanu emowuo ino esekenkei, naitaa iloisotok linono osuyai; iar iyie iloreren kumok aitaa mpurdat, ore imasaa enye nintisinyaki Olaitoriani. Ore enkarsisisho enye nintisinyaki Olaitoriani le nkop pooki.
Eitamanaki intae esuntai, etamanaki iyiook aamuat te ng'udi, etoosho ninche eseder o Laitoriani le Israel.

Kake ore iyie Betlehem Efrata, iyie ora kiti too lgilat le Yuda, iyie epukunye ilo olotu te nkaraki nanu, ilo olo aaku Olaitoriani loo Siraeli; ilo laa ore enkiterunoto enye naa e niopa, ebaiki nkolong'i e moitie.
Ore enkaraki ina, kepalaa ninye ninche ometabau ina kata, pee eiu ina nanuta ninye, netum taa ilalashera lenyena pooki aatorrinyokinoto iltung'ana le Israel.
Naa keitashe ninye aitoti nkerra enyena te ngolon o Laitoriani te nkitoo e nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai enye.
Naa kelo ninye ayau eseriani. Pee kitum iyiook aatudumakinoto ninye ilchekuti oopishana, o ltung'ana isiet kituaak loo ltung'ana.
Kepuo ninche aaitore enkop e Asiria to lalem, neitore enkop e Nimrod te nchutati o lalem; naa kepuo ninche aakordu iyiook too le Siria, tenepuonu ninche enkop ang nepuonu aaituny ilpolosien lang.
Netum taa ilo pisiai le Yakobo atijing'a empolos oo ltung'ana kumok, anaa enkoileelio naing'uaa Olaitoriani, anaa enchan nashaiki nkujit nemeanyu iltung'ana anaa nkera e tung'ana.

Naa kelo ilo pisiai le Yakobo aaku tenebo iloshon, nejing empolos oo ltung'ana kumok netiu anaa olng'atuny otii atua ing'uesi e ntim, anaa olkuoo lo lng'atuny o tiatua eluaata oo nkerra, naa teneimaa atua nenang'ie enkop; neitaa ndung'udung'ot, nemeetae olokordu.
Kepuoi aailepie enkaina ino te shumata ilmang'ati linono, ore ilmang'ati linono pooki naa keiwuang'ieki.
Ore kenya teina olong Olaitoriani ojo, naa kaiwuang'ie nanu mbartan inyi aitung'uaa intae, naidaikie ngarrin inyi oo mbartan;
naa kaiwuang'ie nanu nena anas e nkop inyi nauroo lelo sempewueti linyi pooki;
naiwuang'ie nanu esakutore te nkop inyi, niming'iligili aekata aata esakutore.
Naa kaiwuang'ie nanu nkitanyaanyukot inyi, naiwuang'ie ng'apeta inyi te ntae, niming'iligili intae aairrugokino esiaai oo nkaik inyi;
naa kadotu nanu Asherim inyi aiwuang'ie tiatua intae naidaikie nkanas inyi.
Naa ore te ngoro o te ngoro napi naitalaku elap, te lelo oshon leitu ening'isho.
Toning'o enajo Olaitoriani: “Tudumunye, tasaisho te dukuya ildoinyo, nincho ndoinyo metoning'o oltoilo lino.
Entoning intae lo doinyo, enchankar o Laitoriani, o ntae ilkitamanyunot oo bikoo te nkop; amu eeta Olaitoriani enchankar o ltung'ana lenyena, naa kelo ninye aitang'or Israel.
“Lo tung'ana laainei, kaa nanu aitaasa intae? Kainyoo nanu aitanaurie intae? Entawalikiaki nanu!
Amu ayawua nanu intae ailepunye te nkop e Misiri, nalaku intae te nkaji e sinkaisho; nairriu nanu Musa meshomo te dukuya intae, o Aron, o Miriam.

Lo tung'ana laainei, entadamu ina apa naipirua Balak olaiguanani le Moab, o ina natawalikia Balaam olayioni le Boer ninye, o ina nataasa ebaiki Shitim o metabaiki Gilgal pee itumutumu aatayiolo iasat naaitajeusho o Laitoriani.
“Kainyoo nanu ayau dukuya Olaitoriani, nalotu airrugo te dukuya Enkai natii shumata aisul? Kalotu nanu dukuya ninye oo lasarri oopejori too lasho lo lari obo?

Keitiship Olaitoriani ilmeregeshi enkalifu nabo, o lkejek enkalifu nabo le ilata? Kaishooyo nanu olkikau lai te nkaraki nkitarruorrot aainei, ilo ng'anayioi lo sesen lai te nkaraki eng'oki o ltau lai?”
Kintoduaa ninye iyie lo tung'ani embae sidai o ina nayieu Olaitoriani te iyie, pee ias esipata ninyorru isupati nilo te mborron tenebo Enkai ino?
Eishiraki oltoilo lo Laitoriani enkanasa naa eng'eno nagut teneurei enkarna enye: “Toning'o lo osho o eumata ena anasa.
Ilchumat le nkarruoisho tiatua enkaji o larruoni, o ina temet natii elejare naata oldeket?
Kapalaa nanu oltung'ani oata entemet naineneng'ishoreki e lejare o lbene otii isoito ooineneng'ishoreki le lejare?
Eeta ilkarsisi linono olarrabal; neiro lelo le nkop ino elejare, neeta ilng'ejepa lenye elejare.
Ore enkaraki ina, aaiterua nanu aosh iyie, naitomijoon te nkaraki ing'ok inono.
Ilo iyie adaa nimiraposho naa kelo olameyu atii iwuejitin inono e atua. Inteng'el iyie kake mintagol, ore ina ninteng'el nemeaku. Ore ina nisudoo aiteng'el naisho nanu metara olalem.
“Iun iyie kake minkes; iramat iyie iloirienito kake mielare eilata enye; Irony iyie isabibu, kake miok enaisho enye.

Amu imbung'a iyie nkikoot e Omri, o siaaitin pooki e nkaji e Ahab; nimbung'a iyie nkikoot enye, pee aatum nanu aitaa iyie olmuaate naitaa emanyisho ino entoki naimakini; neaku inap iyie esukeny oo ltung'ana.”

Woi nanu, amu atotiwuo anaa enkata naiturrurri ilng'anayio le nkata e nkirowuaj anaa enkata naikesi isabibu, eitu eleku toki naidimi aainosa meetae nkimarrimarrat oo lng'abolo le nkiterata ooshipakino oltau lai.
Eidaayie oltung'ani le Nkai te nkop, nemeetae oltung'ani supat too ltung'ana eirragita pooki aanyu embukoroto o sarge, nerresh ake pooki tung'ani olalashe to rreshet.
Kaarriyiak pooki too mbaa e ntorroni,, eikilikuanu olkitok o ladung'oni le nkiguana eropare, ore oltung'ani kitok neimaiki ntorrok naang'uar oltau lenye; nena ninche eas tenebo.

Ore ilo supat aisul te ninche netiu anaa enkaitubului nemeeta tipat, ore ilo lenye oji olasipani netiu anaa olpaashe loo lkiku. Etabawua enkata naitame Enkai iltung'ana anaa enaikoo too larripok lenye. Etataana taata olmilo lenye.
Mipik osiligi lino ole latia, niming'arakino olchore; torripo enkutuk ino teina nikilej etii olgoo lino;
amu keitaas olayioni menye mbaa e sulare, nedumakino entito ng'otonye, nedumakino entito nayamaki enkaputani; ore ilmang'ati lo ltung'ani naa lelo le nkaji enye makewan.
Kake ore nanu, kaing'or Olaitoriani naanyu nanu Enkai e njeunoto ai; kaaning nanu Enkai ai.
Mikishipakino nanu, lo mang'atinta lai; tenabatata nanu naa kadumunye; tenaton nanu te naimin, neaku Olaitoriani ewang'an te nkaraki nanu.

Kang'iri nanu engoro o Laitoriani, amu ataasa nanu eng'oki tialo ninye, ometaba anaa naamitu ninye, naadung'oki ninye nanu enkiguana. Kaayau ninye nanu enetii ewang'an naa kaing'or nanu enkordunoto enye.
Nedol taa olmang'atinta lai, neiput enkurruna teina naatiaaka nanu, “Koree Olaitoriani Enkai ino?” Neing'or nkonyek aainei ninye; naa kepuoi aaitunyoki ninye enkop, anaa esarng'ab e nkoitoi.
Enkolong nashetieki isunta inono! Ore teina olong naa kepuoi aaitalala ilpolosien aaponaa.
Ore teina olong naa kepuonu enitii eing'uaa Asiria o metabaiki Misiri, o ebaiki enaiposha ometabaiki enaiposha, o ebaiki oldoinyo ometabaiki oldoinyo.
Kake keaku enkop mijooni te lelo oo manya, te nkaraki ilng'anayio loo nkiaasin enye.
Taramata iltung'ana linono te ng'udi ino, ina luaata e njung'ore ino, oobik maate tiatua entim, te mpolos e nkurma eina kop. Nchoo ninche edaa te Bashan o te Gilead, anaa apa too nkolong'i e apa.
Anaa apa too napa olong'i nitupukunye te Misiri, kaitodol nanu ninche mbaa e nking'asia.
Kedol iloshon nekurru te nkidimata enye pooki; neibung ninche nkutukie enye too nkaik, neming'anu nkiyiaa enye;

nemej ninche enterit anaa olasurai, anaa nkeenta e nkop; nepuonu ninche eikirikira eing'uaa isempewueti lenye; neibelekenyakino ninche to lkirutoto Olaitoriani Enkai ang, neureishoyu ninche te nkaraki iyie.
Kaa Ai natiu anaa iyie, apalaki ntorrok, negiroo nkitarruorrot te nkaraki olpisiai le njung'ore enye? Meibung ninye engoro enye ntarasi amu keshipakino ninye enyorrata nauno.
Keigil ninye atum olng'ur te nkaraki iyiook, neitunyoo ninye ntorrok ang too nkejek enyena. Inturraa iyie ing'ok ang, anang'aki enguton e naiposha.
Intodolu iyie esupatisho o enkisiligata te Yakobo, nintodolu enyorrata nauno te Abraham anaa apa eninosa olmumai too loo papa ebaiki nkolong'i e apa moitie.
Olkilikuai ele oipirta Ninawi. Embuku ena oo nduaat e Nahum le Elkosh.
Ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai o lom neitalaku elap, eitalaku Olaitoriani elap neeta engoro napi, eitalaku Olaitoriani elap too lmang'ati lenyena, negorokino ilmang'ati lenyena.
Mesioki Olaitoriani agoro neeta enkidimata kitok, nemeeta kata nemeitalaku Olaitoriani entorroni. Ore enkoitoi enye naa olkutati o siwuo, ore nkatampo naa enterit oo nkejek enyena.
Eisikong ninye enaiposha neitoi, eitoi ninye ilkejek pooki neitoi Bashan o Karmel, ore ina kishiaa e sikar e Lebanon netoyu.
Eikirikira ildoinyo te dukuya ninye, neshola ndoinyo; neirrag enkop eitomijoonoki te dukuya ninye, o enkop o pooki namanya atua ninye.
Kaing'ae oidim aitasho te dukuya engoro enye? Kaing'ae oidim ating'iriakiyu enkirowuaj e ngoro enye? Etubukuoki engoro enye napi anaa enkima, netebelaki ndapidapo aaidapash te dukuya ninye.
Aisupat Olaitoriani osempewuet ninye te nkolong e nyamali; eyiolo ninye lelo oosaru ninye.
Kake to loirrag le nkare nadooyo eishie ninye tukul ilmang'ati lenyena, nemir ilmang'ati lenyena amiraki enaimin.
Kainyoo iyie irreshie Olaitoriani? Eikindaikie ninye iyie, meetae hoo obo ogilunore ninye katitin are.
Kemuti ninche anaa orrarrati loo lkiku, anaa olkujita otoyio.
Keitu elotu obo oing'uaa atua iyie Ninawi, oitobira entorroni tialo Olaitoriani, neitobir ilosekin loo ntorrok?
Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Ore hoo negol ninche naa kumok keiwuang'ieki ninche neitarasari. Ore hoo naaisilisilo nanu iyie maaigil nanu aisilisil iyie.
Kagil taata nanu enchata enye oo murto aiwuang'ie te iyie nadung inkeenta nikiteenieki iyie aidapash.”

Eishorua Olaitoriani enkitanapata nikimpirta iyie: “Meigili aekata aadumu enkarna ino; kaiwuang'ie nanu te nkaji oo nkaitin inono, enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naguetuno o ina nasholuno. Kaitobir nanu enkurare ino amu ira iyie arruoni.”

Ng'ura roruat enyena too ldoinyo, eilo oyau ilomon supati, ilo olimu eseriani! Imbung'a isiruai linono iyie, Yuda, intabai ilmuma linono, amu mikingil aekata olarruoni agilunore iyie, eiwuang'ieki ninye tukul.
Kiewuo olainyalani arasaki iyie Ninawi, intagolo iltimito, ing'ura enkoitoi terretena empolos ino; enturrurro engolon inyi pooki.
(Amu kerrinyu Olaitoriani enkishiaa e nkitoo e Yakobo. Anaa enkishiaa e nkitoo e Israel, amu eibung'a apa ilainyalak ninche, neinyal ilng'osil lenye.)

Ore ina long'o oo ltung'ana lenye magil naa kenyokie, neishopito isikarini lenye nkilani pilei neiwuang ngarrin enyena oo mbartan anaa olng'ejep le nkima, teneipotuni olarrabal neitureisho lelo ookuetu.
Neruko ngarrin oo mbartan too nkoitoi e nkanasa nepuo idia alo neitu ena alo too wuejitin neetumoreki e nkanasa. Neiwuang'u te nkimerlel anaa sitimani, neimerlel anaa nkiwuang'at e nchan.
Neipotuni lelo kituaak, nerrorro ninche epuoito, nekuetiki ninche esuntai, neidipaki aaitoluaa iloketa.
Etaboloki nchmito o lkeju neiput enkaji e nkitoo enkuretisho.
Ore ina aiguanani enye, etooruoki ilkilani, etanapaki aaya, neishirita nkaisiayak enyena neishir anaa nturkuluoni, neoshiosh ilgooitie lenye.
Eikununo Ninawi anaa olchorro oruko enkare enye neishir ninche aajo, “Ntasho! Ntasho!” Kake meetae olorrinyunye.
Ewaita enkosholai! Ewaita saabu! Meeta olchumati eneiting'ie anaa karsisisho e pooki toki e tipat.
Olmuaate! Emijoonisho o enkidaata! Etalepori iltauja, neikirikira nkejek, eiputa olkirutoto mpolosi enye pooki, neipusita nkomomi enye pooki!
Koree enkapune oo lng'atunyo ina apune oo lkuoo loo lng'atunyo ine neyau olng'atuny eng'ues nataara, ine netii nkiyioitin enyena nemeeta entoki naitanyamal?
Eibung'a olng'atuny eng'ues nanya neyiataa ina ng'ues neyaki ilkuoo lenyena, negor ina meinosa iliponga enyena. Neiput enkapune enye ing'uesi naatara ninye neiput isanagi lenyena nkiri.

Kaagilunore nanu iyie, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kapejoo ngarrin inono oo mbartan te mpuruo nemut olalem lelo ng'atunyo linono ooti; Kaiwuang'ie nanu nena ng'uesi inono te nkop. Nemeigili aekata aaning oltoilo loo lkiliku linono.
Woi ena anasa o sarge, ebore elejare o enkisima nemeiting aekata eyararoto enye!
Entoning endarata e oshoto e nkeene, o ltoilo loo nkejek oo ngarrin enkuetata oo mbartan o elototo oo ngarrin oo mbartan!
Ekuetu ilakedok loo mbartan, eimerlel ilalema neiwuang'u iremeta, olorora olo aye osototi loo mpopoki. Meeta eneiting'ie mpopoki enye nerrorro ninche te nena popoki enye!
Ninawi! Itotiwuo iyie anaa emulayoi te nkaraki ina kiborrra oo nkonyek, nisakutisho niata esulare, nikaldaa iloshon te nkiborra oo nkonyek, nikaldaa iloreren too ntaleng'o inono.
Ng'ura kaagilunore nanu iyie, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kadumu nanu olkila lino lirrotianita apik enkomom ino, naisho nanu iloshon metoduaa emasipaisho ino, nedol nkitoriat enkurruna ino.
Kaairriwaki nanu iyie olduruk naaitaas iyie mbaa e sulare, naitaa entoki torrono naing'asiakinoi.
Ore lelo pooki liking'or iyie, nikilam ejo, “Etumute Ninawi; kaing'ae naishiraki ninye? Kaji nanu atumie iltung'ana ooitagol ninye?”
Ira supat alang Tebes, apa natotona te mbata e Nail, neman enkare ninye, anaa enaiposha esuntai olpaashe lenye?
Etiopia apa o Misiri engolon enye, nemeeta engolon enye enkiting'oto; Ilaretok lenyena apa ile Libia.

Ore ake eyia etaarayioki ninye, neyae meshomo ninye eyararoto, ore nkera enyena neitaaki ndung'udung'ot, te nkiterunoto e pooki oitoi kitok, amu etooshoki enkukuo oo ltung'ana lenyena ooyanyiti, ore iltung'ana lenyena pooki kituaak eteenaki too lpisia.
Ilo sii iyie amera, ilo sii iyie aisudori, nilo aing'oru, enkisudoroto te nkaraki ilmang'ati.
Ore isempewueti linono pooki, neikununo anaa ilng'abolo, ooto ilng'anayio le dukuya teneipiripiri, nerrarrunye, aadoiki enkutuk eilo onya.
Ng'ura ilturrurri linyi ajo nkituaak naatii empolos inyi. Ore nchomito e nkop inyi naa kebolo aang'a too lmang'ati linyi, einosa enkima isekenke inyi.
Entooku enkare enterreten emanata inyi, entagolo isempewueti linyi, enchom atua enterit entunyo esarng'ab, embung'a entobira enkitobirata oo lmatofali.
Eikilo enkima anya teine, eikilo olalem ashurt nikimut iyie anaa olmaati. Entoponai ate anaa lmaat, entoponari anaa ntargeet!
Itoponaiyie ilamirak linono aitulusoo too lakir le shumata. Eisalaash olmaati inaipuko nepuo.

Eikununo ilkituaak linono anaa ntargeet neikununo ilaigerok linono pooki anaa emus o lmaat, neirragita too lpaashen te nkolong e nkirobi ore ake pee eilepu enkolong, nelaari aapuo; meetae oltung'ani oyiolo enetii ninche.
Eirura ilairritak linono, lo aiguanani le Asiria; neimug iltung'ana linono kituaak. Eidapashate iltung'ana linono too ldoinyo, nemeetae oloiturrurr ninche.
Meetae enkishiunoto too lbaa linono, aitorrono oleng olbae lino. Ore lelo pooki ooning mbaa inono, neosh nkaik te nkaraki iyie. Amu kaing'ae eitu ebaiki ina torroni ino nemeish aekata?
Olkilikuai lo Laitoriani ele otoduaa oloiboni le Nkai oji Habakuk.
Iyie Olaitoriani, ke nkata nabaa aishir nanu te nkaraki eretoto, nimining iyie? Aishir nanu ajo, “olarrabal!”, Neitu iyie kintajeu?
Kainyoo iyie pee kincho nanu matoduaa ntorrok, naing'or enyamali? Etii enkidaata o larrabal dukuya nanu; naatudumakine enyamali o enchankar.
Etaa enkitanapata pesho nemeas aekata esipata esiaai amu etamuata iltorrok aaman lelo loo sipat, neaku keibelekenyi esipata.
Ing'ura atua iloshon, pee idol; ning'asia nimputukuny. Amu aasita nanu esiaai too nkolong'i inyi, nimindimidimi intae aairuko tenelikini intae.
Amu eng'ura, kailepunye nanu Ilkaldayo ilo osho odua neisosion, nelo aibulu enkop pooki, nepuonu aaya imanyishoritin neme nkunenye.
Iltung'ana ooitureisho ninche; ore isipat enye o nkiguanat enye naa ninche maate epukunye.

Eneneng mbartan enye aalang ilowuarak kerin, nepi aalang isuyian le nteipa; ore lakedok lenye loo mbartan nenyok oleng to lwuasa. Ee enelakua eing'uaa lakedok lenye loo mbartan, nepuo tiai anaa olkurragos oipirri alo anya eng'ues.
Eetuo pooki te nkaraki olarrabal; neirut pooki ng'ae teina rasakinoto. Neiturrur ninche iyarunot anaa osinyai.
Ore te dukuya ilaiguanak nesukenyisho ninche. Ore ilaitoriak neiguranie ninche. Ekueniyie ninche pooki sempewuet, amu kerup ninche enterit neya ine.
Nepuo ninche neor enkop epuo anaa olkutati, aapuo ninche eeta entioto, kulo tung'ana ooitaa engolon enye enkai enye.

Aimira iyie oloo ntarasi, iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai, lo Sinyati lai? Mikiye iyiook, Olaitoriani itegelua iyie ninche aitaa iladung'ok le nkiguana; ore iyie na dapidapoi, nintasheyie ninche pee eitameisho.
Iyie oloata nkonyek sidain nemeidim aaing'ura entorroni nemeidim aaing'ura enkarruoisho, kainyoo iyie pee ing'or iltung'ana lemeisiligayu, nintirring'a iyie eijoo ilarruok, lelo supati aalang ninche.
Amu ntotiu iyie iltung'ana anaa sinkir le naiposha, anaa nena tokitin naaikurtutari nemeeta oloitore.
Eyau olmang'atinda ninche pooki to ltarge, neyietu ninche pooki to rreshet neiturruru ninche to rreshet lenye sapuk; netum taa atishipayu neitokoos.
Ore te nkaraki ina eitayio ninye olasar te nkaraki orreshet lenye, nepej enkorropil te nkaraki orreshet lenye sapuk; amu te nkaraki ninche pee eishu ninye te sikar, nepir endaa enye.
Keitayu ninye lelo ootii orreshet lenye, near ninye iloshon metuata nemeing'urrie ntarasi?
Kaitashe nanu te rishata ai arripisho. Naton nanu to ltalet orripishoreki naing'orisho nanu, pee adol ina naajoki ninye, o ina nawalu nanu tialo enking'unyung'uny ai.
Naawaliki nanu Olaitoriani ejo, “Ngero ena duaata; ngero mbalie too soito dapashi, pee etum oltung'ani aisuma elakua.
Amu eton ake eanyu enduaata enkata enye; kesieku ninye alotu erishata enye - nemelejisho ninye. Tenelioo ninye aa yietut, taanyu ninye, esipa kelotu ninye nemeimutie.
Ng'ura ajo ore ilo leme sidai oltau lenye, nemetum puaan, kake ore ilo asipani neishu te nkirukoto nairuk Enkai.”

Ore ake sii enkalejani enaisho; mebikoo ilo tung'ani oitokoos nelala olorok lenye eba anaa enemeneng'a; etiu anaa keeya meraposho aekata. Eiturrurroki ninye kewan iloshon pooki neiturrur iloreren pooki anaa iltung'ana lenyena makewan.
Aimeibelekenyakino kulo pooki ninye, neitalaku elap, nesukeny ninye ejo, “Woi ninye ilo osot ntokitin neme nenyena - ae te nkata nabaa ilo asotoki kewan elaakinoto oo silen?”
Aimedumunye lelo lintalak isilen nabo kata, ore lelo oodumunye nikinkirikirie iyie? Nilo iyie aaku oloyaruno te ninche.
Ore te nkaraki nimbung'a araya iloshon kumok, eikimbung iyie aaraya ilo pisiai oleku loo ltung'ana te nkaraki osarge loo ltung'ana o larrabal te nkop, too nkanas e lelo pooki oomanya atua.
Woi ninye ilo otum tumoto e ntorroni te nkaji enye, ilo oilepunye orreshet lenye, pee medoiki entorroni!
Mpiraka iyie enkaji ino enkurruna, ore teine niwuang'ie iloreren kumok ninturrayie enkishui ino makewan.
Amu keishir osoit te suntai, neng'amaa iloom.
Woi ninye ilo oshetu enkang to sarge, neitayu enkanasa te ntorroni.
