Aime Olaitoriani loo lororani eing'uaa, nchere pee easisho iltung'ana te nkaraki enkima, neitanaur iloshon ate te mpesho?
Amu keyookini aaiput enkop, te ng'eno e nkitoo o Laitoriani, anaa enaibulua enkare enaiposha.
Woi ninye ilo oitook ile latia enye, enkikompe e ngoro enye, neitemer ninche, pee etum atishila enkurruna enye!

Eikipuoi iyie aaishopoki esulare te rishata e nkitoo, tookisho iyie, nimerrimerrari. Ore enkikompe natii enkaina e tatene o Laitoriani, naa keitamanuni aayau enitii, nelotu enkurruna shumata enkitoo ino!
Ore olarrabal oitayioki te Lebanon naa eikimisie iyie; Ore enkidaata oo ng'uesi naa eikirutie iyie, te nkaraki ilo sarge loo ltung'ana o larrabal te nkop, nejing'aki nkanas o lelo pooki oomanya atua.

Kaa dupoto eeta enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai, teneidip olaitobirani lenye aitobiru, enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai e sekenkei, olaiteng'enani le lejare? Amu keisilig oloasisho ina kitobirunoto naitobirua ninye, nemeitobiru ninye nkitanyaanyukot nemeiro!
Woi ninye ilo ojoki enchata, inyo; nejoki osoit lemeiro, tudumunye! Ng'ura ajo etumuraki ninye te saabu o te nkosholai, kake metii enkiyang'et tukul atua ninye.
Kake etii Olaitoriani atua enkaji enye Sinyati; nchoo enkop pooki eitirring'a te dukuya ninye.
Enkomono ena e Habakuk oloiboni le Nkai, te risioroto e Shiginot.

Iyie Olaitoriani, atoning'o nanu mbaa inono, ore esiaai ino, iyie Olaitoriani, kaure nanu. Ore te mpolos oo larin ntopiu iyie ninye ore te mpolos oo larin nchoo metayiolouni; ore te ngoro, tadamu olng'ur.
Eewuo Enkai te Teman, nelotu ilo obo Sinyati eing'uaa oldoinyo le Paran. Neiput enkitoo shumata, neiput enkop e nkisisa enye.
Ore enkimerlel enye netiu anaa ewang'an, neng'orunye ewang'an te nkaina enye; ore teine neimulumul engolon enye.
Nelo olbuket te dukuya ninye, nesuju olmeitai ninye etaaniki.

Eitashe ninye netem endapasho e nkop; neing'orisho ninye neiposhiposh iloreren, neitokini aaidapash lelo doinyo ootii atua. Ore lelo doinyo loo ntarasi neidapasha ore nena doinyo oo ntarasi nedoyio aaimis. Ore nkoitoi enyena naa iniapa moitie.
Atoduaa nanu ilng'oborri le Kushan tiatua emion ore iltung'ana le Midian neikirikira.
Itagorokine apa iyie ilkejek iyie Olaitoriani? Itagorokine iyie ilkejek anaa ke naiposha igilunore. Pee itakedo iyie mbartan inono, nena bartan inono e nkishuroto.
Itabolo iyie emootian ino, nipik mbaa empito e nkawuo. Imperra iyie enkop apik ilkejek.
Kidol iyie ildoinyo neikirikira, nenang'ari nkariak aaruko, ore enguton neitayu oltoilo lenye, nedumu nkaik enyena ailepie.
Neitashe enkolong o lapa too wuejitin enye, te wang'an e nkimerlel oo mbaa inono epuo etangoroyioki, o te nkimerlel e ina remet ino naimerlel.
Ntunyoyie iyie aimaa enkop te mpushuna, ntunyoyie iyie iloshon te ngoro.
Ishomo iyie te nkaraki enjeunoto oo ltung'ana linono, te nkaraki enjeunoto eilo litubukoko eilata aput. Itupurda iyie endukuya eilo arruoni, irragie ninye meishopo ebaiki enkupes o metabaiki emurt.
Itangoro iyie too mbaa inono endukuya oo lmurran lenyena, ilo oewuo anaa olkutati aidapash iyiook, neng'ida ninye anaa oloidaikie olaisinani te nkisudoroto.
Ntunyo iyie enaiposha too mbartan inono, ine wueji oo nkariak kumok.

Atoning'o nanu naikirikira, naaonyo enkutuk, teilo toilo latoning'o. Neng'uoyu iloik laainei tiatua nanu, neikirikira nkejek aainei. Kaitirring'a nanu aanyu enkolong e nyamali, pee elotu shumata lelo oorasaki iyiook.
Ore hoo nemeitapuku olng'aboli, nemeiu osabibu ilng'anayio, neimin ilng'anayio lo loirien, nemeiu nkurman endaa, neye iluaat oo ntare pooki neishunye nchoo too nkang'itie.
Ore ake eyia, kashipakino nanu Olaitoriani, kang'idakino nanu Enkai e njeunoto ai.
Enkai, Olaitoriani ninye engolon ai; neitotiu nkejek aainei anaa ine ntarakuet te neneng'i, naaidimie ninye maimai nchumat oo ldoinyo.
Ele ororei lo Laitoriani oishooki Sefania olayioni le Kushi, olayioni le Gedalia, olayioni le Amaria, olayioni le Hesekia, too nkolong'i e Yosia ilo ayioni le Amon, olaiguanani le Yuda.
“Kajutu nanu tukul pooki toki aiwuang'ie ti oriong enkop,” Olaitoriani ojo.

“Kajutu nanu tung'ani o eng'ues; kajutu nanu aiwuang'ie ntaritik o loing'ang'e o sinkir le naiposha. Kanang'aa nanu aiturraa lelo torrok; kaishie nanu iltung'ana, aiwuang'ie ti oriong e nkop,” Olaitoriani ojo.

“Kaitorioo nanu enkaina ai aarare Yuda, naarare sii lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem; naa kaishie nanu aiwuang'ie tene wueji ilo pisiai le nkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Baal o ina arna e lelo apolosak ooserem nkitanyaanyukot;
lelo ooirrugokino too nchumat oo nkajijik olorora le shumata; lelo ooirrugo neinosie Olaitoriani olmumai neitoki ake sii aainos olmumai te nkarna e nkai naji Milkom;
lelo ooibelekenyate ootapala esujata o Laitoriani, lelo lemeing'oru Olaitoriani anaa eikilikuanishore ninye.”
Ntirring'ayu te dukuya olaitoriani Enkai! Amu etataana enkolong o Laitoriani; eitobira Olaitoriani olasar neitisinya ilomon lenyena.
Naa ore teina olong o lasar lo Laitoriani, “Kaitame nanu lelo kituaak o lelo ayiok lo laiguanani o lelo pooki ooishopote too nkilani oo loreren.
Ore teina olong naitame nanu lelo pooki ooseremisho anaa iltung'ana lemeyiolo Enkai lelo oopurrisho near iltung'ana metuata pee etumi aaiputa nkajijik o lkitok lenye iyarunot.”
“Ore kenya teina olong,” Olaitoriani ojo, “Naa kening'i olkiyioi teina Kishomi o Sinkirri, eyietunoto e nkishirata naing'uaa Endung'oto e Are, esulunoto kitok too ldoinyo.
Enteyietu enchira intae iloomanya abori enkanasa e Yerusalem, amu etuata ilbiasharani! Ore lelo pooki ooasishore enkosholai nedung'ori aaiwuang'ie.
“Ore kenya teina olong naa kajur nanu Yerusalem too ltaai, naa kaitame nanu lelo tung'ana ooishiligate te okoto e naisho enye, oojo too ltauja lenye, ‘Meas Olaitoriani esidai nemeas entorrono.’
Keisimari imasaa enye, neitomijooni nkajijik enye. Ore hoo neshet ninche nkajijik, memany ninche; ore hoo neun ninche nkurman oo sabibu meok ninche enaisho enye.”
Ore ina olong kitok o Laitoriani netinyikua, etinyikua naa kesieku; kedua oltoilo le ina olong o Laitoriani, keyietu aishir oltung'ani magilani teine.
Enkolong e ngoro napi ina olong, enkolong o sina o emion, enkolong e nkidaata o emutata, enkolong e naimin o enkimuntut, enkolong oo nkatampo o enaimin nagut,
enkolong e oshoto e ntarumpeta o lkiyioi lo larrabal, egilunore nena anas naasheta isunta negilunore iltaleta lo larrabal.

Kayau nanu osina shumata iltung'ana, o metaa kepuo ninche anaa ilmodook, te nkaraki nataasa ninche eng'oki ti alo Olaitoriani; keibukori osarge lenye anaa enterit, nepurrdi inkiri oo seseni lenye anaa emodiei.

Mekordu ninche enkosholai enye aashu saabu enye teina olong e ngoro o Laitoriani. Ore tiatua enkima e ina goro enye o lom, keinosi aamut enkop pooki; amu te nkiting'oto nara ee enkiting'oto naluamisho keiting'ie ninye asioki lelo pooki oomanya enkop.
Enturrurroto, Enturrurroto ele osho lemedol enkurruna,
eton eitu kirewi anaa nguetat, eton eitu elotu shumata iyie engoro napi o Laitoriani, eton eitu elotu shumata iyie ina olong e ngoro o Laitoriani.
Eng'oru Olaitoriani, intae pooki oobor lena kop, lelo ooibung inkitanapat enyena; eng'oru esupatisho, eng'oru emborron; pee eidimayu neisudori intae teina olong e ngoro o Laitoriani.
Keing'uari Gasa, naa keaku Ashkelon mijooni; nearari iltung'ana le Ashdod enaipirie enkolong, nedotuni Ekron.
Woi intae iloomanya olomanaa le naiposha, intae ilo osho le Kereti! Eipirare intae ororei lo Laitoriani, iyie Kanaan na kop oo Lfilisti; kaidurukie nanu intae o metaa meleku ninye obo.
Ore iyie, Lo omanaa le naiposha, naa iaku endaata oo ntare, ilookeri loo lchekuti o muatat oo luaat oo ntare.

Keaku olomanaa le naiposha ewueji e ilo pisiai otelekua le nkaji e Yuda, naa ninye eirritishore ninche, ore tiatua nkajijik e Askelon neirragie ninche teipa. Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai enye kedamu ninche neitopok ninche.
“Atoning'o nanu imorot e Moab o esukeny oo le Amon, ina natusukenya ninche iltung'ana laainei nerup ate ti alo enkop enye.

Neaku ore anaa enaishu nanu,” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, Enkai e Israel, “Ketiu Moab anaa Sodom, ore ile Amon netiu anaa Gomora, enkop oo suut o ngumot e munyan, neaku olmuaate ntarasi. Ore ilo pisiai otelekua loo ltung'ana laainei neraya ninche, ore ilo pisiai otelekua lo losho lai neya ninche.”
Ena eitalakuni te ninche to lwuasa lenye, te nkaraki natusukenya nerup ate ti alo iltung'ana lo Laitoriani loo lororani.
Kegilunore Olaitoriani ninche; keishie ninye nkaitin pooki e nkop, neaku ninye eirrugokinoi, pooki ake te wueji enye, nkuapi pooki oo loreren.
Ore sii intae, ile Etiopia, keari intae to lalem lai.
Naa keitorioo ninye enkaina enye aarare moikuape, neidaikie Asiria; neitaa ninye Ninawi olmuaate, ewueji netoyio anaa olpurkel.

Keirrag iluaat te mpolos enye, ing'uesi pooki e ong'ata; ore olmotonyi o enjolis nemany ilpaashen lenyena; neishiraki emotonyi oo nkiyiaa ilusien enye neru olkurruk te mbata e kishomi enye; ore nkeek oo lpaashen lenye neitomijooni.

Enkanasa naturupa kewan ena apa natobiko te seriani, apa najo ninye makewan, “Nanu ake nemeetae ae.” Ketaa ninye olmuaate anaa nyoo, ewueji neirragie ing'uesi e ntim! Ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo ninye neiputukuny nenunuk enkaina enye aikirikirie.
Woi ninye ina anasa e Yerusalem natogolong'ua, neiduruk, neitorogonyisho!
Mening ninye hoo likae toilo, meng'amaa ninye ererioroto enkikoo. Meisilig ninye Olaitoriani, menyikaki ninye Enkai enye.
Ore lelo kituaak lenyena ootii atua naa ilng'atunyo ooipur; ore ilarishak lenyena naa isuyian le nteipa lelo lemeing'uaa toki o mekenyu.
Pesho iloibonok lenyena, iltung'ana lemeeta enkirukoto; ore ilapolosak lenyena neisarkionie ine wueji sinyati, neinyala ninche nkitanapat.
Ore Olaitoriani otii atua ninye naa kaasipani, meitarruoo ninye; ore anaake tadekenya neitodolu ninye esupatisho e nkiguana enye, ore anaake ekenyu melai; kake ore lelo torrok nemedol enkurruna.
“Aiwuang'ie nanu iloshon; eidaaitie nkanas enye; aitomijoono nanu nkoitoi enye e nkanasa o metaa melo hoo oltung'ani aim ninche; eitaaki nkanas enye ilmuaateni, nemetii oltung'ani, nemetii olomanya.
Atejo nanu, ‘Esipa kaaureyu ninye, keng'amu ninye enkikoo; merikino ninye nena pooki naitanapa nanu ninye.’ Kake etoponari ninche eyieu neitarruoo nkiasin enye.”

“Metaa entaanyuaki nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo, “teina olong nadumunye nanu ara olchakeni. Amu ore enatudung'o nanu naa pee aiturrur nkuapi, pee aun nkitoriat, nabukoki ninche engoro ai, ina kirowuaj pooki e ngoro ai; amu teina kima e ngoro o lom lai emuti enkop pooki.
“Ee, teina kata kenya aibelekeny nanu nkutukie oo ltung'ana, aitaa nkirorot sidain, pee etum ninche pooki aaipoto enkarna o Laitoriani, neisiaai ninye to ltau obo.
Ebaiki te telido kekun lol lkejek le Etiopia aayaki nanu lelo laasai nkishoorot, ina tito oo looidapashari laainei.

“Ore kenya teina olong nimikintukurruni iyie te nkaraki nena kiasin nikitogolong'aka nanu; amu kaiwuang'ie nanu teina kata te mpolos inyi lelo linyi oowuasa oorup ate, nimintoki iyie awuasa te ilo doinyo lai sinyati.
Amu kaleku nanu tiatua iyie iltung'ana supati oobor. Naa keing'oru ninche enkisudoroto te nkarna o Laitoriani,
ore lelo ootelekuaki te Israel; nemeas ninche entorroni nemeiro elejare, nemetumi too nkutukie enye olng'ejep le lejare. Amu kedaa ninche neirrag nemeetae oloiture ninche.”
Tabuaku taranya, Yerusalem; tabuaku Israel! Ting'idayu nishipayu to ltau lino pooki, na tito e Yerusalem!
Eiwuang'ie Olaitoriani nena dungokinot e nkiguana ti alo iyie, etaarayie ninye ilmang'ati linono. Ilo aiguanani le Israel, Olaitoriani ninye otii empolos inyi; mingil aekata iyie aureyu entorroni.
Ore kenya teina olong naa keji te Yerusalem: “Miureshoyu iyie Sion; mincho nkaik inono elepori.

Olaitoriani, Enkai ino, otii empolos ino, olmurrani oishoru enkishuroto; eikishipakino ninye iyie te nchipai, eikintang'ejuk ninye iyie te nyorrata enye kepik ninye shumata iyie embuakunoto o sinkolio
anaa te nkolong o sirua. “Kaiwuang'ie nanu osina te iyie, pee mitum iyie esulare te ninye.

Ore kenya teina kata naa Kagilunore nanu lelo pooki likintorogong. Naa kaitajeu nanu lelo maiman naiturrurru lelo ooidapashari, naibelekeny nanu enkurruna enye metaa errepet, neyiolouni tiatua enkop pooki.

Ore kenya teina nalotu kata naa kayau nanu intae ang, teina kata naiturrur nanu intae te nebo; ee, kaisho nanu metayiolouni intae nerrepi tiatua iloreren pooki le nkop, teina kata nalo nanu arrinyoki karsisisho inyi dukuya nkonyek inyi,” Olaitoriani ojo.

Ore to lari li are le Dario ilo aiguanani le Pasia, to lapa le ile, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani aimu Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai, alotu enetii Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel, olgafanai le Yuda, o Yoshua olayioni le Yehosadak, ilo apolosani kitok.
“Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ejo kulo tung'ana inchere eton eitu ebau enkata pee eigili aashet enkaji o Laitoriani.”
Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu eimu Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai, ejo,
“Ke nkata naishiaakino nitonini intae tiatua nena ajijik inyi naaikodo too mbaoi, eton etii ena aji enkidaaroto.
Ore naa nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani; Entadamu eninkunariri intae.

Ituunishote oleng, ninkesikese nkuti; idaa intae, kake miraposhosho; niokishosho, kake miishushu aekata enkure; ninchopishopo ate, kake meetae oloirouaju; naa ore ilo ong'amu olekoisiaayio, neng'amu olekoisiaayio nepik embene naudo.
“Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Entadamu eninkunariri intae.
Elepa enchom ildoinyo niyauu ilkeek lishetietie ena aji, pee atum atishipakinoyu natum sii ataliooyu te nkitoo ai, Olaitoriani ojo.

Isiligutua intae nkumok, naa ng'ura, etaa kuti; ore pee iyauu intae ang, nakutaa nanu. Aainyo? Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo. Te nkaraki ena aji ai nairragita te nkidaaroto amijoonu, intanyamaluoluo maate oltung'ani ake te nkaji enye makewan.
Ore enkaraki ina, eibooyie keper natii shumata intae enkoileelio, ore enkop neibooyo ilng'anayio lenyena.
Naipotuo nanu olameyu meeu shumata enkop o ldoinyo, meeu shumata nkurman, o sabibu, o eilata, te nena pooki naabulu te nkop, too ltung'ana o nkishu, o too siaaitin enye pooki.”

Nesuj Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel, o Yoshua olayioni le Yehosadak, ilo apolosani kitok, te nebo nena lekunot oo ltung'ana ilo pisiai pooki loo ltung'ana ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai enye, o rorei le Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai anaa enairriwayie Olaitoriani Enkai enye ninye; neureishoyu iltung'ana te dukuya Olaitoriani.
Neitoki Hagai, ilo kilikuai lo Laitoriani, airorie iltung'ana to lkilikuai lo Laitoriani, ejo, “Atii nanu te nebo intae, ejo Olaitoriani.”

Neputu Olaitoriani enkiyang'et e Serubabel le Shealtiel, ilo balusui le Yuda, o enkiyang'et e Yoshua olayioni le Yehosadak, ilo apolosani kitok, o enkiyang'et e lelo lekunot pooki loo ltung'ana; nepuonu ninche aas esiaai e ina aji o Laitoriani loo lororani Enkai enye,
te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan o lapa, to lapa le ile.
Ore tiatua olari li are le nkitoria e Dario ilo aiguanani, to lapa li opishana, te nkolong e tikitam o obo o lapa, eeuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai
ejo, “Irorie taata Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel ilo balusui le Yuda, o Yoshua olayioni le Yehosadak, ilo apolosani kitok, o nena lekunot pooki oo ltung'ana, nijoki,
‘Kaing'ae etung'uayioki te intae, apa ootodua ena aji e Nkai te nkishiaa e nkitoo enye? Aidolitata taata intae etiu aja? Ae me pesho taata too nkonyek inyi?

Ore etiu neijia entagoluoto, iyie Serubabel, Olaitoriani ojo, ntagoluoyu, iyie Yoshua, olayioni le Yehosadak, ele olapolosani kitok, intagoluoyu intae lo tung'ana pooki lena kop, Olaitoriani ojo; entaasisho, amu atii nanu te nebo intae; Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo,
te risioroto oo nkisiligat apa naisiligie intae ipukuku te Misiri. Etii Enkiyang'et ai te nebo intae; emiureisho.
Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore ake sii, te nkiti rishata, naa kaikirikirie keper o enkop o enaiposha o enkop natoyio,
naikirikirie nanu iloreren pooki, ore ilchumat lenye neyauni ene neiput enkaji e Nkai esikar, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.
Enaai enkosholai naa enaai saabu, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.
Ore ina sikar nayooki alotu ena aji naa keaku kitok alang enapa, e dukuya Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa tiatua ene wueji aaishooyo nanu dupoto, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.’ ”
Ore te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan, o lapa li oudo to lari li are le nkitoria e Dario, eeuo ororei lo Laitoriani aimu Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai, ejo,
“Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Nkilikuana lelo apolosak metolimu ewalata ena kikilikuanata,

‘Amaa te nenap oltung'ani enkiring'o nasinya to lcholoi lo lkila lenye, neiseyie te ilo sholoi lenye emukate, aashu enkurma, aashu enaisho oo sabibu, aashu eilata, aashu ae pukunoto e ndaa, keaku ina sinyati?’ ” Newal ilapolosak aajo, “A'a.”
Neitoki Hagai ajo, “Amaa oltung'ani oiduruk te nkaraki neiseyie olmeneng'ani, te neiseyie nabo e kuna daiki, keiduruku?” Newal ilapolosak, aajo “Keaku keiduruk.”

Neitoki Hagai ajo, “Neijia sii etiu kulo tung'ana, o kulo oshon ootii dukuya nanu ejo Olaitoriani; naa neijia sii etiu pooki siaai oo nkaik enye; ore ina kishorunoto naishoru ninche teine keiduruk naa.
“Asai naa taata intae, entadamu ina nayooki aaku ebaiki ena olong neito idia alo. Amaa eton eitu eiteleikini osoit olikae soit tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, kainyoo intae inotito?
Tenelotu oltung'ani orupati loo mboreitin tikitam, tomon ake etum; te nelotu oltung'ani olchumati le naisho oo sabibu, ajo aaoku mboreitin onom, tikitam ake naatii.
Atoosho nanu intae o lng'anayio pooki le nkinyinyiret inyi to lasai o te mpurukunyi o te nchan oo soito, neitu ake kishukokinono nanu, ejo Olaitoriani.
Entadamu ebaiki ena olong neito idia alo, ebaiki enkolong e tikitam o ong'uan o lapa li oudo. Ebaiki ina olong apa natipikaki olkitamanyunoto le nkaji o Laitoriani, entadamu:
Amaa keton etii olantererai hoo obo atua olkompe, keton eiu osabibu o lng'aboli, o kukumanka, o loirien hoo toki? Ore ebaiki ena olong neito idia alo, kaamayian nanu iyie.”
Enyaaka ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Hagai enkata e are te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan o lapa, ejo,
“Irorie Serubabel, olgafanai le Yuda, tiaaki, etaa enkiti kata pee aikirikirie nanu keper o enkop,

naibelekeny ilorikan le nkitoo loo nkitoriat; etaa enkiti kata pee ainyal nanu engolon oo nkitoriat oo loreren, naibelekeny nena garrin oo mbartan o lakedok lenye; ore mbartan o lelo ookedito nedoyio, o ltung'ani ake to lalem lo likae.

Ore kenya teina olong, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa kaaya nanu iyie, Serubabel osinka lai, olayioni le Shealtiel, naaitotiu nanu iyie anaa olgisoi oata olmishire; amu aategelua nanu iyie, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.”
Ore to lapa le isiet tiatua olari liare le nkitoria e Dario, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Sakaria olayioni le Berekia olayioni le Ido, ilo oiboni le Nkai ejoki,
“Etagore apa Olaitoriani oleng tenkaraki iloo papaai linyi.
Metaa tiaaki ninche, ena ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Entushukunye enatii, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa kashukokino sii nanu intae, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

Emitiuu anaa enaikununo apa iloo papaai linyi, laa ore apa lelo oibonok le Nkai le dukuya eishirakita ninche ejoki, Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Entushukunye entung'uai nkoitoi inyi torrok o nkiasin inyi torrok! Kake eitu ninche aaning aashu aashilaa nanu, ejo Olaitoriani.
Amaa taata iloo papaai linyi koree taata ninche? O loibonok, kebikoo sii ninche intarasi?

Kake ore irorei laainei o nkiguanat aainei, nena apa naitanapa isinkan laainei lelo oibonok le Nkai, keitu ninche egiroo iloo papaai linyi? Metaa eirridutua ninche ejo, Anaa enatumuta Olaitoriani loo lororani pee eitame iyiook tenkaraki inkoitoi ang o siaaitin ang, neaku ina eitaasa ninye iyiook.”

Ore te nkolong e tikitam oong'uan o lapa le tomon oobo, olapa le Shebat to lari liare le nkitoria olaiguanani Dario, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Sakaria olayioni le Berekia olayioni le Ido ilo oiboni le Nkai; nejo Sakaria,

“Atoduaa tena kewarie naa ing'ura, oltung'ani okedito embarta nanyokie! Negira duoo aitashe tiatua ilkeek oo nyori ooji mihadasi tiatua oyerata ore tesiadi ninye netii kulie bartan pilei, o naanyokie o naaibor.
Naitoki ajo, ‘Kainyoo doi kuna Olaitoriani lai?’ Ore ilo malaika laairorie nanu, aatiaaka, ‘Ekaaitodol aitayiolo ajo ainyoo ninche.’
Metaa etawala ilo tung'ani oitashe tiatua lelo keek ooji mihadasi ajoki ore kuna naa inaairriwua Olaitoriani meetu aaman enkop pooki.
Newaliki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani otii atua ilkeek ooji mihadasi ejo, ‘Kishomo aarrip enkop pooki, naa ng'ura, nikitoduaa aajo eeta enkop pooki enkiyeng'iyengata!’
“Neitoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani ajoki, iyie Olaitoriani loo lororani, ke rishata nabaa miata olng'ur tiatua Yerusalem o nkanas e Yuda, nena nitagorokine tiatua kulo arin intomoni naapishana?
Newaliki Olaitoriani ilo malaika laairorie too rorei supati le nkitagoloto e oshoke.”
Metaa ore ilo malaika laairorie aatiaaka, Inchira tabuaku tejo, ena ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Aata olom sapuk tenkaraki Yerusalem o Sion.
Natagorokine oleng lelo oshon oodol ate anaa keserian. Amu ore apa pee agorokino ninche penyo, neitaa lelo oshon osina sapuk te ninche.
Metaa, ina ejo Olaitoriani, atushukokine Yerusalem to lng'ur sapuk; naa ekesheti enkaji ai tiatua ninye, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani nepiki enkopito e nkitorioroto shumata Yerusalem.
Nyaaki inchira tejo, nji Olaitoriani loo lororani; Ekeitoki inkanas aainei aatum dupoto nalus, naa keitoki Olaitoriani aitagol Sion oshoke neigil agelu Yerusalem.
Naraposhu inkonyek aainei aingorisho, naa ng'ura, imowuarak ong'uan!
Najoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Kainyoo doi kuna?” Naawaliki ninye ajoki, “Ore kuna mowuarak naa ninche naaidapasha Yuda, o Israel o Yerusalem.”
Naaitoki Olaitoriani aitodol ilkunono oong'uan.

Najo nanu, “Kainyoo doi epuonu kulo aas?” Newal ajo, “Ore kuna naa imowuarak naa ninche naaidapasha Yuda metaa meetae oltung'ani oraposhu endukuya; neetuo kuna aaiture ninche, pee etum aitadou abori imowuarak oo loshon, lelo ootudumutua imowuarak enye aaitame ina kop e Yuda aaidapash ninye.”
Naraposhu inkonyek aainei aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, oltung'ani oata enkopito natemishoreki te nkaina enye.
Naitoki nanu ajo, “Kaji doi iloito iyie?” Naajoki ninye nanu, “Kalo atem Yerusalem, pee ayiolou eneba endapasho enye o eneba enkadori enye.”
Naa ng'ura, ore ilo malaika laairorie eewuo dukuya, nelotu likae malaika dukuya anang'are ninye, nejoki ninye,
“Kueta, shomo tiaaki lido barnoti, ekeaku Yerusalem enkanasa nemeeta isunta tenkaraki enkumoi o lorere o nkishu naatii atua.
Amu kaaku nanu te ninye esuntai enkima namanita ninye, Olaitoriani ojo, naaku sii enkisisa tiatua ninye!”
Oi! Oi! Enkuet entung'uai ina kop e kopikop, Olaitoriani ojo; amu aidapasha intae aitalamaa anaa enatii inkaloli ong'uan enkijape e keper, Olaitoriani ojo.
Oi! Isikaki Sion, iyie ilo oboitare ina tito e Babilon.
Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, te nkitoo enye laa ninye makewan laairriwaka lelo oreren ooidaikie intae, amu ore ilo likiseyie iyie, naa enerok enkong'u ai eiseyie:
Ing'ura, ekaikirikirie enkaina ai te shumata ninche, naa keidaikie ninche lelo ooisiaai ninche. Nitum taa atayiolo nchere Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye lairriwua nanu.
Taranya nishipayu, iyie Yerusalem; Amu ng'ura ajo, kalotu naa kabik tiatua intae, Olaitoriani ojo.
Naa keibung'are iloreren kumok Olaitoriani teina olong, naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei; naa katon nanu tiatua intae, niyiolouu aajo Olaitoriani loo lororani laairriwua nanu atua intae.
Naa kejung Olaitoriani Yuda anaa erubata enye tiatua ina kop enye sinyati, neitoki ake agelu Yerusalem!
Entigirata, pooki toki naishu te dukuya Olaitoriani; amu etudumunye ninye tiatua ina manyisho enye sinyati.
Naaitoki ninye aitodol nanu Yoshua olapolosani kitok eitashe te dukuya ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, neitashe sii ninye Sheitani te nkaina e tatene aitangor ninye.
Nejoki Olaitoriani Sheitani, “Mikisikong'a iyie Olaitoriani, iyie Sheitani! Metaa ilo Aitoriani otegelua Yerusalem likisikong iyie! Amaa ele aime olchata oishu otawuapuaki te nkima.”
Ore ina kata egira Yoshua aitashe te dukuya ilo Malaika, eishopokoki inkilani naaiduruk naang'u.

Nejoki olmalaika lelo ooitashe te dukuya ninye, “Entayu nena kilani naang'u naaiduruk naaishopito entung'uai ninye.” Nejoki ninye, ninye “Ing'ura, aiwuang'ie ing'ok inono te iyie naa kaaishopoki nanu iyie inkilani sidain.”
Naitoki nanu ajo “Enchoo ninche epik aaishopoki enkarasha sidai endukuya enye neishopokini ninye inkilani; ore olmalaika lo Laitoriani neitashe te mbata ninye.”
Neitanap olmalaika lo Laitoriani Yoshua ejoki,

“Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Tinilo tiatua inkoitoi aainei nimbung enkitanapata ai, neaku iyaku oloitore enkaji ai nintore sii indung'orot aainei, naa kaaisho iyie esipata nijing'ie tenebo kulo ooitashe tene.

Toning'o naa taata, iyie Yoshua olapolosani kitok iyie tenebo ilchorueta linono ootoni te dukuya iyie, amu iltung'ana supati ninche ooitodolu imbaa naapuonu. Ng'ura, ekayaki osinka lai ilo oji Olng'osila.

Amu ng'ura, ore shumata eilo soit laitasheyie te dukuya Yoshua, enchumata osoit obo oata imatuan naapishana, naguetaki osirata, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kaitayu ina kitarruorroto ena kop te nkolong nabo.
Ore teina olong ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa keitoomon pooki te intae olelatia enye meetu aatoni te ntonata o sabibu lenye o te ntonata o lng'aboli lenye.”
Ore ilo malaika laairorie nanu, enyaaka arrinyunye, naainyoyie nanu, anaa oltung'ani otuputuoki too njo.

Naajoki ninye nanu, “Kainyoo idolita?” Iyie. Najo nanu, “Adolita naa ng'ura, enkitashet oltaa naitobiruno pooki te saabu, neeta olbakuli otii shumata ninye, o ltaai oopishana te nchumata ninye, o ltampii oopishana otii lelo taai otii shumata e ina kitashet.
Netii embata iloirienito aare, obo te nkalo e tatene ilo bakuli netii olikae kedianye enye.”
Naajoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Ainyoo doi kuna, olkitok lai?”
Ina pee aawaliki nanu ilo malaika laairorie ejo, “Aimiyiolo doi ajo ainyoo kuna?” Najo, “A'a, olkitok lai.”
Ina pee aajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ele naa ororei lo Laitoriani oirriwakaki Serubabel: Ime te nkidimata, neme te ngolon, kake te Nkiyang'et ai Sinyati, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.
Koree iyie, iyie lo doinyo sapuk? Ore te dukuya Serubabel naa iyaku enkisiashata; naa keyau ninye dukuya ilo soit le shumata ebuakitae aajo, ‘Empiris, Empiris te ninye!’ ”
Ore ake sii eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki,
“Inkaik e Serubabel naaitasheyie olkitamanyunoto lena aji; naa inkaik enyena ake sii naaidip ninye. Ina pee iyiolouu aajo aairriwua nanu Olaitoriani loo lororani enitii.
Amu ore pooki ng'ae otemenayie ina olong oo ntokitin kutiti naa keshipa, naa kedol ina temet te nkaina e Serubabel. Ore kuna naapishana naa nena onyek o Laitoriani, nena naapuo tiatua enkop pooki.”
Naitoki nanu ajoki ninye, “Kainyoo eutu kulo oirienito aare ootii enkaina e tatene o enkaina e kedianye tene netii enkitashet oltaa?”
Naitoki ajoki ninye eniare, “Ainyoo eutu kulo ng'osil pokira lo loirien, lelo ootii embata lelo goso ooitobiruno te saabu oobukunyeki ina ilata aaitayu?”
Naajoki ninye nanu, “Aimiyiolo ajo ainyoo kulo?” Najo, “A'a olkitok lai.”
Ina pee ejo, “Ore kulo naa lelo aare ootubukoki eilata aaput ooitashe te mbata Olaitoriani laa olopeny enkop pooki.”
Naitoki ake araposhu inkonyek aainei aing'orisho, ng'ura olpiyayati le mbuku olo to loing'ang'e!
Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ainyoo idolita?” Nawal ajo, “Adolita olpiyayati le mbuku nalo to loing'ang'e; naa ore enkadori enye naa intemat enkaina tikitam ore endapasho naa intemat e nkaina tomon.”

Ina pee aajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ena naa oldeket olo oriong enkop pooki, amu ore ake ninye pooki opurrisho naa kedung'ori aaiwuang'ie ebaiki ena kata nelo dukuya te risioroto eina purrorre, anaa pooki ng'ae onya olmumai le lejare naa kedung'ori aaiwuang'ie te risioroto ele mumai.

Ekairriwaa nanu meshomo dukuya, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kejing enkaji o lapurroni, nejing sii enkaji e ilo onya olmumai le lejare te enkarna ai; naa kebik te nkaji enye anya ninye, enya imbaoi tenebo isoito.”
Ina pee elotu dukuya ilo malaika laairorie nanu naajoki, “Taraposhu inkonyek inono nidol ena toki nalotu?”
Najo, “Ainyoo doi?” Nejo ninye, “Ore ena naa enkikapu, neitodolu ena kikapu ing'ok enkop pooki.”
Naa ng'ura, etaboloki ninye aadumu enkikenet enye, netii atua enkitok natonita tiatua enkikapu.
Nejo ninye, “Ore ina kitok naa Entorroni eutu.” Nerrumoki ninye atua enkikapu nerrinyoki enkikenet enye aiken enkikapu.

Naraposhu inkonyek aainei aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, inkituaak are naapuonu dukuya! Etii osiwuo inaipuko enye; neeta inaipuko naatiu anaa inaipuko emotonyi nanyaanyukie entilagos, nedumu aailepie ina kikapu metaa etii erishata enkop o keper.
Ina pee ajoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Kaji doi eyaita ina kikapu?”
Naajoki nanu, “Enkop e Shinar, aa teine epuo aashetaki ninye enkaji, naa ore pee eidip aitobira, nepik ina kikapu pee ebik teine.”
Naitoki ake araposhu inkonyek aainei aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, ingarrin ong'uan oo mbartan naatupukutuo te rishata oo ldoinyo aare, naa ore lelo doinyo naa ildoinyo lo suyai.
Ore engarri e dukuya neeta imbartan naanyokie, ore eniare neeta imbartan naarook,
ore ene uni neeta imbartan naaibor, ore eniong'uan neeta imbartan pusi naata iltipot.
Ina pee ajoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Ainyoo doi kuna, olkitok lai?”
Naawaliki nanu olmalaika ajoki, “Ore kuna naa inaapuo ilubot ong'uan e nkijape e keper, eidipa aaitayu ate te dukuya Olaitoriani le nkop pooki.

Ore ngarrin oo imbartan naarook, naa enkop e moikuape epuo, ore ngarrin oo mbartan naaibor naa enkop oloontoluo epuo teneidip kunda aashom, ore ngarrin oo mbartan pusi naata iltipot naa enkop e kopikop epuo.”
Ore pee epuku nena bartan naagol, neenyiyenyu eyieu nepuo aarrip enkop. Nejoki olmalaika ninche, “Enchom, entorrip enkop.” Metaa eshomo aarip enkop.
Ina pee aaishiraki ninye nanu ajoki, “Ng'ura ore nena naapuo ina kop e moikuape neitoborro Enkiyang'et ai te nkop e moikuape.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii ejo:
Iwa te lelo oararo, Heldai, o Tobiya, o Yedaia, laa ninche ootabautua eing'uaa Babilon nilo ina olong ake ina aji e Yosia olayioni le Sefania.
Iwa te ninche enkosholai o saabu, nintobiru enkopiyia e nkitoo, nipik ninye endukuya e Yoshua, olayioni le Yehosadak olapolosani kitok;
nijoki ninye, inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, “Ng'ura, ore ilo tung'ani oji enkarna enye Olng'osila: naa kebulaa ninye teine netii, naa keshetaki ninye Olaitoriani enkaji e Nkai.

Ninye oshetu ina aji o Laitoriani naa keishopokini ninye enkisisa o enkanyit, naa keton aitoreisho to lorika lenye le nkitoria. Naa keaku ketii olapolosani embata o lorika lenye le nkitoo. Nejing olning'o le seriani erishata enye pokira.”
Naa kejing enkopiyia e nkitoo atua enkaji Olaitoriani metaa endamunoto te Heldai o Tobiya o Yedaia o Yosia olayioni le Sefania.

“Naa ore lelo oo lakua naa kepuonu aaretu aashet ina aji Olaitoriani, naa iyiolouu aajo ilo Aitoriani loo lororani ninye laairriwua nanu enetii. Naa kelotu ina bae abaya tininyorraa katukul aairuk ilo toilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi.”
Ore to lari liong'uan le nkitoria o olaiguanani Dario, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Sakaria te nkolong e ong'uan o lapa le naaudo laa ninye eji Kislef.
Ore ina kata eirriwaitie iltung'ana le Betel Sharese o Regemelek oltung'ana lenye pee epuo aomonu omom to Laitoriani.
Neikilikuan ilo apolosani le nkaji Olaitoriani loo lororani tenebo iloibonok le Nkai, ena kikilikuanata: “Amaa kaishir napukoo aaomon to lapa le imiet, anaa enataasa too larin kumok ooishari?”
Ina pee elotu ororei lo Laitoriani loo lororani enatii aajoki:

Tiaaki iltung'ana pooki leina kop tenebo ilapolosak, “Amaa ina kata nipukoo pee iomon, ninchir sii to lapa le imiet, o to liopishana, te kulo arin intomoni naapishana, itupukoyie apa te nkaraki nanu kiomon?
Amaa ina nidaa, niokishosho aimidaa tenkaraki nkorroki inyi, niokishosho tenkaraki nkorroki inyi?”

Aeme irorei apa kulo ooiroro Olaitoriani too loibonok le Nkai te dukuya ina kata apa eton egol Yerusalem o nkanas naamanita, nebore iltung'ana atua ninche, atua o neemanita olkerenket le kopikop te nkalo oo ntonat oo ldoinyo lo loontoluo?
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Sakaria ejoki,
“Ena etejo Olaitoriani loo lororani apa: ng'ura oleng metaasi esipata te nkiguana intodolu esupatisho olng'ur tiatua olalashe lino,
mimbooki enkop enkoliai anaa oltung'ani okishi anaa olomoni, midamu intorrok to ltau lino tenkaraki olalashe lino.”
Kake etanyaita ninche ening, neuno aagolong'u neany ening, nenuk inkiyiaa enye pee mening.

Neitagol iltauja lenye anaa osoit pee mening, ake ina kitanapata o rorei oirriwua Olaitoriani loo lororani te Nkiyang'et enye aimunye lelo oibonok le Nkai le dukuya. Metaa eewuo engoro sapuk naing'uaa enetii Olaitoriani loo lororani.”
“Ore aipotisho nanu nemaaning ninche nanu, ore pee eipotisho sii ninche, nemaning sii nanu ninche” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

“Naidapash ninche to siwuo torrono aidapashaki lelo oreren lemeyiolo ninche. Neaku ore ina kop natung'uaitie neaku mijooni metaa meetae oltung'ani ojing aashu opuku, neitaae ina kop sidai naitishipisho e mijooni.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani loo lororani enatii aajoki,
Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, ekaata olom sapuk oleng te nkaraki Sion, naata olom sapuk tenkaraki ninye te ngoro sapuk.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani: Kashukokino Sion, naa kalotu amany atua Yerusalem, naa keitokini aaipot Yerusalem aajo enkanasa naisiligayu, oldoinyo lo Laitoriani loo lororani, ilo doinyo sinyati.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore ilpayiani kituaak o ntasati moruak, ekeitoki aatoni too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem, pooki ng'ae eeta entirma te nkaina enye tenkaraki enkitoo.
Naa Ore inkoitoi naalala eina anasa, neiput inkayiok o ntoyie eiguran teine.

Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Amaa tenaa embae enking'asia te nduata e lelo lekunot tiatua lelo oreren ootung'uayioki te kuna olong'i, Keaku sii embae enking'asia too nkonyek aainei, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Ng'ura, kaitajeu iltung'ana laainei te nkalo enkop oloosaen, o te nkalo enkop oloontoluo;
naa kayau ninche metotoni tiatua Yerusalem; naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei naaku nanu Enkai enye, te dede o te sipata.”

Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Enchoo inkaik inyi etum engolon, intae lelo te kuna olong'i ooning'ito kulo rorei oing'uaa enkutuk oo Loibonok le Nkai, eiteru ina olong apa nairragieki olkitamanyunoto le ina aji o Laitoriani loo lororani, nchere pee etumi aateshet enkaji e Nkai.

Amu ore apa eng'or nena olong'i, meetae apa oltung'ani oidim aigero oltung'ani aashu eng'ues meitaiki esiaai. Nemeetae sii oltung'ani oserian too lmang'ati lenyena te pooki ng'ae oipang'a aashu olotijing'ua. Amu eibelekanyaka aitaar pooki tung'ani olelatia enye.
Kake ore naa tena kata, meekure aitaas ilekunot le kulo tung'ana anaa enaikuna too nkolong'i naatulusoitie, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

Naa keun ninche nkurman enye te seriani; naa keiu o sabibu ilng'anayio lenyena naa keiu enkop te nkumoi enye naa keishoru keper enkoileelio enye. Naa kaisho kulo lekunot le kulo tung'ana meitaa kuna tokitin pooki inkunenye.
Ore apa anaa enira entoki naimakini aadiaare too loreren, Iyie na aji e Yuda o enkaji e Israel, kaitajeu nanu intae niakuku emanyianata. Emiureisho, kake enchoo egolu nkaik inyi.”

Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Anaa enatonyorra apa aitaas intae intorrok aitame ina kata pee aaitagor iloo papaai linyi te ng'oro sapuk, neitu arriny endamunoto ai, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani,
neaku ore te kuna olong'i atipika endamunoto peyie eitaas esidai Yerusalem o enkaji e Yuda; metaa emiureisho.
Kuna imbaa nayieu niasiasa: eroro esipata o likae o to likae, entayu too nchomito inyi inkiguanat naasipa nintayuyu sii osotua.
Nimimpiru entorroni to ltau lino tenkaraki olikae. Niminyorru enkinosata olmumai le lejare, amu ore kuna tokitin pooki naa kaiba, Olaitoriani ojo.”
Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani loo lororani enatii aajoki,

“Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore ina enata nintupukoo ate to lapa liong'uan o enata enkitupukoroto nintupukoo ate to lapa le imiet, o ina enata enkitupukoroto o lapa liopishana, o enata nintupukoo ate to lapa le tomon, keaku ninche te nkaji e Yuda irishat e ng'ida o enchipai o sirua lo lkerempe. Metaa entonyor esipata o eseriani.”
Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ekelotu enkata naaku kepuonu olorere le kulie anas Yerusalem.
Keaku kepuo olorere le ae anasa enkae anasa aajoki, “Emaape nabo kata aaomonu omom to Olaitoriani, niking'oru Olaitoriani loo lororani; aloito nanu!
Ore iloshon kumok o loreren oogol naa kepuonu aaserem Olaitoriani loo lororani te Yerusalem, neomonu omom to Laitoriani.

Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani; ore te nena olong'i, keibung iltung'ana tomon ooing'uaa iloreren le pooki ng'ejep olkila lo Lyahudi, ejoki, ‘Maape tenebo aairiamari, amu kitoning'o aajo etii Enkai tenebo iyie.’ ”
Ore ele naa ororei lo Laitoriani ogilunore ina kop e Hadrak, tenebo ina anasa e Dameski. Amu ino Laitoriani inkanas e Aram anaa enatiu iloshon le Israel;
neijia sii etiu Hamat natii olpolosie le Hadrak, tenebo Tiro o Sidon tenebo enkarriyiano e ng'eno enye.
Eteshetaka Tiro kewan esuntai nagol, netasoto ninye enkosholai naba anaa enterit, tenebo saabu naba anaa enterit oo nkoitoi.
Kake ng'ura, ekeya Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie nena pooki naata ninye, nenang'aki enkarsisisho enye atua enaiposha naa kepejori ninye aamut te nkima.

Kedol Ashkelon ina neureishoyu; neijia sii etiu Gasa, nemerregela te mion sapuk, neijia sii etiu Ekron, amu keiting osiligi lenye. Ekeidaikieki olaiguanani le Gasa, nepuoi aaisik aaing'uaa Ashkelon memanya.
Kemany Ashdod iloreren ooshulushula, naa kaiting'ie nanu ilo wuasa le Filistia.

Meitoki aekata ninche aanya inkiri naatii osarge aashu kulie daiki naaiturujaki. Ore lelo lekunot naa keaku ile nchoto oo ltung'ana laainei, netiu anaa olgilata tiatua olosho le Yuda, neaku sii Ekron ile nchoto oo ltung'ana laainei anaa enataasa Ilyebusi.
Ekamany nanu enkaji ai arrip, pee metii ololotu nelo; nemetii olaitorogonyani oitoki aitunyoo ninche. Amu ore taata, adolita too nkonyek aainei.

Entabuaku lo tung'ana le Yerusalem! Te nchipai sapuk, intae iltung'ana le Yerusalem! Eng'ura, elotu olaiguanani linyi atua intae, elotu eisula etimirishe, nelotu te mborron ekedito enkurrarru e sikiria.

Ejo Olaitoriani, “Ekaiwuang'ie ingarrin oo mbartan e njore te Israel; naa kaiwuang'ie imbartan te Yerusalem; naa keinyali aaisho enkawuo olarrabal, naa keitobir olaiguanani lino osotua o iloreren; ore enkitoo enye neiteru te naiposha o metabaiki enaiposha neiteru to lkeju te Frati o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.”
Ejo Olaitoriani, Ore sii tialo iyie, “Te nkaraki olning'o lo sotua o iyie, apa otimishiraki to sarge loo lasarri, kalaku nanu iltung'ana linyi ooena nepuku teina gumoto nemetii enkare.
Entorrinyokinoto isempewueti linyi, intae ilooena oata osiligi. Aibalunye nanu ena olong nchere karrinyoki intae eseriani.
Atoriwuo nanu Yuda aitaa enkawuo ai. Naitotiu Efraim anaa mbaa enyena. Naa kaasishore ilewa le Sion anaa olalem, pee earare ilayiok loo Lyunani.

Ekeliooyu Olaitoriani te shumata iltung'ana lenyena; naa kengoroo ninye imbaa enyena anaa enkiwuang'ata, Olaitoriani Enkai ninye oosh entarumpeta; naa kelotu te ngolon tiatua osiwuo ogol oing'uaa kopikop.

Olaitoriani loo lororani omitu ninche, naa kemut ninche neitunyoki enkop ilmang'ati lenye. Naa keok ninche osarge lenye anaa enaisho oo sabibu, neiputayu anaa olbakuli; nedooyo anaa too lpijat lo lperere lo lasar.
Ore tenebau ina olong, naa keitajeu Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena. Amu ore ninche naa intare oo ltung'ana lenyena. Naa kewang'u ninche te nkop enye anaa enawang isoito ooripakino enkopiyia.
Kebaa esidano natum ina kop! Ore lelo barnot naa kabul tenkaraki entapa enye tenebo enaisho o sabibu.
“Entoomon Olaitoriani enchan te nkata oloirujuruj, Olaitoriani ninye oitobiru olkutati o nkatampo, naa ninye oisho iltung'ana enkirujuruj e nchan, neitonyorij pooki toki tiong'ota.

Eikilikuanishore iltung'ana nkitanyaanyukot o laitumusumusok kake ore iwalat naatum naa elejare o emodai. Eibelekeny kulikae nkidetidetat neitapong'oo intae. Enepesho enkikoo enye. Neaku kelimana iltung'ana anaa ntare naaimina. Etii ninche atua enyamali amu meeta olarikoni.
“Eirowuaja engoro ai tenkaraki lelo shekuti, naa kaitame nanu lelo arikok; amu kegolie Olaitoriani loo lororani eluaata enye ina aji e Yuda. Eketiu ninche anaa imbartan aainei naagol o larrabal.
Atua ninche epukunye ilaitoriak, o larikok o lkituaak ooitore iltung'ana laainei.

Ore pooki tenebo naa keaku iltung'ana magil to larrabal, eitunyoki ilmang'ati lenye atua esarng'ab oo nkoitoi naalala; naa kearisho ninche amu etii Olaitoriani tenebo ninche, naa kemir ninche lelo akedok loo mbartan.

“Ekaitagol iltung'ana le Yuda; naa kaitajeu enkaji e Yosef. Ekashuku ninche amu aata olng'ur te ninche, naa ketiu ninche anaa keitu aekata ang'as aany ninche: Amu are nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, naa kawaliki ninche.
Ketiu Efraim anaa olmorrani magilani, neshipa iltauja lenye anaa iltung'ana ootooko enaisho oo sabibu. Edol inkera enye ina naa keshipa, neshipakino ina mirata naishoo Olaitoriani ninche.
“Kaipot iltung'ana laainei aiturrurr tenebo, amu atokordua nanu ninche, naa keaku ninche kumok anaa apa te moitie.
Ore hoo naidapashaka nanu ninche atua iloreren, kake ore too nkuapi naalakua naa kaadamu ninche, nanu, neaku ore ninche tenebo inkera enye naa kepok nerrinyunye ang tenebo.
Ayau ninche aitung'uaa Misiri o Asiria enkang enye nalotu aitamany ninche enkop enye. Ekaitamany sii ninche enkop e Gilead o Lebanon, o metaa meekure eeta enkop enemanyi te nkumoi o lorere.

Naa keeim ninche enaiposha e Misiri ore ilopir le naiposha naa kepuoi aaishie ore eng'uton pooki olkeju le Nail naa keitoi. Ore olwuasa le Asiria naa keitadoyiori aaitobor, ore engolon e Misiri nelo aing'uaa ninye.
Ekaitagol ninche tiatua Olaitoriani, naa kepuo ninche tiatua enkitoo e nkarna enye, Olaitoriani ojo.”
Tabolo nchomito inono, iyie Lebanon, Pee etum enkima ainosa atumuta iltarakua linono!

Teyietu inchira iyie lo shani onyaanyukie oltarakuai, amu eturori oltarakuai, ore lelo keek oata enkishiaa sidai einyalaki pooki. Enchira niyietutu lo keek oogol le Bashan; ore ina tim nasur too lkeek netumutaki aadung!
Entoning olkiyioi le lelo shekuti; amu eiwuang'ieki aaoru enkitoo enye! Entoning, enkikurrukur e lelo ng'atunyo ore entim natii embata e Yordan, netumutaki aaidaikie.
Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ai: “Taa olchekut le nena tare naapuoi aayieng.
Ore lelo ooinyang'u ninche neyieng ninche nepuo eitu eitamei ninche. Emir ninche inkiri nejo, ‘Meisisi Olaitoriani ataa nanu karsis.’ Ore ilchekuti lenye maate nemeetayie ninche olng'ur.

Amu maitoki nanu aing'urrie lelo oomanya ena kop, Olaitoriani ojo, ng'ura, kaisho nanu iltung'ana metabatatakinoyu, oltung'ani ake, inkaik olchekut lenye, oltung'ani ake nkaik o laiguanani lenye, naa kepuo ninche aarrarrakino enkop, nemakordu nanu hoo obo too nkaik enye.”

Metaa ataa nanu olchekut le nena tare naaiguanareki pee eyiengi te lelo oomir intare, naya nanu ing'udisin are. Ore nabo naisho enkarna ajo “Empiris,” ore enkae naisho enkarna aajo, “Naboisho,” Nairrita nanu ntare.
Ore to lapa obo, naidaikie lelo shekuti okuni. Ataa nanu olemeeta eng'iriata te ninche, naaibayie sii.
Metaa atejo, “Maaku nanu olchekut linyi. Ore ilo oye inchoo eye; ore ina namuta inchoo emuta; ore lelo ootelekutua nchoo eidaikie iseseni loo lkulikae maate.”
Nadumu eng'udi ai naji “Empiris,” nagil ninye pee atum atujuto ilo sotua apa oitayio Olaitoriani too loshon pooki.
Metaa etua apa ilo sotua ina olong. Ore lelo amirak o lainyang'ak le nena tare naagira aaing'or, neyiolou aajo ororei lo Laitoriani.

Na pee ajoki ninche, “Tinidolidolo eishaakino too nkonyek inyi, enchooki olekoisiaayio lai naa tenemeishaakino, niminchoruru.” Metaa aatalaakita ninche nanu olekoisiaayio lai shekeli tomoni uni e nkosholai.

Ina pee aajoki Olaitoriani nanu, “Tipika ninche atua olbene le nkaji Enkai.” Ina laata sapuk natejo ninche ekaaishaakino. Meeta atudumua nena shekeli tomoni uni enkosholai napik atua olchumati otii atua enkaji o Laitoriani.
Naitoki agil eng'udi ai e are naji “Naboisho.” Neaku etaraki Naboisho oo lalashera, Yuda o Israel.
Ina pee aajoki Olaitoriani nanu, “Nyaaki ake iwa imasaa olchekut lemeeta tipat.

Amu ng'ura, ekadumu aitasheyie tena kop olchekut lemeret lelo ooye, aashu eing'oru nena naaidapashari, aashu eishiunye nena ng'ojiniaa, aashu eitoti nena naatelekutua, kake nenya nkiri e nena naapir nepolol o metabaiki iloisotok lenye.
Oi ele shekut lai lemeeta tipat, ilo olo aing'uaa intare! Metara olalem enkaina enye tenebo enkong'u enye e tatene! Inchoo enkaina enye eikaolo pooki, ore enkong'u enye e tatene nemodoku tukul!”
Ele ninye ororei lo Laitoriani oipirta Israel. Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo oisalaasha keper neitobir enkop, neisho tung'ani enkishui natii atua ninye,

“Ng'ura, etaa nanu enajo pee aitotiu Yerusalem anaa enkikompe e naisho oo sabibu; ore lelo oshon oomanita ninye naa keok netiu epuo anaa oltung'ani otemere. Naa ore teneman Yerusalem, naa kemani sii nena anas e Yuda.
Ore teina olong naa kaitaa Yerusalem osoit oiroishi too loreren pooki le nkop tenetem ninche aadumu ninye, naa keitame ate oleng. Naa kedumakino ninye iloreren pooki le nkop aarare ninye.

Ore kenya teina olong Olaitoriani ojo, naa kaosh nanu pooki barta to lkirutoto, naosh olakedoni lenye to lmilo, kake ore tialo enkaji e Yuda, naa kamitu nanu ninche, ina kata aosh nanu pooki barta oo loreren te modoki.
Ina pee ejokino ilgilat le Yuda maate, ‘Ore lelo oomanya Yerusalem eeta engolon tiatua Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai enye.’

“Ore teina olong naa kaitotiu nanu ilgilat le Yuda anaa olmoti le nkima te mpolos entim, aashu enkima nayupuyup natii atua irridat le nkano; naa kemut ninche eiteru te tatene o metabaiki kedianye olorere pooki omanita ninche. Ore Yerusalem neton ake emanyae.
“Naa keng'as Olaitoriani aisho enkisulata lelo ng'oborri le Yuda, pee eaku ore enkitoo e nkaji e Daudi o enkitoo e lelo oomanya Yerusalem, nemelus te nkitoo Yuda.

Ore kenya teina olong, naa keitaman Olaitoriani elong'o lelo oomanya Yerusalem, metaa ore ninye oloshal aisul tiatua ninche teina olong netiu anaa Daudi. Ore enkaji e Daudi netiu anaa Enkai, netiu anaa olmalaika lo Laitoriani olo te dukuya ninche.
Naa ore teina olong, naa kaing'oru amut lelo oshon pooki oopuonu aarare Yerusalem.

“Naa kabukoki nanu enkaji e Daudi o lelo oomanya Yerusalem enkiyang'et o lng'ur o esayiare, metaa, tenelo neing'or aakurraki ilo otaremo ninche, naa keishiraki ninye, anaa oltung'ani oishiraki ina kerai nabo naa ninye ake eeta. Neishir te mion sapuk oleng te ninye anaa ilo oishiraki olkikau lenye otua.
Ore teina olong, naa ketiu olkiyioi te Yerusalem anaa olkiyoi le Hadadrimon te nkisiashata e Megido.
Ekeishir enkop pooki, neishir pooki marei openy; neishir ilo marei le Daudi openy, neishir inkituaak enye maate; neishir olmarei le Natan makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate.
Neishir olmarei le nkaji e Lawi makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate; neishir olmarei le Shemeit makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate;
ore lelo marei ootelekutua, neishir ake olmarei makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate.
“Ore kenya teina olong, naa ketumi enkong'u enkare nabolo te nkaraki enkaji e Daudi o lelo oomanya Yerusalem pee eitukuoo ing'ok enye o pooki nemesinya.
Naa ore teina olong, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, ekajutoo aiwuang'ie nkarn oo nkitaanyaanyukot oo nkaitin teinakop, ometaa meigili aekata aadamu; naiwuang'ie sii iloibonok o nkiyang'eta torrok.

Naa teneitoki ake ninye oltung'ani alotu anaa oloiboni naa kejoki ninye menye otoiwuo tenebo ng'otonye, ‘Mintoki taa aishu, amu iroro elejare te nkarna o Laitoriani;’ ore menye o ng'otonye naatoiutuo ninye neng'or ninche ninye meipang'a ina kata eibonisho.
Ore kenya teina olong naa kekurru pooki oiboni teneibonisho te nduata enye; meitoki aishop olkila oju pee etum atelejisho.
Ekeaku kejo, ‘Mara nanu oloiboni, ara olaturoni le nterit; amu ara apake olaturoni ebaiki lelero ai.’
Naa teneikilikuan likae ajoki ninye, ‘Kainyoo doi kulo baa ootii enkoriong ino?’ Naa kejo, ‘Ilbaa laatipikaki tiatua enkaji oo lchoreta laainei.’ ”

“Inyo lo alem tudumakinoyu olchekut lai, tigilunore ilo tung'ani oitashe te mbata nanu:” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo. “Toosho ilo shekut, pee etum ntare aaidapashata; naa kaibelekeny, enkaina ai agilunore lelo ooti.
Ore tiatua enkop pooki, Olaitoriani ojo, ore ematua e are te uni tiatua iltung'ana naa kemuta, neaku ematua nabo te uni eing'uari eishu.

Naa kapik nanu ina matua nabo te uni atua enkima, naa kasil nanu ninche anaa olosil enkosholai naitoki atem ninche anaa enatemi saabu. Naa keipot ninche enkarna ai, nawaliki nanu ninche. Naa kajo nanu, ‘Iltung'ana laainei ninche, Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’ ”
Ng'ura, elotu enkolong o Laitoriani, naa ore iyarunot naawaki aitung'uaa intae naa keori te dukuya inkonyek inyi.

Amu kaiturrurru iloreren pooki metudumakinoto Yerusalem to larrabal, naa keyai ina anasa, nepurri inkajijik, neikonyi inkituaak. Eyae ematua e nkanasa te yararoto. Ore ilkulikae tung'ana nemeyae ninche te nkanasa.
Ina pee elo Olaitoriani aarare lelo oshon, anaa enataarishe ninye te nkolong o larrabal.

Ore kenya teina olong naa keitashe nkejek enyena toldoinyo loo loirienito, ilo otii dukuya Yerusalem te nkalo o loosaen. Ore ilo doinyo loo loirienito naa keiperra kat are eiteru to loo saen o meshomo oloo ntoluo aaku eululu sapuk. Metaa ore ematua nabo oldoinyo nelo enkalo e moikuape ore enkae seshati oldoinyo nelo enkalo e kopikop.

Ore ina ululu oo ldoinyo laainei nemeitoki aponari agutu neaku keibung'are isunta pokira oldoinyo, nitumutumu aaisika anaa apa ina kata nisikisiki aailany olokirikiri too nkolong'i e Usia olaiguanani le Yuda. Ina pee elotu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi tenebo lelo pooki sinyat eboitare ninye.
Ore kenya teina olong, meetae hoo enkirobi aashu enkurriny e ndeem.
Naa keaku endama enaado oleng (Olaitoriani oyiolo ena), ime endama neme enkewarie, amu ore enoshi kata nikijo iyiook emuto, eton ake etii ewang'an.

Ore teina olong naa keruko inkariak e mpuaan naapuku aing'uaa Yerusalem. Ore ematua enye nabo nerukokino enaiposha enkalo oloo saen ore enkae matua nerukokino enaiposha e nkalo oloontoluo; naa keruko to lari pooki.
Naa keaku Olaitoriani Olaiguanani le nkop pooki, ore kenya teina olong neaku Olaitoriani obo o enkarna enye nabo.

Ore enkop pooki naa keibelekenyi aitaa enkop naisiasha eiteru te Geba o metabaiki Rimon natii kopikop e Yerusalem. Ore Yerusalem neaku ketala etii shumata ina kop namanita ninye; ebaiki enkanasa e Yerusalem epuku te nkishomi e Benchamen o metabaiki ewueji e nkishomi musana, ine apa ebaiki oltalet le Hananel o meshomo ina aji naironyieki enaisho oo sabibu o laiguanani.
Naa kemany iltung'ana ninye amu meitokini aata oldeket, keton Yerusalem te seriani.

Naa ele olmeitai laa ninye emutie Olaitoriani iloreren pooki lelo oodumaki olarrabal Yerusalem. Ekeng'uoyu iseseni lenye eton eitashoo, naa keng'uoyu inkonyek enye etii atua ilukuny enye, naa keng'uoyu ilng'ejepa lenye tiatua inkutukie enye.
Naa ore kenya teina olong naa kedoiki ninche olkirutoto sapuk oing'uaa Olaitoriani, ometaa keibung ake oltung'ani enkaina o likae, ore nkaik enye, nedumakino olikae olikae aarare.
Ore sii iltung'ana le Yuda naa keara emitu Yerusalem. Naa kearu ninche enkarsisisho oo loshon pooki oomanita saabu, o enkosholai tenebo inkilani te nkumoi.
Naa kedoiki olmeitai laaijo oloo mbartan, o nyumpui, o ntamesin, o sirkon o pooki ng'ues ake ninye natii atua lelo ng'oborri.
Ore taa pooki ng'ae oimisho te lelo oshon pooki ooetuo aadumakino Yerusalem, neaku keilepu too larin pooki aapuonu aaserem olaiguanani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani, neibung osirua loo lng'oborri.
Naa tenetii olmare obo te nkop lemelo Yerusalem aserem Olaiguanani, Olaitoriani loo lororani, nemetum ninche enchan.
Naa tenemelo olmarei loo Lmisiri aapuo aaitarasaa ate, nedoiki ninche olmetai laa Olaitoriani ninye oosh lelo oshon lemeilep aapuo aaibung osirua loo lng'oborri.
Ena nalo aaku enkitamioto te Misiri o enkitamioto oo loshon pooki lemeilep aapuo aaibung osirua loo lng'oborri.

Naa ore kenya teina olong, naa keaku keetae iltualan loo mbartan nesirakino irorei oojo, “Sinyati to Laitoriani.” Ore imotioo naayierishoreki naatii atua enkaji Enkai naa keaku sinyat anaa ilbakulini otii dukuya olperere;

neaku ore pooki moti natii atua Yerusalem o Yuda neaku pooki sinyati to Laitoriani loo lororani, metaa ore lelo pooki ooitayu olasar, nepuonu aaya ninche neitokitokie nena kiri o lasar tiatua ninche. Nemeitokini aata olamirani tiatua ina aji Olaitoriani loo lororani ina olong.
Ele olkilikuai oishoo Olaitoriani Malaki metoliki Isiraeli.
Ejo Olaitoriani: Atonyorra intae. Kake itejo intae “Kaji doi inkuna tininyorru iyiook?” “Amaa Esau aime olalashe le Yakobo?” Olaitoriani ojo. “Natonyorra nanu Yakobo
naibayu Esau, naitomijoono nanu enkop enye oo ldoinyo, naing'ueiki enjung'ore enye imbariak o lpurkel.”

Tenejo eishoi e Esau, ile Edom; “Etumutaki iyiook kake aikintoki aashet ineeidaaitie”, newal Olaitoriani loo lororani ajo, “Keidim ninche aateshet, kake kasulaki nanu enkop ometaba anaa neipoti aajo enkop e ntorroni, iltung'ana ootagorokine Olaitoriani intarasi.”
Idolidolo ena too nkonyek inyi maate, nijojo ina kata; “Aikitok Olaitoriani negiroo enkitoo enye ilpolosien loo Siraeli!”

“Keyanyit olayioni menye, neyanyit osinka olkitok lenye. Amaa naa tenaa kara papaai linyi, koree enkanyit ai naairare? Naa tenaa kara olkitok, koree euriata ai naairare? Ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani. Lo apolosak kulo oomen enkarna ai. Ijojo intae, ‘Kaji doi kinkuna tinikimenu enkarna ino?’
Aliki intae ajoki; tinintayuyu endaa naiduruk aapik shumata olperere lo lasar lai. Nijojo sii; ‘Kaji doi kinkuna tinikindurukie ninye?’ Amu ijojo ntae ore emisa o Laitoriani naa entoki namenari.

Amaa tinintayuyu ilasarri loo masaa modook, aime eng'oki ina sapuk? Amaa sii tinintayuyu ilasarri loo ntokitin ng'ojiniaa anaa inaamuoi, aime eng'oki ina? Entetem sii intae enchoo nena olkitok linyi, aijojo keshipakino intae anaa eisho intae omom? Ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.
“Ajoki intae, engoru omom e Nkai peyie eidim aing'urrie iyiook. Amaa teina kishooroto naing'uaa inkaik inyi, aijojo keidim aing'urrie hoo obo linyi? Ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

Oi te naa ketii obo linyi oidim aikeno kutuk aji peyie mikintokiki aainuaaki enkima e pesho to lperere lo lasar! Mashipakino nanu intae, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, nemang'amaa sii olasar linyi too nkaik inyi.

Amu ore eiteru te nkilepunoto e nkolong ometabaiki endoyioroto, aikitok enkarna ai too loreren pooki, ore te pooki wueji, neitayuni enkorropil te nkaraki enkarna ai, neitayuni sii ilasarri oosinya amu aikitok enkarna ai neyanyiti too loreren pooki, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.
Kake isarkionie intae ninye pee ijojo eidurukieki emisa o Laitoriani, ore sii endaa enye nemenuni.

Ijojo intae, eng'ura sii intae eneba enauri, nikidasakiki nkineji, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani. Kiyakiki sii intokitin naapurruno anaa ing'ojiniaa o naamuoi, eji naa ninche kipuonunu aaitaikinye olasar! Aijojo kang'amaa ina too nkaik inyi? Ejo Olaitoriani.

Metedeki olalejani pooki ooata olkuoo supat te luaata enye, nenya olmumai ejo ekaishoru eji neitoki apolosaki Olaitoriani ina naata eleyiata. Amu kara nanu olaiguanani kitok, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani naa keurei enkarna ai too loreren pooki.
“Ore naa taata lo apolosak, eninyi ena kitanapata.

Ti nimining'ining'i, tinimipikipiki atua iltauja linyi ninchosho enkitoo enkarna ai, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, kaae nairriu oldeket shumata intae nadek sii imayianat inyi. Nesipa ajo aidipa nanu atediaa ninche, tenkaraki mipikitata ntae ltauja linyi.
Kaisikong nanu eishoi inyi, napik inkomomi inyi emodiei, nena modiok oo lasarri linyi, naitalamaa intae te dukuya nanu.
Ore te nkaraki ina, niyiolouu aajo airriwua nanu ena kitanapata atua intae, pee etum olning'o lai lo sotua o Lawi aitasho, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.
“Ore apa olning'o lai lo sotua o ninye, naa olning'o lo osotua le nkishui o eseriani, naishoo apa nanu ninye kuna peyie etum aturia; naaureyu ninye nanu, neitashe te nkanyit euriata e nkarna ai.
Etii apa enkiteng'enata nasipa enkutuk enye, neitu etumi enkitapong'oto te enkutuk enye. Eshomo tenebo nanu te seriani o te nkitashoto nanare, neibelekenya ninye ilkumok metung'uai intorrok.
Amu ore enkutuk olapolosani neishiaakino nerrip eng'eno, ore sii iltung'ana neishiaakino neing'oru enkiteng'enare te nkutuk enye, amu ore ninye naa olkilikuai lo Laitoriani loo lororani.
“Kake imbelekenye iyie apaash enkoitoi, inchoo ilkumok errorro too nkiteng'enat inono, indurukie iyie olning'o lo sotua le Lawi, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani
naa kaisho nanu mikitemenuni nikintadouni te dukuya iltung'ana pooki, anaa ina neitu iyie imbung nkoitoi aainei, kake intodolua olkep too nkiteng'enat inono.”
Aimikiaata iyiook pooki papa obo? Aime Enkai nabo naitobira iyiook? Kainyoo naa peyie mikisiliga iyiook maate, nikisarkionie olning'o loo loo papa lang?
Etaa iltung'ana le Yuda ilemeisiligayu, netaasaki embae o lminong te Israel o tiatua Yerusalem, amu eisarkionie Yuda ewueji sinyati o Laitoriani, teina natonyorra neyam entito e nkai oo loreren.
Metudung'oi Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie too Siraeli tenebo oltung'ani oas ina, o loishakenoki, anaa olowal anaa oloyaki olasar Olaitoriani loo lororani!
Niaasita ake sii ena. Imulumul olperere lo lasar to Laitoriani too lkiyio, te nkishirata o too nkigorot eshipakino te nkaina ino.

Ninkilikuanu ajo, “Kainyoo doi pee meng'amaa ninye?” Enkaraki nataa Olaitoriani shakeni lo lning'o te rishata eina kitok niyama te kitisho, itaa iyie olemeisiligayu te ninye hoo duoo naa enkitok ino te naboisho o to lning'o.
Aime Enkai nabo naitaa osesen obo o nkiyang'et nabo? Naa kainyoo ninye eyieu? Eyieu ninye eishoi naure Enkai. Metaa entagolie ate emincho obo linyi eaku olemeisiligayu teina kitok e kitisho enye.
“Amu kaiba nanu, eoro o lpayian o enkitok ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel naiba enkimulumulata o lkila le nkarruoisho, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani. Metaa eng'ura ate, nimiakuku ilemeisiligayu.”

Intanaura intae Olaitoriani too rorei linyi. Hoo nijojo, “Kaji doi kinkuna ti nikintanaur ninye?” Intanaura ninye te nijojo: “Aisupat pooki tung'ani oas intorrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, naa keshipakino ninye ninche.” Anaa inkilikuanunu ijojo, “Koree doi Enkai oo sipat?”

“Ng'ura ajo ekairriu nanu olkipaaret lai pee eitobir enkoitoi te dukuya nanu, ore ilo Aitoriani ling'oruru, nelotu nabo kata atua enkaji enye. Ore olkilikuai leilo ning'o lishipakinono, ng'ura elotu ninye, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.
“Kake aing'ae oidim ating'iria ina olong e lotunoto enye? Naa aing'ae oidim aitasho tenelioyu ninye? Amu etiu ninye anaa enkima o lasikani, netiu sii anaa osabuni oishu oloirerio.
Kelo ninye aton anaa olasilani osil enkosholai, naa kesil aitisidan ilayiok le Lawi neitisidan ninche anaa saabu o enkosholai o metaba anaa neitarasaki Olaitoriani ilasarri ooishiaakino.
Neaku ore olasar le Yuda o Yerusalem neitiship Olaitoriani anaa inkolong'i apa e moitie oo larin ootulusoitie.

“Natum taa atinyikaki intae te nkiguana, aaku olchakeni osieku agilunore ilkuyantik, nagilunore iloololoito, nagilunore lelo oonya ilmuma le lejare, nagilunore lelo ooitorogonyisho too laakinot enye, tenebo inkolia o nkera okishin, nagilunore lelo ooinyal ilomon nemaaure ninche nanu, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.
“Ore nanu Olaitoriani nemaibelekenya, ore naa intae, na ishoi e Yakobo, neitu emuti intae.

Ore ebaiki nkolong'i oo loo papaai linyi itapaasha nkiguanat aainei neitu imbung'ubung'u ninche. Entushukunye enatii, naa kashukokino sii nanu intae ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani. Kake ijojo ntae; ‘Kaji kinko tenikishukunye?’
Kepur oltung'ani Enkai? Eji nikipurritoto intae nanu. Nijojo ntae, ‘Kaji doi kinkuna tinikipur iyie?’ Te matua inyi e tomon o too lasarri.
Etediaaki intae to ldeket, amu kipurritoto intae nanu, intae olosho pooki.

Eyau ematua e tomon pooki atua enkaji ai nashumishoreki pee eaku ketii endaa atua enkaji ai; entetemaki sii iyie, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani tenemaboloki intae ilusien e shumata, nabuku abori imayianat naadooyo.
Kaisikong sii ilo maati omutisho te nkop peyie meitoki aainyal ilng'anayio le nkop ino. Ore osabibu otii enkurma nemeitoki alau eishoi, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.
Ore iloshon pooki nikimpot aajo olomayiana, amu iaku enkop nashipakinoi, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.
“Ore irorei linyi naaitame nanu katukul, Olaitoriani ojo. Nijojo ake, ‘Kaji kinkuna tinikiro mbaa torrok tialo iyie?
Itejo intae ‘Pesho ti nikisiaai Enkai,’ ainyoo esidano ti nikimbung enkitanapata enye anaa tinikipuo anaa ilooata osina te dukuya Olaitoriani loo lororani?
Ore anaa enatiu, ekidol iloowuasa anaa kemayiana, ore ilarruok neme kebul ake kake tenetem ninche Enkai neimisho.’ ”

Ore lelo ooure Olaitoriani, neiro maate naa keirrugoki Olaitoriani ninche enkiok ainining ninche. Neigeri embuku nadamunyeki te dukuya ninye o lelo pooki ooure Olaitoriani, neing'oru sii enkarna enye.
“Keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, intokitin aainei kiroteti teina olong naasisho naa kaleku nanu ninche anaa oltung'ani opalaki enkerai enye naisiaaita.
Nitum taa ina kata ategela ilo oitashe too sipat o laasani loo ng'ok o ilo oisiaai Enkai o lemeisiaai ninye.”

“Kesipa elotu enkolong napejisho anaa olmoti le nkima, ina pee eaku ilooitokoos o laasak pooki loo ng'ok isuut; ore ina olong nalotu napejoo ninche, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, melekaki ninche entonai anaa olng'osila.
Kake ore iyie oure enkarna ai, keilepaki intae enkolong e supatisho eetae enkishiunoto too naipuko enyena. Ipuopuo intae intigiranana anaa ilasho ooti ooitigiran epuku to lale.
Naa intunyokiki enkop iltorrok. Amu keaku ninche nkuruon tiabori ndapi oo nkejek inyi ina olong naas ina, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.
“Entadamu inkiguanat o sinka lai Musa o nkitanapat naitanapa ninye to ldoinyo le Horeb naaipirta Israel pooki.
“Ng'ura ajo kairriwaki nanu intae Eliya oloiboni le Nkai eton eitu elotu ina olong torrono o Laitoriani.
Naa keitutum ninye intoiwuo o nkera enye malotu ake aosh enkop to ldeket.”
Ena entipat e Yesu Kristo enkerai e Daudi, enkerai e Abraham.
Etoiwuo Abraham Isaak, neiu Isaak Yakobo, neiu Yakobo Yuda o lalashera lenyena;
neiu Yuda o enkitok enye Tamar Peres o Sera; neiu Peres Hesron; neiu Hesron Aram;
neiu Aram Aminadab; neiu Aminadab Nashon; neiu Nashon Salmon;
neiu Salmon Boas te Rahab; neiu Boas o enkitok enye Rusi Obed; neiu Obed Yese;
neiu Yese olaiguanani Daudi. Neiu Daudi o enkitok e Uria Solomon;
neiu Solomon Rehoboam; neiu Rehoboam Abiya; neiu Abiya Asa;
neiu Asa Yehoshafat; neiu Yehoshafat Yoram; neiu Yoram Usia;
neiu Usia Yotam; neiu Yotam Ahas; neiu Ahas Hesekia;
neiu Hesekia Manase; neiu Manase Amon; neiu Amon Yosia;
neiu Yosia Yekonia o lalashera lenyena te nkata e yararoto e Babilon.
Ore te siadi e yararoto e Babilon, neiu Yekonia Shealtiel; neiu Shealtiel Serubabel
neiu Serubabel Abiud; neiu Abiud Eliakim; neiu Eliakim Asor;
neiu Asor Sadok; neiu Sadok Akim; neiu Akim Eliud;
neiu Eliud Eleasar neiu Eleasar Matan; neiu Matan Yakobo;
neiu Yakobo Yosef, ilo payian le Mariamu natoiwuo Yesu oji Kristo.

Metaa era iishoritin ebaiki Abraham o metabaiki Daudi iishoritin tomon o ong'uan; ore ebaiki Daudi o metabaiki eyararoto e Babilon era iishoritin tomon o ong'uan; ore ebaiki eyararoto e Babilon o metabaiki Yesu Kristo nera iishoritin tomon o ong'uan.
Inji eikununo einoto e Yesu Kristo; ore eidipa Yosef atisira Mariamu ng'otonye Yesu, eton eitu eboitare, nedoli enuta, enutai e Nkiyang'et Sinyati.
Ore amu oltung'ani apa loo sipat Yosef, olpayian lenye, nemeyieu nesul Mariamu, neyieu neleliari aing'uaa.
Ore eton eiguanare kuna baa, neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani te nkidetidet, nejoki, “Yosef, olayioni le Daudi, miureyu irik esiankiki ino Mariamu, amu ore enutai enye, naa ene Nkiyang'et Sinyati.
Naa keiu enkayioni, nijo enkarna enye Yesu, amu ninye oyooki aitajeu iltung'ana lenyena too ng'ok enye.”
Etaasate kuna pooki pee ebaya inaatejo Olaitoriani to lkilikuai lo loiboni le Nkai otejo,
“Kenutayu entito neiu enkayioni; neji enkarna enye Immanuel;” naa eji, “Enkai te nebo iyiook.”
Ore pee eputunye Yosef too njio neas anaa enaitanapa olmalaika lo Laitoriani nerik esiankiki enye ang;
neitu eboitare ninye o metoiu enkayioni, nejo enkarna enye Yesu.
Ore pee eini Yesu te Betlehem e Yudea te nkata o laiguanani Herode nepuonu ilang'eni ooing'uaa oloosaen, nebau Yerusalem,
neikilikuanu, aajo “Kaji etii Olarikoni loo Lyahudi otoiwuoki? Amu kitoduaa olakira lenye eilepu to loosaen, nikietuo iyiook aaserem ninye.”
Ore pee ening Herode ina, neing'aeng'ai ninye o Yerusalem pooki.
Ore pee eiturrur Herode ilapolosak kituak o ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat leilo orere, neikilikuan ajoki, “Kaji etoiunyeki Kristo?”
Nejokini, “Te Betlehem e Yudea; amu inji eigeroki aajo to loiboni le Nkai:
‘Ore iyie Betlehem te nkop e Yuda, mira hoo kini tiatua ilaitoriak le Yuda; amu iyie epukunye olarikoni oyooki aitore iltung'ana laainei loo Siraeli.’ ”
Ina pee eipotu Herode ilang'eni too nkurrat, netem asipunye oleng enkata apa nataliee ilo akira.
Neirriwaa ninche Betlehem nejoki, “Enchom, enkilikuanu imbaa eina kerai, ore pee itumutumu ninye nikiyakiki olomoni pee alotu sii nanu aserem ninye.”
Ore pee eidip ilang'eni aatoning olaiguanani nepuo; ore ilo akira apa otoduaa ninche to loosaen nerikoo ninche o metaba anaa neitashe te shumata ewueji netii enkerai.
Ore pee edol ninche ilo akira neng'ida te ng'ida kitok oleng.
Ore pee ejing aji, nedol ina kerai o Mariamu ng'otonye, negil kung aaserem ninye; nebol ilbenia lenye neitaiki ninye inkishoorot: saabu o enkorropil o emanoo.
Ore pee eikok Enkai ninche te nkidetidet pee meshukokino Herode nerrinyo ti ae oitoi aapuo enkop enye.

Ore pee errinyo ilang'eni, neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani Yosef te nkidetidet nejoki, “Inyo, tudumu enkerai o ng'otonye, isikaki Misiri, niton teine o metaba anaa naaliki, amu eing'oru Herode ina kerai pee ear metua.”
Neinyototo nedumu enkerai o ng'otonye arik Misiri kewarie;
neton teine o metua Herode; pee ebaya enapa natejo Olaitoriani to loiboni le Nkai pee ejo, “Aipotuo enkerai ai aitung'uaa Misiri.”

Ore pee edol Herode ajo etipika lelo ang'eni olosek negoro metiminisa, neirriwaa iltung'ana metaara metuata inkayiok pooki naatii Betlehem o neemanita pooki naaitabaitie ilarin aare nedou aishiaakinye ina kata natisipunye lelo ang'eni.
Nebaya ina kata ororei oiroro oloiboni le Nkai oji Yeremia otejo,
“Etoning'oki oltoilo te Rama, olkiyioi o enkishirata sapuk, eishiraki Raheli inkera enyena, nemeitigirayu amu meekure eetae.”
Ore pee eye Herode, neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani Yosef te nkidetidet te Misiri.
Nejoki, “Inyo tudumu enkerai o ng'otonye, shomo enkop oo Siraeli amu etuata lelo apa ooing'oru enkishui eina kerai.”
Neinyototo arik enkerai o ng'otonye nepuo enkop oo Siraeli.
Kake ore pee ening inchere etaa Arkelaus olaiguanani le Yudea, te rishata e papaai lenye Herode neureyu errinyo ina alo; neikoki te nkidetidet nebo ina alo olkerenket le Galilaya.
Nelo aton te nkang naji Nasaret, pee ebaya enatejo oloiboni le Nkai nchere: “Keaku keji Olnasarayoi.”
Ore te nena olong'i nelotu Yohana Olaibatisani elikioo ti ong'ata e Yudea, ejo,
“Erridutu, amu etinyikua enkitoria e keper.”
Amu ore ele, ninye eimaka oloiboni le Nkai oji Isaya pee ejo, “Etii oltoilo obuaku ti ong'ata Entobiraki Olaitoriani enkoitoi nalala entorioi inkoitoi enyena.”
Neishopito apa ninye Yohana enkila oo lpapit le ntames, o enkeene te mpolos enye; ore endaa enye na lmaat o naishi e ong'ata.
Nepuo apa enetii ninye ina kata Yerusalem o Yudea pooki o lkirinen pooki lo lkeju Yordan;
neibatisai pooki to lkejule le Yordan neirridu ing'ok enye.
Ore pee edolu Yohana Ilfarisayo kumok o Sadukayo epuonu meibatisae nejoki ninche, “Naishoi oo lasuriaa ai ng'ae otoroja intae elanya engoro nalotu?
Entoiu ilng'anayio ooishiaakinore enkirridunoto.
Nimijojo tiatua ate, ‘Kiaata iyiook Abraham aa papa lang; amu ajoki intae, keidim Enkai aishoo Abraham inkera te kulo soito.
Neiteleikiaki taata entolu intona oo lkeek naa ore pooki shani lemeiu lng'anayio sidain, nedung'i aanang'aki enkima.’ ”

“Kaibatisa nanu intae te nkare pee eitodolu nchere irridutua ing'ok; kake ore olaasujita, naa kegol ninye, aalang nanu, maaishiaakino hoo nanu te nanapaki inamuka enyena, naa ninye oibatisa intae te Nkiyang'et Sinyati o te nkima.
Neeta esilet enye te nkaina enye, naa keor asip olkurroto lenye oidong'ishoreki, nesotoki enkano enye olkompe, ore isuut nepej te nkima nemearayu.”
Ore te siadi ina nelotu Yesu eing'uaa Galilaya enetii Yohana meibatisa to lkeju le Yordan.
Neyieu Yohana neany eibatisa Yesu, nejoki, “Keishiaakino naa iyie likimbatisa nanu, paa nilotu iyie enatii?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Tonyorrai taata iyie, amu teina eishiakino nikintabaya naayieu Enkai pooki.” Nenyorraa Yohana.
Ore pee eidipi aaibatisa Yesu, neilepu nabo kata aing'uaa enkare; ng'ura, nebolo shumata nedol ninye Enkiyang'et Sinyati e Nkai edou anaa enturkuluo, elotu shumata ninye;
neningi oltoilo te shumata ejo, “Enkerai ai ena nanyor, natishipe te ninye.”
Ore ina kata neilepie Enkiyang'et e Nkai Yesu arik ong'ata metetema oloirirua.
Ore pee eidip atupukoi nkolong'i artam dama o kewarie.
Nelotu olatemani nejoki, “Te naa ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai, tiaaki kulo soito metaa mukateni.”
Kake newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Etisiraki nchere, ‘Meishuyie oltung'ani emukate ake, kake eishuyie pooki rorei oing'uaa enkutuk e Nkai.’ ”
Neitoki Sheitani arik Yesu enkanasa sinyati neitoton ninye te ntopij e nkaji e Nkai.
Nejoki. “Te naa ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai, tusulai kewan enkop; amu etisiraki aajo: ‘Keitanap Enkai ilmalaika lenyena te nkaraki iyie, eikinap ninche too nkaik enye, pee mikinkob osoit enkeju ino.’ ”
Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Etisiraki sii aajo, ‘Mitem iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.’ ”
Neitoki Sheitani arik ninye oldoinyo oado oleng, neitodol ninye inkitoriat pooki e nkop o enkitoo enye.
Nejoki ninye, “Ekaaisho nanu iyie kuna tokitin pooki ti nikigilaki kung aserem.”
Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Shomo Sheitani amu, etisiraki aajo, ‘Teserema Olaitoriani Enkai ino naa ninye ake openy isiaai.’ ”
Neing'uaa Sheitani ninye teina kata; nepuonu ilmalaika aaisiaai ninye.
Ore pee ening Yesu ajo eteenaki Yohana neibelekenya alo Galilaya.
Neing'uaa Nasaret nelotu abik te Kapernaum, enkang natii embata e naiposha te nkop e Sebulon o Naftali,
pee ebaya enatejoki to loiboni le Nkai oji Isaya pee ejo,
“Enkop e Sebulon o enkop e Naftali ineeshepita enkoitoi nalo enaiposha, lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan te Galilaya oo loreren,
etoduaa ewang'an kitok olorere otonita tiatua enaimin, ore lelo ootonita te nkop o to loip lee keeya, etabaikia ewang'an.”
Ore ebaiki ina kata neiteru Yesu alikioo ororei le Nkai ejo, “Erridutu amu etinyikua enkitoria e keper.”
Ore eloito Yesu te mbata e naiposha e Galilaya nedol ilalashera oaare, Simon oji Petero o lalashe lenye Anterea, enang'aki o rreshet atua enaiposha, amu ilarreshok apa loo sinkir.
Nejoki ninche, “Wootu, erukurukoreki, naa kaitaa intae ilarreshok loo ltung'ana.”
Neing'uaa nabo kata irresheta lenye neirukurukore Yesu.
Ore pee enyikaa Yesu penyo nedol kulikae alashera oaare. Yakobo le Sebedayo, o Yohana olalashe lenye, tiatua empeut eboitare papaai lenye Sebedayo, eripita irresheta lenye neipot ninche.
Neing'uaa nabo kata empeut o papaai lenye neirukurukore.
Nemanaa Yesu te Galilaya pooki eiteng'enisho too nkajijik enye e ntumo, nelikioo ilomon Supati le ina kitoria, neishiunye pooki keeya o emuoyian tiatua olorere.

Neibula olning'o lenye te enkop pooki e Siria; neyakini Yesu iltung'ana pooki oomuoyiaa ooibung'a nkeyaitin oo mpukunot kumok o looata iloiriruani o looata emuoyian e nkiterria o lmaiman o looidimua emion; neishiunye ninye ninche.
Nesuj iltung'ana kumok ooing'uaa Galilaya o Dekapoli o Yerusalem o Yudea o lido kekun lo lkejule Yordan.
Ore pee edol Yesu iltung'ana kumok neilepaki oldoinyo: ore pee eton nepuonu lkipaareta lenyena enetii.
Neiteng'en ninye ninche nejo:
“Emayiana ilaisinak too ltauja; amu enenye enkitoria e keper.
“Emayiana ilooishir; amu ninche eilejileji.
“Emayiana ilo obor; amu ninche oojung enkop.
“Emayiana ilooata esumash o enkure eing'oru enayieu Enkai; amu ninche eitaraposhi.
“Emayiana ilooata olng'ur amu ninche eing'urrieki.
“Emayiana ilooitukuo iltauja; amu ninche oodol Enkai.
“Emayiana lelo ooitayu osotua; amu ninche eji inkera e Nkai.
“Emayiana lelo ooisilisili te nkaraki enayieu Enkai amu enenye enkitoria e keper.
“Imayianana intae te nesukeny ninche intae, neisilisil, neiteeniki intae imbaa pooki torrok e lejare te naa te nkaraki nanu.
Enting'idata nishipapa oleng; amu kitok olerrinyore linyi te keper; amu eisilisilo ninche aaiko neijia iloibonok le Nkai ootii apa te dukuya intae.
“Irara intae emunyan e nkop; kake te netuyiatuyu emunyan, ainyoo eshukokinyeki enkisuisho? Meitoki aata tipat katukul, kake kenang'ari boo meitunyoi iltung'ana too nkejek.
“Irara intae ewang'an e nkop. Meisudoroyu enkanasa natii oldoinyo.
Nemeinok sii ltung'ana oltaa nepising to ltoo, kake eiteleiki olperere; neitawang'aki pooki ootii aji.
Ore sii ntae enchoo ewang'an inyi metawang'a te dukuya iltung'ana pee edol iasat inyi supati, pee eyanyituni Papa linyi otii keper.
“Emijo kaewuo aitarruoo Nkitanapat aashu inaaigero loibonok le Nkai, eitu alotu aitarruoo kake pee aitabaya.
Amu esipa ajoki intae, ore ometaba anaa nelusoo shumata o enkop, melusoo osirata obo anaa oltipoto obo loo Nkitanapat eitu eitabari.

Ore pooki ng'ae ogil enkitanapata nabo e kuna kutiti, hoo te naa enkinyi, neitayiolo ilkulikae metigila, naa keji ninye olkini te pooki te nkitoria e keper; kake ore oloas nena neitayiolo sii ilkulikae metaasa, naa keji ilo olkitok te nkitoria e keper.
Amu ajoki intae te nemelusoo esupatisho inyi alang enoo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o enoo Lfarisayo, nimijing'ijing'i enkitoria e keper.
“Itoning'o aajo etiaakaki iltung'ana li apa, ‘Miar metua; naa ore oloar metua neishiaakino enkiguana.’

Kake ajoki nanu intae, ore pooki ogorokino olalashe, naa keishiaakino enkiguana; ore olosukeny olalashe, neishiaakino, nerikokini ilkituaak; ore olodekisho ajo ‘Lo modai!’ Keishiaakino olbalbal le nkima.
Naa ti niyau enkishooroto ino olperere lo lasar, nidamu teine olalashe lino likiaatakinore,
tung'uai teine enkishooroto te mbata o lperere lo lasar, shomo; tang'asa toning'ore olalashe lino, pee intoki ashukunye aitayu enkishooroto ino.
“Tasioki toning'ore olintarrikinore eton iriamariri te nkoitoi; pee mikirik enetii oladung'oni le nkiguana nikirikoki oladung'oni le nkiguana osikari, nikinang'akini jila.
Esipa aajoki, mipuku teine katukul ometaba anaa nilak empisai nabayie.
“Itoning'o aajo etejoki, ‘Miloloito.’
Kake ajoki nanu intae, ore oloing'or eng'oruoi neng'uar eidipa atololoito to ltau lenye.
Ti nikintasur enkong'u ino e tatene, tukurtu, inturrai, amu enaikash te neimin erubata nabo alang te nenang'akini osesen lino pooki olbalbal le nkima.
Naa ti nikintasur enkaina ino e tatene, tudung'u inturrai; amu eikash erubata ino nabo te neimin, alang osesen lino pooki te nenang'akini olbalbal le nkima.
“Etejoki sii, ‘Ore oloorore enkitok enye, inchoo eisho ninye empalai naorore.’
Kake ajoki nanu intae, ore pooki ng'ae oorore enkitok enye, neme te nkaraki e loloito ake, etipika ninye atua eloloito; ore oloyam ina natoororeki, etololoite ninye.
“Itoning'o sii iltung'ana li apa enatiaakaki, ‘Minya olmumai le lejare, kake intabai ilmuma linono to Laitoriani.’
Kake ajoki nanu intae eminya ilmuma katukul hoo te keper, amu olorika le nkitoria e Nkai;
aashu te nkop, amu olorika loo nkejek enyena; aashu te Yerusalem, amu enkang o laiguanani kitok.
Minya olmumai te ndukuya ino, amu mindim aiborrie olpapita obo anaa aitoroka.
Kake enchoo irorei linyi metaa ee, neaku ee, aashu mme, neaku mme, amu ore enalusoo te nena naa ilo torrono eing'uaa.
“Itoning'o aajo etejoki, ‘Enkong'u o te nkong'u, o olalae to lalae.’
Kake ajoki nanu intae, migilunore olikintaas entorrono kake ore olikiosh eseder e tatene, imbelekenyaki sii enkae.
Ore oltung'ani pooki oyieu nikirik enkiguana, eyieu nikioru olkila li atua, inchoo meewa sii oli oriong.
Ore olikiaraki, shomo enkilomita nabo, shomo are.
Ore olikiomon, inchoo; ore olikisilen, mimitiki.
“Itoning'o aajo etejoki, ‘Tonyorra ole latia ino, nimbayu olmang'atinta lino.’
Kake ajoki nanu intae, entonyor ilmang'ati linyi, niomonokiki lelo ooisilisil intae;
pee itumutumu intae aataa inkera e Papa linyi otii keper; amu eilepakinye enkolong enye iltorrok o supati neirriwaki enchan ilooata sipat o ilemeeta.
Amu ti ninyorrinyorro iloonyor intae, kaa shunet itumutumu intae? Ai meiko neijia oshi ilasotok le kodi?
Naa te naa ilalashera linyi ake irorokiki, kaa yasata naa italang'ie ilkulikae? Ai meiko oshi neijia ilkulikae oreren?
Entaa naa bayarot anaa Papa linyi otii keper laa aibayaroti.
“Eng'ura pee miasiasa isupati inyi te dukuya inkonyek oo ltung'ana ijojo pee edol ninche intae; amu ti ninkoko neijia nimitumutumu shunet te Papa linyi otii keper.
“Ore ti nintayu iyie enkishooroto ino o lng'ur nimiosh emowuo, anaa enaiko isunkuro too nkajijik e ntumo o too nkoitoi, pee errep iltung'ana. Esipa ajoki intae, eidipa ninche aanoto enchunet enye.
Kake ti nintayu iyie enkishooroto ino o lng'ur nimincho enkaina ino e kedianye metayiolo enaas ene tatene;
pee eaku intokitin ninchooyo, inoo nkisudorot; naa ore Papa lino odol too nkisudorot, nikincho ninye olerrinyore.”

“Naa ti niomonono nimitiuu anaa isunkuro, amu kenyor ninche aatoomon eitashoo too nkajijik e ntumo o too lojat oo nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa, pee etum aatodol iltung'ana. Esipa ajoki intae, eidipa ninche aanoto shunet enye.
Kake ti niomon iyie, tijing'a olgilata lino, ore pee indip aikeno kutuk aji niomon Papa lino too nkisudorot, ore Papa lino odol too nkisudorot naa aikilaaki iyie.
“Naa tiniomonono, emintaa irorei kumok anaa enaas iloreren, amu kedamu ninche aajo kening'i ninche te nkumoi oo rorei lenye.
Emitiuu anaa ninche, amu keyiolo Papa linyi iniyieuu eton eitu iomonunu intae.
Naa inji entejo: ‘Papa lang otii keper meitisinyi enkarna ino
meeu enkitoria ino, metaasi eniyieu te nkop anaa enatiu te keper.
Inchoo iyiook ena olong endaa ang e anaake.
Nipalaki iyiook inkitarruorrot ang, anaa eninikipalaki iyiook ilooinyal iyiook.
Nimirikoki iyiook atua intemat, kake intajeu iyiook tialo ilo torrono.’
“Amu tinipalakiki intae iltung'ana inkitarruorrot enye, naa kepalaki sii ninye intae Papa linyi otii keper.
Kake ti nimipalakiki intae iltung'ana inkitarruorrot enye, nemepalaki sii intae Papa linyi inkitarruorrot inyi.
“Naa ti nieniene ate aapukoo, emitiu anaa isunkuro oosot inkomomi, amu keidisie ninche inkomomi enye, pee edol iltung'ana aajo etupukoitie. Esipa ajoki intae, eidipa aanoto shunet enye.
Kake ore ti nipukoo iyie, iela endukuya ino nisuj enkomon ino;
mikidol iltung'ana inchere itupukoiyie, kake kedol Papa lino otii inkisudorot; ore Papa lino odol too nkisudorot nikimputaki.
“Emishumaki ate te nkop imasaa kiroteti, eneinosie oriri o olasai, negil ilapurrok, nepurroo,
Kake entushumaki ate te keper imasaa inyi kiroteti, enemeinosie oriri, anaa olasai, nemegil ilapurrok nemepurroo;
amu ore enetii masaa inono kiroteti, naa ine eyooki atii oltau lino.
“Ore oltaa lo sesen naa enkong'u, metaa te neikishiaan enkong'u ino, neiput osesen lino pooki ewang'an.
Kake te naa torrono enkong'u ino neiput osesen lino pooki enaimin. Amaa te neaku ore ewang'an nikitii iyie naa enaimin: kebaa esapuko e ina aimin?
“Metii oltung'ani oidim aaisiaayia ilkituaak oaare amu keibayu obo nenyorru olikae; aashu eibung'are obo nemenu olikae. Mindimidimi aaisiaayia Enkai o Masaa, Enkai oo mpisai.

“Neaku ina pee ajoki intae, eminyamaliki enkishui inyi, aajo ainyoo inyanya, anaa ainyoo iokioko, anaa too seseni linyi aajo ainyoo inchopishopo. Ai melusoo enkishui alang endaa, nelusoo osesen alang nkilani?
Eng'ura imotonyi o loing'ang'e ajo meunisho nemeikesisho, nemeiturrurroki ilkompen neitoti ninche Papa linyi otii Keper. Aimirara intae kiroteti aalang ninche?
Ai ng'ae te intae oidim te neitanyamaluo atoponai enkadori enye entemata nabo?
“Kainyoo naa pee inyamalakiki inkilani? Entadamu intapuka e ong'ata enaikununye te nebulu; amu measisho ninche nemepiyaisho;
