kake ajoki nanu intae eitu eishopi ninye Solomon te sikar enye pooki anaa nabo e kuna tapuka.
Amaa te neishop Enkai inkujit e ong'ata aiko neijia, naatai taata neyookini aanang'aki enkima taaisere, ai meitulusoo oleng aishop intae, lo tung'ana ooti enkirukoto?
“Eminyamalu ijojo, ‘Kainyoo kinya?’ Anaa, ‘Kainyoo kiok?’ Anaa ‘Kainyoo kinchop?’
Amu nena pooki eing'oru iloreren lemeyiolo Enkai; amu eyiolo Papa linyi le keper ajo iyieuu nena pooki.
Kake entang'as eng'oru enkitoria enye o sipat enyena; naa keponikini intae nena pooki.
Metaa eminyamalaki ine ntaaisere amu enyamalaki e ntaaisere kewan. Eidip enkolong intorrok enyena.
“Eminguanare pee meiguanareki intae.
Amu ore enkiguana ning'uanarere, naa ninye eiguanareki intae; ore enintorisiokiki ilkulikae, naa ninye eitorisiokini intae.
Kainyoo pee ing'uraa entubuloi natii enkong'u o lalashe lino, nimidol olchata otii enkong'u ino makewan?
Anaa kaji inko ti nijoki olalashe lino, ‘Inchooki maitayu entubuloi te nkong'u ino;’ etii olchata atua enkong'u ino makewan?
Lo sunkuroi, tang'asa intayu ilo shata te nkong'u ino makewan pee itumoki atoduaa oleng, aitayu ina tubuloi te nkong'u o lalashe lino.
“Emincho ildiein entoki nasinya, niminang'akiki ilului inyi ilbitiro pee meituny too nkejek enye, neibelekenyakino intae aanya.
“Entoomonu pee eishori intae; eng'oru naa itumutumu entooshiosh kutuk aji pee eboluni intae.
Amu ore pooki oomonu neishori, ore olooshiosh neboluni.
Anaa kalo tung'ani te intae laa, te neomon enkerai endaa, neisho ninye osoit?
Aashu aa te neomon osinkirri, neisho olasurai?
Aiti niyiololo intae oora torrok aaishoo inkera inyi inkishoorot sidain, kebaa eitulusoo naleng Papa linyi otii keper aisho intokitin sidain lelo oomon ninye?
Metaa ore pooki niyieuu neitaas intae iltung'ana entaasa sii intae ninche nena, amu kuna nkitanapat o loibonok le Nkai.
“Entijing intae te nkishomi napirik amu dapash kishomi nelala enkoitoi nalo enkiminata, naa kumok iloojing ina kishomi nalala.
Amu kepirik kishomi naa ronkai enkoitoi nalo enkishon, naa ilkuti ootum ina kishomi napirik.
“Entorrip ate too loibonok le lejare oopuonu enitii eishopito inkilani oo ntare, kake ore atua ninche, naa isuyian ooata enkarri.
Too lng'anayio lenye iyiolouu. Keitayuni isabibu too lkiku anaa ilng'abolo too ilkeek loo ilkiku?
Neijia etiu, eiu pooki shani sidai ilng'anayio sidain, neiu pooki shani torrono ilng'anayio torrok.
Meidim olchani sidai atoiu ilng'anayio torrok, nemeidim sii olchani torrono atoiu ilng'anayio sidain.
Ore pooki shani lemeiu ilng'anayio sidain, nedung'i aauroo nenang'akini enkima.
Neijia naa etiu, too lng'anayio lenye iyiolouu ninche.
“Mme pooki tung'ani laajo ‘Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani,’ ojing enkitoria e Nkai, kake ilo oas enayieu Papa lai otii keper.
Aayooki aajoki ilkumok teina olong, ‘Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani, keitu kimbonisho te nkarna ino, nikiaraa iloiriruani te nkarna ino, nikiaas ine nking'asia te nkarna ino?’
Naa kashirraki ina kata ajoki ninche, ‘Eitu aekata ayiolou intae, enchom entung'uayioki intae, ilaasak loo ntorok.’
“Metaa ore pooki ng'ae oning lelo rorei laainei neas, neitanyaanyukieki oltung'ani otesheta ng'en enkaji enye te ndapidapoi,
nesha enchan, nenang'unye enkare, nekutu olkutati, neosh ina aji, neitu euroo; amu etuunokoki olkitamanyunoto lenye shumata endapidapoi.
“Naa ore pooki ng'ae oning kulo rorei laainei nemeas, neitanyaanyukieki oltung'ani omoda otesheta enkaji enye te shumata osinyai;
nesha enchan nenang'unye enkare, nekutu olkutati, neosh ina aji, neurori neaku kitok euroroto enye.”
Ore pee eidip Yesu kulo rorei, neing'asia siamon te nkiteng'enare enye;
amu eiteng'ena Yesu ninche anaa oloata enkidimata nemetiu anaa ilaiteng'enak lenye loo nkitanapat.
Ore pee edou Yesu to ldoinyo, neirukurukore iltung'ana kumok.
Nelotu enetii oloata enkeeya oo lbolot, negil kung aserem, nejoki, “Lo kitok, ti niyieu kindim atisika.”
Neitorioo Yesu enkaina enye neiseyie nejo, “Kayieu; tisikayu.” Nesikari nabo kata enkeeya enye.
Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Miliki ake oltung'ani, kake shomo intoduaai kewan to olapolosani, nintayu enkishooroto naitanapishe Musa, metaa shakenisho te ninche.”
Ore pee ejing Yesu Kapernaum, nelotu olkitok loo sikarini enetii asai ninye,
nejoki, “Lo kitok, eirrag olaisiaayiani lai ti aji, etaa olmaima, neitabayie emuoyian oleng.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Kalotu aishiunye.”
Newaliki ilo kitok loo sikarini ajoki, “Lo kitok, kaamakua nanu ti nijing'u enkaji ai, kake tejo ake olomoni obo, naa keishiu olaisiaayiani lai.
Amu ara sii nanu oltung'ani otii abori enkitoo, naata nanu sikarini laatii ti abori, te najoki obo, ‘Shomo,’ nelo; najoki likae, ‘Wou,’ nelotu; naa te najoki osinka lai, ‘Taasa ena, neas.’ ”
Ore pee ening Yesu nena, neing'asia nejoki lelo oosujita, “Esipa ajoki intae, eitu ae kata adol likae tiatua Siraeli oata enkirukoto sapuk naba inji.
Najoki nanu intae, kepuonu ilkumok ooing'uaa oloosaen o loontoluo aatoni te nebo Abraham o Isaak o Yakobo tiatua enkitoria e keper;
kake ore lelo laa ninche naaji ile ina kitoria nenang'akini atua enaimin e auluo; neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.”
Nejoki Yesu ilo kitok loo sikarini, “Shomo ang; metotiwuo te iyie anaa ina niruko.” Neishiunyeki olaisiaayiani lenye teina kata ake.
Ore pee ejing Yesu enkaji e Petero, nedol enkaputani e Petero eirrag emuoi oloirobi.
Neiseyie enkaina enye neing'ueki oloirobi, neinyototo aisiaai ninye.
Ore pee eaku teipa, neyakini Yesuilkumok ooata iloiriruani nearaa iloiriruani to rorei, neishiunye lelo pooki oomuoi,
Pee etum atabai enairoroki to loiboni le Nkai oji Isaya pee ejo, “Ewa ninye openy imuoyiaritin ang, netanapa inkeyaitin ang.”
Ore pee edol Yesu iltung'ana kumok emanita, neitanap metalang'a aapuo lido kekun.
Nelotu olaiteng'enani loo nkitanapat nejoki, “Lo Aiteng'enani, kaasuj pooki wueji nilo.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Keeta imbariak ingumot, neeta motonyi o loing'ang'e nkajijik enye kake meeta Enkerai e Tung'ani eneiteleiki endukuya enye.”
Nejoki likai loo lkipaareta lenye, “Lo kitok, inchooki matang'asa alo anukaa papa.”
Kake etiaaka Yesu ninye, “Tusujuaki iyie; inchoo ilmeneng'a metunukai ilmeneng'a lenye.”
Ore pee ejing Yesu empeut, nesuj lkipaareta lenyena.
Nedumunye olkutati kitok te naiposha, metaa keimisie ilopir le nkare empeut; kake keirura ninye Yesu.
Nepuo enetii lkipaareta lenyena, neinyeyie, nejoki, “Intajeu iyiook, Lo Kitok, amu kindaaitie.”
Nejoki, “Kainyoo pee iureishoyuyu intae ilooti enkirukoto?” Neinyototo neisikong olkutati o enaiposha; nelotu enkitirring'ata kitok.
Neing'asia lelo tung'ana nejo, “Kaa pukunoto o ltung'ani ele oning olkutati o enaiposha?”
Ore pee ebaiki Yesu lido kekun le nkop oo Lgadaren, nenang'are iltung'ana oaare ooata iloiriruani oopi oleng ooing'uaa inkuraren o metaa meidim oltung'ani aima ina oitoi.
Nebuak ninche aajo, “Kainyoo iatakinore iyie iyiook Enkerai e Nkai? Amaa iewuo iyie aitame iyiook eton eng'or enkata?”
Netii eluaata oo lbitiro nadaa nalakuaniki ninche.
Nesai lelo oiriruani Yesu aajoki, “Te naa iaraa iyiook aipang'ie, inchoo iyiook maape aajing enda boo oo lbitiro.”
Nejoki, “Enchom.” Ore pee eipung ninche, nepuo aajing ilbitiro; nekuet emboo pooki, nesulari te marti aajing enaiposha, neye tiatua enkare.
Neilanyisho ilchekuti aapuo inkang'itie enye nelikioo imbaa pooki o nena naataasate te lelo ooata iloiriruani.
Nepuku enkanasa pooki aapuo aanang'are Yesu; ore pee edol nesai metung'uai ilo kirine lenye.
Neked Yesu empeut nelang alo enkanasa enye.
Neyakini oltung'ani maima, eirrag te rruat; ore pee edol Yesu enkirukoto e lelo tung'ana, nejoki ilo maima, “Nakerai, ntagoluoyu to ltau amu kitapalakaki ng'ok inono.”
Nejo kulikae aiteng'enak loo nkitanapat maate, “Enkai emor ele tung'ani.”
Neyiolou Yesu ndamunot enye nejoki, “Aainyo pee mbirribirrirri ntorrok too ltauja linyi?
Kaa nalelek, te neji ‘Kitapalakaki ng'ok inono,’ ana te neji, ‘Inyo shomo?’
Kake ore pee itumutumu aatayiolo aajo, keeta Enkerai e Tung'ani engolon te nkop napalakinye iltung'ana ng'ok,” nejoki ilo maima, “Inyo, tudumu erruat ino, shomo ang.”
Neinyototo ilo tung'ani, nelo ang.
Kake ore pee edol iltung'ana kumok, neureishoyu neisho Enkai enkitoo naishoo ltung'ana engolon naaijo ina.
Ore eimita Yesu ine nedol oltung'ani oji Matayo, eton te nelakieki kodi nejoki, “Tusujuaki,” neinyototo asuj.
Eaku ore eton Yesu teina aji e Matayo anya endaa, nepuonu ilasotok le kodi o laing'okok kumok netoni te nebo Yesu o lkipaareta lenyena.
Ore pee edol Ilfarisayo ina, nejoki lkipaareta lenyena, “Aainyo pee eng'arie Olaiteng'enani linyi endaa ilasotok le kodi olaing'okok?”
Kake ore pee ening Yesu, nejo, “Meyieu ilememuoi olabaani, kake iloomuoi ooyieu.
Enchom enteng'ena ate eneikununo ele rorei, ojo, ‘Olng'ur ayieu mme olasar;’ amu eitu alotu aipot isupati kake ilaing'okok.”
Nepuonu ina kata lkipaareta le Yohana enetii Yesu nejoki, “Aainyo pee kipukoo oleng iyiook o Lfarisayo, nemepukoo lkipaareta linono?”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Keidim ilchoreta lo loyamishe aaishira eton eboitare oloyamishe? Kake kepuonu nkolong'i naayae olayamishe aaitung'uaa ninche, ina kata kenya epukoo.
“Meetae oltung'ani oripaki enkarasha ng'ejuk enkila musana; amu ore ina natipikaki nepolos enkila, neponari apolosa.
Nemepik sii iltung'ana enaisho ng'ejuk oo sabibu ilbenia musan; naa te nepik nepolosa ilbenia, neibukori enaisho oo sabibu nepolosa sii Lbenia; kake ilbenia ng'ejuko epiki pee erripi pokira are.”
Ore eton eliki Yesu ninche kuna baa, nelotu oltung'ani oitore enkaji e ntumo negilaki Yesu kung nejoki, “Etua te na kata entito ai, kake wou inteleiki enkaina ino pee epiu ninye.”
Neinyototo Yesu o lkipaareta lenyena nesuj ninye.
Nelotu enkitok te siadi ninye, naturuke osarge larin tomon o are, neiseyie olcholoi lo lkila lenye; amu etejo to ltau lenye,
“Te naiseyie ake olcholoi lo lkila lenye naishiu.”
Neibelekenya Yesu nedol ninye, nejoki, “Naito, intagoluoyu amu kinchiunye enkirukoto ino.” Neishiu ina kitok aiteru teina kata ake.
Ore pee elotu Yesu enkaji eilo oitore enkaji e ntumo nedol ilookut indulen o lorere eilepilep oleng,
nejoki, “Ewuang'a amu eitu eye entito, keirura.” Nekueniyie ninche aayiet.
Ore pee eidipi aaipung'ie olorere, nejing neibung enkaina enye, neinyototo entito.
Neibulu kulo omon ilo kerenket pooki.
Ore pee egiroo Yesu ine nesuj iltung'ana aare modook ooishiraki aajoki, “Ing'urrie iyiook enkerai e Daudi.”
Ore pee ebaiki aji, nepuonu ilmodook enetii, nejoki Yesu ninche, “Irukuruku aajo kaidim ataasa ena?” Nejoki, “Ee lo kitok.”
Neiseyie nkonyek enye nejo, “Inchoo etiu anaa enkirukoto inyi.”
Nebolo inkonyek enye. Neitanap Yesu nereiki ajoki ninche, “Entodol emincho hoo oltung'ani obo eyiolou.”
Kake eipung'o nepuo aaibulunye ilomon lenyena ilo kerenket pooki.
Ore pee eipang lelo, neyakini Yesu oltung'ani lemeiro otijing'a oloirirua.
Ore pee earaa oloirirua, neiro ilo lemeiro apa, neing'asia iltung'ana kumok nejo, “Eitu ae kata edoli ena tiatua enkop oo Siraeli.”
Kake etejo Lfarisayo, “Engolon oo loiriruani eararie Yesu iloiriruani.”
Neman Yesu inkang'itie pooki sapuki o nkutiti, neiteng'enisho too nkajijik enye e ntumo, nelikioo ilomon supati le nkitoria e keper, neishiunye pooki keeya o pooki pukunoto e muoyian.
Ore pee edol ninye olorere netum olng'ur te ninche amu eteekate ninche, nelepori neidapashari netiu anaa ntare nemeeta olchekut.
Nejoki Yesu lkipaareta lenyena, “Esipa aisapuk enkikesare kake kuti ilaisiaayiak.
Kaae, entoomon naa Olaitoriani liopeny enkikesare meirriu ilaisiaayiak atua enkikesare enye.”
Neipot Yesu lelo ooiteng'eni lenyena tomon o aare, neisho meitoria nearaa iloiriruani ooiduruk, neishiunye sii mpukunot pooki oo muoyiaritin o nkeyaitin.
Naa kuna nkarn oo lkipaareta lenyena pokira tomon o aare; ole dukuya naa Simon oji Petero, o Andrea olalashe lenye; Yakobo le Sebedayo o Yohana olalashe lenye;
Filipo, o Bartolomayo; Tomas o Matayo olasotoni le kodi; Yakobo le Alfayo, o Tadayo;
Simon onyor olosho lenye o Yudas Iskariot laa ninye otakaldayie Yesu.
Kulo pokira tomon o aare eirriwayie Yesu neitanap ajoki, “Emipuo nkoitoi oo Loreren, nimijing'ijing'i enkang hoo nabo oo ltung'ana le Samaria
kake enchom enetii ntare kiminat e nkaji e Siraeli.
Ore ipuopuo, entolikioi entejo ‘Etinyikua enkitoria e keper.’
Enchiunye iloomuoi, entopiu ilootuata enchiunye ilooata enkeeya oo lbolot, entaarai iloiriruani. Eishooki intae pesho, enchooi sii intae pesho.
Emishoroo saabu anaa mpisai too lbenia linyi,
nimishoroo olbene te lototo inyi, anaa inkilani maare, anaa inamuka, anaa eng'udi, amu keishiaakino olaisiaayiani endaa enye.
“Ore pooki ang sapuk o enkiti nijing'ijing'i, enkilikuanisho tenaa ketii oltung'ani supat atua, nitonini tenebo ninye o metaba anaa nidumunyenye aapuo.
Naa tinijing'ijing'i enkaji eroroki.
Naa te neitoomoni intae teina aji, nejing osotua linyi shumata ninye, naa te neitu eitoomoni intae, neshukokino intae osotua linyi.
Ore pooki ng'ae lemeng'amaa intae, anaa olemening ororei linyi, ore pee ipukuku aaing'uaa ina aji, anaa ina ang, nimpiripiroo enterit natii nkejek inyi.
Esipa ajoki intae, keikashieki Sodom o Gomora teina ang te nkolong enkiguana!
“Kairriwaa intae anaa nkerra atua suyian, enteng'enita anaa lasuriaa, niborrurru anaa nturkuluoni.
Kake entodol ate too ltung'ana amu keishooyo intae meiguanareki neidong intae tiatua nkajijik enye e ntumo
Naa keriki intae dukuya ilbalosuni o laiguanak te nkaraki nanu, pee iakuku shakeni te ninche o too Loreren.
Kake ore ina kata te nerik intae, eming'aeng'ae aajo, ‘Kaa kijo’, amu keishori intae teina kata enijojo.
Amu mme intae ooiro, Enkiyang'et e Papa linyi nairo tiatua intae.
“Naa keishooyo olalashe olikae, metaari metua, neishooyo menye enkerai, nedumakino nkera ntoiuo enye neishooyo ninche metaari metuata.
Naa keibayu intae iltung'ana pooki, te nkaraki enkarna ai, kake ore olong'iri o metabaiki enkiting'oto nejeu.
Naa te nearari intae te nkang nabo, esikaki enkae, amu esipa ajoki intae, miishushu nkang'itie e Siraeli pooki eitu elotu Enkerai e Tung'ani.
“Melang oloiteng'eni oloiteng'en ninye, nemelang osinka oloitore ninye.
Keidim oloiteng'eni atotiuo anaa oloiteng'en ninye, netiu osinka anaa oloitore ninye. Pasa taa etejo olopeny enkaji Beelsebul, kebaa eitulusoo aajo neijia lootii enkaji enye!
“Metaa emiure lelo tung'ana amu meetae embae naisudoyioki nemeyiolouni.
Ore enajoki nanu intae te naimin embalunye te wang'an, ore enining'ining'i te nkiok, entolikioi too nchumarot oo nkajijik.
Emiureyu ilo oar osesen nemeidim aatar enkiyang'et, enare ti niureyuyu ilo oidim aidaikie pokira are enkiyang'et o sesen tiatua olbalbal le nkima.
Ai meinosieki imotonyi are empisai nabo, kake mesulunye nabo aosh enkop, meyiolo Papa linyi.
Ore ninche intae, eikenaki o metabaiki lpapit loo lukuny inyi.
Ore te nkaraki ina emiureishoyu amu irara ile tipat inkashikasha aalang imotonyi kumok.
“Ore naa pooki laaibalie te dukuya ltung'ana, naa kaibalie sii ninye te dukuya Papa lai otii keper.
Ore pooki laamiki te dukuya ltung'ana naa kamiki sii nanu ninye te dukuya Papa lai otii keper.
“Emidamu nijojo kaewuo ayau osotua enkop; eitu alotu ayau osotua, kake olalem ayaua.
Aewuo nanu airriki olayioni o menye nairriki entito o ng'otonye, nairriki entito o enkaputani.
Ore lmang'ati lo ltung'ani keaku lelo le nkaji enye.
“Ore olonyor menye anaa ng'otonye aitalang nanu, anaa olonyor olayioni lenye anaa entito enye pee aaitalang nanu, nemaishiaakino nanu.
Ore olemenap osalaba lenye naasuju nemaaishiakino nanu.
Ore ologolie enkishui enye neiminie, ore oloiminie enkishui enye te nkaraki nanu negolie.
“Ore olong'amaa intae, nanu etang'amayie, ore olaang'amaa nanu naa ilo lairriwua etang'amayie.
Ore olong'amaa oltung'ani supat te nkaraki naa supat, netum olerrinyore lo ltung'ani supat.
Ore oloisho obo le kulo ooti, enkikompe e nkare nairobi te nkaraki naa oloiteng'eni lai, esipa ajoki intae, meimin olerrinyore lenye.”
Ore pee eidip Yesu aitanapa lkipaareta lenyena tomon o are, neing'uaa ine nelo aiteng'enisho, nelikioo ororei too nkang'itie naamanita ine.
Nening Yohana eena te jila nkiasin e Kristo, neirriwaki lkipaareta lenyena nejoki,
“Ai yie olapa olotu ana keetae likae likiaanyu?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Enchom entoliki Yohana imbaa nining'itoto o nidolitata.
Etodolishote ilmodook, nepuo ilmaiman, neishiunyeki le nkeeya oo lbolot, nening'ishoyu lming'anta, neitopiuni ilootuata, ore ilaisinak, nelikini Ororei Supat le Nkai.
Nemayiana olemetum olkob te nanu.”
Ore epuoito lkipaareta le Yohana neimaki Yesu Yohana to lorere ajoki, “Kainyoo ishomo intae aadol ti ong'ata? Ke olperesi oyuk osiwuo?
Kake aainyo pee impang'a aapuo? Ke oltung'ani oishopito nkilani naapuyiapui ishomo aadol? Ore ilo oishop inkilani naapuyiapui nkajijik oo laiguanak etii.
Kake ainyoo pee impang'a aapuo? Ke oloiboni le Nkai ishomo aadol? Ee pae olkitok olang oloiboni le Nkai Yohana.
Amu ninye eimakaki pee etisiraki aajo, ‘Kairriwaa olkipaaret lai aiturukie te iyie, likintobiraki enkoitoi ino.’
Kesipa ajoki intae, eitu etumi aekata too ltung'ana ooiu nkituaak, olkitok olang Yohana Olaibatisani. Kake ore oloti aisul te nkitoria e keper naa kitok te ninye.
Ore ebaiki nkolong'i e Yohana Olaibatisani o taata eisimitai te ngolon enkitoria e keper, neisimaa ilo ogol.
Amu eibonutuo loibonok pooki le Nkai nkitanapat ometabaiki Yohana;
naa te naa iyieuu ning'amumu ena, ele doi Eliya, olapa olotu.
Oloata nkiyiaa toning'o.
“Kainyoo aitanyaanyukie ltung'ana le na kata? Etiu anaa nkera naatoni too neemirishoreki, neipot inkulie nejoki,
‘kitooshokito intae ndulen neitu iranyiranya; nikinchirakita intae neitu nchirishiri.’
Amu eewuo Yohana nemedaa, nemeokisho, nejo ltung'ana, ‘Keeta oloirirua.’

Ore Enkerai e Tung'ani neewuo nedaa, neokisho, nejo ninche, ‘Eng'ura oltung'ani oulu, olaokoni le naisho naa olchore loo loosotu kodi o laing'okok!’ Kake too nkiasin etokorduaki kulo tiatua ltung'ana, pee eaku ilng'anayio le dukuya le Nkai o lo Lkuoo le Ker.”
Neiteru Yesu aisikong nkang'itie naataasie siaaitin enyena e nking'asia, amu eitu eirridu ng'ok enye,
“Ee kake ayia Korasin, ee kake ayia Betsaida, amu te naa ketaasaki inenking'asia naataasaki tiatua intae, te Tiro o te Sidon anaata eirridutua apa te musano, neishop ilkuniyiani neelare nkuruon.
Kake ajoki intae, keikashieki Tiro o Sidon te nkolong e nkiguana aaitalang intae.
Oi iyie Kapernaum aa ijo eikisisi aailepie shumata? Ae kintadouni tabaiki enemeneng'a. Amu ore isiaaitin naataasaki tiatua iyie, te naa ketaasaki apa te Sodom anaata eton eetae ina ang o tene.
Amu esipa ajoki intae, keikashieki enkang e Sodom te nkolong e nkiguana aaitulusoo te iyie.”
Neitoki Yesu ajo teina kata, “Aaisho iyie enashe, Papa Olaitoriani le keper o enkop, amu isudorie kuna baa iltung'ana ng'eni niboloki nkera.
Ee neijia etiu Papa amu ina nikintishipa iyie.
“Aaishoo Papa pooki toki, nemeetae hoo obo oyiolo ina Kerai leme Papa ake, nemeetae hoo obo oyiolo Papa leme ina Kerai ake o pooki ng'ae ogelu Enkerai aboloki.
“Wootu enatii intae pooki oonyamal niatata ilolan ooiroshi, pee ayeng'iyeng'ie intae.
Enteleiki ate enchata ai oo murto, enteng'ena ate te nanu, amu kabor nemawuasa to ltau, naa itumutumu intae enkiyeng'iyeng'ata to nkorroki inyi;
amu kelelek enchata ai oo murto naa keneneng olola lai.”
Ore teina kata nelo Yesu te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng naji Sabato aim atua nkurman e nkano, netir esumash lkipaareta lenyena, neitayu enkano aanya.
Ore pee edol Ilfarisayo nejoki, “Ng'ura enaasita lkipaareta linono, nemeishiaa te neasi te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Keitu isumusumu enataasa apa Daudi o looboitare etotiro esumash?
Etijing'a enkaji e Nkai nenya emukate nasinya nemeishoruno too nkitanapat meinosa ninye o lelo ooboitare, ilapolosak ake oonya.
Ana keitu isumusumu too nkitanapat inchere kegil ilapolosak le nkaji e Nkai enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng naji Sabato nemeikeni aajo eisarkionie ninche nemeji eitarruoitie ninche?
Kake ajoki intae, etii ene entoki kitok alang enkaji e Nkai.
Kake te naa itayioloito eneikununo ele rorei ojo, ‘Olng'ur ayieu mme olasar.’ Naa anaata mipikipiki entioto ilemeeta.
Amu Olaitoriani le nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata Enkerai e Tung'ani.”
Nelo Yesu aing'uaa ine alo ajing enkaji e ntumo
Netii ine oltung'ani oikaole enkaina. Neikilikuan ninche aajoki, “Inyorriki keishoruno too nkitanapat te nebakishoe te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng naji Sabato?” Aa kejo taa pee etum aaitang'oro ninye.
Nejoki ninche, “Kalo tung'ani linyi oata enker nabo, naa te nedoiki ina ker engumoto te nkolong e kiyeng'iyeng'ata, nemeibung aitayu?
Kebaa naa elusoo oltung'ani te nker! Te nkaraki e ina keishoruno metaasi mbaa supati te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata.”
Nejoki Yesu ilo tung'ani, “Intorioi enkaina ino!” Neitorioo neishiu atiu anaa enkae.
Kake eipang'a ake Ilfarisayo nepuo aaiguanare aaing'oru eneiko pee ear ninye metua.
Neyiolou Yesu ilo rorei nelo teine, nesuj iltung'ana kumok neishiunye ninche pooki.
Neitanap ajoki, pee melikioo,
ejo pee etum atabai enatejoki te nkutuk o loiboni le Nkai oji Isaya pee ejo,
“Osinka lai ele, lategelua, olanyor lai, oshipakino oltau lai; naa kapik Enkiyang'et ai shumata ninye, olaa ninye odung'oki loreren enkiguana te sipata
nemeilepilep ninye nemebuak; nemening'i oltoilo lenye too nkoitoi oo nkaulele,
nemegil oltiyani oilenye, nemear oltaa oiliilari, omanaa omeisulie enkiguana.
Naa enkarna enye eyooki Loreren aaisilig.”
Nerikokini Yesu ina kata oltung'ani oata oloirirua; naa modooni nemeiro, neishiunye, Yesu ninye neiro nedolishoyu.
Neing'asia olorora pooki nejo, “Keidim ele ataa ninye Enkerai e Daudi?”
Ore pee ening Ilfarisayo ina nejo, “Mearaa ele tung'ani iloiriruani mme te ngolon e Beelsebul olkitok loo loiriruani.”
Neyiolou Yesu ndamunot enye nejoki, “Ore enkitoo pooki naoro tiatua nerruoyo; anaa enkang ake pooki, anaa enkaji naoro aara maate, meitashe.
Amaa teniaraa Sheitani Sheitani, neoro ninye makewan, kaji naa eiko enkitoria enye teneitashe?
Amaa te naa te Beelsebul aaraa nanu iloiriruani, ai ng'ae eararie ninche nkera inyi? Ninche maate ooyooki aairrash intae.
Kake amaa te naa te Enkiyang'et e Nkai aaraa nanu iloiriruani, enkitoria e Nkai naa naewuo atua intae.
“Keidim oltung'ani atijing'a enkaji o ltung'ani ogol neya ntokitin enyena, eitu eng'as aen ilo tung'ani ogol? Pee etum aawa ntokitin e nkaji enye?
“Ore olemaaning'ore naa olmang'atinta lai ore olemeiturrur te nebo nanu, keisardaikie.
Te nkaraki ena ajoki intae, epalakini ltung'ana ng'ok pooki o emoroto namor Enkai, kake ore emoroto namor Enkiyang'et Sinyati, nemepalakini.
Ore olomor Enkerai e Tung'ani, kepalakini, kake ore pooki ng'ae omor Enkiyang'et Sinyati, nemepalakini tena ishoi o te ishoi nalotu.
“Entaa olchani sidai, nesidanu ilng'anayio lenyena, aashu entaa olchani torrono, netorronu lng'anayio lenyena amu too lng'anayio lenyena eyiolouni olchani.
Naishoi oo lasuriaa, kaji nkoko pee ndimidimi aairoro irorei supati irara intae torrok? Amu inaabore oltau eiro enkutuk.
Ore oltung'ani supat neitayu supati tiatua olchumati lenye sidai, ore oltung'ani torrono, neitayu ntorrok to lchumati lenye torrono.
“Ajoki naa intae, ore pooki rorei lemeeta tipat oiro iltung'ana, eikenu kenya ake te nkolong e nkiguana.
Amu to nkirorot inono kinkenakini isupati, naa to nkirorot inono kinkenakini ntorrok.”
Nejoki ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o Lfarisayo Yesu, “Olaiteng'enani, kiyieu nikidol olmonekie te iyie.”
Newaliki ajoki, “Keyieu kulo tung'ana lena kata torrok oololoito olmonekie nemeishori, pooki o lmonekie oishori naa olo loiboni le Nkai oji Yona.
Ore anaa apa etii Yona enkoshoke e ntiamasi o sinkirri ndamaritin uni o nkewarieitin uni, neijia sii etiu Enkerai e Tung'ani, kelo aton ndamaritin uni o nkewarieitin uni tiatua olodo lenkop.
Keitasheikinore iltung'ana le Ninawi te nkiguana ltung'ana le na ishoi, naa keiguanaki ninche nchere, eitarruoitie amu eirridutua ninche to lkilikuai le Yona; netii ene olkitok olang Yona.

Keitasheikinore enkaiguanani e moikuape te nkiguana ltung'ana le na kata naa keiguanaki ninche nchere eitarruoitie, amu eewuo ninye te nkop nalakua alotu ainining eng'eno e Solomon, netii ene olkitok olang Solomon.
“Te nepuku oloirirua torrono aing'uaa oltung'ani neimaa iwuejitin netoito eing'oru eneyeng'iyeng'are, nelau;
nejo, ‘Kashukokino enkaji ai natung'uayie’; ore pee elotu nedol ajo mijooni netooroki enkaji neikodi.
Nelo ariku kulikae oiriruani oopishana torrok aalang ninye, nejing aatoni, neaku mbaa eilo tung'ani torrok aalang enkiterunoto; neijia sii etiu te kulo tung'ana le na ishoi torrono.”
Ore eton eirorie Yesu iltung'ana neitashe ng'otonye o lalashera te boo eyieu neirorie.
Nejoki oltung'ani, “Eitashe ng'utunyi te boo, o lalashera linono, kiyie nikirorie.”
Newaliki Yesu ilo tung'ani ajoki, “Ae ng'ae yieyio anaa ae loo ng'ae ilalashera laainei?”
Neutaki te nkaina enye lelo ooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki, “Kulo yieyio o lalashera laainei.
Amu ore oloas enanyor Papa otii keper, ninye olalashe lai o enkanashe ai, o yieyio lai.”
Nepuku Yesu teina olong ti ang, nelo aton te mbata e naiposha.
Neiturrurrokino iltung'ana kumok, nejing empeut aton, neitashe olorere te mbata e naiposha.
Neirorie ninye too nkitanyaanyukot ajoki, “Etupukuo olaunoni alo aunisho.
Ore eunisho, nedoiki kulikae anterera embata e nkoitoi, nepuonu imotonyi aanya.
Nedoiki kulikae olkarkar loo soito ewueji nemetii enkulupuoni sapuk, nebulu nabo kata, amu metii enkulupuoni sapuk.
Ore pee edalu enkolong nepej, ore te nkaraki nemeeta ntona netoyu.
Nedoiki kulikae atua ilkiku negor ilkiku nkaitubulu.
Nedoiki kulikae enetii enkulupuoni sidai, neiu obo iip neiu likae ntomoni ile, neiu likae tomoni uni.”
“Oloata nkiyiaa toning'o.”
Nepuonu lkipaareta le Yesu nejoki ninye, “Kaji etiu pee irorie ninche too nkitanyaanyukot?”
Neng'amaa ajoki, “Te nkaraki naishooki intae entayiolo inkisudorot e nkitoria e keper, kake eitu eishori ninche.
Amu ore oloata naa keishori neponikini ninye enadooyo, ore olemeeta neoruni ninye ina naata.
Te nkaraki ina pee airorie nanu ninche too nkitanyaanyukot amu kedolisho too nkonyek nemedol, nening'isho too nkiyiaa nemening, nemejing'aa.
“Naa te ninche eitabari enaibon e Isaya pee ejo, ‘Ining'ining'i nimining'ung'u hoo pito, ning'oring'oro, nimidolidolo toki,

amu eiroshiutuo iltauja le kulo tung'ana, netiripate inkiyiaa mening, neikeno nkonyek enye, pee medolisho ake too nkonyek enye, nening'ishoyu too nkiyiaa enye, neyiolou ltauja lenye, naaibelekenyakino nanu pee aishiunye ninche.’
“Kake emayiana inkonyek inyi amu idolishosho, nemayiana nkiyiaa inyi amu ining'ishosho.
Kesipa ajoki intae, kumok iloibonok le Nkai o ltung'ana supati oong'uar apa pee edol kuna baa nidolitata intae, neitu edol, o pee ening kuna baa nining'ining'i intae, neitu ening.
“Entoning naa intae enkitanyaanyukoto o launoni.
Ore pooki tung'ani oning ororei le nkitoria e keper nemejing'aa, nelotu ilo torrono awuapaa inaatuunoki to ltau lenye. Nena etuunoki te mbata e nkoitoi.
Ore inaatuunoki to lkarkar loo soito, na elde oning ororei neng'amaa nabo kata te ng'ida;
kake meeta intona makewan, kake keton penyo, ore pee epuonu isinaitin anaa olosilisili te nkaraki eilo rorei nerrorro.
Naa ore inaatuunoki tiatua lkiliku, naa ilo oning ororei, neirony isinaitin le na kop, o elejare oo masaa e na kop, negor ororei nemeisho.
Ore nena naatuunoki te nkulupuoni sidai, naa ilo oning ororei nejing'aa naa keiu ilng'anayio, aiu obo iip, neiu likae intomoni ile, neiu likae tomoni uni.”
Neitoki aliki ae kitanyaanyukoto ajo, “Etiu enkitoria e keper anaa oltung'ani otuuno enkano te nkurma enye.
Kake ore eirura ltung'ana nelotu olmang'atinta aun endiati tiatua enkano, nelo.
Ore pee ebulu enkano, neiu ilng'anayio nebulu sii ninye eriaa.
Nepuo isinkan enetii olopeny enkaji nejoki, ‘Lo kitok, keitu iyie iun enkano te nkurma ino? Kaji eing'uaa eriaa?’
Nejoki, ‘Olmang'atinta lai oikuna neijia.’ Nejoki isinkan, ‘Iyieu nikipuo aadotu aaiturrurru?’
Nejoki, ‘Emipuo pee midotunyenye eriaa enkano.
Entapal metubulu pokira are ometaa enkata nadung'i, paa ore enkata enkikesare, najoki iladung'ok entang'as enturrurro eriaa, enteen irridat, entapejoi, ninturrurrokiki enkano olkompe lai.’ ”
Neitoki Yesu aliki ninche ae kitanyaanyukoto ajo, “Etiu enkitoria e keper enaa enkantererai naji karadali natuuno oltung'ani te nkurma enye.
Naa kiti ninye alang ilanterera pooki, kake ore pee ebulu neaku sapuk alang inkaitubulu ometaa olchani, omeetu imotonyi aapik nkajijik ilng'osil lenyena.”
Neitoki aliki ninche ae kitanyaanyukoto nejo, “Etiu enkitoria e keper anaa enkaisuishoi natudumua enkitok neitushulaki imboreitin uni e nkurma e nkano ometaba anaa neisuishoyu pooki.”
Einosaka Yesu olorora mbaa pooki too nkitanyaanyukot, neitu hoo einosaki likae rorei metii enkitanyaanyukoto.
Pee etum atabai enatolimuo oloiboni le Nkai otejo, “Too nkitanyaanyukot abol enkutuk ai, alimu mbaa naaisudoro apa te musano pee eitamanyuni enkop.”
Neing'uaa Yesu siamon nejing aji, nepuonu lkipaareta lenyena nejoki, “Imbalakinye iyiook enkitanyaanyukoto endiati te nkurma.”
Neng'amaa ajoki, “Ore oloun ilanterera sidain, naa Enkerai e Tung'ani.
Ore enkurma naa enkop, ore ina antererai sidai naa nkera e ina Kitoria, ore endiati na nkera e ilo torrono.
Ore ilo mang'atinta oun naa Sheitani, ore enkikesare, naa enkiting'oto e nkop, ore ilooikes naa ilmalaika.
Ore anaa enatasotuoki endiati aapejoo te nkima, neijia sii etiu te nkiting'oto e nkop.
Keirriu Enkerai e Tung'ani ilmalaika lenyena, meitayu tiatua enkitoria enye inkitadiaat pooki o loas intorrok.
Nenang'aki ninche olmoti le nkima, neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.
Ore teina kata newang'u isupati anaa enkolong te nkitoria e Menye. Oloata nkiyiaa naaning'ie, toning'o.
“Etiu enkitoria e keper anaa olchumati oisudoyioki tiatua enkurma, netum oltung'ani neturoo aisudoo, ore te nchipai enye, nelo amir pooki toki naata nelotu ainyiang'u ina kurma.
“Etiu enkitoria e keper anaa oltung'ani omirisho, oing'oru soito oogol enkinyang'a.
Ore pee etum obo, nelo amir intokitin pooki naata, neinyang'u ina.
“Ore ake sii, etiu enkitoria e keper anaa orreshet otanang'akaki atua enaiposha, nejing impukunot pooki oo sinkir.
Ore pee eiput neyietuni embata e naiposha, netoni aagelaki isidain ilbenia, neiturrarri iltorrok.
Neijia etiu te nkiting'oto e nkop. Kepuonu ilmalaika aagelu iltorrok aarishie isupati.
Nenang'akini ninche atua olmoti le nkima, neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.”
Neikilikuan Yesu ajoki, “Itoning'utuo nena pooki?” Nejoki ninche, “Ee.”
Nejoki, “Te nkaraki ina, ore pooki aiteng'enani loo nkitanapat ng'en te nkitoria e keper etiu anaa oltung'ani liopeny enkaji oitayu te nkaji enye nashumishoreki olchumati lenye, ing'ejuko o musan.”
Ore pee eidip Yesu atolimu kuna kitanyaanyukot nelo.
Ore pee ebaya enkang enye, neiteng'enisho te nkaji e ntumo, neing'asia iltung'ana oleng, nejo, “Kaji enotie ele tung'ani eng'eno o enkidimata naasie kuna naas e nking'asia?
Ae mme ele doi olayioni lo laguetani? Neji ng'otonye Mariamu? Ae emeji lalashera lenyena Yakobo o Yosef o Simon o Yuda?
Ae metii sii nkanashera enyena pooki atua iyiook? Kaji enotie ele tung'ani kuna baa pooki?”
Neaku etanyaita ninche ninye, kake etiaaka Yesu ninche, “meishori oloiboni le Nkai enkanyit te nkop enye aashu te nkaji enye.”
Neitu eas Yesu inenking'asia kumok teine te nkaraki enkirukoto nemeeta ninche.
Ore ina kata nening'oo olaiguanani Herode olning'o le Yesu
nejoki sinkan lenyena, “Yohana Olaibatisani taa ele otopiwuo aing'uaa lootuata, paa ina magilanisho naasisho tiatua ninye.”
Amu eibung'a apa Herode Yohana aen apik jila te nkaraki e Herodias enkitok e Filipo olalashe lenye.
Amu etiaaka Yohana, “Mikinchoro too nkitanapat ti niaata ninye.”
Ore pee eyieu near Yohana metua, neureyu olorere amu kejo pooki oloiboni le Nkai Yohana.
Ore pee ebau enkolong e inoto e Herode, neranyisho entito e Herodias te mpolos o lorere, neitiship Herode.
Nenya Herode olmumai nchere, ore entoki pooki naomon ninye, neisho.
Neiguan ng'otonye, nejoki tiaaki, “Inchooki tena beshen elukunya e Yohana Olaibatisani.”
Neisinanuo Olaiguanani, kake ore te nkaraki ilmuma lenyena o lelo ooboitare neitanapisho meishori.
Neirriwaa oltung'ani meshomo adung'u elukunya e Yohana te jila.
Neyauni elukunya enye te mbeshen neishori entito, neyaki ina tito ng'otonye.
Nepuo lkipaareta le Yohana aaya osesen aanukaa, nepuo aainosaki Yesu.
Ore pee ening Yesu lelo omon, neinyototo ajing empeut alo ewueji neliyio, ore pee ening olorere, nesuj too nkejek eing'uaa nkang'itie enye.
Ore pee edou Yesu te mpeut, nedol olorere kumok, neing'urrie neishiunye iltamuoyia lenye.
Ore pee eaku teipa, nepuo lkipaareta lenyena enetii nejoki, “Ore ene nikitii naa ewueji neliyio, netaa teipa tiaaki olorere meshomo kuna ang'itie pee epuo aainyiang'aki ate endaa.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Meeta tipat napuoyie, enchoo intae endaa.”
Nejoki lkipaareta, “Mikiaata iyiook toki neme mukateni miet o sinkir aare.”
Nejoki, “Eyakaki.”
Nejoki olorere metotona too nkujit, nedumu nena mukateni imiet o sinkir aare, neing'or shumata, nemayian, negil nena mukateni, neisho lkipaareta lenyena, neisho lkipaareta lenyena olorere.
Nenya pooki neraposho, nesotuni naatelekutua nkikapuni tomon o aare, naabore.
Ore ilooinosa naa inkalifuni imiet ilewa metii nkituaak o nkera.
Neitanap Yesu ina kata lkipaareta lenyena meituruko aapuo te mpeut lido kekun ometaba anaa neitanapare olorere.
Ore pee eidip aitanapare olorere, neilepaki oldoinyo alo aomon; ore pee eaku teipa neaku ninye ake openy.
Netalama empeut enkop natoyio, eyukito lopir le nkare amu kenang'are osiwuo.
Ore pee enyiku enkakenya, nelotu Yesu enetii ninche elo too nkejek ti oriong enkare.
Ore pee edol lkipaareta lenyena eloito too nkejek ti oriong enkare neureishoyu nejo, “Oloip doi!” Nebuak aaishir te nkuretisho.
Neirorie taa Yesu nejoki, “Entagoluoto, Nanu doi! Emiureisho.”
Newaliki Petero ajoki, “Lo Kitok, te naa eiyie, tiaakaki maeu enitii too nkejek ti oriong enkare.”
Nejoki, “Wou.” Nedou Petero te mpeut nelo too nkejek ti oriong enkare enetii Yesu.
Ore pee edol osiwuo neureishoyu neiteru aimis, nebuak to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Lo Kitok, tasaruaki!”
Neitorioo Yesu enkaina nabo kata aibung nejoki, “Oi iyie oloti enkirukoto, aainyo pee inyaaka aing'ash?”
Ore pee eilepaki, empeut, negira osiwuo.
Ore ilo otii ina peut neserem ninye nejoki, “Esipa ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai.”
Ore pee eidip aatalang, nebaiki enkop e Genesaret.
Ore pee eyiolou iltung'ana le ina kop ninye neirriwaa ilkiliku ilubot pooki eilo kirine neyakini ltamuoyia.
Nesai meiseyie olcholoi lo lkila lenye, ore ilooiseyie pooki neishiu.
Nepuonu Ilfarisayo oo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ooing'uaa Yerusalem enetii Yesu ejo,
“Kainyoo pee einyal lkipaareta linono inkoon oo lpayiani? Amu kenya endaa meisuja inkaik.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Kainyoo pee inyalinyala intae inkitanapat e Nkai te nkaraki nena koon inyi?
Amu etejo Enkai, ‘Iyanyita minyi o ng'utunyi; ore oloitarriki menye aashu ng'otonye, inchoo metua.’
Kake ijojo intae, ore oltung'ani ojoki menye anaa ng'otonye inchere, ‘Ore toki naata naaretie iyie etaa enaisho Enkai to lasar,’ neaku meyanyit menye aashu ng'otonye.
Ore te nkaraki nkoon inyi niwuang'ieng'ie nkitanapat e Nkai.
Lo sunkuro, enotoko Isaya te naibon enye pee ejo,
‘Kayanyit ele orere too nkutukie, kake kaalakuaniki iltauja lenye;
naa pesho aaserem ninche nanu, aa nkitanapat oo ltung'ana eitudupaa anaa ae ninche enkiteng'enare nasipa.’ ”
Neipotu iltung'ana nejoki, “Enining'o niyiolouu.
Mme entoki naim enkutuk naidurukie oltung'ani, kake enapuku te nkutuk naidurukie oltung'ani.”
Nepuonu lkipaareta lenyena nejoki, “Itayioloito aajo etirikate Ilfarisayo pee ening ilo rorei?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Ore pooki aitubului neme Papa le keper otuuno kedotuni.
Entapal ilarikok modook loo lmodook. Naa te nerik olmodooni olikae modooni nesulakino pokira aare engumoto.”
Newaliki Petero ajoki, “Imbalakinye iyiook ena kitanyaanyukoto.” Nejoki Yesu,
“Keton ake sii mejing'aa intae?
Aimiyiololo aajo ore pooki toki najing enkutuk o ltung'ani, enkoshoke elo neipang?
Kake ore enapuku te nkutuk, oltau eing'uaa; naa ninye naisarkionie oltung'ani;
amu oltau epukunye indamunot torrok, enkitayunoto oo loikop, eloloito, enkiborra oo nkonyek, enkiteenikinoto o emorore.
Kuna naaisarkionie oltung'ani, kake te nedaa meisuja inkaik, nemeisarkionie oltung'ani.”
Nelo Yesu teine aito enkalo o lkerenket le Tiro o Sidon.
Nelotu enkitok e Kanaan naing'uaa ina kop neishiraki ajoki, “Lo Kitok, ng'urrieki, ara Daudi, eitanyamalita enkerai ai oloirirua.”
Kake eitu hoo eng'amaa Yesu. Nepuonu lkipaareta lenyena aasai aajoki, “Inchoo ena kitok elo amu, kesujita iyiook eishirita.”
Newaliki ajoki, “Ntare kiminat ake e nkaji e Siraeli aairriwakaki.”
Nelotu ina kitok neserem nejoki, “Lo Kitok, taretuoki.”
Newaliki ajoki, “Meishiaakino te nenang'akini ildiein endaa oo nkera.”
Nejoki, “Kedede, Lo Kitok; kake kenya sii ildiein inaadoyio te misa oo lkituaak lenye.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Na kitok, aisapuk enkirukoto ino, metotiwuo te iyie anaa ina niyieu;” neishiu entito enye teina kata.
Nelo Yesu teine ashep enaiposha e Galilaya; neilepaki oldoinyo neton teine.
Neyiaya olorere kumok, erikito iltung'ana ng'ojiniaa o lmodook o lemeiro, o lmaiman, o lkulikae kumok neirragie too nkejek enyena, neishiunye pooki,
ometaba anaa neing'asia iltung'ana pee edol eiroro ilemeiro, neishiu ilmaiman, nepuo iltung'ana ng'ojiniaa, nedolishoyu ilmodook, neisis Enkai oo Siraeli.
Neipot Yesu lkipaareta lenyena meetu enetii nejoki, “Kaing'urrie iltung'ana amu, nkolong'i uni taata aaboitare nemeeta entoki nanya, nemayieu naisho meshomo eeta esumash, meiterriaa te nkoitoi.”
Nejoki lkipaareta lenyena, “Kaji kitumie tena ong'ata imukateni naaraposh ena siamo kitok naba inji?”
Nejoki Yesu, “Kaja mukateni niaatata?” Nejoki, “Naapishana o lkuti sinkir kutiti.”
Neitanap iltung'ana metotona te nkop;
nedumu nena mukateni naapishana o lelo sinkir, ore pee eisho Enkai enashe, nebelibel neisho lkipaareta lenyena pee eisho lkipaareta iltung'ana.
Nenya pooki neraposho neiturrur mbelat naatelekuaki naaiputa nkikapuni naapishana.
Ore ilooinosa nera ilewa nkalifuni ong'uan, metii inkituaak o nkera.
Neisho esiamo meshomo nejing ninye empeut nelo enkop e Magadani.
Nepuonu Ilfarisayo o Sadukayo enetii Yesu aatem eyieu neitodol olmonekie ooing'uaa keper.
Newaliki ajoki, “Ore te nteipa nijojo, ‘Mesha ade taata amu kenyokie shumata.’
Nijojo tadekenya, ‘Keidis ade taata amu kenyokie shumata netunukua.’ Indimidimi intae aatumusu ilmonek le shumata kake mindimidimi aaibalie ilmonek le kuna katitin.
Keing'oru kulo tung'ana torrok lena kata olmonekie kake meishori likae leme olapa le Yona.” Nelo aing'uaa ninche.
Ore pee epuo lkipaareta lido kekun, nerikino eitu eya imukateni.
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Entorrip ate te nkisuisho oo Lfarisayo o Sadukayo.”
Nejokino maate, “Te nkaraki neitu kiyau mukateni.”
Neyiolou Yesu ilo rorei nejo, “Oi intae ilooti enkirukoto, kainyoo pee ijokinono maate mukateni miaatata?
Keitu ejing'aa intae? Aimidamumu mukateni imiet naainosa iltung'ana nkalifuni imiet, kaja nkikapuni ninturrurrutuo?
Aashu mukateni naapishana naainosa inkalifuni ong'uan oo ltung'ana, kaja nkikapuni ninturrurrutuo?
Kainyoo pee mejing'aa intae nchere mme mukateni aimaka? Kake entorrip ate te nkisuisho oo Lfarisayo o Sadukayo.”
Nejing'aa teina kata inchere, mme enkisuisho oo mukateni eimaka kake inenkiteng'enare oo Lfarisayo o Sadukayo.
Ore pee elo Yesu enkalo e Kaisari e Filipi neikilikuan lkipaareta lenyena aajoki, “Kejo iltung'ana ae ng'ae Enkerai e Tung'ani?”
Nejoki, “Kejo kulikae Yohana Olaibatisani; nejo kulikae Eliya; nejo kulikae Yeremia, anaa obo loo loibonok le Nkai.”
Nejoki, “Paa aijojo intae kara nanu ng'ae?”
Newaliki Simon Petero ajoki, “Ira Iyie Kristo, Enkerai e Nkai naishu.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Imayiana Simon ara Yona, amu eitu kiboloki ena entoki naata osesen o sarge, kake Papa lai otii keper.
Naajoki nanu iyie, ira Petero naa te nchumata ele soit ashet enkanisa ai; nemegilu aekata ltimito le nemeneng'a.
Naa kaaisho iyie ilboleta le nkitoria e keper ore eniyiooki aen te nkop, neaku eidipaki aateen te keper; ore enilak te nkop eidipaki aatalak te keper.”
Neitanap lkipaareta lenyena pee meliki oltung'ani nchere ninye Kristo.

Neiteru Yesu teina kata aibalakinye lkipaareta lenyena inchere meeta kata nemelo Yerusalem meisilisili too mbaa kumok ilpayiani o lapolosak kituaak, o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat neari metua, neitopiuni te nkolong e uni.
Nerik Petero Yesu enkilepata nekurraki ajoki, “Mikintapaasha Enkai, Lo Kitok, mikitalama nena.”
Neibelekenyakino Petero ajoki, “Shomo te siadi nanu Sheitani, amu aikirror; amu mme imbaa e Nkai idamu kake noo ltung'ana.”
Nejoki Yesu teina kata lkipaareta lenyena, “Ore pooki tung'ani oyieu naasuj inchoo eany kewan nenap osalaba lenye naasuj.
Amu ore pooki tung'ani ojo aitajeu enkishui enye neiminie, ore pooki oiturraa enkishui enye te nkaraki nanu, neitoki atum.
Amu kaa dupoto etum oltung'ani te netum enkop pooki, neiturraa enkishui enye?
Amu kelotu Enkerai e Tung'ani te nkitoo e Menye te nebo o lmalaika lenyena; nelaaki pooki tung'ani teina kata aitorisioki inaataasa.
Kesipa ajoki intae, Ketii kulikae ooitashe te ne, lemeishamisham keeya katukul ometaba anaa nedol Enkerai e Tung'ani elotu te nkitoria enye.”
Ore pee elusoo inkolong'i ile, nerik Yesu Petero o Yakobo o lalashe lenye Yohana ailepie ninche oopeny shumata oldoinyo oado.
Neibelekenya empukunoto e Yesu newang'u enkomom enye anaa enkolong, neiborru inkilani enyena aatiu anaa ewang'an.
Neipang'aki Musa o Eliya aairorie ninye.
Neirorie Petero Yesu nejoki, “Lo Kitok, ai sidai kitii ene, naa te naa iyieu naitobir ilng'oborri okuni, olino obo o le Musa o le Eliya.”
Ore eton eirorita, neitushur enkatampoi nawang; neningi oltoilo teina atampoi ojo, “Enkerai ai ena nanyor, natishipe te ninye. Entoning ninye.”
Ore pee ening lkipaareta lenyena neirut oleng nebatata aairrabalakino enkop.
Nelotu Yesu neiseyie nejoki, “Enyoito emirut.”
Nejo mataraposhu nkonyek, neitu edol likae tung'ani Yesu ake openy.
Ore edou ninche to ldoinyo neitanap Yesu ajoki, “Emiliki oltung'ani nena nitoduaa ometaba anaa nepiu Enkerai e Tung'ani aing'uaa ilootuata.”
Neikilikuan lkipaareta lenyena aajoki, “Kainyoo naa pee ejo ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat eji keng'as Eliya alotu?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Kesipa eng'as Eliya alotu neitobir imbaa pooki.
Kake ajoki intae, eidipa Eliya aeu, neitu eyiolou ninche ninye, kake eitaasa pooki ninye naayieu. Neijia sii etiu Enkerai e Tung'ani, keisilisil ninche.”
Neyiolou taa teina kata lkipaareta aajo Yohana Olaibatisani eimaka.
Ore pee ebaya enetii iltung'ana nelotu oltung'ani obo agilaki kung nejoki,
“Lo Kitok, ing'urrie enkerai ai amu keeta enkiterria neisilisilo oleng amu katitin kumok eurokino enkima nesulakino enkare.
Natorikoko lkipaareta linono, netalaikinote aaishiunye.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Oi intae iltung'ana lena ishoi lemeeta enkirukoto, ootapong'ori, kaboitare intae o anu? Kang'iri te intae o anu? Entorikokoki.”
Neisikong Yesu oloirirua, nepuku oloirirua aing'uaa neishiu enkayioni teina kata.
Nepuo ina kata lkipaareta enetii Yesu oopeny nejoki, “Kainyoo pee kitalakinote iyiook aataarai?”

Nejoki, “Te nkaraki naa kiti enkirukoto inyi, amu kesipa ajoki intae, ti niaatata enkirukoto naba anaa ene kantererai naji karadali, naa indimidimi aatiaaki ele doinyo ‘Tadotunye te ne, shomo idie;’ nedotunye; nemetii embae nemeidimayu te intae.
Kake mepuku eneeijo ena mme te nkomono o te mpukoroto.”
Ore eiturrurro te Galilaya nejoki Yesu lkipaareta, “Etaa kepiki Enkerai e Tung'ani nkaik oo ltung'ana;
near ninche ninye metua, ore te nkolong e uni neitopiuni.” Neisinanuo lkipaareta oleng.
Ore pee epuonu Kapernaum, nepuo iloosotu olpisiai le shekeli e kodi enetii Petero nejoki, “Aimelak Olaiteng'enani linyi shekeli e kodi?”
Nejo, “Kelak.” Ore pee ejing aji nemurutoki Yesu aikilikuan ajoki, “Ijo aa Simon? Ai ng'ae eitalak ilkituaak le na kop kodi oo masaa aashu enoo ltung'ana, ai nkera enye ana ineeiking'a.”
Ore pee ejo Petero, “Ineeiking'a.” Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Neijia etiu, metii nkera enye esiana.
Kake ore pee mikintagor, shomo iyie enaiposha tanang'aki orreshet nintayu osinkirri ling'as aibung; nibol enkutuk, nitum shekeli, niya aitainye kodi ai o enino.”
Nepuonu ina kata lkipaareta enetii Yesu nejoki, “Kaing'ae olkitok te nkitoria e keper?”
Neipot enkerai neitasheyie te mpolos enye.
Nejo, “Kesipa ajoki intae, te neitu imbelekenyanya aatiu anaa inkera kutiti, nimijing'ijing'i katukul enkitoria e keper.
Ore pooki oitadou kewan anaa ena kerai, ninye olkitok aisul te nkitoria e keper.
Ore pooki ng'ae ong'amu enkerai naba anaa ena te nkarna ai, naa nanu etang'amua.
“Kake ore oloitapong'oo nabo kiti te kuna naairuk nanu metaasa ing'ok, keishiaakino neenikini osoit oituutishoreki emurt nenang'akini olmegut le naiposha.
Oi enkop te nkaraki mbaa naayau empong'oroto, amu meeta nchere pee mepuonu mbaa e nkitapong'oroto. Kake ee kake ayia te ilo laa ninye eimu empong'oroto.
“Ti nikintapong'oo enkaina ino aashu enkeju ino, tudung'oi nturrai amu enaikash te nijing enkishui miata enkaina aashu enkeju alang ti niata inkaik are o nkejek are, nikinang'akini enkima oo ntarasi.
Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkong'u ino, tukurtu nturrai amu enaikash ti nijing enkishui iata enkong'u nabo alang ti nikinang'akini enkima e Yehanam iata nkonyek pokira are.
“Eng'ura emimenaa nabo e kuna kutiti; amu ajoki intae ore te keper, eing'orita oshi ake ilmalaika lenye enkomom e Papa lai otii keper.
[Amu eewuo Enkerai e Tung'ani pee eitajeu inaaimina].
“Aijojo aa intae? Amaa te neeta oltung'ani nkerra iip nabo, aimeing'uaa kunda ntomoni naaudo o naaudo too ldoinyo nelo aing'oru ina naimina?
Ore pee etum, Kesipa ajoki intae, keshipakino oleng ina alang nena ntomoni naaudo o naaudo neitu eimin.
Neijia sii etiu mme eyieunoto e Papa linyi otii Keper, pee eimin nabo e kuna kutiti.
“Ti nikinyal olalashe lino, shomo toliki enikinyalie aa intae ake pokira aare; naa ti nikining, itoning'ote o olalashe lino.
Naa te neitu kining, torikoki likae tung'ani obo aashu aare, pee esipuni pooki bae too nkutukie oo lchakenini oaare aashu okuni.
Naa te neany ening ninche toliki kanisa; naa te neitu ening sii kanisa, inchoo etiu te iyie anaa oloo loreren lemeiruk, anaa olosotu kodi.
“Kesipa ajoki intae, ore pooki niyeniyene te nkop, neeni te keper; ore pooki nitalaa te nkop, nelaki sii te keper.
“Kesipa aitoki ajoki intae, te nining'okinono oaare linyi embae ake pooki te nkop niomonunu, naa keitaas intae Papa lai otii keper
Amu ore enetumore oaare anaa okuni te nkarna ai, natii nanu ine atua ninche.”
Nelotu Petero teina kata nejoki Yesu, “Lo Kitok, ae katitin aja aainyal olalashe lai, napalaki? Kemetabaiki katitin naapishana?”
Nejoki Yesu, “Maajoki metabaiki katitin naapishana, kake metabaiki ntomoni naapishana katitin naapishana.
Ore te nkaraki ina, etiu enkitoria e keper anaa olaiguanani otayiewua neikenisho te nebo isinkan lenyena.
Ore pee eiteru aikenisho nerikokini oltung'ani obo oata esile enye intalantani nkalifuni tomon.
Ore pee elau entoki nalakie, neitanapisho olkitok lenye metimiri ninye o enkitok enye o nkera enyena o ntokitin pooki naata, aalakie ina sile.
Nebatata ilo sinka too nkejek enyena nesai nejoki, ‘Lo Kitok, ting'iriakaki ometaba anaa naalaaki pooki.’
Neing'urrie olkitok ilo sinka nelaku nepalaki ina sile pooki.
“Ore pee eipung ilo sinka nedol likae sinka oboita te siaai oata esile enye dinari iip nabo; neibung olgos agor nejoki, ‘Talaakaki esile ai pooki.’
Nebatata ilo sinka oboita te siaai too nkejek enyena nesai ejo, ‘Ting'iriakaki ometaba anaa naalaaki pooki.’
Neany nerik apik jila ometaba anaa nelak esile pooki.
Ore pee edol ilkulikae ooboitare te siaai ena bae, neisinanuo oleng nepuo aaliki olkitok lenye inaataasate pooki.
Neipot olkitok ilo sinka nejoki, ‘Lo sinka arruoni, kaatapalaka idia sile pooki te nkaraki nikitasayia:
paa aimeishiaakino sii iyie ning'urrie osinka liboitare te siaai anaa enaaing'urrie nanu iyie?’
Negoro olkitok nepik inkaik oo looitameisho ometaba anaa nelak esile enye pooki.
“Neijia sii eiko intae Papa lai otii keper ti nimipalakiki too ltauja pooki tung'ani olalashe lenye.”
Ore pee eidip Yesu atejo kuna baa neing'uaa Galilaya nelotu enkop e Yudea te lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan;
nesuj ninye iltung'ana kumok; neishiunye ninche teine.
Nepuonu Ilfarisayo enetii aatem aajoki, “Keishiaakino te neorore olee enkitok enye te pooki bae?”
Newaliki ajoki, “Keitu isumusumu aajo ore oloitobira ninche te nkiterunoto, eitobira olee o eng'oruoi?
Nejo ninye te nkaraki ena eing'uaa olee menye o ng'otonye neibung'are enkitok enye, neaku ninche pokira osesen obo?
Metaa meekure aa are, kake osesen obo. Ore enaitutumo, Enkai, mincho erish oltung'ani.”
Nejoki Ilfarisayo ninye, “Kainyoo naa pee eitanapishe Musa meishori empalai e oro, neing'uaro?”
Nejoki Yesu, “Eishoo Musa intae entoorore inkituaak inyi te nkaraki engolon oo ltauja linyi, kake mme neijia apa etiu te nkiterunoto.
Ajoki nanu intae, ore pooki ng'ae oorore enkitok enye neme te nkaraki eloloito neyam ae, netololoite, ore oloyam enda natoororeki naa keloloito.”
Nejoki lkipaareta ninye, “Te naa inji naa etiu, embae o lmoruo o enkitok enye, meeta tipat enkiyama.”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Mme pooki ooidim aatang'amai ele rorei, kake lelo ake ooishoro.
Amu etii ilooini aa sunashi too nkoishuaa oo noo ng'otonye, netii iloogelem iltung'ana, netii ilooitaa ate sunashi te nkaraki enkitoria e keper. Ore ilo oidim atang'amu ena, inchoo eng'amu.”
Neyakini Yesu inkera kutiti pee eiteleiki nkaik enyena, neomonoki. Neisikong lkipaareta lenyena ilooyautua.
Nejoki Yesu, “Entapal inkera kutiti emimitiki epuonu enatii, emimitiki amu enoo naatiu anaa kuna enkitoria e keper.”
Neiteleiki ninche inkaik enyena nelo teine.
Nelotu oltung'ani nejoki, “Olaiteng'enani, kaa bae naikishiaan aas pee atum enkishui nemeish?”
Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Kainyoo pee kinkilikuan nanu inenkishiaa? Obo ake eetai aa supat; te naa iyieu nijing atua enkishui, imbung'a inkitanapat.”
Nejoki, “Akua?” Nejoki Yesu, “Kuna, miar metua, miloloito, mipurrisho, minchakenoki elejare.
Iyanyita minyi o ng'utunyi, tonyorra ole latia ino anaa kewan.”
Nejoki ilo barnoti ninye, “Aidipa aibung'a nena pooki: kainyoo ae naatong'orikia?”
Nejoki Yesu, “Te naa iyieu niaku bayaroti, shomo timira masaa pooki niaata, inchoo ilaisinak, neaku iata olchumati te keper, nikilotu asuj.”
Ore pee ening ilo barnoti ilo rorei, nelo eisinanuo amu eeta masaa kumok.
Nejoki Yesu lkipaareta lenyena, “Esipa ajoki intae nchere kegol pee ejing olkarsis enkitoria e keper.
Naitoki ajoki intae, kelelek te ntames eim enaudoto o ltidu alang olkarsis ejing enkitoria e Nkai.”
Ore pee ening lkipaareta lenyena neing'asia oleng nejo, “Aing'ae naa oidim atajeu?”
Nekurraki Yesu nkonyek nejoki ninche, “Meidimayu ina too ltung'ana, kake eidimayu pooki te Nkai.”
Newaliki Petero teina kata ajoki, “Ng'ura ajo kitung'aitie iyiook pooki toki, nikisuj iyie, kainyoo naa kenya kitum?”

Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Kesipa ajoki intae, ore intae likitusuja nanu, ore te nkop ng'ejuk te neton kenya Enkerai e Tung'ani to lorika le nkitoo enye, ore intae likitusuja nanu nitonini sii intae too lorikan tomon o aare aaiguanare lelo oshon tomon o aare loo Siraeli.
Naa ore pooki ng'ae otung'uayie inkajijik, anaa lalashera, anaa nkanashera, anaa menye anaa ng'otonye, anaa nkera, anaa nkurman te nkaraki enkarna ai naa ketum ninche inaalus o enkishui nemeish.
Kake keaku ilkumok le dukuya ile siadi, neaku ile siadi ile dukuya.
“Amu etiu enkitoria e keper anaa oltung'ani liopeny enkang otayoo enasirie alo aing'oru iltung'ana ootur enkurma enye oo Ing'anayio.
Ore pee eidip atoning'ore ilaisiaayiak pee elaaki dinari te nkolong, nerik enkurma enye oo sabibu.
Neitoki alo saa uni, netum kulikae eitashoo te nemirishoreki meeta esiaai,
nejoki sii lelo, ‘Enchom sii intae enkurma oo sabibu naisho intae entoki nairirikino.’ Nepuo.
Neitoki ake alo etaa saa ile, o saa naaudo, neiko ake neijia.
Ore saa tomon o obo, nelo netum kulikae ooitashoo nejoki, ‘Kainyoo pee intasheshe intae te ne endama pooki, miatata esiaai?’
Nejoki ninche ninye, ‘Amu eitu kitum oltung'ani oishoo iyiook esiaai.’ Nejoki, ‘Enchom sii intae enkurma oo sabibu.’
“Ore pee eaku teipa nejoki olopeny enkurma oo lng'anayio olaitasheikinoni lenye, ‘Impoto laisiaayiak, inchoo olekoisiayio, tang'asu to lobayie o mpung'ie to loiturukuo.’
Ore pee epuonu laduoo ooiterutua saa tomon oo obo netum ake pooki tung'ani dinari.
Nepuonu ile dukuya ejo ketum ninche nkumok, netum sii ninche pooki tung'ani dinari.
Ore pee eidip ninche aatang'amu neing'unyung'unyaki ilo openy enkang.
Nejo, ‘Ore kulo ooisiadutua esaa nabo ake etaasishote, nintorisioko iyiook ooting'iria te esiaai nagol enkolong pooki.’
“Newaliki obo lenye ajoki, ‘Olchore eitu nanu aainyal. Keitu duoo kining'okino o iyie dinari?
Imbung'a enino shomo. Amu atonyorrayie aisho ele oisiadua anaa enaaisho iyie.
Aimaaishiaakino te naas anaa enayieu too naainei? Ana keiba enkong'u ino te nkaraki naleng nanu?’
“Neijia etiu, keaku ile siadi ile dukuya, neaku ile dukuya ile siadi.”
Ore pee eaku keilep Yesu alo Yerusalem nerik lelo ooiteng'eni lenyena tomon o aare enkilepata te nkoitoi, nejoki,
“Kilepita aapuo Yerusalem, naa kepiki Enkerai e Tung'ani nkaik oo lapolosak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat neiguanare ninye enkiguana e keeya.
Neisho iloreren metusurdaanya,, near too nkeenta, neshei neitopiuni te nkolong e uni.”
Nelotu ng'otonye layiok le Sebedayo enetii Yesu eboitare ilayiok lenyena pokira aare neserem eeta enaomonu.
Neikilikuan Yesu ajoki, “Kainyoo iyieuu?” Nejoki, “Intanapisho metotona kulo ayiok laainei pokira aare obo te nkaina ino e tatene, neton olikae te nkaina e kedianye te nkitoria ino.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Miyiololo eniomonunu, aa ndimidimi aatook enkikompe naok nanu?” Nejoki, “Ee kindim.”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ee kesipa iokioko enkikombe ai kake ore entonata te nkaina ai e tatene ana te ne kedianye, mme nanu oishoru, kake eaku ene lelo ooitobiraka Papa lai.”
Ore pee ening kuldo tomon ina, negorokino lelo alashera pokira aare.
Neipot Yesu ajoki, “Iyiololo aajo, ore Ilaitoriak loo Loreren eitaa ate kituaak, neitoreisho te ngolon.
Ore te intae metiu neijia; kake ore pooki tung'ani te intae oyieu neaku kitok; inchoo eaku olaisiaayiani linyi,
ore oloyieu neaku ole dukuya te intae neaku osinka linyi;
anaa eneitu elotu Enkerai e Tung'ani meisiaai kake eewuo aisiaaisho neitayu enkishui enye metaa elakunoto oo lkumok.”
Ore epuo aaing'uaa Yeriko nesuj olorora kitok.
Naa ng'ura, Netii ltung'ana aare modook ootoni te mbata e nkoitoi, ore pee ening inchere Yesu ilo oimita ine nebuak aajo, “Lo Kitok ara Daudi, ing'urrie iyiook!”
Neisikong olorere ninche aaitigir, kake enyaakita aaitulusoo aabuak aajo, “Lo Kitok ara Daudi, ing'urrie iyiook!”
Neitashe Yesu neipot ninche nejoki, “Kaa iyieuu naitaas intae?”
Nejoki ninche ninye, “Lo Kitok, pee eboli iyiook inkonyek.”
Neing'urrie Yesu ninche neiseyie inkonyek enye; nedolishoyu ninche teina kata nesuj ninye.
Ore pee enyikaki Yerusalem nebaiki Betfage to Ldoinyo loo Loirienito neirriwaa Yesu lkipaareta oaare, nejoki ninche,
“Enchom enkang natii dukuya intae na idolidolo nabo kata teine esikiria naena o lkurrarru, entalaku enterewakaki.
Naa te neng'amaa intae oltung'ani entiaaki, ‘Olkitok oatayie enkolat’; nerewakini teina kata.”
Netaasate nena pee ebaya enatejo oloiboni le Nkai,
“Entiaki Yerusalem, kelotu enitii iyie olaiguanani lino, nebor nekedito esikiria, akedito olkurrarru le sikiria.”
Nepuo lkipaareta neas anaa inaitanapa Yesu,
nereu ina sikiria o enkurrarru neirotoki inkilani enye neked Yesu atonie.
Neisalaash ilkumok lo lorora ilkilani lenye te nkoitoi nedung'u kulikae ilng'osil loo lkeek neisalaashaki enkoitoi.
Ore olorere oituruko o losujita, nebuak aajo, “Hosana, Enkerai e Daudi; metamayiani ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani; Hosana te shumata naisul pooki.”
Ore pee ejing ninye Yerusalem, neiriiro enkang pooki, aajo, “Ai ng'ai ele?”
Nejo esiamo, “Yesu ele, oloiboni le Nkai le Nasaret e Galilaya.”
Nejing Yesu enkaji e Nkai nearaa lelo pooki oomirisho o looinyiang'isho aitupuku te nkaji e Nkai neibeloo misai oo ilooibelekeny mpisai o lorikan loo loomir inturkuluoni.
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Etisiraki inchere, ore enkaji ai keji enkaji e nkomono kake intaa intae enkapune oo laisimak.”
Nepuonu enetii Yesu tiatua enkaji e Nkai ilmodook o lng'ojiniaa; neishiunye ninye.
Kake ore pee edol ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat imbaa e nking'sia naataasa ninye o nkera eilepie iltoiloishi lenye te nkaji e Nkai ejo, “Hosana, Enkerai e Daudi.” Negoro ninche,
nejoki ninye, “Aa ining'ito enajoito kuna?” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ee, keitu isumusumu ai kata nchere, ‘Intabayie enkisisa too nkutukie oo nkera kutiti naanakita’?”
Neing'uaa ninche, neipang teina anasa nelo Betania neirrag ine.
Ore tadekenya eloito Yesu arrinyokino ina anasa netir esumash.
Nedol olng'aboli te mbata e nkoitoi neiwuang'aki, neitu etumie toki, imbenek ake; nejoki ilo shani, “Tala Ing'anayio ntarasi.” Netoyu nabo kata olng'aboli.
Ore pee edol lkipaareta ina bae, neing'asia nejo, “Kaji eikuna pee etoyio olng'aboli nabo kata?”

Newaliki Yesu, ajoki, “Kesipa ajoki intae, te naa iatata enkirukoto ming'ashing'asha, neme ena ake naitaasaki olng'aboli iasiasa kake ti nijokiki oldoinyo, ‘Tadotunye tanang'akinoyu enaiposha,’ neaku ina.
Ore pooki toki ninkilikuanunu te nkomono te nkirukoto nitumutumu.”
Ore pee ejing Yesu enkaji e Nkai nepuonu ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani kituaak enetii, eiteng'enisho nejoki, “Ai ti aa kidimata ias iyie kuna baa? Naa ai ng'ae likinchoo ena kidimata?”
Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Kaikilikuan sii nanu intae embae nabo, naa tinikiwalikiki, naliki sii nanu intae enkidimata naasie kuna baa.
Amaa, enkibatisa e Yohana, kaji eing'uaa? Ke keper eing'uaa ana ke ltung'ana?” Nejokino maate, “Te nikijo, ‘keper eing'uaa;’ naa kejoki iyiook, ‘Oo naa pee eitu irukuruku?’
Naa ti nikijo, ‘Iltung'ana eing'uaa’ nikiure olorere, amu kejo ltung'ana pooki oloiboni le Nkai Yohana.”
Newaliki ninche Yesu aajoki, “Mikiyiolo.” Nejoki sii ninye, “Maliki sii nanu intae enkidimata naasie kuna baa.
“Ijojo aa? Eeta apa oltung'ani ilayiok aare; nelo enetii obo nejoki, ‘Enkerai ai, shomo taata ntayu esiaai te nkurma oo sabibu.’
Neng'amaa ajoki, ‘Malo’ ore te siadi neirridu nelo.
Neitoki alo enetii olikae nejoki neijia. Neng'amaa ilo ajoki, ‘Kalo Papa’, kake eitu elo.
Kalo te lelo pokira aare otaasa enanyor menye?” Nejoki, “Lido le dukuya.” Nejoki Yesu, “Kesipa ajoki intae, iloosotu kodi o loololoito oong'as aajing enkitoria e Nkai te dukuya intae.
Amu eewuo Yohana enitii, te nkoitoi e supatisho, neitu irukuruku; kake eiruko iloosotu kodi o loololoito; kake ore pee idolidolo intae ina, neitu irridudu te siadi, aairuk ninye.

“Enining'o sii ae kitanyaanyukoto: Etii apa oltung'ani oata enkang, neun enkurma oo lng'anayio neitaman enkikarrata netur ewueji neironyie lng'anayio, neshetaki oltalet, neing'ueiki ilaturok, nelo ninye paran ae kop.
Ore pee eaku enkata naku lng'anayio, neirriwaki isinkan lenyena lelo aturok, meishoo lng'anayio lenyena.
Neibung ilaturok isinkan lenyena, neidong obo, near likai metua, near likai too soito.
Neitoki airriwaki kulikae sinkan kumok oolang lelo le dukuya, neiko sii ninche neijia.
Ore te siadi neirriwaki enkerai enye ejo, ‘Keyanyit ninche enkerai ai.’
“Kake ore ake pee edol ilaturok enkerai, nejokino maate, ‘Ele olajung'oni, mataar pee kitum enjung'ore enye.’
Neibung ninye nearaa aaipung'ie oriong enkurma oo lng'anayio near metua.
Amaa kenya te nelotu olopeny ina kurma oo lng'anayio, kaa eitaas lelo aturok?”
Nejoki, “Kear oleng lelo tung'ana torrok metuata neisho enkurma oo lng'anayio kulikae aturok ooitabaiki ninye ilng'anayio too rishat enye.”

Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Keitu aekata isumusumu too lkigerot, ‘Ore ilo soit otanyaita ilashetak ninye otaa osoit kitok lo lmairroto. Ore ilo rorei naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa, naa ole nking'asia too nkonyek ang.’
Te nkaraki ina pee ajoki intae, keoruni intae enkitoria e Nkai aaisho olorere oiki lng'anayio, [
naa ore olosulakino ilo soit, negiligil. Ore olosulakino ilo soit neidong aitaa emposio.]”
Ore pee ening ilapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo kuna kitanyaanyukot, neyiolou aajo ninche eipirta.
Ore eing'oru eneiko pee eibung, neureyu olorere amu ejo ninche, oloiboni le Nkai Yesu.
Neitoki Yesu airorie ninche, too nkitanyaanyukot ejo:
“Etiu enkitoria e keper anaa olaiguanani oitobiraka enkerai enye osirua le nkiyama.
Neirriwaa isinkan lenyena meipoto ilooitoomonoki meetu osirua le nkiyama neany ninche epuonu.
Neitoki airriwaa kulikae sinkan ajoki, ‘Entiaki lelo ooipotoki, Eng'ura Aidipa aitobira endaa o sirua, eyiang'a ilmong'i o lasho oopir eidipate intokitin pooki, wootu osirua le nkiyama.’
Neitu ninche eshilaa ina, nepuo pooki nkolati enye, nelo likae enkurma enye, nelo likai emirare enye.
Ore ilkulikae ootelekutua, neibung isinkan lenyena aainyal near metuata.
Ore pee ening olaiguanani ina negoro oleng, neirriwaa iltimito loo lmurran lenyena metaara lelo tung'ana arruok, nepejoo enkang enye.
Nejoki olopeny enkiyama isinkan lenyena, ‘Eoto indaiki o sirua le nkiyama, kake ore lelo ooipotoki nemeishiaakino nepuonu ele sirua.
Enchom ineerishare inkoitoi ore pooki lidolidolo, empotoki osirua le nkiyama.’
Nepuo lelo inkoitoi naalala enkanasa, neiturrurru pooki oonoto ninche, iltorrok o supati, neiput ilomon ina aji e nkiyama.
Nejing'u olaiguanani aing'or ilomon, nedol oltung'ani obo lemeishopito enkila e nkiyama; nejoki,
‘Olchore kaji nkununye ene miaata enkila e nkiyama?’ Negira
Nejoki olaiguanani isinkan lenyena, ‘Enteen ninye inkaik o nkejek, ninang'akiki enaimin e auluo; neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.’
“Amu kumok ilooipotoki kake ilkuti oogeluno.”
Nepuo ina kata Ilfarisayo aaiguanare enaiko pee erresh Yesu too nkirorot enyena.

Neirriwaki ninche ninye lkipaareta lenye te nebo ile Herode aajoki, “Loaiteng'enani, kiyiolo aajo ira olasipani nintayiolo ltung'ana; enkoitoi e Nkai te sipata amu miing'or empukunoto o ltung'ani. Toliki naa iyiook.
Ijo aa iyie? Keishaa ti nikincho Kaisari kodi ana eimeishaa?”
Kake neyiolou Yesu esunkuroisho enye nejoki, “Lo sunkuro, kainyoo pee kitemiteme intae?
Entoduaaki empisai e kodi.” Neyaki ninche ninye empisai.
Neikilikuan Yesu ninche ajoki, “Koleng'ae ele oip o ele kigeroto?”
Nejoki, “Ole Kaisari.” Nejoki ina kata, “Enchoo Kaisari ine Kaisari, ninchosho Enkai ine Nkai.”
Ore pee ening ninche ina, neing'asia oleng nepuo aaing'uaa ninye.
Ore teina olong nepuonu Isadukayo, lelo oojo meetae empiunoto, neikilikuan aajoki,
“Lo Aiteng'enani, etejo Musa te neye oltung'ani neitu eiu inkera, neyam olalashe enkitok enye aiki inkera.
Etii apa atua iyiook ilalashera oopishana, neyamisho ole dukuya neye meeta inkera, neing'ueiki olalashe enkitok enye.
Neiko neijia ole aare o le okuni o metabaiki ole oopishana.
Ore te siadi pooki neye sii enkitok.
Amaa, kenya te mpiunoto, keaku enkitok ene ng'ae te lelo oopishana? Amu eyama pooki.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ipong'oriri amu miyiololo ilkigerot anaa engolon e Nkai.
Amu ore te mpiunoto nemeyamishoe, nemeishoori meyami, kake etiu anaa ilmalaika te keper.
“Kake ore too naaipirta empiunoto oo lootuata, keitu isumusumu enatiaaka intae Enkai pee ejo,
‘Kara Enkai e Abraham nara Enkai e Isaak nara Enkai e Yakobo?’ Mme Enkai oo lootuata, enoo looishu.”
Ore pee ening esiamo, neing'asia too nkiteng'enat enyena.
Kake ore pee ening Ilfarisayo inchere eitigira Isadukayo nepuo aatumo.
Neikilikuan olang'eni obo lenye atem Yesu, ajoki,
“Lo Aiteng'enani kaa kitanapata naisul inkitanapat?”
Nejoki Yesu, “Tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki ote nkishui ino pooki o te ng'eno ino pooki.
Ena kitanapata ene dukuya naa ninye naisul.
Ore eni are nanyaanyukie naa ena, ‘Tonyorra ole latia ino anaa kewan.’
Ore kuna kitanapat pokira are ninche naaun nkitanapat o loibonok le Nkai.”
Ore pee eiturrurro lelo Farisayo neikilikuan Yesu ninche ajoki,
“Ijojo aa too mbaa e Kristo? Kole ng'ae?” Nejoki, “Ole Daudi.”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kaji naa etiu pee eipot Daudi te Nkiyang'et Sinyati ajo ‘Olaitoriani’, ejo,
‘Etiaaka Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lai, Totona te tatene ai, ometaba anaa naitadou ilmang'ati linono apik abori nkejek inono.’
Amaa naa te naa kejo Daudi ninye Olaitoriani, kaji eiko pee eitoki ninye aaku enkerai enye?”
Nemetii ho obo oidima atawaliki ninye ororei hoo obo, nemetii oltung'ani ebaiki ina olong onyaaka aitieu aikilikuana likai rorei.
Neirorie Yesu ina kata siamon o lkipaareta lenyena ajoki,
“Laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o Lfarisayo ootonita to lorika le Musa.
Ore imbaa pooki naajoki ninche intae entaas, niaasiasa; amu keiro ninche nemeas.
Amu keeniki ilolan sapuki ooiroishi aaiteleiki iloilila loo ltung'ana; nemeyieu ninche neiseie to lkimojino lenye.
Neas isiaaitin enye pooki pee edol iltung'ana, amu keitalala ilkerreti lenye neitulus enkikodo oo nkilani enye.
Nenyor iwuejitin enkanyit too siruai, o lorikan sidain tiatua inkajijik e ntumo,
neshipa te neirorokini too wuejitin neemirishoreki, nenyor te neipoti aajo ‘Olaiteng'enani’.
Kake eminchosho eipoti intae aajo ‘Olaiteng'enani’ amu obo olaiteng'enani linyi, nirara pooki ilalashera.
Nimijojo oltung'ani papa te nkop, amu obo Papa linyi otii keper.
Niminchosho eji intae ilarikok amu obo olarikoni linyi naa Kristo.
Ore ilo ora kitok te intae, keaku osinka linyi.
Ore oloilepie kewan, neitadouni; ore oloitadou kewan neilepieki.
“Oi! Intae isunkuro loo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o Lfarisayo! Amu irishieshie ltung'ana enkitoria e Keper, nimijing'jing'i intae maate, ore ilooyieu nejing, nimitikiki ejing.
‘Ee kake ayia! Isunkuro o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o Lfarisayo, amu idaarere nkajijik oo nkolia, niomonono enkomono naado aaitaakuno; ore te nkaraki ina itumutumu enkiguana nagol oleng.’
“Ee kake ayia! Ilaigerok o Lfarisayo sunkuro! Amu imanimana naaiposha o enkop natoyio aaing'oru obo osuj intae, ore pee eibelekenya, nintaa ninye ololmoti le nkima katitin are alang ninye intae.
“Ee kake ayia! Ilarikok modook oojo, ‘Te nenyayie oltung'ani enkaji e Nkai olmumai neme toki; kake te nenyayie olmumai saabu e nkaji e Nkai neen ilo mumai.’
Lo moda modook; kaa nalusoo, ai saabu ana kenkaji e Nkai naitisiny ina saabu?
Ijojo sii ore oloinosie olmumai olperere lo lasar, neme toki kake ore oloinosie olmumai enkishorunoto natii olperere lo lasar, neen ilo mumai.
Lo tung'ana modook, kaa nalusoo, e ina kishorunoto ana kolperere lo lasar oitisiny ina kishorunoto?
Ore oloinosie olmumai olperere lo lasar, einosie olperere lo lasar o pooki toki natii enchumata enye.
Ore oloinosie olmumai enkaji e Nkai neinosie o ilo obik tiatua.
Ore oloinosie keper olmumai neinosie olorika le nkitoo le Nkai neinosi ilo otonita.

“Ee kake ayia! Ilaigerok o lfarisayo sunkuro! Amu intayuyu ematua e tomon o enkorropil o sinantei o empeu naitorropil endaa, nitapalaitie mbaa kituaak oo nkitanapat, aa isipat e nkiguana, o lng'ur o enkirukoto; kuna eishiaakino nitaasa nimipalipala nena kulie.
Lo arikok modook, isilulu enkojong'ani nimurgutaa entames!
“Ee kake ayia! Ilaigerok o Lfarisayo sunkuro amu intukuku oriong enkikompe o esaani kake ebore atua intae eului o enkarri nemeeta enkiririkinoto.
Lo Farisayoi modooni! Tang'asa intukuo atua enkikompe o esaani pee etum sii oriong ataa sidai.
“Ee kake ayia! Ilaigerok o Lfarisayo! Amu itiuu intae anaa nkuraren naaelieki enturoto meiborra, nedoli anaa ai sidain ti oriong kake ore atua eiputa loik loo lmeneng'a o loirerioni pooki.
Naa neijia sii itiuu intae, kedoli intae ti oriong aa ijo irara supati kake ore tiatua, nebore esunkuroisho o enkarruoisho.
“Ee kake ayia! Ilaigerok o lfarisayo sunkuro amu ishetishete inkuraren oo loibonok ninkodikodo inkuraren e lelo asipak le Nkai,
nijojo, ‘Te naa ai kitii apa too nkolong'i oo loo Papa, anaata eitu kishulare ninche te nkibukoroto osarge loo loibonok.’
Nitaa intae shakeni nchere irara inkera e lelo ootara lelo oibonok le Nkai.
Emputa eneitong'oro iloo minyi.
Naishoi oo lasuriaa o nturbubuani, kaji inkoko pee ilanyilanya enkiguana o lmoti le nkima.

“Ore te nkaraki ena, eng'urai airriwaki intae iloibonok o ltung'ana ng'eni o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat; niariara kulikae, metuata nisheshe, niariara kulikae too nkajijik inyi e ntumo, niaraa kulikae too nkang'itie aaisikie;

pee etum ainepu intae osarge loo ltung'ana le Nkai oibukori te nkop ebaiki osarge le Abel lemeeta entiyoto, o metabaiki osarge le Sakaria le Barakia litaara intae te rishata ewueji sinyati o olperere lo lasar.
Esipa ajoki intae, kepuonu kuna baa pooki shumata kulo tung'ana le na kata.

“Woi Yerusalem, Yerusalem naar iloibonok le Nkai, nenang too soito lelo ooirriwakini ninye! Ai katitin aja atonyuaa ajo aiturrur inkera inono anaa elukunku naiturrur inkuoo enyena too naipuko enyena, nitanyaita!
Neina enkaji inyi natung'eikiaki eliyio.
Amu ajoki intae, mikintokiki aadol katukul, metaba anaa nijojo, ‘Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani.’ ”
Nepuku Yesu te nkaji e Nkai alo, nepuonu lkipaareta lenyena enetii pee eitodol enchetunoto e nkaji e Nkai.
Newaliki ajoki, “Ai midolitata kuna pooki? Kesipa ajoki intae meing'uari te ne wueji osoit obo te shumata olikae, lemesulakini enkop.”
Ore eton Yesu to Ldoinyo loo Loirienito, nepuonu lkipaareta enetii ninye too nkurrat nejoki, “Toliki iyiook ajo kanu ebau kuna baa? Naa kainyoo olmonekie le lotunoto ino o ene nkiting'oto e na kop?”
Neng'amaa Yesu nejoki, “Entorrip ate meitapong'oo intae oltung'ani.
Amu kepuonu ilkumok te nkarna ai oojo, ‘Kara nanu Kristo,’ neitapong'oo ilkumok.
Naa ining'ining'i intae ilarrabali o mbaa oo njoreitin eimakini, naa entodol ake emirut amu meeta inchere pee mebau kuna baa; kake eton eng'or enkiting'oto.
Amu kedumakino olorere olikae orere, nedumakino enkitoria enkae kitoria; naa kepuonu ilameitin o nkikirikirat e nkop too wuejitin kumok.
Kake ore nena baa pooki naa ine nkiterunoto oo sinaitin.
Teina kata taa eishoori intae meisilisili neari intae entuata; neibayu intae iloreren pooki te nkaraki enkarna ai.
“Teina kata taa errorro ilkumok nekaldaa olikae olikae, neibayuno ninche maate.
Naa kepuku iloibonok kumok le lejare neiminie lkumok.
Naa ore te nkaraki naponari entorroni neiropiju enyorrata oo lkumok.
“Kake ore olongiri ometabaiki enkiting'oto nejeu.
Naa kelikiori kulo omon supati le na kitoria e Nkai te nkop pooki metaa shakenisho too loreren pooki; ore ina kata nebau enkiting'oto.
“Ore pee idolidolo ina torroni nabau e mutata natolimuo oloiboni le Nkai oji Daniel eitashe te wueji sinyati. (Inchoo ilo oisumita metayiolo.)
Ore ina kata lootii Yudea neipukoki ldoinyo.
Ore olotii shumata enkaji nemedou alo aitayu intokitin te nkaji enye.
Ore olotii enkurma nemeshukunye adumu enkila enye.
Wooi nena naanuta o naaitanakisho te nena olong'i!
Entoomon pee meaku enaipuk inyi ene nkata o loirujuruj anaa enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata.
Amu keaku elotu ina kata entaboi sapuk neitu ae kata etumi, anaa pee eiteruni enkop o taata, nemeitoki aaku katukul.
Naa te neme keitodorropaki nena olong'i anaata mejeu toki naishu; kake ore te nkaraki oo lgelunot lenyena eitodorropaki nena olong'i.
“Te nejoki intae ina kata oltung'ani, ‘Nele Kristo otii ene!’, Anaa ‘Nelido otii idie!’, Emiiruk
amu kepuonu ilooitaa ate iloo Kristo le lejare o looitaakuno iloibonok ooitoduaaya ilmonek o nenking'asia kituaak pee te naa keidimayu naaji neiminie ninche lelo gelunot le Nkai.
Ng'ura ajo aidipa atoliki intae te dukuya eitu abau.
Metaa te nejoki intae, ‘Ng'ura, Etii ong'ata’, emipuku; anaa, ‘Etii lgilat li atua aji’ emiruk.
Amu ore anaa enatiu enkiwuang'ata naing'uaa eneilepunye enkolong nelioyu te nedoyiorie; neijia etiu elotunoto e Nkerai e Tung'ani.
Amu enetii empopok eiturrurrokino lmotonyi.
“Ore ake pee eish isinaitin le nena olong'i, neitomisimisi enkolong nemeitoki olapa awang'u, nesulunye ilakir to loing'ang'e, neigirigiro engolon o loing'ang'e.
Nelioyu ina kata olmonekie le Nkerai e Tung'ani te keper neaku olkiyioi lo lauui too loreren pooki le nkop, nedoli Enkerai e Tung'ani elotu too nkatampo e keper te ngolon o te nkitoo sapuk.
Naa keirriwaa ninye ilmalaika lenyena te ndarata kitok e mouwo meiturrurru ilgelunot lenyena too lubot pokira ong'uan naaing'uaa osiwuo, neitung'uaa ineeiting'ie keper, too lubot pooki.
“Entuutarie ate enkitanyaanyukoto o lng'aboli ore te neiteru aitayu imbenek niyiolouu aajo etinyikua oladalu.
Ore sii intae ti nidolidolo nena pooki, entayiolo aajo etinyikua, ee etii inkutukie oo nkajijik.
Kesipa ajoki intae, meishari kulo tung'ana le na kata eitu ebau kuna baa.
Keish keper o enkop kake meish irorei laainei katukul.
“Kake meetae oloyiolo ina olong anaa ina saa, aa ilmalaika le keper anaa Enkerai, Papa ake oyiolo.
Amu ore anaa enatiu apa too nkolong'i e Noa, neijia sii etiu elotunoto e Nkerai e Tung'ani.
Amu ore te nena olong'i eton etioyo oloirrag le nkare, kedaae, neokishoi, neyamishoe, neishoori meyami, o metabau ina olong natijing'a Noa esafina,
neitu eyiolou o meeu oloirrag le nkare aya pooki ng'ae; neijia sii etiu elotunoto e Nkerai e Tung'ani.
Ore ina kata te netii ilewa oaare enkurma, neyae obo neing'uari olikae.
Neiutuutisho nkituaak are to soit neyai nabo neing'uari enkae.
“Entorripisho naa, amu miyiolo enkolong nalotu Olaitoriani linyi.
Kake iyiololo aajo, te naa keyiolo olopeny enkaji enkata nalotu olapurroni, anaata etorripishe pee meisho enkaji enye metigili.
Enterretenata sii intae; amu te nkata niminteikiki elotu Enkerai e Tung'ani.
“Kalo naa sinka ilo oisiligayu naa ng'en otung'eikia olkitok lenye enkaji enye, meitotio ltung'ana te nkata naishiaakino?
Emayiana ilo sinka laa te nelotu olkitok lenye nenyorriki easita enatung'eikia.
Esipa ajoki intae, keisho meitoria intokitin enyena pooki.
Kake te nejo ilo sinka torrono to ltau lenye, ‘Keimutie olkitok lai’;
neng'as aar isinkan ooboitare, nedaa neokisho te nebo o lamerak;
kelotu olkitok le ilo sinka te nkolong nemeiteikini o te saa nemeyiolo,
naa kedung'udung neitaboitaki sunkuro. Neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.
“Etiu enkitoria e keper anaa ntoyie tomon, naatudumutua ltaai lenye aapuo aanang'are oloyamisho.
Ore imiet nemoda, ore inkulie imiet naa ng'eni.
Amu ore nekua naamoda ewaita iltaai lenye neitu eya eilata
Ore nekua ng'eni, neya eilata too ltuleta lenye o too ltaai.
Ore pee eimutie oloyamisho, neimug pooki neirura.
Ore te mpolos e nkewarrie, nebuaki aajo, ‘Neilo oloyamisho, entupuku entanang'are.’
Neinyototo ina kata nena toyie aaitobir iltaai lenye.
Nejoki naamoda kunda ng'eni, ‘Enchoo iyiook enkiti ilata inyi; amu keye iltaai lang.’
Kake newaliki ng'eni ajoki, ‘A'a mebaiki iyiook o ntae; enaikash ti nipuopuo enetii iloomir aainyang'aki ate.’
Ore pee einyototo aapuo aainyiang'u, nebau oloyamisho, nejing nena naaterretenate tenebo oloyamisho atua osirua le nkiyama; neikeni kutuk aji.
Neitoki te siadi aapuonu nekua toyie aajo, ‘Lo kitok, Lo, kitok, tabolu iyiook.’
Newaliki ajoki, ‘Kesipa ajoki, intae, mayiolo ntae.’
Entorripisho naa, amu miyiololo ntae ina olong aashu esaa.
“Etiu enkitoria e keper anaa te neyieu oltung'ani nelo enkop nalakua neipot isinkan lenyena neitaaki ntokitin enyena.
Neitaaki obo ntalantani imiet, neitaaki olikae are neitaaki likae nabo; aisho pooki tung'ani anaa enkidimata enye; nelo.
Ore lido oitaakaki ntalantani imiet nelo nabo kata aasishore netum kulie talantani imiet.
Netumie sii elde oitaakaki are kulie are.
Kake ore elde oitaakaki nabo, nelo aturoo aisudoo empisai o lkitok lenye.
Ore etulusoyie enkata naado nelotu olkitok le lelo sinkan, neyieu esiana oo ntokitin enyena.
Neng'asunye oloitaakaki ntalantani imiet neyau kulie talantani imiet; nejoki, ‘Lo Kitok kinchoo apa ntalantani imiet; ng'ura ajo anoto kulie imiet.’
Nejoki olkitok lenye, ‘Ee osinka supat laisilig, itaa oloisiligayu too nkuti, kaaisho intoria kumok; tijing'a eng'ida o lkitok lino.’
Nelotu oloitaakaki ntalantani are nejoki, ‘Lo Kitok, kintaaka apa ntalantani are, ng'ura ajo, anotie kulie are.’
Nejoki olkitok lenye, ‘Ai sidai enitaasa iyie osinka supat oisiligayu; tijing'a eng'ida o lkitok lino.’
Nelotu sii elde oitaakaki entalanta nabo nejo, ‘Lo Kitok, kayiolo ajo ira iyie oltung'ani ogol oikes ineitu iun, ninturrur ineitu isuaaya.
Neaku atureishie nanu nalo aturoo aisudoo ina talanta ino tiatua enkop, ing'ura, nena enino, inko.’
Neng'amaa olkitok lenye, nejoki, ‘Lo sinka torrono oshal, itayiolo ajo kaikes ineitu aun, nasotu ineitu aisuaaya;
anaata naa inchoo ina pisai ai lelo ooasishore pee te nalotu natum enaai o kulie.
Entooru naa ina talanta enchoo ilo oata ntalantani tomon.
Amu ore pooki oata neponikini pee eaku naata nkumok kake ore olemeeta, ore ninye enda naata neoruni.
Entanang'aki ilo sinka lemeeta tipat enaimin e auluo; neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.’
“Ore te nelotu Enkerai e Tung'ani te nkitoo enye, eboitare ilmalaika pookin, neton ina kata to lorika lenye le nkitoo.
Neiturrurrokino iloreren pooki dukuya ninye negel ninche anaa olchekut ogelu nkerra arishie nkineji.
Nepik nkerra enkaina enye e tatene, nepik inkineji ene kedianye.
Naa kejoki ina kata olaiguanani lelo ootii enkaina enye e tatene, ‘Wootu intae ilootamayiana Papa lai, entujung enkitoria naitobirakaki apa intae apa ebaiki enkiterunoto e nkop.
Amu kaata apa esumash nikinchosho endaa; naata enkure nikinchosho enkare naok; nara omoni nikirikiriki ang;
nemaishopo nikinchopishopo; namuoi nikirumurumu, naena nikibaikiki.’
Neng'amaa ina kata ltung'ana le Nkai aajoki, ‘Lo kitok, kanu kitoduaa iyie iata esumash nikintoti iyie? Aashu iata enkure nikintook iyie?
Ana kanu kitaduaa iyie ira omoni nikirik iyie ang? Anaa minchopo nikinchop iyie?’
Ana kanu kitaduaa iyie imuoi anaa iena nikibaiki iyie?
Neng'amaa olaiguanani ajoki, ‘Kesipa, ajoki intae, ore anaa enintaasa lelo alashera laainei ooti, nanu intaasa.’
Neitoki Yesu ina kata ajoki ilootii enkaina enye e kedianye, ‘Enyoito intae entung'uayioki iloodiaa, enchom enkima oo ntarasi naitobirakaki Sheitani o lmalaika lenyena.
Amu aata apa esumash neitu kintotiti; naata enkure neitu kinchosho enkare naok.
Nara omoni neitu kirikiriki ang; nemaishopo neitu kinchopishopo; namuoi, naena neitu kibaikiki.’
Neng'amaa sii ninche aajoki, ‘Kanu kitaduaa iyie iata esumash, anaa enkure, anaa ira omoni, anaa minchopo, anaa imuoi anaa iena neitu kisiai iyie?’
Naa keng'amaa ajoki, ‘Kesipa ajoki intae, ore anaa eneitu intaasiasa obo le kulo ooti, nanu eitu intaasiasa.’
Naa kepuo ninche enkitamioto oo ntarasi; nejing iltung'ana le Nkai enkishui nemeish.”
Ore pee eidip Yesu lelo rorei pooki, nejoki lkipaareta lenyena,
“Iyiololo aajo inkolong'i are naatiooyo pee eaku Pasaka, naa keishoori Enkerai e Tung'ani metashei.”
Neiturrurro lapolosak kituaak o lpayiani te wueji olapolosani kitok oji Kaiafas;
neiguana maate te nebo pee etum aaibung'a Yesu to losek aataar metua.
Neitoki aajo, “Neme to sirua pee mejing olong'oling'oli atua ltung'ana.”
Ore etii Yesu Betania enkaji e Simon le nkeeya oo lbolot,
nelotu enetii ninye enkitok naata oltulet lo soit oji alabasta le ilata narropil nagol enkinyang'a nebukoki elukunya enye teine einosita endaa.
Ore pee edol lkipaareta lenyena ina negoro naleng nejo, “Ijo meima ena ilata siu?
Amu anaata etimiraki aainosie mpisai kumok pee eishori ilaisinak.”
Kake etayiolo Yesu ina nejoki, “Kainyoo pee intanyamalala ena kitok? Naa esidai aaitaasa.
Amu iatata ilaisinak anaake kake mikiaata nanu anaa ake.
“Amu ore ina ilata narropil naatubukoko, osesen lai eitobiraki enukaroto.
Esipa ajoki intae, ore pooki wueji nelikiorieki ele rorei supat te nkop pooki, naa keimakini ena naaitaasa ena kitok metaa enadamunyeki ninye.”
Nelo ina kata obo le lelo tomon o aare oji Yudas Iskariot enetii ilapolosak kituaak,
nejoki, “Kainyoo kinchosho te naitarasaki intae Yesu?” Nelaaki ninche impisai tomoni uni e nkosholai.
Ore ebaiki ina kata neing'oru erishata nakaldarie ninye.
Ore te nkolong e dukuya o sirua loo Mukateni Nemeisuishieki, nepuonu lkipaareta enetii Yesu nejoki, “Kaji kintobiraki iyie pee inyayie osirua le Pasaka?”
Nejoki, “Entijing enkanasa enchom enetii oltung'ani oje entiaki, ‘Eji Olaiteng'enani, etinyikua enkiririkinoto e nkata ai; te nkaji ino aitobir Pasaka te nebo o lkipaareta laainei.’ ”
Neas lkipaareta ina natiaka Yesu, neitobiraki Yesu Pasaka.
Ore pee eaku tara, neton Yesu te misa tenebo lkipaareta lenyena tomon aare.
Ore einosita endaa nejoki, “Kesipa ajoki intae, kaakaldaa obo linyi.”
Neisinanuo oleng neikilikuana moo obo, “Ainanu sa Lo Kitok?”
Newaliki ajoki, “Elde oitadoikio enkaina enye esaani te nebo nanu, ninye laakaldaa nanu.
Kelo Enkerai e Tung'ani anaa enatisiraki, kake, ee kake ayia elde la ninye oitarasaa Enkerai e Tung'ani. Enaikash apa te neitu eini.”
