Neng'amaa Yudas laa ninye otakaldaiyie ajoki, “Aijo, sa ainanu, Olaiteng'enani?” Nejoki Yesu, “Iyie otejo.”
Ore einosita endaa nedumu Yesu emukate nemayian negiligil; neisho lkipaareta lenyena nejo, “Enkoito enosa; osesen lai ele.”
Nedumu enkikompe, neisho Enkai enashe, neitarasaki ninche nejoki, “Entook pooki;
amu osarge lai ele lo sotua oibukori te nkaraki oo lkumok te mpalakinoto oo ng'ok.
Ajoki intae, ore ebaiki taata, maitoki aekata aok enaisho oo lng'anayio loo sabibu o metabau enkolong naok eokoto ng'ejuk te nebo intae te Nkitoria e Papa.”
Ore pee erany osinkolio neipang aapuo Oldoinyo loo Loirienito.
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ore tena kewarie, naa aikisikisiki pooki aaing'uaa nanu amu etisiraki aajo, ‘Kaosh olchekut neidapasha eluaata oo nkerra.’
Kake ore pee aaitopiuni naituruk alo Galilaya.”
Newaliki Petero ajoki, “Te naa aiking'uaa pooki, maaing'uaa aekata nanu.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Kesipa aajoki iyie, ore te na kewarie, eitu eru olchogoo, nikimiki iyie katitin uni.”
Nejoki Petero, “Te naa kaye te nebo iyie maamiki nanu iyie.” Nejo sii neijia lkipaareta pooki.
Nelotu Yesu o ninche ewueji neji Getsemane nejoki lkipaareta lenyena, “Entotoni te ne mashomo ende aomon.”
Nerik Petero o layiok pokira aare le Sebedayo. Neiteru aisinanuo nenyamalu oltau.
Nejoki, “Keeta oltau lai osina kitok o metaa kaye; entotoni te ne entashololoto te nebo nanu.”
Neigut penyo neirrabalakino enkop neomon nejo, “Papa lai, te naa keidimayu intapaashaki ena kikompe, kake mme anaa enayieu nanu kake anaa eniyieu iyie.”
Nelotu enetii lkipaareta neinepu eirurate, nejoki Yesu Petero, “Amaa ai mindimidimi hoo aatashololoto te nebo nanu esaa nabo?
Entashololoto niomonono pee mijing'ijing'i atua intemat; kesipa keyieu oltau, kake keshal osesen.”
Neitoki alo enkata e are neomon nejo, “Papa lai, te nemeidimayu pee aapaash ena kikompe eitu aok, inchoo metotiwuo anaa eniyieu.”
Neitoki alotu, neinepu ninche eirurate, amu eiroshiutuo inkonyek enye.
Neitoki aing'uaa ninche nelo aomon enkata e uni te lelo ake rorei.
Neitoki ashukokino lkipaareta lenyena nejoki, “Keton doi ake irurara aayeng'iyeng'a! Eng'ura Etinyikua esaa napikieki Enkerai e Tung'ani inkaik oo laing'okok.
Enyeoto emaape; nelde olaakaldaa otabawua.”
Ore eirorita, ng'ura, nelotu Yudas laa obo le lelo tomon o aare, eboitare empikas sapuk naata lalema o siaren ooing'uaa enetii lapolosak o lpayiani lo lorere.
Naa ore ilo oitarasayie eidipa aishoo ninche olmonekie ejoki, “Ore elde lang'utut, ninye ilo embung'a.”
Nelo ina kata enetii Yesu nejoki, “Supa Olaiteng'enani;” neng'utut.
Nejoki Yesu, “Olchore, kainyoo pee itii ene? Tasioki taasa ina nikiyawua.” Nepuonu taa enetii neibung aakurraki.
Neshutu obo le lelo ooboitare Yesu olalem, neosh osinka lo lapolosani nedung'u enkiok.
Nejoki Yesu, “Tushukoki olalem lino enchashur amu ore pooki oibung olalem nemuta to lalem.
Aijo iyie eimaidim atasayia Papa maairriwaki nabo kata mpuot tomon o aare oo lmalaika?
Paa kaji naa eiko pee eitabari ilkigerot nemeeta nchere pee eitu ebaya?”
Ore ina kata nejoki Yesu ina siamo, “Aikipuonunu aaibung iatata ilalema o siaren anaa ilo oibung olaisimani? Natii oshi ake enkaji e Nkai aiteng'enisho neitu kimbung'ubung'u?”
Kake etaasate kuna pooki pee ebaya ilkigerot loo loibonok le Nkai. Neilanyisho ina kata lkipaareta pooki aaing'uaa.
Ore lelo ooibung'a Yesu nerikoki olapolosani kitok, oji Kaiafas, enotote teine laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o lpayiani.
Kake esujita Petero ninye te nelakua, o metabaiki olgoriet lo lapolosani kitok. Ore pee ejing atua, neton ninye te nebo ilarripok adol enaasayu.
Neing'oru ilapolosak kituaak o enkiguana pooki shakenisho e lejare naiteeniki Yesu pee eari metua.
Kake eitu etum hoo pito hoo neetuo lchakenini kumok le lejare.
Ore te siadi nepuonu aare ootejo, “Etejo ele tung'ani kaidim atigila enkaji e Nkai naitoki ashet too nkolong'i uni.”
Neitashe olapolosani kitok ajoki ninye. “Aimeeta eniwalu? Kakua baa kuna nikinteeniki kulo tung'ana?”
Kake etigire Yesu. Nejoki taa olapolosani kitok, “Aainosie olmumai te Nkai naishu, toliki iyiook te naa ira iyie Kristo, Enkerai e Nkai.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Iyie otejo; kake ajoki intae, ore ebaiki taata idolidolo Enkerai e Tung'ani eton te nkaina e tatene naata engolon edou too nkatampo e shumata!”
Nepolos olapolosani kitok ilkilani lenyena nejo, “Etamorishe ele, kainyoo shakenisho neton kiyieu? Itoning'o emorore enye.
Ijojo aa?” Newaliki aajoki, “Keiririkino ele tung'ani keeya.”
Ore teina kata nenotaki enkomom neikum, nedam, neosh kulikae te ndap.
Ejoki, “Kristo, imbonoki yiook, ai ng'ae likitoosho?”
Neton Petero te boo to olkoriet. Nelo enkaisiaayiani enetii nejoki, “Ira sii iyie obo loo loboitare Yesu le Galilaya.”
Nemiki ninye te dukuya ninche pooki ejo, “Maiyiolo enijoito.”
Ore pee eipung alo entaloishi e kishomi nedol ae tito ninye nejoki ilootii ine, “Eiriamariyie sii oshi ele tung'ani Yesu le Nasaret.”
Neitoki anya olmumai amiki ajo, “Maiyiolo ilo tung'ani.”
Ore te nkiti kata nepuonu lelo ooitashoo teine nejoki Petero, “Kesipa ira sii iyie obo le lelo; amu aikilikioo nkirorot inono.”
Neiteru, adek kewan nenya olmumai nejo, “Maiyiolo ilo tung'ani.” Neru nabo kata olchogoo.
Nedamu Petero olapa rorei otiaaka Yesu inchere, “Ore eitu eru olchogoo, aikimiki katitin uni.” Neipang alo aishir te mion.
Ore pee ekenyu, netumo ilapolosak pooki o lpayiani lo lorere neiguanare pee ear Yesu metua.
Neen ninye nerik aaitarasaki olgafanai oji Pilato.
Ore Yudas ilo otakaldayie Yesu pee edol ajo eidipaki aaiguanare, neitoki ainosu neshuku nena pisai tomoni uni e nkosholai ashukoki ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani,
nejo, “Aitarruoyie atakaldayie oltung'ani lemeeta entiyoto metari.” Kake etiaakita ninche, “Kainyoo natii ninche iyiook? Iyie ine.”
Nenang'aki nena pisai e nkosholai atua enkaji e Nkai neipung; nelo agor kewan.
Nedumu ilapolosak nena pisai e nkosholai nejo, “Mebara ti nikipik olbene le Nkai amu osarge einosieki.”
Neiguana te nebo neinyiang'unye enkurma o laitobirani loo motioo pee enukarieki iltung'ana leeiking'a.
Te nkaraki e ina pee eji ina kurma, enkurma o sarge o taata.

Ina kata eitabayioki ina natejo oloiboni le Nkai oji Yeremia pee ejo, “Neya ninche impisai tomoni uni e nkosholai nainosieki ilo otudung'oki enkinyiang'a, otudung'okito enkinyiang'a lkulikae ayiok loo Siraeli.
Neishooyo aainosie enkurma o laitobirani loo motioo anaa enaaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani.”
Neitasheyieki Yesu te dukuya olgafanai neikilikuan olgafanai ninye ajoki, “Aa ira iyie olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?” Nejoki Yesu, “Iyie ojo.”
Ore pee eitang'or ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani, neitu hoo ewaliki.
Nejoki Pilato, “Ai mining eneba imbaa nikinteenikini?”
Kake eitu ewaliki te mbae hoo nabo, o meing'asiayu olgafanai oleng.
Naa ore apa ake to sirua le Pasaka, naa kelaaki olgafanai esiamo oltung'ani obo oena anaa oloyieu ninche.
Netii ina kata oltung'ani obo yioloti te nkarruoisho oena oji Barabas.
Ore pee etumo, nejoki Pilato ninche, “Kalo iyieuu nalaaki intae? Ai Barabas anaa Yesu oji Kristo?”
Amu keyiolo ajo to lom eishooitie ninye.

Ore pee eton Pilato to lorika le nkiguana neirriwaki enkitok enye olkilikuai ajoki, “Toduaa miaas ae te ilo tung'ani lemeeta entiyoto amu atanyamala duoo too mbaa kumok te nkidetidet te nkaraki ninye.”
Kake etukurrakita ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani lo lorere metoomonu Barabas, neishooyo Yesu metaari.
Neitoki ake olgafanai ajoki ninche, “Kaing'ae te kulo pokira aare iyieuu nalaaki intae?” Nejo, “Barabas.”
Nejoki Pilato, “Kaa naa aitaas Yesu oji Kristo?” Nejoki pooki, “Inchooi metashei.”
Nejo, “Aainyo, kaa torroni etaasa ninye?” Neitoki aaitulusoo aabuak aajo, “Inchoo metashei!”

Ore pee edol Pilato ajo meeta ae naidim ataasa, kake keponari ake oloilole nedumu enkare, neisuj inkaik te dukuya olorere nejo, “Maata taa nanu entiyoto to sarge lele tung'ani eng'urai maate ena bae.”
Newaliki iltung'ana pooki aajoki, “Inchoo osarge lenye meeu shumata iyiook o nkera ang.”
Nelaaki teina kata Barabas; neari Yesu too nkeenta, neishori metashei.
Nerik isikarini lo lbalusui Yesu atua enkaji o lbalusui naji Praitorio neiturrurrokinote oltim pooki.
Neoru nkilani enyena neishopoki olkila onyokie.
Neshetu olmarisian loo lkiku nepik elukunya enye, nepik entiyani enkaina enye e tatene, negilaki kung aakueniyie nejoki, “Supa olaiguanani loo Lyahudi!”
Nenotaki ninye neoru ina tiyani naibung'ita, neoshioshie endukuya enye.
Ore pee eidip aatakueniyie, neoru olkila onyokie neishopoki nkilani enyena, nerik ninye aapuo aashe.
Ore epuku aapuo neinepu oltung'ani le Kirene oji Simon nearaki ninye pee enap osalaba.
Ore pee ebaiki ewueji neji Golgata, (aa keji ewueji e mborbor),
neisho ninche Yesu enaisho oo sabibu naitushulakaki olodua metooko. Ore pee eishamisham neany eok.
Ore pee eidip aatasho ninye, neor nkilani enyena aaoshie enkukuo.
Netoni ninche aarrip ninye teine.
Nepik ele sirata shumata elukunya enye aajo “YESU ELE OLAIGUANANI LOO LYAHUDI.”
Neshei ninye teina kata te nebo o lapurrok aare, obo te nkaina e tatene, o likae te nkaina e kedianye.
Nemor iloogiroo eipirripir ilukuny, aajo,
“Eiyie doi ogil enkaji e Nkai nishet too nkolong'i uni, intajeu kewan; te naa iyie Enkerai e Nkai, tadou to salaba.”
Neiko sii ninche neijia lapolosak o lasirak te nebo lpaiyiani ejo,
“Kulikae ake eitajeu nemeidim aitejeu kewan, olaa ninye olaiguanani loo Siraeli. Inchoo taata edou to salaba pee kiruk ninye.”
Ore amu Enkai etipika osiligi lenye inchoo naa eitajeu Enkai ninye tenaa keetayie tipat; amu etejo naa, “Kara Enkerai e Nkai!”
Nemor sii lelo apurrok ootashoki te nebo o ninye.
Ore pee ebaiki saa ile, nerip enaimin enkop o metabaiki saa naaudo.
Ore pee ebaya saa naaudo, neishir Yesu to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” Naa inchere, “Enkai ai, Enkai ai, kaainyo pee kitung'uayie?”
Ore pee ening kulikae te lelo ooitashe teine nejo, “Eliya eipoto.”
Nekuet nabo kata obo le lelo nepik osuguroi enaisho naisuisho oo sabibu neremoki eng'udi naado neisho metooko.
Nejoki ilkulikae, “Tapala maing'urai te naa kelotu Eliya aitajeu.”
Neitoki Yesu aishir to ltoilo sapuk, nedung'o tau.
Neiperra nabo kata olkarasha le nkaji e Nkai aaku are, aiteru te shumata o metabaiki abori, neikirikira enkop nedanya ndapidapo;
nebolo inkuraren neitopiuni seseni kumok loo sinyat ooirurate;
ore pee epuku too nkuraren eidipa Yesu atopiu, nejing ina ang sinyati neipang'aki ltung'ana kumok.
Ore ilo kitok loo sikarini oorripito Yesu o lelo ootii te nebo ninye, pee edol eikirikire enkop o kulie baa naataasate, neureishoyu oleng ejo, “Kesipa Enkerai e Nkai ele tung'ani.”
Netii ine wueji inkituaak kumok naaing'orita te nelakua naatusujutua Yesu eing'uaa Galilaya eisiaaita ninye.
Ore te nebo ninche etii Mariamu Magdalene o Mariamu ng'otonye Yakobo o Yosef o ng'otonye layiok le Sebedayo.
Ore pee eaku teipa nelotu oltung'ani karsis oing'uaa Arimatea oji Yosef, otaa apa olointeng'eni le Yesu.
Nelo sii apa ninye enetii Pilato neomonu osesen le Yesu. Neitanapisho Pilato pee eishori.
Neitayu Yosef osesen, neirin te nkarasha sidai e kitani,
neirragie te nkurare enye ng'ejuk nataguetua to soit, neibeleleng'oki osoit sapuk enkutuk e ngumoto, nelo.
Netii ine Mariamu Magdalene o enkae Mariamu etoni aaipirare enkurare.
Ore taaisere aa enkolong nasujita ene Nkitobirare, neiturrurrokino lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo Pilato,
aajoki, “Lo kitok, kitadamutua aajo etejo, apa ilo kalamas eton eishu, ‘Ore pee elusoo nkolong'i uni, napiu.’
Intanapisho naa metorripi enkurare o metabaiki enkolong e uni, pee mepuonu lkipaareta lenyena aapurroo nejoki olorere, ‘Etopiwuo’; neaku elejare torrono oleng alang ene dukuya.”
Nejoki Pilato, “Iatata larripok loo sikarini, enchom entorrip anaa enindimidimi.”
Nepuo aaitagol erripoto e nkurare, nepik olmishire osoit te nebo ilarripok.
Ore pee eidipayu enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng naji Sabato ekenyu aa enkolong e dukuya e wiki, nelotu Mariamu Magdalene oo enkae Mariamu aaing'uraa enkurare.
Na ng'ura ajo etijing'a olokirikiri kitok enkop, amu etadowuo olmalaika lo Laitoriani oing'uaa keper, nelotu neibeleleng'oo osoit netonie enchumata.
Netiu enkomom enye anaa enkiwuang'ata, neibor inkilani enyena anaa empaso.
Neikirikira ilarripok te nkaraki ninye, netiu anaa ilootuata.
Nejoki ilo malaika inkituaak, “Emiureishoyu intae; amu kayiolo ajo Yesu ing'oruru otashoki.
Metii ene amu etopiwuo anaa enatejo ninye. Wootu eng'urai ewueji apa neirragieki.
Naa enchom entasiooi entoliki lkipaareta lenyena entiaaki, ‘Etopiwuo aing'uaa lootuata; neituruko alo Galilaya, naa teine idolidolo.’ Entadamu enaidipa atoliki intae.”
Nepuo nabo kata aaing'uaa enkurare te nkuretisho o te ng'ida sapuk, nekuet aaliki lkipaareta.
Nenang'are Yesu ninche nejoki, “Entakuenya.” Nenyikaki ninche aaibung inkejek enyena aaserem.
Nejoki Yesu, “Emiureishoyu; enchom entoliki ilalashera laainei meshomo Galilaya naa kaadol teine.”
Ore epuo te nkoitoi, nejing kulikae loo larripok atua enkanasa neliki ilapolosak kituaak imbaa pooki naataasate.
Netumo ilpayiani te nebo, ore pee eidip aaiguanata, neisho isikarini impisai kumok aajoki,
“Entiaaki olorere, lkipaareta lenyena ooetuo kewarie aapurroo kirura.
Naa te nebaiki ele rorei nkiyiaa o lbalusui, nikirorie iyiook pee kintung'uaa intae enyamali.”
Neya ninche impisai neas anaa enatiaakaki. Neibulunyeki ele rorei Ilyahudi o metabaiki taata.
Nepuo lelo ooiteng'eni tomon o obo Galilaya o metabaiki oldoinyo otiaaka Yesu enchom.
Ore pee edol neserem ninye; kake eing'asha kulikae.
Nelotu Yesu enetii neirorie ajoki, “Aaishooki enkidimata pooki te keper o te nkop.
Enchom entaa iloreren pooki lkipaareta laainei, nimbatisasa te nkarna e Papa o ene Nkerai o ene Nkiyang'et Sinyati:
ninteng'ening'ene meibung'a inaaitanapa intae pooki; amu atii te nebo intae nkolong'i pooki o metabau enkiting'oto e nkop.”
Nji eikununo enkiterunoto oo lomon supati le Yesu Kristo Enkerai e Nkai.
Anaa enaigero oloiboni le Nkai oji Isaya pee ejo, “Kairriwaa olkipaaret lai dukuya iyie, oitobir enkoitoi ino.
Etii oltoilo obuaku ti ong'ata, ‘Entobiraki Olaitoriani enkoitoi, entobiraki irrekiei ooitoriori.’”
Neipang'u ti ong'ata Yohana Olaibatisani, nelimu enkibatisa nayau enkirridunoto neyau empalakinoto oo ng'ok.
Nepuo enetii ninye iltung'ana le nkop pooki e Yudea, o le Yerusalem, neibatisa Yohana ninche to lkeju le Yordan eirridu ing'ok enye.
Naa enkila oo lpapit e ntames eishopito Yohana neeta enkeene e mpolos, naa lmaat o naishi e ong'ata enya.
Nelikioo ninye ejo, “Kelotu te siadi nanu ologol laalang nanu olaa kaamakua te nairrugokino alak enkeene e namuke enye.
Aidipa nanu aibatisa intae te nkare kake te Nkiyang'et Sinyati eibatisa ninye intae.”
Nelotu Yesu te nena olong'i eing'uaa enkanasa e Nasaret te Galilaya, neibatisa Yohana ninye to olkeju le Yordan.
Ore nabo kata pee eilepu Yesu te nkare, nedol pee ebolo keper nedou Enkiyang'et Sinyati eikununo anaa enturkuluo adoiki ninye;
nelotu oltoilo oing'uaa keper ojo, “Ira iyie Oinoti lai lanyor; atishipe te iyie.”
Ore nabo kata nerik Enkiyang'et e Nkai Yesu ong'ata.
Nebik ti ong'ata nkolong'i artam, etemita Sheitani; neboitare ng'uesi e ong'ata; neisiaai ilmalaika ninye.
Ore eidipaki aateen Yohana, nelotu Yesu Galilaya, alikioo lomon Supati le Nkai;
ejo, “Etabaua enkata, netinyikua enkitoria e Nkai; erridutu, naa eruko ele rorei supat.”
Ore eshepita Yesu enaiposha e Galilaya, nedol Simon o Andrea olalashe le Simon enang'aki orreshet atua enaiposha; amu ilarreshok loo sinkir apa ninche.
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Entusujuaki pee aitaa intae ilarreshok loo ltung'ana.”
Neing'uaa nabo kata irresheta lenye nesuj Yesu.
Ore pee enyikaa peno, nedol Yakobo o Yohana ilayiok le Sebedayo etii atua empeut eripita irresheta.
Neipot nabo kata; neing'uaa Sebedayo menye lenye te mpeut eboitare ilaisiaayiak nesuj Yesu.
Nepuo Yesu o lkipaareta lenyena aabaya Kapernaum. Ore ake pee eaku enkolong e Sabato nejing enkaji e ntumo neiteng'enisho.
Neing'asiae te nkiteng'enare enye, amu eiteng'ena ninche anaa oloitore enajo, nemetiu anaa ilaigerok.
Netii teina kata ake te nkaji enye e ntumo oltung'ani oata oloirirua oiduruk;
nebuaku ajo, “Kainyoo iatayie iyie iyiook, Yesu le Nasaret? Iewuo aidaikie iyiook? Kaayiolo ajo ira ng'ae, ira iyie ilo Sinyati le Nkai.”
Kake eisikong'a Yesu ninye ajoki, “Tigirayu, tupuku tung'uai ninye!”
Nediding'unye oloirirua aiterreyie, nebuaku to ltoilo sapuk, nepuku aing'uaa.
Neing'asia pooki, o meikilikuanata aajo, “Kainyoo ena? Enkiteng'enare ng'ejuk! Eji keitore te ngolon iloiriruani ooiduruk, nening ninche ninye.”
Ore ina kata ake, neibulu olning'o lenye pooki wueji te nene neemanita Galilaya.
Nepuku Yesu te nkaji e ntumo, nejing enkaji e Simon o Andrea, eboitare Yakobo o Yohana.
Neirrag enkaputani e Simon emuoi oloirobi, neinosakini ninye teina kata.
Nelotu neibung enkaina nedumu, neing'ueiki oloirobi, neinyototo aisiaai ninche.
Ore pee eaku teipa, etadoyie enkolong, nerikokini Yesu iltamuoyia pooki o lelo ooata loiriruani.
Nesotokino enkanasa pooki enkalo e kutuk aji.
Neishiunye ilkumok ooata muoyiaritin oo mpukunot kumok, nearaa iloiriruani kumok; neitu eisho iloiriruani meiroro amu keyiolo ninche ninye.
Ore enasirie, neinyototo Yesu ayok alo ewueji neliyio neomon teine.
Neing'oru Simon o lelo ooboitare.
Ore pee etum nejoki, “King'oru ltung'ana pooki.”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Emaape kunda kulie ang'itie, pee aliki sii ninche, amu ina doi pee aewuo enkop.”
Neman Yesu Galilaya pooki, alikioo ilo rorei too nkajijik enye e ntumo, nearaa loiriruani.
Nelotu oltung'ani oata enkeeya oo lbolot asai Yesu, negilaki kung nejoki, “Tiniyieu eikindim aishiunye matisikayu.”
Neing'urrie Yesu, neitorioo enkaina aiseyie, nejoki, “Ekayieu, tisikayu.”
Neing'uaa enkeeya oo lbolot nabo kata ilo tunga'ani, nesika.
Neing'ode Yesu oleng nereu nabo kata,
nejoki, “Toduaa ake miliki likae tung'ani; kake shomo intoduaai kewan to lapolosani; ninchooyo entoki apa naitanapishe Musa te nkisujata, pee intadedeyie to lorere.”
Kake etupukuo ake ilo tung'ani neiteru ainosaa, aibalie ilo omoni, neaku eitu eitoki Yesu aidim atijing'a enkang eduaakini, neaku ti ong'ata eton; nepuonu ltung'ana aayiaya eing'uaa nkaloli pooki.
Ore pee errinyo Yesu Kapernaum eishari nkuti olong'i, nening'i aajo etii ang.
Neiturrurrokino iltung'ana kumok o metaa, meetae enepaashareki te kutuk aji, einosaki Yesu ninche ilomon.
Nepuonunui neyakini oltung'ani tarrush oikaole onapita ltung'ana oong'uan.
Ore pee elau eneimu te nkumoi o lorere, nebol aadede shumata enkaji, ine neipirare. Ore pee eidip aatabol neitadou erruat napetita ilo oikaole.
Ore pee edol Yesu enkirukoto e lelo tung'ana, nejoki ilo oikaole, “Enkerai ai, kitapalakaki ng'ok inono.”
Netoni teine laigerok nedamisho aajo too ltauja lenye,
“Kainyoo pee ejo ele tung'ani inji? Eijo kemorisho! Ai ng'ae oidim atapalaki ng'ok, leme Enkai ake?”
Neyiolou nabo kata Yesu ina to ltau lenye nchere, kedamu ninche nena too ltauja lenye, neikilikuan ajoki, “Kaji etiu pee inkilikuanana ate nena too ltauja linyi?
Kaa nalelek, ai te najoki ele oikaole, ‘Kitapalakaki ng'ok inono,’ ana ai te najoki, ‘Inyo, tudumu erruat ino shomo?’
Kake ore pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere keeta Enkerai e Tung'ani enkidimata te nkop napalakinye ng'ok.” Nejoki ilo oikaole,
“Aajoki, inyo, tudumu erruat ino shomo ang.”
Neinyototo, nedumu nabo kata erruat enye, neipang te dukuya ninche pooki; o meing'asiata pooki neisis Enkai, ejo, “Eitu ai kata kidol embae naaijo ena!”
Neitoki Yesu apuku teine nelo embata e naiposha, nesotokino iltung'ana kumok ninye neiteng'en ninche.
Ore ina kata eloito nedol Lawi ole Alfayo eton te nkapisi oo mpisai e kodi nejoki, “Tusujuaki.” Neinyototo Lawi asuj ninye.
Ore etonita anya endaa te nkaji e Lawi, netoni ilasotok kumok loo mpisai e kodi o looata ng'ok te nebo Yesu o lkipaareta lenyena; amu aikumok apa iloosujita.
Ore pee edol ilaigerok lo Lfarisayo eng'arie ninye endaa looata ng'ok o lasotok le kodi, nejoki lkipaareta lenyena, “Kaji etiu pee eng'arie ninye ilasotok le kodi o looata ng'ok endaa?”
Ore pee ening Yesu, nejoki ninche, “Meyieu ilememuoi olabaani, iloomuoi ake ooyieu neitu alotu aipot isupati, kake ilooata ng'ok aewuo aipot.”
Neaku enkata naitupukoo ate lkipaareta le Yohana o loo Lfarisayo. Nepuonu ltung'ana enetii Yesu nejoki, “Kaji etiu pee eitupukoo ate lkipaareta le Yohana o loo Lfarisayo, nemeitupukoo ate ilinono?”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Keitupukoo ate ilchoreta lo loyamishe eton eisiritore? Ore eton eisiritore oloyamishe, nemeidim aaitupukoi ate.
Keyooki aapuonu nkolong'i, naayae oloyamishe aaitung'uaa ninche, neitupukoo taa a teina olong.
Meetae oltung'ani oripaki enkarasha ng'ejuk enkila musana; amu te neripaki, neng'erunye ina ng'ejuk teidia musana, nejarari eng'erata.
Nemeetae oltung'ani opik enaisho ng'ejuk atua ilbenia musan; naa te nepik, nedany ina aisho ilbenia. Ilbenia ng'ejuko ake epiki enaisho ng'ejuk.”
Ore egira Yesu aim inkurman te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng naji Sabato, ore epuoito neiteru lkipaareta lenyena aagilu ilukuny e nkano.
Nejoki Ilfarisayo ninye, “Amaa kaji etiu pee easita lkipaareta linono enemeishoruno too nkitanapat metaasi te nkolong e Sabato?”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Keitu ai kata isumusumu enataasa Daudi, etanyamala netir esumash ninye o lelo ooisiritore:
eneikuna pee ejing enkaji e Nkai enapa kata aa Abiatar olapolosani kitok, nenya emukate nasinya nemeishoruno too nkitanapat meinosa likae leme olapolosani, nenya ninye neisho sii lelo ooboitare?”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eitayioki enkolong e Sabato te nkaraki oltung'ani, eitu eitaini oltung'ani te nkaraki enkolong e Sabato;
netaa Enkerai e Tung'ani Olaitoriani le nkolong e Sabato.”
Neitoki Yesu ajing enkaji e ntumo, netii ine oltung'ani oikaolo enkeeya enkaina.
Neing'or iltung'ana ninye tenaa keishiunye ilo tamoyiai te nkolong e Sabato, pee etum aaitang'oro ninye.
Nejoki Yesu ilo tung'ani oikaole enkaina “Wou ene.”
Nejoki ninche, “Kaa naishoruno too nkitanapat mataas te nkolong e Sabato, metaasi isupati anaa metaasi intorrok, meitopoki ana metaari metua?” Kake etigirate lelo tung'ana.
Nekurraki Yesu pooki nkonyek te ngoro, eisinanuo te nkaraki nerook oishuaa, nejoki ilo tung'ani “Intorioi enkaina ino!” Neitorioo, neishiu, enkaina.
Neipang Ilfarisayo, nepuo nabo kata aanya enkiguana eboitare esirit oo le Herode, pee egilunore ninye eing'oru olosek oarie Yesu metua.
Nerrinyo Yesu teine te nebo o lkipaareta lenyena aapuo enaiposha e Galilaya, nesuj olorora kitok oing'uaa Galilaya; o looing'uaa Yudea
o Yerusalem o Idumea o lido kekun le Yordan o lorora kitok oing'uaa Tiro o Sidon; etoning'o nena pooki naataasa Yesu, nepuonu enetii ninye.
Nejoki lkipaareta lenyena meitobirakini empeut te nkaraki olorere, pee merratanyi ninye;
amu eidipa aishiunye lkumok, ometaa keiding'akino lelo pooki oomuoyiaa ejo maiseyie.
Naa ore ake pee emaniki iloiriruani ooiduruk, nerriaa te dukuya ninye ebuaku aajo, “Ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai!”
Nekurraki areiki ajoki pee melikioo.
Neilepaki Yesu oldoinyo, neipotu lelo ooyieu ninye openy nepuonu enetii ninye.
Negelu tomon o aare, ooisiritore ninye, pee etum airriwai metolikioi ororei le Nkai;
neisho ninche enkitoria naararie iloiriruani.
Neisho Simon enkarna ajo Petero;
Yakobo le Sebedayo, o Yohana olalashe Yakobo, neisho lelo enkarna ajo Boanerge, aa keji Ilenkikurrukur:
Andrea, o Filipo, o Bartolomayo, o Matayo, o Tomas, o Yakobo le Alfayo o Tadayo, o Simon olkanaani,
o Yudas Iskariot, laa ninye otakaldayie. Nelo ang.
Neitoki ake olorere aasoto, metaa metumoki Yesu o lkipaareta lenyena aainosa endaa.
Ore pee ening iltung'ana lenyena le sotua, nepuo pee epuo aaibung, amu kejo, “Etarruoyie elukunya.”
Nejo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ootadoutuo eing'uaa Yerusalem, “Beelsebul eeta, naa ninye etumie engolon naararie loiriruani.”
Neipotu enetii ninye, nejoki too nkitanyaanyukot, “Kaji eiko pee eidim Sheitani ataarai Sheitani?
Teneoro enkitoria tiatua, nemeidim ina kitoria aitasho.
Naa te neoro enkaji tiatua kewan, nemeidim ina aji aitasho.
Naa te netudumakine Sheitani kewan aor, meitashe, kake keiting.
Meetae oltung'ani oidim atijing'a enkaji o ltung'ani ogol nearaa masaa enyena, eitu eng'as aen ilo ogol, pee etumoki taa ataara enkaji enye.
Esipa ajoki intae, epalakini ltung'ana ng'ok pooki, o emorore pooki namorisho ake;
kake ore oloba anaa olomor Enkiyang'et sinyati, metum empalakinoto aikata, kake etum eng'oki ntarasi.”
Amu ketejo ninche, “Oloirirua oiduruk eeta ninye.”
Nelotu ng'otonye Yesu o lalashera lenyena; ore eitashe ninche te boo neirriwaa enkutuk meipoti ninye.
Netoni olorere aamanita ninye; nejokini, “Etii ng'utunyi o lalashera linono boo kinkilikuanu.”
Newaliki ajoki, “Ai ng'ae yieyio o lalashera laainei?”
Ore pee eitaman inkonyek lelo oomanita ninye, nejo, “Noolo yieyio o lalashera laainei!
Ore pooki ng'ae oas enayieu Enkai, ninye olalashe lai, o enkanashe ai o yieyio.”

Neitoki Yesu aiteru aiteng'enisho te mbata e naiposha e Galilaya. Neiturrurrokino iltung'ana kumok oleng, o metijing'a atua empeut aton tiatua enaiposha; netoni lelo tung'anak te nkop natoyio te mbata e naiposha.
Neutaki Yesu ninche mbaa kumok too nkitanyaanyukot nejoki:
“Entoning! Eshomo olaunoni aunisho.
Ore eunisho nedoiki kulikae anterera embata e nkoitoi, nepuonu motonyi aanya.
Nedoiki kulikae enkop oo soito nemetii inkulupuok kumok, nesioki aabulu, naa ore ake pee ebulu amu megut nkulupuok;
ore pee eilepu enkolong nepej, naa ore amu meeta intona netoyu.
Nedoiki kulikae anterera atua lkiku nebulu lelo kiku negor, metaa eitu eiu ilng'anayio.
Nedoiki kulikae anterera atua nkulupuok sidain nebulu neiu ilng'anayio, neponari aaiu maa tomoni uni, maa ntomoni ile, maa iip.”
Nejo Yesu, “Oloata nkiyiaa naaning'ishore, toning'o.”
Ore etaa Yesu ake, neikilikuan lelo ooboitare tenebo lkipaareta lenyena enajo nena kitanyaanyukot.
Nejoki Yesu, “Eishooki intae entayiolo mbaa nemeibala e nkitoria e Nkai, kake ore te lelo ootii auluo, etiu mbaa pooki anaa nkitanyaanyukot;
pee te neing'or, neing'or nemedol, naa te nening, nening nemejing'aa, pee meibelekenyakino ake Enkai, nepalakini.”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Aimining'ung'u ena kitanyaanyukoto? Kaji naa inkoko pee ining'ung'u nkulie kitanyaanyukot pooki?
“Ore olaunoni, ororei eun.
Naa kulo ilootii embata e nkoitoi, ine eunieki ororei. Ore pee ening; nelotu Sheitani nabo kata aya ilo rorei otuunoki tiatua ninche.
Naa inji etiu lelo ootuunoki te nkop oo soito, lelo laa, ore pee ening ororei, neng'amu nabo kata te ng'ida;
nemeeta ntona tiatua ate, kake kebikie enkiti kata; kake ore pee elotu osina anaa enkisilisilore te nkaraki ilo rorei, nerrorro nabo kata.
Ore lelo ootunokoki atua lkiku; naa lelo ooning ilo rorei,
kake ore pee ejing'aki nyamalaritin e nkop, o eng'ida oo masaa, o eng'uarrata e kulie tokitin, negor ilo rorei, metaa meisho etum ilng'anayio.
Kake ore lelo ootuunokoki enkulupuoni sidai, naa lelo ooning ilo rorei neiruk nepik iltauja neiu ilng'anayio maa tomoni uni, maa ntomoni ile, maa iip.”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Keyauni oltaa nepising'ari to ltoo, aashu epiki orunku le erruat? Mme eneiperere epiki?
Amu meetae entoki naisudoyioki neme keji ake pee eibalunyeki; nemeetae entoki natunukaki neme keji ake pee eibalayu.
Oloata nkiyiaa naaning'ishore, toning'o.”
Nejoki ninche, “Enining'o entobiraki ena nining'itoto; amu ore emborei ninchooyo iyie naa ninye kinchori sii iyie, nikiponikini.
Amu keponikini ilo oata aaisho kulie; ore ilo lemeeta, neoruni ina naata.”
Nejo Yesu, “Etiu enkitoria e Nkai anaa te neisuaaki oltung'ani lanterera enkop.
Neirura, neinyototo dama o kewarie, nerumishoyu lanterera nebulu, nemeyiolo ninye eneikununye.
Enkop naitubulu openy, neng'asunye mbenek, neitoki ntapuka neitoki ilng'anayio aabulaki.
Kake ore pee eku ilng'anayio, neitayu oltung'ani olalem adung'u amu etabawua enkikesare.”
Nejo Yesu, “Kainyoo kintanyaanyukie enkitoria e Nkai, anaa kaa kitanyaanyukoto kiaasishore te ninye?
Etiu anaa enkantererai kini, enaa ore euni te nkop, ninye enkini aisul ilanterera le nkop;
kake ore pee euni nebulu, aisul inkeek e ntim, neitayu lng'osil, o metaa kepuonu imotonyi e shumata aapik inkajijik oloip lenye.”
Neinosaki Yesu iltung'anak ilo rorei aiko neijia too nkitanyaanyukot kumok, anaa enaidima ninche aatoning.
Neitu eirorie metii enkitanyaanyukoto, kake ore pee eaku ninye ake o lkipaareta lenyena neibalakinye ninche pooki toki.
Ore ina olong pee eaku teipa, nejoki Yesu lkipaareta lenyena, “Ematalang aapuo lido kekun.”
Neing'uaa olorere nerik ninche ninye, etiu anaa duoo ake, teina peut. Netii kulie peuti ine te nebo ninye.
Nedumunye olkutati kitok, nedam ilopir le nkare ina peut, o metaa keiput enkare.
Kake etii ninye Yesu siadi empeut, eirura epetita enkirishet e lukunya; neinyeyie lkipaareta lenyena ninye nejoki, “Olaiteng'enani, aimme toki te iyie te nikindaaya?”
Neinyototo Yesu neisikong osiwuo, nejoki enaiposha, “Tigirayu! Ntirring'ayu.” Neish osiwuo, neitiring'a enkare oleng.
Nejoki ninche, “Kainyoo pee itureishote?”
Neiputukuny ninche, nejokino, “Ai ng'ae doi ele? Olaa kening ninye osiwuo o enaiposha?”
Nebaiki Yesu o loiteng'eni lenyena olikae kekun le naiposha, te enkop oo Lgerasene.
Ore pee edou Yesu te mpeut, nenang'are nabo kata oltung'ani otamanya nkuraren, eeta oloirirua oiduruk:
nemeetae oltung'ani oidima ateena ninye too lpisia.
Amu eteenaki katitin kumok too lpisia; nemeeta hoo obo oidimua aitoborro.
Naa kebuakita ake dama o kewarie too nkuraren o to o ldoinyo, near kewan too soito.
Ore pee edol Yesu te nelakua, nekuet aserem ninye.
Nebuaku to ltoilo sapuk, ajo, “Kainyoo kiatayie nanu, Yesu, Enkerai e Nkai natii Shumata Aisul? Aatasayia te Nkai, mikisilisil.”
Amu ketiaaka, “Tupuku tung'uai ilo tung'ani, lo oirirua oiduruk!”
Neikilikuan Yesu ajoki, “Aikiji ng'ae?” Newaliki ajoki, “Kaaji empuoto; amu aikira kumok.”
Nesai ninche Yesuoleng pee mearaa teinakop.
Netii eluaata oo lbitiro nadaa teine te mbata o ldoinyo.
Nesai iloiriruani Yesu aajoki, “Irriwai iyiook maape aajing kuldo bitiro, nchoo iyiook matijing.”
Neisho Yesu meshomo. Nepuku lelo oiriruani ooiduruk nejing lelo bitiro; ore ina luaata, nabaya nkalifuni are, neipirri aadoyio to loshong'ishong'i neng'orokino enaiposha, neimis te naiposha.
Neisik ilchekuti lenye, nepuo aalikioo teina anasa o teina kop. Nepuonu ltung'ana aadol enataase.
Nepuonu enetii Yesu, nedol oladuoo tung'ani oata oloirrirua eton teine, eishopo naa biyoto enkorrok enye, oladuoo otang'asa aata empuoto oo loiriruani: neureishoyu ninche.
Ore lelo ootoduaa ina nelikioo nena nataasate te ilo apa otang'asa aata iloiriruani o too lbitiro.
Neiteru aaomon Yesu metung'uai ina latia enye.
Ore ejing'ita Yesu empeut, neomon ilo apa otang'asa aata iloiriruani eji pee eisiritore.
Kake etanya Yesu nejoki, “Shomo ang enetii ilchoreta linono, toliki ninche eneba enikintaasa Olaitoriani, o eneikuna pee king'urrie.”
Nelo ilo tung'ani neiteru alikioo te Dekapoli nena naaitaasa Yesu ninye; neing'asia ltung'ana pooki.
Ore pee eitoki Yesu alang'aki olikae kekun, neiturrurrokino olorora kitok; etii ninye embata e naiposha.
Nelotu ina kata obo le lelo ooitore enkaji e ntumo, oji enkarna Yairo; ore pee edol Yesu, nebatata too nkejek enyena.
Nesai, ajoki, “Etaa keye entito ai kiti. Wou inteleiki nkaik, pee eishiu, nepok.”
Neiriamariyie Yesu ninye. Nesuj iltung'ana kumok aaiding'akino.
Netii enkitok natawe larin tomon o aare,
netanyamala oleng eruk ilabaak kumok, netumuta ntokitin pooki apa naata, nepal enaikashu, neponari arrishu.
Netoning'o eimakini Yesu, neimu te siadi tiatua olorere neiseyie olkila lenye.
Amu etejo, “Te naiseyie ninye olkila lenye, naishiu.”
Negem nabo kata ewooto enye, nening to sesen lenye nchere eishiunyeki emuoyian enye.
Ore Yesu, etayiolo ajo eshomo engolon aing'uaa ninye, neibelekenya nabo kata tiatua olorere, nejo, “Ai ng'ae naaiseyie lkilani laainei?”
Nejoki lkipaareta lenyena, “Idolita iltung'ana kumok kinding'akino, nintoki ajo, ‘Ai ng'ae naaiseyie?’ ”
Neing'orisho Yesu pee edol olotaasa ina.
Kake eishoo ina kitok pee edol enaitaasaki, nelotu te nkuretisho eikirikira, nebatata te dukuya ninye, neliki sipat pooki.
Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Na kerai, kinchiunye enkirukoto ino; shomo te seriani, ninchiu emuoyian ino.”
Ore eton eirorita Yesu, nepuonu ilooing'uaa enkaji e ilo oitore enkaji e ntumo nejo, “Etua entito ino kainyoo pee intoki aitanyamal Olaiteng'enani?”
Kake eitu eshilaa Yesu ina natejoki, nejoki oloitore enkaji e ntumo, “Miureishoyu, iruko ake iyie.”
Neitu eisho likae tung'ani metusuja ninye leme Petero ake o Yakobo o Yohana olalashe Yakobo.
Ore pee ebaiki ninche enkaji e ilo oitore enkaji e ntumo, nedol olong'oling'oli lo lorere ooishirita nebuaku aaishir oleng.
Ore pee ejing atua, nejoki ninche, “Kainyoo pee inchirishiri aabuaku? Eitu eye enkerai keirura.”
Nekueniyie iltung'ana ninye. Kake eipang'ie Yesu lelo pooki boo, nerik menye enkerai o ng'otonye o lelo ooiriamunore, nejing ine netii enkerai.
Neibung enkaina nejoki, “Talita kumi;” eji, “Entito kinyi, aajoki inyo.”
Neinyototo nabo kata entito aitashe nelo, amu enoo larin tomon o aare embotoro enye. Ore nabo kata neing'asia iltung'ana oleng.
Nereiki Yesu ajoki pee meliki hoo likae tung'ani ena bae nejoki ninche meishoo ina tito endaa nanya.
Neing'uaa Yesu ine nelotu enkop enye e Nasaret, nesuju lkipaareta lenyena.

Ore te nkolong e Sabato neiteru aiteng'enisho te nkaji e ntumo; ore ilkumok ootoning'o ninye neing'asia, ejo, “Kaji enotie ele tung'ani kuna pooki. Kaa ng'eno eishooki ninye? Kebaa kuna baa e nking'asia naas inkaik enyena!
Mme olaguetani loo nkeek doi ele, olayioni le Mariamu, naa olalashe Yakobo o Yosef, Yudas o Simon, naa aimetii inkanashera enyena atua iyiook?” Neany ninche eiruk ninye.
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Meishori oloiboni le Nkai enkanyit te nkop enye, o tiatua enkaji enye.”
Nelaikino Yesu ataasa inenking'asia teine; ilkuti tung'ana ake oomuoi eiteleikia inkaik neishiunye.
Neing'asia ninye te nkaraki nemeeta ninche enkirukoto. Nemanaa too nkang'itie eiteng'enisho.
Neipotu Yesu lelo Ooiteng'eni lenyena tomon o aare, neisho meitoria iloiriruani torrok.
Neitanap ajoki, “Emishoroo toki te lototo inyi, eng'udi ake; naa emiya emukate, aashu olbene, aashu impisai too ilkonosi linyi.
Enchopoi inamuka kake eminchopoo lkilani maa are.”
Nejoki ninche, “Ore ake enkaji nijing'ijing'i, entotoni teine o entung'uai ine wueji.
Naa te neitu eng'amu intae dikae wueji, nemening intae, ore ipuopuo, empiripiroi enterit niaatata too nkejek inyi metaa shakeni te ninche.”
Nepuo aalikioo nchere keishiaakino neirridu ltung'ana.
Nearaa ninche iloiriruani kumok, neelie eilata iltamuoyia kumok neishiunye.
Nening olaiguanani oji Herode ina; amu etayioloki enkarna e Yesu. Nejo kulikae, “Eitopiwuoki Yohana Olaibatisani too lootuata; ina pee easisho ena golon tiatua ninye.”
Nejo kulikae, “Eliya doi.” Nejo sii kulikae, “Oloiboni le Nkai otiu anaa iloibonok le Nkai li apa.”
Kake ore pee ening Herode nejo, “Yohana, olapa latudung'oyie elukunya eitopiwuoki.”
Amu eirriwayie Herode ltung'ana meibung'i Yohana, neen apik jila te nkaraki Herodias, enkitok o lalashe lenye oji Filipo amu eyama apa ninye.
Amu etiaaka Yohana Herode, “Mikinchoro too nkitanapat iyama enkitok o lalashe lino.”
Neetayie Herodias elap Yohana neaku keyieu near metua, Kake etalaikine,
amu keure Herode Yohana, eyiolo ajo oltung'ani supat naa sinyati, nerrip eseriani enye. Ore pee elo neinining nemiloyu; eji neng'ida sii te nening.
Kake eewuo erishata to lkekun otoinyieki Herode neitoomonisho ninye neipot ilkituaak lenyena o ltung'ana arikok le Galilaya.
Ore pee elotu entito e Herodias aranyaki, neitiship Herode o lomon lenyena; nejoki olaiguanani ina tito, “Toomonoki entoki ake pooki niyieu, naa kaaisho.”
Nenya olmumai ajo, “Ore entoki ake pooki nikiomon, kaaisho o metabaiki ematua e nkop naitore.”
Neipang nelo ajoki ng'otonye, “Kainyoo aomonu?” Nejoki ng'otonye, “Elukunya e Yohana Olaibatisani.”
Nejing'u nabo kata asieku enetii olaiguanani, neomon ajoki, “Ayieu nikincho nabo kata elukunya e Yohana Olaibatisani te mbeshen.”
Neisinanuo naleng olaiguanani; kake ore te nkaraki ilmuma lenyena o lelo omon lenyena neaku, meyieu nedot ina natiaaka.
Neirriwaa olaiguanani nabo kata osikari le rripore, neitanap ninye meyau elukunya e Yohana. Nelo ilo nedung'u elukunya te jila,
neyau ina lukunya te mbeshen, neisho ina tito; neisho entito ng'otonye.
Ore pee ening lkipaareta le Yohana, nepuonu aaya osesen lenye, neturoo te nkurare.
Nerrinyunye ilkipaareta enetii Yesu, neliki ninye nena pooki naataasa o naaiteng'enishote.
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Wootu oopeny emaape eneliyio, eyeng'iyeng'ata enkiti kata.” Amu aikumok iloopuonu epuo, neaku meeta ninye erishata nainosie endaa.
Nepuo te mpeut ewueji neliyio aa ninche ake oopeny.
Netoduaaitie iltung'ana kumok, neyiolou, neipirri aapuo too nkejek ine eing'uaa nena ang'itie pooki, neng'asie ine wueji.
Ore pee edou Yesu te mpeut nedol iltung'ana kumok, neing'urrie ninche, amu etiu anaa ntare nemeeta olchekut; neiteru aiteng'en mbaa kumok.
Ore pee emutu, nepuonu lkipaareta lenyena enetii nejoki, “Keliyio ene wueji, nemuto;
intanapa iltung'ana, meshomo nkurman o kuna ang'itie naamanita ene aainyang'aki ate entoki nanya.”
Kake etawalikia Yesu ajoki ninche, “Enchoo intae ninche entoki nanya.” Nejoki ninche ninye. “Aikipuo aainyiang'u mukateni oo ndinarii iip are, pee kincho meinosa?”
Nejoki ninche, “Kaja mukateni niatata intae? Enchom eng'urai.” Ore pee eing'uraa neyiolou, nejoki, “Imiet o sinkir aare.”
Neitanap Yesu lkipaareta lenyena meitotona olorere too nkujit naanyori, anaa ltimito.
Netoni aaitayu ltimito maa iip, anaa maa onom.

Ore pee edumu Yesu nena mukateni imiet o sinkir aare neshumu inkonyek aing'or shumata, nemayian, nebel imukateni neisho lkipaareta lenyena meishoo lelo tung'ana; neoriki lelo sinkir aare ninche pooki.
Nenya pooki neraposho.
Nesotu mbelat naatelekuaki o noo sinkir sii neiput inkikapuni tomon o aare.
Ore lelo ooinosa nena mukateni nera nkalifuni imiet ilewa.
Nejoki Yesu lkipaareta lenyena nabo kata meshomo, nejing empeut neituruk aapuo lido kekun, aapuo Betsaida eitanapare ninye olorere.
Ore pee eorore, nelo aomon to ldoinyo.
Ore etaa teipa, eidipa empeut ashomo empolos e naiposha, netii ninye openy enkop natoyio.
Nedol ajo keekenya lkipaareta lenyena earare enkurtoroto e mpeut amu kenang'are osiwuo ninche. Ore saa naudo e nkewarie nelotu enetii ninche, elo eporito enkare. Neyieu negiroo.
Kake etoduaa ninche Yesu eloito te shumata e nkare nejo ke nkukuu tung'ani, nebuaku aaishir;
amu etoduaa pooki ninye, neiputukuny. Kake eirorie Yesu ninche nabo kata nejoki, “Entagoluoto, nanu doi, emiureisho.”
Nejing ninye atua empeut te nebo ninche negira osiwuo. Neing'asia pooki,
amu eitu ejing'aa enapa kias oo mukateni, kake eitagoloki iltauja lenye.
Ore pee elang ninche lido kekun, nepuonu enkop e Genesaret, neen empeut te mbata e naiposha.
Ore pee epuku te mpeut neyiolou iltung'ana Yesu teina kata ake.
Nekuet aaman ina kop pooki, neiteru aariku ltung'ana pooki oomuoi too rruatin enye aaya ewueji ake pooki nening'oki aajo etii.

Neaku ore pooki wueji nelo, too nkang'itie, too nkanas kituaak, o teina kop, nerikokini iloomuoyiaa aairragie too wuejitin neemirishoreki, nesai Yesu meishoo eiseyie ninye olcholoi lo lkila lenye; ore lelo pooki ooiseyie neishiunyeki.
Ore pee eiturrurrokino Ilfarisayo enetii Yesu, eboitare ninche ematua oo lasirak, ooetuo eing'uaa Yerusalem.
Nedol aajo kenya kulikae ooiteng'eni lenyena endaa eiduruk inkaik, eji meisuja.
(Amu ore Ilfarisayo, naa neijia etiu Ilyahudi pooki, menya endaa eitu eisuj inkaik enye, pee eitabaya nkoon oo loo nkakuyiaa.
Naa te nepuonu eing'uaa ineemirishoreki; menya endaa eitu eng'as aaisuj ate. Naa keeta kulie koon naaitabaya ninche, anaa enkisujata oo nkikompeni o motioo o ntokitin oo suyan.)
Neikilikuan Ilfarisayo o lasirak Yesu aajoki, “Kainyoo pee mesuj lkipaareta linono inkoon oo loo nkakuyiaa metaa kenya endaa too nkaik naaiduruk.”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Kesipa enotoko Isaya pee eibonisho ajo tialo intae, irara isunkuro, anaa enaigero; ‘Too nkutukie ake, aayanyit, kulo tung'ana, kake kaalakuaniki ltauja lenye nanu,
naa pesho aaserem nanu, aa nkoon oo ltung'ana eiteng'enare.
Itapalaitie intae inkitanapat e Nkai, nikurrakiki aaibung inkoon oo ltung'ana.’ ”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Inotito intae olosek lianyienyie nkitanapat e Nkai, pee itumutumu aaitabai nkoon inyi.
Amu etejo, Musa ‘Iyanyita minyi o ng'utunyi,’ nejo sii, ‘Ore olomor menye anaa ng'otonye, neiririkino keeya.’
Kake nijojo intae, ‘Te nejoki oltung'ani menye aashu ng'otonye, Ore dupoto duoo nikitumie nanu etaa Korban (aa taa enkishooroto naishori Enkai)
nimintokiki aaisho ilo meitaasa menye anaa ng'otonye toki.’
Ore teina nintaa pesho ororei le Nkai te nena koon inyi nintarasakinono. Niasiasa doi kulie kumok naaijo nena.”
Neitoki Yesu aipotu olorere nejoki, “Entoning'oki intae pooki, naa enchoo ejing'aa intae.
Meetae entoki e oriong oltung'ani naa te nejing ade atua neidim aisarkionie ninye; kake mbaa naapuku tiatua oltung'ani naaitaa ninye torrono.
Te neeta oltung'ani nkiyiaa naaning'ishore toning'o.”
Ore pee ejing aji, neing'uaa olorere, neikilikuan lkipaareta lenyena enajo ina kitanyaanyukoto.
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Aimejing'aa sii ninche intae? Aimidolidolo aajo ore pooki toki natii oriong oltung'ani, te nejing nemeidim aitarruoi;
amu te nejing, mme oltau lenye ejing kake enkoshoke, neipang ade ake?” (Ore pee ejo neijia neitisiny indaiki pooki.)
Nejo, “Ore inaapuku tiatua oltung'ani, ninche naaitarruoo oltung'ani.
Amu atua oltung'ani eing'uaa indamunot torrok, enkiborra oo nkonyek, empurrorre, earata metua, eloloito,
ng'uarrat torrok, enkarruoisho, olosek torrono, enkipororonkos, olom, esulare, olwuasa, emodai.
Atua oltung'ani eing'uaa kuna torrok pooki, naa kuna naaisarkionie oltung'ani.”
Ore pee epuku Yesu teine nelo olkirine le Tiro o Sidon. Nejing enkaji nabo, nemeyieu neyiolouni aajo etii ine; kake etalaikinoteki aaisudoi.
Kake ore nabo kata netii enkitok, naibung'a entito enye kiti oloirirua oiduruk, nening ajo etii Yesu ine, nelotu, nebatata too nkejek e Yesu aserem.
Ore ina kitok naa enoo Lyunani, o losho le Foinike te inoto. Neomon metaarai oloirirua teina tito enye.
Nejoki Yesu ina kitok, “Inchoo eng'asi aaitoti nkera, amu meishiaakino teneyae mukateni oo nkera aanang'aki ildiein.”
Kake etawalikia ninye nejoki, “Ee itisipa lo kitok; kake ore sii ninche ildiein kelutoo emisa nesotu rrarrat naitadoyio nkera.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Ore te nkaraki ina nitejo, shomo ang; etung'uayie oloirirua entito ino.”
Nelo ang, neinepu enkerai eirrag te rruat, neshomo oloirirua.
Nerrinyunye Yesu aing'uaa ilo kirine le Tiro, neimaa Sidon alo enkalo e naiposha e Galilaya, nepolos aimaa atua Dekapoli.
Nerikokini oltung'ani ming'ani laa penyo sii neiro, nesai meiteleiki inkaik.
Nerik aitung'uaa atua olorere ewueji naa ninye ake openy, nepik ilkimojik inkiyiaa enyena, nenotu inkamulak neiseyie olng'ejep lenye;
neing'or keper, neitadoiyio oltau, nejoki ilo tung'ani, “Efafata,” nchere, “Taboloyu.”
Nebolo nkiyiaa, enyena nelaa eneta o lng'ejep lenye, neiro aitobiraki.
Neitanap Yesu pee meliki likae tung'ani; kake ore anaa pee eitanap ajoki pee melikioo, neitulus ninche eitadaraa ina.
Nelus enking'asia e Yesu neaku keji, “Etaasa mbaa pooki aitobiraki ore ninye ilming'anta o lemeiro, neidimie aisho meiroro.”
Ore te nena olong'i, enyaaka olorora kitok asoto, nemeeta entoki nanya, neipotu Yesulkipaareta lenyena nejoki ninche,
“Kaata olng'ur tele orere, amu nkolong'i uni taata aaisiritore nanu nemeeta entoki nanya.
Naa te najoki meshomo nkang'itie enye, neiterriaa te nkoitoi; neetuo kulikae eing'uaa enelakua.”
Newaliki lkipaareta lenyena aajoki, “Kaji eiko oltung'ani te neitoti kulo tung'ana too mukateni te ne ti ong'ata?”
Neikilikuan Yesu ajoki, “Kaja mukateni niatata intae?” Nejoki, “Naapishana.”
Neitanapisho metotona ltung'ana te nkop, nedumu nena mukateni naapishana, ore pee eisho Enkai enashe nebelibel neisho lkipaareta lenyena meitarasaki olorere. Neitarasaki ninche ilo orora.
Neeta sii lkuti sinkir kutiti. Ore pee emayian, neitanapisho meitarasari sii ninche lelo aaisho olorere.
Nenya, neraposho. Nesotuni lmong'oishi ootelekuaki, nkikapuni naapishana naabore.
Nebaya lelo tung'ana nkalifuni ong'uan.
Neitanap Yesu meshomo ang; nejing ninye nabo kata atua empeut te nebo lkipaareta lenyena, nepuo enkalo olkerenket le Dalmanuta.
Nepuonu Ilfarisayo, aaishankarrarre Yesu aayie olmonekie oing'uaa keper aatem.
Neitadoiyio Yesu oltau te nguton, nejo, “Kainyoo pee eing'oru kulo tung'ana le na kata olmonekie oing'uaa keper? Esipa, ajoki intae, meetae hoo olmonekie oishori ltung'ana le na kata.”
Neing'uaa Yesu ninche, neitoki ajing empeut nelo olikae kekun.
Netorikine lkipaareta eitu eyau mukateni; neaku emukate nabo ake eeta tiatua empeut.
Neitanap Yesu ninche ajoki, “Entorrip ate te nkisuisho oo Lfarisayo o te nkisuisho e Herode.”
Neiguana maate aajo, “Mukateni mikiaata.”
Neyiolou Yesu ina, nejoki ninche, “Kainyoo pee ijokinono eji miatata mukateni? Keton ake mejing'aa intae naa aimining'ung'u? Kaji etiu pee egol intae ilukuny?
Aimidolidolo niatata nkonyek? Niatata nkiyiaa aimining'ishosho? Aimidamumu?
Amaa pee abel imukateni imiet abelaki ltung'ana nkalifuni imiet, kaja nkikapuni oo lmong'oishi naabore nitasotutuo?” Nejoki, “Tomon o aare.”
“Oo napa naapishana natebelaka nkalifuni ong'uan: kaja nkikapuni naabore oo lmong'oishi nitasotutuo?” Nejoki, “Naapishana.”
Nejoki Yesuninche, “Neton ake intae mining'ung'u?”
Nepuonu Betsaida. Nerikokini Yesu olmodooni, aaomon meiseyie.
Nerik ilo modooni aibung enkaina, neipung'ie teina ang. Ore pee enotaki nkonyek enyena, neiteleiki nkaik, neikilikuan ajoki, “Idol toki?”
Neshumu nkonyek nejo, “Kadol iltung'ana; kake etiu anaa lkeek, epuoito.”
Neitoki ake Yesu aiteleiki nkonyek enyena nkaik, neing'orisho ninye oleng neishiu, nedolishoyu aitobiraki.
Neisho elo ang, nejoki, “Nimirrinyo ake ajing ena ang.”
Nelo Yesu o lkipaareta lenyena, nkang'itie e Kaisaria e Filipi. Ore epuo te nkoitoi neikilikuan Yesu lkipaareta lenyena ajoki, “Kejo iltung'ana kara nanu ng'ae?”
Nejoki ninche ninye, “Yohana Olaibatisani, nejo kulikae, Eliya; nejo sii kulikae ira obo loo lapa oibonok le Nkai.”
Neikilikuan Yesu ajoki, “Kake amaa intae, nijojo kara ng'ae?” Newaliki Petero ajoki, “Ira iyie Kristo.”
Neitanap ninche pee meliki likae tung'ani.

Neiteru Yesu aiteng'en ilooteng'eni lenyena ajoki meeta nchere pee meisilisili Enkerai e Tung'ani too mbaa kumok neany ilpayiani o lapolosak kituaak o lasirak, neari metua, ore pee elusoo nkolong'i uni neitoki apiu.
Nelimu ina aibalunye. Nerik Petero ninye neiteru aisikong.
Kake eibelekenye Yesu ore pee edol lkipaareta lenyena, neing'ode Petero, nejoki, “Shomo kurum ai Sheitani! Amu mitii iyie enkalo e Nkai, kake enoo ltung'ana itii.”
Neipotu Yesu olorere te nebo o lkipaareta lenyena meetu enetii ninye, nejoki ninche, “Te neyieu oltung'ani naasuj nanu, nchoo metanya inaayieu oltau lenye, nedumu osalaba lenye naasuj nanu.
Amu ore olojo aitopok enkishui enye neiminie; ore oloiturraa enkishui enye te nkaraki ele rorei supat, neitajeu.
Amu ainyoo edupore oltung'ani, te netum enkop pooki neiturraa enkishui enye?
Anaa kainyoo einosie oltung'ani enkishui enye?

Amu ore olodol enkurruna te naaimaki nanu aashu ororei lai tena ishoi oo ng'ok naloloito nedol sii ninye Enkerai e Tung'ani enkurruna eimaki ninye teina olong elotu te nkitoo e Menye eiriamunore ilmalaika sinyat.”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Esipa, ajoki intae, etii doi ilooitashe tene lemeishamisham keeya katukul o metaba anaa nedol enkitoria e Nkai eewuo te ng'olon.”
Ore pee eishunye nkolong'i ile nerik Yesu Petero o Yakobo o Yohana, neilepie enchumata o ldoinyo oodo aa ninche ake. Neibelekenya emua e Yesu edolita ninche.
Neitintilu lkilani lenyena, aaiborru oleng, enaa meetae olaisujani te nkop oidim aiborrie metotiwuo neijia.
Neliooyu Eliya o Musa te dukuya ninche; eirorie Yesu.
Nejoki Petero Yesu, “Olaiteng'enani, aisidai kitii ene; nchoo iyiook mateshetu ilng'oborri okuni, olino obo o le Musa o le Eliya”
naa aimeyiolo enajoito, amu eiputukunyo oleng.
Neitemoo enkatampoi ninche, nepuku oltoilo ojo, “Nele Oinoti lai lanyor, ninye entoning.”
Ore nabo kata ake, ejo maing'orisho neitu eitoki aadol likae otii te nebo ninche. Yesu ake openy.
Ore edou to ldoinyo, neitanap Yesu amitiki einosaki likae tung'ani nena naatoduaa ninche, o metaba naa nepiu Enkerai e Tung'ani aing'uaa ilootuata.
Neibung ninche ilo rorei, neikilikuana maate aajo. “Kainyoo doi ena najo ake, kepiu aing'uaa ilootuata?”
Neikilikuan ninche Yesu aajoki, “Kainyoo pee ejo ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat eji meeta nchere pee meng'as Eliya alotu?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Esipa eng'as Eliya alotu neitang'ejuk imbaa pooki. Paa amaa, kainyoo pee ejo lkigerot tialo Enkerai e Tung'ani, eji keitamei too mbaa kumok nemenuni?
Kake ajoki nanu intae, eewuo Eliya, neitaas ninche ninye enapa ake nayieu neitaas, anaa enatisirakaki ninye.”
Ore pee epuonu enetii ilkulikae ooiteng'eni, nedol emanita olorere kumok, neishankarrarre ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ninche.
Ore ake pee edol ilo orere Yesu, neing'asia oleng, nekuetiki aairoroki.
Neikilikuan ajoki, ninche, “Kainyoo doi ena shankar niaatata o ninche?”
Newaliki oltung'ani obo te ilo orere ajoki, “Olaiteng'enani, atorikuo duoo enkayioni ai enitii, eeta oloirirua lemeisho eiro;
olaa ore pee eibung, nenang'ie enkop; neitayu ilabur, nenya lala neikaolo; najo ajoki lkipaareta linono metaarai, nelaikino.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Wooi ena ishoi nemeeta enkirukoto! Kebaa aton aboitare intae? Kapal intae o anu? Entoriku ninye ene natii.”
Nerikokini; ore pee edol ilo oirirua Yesu neiterreyie enkayioni nabo kata, nebatata te nkop neiperipera, neitayu ilabur te nkutuk.
Neikilikuan Yesu menye enkerai ajoki, “Kanu iterua atum ena pukunoto?” Nejo, “Te keraisho eiterua.
Naa katitin kumok etanang'aka ninye atua enkima nenang'aki enkare ejo aar; kake te nindim iyie ataasa ae, ing'urrie iyiook taretu iyiook.”
Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Eji te nindim Keidimayu imbaa pooki to loiruk.”
Nebuak nabo kata menye ina ayioni nejo, “Airuko, ore eneton eitu airuk taretokoki!”
Ore pee edol Yesu olorere ekuetu aasotokino, neing'ode ilo oirirua oiduruk, nejoki, “Lo oirirua ming'ani lemeiro, nanu laaitore, tupuku tung'uai ena ayioni, nimingil ajing ae kata.”
Nebuaku aishir neiterreyie aipushupush oleng, nepuku, netiu enkayioni anaa olmeneng'ani o metejo lkumok, “Ae etua!”
Kake eibung'a Yesu enkaina nedumu, neinyototo aitashe.
Ore pee ejing atua aji, neikilikuan lkipaareta lenyena too nkurrat aajoki, “Kainyoo pee eitu kindim iyiook aatarai ninye?”
Nejoki, “Meararoyu ena pukunoto ti ae oitoi neme te nkomono ake.”
Nepuo Yesu o lkipaareta lenyena teine neimaa Galilaya. Nemeyieu Yesu neyiolou hoo oltung'ani:
amu lkipaareta lenyena eiteng'enita, ajoki, “Keitarasakini Enkerai e Tung'ani inkaik oo ltung'ana, near ninche ninye metua; ore pee eidipi aatar metua, neishari nkolong'i uni nepiu.”
Kake eitu ening'u ninche ina natejo, neureyu sii eikilikuan.
Nepuonu Kapernaum; ore etii Yesu aji neikilikuan ninche ajoki, “Kainyoo naaji enchankar niaatata te nkoitoi?”
Negira ninche; amu keishankarrate aajo kalo olkitok te pooki.
Neton Yesu neipot lelo tomon o aare; nejoki ninche, “Ore oloyieu neaku ole dukuya, nchoo metaa ninye obayie te pooki neaku osinka le pooki.”
Nedumu enkerai, neitasheyie te mpolos enye; nedumu aibung too nkaik enyena nejoki ninche,
“Ore pooki ong'amu enkerai anaa ena te nkarna ai, nanu eng'amu; ore olaang'amu, neme nanu ake eng'amu kake ilo laairriwua.”
Nejoki Yohana ninye, “Olaiteng'enani, kitoduaa oltung'ani earaa iloiriruani te nkarna ino, nikimitiki, amu mme ole ncholiek ang.”
Kake etiaaka Yesu, “Emimitiki, amu meetae hoo oloas embae sapuk te nkarna ai, laa ore aa enaidipie ina, naaitoki aidim atusukenya.
Amu ore ilo lemegilunore iyiook naa ole nkalo ang.
Kesipa, ajoki intae, ore ake oloisho intae enkikompe e nkare entook te nkaraki naipotieki intae Kristo, nemeeta nchere pee etala olerrinyore lenye.
“Ore ake oloitapong'oo nabo e kuna kutiti naairuk nanu, enaikash te neenikini ninye osoit oiutuutishoreki emurt, nenang'akini enaiposha.
Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkaina ino, tudung'oi; enaikash te nijing enkishui iata enkumur alang ti niata nkaik pokira are, nilo Yehanam atua enkima nemeye ntarasi;
(enemeye lkuru lenye nemeye enkima.)
Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkeju ino, tudung'oi; amu enaikash te iyie ti nijing enkishui ira ng'ojine, alang ti nikinang'akini Yehanam, iata nkejek pokira are;
(ewueji nemeye ilkuru lenye, nemeye enkima.)
Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkong'u ino, tukurtu; enaikash ti nijing enkitoria e Nkai iata enkong'u nabo alang ti nikinang'akini Yehanam iata inkonyek pokira are;
ewueji nemeye ilkuru lenye, nemeye enkima.
“Amu keitisinyi pooki ng'ae te nkima, anaa enaitisinyi olasar te munyan.
Sidai emunyan; kake amaa te nelau emunyan enkisukut enye, kaji eikoni pee eitokini aaisukutie? Enoto emunyan tiatua ate, nitonini te seriani intae maate.”
Nedumunye Yesu teina alo, nelotu olkerenket le Yudea te lido kekun le Yordan, neiturrurrokino ninye aaitoki iltung'ana kumok enetii ninye; neitoki ake aiteng'en ninche anaa enatamoo apake.
Nepuonu Ilfarisayo enetii ninye neikilikuan, ejo pee etem aajoki, “Keishiaakino te neiturraa oltung'ani enkitok enye?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Kaa eitanapa intae Musa?”
Nejoki, “Eishorua Musa meigeroki oltung'ani enkitok enye empalai naiturrarie, nearaa.”
Kake etiaaka Yesu ninche, “Te nkaraki engolon oo ltauja linyi pee etisiraka intae ina kitanapata.
Kake ore ebaiki enkiterunoto e nkop, eitobira Enkai olee o eng'oruoi.
Te nkaraki ena pee eing'uaa olee menye o ng'otonye, neibung'are enkitok enye,
neaku ninche pokira are osesen obo, Metaa meekure era are kake etaa osesen obo.
Ore naa inaaitutumo Enkai mincho ake erish oltung'ani.”
Ore ti aji neitoki ake lkipaareta lenyena aaikilikuan ena bae.
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ore ake oloiturraa enkitok enye neyam ae, keloloito.
Naa te neiturraa enkitok olmoruo lenye, nelo meyama likae, keloloito.”
Neyakini Yesu nkera kutiti pee etum aiteleiki nkaik, nebuaaki lkipaareta lenyena lelo tung'ana ooriku.
Ore pee edol Yesu ina, negoro, nejoki lkipaareta lenyena, “Enchoo nkera epuonu enatii emimitiki; amu enoo nkera naatiu anaa kuna enkitoria e Nkai.
Kesipa ajoki intae, ore olemeng'amu enkitoria e Nkai anaa enang'amu enkerai kiti, nemejing katukul.”
Nemuataki inkera inkaik amayian, neiteleiki nkaik nemayian ninche.
Ore te nkoitoi epuku Yesu alo, nekuetiki oltung'ani negilaki kung, neikilikuan ajoki, “Olaiteng'enani supat, kaji aiko pee ajung enkishui nemeish?”
Nejoki Yesu, “Kaji etiu pee kijo nanu supat? Meetae hoo obo supat, Enkai ake esupat.
Iyiolo iyie nkitanapat, inchere, ‘Miar metua, miloloito, mipurrisho, minteeniki likae elejare, minkonyisho to losek, iyanyita minyi o ng'utunyi.’ ”
Nejoki ninye, “Olaiteng'enani, aibung'a kuna pooki ebaiki apa ara enkerai.”
Neing'or Yesu ninye akurraki nkonyek nenyorru, nejoki, “Nabo ake nikitong'orikia; shomo, timira iniata pooki nincho laisinak, naa itum olchumati te keper; nikilotu taa asuj.”
Neidisie enkomom enye teina bae, nelo eisinanuo; amu keeta imasaa kumok.
Neing'or Yesu nkaloli pooki, nejoki lkipaareta lenyena, “Kegol atiu aja to lkarsis pee ejing enkitoria e Nkai!”
Neing'asia lkipaareta too rorei lenyena. Kake eigilie Yesu ajoki, “Nakera, kegol atiu aja pee ejing oltung'ani enkitoria e Nkai!
Entames nalelek te neim enaudoto o ltidu alang olkarsis ejing enkitoria e Nkai.”
Neing'asia lkipaareta lenyena oleng, nejoki ninche ninye, “Ae ng'ae naa kenya oidim atajeu?”
Neing'or Yesu ninche nejoki, “Meidimayu too ltung'ana, kake mme neijia etiu te Nkai; amu keidimayu mbaa pooki te Nkai.”
Neiteru Petero ajoki ninye, “Kitung'uaitie iyiook pooki toki aasuj iyie.”
Nejo Yesu, “Esipa ajoki intae, meetae hoo obo otung'uayie enkaji anaa lalashera anaa nkanashera anaa ng'otonye anaa menye anaa nkera anaa nkurman, te nkaraki nanu o te nkaraki kulo omon supati,
lemetum inkatitin iip taata te na kata, aa nkajijik o lalashera o nkanashera o noo ng'otonye o nkera o nkurman te nebo oloisilisili, naa ore te ina kata nalotu netum enkishui nemeish.
Kake etii ilkumok ooiturukutuo ooyooki aaku ile siadi, neaku ilooisiadutua ile dukuya.”

Ore etii Yesu o lkipaareta lenyena enkoitoi, eilep aapuo Yerusalem eiturukito Yesu te dukuya ninche; neing'asia ninche, ore iloosujita netureishote. Neitoki ake arik lelo tomon o aare neiteru aliki nena naapuo aatum ninye.
Nejoki, “Yerusalem kilep aapuo; naa keitarasakini Enkerai e Tung'ani ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat, nedung'oki ninche ninye enkiguana e keeya, neitarasaki Iloreren;
nesukeny ninche ninye, nenotaki, neosh aaitame near metua ore pee eishari nkolong'i uni nepiu.”
Neisho Yakobo o Yohana, ilayiok le Sebedayo, nepuonu enetii Yesu, nejoki, “Olaiteng'enani, kiyieu nintaas iyiook embae ake pooki nikiomon iyie.”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kainyoo iyieuu naitaas intae?”
Nejoki ninche, ninye, “Inchoo iyiook metotona obo lang te nkaina ino e tatene neton olikae te ne kedianye, te nkitoo ino.”
Kake etiaaka Yesu ninche, “Miyiololo intae ina niomonunu. Indimidimi sa aatook enkikompe naok nanu, aashu meibatisai intae te nkibatisa naaibatisai nanu?”
Nejoki, “Ee kindim.” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Iokioko taa ninye enkikompe naok nanu, neibatisae intae te nkibatisa naaibatisai nanu;
kake ore entonata te nkaina ai e tatene aashu te ne kedianye, mme nanu oishoru, kake ene lelo laa ninche eitobirakaki.”
Ore pee ening lelo pokira tomon ina, neiteru aagorokino Yakobo o Yohana.
Neipotu Yesu ninche enetii nejoki, “Iyiololo aajo ore lelo ooitaa ate ilaitoriak loo Loreren neitoreisho te ng'olon, negilu iltung'ana lenye kituaak ninche.
Kake mme neijia etiu te intae, kake ore olinyi oyieu neaku kitok neaku olaisiaayiani linyi,
ore oloyieu neituruk neaku osinka le pooki.
Amu eitu elotu Enkerai e Tung'ani meisiaai kake keewuo aisiaaisho, neishoru enkishui enye metaa elakunoto oo lkumok.”
Nepuonu Yeriko; ore epuo aaing'uaa Yeriko eiriamariyie Yesu lkipaareta lenyena o lorora kitok, netii olmodooni oomonisho oji Bartimayo ole Timayo, oton te mbata e nkoitoi.
Ore pee ening eji Yesu le Nasaret ilo neiteru abuak eishiraki ajo, “Yesu, olayioni le Daudi, ing'urrieki!”
Nebuaaki ilkumok aajoki metigirayu; kake etabuaa oleng ajo, “Olayioni le Daudi, ing'urrieki nanu!”
Neitashe Yesu nejo, “Empoto.” Neipoti ilo tung'ani modooni aajoki, “Intagoluoyu; inyo amu kimpot ninye.”
Nenang'aa olkila lenye, neipid nelo enetii Yesu.
Neng'amaa Yesu ajoki, “Kaa iyieu naaitaas?” Nejoki ilo modooni, “Lo kitok kayieu nadolishoyu.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Shomo, kinchiunye enkirukoto ino.” Nedolishoyu ina kata ake neirukurukore Yesu te nkoitoi.
Ore pee etaaniki ninche embata e Yerusalem, aabaiki Betfage o Betania, to Ldoinyo loo Loirienito, neirriwaa Yesu lkipaareta aare lenyena,
nejoki, “Enchom enda ang naipirare intae, ore ake pee ijing'ijing'i nitumutumu olkurrarru oena, leitu ae kata eked likae tung'ani. Entalaku entereu ene.
Ore te nejoki intae oltung'ani, ‘Kainyoo pee inkoko inji?’ Entejo, ‘Olkitok oatayie enkolat naa keshuku nabo kata.’ ”
Nepuo ninche, neinepu olkurrarru eena te kishomi ti auluo enkoitoi nalala e nkanasa, nelaku ninche.
Nejoki lelo ooitashe teine, “Kainyoo pee igirara aalaku olkurrarru?”
Neliki ina natiaaka Yesu, neisho ninche meshomo.
Nerewaki Yesu ilo kurrarru, neirotoki lkilani lenye, neked atonie.
Neisalaash ilkumok lenye lkilani te nkoitoi nalala, neisalaash kulikae ilng'osil ooata mbenek ootudung'utuo too nkurman.
Ore lelo ooituruk o loosujita nebuaku aajo, “Hosana! Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani!
Emayiana enkitoria nalotu e papa lang Daudi! Hosana te shumata naisul!”
Nejing Yesu Yerusalem, nelo atua enkaji e Nkai, ore pee eshil pooki toki, nemuto, neipang alo Betania o lelo pokira tomon o aare.
Ore te nkolong nasujita ina, pee eshukunye Yesu te Betania, netir esumash.
Ore pee edol te nelakua olng'aboli oata mbenek, nelo ejo ebaiki netumie toki. Nejo abaiki, mbenek ake eeta, amu mme enkata oo lng'abolo.
Nejoki ilo ng'aboli, “Metaa mikingil likae anyayie lng'anayio ntarasi.” Nening lkipaareta lenyena.
Nepuonu Yerusalem. Nejing Yesuenkaji e Nkai neiteru aaraa lelo oomirisho o looinyang'isho te nkaji e Nkai, neibeleleng'oo imisai oo laibelekenyak loo mpisai o lorikan le lelo omir inturkuluoni;
nemit meitoki oltung'ani anap toki aitudung enkaji e Nkai.
Neiteng'enisho, nejoki ninche, “Keitu eigeri aajo, ‘Keaku enkaji ai ene sayiare too loreren pooki?” Kake intaa intae enkapune oo laisimak.
Nening ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ina neing'oru enkoitoi pee ear Yesu; kake etureita ninye, amu eing'asiayie enkikoo enye ilo orora pooki.
Ore pee ebau enteipa neipang teina anasa.
Ore epuoito te nkakenya, nedol olang'ole ng'aboli etoyio o metabaiki intona.
Nedamu Petero nejoki Yesu, “Olaiteng'enani, ng'ura ajo etoyio olang'ole ng'aboli litediaa!”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Eruko Enkai.
Esipa ajoki intae, ore ake olojoki ele doinyo, ‘Tadotunye tanang'akinoyu enaiposha’, nemeing'ash to ltau lenye, kake neiruk ina najo nchere keaku, neaku te ninye anaa enatejo.
Metaa ajoki intae, ore embae ake pooki ninkilikuanunu te nkomono, eruko nchere itumutumu neaku ina.
Naa ore nkatitin pooki nintasheshe aaomon, entapalakinoto pee epalaki sii ninche intae Papa linyi otii keper nkitarruorrot inyi.
(Kake ti nimipalakinono, nemepalaki sii ninye Papa linyi otii keper intae nkitarruorrot inyi.)”
Neitoki ake aapuonu Yerusalem. Ore eloolo Yesu te nkaji e Nkai, nepuonu aayiaya ninye ilapolosak kituaak o lasirak o lpayiani.
Nejoki ninche ninye, “Kaa golon ena niaasie iyie kuna baa, naa ae ng'ae likinchoo ena golon niasie?”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Kaikilikuan intae embae nabo; entawalikiaki pee, aliki intae engolon naasie kuna baa.
Amaa apa enkibatisare e Yohana ae keper eing'uaa anaa ei ltung'ana? Entawalikiaki.”
Neishankarra aajo maate, “Ti nikijo, ‘Keper eing'uaa,’ naa kejoki iyiook, ‘Oo naa pee eitu irukuruku?’
Kake ti nikijo, ‘Ltung'ana eing'uaa?’ ” Neureyu iltung'ana, amu etonyorraitie pooki inchere oloiboni le Nkai o dede Yohana.
Neaku etawalikitia Yesu aajoki, “Mikiyiolo.” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Maliki sii nanu intae eneing'uaa enkitoria naasie kuna baa.”

Neiteru Yesu airorie ninche too nkitanyaanyukot ajoki, “Etuuno oltung'ani enkurma oo sabibu, neitaman enkikarrata, neturu engumoto naironyieki lng'anayio, neshetu oltalet oodo, neitaaki laturok enkurma enye, nelo enkop nalakua.
Ore pee ebau enkata enye, neirriwaki lelo aturok osinka, meishoo ematua oo lng'anayio le ina kurma.
Neibung lelo aturok ilo sinka near, nearaa meeta toki.
Neitoki ake airriwaki likae sinka, nebor ilo elukunya, neinyal aasul.
Neirriwaki ake likae, near ilo metua; neiko sii neijia kulikae kumok, neosh kulikae near kulikae metuata.
Neaku eton apa eeta likae obo, laa oinoti lenye kirotet; neirriwaki aitabayie ninye, nejo, ‘Keyanyit oinoti lai.’
Kake etiakinote lelo aturok ooitaakaki enkurma, ‘Ele doi olajung'oni; wootu, mataar metua pee eaku enaang enjung'ore.’
Neibung ninche ninye near metua, nenang'aki auluo ina kurma oo sabibu.
Kaa kenya eitaas olopeny ina kurma oo sabibu? Kelotu kenya aidaikie lelo aturok neisho ninye kulikae enkurma oo sabibu.
Keitu doi isumusumu ele kigeroto ojo, ‘Ilo soit otanyaita ilashetak otaa osoit kitok lo lmairroto;
Olaitoriani otaasa ena, naa ene nking'asia too nkonyek ang’?”
Neing'oru ninche eneiko pee eibung Yesu, kake etureita olorere, amu etayioloito aajo ninche eipirta ina kitanyaanyukoto; neaku eshomo aaing'uaa.
Neirriwakini Yesu ematua oo Ilfarisayo o ematua oo le ncholiek e Herode, pee epuonu aarresh too rorei lenyena.

Nepuonu enetii nejoki, “Olaiteng'enani, kiyiolo aajo ira iyie, asipani, nimishilaa hoo iyie likae tung'ani; amu mishilaa enkitoo oo ltung'ana, kake enkoitoi ake e Nkai iutaa too sipat. Keishiaakino te nikincho Kaisari kodi, anaa aimeishiaakino?
Aikilak, ana aimikilak?” Kake ore amu etayiolo Yesu esunkuroisho enye, nejoki, “Kainyoo pee kitemiteme? Eyakaki empisai, maing'ura.”
Neyakini. Nejoki ninche, “Ai ng'ae ele osirakino ena pisai naa ae ng'ae eigero?” Nejokini, “Kaisari.”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Enchoo Kaisari ine Kaisari, ninchosho Enkai ine Nkai.” Neing'asiakino ninche Yesu oleng.
Nepuonu Sadukayo enetii Yesu, lelo taa oojo eji meetae empiunoto; neikilikuan aajoki;
“Olaiteng'enani, eigeroko Musa iyiook nchere te neye oltung'ani alashe olikae, neing'uaa enkitok meeta enkerai, neyam olalashe ina kitok, pee eiki olalashe nkera.
Eetae apa lalashera oopishana; neyam olbotor enkitok, ore pee eye neitu eing'uaa nkera.
Neyam oliaare, neye neitu eiu nkera; naa neijia eikuna oliokuni;
neaku eitu eing'uaa nkera pokira oopishana. Ore te nkiting'oto neye ina kitok.
Amaa kenya te mpiunoto oo lootuata, keaku ene ng'ae ina kitok? Amu eyama naa pokira oopishana?”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eijojo mme nji taa doi etiu pee ipong'oriri, mme ilkigerot miyiololo nimiyiololo sii engolon e Nkai?
Amu te nepiu kenya lelo too lootuata, meyamisho nemeyami, kake ketiu anaa lmalaika te keper.

Naa amaa doi enkitopiunoto oo lootuata, keitu isumusumu too nkitanapat e Musa, te noshi wueji neimaki osanag oyupuyup, pee ejoki Enkai ninye. ‘Ara nanu Enkai e Abraham, o Enkai e Isaak o Enkai e Yakobo?’
Mme Enkai oo lootuata ninye, kake enoo looishu, itapong'ori oleng.”
Nelotu obo loo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat nening eishankarra, ore pee ening ajo etawalikia Yesu aitobiraki, neikilikuan ninye ajoki, “Kaa kitanapata naituruk?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ena naituruk, ‘Toning'o iyie Siraeli; Enkai ang Olaitoriani; obo Olaitoriani;
naa tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki, o te nkishui ino pooki, o te ng'eno ino pooki, o te ngolon ino pooki.’
Naa ena eniare, ‘Tonyorra ole latia ino anaa eninyor kewan.’ Meetae ae kitanapata kitok nalang nena.”
Nejoki ilo aiteng'enani loo nkitanapat, “Itisipa, Olaiteng'enani; itisipa nchere nabo Enkai, nemeetae likae leme ninye;

naa ti ninyorru ninye to ltau lino pooki o te ng'eno ino pooki, o te ngolon ino pooki, ninyorru sii ole latia ino anaa eninyor kewan, nelang nena kishorunot pooki naapeji elulung'a nelang ilasarri ake pooki.”
Ore pee edol Yesu ajo etawalikia te ng'eno, nejoki, “Milakuaniki iyie enkitoria e Nkai.” Ore ebaiki ina kata, metii oltung'ani onyaaka aitieu aikilikuana Yesu ae bae.
Ore eiteng'enisho Yesu te nkaji e Nkai, nejo, “Kaji etiu pee ejo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat Kristo eji olayioni le Daudi?
Netejo Daudi openy, etuutaka Enkiyang'et Sinyati, nchere, ‘Etiaka Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lai, Totona te nkaina ai e tatene, o matipika lmang'ati linono abori nkejek inono.’
Eipoto Daudi openy ajo Olaitoriani; kaji eitoki aakunye enkerai enye?” Neinining ilo orora kitok ninye te ng'ida.
Ore eiteng'enisho Yesu nejo, “Entodol ake ate too laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat, oonyor aaishopo lkilani adoru neyieu neirorokini too neemirishoreki,
nenyor ilorikan le nkitoo too nkajijik e nkomono o wuejitin e nkitoo too mashoi,
nedaare nkajijik oo nkolia neitaakuno eitoodor enkomono. Keyooki lelo aatum enkiguana kitok.”
Neton Yesu aishiaakinore eneitadoikini mpisai e nkaji e Nkai, nejur olorere epik mpisai ilo sanduku. Nepik iltung'ana kumok karsisi te nkumoi.
Nelotu enkoliai aisinani, nepik isuyan are naabaya olking'otore obo.
Neipotu Yesu lkipaareta lenyena enetii, nejoki, “Esipa, ajoki intae, etipika ena oliai aisinani nkumok alang lelo kulikae pooki ootipika ilo sanduku.
Amu etipika pooki te nkumoi naata; kake ore ninye to sina lenye netipika entoki duoo pooki naata, entoki duoo pooki naishuyie.”
Ore ina kata epuku Yesu te nkaji e Nkai, nejoki obo loo lkipaareta lenyena ninye, “Olaiteng'enani, ng'ura eneba kulo soito le nking'asia o kuna ajijik e nking'asia!”
Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Idol kuna kituaa ajijik sapuki? Meing'uari tene osoit obo oiteleikino olikae lemesulakini enkop.”
Ore etonita Yesu to Ldoinyo loo Loirienito eipirare enkaji e Nkai, neikilikuan Petero o Yakobo o Andrea too nkurrat aajoki,
“Toliki iyiook, kanu ebau kuna baa, naa kalo olmonekie oitodolu enkata nataanu kuna baa pee eitabari?”
Neiteru Yesu ajoki, “Enteng'enuoto meitapong'oo intae oltung'ani.
Kepuonu lkumok te nkarna ai, ejo, ‘Nanu ilo!’ Neitapong'oo lkumok.
Naa te nining'ining'i njoreitin o lmarenke loo njoreitin, eming'aing'ae; amu meeta nchere pee metiu neijia; kake eton eng'or ina kiting'oto.
Amu kedumakino olorere olikae orere, nedumakino enkitoria enkae kitoria; netumi olokirikiri le nkop too wuejitin kumok, netumi lameitin; naa ena enkiterunoto oo sinaitin.
“Kake entodol ate. Amu keitarasakini intae nkiguanat; neari intae too nkajijik enye e ntumo; nintasheshe te dukuya ilaitoriak o laiguanak te nkaraki nanu, pee iakuku shakeni te dukuya ninche.
Nemeeta nchere pee meng'asi aalikioo ele rorei supat too loreren pooki.
Naa ore pee erikuni intae enkiguana aaitarasaa, eming'aing'ae te dukuya aajo aikijo aa; kake ina naishori intae teina saa entejo, amu mme intae ooiro, kake Enkiyang'et Sinyati.
Naa keitarasaa olalashe olalashe lenye metari metua, neitarasaa menye enkerai enye, nedumakino nkera iloomenye, neitarasaa metari metuata.
Naa keibayuni intae iltung'ana pooki te nkaraki enkarna ai. Kake ore olong'iri ometabaiki enkiting'oto naa keitajeuni.
“Kake ore pee idolidolo ina taboi nayau emutata eitashe te wueji nemeishiaakino (tayiolo taa ake oloisuma ena), esikaki ildoinyo ilootii Yudea.
Ore olotii shumata enkaji nemedou ajing aji ashoroo ae toki.
“Ore olotii enkurma nemeshuko ang ajo ashoroo olkila lenye.
Wooi nena tuaan o naaitanakisho te nena olong'i!
Entasaisho pee mebau nena te nkata e nkirobi.
Amu ore te nena olong'i kepuonu isinaitin leitu ae kata etumi anaa apa pee eitayu Enkai enkop o te nne, nemeitokini ae kata aatum intarasi.
Te neme Olaitoriani oitodorropa nena olong'i, anaata meetae hoo oltung'ani obo opok. Kake ore te nkaraki ilgelunot lenyena ootegelua ninye, neitodorropa ninye nena olong'i.
Ore ina kata te nejoki intae oltung'ani, ‘Ng'ura, nele Kristo otii ende!’ Anaa ‘Ng'ura, nelido otii ende!’ Emiruk.
Keinyototo loo Kristo le lejare o loibonok le lejare neitoduaaya lmonek o mbaa e nking'asia, ejo maitapong'oi, te naa keidimayu, ebaiki lelo ootegeluaki.
Kake entodol ate; aidipa atoliki intae mbaa pooki te dukuya.
“Kake ore te nena olong'i, etulusoitie lelo sinaitin, nemisimisu enkolong, nemeitoki olapa awang'u
nesulunye ilakir te keper, neikirikirieki engolon o loing'ang'e.
Nedoluni ina kata Enkerai e Tung'ani elotu too nkatampo te ngolon sapuk o te nkitoo.
Neirriwaa teina kata ilmalaika, meiturrurro lelo gelunot lenyena aaitung'uaa ilubot pokira ong'uan, neitung'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop o neeiting'ie keper.
“Enteng'ena ate te nkitanyaanyukoto o lng'aboli; laa ore ake pee enanau ilng'osil neiturumisho mbenek, niyiolouu aajo etinyikua erishata oladalu.
Neijia naa etiu, ti nidolidolo nena baa etabautua, niyiolouu aajo etataana ninye, auluo etii.
Esipa ajoki intae, meishari ena ishoi eitu eitabari kuna baa pooki.
Keishari keper o enkop, kake meishari irorei laainei.
“Kake ore ina olong o ina saa, meetae hoo obo oyiolo, aimeyiolo ninche lmalaika le keper, nemeyiolo Enkerai e Tung'ani, Papa ake oyiolo.
Entodol ate, entashololoto; amu miyiololo aajo kanu ebau ina kata.
Etiu anaa oltung'ani oshomo elototo, ore elo ti ang, neing'ueiki ilaisiaayiak, neisho ake oltung'ani eramatare enye, neitanap olorrip kishomi metashololoyu.
Entashololoto naa amu miyiololo aajo kanu elotu olopeny enkaji, anaa ae te nteipa, anaa ae te nasirie
pee melotu ake neluamisho neinepu intae irurara.
Naa ore ina najoki intae, neijia ajoki pooki: entashololoto.”
Ore etaa nkolong'i are naatiooyo pee ebau Pasaka, nebau sii osirua loo Mukateni Nemeisuiisheki. Neing'oru ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat eneiko pee eibung Yesu to losek, aar metua;
amu etejo ninche, “Neme taa te nkata o sirua, mepuku ake olong'oling'oli lo lorere.”

Ore etii Yesu Betania enkaji e Simon oata enkeeya oo lbolot. Ore einosita endaa, nejing'u enkitok naata oltulet lo soit oji alabasta nebore eilata narropil naleng naji nardo, nagol oleng enkinyang'unoto, nedany ilo tulet nebukoki ina ilata elukunya e Yesu.
Kake etii ilootagorote nejokino, “Kainyoo pee eitarruoyioki ena ilata narropil aaiko inji?
Amu anaata etimiraki ena ilata aainosie dinari iip uni, neishori laisinak.” Neing'unyung'unyaki ina kitok.
Nejo Yesu, “Entapal, kainyoo pee intanyamalala? Nanu eitaasa embae naikishian oleng.
Amu iatata laisinak anaake, naa te niyieuu, indimidimi ake aaitaasa ninche isupati; kake mikiaatata nanu anaake.
Etaasa anaa enaidima; osesen lai eitera ael eton eitu enukari.
Naa kesipa, ajoki intae, ore pooki wueji nelikiorieki ele rorei supat te nkop pooki, neinosari ena nataasa edamunyeki ninye.”
Nelo Yudas Iskariot laa obo le lelo tomon o aare enetii ilapolosak kituaak pee etum atakaldai Yesu te ninche.
Ore pee ening ninche neshipayu neisiligie aajo keisho mpisai. Neing'oru Yudas erishata nakaldarie Yesu.
Ore te nkolong e dukuya e nkata oo Mukateni Nemeisuiishieki, enkolong apa nayieng'i ilkuoo, oodamunyeki Pasaka, nejoki lkipaareta lenyena Yesu, “Kaji iyieu nikipuo aaitobir pee inyayie Pasaka?”
Neirriwaa lkipaareta lenyena aare, nejoki, “Enchom enda anasa, ore pee enang'are intae oltung'ani onapita emoti e nkare; erukurukore,
ore ake enejing, entiaaki olopeny enkaji. ‘Etejo Olaiteng'enani, Koree enkaji ai oo lomon, nainosie Pasaka te nebo lkipaareta laainei?’
Naa keitodol intae enkaji e shumata nalala naitobira; teine entobiraki iyiook.”
Nedumunye lkipaareta lenyena nepuo ina anasa, neinepu etiu anaa enatiaakaki neitobiraki Pasaka.
Ore pee eaku teipa nelotu Yesu o lelo tomon o aare.
Ore etoni aanya endaa, nejo Yesu, “Esipa, ajoki intae, kaakaldaa obo linyi, oloinosita endaa te nebo nanu.”
Neiteru lkipaareta aaisinanuo, nejoki maa obo ninye, “Ke nanu sa?”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Obo doi le kulo tomon o aare, obo oitadoiki emukate embakuli te nebo nanu.
Amu elo ake Enkerai e Tung'ani aikunari anaa enatisirakaki ninye, kake ooi ilo tung'ani laa ninye okaldaa Enkerai e Tung'ani! Enaikash apa te neitu eini ilo tung'ani.”
Ore einosita endaa, nedumu Yesuemukate nemayian, nebelibel, neisho ninche, nejo, “Enkoito; osesen lai ele.”
Nedumu enkikompe, ore pee eisho Enkai enashe neisho ninche, neok pooki.
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Osarge lai ele lo sotua, oibukori te nkaraki ilkumok.
Esipa, ajoki intae, meekure aigil aok aekata enoo lng'anayio loo sabibu o metabau ina olong naok eokoto ng'ejuk te nkitoria e Nkai.”
Ore pee eidip aatarany osinkolio nepuku aapuo Oldoinyo loo Loirienito.
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Isikisiki ade pooki aailanyisho; amu etisiraki aajo, ‘Kaosh olchekut, neisardak intare!’
Kake ore pee aaitopiuni, naituruk te intae alo Galilaya.”
Nejoki Petero, “Te naa keisik pooki, maaorore nanu.”
Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Esipa aajoki iyie, ore ade te na kewarie, eton eitu eru olchogoo katitin are nikimiki iyie katitin uni.”
Neisimu oleng ajo, “Te naa kaye te nebo o iyie, maamiki nanu iyie.” Nejo ninche pooki neijia.
Nepuo ewueji neji Getsemane; nejoki Yesu lkipaareta lenyena, “Entaanyuaki tene o maidipa enkomono.”
Nerik Petero o Yakobo o Yohana, pee eiriamariyie, neiteru aiputukuny oleng nenyamalu.
Nejoki ninche, “Keeta oltau lai osina kitok oba anaa keeya; entotoni tene entashololoto.”
Neigut penyo, neirrabalakino enkop neomon inchere, te naa keidimayu metogiroi ina kata ninye.
Nejo, “Abba, Papa, keidimayu imbaa pooki te iyie; iwuang'akinyeki ena kikompe; kake mme enaa enayieu nanu, kake anaa eniyieu iyie.”
Neshukunye neinepu eirurate, nejoki Petero, “Simon, iyie ilo oirura? Italaikine atashololoyu ena ninye nabo?
Entashololoto naa entasaisho pee mijing'ijing'i atua ntemat; keyieu oltau, kake keshal osesen.”
Neitoki ake alo neomon, neigil iladuoo ake rorei.
Neitoki aitu neinepu eirurate, amu eiroshiutuo nkonyek oleng; nelau ninche enawaliki ninye.
Neitu ene uni nejoki ninche, “Keton ake duoo irurara aayeng'iyeng'a? Eidipe; etabawua esaa; naitarasari Enkerai e Tung'ani aaitarasaki nkaik oo larruok.
Enyoito, emaape; idol etabaua ilo laakaldaa.”
Ore nabo kata, eton eirorita Yesu, nelotu Yudas, obo le lelo tomon o aare, neiriamunore ninye empuoto neeta lalema o siaren, eirriutua ilapolosak kituaak o lasirak o lpayiani.
Eishoo taa duoo ilo otakaldayie olmonekie, ajoki, “Ore taa olang'utut ninye ilo, embung'a entorik entirrisha.”
Ore pee elotu Yudas, nelo nabo kata enetii Yesu, nejoki, “Lo kitok!” Neng'utut.
Nesaru aaibung ninye.
Kake etushutua obo le lelo ooitashe teine olalem, neosh osinka lo lapolosani kitok nedung'u enkiok.
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ietuo itanapate anaa iloopuo aaibung olaisimani, aa nanu ipuonunu aaibung inapitata ilalema o siaren?
Natii oshi ake enkaji e Nkai te nebo intae aiteng'enisho, neitu kimbung'ubung'u? Kake nchoo eitabari ilkigerot.”
Neing'uaa lkipaareta lenyena pooki ninye, neilanyisho.
Neirukurukore oloti barnoti Yesu laa olkarasha ake errotianita; neibung ninche ninye.
Kake eitiaa ninye ilo karasha neisik meishopo.
Nerikoki ninche Yesu olapolosani kitok, netumo lapolosak pooki kituaak o lpayiani o lasirak.
Nesujita Petero ninye elakuaniki, o metijing'a abaiki olgoriet lo lapolosani kitok; neton te nebo ilarripok aij enkima.
Neing'oru lapolosak kituaak o ina kiguana pooki shakenisho naarie Yesu metua; kake etalaita.
Amu eetuo lkumok ooiteenikitia mbaa, kake eitu eipira nkiteenikinot enye.
Neinyototo kulikae aaiteeniki, ejo,
“Kitoning'o iyiook ejo, ‘Kagil nanu ena aji e Nkai naitobiraki too nkaik, ore too nkolong'i uni nashetu ae, neitu eitobiri too nkaik.’ ”
Kake ore ake eyia, eitu eipira ina shakenisho enye.
Neinyototo olapolosani kitok nelo aitashe te mpolos, neikilikuan Yesu ajoki, “Ai miata ewalata niwalu? Kaa shakenisho ena nikintang'orie kulo tung'ana?”
Kake etigire Yesu neitu ewaliki. Neitoki ake olapolosani kitok aikilikuan ajoki. “Ira iyie Kristo, Oinoti lo Lomayiana?”
Nejo Yesu, “Ee, ara, naa iyiookiki aadol Enkerai e Tung'ani eton te nkaina e tatene o Lopeny Engolon, elotu too nkatampo e keper.”
Nepolos olapolosani kitok ilkilani lenyena nejo, “Kainyoo kintoki aayieunye lchakenini?
Itoning'okito ate emoroto namor Enkai. Ijojo aa?” Nedung'oki pooki enkiguana aajo keishiaakino keeya.
Neiteru kulikae aanotaki, neimulumul enkomom, nedam, nejoki, “Imbonisho!” Neitanang'are ilarripok ninye ioshot.
Ore etii Petero olgoriet ti abori ine, nelotu enkaisiaayiani nabo o lapolosani kitok.
Ore pee edol Petero eijito enkima, neing'or ninye, nejo, “Iboitare sii oshi iyie Yesu le Nasaret.”
Kake etomikio ejo, “Mayiolo nemaning'u enijoito.” Nepuku ninye alo kishomi.
Nedol ina aisiaayiani, neitoki ake ajoki lelo ooitashe teine, “Ore ele tung'ani, obo lenye.”
Kake enyaaka ake Petero amiki. Ore ake sii te nkiti rishata nejoki lelo ooitashe te nebo Petero, “Edede taa ninye ira iyie obo lenye; amu ira ole Galilaya.”
Kake eiterua adek kewan nenya lmuma ajo. “Mayiolo nanu ele tung'ani liimakiki.”
Ore nabo kata ake neru olchogoo ene are. Nedamu Petero enatiaaka Yesu nchere, “Ore eton eitu eru olchogoo katitin are, nikimiki iyie katitin uni.” Nedanya Petero aishir.
Ore ake pee ekenyu, neiguana ilapolosak kituaak, o lpayiani o laigerok o enkitoo pooki nalulung'a. Neen Yesu, nerik neitarasaki Pilato.
Neikilikuan Pilato ajoki, “Ira doi iyie Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?” Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Iyie otejo neijia.”
Neitang'or ilapolosak kituaak ninye too mbaa kumok.
Neigil Pilato aikilikuan ninye ajoki, “Aimiata hoo embae niwalu? Nidol eneba mbaa nikintang'orie ninche?”
Kake eitu hoo ewaliki Yesu, o metaba anaa neing'asia Pilato.
Naa ore apake te ilo sirua kelaku apa Pilato oltung'ani obo oena, naa olotoomonutuo ake iltung'ana.
Ore too ltung'ana otigilunore enkitoria ooena te jila, neitayutuo loikop ina kata, netii oltung'ani oji Barabas.
Nepuonu lelo tung'ana neiteru aaikilikuan Pilato meitaasa enoshi ake naitaas.
Newaliki ajoki, “Iyieuu nalaaki intae Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?”
Amu etayiolo Pilato ajo olom ake eitarasarie ilapolosak kituaak Yesu.
Kake einuaakita ilapolosak kituaak olorere metejo pee elaakini ninche Barabas.
Neitoki ake Pilato ajoki ninche, “Paa kaa naa aitaas ele tung'ani lijojo Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?”
Neilepilep aaigil aajo, “Tasho ninye.”
Nejoki Pilato ninche, “Kainyoo, kaa torrono etaasa ninye?” Kake eilepilepa oleng aajo, “Tasho ninye.”
Ore amu keyieu Pilato neitiship lelo tung'ana, nelaaki Barabas neng'as aishooyo Yesu metooshi too nkeenta neitoki aitarasaa metashei.
Neriku sikarini Yesu atua enkaji e nkitoo naji praitorio; neipotu esikari e sirit nalulung'a.
Neishopoki Yesu olkila mugie neshetu olmarisian loo lkiku neishopoki Yesu elukunya.
Neiteru aairoroki aajoki, “Olele Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi!”
Neigilie aaosh elukunya te ntiyani, nenotaki, negilaki kung aaitaakuno keserem.
