Ore pee eidip aatadalare, neoru ilo kila mugie neishopoki nkilani enyena. Nerik auluo pee epuo aashe.
Nearakini olpayian obo oji Simon le Kirene, otadokuo ti ae kop, menye taa Aleksanta o Rufus, metanapa osalaba le Yesu.
Nerik o meitabaiki Golgota, (eji ewueji e mborbor).
Neisho enaisho natipikaki entoki naji manemane, kake etanya ninye eok.
Neshe ninche ninye, neorikino lkilani lenyena, neoshie enkukuo pee etum oloya.
Naa saa uni ina kata pee eshe ninche ninye.
Ore embae naitanang'aki ninye neigero ajo, “Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi.”
Netashoki lapurrok aare te nebo Yesu, atii obo te tatene netii olikae te kedianye.
Neitabari olkigeroto ojo, “Eikenayioki ninye te nebo ilarruok.”
Ore lelo oopuaya o looim ine, nesurdaany ninye eing'unie lukuny, nejo, “Hoo! Eiyie doi ojo igil enkaji e Nkai nintoki ashetu too nkolong'i uni?
Intajeu kewan tadou te ilo salaba!”
Neiko sii ninche neijia ilapolosak kituaak aaikordod ejokino maate, “Kulikae ake eitajewuo; nemeidim aitajeu kewan.
Nchoo naa duoo Kristo, Olaiguanani le Siraeli, edou to salaba matodol pee kiruk.” Ore lelo ootashoki te nebo ninye nemor sii ninche.
Ore pee eipir enkolong, neiput enaimin enkop pooki o metabaiki saa naaudo.
Ore pee eaku saa naaudo nebuak Yesu to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” Eji, “Enkai ai, Enkai ai, ainyoo pee kitung'uayie?”
Ore pee ening kulikae ooitashe teine nejo, “Ining, Eliya eipoto.”
Nekuet obo, neiput osuguroi enaisho naisuisho naji siki, nepik oloomi neisho metooko, nejo, “Ntasho matodol te naa kelotu Eliya aitadou.”
Nebuaku Yesu oleng, nedung'o tau.
Neiperra aaku are olkarasha oor enkaji e Nkai, eiteru te shumata o meiting'o ti abori.
Ore pee edol osajini oitashe aipirare Yesu, ajo etaa etundung'e tau, nejo, “Kedede Oinoti le Nkai ele tung'ani.”
Netii sii nkituaak naaing'orita elakuaniki inaatii Mariamu Magdalene, o Mariamu ng'otonye Yakobo oti o Yosef, netii sii Salome,
ninche napa, etii Yesu Galilaya, naatusujutua neisiaai. Netii sii kulie kituaak kumok naairiamunore ninye epuonu Yerusalem.
Ore pee eaku teipa, naa enkolong e Nkitobirakinoto, aa enoshi olong taa pee eyookini enkolong e Sabato.
Neshirraki Yosef le Arimatea, obo loo looyanyiti le nkiguana, olaa keanyita ninye enkitoria e Nkai, nelo enetii Pilato neomonu osesen le Yesu.
Neing'asia Pilato pee eji eidipa Yesu atua, ore pee eipotu osajini, neikilikuan te naa keidipa Yesu atua.
Ore pee ening to sajini ajo etua, neisho Yosef ilo sesen.
Neinyang'u Yosef olkarasha le kitani neenie osesen le Yesu, neirragie te nkurare nataguetuaki to soit, neibeleleng'oki osoit enkutuk e ina kurare.
Netoduaa Mariamu Magdalene o Mariamu ng'otonye Yosef eneirragieki osesen le Yesu.
Ore pee eishari enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng naji Sabato, neinyang'u Mariamu Magdalene o Mariamu ng'oto Yakobo, o Salome iila naarropil pee epuo aael osesen le Yesu.
Ore tadekenya oleng te nkolong e nkiterunoto e wqiki, nepuonu enkurare eilepua enkolong,
ejokino maate, “Ae ng'ae ade oret iyiook aibeleleng'oo, osoit te nkutuk e nkurare?”
Nejo maing'ura, nedol aajo eidipaki aaibeleleng'oi osoit aaiwuang'ie amu ae sapuk apa oleng.
Ore pee ejing enkurare, nedol oltung'ani barnoti eitashe te nkalo e tatene, neishopito olkila oibor; neing'asia ninche.
Nejoki ilo tung'ani ninche, “Eming'asia; Yesu le Nasaret ing'oruru, otashoki. Etopiwuo, metii ene; eng'ura enapa wueji neirragieki ninye.
Kake enchom, entoliki lkipaareta lenyena o Petero nchere, keituruk alo Galilaya; teine ipuopuo aadol, anaa enatiaaka intae.”
Nepuku aapuo neipirri aaing'uaa enkurare; amu einepua olokirikiri o enkiputukuny, neitu eliki likae tung'ani, amu etureishote.

Ore pee epiu Yesu enasirie te nkolong e nkiterata e wiki, Mariamu Magdalene etang'asa aipang'aki enapa kitok nataararie iloiriruani oopishana. Kake etolikitio Petero too ndorropu o lelo ooboitare nena naatolikioki ninche.

Nelo ninye aliki lelo apa ooiriamariyie ninye, eishirita ninche neilisho. Ore te siadi nena, neitanap yesu makewan ninche mewaita enkilepunoto neya endoyioroto elikioroto sinyati e njeunoto nemeish nebik intarasi.]
Kake ore pee ening ninche aajo eishu netoduaa ninye, neitu sii eiruk.
Ore te siadi nena, eibelekenye Yesu atum ae mua, neitalioo kewan te kulikae kipaareta aare lenyena epuo nkurman.
Nerrinyo lelo aapuo aaliki lkulikae, kake eitu ninche eiruk.
Ore te siadi nena, neipang'aki Yesu lelo tomon oobo etoni aadaa; neisikong ninche te nkaraki engolon oo lukuny enye o te nkaraki nemeeta enkirukoto amu eitu eiruk lelo ootoduaa ninye eidipa atopiu.
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom enkop pooki entoliki ltung'ana pooki ele rorei supat.
Ore oloiruk neibatisae nejeu; ore olemeiruk nedung'okini enkiguana.
Naa kulo lmonek ooiriamariyie lelo ooiruk te nkarna ai earaa loiriruani; neiro too nkutukie ng'ejuko.
Nedumu lasuriaa, naa teneok entoki ake pooki nayaisho nemeeta enaiko ninche; neiteleiki ltamuoyia nkaik, neishiu.”
Neaku ore pee eidip Olaitoriani Yesu airorie ninche, neilepieki aaya Keper, neton te nkaina e tatene e Nkai.
Nedumunye ilkipaareta aapuo aalikioo ilo rorei too wuejitin pooki, neasisho Olaitoriani te nebo ninche neitadedeyie ilo rorei too lmonek ooiriamariyie. Eesai. [
Ore te nkaraki natii lkumok ootonyuaakita aaiger imbaa naatupukutuo tiatua iyiook.
Neigero anaa enainosakita iyiook lelo apa ootoduaa te nkiterunoto too nkonyek enye, oora ninche ilaisiaayiak ooinosu ele rorei le Nkai.
Nadol sii nanu, Oloyanyiti Teofilo, ajo keishiaakino amu atisipua mbaa pooki te rishata naado, naaigeroki mbaa naaitobirakino aitisipaki,
pee itum atayiolo esipata e kuna baa nikinosakaki.
Etii apa te nkata o laiguanani Herode, le Yudea, olapolosani oji Sakaria, le ntalipa o lapolosak e Abija. Ore enkitok enye naa ene ntalipa e Aaron, neji enkarna enye Elisabet.
Naa supati ninche pokira are tialo Enkai, nesuj inkitanapat o nkitoriat pooki o Laitoriani, meitong'or.
Nemeeta enkerai, amu koolupi Elisabet, naa moruak pokira are oleng.
Neaku ore eitayu Sakaria esiaai e mpolosare too nkatitin olkekun lenye te dukuya Enkai,
anaa enaikununo olkuak loo lapolosak. Nedoiki enkukuo metaa ninye ojing enkaji o Laitoriani, ainok olasar le nkorropil.
Neomon olorere te boo, ina kata einoki enkorropil.
Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani aitashe te nkalo e tatene olperere lo lasar le nkorropil.
Ore pee edol Sakaria neirut,
nejoki olmalaika, “Sakaria, miureishoyu, etoning'oki enkomono ino: naa aikiiki enkitok ino Elisabet enkayioni, naa ijo enkarna enye Yohana.
Naa itum iyie enchipai o eng'ida to ltau lino, neng'ida ltung'ana kumok te inoto enye.
Amu keakuninye kitok te dukuya Olaitoriani, nemeok enaisho oo sabibu aashu enaisho napi, naa keiput Enkiyang'et Sinyati ebaiki etii enkoshoke e ng'otonye.
Naa kerrinyoki Siraeli kumok Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

Neituruk te dukuya Olaitoriani aaku olkilikuai lenye, te nkiyang'et o te ngolon naaijo ene Eliya. Neitaiki osotua inkera o loo menye, neibelekeny iloogolong'u menoto eng'eno e lelo supati pee eitobiraki Olaitoriani iltung'ana ooishiaakino.”
Nejoki Sakaria olmalaika, “Kainyoo ayiolounye ena bae? Nataa moruo, naa moruo sii ninye enkitok ai?”
Newaliki olmalaika ajoki, “Ara nanu Gabriel, oitashe te dukuya Enkai; naairriwua maairorie naaitabaiki ele kilikuai supat.
Ekionyo enkutuk nimintoki airo, o metabau ina olong naibalayu nena, amu eitu iruk irorei laainei, kake keitabari ake te nkata naikenakaki.”
Naa keanyita apa lelo tung'ana Sakaria neing'asia te nkimutioto naimutie tiatua Enkaji e Nkai.
Ore pee epuku Sakaria, nelaikino airorie ninche, neyiolou ninche aajo eeta enatoduaa te neinokieki olasar. Neitodol too lmonek etalaikine airorie.
Ore pee eidipayu ilkekuno le nkisiayiare enye, nelo Sakaria ang.
Ore pee elusoo nena olong'i, nenutayu enkitok enye Elisabet, neisudoo kewan ilapaitin imiet, nejo,
“Ena aaitaasa Olaitoriani te nkata natoduaa naaoru esulare te dukuya iltung'ana.”
Ore to lapa le ile le nutai e Elisabet, neirriwaa Enkai olmalaika oji Gabriel, meshomo enkanasa e Galilaya naji Nasaret,
enetii eselenkei natisira oltung'ani oji Yosef, lo lgilata le Daudi; naa keji apa ina selenkei Mariamu.
Nejing'aki olmalaika nejoki, “Takuenya na kirotet! Etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyie!”
Neirut Mariamu oleng te nkaraki lelo rorei, nejo to ltau, “Kaji eikununo ina kirorokino?”
Nejoki olmalaika, “Mariamu, miureishoyu, itaa kirotet te Nkai.
Naa inutayu, niiu enkayioni, nijo enkarna enye Yesu.
Naa keaku kitok neji Enkerai e Nkai natii shumata aisul te pooki naa keisho Olaitoriani Enkai ninye olorika le nkitoo le Daudi menye lenye,
neitore olgilata le Yakobo intarasi, nemeiting enkitoria enye.”
Nejoki Mariamu ilo malaika, “Kaji eiko pee eaku ena nemayiolo olee?”
Newaliki olmalaika ajoki, “Kelotu Enkiyang'et Sinyati shumata iyie, nikintoip engolon o Lotii Shumata Aisul, ore te nkaraki ina, ore enkerai naini, neji sinyati, Enkerai e Nkai.
Naa ore enkanashe ino Elisabet nenuta te moruao enye, naa keiu enkayioni, naa ole ile ele apa, te nutai enye, netejoki oshi koolupi.
Amu meetae embae nemeidimayu te Nkai.”
Nejo Mariamu, “Kara nanu esinka o Laitoriani; metotiwuo te nanu anaa enitejo.” Nelo olmalaika aing'uaa ninye.
Ore te nena olong'i, nedumunye Mariamu aisarrisar alo enkop oo oldoinyo natii enkanasa e Yuda.
Nejing enkaji e Sakaria, neiroroki Elisabet.
Ore ake pee ening Elisabet enkirorokino e Mariamu, neipid enkerai te nkoshoke; neiput Elisabet Enkiyang'et Sinyati,
nebuak to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Kitamayianaki iyie too nkituaak, nemayiani eishoi e nguset ino!
Kaji eikununo ena kias kitok, eji ng'otonye Olaitoriani lai nalotu enatii?
Amu ore ake pee aning too nkiyiaa aainei enkiroroto ino, neipid enkerai te nchipai te nkoshoke ai.
Emayiana enairuko nchere keitabari inaatiaakaki ninye eing'uaa Olaitoriani.”
Nejo Mariamu, “Kalimu to ltau lai enkitoo o Laitoriani;
neshipakino enkiyang'et ai Enkai Olaitajeunoni lai,
amu etadamua enchalan e sinka enye. Amu ore ebaiki taata, kaajo ishoritin pooki namayiana;
amu aaitaasa ologol isapuki, aisinyati enkarna enye.
Ore olng'ur lenye netii shumata lelo ooure ninye too ishoritin pooki.
Etaasa ine ngolon te nkaina enye; neisardakie iloowuasa o nkiguanat oo ltauja lenye.
Eitadowuo ilaitoriak too lorikan lenye le nkitoo, neilepie iloomeni.
Eitaraposho ilooata esumash too ntokitin sidain, nearaa ilkarsisi meeta toki.
Etasarua Israel osinka lenye, te nkaraki olng'ur lenye,
anaa enatiaaka iloo papa, Abraham o eishoi enye intarasi.”
Neton Mariamu aboitare Elisabet ilapaitin oobaya okuni, nerrinyo alo ang.
Nebau enkata naishore Elisabet, neiu enkayioni.
Nening elatia enye, o lgilata lenye nchere, eing'urrie Olaitoriani, neshipayu te nebo ninye.
Ore te nkolong e isiet, nepuonu aamurat enkerai, neyieu nedung'oki enkarna aaipotie Sakaria menye lenye.
Nejo, ng'otonye, “Mme nejia, keipoti aajo, Yohana.”
Nejokini Elisabet, “Meetae oltung'ani lo lmarei linyi oji nejia.”
Neikilikuan menye too lmonek enayieu neji enkerai.
Neipotu osoit dapash neiger ajo, “Keji enkarna enye Yohana!” Neing'asia pooki.
Nebolo Sakaria enkutuk ina kata ake, nelaa olng'ejep lenye, neiteru airo, aisis Enkai.
Neureishoyu pooki oomanya ina latia, nelikiori nena baa pooki to ldoinyo le Yudea.
Ore lootoning'o pooki neiteng'el too ltauja lenye ejo, “Keaku pasa ena kerai keniaa pukunoto?” Amu etii engolon e Nkai tenebo ninye.
Neiput Sakaria, menye le Yohana Enkiyang'et Sinyati neibonisho ajo;
“Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, amu etabaikia nekordu ltung'ana lenyena.
Eishorua Olaitajeunoni Magilani to lgilata lo sinka lenye Daudi,
anaa enatejo apake too nkirorot oo sinyat o enoo loibonok le Nkai liapa moitie
pee kijeu too lmang'ati lang, o too nkaik e lelo pooki ooiba iyiook;
neitabaya olng'ur oisiligie iloo papa lang, nedamu osotua lenye sinyati,
olmumai oinosie papa lang Abraham,
nchere, ore pee eitajeu iyiook, too nkaik oo lmang'ati lang, nikisiaai ninye metiii enkuretisho,
te sinyatisho o te supatisho, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ang.
Ore sii iyie na kerai ai, aikiji oloiboni lo Lotii Shumata Aisul te pooki. Amu inturuk te dukuya Olaitoriani, aitobiraki nkoitoi enyena.
Aliki ltung'ana lenyena enjeunoto, te mpalakinoto oo ng'ok enye,
te nkaraki enanai o lng'ur le Nkai ang, laa te ninye ekenyiki iyiook enjeunoto eing'uaa keper,
eitawang'aki ilootoni te naimin, o lootoni to loip le keeya, pee eutaki nkejek ang inkoitoi osotua.”
Nebulu enkerai, neponari engolon e nkiyang'et, nebik ti ong'ata o metabau enkolong naipang'akinyeki olorere loo Siraeli.
Ore te nena olong'i nepuku enkitanapata naing'uaa olaiguanani kitok Kaisari Augustus inchere pee eikeni iltung'ana pooki te nkitoria oo Roma.
Naa ena enkikena oo ltung'ana e dukuya nataasaki te nkata e Kirinius olgafanai le Siria.
Neshuko ake oltung'ani enkang enye meigeri.
Nelo sii ninye Yosef te Galilaya aing'uaa enkang e Nasaret, ailep alo enkang e Daudi naji Betlehem amu ole nkaji e Daudi apa te ntalipa,
pee eikeni te nebo enkitok enye, Mariamu, natasayia aa entuaa.
Ore ebikito teine, nebaya inkolong'i pee eisho Mariamu.
Neiu enkerai enye kikau, neishopoki nkilani e keraisho, neirragie ninye te mpeut oo nkishu, amu eitu etum enejing te nkaji oo lomon.
Naa ore teina kop netii apa ilchekuti ootoni arrip intare kewarie.
Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani, neimerlelu enkitoo o Laitoriani too nkaloli pooki, neureishoyu ninche oleng.
Nejoki olmalaika ninche, “Emiureishoyu amu ilomon supati le ng'ida sapuk ayau naaku too ltung'ana pooki,
amu ore te nkanasa e Daudi, netoiwuoki Olaitajeunoni, te nkaraki intae, laa ninye Kristo, Olaitoriani.
Naa ele olmonekie te intae: itumutumu elooyo naishopokino nkilani e keraisho, neirragita te mpeut oo nkishu.”
Neboitare ilo malaika, olorora kitok le keper oisisita Enkai aajo,
“Meisisi Enkai te shumata naisul te pooki, netumi osotua te nkop, too ltung'ana pooki laa ninche eshipakino ninye!”
Ore pee epuo lelo malaika keper aaing'uaa ninche, nejokino ilchekuti, “Enyoito emaape aabaya Betlehem, aadol ena bae nataase naitayiolo iyiook Olaitoriani.”
Neisarrisar aapuo neinepu Mariamu o Yosef, nedol eirrag elooyo te mpeut.
Ore pee edol ilchekuti ninye neinosu ninche lomon ootiaakaki te nkaraki ina looyo.
Ore lelo pooki ootoning'o nena naatolimutuo ilchekuti neing'asia.
Kake eiteng'ela Mariamu nena baa pooki edamu to ltau lenye.
Neshuko lelo shekuti eisho Enkai enkitoo neisis too mbaa pooki naatoning'o o naatoduaa anaa enatiaakaki ninche.
Ore pee eaku enkiting'oto e nkolong e isiet, nemurati neji enkarna enye Yesu, ina arna apa natudung'oko olmalaika eton eitu enutaini.
Ore pee ebaya nkolong'i e nkata e nkipooto anaa enatiu too nkitanapat e Musa, neriku ninye Yerusalem pee eitarasakini Olaitoriani,
anaa enatisiraki too nkitanapat o Laitoriani nchere, “Ore pooki lee kikau, neng'amari te dukuya Olaitoriani.”
Nejo sii pee eishooyo olasar anaa enajo nkitanapat o Laitoriani, aa, “Nturkuluoni are, aashu nkera are e nturkuluo.”
Naa ketii apa Yerusalem oltung'ani oji Simeon, naa oltung'ani apa supat nenyor Enkai, neanyita apa meitajeu Enkai Siraeli. Netii Enkiyang'et Sinya tiatua ninye.
Neitayiolo Enkiyang'et Sinyati ninye nchere meye eitu edol Olaitajeunoni oisiligie apa Olaitoriani.
Nelotu enkaji e Nkai, erikito Enkiyang'et Sinyati ninye, ore pee eyaki intoiwuo enkerai Yesu meitaasa anaa entipat oo nkitanapat e Musa,
neng'amu Simeon Yesu too nkaik enyena, neisis Enkai nejo,
“Olaitoriani, inchoo taata osinka lino meshomo te seriani, anaa enisiligie.
Amu etoduaa nkonyek aainei enjeunoto ino
nintobira meibalayu too loreren pooki:
ewang'an naboloki loreren enkoitoi ino, neaku errepet oo Siraeli linono.”
Neing'asia menye o ng'otonye Yesu te nena naairoroki te nkaraki ninye.
Nemayian Simeon ninche nejoki Mariamu, ng'otonye Yesu, “Eitaaki ena kerai olobatatare naa olodumunore sii ilkumok ootii Siraeli. Neaku olmonekie le nkai ogilunoreki,
naa aikiim olalem oltau lino, pee eibalunyeki indamunot oo ltauja kumok.”
Netii enkoiboni naji Ana entito e Fanuel, o losho le Asheri: naa entasat moruo, naa larin oopishana ake etotona eeta olmoruo.
Naa enkoliai oo larin ntomoni isiet o oong'uan. Nemepuku tiatua enkaji e Nkai, neen kewan aitupukoo.
Nelotu ninye teina kata, neisho Enkai enashe, neimaki ina kerai aliki lelo pooki ooanyita metalaku Enkai Yerusalem.
Ore pee eidip intoiwuo e Yesuaaitabai inaaitanapishoteki pooki, too nkitanapat o Laitoriani, nerrinyo aapuo Galilaya, enkang enye te Nasaret.
Nebulu ina kerai negolu, neiput eng'eno nagut, netii enkirotetisho e Nkai shumata ninye.
Kepuo apake ntoiwuo e Yesu Yerusalem to lari ake pooki pee enyiku osirua le Pasaka.
Ore pee eaku Yesu oloo larin tomon o aare neilep aapuo anaa olkuaak le ilo sirua.
Ore pee ebaya nkolong'i naashukore, neing'uari enkayioni Yesu te Yerusalem. Neitu eyiolou intoiwuo enyena.
Kake ore ejo ninche etii ake atua encholiek enye, nepuo endama nalulung'a, neing'oru te lelo lo lgilata lenye, o too le latia enye.
Ore pee elau ninye, neshuko Yerusalem aapuo aaing'oru.
Ore etulusoitie nkolong'i uni, netum te nkaji e Nkai, etonita te rishata ilaiteng'enak, einining'ito neikilikuanishore.
Ore ilootoning'o pooki, neing'asia te ng'eno enye o too naawalu.
Ore pee edol intoiwuo enyena neing'asia. Nejoki ng'otonye, “Na kerai; aainyo pee inkuna iyiook inji? King'orutua iyie, nanu o papaai lino te nkirutoto o to sina.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Kainyoo pee king'oruru? Aimiyiololo aajo keishiaakino tenatii enkaji e Papa?”
Neitu eibung ele rorei otiaaka.
Nedou Yesu airiamunore ninche nebau Nasaret, nening ninye ninche. Neshum ng'otonye nena baa pooki to ltau lenye.
Neponari Yesu eng'eno, nebulu, neitiship Enkai o ltung'ana.

Ore to lari le tomon o miet le nkitoria o laiguanani kitok oji Tiberia Kaisaria, aa Pontio Pilato olgafanai le Yudea, naa Herode olkitok le Galilaya, naa Filipo olalashe lenye olkitok le Iturea o Trikoniti, naa Lisenias olkitok le Abilene,
naa Annas o Kaiafas ilapolosak kituaak. Nebaiki ororei le Nkai Yohana olayioni le Sakaria ti ong'ata.
Nelo ina kop pooki oo mbat o lkeju le Yordan elikioo enkibatisa nayau enkirridunoto neyau empalakinoto oo ng'ok,
anaa enaigero te mbuku e Isaya oloiboni le Nkai ajo, “Oltoilo lo lobuakita ti ong'ata, entobiraki Olaitoriani enkoitoi, entorioi irrekiei lenyena.
Nenuki nong'ot pooki, ore pooki doinyo o lkiushin neitodorropi; ore ineekordilo nererei, ore nkoitoi naasur neisiashayieki;
pee etum iltung'ana pooki enjeunoto e Nkai.”
Nejoki Yohana ilo orere ooetuo enetii ninye meibatisa, “Na ishoi oo lasuriaa! Ae ng'ae naikoo intae eng'atai engoro nalotu?
Entadedeyie naa enkirridunoto inyi too lng'anayio lenyena; nimintokiki ake ajo, ‘Kiata Abraham aa papa lang.’ Ajoki intae, keidim Enkai aitobiraki Abraham nkera te kulo soito.
Eidipaki taata aaiteleiki entolu ntonat oo lkeek; ore olchani ake pooki lemeiu lng'anayio sidain nedung'i aauroo nenang'akini enkima.”
Neikilikuan lelo tung'ana Yohana aajoki, “Kaa naa kiaas?”
Newaliki ajoki, “Ore oloata nkilani are, inchoo eisho nabo ilo lemeeta, ore oloata endaa neng'arie olemeeta.”
Nepuonu sii ninche ilasotok le kodi meibatisai, neikilikuan aajoki, “Lo aiteng'enani, kaa kiaas iyiook?”
Nejoki ninche, “Emintulus aitalak ltung'ana alang ina naitanapaki intae.”
Neikilikuan sii ninche sikarini aajoki, “Oo iyiook, kaa kiaas?” Nejoki ninche, “Emisim oltung'ani anaa inteenikiki elejare, ninchosho sii ebaiki intae olekoisiayio linyi.”
Ore elimana ltung'ana eanyita enaasayu, neitiko ltauja le pooki te nkaraki Yohana, emusumusu aajo ebaiki naa Kristo ninye, ana mme ninye.

Newaliki Yohana ninche pooki ajoki, “Esipa aibatisa nanu intae te nkare, kake kelotu ologol te nanu lemeishiaakino nalak inkeenta oo namuka enyena. Ilo oibatisa intae te Nkiyang'et Sinyati o te nkima.
Neibung'ita ninye esilet enye te nkaina pee eor asip katukul olkurroto lenye oidong'ishoreki, nesotoki enkano olkompe; kake ore suut, nepej te nkima nemearayu ntarasi.”
Ore te kulie oitoi kumok nereiki Yohana aikok olorere eliki lomon supati.
Kake ore Herode ilo balusui pee eisikong ninye Yohana te nkaraki nayama Herodias enkitok o lalashe lenye, o sii te nkaraki kulie bususi naataasa,
neponiki Herode ena nena pooki neikenoo Yohana te jila.
Ore eibatisaki iltung'ana pooki neidipaki aaibatisa sii ninye Yesu, eomonito Enkai nebolo keper,
nedou Enkiyang'et Sinyati etiu anaa enturkuluo adoiki Yesu. Nelotu oltoilo oing'uaa keper ojo, “Ira iyie Oinoti lai lanyor, kaashipakino iyie.”
Ore pee eiteru Yesu enkisiaayiare enye naa oloo larin oobaya tomoni uni. Ore ninye anaa enajo iltung'ana naa olayioni le Yosef, olayioni le Heli,
olayioni le Matat, olayioni le Lawi, olayioni le Melki, olayioni le Yanai, olayioni le Yosef,
olayioni le Matatias, olayioni le Amos, olayioni le Nahum, olayioni le Elsi, olayioni le Nagai,
olayioni le Maat, olayioni le Matatias, olayioni le Semein, olayioni le Yosek, olayioni le Yuda,
olayioni le Yonan, olayioni le Resa, olayioni le Serubabel, olayioni le Shealtiel, olayioni le Neri,
olayioni le Melki, olayioni le Adi, olayioni le Kosam, olayioni le Elmadam, olayioni le Er,
olayioni le Yoshua, olayioni le Eliesa, olayioni le Yorim, olayioni le Matar, olayioni le Lawi,
olayioni le Simeon, olayioni le Yuda, olayioni le Yosef, olayioni le Yonam, olayioni le Eliakim,
olayioni le Melea, olayioni le Mena, olayioni le Matata, olayioni le Natan, olayioni le Daudi,
olayioni le Yese olayioni le Obed, olayioni le Boas, olayioni le Sala, olayioni le Nashon,
olayioni le Aminadab, olayioni le Admin, olayioni le Arni, olayioni le Hesron, olayioni le Peres, olayioni le Yuda,
olayioni le Yakobo, olayioni le Isaak, olayioni le Abraham, olayioni le Tera, olayioni le Nahor, olayioni le Serug,
olayioni le Reu, olayioni le Peleg, olayioni le Eber, olayioni le Shela,
olayioni le Kainan, olayioni le Alfasad, olayioni le Shem, olayioni le Noa, olayioni le Lamek,
olayioni le Metusela, olayioni le Enok, olayioni le Yared, olayioni le Mahalalel, olayioni le Kainan,
olayioni le Enos, olayioni le Seti, olayioni le Adam, olayioni le Nkai.
Neiput Yesu Enkiyang'et Sinyati apa pee errinyunye eing'uaa olkeju le Yordan, Nerik Enkiyang'et ninye ong'ata,
nkolong'i artam, metetema oloirirua. Neitu enya Yesu ae toki te nena olong'i. Ore pee eishunye nena olong'i netir esumash.
Nejoki Sheitani ninye, “Te naa ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai, tiaaki ele soit metaa endaa.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Etisiraki aajo, ‘Mme endaa ake eishuyie oltung'ani.’ ”
Neilepie Sheitani Yesu enchumata o ldoinyo oodo, neitodol enkitoo o pooki e nkop, te nkiti kata,
nejoki Sheitani ninye, “Kaaisho ntoria kuna pooki, o enkitoo enye, amu aaishooki, pee aisho pooki layieu naisho;
metaa te nikiserem iyie nanu neaku ninono pooki.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Etisiraki aajo, ‘Olaitoriani Enkai ino ake iserema, naa ninye ake isiaai.’ ”
Nerik Sheitani Yesu Yerusalem neitasheyie te ntopij e enkaji e Nkai, nejoki, “Te naa ira Enkerai e Nkai, tusulai kewan,
amu etisiraki aajo, ‘ekirriwaki Enkai lmalaika, mikitorripo,’ netejoki sii,
Eking'amaa too nkaik enye, pee mikinkob osoit enkeju ino.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Eigeroki aajo, ‘Mitem iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.’ ”
Ore pee emitunye Sheitani too ntemat enyena pooki nelo aing'uaa eanyu ai rishata enye.
Nerrinyo Yesu Galilaya ebore engolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati, neibulaa enkisisa enye, nkuapi naamanita ilo kerenket.
Neiteng'enisho too nkajijik enye e ntumo nerrep iltung'ana pooki ninye.
Neito Yesu Nasaret ine netubulaka, nejing enkaji e ntumo te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata, anaa enaiko apake, neitashe aisum ilkigerot.
Neishori embuku o loiboni le Nkai Isaya. Nebol ina buku netum ewueji netisiraki aajo,

“Etii Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani atua nanu, amu aatubukoko ninye eilata, aput, naairriwua matoliki ilaisinak ororei supat, nalaku te sinkaisho ilooena, naliki lmodook emboloto oo nkonyek enye, nalaku aisho epuo lelo ooitorogonyaki,
nalimu olari osarunye Enkai ltung'ana lenyena.”
Neiken Yesu embuku, neshukoki olashumani neton. Neibelekenya lelo pooki ootoni te nkaji e ntumo aaing'or ninye.
Neiteru ajoki ninche, “Eitabayioki taata kulo sirat ining'itoto too nkiyiaa inyi.”
Neimaki pooki ninye aarrep eing'asia too rorei le mpiris ooimu enkutuk enye. Nejo, “Ae mme olayioni le Yosef doi ele?”

Nejoki ninye ninche, “Meeta nchere pee eitu kiyiookiki aadung'ie rashe aajoki, ‘Olabaani tabaa kewan,’ nijojo, ‘Taasa sii iyie teine nitubulaka, mbaa naaijo nena nikitoning'o nchere itaasa te Kapernaum.’ ”
Nejo Yesu, “Esipa ajoki intae, meetae oloiboni le Nkai oyanyiti te murua natubulaka.
Esipa nchere keetae apa nkolia kumok tiatua Siraeli te nkata o loiboni Eliya, pee elai enchan too larin okuni o lapaitin ile, neibulu olameyu ina kop pooki;
kake ore eyia, eitu eirriwakini Eliya oltung'ani hoo obo te Siraeli, enkoliai e Sarepta ake eirriwakaki te nkop e Sidon.
Kumok sii iltung'ana le nkeeya oo lbolot ootae te Siraeli te nkata o loiboni le Nkai Elisha, nemeetae hoo likae obo oishiunyeki, leme Naaman ake le Siria.”
Ore pee ening iltung'ana nena baa pooki etoni tiatua enkaji e ntumo neiput engoro.
Neinyototo, nearaa Yesu auluo eina anasa neriku embata e marti nataaniki ina anasa, ejo pee esulaa teina marti;
kake etapaashare Yesu apolos atua lelo tung'ana nelo ninye.
Nedoyio Yesu alo Kapernaum, enkanasa natii Galilaya, neiteng'en iltung'ana te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata naji Pasaka.
Neing'asia iltung'ana te nkiteng'enare enye, amu keiro anaa oloata enkitoria.
Netii atua ina aji e ntumo oltung'ani oata oloirirua oiduruk. Nebuak aishir to ltoilo sapuk ejo,
“Ooi Yesu le Nasaret, ainyoo iatakinore iyiook? Iewuo aidaikie iyiook? Kaayiolo ajo ira ng'ae: ira ilo obo Sinyati le Nkai.”
Neisikong Yesu ilo oirirua nejoki, “Tigirayu! Tupuku tung'uai ninye.” Nebatat ilo oirirua torrono ilo tung'ani te dukuya ninye nepuku aing'uaa meeta enaitaasa ninye.
Neing'asia iltung'ana pooki nejokino, “Kaa kiroroto ena nairo ele tung'ani? Aaku kearaa te nkitoria o te ngolon iloiriruani ooiduruk, nepuku ninche.”
Neibulu enkisisa e Yesu pooki wueji te nena murua naamanita.
Ore pee eing'uaa Yesu enkaji e ntumo nejing enkaji e Simon. Neitirrishaka olkirobi enkaputani e Simon, neomoni Yesu meishiunye.
Neitashe arumaki ninye kop nearaa ilo kirobi, neishiu olkirobi. Neinyototo nabo kata aisiaai ninche.
Ore edoyio enkolong, neyau lelo pooki ooata ltamuoyia loo mpukunot kumok aayaki Yesu meishiunye. Neiteleiki ake pooki tung'ani nkaik neishiunye ninche.
Nepuku sii iloiriruani ooiduruk kumok, aaing'uaa iltung'ana ebuaaya aajo, “Ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai.” Neing'ode amitiki eiro, amu keyiolo ninche aajo Kristo ninye.
Ore pee ekenyu nelo Yesu ewueji neliyio; kake eing'orutua olorere ninye. Nepuonu enetii, nejo maiboo neing'uaa ninche;
kake etiaaka ninche, “Kalo ake pee aliki sii ninche kulie ang'itie kulo omon supati le nkitoria e Nkai. Ina pee aairriwuaki.”
Nelikioo lelo omon too nkajijik e ntumo e Yudea.
Ore eiding'akino ltung'ana aaman Yesu einining'u lomon le Nkai, neitashe ninye te mbata e naiposha e Genesaret.
Nedol impeuti are eirrag te mbata e naiposha. Etupukutuo larreshok loo sinkir aapuo aaisuj irresheta lenye.
Nejing Yesu atua empeut nabo, naa ene Simon nejoki meturrumoi peno aitalam enkop natoyio. Neton aiteng'en olorere etonita ninye tiatua empeut.
Ore pee eidip airoro nejoki Simon, “Terewa enegut nintadoikiki irresheta linyi enaiposha aaibung isinkir.”
Nejoki Simon, “Lo Kitok, kitaasishote enkewarie nalulung'a neitu kitum toki, kake ore amu itejo, kaitadoyio irresheta.”
Ore pee eiko nejia neibung olkito turrur loo sinkir omeiteru aang'era resheta lenye.
Neyuku ile ncholiek enye ootii enkae peut meetu aaret. Nepuonu, neiput impeuti pokira are, ometaa keimis.
Ore pee edol Simon Petero ina nebatata too nkejek e Yesu, nejoki, “Olaitoriani, tung'uayioki nanu amu, kara oltung'ani loo ng'ok.”
Amu eing'asie ninye o lelo ooboitare, te nkumoi oo sinkir ooibung'a;
eing'asiate sii ninche layiok le Sebedayo, aa Yakobo o Yohana, oora le ncholiek e Simon, Nejoki Yesu Simon, “Miureishoyu; ore ebaiki taata, iltung'ana intorioo aibung.”
Nereu mpeuti enkop natoyio, neing'uaa pooki toki nesuj Yesu.
Ore etii Yesu ae ang, netii oltung'ani oata enkeeya oo lbolot, ore pee edol ninye Yesu, nebatata te nkomom, neserem ajoki, “Olaitoriani, te niyieu eikindim aishiunye naishiu.”
Neitorioo Yesu enkaina enye neiseyie nejoki, “Ekayieu, inchiu tisikayu.” Neishiu asika nabo kata ina keeya oo lbolot.
Neitanap Yesu ninye pee meliki likae tung'ani; nejoki, “Kake shomo, intoduaai kewan mikitisipu olapolosani ninchooyo olasar le nkishiunoto naitanapishe Musa pee eitadedeyie ina sikata ino te ninche.”
Kake etoponari lomon le Yesu aaibulu enkop pooki, nepuonu iltung'ana kumok enetii aainining neishiunye imuoyiaritin enye pooki.
Kake kekepari ake nelo ong'ata, aomon Enkai openy.
Ore nabo olong eiteng'enisho Yesu, netii ine Ilfarisayo o laigerok ooing'uaa nkang'itie pooki e Galilaya, o Yudea o Yerusalem. Netii engolon e Nkai atua Yesu pee etum aishiunye olorere.
Nepuonu ina kata ltung'ana oonapita te rruat, oltung'ani maima, netem aajo mayaki Yesu tiatua aji.
Ore te nkaraki enkiding'a o lorere nelaikino aayaki. Nedumu aailepakinye shumata enkaji, nebol aaitayu elusie, neitadou te rruat aaitadoiki nkejek e Yesu te mpolos o lorere.
Ore pee edol Yesu enkirukoto naata ninche, nejoki ilo tung'ani, “Olchore, kitapalakaki ng'ok inono.”
Neiteru ilaigerok o Lfarisayo aaishankarra ejo, “Ae ng'ae ele oiro amor Enkai? Aimme Enkai ake naidim atapalaki oltung'ani ing'ok?”
Nedol Yesu eishankarra newaliki ajoki, “Kainyoo pee inchankarrarra maate?
Kaa nalelek, te najo, ‘Kitapalakaki ng'ok inono,’ ana te najo, ‘Inyo shomo?’
Kake ore pee iyiolouu aajo keeta Enkerai e Tung'ani enkitoria te nkop napalakinye ng'ok,” nejoki ilo tung'ani maima, “Aajoki inyo tudumu erruat ino shomo ang.”
Neinyototo nabo kata ilo tung'ani te dukuya ninche, nedumu enaduoo rruat napetita, nelo ang eisisita Enkai.
Neing'asia pooki neisis Enkai, neureishoyu, nejo, “Kitoduaa ake taata mbaa e nking'asia!”
Ore pee eidipayu nena nelo Yesu, nedol oltung'ani osotu kodi oji Lawi, eton te wueji nesotunye kodi; nejoki, “Tusujuaki nanu.”
Neing'uaa Lawi pooki toki, neinyototo asuj Yesu.
Neitoomon Lawi Yesu to sirua kitok netii iltung'ana kumok oo loosotu kodi o kulikae ake oodaa te nebo ninche.
Neing'unyung'unyaki Lfarisayo o laigerok lkipaareta lenyena aajo, Kainyoo pee ing'arierie endaa niokishosho te nebo iloosotu kodi o laing'okok?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Meyieu iltung'ana biyot olabaani, iloomuoi ooyieu.
Eitu alotu aipot lelo supati kake ilaing'okok aeuo aipot meetu aairridu.”
Nejoki iltung'ana Yesu, “Anaaijo keen ate aaitupukoo oshi lkipaareta le Yohana neomon Enkai naleng sii, naa nejia eiko lkipaareta loo Lfarisayo, nedaa ninche linono neokisho?”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Indimidimi aaitupukoi ilomon lo loyamisho eton eboitare oloyamisho?
Kake keyooki aapuonu nkolong'i naayae oloyamisho aaitung'uaa, nepukoo taa ninche te nena olong'i.”
Neitoki Yesu aliki ena kitanyaanyukoto nejoki, “Meetae oltung'ani oboru erashe to lkila ng'ejuk aripaki olkila musana, pee meinyal ilo ng'ejuk elde musana.
Meetae sii olobukoki enaisho oo sabibu ng'ejuk ilbenia musan pee medany ina aisho oo sabibu lelo benia musan, neibukori enaisho neidaaya ilbenia.
Kake ilbenia ng'ejuko epiki enaisho ng'ejuk.
Meetae sii oltung'ani otooko enaisho nao oitoki ayieu enajon, amu kejo, ‘Enao esidai.’ ”
Neaku ore te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng naji Sabato, neim Yesu atua nkurman e nkano. Negilu lkipaareta lenyena lukuny e nkano nepupu too nkaik aanya lanterera.
Nejoki embata oo Lfarisayo, “Kaji etiu pee iasiasa enemeishoruno too nkitanapat ang te nkolong e Sabato?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Keitu ai kata isumusumu enataasa Daudi o looisiritore pee etir esumash?
Eneikuna pee ejing enkaji e Nkai, neitayu emukate nasinya, nenya, neng'arie sii lelo ooisiritore. Neibala nchere meishoruno too nkitanapat meinosa likae tung'ani ina mukate leme lapolosak?”
Neitoki Yesu ajoki, “Olkitok le nkolong e Sabato doi Enkerai e Tung'ani.”
Ore ti ae olong e Sabato nejing Yesu enkaji e ntumo aiteng'enisho. Netii oltung'ani ine oikaoele enkaina e tatene.
Neing'oru ake kulikae aigerok o Lfarisayo embae naitang'orie Yesu aajo eitarruoyie; nejur pee edol te naa keeta oltung'ani oishiunye te nkolong e Sabato.
Kake etayiolo Yesu ndamunot enye nejoki ilo tung'ani oikaoele enkaina, “Inyo wou dukuya tene.” Neinyototo ilo tung'ani neitashe teine.
Nejoki taa Yesu ninche, “Aikilikuan intae ena? Kaa naishoruno too nkitanapat mataas te nkolong e Sabato? Keishoruno mataar ana mataret?”
Nekurraki pooki inkonyek aing'or, neitoki ajoki ilo tung'ani, “Intorioi enkaina ino!” Neiko nejia, neishiu enkaina enye.
Kake eiputa ninche engoro sapuk neiguana maate eing'oru enaitaas Yesu.
Ore te nena olong'i, neilep Yesu alo oldoinyo aomon, neton enkewarie pooki eomonito Enkai.
Ore pee ekenyu neipot lkipaareta lenyena negelu tomon o aare tiatua ninche nejo ninche lkipaareta.
Naa Simon eipoto ajo Petero o Anterea olalashe lenye; o Yakobo o Yohana, o Filipo o Bartolomayo;
Matayo o Tomas, Yakobo ole Alfayo o Simon oji olkirowuai;
Yudas olayioni le Yakobo o Yudas Iskariot laa ninye otakaldayie Yesu.
Ore pee edou Yesu oo lkipaareta lenyena to ldoinyo nepuonu enkisiashata. Netii ine lkipaareta lenyena kumok o siamon naaing'uaa Yudea o Yerusalem o lomanaa le Tiro o Sidon;
laa ninye eetuo aainining nejo sii pee eishiunye imuoyiaritin enye. Ore lelo ooitanyamalita loiriruani ooiduruk, neishiunye.
Netem pooki ng'ae teina siamo aiseyie ninye amu, kepuku engolon tiatua ninye neishiunye pooki.
Neraposhu Yesu nkonyek aing'or lkipaareta lenyena nejo, “Imayianana intae ilaisinak amu eninyi enkitoria e Nkai.
“Imayianana ilooata taata esumash; amu keitaraposhi intae. “Imayianana ilooishir taata amu iyiookiki aakueni.
“Imayianana te neibayu intae iltung'ana, nekepaa intae nemor, nemit eipoti nkarn inyi ejo ntorrok, te nkaraki Enkerai e Tung'ani.
Ore ina olong entishipata niranyiranya aaipidipid te ng'ida, amu kesipa ai kitok enkishorunoto naishori intae te Keper; amu ina apa eitaasa iloo papaai linyi iloibonok li apa.
“Kake ee ekake ayia intae ilkarsisi taata; indipa intae aanoto olkar linyi.
“Ee kake ayia intae ilooraposho taata; keyooki atir intae esumash. “Woi ake intae ilookueni taata; iyiookiki ake aaishir.
“Ee kake ayia te neimaki intae ltung'ana aaisis; nejia taa apake eikuna iloo papaai linyi aaisis iloibonok le lejare.
“Kake ajoki intae kulo laaning'ito,
entonyor ilmang'ati linyi; entaasa isupati ilooiba intae; entamayian ilo odek intae; ore iloosukeny intae neinyial, entoomonoki.
Ore pee kiosh oltung'ani eseder nyaaki inchoo sii enkae; ore pee eya oltung'ani olkila lino; inchoo sii enchati meewa.
Inchoo pooki likiomon; ore pee eya oltung'ani enino, mimpotu aoru.
Intaasa ilkulikae tung'ana anaa eniyieu nikintaas ninche iyie.
“Amaa te naa iloonyor intae ake inyorrinyorro, kaji eret ina te intae? Kenyor sii ninche larruok iloonyor ninche.
Amaa sii te naa lelo ake ooitaas intae isupati intaasiasa sii intae, kaji eret ina te intae? Nejia eiko sii ninche ilarruok.
Naa amaa te naa pooki ake olisilen naa elde ake liyiolo ajo kilaaki, ainyoo eret ina te iyie? Keisilenokino sii ninche ilarruok eyiolo aajo kelaakini aaiputaki.

Kake ore intae, entonyor ilmang'ati linyi niaasiasa isupati; enchooi te sile misiligugu toki naitu; naa itumutumu enkishorunoto kitok; niaakuku nkera o lotii Shumata Aisul te pooki, amu ore ninye keing'urrie ilarruok o lemeeta enashe.
Enoto olng'ur anaa Papa linyi oata olng'ur.
“Minguanare pee mikinguanareki; minor pee mikinorri, entapalaki pee epalakini intae.

Enchooi pee eishori intae; aaisho emborei sidai narujakino, neiposhakino, o metadooi nepiki ilbenia too lgooitie linyi; amu ore ake ina nitemakinyenye lkulikae naa ninye ake etemakinyeki sii ninche intae.”
Neitoki Yesu aisho ninche enkitanyaanyukoto, nejo, “Keidim olmodooni atoriko likae modooni? Aimesulakino pokira aare engumoto?
Megiroo oloiteng'eni oloiteng'en; kake ore eidipaki aaiteng'ena netiu anaa oloiteng'ena ninye.
Kainyoo pee idol entubuloi natii enkong'u o lalashe lino, nimidol olchata otii enkong'u ino makewan?

Kaji nko pee ijoki olalashe lino, ‘Olalashe lai, ntasho maaitayu entubuloi nikitii enkong'u ino makewan,’ eji nimidol olchata likitii enkong'u ino makewan? Lo sunkuroi, tang'asa intayu ilo shata likitii enkong'u ino pee itum taa atodolisho, nintayu entubuloi natii enkong'u o lalashe lino.
“Meetae olchani sidai oiu ilng'anayio torrok, aashu olchani torrono oiu ilng'anayio sidain;
amu eyiolouni ake olchani too lng'anayio lenyena. Amu metumieki olaimurunyai ilng'abolo, nemetumieki isabibu intulele.

Keitayu oltung'ani supat isupati naaitung'uaa olchumati supat otii oltau lenye, neitayu oltung'ani torrono ntorrok naaitung'uaa olchumati torrono otii oltau lenye, amu inaabore oltau lo ltung'ani eiro oltung'ani te nkutuk enye.
“Kainyoo pee kijojo, ‘Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani,’ nimiaasiasa enajoki intae?
Kaliki intae enetiu ololotu enatii nening enajoki, neas nena natejo.

Etiu ninye anaa oltung'ani oshet enkaji, neng'as atur enkop aitugut, neunoki osoit olkitamanyunoto. Ore pee enang'unye enkare nenang'akino ina aji, kake nelaikino aigusugusie amu enotokoki olkitamanyunoto.

Kake ore ilo oning nemeas ae, etiu anaa oltung'ani otesheta enkaji eitu eng'as apik olkitamanyunoto. Ore pee enang'unye enkare neipony te ngolon enaduoo aji, neurori nabo kata, neme euroroto sii iyie ina natuurori enaduoo aji.”
Ore pee eidip Yesu atoliki nena baa pooki, nejing Kapernaum.
Nemuoi naleng osinka kirotet lo sajini kitok loo Roma, etaa keye.
Ore pee ening ilo kitok eimakini Yesu, neirriwaki lpayiani loo Lyahudi meeu ninye aishiunye ilo sinka lenye.
Ore pee epuonu ninche enetii Yesu, neitirrishaki aasai aajoki, “Keishiaakino nintaas ninye ena:
amu kenyor olorere lang, neteshetaka ninye iyiook enkaji e ntumo.”
Neiriamariyie Yesu ninche. Ore etataanikia enkaji enye, neirriwaki ilo kitok loo sikarini ilchoreta lenyena ajoki, “Olaitoriani, mintanyamal kewan, amu maaishiaakino nanu te nijing'u enkaji ai;
nemajo kara hoo ng'ae likilotu anang'are: kake olomoni obo doi ake tejo neishiu osinka lai.
Amu ara sii nanu oltung'ani otii enkitoria, naaitorei, naata sii nanu sikarini laitore. Naitore ele ajoki, ‘Shomo!’ Nelo; najoki elde ‘Wou!’ Nelotu; naitore osinka lai ajoki, ‘Taasa ena!’ Neas.”
Ore pee ening Yesu nena, neing'asia te nkaraki ninye. Neibelekenya, nejoki lelo tung'ana oosujita, “Ajoki intae, eitu ai kata atum enkirukoto kitok naba nji tiatua Siraeli, eitu atum.”
Nejo matorrinyoto aji iladuoo ooirriwuaki eishiwuo oladuoo sinka omuoi.
Ore te nkiti kata nelo Yesu enkanasa naji Nain; neiriamariyie ninye lkipaareta lenyena o lorora kitok.
Ore etii auluo etinyikaka kishomi e ina anasa, nedol enapitai olmeneng'ani aaya, naa ilo otua ake eeta ng'otonye, naa enkoliai; nerubare ltung'ana kumok le ina anasa.
Ore pee edol Olaitoriani ninye neing'urrie nejoki, “Minchir.”
Nenyikaki Yesu neiseyie osanduku neitashe lewa oonapita. Nejoki Yesu, “Lo barnoti! Inyo!”
Neinyototo ilo duoo otua aton, neiteru airo. Neisho Yesu ng'otonye.
Neureishoyu ninche pooki; neisis Enkai nejo, “Einyo oloiboni kitok le Nkai tiatua iyiook,” nejo sii, “Eewuo Enkai abaiki iltung'ana lenyena.”
Neibulu enkisisa e ina nataasa Yesu Yudea pooki, o ina kop namanita.
Neliki lkipaareta le Yohana, Yohana nena baa pooki naasita Yesu.
Neipot Yohana aare le lelo kipaareta lenyena neirriwaki Yesu meikilikuana aajoki, “Aa iyie doi apa olotu? Anaa ai likae kiaanyu?”
Ore pee epuonu lelo tung'ana enetii Yesu nejoki, “Yohana Olaibatisani oirriwua iyiook enitii ejo, ‘Aa iyie doi apa olotu anaa ai kianyu likae?’ ”
Ore teina kata ake neishiunye Yesu iltung'ana ooata nkeyaitin o muoyiaritin kumok, nearaa nkiyang'eta torrok. Ore ilmodook kumok nebol inkonyek nedolishoyu.

Newaliki Yesu ninche nejoki, “Enchom entoliki Yohana kuna nitoduaa o nitoning'o; etodolishote ilmodook, nepuo lmaiman, neishiunyeki aasik ilooata enkeeya oo lbolot, nening'ishoyu lming'anta, neitopiuni ilootuata, nelikini laisinak ororei supat.
Emayiana ilo tung'ani lemetum olkob te nanu.”
Ore eidipa aashom ilkipaareta le Yohana neiteru Yesu ainosaa Yohana to lorere nejo, “Kainyoo nawa intae enchom entodol ti ong'ata? Kolperesi oyuk enkijape?
Mme ninye? Kainyoo naa ishomo intae aadol? Ko ltung'ani oishopito nkilani naapuyiapui o naaitintil? Nkang'itie oo laiguanak etumieki lelo ooishop nkilani naapuyiapui o ne nkuso.
Kake kainyoo doi ishomo aadol? Koloiboni le Nkai? Ee pae naa kelang ninye oloiboni le Nkai.
Ninye doi eimakita lkigerot aajo, ‘Nele olkipaaret lai laiturukie te iyie, olaa ninye likintobiraki enkoitoi ino.’
Ajoki intae, kitok Yohana alang pooki tung'ani oiu enkitok kake ore eyia, ore olobayie te nkitoria e Nkai naa kitok alang ninye.”
Ore pee ening iltung'ana pooki o loosotu kodi neitadedeyie Enkai amu eibatisaki te nkibatisare e Yohana.
Kake etanyaita ninche Lfarisayo o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat enayiewuaki Enkai amu etanyaita ninche maate eibatisa Yohana.
Nejo Yesu, “Kainyoo atemaki kulo tung'ana le kuna olong'i? Kainyoo enyaanyukie?
Kenyaanyukie nkera naatoni te nemirishoreki, naaipotuno ejo, ‘Kitooshokito intae ndulen, neitu iranyishosho; nikinchirakita intae, neitu nchirishiri.’
Amu eewuo Yohana Olaibatisani neitupukoo kewan, nemeok enaisho oo sabibu; nijojo intae, ‘Keeta oloirirua.’
Eewuo Enkerai e Tung'ani nedaa neokisho; nijojo, ‘Eng'ura oltung'ani oulu, naa olamerani, naa olchore loo loosotu kodi o laing'okok!’
Ore naa eng'eno e Nkai, neitadedeyie pooki oora inkera enyena.”
Neipot oltung'ani obo loo Lfarisayo Yesu pee eitoomon te nkaji enye. Nejing Yesuenkaji e ilo Farisayoi neton anya endaa.
Netii enkitok ina anasa, naa enkaasani oo ng'ok. Ore pee eyiolou ajo einosita Yesu endaa te nkaji e ilo Farisayoi, neyau oltulet lo soit oji alabasta le ilata narropil,
neitashe te siadi ninye too nkejek, e Yesu, neiteru aituku nkejek enyena too lkiyio, nejut too lpapit le endukuya enye, neng'utut nkejek enyena, neelie ina ilata.
Ore pee edol ilo Farisayoi oitoomono Yesu nejo to ltau, “Te naa koloiboni le Nkai ele tung'ani anaata etayiolo ajo aing'ae anaa kaa pukunoto e nkitok ena naibung ninye!”
Neirorie Yesu nejoki, “Simon, kaata embae naaliki.” Nejoki, “Ee Olaiteng'enani.”
Neliki Yesu ena kitanyanyukoto, “Eisilenoko oltung'ani iltung'ana aare indinari enyena, neisho obo indinari iip imiet, neisho olikae onom.
Ore pee elau pokira aare entoki nalakie, nepalaki pokira aare. Amaa te pokira aare, kalo onyorru ninye oleng?”
Newaliki Simon ajoki, “Amen ajo, elde otapalakaki nkumok.” Nejoki Yesu, “Itisipa ewalata.”
Neibelekenyakino Yesu enkitok, nejoki Simon, “Idol ena kitok? Aewuo enkaji ino neitu kincho enkare oo nkejek; kake aaitashala ena kitok inkejek aainei too lkiyio nejut too lpapit lenyena.
Eitu king'utut; ore ninye, anaa duoo pee ajing'u eitu aapal maang'utut inkejek aainei.
Eitu kiel endukuya te ilata, kake aaela ninye nkejek te na ilata.
Aajoki naa te nkaraki ina, etapalakaki ng'ok enyena, aa kumok, amu etonyorrishe oleng, amu ore doi olopalakini nkuti naa kiti enyorrata enye.”
Nejoki Yesu ina kitok, “Kitapalakaki ing'ok inono.”
Ore lelo ootoni aadaa te nebo ninye neiteru aajo maate, “Ai ng'ae ele eji opalaki oltung'ani ng'ok?”
Nejoki ina kitok, “Kintajewuo enkirukoto ino; shomo te seriani!”
Neaku ore pee eidipayu nena, nemanaa Yesu too nkanas sapuki o nkutiti elikioo ilo rorei neyaki lomon supati le nkitoria e Nkai. Neiriamariyie ninye lkipaareta lenyena tomon o aare,
o nkituaak naaishiunyeki nkiyang'eta torrok o nkeyaitin: Mariamu Magdalena, nataarayioki loiriruani oopishana metung'uai,
o enkitok e Kusa osinka le Herode naji Yoana o Susana o kulie kumok naaitoomono ninche Yesu o lkipaareta too masaa enye.
Ore pee etumo ltung'ana kumok aaiturrurro, nesotokino lelo le nena ang'itie pooki, neiro Yesu alimu ena kitanyaanyukoto.
“Etupukuo olaunoni alo aun ilanterera lenyena; ore eunisho, nedoiki kulikae embata e nkoitoi, neitunyori too nkejek, nenya motonyi e shumata.
Nedoiki kulikae enkop o soit, nejo matubulu, netoyu amu meeta enkare naok.
Nedoiki kulikae atua lkiku, neiriamunore lkiku, negor ninche.
Nedoiki kulikae enkop sidai, nebulu, neiu ilng'anayio iip nabore.” Ore ejoito Yesu nejia nebuak ajo, “Oloata nkiyiaa, toning'o!”
Neikilikuan lkipaareta lenyena ninye enalimu ena kitanyaanyukoto.
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Eishooki intae entayiolo nkisudorot e nkitoria e Nkai; kake keishori ilkulikae too nkitanyaanyukot pee eing'or nemedol, nening ninche nemejing'aa”.
“Naa inji eikununo ina kitanyaanyukoto. Ore ilanterera naa ninche ororei le Nkai.
Ore lelo ootadoikitio embata e nkoitoi naa lelo ooning ororei; nelotu Sheitani aitayu too ltauja lenye arishie pee meiruk neitajeuni.
Ore ilanterera ootadoikitio enkop o soit naa lelo ooning ororei neng'amu te ng'ida. Kake eitu ejing'aa atua ninche; neiruk te nkiti kata ake, ore pee epuonu ntemat nebatata aaitiak.
Ore lelo ootadoikitio atua lkiku naa lelo ooning, kake nepuo neitirrishaki enyamali oo masaa o esikar ena kishon nemeitabaya aaiu ilng'anayio.
Ore ilanterera ootadoikitio enkulupuoni sidai naa lelo ooning ele rorei, neibung aakuraki too ltauja lenye neiu ilng'anayio.
“Meetae oltung'ani oinok oltaa neitoki aitoip to ltoo anaa epik orunku le rruat, kake kepik enerupa neitasheyie pee edol iloojing ewang'an.
Amu meetae entoki naisudoro, nemeibalunyeki; nemeetae enoo nkurrat nemeibalunyeki te wang'an.
Enteng'enuoto too mbaa nining'ining'i amu ore oloata, naa keishori, ore olemeeta neoruni ina najo ninye keeta.”
Nelotu ng'otonye Yesu o lalashera lenyena nelaikino aatabaiki ninye te nkiding'a o lorere.
Neyakini olkilikuai aajoki, “Etii ng'utunyi o lalashera linono boo, eitashe, kiyieu nikitumore.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ore yieyio o lalashera laainei naa, lelo ooning ororei le Nkai neibung.”
Ore nabo olong; nejing Yesu empeut o lkipaareta lenyena; nejoki ninche, “Ematalang aapuo lido kekun le naiposha,” nedumunye aapuo.
Ore epuoito neirura Yesu. Nedumunye olkutati te naiposha, neaku keiput empeut enkare, nejing bata.
Nepuo loiteng'eni aainyeyie ninye ajoki, “Lo Kitok! Lo Kitok! Kindaaitie!” Neinyototo neisikong osiwuo o enkilugo e nkare; negira, nelotu enkitirring'a.
Nejoki ninche, “Koree enkirukoto inyi?” Neureishoyu lkipaareta lenyena, neing'asia, nejokino maate, “Kaing'ae taa ele laa keitore osiwuo o enkare, nening?”
Nebaya ninche lido kekun loo Lgeraseni, oipirare Galilaya.
Ore pee edoiki Yesu enkop natoyio nenang'are oltung'ani obo leina anasa oata iloiriruani; oshomo nkolong'i kumok meishopo, nemejing ang, too nkuraren eton.
Ore pee edol Yesu, nebuak, nebatata te dukuya ninye, nejo to ltoilo sapuk, “Kainyoo aatayie nanu iyie Yesu, Enkerai e Nkai Natii Shumata Aisul te pooki? Aatasayia mikisilisil.”

Amu ketaarayie Yesu ilo oirirua torrono otii ilo tung'ani metupuku. (Amu eibung'a nkolong'i kumok, neteenaki aarrip, nerridi too sekenke naairoishi o too lpisia; ore pee eitirrie pooki nearaa oloirirua ninye ong'ata.)
Neikilikuan Yesu ajoki, “Aikiji ng'ae?” Nejo, “Kaaji, Empuoto;” amu iloiriruani kumok ootijing'a.
Nesai iloiriruani Yesu pee mearaa ninche meshomo olodo le nkop.
Netii ine emboo oo lbitiro, nadaa to losho; nesai meishoo pee epuo aajing lelo bitiro. Neisho meshomo.
Nepuku lelo oiriruani te ilo tung'ani, nejing ilbitiro; nekuet ina luaata oo lbitiro to loshong'ishong'i neimis te naiposha neya enkare.
Ore pee edol lchekuti le lelo bitiro inaatotiwuo, neisik aapuo aalikioo teina anasa o teina kop.

Nepuku iltung'ana aapuo aadol enatotiwuo. Nepuonu enetii Yesu, neinepu ilo tung'ani otaarayioki loiriruani etonita, neishopo, nenyakua oltau lenye biyoto, etonita too nkejek e Yesu; neureishoyu ninche.
Nelikioo lelo apa ootoduakita ilo tung'ani earari loiriruani metaa biyoto, enaikuna pee eishiunyeki.
Ore lelo tung'ana pooki le nkop oo Lgeraseni o neemanita, nesai Yesu metung'uai ninche amu etureishote oleng. Nejing ninye empeut ashuko.
Nesai oladuoo oishiunyeki Yesu meturubare, kake eitanapa Yesu ajoki,
“Tushukoyu enkang inyi, imbalakinye enaba ina nikintaasa Enkai.” Nelo aing'uaa, einosaa teina anasa pooki nena e nking'asia naaitaasa Yesu ninye.
Ore pee eitu Yesu, neitoomon olorere te nchipai amu keanyita apa ake pooki.
Nelotu oltung'ani oji Yairo naa olkitok le nkaji e ntumo; nebatata too nkejek e Yesu nesai meshomo enkaji enye,
amu entito nabo ake eeta, oo larin tomon o aare, neirrag etaa keye. Kake ore ejo Yesu alo neiding'akino olorere.
Netii enkitok naturuke osarge larin tomon o aare; netumuta masaa enyena kumok too labaak, neitu eishiunye hoo obo.
Neimu te siadi Yesu, neiseyie olcholoi lo lkila lenye negem nabo kata osarge.
Nejo Yesu, “Ae ng'ae naatoshoroyie?” Neitolilo olorere, nejoki Petero, “Lo Kitok, kironyita olorere likinturrurrokinote!”
Kake etiaaka Yesu, “Etii oltung'ani laatoshoroyie, amu atayiolo ajo etii engolon natupukuo te nanu.”
Neisho ina kitok, pee edol ajo meekure eidim aisudori, nekuetu eikirikira, nebatata te dukuya Yesu, neibalakinye mbaa pooki te dukuya olorere, ajo ainyoo pee etaasa ina, o eneikuna pee eishiwuo.
Nejoki Yesu ina kitok, “Naito, kinchiunye enkirukoto ino. Shomo te seriani.”
Ore ejo nejia, nelotu oltung'ani oing'uaa enkaji e ilo kitok le nkaji e ntumo, nejoki, “Etua entito ino; mintoki aintanyamal olaiteng'enani.”
Ore pee ening Yesu ina, newaliki Yairo ajoki, “Miureishoyu: iruko ake iyie, naa keitaae biyoto.”
Ore pee ebaya ina aji, neitu eisho Yesu likae tung'ani ejing'u, Petero ake o Yohana o Yakobo, o menye o ng'otonye ina kerai.
Ore aa kitok olkiyioi loo ltung'ana, nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eminchir amu eitu eye, keirura.”
Nekueniyieki oleng, amu keyiolo aajo eidipa atua.
Kake ore ninye, neibung, neipot ajoki, “Nakerai, inyo!”
Neshukokino ninye enkiyang'et enye, neinyototo nabo kata, neitanapisho meishori endaa.
Neing'asia ntoiwuo e ina kerai kake eitanapa Yesu pee meliki hoo oltung'ani enataase.
Neipot Yesu lkipaareta lenyena tomon o aare, neisho engolon o enkidimata naitoreyie iloiriruani pooki, neishiunye imuoyiaritin.
Neirriwaa metolikioi enkitoria e Nkai, neishiunye iloomuoyiaa.
Nejoki ninche, “Emiya hoo toki te lototo inyi, aa eng'udi, aashu embene, aashu endaa, aashu impisai, nimiyaya nkilani maa are.
Ore enkaji pooki nijing'ijing'i, entotoni teine o entupuku teina ang.
Ore ilemeitoomon intae, entung'uai ina ang nimpiripiroo enterit natii nkejek inyi metaa shakeni te ninche.”
Nepuo aamanaa te nena ang'itie, pooki elikioo lomon supati, neishiunye iltamuoyia too wuejitin pooki.
Ore Herode laa ninye oitore Galilaya, pee ening nena pooki naasitae; neiputukuny amu etejo kulikae tung'ana, “Yohana otopiwuo too lootuata.”
Nejo kulikae, “Eliya oipang'ua.” Nejo kulikae, “Obo loo loibonok li apa otopiwuo.”
Nejo Herode, “Atudung'oyie taa ninye Yohana elukunya, ae ng'ae naa ele laning mbaa enyena?” Neing'oru eyieu nedol ninye.
Ore pee eshukunye ilkipaareta, neinosaki Yesu mbaa pooki naataasa. Nerik nepuo enkilepata, o metoriko enkanasa naji Betsaida.
Ore pee eyiolou olorora, nesujaa. Neitoomon neirorie aliki ninche mbaa e nkitoria e Nkai, neishiunye ilooyieu neishiunyeki.
Ore pee eaku kedoiyo enkolong, nepuonu lkipaareta lenyena enetii nejoki, “Intanapa olorere meshomo kuna kurman o nkang'itie naataana aairrag neing'oru endaa amu ong'ata ene nikitii.”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Enchoo doi intae endaa.” Nejoki ninche, “Mikiaata ae toki neme mukateni miet o sinkir aare, aashu te naa aikipuo aainyang'aki ele orere pooki endaa.”
Amu kebaya lewa ootii, nkalifuni miet. Nejoki Yesu lkipaareta lenyena, “Entotona olorere too intukusi maa onom.”
Neas ina, neitoton iltung'ana pooki.
Nedumu Yesu imukateni pokira miet, o sinkir are, neing'or shumata nemayian nebel, neisho lkipaareta lenyena meishoo olorere.
Nenya, neraposho pooki. Nesotuni lmong'oishi, neiput inkikapuni tomon o aare.
Ore eomonito Yesu openy, netii lkipaareta lenyena, neikilikuan ajoki, “Kejo olorere kara nanu ng'ae?”
Newaliki aajoki, “Ejo Yohana Olaibatisani, nejo kulikae, Eliya; nejo kulikae ira obo loo loibonok li apa otopiwuo.”
Nejoki, “Nijojo intae kara ng'ae?” Nejoki Petero, “Iyie Kristo le Nkai.”
Neitanap Yesu lkipaareta lenyena neitanap pee meliki hoo oltung'ani ilo rorei.
Nejoki, “Meeta nchere pee meinyali Enkerai e Tung'ani too mbaa kumok, neany ilpayiani o lapolosak kituaak o lasirak neari metua, neitopiuni te nkolong e uni.”
Nejoki ninche pooki, “Te neyieu oltung'ani naasuj nanu, inchoo emenaa kewan, nenap osalaba lenye inkolong'i pooki, naasuj.
Amu ore oloyieu neitajeu enkishui enye, neiminie; kake ore pooki oiturraa enkishui enye te nkaraki nanu neitajeu.
Amu ainyoo dupoto o ltung'ani tenetum enkop pooki neiturraa enkishui enye.
Amu ore olodol enkurruna te nanu o too rorei laainei, neduaaki sii ninye Enkerai e Tung'ani ninye enkurruna te nelotu te nkitoo enye o ene menye o enoo lmalaika sinyat.
Kake ajoki intae too sipat nchere etii kulo ooitashe te ne lemeishamisham keeya katukul, eitu eng'as aadol enkitoria e Nkai.”
Ore too nkolong'i naabaya isiet eidipate nena baa nerik Yesu Petero o Yohana o Yakobo neked oldoinyo aaomon.
Neaku ore eomonito, neibelekenya emua e nkomom e Yesu, o nkilani enyena, neiborru neimerlelu.
Neirorie ninye Musa o Eliya
etalioote te nkitoo e keper, neirorie Yesu eimaki eneyooki aiko teneitabaya eyieunoto e Nkai aye te Yerusalem.
Ore Petero o looboitare neiliara too njio, kake edolisho ake nedol enkitoo e Yesu, o lelo tung'ana pokira aare ooitashe te nebo ninye.
Ore epuo lelo tung'ana aaing'uaa Yesu, nejoki Petero Yesu, “Lo Kitok, eisidai kitii ene, maitobira lng'oborri okuni, obo lino, o obo le Musa o le Eliya.” Nemeyiolo enajoito.
Ore ejoito nejia nedou enkatampoi neitoip ninche apik oloip; neureishoyu pee ejing atua ina atampoi.
Nepuku oltoilo te nkatampoi nejo, “Ena Enkerai ai Gelunoti, entoning ninye.”
Ore pee egira ilo toilo, nedoli Yesu aa ninye ake. Negira ninche, eitu eliki ltung'ana te nena olong'i inaatoduaa.
Ore pee ekenyu pee edou ninche to ldoinyo, netumore olorora kitok Yesu.
Nebuaku oltung'ani obo tiatua ilo orora ajo, “Olaiteng'enani, aatasayia ng'urai enkerai ai amu ninye ake aata;
naa kenang'aa oloirirua, nebuak, neiterreyie o meitayu labur nemeing'uaa asioki, near oleng.
Natasayia lkipaareta linono meitayu netalaikinote.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Oi ena ishoi nemeeta enkirukoto, kaboitare intae naitaas intae o anu? Iyau enkerai ino ene.”
Ore egira ayau, nenang'aa oloirirua neiterreyie. Nebuaaki Yesu ilo oirirua torrono, neishiunye ina kerai, neshukoki menye.
Neing'asia lelo pooki ootoduaa engolon magilani e Nkai. Ore eton eing'asia pooki too mbaa naataasa Yesu, nejoki ninye lkipaareta lenyena,
“Emincho ake erikino intae kuna taata naliki intae! Keishoori Enkerai e Tung'ani aaitarasaki inkaik oo ltung'ana.”
Kake eitu ejing'aa lkipaareta ina natiaaka; eton eisudoro te ninche, metaa mening'u tipat enye, nemeitieu sii aaikilikuana.
Neiteru enchankar tiatua ninche maate ejo kalo lenye olkitok te pooki.
Neyiolou Yesu ina naibirribirrita ninche, nedumu enkerai neitataaniki kewan aitasheyie.
Nejoki ninche, “Ore pooki ng'ae ong'amu ena kerai te nkarna ai, nanu etang'amua, ore oloisul te nkitisho tiatua intae, naa ninye oisul te nkitoo.”
Neng'amaa Yohana Yesu ajoki, “Lo Kitok, kitoduaa oltung'ani earaa loiriruani te nkarna ino nikimitiki, amu mme ole ncholiek ang.”
Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Emimitiki, amu ore olemekesh intae, naa ole nkalo inyi.”
Netaanu nkolong'i pee eilep Yesu alo keper, nemut nabo ajo kelo Yerusalem.
Neirriwaa ilkipaareta meituruko dukuya ninye aajing enkang oo Samaria, pee eitobiraki enejing.
Kake eitu eitoomon ilopeny te nkaraki neipirita Yerusalem.
Ore pee edol lkipaareta lenyena, Yakobo o Yohana nena, nejo, “Olaitoriani, iyieu nikimpotu enkima te keper metapejoi?”
Neibelekenyakino Yesu aing'ode nejoki, “Mayiolo aajo kaa pukunoto oo ltauja iatata,
amu eitu doi elotu Enkerai e Tung'ani amut iltauja loo ltung'ana, kake pee eitajeu.” Nepuo ae ang.
Ore epuoito te nkoitoi, nejoki oltung'ani obo Yesu, “Ekaasuj nanu iyie pooki wueji nilo.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Eeta mbariak ngumot enye, neeta motonyi nkajijik enye. Kake meeta Enkerai e Tung'ani eneirishaki elukunya enye.”
Nejoki likae, “Tusujuaki nanu.” Kake etiaaka, “Lo Kitok, nchooki ang'as alo anukaa papa.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Inchoo lmeneng'a, metunukai ilmeneng'a kake shomo iyie tolikioi ilomon le nkitoria e Nkai.”
Nejoki sii likae, “Olaitoriani, kaasuj kake, nchooki ang'as alo aitanapare iltung'ana to lmarei lang.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Ore oltung'ani otonyorra enturore neitoki anang silig, nemeishiaakino enkitoria e Nkai.”
Ore te siadi nena, negelu Olaitoriani kulikae tung'ana ntomoni naapishana neirriwaa maare, meturuko nena ang'itie o pooki wueji neyieu neitoki openy alo.
Ejoki Yesu ninche, “Aisapuk enkikesare kake aikuti ilaisiaayiak, entoomon naa olopeny enkikesare meirriu ilaisiaayiak meetu enkikesare enye.
Enchom! Airriwaa intae anaa lkuoo le kerra ooirrikini atua suyian.
Emiya embene, aashu nkilani, aashu namuka, nimirorokiki hoo oltung'ani te nkoitoi.
Ore enkaji pooki nijing'ijing'i entang'as entejo, ‘Metijing'a eseriani ena aji.’
Naa te netii oltung'ani onyor eseriani ine netum ninye eseriani inyi, naa te nemetii, neshukokino intae eseriani inyi.
Entotoni teina aji ninyanya, niokioko entoki naba anaa enaishori intae, amu kenare olaasani le siaai olekoisiaayio lenye; emipuo aarukurukoo nkajijik.
Ore enkang pooki nijing'ijing'i neitoomon intae, enosa endaa naishooki intae;
ninchiunyenye iloomuoi ootii nijokiki etinyikua enkitoria e Nkai.
Ore enkang nijing'ijing'i nemeitoomon intae, enchom inkoitoi enyena naalala nijojo,
‘Ore ninye enterit e nkang inyi nikiaata too nkejek ang, kimpiripiroki intae, kake entayiolo nchere, etinyikua enkitoria e Nkai.’
Esipa ajoki intae, ore teina olong e nkiguana, Sodom eikashieki alang enaitaasi ina ang!

“Ee kake ayia iyie Korasin! Ee kake ayia iyie Betsaida! Amu tenaa ketaasaki apa te Tiro o Sidon nena e nking'asia naatasaki tiatua intae, anaata eirridutua apa moitie, neishop lkuniyiani, neelare nkuruon.
Kake Tiro o Sidon eikashieki te nkolong e nkiguana aaitalang intae.
Oi iyie Kapernaum, eijo shumata kilepieki! Kintadouni shomo enemeneng'a.”
Nejoki Yesu lkipaareta lenyena, “Ore pooki oning intae, nanu ening, ore oloany intae, nanu eany, ore olaany nanu, naa ilo laairriwua etanya.”
Neshukunye lelo kipaareta ntomoni naapishana o aare te ng'ida. Nejo, “Olaitoriani, ore ebaiki loiriruani, etoning'o iyiook kiaaraa te nkarna ino!”
Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Atoduaa Sheitani esulunye anaa enkiwuang'ata eing'uaa shumata.
Enining'o! Aishoo intae enkidimata, metaa indimidimi aaitunyoi ilasuriaa o nkulupani, o engolon pooki e ilo mang'atinta, nemeeta enaiko intae.
Kake eming'idare ina naning intae iloiriruani; kake enting'idata amu eigero nkarn inyi te keper.”

Ore ina kata ake neshipayu Yesu eiputa Enkiyang'et Sinyati, nejo, “Ashe Papa Olaitoriani le keper o enkop! Amu isudorie kuna baa ilang'eni o loata eyiolounoto niboloki inkera naanana, amu ina eyieunoto e mpiris ino.
Nanu eishoo Papa pooki toki, nemeetae oloyiolo Oinoti leme Papa ake, nemeetae oloyiolo Papa leme Oinoti lenye ake, o pooki ng'ae ake ogelu enkerai aboloki ninye.”
Neibelekenyakino Yesu lkipaareta lenyena, neirorie too nkurrat nejo, “Emayiana inkonyek naadol kuna nidolitata intae.
Amu ajoki intae, keyieu apa iloibonok o laiguanak, nedol kuna nidolidolo, kake eitu hoo edol; neyieu apa nening kuna nining'ining'i kake eitu hoo ening.”
Neinyototo olang'eni obo aikilikuanishore Yesu, eyieu netem, nejoki, “Lo Aiteng'enani, kaji aiko pee ajung enkishui nemeish?”
Nejoki Yesu, “Kakua baa naaigero too nkitanapat e Nkai? Kejo aa enisuma iyie?”
Newaliki olang'eni ajoki, “Tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki, o te nkiyang'et ino pooki, o te ng'eno ino pooki, o te ngolon ino pooki, ninyorru o le latia ino anaa eninyor kewan.”
Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Itawalua aitobiraki, taasa ina pee ibik inchu.”
Neyieu ninye neitaa kewan asipani, nejoki Yesu, “Ai ng'ae doi ole latia ai?”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Etadowuo oltung'ani eing'uaa Yerusalem alo Yeriko, neinepu ilaisimak ninye neoru nkilani, near neing'uaa etaa keye.
Nelotu olapolosani aim ina oitoi, ore pee edol nepaash, nelo.
Nelotu sii ninye ole Lawi aim ine ore pee edol nepaash, nelo.
Kake ore pee elotu Osamariyiai olo sii ninye nkang'itie, ore pee edol neing'urrie.
Nebaiki neen ilbaa lenyena nebukoki eilata neisho enaisho oo sabibu, neitoki aitaked esikiria enye, nerik enkaji naitoomonishoreki neramat teine.
Ore pee ekenyu, neitayu dinari are aisho olopeny ina aji nejoki, ‘Ing'ura taa ele tung'ani, ore pooki toki nanya nalusoo te nena, nalotu alak tenashukunye.’
Kaa idol iyie te lelo tung'ana pokira okuni, kalo otaa ole latia teilo otara ilaisimak?”
Nejo ninye; ilo oing'urrie ninye. Nejoki Yesu Ninye shomo sii iyie taasa ina.
Ore epuoito Yesu o lkipaareta lenyena neimaa Yesu enkang namanya enkitok naji Marisa, neitoomon te nkaji enye.
Neeta enkanashe naji Mariamu, nelotu ina aton too nkejek e Yesu, aton aainining inkiteng'enat e Yesu.
Nenyamalu Marisa too siaaitin enyena kumok, nelotu enetii Yesu nejoki, “Olaitoriani, aimidol ajo emakua te naasisho openy, naapalaki enkanashe ai? Tiaaki naa maaeu aret.”
Kake etawalikia Olaitoriani ajoki, “Marisa, Marisa, intanyamaluo nimposha too mbaa kumok;
kake nabo bae ake naata tipat, ena bae natudutayie Mariamu naisul; nemeyae aaitung'uaa ninye.”
Neaku ore eomonito Yesu te dikae wueji, ore pee eidip, nejoki obo loo lkipaareta lenyena, “Olaitoriani, inteng'ena iyiook enkomono anaa enaiteng'ena Yohana lkipaareta lenyena.”
Nejoki Yesu, “Ti niomonono entejo: Papa meitisinyi enkarna ino, meeu enkitoria ino.
Inchoo iyiook anaa ake endaa nabaiki iyiook.
Nipalaki iyiook ing'ok ang, anaa pee kipalaki sii iyiook ilooinyal iyiook. Nimirik iyiook atua ntemat.”
Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Kalo linyi oata olchore laa te nelo ainyeyie eitorite enkewarie, ajoki, ‘Olchore, isilenokoki mukateni uni;
amu eewuo olchore lai eing'uaa nkang'itie nemaata entoki naisho.’
Kejoki ilo otii aji, ‘Mikintanyamal, amu eikeno kutuk aji, neirurate nkera, kirurate pooki. Meekure aidim ainyo pee aaisho?’
Ajoki ntae, te nemeisho duoo te nkaraki naa olchore lenye, kake ore te nkaraki naitirrishaka olikae, keinyototo ake aisho naaba anaa naayieu.
Najoki naa ntae, entoomonu pee eishori ntae, eng'oru pee itumutumu; entooshiosh kutuk aji pee eboluni ntae.
Amu ore pooki oomonu netum; ore oloing'oru netum; ore olooshiosh kutuk aji neboluni.
“Kalo te ntae oisho enkerai enye osoit etoomonuo emukate? Aashu te neomonu osinkirri, neisho olasurai?
Aashu te neomonu olmosori, neisho enkulupa?
Asa taa doi iyiololo ntae iltung'ana torrok, aaishoo nkera inyi ntokitin sidain, kebaa na eitulus Papa linyi otii keper aisho Enkiyang'et Sinyati lelo oomon ninye?”
Neera Yesu oloirirua lemeiro. Neaku ore pee epuku ilo oirirua lemeiro, neiro ilo tung'ani apa oonyo kutuk, neing'asia olorere.
Kake etejo kulikae lenye, “Beelsebul, olkitok loo loiriruani oishoo engolon naararie loiriruani.”
Netem sii kulikae eing'oru osapiipiyiet oing'uaa keper.
Kake ore pee eirrash Yesu ndamunot enye, nejoki, “Ore enkitoria ake ninye pooki naoro aara oopeny neidaaya, ore enkaji naara openy neurori.
Kaji eiko enkitoria e Sheitani te neoro aara makewan, keitoki enkitoria enye auno? Amu ijojo naa te ngolon e Beelsebul aaraa loiriruani?
Naa amaa te naa keng'olon e Beelsebul aararie nanu loiriruani, keng'olon e ng'ae doi eararie ninche nkera inyi loiriruani? Ninche naa ooyooki aaiguanare ntae.
Kake te naa ai to lkimojino le Nkai aaraa loiriruani, enkitoria e Nkai naewuo atua ntae.
Ore te nerrip oltung'ani ogol otanape enkaji enye, neserian imasaa enyena pooki.
Kake te nerasaki ologol alang ninye nemir, neoru masaa o larrabal duoo naawuasare, nelo aor iyarunot naatarua.
“Ore pooki leme ole nkalo ai, nanu ekesh, ore ole maaret asotu, naa keisardaikie.
“Ore te neidur oloirirua oiduruk to ltung'ani nelo aimaa iwuejitin nemetii enkare, eing'oru eneyeng'iyeng'are; ore pee elau, nejo, ‘Kashukokino enkaji ai apa natung'uayie.’
Ore pee ebau, neinepu etooroki neikodi,
neito ninye alo aipot kulikae oiriruani oopishana torrok aalang ninye, meetu aamany ine; nerruoyo empukunoto e ilo tung'ani alang enatiu apa te dukuya.”
Ore pee ejo Yesu nejia, nebuaku enkitok nabo tiatua olorora nejoki, “Emayiana sii ake enkoshoke nikitoiwuo o lki likintanaaki.”
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ee paa emayiana aaisul, ilooning ele rorei le Nkai neibung.”
Ore pee eiturrurrokino esiamo Yesu neiteru ajoki, “Arruok sii ake ltung'ana lena kata, embae eing'oru; kake meetae naa embae enking'asia naishori neme ene Yona.
Amu ore anaa enataa Yona embae enking'asia too ltung'ana le Ninawi, nejia sii etiu Enkerai e Tung'ani too ltung'ana le na kata.

Keyooki enkaiguanani e kopikop adumunye te nkiguana oo ltung'ana lena ishoi nedung'oki ninche enkiguana, amu eewuo ninye too neeiting'ie enkop elotu ainining eng'eno e Solomon, naa ketii ene olkitok olang Solomon.

Keyooki ltung'ana le Ninawi aaitasheiki neitang'or ltung'ana le na ishoi, te nkolong e nkiguana, nedung'oki enkiguana, amu eirridutua ninche etolikio Yona ororei le Nkai, naa ketii taa ene olkitok olang Yona.
“Meetae oltung'ani oinok oltaa nepik orunku aashu epising to ltoo, kake kepik eneiperere pee eitawang'aki iloojing'u.
Etiu nkonyek inono anaa oltaa lo sesen lino, naa te naa biyot nkonyek inono, newang osesen lino pooki; kake ore pee kira torrok nkonyek nerip enaimin osesen lino pooki.
Toduaa naa pee miaku ewang'an niata enaimin.
Amu te nebore osesen lino pooki ewang'an, nemeeta enemisimis, newang'u pooki wueji, atiu anaa te nikilang oltaa owang.”
Ore eirorita Yesu, neipot Olfarisayoi obo meshomo anya endaa te nkaji enye, nelo, neton anya endaa.
Neing'asia ilo Farisayoi pee edol ajo eitu eng'as aisuj inkaik eitu enya endaa.
Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani ilo Farisayoi, “Intukuku ntae Ilfarisayo oriong enkikompe o esaani, kake ore atua ntae nebore enkowuarisho o enkarruoisho.
Lo moda! Aime ele obo oitobira oriong o atua?
Kake enchoru to lng'ur nena tokitin naatii atua, naa kesinyayu pooki toki te ntae.
“Ee kake aiyia intae lo Farisayo! Amu inchoruru ematua e tomon oo ntasimi oo mbenek pooki nipalaa enkiguana oo sipat o enyorrata e Nkai, naa keishiaakino nitaasa nimipalaa nena kulie.
Ee kake aiyia ntae Ilfarisayo! Amu inyorrinyorro ilorikan sidain too nkajijik e ntumo, ninyorrinyorro lng'asak too wuejitin neemirishoreki.
Ee kake aiyia ntae! Amu itiuu anaa nkuraren nemelioo, naaitunyoo ltung'ana meyiolo.”
Newaliki obo loo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ajoki, “Olaiteng'enani, te nijo nji, iyiook sii iyiataa.”
Nejoki, “Ee kake ayia sii ntae ilang'eni loo nkitanapat! Amu intanapinapa ilkulikae ilolan ooiroishi lemenapayu, ore ntae maate nimiseyieyie too lkimojik linyi.
Ee kake ayia! Amu ishetishete nkuraren oo iloibonok le Nkai laa loo papaai linyi ootaara metuata.
Metaa, itaa shakeni, nitonyorraitie nkiasin oo loo minyi, amu ninche ootaara metuata, nishetakiki ntae nkuraren.
“Ore te nkaraki ina, etejo eng'eno e Nkai, ‘Kairriwaki ninche iloibonok o lkipaareta, near kulikae metuata, nearaa kulikae’,
paa ore ilo sarge loo loibonok le Nkai, oibukoyioki ebaiki apa pee eitamanyuni enkop, neitalakuni ltung'ana le na ishoi;
ebaiki osarge le Abel o metabaiki osarge le Sakaria, oitanang'aki erishata olperere lo lasar o ewueji sinyati, ee ajoki intae keitalakuni too ltung'ana lena ishoi.
“Ee kake aiyia lang'eni loo nkitanapat! Amu iwaita embolet najing'ieki ewueji e ng'eno; neitu ijing'ijing'i ntae maate nirishieshie lelo oojing'ita.
“Ore eing'uaa Yesu ine, neiteru lasirak o Lfarisayo aaitirrishaki oleng, nerrumoki meimaki imbaa kumok
erreshu enaitang'orie te nena naajo ninye.”
Ore kiti, neiturrurro olorora kitok metaa keitunyoro, neiteru Yesu aiturukie lkipaareta lenyena ajoki, “Entodol ake ate te nkisuisho oo Lfarisayo amu keisunkur.
Meetae enaimulumularo nemeibalunyeki, aashu enaisudoro nemeyiolouni.
Ore embae pooki nitejo ntae te naimin neyookini aalikioo te wang'an, ore nena nipuopuo aaing'oming'omakino too lgilat loo nkisudorot neyookini aalikioo too nchumarot oo nkajijik.
“Ajoki ntae, loshoreta laainei, emiure lelo ooar osesen, nemeitoki aata ai naaidim aataas eidipa ina.
Kake aikok intae aliki olonare niurere; entureita ilo laa ore eidipa atara metua, neitoki aata engolon nanang'akinye Yehanum; ee ajoki ntae, ilo entureita!
“Aimme nchilinkini are ake enya imotonyi miet? Nemelang ninye Enkai hoo nabo e nena.
Oo naa ntae ilaa keikena ninye lpapit loo lukuny inyi. Emiureisho; iatata pae tipat aalang motonyi kumok.
“Najoki nanu ntae, ore pooki laaibalie te dukuya ltung'ana, neibalie sii ninye Enkerai e Tung'ani ninye te dukuya ilmalaika le Nkai.
Kake ore ilo laamiki te dukuya ltung'ana nemikini sii ninye te dukuya lmalaika le Nkai.
Ore oltung'ani pooki osukeny Enkerai e Tung'ani kepalakini, kake ore olomor Enkiyang'et Sinyati nemepalakini.
Naa te neyae ntae nkajijik e ntumo o laitoriak o enkitoo, eming'aing'ai aajo ai jojo aa anaa aiwalulu aajo aa;
amu keutaki ntae Enkiyang'et Sinyati teina saa enijojo.”
Nejoki oltung'ani obo otii atua ilo orere Yesu, “Olaiteng'enani, tiaaki olalashe lai maatooriki enjung'ore ang.”
Kake etiaaka, “Lo tung'ani, ai ng'ae laaitaa nanu olarishani anaa olooriki ntae imasaa?”
Neitoki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Entodol ake ate, entodol ate to lng'uarra; amu ore enkishui neme nkumoi oo masaa naata oltung'ani.”
Neitoki aliki enkitanyaanyukoto, nejoki, “Eetae apa olkarsis neisho enkurma enye oleng,
nejoki kewan enye, ‘Kaa taa aas, amu maata enapik endaa ai?’
Nejo, ‘Inji aiko, kaar ilkompen laainei nashetu loolala oolang kulo pee ashumie endaa ai o masaa aainei.
Naa kajoki oltau lai, lo tau! Iata masaa kumok nikitushumakaki too larin kumok; isikarrayu tadaayu niokisho nishipa.’
Kake nejoki Enkai, ‘Lo modai! Ena kewarie kiyieki oltau lino; paa amaa nena tokitin ninteng'ela keaku pasa nkuneng'ae ninche?’
Nejia etiu oloshumaki kewan imasaa neme karsis tialo Enkai.”
Nejoki Yesu lkipaareta lenyena, “Ajoki naa ntae, emintanyamaluo te nkaraki enkishon inyi, te ntoki ninyanya, o too seseni linyi te ntoki ninchopishopo.
Amu kitok enkishui alang endaa, naa kitok osesen alang inkilani.
Ing'ura lkurruki; meunisho, nemesotisho, nemeeta sitooni anaa ilkompen, neitoti ake Enkai sii ninche. Kebaa naa elang tipat inyi ntae enoo motonyi!
Naa kalo obo linyi oidim atoponiki kewan entemata nabo e nkaina te nkishui enye?
Amaa naa te nimindimidimi aataas enkiti bae anaa ina, oo pee intanyamaluoluo too nkulie pooki?
Ng'ura ntapuka, eneiko te nebulu, nemeekenya nemepiyaisho; kake ajoki ntae, ore ninye Solomon te sikar enye pooki nemeikodo anaa enatiu nabo e kuna.
Kake pasa taa eishop Enkai aiko nji olkujita obulu taata ti ong'ata ore taaisere nenang'akini enkima, kebaa eitulus aishop intae, lo tung'ana kulo ooti enkirukoto!
Naa eming'oruru entoki ninyanya anaa eniokioko, naa emisinanuo.
Amu kuna tokitin eing'oru loreren pooki le nkop; neyiolo Papa linyi ajo nkolati inyi nena.
Ore enaikash, naa eng'oru enkitoria enye, naa keaku sii nkuninyi nena kulie.
“Emiureisho, lo turrur oti, amu Papa linyi otonyorra aisho ntae enkitoria enye.
Entimir imasaa inyi, enchoo laisinak; eng'uraki ate lbenia lememusanu, ooata olchumati te keper lememuta, ine nemenyikaki olapurroni nemeinosie oriri.
Amu ore ine netii olchumati lino naa ine etii oltau lino.
“Enterreten impolosi inyi, naa enchoo etoni eyupuyup ltaai linyi
nitiuu anaa iltung'ana ooanyita olkitok lenye elotu eing'uaa osirua le nkiyama, pee te nebau neipotisho nesioki aabolu nabo kata.
Emayiana ake lelo aisiaayiak laa te nebau olkitok lenye neinepu erripisho. Esipa ajoki ntae, kerretena ninye openy neisho ninche metotona te misa, nelotu aitoti ninche.
Naa te neewuo te rripore e are, aashu tene uni, neinepu etiu nejia nemayian ake lelo aisiaayiak!
Kake entayiolo nchere, tenaa keyiolo olopeny enkaji esaa nalotunye olapurroni, anaata etorripishe naa anaata eitu eisho metigili enkaji enye.
Entashololoto sii ntae; amu kelotu Enkerai e Tung'ani te saa niminteikiki.”
Nejoki Petero, “Olaitoriani, aiyiook ake iliki ena kitanyaanyukoto ena ei pooki ng'ae?”
Nejoki Olaitoriani, “Kalo pasa abarani? Ilo supat naa ng'en otung'eikia olopeny enkaji, meitotio lootii too rishat enye.
“Emayiana ake sii ilo aisiaayiani oinepu olkitok lenye easita ina naitanapa.
Esipa ajoki ntae, keisho meitoria masaa enyena pooki.
Kake oo te nejo ilo aisiaayiani openy, ‘Eimutie olkitok lai,’ neiteru aidong nkaisiaayiak, nedaa ninye neokisho amera.
Neyooki alotu olkitok le ilo aisiaayiani to lkekun, lemeiteikini o te saa nemeyioloi, neitame neitaboitaki ilemening'isho.
Ore ilo aisiaayiani apa oyiolo enayieu olkitok lenye, neitu eas aitabaya aashu ina nanyor, neidong'i oleng.
Kake ore ilo lemeyiolo, netaasa enaishiaakino enkidong'oto, eari penyo. Ore pooki oishooki nkumok, neyieki ninye nkumok; ore ilo laa ninye eitanap iltung'ana nkumok neyieki ninye nkumok oleng.
“Aewuo aisuroki enkop enkima; naa oi sii ake duoo te naa keidipa atudupai!
Kake kaata enkibatisa naaibatisae; nebaa enaaitirrishita o meitabari kenya!
Aijojo pasa kaewuo ayaki enkop osotua? A'a, ajoki eoro ayaki;
amu ore ebaiki taata eoro enkaji nara miet; nepong'ore uni are, nepong'ore are uni;
nepong'o enkerai o menye, nepong'o entito o ng'otonye, nepong'ore enkaputani enkitok o layioni lenye, nepong'ore esiankiki enkaputani.”
Nejoki sii Yesu olorere, “Te nidolulu oshi enkatampoi eilepu te nkalo e ndoyioroto, nijojo nabo kata, ‘Kelotu asha’; netiu nejia.
Ore pee idolidolo osiwuo oing'uaa moikuape nijojo, ‘Kelotu airowuaju’; netiu nejia.
Lo sunkuro kulo! Iyiololo intae aatolimu ilbulabul le nkop o loing'ang'e; kake kaji inkoko pee miyiololo aaing'ura nilimumu enatiu ena kata?
“Naa kaji etiu pee mirishushu oopeny enasipa?
Ore eton iriamariri te nkoitoi o ilo likintang'or to larishani, tetema toning'ore ninye eton ipuopuo, pee mikiyeataki enetii olaiguanani, nikintarasaki olaiguanani osikari, nikipik osikari jila.
Aajoki, mipuku aikata teine mme italaa empisai nabayie.”
Netii apa kulikae ootii ine ina kata ootolikitio Yesu eneikuna Pilato Ilgalilaya ootara metuata neitushulaki osarge loo lasarri lenye.
Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ijojo pasa ai lelo Galilaya ooata ing'ok aalang ilkulikae Galilaya pooki, eji amu nejia eikunaki enkitamioto?
Ajoki ntae, mme nejia; kake te neitu iridudu sii ntae nindaayaya aaiko nejia.”
Aashu doi lapa oora tomon o isiet ootuurokine enkaji naado te Siloam near metuata, ijojo pasa ninche larruok aalang ilkulikae pooki oomanya apa Yerusalem?
Ajoki ntae mme nejia; kake te neitu irridudu sii ntae nindaayaya aaiko nejia.
Neinosaki Yesu ninche ena kitanyaanyukoto: “Eeta apa oltung'ani olng'aboli ouno te nkurma enye oo lng'anayio nelotu aing'orunye lng'anayio neitu etumie.
Nejoki oloramat ilng'anayio, ‘Eji larin okuni taata alotu ake aing'orunye ele ng'aboli lng'anayio, nematumie, tudung'o tuuroi; oo pee etumuta empiron e nkop?’
Newaliki ajoki, ‘Tapala, lo kitok, tele ari sii taata, matuturoki napik entulugumi.
Ore pee etoiwuo lng'anayio tele ari olotu naa sidai; kake te neitu, nidung auroo.’ ”
Neaku eiteng'enisho apa ninye Yesu te nkaji e ntumo te nkolong e Sabato.
Netii enkitok naata oloirirua le lepori too larin tomon o isiet; neaku keirrugori meidim ataraposhunye.
Ore pee edol Yesu ninye, neipot, nejoki, “Na kitok, kitooruoki emuoyian ino.”
Neiteleiki nkaik enyena, neraposhunye teina kata. Neisis Enkai.

Kake etagore olkitok le nkaji e ntumo te nkaraki naishiunye Yesu olorere te nkolong e Sabato nejoki olorere, “Eetai nkolong'i ile naaishiaakino neasieki esiaai; wootu te nena olong'i meishiunyeki ntae, neme te nkolong e Sabato.”
Newaliki taa Olaitoriani nejoki, “Lo sunkuro! Keetae obo linyi lemelaku olkiteng anaa osikiria lenye to lale te nkolong e Sabato, nerik aitook enkare?
Paa aimeishiaakino ninye ena kitok, entito e Abraham nateena Sheitani larin tomon o isiet, aimeishiaakino netalakuaki te nkolong e Sabato?”
Ore pee ejo nejia, nekurru lelo pooki ooing'orunore; neshipa olorere pooki too mbaa pooki e nkisisa naataasa ninye.
Neitoki taa Yesu aikilikuan ajoki, “Kaji eikununo enkitoria e Nkai? Naa kainyoo pasa eitanyaanyukieki?
Etiu anaa enkantererai e karadali natuuno oltung'ani te nkurma enye; nebulu aaku olchani, nemany imotonyi ilng'osil lenyena aapik inkajijik enye.”
Neitoki ake Yesu aikilikuan ajoki, “Kainyoo pasa aitanyaanyukie enkitoria e Nkai?
Etiu anaa enkasuishoi natudumua enkitok neitushulaki mboreitin uni e nkano, o metaba anaa neisuishoyu pooki.”
Neimaa Yesu nkang'itie sapuki oo nkutiti neiteng'enisho eloito enkalo e Yerusalem.
Nejoki oltung'ani obo, “Olaitoriani, ai kuti pasa lelo oojeu?” Newaliki ninche ajoki,
“Entonyok eimu kutuk aji napirik; amu ajoki ntae, eyooki lkumok aaing'oru pee eimu nelaikino.
Ore ake pee eaku einyo olopeny enkaji aiken kutuk aji, ninteruru aaitashoo te boo ioshiosho kutuk aji ijojo, ‘Olaitoriani, tabolu iyiook.’ Newaliki ninye ntae ajoki, ‘Mayiolo nanu ajo kaji ing'uaa.’
Nintokiki taa aajo, ‘Kitadaate nikitookishote o iyie, ninteng'enishe too nkoitoi ang naalala oo nkanas.’
Kake kejoki ninye ntae, ‘Ajoki ntae, mayiolo nanu ajo kaji ing'uaa; entalamaki nanu, intae pooki oora laasak loo ntorrok?’
Ore teine ninchirishiri nionyionyo lala, idolidolo Abraham o Isaak o Yakobo o loibonok le Nkai pooki etii enkitoria e Nkai nimanikiki ate etanang'ayioki ntae auluo.
Naa kepuonu ltung'ana ooing'uaa enkilepunoto o endoyioroto, o looing'uaa kopikop o moikuape aatoni te misa tiatua enkitoria e Nkai.
Naa ketii ile siadi ooaku ile dukuya, netii ile dukuya ooaku ile siadi.”
Ore teina saa ake nepuonu embata oo Ilfarisayo, nejoki Yesu, “Inyo shomo te ne amu keyieu Herode nikiaar tua.”
Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom entiaaki ilo barie, ‘Kaaraa nanu loiriruani naishiunye iltamuoyia taata o taaisere o te nkolong e uni; naidip inkolati aainei.
Kake ore etiu nejia enkoitoi ai ake asuj taata o taaisere o idia olong; amu meidimayu metaa kenang oloiboni le Nkai dikae neme Yerusalem.’

Oi Yerusalem, Yerusalem naar iloibonok le Nkai ninang too soito lelo likirriwakini. Aikat aja pasa ajo aiturrur inkera inono te nebo anaa elukungu naiturrur inkuoo enyena ti abori inaipuko enyena nimiyieu.
Eitaa Enkai enkaji ino mijooni. Naajoki meekure kintoki aekata adol o tejo, ‘Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani!’ ”
Ore apa te Sabato nabo nelo Yesu anya endaa te nkaji o Lfarisayoi obo kitok, te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata, neing'or ninche aajur.
Naa ketii ine oltung'ani dukuya ninye otejia osesen.
Neirorie Yesu lang'eni loo nkitanapat o Lfarisayo ajoki, “Keishoruno pasa too nkitanapat meishiunyeki oltung'ani te nkolong e Sabato anaa ai meishoruno?”
Kake etigirate ninche. Neibung ilo tung'ani neishiunye, neisho meshomo.
Nejoki ninche, “Ai ng'ae te ntae laa te neeta enkurrarru anaa olkiteng otusulakine olkesumet lemesaru nabo kata aitayu, oi aa te nkolong e Sabato.”
Nelaikino aatawaliki ina.
Neitoki Yesu aliki enkitanyaanyukoto lelo ooitoomoni, etoduaa eneiko tenegelaki ate iwuejitin oo lorikan aailepie ate. Nejoki ninche,
“Te nikimpotokini osirua le nkiyama, mitonie ake ewueji enkanyit, melotu ake likae oipoto kitok likilang;
nelotu ilo oipoto ntae, pokira oaare, nikijoki, ‘Nchoo sii iyie ele tung'ani enetonie,’ nintoki iyie adou te nkurruna alo ewueji e abori.
Kake ore iyie pee kimpoti, totona te wueji nebayie tukul, paa te nelotu ilo oitoomonisho nikijoki, ‘Olchore, ilepa sii iyie;’ nikiyanyitu iltung'ana pooki liboitare te misa.
Amu ore pooki oilepie kewan neitadouni, ore oloitadou kewan neilepieki.”

Nejoki sii ninye ilo oitoomonisho, “Te nincho ltung'ana endaa aashu ntobiraki osirua, mimpot lchoreta linono o lalashera linono o lelo lo lmarei lino aashu lkarsisi le latia ino, pee mikiyiooki sii ninche aaitoomon, nikilaaki enda apa nintaasa.
Kake ore ti nintobir iyie osirua, mpoto laisinak, o ltarrushi o lng'ojiniaa o lmodook,
naa eikimayiani amu mikindim ninche aatalaaki iyie. Aikilaakini kenya ake te mpiunoto e lelo supati.”
Ore pee ening ina obo le lelo ootoni te misa tenebo o Yesu, nejoki, “Emayiana ilo oyooki adaa te nkitoria e Nkai.”
Kake etiaaka ninye ilo, “Etii apa oltung'ani oitobira osirua kitok, neipot iltung'ana kumok,
ore pee ebau enkata e ilo sirua neirriwaa olaisiaayiani lenye metiaaki lelo ooipotoki, ‘Wootu; amu keirrag pooki toki!’
Kake eiterutua pooki aaitaakuuk. Nejo ole dukuya, ‘Ainyang'ua enkurma, naa kalo ake adol; aatasayia tung'ueikiaki nanu.’
Nejo likae, ‘Ainyang'ua nanu lmong'i tomon naa kalo pee alo asipu; aatasayia tung'ueikiaki nanu.’
Nejo likae, ‘Enayamie enkitok, nemaidim naa aeu.’

Kaae, nelotu olaisiaayiani aliki olkitok lenye nena. Negoro olopeny enkaji nejoki olaisiaayiani lenye, ‘Tasiooi shomo nkoitoi oo nkaulele e ina anasa, toriku laisinak o ltarrushi o lmodook o lng'ojiniaa.’
