Neme ina ake, keishiaakino neeta errepet te lelo leme ilairukok pee medoiki ake atua esulare o rreshet le Sheitani.
Neijia ake sii etiu ilaisiaayiak, inchoo emut nabo nemeitoki aaing'ashing'ash too nkirorot, neme ilooitabaitie enaisho, nemeeta olorok le dupoto,
inchoo eibung enkirukoto to ltau owang.
Nchoo sii eng'asi aatem ninche, ore ake peyie eitisipi nchere meeta ileyiat, nchoo easisho anaa ilaisiaayiak.
Neijia ake sii eishiaa neikununo inkituaak enye; nchoo emut nabo, neme inaakurrisho kake inoo nkiririkinot, neisiligayu too mbaa pooki.
Inchoo ilaisiaayiak eaku ilpayiani loo nkituaak maa naabo, neitasheiki sii ninche inkera enye o nkajijik enye aaitobiraki.
Amu ore lelo ooasisho aaitobiraki anaa ilaisiaayiak naa ketum errepet sidai maate, netum enkitieunoto kitok tiatua enkirukoto natii atua Kristo Yesu.
Kaisilig ajo kalotu enitii asieku, kake kasiraki intae kuna kiteng'enat peyie,
te naimutie niyiolouu enaishiaakino neas oltung'ani tiatua enkaji e Nkai. Naa ninye esirit e Nkai naishu, ninye eng'ape o olkitamanyunoto loo sipat.

Kitejo iyiook tukul inchere, eikitok oleng enkisudoroto e nkirukoto ang: Eibalunyeki ninye to sesen, neitadedeyieki ninye te Nkiyang'et nedol ilmalaika, nelikiori too loreren, neiruk enkop, neyae ninye keper te nkitoo.
Eibalunye Enkiyang'et Sinyati ajo nchere, ore too nkatitin e nkiting'oto, naa keing'uaa kulikae enkirukoto nerubare lelo tauja le lejare o nkiteng'enat oo loiriruani
eimu esunkuroisho e lelo oolejisho ootokilote iltauja lenye,
oomit eyamishoe, nemit einosi kulie daiki naaitayio Enkai, nemit eng'amuni te nashe lelo ooata enkirukoto ooyiolo isipat.
Amu ore pooki toki naitayio Enkai naa eisidai, nemeetae hoo ae toki nabo naanyi te naa te nashe eng'amuni;
amu keitisiny ororei le Nkai o enkomono.
Ti ninguan esirit te kuna kiteng'enat niaaku olaisiaayiani supat le Kristo Yesu, oitubuluaki too rorei le nkirukoto o nkiteng'enare sidai naa ninye iyie itusuja.
Tapaasha nena atinin e modai neme ne Nkai. Intamoo kewan orrekie le Nkai;
amu te naa keeta enkitamooto o sesen enkiti retoto, enkitamooto oo mbaa e Nkai naata te pooki oitoi, amu keeta enkisiligata tena kishui o te nkishui nalotu.
Ororei osipa ele neishiaakino neng'amari katukul.
Te nkaraki kuna pee kintanyamal ate nikinyok, amu Enkai naishu kitipika osiligi lang naa ninye Olaitajeunoni le pooki tung'ani neisulaki lelo ooiruk.
Intanapisho ninteng'enishore kuna baa.
Mincho oltung'ani hoo obo kimenu te nkaraki kitisho ino, kake intoduaa ilairukok enkitanyaanyukoto tiatua enkiroroto o to lkuaak, tiatua enyorrata, tiatua enkirukoto o tiatua esinyatisho.
Tasheikinoyu enkisumata oo lkigerot te dukuya iltung'ana o elikioroto o enkiteng'enare o metaba anaa nalotu.
Mintololoiki ina kishooroto niaata, nikinchooki apa too nkirorot e naibon apa peyie kinteleiki ilpayiani inkaik.
Intamoo kewan kuna siaaitin tasheikinore ninche, pee edol pooki ng'ae eninkunari te nyuaata.
Tagolie kewan o nena kiteng'enat inono, imbung'a, amu te niaas ina nintajeu kewan o lelo likinining.
Mibuaaki olpayian kitok kake irorie anaa papaai lino. Ntaasa iltung'ana ooti anaa ilalashera linono,
ninko nkituaak moruak anaa noo ng'utunyi, ninko nkituaak kutiti anaa nkanashera inono te sinyatisho pooki.
Iyanyita inkolia naara te dede.
Naa te neeta enkoliai inkera aashu inoo nkoko, inchoo eng'as aitabaya nena siaaitin e nkirukoto too lmareita lenye neisho intoiwuo enye olerrinyore amu keng'amaroyu ena te dukuya Enkai.
Ore naa enkoliai te dede, netung'uayioki aa ninye ake naa Enkai eisilig nebik eomon dama o kewarie;
kake ore ina naa ng'uarrat ake naaitore, netua hoo neishu.
Intanapa nena pee metum ake ninche ileyiat.
Te netii oltung'ani lemegolie iltung'ana lenyena neisulaki lelo le nkaji enye, neiturrayie ninye enkirukoto, neaku torrono alang oleitu eiruk.
Nchoo eng'amuni aaiger enkoliai nemeitong'or ilarin ntomoni ile, naa enkitok apa o lpayian obo,

neeta ake sii shakenisho oo mbaa enyena sidain anaa enaitubulua inkera neitoomonishe, neitukuo inkejek oo sinyat, netasarua lelo oonyamal, netasheikine aas impukunot pooki oo siaaitin sidain too nkoitoi pooki.
Kake tanya ing'amu aiger inkolia kutiti: amu te nepaashari ninche neyieu neyami,
neaku keiguanareki ninche amu eiturraitie enapa kiroroto natang'asa aaibung.
Ore ake etiu neijia, keitamok ate enturuaisho neirrang'irrang aaruk inkajijik, neme neijia ake, kake keeta sii olmarenke o enkilepilep nekurrisho neiro mbaa nemeishiaakino neiro.
Metaa ajo nanu, keishiaakino neyami inkolia kutiti, neiu inkera, neitore nkajijik enye, peyie metum olmang'atinta erishata nasukenyie iyiook.
Amu eidipa kulie aatapong'ori aasuj Sheitani.
Te netii enkairukoni naata inkolia too lmarei lenye, nchoo enap ninche; Mincho esirit eiteleikini olola, peyie etum ataretu nena kulie olia te dede.
Nchoo lelo payiani laa larikok supati edamuni neigilieki aaisho enkanyit, neisulaki lelo oonyok te likioroto o te nkiteng'enare.
Amu ejo ilkigerot, “Mien olkiteng enkutuk eidong'ito enkurma,” nejo sii, “Keishiaakino olaisiaayiani olekoisiaayio lenye.”
Minyorraa te neitang'ori olpayian aashu te naa ketii ilchakenini oaare anaa okuni.
Kake ore lelo ooenikino ing'ok tabuaaki etii pooki pee etum iltung'ana pooki enkuretisho.
Ore te dukuya Enkai o Kristo Yesu o lelo malaika oogeluno, aaitanap iyie nchere imbung'a kuna kitanapat miaata nyorrakino, nimiaas hoo ae bae to lkep.
Misioki enkiteleikinoto oo nkaik te lelo ooputokini enkisiaayiare, niming'arie likae tung'ani ing'ok enyena, torripo kewan, taa sinyati.
Mintoki aok enkare narok, kake tooko enkiti aisho oo sabibu te nkaraki enkoshoke ino o teina muoyian e anaa ake.
Keibala ing'ok e kulikae tung'ana neutu endung'okinoto e nkiguana, kake ore kulikae te siadi eyooki aaibalayu.
Neijia sii etiu iasat supati e kulikae tung'ana, keibalayu aasioki, naa te nemeibalayu nemeidim aaisudori o kenya.
Nchoo lelo pooki ootii abori enchata e rrindikisho eikenaa ilkituaak lenye aajo keiririkino enkanyit pooki, peyie mesukenyi ake enkarna e Nkai aashu nkiteng'enat ang.

Ore lelo ooata ilkituaak airukok nemeishiaa neituraa enkanyit enye amu kejo lelo ilalashera, kake peyie easisho oleng amu ore lelo oodupore ena siaai enye naa ile tipat, amu lairukok oonyor. Inteng'ena nintudup ninche kuna siaaitin.
Te neiteng'enisho oltung'ani ae kiteng'enare napaashaa neany eibung irorei supati lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo o enkiteng'enare naishiaakino orrekie le Nkai,
nerup kewan te modai nemeyiolo toki. Keeta ninye enkure e nchankar o empong'o, naa ine epukunye olom o lolepilepi o emorore o nkiteenikinot torrok,
o enchankar tiatua iltung'ana lemelulung'a lukuny enye, nemeeta esipata, oojo ore orrekie le Nkai naa enkoitoi naduporeki.
Ketii dupoto sapuk orrekie le Nkai te nebo enkidipakinoto.
Amu eitu apa kiyau ae toki atua enkop, nimikindim aawaita hoo toki aaitung'uai enkop.
Kake ti nikiaata endaa o nkilani, ore kiaata kuna, neidip iyiook nena.
Kake ore lelo ooyieu neaku karsisi naa kedoiki ntemat nedoiki atua orreshet, nedoiki atua mbaa kumok e modai, naaitameisho neitadoiki iltung'ana atua enkitarruorroto o enkidaaroto.
Amu ore enyorrata oo mpisai ninye entonai oo ntorrok pooki naa te nkaraki ena pee etapaashari ilkulikae aaing'uaa enkirukoto nerem iltauja lenye too nkitamiot kumok.
Kake ore iyie, lo tung'ani le Nkai, ilanya kuna pooki, ing'oru esupatisho o rrekie le Nkai o enkirukoto o enyorrata o enkitashoto o emborron.
Taarisho te ilo arrabal sidai le nkirukoto; imbung'a ina kishui nemeiting, nikimpotokoki apa pee imbalie te dukuya ilchakenini kumok.
Ore te dukuya Enkai naa ninye naishoo empuaan pooki toki; o te dukuya Kristo Yesu laa ore shakenisho enye te dukuya Pontio Pilato neibalunye enkirukoto enye,
aaitanap inchere, imbung'a inkitanapat miata olduruk nimiaata enikimpotokini o metabau eliooto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.
Naa keibalunyeki ena te nkata naishiaakino, ilo omayiana naa ninye ake Olaitoriani loo laitoriak;
laa ninye ake le meye, obik te wang'an nemeing'urayu. Nemeetae aekata oltung'ani otoduaa ninye nemeeta oloidim atoduaa. Metaa enenye enkanyit o enkitoria intarasi. Eesai.
Ore lelo karsisi le na kop inkoo pee mepik osiligi atua enkarsisisho enye nemebikoo, kake peyie eisilig Enkai naiputaki iyiook nena pooki pee kishipakino.
Nchoo ninche eaku supati, nekarsisu too iasat sidain, neretisho neleng'u sii,
amu te nena eitobiraki ate olkitamanyunoto sidai too nkolong'i naapuonu, peyie eyooki aang'amu ina kishui naa ninye nara katukul.
Oo Timoteo, torripo ina toki apa nikisiligieki. Talama nena kirorot neme no rrekie le Nkai, o mpaashat e nena naaitaae eng'eno te lejare.
Amu ena eibung'a kulikae nepong'ori neitu etil enkirukoto. Metaa empiris e Nkai te nebo intae.
Paulo, olkipaaret le Yesu Kristo te yieunoto e Nkai te risioroto e nkisiligata e mpuaan natii atua Kristo Yesu.
Timoteo enkerai ai nanyor aigeroki: Metaa te nebo iyie empiris o lng'ur o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa o Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang.
Te naadamu oshi te nkomono dama o kewarie naisho Enkai enashe, ina naisiaaita to oltoilo lo ltau owang, anaa apa iloo papa.
Ore te nadamu ilkiyio linono ina kata apa inchirita, naayieu naadol dama o kewarie, peyie aaboreyu eng'ida.
Kadamu sii ina kirukoto ino nasipa, enkirukoto apa naitera amany kokoo ino Lois, o ng'utunyi Oinike, nayiolo taata aitisip nchere etamanya atua iyie.
Te nkaraki ina peyie aaitadamu nchere nyaaki ntopiu enkishooroto e Nkai natii atua iyie ninoto apa te nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik aainei.
Amu eitu eisho iyiook Enkai oltau le nkuretisho kake oltau le ngolon o le nyorrata o le nkibooroto e maate.
Mikurru naa te nintayu shakenisho o Laitoriani lang aashu te nanu oloena lenye, kake tonyorrai erishata ino o sina litum te nkaraki ororei supat te ngolon e Nkai,

naitajewuo iyiook neipot iyiook teina kipototo nasinya, neme te nkaraki esupatisho oo nkiaasin ang, kake te nkaraki esupatisho e yieunoto enye makewan o te mpiris naishoo ninye iyiook tiatua Kristo Yesu apa moitie.
Neibalunyeki taata te lotunoto o Laitajeunoni lang Kristo Yesu, oiwuang'ie keeya neyau puaan o enkishui nemetii keeya.
Te nkaraki ele rorei pee aategeluaki mataa olalikioroni o Lkipaaret o laiteng'enani,
naa te nkaraki ena pee aata ele sina. Kake madol enkurruna amu kayiolo ilo lairuko natisipua nchere keidim ninye atorripo ina naaisiligieki nanu o metabau ina olong.
Tusuja ilo rrekie loo rorei ooata puaan apa litoning'uo te nanu, te nkirukoto o te nyorrata natii atua Kristo Yesu.
Torripo ina sipata nikinchooki iyie te Nkiyang'et Sinyati natamanya atua iyiook.
Iyiolo ajo ore lelo pooki ootii Asia neibelekenyate, naaing'uaa nanu, ore te lelo netii Figelo o Ermogene.
Meishoo Olaitoriani olng'ur enkaji e Onesiforo amu aaitagolo ninye oshoke katitin kumok, eitu edol isura too lpisia le enata ai,
kake ore pee ebau Roma naing'oru omaanoto.
Meidimie Olaitoriani menoto olng'ur te ina olong kenya o Laitoriani, niyiolo sii eneba esiaai nataasa Onesifero te Efeso.
Ore naa iyie, enkerai ai, tagolo te mpiris natii atua Kristo.
Ore ina nitoning'o te nanu te dukuya lchakenini kumok, intarasaki lelo tung'ana ooisiligayu ooidim sii ninche aaiteng'ena ilkulikae.
Tonyorrai tang'arieki osina anaa osikari odupa le Kristo Yesu.
Meetae osikari otii enjore oisho metarruesha mbaa neme ne njore, amu ore enayieu ninye naa pee eitiship ilo oigero.
Meishori olokuet enkopiyia e nkitoo mme keshomo te risioroto oo nkitanapat.
Ore olaturoni le nkurma onyok keiririkino netum ilng'anayio le dukuya.
Tadamu kuna najo amu eikincho Olaitoriani ening'unoto te pooki toki.
Tadamu Yesu Kristo, otopiwuo aing'uaa ilootuata, le ntalipa e Daudi, anaa enainosuaki te ilo rorei supat lalikioo.
Lelo omon supati laa te ninye aainosieki osina o maateeni too lpisia anaa olarruoni. Kake ore ororei le Nkai nemeena.
Neaku kang'iri pooki toki te nkaraki lelo gelunot, pee etum sii ninche aanoto ina jeunoto tiatua Kristo Yesu, te nebo enkitoo oo ntarasi.
Ororei osipa ele nchere: Ti nikituata te nebo ninye, naa eikiyiooki sii aaishu te nebo ninye.
Ti niking'iri nikiyiooki sii aaitoreisho te nebo ninye; ti nikimiki ninye nemiki sii ninye iyiook;
ti nimikisiligayu, neton ninye eisiligayu - amu meidim ninye atomiki kewan.
Intadamu iltung'ana linono ena, nintanap te dukuya Olaitoriani, metapaashare enchankar oo rorei amu meretisho, kake keiminie ake lelo ooning.
Tonyuaa intoduaai kewan te Nkai ajo inyorraro, nira olaisiaayiani lemeeta enaitukurru, oasishore te nkitoriokinoto ilo rorei osipa.
Tapaasha nena kirorot e pesho nemetii euriata e Nkai, amu iltung'ana ake erikoo metalama euriata e Enkai oleng.
Ore inkirorot enye nedaari anaa enkeeya nayieng'i, ore te lelo netii Hermenayo o Fileto;
ootapong'o enkoitoi nasipa, eji kejo eidipa empiunoto oo lootuata atulusoi, neibelekeny enkirukoto e kulikae.
Kake etuuno Enkai olkitamanyunoto le nkirukoto, nepik ele mishire ojo, “Keyiolo Olaitoriani lelo oora ilenyena,” neitoki ajo, “Ore pooki ng'ae oipot enkarna o Laitoriani nchoo eing'uaa entorroni.”

Ore atua enkaji sapuk neme ntokitin e saabu o ne nkosholai ake natii, kake ketii sii noo nkeek o ne nkulukuoni, ore nkulie neasishoreki too mbaa e tipat ore nkulie neasishoreki too mbaa neme ine tipat.
Te neituku oltung'ani kewan nepaash iloirerioni, neaku emasaai naasishoreki te nkanyit naitisinyaki pee easishore olopeny enkaji, neirragieki aaitaanyu nena siaaitin sidain.
Neaku ilanya naa ng'uarrat e lelero, ning'oru esupatisho o enkirukoto o enyorrata o eseriani, te nebo lelo ooipot enkarna o Laitoriani to ltau owang.
Tapaashare enchankar e modai nemeeta enajo, iyiolo iyie ajo ilarrabali ake eiu.
Meishiaakino osinka lo Laitoriani te neaku olo larrabal kake keishia paa oltung'ani oibor oshoke te pooki ng'ae, olaiteng'enani onyor aiteng'enisho, ong'iri,
nererioo te mborron lelo ookesh ninye, amu ebaiki neidim Enkai aishoo meirridu nepuonu aayiolou ina sipata.
Pee ebaiki neisik aaing'uaa oorreshet le Sheitani, otang'asa apa aibung metaasa enayieu ninye.
Kake tayiolo ena nchere ore too nkolong'i e nkiting'oto naa kepuonu nkatitin oo sinaitin.
Amu keaku iltung'ana iloonyor ate, iloonyor mpisai, iloowuasa, ilooilash, iloomorisho, iloogolong'aki intoiwuo enye, ilemeeta enashe, nemeure Enkai.
Iloorook oishuaa, ilemesayiayu, nekurrisho, nemeeta esupatisho, ilemeibooyo ate too ntorrok pushunot, ilooiba esupatisho.
Ilooudoo ilkulenye, neipopong'a to lwuasa, iloonyor esikar alang enanyor Enkai.
Iloitaakuno kenyor Enkai netanyaita engolon enye. Talama iyie iltung'ana ooikununo neijia.
Amu ore tiatua ninche netii lelo ooruk inkajijik, neibung nena kituaak naamoda naanapita lolan loo ng'ok nerikito ng'uarrat enye oo mpukunot kumok,
nkituaak naainining pooki ng'ae nemebaiki aikata eyiolounoto e ina sipata.
Anaa Yanes o Yampres ootanyaita enatejo Musa, neijia sii etiu kulo tung'ana ootanyaita esipata, iltung'ana ootarruoitie indamunot ninche.
Kake meeta dikae nebaya ilenkirukoto e nkitaakuno amu keibalayu emodai enye te pooki anaa ene lelo tung'ana apa pokira oaare.
Kake indipa iyie atoduaa enkiteng'enare ai o rrekie lai o enaipirta te nkishui ai o nkirukoto ai o eng'iriata ai o enyorrata ai, o enkitashoto ai o
inkisilisilot aainei o sinaitin laainei. Iyiolo iyie nena naaineputua te Antiok o te Ikonio o te Listra, eneba inkisilisilot nating'iria nanu; kake ore te nena pooki naatokordua Olaitoriani.
Kesipa ore lelo pooki ooyieu neibung orrekie le Nkai tiatua Kristo Yesu, nemeeta nchere pee meisilisili.
Ore lelo tung'ana torrok o lalejak neponari aaku torrok, elejisho neleji sii ninche.
Kake ore iyie, tobiko te nena nindipa atayiolo aitisip, amu iyiolo iyie ajo aing'ae likinteng'ena nena.
Naa ore ebaiki keraisho ino itayiolo lelo kigerot sinyat likindim aaiteng'ena te njeunoto naimu enkirukoto tiatua Yesu Kristo.
Ore ilkigerot pooki naa Enkai nayang'ua naa keeta dupoto te nkiteng'enare o te nkisikong'ata o ereriot o te nkitubulunoto tiatua esupatisho,
paa ore oltung'ani le Nkai neitabari te nkiaas pooki sidai.
Aaitanap iyie te dukuya Enkai o Kristo Yesu, laa ninye oyooki aiguanare ilooishu o lootuata, o teina lotunoto enye,
tolikioi ele rorei, isosiono te nkata sidai o te ntorrono. Inguanaki intijing'ai, nisikong, ninkok niaaku olemesi te ng'iriata o te nkiteng'enare.

Amu kelotu enkata nemeyieu iltung'ana neng'iri ina kiteng'enare supat kake kesuj ninche iyieunot enye neing'uraki ate ilturrurri loo laiteng'enak ooitabaya nena naayieu ninche, te ng'ion oo nkiyiaa enye.
Nepaash inaasipa aasuj inkaatini e lejare.
Kake ore iyie ntasho anaake, ting'iria osina, taasa esiaai o lalikioroni, ntabai enkisiaayiare ino.
Amu eidipa atabau enkata pee aaitaae olasar. Etabawua enkata e lototo ai.
Ataarare olarrabal sidai, naidipa ina kuetata, natagolie enkirukoto.

Ore ebaiki taata aatushumakaki nanu enkopiyia e nkitoo e supatisho, naa Olaitoriani, ilo arishani asipani laayooki aisho teina olong, neme nanu ake eishori, kake keishori sii lelo ootonyorra aanyu enkata naliooyu ninye.
Tonyuaa oleng, tasieku ene natii.
Amu ore Demas, etonyorra ena kop e taata naashomo aing'uaa nelo Sesalonike. Eshomo Kreskes Galatia neshomo Tito Dalmatia.
Luka ake openy laaboitare. Ing'oru Marko pee ishoru, amu kaaretu oleng te siaai.
Airriwayie Tikikos meshomo Efeso.
Ore te nilotu iyie nishoru olkila apa latung'ueikia Karpo te Troas o mbukui sii, neisulaki nena oo ndapan.
Ore Aleksanta ele kunoni loo suyan aaitaasa ntorrok oleng, keitalak Olaitoriani te nkaraki nkiaasin enyena.
Torripo naa kewan te ninye amu etishirraka aany olkilikuai lang.
Ore apa ang'orito kewan te dukuya nemetii hoo obo laatijing'a enkoriong; aatung'uaitie pooki. Oi ake eaku meikenakini ninche ena!
Kake eitasho Olaitoriani te nkalo ai, naaisho nanu engolon nalimunye ororei te lulung'ata, pee etum iloreren pooki aatoning, neaku aatang'adieki enkutuk o lng'atuny.
Ee kaakordu Olaitoriani te ntorroni ake pooki, naaitajeu aaitaany ina kitoo enye e keper metaa enenye enkitoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Eesai.
Iroroki Priska o Akuila o enkaji e Onesiforos.
Etobiko Erasto te Korinto natung'uayie Trofimo emuoi te Mileto.
Tonyuaa tasioku eton eng'or enkata e nkirobi. Kirriwaki Eibulo enkirorokino naa neijia etiu Punten o Lino o Klaudia o lalashera pooki.
Metaa Olaitoriani te nebo enkishui ino. Metaa empiris e Nkai te nebo intae.
Paulo osinka le Nkai olkipaaret le Yesu Kristo, pee eitubulaa enkirukoto e lelo gelunot le Nkai o eng'eno naishiaakino orrekie le Nkai,
te ilo siligi le nkishui nemeiting, oisiligie apa Enkai nemeeta elejare ninche apa moitie;
ore ake pee eiririkino enkata, neibalunye tiatua ororei lenye aimunye ina likioroto naaishooki nanu mainosai te nkitanapata e Nkai Olaitajeunoni lang.
Tito aigeroki, enkerai ai nasipa tiatua enkirukoto niking'ar. Meeu enitii empiris o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa o Kristo Yesu Olaitajeunoni lang.
Te nkaraki ena apa pee aatung'uayie te Krete, pee itum aitobira mbaa naang'or, nigelu ilpayiani too nkang'itie pooki anaa enaatuutaka,
olpayian lemeeta eleyiata, olee le nkitok nabo, neiruko inkera enyena, nemekurri aajo aiserseri aashu mening'isho.

Amu ore olaitasheikinoni te nkaji e Nkai, naa olaisiaayiani le Nkai, meishiaakino neeta eleyiata; nchoo eaku mme ole makewan aashu olosieku engoro, aashu emera, aashu arruoni aashu eeta olorok le dupoto.
Kake keishiaa paa aminin, olonyor esupatisho, oloata entonata sidai, oloitoriori, sinyati neibooyo kewan.
Neibung akurraki ilo rorei osipa anaa enaiteng'enishoteki, pee eidim ninye aishooi eutaroto tiatua ina kiteng'enare supat, neibooyo lelo ooishankarra.
Ketii iltung'ana kumok lemening'isho, ooata irorei le pesho, oolejisho neisul lelo ooibung imbaa e muratare aitaa enjeunoto.
Meeta nchere emeitigiri ninche, meitoki aaibelekeny ilmareita oolulung'a eiteng'enisho nena nemeitoriori ejo pee etumisho te ntorroni nemeeta esipata naiteng'enishore.
Ore obo lenye maate eji laa kejo ninche oloiboni, nejo, “Ilalejak oshiaake Lkrete, ilowuarak torrok, ilaikoshuaak turua!”
Ekesipa ena shakenisho. Metaa isikong'a ninche te mpijan pee etum aataa supati te nkirukoto
alang te nesuj nkaatini oo Lyahudi aashu nkitanapat oo ltung'ana ooany isipat.
Ore to supat naa eisidain intokitin pooki kake ore te ilo torrono o too lemeiruk meetae entoki sidai. Eidurukieki eng'eno enye o ltoiloishi loo ltauja lenye.
Kejo ninche keyiolo Enkai, kake neany ninye too nkiasin enye; ilainyalak ninche, oogolong'u lemeeta tipat ti ae siaai sidai hoo nabo.
Kake ore iyie Tito nteng'enisho nena naaishiaakino enkiteng'enare sidai.
Tiaaki ilpayiani kituaak meiririki mbaa, nedupayu naa ng'eni, neaku sidain te nkirukoto, te nyorrata, te nkitashoto o te ng'iriata.
Tiaaki nkituaak moruak neijia, metaa inaayanyitayu to lkuaak, nepal olmarenke nemeaku rrindiki e merai; nchoo eiteng'enisho nena sidain.
Neiteng'eni sii isiankikin metonyorra ilpayiani lenye o nkera enye,
neaku ng'eni neisosion, neramatisho ti ang, naa supati, nening ilpayiani lenye pee memenuni ake ororei le Nkai.
Neijia sii nkuna, tiaaki ilpayiani ooti pee eibooyo ate.
Intoduaai kewan too mbaa pooki, niaaku enkitanyaanyukoto oo nkiasin sidain. Ore te nkiteng'enare ino ntodolu esipata o ltau o entukunyakinoto,
o enkiroroto sidai nemeidimi aatusukeny, pee etumi aaitukurru ilo okeshisho, meeta ae torrono najo tialo iyiook.
Tiaaki irrindiki metoning'o ilaitoriak lenye, neitiship ninche te pooki bae, nemeeta ntorok naawaliki, pee eitoduaaya esupatisho pooki,
paa ore too mbaa pooki nejukaa enkiteng'enare e Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang.
Amu eitaliooki empiris e Nkai te nkaraki enjeunoto oo ltung'ana pooki,
neiteng'en iyiook maibai nena pooki neme nne Enkai, o ng'uarrat e nkop, nikitoni te nkiririkinoto, o te nkitorioroto o to rrekie le Nkai tena kop,
nikiaanyu osiligi lang omayiana, ina lotunoto e nkitoo e Nkai ang kitok o Laitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo,
oishorua kewan te nkaraki iyiook, pee elaku iyiook aitung'uaa entorroni pooki neitisinyaki kewan iltung'ana lenyena. Lelo ooata enyuaata te nkaraki nkiasin sidain.
Mbalunye kuna baa, nkoo ninguan te ngolon pooki. Mincho hoo oltung'ani obo mikitemena.
Ntadamu iltung'ana metaa ilooning'isho too laitoriak nening'isho, neas pooki siaai metii esunkuroisho,
nememor likae tung'ani, nepaash olarrabal, neaku loobor, neitoduaaya esupatisho too ltung'ana pooki.

Amu eikira sii apa iyiook ilmoda, nikigolong'u, neitapong'oyioki iyiook, nikiaaku rrindiki loo ng'uarrat o sikarri oo mpukunot pooki, nikinturraa nkolong'i ang te ntorroni o lom, neibayuni iyiook iltung'ana nikimbayuno iyiook maate;
kake ore ake pee eliooyu esidano o enyorrata o esupatisho e Nkai Olaitajeunoni lang,
neitajeu ninye iyiook neme te nkaraki nkiasin nikitaasa iyiook tiatua esupatisho, kake te nkaraki olng'ur lenye, te nkitukuoto o enkitang'ejukoto o einoto tiatua Enkiyang'et Sinyati,
ina natubukoko ninye iyiook te nkiputakinoto tiatua Yesu Kristo Olaitajeunoni lang,
pee eikenaki iyiook esupatisho te mpiris enye nikiaaku ilajung'ok lo siligi le nkishui oo ntarasi. Ororei osipa ele.
Kayieu naa nimbung akurraki kuna baa, peyie aa ore ilooiruko Enkai nejurru aaitayiolo ate nkiasin sidain; kuna ninche sidain naata dupoto too ltung'ana.
Kake tapaasha nkirorot emodai o ishoritin oo lmakui o mpaasharot o enchankar oo mbaa oo nkitanapat, amu meeta eretoto naa pesho.
Ore oltung'ani okepari indipa aikoo ninye ene dukuya o eniare, talama.
Iyiolo ajo ore oltung'ani oikununo inji netapong'ori naa kaaing'okoni netudung'oko kewan enkiguana.
Te nairriu nanu Atemas aashu Tikikos meeu enitii, tonyuaa oleng, wou ene natii te Nikapolis, amu atonyorayie pee aton teine te nkata e nkirobi.
Tonyuaa isosionie Senos, ilo aiteng'enani loo nkitanapat o Apolos te lototo enye; nimincho eng'oriki hoo toki.
Naa nchoo iltung'ana lang meitamoo ate nkiasin sidain, pee eretu nkolati naarrish pee meaku ilemeeta ilng'anayio.
Eirriwaki intae enkirorokino kulo pooki laboitare. Iroroki lelo pooki oonyor iyiook tiatua enkirukoto. Metaa empiris e Nkai te nebo intae pooki.
Paulo oena te nkaraki Yesu Kristo o Timoteo olalashe lang - kingeroki Filimon likinyor oasisho te nebo iyiook
o Afia enkanashe ang o Arkipos osikari te nebo iyiook, o esirit natii atua enkaji ino.
Meeu empiris enitii o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa lang o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.
Aisho Enkai ai enashe te naadamu iyie te nkomono ai,
amu aning'ito enyorrata ino o enkirukoto niaata ti atua Olaitoriani Yesu o lelo sinyat.
Naomon paa ore ing'arie ilkulikae enkirukoto ino, neitubulaa eyiolounoto enena pooki supati naara nkunaang ti atua Kristo.
Amu anoto nanu eng'ida sapuk o enkilejilejata naayaka enyorrata ino, olalashe lai, amu eitagoloki iltauja loo sinyat te nkaraki iyie.
Ore etiu neijia, hoo naaitieu ti atua Kristo, aaitanap taasa ina naishiaakino,
Kake ore te nkaraki enyorrata, nayieu naasai nanu Paulo, Olbalusui lo Laitoriani naena taata te nkaraki Kristo Yesu
aasai nanu iyie te nkaraki enkerai ai Onesimas, ataa nanu menye ti atua eenata ai.
(Ore apa te dukuya naa pesho ninye te iyie, kake ore taata netaa ole tipat oleng, te iyie o te nanu.)
Naa kairriu nanu ninye metushukunye enitii, airriu oltau lai kewan.
Kayieu naaji naa kaiboo maataboitare, peyie aatum aisiaayia te rishata ino, te enata ai te nkaraki Ororei Supat;
kake atejo maas aetoki eitu atum ewalata ino pee metiu esupatisho ino anaa earakinoto kake pee eaku eyieunoto ino makewan.
Ebaiki naa ina apa pee kintung'uayioki Onesimas te nkiti kata, pee kintokini aaitaboitaki ntarasi,
meekure aa orrindik, kake etuluso alang orrindik, etaa olalashe onyorri, eisulaki te nanu kake eisul naa oleng te iyie, te pokira are to sesen o to Laitoriani.
Metaa te naa eikinken nanu ajo kira nabo, tang'amu ninye anaa naaji eniking'amu nanu.
Te nikinyala apa ninye ti ae bae aashu te neeta esile ino e ae toki, nchoo eaku esile ai.
Nanu Paulo oigero ena te nkaina ai makewan. Ekalak nemaimaki esile nikiaatayie nanu ebaiki kewan ino.
Ee, olalashe kayieu nanu dupoto te iyie ti atua Olaitoriani. Entagolo oltau lai ti atua Kristo.
Ore amu kaaisilig ajo ining'isho, aaigeroki kuna ayiolo ajo ias oleng aitulus enatejo.
Ore te nebo nena, intobirakaki olgilata loo lomon, amu aisilig ajo ore te nkaraki enkomono inyi naa kaaishori nanu maeu enitii intae.
Kirriwaki enkirorokino Epafras, ilo oena te nebo nanu te nkaraki Kristo Yesu.
Naa neijia etiu Marko, o Aristakos o Demas o Luka ooasisho tenebo nanu.
Metaa empiris o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo te nebo enkiyang'et inyi.
Eirori apa Enkai iloo papa too nkoitoi kumok o too mpukunot kumok too loibonok lenyena,
kake ore te kuna olong'i naabayie neirorie iyiook to Inoti otegelua ninye metaa olajung'oni loo ntokitin pooki, olaa te ninye eitayioki enkop.

Ninye oitodolu enatiu enkitoo e Nkai naa ninye otaa olmishire le naikununo Enkai, naa ninye oibung'ita shumata o enkop to rorei le ngolon enye. Ore apa pee eidip aitobira enkipooto oo ng'ok, neton te tatene e Nkitoo te keper.
Eidipa Enkerai aisula ilmalaika amu ore enkarna nanoto naa ninye nalusoo too nkunenye.
Amu kalo malaika etiaaka Enkai ae kata nchere, “Ira iyie Oinoti lai latoiwuo tele kekun?” Aashu sii, “Kaaku nanu menye lenye, neaku ninye Oinoti lai?”
O sii, pee eyau olkikau lenye enkop nejo, “Inchoo eserem ninye ilmalaika pooki le Nkai.”
Ore tialo ilmalaika nejo ninye, “Oloitaa ilmalaika lenyena isiwuoishi, neitaa isinkan lenyena ilng'ejepa le nkima.”
Kake etejo tialo Oinoti lenye, “Ore olorika lino, iyie Enkai naa oloo ntarasi o ntarasi orinka le supatisho ilo rinka le nkitoria ino.
Itonyorra iyie esupatisho nimbayu entorroni. Ore te nkaraki ina nikitubukoko Enkai ino eilata aput, nikiela te ilata e ng'ida nalang ene sirit ino.”
Ore sii, “Iyie, Olaitoriani, oitobira enkop te nkiterunoto, ore keper naa esiaai oo nkaik inono.
Keishari ninche, kake ibik ake iyie, kemusanu ninche, kake ibik ake iyie, kemusanu ninche anaa enkila,
naa iyie oyooki apiyai ninche anaa enkila neibelekenya ninche. Kake itiu iyie anaa apake, nemeishunye ilarin linono ntarasi.”
Kake kalo malaika etiaaka aekata Enkai, “Totona te nkaina ai e tatene o metaba anaa naitaa ilmang'ati linono olorika loo nkejek inono?”
Aime nkiyang'eta aisiaayiak ake ilmalaika pooki oirriwayioki meisiaaisho, te nkaraki lelo ootum enjeunoto?
Ore te nkaraki ina, keishiaakino nikirrip nena nikitoning'o oleng, pee mikipaashare ake aaing'uaa.
Amu amaa tenaa keewuo olkilikuai apa otolimutuo ilmalaika neaku ore engilata enye aashu eanyata netum enkitamioto,
kaji kijeunye iyiook ti nikintololoiki enjeunoto kitok naba inji? Olaitoriani otang'asa alimu ena jeunoto te dukuya, neetuo aaishakenoki tialo iyiook lelo apa ootoning'o ninye.
Neishakenoko sii ninye Enkai too lmonek o too mbaa e nking'asia o too mpukunot kumok e nking'asia o too nkishorunot e Nkiyang'et Sinyati naaori te risioroto e yieuna enye.
Amu mme ilmalaika eishoo Enkai meitoria enkop nalotu, naa ninye ena nikiimaki.
Eishakenoki aajo te dikae, “Kainyoo ninye oltung'ani linkenaa iyie, anaa enkerai e tung'ani niramat iyie?
Iyie oitadowuo ninye te nkiti rishata meeu abori lmalaika, naa iyie oishoo olmarisian le nkitoo o enkanyit,

nintadowuo pooki toki meeu abori nkejek enyena.” Nitipika pooki toki abori enkitoria enye, nemeetae ae toki natelekua nemeitore ninye. Ore anaa enatiu, eton mikidol iyiook pooki toki, tiabori enkitoria enye.

Kake kidolita Yesu, otang'asaki aaitadou te nkiti rishata metadou abori ilmalaika, neishooki enkopiyia e nkitoo o enkanyit te nkaraki emion enye e keeya, peyie aa te mpiris e Nkai eishamishama ninye keeya te rishata e pooki ng'ae.

Amu keiririkino apa paa ore Enkai, olaa inenyena naa te ninye pee eetae intokitin pooki naa ore pee etumoki ninye atorikoki inkera kumok enkitoo, neiteraka emion neitaa bayaroti ilo oipirua enjeunoto enye te mion o larikoni.
Amu ore ilo oitisinyi o lelo ooitisinyi nebo eing'uaa pooki. Naa ina pee mekurru Yesu te nejo ninche ilalashera
Nejo, “Kaliki ilalashera laainei enkarna ino, naaisis iyie te mpolos e umata.”
Nejo sii, “Ekapik nanu osiligi lai atua Enkai.” Neigil ake ajo, “Nele nanu o nena kera naaishoo nanu Enkai.”
Ore naa te nkaraki nang'ar inkera nkiri o sarge, etang'arie sii ninye Yesu makewan ina pukunoto, paa te keeya etum ninye aitarruoi ilo oata engolon e keeya, aa oloirirua,
netum atokordu lelo pooki ooena te nkishui enye pooki te nkaraki naure keeya.
Amu kesipa nchere mme lmalaika doi eret kake eishoi e Abraham.

Te nkaraki ina pee eishooki Yesu metotiwuo anaa lalashera lenyena too mpukunot pooki, pee etum ataa olapolosani oata olng'ur neisiligayu te siaai e Nkai, netum aitayu enkitukuoroto oo ng'ok oo ltung'ana.
Amu ore te nkaraki netamio ninye makewan pee etemi, ekeidim ninye atareto lelo ootemi.
Ore te nkaraki nena, lo alashera sinyat, oong'ar enkipototo e keper, entadamu Yesu, olkipaaret naa olapolosani kitok likilikioo.
Etaa ninye oloisiligayu tialo ilo otegelua ninye, anaa apa sii ninye Musa pee etaa oloisiligayu tiatua enkaji e Nkai.
Kake ore ninye Yesu neikenakaki nchere keiririkino enkitoo nalang ene Musa anaa te neeta oloshetu enkaji enkitoo nalang ene nkaji.
Amu keeta ake enkaji pooki oloteshetua kake Enkai olashetani loo ntokitin pooki.
Etaa apa Musa oloisiligayu anaa olaisiaayiani te pooki naatii enkaji e Nkai, pee eishakenoki mbaa naanyaakaki aalimu te siadi.
Kake ore Kristo netaa oloisiligayu te nkaji e Nkai anaa Oinoti. Nikira iyiook enkaji enye ti nikimbung aakurraki empijan ang o lwuasa tiatua ilo siligi lang.
Ore te nkaraki ina, anaa enajo Enkiyang'et Sinyati, “Ore taata ena olong, ti nining'ining'i oltoilo le Nkai,
emintagol iltauja linyi anaa te napa gogong'i, te napa olong e ntemata ti ong'ata,
peyie aatem iloo minyi, nedol isiaaitin aainei too larin artam.
Ore te nkaraki naaitagoro ilo porror, najo, ‘Kepaashari oshi ake ninche tiatua iltauja lenye; neitu aekata eyiolou inkoitoi aainei.’
Ore anaa enainosa olmumai te ngoro ai, ‘Mejing aekata ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata ai.’ ”
Entodol ate, lo alashera, pee metii ake atua intae likae linyi lo ltau torrono, lemeiruk, orik intae nesulaa neitapaash Enkai naishu.
Kake entaretunoto anaa ake, anaa neton ejoitoi, “Taata ena olong,” pee megolu likae linyi lukunya te nkaraki elejaroto oo ng'ok.
Amu Kristo king'ar iyiook te nesipa eikikurraki aaibung empijan ang o metabaiki enkiting'oto,
eton ejoitoi, “Ore taata ena olong, ti nining'ining'i oltoilo lenye, emintagol iltauja linyi anaa te napa gogong'i.”
Kakua apa lelo ootoning'o oltoilo le Nkai neitoki aagolong'aki? Aime lapa pooki ootung'uaitie Misiri ootorikuo Musa?
Naa kakua etagorokine Enkai too larin artam? Aime lelo ootaasa ng'ok, ooitanang'a iseseni lenye ilo purkel?
Naa kakua einosaka Enkaiolmumai ajo, mejing enkiyeng'iyeng'ata enye ntarasi, ei kulikae leme lelo ootogolong'akita?
Neaku kidol aajo eitu eidim ninche aatijing ine te nkaraki neitu eiruk.
Ore te nkaraki ina eton eetae enkisiligata najing'ieki enkiyeng'iyeng'ata e Nkai, emaing'ura ake pee meiguanareki ake likae linyi neji eturua ebaiki.
Amu etabaikitia iyiook lelo omon supati anaa enatabaikitia sii ninche; kake ore ilo kilikuai otoning'o ninche neitu eret, amu eitu einepu enkirukoto tiatua lelo ootoning'o.

Amu iyiook ilooiruko oojing ina kiyeng'iyeng'ata, anaa ina natejo Enkai nchere, “Ore anaa enainosa olmumai tiatua engoro ai nchere, ‘Mejing ae kata ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata ai ntarasi,’ ” hoo neidipate isiaaitin enyena ebaiki apake pee eitamanyuni enkop.
Amu eimakaki enkolong e naapishana te dikae nejo nji, “Neyeng'iyeng'a Enkai te nkolong e naapishana eidipa isiaaitin enyena pooki.”
Nenyaaka ake ajo teine wueji, “Mejing aekata ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata ai.”
Ore naa amu ketiooyo pee ejing kulikae ine, ore lelo ootang'amutua lelo omon supati neitu ninche ejing te nkaraki neitu eiruk.

Enyaaka naa Enkai apik ae olong, “Taata ena olong”, etejo te Daudi etulusoyie enkata naado, te lelo rorei ooidipaki aairoro, “Ore taata ena olong ti nining'ining'i oltoilo le Nkai, emintagol iltauja linyi.”
Amu tenaa keidipa apa Yoshua aishoo ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata anaata eitu eitoki Enkai aimaki ae olong.
Neaku eton ake eetae enkiyeng'iyeng'ata e Sabato oo ltung'ana le Nkai;
amu ore pooki ng'ae, ojing enkiyeng'iyeng'ata e Nkai nepal sii ninye isiaaitin enyena anaa enatapala Enkai inenyena.
Ematonyok naa pee kijing ina kiyeng'iyeng'ata, pee mebatata hoo obo te ngolong'u naaijo ina apa enye.
Amu keishu ororei le Nkai neeta engolon, nepi ninye alang olalem ake pooki opi mbat pokira, neimisho enarish oltau o enkiyang'et, neim irubat o ntolo, neyiolou indamunot o nkiguanat o ltau.
Naa ore te dukuya Enkai, meetae hoo toki te nena naaitayioki naisudoro kake keibala pooki neboluno te dukuya inkonyek e ilo likiyaki imbaa ang.
Ore naa amu kiaata olapolosani kitok oilepa keper, Yesu, Oinoti le Nkai, ematukurraki aaibung elimunoto ang.
Amu mme olapolosani likiaata olemeidim atayiolo enchalan ang, kake ore ilo obo likiata naa oloidipaki apa aatetem anaa enatemitae iyiook, kake eitu eas ninye ng'ok.
Ematinyikaki naa ilo orika le mpiris kintieu, pee king'amu olng'ur nikitum empiris naretu iyiook te nkata e ngoloto.
Amu ore olapolosani ake pooki ogeluni tiatua olorere netegeluaki metaasisho te nkaraki olorere tialo Enkai, neitayu nkishoorot o lasarri te nkaraki ing'ok.
Neidim ninye ataretu te mborron ilmoda o lwushuush, enapita ninye makewan enchalan enye.
Ore te nkaraki ena, meeta nchere pee meng'as aitayu olasar loo ng'ok enyena makewan neitayu sii noo ilkulikae tung'ana.
Nemeetae oloisho kewan ina kitoo, kake Enkai naipot, anaa apa pee eipot Aron.
Neaku ore sii ninye Kristo eitu eilepie kewan meitaae olapolosani kitok, kake ketegelua ilo otiaaka ninye, “Ira iyie Oinoti lai taata aatoiwuo iyie,”
anaa pee ejo te dikae wueji, “Ira iyie olapolosani ntarasi, to lkerreti le Melkisedek.”
Ore too nkolong'i enyena o sesen etoomonuo Yesu esaisho, nebuaku oleng too lkiyio, esai ilo apa oidim aitajeu te keeya, netoning'oki ninye te nkaraki naure ninye Enkai.
Amu ore hoo naa Oinoti ninye le Nkai, eitamoo kewan enkirukoto teina mion nanoto,
naa ore amu eitabayioki, etaa ninye enjeunoto oo ntarasi te lelo pooki ooning ninye,
neitaa Enkai ninye olapolosani kitok to lkerreti le Melkisedek.
Ore tena bae naa keetae nkumok naaji naagol elimunoto, amu eijo ketagolo intae ilukuny mining'ung'u.
Amu ore aa intae naaji taata ilaiteng'enak, eton eiririkino tenelotu likae aigilie aiteng'en intae nkiterunot o rorei le Nkai. Eton aa kule naairirikino intae, mme endaa nagol;
amu ore pooki ng'ae laa kule ake eishuyie naa kaalani to rorei le supatisho, amu eton aa enkerai ninye.
Kake ore endaa nagol naa enoo ltung'ana botoro, ene lelo ooiteng'enaki to lmoo metayiolo aatirishu isupati o ntorrok.
Ore naa ematogiroi nkiterunot oo nkiteng'enat e Kristo emaape dukuya aabulu pee meaku aikintoki aaitamanya enkirridunoto naipirta isiaaitin naatuata, o enkirukoto e Nkai,
o enkiteng'enata e nkisuja o enkiteleikinoto oo nkaik, o empiunoto oo lootuata, o enkiguana oo ntarasi.
Naa aikiaas kuna pooki eishorua Enkai.
Amu meidimayu neitokini aitasheyie te nkirridunoto lelo ooidipaki aaitawang'a, neishamishama enkishorunoto e keper, netang'arieki Enkiyang'et Sinyati,
neishamishama esupatisho o rorei le Nkai o engolon e ina kata nalotu.
Teneitoki ninche etii nena, aaibelekenya neany eiruk, amu ilo Inoti le Nkai eigil aashe maate nepik enkurruna metalioyu.
Amu ore enkop naok enkare nashaiki nkatitin kumok, nebulaki endaa naret lelo ooturokini, netum emayianata naing'uaa Enkai.
Kake te neiu ilkiku o endiati, neaku pesho nenyikaki oldeket; naa empejoroto eiting'oki.
Ore hoo naa neijia etiu tinikiro, ore te intae, ilanyor laainei, kesipa nchere kiatayie intae osiligi loo mbaa naaikash e njeunoto.
Mme Enkai neme asipani metaa kerikino enkisiaayiare inyi o enyorrata nintoduaaitie tialo lelo sinyat ooisiaaisho, neton ake isiaaitata.
Ekiiyeu neitoduaaya pooki ng'ae linyi enyuaata naikununo neijia pee itumutumu emborei oo sipat o siligi o metabaiki enkiting'oto,
pee miaakuku yietuti, kake ilooduaaya lelo laa te nkirukoto enye o te ng'iriata etujung'o nkisiligat.
Amu ore pee eisho Enkai Abraham enkisiligata naa ore amu meetae likae kitok olang oinosie olmumai, neinosie kewan olmumai,
ejo, “Kesipa kaamayian nanu iyie naaponaa.”
Neaku ore Abraham, etobiko neng'iri, netum ina naisiligieki.
Oltung'ani kitok alang kewan einosie oltung'ani olmumai naa ore te nchankar ake pooki naa olmumai oitadedeyie ina shankar pooki.
Neaku ore apa pee eyieu Enkai neitoduaaya tukul nchere meibelekenya enkiguana enye, nepik olmumai,
peyie aa too mbaa are nemeibelekenya, naa te nena meidimayu pee eaku Enkai olalejani, kinoto iyiook ilooisikakita aasaru eretoto nagol nikimbung'ie ilo siligi otipikaki dukuya iyiook.
Kiata iyiook ena ng'ape nauno naenikino oltau, naa osiligi ojing agiroo oliatua lo lkarasha orish enkaji e Nkai,
ine neshomo Yesu aituruk te nkaraki iyiook, eidipa ninye ataa olapolosani kitok intarasi to lkerreti le Melkisedek.
Amu ore ele oji Melkisedek, olaiguanani le Salem, naa olapolosani le Nkai natii shumata te pooki. Netanang'are ninye Abraham eshukunye eing'uaa enjore natimirie ilaiguanak, nemayian ninye;
naa ninye etoorikia Abraham ematua e tomon e pooki toki. Ore te walunto e nkarna enye naa olaiguanani le supatisho, naa olaiguanani le Salem, “Eji Olaiguanani le seriani”.
Meeta ninye menye anaa ng'otonye, nemeeta entipat, nemeeta eneiting'ie enkishui enye, kake etiu anaa ilo Inoti le Nkai, ora olapolosani ntarasi.
Ng'ura eneba enkitoo enye! Eishoo papa lang Abraham ninye ematua e tomon oo yarunot.
Naa ore lelo le ishoi e Lawi oong'amu empolosare neetae inaaitanapaki tiatua nkitanapat meishoo olorere ninche ematua e tomon, naa too lalashera lenye, hoo naa le ishoi e Abraham sii ninche.
Kake ematua e tomon naishoo Abraham Melkisedek hoo neme ole ishoi oo Lawi naishoo metamayiani ninye, otang'amua nkisiligat.
Metii enchankar inchere olkitok ake omayian oloti.
Ore tene, iltung'ana ooyooki aaye oong'amu ematua e tomon, ore teine, naa ilo obo oitadedeyieki aajo keishu.
Keidim doi ninye oltung'ani atejo ore ninye Lawi makewan, oishoro metang'amu ematua e tomon, eishooyie ematua e tomon te Abraham,
amu eton apa etioyo too sapo e nkakuyiaa lenye pee enang'are Abraham Melkisedek.
Ore naa tenaa ketumoyu apa bayarotisho te mpolosare oo le Lawi, amu te ninche etang'amutua ilo orere nkitanapat, kainyoo eitokini aayieunye likae apolosani olotu to lkerreti le Aron?
Amu te neibelekenyi ilapolosak neibelekenyi sii ninche inkitanapat.
Amu ore ele oimaki kuna baa naa ole likae osho lemeeta ninye aekata oltung'ani lenye otopolosishe to lperere lo lasar.
Amu keibala ajo olosho le Yuda etoikioki Olaitoriani lang, naa ore te ilo osho, neitu ejo Musa ae naipirta ilapolosak.
Keitoki ena bae awang'u oleng te neinyototo likae apolosani lo rrekie le Melkisedek,
ajo eitaaki olapolosani neme to rrekie loo nkitanapat anaa te ntipat o sesen ake eeta engolon, kake te nkidimata e nkishui nemeidimi aaishie.
Amu keitaikiaki ninye shakenisho nchere, “Ira iyie olapolosani ntarasi to rrekie le Melkisedek.”
Ore te nabo alo, eiwuang'ieki enapa kitanapata naituruku te nkaraki nashal nemeeta dupoto,
amu meetae entoki nataa bayaroti te nkaraki nkitanapat, ore te nkae alo, eyawuaki osiligi oikash, laa te ninye kinyikaki iyiook Enkai.
Neitu easi ina metii olmumai.
Ore lelo apa ooitera aaku ilapolosak netaa metii olmumai, kake ore ele netolimuoki to lmumai, “Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai nemeibelekeny enatejo inchere, ‘Ira iyie olapolosani intarasi.’ ”
Ena naishoo Yesu meitadedeyie osotua olusoo to likae.
Ore lapa apolosak ooiturukutuo naa kumok esiana enye, amu etomitikio keeya ebikoo te mpolosare;
kake eibung'ita ninye Yesu empolosare enye nemeiting, amu kebik ninye intarasi.
Ina pee eidim ninye aitajeu nkatitin pooki lelo ooimu ninye epuonu aanyikaki Enkai, amu keishu oshi ake ninye netumoki atoomonoki ninche.
Amu keishiaakino te iyiook, ti nikiata olapolosani kitok oba nji, osinyati, lemeeta entiyoto, nemeeta entibili, olotirishuaki too laing'okok neilepieki aaitogiroo shumata.

Meetayie ninye tipat, anaa enatiu apa lelo kulikae apolosak, meeta tipat napolosishore anaake, to lbae loo ng'ok enyena makewan, neitoki apolosisho to lbae loo ng'ok o lorere, eitabayie ninye ina nabo kata ake apa pee eishooyo kewan.
Kesipa nchere nkitanapat naaitaa ltung'ana ooshal ilapolosak kituaak, kake ore ilo rorei lo lmumai, otusujua nkitanapat, netegelua ilo Inoti bayaroti obik intarasi.
Ore embae sapuk te kuna baa naa ena: eikiaata doi iyiook olapolosani kitok oba neijia, olotonita te tatene e Nkitoo e keper,
olaisiaayiani le ine wueji sinyati o le ilo ng'obor osipa leme oltung'ani oitasheyie kake Olaitoriani.
Amu ore olapolosani ake pooki netegeluaki meishooi nkishoorot neitayu lasarri, naa keishiaakino apa neeta sii ninye ele apolosani entoki naishooyo.
Ore te naa kena kop etii, nemeaku hoo olapolosani, amu keetae naa lelo kulikae apolosak ooishooyo nkishoorot anaa enajo nkitanapat.

Neisiaai ninche nyaanyukie o loip le ine wueji sinyati te keper; amu ore pee eaku keun Musa olng'obor, netuutaka Enkai ninye nejoki, “Toduaa taa ntobira pooki toki nturubare lelo sirat likintoduaaki to ldoinyio.”
Kake ore anaa enatiu, enoto ninye Kristo enkisiaayiare naisul ele sotua oyau ninye, amu eitabayioki too nkisiligat naalusoo te nekua.
Amu tenemeeta apa ilo sotua le dukuya ntiyot, naa anaata meetae ae nayaunyeki likae liaare.
Amu ntiyot etoduaa Enkai te ninche pee etejo: “Kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, naa kayooki aitayu osotua ng'ejuk o enkaji oo Siraeli o enkaji e Yuda.

Nemetiu anaa olapa sotua laitayio o loo menye enapa olong pee aibung ninche te nkaina ariku aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri; amu eitu ninche etoni tiatua osotua lai, naa ina pee eitu aitoki ashilaa ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.

Nele osotua laitayu o enkaji oo Siraeli te nelusoo nena olong'i, Olaitoriani ojo. Kapik inkitanapat aainei atua ilukuny enye, naiger ninche tiatua iltauja lenye, naa kaaku Enkai enye, neaku ninche iltung'ana laainei.

Nemeitoki pooki ng'ae aiteng'en ole latia enye aashu eiteng'en pooki ng'ae olalashe lenye, ajoki, ‘Tayiolo Olaitoriani,’ amu kaayiolou pooki nanu, eiteru to loti te pooki o metabaiki olkitok te pooki.
Amu katum kenya ake olng'ur tialo ntorrok enye, nemaitoki aekata adamu ng'ok enye.”
Ore eimaki ninye osotua ng'ejuk neitaa Enkai musana ole dukuya. Ore ilo omusanu aaku moruo netinyikaka enkiishata.
Ore doi ninye ilo sotua le dukuya naa keeta apa irrekiei le seremare o ewueji sinyati e nkop.
Amu eitobiraki olng'obor li oriong, laa atua ninye etii olkilang'et o emisa o emukate nasinya; neji ine Ewueji Sinyati.
Ore ti oriong olkarasha li aare neitashe olng'obor oji ewueji Sinyati Oleng,

netii olperere lo lasar le nkorropil le saabu o ilo sanduku lo sotua omura pooki alole te saabu, netii atua ilo moti e saabu natii mana, o enapa ng'udi e Aron natubulakita mbenek, o lapa soito lo sotua;
netii ilkerubi le nkitoo ooitushurita ilo orika lo lng'ur. Ore kuna tokitin nimikindim aaimaki taata nikisipu.
Ore pee eidipi aaitabai kuna kitobirat, neaku kejing ilapolosak anaake atua ilo ng'obor aaitabaya empolosare enye;
kake ore ilo ng'obor li are, olapolosani kitok ake ojing, ore ninye naa kata nabo to lari, nemejing meetae osarge oishooyo te nkaraki kewan enye o te nkaraki inkitarruorrot e ilo orere.
Te na bae eitodolu Enkiyang'et Sinyati inchere eton mebolo enkoitoi najing'ieki ine wueji sinyati eton ake eitashe ilo ng'obor lioriong,
naa ina enkitanyaanyukoto e na kata taata. Ore te risioroto ele rrekie neishoori inkishoorot, o lasarri kake meidim aaitaa supati indamunot e lelo oosaisho,
kake endaa ake eipirta o enaoki o enkitukuore oo mpukunot kumok, naa imbaa naaitore osesen naatuunoki o metabau enkata e nkibelekenyata.
Kake ore eewuo Kristo anaa olapolosani kitok loo mbaa supati naapuonu, neaku ore to lng'obor kitok obaya, leme inkaik naaitobira, inchere (ime olena kitayunoto),
etijing'a ninye nabo kata Ewueji Sinyati, neme osarge loo lkineji o lasho etoshoroyie kake osarge lenye makewan, neitadedeyie teina elakunoto oo ntarasi.
Amu amaa te naa ore iltung'ana ooiduruk naa keituku enkisuaakinoto o sarge loo lkineji o loo loing'ok o nkuruon e ntawuo te nkipooto o sesen,
kebaa naa elusoo osarge le Kristo, laa teina Kiyang'et oo ntarasi eishoo kewan Enkai meeta entiyoto eituku indamunot inyi neitung'uaa intae isiaaitin naatuata esiaayia Enkai naishu.

Ore te nkaraki nena, Kristo olaitutumoni lo sotua ng'ejuk, paa ore lelo ooipotoki netum inkisiligat e njung'ore oo ntarasi, amu enotoki keeya ng'ejuk nalaku too nkitarruorrot lelo ootii abori lido sotua le dukuya.
Amu ore te neetae empalai e njung'ore, neng'asi ake aaitadedeyie keeya eilo oitujung'ishe.
Amu pooki ake pee ejung'ishoi naa te neetae olotua, amu mejung'ishoi eishu olojung'isho.
Naa ina pee eitu apa eitabari olapa sotua musana metii osarge.

Amu ore apa, keimaki ake Musa enkitanapata ake pooki enena aliki olorere nedumu osarge loo lasho o loo lkineji, te nebo enkare o lpapit oonyokie loo ntare o lchani oji hisop, neisuaaki embuku kewan o lelo tung'ana pooki,
ejoito, “Osarge ele lo sotua oitanapa intae Enkai.”
Neiko sii neijia ilo sarge eisuaaki kunda pokira are, ilo ng'obor o ntokitin pooki naasishoreki te seremare.
Kesipa nchere, ore to lkerreti loo nkitanapat, osarge apake eipokieki pooki toki, naa ore eitu eibukori osarge nemeetae empalakinoto oo ng'ok.
Neaku meeta apake kata nemeitukui kuna tokitin naa inkitanyaanyukot ake e nekua e keper aaipokie kulo asarri, kake ore nena tokitin maate e keper neipokieki lasarri oolang kulo.
Amu eitu eitijing'i Kristo, ewueji sinyati naitobiraki too nkaik naa enkitanyaanyukoto ake e idia nasipa, kake atua keper kewan etijing'a, paa keitashe taata te dukuya Enkai te rishata ang.
Neme keitoki ninye Kristo aigiligil aishooyo kewan, anaa enaiko ilo apolosani kitok ejing atua ine Wueji Sinyati anaake to lari eeta osarge leme o lenye;

amu te naa neijia etiu, naa anaata eigilieki ninye emion ana apa moitie pee eitamanyuni enkop. Kake ore enatiu, etaliee ninye nabo kata ake te pooki eiting'o enkata pee eiwuang'ie ing'ok eitaa ninye kewan olasar.
Naa ore anaa enaye iltung'ana nabo kata ake, ore pee elusoo ina nelotu enkiguana,
neijia sii etiu Kristo, ore eidipaki aaitarasai ena nabo newa ng'ok oo lkumok, keliooyu eni are, neme ng'ok elotu aararr kake kelotu aitajeu lelo ooanyita ninye te yieunoto sapuk.
Ore amu oloip ake le nena sidain naapuonu eeta nena kitanapat neme nekua tokitin naasipa naara, meidim aekata lelo asarri ooitaini te pooki ari, aaitaa bayarot lelo tung'ana oonyikaki.
Amu te naa keidim anaata apa meekure eitaini. Te naa keitukuoki lelo aseremak, anaata meitoki aayioloiki ate ng'ok.
Kake ore tiatua lelo asarri netii enkitadamunoto oo ng'ok anaake te pooki ari.
Amu meidimayu metaa osarge loo loing'ok o lkineji ooya ng'ok.
Naa ina paa, ore apa pee elotu Kristo enkop, nejo, “Ore ilasarri o nkishoorot nimiyieu kake kintobiraka iyie nanu osesen.
Ore ilasarri oopeji o nkishorunot oo ng'ok neitu ishipakino iyie.
Ina pee atejo, ‘Ng'ura nele nanu, oewuo pee aas eniyieu, eyieunoto ino, Na Ai ai!’ Anaa enatisiraki tialo nanu tiatua olpiyayati le mbuku.”
Ore pee ejo te ine te shumata, “Eitu iyieu iyie neitu ishipakino ilasarri o nkishoorot naapeji o nkishoorot oo ng'ok.” (Neishooyioki kuna te risioroto anaa enajo nkitanapat),
nenyaaka aponaa ajo, “Nele nanu, aewuo pee aas eyieunoto ino.” Keiwuang'ie ninye idia e dukuya peyie etum aitasheyie eniare.
Naa ina eitukuyieki iyiook te nkishorunoto o sesen le Yesu Kristo nabo kata ake te rishata e pooki.
Neitashe olapolosani ake pooki anaake te siaai enye, neigil aitayu iloshi ake asarri, lemeidim aekata aawaita ng'ok.
Kake ore pee eidip Kristo aitayu olasar loo ng'ok obo ake loo nkatitin pooki, neton ninye te nkaina e tatene e Nkai.
Paa teine eton o metaba anaa neitaae ilmang'ati lenyena olorika loo nkejek enyena.
Amu to lasar obo eitabayie ninye te nkata pooki lelo ooitukuoki.
Neitaiki sii ninye iyiook enkiyang'et Sinyati shakeni; te nkata nasuju ejo,
“Nele osotua laitayu nanu o ninche te siadi nena olong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, naa kapik inkitanapat aainei iltauja lenye, naiger ninche too ndamunot enye.”
Neitoki aponaa nejo, “Ore ing'ok o nkitarruorrot enye nemaitoki adamu aekata.”
Ore enetii empalakinoto e kuna, nemeitoki atii olasar loo ng'ok.
Ore te nkaraki nena, ilalashera, ore naa amu eikiaata iyiook enkitieunoto nikijing'ie ine wueji sinyati to sarge le Yesu,
teina oitoi ng'ejuk naishu nataboloko ninye iyiook te ilo karasha, aa taa to sesen lenye,
nikiaata sii olapolosani kitok oitore enkaji e Nkai.
Ematinyikaki to ltau osipa tiatua emborei e nkirukoto, neisuaakaki iyiook aaisuj ltauja lang metaa mikiaata nkibirribirrat torrok too ltauja lang neisujaki iseseni lang te nkare nasila.
Emaibung'a aakurraki elimunoto o siligi lang mikingusugus, amu keisiligayu ilo oishorua ina kisiligata;
naa ematadamu enikinkunakino olikae olikae enkisusunkat o enyorrata o siaaitin sidain.
Nimikipalaa entumo, anaa enatiu olkuaak le kulikae, kake intagolo olikae olikae neisul idolitata aajo etinyikua ina Olong.
Amu ti nikiaas ing'ok aaotiki kindipa aatang'amu eyiolounoto e sipata, nemeitokini aata olasar loo ng'ok,
kake enkuretisho e anyunoto e ndung'okinoto e nkiguana, o engoro e nkima namut lelo mang'ati.
Ore apa oltung'ani ogil nena kitanapat e Musa neye metii olng'ur te neetae shakenisho oo ltung'ana aare aashu okuni.
Ijo kebaa elusoo enkitamioto nayaki kewan oltung'ani oany Oinoti le Nkai, neisarkionie osarge lo sotua laa ninye eitukuyieki neitagor ina Kiyang'et e mpiris?
Amu eikiyiolo ilo otejo, “Enaai elap, nanu oitalaku.” Nejo sii, “Olaitoriani oiguanare iltung'ana lenyena.”
Entoki naitureisho ti nibatatakino inkaik e Nkai naishu.
Kake entadamu sii intae napa olong'i e dukuya ina kata apa eidipaki aaitawang'aki intae, ning'iriri enkitirrishakinoto nagol te nebo o emion,
neaku kebolori intae metamori te dukuya olorere neisilisili intae, nitaa ti aekata encholiek e lelo ooikunaki neijia.
Amu iatata apa olng'ur too looena, nitonyorraitie te nchipai meishang'itieki masaa inyi, amu iyiololo apa aajo iatata intae maate entoki nalang naa enabikoo.
Ore te nkaraki ina, eminturraa naa empijan inyi, amu keeta olerrinyore kitok.
Amu meeta nchere pee ming'iriri, pee itumutumu aataas enayieu Enkai, ning'amumu ina kisiligata natolimuoki,
“Amu keng'or enkiti kata, pee elotu ilo olotu nemeimutie;
Kake enkirukoto eishuyie osinyati lai, naa te nerrinyo siadi, nemeshipakino oltau lai ninye.”
Kake mikira iyiook ile lelo oorrinyo siadi nemuti, kake kira ile lelo ooata enkirukoto negolie iltauja lenye.
Ore enkirukoto naa ninye naitadedeyie intokitin naaisiliguni, naa ninye enkitisipata e nena tokitin nemelioo.
Amu te nkirukoto etonyorrarrie Enkai iltung'ana li apa.
Te nkirukoto kiyiolo aajo eitayioki enkop te nkiroroto e Nkai, neaku ore kuna naadolitai naa too nemelioo eitobiraki.

Te nkirukoto eyaka Abel Enkai olasar ong'amaroyu alang ole Kain, laa ninye etonyorrarrie Enkai ninye ajo eisupat. Etaa Enkai shakeni amu etang'amayie olasar lenye; etua ninye Abel kake ore te nkirukoto enye neton eirorita.
Te nkirukoto ewaki Enok aailepie pee medol keeya; neitu etumi, amu Enkai naawa ninye. Naa ore eton eitu eilepieki neitisipaki nchere eitishipa ninye Enkai.
Naa ore metii enkirukoto nemeidimayu peyie eitishipi Enkai. Amu ore pooki ng'ae oyieu nenyikaki Enkai keishiaa neiruk inchere keetae Enkai naa ninye oisho inkishoorot lelo ooing'oru ninye.

Te nkirukoto eitoduaa Enkai Noa nena baa apa neton melioo, nening ninye neitobir esafina pee esaru enkaji enye; tena bae etudung'oko Noa enkop enkiguana neaku ninye olajung'oni le supatisho natumi te nkirukoto.
Te nkirukoto etoning'ishe Abraham pee eipoti metupuku alo ewueji nelotu atum nejung; nepuku ninye nelo, nemeyiolo enelo.
Te nkirukoto etobiko aa omoni teina kop naisiligieki, anaa te nkop eeiking'a naa ilng'oborri emany o Isaak o Yakobo, oora sii ninche ilajung'ok le ina kisiligata te nebo ninye.
Amu ina anasa apa eanyita naata olkitamanyunoto, enaa ore oloshetu o loitobir naa Enkai.
Te nkirukoto enoto Sara enkidimata e ishoi hoo netaa moruo, netulusoitie ilarin lenyena, etoduaa ninye ajo keisiligayu ilo oishoo enkisiligata.
Te nkaraki ena paa ore eimu oltung'ani obo, hoo netiu apa ninye anaa olotua enotoki eishoi naba te nkumoi anaa ilakir le shumata nemeikenayu, etiu anaa osinyai le mbata e naiposha.
Etuata kulo pooki etii atua enkirukoto, neitu eng'amu ninche enapa naisiligieki, kake etoduaa neirorokito te nelakua, netolimutuo inchere ilomon ninche naa yararot ninche te nkop.
Amu ore lelo tung'ana oojo neijia neibalunye inchere enkop apa nabikie eing'oru.
Te naa kenkop apa natung'uaitie edamu ninche, anaata apa enoto erishata nashukore.
Kake ore anaa enatiu, ae kop eyieu sidai teina, naa ene Keper, te nkaraki e ina pee mekurru Enkai te neji ninye Enkai enye, amu eitobiraka ninye ninche enkanasa.
Te nkirukoto eitayio Abraham, Isaak, enapa kata pee etemi, aishooyo oinoti lenye obo,
oloimakaki aajo, “Isaak eipotieki eishoi ino.”
Etoduaa Abraham ajo keidim Enkai aitopiu iltung'ana ebaiki ilootuata; neaku ore teina kitanyaanyukoto, etushukoko Enkai Isaak Abraham too lootuata.
Te nkirukoto etamayiana Isaak Yakobo o Esau too naapuonu.
Te nkirukoto, etaa keye, etamayiana Yakobo ilayiok le Yosef, eigarakino ninye elukunya e ntirma enye eirrugo aseremisho.
Te nkirukoto etaa keye Yosef, eimaka enaidurra oo Siraeli neutaki eneikunaa enukaroto enye.
Te nkirukoto, pee eini Musa, eisudoyioki lapaitin okuni intoiwuo enyena, amu etoduaa ninche aajo aisidai ina kerai; neitu eureyu ninche ina naitanapishe olaiguanani.
Te nkirukoto, etanya Musa, etubulua, eipoti aajo ole ntito e Farao,
nedutaa meinosieki osina te nebo iltung'ana le Nkai alang te neton aitumurru olkar loo ng'ok.
Etoduaa ajo emoroto namori te nkaraki Kristo naikash alang enkarsisisho o masaa kiroteti e Misiri, amu keanyita idia kishorunoto.
Te nkirukoto eshomo aing'uaa Misiri, neitu eiureyu engoro e ilo aiguanani; amu eting'iria anaa olodolita ilo lemelioo.
Te nkirukoto, eitayio Pasaka neisuaaya osarge, pee, mear ninche ilo Arani loo lkikaunot.
Te nkirukoto etalang'a lelo tung'ana enaiposha nanyokie anaa enkop natoyio; kake ore Ilmisiri pee etem aajo matalang, neya enkare.
Te nkirukoto etuurori isunta e Yeriko etamanaki too nkolong'i naapishana.
Te nkirukoto pee eitu eari Rahab ina mulayoi, te nebo lelo apa kulikae lemening'isho, amu etang'amua ninye lelo aikitalak to sotua.
Naa kakua kulie naitoki ajo? Amu maata enkata naimakinye Gideon, Barak, Samson, Yepta, Daudi o Samuel o lelo oibonok le Nkai
ilaa te nkirukoto etimira inkitoriat, neitabaya te ngolon enkiguana oo sipat, neng'amu nkisiligat, neibooyo nkutukie oo lng'atunyo,
near olkutati le nkima, neilany enepi o lalem, netum enkidimata tiatua enchalan, neaku magil te njore, nemir injoreitin oo lmang'ati.
Etang'amutua inkituaak ilootuata lenye eitopiwuoki, Einosieki kulikae osina etanyaita elakuni, ejo pee eyooki aapiu te mpuaan nalang ina.
Eting'iria kulikae imorot o oshot, o metabaiki ilpisia o jila.
Eirruyaki too soito, nedung'i te musumeno aitaa are, neari to lalem nepuaya eishopito ndapan oo nkerra oo noo nkineji, ilaisinak o looisilisili neinyali,
ilemeishiakino enkop te netii nepuaya too lpurkel o too ldoinyio, o too rrumati o too nkapuniaa e nkop.
Ore kulo pooki, hoo neitadedeyieki te nkirukoto enye, neitu eng'amu ina kisiligata,
amu etasioko apa Enkai adol embae naikash te iyiook, inchere ore mikitii iyiook nemeitabari ninche.

Ore te nkaraki nena, amu kemanita iyiook enkatampoi kitok e lelo shakenini, emaiturrai sii iyiook enkiroishi ake pooki o eng'oki naonyikino iyiook oleng, emaipirrio te ng'iriata teina kuetata natipikaki dukuya iyiook.

Emaimariria Yesu olaa ninye oiterua naa ninye oitabaya enkirukoto ang, olaa ore te nkaraki eng'ida natipikaki dukuya ninye neting'iria osalaba, nemenu ina kurruna, neton taata te nkaina e tatene o lorika le nkitoo e Nkai.
Entadamu intae ilo oting'iria enkiba naba neijia oo laing'okok eiba kewan enye, pee minaururu intae nemidukenyanya tiatua iltauja linyi.
Ore te nkesha inyi iararere ing'ok neton eitu igilunorere o meibukori osarge.
Anaa ketorikine intae ina naikokieki intae anaa nkera? “Enkerai ai, nimimenu earata nikiaar Olaitoriani, nimilepori ti nikiosh ninye!
Amu olonyor eosh Olaitoriani, neitame enkerai ake pooki nang'amu ninye.”
Te nkaraki naa ioshot e nkikoo pee ing'iriri. Eitaasa intae Enkai enaitaas inkera enyena, anaa kaa kerai eetae nemeosh menye arere?
Te nemeoshi intae aarere, anaa enaitaasaki ilkulikae pooki, nitaa nkera naadumuni nimirara inot.
Ore etii ena, ekiaata loo papa lang te nkop ootosho iyiook aarere nikiyanyita ninche. Paa eimikiyanyit naa oleng ilo Papa loo nkiyang'eta pee kinchu?
Amu etoosho ninche iyiook aarere te nkiti rishata anaa enayieu ninche, kake keosh ninye iyiook arere amu eisidai ina te iyiook pee kitum esinyatisho o esupatisho enye.
Ore te pooki rishata ore eoshoto pooki narere oltung'ani nememelok; ore te siadi neiu ilng'anayio le seriani e supatisho te lelo ootarerioki teina.
Ore te nkaraki ina entarrapu nena aik naalepori naa entagolo nena kung inyi naashal,
naa entobiraki inkejek inyi inkoitoi naaitoriori, paa ore ilo ng'ojine nemeburukusha kake pee etumi aaishiunye.
Entonyok eng'oru osotua too ltung'ana pooki o esinyatisho naa ore te nemeetae nemetumi hoo olodol Olaitoriani.
Entodol ake pee meetae hoo obo olau empiris e Nkai; inchere pee metumi “Entonai e nduaran” nabulu neyau entorroni, neaku teina eisarkionieki ilkumok.
Eminchosho etumi oltung'ani hoo obo ololoito aashu olemeserem Enkai anaa Esau, otimira enjung'ore e ikinet enye neinosie endaa e nabo kata.
Amu iyiololo aajo ore te siadi, pee eitoki aayieu nejung ina mayianata, netanyaki ninye, amu eitu etum erishata pee eirridu, hoo neing'orua too lkiyio.
Amu mme doi entoki naiseyieki ietuo enetii, enkima nayupuyup o enaimin o entoki naitureisho o lkutati,
o ltoilo le ntarumpeta o ltoilo laa ore nkirorot enyena netureita lelo apa ootoning'o metasaisho aajo pee meitokini aaigilie kulie kirorot.
Amu meitieu apa ninche aating'iria enkitoria naishooki, “Te neiseyie ninye eng'ues ele doinyio, neari too soito.”
Eituria ina naitoduaaki o metejo Musa, “Kaikirikira nanu te nkuretisho.”
Kake Oldoinyo le Sion ietuo intae o enkanasa e Nkai naishu, Yerusalem e keper, o enetii ilmalaika lemeikenayu ooiturrurro eikodoki,
nietuo eumata oo lkikaunot ooigero te keper, nietuo enetii olarishani laa ninye Enkai e pooki; o enetii inkiyang'eta oo ltung'ana sinyat ooitabayioki,
o enetii Yesu, ilo Aitutumoni lo sotua ng'ejuk, o enetii ilo sarge oisuaayioki neiro te mpiris nalang eno sarge le Abel.
Entodol ake emiaany ele olimu kuna. Amu amaa te neitu eilanyisho lelo ootanyaita ninye te nkop, mikiaata sii iyiook enikilanyie ilo oirorie iyiook etii keper.
Eikirikirie oltoilo lenye enkop ina kata apa; kake eitayio taata enkisiligata ajo, “Eton aigil ena nabo neme enkop ake aikirikirie kake o shumata sii.”
Ore ena bae najo “Kaigil ena nabo,” neitodolu inchere keiwuang'ieki ina apa naikirikirieki, neitodolu ena entoki naitobiraki, pee eing'uari ina nemeikirikirieki.
Ore te nkaraki ina emanoto iyiook enashe kitang'amutua enkitoria nemeidimi aaigusugusie, naa emaishoo Enkai eseremata nang'amaroyu, natii enkanyit o lturiaki;
amu ore Enkai ang naa enkima namutisho.
Entonyorrata anaa lalashera o nkanashera tiatua Kristo.
Emintololoiki enkitoomono oo lomon amu teina eitoomono apa kulikae ilmalaika meyiolo.
Entadamu lelo ootii jila, anaa itii jila te nebo ninche, o lelo ooinyali, amu itii sii intae atua ilo sesen.
Enchoo eyanyiti enkiyama tiatua iltung'ana pooki naa emincho ina rruat e nkiyama eisarkionieki; amu Enkai naiguanare lelo ooibor onyek o loo lololoito.
Entorrip enkishui inyi tialo enyorrata oo mpisai ninchosho ebaiki intae entoki niaatata; amu etejo Enkai, “Maapal maadamu nemaaing'uaa.”
Neaku eikintieu aatejo, “Olaitoriani olaretoni lai, nemaureishoyu. Kaa aaidim oltung'ani aitaasa?”
Entadamu ilarikok linyi, lelo ooinosakita apa intae ele rorei le Nkai, entoduaai inkiasin enye, naa enturubare enkirukoto enye.
Ore Yesu Kristo ninye ake olang'ole taata o ntarasi.
Emincho eitapong'ori intae too nkiteng'enat naapaashaa; amu keishiaakino naa empiris naitagol oltau, neme indaiki, neitu eret lelo ooitudupita.
Eikiaata iyiook olperere lo lasar lemeng'arie iyiook lelo ooisiaaisho teilo ng'obor.
Amu ore nkiri e nena kishu naayau olapolosani ine wueji sinyati aitaa olasar loo ng'ok naa ti auluo enkang oo lng'oborri epejori.
Neaku ore sii ninye Yesu naa ti auluo kishomi einosieki osina pee etum aitisinya iltung'ana lenyena to sarge lenye makewan.
Ore te nkaraki ina emainyoito aapuo auluo enkang oo lng'oborri, nikinapaki nena morot.
Amu mikiaata iyiook enkanasa nikibikie tene, kake ae anasa king'oru nalotu.
Tiatua ninye naa maitaiki Enkai anaa ake olasar le nkisisa, aa inchere, ilng'anayio loo nkutukie naalimu enkarna enye.
Emintololoiki easata oo supati, o eng'arata oo ntokitin niaatata, amu ore ilasarri laaijo lelo naa keitiship Enkai.
Entoning ilarikok linyi niyanyititi, amu iltauja linyi eirrita, anaa iltung'ana ooyookini aikilikuan, enchoo naa eiko ninche neijia te ng'ida, neme to sina, amu meeta ina dupoto te intae.
Entoomonoki iyiook, amu king'idare ena nchere mikiaata nkibirribirrat torrok tiatua iltauja lang, eikiyieu nikiaasisho to rrekie sidai too mbaa pooki.
Atukunyaki intae naleng enkuna neijia pee aasiokini aarrinyoki intae.
Ore naa taata Enkai e seriani nanyaaka ashuku Olaitoriani Yesu aitung'uaa ilootuata, ilo shekut kitok loo nkerra, te ilo sarge lo sotua loo ntarasi,
meishopoki intae pooki toki sidai pee itumutumu aataas ina nayieu ninye, neas ina naitiship ninye tiatua intae; tiatua Yesu Kristo, olaa enenye enkitoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Eesai.
Asai intae ilalashera o nkanashera, emisi tele rorei lai le nkikoo, amu too ndorropu atisiraka intae.
Entayiolo inchere etalakuaki olalashe lang Timoteo, naa kayooki adol intae te nebo ninye te netasiekuo.
Eroroki ilarikok linyi pooki o lelo sinyat pooki. Eiroroki intae ilooing'uaa Italia.
Metaa empiris e Nkai te nebo intae pooki. Eesai.
Yakobo, osinka le Nkai o lo Laitoriani Yesu Kristo, Enkirorokino, too loshon tomon o aare ooidapashakino inkuapi pooki.
Ilalashera laainei, enkenai inchere eng'ida te nitumutumu intemat oo mpukunot kumok,
amu iyiololo nchere ore entemata natemi enkirukoto inyi neyau eng'iriata.
Ning'iriri ometabaiki enkiting'oto pee iakuku ilooiputakinote nelulung'a neitu eng'oriki toki.
Naa te netii olinyi otong'orikia eng'eno, enchoo ninye metoomonu te Enkai naisho iltung'ana pooki te leng'on o te mpiris naa keishori sii ninye.
Kake enchoo ninye eikilikuanu te nkirukoto meeta olng'ash katukul; amu ore oltung'ani oing'ash netiu anaa ilopir le naiposha ooreu osiwuo nekutaa.
Mincho oltung'ani laaijo ilo edamu ajo ketum toki to Laitoriani,
oltung'ani oata mbaa are to ltau lemeuno too rrekiei lenyena pooki.
Inchoo olalashe aisinani metishipayu te nkaraki nailepieki ninye,
ore olalashe karsis enchoo sii ninye metishipayu te nkaraki neitadowuoki, amu etiu anaa intapuka e ntim kelusoo.
Amu keilepu enkolong eirowua, nepej intapuka nemugut, nedoiyio, nerruoyo empukunoto e sidano enye. Neijia ake etiu oltung'ani karsis, kerruoyo eitoritote mbaa enyena pooki.
Emayiana oltung'ani ong'iri too ntemat, amu ore pee eidip ating'iria entemata neng'amu ninye enkopiyia e nkitoo e nkishui naisiligie Enkai, lelo oonyor Ninye.
Emincho ake oltung'ani te netemi, ejo, “Enkai naatetema;” amu metemisho Enkai too ntorrok, nemetem sii ninye Enkai oltung'ani.
Kake ketemi pooki tung'ani, te nkaraki eng'uarrata enye torrono; nayietaa aitalamaa neitasur.
Ore pee eidip ina ng'uarrata anoto intona neiu ing'ok. Ore pee ebaya ng'ok, neiu keeya.
Ilalashera laainei lanyor, eminchosho eleji intae.
Ore entoki pooki sidai o enkishooroto pooki nemeeta entiyoto nedou eing'uaa keper enetii Papa loo wang'aritin, nemeibelekenya Ninye, aashu etii enetii Ninye oloip le nkibelekenyata.
Te nkaraki eyieunoto enye, etoiwuo Ninye iyiook to rorei loo sipat, pee eaku iyiook ilng'anayio le dukuya loo nkitobirat enyena.
Entayiolo ena ilalashera laainei lanyor. Inchoo pooki tung'ani metaa olosioki aning, nemesioki airo, nemesioki sii agoro.
Amu ore engoro o ltung'ani nemeas isipat e Nkai.
Entalama ate olduruk pooki o enkumoi oo ntorrok, ning'amaa te mborron Ororei otuunokoki atua intae oidim aitajeu iltauja linyi.
Emilejileje ate kake entaa laasak lo rorei mme lainining'ok ake.
Amu te neaku ake oltung'ani olaning'oni lo rorei, neme olaasani, netiu ninye anaa oltung'ani oing'or enkomom enye te nking'uret.
Amu keing'or ninye enkomom enye, ore pee elo, nerikino nabo kata enaikununo.
Kake ore olojur asipu inkitanapat bayarot, inkitanapat e lakunoto, nesheikino, nemetiu anaa elde ake oning nerikino, kake olaasani ooata nkiaasin, ore ilo nemaiyiani ti atua iyiasat enyena.
Te nedamu oltung'ani ajo olaseremani le Nkai, nemeitore olng'ejep lenye, kewan elej, ore eseremare enye naa pesho.
Ore eseremare sidai nemeeta entiyoto te nkomom e Nkai, Papa, naa ena: embaikinoto oo ltung'ana okishin o nkolia, tiatua isinaitin lenye o erripoto e kewan pee mitum entibili te nkop.
Ilalashera o nkanashera aainei, emiaaku ilooata olkep imbung'itata enkirukoto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, Olaitoriani le nkisisa.
Amu te nelotu naaji oltung'ani oata ilgiso le saabu, neishopito inkilani sidain atua enkaji inyi e ntumo, nelotu sii ninye ine oltung'ani aisinani oishopito isiapird.
Ning'oring'oro intae elde oishopito inkilani sidain, nishilaa aajoki, “Totona te ne,” nijokiki elde aisinani, “Intasho te nde,” aashu, “Isukudoyu te mbata oo nkejek aainei.”
Aimidol ajo iatata olkep maate, niaakuku ilooiguanare too ndamunot torrok?
Entoning, ilalashera laainei o nkanashera aainei. Keitu egelu Enkai laisinak te nkop metaa karsisi te nkirukoto o lajung'ok le nkitoria naisiligieki lelo oonyor ninye?
Kake eitu iyanyititi intae ilo tung'ani aisinani. Aime ilkarsisi doi ooibooki intae enkop?
Aime ninche doi ooyiataki ntae inkajijik e nkiguana? Aime ninche doi oomor ina arna sidai nayanyiti?
Te nintabayaya inkitanapat o Laitoriani anaa enajo isirat, “Tonyorra olelatia ino anaa eninyor kewan,” itaasa esupat.
Kake te nintodolulu olkep, nitaasa eng'oki, neiguanare intae inkitanapat inchere irara ilagilak loo nkitanapat.
Amu ore pooki ng'ae oibung inkitanapat pooki neitapong te nabo, netaa eitarruoyie te pooki.
Amu ore olotejo, “Miloloito,” netejo sii, “Miaar metua.” Metaa te neitu iloloito, kake itaara metua, itaa naa olagilani loo nkitanapat.
Eroro, niaasishosho, anaa iloopuoi aaiguanare too nkitanapat e lakunoto.
Amu meeta enkiguana olng'ur, te ilo leitu eitodolu olng'ur, kake kemir olng'ur enkiguana.
Kaa dupoto, ilalashera o nkanashera aainei, eeta, te nejo oltung'ani keeta enkirukoto nemeeta nkiasin? Keidim enkirukoto enye aitajeu?
Amaa te nemeishopo anaa te nemeeta endaa olalashe anaa enkanashe,
nejoki obo linyi ninche. “Enchom te seriani, erowuaja, niraposhosho,” neitu eisho ninche nkolati o sesen, kaa dupoto eeta?
Neijia etiu enkirukoto openy, te nemeeta nkiasin, netua naa pesho.
Kake eidim oltung'ani oje atejo, “Iata iyie enkirukoto naata nanu nkiasin.” Intoduaaki naa enkirukoto ino aa ninye ake, metii nkiasin inono ore naa too nkiasin aainei naaitodol enkirukoto ai.
Iruk iyie ajo nabo Enkai? Itaasa esidai. Eiruk sii ninche iloirriruani neikirikira.
Iyieu iyie nikintodoli lo tung'ani omoda inchere ore enkirukoto nemeeta nkiasin naa koolupi?
Amaa papa lang Abraham keitu eikenakini sipat te nkaraki nkiasin, pee eishoyo oinoti lenye Isaak to olperere lo lasar?
Aimidol ajo ore enkirukoto o nkiasin enyena neasisho te nebo? Neitabayioki enkirukoto enye too nkiasin.
Pee ebaya osirata ojo, “Eiruko Abraham Enkai, ore te nkaraki enkirukoto neikenaki Enkai ninye esupatisho,” Neipoti aajo olchore le Nkai.
Idol taa ajo eikenakini oltung'ani isipat too nkiasin mme to lbae le nkirukoto ake.
Aime teina oitoi ake sii oo nkiasin eikenakaki Rahab ina mulayoi isipat pee eng'amu lelo aikitalak, neipang'ie ninche ti ae oitoi?
Ore anaa enatua osesen te nemetii enkiyang'et neijia etiu enkirukoto nemetii nkiasin ketua.
Emincho ilkumok te intae ilalashera o nkanashera aainei eaku ilaiteng'enak, amu iyiololo aajo ore iyiook pooki ooiteng'enisho naa keiguanareki oleng iyiook te nikintadiak.
Amu ore iyiook pooki naa eikintadiak too nkumok naa te netii obo lemeitadiak too naajo, oltung'ani lemeeta entiyoto ilo, oidim sii aitoria osesen lenye pooki.
Ing'ura ti nikipik mbartan isenkenke inkutukie naarewueki, nening iyiook, nikindim aatoboin iseseni lenye pooki anaa enikiyieu.
Eng'ura sii imelin, hoo naa sapuki oleng, nerrumoo olkutati ogol oleng, neutaa ninche enkiti toki aipirie enkalo ake ninye naba anaa enayieu olarewani.
Neijia etiu olng'ejep enkiti rubata to sesen, kake ejo isapuki oleng. Tadamu eneba esapuko e ntim, naidim oloti tiili atapejo?
Ore olng'ejep naa enkima, enkop nebore intorrok ti atua irubat ang, nepik osesen pooki intibil, neinuaaki enkima enkishui o sesen olulung'a te nkima naing'uaa Yehanum.
Amu keidim iltung'ana aaitamo neidipa aaitamo pooki pukunoto oo ng'uesi o motonyi o noo ng'uesi naaiserpepiari te nkop oo noo ng'uesi e naiposha,
kake metii oltung'ani oidim aaitamo olng'ejep, eeta entorroni nemeitirring'a, nebore esayiet nayaisho.
Te ilo ng'ejep kimayian Olaitoriani o Papa, naa ninye kidekie iltung'ana, lelo ooitobiraki te nkitanyaanyukoto e Nkai.
Ina kutuk ake eimu emayian o ldeket. Ilalashera o nkanashera aainei mme neijia duoo eishiaakino netiu.
Keimu enkong'u nabo e nchorro enkare namelok o e naisukut?
Amaa ilalashera laainei, keidim olng'aboli atoiu ilosiyio anaa osabibu ilng'abolo? Meidim sii ninye enchorro naisukut aishoru enkare namelok.
Kaing'ae te intae olng'en neeta endamunoto? Nchoo eitoduaaya te nkishon enye sidai o to lkuaak lenye inkiaasin enyena te mborron e ng'eno.
Kake ti niatata olom odua o enyorrata e ate ti atua iltauja linyi, eminya kutukie nimilejishosho aaibooyo esipata.
Ore ena ng'eno eitu edou eing'uaa shumata, kake ene nkop, o enoo ltung'ana, o enoo loiriruani.
Amu ore enetii olom o enyorrata e kewan, netii olong'oling'oli o empukunoto pooki suuji.
Kake ore eng'eno nagut naing'uaa shumata nesila neeta eseriani, nebor, netemaa mbaa, nebore olng'ur, neiu ilng'anayio sidain, nemeeta olng'ash anaa esunkuroisho.
Ore enkikesare e supatisho neun ti atua osotua lelo ooitayu osotua.
Kainyoo nayau ilarrabali o nchankari ti atua intae? Aime ing'uarrat inyi naara ti atua intae?
Iyieuwu nimitumutumu; ina pee, iariara metuata, ning'uarring'uarra, nimindimidimi aanoto, naa ina pee iarara nidumumu olarrabal. Miaatata toki amu miomonunu te Nkai.
Iomonunu intae nimitumutumu, amu iomonunu te nkoitoi torrono, pee itumokiki aaishang'itie too ng'uarrat oo seseni linyi.
Intae iloololoito, aimiyiololo aajo ore olchore le nkop naa olmang'atinta te Enkai? Ore pooki oyieu neaku olchore le nkop, neitaa kewan olmang'atinta le Nkai.
Anaa aijojo eimesipa isirat oojo, “Ore ina kiyang'et natipika Enkai atua iyiook keeta olom too nguarrat o sesen?”
Kake keisho iyiook empiris nalus, amu ejo isirat, “Keany Enkai iloowuasa neisho empiris ilo obor.”
Entoning naa Enkai, erisha Sheitani, naa keipirri ninye ailany intae.
Entinyikaki Enkai, pee enyikaki sii ninye intae. Entukuo inkaik inyi, intae ilaing'okok, nintukuku iltauja linyi, intae iloo ndamunot maare.
Esinanuoto, ninchirishiri, niyietutu aaishir. Enchoo enkuenia inyi meta enkishirata neaku eng'ida inyi enkimuntut.
Entadou ate te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee eilepie ninye intae.

Emisukenya maate ilalashera laainei, amu ore ilo osukeny olalashe lenye anaa eiguanare olalashe lenye, inkitanapat esukeny, aa ninche eiguanare. Amu te ninguanare inkitanapat, nimira naa olaibung'ani loo nkitanapat, kake itaa oloiguanare.
Obo ake olaishooroni loo nkitanapat o ladung'oni le nkiguana naa ninye oidim aitajeu anaa aitarruoi. Aira iyie ng'ae oiguanare olelatia ino?
Entoning naa lelo oojo, “Kipuo taata anaa taaisere atua enkanasa naje o enaje nikibik teine olari obo nikimirisho, nikitum dupoto.”
Nimiyiololo enayooki atiu taaisere; anaa ainyioo enkishon inyi? Itiuwu ake anaa enkinuku naliooyu enkiti kata, kiti neishunye.
Ore enaishiaakino te nijojo. “Naa inchere te naa eyieunoto Olaitoriani, nikinchu nikiaas ena anaa enda.”
Kake ore eyia, isisisisi ate to lwuasa. Ore ina kinosata e kutuk pooki naa entorroni.
Ore pooki ng'ae oiyiolo ataasa esidai, nemeas, naa eng'oki te ninye.
Entoning taa lo karsisi, enchira nibuakibuaka amu kelotu shumata intae osina.
Netupurdate imasaa inyi, neinosa oriri inkilani inyi.

Ore saabu inyi o nkoshola inyi etodoro einosa enkop, ore ina doron e nkinosata e nkop neaku olmonekie te intae naa kenya inkiri oo seseni linyi anaa enkima. Irragie olchumati loo masaa too nkolong'i e nkiting'oto.
Eng'ura ajo ore olekoisiaayio loo laisiaayiak ootudung'o inkurman, litomito too losekin, etabuaa aishir, netabaikia olkiyioi loo laisiaayiak inkiyiaa o Laitoriani loo lororani.
Inosa intae olkar te nkop, nitonini ti atua inaaitiship osesen, nintotiti iltauja linyi te nkolong e yiang'are.
Itudung'okito enkiguana niaariara metua oltung'ani supat lemeirish ninye intae.

Enting'iria, intae ilalashera o nkanashera; o metabau elotunoto o Laitoriani. Eng'ura aajo keanyu olaturoni le nkurma ilng'anayio sidain le nkop. Neng'iri o metaba anaa netum enchan e dukuya o ene siadi.
Enting'iria sii intae. Entagolo ltauja linyi, amu etinyikua elotunoto o Laitoriani.
Eming'unyung'unyakino, ilalashera o nkanashera aainei pee meiguanareki ake intae, eng'ura eitashe Oladung'oni le nkiguana too nkutukie oo nkajijik.
Entusuj, ilalashera o nkanashera aainei enkitanyaanyukoto o sina o eng'iriata oo loibonok le Nkai ooiroro te nkarna o Laitoriani.
Eng'ura, kijo emayiana lelo oongiri. Itoning'o eng'iriata e Yoab, nitoduaa enaitaasa Olaitoriani ninye te nkiting'oto, amu kenana Olaitoriani oshoke neeta olng'ur.

Kake ore enalang pooki, ilalashera o nkanashera aainei eminya olmumai te shumata anaa te nkop, anaa ti ae ake ninye toki, enchoo “ee” inyi metaa “ee” ake, ore “A'a” neaku “A'a” ake, pee mijing'ijing'i ake abori enkiguana.
Ketii obo ti atua intae oata enyamali? Inchoo eomon. Ketii oloshipa? Inchoo erany isinkolioitin le nkisisa.
Ketii obo ti atua intae omuoi Inchoo eipot ninye ilpayiani le sirit pee eomonoki, neelie ninye eilata te nkarna o Laitoriani;
naa keitajeu enkomono e nkirukoto ilo tung'ani omuoi, neinyeyie Olaitoriani ninye, naa te netaasa ng'ok, nepalakini.
Neeku, embalakinoto ng'ok inyi maate, niomonokinono, pee eishiunyieki intae. Amu eeta enkomono o ltung'ani supat enkidimata sapuk.
Ore Eliya, oltung'ani apake le mpukunoto ang. Netoomono akurraki pee mesha; neitu eshaiki enchan enkop too larin okuni o lapaitin ile.
Neitoki ake aomon, neishoru shumata enchan, neiu enkop ilng'anayio lenyena.
Ilalashera o nkanashera aainei te neibakibak obo linyi aing'uaa esipata, neshuku likae ninye,
nincho ninye metaiyiolo inchere ore pooki oshuku olaasani loo ng'ok aitung'uaa enkoitoi enye e marmalisho, eitajewuo oltau lenye te keeya neitoipoo olorora loo ng'ok.
Petero, olkipaaret le Yesu Kristo - enetii ilgelunot ooidapashakinote Ponto o Galatia o Kapodokia o Asia o Bitinia
ootegeluaki apa neitaanya Enkai Papa te Nkiyang'et metoning'o Yesu Kristo te nkisuaakinoto o sarge lenye. Metoponari tiatua intae empiris o eseriani.
Meisisi Enkai naa Papa lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo! Ore te nkaraki olng'ur lenye sapuk eishoo iyiook metoini aaigil tiatua osiligi oishu te mpiunoto e Yesu Kristo aing'uaa lootuata,
pee kitum enjung'ore nemerruoyo, nemeiduruk, nememusanu naiteng'elaki te keper te nkaraki intae.
Kerripi ntae te ngolon e Nkai te nkaraki enkirukoto inyi, pee itumutumu enjeunoto nairragita ake pee eibalunyieki te nkolong e nkiting'oto.
Entishipata te nkaraki ina, hoo ninye te naa aimeeta inchere pee mitumutumu intemat oo mpukunot kumok te nkiti kata,
ore pee etiu inji, enkirukoto inyi eji pee etemi nenyorrarri aajo keeta tipat alang saabu narruoyo netetemaki te nkima nitumutumu enkisisa, o enkitoo o enkanyit te mbolunoto e Yesu Kristo.
Oleitu idolidolo, ninyorrinyorro ninye, nirukuruku hoo nimidolitata ninye taata, nishipapa, enchipai nemeimakinoyu ebore enkisisa.
Ning'amumu te nkiting'oto e nkirukoto inyi, enjeunoto oo ltauja linyi.
Ena jeunoto apa eing'orutua, neikeni iloibonok le Nkai ooibonutuo empiris nalotu aaku eninyi.
Eikilikuanutua aajo kalo tung'ani naa kaa kata etuutua Enkiyang'et e Kristo natii atua ninche, ina kata apa namurutoo aalimu inkisilisilot e Kristo o enkitoo nasuju.

Etabolokoki ninche metayiolo, inchere imme ate eisiaayiaki te nena kake intae, nena baa naainosakaki intae taata lelo oolikioo ilomon supati te ngolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati nairriwuaki eing'uaa keper naa imbaa naang'uar apa ilmalaika pee edol.
Ore naa entorrip indamunot inyi, eririki mbaa nipikipiki osiligi linyi pooki shumata empiris nayakini intae te mbolunoto e Yesu Kristo.
Anaa inkera naaning'isho, eminturubare ate inapa ng'uarrat niaatata enapa kata imodada.
Kake ore anaa sinyati ilo oipoto intae, entaa sii intae sinyat to lkuaak linyi pooki.
Amu etisiraki aajo, “Entaa intae sinyat, amu kara Nanu Sinyati.”
Naa te naa aimpotipoto ninye aajo Papa, ilo oiguanare pooki tung'ani metii enyorrakinoto eng'ura ate entotoni te nkuretisho tena rishata nitii ene anaa nkisikat.
Iyiololo aajo, etalakuaki intae too rrekiei linyi lemeeta tipat litujung'utuo too loo papaai linyi, mme too ntokitin naaruoyo anaa enkosholai o saabu
kake to sarge ogol enkinyiang'a le Kristo, otiu anaa olkuoo lemeeta entiyoto anaa entibili.
Oloitaanyitai apa eton eitu eitamanyuni enkop, kake keibalunyieki te nkiting'oto oo nkatitin te nkaraki intae,
naa te ninye ing'idarere intae Enkai, ilo oitopiwuo Yesu aitung'uaa ilootuata, neisho ninye enkitoo paa ore enkirukoto o siligi linyi naa atua Enkai etii.
Ore te nkaraki nindipa aaitukuo iltauja linyi te nkibung'ata oo sipat, niaatata enyorrata nemetii esunkuroisho too lalashera linyi o nkanashera inyi, entonyorrata intae maate aakurraki too ltauja.
Etoiwuoki intae aaigil neme te mpeu narruoyo kake te nemerruoyo, eimu ororei le Nkai oishu nebik intarasi.
Amu “Etiu iseseni anaa nkujit, netiu enkitoo enye pooki anaa ene ntapukai oo nkujit. Ketoyu inkujit, nedoiyio entapukai;
kake kebik ororei lo Laitoriani intarasi.” Ore ilo rorei naa lelo omon supati ooinosakaki intae.
Enturrai elap pooki o losek o esunkuroisho o esukeny pooki, nitiuwu anaa inkera naanana,
entang'uar ororei le Nkiyang'et lemeeta olosek, paa te ninye ibululu aabaiki enjeunoto.
Amu inchiamishama enanai e oshoke o Laitoriani.
Wootu enetii ninye, osoit otanyaita iltung'ana, kake etegeluaki, neeta tipat too nkonyek e Nkai.
