Anaa isoito ooishu, pee iakuku inkasisin e mumuaisho sinyati ooitayu ilasarri sinyat le Nkiyang'et oong'uarrayu te Nkai te Yesu Kristo.
Amu etisiraki tiatua Ilkigerot aajo, “Ng'ura airragie te Sion Osoit kitok lo lmairroto, ogeluno negol enkinyiang'a, ore pooki oiruk nemeitukurruni.”
Ore te intae ilo oiruk keeta tipat oleng, kake ore te lelo lemeiruk, etaa “Ilo soit otanyaita ilashetak otaa kitok to lmairroto”
naa “Osoit orror iltung'ana, osoit sapuk obatat iltung'ana,” kerrorro ninche amu etanyaita ening ororei, naa ina apake eji pee eitaaie ninche.

Irara intae olorere ogeluno, inkasisin e nkaji e nkitoo, olorere sinyati, iltung'ana le Nkai makewan, pee itumutumu aainosai inkiaasin enyena e nking'asia, o loipotuo intae entung'uai enaimin aitijing atua ewang'an enye naing'asiasho.
Intae ilemera olorere apa; kake irara taata olorere le Nkai Ileitu apa etum olng'ur kake itang'amutua olng'ur.
Ilanyor laainei asai intae, anaa ilomon o laisikak pee ipaasharere ing'uarrat o sesen naashet enjore naarare iltauja linyi.
Niaakuku ilooata orrekie sidai tiatua Loreren lemeiruk, pee te neiro neiteleiki intae mbaa anaa laasak loo ntorrok, neidim te nedol too nkiasin inyi sidain, aaisisa Enkai te nkolong e mbaikino.
Eyanyita pooki kitoria oo ltung'ana to lbae lo Laitoriani, te naa ko laiguanani kitok,
anaa ilooti te ninye ooirriwuaki meitamio lelo ooas intorrok neisis lelo ooas isidain.
Amu eyieunoto e Nkai inchere ore te yasata oo sidain nintigiriri emodai oo ltung'ana oomoda.
Entotoni anaa iltung'ana oolakuno, nimintaa elakunoto inyi entoki nintiemorierie entorroni, kake entobik anaa ilaisiaayiak le Nkai.
Eyanyita iltung'ana pooki, entonyor ilalashera, o nkanashera eyanyita Enkai niureyuyu olaiguanani kitok.
Lo aisiaayiak entadou ate, niyanyititi oleng ilaitoriak linyi, neme ake isupati nebor, kake o metabaiki lelo ooisomit intae.
Amu ketum oltung'ani enchunet te naa, ore te nkaraki nadamu Enkai neng'iri te neidong'i metii esipata.
Amu kaa dupoto ina, te neitamei intae enkata niaasiasa intorrok? Kake te niaasiasa isupati, ning'iriri te neisilisili intae niaatata enchunet te Nkai.
Amu teina eipotoki intae, amu eisilisiloki sii ninye Kristo te nkaraki intae, neing'ueki intae enkitanyaanyukoto, pee isujusuju iroruat enyena.
Eitu eas ninye eng'oki, neitu etumieki te nkutuk enye ororei lo losek laa ore pee emori,
neitu eshukoki emorisho, ore pee eisilisili neitu ejo aarisho, kake eitarasaka imbaa enyena pooki ilo oiguanare te sipata.
Ninye makewan otanapa ing'ok ang to sesen lenye te nchumata olchani, pee kitum aatuata too ng'ok, nikinchu too supati, too lbaa lenyena eishiunyieki intae.
Amu itapong'ori apa anaa intare naaimina, kake itorrinyokinote taata Olchekut naa Olarriponi loo ltauja linyi.
Neijia entotiu sii intae, na kituaak entadou ate too lpayiani paa te netii te ninche oleitueiruk Ororei, netum aairuko metii ororei te nkaraki olkuaak loo nkituaak enye,
te nkaraki nadol ninche olkuaak linyi sidai, le nkuretisho.
Eminchosho eaku enkuso inyi enioriong osesen, o enchetata oo lpapit, o enkikodo oo ntokitin e saabu anaa ene nkishopoto o nkilani,
kake enaisudoro tiatua oltau, nememuta o emborron o engira, neeta tipat oleng too nkonyek e Nkai.
Amu neijia apa eikuna inkituaak sinyat, naaisilig Enkai te nekus ate, aaning ilpayiani lenye,
anaa enatoning'o Sara Abraham pee eipot ninye ajo olaaitore lai. Nitaa intae inkera enyena, ti niaasiasa sidan, niminchosho toki meituria intae.

Entotiu sii intae neijia lo payiani, entotoni aitobiraki o nkituaak inyi te ng'eno, nincho enkitok inaairirikino anaa entoki nashal, amu irara ilajung'ok te nebo le mpiris e mpuaan pee meiboori enkomono inyi.
Ore enabayie entaa pooki ilooata endamunoto nabo, loobore olng'ur o enyorrata oo lalashera, o nkanashera iloonana oishuaa, ilo obor indamunot.
Neme iloolaakino entorroni te ntorroni, anaa oldeket to ldeket, kake entapaashare intae entamayianisho, amu teina doi eipotoki intae pee itumutumu aatujung emayianata.
Amu ejo ilkigerot “Ore ilo onyor enkishui neyieu nedol inkolong'i sidain, inchoo erishie olng'ejep lenye entorroni nerishie enkutuk enye pee mejo emonkoi.
Inchoo eibelekenya apaashare entorroni neas esidai; inchoo eing'oru eseriani nesuj oleng.
Amu etii inkonyek o Laitoriani shumata oo lelo supati, nebolo inkiyiaa enyena te enkomono enye; kake kegilunore enkomom o Laitoriani lelo ooas intorrok.”
Kaing'ae oidim aitaasa intae entorrono, te naa airara intae ilanyuaak le nena sidain?
Kake te naa keisilisili hoo ninye intae te nkaraki oo supati, imayianana. Emiureyu ninche, nimiruturutu.
Kake ore too ltauja linyi eyanyita Kristo anaa Olaitoriani, enterretenata anaake pee iwalikiki oltung'ani pooki oikilikuan intae embae o siligi otii atua intae. Kake te mborron o te nkanyit.
Entisidana iltauja linyi, paa ore enkata nasukenyi olkuaak linyi sidai tiatua Kristo, netumi aaitukurru.
Amu enaikash te neitamei oltung'ani easita isupati te naa eyieunoto e Nkai, alang te naa intorrok.
Amu etua sii Kristo nabo kata ake too ng'ok nemeigil, osupat too leme supati, pee etum atoriku iyiook enetii Enkai. Amu etaraki metua to sesen neitopiwuoki te Nkiyang'et
te ninye sii eshomo ainosaki ilomon le Nkai nkiyang'eta naa ena.
Lelo apa ootanyaita ening, eton eanyisho eng'iriata e Nkai too nkolong'i e Noa eshetita emeli, ina naa ilkuti tung'ana isiet ake eitajewuoki te nkare.
Naa keitanyaanyukieki ena are enkare e nkibatisa naitajeu neme te nkisujata o loirerio lo sesen, kake eomonoto e Nkai to ltoilo oisiasha lo ltau te mpiunoto e Yesu Kristo,
oilepa alo keper, neton te nkaina e tatene e Nkai, netipikaki te nebo ilmalaika, o enkitoria e ngolon meetu abori ninye.
Ore naa te nkaraki naitamioki Kristo to sesen, enterreten sii intae ate teina damunoto, amu ore pooki onoto emion to sesen nemeitoki aas ing'ok,
pee meitoki ninye arubare imbaa o sesen too nkolong'i enyena naatelekutua te nkop anaa enatiu ing'uarrat oo ltung'ana kake anaa eyieunoto e Nkai.

Nchoo enkata natulusoiyie eidip nena naayieu neas iloreren oolamita Enkai oopuoyie enkiborra oo nkonyek, o ng'uarrat e merai, ooitalala indaat, incholieki e okore, agilak loo nkitanapat ooserem kulie aitin.
Neing'asia te nedol intae mishularere ninche te nena baa e nkiminchalisho, nemor intae;
kake kepuo aaisho iwalat ilo oterretene pee eiguanare ilooishu o lootuata.
Naa te nkaraki ena pee etolikioki sii ilootuata Ilomon Supati le Nkai pee eiguanareki to sesen anaa iltung'ana, nepok te nkiyang'et anaa Enkai.
Etinyikua enkiting'oto oo ntokitin pooki, neaku enoto eng'eno o ndamunot naauno nebor pee itumokiki enkomono.
Ore enalusoo te pooki, embung'a enyorrata nauno olikae o likae amu keitoip enyorrata olorora loo ng'ok.
Intoomono olikae olikae metii enking'unyung'uny.
Taasishore inkishoorot naaba anaa inikinchooki aisiaayie ilkulikae, anaa olaing'urani supat te mpiris e Nkai oo mpukunot kumok.

Naa te neiro oltung'ani inchoo eiro anaa enatiu Ororei le Nkai; naa te neisiaaisho oltung'ani, inchoo eisiaaisho anaa enkidimata naishoo Enkai: pee eisiaai Enkai te pooki toki tiatua Yesu Kristo, laa enenye enkisisa, o enkitoria ntarasi o ntarasi. Eesai.
Ilanyor laainei, eming'asia intae too ntemat naata emion e nkima naapuonu shumata intae, aatem intae anaa duoo kentoki omoni naipang'aka intae.
Kake enting'idata te nkaraki ning'arierie Kristo isinaitin lenyena pee itumutumu sii intae aating'idata te ng'ida sapuk te nkata naibalieki enkisisa o enkitoo enye.
Kake imayianana intae te nesukenyi intae te nkaraki enkarna e Kristo, imayianana amu eton te shumata intae oltau le nkisisa e nkitoo o le Nkai.
Kake emincho obo te intae meitamei te nkaraki etara metua anaa olapurroni, anaa olarruoni, anaa olaisuroni.
Kake te neitamei oltung'ani, eji amu olairukoni, mincho edol enkurruna, kake inchoo eisis Enkai teina arna.
Amu etabawua enkata e nkiguana naa te nkaji e Nkai eng'asu. Amaa te naa iyiook eng'as, kaji pasa etiu enkiting'oto e lelo lemeiruk Ororei supat le Nkai?
Naa, “Amaa aa te pesho eitajeuni Oltung'ani supat, ai ti aaji eliooyu oltung'ani lemeiruk Enkai naa olaasani loo ng'ok?”
Te nkaraki ena enchoo lelo pooki oomeyu te risioroto o enyorrata e Nkai, eas isupati neitarasaki iltauja lenye ilo oitayio enkop oisiligayu.
Neaku airorie ilpayiani ootii atua intae, ara sii nanu olpayian anaa ninche nara olchakeni loo nkisilisilot e Kristo nang'arie enkitoo napuoi aabolu.
Taramata ntare e Nkai niking'orieki, neme te arakinoto kake te nyorrata ino, neme te dupoto e nkurruna kake te yieunoto
neme anaa ilaitoriak ooimagarraki lelo ooishooki intae entaramat, kake aaku enkitanyaanyukoto naduaaya intare.
Pee te neboluni ilo Shekut kitok, neishori intae enkopiyia e nkitoo nemejuto emua.

Neijia enkuna sii intae iltung'ana ooti entoning enkitoo inyi, Enchopoki ate intae pooki emborron anaa enkila, nintadouu ate pee isiaayiayia maate, amu keany Enkai iloowuasa, “Kake keisho empiris ilooitadou ate.”
Entadou naa ate ti abori enkaina nagol e Nkai, pee etum ninye ailepie intae te nkata nageluno.
Enteleiki inkolati inyi shumata Ninye, amu kegolie Ninye intae.
Entashololoto nirretenana amu kemanimanaa olmang'atinta linyi, Sheitani, anaa olng'atuny, oikurrukur eing'oru olonya.
Erisha ninye te nkirukoto nauno iyiololo aajo osina laaijo ele eimatie ilalashera linyi te nkop pooki.

Ore pee indipidipi aanoto osina le nkiti kata, ore Enkai e mpiris pooki naa ninye naipotoko intae atua enkisisa e nkitoo enye oo ntarasi tiatua Kristo, ninye makewan oramat intae, neitirring'ie miwuatiwuatata neitopok, neitasheyie neitagol intae.
Metaa enenye enkitoo o enkitoria, intarasi o ntarasi. Eesai.
Te Silvano, olalashe laaijo nanu oisiligayu, atisiraka intae ena kiti palai, pee aitukuj intae naishakenoki intae inchere empiris e Nkai ena nasipa. Entasho emiwuatiwuata tiatua Ninye.
Eiroroki intae esirit natii atua Babilion nageluno sii ninye anaa intae, neijia etiu enkerai ai Marko.
Erorokinoto intae maate te ng'ututata e nyorrata. Metijing'a osotua intae pooki ootii atua Kristo.
Simon Petero osinka naa olkipaaret le Yesu Kristo oigeroki lelo oonoto enkirukoto naba anaa enaang, tiatua esupatisho e Nkai ang o eno Laitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo.
Metoponari empiris osotua te intae te yiolounoto e Nkai o Yesu Olaitoriani lang.
Engolon kitok e Nkai naishoo iyiook intokitin pooki naaishiaakino te nkishon o te sinyatisho e Nkai, te yiolounoto enye ilo oipotoko iyiook enkitoo o enkishiaan enye.

Naa te na oitoi eishoo iyiook nkisiligat enyena e tipat naa sapuki oleng, paa ore te nkaraki nena nitumutumu aailanya erruorroto natii enkop te nkaraki ing'uarrat, niaakuku ilooshulakino esinyatisho e mpukunoto e Nkai.
Ore te nkaraki ena, entipik enyuaata pooki aponaa enkirukoto inyi, ore enkirukoto niponikiki eng'eno;
ore eng'eno inyi niponikiki enkibooroto e maate, ore enkibooroto e maate enkitashoto, ore enkitashoto esinyatisho e mpukunoto e Nkai.
Ore esinyatisho e mpukunoto e Nkai entoponiki enkaripo e nyorrata too lalashera, ore enkaripo enyorrata too lalashera.
Ore iyatata kuna tokitin te nkumoi nemeisho intae iliarara anaa ilauu ilng'anayio tiatua eyiolounoto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.
Ore pooki ng'ae lemeeta kuna baa naa aimodooni, nemedol enelakua, netorikine enkitukuoto oo ng'ok enyena musan.
Te nkaraki ena, ilalashera entonyok oleng entisipa enkipototo o engelunoto inyi, amu ti niaasiasa ina nimibatata aekata.
Amu tena oitoi eishori intae esipata te leng'on entijing atua enkitoria oo ntarasi o Laitoriani lang naa Olaitajeunoni Yesu Kristo.
Ore te nkaraki ena, kayieuta oshiaake naitadamu intae kuna baa, hoo ninye te naa indipa aatayiolo, nintirring'ang'a tiatua isipat naatii atua intae.
Adol ajo keishakino, eton atii ele ng'obor te nkop, te nainyeiyie intae te nkoitoi e nkitadamunoto,
amu kayiolo ajo, kasioki airragie osesen lai le nkop, anaa enaitoduaa Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.
Kanyok aas anaa enaidim, paa ore aidipa ashomo, nindimidimi aatadamu kuna baa inkatitin pooki.
Amu eitu kisuj iyiook inkaatini naaitobiruaki te ng'eno ina kata kintayiolo intae engolon o elotunoto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, kake kira ilchakenini ootoduaa too nkonyek enkitoo enye e nkisisa.
Amu ore pee eng'amu enchunet e nkisisa e nkitoo eing'uaa Enkai Papa, neewuo oltoilo enetii eing'uaa Enkitoo e nkisisa nalus, nejo, “Oinoti lai ele lanyor, natishipe oleng te ninye.”
Kitoning'o iyiook ele toilo pee elotu eing'uaa shumata amu kiboitare apa iyiook ninye te ilo doinyo sinyati.
Amu kiaata iyiook ilo rorei le naibon oitadedeyieki oleng nitaasa intae esidai te ning'amaa ninye anaa oltaa oilang'ilang ewueji nemisimis o metaba naa nekenyu, neilepu olakira too ltauja linyi.
Ore enaituruk te pooki, entayiolo ena, inchere meetae enaibon oo sirat nalotu ake te yieunoto o ltung'ani makewan,
amu metii aekata enaibon naishoruaki te yieunoto o ltung'ani, kake eiroro iltung'ana sinyat ilomon le Nkai anaa enautaki Enkiyang'et Sinyati eing'uaa Enkai.

Kake enyoito sii apa iloibonok le lejare tiatua olorere, anaa enayooki sii aainyototo tiatua intae ilaiteng'enak le lejare, ooyau too nkisudorot inkiteng'enat naaiminie neitarruoo, nemiki doi ninye Olaitoriani laa ninye oinyiang'ua ninche, neyaki ate enkidaaroto nasieku.
Naa kesuj ilkumok irrekiei lenye torrok, ore te nkaraki ninche nesukenyi enkoitoi oo sipat.
Ore te nkowuarisho enye neitorogony intae too rorei loo monko, amu meyiata enkiguana enye e apa, nemeirura erruorroto enye.
Amu amaa te neitu eing'urrie Enkai ilmalaika apa pee eitarruoo, kake etanang'aka ninche atua enkima, meteeni too ngumot e naimin, ometabau enkata enkiguana,
amaa te neitu eing'urrie enapa kop musana, kake etalakua Noa eserian, ilo alikioroni loo supati te nebo kulikae oopishana, pee eyau oloirrag le nkare shumata enkop oo ltung'ana torrok.
Amaa te neibelekenya Enkai inkang'itie e Sodom o Gomora metaa inkuruon, nedung'oki enkiguana neidaikie, neitaa enkitanyaanyukoto e natiu too nkolong'i naapuonu te lelo lemeure Enkai;
naa amaa te neitajewuo Lutu supat, oitanyamala naleng orrekie lo lduruk loo ltung'ana torrok,
ebikito tiatua ninche, nemeyu oltau lenye supat too iasat enye torrok oo nkolong'i pooki.
Neaku keyiolo Olaitoriani enaiko te nekordu too ntemat lelo ooure ninye, o enaiko pee eibooki enkitamioto lelo ooas intorrok o metabau ina olong e nkiguana
neisulaki lelo oosuj ing'uarrat naaidurukie osesen nemen enkitoria e Nkai. Ilootolo negogong, nemeure ninche aatamor ilo oata enkitoo e shumata.
Ore ninye ilmalaika oolusoo te nkidimata o te ngolon, eitu eyau enkitang'oroto e nkiguana torrono shumata ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani.

Kake ore kulo ootiu anaa ing'uesi nemedamisho, ooitore ing'uarrat e atua ate, ilootoiwuoki pee eibung'i neari metuata, iloomorisho too mbaa nemeyiolo, keidaikieki ninche teina kidaaroto te nebo ninche.
Netum osina torrono te nkaraki iasat enye torrok, nedol ninche anaa olkar te nemera dama, intibil ninche o ntiyot, edaa te nkilepilep, epepeeno enyaita osirua te nebo intae.
Neeta inkonyek naabore eloloito, nemeraposho aekata eas ing'ok. Nelejaa iltauja lemeuno, neeta iltauja ooitamooki ing'uarrat nemeishiaakino, Inkera o Ldeket!
Etung'uaitie enkoitoi naitoriori, eibaabaa aasuj inkoitoi e Balaam olayioni le Beor, otonyorra dupoto naing'uaa easata oo ntorrok.
Kake etabuaakaki te nkaraki natigila ninye makewan inkitanapat; airo osikiria lemeeta enkutuk to ltoilo lo ltung'ani; aibooyo oloirirua le ilo oiboni.
Ore kulo naa inchorroi nemetii enkare, inkinukun naareu olkutati, amu ninche eitaanyaki emisimisi o lodo le nkop.
Amu keiro ninche imbaa o lwuasa le pesho, neitasur too yieunot o sesen, o ng'uarrat torrok lelo tung'ana laa enailanyie lelo ootoni tiatua inkitadiaat.
Eisiligie ninche lelo elakunoto, ore ninche maate naa isinkan le ntorroni; amu ore pooki naidimu oltung'ani neaku ninye osinka le ina naidimua ninye.

Amu amaa eidipa ailanya ilduruki le nkop te yiolounoto o Laitoriani naa Olaitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo, neitoki ake aaisho metarrueshi te ninche, neidimuni, ore imbaa enye e nkiting'oto neaku torrok te ninche oleng aalang ine dukuya.
Amu enaikash te ninche te neitu apa eitasim aaiyiolou nkoitoi e sipata, alang teneyiolou ina oitoi, neitoki aaibelekenya aaing'uaa ina kitanapata sinyati naishooki ninche.
Etotiwuo te ninche anaa endung'et e rashe nasipa inchere, “Keshukokino oldia irrugumat enyena,” neji sii “Naa keisuji embitir neitoki ashukokino olokidong'oi aiperipera.”
Ena taata empalai e are nasiraki intae, ilanyor laainei. Ore te pokira are natuputuo indamunot inyi nemetii esunkuroisho te nkitadamunoto e kuna baa,
inchere kenyor nidamumu intae irorei ooiroro iloibonok sinyat le dukuya o enkitanapata o Laitoriani naa Olaitajeunoni, oimua ilkipaareta linyi.
Entayiolo ena te dukuya inchere ore too nkolong'i e siadi kepuonu ilasukenyak te sukeny enye, oopuoyie ing'uarrat enye maate,
neikilikuanu aajo, “Koree doi enkisiligata e lotunoto Enye? Amu ore apa ebaiki pee eirura iloo papa, epuoito intokitin pooki aaikunari anaa enatiu apake te nkiterunoto pee eitaini enkop.”
Etootikitio ninche aagiroo ena sipata, inchere to rorei le Nkai eetae keper apa moitie o enkop naitobiraki te nkare naa enkare eitainyieki;
naa te ninye eidaikieki ina kop apa naatae aaitemoo to loirrag le nkare neidaaya.
Naa te ilo rorei ake sii etushumaki keper taata natii o nkop aaitanyu enkima, nepali o metabaiki enkolong e nkiguana o emutata oo ltung'ana lemeure Enkai.
Kake ore intae, ilchoreta laainei, emincho erikino intae ena bae nabo, inchere ore enkolong nabo to Laitoriani netiu anaa ilarin enkalifu nabo, ore ilarin enkalifu nabo netiu anaa enkolong nabo.
Meimutie Olaitoriani eitu eitabaya enkisiligata enye anaa enadamu kulikae enkimutioto, kake keng'iri te intae amu meyieu obo oimin, kake pee ebaiki pooki ng'ae enkirridunoto.
Kake kelotu enkolong o Laitoriani anaa olapurroni. Ore teina olong neishieki keper to ltoilo kitok. Ore wuejitin e shumata nepejori aaidaikie, ore enkop o pooki toki natii nepejori.
Amaa taa te naa inji eikoni kuna tokitin pooki aaidaikie keishiaakino intae niaakuku iltung'ana ooikununo aja, to rrekie le sinyatisho o esidano e nkishiaa inyi too naaishiaakinore e Nkai?
Ore iyanyitata nintasiekuku ina olong e Nkai, ore ina olong naa kepeji shumata nesholi, ore intokitin naaitobirieki shumata neshola te nkima.
Kake ore te risioroto e nkisiligata e Nkai, kiaanyita iyiook keper ng'ejuk o enkop ng'ejuk naa atua ninye emanya esupatisho.
Ore te nkaraki ina ilanyor amu kuna iyanyitata entonyok naa pee einepu Enkai intae miaatata entibili anaa entiyoto, niserianana.
Naa enkenai eng'iriata o Laitoriani lang inchere enjeunoto, neijia sii etiu olalashe lang onyorri Paulo etisira te risioroto e ng'eno naishooki ninye,

eimaki ena anaa enajo too mpala enyena pooki. Amu etii atua ninche kulie naagol eyiolounoto naaboin iltung'ana lemeiteng'ena, nemeeta enkitashoto nauno nemerregel te nkidaaroto enye maate, anaa enaiko ilkulikae kigerot.
Ore naa intae, ilanyor, itayioloito ena eton eado kop, entorrip ate pee meshoroo ake aaya intae te nkitapong'oroto oo ltung'ana lemeshilaa inkitanapat, neitiakieki intae enkitashoto inyi nauno.
Kake entubulu te mpiris o te yiolounoto o Laitoriani naa Olaitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo. Metaa enenye enkitoo te pokira, taata o metabaiki ina olong oo ntarasi.
Ore ilo Rorei le nkishui otii apake te nkiterunoto, ilo likitoning'o iyiook, nikitoduaa too nkonyek ang, niking'ura nikimbung'a too nkaik ang,
ina kishui naibalunyeki, nikitoduaa iyiook, naa ina kinchakenoo aajoki intae nchere ina kishui oo ntarasi natii apake te nebo Papa, neibalakinyeki iyiook.
Ilo likitoduaa nikitoning'o kinosaki sii ninche intae pee itumutumu enchula te nebo iyiook; naa ene Papa enchula ang te nebo Oinoti lenye Yesu Kristo.
Nikinger ena pee elulung'ayu eng'ida ang.
Olkilikuai ele laa ninye kitoning'o te Kristo Yesu kinosaki intae nchere, ewang'an Enkai nemetii enaimin atua ninye katukul.
Ti nikijo kiaata o ninye enchula neton ake kipuo te naimin, eikilejisho neme sipat kinchuyie;
kake ti nikitii iyiook ewang'an, anaa pee etii ninye ewang'an, nikiata enchula olikae o likae, neituku iyiook osarge le Yesu Kristo, Oinoti lenye aoru iyiook ing'ok pooki.
Ti nikijo mikiata iyiook ing'ok naa ate kilej, nemetii esipata atua iyiook.
Ti nikirridu ing'ok ang te Nkai naa keisiligayu ninye naa asipani, naa kepalaki ninye iyiook ing'ok ang neituku ntorrok ang pooki.
Ti nikijo eitu kias ing'ok, ninye kintaa olalejani, nemetii ororei lenye atua iyiook.
Nkera aainei kutiti, intae aigeroki kuna pee miasiasa ing'ok; kake te neas oltung'ani ing'ok, nikiata olomitu iyiook te Papa, naa Yesu Kristo loo sipat;
naa ninye olkituket loo ng'ok ang, neme nkunaang ake kake o ne nkop pooki.
Naa ore pee kintadedeyie nchere eikiyiolo ninye, nikimbung inkitanapat enyena.
Ore olojo, “Kayiolo nanu ninye” nemeibung inkitanapat enyena naa olalejani ilo, nemetii esipata atua ninye;
kake ore pooki ng'ae oibung ororei lenye, naa tiatua ninye eitabari enyorrata e Nkai. Teina kintisip inchere kitii iyiook atua ninye.
Ore olojo keton tiatua ninye neishiakino te neikunari anaa eneikunari apa ninye.
Ilanyor laainei, mme enkitanapata ng'ejuk aigeroki intae, kake enkitanapata musana niatata apake te nkiterunoto; ore ina kitanapata musana naa ilo rorei lindipa aatoning.
Kake, aigeroki ake intae enkitanapata ng'ejuk, nasipa te ninye nesipa te intae amu keishari enaimin neidipa atawang'a ina wang'an nasipa.
Ore ilo ojo te wang'an eloito neton ake eiba olalashe lenye neton etii ninye atua enaimin.
Ore olonyor olalashe lenye neton tiatua ewang'an, ore tiatua ina ewang'an nemeetae entoki narrorrisho.
Kake ore ilo oiba olalashe lenye atua enaimin etii neloito tiatua enaimin, nemeyiolo eneloito, amu eitamodoo enaimin inkonyek enyena.
Nkera aainei kutiti, aigeroki intae, amu, etapalikiaki intae ing'ok inyi te nkaraki ninye.
Naigeroki intae iloo papa amu, iyiololo ilo otii apake te nkiterunoto. Naigeroki intae lo barnot, amu itimira ilo torrono. Naigeroki intae, nakera, amu iyiololo Papa.
Naigeroki intae iloo papa, amu iyiololo ilo otii apake te nkiterunoto. Naigeroki intae, lo barnot, amu igoligolo, neton ororei le Nkai tiatua intae, nitimira ilo torrono.
Eminyorru enkop anaa ntokitin naatii enkop. Ore oltung'ani ake pooki onyor enkop, nemetii enyorrata nanyor Papa atua ninye.
Amu ore nena pooki naatii enkop, ng'uarrat o sesen, ng'uarrat oo nkonyek o lwuasa le nkishui, ine nkop nena mme ne Papa.
Naa keishari enkop, o ng'uarrat enyena; kake ore ilo oas enayieu Enkai nebik intarasi.
Nakera esaa nabayie ena, naa ore amu itoning'o aajo kelotu Oloiba Kristo, eidipa doi taata aaetu ilooiba Kristo kumok, teina kiyiolo aajo esaa nabayie ena.
Tiatua iyiook etupukutuo aapuo, kake mme ilkulalang apake, amu te naa ke lkulalang apa, anaata etotona tenebo o iyiook; kake etupukutuo aapuo, pee eibalayu nchere mme lkulalang lelo pooki.
Kake eidipaki aaela ninche intae ilo Obo Sinyati, niyiololo pooki.
Ore pee aigeroki intae, neme te nkaraki nimiyiololo esipata, kake te nkaraki niyiololo, niyiololo sii aajo metii elejare atua esipata.
Kalo doi olalejani leme ilo otanya ejo ore Yesu ninye Kristo, Ilo doi Oiba Kristo, olotanya Papa neany Oinoti lenye.
Meetae oloany ilo Inoti oitoki ninye aata Papa. Ore oloibalunye ilo Inoti keeta sii ninye Papa.
Enchoo ina nitoning'o apake te nkiterunoto ebik tiatua intae. Te nebik tiatua intae ina nitoning'o apake te nkiterunoto naa eibikibiki sii tiatua ilo Inoti o tiatua Papa.
Naa ena eisiligie ninye iyiook, enkishui oo ntarasi.
Aigeroki intae ena tialo lelo oojo pee elej intae;

kake etamanya intae enkielata nitang'amutua te Kristo; nimiatayieyie tipat enkiteng'enare nalotu likae aitoki aiteng'en intae amu eiteng'ena intae enkielata too mbaa pooki, nesipa ninye, mme elejare, ore ake anaa ina naiteng'ena intae, entotoni intae tiatua ninye.
Ore taata, naa kera kutiti, entotoni tiatua ninye, paa ore pee elioyu nikintieu aaing'ura nimikikurru te lotunoto enye.
Ti nitayioloito ilo aajo oloo sipat ninye, nitayiloito aajo ore ake pooki ng'ae oas isidan naa keino te Nkai.
Eng'ura eneba enyorrata natonyorra iyiook Papa, pee eipoti iyiook aajo nkera e Nkai; naa kesipa eikira. Ore pee meyiolo iyiook enkop naa te nkaraki neitu eiyiolou Enkai.
Ilanyor laainei, kira taata iyiook inkera e Nkai, neton eitu elioyu enikiyiooki aatiu, kake kiyiolo aajo ore pee elioyu Kristo nikitiu anaa ninye amu aikidol ninye anaa eneikununo.
Naa ore pooki ng'ae oata ele siligi te ninye neitisiny kewan anaa enasinya ninye.
Ore pooki ng'ae oas intorrok neeta entiyoto e mpaashata oo nkitanapat; ing'ok empaashata o nkitanapat.
Iyiololo aajo eewuo ninye pee etum aawa ing'ok, nemetii ing'ok atua ninye.
Meetae oloton tiatua Kristo oas ing'ok, nemeetae oloas ing'ok otoduaa ninye aashu otayiolo ninye.
Nakera kutiti, emincho elej intae oltung'ani. Ore ilo oas isidan naa aisupat, anaa paa supat ninye.
Ore ilo oas ing'ok naa ole Sheitani, amu etaasa apa Sheitani ing'ok ebaiki enkiterunoto. Ina pee etaliee Oinoti le Nkai pee eidaikie isiaaitin e Sheitani.
Meetae oloino te Nkai oas ing'ok amu eton empukunoto e Nkai tiatua ninye. Nemeas ninye ing'ok amu keino te Nkai.
Tena eidimi aatodol nchere kakua inkera e Nkai, naa kakua inkera e Sheitani: ore pooki ng'ae lemeas enaishaakino neme ole Nkai, naa nejia etiu ilo lemenyor olalashe lenye.
Ele kilikuai itoning'o apake te nkiterunoto, nchere matonyorrata olikae o likae,
pee mikitiu anaa Kain le ilo torrono otara apa ninye olalashe lenye metua. Naa ainyoo pee etara ninye metua? Te nkaraki naa torrok inkiasin enyena naa sidain ino lalashe lenye.
Eming'asia ilalashera, nchere keiba intae enkop.
Eikiyiolo iyiook aajo kitupukutuo te keeya aajing empuaan, amu kinyor ilalashera. Ore olemenyorrisho netii atua keeya.
Ore pooki ng'ae oiba olalashe lenye naa olarani, niyiololo intae aajo meetae olarani omany enkishui oo ntarasi atua ninye.
Ena kiyiolounye enyorrata, nchere eirragie Kristo enkishui enye te nkaraki iyiook; neishiakino sii ninche iyiook te nikirragie enkishui ang te nkaraki ilalashera.
Kake te neeta ake oltung'ani masaa e nkop neduaaki olalashe enyamali, nemeeta olng'ur tialo ninye, kaji naa etamanya enyorrata e Nkai tiatua ninye?
Nakera kutiti emikinyorrisho to rorei ake aashu to lng'ejep kake to nkiasin o te sipata.
Ena kiyiolounye aajo kira iyiook ile sipata, nikintadedeyie iltauja lang te dukuya ninye,
enoshi kata naiguanare iyiook iltauja lang, amu kitok Enkai alang iltauja lang, neyiolo pooki toki.
Ilanyor laainei, te nemeiguanare iyiook iltauja lang, nikiata empijan nikintoriokinore Enkai;
naa eikitum pooki toki nikiomonu, amu eikimbung inkitanapat enyena nikias ina naitiship ninye.
Naa ena enkitanapata enye, nchere mairuko enkarna o Inoti lenye Yesu Kristo nikinyorruno maate, anaa ina ake naitanapa iyiook.
Ore lelo pooki ooibung inkitanapat enyena netoni ninche tiatua ninye. Naa ena kiyiolounye nchere etonita ninye tiatua iyiook, te nkaraki ina Kiyang'et Sinyati naishoo ninye iyiook.
Ilanyor laainei, emiiruk enkiyang'et ake pooki, kake entetem inkiyang'eta pee idolidolo te naa eine Nkai; amu etijing'a enkop iloibonok kumok le lejare.
Ena iyiolounyenye Enkiyang'et e Nkai; ore enkiyang'et ake pooki naibalunye Yesu Kristo nchere eewuo to sesen naa ene Nkai.
Ore enkiyang'et ake pooki nemeibalunye Yesu neme ene Nkai. Enkiyang'et o Loiba Kristo ina, naa ninye apa itoning'o aajo kelotu, neidipa taata atijing'a enkop.
Nakera kutiti, irara intae ine Nkai, nindipa aatimir lelo oibonok le lejare; amu ore ilo otii atua intae naa eikitok alang ilo otii atua ena kop.
Ile nkop ninche, metaa ore ina najo ninche naa ine nkop, naa ninche ening enkop.
Kira iyiook ile Nkai, ore oloyiolo Enkai nening iyiook, ore ilo lemeyiolo Enkai nemening ninye iyiook. Ena kiyiolounye enkiyang'et e sipata o enkiyang'et e nkitadiaata.
Ilanyor laainei, ematonyorrata maate amu ene Nkai enyorrata naa ore ilo onyorrisho neino te Nkai neyiolo Enkai.
Ore ilo lemenyorrisho nemeyiolo Enkai; amu ore Enkai naa enyorrata.
Inji eikuna Enkai pee eibalie enyorrata enye tiatua iyiook, nchere eirriwua Enkai Enkerai enye meeu enkop, metaa ninye kinchuyie.
Ene doi etii enyorrata nchere, mme iyiook ootonyorra Enkai kake ninye natonyorra iyiook neirriu Enkerai enye metaa olkipoket loo ng'ok ang.
Ilanyor laainei, te netonyorra iyiook Enkai aiko nji, keishiaakino sii ninche iyiook te nikinyorruno olikae olikae.
Meetae oltung'ani otoduaa Enkai aekata; te nikinyorra maate, nebik Enkai tiatua iyiook neitabari enyorrata enye tiatua iyiook.
Ena kiyiolounye nchere ekitoni tiatua ninye, neton ninye tiatua iyiook, te nkaraki naishoo iyiook Enkiyang'et enye.
Nikitoduaa iyiook nikinchakenoo nchere eirriwua Papa Enkerai enye metaa Olaitajeunoni le nkop.
Ore pooki ng'ae oibalie nchere Enkerai e Nkai Yesu kebikito Enkai tiatua ninye, nebikito ninye tiatua Enkai.
Metaa eikiyiolo iyiook nikiruko enyorrata naata Enkai te iyiook. Ore Enkai naa enyorrata, ore ilo obik tiatua enyorrata nebik tiatua Enkai, nebik Enkai tiatua ninye.
Ena eitabarieki enyorrata tiatua iyiook, nchere eikiata enkitieunoto te nkolong e nkiguana, amu ore enatiu ninye naa nejia sii iyiook kitiu te na kop.
Ore etii enyorrata nemetii enkuretisho, kake kemir enyorrata nadede enkuretisho. Amu ore enkuretisho naa enkitamioto eipirta, naa ore ilo oureisho nemedede enyorrata te ninye.
Ekinyorisho iyiook amu Enkai natang'asa anyorru iyiook.
Te nejo likae, “Kanyor nanu Enkai,” neiba olalashe lenye, kelejisho amu ore olemenyor olalashe lenye otoduaa, nemeidim ninye atonyorra Enkai neitu aekata edol.
Naa ena enkitanapata nikiata aa Kristo eing'uaa, nchere ore ilo onyor Enkai neishiakino nenyorru sii ninye olalashe lenye.
Ore pooki ng'ae ooiruk nchere ore Yesu ninye Kristo naa enkerai e Nkai. Ore pooki ng'ae onyor menye nenyor sii ninye enkerai enye.
Ena kiyiolounye nchere kinyor inkera e Nkai te nikinyor Enkai nikimbung nkitanapat enyena.
Ena enyorrata e Nkai, nchere maibung'a nkitanapat enyena. Naa ore nkitanapat enyena nemeekisho.
Ore pooki toki naino te Nkai nemir enkop; naa ena emirata namir enkop, enkirukoto ang.
Ai ng'ae doi omir enkop leme ilo oiruko nchere Enkerai e Nkai Yesu?
Yesu Kristo doi ele oewuo te nkare o to sarge, neme te nkare ake eewuo kake te nebo enkare o sarge.
Naa Enkiyang'et shakeni, amu ore Enkiyang'et naa esipata.
Eetae shakeni nara uni Enkiyang'et, enkare, o sarge; nening'o pokira uni anaa nabo.
Te naa eiking'amaa shakeni oo ltung'ana, shakeni e Nkai nalusoo; naa ena shakeni e Nkai nchere etaa ninye shakeni te Nkerai enye.
Ore ilo oiruk Enkerai e Nkai neeta shakeni tiatua kewan. Ore ilo lemeiruk Enkai neitaa ninye olalejani, amu eitu eiruk shakenisho naitadedeyie Enkai te Nkerai enye.
Naa ena shakeni, nchere eishoo iyiook Enkai enkishui oo ntarasi, naa atua Enkerai enye etii ina kishui.
Ore oloata Enkerai e Nkai neeta enkishui; ore olemeeta Enkerai e Nkai nemeeta enkishui.
Intae lelo ooiruko Enkerai e Nkai aigeroki ena, pee iyiolouu intae aajo iatata enkishui oo ntarasi.
Naa ena kitieunoto kiata iyiook tiatua ninye, nchere ti nikiomonu ake ninye entoki pooki te risioroto e yieunoto enye naa kening ninye iyiook.
Naa ti nikiyiolo aajo kening ninye iyiook te pooki nikiomonu, ekiyiolo aajo kitang'amutua nena pooki nikitoomonutuo te ninye.

Te neduaaki likae lang olalashe aashu enkanashe easita entorrono neme ene keeya, neomonoki, naa kening Enkai neisho enkishui lelo leme ine keeya ing'ok enye. Keetae ng'ok e keeya; eitu ajo metoomonokini oltung'ani teina.
Ing'ok nkitarruorrot pooki, kake keetae ing'ok neme ne keeya.
Kiyiolo iyiook aajo ore pooki ng'ae oino te Nkai nemeas ing'ok, kake Ilo oino te Nkai orrip ninye nemeiseyie ilo torrono ninye.
Kiyiolo iyiook aajo kira ile Nkai, ore enkop pooki naa atua eng'olon e ilo torrono etii.

Nikiyiolo sii aajo eewuo Enkerai e Nkai neishoo iyiook enining'unoto, matayiolo olosipa; naa ilo osipa kitii iyiook atua, aatii atua Enkerai enye Yesu Kristo. Ninye doi Enkai nasipa naa ninye enkishui oo ntarasi.
Nakera kutiti, entodol ate too nkitanyaanyukot naaitaae nkaitin.
Nanu olpayian oigeroki enkitok nageluno o nkera enyena nanyor ti atua sipat, neme nanu ake, kake nejia etiu lelo pooki ooyiolo esipata,
te nkaraki esipata nebikito ti atua iyiook naa keton te nebo iyiook ntarasi.
Metaa te nebo iyiook empiris o lng'ur, o eseriani naing'uaa Enkai Papa neing'uaa Yesu Kristo Oinoti le Papa, te sipata o te nyorrata.
Kang'ida naleng tenadol kulie kera inono esujita esipata anaa ina ake naitanapa iyiook Papa.
Naasai naa taata nakitok, neme taa kaata ae kitanapata ng'ejuk naaigeroki, kake enapa ake nikiaata te nkiterunoto, nchere matonyorrata maate.
Naa inji eikununo enyorrata te nikisuj iyiook inkitanapat enyena, naa ena enkitanapata anaa enikitoning'o apake te nkiterunoto, nchere enchomie enyorrata.
Etijing'a lalejak kumok enkop, iltung'ana lemenyorraa elotunoto e Yesu Kristo to sesen, ore oltung'ani laaijo ilo naa olalejani, oloiba Kristo.
Entodol ate pee minturraa ina nikisiaayutua, kake pee itumutumu olekoisiaayio linyi ebore.
Ore pooki olo dukuya nemebik te nkiteng'enare e Kristo nemeeta ilo Enkai; ore ilo obik teina kiteng'enare neeta pokira aare Papa o Enkerai.
Ore ake ololotu enitii lemeyau ena kiteng'enare eming'amu aaitijing aji aashu irorokiki;
amu ore oloiroroki netang'arie esiaai enye torrono.
Ore hoo naata nkumok naaigeroki, mayieu naiger te nkardasi o ranki le nkalamu, kake kaisilig ajo kalotu adol intae nairorie intae enotote iyiok nkomomi, pee elulung'ayu eng'ida ang.
Eiroroki intae nkera e nkanashe ino nageluno.
Nanu Olpayian oigeroki olanyor Gayo, ilo lanyor te sipata.
Olanyor lai, aaomonoki pee eitabari mbaa pooki te iyie niaku biyoto; kayiolo ajo aibiyoto oltau lino.
Amu ating'ide oleng pee ebau kulikae alashera ootaa shakeni nchere inyok too sipat te nkishon ino, amu kesipa ajo isujita iyie esipata.
Matum nanu ae ng'ida nalang ena, te naning eji kesujita inkera aainei esipata.
Olanyor lai, itaa oloisiligayu too nintaasa ilalashera, neisul too ltung'ana omon, lelo ooishakenutuo,
enyorrata ino te dukuya esirit. Embae sidai ina tenintobiraa ninche epuo anaa, enaishiaakino esiaai e Nkai.
Amu te nkaraki ninye pee etudumunye nemeeta toki natang'amutua te lelo leitu eiruk.
Metaa keishiakino te nikiretu iltung'ana laaijo lelo, pee kiaku ilaisiaayiak ti atua esipata.
Kaata enaigeroko esirit; kake ore Diotrefes, ilo onyor aiturukie kewan, nemeyieu neening enajo.

Metaa, te nalotu, naibalie nena naasita, nanu esukeny too rorei le nkarruoisho. Neitu doi eidip ina, etanya ninye makewan eng'amu ilalashera, nemitiki sii lelo ooyieu neitoomon nearaa ninche te sirit.
Olanyor lai, misuj iyie enkarruoisho kake isupati tusuja. Ore oloas isupati ninye ole Nkai; ore oloas enkarruoisho neitu edol Enkai.
Keeta Demetrus shakenisho sidai te pooki ng'ae, o te sipata kewan, naitadedeyie sii nanu, nikira sii iyiook shakeni niyiolo ajo kesipa shakeni ang.
Kaata nkumok naaigeroki paa ae mayieu naiger te nkalamu o to ranki le nkalamu;
ekaisilig ajo etataana pee kitumo, nikiro te nebo enotote nkomomi.
Metaa eseriani tenebo iyie. Kiroroki ilchoreta. Iroroki ilchoreta lang, pooki.
Nanu Yuda, osinka le Yesu Kristo naa olalashe le Yakobo, oigeroki lelo ooipotoki, oonyorri ti atua Enkai Papa lang ooiteng'elaki te nkaraki Yesu Kristo.
Metoponikini intae olng'ur o eseriani o enyorrata.

Ilanyor laainei, ore anaa eyieunoto naata naleng pee aigeroki intae mbaa naaipirta enjeunoto ang niking'ar, nadol ajo meeta nchere pee maigeroki intae, asai intae erishisho aamitu enkirukoto e Nkai naishooki apa nabo kata te lulung'ata lelo sinyat.

Etijing'akita atua intae te mpurrokinoto ilkulikae laa ninche apa etegelakaki endung'okinoto e nkiguana, iltung'ana lemeiruk Enkai ookur empiris e Nkai ang aaitaa enkoitoi naasie ntorrok nemiki ilo laa ninye ake olkitok lang, naa Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.
Kayieu naitoki aitadamu intae, hoo naidipa apa aitayiolo intae nchere ore ilo oitajewuo iltung'ana aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, nenyaaka amut lelo leitu eiruk.
Ore lelo malaika leitu egolie ewueji enye neing'uaa emanyisho enye naishiaakino, neteenaki ninche too lpisia loo ntarasi ti abori te nemisimis ometabau ina olong kitok e nkiguana;
anaa enaikunaki Sodom o Gomora o nena ang'itie naamanita naatusuja sii ninche ng'uarrat oo loirerioni torrok, neitamioki ninche te nkima oo ntarasi pee eaku enkitanyaanyukoto te pooki.
Neton ake eiko neijia kulo tung'ana too nkidetidetat enye neidurukie osesen, neany enkitoria, nemor ilo oata enkitoo le shumata.
Kake ore Mikael ilo malaika kitok, eishankarra o loirirua eorro osesen le Musa, eitu ninye eitasim aipotoki emoroto e nkiguana, Kake etiaaka, “Metaa Enkai nikisikong.”
Kedekisho lelo tung'ana too ldeketa lemening'u ninche, ore too naayiolo te mpukunoto o sesen anaa pee eyiolo ng'uesi, neyaki ate embatisho nemuti ninche.
Oi ninche! Amu etusujaitie orrekie le Kain netapalakita ate enkitapong'oroto e Balaam te nkaraki dupoto, nemuti ninche te nkiseroto e Kora.

Ore ninche naa iltipot ooiduruk ti atua isiruai linyi le nyorrata epepeeno te nebo meeta osul negolie ate meeta isura. Inkatampo nemeeta enkare, naaya osiwuo, o lkeek lemeeta ilng'anayio te siadi ari ootuata katitin are, ootadotuoki.
Ilopir le naiposha ootarasutua ooitokitoku ilabur le nkurruna enye, ilakir oopuaya laa ninche eitaanyitai emisimisi e naimin o lodo le nkop ntarasi.
Kuna apa sii eibonuo Enok ilo apa le ishoi e naapishana ebaiki Adam ejo, “Ng'ura eewuo Olaitoriani te nebo iip inkuyu oo sinyat lenyena,

pee edung'oki enkiguana pooki ng'ae nemir lelo pooki lemeure Enkai, too nkiaasin enye pooki torrok nemetii euriata e Nkai naatasa too rrekiei lemetii olturiaki le Nkai, o too mbaa pooki e nkisikong naatejo ilaasak loo ng'ok lemeure Enkai neiba ninye.”
Kulo laing'unyung'unyak, ilooata olorok, iloosuj ing'uarrat oo seseni lenye, iloorup ate te njartano enye, nepakas iltung'ana ejo pee edupore.
Kake entadamu intae ilanyor laainei nena apa naatolimutuo ilkipaareta lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.
Etiaakita intae, “Ore te nkata e nkiting'oto naa kepuonu ilasukenyak, oosuj ing'uarrat enye nemetii euriata e Nkai.”
Kulo ninche ooyau eoro, ile na kop ninche lemeeta Enkiyang'et Enkai.
Kake ore intae ilanyor laainei, enteshetu ate ti atua ina kirukoto inyi nasinya, entoomon te Nkiyang'et Sinyati.
Entotoni intae maate ti atua enyorrata e Nkai, entaanyu olng'ur lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo oitabaiki intae ina kishui oo ntarasi.
Entudupa ilkulikae leton eing'ashing'ash.
Entajeu ilkulikae entawuapu ninche tiatua enkima, eng'urrie lelo kulikae to lturiaki nimbayuyu ebaiki ninye enkila naidurukie osesen.
Ore taata ilo oidim atorripo intae pee mibatatata, neitoduaaya intae te dukuya enkitoo enye miaatata eleyiata, iatata eng'ida,
olaa ninye ake Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang, tiatua Yesu Kristo Olaitoriani lang. Metaa enenye enkitoo o enkisisa, o enkitoria, o engolon, te dukuya nkatitin pooki taata o ntarasi. Eesai.
Embolunoto e Yesu Kristo, naishoo Enkai ninye meitoduaa isinkan lenyena, imbaa nemeeta nchere pee meesayu aasioki. Neisho metayiolouni te nkirriwakinoto nairriwaka olmalaika osinka lenye Yohana,
oishakenoko ororei le Nkai o shakenisho e Yesu Kristo, ebaiki nena pooki naatoduaa.
Emayiana ilo oisum metoning'i irorei le naibon, nemayiana lelo ooning, neibung nena naaigero teine, amu etataana enkata.

Nanu Yohana oigeroki isirito naapishana e Asia: Enoto empiris o eseriani eing'uaa ilo otii taata, netii apa, naa ninye kenya olotu, neing'uaa sii inkiyang'eta naapishana naatii dukuya olorika lenye le nkitoo,
neing'uaa Yesu Kristo olchakeni osipa, olaa ninye olkikau loo lootuata, naa Olaitoriani loo laiguanak ootii enkop. Metaa ene ilo otonyorra iyiook nelaku iyiook too ng'ok ang to sarge lenye,
neitaa iyiook enkitoria oo lapolosak le Enkai Menye lenye, metaa enenye enkisisa o enkitoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Eesai.
Ng'ura elotu ninye too nkatampo, naa kedol pooki ong'u ninye, lelo pooki ootaremo ninye. Ore loshon pooki le nkop, neyietu neishir te nkaraki ninye. Neijia taa etiu. Eesai.
“Kara nanu Alfa o Omega,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo, Otii taata, netii apa, naa ninye olotu, Olaidimani.
Nanu Yohana olalashe linyi ong'arie intae tiatua Yesu, osina o enkitoo o eng'iriata o enkisulata, atii apa olemankale le naiposha oji Patmos te nkaraki ororei le Nkai o shakenisho e Yesu.
Naainepu Enkiyang'et te nkolong o Laitoriani, naning oltoilo kitok te siadi nanu laaijo ole ntarumpeta,
ejo, “Ingero nena nidolita tiatua embuku nirriwaki nena sirito pokira naapishana, ene Efeso, o Smirna o Pergamam o Tiatira o Sardis o ene Filadelfia o Laodikea.”
Naibelekenya ajo pee adol ilo toilo laairorie, ore ake pee aibelekenya nadol ilkilang'ilang'eta oopishana le saabu,
naa ore te mpolos e lelo kilang'ilang'eta netii ilo obo laaijo Enkerai e Tung'ani, eishopokoki olkila oodo neenita enkeen e saabu to lgoo lenye.
Ore endukuya enye o lpapit lenyena naa keibor anaa lpapit loo ntare, neibor anaa enturoto, netiu nkonyek enyena anaa olng'ejep le nkima,
netiu inkejek enyena anaa isuyan oosika te nkima, netiu oltoilo lenye anaa iltoiloishi loo nkariak kumok;
neeta te nkaina enye e tatene ilakir oopishana, nepuku te nkutuk enye olalem opi nkaloli pokira are, netiu enkomom enye anaa enkolong te nedalu te ngolon enye pooki.
Ore peyie adol ninye nabatatakino nkejek enyena natiu anaa oltung'ani otua. Kake aaiteleikia enkaina enye e tatene, nejo, “Miureishoyu, kara nanu ole nkiterunoto o le nkiting'oto;
nara ilo oishu, atua apa, naa ng'ura ajo kaishu taata o ntarasi, naa nanu oata imboleta e keeya o ewueji e nkima.
Naa ngero taata nena nidol, enatii o enayooki aaku.

Ore enkisudoroto e lelo akir oopishana litoduaa te nkaina ai e tatene, o lelo kilang'ilang'eta oopishana le saabu naa nji etiu: ore ilakir oopishana naa ilmalaika loo sirito naapishana, ore ilkilang'ilang'eta naa sirito, pokira naapishana.
“Tisiraki ilo malaika le sirit natii atua Efeso nchere, ‘Irorei le ilo oibung'ita ilakir oopishana te nkaina enye e tatene, olo tiatua ilkilang'ilang'eta oopishana le saabu.
“ ‘Kayiolo nkiaasin inono o eekenyata ino o eng'iriata ino, nchere mindim aisiritore iltung'ana torrok kake itetema lelo oojo ate ilkipaareta neme ninche, nirrasha ninche ajo ilalejak.
Kayiolo ajo iata enyuaata niting'iria te nkaraki enkarna ai, neitu inauru.
Kake kaata ena namen te iyie. Nchere, itung'uaiyie enyorrata apa niaata te dukuya.
Tadamu naa eneba enitusulunore, irridu niaas isiaaitin niaasita apa te dukuya. Naa ti nimiaas, naa kalotu enitii naiwuang'ie olkilang'ilang'et lino te wueji enye, te neitu irridu.
Kake iata ena nabo, imba isiaaitin oo Lnikolatin naiba sii nanu.
Ore oloata enkiok inchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito. Ore ilo omirisho naisho meinosa ilng'anayio te ilo shani le mpuaan otii atua olchampa le Nkai.’
“Naa ore olmalaika le sirit natii atua Smirna, tisiraki nchere, ‘Irorei le ilo le Nkiterunoto o le nkiting'oto, otua apa, nenyaaka apiu.
“ ‘Kayiolo osomit lino o aisinanisho ino, kake ira karsis, nayiolo sii imorot e lelo oojo ate Ilyahudi neme ninche, kake enkaji e ntumo e Sheitani ninche.

Miureyu ilo sina olotu. Ng'ura, etaa enajo pee enang'aki Sheitani lkulikae te intae atua jila pee etum atetema intae, naa ore too nkolong'i tomon nitumutumu intae osomit. Taa oloisiligayu o tabaiki keeya naa kaaisho iyie enkopiyia e nkitoo e nkishui.
Oloata enkiok, inchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito. Ore ilo omirisho nemeitame ninye ina keeya e are.’
“Naa ore olmalaika le sirit natii atua Pargamam, tisiraki nchere, ‘Irorei lo loata olalem opi nkaloli pokira are.

“ ‘Kayiolo enikimanya, ine etii olorika le nkitoo le Sheitani; nimbung'ita enkarna ai akurraki, neitu imiki enkirukoto ai ebaiki inkolong'i e Antipas olchakeni lai asipani otaraki metua tiatua intae teine nemanya Sheitani.

Kake kaata nkuti namen te iyie; iata kulikae teine ooibung inkiteng'enat e Balaam oiteng'ena Balak metipiki eloket narror inkera oo Siraeli pee etum aainosa indaiki oo lasarri ootopolosaki leme le Nkai, neas intorrok e loloito.
Metaa iata sii iyie kulikae ooibung inkiteng'enat oo Lnikolatin.
Irridu naa. Naa te neitu, nalotu enitii asieku naitainyie ninche olarrabal to lalem le nkutuk ai.

Oloata enkiok inchoo ening enajoki, Enkiyang'et nena sirito. Ore ilo omirisho naa kaisho ninye eoroti e mana naisudoro, naisho osoit oibor, osirakino enkarna enye ng'ejuk, nemeyiolo likae tung'ani meteleku ilo ake ong'amu.’
“Ore olmalaika le sirit natii atua Tiatira, tisiraki nchere, ‘Irorei lo Inoti le Enkerai e Nkai, otiu nkonyek enyena anaa lng'ejepa le nkima, netiu nkejek enyena anaa isuyan ootisikaki.
“ ‘Kayiolo isiaaitin inono, o enyorrata ino, o enkirukoto o enkisiaayiare, o eng'iriata, o nchere etalang'a isiaaitin inono e det ine dukuya.

Kake kamen ena te iyie nchere, itapalayie ina kitok naji Yesebel naitaa kewan enkoiboni pee eiteng'enisho neitapong'oo isinkan laainei metaasa imbaa e loloito nenya indaiki naatopolosakaki inkitanyaanyukot.
Aishoo ninye enkata meirridu, kake etanya eirridu te loloito enye.
Neaku, ekanang'aki ninye erruat e muoyian, ore lelo oololoito te nebo ninye nanang'aki atua olosilisili kitok aashu te neirridu inkiaasin enye.
Naa kaosh inkera enyena metuata. Naa keyiolou isirito pooki aajo nanu ilo ojur indamunot o ltau, naa nanu oisho pooki ng'ae linyi anaa erisioroto e siaai enye.
Kake ore intae kulikae ootii atua Tiatira leitu eibung ena kiteng'enare, leitu eiteng'en ate te nena naajo kulikae imbaa naagut e Sheitani, ajoki intae, maitoki aiteleiki intae likae ola.
Embung'a ake intae entukurraki ina niaatata, o metaba anaa nalotu.
Ore ilo omirisho neibung isiaaitin aainei o metabau enkiting'oto naisho ninye engolon meitoria iloreren.
Naa keitore ninche te ng'udi e sekenkei anaa te nedanyi motioo oo nkulupuok metaa mbelibelat, anaa sii ninye nanu enatang'amua engolon eing'uaa Papa lai.
Naa kaisho ninye olakira le nkakenya.
Oloata enkiok nchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito.’

“Naa ore to lmalaika le sirit natii atua Sardis, ing'ero nchere, ‘Irorei le ilo oata nena kiyang'eta naapishana e Nkai o lelo akir oopishana. “ ‘Kayiolo isiaaitin inono, iata enkarna anaa oltung'ani oishu, nitua.
Tuputunye naa nintagol ina natelekua netaa keye, amu eitu ainepu isiaaitin inono aa bayarot too nkonyek e Nkai ai.
Tadamu naa ina apa nitang'amua o nitoning'o, mbung'a ina nirridu. Te nimiputunye nalotu anaa olapurroni, nimiyiolou ajo kaa saa alotunyie enitii iyie.
Neton ake iatata nkuti arn tiatua Sardis, iltung'ana leitu epik oloirerio inkilani enye, naa kaairiamariyie ninche nanu eishopo inkilani naaibor amu keiririkino ninche.
Ore ilo omirisho neikodi aaiko nejia too nkilani naaibor, nemajut enkarna enye te mbuku e mpuaan; naishakenoki enkarna enye te dukuya Papa lai o te dukuya ilmalaika lenyena.
Oloata enkiok, nchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito.’
“Naa ore to lmalaika le sirit natii atua Filadelfia, ingeroki nchere, ‘Irorei le ilo Obo Sinyati, olosipa, oloata embolet e Daudi, olobol nemeetae likae oiken, oloiken nemeetae likae obol.
“ ‘Kayiolo nkiaasin inono. Ng'ura ajo atipika dukuya iyie kutukaji nabolo nemeidim hoo ng'ae aikeno; kayiolo ajo enkiti golon iata, kake imbung'a ororei lai neitu imiki enkarna ai.
Ng'ura ajo kareu lelo le nkaji e ntumo e Sheitani oojo ate Ilyahudi neme ninche, kake kelejisho, kareu ninche meetu aairrugokino inkejek inono neyiolou nchere aatonyorra nanu iyie.
Ore amu imbung'a ororei lai te nyuaata o eng'iriata, ekaarrip teina saa oo ntemat nalotu enkop pooki, atem lelo ootii enkop.
Ekalotu asieku. Imbung'a tukurraki ina niaata pee mikioru ake likae enkopiyia ino e nkitoo.

Ore ilo omirisho naitaa ninye eng'ape tiatua enkaji e Nkai ai, nemeitoki aekata aipang aing'uaa ine, naa kasiraki ninye enkarna e Nkai ai, o enkarna e nkanasa e Nkai ai, ina Yerusalem nadou eing'uaa Enkai ai te keper o enkarna ai kewan ng'ejuk.
Oloata enkiok, nchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito.’
“Naa ore too lmalaika le sirit natii atua Laodikea, ingeroki, ‘Irorei le ilo oji Eesai, Oloisiligayu naa olchakeni osipa, naa ninye enkiterunoto e nkitobirata naitobira Enkai seuseu.
“ ‘Kayiolo inkiaasin inono. Mirobi iyie nimirowua, oi imut airopiju aashu irowuaju.
Neaku ore amu imololong, mirobi nimirowua, ekaanotu aitayu te nkutuk ai.
Amu ijo iyie, Kara nanu karsis, atudupe, malau toki. Nimiyiolo iyie ajo ira menati, ira tolut, nira olaisinani modooni niminchopo.

Ore te nkaraki ina, aaikok iyie naa pee inyiang'u te nanu saabu natisilaki te nkima, pee itum ataa karsis, ninchop ilkilani ooibor pee eitemoo enkurruna e masipaisho ino, meitokini aadol, o lchani liyelie nkonyek inono pee idolishoyu.
Ore lelo lanyor naa kaisikong naitame metaa, tonyuaa naa irridu.
Ng'ura ajo aitashe te kutukaji naoshiosh, ore ake pooki ng'ae oning oltoilo lai nebol kutukaji, naa kajing'aki nanu;

nalo anya endaa te nebo ninye, nenya sii ninye te nebo nanu. Ore ilo omirisho naa kaisho ninye metotona te nebo nanu to lorika lai le nkitoo anaa apa enatimirishe nanu, naton te nebo Papa lai to lorika lenye le nkitoo.
Oloata enkiok nchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito.’ ”

Ore pee eidipayu ena, naing'orisho, nadol etii atua keper kutukaji nabolo! Ore oladuoo toilo latang'asa aning aairorie te dukuya, etiu anaa ole ntarumpeta. Nejo, “Ilepu, tinyiku ene, pee aaitodol ina nemeeta nchere pee measayu asuju ena.”
Ore nabo kata naaigany Enkiyang'et, naa ng'ura, euno olorika le nkitoo te keper, netii obo otonita te ilo orika.
Ore ilo otonita teine neikununo anaa osoit oji Yaspa, o ltoto oonyori ooji karnelian nemanita olokirrai ilo orika oikununo anaa iltoto ooji emerald.
Nemanita ilo orika ilorikan tikitam oong'uan le nkitoo. Netonita te lelo orikan le nkitoo ilpayiani tikitam oong'uan ooishopito nkilani naaibor, neeta too lukuny enye nkopiyiani e nkitoo e saabu.

Nepuku te ilo orika le nkitoo inkiwuang'at naaimerlel o ndarat o enkikurrukur. Ore te dukuya ilo orika le nkitoo neyupuyup ilkilang'ilang'eta oopishana le nkima, naa ninche inkiyang'eta naapishana e Nkai.

Ore te dukuya ilo orika le nkitoo netii entoki natiu anaa enaiposha e kiok nayia anaa oltotoi oibor, nemanita ilo orika le nkitoo too nkaloli pooki ing'uesi ong'uan naaishu, naabore nkonyek dukuya o siadi.

Ore ina ng'ues e dukuya naishu neikununo anaa olng'atuny, ore ina ng'ues e are naishu neikununo anaa olkiteng, ore ina ng'ues e uni naishu neeta enkomom o ltung'ani, ore ina ng'ues e ong'uan naishu neikununo anaa olkurragos olo ti ai.

Ore nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu neeta ake nabo inaipuko ile, nebore ninche inkonyek pooki wueji, oriong o atua. Ore dama o kewarie nemegira aekata meranyisho ejo, “Osinyati, Osinyati, Osinyati, Osinyati, Olaitoriani Enkai, Olaidimani le pooki, otii apa netii taata, naa ninye olotu.”
Naa ore ake pee eisho nena ng'uesi naaishu enkisisa, o enkitoo o enkanyit enashe ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo, oishu ntarasi o ntarasi.

Nebatata lelo payiani tikitam o oong'uan te dukuya ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo, neserem ilo oishu ntarasi o ntarasi, neirragie nkopiyiani enye e nkitoo te dukuya ilo orika le nkitoo, neranyisho aajo,
“Kinchiaakino iyie, Olaitoriani lang o Enkai ang, pee ing'amu enkisisa o enkanyit o engolon, amu iyie oitobirua intokitin pooki, naa te yieuna ino eetae ninche neitobiruaki ninche.”
Nadol sii te nkaina e tatene e ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo olpiyayati le mbuku naigero atua o oriong, netipikaki ilmishiren oopishana.
Nadol sii olmalaika ogol elimu to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Ai ng'ae eishiaakino nebol ele piyayati le mbuku nebol lelo mishiren lenyena.”
Nemeetae hoo obo te keper aashu te nkop aashu tiabori enkop oidima atabolo ilo piyayati aashu aing'ura atua.
Naishir oleng amu eitu etumi oltung'ani hoo obo oishiaakino pee edol ilo piyayati aashu eing'or atua.
Naajoki nanu obo le lelo payiani lo losho le Yuda, mintoki aishir. Ng'ura, olng'ur le ntonai e Daudi etimirishe peyie etum atabolo ilo piyayati o lelo mishiren lenyena oopishana.

Ore te rishata o lorika le nkitoo o ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu o tiatua ilpayiani, nadol olkuoo le ker eitashe, etiu anaa keteyiang'aki apa, neeta mowuarak naapishana o nkonyek naapishana, naa ninche nkiyang'eta naapishana e Nkai, naairriwayioki meshomo enkop pooki.
Nelo ilo kuoo le ker nedumu ilo piyayati le mbuku te nkaina e tatene e ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo.

Ore ake pee edumu ilo piyayati le mbuku, nebatata nena ng'uesi naaishu ong'uan te dukuya ilo kuoo le ker, nemeetae ake enemeibung'ita enkawuo oo sinkolioitin, o mbakulini e saabu naabore empuruo narropil naa enkomono oo sinyat.

Nerany osinkolio ng'ejuk aajo, “Kinchiaakino iyie pee idumu olpiyayati le mbuku, nibel ilmishiren lenyena. Amu kiteyieng'aki apa naa to sarge lino inyiang'aka Enkai iltung'ana aitung'uaa loshon pooki, o lng'ejepa, o ltung'ana o loreren.
Nintaa ninche enkitoria o lapolosak le Nkai ang, naa keyooki ninche aaitoreisho te nkop.”
Naitoki nanu aing'orisho, naning emanita olorika le nkitoo o nena ng'uesi naaishu o lelo payiani oltoilo loo lmalaika kumok. Ore esiana enye naa iip nkuyu iip nkuyu o nkalifuni o nkalifuni.
Nejo ninche to ltoilo sapuk, “Keishiakino ilo Kuoo le ker apa oteyiang'aki te neng'amu engolon o enkarsisisho o eng'eno nagut o enkidimata o enkanyit o enkitoo o emayianata.”

Naning nena pooki naaiseuseu te keper o te nkop o tiabori enkop o naatii enaiposha, o nena pooki naatae ejo, “Metaa ene ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo neaku eno lkuoo le ker, emayianata o enkanyit o enkisisa o enkidimata intarasi o ntarasi!”
Nejo nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, “Eesai.” Nebatata ilpayiani aaserem.
Nadol ina kata pee elo ilo Kuoo le Ker abol obo le lelo mishiren oopishana, naning nabo e nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu ejo to ltoilo le ndarata, “Wou!”
Nadol te dukuya nanu embarta naibor, neeta ilo okedito enkawuo o enkopiyia e nkitoo naishooki ninye, neipang alo.
Ore pee ebol ilo kuoo ilo mishire li aare, naning ina ng'ues e are naishu ejo, “Wou!”
Neipang'u enkae barta nanyokie oleng, ore ilo okedito neishooki engolon meiwuang'ie eseriani aitung'uaa e nkop pee eyiang'a iltung'ana maate, neishooki ninye olalem sapuk.
Ore pee ebol olmishire li okuni, naning ina ng'ues e uni naishu ejo, “Wou!” Naing'orisho nadol nanu, embarta narok, ore ilo okedito neeta entemet te nkaina enye.

Naning entoki naaijo oltoilo te mpolos e nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu ejo, “Emborei e mpirlbil e nkano te mpisai nabo, o mboreitin uni e shairi te dinari nabo. Kake mintarruoo eilata o enaisho oo sabibu.”
Ore pee ebol ilo kuoo leker olmishire li ong'uan, naning oltoilo le ina ng'ues e ong'uan naishu ejo, “Wou!”

Naing'orisho nanu, nadol embarta pus, ore enkarna e ilo okedito naa keji Keeya, neirukurukore ninye Enemeneng'a. Neishooki ninye engolon meitoria ematua e ong'uan e nkop, peyie ear metuata to lalem o to lameyu o too lmeitai o too ng'uesi e ntim naatii enkop.
Ore ebol ilo kuoo olmishire le miet nadol ti abori olperere lo lasar iltauja le lelo apa ootaaraki te nkaraki ororei le Nkai o te shakenisho naitayutuo.
Neishir aajo to ltoilo sapuk, “Iyie Olaitoriani Kitok, Oyanyiti nesipa, kanu kenya inguan nintalaku osarge lang te lelo ootii enkop?”
Neishori pooki te lelo olkila oibor, nejokini meyeng'iyeng'ata te nkiti kata, o metaba anaa neiputayu esiana e lelo ooisiaaishote te nebo ninche leton eitokini aar anaa apa ninche maate.
Ore pee ebol ilo kuoo olmishire le ile, naing'orisho nadol etii enkikirikirata sapuk enkop, neroku enkolong netiu anaa olkila orok, neibelekenya olapa olulung'a netiu anaa osarge.
Nesulunye ilakir to loing'ang'e nesulakino enkop anaa ilng'abolo oorrarrunye ilng'anayio te nkata enkirobi eyukito olkutati.
Neng'ishari oloing'ang'e anaa olpiyayati otununukoki. Neiwuang'ieki pooki doinyo, o pooki lemankale aaitung'uaa ewueji enye.
Ore ilaiguanak le na kop, o ltung'ana kituaak, o larikok loo njorin, o lkarsisi o loogol, o pooki ng'ae orrindik aashu ololakuno. Neisudori too nkapuniaa o too soito loo ldoinyo.
Neipot nejoki ildoinyo o soito, “Entusulakinoto iyiook, nisudoo iyiook too nkonyek e ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo, o te ngoro e ilo Kuoo le Ker.
Amu etabawua ina olong kitok e ngoro enye, naa ai ng'ae oidim aitasho te dukuya ninye?”

Ore te siadi ena nadol ilmalaika oong'uan eitashe too lubot pokira ong'uan e nkop, eibooyo isiwuoishi pokira oong'uan le nkop, pee meitoki olkutati akutu te nkop aashu te naiposha aashu akutaki olchani ake pooki.
Naitoki adol likae malaika eilepu te nkilepunoto e nkolong, neeta olmishire le Nkai naishu, neipot to ltoilo sapuk lelo malaika oong'uan ooishooki engolon meinyiala enkop o enaiposha.
Nejoki, “Eminyial enkop aashu enaiposha aashu ilkeek, o metaba anaa nikimishir isinkan le Nkai ang inkomomi enye.”
Naning esiana, e lelo ootimishiraki; naa nkalifuni iip artam o oong'uan ilootimishiraki eing'uaa iloshon pooki loo layiok loo Siraeli:
inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Yuda,

inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Ruben, inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Gad, inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Asheri, inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Naftali, inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Manase.
Inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Simion, inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Lawi,

inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Isaakar naa nkalifuni tomon o aare ilootimishiraki eing'uaa olosho le Sebulon, nkalifuni tomon aare ilo losho le Yosef, nkalifuni tomon oaare ilootimishiraki to losho le Benchamen.

Ore te siadi ena, naing'orisho, nadol olorora kitok lemeeta oltung'ani oidim aikena, eing'uaa pooki orere, neing'uaa iloshon pooki, o ltung'ana o lng'ejepa pooki, eitashe te dukuya olorika le nkitoo o te dukuya ilo Kuoo le Ker, neishopito ilkilani ooibor, neibung'ita ilng'osil loo ltuka too nkaik enye.
Nebuaku too ltoiloishi sapuki aajo, “Ene Nkai ang enjeunoto: ina natonita to lorika le nkitoo o ene ilo Kuoo le Ker.”
Neitashe ilmalaika pooki aaman olorika le nkitoo o lelo payiani o nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, nebatata too nkomomi enye te dukuya ilo orika le nkitoo neserem Enkai.
Ejoito, “Eesai, metaa emayianata o enkisisa o enkitoo, o eng'eno nagut o enkishooroto enashe o enkanyit o engolon o enkidimata ene Enkai ang intarasi o ntarasi. Eesai.”
Naaitoki obo le lelo payiani airorie nanu ajoki, “Kakua tung'ana kulo ooishopito ilkilani ooibor, naa kaji eing'uaa ninche?”
Najoki nanu ninye, “Olkitok, iyiolo iyie.” Naaitoki aajoki, “Kulo ninche lelo ooiturukutuo aaing'uaa ilo sina kitok neitukuo ilkilani lenye neiborrie to sarge lo Lkuoo le Ker.”
Naa te nkaraki ina pee etii dukuya olorika le nkitoo le Nkai neisiaai ninche ninye dama o kewarie tiatua enkaji enye. Ore ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo naa keitushur ninche teine netii ninye.
Nemeitoki aekata ninche aaisumashu aashu aatum enkure. Nemedal enkolong ninche aashu ae kirowuaj napejisho.
Amu ilo Kuoo le Ker otii empolos o lorika le nkitoo oaku olchekut lenye, naa kerikoo ninche too nchorroi oo nkariak naaishu. Naa kejut Enkai pooki kiyioi too nkonyek enye.
Ore pee ebol Olkuoo le Ker olmishire li oopishana, negira keper te rishata naba anaa enusu e saa.
Nadol nanu lelo malaika oopishana, ooitashe te dukuya Enkai, neishori ninche sekekuani naapishana.

Nelotu likae malaika aitashe te mbata o lperere lo lasar, eeta emoti e saabu napejirishoreki, neishori enkorropil sapuk, meitushulaki enkomono e lelo sinyat pooki te nchumata o lperere lo lasar le saabu otii dukuya olorika le nkitoo.
Neilep empuruo e nkorropil o lasar te nebo enkomono e lelo sinyat te nkaina o lmalaika otii dukuya Enkai.
Nedumu olmalaika emoti neiput enkima naitayio to lperere lo lasar, neisuaaki enkop neaku kumok indarat sapuki o nkikurrukurrot naabuaku, o enkimerlel o nkiwuang'at, o enkikirikirata e nkop.
Ore lelo malaika oopishana ooibung'ita sekekuani naapishana neitobir ejo pee eosh.

Neosh ilo malaika le dukuya esekekua enye, neshau enchan oo soito o enkima, nashulare osarge; nedoiki enkop; nepejori ematua e uni e nkop, nepejori ematua e uni oo lkeek, nepejori nkujit pooki naanyori.
Neosh olmalaika li aare esekekua enye. Ore enkito toki naaijo oldoinyo nayupuyup te nkima nenang'akini atua enaiposha.
Neaku ematua e uni e naiposha osarge, neye ematua e uni oo ng'uesi naaishu naatii atua enaiposha, nemuti ematua e uni oo melin.
Neosh olmalaika liokuni esekekua enye, nedou olakira sapuk oing'uaa shumata eyupuyup anaa olkilang'ilang'et, nedoiki ninye ematua e uni oo lkejek, o enoo nkonyek oo nkariak.
Neji enkarna e ilo akira Enduaran. Neitaduari ematua e uni e nkare, neye iltung'ana kumok teina are, amu eitaduaraki.

Neosh olmalaika li oong'uan esekekua enye, ore ematua e uni e nkolong neari, o ematua e uni o lapa, o ematua e uni oo lakir, neaku eitomisimisoki ematua e uni e wang'an enye. Nemitikini ematua e uni e ndama ewang'u naa neijia etiu ematua e uni e nkewarie.

Naitoki aing'orisho naning olkurragos oishirita to ltoilo sapuk eipirri te mpolos o loing'ang'e nejo, “Wooi, Wooi, Wooi, ninche lelo oomanya enkop, te nkaraki enkorui e nena tarumpetani netaa keosh ilmalaika okuni.”
Neitoki olmalaika le imiet aosh esekekua enye, nadol olakira otusulunye eing'uaa shumata elotu enkop. Neishori ninye olbolet lo lgos le ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie.
Nebol ilo gos le ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie, neilepu empuruo te ilo gos naikununo anaa empuruo o lkokuet sapuk, nemisimisu enkolong, o enkijape teina puruo napuku teina gumoto.
Nepuku teina puruo ilmaat nepuonu enkop. Neishori engolon natiu anaa engolon oo nkolopani e nkop.
Nejokini ninche pee meinyal inkujit e nkop, aashu ae toki nabulu nanyori aashu pooki shani, kake lelo tung'ana ake lemeeta olmishire le Nkai too lpurai loo nkomomi enye.
Neishori ninche meisilisilo ninche too lapaitin imiet, kake pee mear metuata. Netiu enkitamioto enye anaa emion e nkolopa, te neng'or oltung'ani.
Naa ore te nena olong'i naa keing'oru oltung'ani keeya nemetum ninye. Neng'uar ninche keeya, neilany keeya ninche.
Ore lelo maat te nidol, neikununo anaa mbartan naatanapate to larrabal. Netii ilukuny enye ntokitin naatiu anaa nkopiyiani e nkitoo e saabu, neikununo nkomomi enye anaa nkomomi oo ltung'ana.
Neikununo ilpapit lenye anaa ilpapit loo nkituaak, neikununo ilala lenye anaa ilala loo lng'atunyo.
Neeta ilpala laaijo nkilani oo lgooitie oo sekenke, ore enkikurrukur oo naipuko enye, netiu anaa enkikurrukur oo ngarrin oo mbartan kumok ekuetiki olarrabal.
Neeta ilkidong'o laaijo loo nkolopani oonyisho, ore engolon enye naitameiyie iltung'ana too lapaitin imiet naa atua lkidong'o lenye etii.
Ore olaiguanani oitore ninche naa ilo malaika le ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie. Ore enkarna enye too Lbrania naa Abadon neji te nkutuk o Lyunani Apolion (nchere olamutani).
Eidipa entaboi e dukuya atulusoi, kake eton eng'or intabo are naapuonu te siadi.
Neitoki olmalaika le ile aosh esekekua enye, naning oltoilo oing'uaa nena mowuarak pokira ong'uan o lperere lo lasar le saabu otii dukuya Enkai.
Nejoki ilo malaika le ile, oata emowuo, “Talaku lelo malaika oong'uan ooena to lkeju sapuk le Frati.”
Nelakuni lelo malaika pokira oong'uan apa ooibooki aaitaanyu ina saa, o ina olong, o ilo apa, oilo ari, pee ear ematua e uni oo ltung'ana.
Ore esiana oo ltimito ookedito mbartan netasha are naa nkalifuni tomon katitin nkalifuni tomon. Atoning'o nanu esiana enye.

Naa nji eikununo nena bartan natoduaa te nduaata ai, neeta lelo ookedito nkilani oo lgooitie oo sekenke naayia anaa enkima, neyia anaa soito pusi ooji Salfa neyia anaa enkima e nkibiriti. Neikununo ilukuny oo mbartan anaa ilukuny oo lng'atunyo Nepuku enkima e Nkibiriti too nkutukie enye.
Ore te kulo meita pokira okuni near metuata ematua e uni oo ltung'ana te nkima o te mpuruo o te nkima e nkibiriti, naing'uaa inkutukie enye.
Amu ore engolon e nena bartan naa atua inkutukie enye etii o lkidong'o lenye. Netiu ilkidong'o lenye anaa ilasuriaa, keeta ilukuny, naa ninche epikishore ilbaa.

Ore iltung'ana ootelekutua, leitu eari metuata te kulo meita, neitu eirridu inkiaasin oo nkaik enye, neitu epal eseremata o eomonoto oo loiriruani o nkitanyaanyukot neme nkaitin e saabu o enkosholai o suyai o soito o enoo nkeek nemedolisho, aashu ening'isho aashu aashom.
Neitu sii eirridu too loikop lenye o te sakutore enye, o te loloito enye o te mpurrorre enye.
Naitoki adol likae malaika edou eing'uaa keper eimulumula te nkatampoi, netii olokirrai shumata endukuya enye, netiu enkomom enye anaa enkolong, neikununo nkejek enyena anaa ng'apeta e nkima.
Neeta te nkaina enye enkiti piyayati e mbuku nabolo. Neroro te nkeju enye e tatene enaiposha, neroro te ne kedianye enkop natoyio.
Neipotisho abuaku to ltoilo sapuk, anaa olo lng'atuny oipur. Ore ake pee eipotisho nedaru nena kikurrukurrot naapishana.
Ore pee edar nena kikurrukurrot naapishana, najo aigerisho kake, naning oltoilo oing'uaa keper ejo, “timishira nena naatejo ndarat naapishana, niminger ake.”
Ore ilo malaika latoduaa eitashe te naiposha o te nkop natoyio, neilepakinye enkaina enye e tatene keper.
Nenya ninye olmumai te ilo oishu ntarasi o ntarasi, laa ninye oitaa keper o pooki naatii atua, o enkop o pooki natii atua, o enaiposha oo pooki naatii atua nejo pee meitoki atii enkimutioto.
Kake ore ti atua inkolong'i naaoshi ina tarumpeta, neosh kenya ilo malaika li oopishana neitabari enkisudoroto e Nkai anaa apa enatolikio ninye, isinkan lenyena lelo oibonok.
Ore ilo toilo duoo latoning'o eing'uaa keper, naaitoki airorie, nejo, “Shomo tudumu ilo piyayati le mbuku obolo, otii enkaina e ilo malaika oitashe te naiposha o te nkop natoyio.”
Nalo enetii olmalaika najoki ninye maaishoo nanu ilo piyayati le mbuku. Naajoki ninye nanu, “Tudumu naa inosa. Kelo aduaru te nkoshoke kake kemelok anaa enaisho oo lotorok te nkutuk ino!”
Nadumu ilo piyayati le mbuku te nkaina e ilo Malaika. Naa kemelok anaa enaisho te nkutuk ai, kake ore ake pee aaidip ainosa neitaduar enkoshoke ai.
Naajokini, “Meeta nchere pee mintoki aibonisho too ltung'ana kumok, o too lng'ejepa o laiguanak.”
Naaitokini aaisho entemet naikununo anaa eng'udi, naajokini nanu, “Inyo tetema enkaji e Nkai o ewueji o lperere lo lasar o lelo ooserem teine.
Kake mitem ake olgoriet otii boo e nkaji e Nkai. Tapala ilo amu eishooki iloreren, naa keituny ninche ina ang sinyati too lapaitin artam o aare.
Naa kaisho ilchakenini laainei oaare engolon naibonishore nkolong'i enkalifu nabo o iip are o ntomoni ile, eishopito ilkuniyiani.”
Kulo ninche lelo oirienito aare, o lelo kilang'ilang'eta aare ooitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani le nkop.
Naa te neyieu oltung'ani neinyal ninche, nepuku enkima too nkutukie enye, nemut ilmang'ati lenye. Te neyieu oltung'ani near ninche neari metua aaiko neijia.

Keeta ninche engolon naikenie oloing'ang'e pee meshau enchan te nena olong'i e naibon enye. Neeta ninche engolon naitoreyie inkariak o enaibelekenyie metaa osarge. Near enkop to lmeitai ake pooki oba anaa enayieu ninche.
Ore ake pee eidip ninche shakenisho enye, ore ina ng'ues nailepua teina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie nedumaki ninche enjore, nemir ninche, near ninche metuata.
Neirrag impopoki enye te nkoitoi nalala eina anasa kitok, naji te nkiroroto e nkitumususet, Sodom o Misiri, naa teine apa etashoki Olaitoriani lenye.
Ore too nkolong'i uni o lpisiai ore iltung'ana loo loshon, o lng'ejepa o loreren neshil nena popoki enye, nemit enukari aapik inkuraren.
Ore lelo tung'ana omanya enkop, neshipakino ninche, neitayu isiruai neishoro inkishoorot, amu ore kulo oibonok le Nkai pokira aare, neisomita oleng lelo ootii enkop.
Kake ore te siadi nena olong'i uni o lpisiai, nejing enkiyang'et e nkishui naing'uaa Enkai, atua ninche neitashe ninche too nkejek enye, neiput enkuretisho sapuk lelo ootoduaa ninche.
Ore ina kata nening lelo oibonok le Nkai aare oltoilo sapuk oing'uaa keper ejoki ninche. “Elepu wootu ene!” Ore eing'orita ilmang'ati lenye neilep ninche aapuo keper te nkatampoi.

Ore teina saa nejing olokirikiri kitok enkop, neurori ematua e tomon e ina anasa. Neari iltung'ana inkalifuni naapishana, metuata teina kikirikirata. Neiputukuny lelo ootelekutua, neisho enkisisa Enkai e keper.
Etulusoyie entaboi e are kake kelotu entaboi e uni asieku.

Neitoki olmalaika li oopishana aosh esekekua enye, netii iltoiloishi sapuki te keper oojoito, “Etaa enkitoo e nkop enkitoo o Laitoriani lang o ene Kristo lenye, naa keitoreisho ninye intarasi o ntarasi.”
Ore lelo payiani tikitam oong'uan ootoni too lorikan lenye le nkitoo te dukuya Enkai nebatata too nkomomi enye aaserem Enkai.
Nejo, “Kincho iyie enashe, Olaitoriani Enkai, olopeny enkidimata pooki, otii taata, netii apa amu iwa te ngolon ino sapuk, ninterua aitoreisho.

Etagorote loreren, kake eewuo engoro ino, neewuo enkata naiguanareki ilootuata, nilaaki ole koisiaayio isinkan linono, iloibonok sinyat o lelo ooure enkarna ino, ilooti o lkituaak, o enkata namuti lelo amutak le nkop.”

Neitokini aabol enkaji e Nkai te keper nedoli osanduku lo sotua lenye ti atua enkaji enye. Netii enkimerlel oo nkiwuang'at o ltoiloishi oobuak, o ndarat e nkikurrukur o lokirikiri le nkop, o enchan sapuk oo soito oleng.
Neliooyu entoki sapuk enking'asia te shumata, enkitok naishopokoki enkolong netii olapa abori inkejek enyena. Ore te ndukuya enye, neeta enkopiyia e nkitoo oo lakir tomon o aare.
Naa entuaa ninye, neishir te mion e saisai o te mion e ishoi.
Neitoki aliooyu enkae toki sapuk e nking'asia te shumata, nadol enkito tiamasi nanyokie, naata lukuny naapishana o mowuarak tomon, neishopokino nkishiliaa e nkitoria naapishana ilukuny enyena.
Neor olkidong'oe lenye ematua e uni oo lakir le shumata, nenang'aki ninche enkop. Neitashe ina tiamasi te dukuya ina tuaa nasaisai, pee enya enkerai enye te neini.
Neiu enkayioni naa ninye oyooki aitore iloreren pooki te ng'udi e sekenkei, kake etawuapayioki ina kerai enye aailepie enetii Enkai o enetii olorika lenye le nkitoo.
Neipirri ina kitok ong'ata, ewueji neitobiraka Enkai, naa ine eitotiyieki aaitagol ninye too nkolong'i enkalifu nabo o iip are o ntomoni ile.
Nepuku olarrabal te Keper earare Mikael o lmalaika lenyena ina tiamasi. Nearare sii ninye ina tiamasi o lmalaika lenyana.
Kake etimiraki ina tiamasi o lmalaika lenyena neaku meeta ewueji netii ninche te Keper.
Nenang'uni ina tiamasi kitok enkop, ilo asurai musana, laa ninye eji Oloirirua o Sheitani, ilo alejani le nkop pooki, nenang'uni ninye enkop, ore ilmalaika lenyena nenang'akini enkop te nebo ninye.

Naning oltoilo sapuk te Keper ejoito, “Eewuo taata enjeunoto, o engolon, o enkitoria e Nkai ang, o enkidimata e Kristo lenye. Amu etanang'akaki enkop olaitang'oroni loo lalashera lang, laa ninye oitang'or ninche dama o kewarie te dukuya Enkai ang.
Netimira ninche ninye te ilo sarge lo Lkuoo le Ker, o to rorei le shakenisho enye, amu eitu enyorru ninche enkishui enye o metabaiki keeya.
Ting'idayu naa, iyie keper o intae lelo pooki ootii atua. Kake wooi, intae nakop o enaiposha, amu etadowuo Sheitani enitii te ngoro sapuk. Amu eyiolo ajo dorrop enkata enye.”
Ore ake pee edol ina tiamasi ajo etanang'akaki enkop, nemir ina kitok natoiwuo enkayioni.

Kake eishooki ina kitok inaipuko are naaijo ino lkurragos sapuk loo lmurran, pee elotie ti ai ailany ilo asurai, nelo ong'ata, ine wueji neitotiyieki aaitagol, te nkata, o too nkatitin, o lpisiai le nkata.
Nebuku ina tiamasi enkare naaijo olkeju eing'uaa enkutuk enye te siadi ina kitok ejo pee eoroo to loirrag le nkare.
Kake etaretuo enkop ina kitok, neng'a enkop enkutuk neijoo ilo keju otonotua ina tiamasi te nkutuk enye.
Negorokino taa ina tiamasi ina kitok nelo aitainye olarrabal eishoi natelekua e ina kitok, lelo pooki leton eibung'ita nkitanapat e Nkai, neishakenoki Yesu.
Neitashe ina tiamasi to sinyai le naiposha.
Nadol nanu eng'ues eilepu aing'uaa atua enaiposha naata imowuarak tomon o lukuny naapishana neishopokino nkishiliaa tomon e nkitoo nena mowuarak enyena. Netii enkarna e morore nena lukuny enyena.

Ore ina ng'ues natoduaa neikununo anaa olowuaru keri, netiu inkejek enyena anaa ino lng'arurumi, netiu enkutuk enye anaa eno lng'atuny. Neisho ilo asurai ina ng'ues engolon enye o lorika lenye le nkitoo, o enkidimata sapuk.
Ore nabo oo lukuny enyena, naa ijo keeta olbae le keeya. Ore ilo bae lenye le keeya neishiwuo, nesuj enkop pooki ina ng'ues eing'asia.
Neserem iltung'ana ilo asurai, amu eishoo ninye enkidimata enye ina ng'ues, neserem ninche ina ng'ues ejo “Ae ng'ae otiu anaa ina ng'ues, naa ae ng'ae oidima airisha?”
Neishori ina ng'ues enkutuk nairorie imbaa naarupie kewan o roreii oomor Enkai, neishori meitoreisho too lapaitin artam o are.
Nebol enkutuk enye emorisho, nemor Enkai, amor enkarna enye o emanyisho enye. Aa nchere lelo pooki oomanya keper.
Neishori sii meitayunye olarrabal isinyat, nemir ninche. Neishori ninye enkitoria naitoreyie iloshon o ltung'ana, o lng'ejepa, o loreren.
Ore lelo pooki ootii enkop neserem ninye, pooki ng'ae apa leitu eigeri enkarna enye apa eton eitu eitamanyuni enkop, ti atua embuku e mpuaan e ilo Kuoo le Ker apa otaraki.
Te neetae oloata enkiok, nchoo ening.
Ore ake pooki ng'ae oarari, nelo eyararoto; ore ake pooki ng'ae oarisho to lalem meeta nchere meari sii ninye to lalem. Ene taa etii enkipototo te nkaraki eng'iriata o enkirukoto oo sinyat.
Naitoki adol ae ng'ues natudumunye te nkop neeta mowuarak are anaa olkuoo le ker, neiro ninye anaa ilo asurai.
Neitoreishore ninye enkidimata pooki e idia ng'ues e dukuya, teine netii ninye, nearaki enkop o pooki oomanya enkop meteserema ina ng'ues e dukuya, apa naishiwuo olbae lenye le keeya.
Neas ilmonek sapuki o metaa ninye keitadou enkima eing'uaa keper meeu enkop edolita iltung'ana.

Ore too lmonek ooishooki metaasa teine netii ina ng'ues neitapong'oo lelo ootii enkop. Neitanap lelo oomanya enkop meitobira ninche enkitanyaanyukoto e ina ng'ues naata endung'oto o lalem neton ake eishu.
Neishori ninye meishoo enkiyang'et ina kitanyaanyukoto e ina ng'ues, pee etum ninye ina kitanyaanyukoto ataa keiro. Nejo metaari metuata lelo pooki lemeserem ina kitanyaanyukoto e ina ng'ues.
Neisho sii pooki ng'ae, looti o lkituaak, ilkarsisi o laisinak, irrindiki o leme rrindiki, metipiki olmishire enkaina e tatene aashu enkomom,
pee meitoki hoo obo ainyiang'isho aashu emirisho, meteleku ake te neeta ilo mishire, aa taa enkarna e ina ng'ues, aashu esiana e ina arna enye.
Keyieu taa ena eng'eno nagut, nchoo ilo oata ening'unoto eikenisho atum esiana e ina ng'ues. Amu esiana e tung'ani. Ore esiana enye naa iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile.

Naitoki aing'orisho, nadol te nchumata o Ldoinyo le Sion eitashe Olkuoo le Ker. Netii te nebo ninye iltung'ana nkalifuni iip artam o oong'uan ooata enkarna enye o ene menye lenye eigero too lpurai loo nkomomi enye.
Naning oltoilo eing'uaa keper laaijo enkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok, netiu sii anaa enkikurrukur sapuk. Ore ilo toilo latoning'o netiu anaa oltoilo loo laoshok loo nkinantani eoshito inkinantani enye.

Nerany osinkolio ng'ejuk te dukuya olorika le nkitoo o te dukuya nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, o te dukuya lelo payiani. Nemeetae hoo obo oidim atayiolo ilo sinkolio meteleku ake lelo nkalifuni iip artam o ong'uan ooidipaki aatokordu te nkop.

Naa kulo leitu eidurukie ate too ng'oruo, amu meyiolo ninche inkituaak. Naa kulo ooirukurukore ilo Kuoo le Ker pooki wueji nelo. Etokorduaki kulo ti atua ltung'ana, pee eaku ilng'anayio le dukuya le Nkai o ilo Kuoo le Ker.
Neitu etumieki nkutukie enye emonkoi, amu meeta eleyiata.
Naitoki adol likae malaika eipirri te mpolos o loing'ang'e, neeta ilomon supati loo ntarasi olo aliki lelo oomanya enkop, pooki kop, o pooki osho o pooki ng'ejep o ltung'ana.
Nejo to ltoilo sapuk, “Entureita Enkai ninchosho ninye enkisisa. Amu eewuo e nkiguana enye. Enteserem ilo oitobira keper o enkop, o enaiposha o nchorroi oo nkariak.”
Ore likae malaika, li aare, nesuju, ejo, “Eturori, eturori Babilon kitok, ina naitooko iloreren pooki enaisho e mpushuna e loloito enye.”
Nelotu likae malaika liokuni asuju ninche, ejoito to ltoilo sapuk, “Ore pooki ng'ae oserem ina ng'ues o enkitanyaanyukoto enye, netum olmishire to lpura le nkomom enye aashu te nkaina enye,
neyooki sii aok e naisho e ngoro, e Nkai, natubukokoki enkikompe e ngoro eirrusha. Naa keitamei te nkima o te nkibiriti te dukuya lelo malaika sinyat o te dukuya ilo Kuoo le Ker?

Ore empuruo e nkisilisiloto enye neilep intarasi o ntarasi. Nemeeta enkiyeng'iyeng'ata dama o kewarie lelo aseremak le ina ng'ues o enkitanyaanyukoto enye, o pooki ng'ae ong'amu olmishire le nkarna enye.”
Ene taa etii enkipototo e ng'iriata e lelo sinyat, lelo ooibung inkitanapat e Nkai o enkirukoto e Yesu.

Naning oltoilo oing'uaa keper ejo, “Ngero ena, Emayiana lelo ootuata laa ti atua Olaitoriani eye taata o kenya.” “Esipa emayiana,” ejo enkiyang'et, “Pee etum aayeng'iyengata too sinaitin lenye, amu kesuj ninche inkiaasin enye.”

Naitoki aing'orisho nadol enkatampoi naibor. Netonita teina atampoi obo onyaanyukie Enkerai e Tung'ani, neishopito te lukunya enye enkopiyia e nkitoo e saabu, neibung'ita olalem opi oololo te nkaina enye.

Nepuku likae malaika eing'uaa atua enkaji e Nkai, eipotito to ltoilo sapuk ilo otonita te nkatampoi amu ejo, “Tudung'ishore ilo alem lino oololo ninkesisho amu enkata e nkikesare, eo abaya enkikesare e nkop.”
Neyuk ilo otonita te nkatampoi olalem lenye oololo neikesishoe te nkop.
Neitoki apuku likae malaika teina aji e Nkai natii keper, neeta sii ninye olalem opi oololo.

Neitoki likae malaika apuku eing'uaa olperere lo lasar, laa ninye oata engolon naitoreyie enkima. Neipot to ltoilo sapuk ilo oata olalem opi oololo nejoki, “Tudung'ishore olalem lino oololo tasotu nkimarrimarrat oo sabibu te nkop, amu eoto isabibu lenyena.”
Neaku eyuko olmalaika olalem lenye oololo te nkop nesotu isabibu le nkop. Nenang'aki ninche atua enkironyet e ngoro e Nkai.
Neitunyi lelo sabibu teina kironyet ti auluo ina anasa, nerukunye osarge teina kironyet, o metabaiki mbartan inkeenta oo nkutukie, neba te nkadoro anaa inkilomitani iip uni.
Naitoki adol entoki sapuk e nking'asia te shumata, kitok naa ene nking'asia, ilmalaika oopishana ooata ilmeita oopishana laa ninche oobayie, laa te ninche etimitunye engoro e Nkai.

Naitoki adol entoki naikununo anaa enaiposha e kiook nashulare enkima. Ore lelo ootimira ina ng'ues o enkitanyaanyukoto enye o esiana e nkarna enye, neitashe te mbata e ina aiposha e kiook, neibung'ita nkinantani e Nkai too nkaik enye.

Nerany osinkolio le Musa ilo sinka le Nkai osinkolio lo Lkuoo le ker, aajo, “Eikituaak naa ine nking'asia nkiaasin inono, iyie Olaitoriani Enkai Magilani, keitoriori nesipa inkoitoi inono, Olaiguanani loo lporori.
Ae ng'ae lemeureisho neisis enkarna ino, Olaitoriani. Amu iyie ake openy osinyati. Eikipuonu nkuapi pooki aserem iyie, amu ore inkiguanat inono neidipaki aaibalunye.”
Ore te siadi ena naing'orisho, ore enkaji e Nkai o lng'obor le shakenisho ti atua keper neboli.
Neipang'u tiatua ina aji e Nkai lelo malaika oopishana ooata ilmeita oopishana, eishopito nkilani nemeiduruk naawang oleng neenita too lgooitie lenye nkeenta e saabu.
Ore nabo e nena ng'uesi e ong'uan naaishu, neisho lelo malaika oopishana mbakulini naapishana e saabu naabore engoro e Nkai, naishu ntarasi o ntarasi.

Neigany enkaji e Nkai empuruo eing'uaa enkitoo e Nkai neing'uaa engolon enye. Nemeetae hoo obo oidima atijing'a atua ina aji e Nkai o metaba anaa nelusoo lelo meita oopishana le lelo malaika oopishana.
Naitoki aning oltoilo sapuk oing'uaa enkaji e Nkai ejoki lelo malaika oopishana, “Enchom entubukoki enkop lelo bakulini oopishana le ngoro e Nkai.”
Nelo olmalaika le dukuya nebukoki olbakuli lenye oriong enkop. Nejing inkirondoni torrok naang'u lelo tung'ana ooata olmishire le ina ng'ues neserem enkitanyaanyukoto enye.
Nebukoki olmalaika li aare olbakuli lenye enaiposha, netiu enkare anaa osarge lo ltung'ani otua. Neye pooki toki naishu natii atua enaiposha.
Nebukoki olmalaika liokuni olbakuli lenye atua ilkejek o nchorroi e nkare, neaku ninche osarge.
Naning ilo malaika loo nkariak ejo, “Ira iyie asipani te kuna kiguanat inono, iyie olotii taata nitii apake, losinyati obo, amu ena enkiguana ino.
Amu eibukoitie iltung'ana osarge loo sinyat o loo loibonok le Nkai, ninchoo iyie ninche osarge metooko. Ina nairirikino ninche.”
Naning olperere lo lasar pee eishir ajo, “Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, Olmagilani, esipa neitoriori nkiguanat inono.”
Nebukoki olmalaika liong'uan olbakuli lenye enkolong, neishori ninye metapejo iltung'ana te nkima.
Nepeji iltung'ana te nkirowuaj napi, nedek ninche enkarna e Nkai naa ninye naata engolon te kulo meita. Neitu eirridu ninche anaa eisho ninye enkitoo.
Nebukoki olmalaika le miet olbakuli lenye ilo orika le nkitoo le ina ng'ues, nemisimisu enkitoria enye. Neony iltung'ana ilng'ejepa lenye te mion.
