Nedek Enkai e keper te nkaraki emion o te nkaraki inkirondoni, neitu eirridu inkiaasin enye.
Nebukoki olmalaika le ile olbakuli lenye olkeju kitok le Freti, netoyu enkare e ilo keju, pee eitobiri enkoitoi naimu ilaiguanak ooing'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong.
Nadol nanu, epuku te nkutuk e ina tiamasi, o te nkutuk e ina ng'ues, o te nkutuk e ilo le lejare, inkiyang'eta uni torrok naaijo ntuaan e nkare.
Amu inkiyang'eta oo loiriruani ninche naas inkitoduaat, nepuaya enetii ilaiguanak le nkop pooki pee eiturrurru ninche te njore ena olong kitok e Nkai Magilani.
“Ng'ura, kalotu nanu anaa olapurroni. Emayiana ilo oshololo, ogolie inkilani enyena pee melo ake meishopo nedoli meishopo.”
Neiturrur ninche te wueji neji te nkutuk oo Lbrania Har-Magedon.
Nebukoki olmalaika liopishana olbakuli lenye atua enkijape. Nepuku oltoilo sapuk tiatua enkaji e Nkai, eing'uaa ilo orika le nkitoo nejo, “Etaasaki!”
Nepuku nkiwuang'at e enkimerlel, o ltoiloishi sapuki, o ndarat o enkikurrukur, o enkikirikirata e nkop neitu aekata etumi anaa nejing tung'ani oriong enkop. Kitok ilo okirikiri le nkop oleng.
Neoro ina anasa kitok aaku matuan uni, neuror nkanas kituaak oo loreren. Nedamu Enkai Babilon kitok, pee eitook ninye metimita enkikompe e mpijan e ngoro enye.
Neilanyisho aaisik pooki lemankale, neitu eitokini aadol ildoinyo.

Neshau enchan isoito sapukin oleng, laa nkiloi onom enkiroishi o soit obo, nedoiki iltung'ana eing'uaa keper, o metaba anaa nedek iltung'ana Enkai te nkaraki ina shan oo soito, ilo meitai oitureisho naleng.
Neitoki olmalaika obo le lelo oopishana ooata ilbakulini oopishana alotu enatii naajoki, “Wou, maaitoduaa nanu iyie enkiguana nadung'okini ena mulayoi yioloti, natonita too nkariak kumok.
Naa te ninye etololoitore ilaiguanak le nkop naa te naisho e loloito enye etemerate lelo ootii enkop.”
Naaya ilo malaika nanu te nkiyang'et ong'ata nadol enkitok natonita te nkoriong e ng'ues nanyokie nabore nkarn e morore neeta ilukuny naapishana o mowuarak tomon.

Netukusoki ina kitok too nkilani morijo o naanyokie. Neikodi te saabu o too ntoto sidain o museitani naagol o too lului. Neibung'ita te nkaina enye enkikompe e saabu nabore olminong o loirerioni le loloito enye.
Ore to lpura le nkomom enye neigero enkarna e nkisudoroto: “Babilon kitok, ng'oto mulayoni o ilo minong le nkop.”
Nadol ina kitok etemere to sarge loo sinyat le Nkai o to sarge loo lchakenini le Yesu. Ore pee adol nanu ninye naing'asia oleng.
Kake aatiaaka olmalaika, “Kainyoo pee ing'asia? Kaaliki taata enkisudoroto e na kitok, o ene ina ng'ues naata ilukuny naapishana o mowuarak tomon naanapita ninye

re ina ng'ues nitoduaa keishu apa, nemeekure eishu. Naa kepuku ailepu te ngumoto nemeeta enkiting'oto nelo atua enkidaaroto. Ore lelo oomanya enkop leitu esiri inkarn enye te mbuku e mpuaan ebaiki apa pee eitamanyuni enkop naa keing'asia te nedol ina ng'ues, amu etii apa, nemeetii taata, naa kelotu.
Eyieu ena eng'eno nagut. Ore nena lukuny naapishana naa ildoinyo oopishana oogira ina kitok atonie.
Naa ilaiguanak oopishana sii. Netabatatate imiet lenye, netii obo, neton eitu elotu olikae, naa ore te nelotu meeta nchere pee me nkiti kata ake eton.
Ore ina ng'ues apa natii nemetii taata, naa ene isiet kake ene nena naapishana sii, naa kelotu enkidaaroto.
“Ore nena mowuarak tomon nitoduaa naa ilaiguanak tomon leton eitu eng'amu engolon naitoreishore. Kake keng'amu engolon anaa ilaiguanak te saa nabo te nebo ina ng'ues.
Ile ndamunoto nabo kulo neishoo ina ng'ues engolon o enkidimata enye.
Neitayunyie olarrabal ilo kuoo le ker, nemir Olkuoo le Ker ninche, amu ninye Olaitoriani loo laitoriak naa Olaiguanani loo laiguanak, ore lelo ooboitare ninye naa keipoto negeluno neisiligayu.”
Naajoki ninye ilo malaika, “Ore nena ariak nitoduaa teine netonie emulayoi naa iltung'ana o lororani o nkuapi o lng'ejepa.
Ore nena mowuarak tomon nitoduaa, ore ninche o ina ng'ues keibayu ina mulayoi, nekiny ninye aitalioo meishopo, nenya nkiri o sesen lenye nepejoo ninye te nkima.
Amu Enkai natipika atua oltau lenye meitabai inaayieu ninye, neaku ile ndamunoto nabo, neishooyo engolon enye, e nkitoria aaisho ina ng'ues, o metaba anaa neitabari ororei le Nkai.
Ore ina kitok nitoduaa naa ina anasa kitok naata enkitoria alang ilaiguanak le nkop.”
Ore te siadi ena nadol likae malaika edou aing'uaa keper neeta enkidimata sapuk, neitawang'i enkop teina sikar enye.
Nebuaku to ltoilo le ngolon ejo, “Eturori, eturori Babilon kitok! Etaa emanyisho oo loiriruani, orrumat le pooki kiyang'et torrono, orrumat le pooki motonyi torrono naibaisho.
Amu etooko iloreren pooki enaisho oo sabibu oo ng'uarrat enyena torrok. Ore laiguanak le nkop neloloito te ninye, netaa karsisi ilbiasharani le nkop te nkiborra enye oo nkonyek.”
Naitoki aning likae toilo oing'uaa keper ejo, “Entupuku entung'uai ninye lo tung'ana laainei, pee mimbung'arere ake ninye ti atua ing'ok enyena, pee ming'arierie ake ilmeita lenyena.
Amu eturupate ng'ok enyena oleng aabaya keper. Netadamua Enkai intorrok enyena.
Entalaaki ninye anaa enaitalakishe sii ninye makewan. Entalaaki katitin are te risioroto oo nkiaasin enyena. Eng'oling'olaki ninye mboreitin are teina kikompe naing'ola sii ninye.
Ore anaa ina naturupa ninye kewan neiborrie onyek nchoo sii ninye olosilisili o lkiyioi ntorisioki ena. Amu ejo to ltau lenye eton ara enkaiguanani, mara nanu enkoliai, ore olkiyioi madol aekata.
Metaa kepuonu ilmeita lenyena te nkolong nabo, inkeyaitin o lkiyioi o lameyu. Naa kepejori ninye te nkima. Amu aimagilani Olaitoriani Enkai nadung'oki ninye enkiguana.”
Ore ilaiguanak le nkop ootololoitore ninye neiborrie onyek te nebo ninye naa keyietu neishir neishiraki ina anasa te nedol empuruo enye e mpejoroto.
Neitashe ninche te nelakua te nkuretisho o enkitamioto enye ejo, “Wooi ina anasa kitok, naa magilani Babilon! Te saa nabo eewuo endung'okinoto ino e nkiguana.”
Ore ilbiasharani le nkop neishir aaishiraki ninye amu meekure eetae hoo obo oitoki ainyiang'u imasaa enyena.

Imasaa e saabu o enkosholai, o soito oogol enkinyang'a o lului, o lkarash oopuyiapui o lmorijo o loonyokie o mpukunot pooki oo lkeek oorropil o ntokitin pooki naaguetuni too lala loo lkanchaoni, o ntokitin pooki oo nkeek naagol enkinyiang'a, o suyai, o esekenkei o ltoto ooibor;

o lmadalasini o ltankausi o enkorropil o emanoo narropil o lbani, o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata enkurma napuyiapui, o enkano o nkishu o nkerrai o mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan o rrindiki, aa taa iltauja loo ltung'ana.
“Ore ilo ng'anayioi oshi otang'uarra oltau lino nikitung'uayie iyie, ore intokitin inono pooki e nkuso o esikar kitung'uaitie ninche, nemeitokini aekata aatum.”
Ore ilamirak le nena masaa ootudupore enkarsisisho naing'uaa ina anasa neitashe te nelakua te nkuretisho e mion enye, neishir neyietu abuaku ajo,
“Wooi, wooi ena kito anasa naishopo apa too nkilani naapuyiapui o morijo o naanyokie, neikodi, te saabu o too soito oogol enkinyiang'a o too lului.

Te saa nabo eidaikieki ena arsisisho pooki.” Ore ilkituaak pooki loo melin, o ltung'ana oopuo too naaiposha, ilaisiaayiak loo melin o pooki laa ore enkinyiang'a enye naa enaiposha etii neitashe te nelakua.
Nebuaku aaishir ina kata pee edol empuruo e mpejoroto eina anasa nejo, kaa anasa nanyaanyukie enkanasa kitok?

Neisuaaki enterit ilukuny enye, eishiraki ninye. Neyietu nebuaku aaishir nejo, “Wooi, wooi, te nkaraki ena anasa kitok natudupore kulo pooki ooata melin, te naiposha teina arsisisho enye. Te saa nabo eidaikieki.
Ting'idakinoyu iyie ninye na keper o intae isinyat, o lkipaareta, o loibonok le Nkai, amu etudung'oko Enkai ninye enkiguana te nkaraki intae.”
Nedumu olmalaika ogol osoit kitok laaijo oloiwutuutishoreki nenang'aki atua enaiposha nejo, “Neijia eikunakini Babilon kitok ina ang kitok esuluni enkop te ngolon, nemeitokini aekata aatum;

ore iltoiloishi loo loowosh nkinantani o laranyak, o lakutak loo ndulen, o sekekuani, nemeitokini aekata aaning ti atua iyie. Nemeitokini aekata aatum ti atua iyie oltung'ani le nkiaas e nkarriyiano hoo nabo. Ore Oltoilo lo soit ooiwutuutishoreki nemeitokini aekata aaning ti atua iyie;

ore ewang'an o ltaa nemeitoki aekata awang'u ti atua iyie; ore oltoilo lo loyamisho o enayami nemeitokini aekata aaning ti atua iyie amu ore lbiasharani linono naa ninche apa iltung'ana kituaak te nkop, netelejaki nkuapi pooki teina sakutore ino.
Naa ti atua ninye enotoki osarge loo loibonok le Nkai o loo sinyat, o lelo pooki ootaraki te nkop.”
Ore te siadi ena naning entoki naaijo oltoilo kitok lo lorora kitok te keper ebuaku aajo, “Haleluya, ene Nkai ang enjeunoto o enkisisa o engolon.
Amu ore nkiguanat enyena nesipa neitoriori; etudung'oko ninye enkiguana ina mulayoi yioloti apa naitapong'oyie enkop te loloito enye, neitalakua te ninye osarge loo sinkan lenyena.”
Neitoki ake ninche aaigil aabuaku aajo, “Haleluya eijukujuk empuruo enye ailep alo shumata ntarasi o ntarasi.”
Ore lelo payiani tikitam oong'uan o nena ng'uesi naaishu nebatata neserem Enkai etonita te ilo orika le nkitoo, ejoito, “Eesai Haleluya!”
Nepuku oltoilo oing'uaa olorika le nkitoo obuaku ajo “Esisa Enkai ang intae isinkan lenyena pooki, intae ilooure ninye, ilooti o lkituaak.”

Naitoki aning oltoilo laaijo olo lorora kitok oikununo anaa enkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok netiu sii anaa indarat oo nkikurrukurrot sapuki ebuaku aajo, “Haleluya! Amu Olaitoriani Enkai ang Magilani oitoreisho.
Mating'idata nikiosh olkerempe, nikincho ninye enkitoo, amu etabawua enkiyama o Lkuoo le Ker, netukuso kewan ina nayami.
Neishooki ninye meishopo ilkarash oopuyiapui ooibor newang,” nemetii olduruki. Amu ore lelo karash sidain naa iasat supati e lelo sinyat.
Naajoki ilo malaika, “Ing'ero, ena; emayiana lelo ooitoomonoki to sirua le nkiyama o Lkuoo le Ker.” Naajoki ninye nanu, “Irorei oosipa le Nkai kulo.”

Nabatata too nkejek enyena aserem ninye, kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, “Mintoki aiko neijia! Amu kara ake osinka oasisho te nebo iyie o lalashera linono ooibung'ita shakenisho e Yesu. Teserema Enkai!” Amu ore shakenisho e Yesu naa ninye enkiyang'et e naibon.
Naitoki adol keper etaboloki; nadol embarta naibor, ore ilo okedito ina naa keji, Oloisiligayu naa Asipani, naa too sipat eiguana neitayu olarrabal.
Ore nkonyek enyena neikununo anaa olng'ejep le nkima neeta te lukunya enye nkaradan e nkitoria kumok, neeta enkarna nasirakino nemeyiolo likae tung'ani kake ninye ake oyiolo.
Neishopito olkila oitadoikioki osarge neji enkarna naipotieki Ororei le Nkai.
Nesujita ninye njorin e keper naaishopito nkilani sidain e kitani napuyiapui newang, nesujita ninye imbartan naaibor.
Nepuku te nkutuk enye olalem opi laa ninye earie inkuapi, neitore ninche te ng'udi e sekenkei. Neituny ninye ewueji neironyieki enaisho e ngoro napi e Nkai Magilani.
Ore to lkila lenye o te nkupes enye neeta enkarna naigerokino ajo, Olaiguanani loo laiguanak naa Olaitoriani loo laitoriak.
Naitoki adol olmalaika eitashe tiatua enkolong. Nebuaku aipotisho to ltoilo sapuk aipot imotonyi pooki naapuoito te mpolos o loing'ang'e, nejoki, “Wootu enturrurrokinoto osirua kitok le Nkai,

pee inyanya nkiri oo ilaiguanak o ilarikok loo njorin o nkiri oo ltung'ana magil, nkiri oo mbartan o noo lookedito ninche o nkiri oo ltung'ana pooki, loolakuno o rrindiki, ndung'ot pokira, ilooti o lkituaak.”
Nadol nanu ina ng'ues o lelo aiguanak le nkop te nebo o njorin enye eiturrurrote pee earare ilo okedito ina barta nearare enjore enye.

Neibung'i ina ng'ues, te nebo ilo oiboni lenye le lejare, otaasa ilmonek te dukuya ninye naa ninche etelejie lelo ootang'amaitie olmishire le ina ng'ues o lelo ooteserema ina kitanyaanyukoto enye. Ore lelo pokira o are, nenang'akini eishu atua ilo balbal le nkima, oyupuyup te nkibiriti.
Ore ilootelekutua neari to lalem le ilo okedito ina barta. Te ilo alem opuku ti tua enkutuk enye; ore imotonyi pooki nenya inkiri enye ometaraposhoto.
Naitoki adol olmalaika odou aing'uaa keper, eibung'ita te nkaina enye olbolet le ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie o lpisiai kitok.
Neibung ninye ilo asurai, ilo asurai musana laa ninye Oloirirua naa Sheitani, neen ninye ilarin enkalifu nabo.

Nenang'aki olmalaika ninye atua ina gumoto, neiken nemishiraa ninye teine pee meitoki ae kata alej iloreren, o metaba anaa neishunye lelo arin enkalifu nabo. Ore pee elusoo ina nemeeta nchere pee melakuni te nkiti rishata.

Naitoki adol ilorikan le nkitoo, ore lelo oogira aatonie ninche naa ninche eishoro endung'okinoto e nkiguana. Naitoki sii adol iltauja le lelo ootudung'oyioki ilukuny enye te nkaraki shakenisho e Yesu o te nkaraki ororei le Nkai, naa lelo leitu eserem ina ng'ues aashu ina kitanyaanyukoto enye, neitu, eng'amu olmishire lenye too lpurai loo nkomomi enye aashu too nkaik enye. Nepiu ninche neitoreisho te nebo Kristo ilarin enkalifu nabo.
Ore lelo kulikae ootuata neitu epiu o metaba anaa neishunye ilarin enkalifu nabo. Ena empiunoto e dukuya.

Emayiana naa sinyati ilo ong'arieki empiunoto e dukuya. Ore te lelo, nemeeta keeya e are engolon. Kake keaku ninche ilapolosak le Nkai o le Kristo naa keitoreisho ninche te nebo ninye ilarin enkalifu nabo.
Ore pee eishunye lelo arin enkalifu nabo, nelakuni Sheitani te jila enye.
Naa kelotu alej inkuapi naatii ilubot pokira ong'uan e nkop, aa taa Gog o Magog, neiturrur ninche te nkaraki olarrabal, neba esiana enye anaa osinyai le naiposha.
Neidondorra ninche aailepaki endapasho e nkop, neman ina ang oo ilng'oborri loo sinyat, o ina anasa kirotet kake etadowuo enkima eing'uaa keper neidaikie ninche.
Ore oloirirua laa ninye apa oteleja ninche nenang'akini atua olbalbal le nkima o enkibiriti ine netii ina ng'ues o ilo oiboni le lejare, nepuoi aaitame ninche dama o kewarie intarasi o ntarasi.
Naitoki adol olorika le nkitoo oibor kitok o ilo otonita. Neilanyisho enkop o keper aaing'uaa ine netii ninye nelaii ewueji neishaa ninche.

Nadol nanu lelo apa ootuata, ilkituaak o looti eitashe te dukuya olorika le nkitoo, neboli mbukui. Neitokini sii aabol ae buku naa ninye embuku e mpuaan. Nedung'okini lelo ootuata enkiguana anaa enasira tiatua nena bukui, te nena apa naataasa ninche.
Neitayu enaiposha ilootuata ootii atua ninye. Neitayu keeya o ene meneng'a ninche neiguanareki ninche too naataasa.
Nenang'akini keeya o enemeneng'a atua ilo balbal le nkima. Ena ninye keeya e are, ilo balbal le nkima.
Naa ore pooki ng'ae leitu etumi enkarna enye eigero tiatua ina buku e mpuaan, nenang'akini ninye atua olbalbal le nkima.
Naitoki adol keper ng'ejuk o enkop ng'ejuk. Amu ore keper e dukuya o enkop e dukuya neidipa aatulusoi, meekure eetae enaiposha.
Nadol ina anasa Sinyati, Yerusalem ng'ejuk edou te keper eing'uaa Enkai, eitobiraki anaa esiankiki naikodokini olpayian lenye.
Naning oltoilo kitok oing'uaa olorika le nkitoo ejo, “Ng'ura Etii emanyisho e Nkai te nebo iltung'ana. Keton ninye te nebo ninche neaku iltung'ana lenyena. Ore Enkai kewan neaku ketii te nebo ninche;
naa kejut ninye pooki kiyioi too nkonyek enye, ore keeya nemeitokini aekata aata aashu eitokini aata olkiyioi, aashu enkishirata aashu emion aekata. Amu etulusoitie intokitin pooki e dukuya.”
Ore ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo nejo, “Ekaitaa intokitin pooki ng'ejuko.” Nejo sii, “Ngero ena, amu ore kulo rorei naa keisiligayu nesipa.”
Naajoki ninye nanu. “Eidipe, Ara nanu Alfa o Omega, enkiterunoto o enkiting'oto. Ore oloata enkure naa kaisho nanu enkare metii enkinyiang'a eing'uaa enchorro e nkare e mpuaan.
Ore ilo omirisho naa ketum ena jung'ore naa kaaku nanu Enkai enye neaku ninye enkerai ai.

Kake ore ilkureti o lemeiruk o looikereek o larak o loololoito o lasakutok o looserem inkitanyaanyukot o lalejak pooki, ore ewueji enye naa keaku ilo balbal le nkima oyupuyup te nkima e nkibiriti. Naa ninye keeya e are.”
Neitoki alotu olmalaika obo le lelo oopishana ooata ilbakulini oopishana oobore ilmeita oopishana oobayie naairorie naajoki, “Wou, kaaitodol ina siankiki, ina kitok o Lkuoo le Ker.”
Naaya enkiyang'et o maaitabaiki oldoinyo kitok oodo, naaitodol ina anasa sinyati, Yerusalem, edou te shumata eing'uaa enetii Enkai te keper,
eeta enkitoo e Nkai, naikununo enkitiil anaa eno soit lemetumoyu aashu osoit oji yasper, owang anaa oltotoi.
Neeta esuntai kitok naado, neeta inchomito tomon o aare, netii ilmalaika tomon o aare, nena shomito, nesira inkarn e lelo oshon tomon o aare loo layiok loo Siraeli te nena shomito.
Netii enkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong inchomito uni, netii kopikop inchomito uni, netii moikuape uni, netii endoyioroto e nkolong inchomito uni.
Neeta ina suntai e ina anasa ilkitamanyunot tomon o aare, nesirakino ninche inkarn tomon o aare o lkipaareta lo Lkuoo le Ker.
Ore ilo laairorie nanu neeta ninye entemet e ng'udi e saabu natemie ina anasa, o nchomito enyena o sunta.

Ore ina anasa nerisio nkaloli pokira ong'uan, erisio enkadoro enye o endapasho enye, netem ninye ina ang teina ng'udi, neaku inkilomitani nkalifuni are o iip ong'uan. Erisio enkadoro o endapasho o enkadoro nailep.
Netem sii esuntai enye naa ntemeta ntomoni ile te ntemata o ltung'ani aa taa enoo lmalaika.
Ore ina suntai naa osoit oji yasper eshetare. Ore ina anasa naa ene saabu nasila, newang anaa kiook.

Ore ilkitamanyunot le suntai e ina anasa neikodoki te pooki soit oata tipat; ore ole dukuya naa yasper, ore o liaare naa soito pusi ooji safi, ore o liokuni naa soito ooji agate, ore o lioong'uan naa soito oonyori ooji emerald,

ore ole mmiet naa osoit oji oniks ore ole ile naa osoit oji karnelian, ore ole oopishana naa osoit oji krisolite, ore ole isiet naa osoit oji beril, ore o liooudo naa osoit oji topas, ore ole tomon naa osoit oji krisopras, ore ole tomon o obo naa osoit oji yasinas, ore ole tomon o aare naa osoit oji ametist.
Ore nena shomito tomon o aare naa ilului tomon o aare, ore ake enkishomi naa lulu nabo eitobirieki, ore enkoitoi e ina anasa naa saabu nasila newang anaa kiook.
Neitu adol enkaji e Nkai teina anasa amu ore enkaji enye naa Olaitoriani Enkai Magilani, o Lkuoo le Ker.
Ore ina anasa nemeetayie tipat enkolong aashu olapa oitawang ninye amu enkitoo e Nkai ewang'an enye naa ilo Kuoo le Ker Oltaa lenye.
Naa ina wang'an enye epuoyie iloreren ore ilaiguanak neyau enkitoo enye atua ninye.
Nemeikeni aekata inchomito enyena dama nemeetae enkewarie teine.
Naa keyau ninche atua ina anasa enkitoo o enkanyit oo loreren.
Kake mejing entoki hoo nabo naiduruk atua ninye aashu pooki ng'ae oas olminong aashu elejare, kake lelo ake ooigeroki inkarn enye tiatua embuku e mpuaan e ilo Kuoo le Ker.
Naaitoki olmalaika aitodol nanu olkeju le nkare e mpuaan owang anaa oltotoi orukunye aing'uaa olorika le nkitoo le Nkai olo Lkuoo le Ker.

Neruko aim empolos enkoitoi nalala e ina anasa. Ore sii too lkekuno pokira leilo keju netii ilo shani le mpuaan te nebo o mpukunot tomon o aare oo lng'anayio lenyena. Neiu ake to lapa lelo ng'anayio lenyena; ore imbenek e ilo shani naa ninche naaishiunye iloreren.
Nemeitokini aekata aata hoo toki nadiaa, kake ilo orika le nkitoo le Nkai o lo Lkuoo le Ker, ninche kenya ootii atua ina anasa, naa keserem ninye isinkan lenyena;
naa Kedol ninche enkomom enye, ore inkarn enye netii ilpurai loo nkomomi enye.
Nemeitokini ai kata aata enkewarie nemeetayie ninche tipat ewang'an o ltaa aashu ene nkolong, amu Olaitoriani Enkai oaku ewang'an, naa keitoreisho ninche intarasi ontarasi.

Naajoki olmalaika nanu, “Keisiligayu nesipa kulo rorei. Naa Olaitoriani Enkai o nkiyang'eta oo loibonok le Nkai nairriwua olmalaika lenye meitoduaa isinkan lenyena nena nemeeta nchere pee eitu epuonu aasieku.
Naa toning'o kalotu asieku.” Emayiana ilo oibung ororei le naibon e na buku.
Nanu Yohana ilo otoning'o nadol kuna baa. Ore ake pee aning nadol ninche, nabatata too nkejek e ilo malaika laaitoduaa ninche aserem ninye.
Kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, “Mintoki aiko neijia! Kara nanu osinka te nebo iyie o lalashera linono lelo oibonok le Nkai, o lelo ooibung irorei le na buku. Enkai teserema.”
Naajoki ninye nanu, “Minuk irorei le naibon ena buku, amu etinyikua enkata.
Inchoo olarruoni eton aas enkarruoisho, nchoo oloiduruk eton eiduruk, nchoo osupat eton aas isupati. Neton osinyati aa sinyati.”
“Ng'ura, kalotu asieku naata olekoisiaayio lai te nebo nanu, pee alaaki pooki ng'ae anaa anataasa ninye.
Kara nanu Alfa o Omega, ole dukuya o le siadi, enkiterunoto o enkiting'oto.”
Emayiana lelo ooisuj ilkilani lenye pee etum esipata nabaikinye ilo shani le mpuaan netum sii aaima inchomito e ina anasa.
Auluo etii ildiein, o lasakutok, o loololoito, o looitayu iloikop, o looserem inkitanyaanyukot, o pooki tung'ani onyor elejare nelejisho.
“Nanu Yesu laairriwaka iyie olmalaika lai meeu enitii, ayau ena shakenisho te nkaraki sirito, nanu entonai e ishoi e Daudi, olakira owang le Nkakenya.”
Ejo enkiyang'et o ina siankiki narikori. “Wou!” Nchoo ilo oning ejo, “Wou!” Nchoo ilo oata enkure, elotu, nchoo ilo oyieu eng'amu enkare e mpuaan metii enkinyiang'a.
Aikok pooki ng'ae oning irorei le naibon ena buku: te neponaa ake oltung'ani, neponiki sii ninye Enkai lelo meita ootolimuoki tiatua ena buku.
Ore pooki ng'ae oiwuang'ie tiatua ilo irorei le naibon ena buku, neiwuang'ie Enkai erubata enye tiatua ilo shani le mpuaan tiatua ina anasa sinyati, nalimuno imbaa enye tiatua ena buku.
Ore ilo oishakenoki kuna baa, “Ejo kalotu asieku!” Eesai. Wou, Olaitoriani Yesu!
Metaa empiris o Laitoriani Yesu te nebo isinyat pooki. Eesai.
